TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_SWIFT_000_001: Yours is a welcome face, . I have a task for which one of your impeccable record would be well suited. Though perhaps “campaign” would be a more fitting description, given the sheer commitment this mission demands.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_SWIFT_000_002: As you are well aware, the inhabitants of Thanalan have long suffered the hostilities of the Amalj'aa.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_SWIFT_000_003: The lizardmen had been quiet for a time, chastened by your victory over the primal Ifrit. But once again the beastmen stir.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_SWIFT_000_004: There has been a resurgence in kidnappings, and in greater numbers than before. Matters have grown so far out of hand that the local garrisons have petitioned us for reinforcements. That is why I wish you to lead an extended action against the Amalj'aa, and put a stop to these raids.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_SWIFT_000_005: Report to Commander Gisilbehrt, head of security in Little Ala Mhigo, and he will brief you on the details of your duty.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_GISILBEHRT_000_010: Commander Swift said he'd assigned someone to assist with our growing beastman problem. Glad to see the urgency of our situation is being taken seriously.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_GISILBEHRT_000_011: Now, as I'm sure the commander explained, the Amalj'aa activity in the region has grown almost frenzied. Seems like the lizardmen are determined to carry off every peddler and traveler that tries to pass through southern Thanalan.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_GISILBEHRT_000_012: And I'm not speaking of furtive, nighttime raids here─the bastards're striking in full daylight, even against escorted merchant caravans.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_GISILBEHRT_000_013: We've heard reports of raids as far south as the Sagolii Desert, so it's not a simple matter of increasing patrols on the roads into Little Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_GISILBEHRT_000_014: We must mount a decisive response, and soon. The next time the Amalj'aa appear, I want you ready to send them howling back into the desert!
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_GISILBEHRT_000_015: Not long before you arrived, in fact, our scouts reported a merchant resting in plain view on one of the trade routes. Make haste to the location I've marked on your map, and see that the fool isn't taken by a raiding party.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_GISILBEHRT_100_016: If that merchant refuses to move along, the Amalj'aa are sure to take notice. Pray make haste to the location I've marked on your map and keep an eye out for raiders.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_MERCHANTA_000_050: What is it, adventurer? I'm not setting up shop here, I simply stopped to give the birds a bit of a r─ Amalj'aa raiders, you say? Kidnapping merchants!? I don't suppose you'd consider waiting around until I've got my chocobos back in the traces, would you?
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_MERCHANTA_000_051:
Thank you for not abandoning me to those savages!
...Is it not unusual for Amalj'aa to fight amongst themselves? I suppose even the beastmen must have squabbles.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_HAMUJIGAH_000_020: (-Ash-smeared Amalj'aa-)Overconfident fools! You think your raids here go unnoticed?
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_AMALJAAENEMY_000_02: (-Amalj'aa Raider-)What treachery is this!? You...you are of the Brotherhood of Ash!?
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_HAMUJIGAH_000_022: (-Ash-smeared Amalj'aa-)We are. Though we number but few, we shall be your death this day!
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_AMALJAAENEMY_000_02: (-Amalj'aa Raider-)Traitorous heathens! Your victory will come at a price!
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_LLOONGAH_000_025: (-Masked Miqo'te-)Attacking when the enemy's back is turned? Your ancestors would turn in their graves!
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_HAMUJIGAH_000_026: (-Ash-smeared Amalj'aa-)A soldier's life is one of peril. And the first rule of war is to understand the mind of your enemy, as well as your own.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_HAMUJIGAH_000_027: (-Ash-smeared Amalj'aa-)Your presence is noted here, adventurer. But this is our battle─you need not become involved!
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_HAMUJIGAH_000_028: I am Hamujj Gah, and I lead the Brotherhood of Ash. We are what remain now that the all-consuming flames have reduced the rest of my people to unthinking zealots.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_HAMUJIGAH_000_029: You interest me, child of Eorzea─be it fortune or fate, I would not ignore the forces that sought to bring us together. I extend to you an invitation to join us at the Ring of Ash.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_HAMUJIGAH_000_030: Welcome to the Ring of Ash, adventurer. This place serves as home for our humble gathering of soldiers.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_HAMUJIGAH_000_031: My brothers and I ever seek to hone our martial prowess, and honor the blood of our ancestors. We keep to the old ways, of the desert nomad and of the warrior. To those who are worthy, we show the proper respect regardless of origin.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_HAMUJIGAH_000_032: <sniff> Your aura...it carries the reek of brimstone. Could you be one of the champions said to have laid low the Lord of the Inferno?
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_HAMUJIGAH_000_033: Then I would have you understand the curse that has befallen our fanatic brethren.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_HAMUJIGAH_000_034: They have forgotten the code that governs our people, the glory that comes with a warrior's death. They spirit away the weak and the feeble, and offer them up in exchange for the barbed blessings of a hoary god.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_HAMUJIGAH_000_035: Day after day, I witness the shameful acts of my kin. The honor of the Amalj'aa is a faded, paltry thing, no longer driven by the righteous fortunes of battle.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_HAMUJIGAH_000_036: It is these kidnappings that most stoke the flames of my fury. Why, the victims often bear no arms at all! What triumph can be found in such cowardly attacks?
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_HAMUJIGAH_000_037: We are hunters, my brothers and I, and the fallen Amalj'aa who huddle in Zanr'ak our prey. If you share my outrage, then I bid you join us in our kin war!
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_LLOONGAH_000_038: (-???-)No, I will not accept this pretender!
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_LLOONGAH_000_039: (-Masked Miqo'te-)You claim to be one of the heroes that felled Ifrit? I've cut down a dozen men who boasted that feat. More likely you slew a guttering fire sprite and convinced yourself it was the king of the seventh hell!
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_HAMUJIGAH_000_040: I did not ask for your counsel, Loonh Gah. I, and I alone, make this decision for the Brotherhood.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_LLOONGAH_000_041: Hmph. Then you better not stray into the path of my arrows, adventurer. We have too many enemies for me to waste ammunition on puffed-up “heroes” like you!
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_HAMUJIGAH_000_042: Forgive this interruption. I shall vouch for the authenticity of your claim. Only one who has faced and defeated Ifrit could have the scent that you do.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_HAMUJIGAH_100_042: Past glories, however, will not impress my soldiers. Prove yourself through your actions, and you might find your reception here improved.
TEXT_BANAMA001_01217_HAMUJIGAH_000_043: Our foes are the Amalj'aa of Zanr'ak! We shall break the fangs that feast on the helpless! Our target is clear, and our resolve unshakable!
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_HAMUJIGAH_000_001: We, the Amalj'aa, were once simple nomads who roamed the vast plains of Paglth'an. If any sought to impede our path, we relished the challenge to our skill at arms.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_HAMUJIGAH_000_002: For as long as our people have existed, it has been the tradition for aging warriors to make the pilgrimage to the holy land of Zanr'ak, and there confront the specter of death. It is an honor to cast one's time-tempered soul into the sacred flames, and return one's body to ash.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_HAMUJIGAH_000_003: But these craven whelps of Zahar'ak quaver before death's inevitability─they seek not to fortify their spirits, instead groveling before a deity for the strength they do not deserve.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_HAMUJIGAH_000_004: I have not the words to express my disgust for the manner of this groveling, this...subjugation of the meek by contemptuous weaklings. The path to true greatness lies only in conquering those greater than oneself, and in the doing attaining mastery over one's own failings.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_AMALJAAFRIEND_000_0: Warleader, there is trouble! The Flamefangs have scented fresh prey! We must sound the call to arms!
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_HAMUJIGAH_000_006:
It seems you shall have the chance to prove your talents, adventurer. Show the Brotherhood your unbending steel!
...Loonh Gah!
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_HAMUJIGAH_000_008: This warrior is known by the name Loonh Gah. Though her form may be Miqo'te, her soul harbors a raging blaze to match that of any Amalj'aa soldier. We of the Brotherhood know only the struggle for martial perfection. Tribe, clan, gender─these details matter not.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_HAMUJIGAH_000_009: Loonh Gah, you will accompany our newest ally into battle.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_LLOONGAH_000_010: What!? Why choose me for this task? Surely, there are others more fitting! Some hatchling in training, perhaps?
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_HAMUJIGAH_000_011: Enough! I grow weary of your insolence! Shall I have my blade answer your mewling?
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_LLOONGAH_000_012: ...No, Warleader. It shall be as you command.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_LLOONGAH_000_013: Now we shall see you for the charlatan you are! Meet me at this spot on your map. I pray your screams are short-lived.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_MERCHANT_000_020: Oh gods, oh gods, save me! Save meee!
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_LLOONGAH_000_021: Where have you been!? I've already felled the forward scout!
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_LLOONGAH_000_022: See the markings? We most certainly face Flamefangs. Take up your position and keep your weapon handy─the rest will soon be upon us!
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_MERCHANT_000_031: Phew, you made short work of those raiders. I don't know who you are or where you came from, but you have my thanks.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_MERCHANT_000_032: I'd heard the Amalj'aa were snatching folk from the trade routes again, but I thought that was just my rivals trying to scare me out of business. After all, the roads had been safe enough until now.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_MERCHANT_000_033: I'll have to hire a guard or two for the next time I pass through here. Damn beastmen. Sellsword wages do so eat into a man's profits...
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_LLOONGAH_000_034: Hmph, I expected you to die here. Come now, we return to the Ring of Ash!
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_LLOONGAH_000_041: You are no hatchling in battle─that much is obvious. But do not think me so easily impressed! There is yet the question of your resolve!
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_LLOONGAH_000_042: The Brotherhood of Ash is a conclave of elite warriors. Under the command of Hamujj Gah, we wage a war of attrition against the zealots of Zanr'ak.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_LLOONGAH_000_043: Those fallen Amalj'aa build altars and pitch camps wherever they please, convincing themselves they are the masters of the holy land. It must feel brave indeed to challenge none but the weak and undefended.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_LLOONGAH_000_044: Recall the raiders you but recently faced. They were members of the Flamefangs─a faction among the Zanr'ak Amalj'aa that, more than any other, delights in kidnappings. Naturally, they also draw the most ire of the Brotherhood.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_LLOONGAH_000_045: It is our mission to see their ambitions ground into dust and their leaders slain! Indeed, it is the duty of all who would call themselves true Amalj'aa warriors.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_LLOONGAH_000_046: And now, a warning: do not seek to meddle too deeply in our affairs. This war is not some distraction to be dabbled in by outsiders such as you!
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_LLOONGAH_000_047: Hm? You think my words unconvincing? You think that I, too, am no Amalj'aa? To the seven hells with what you think!
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_LLOONGAH_000_048: Go, make your report to Hamujj Gah before he has to find himself a new pet adventurer!
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_HAMUJIGAH_000_050: Honored ally, news of your battle has spread through the camp. By all accounts, you fought with uncanny ability. None may now doubt that yours was the hand that slew a raging god.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_HAMUJIGAH_000_051: If our cause rings true in your heart, then I would further welcome your aid. Will you unleash your fury alongside the soldiers of the Brotherhood?
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_SYSYTEM_Q1_000_1: Unleash your fury alongside the Brotherhood?
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_SYSYTEM_A1_000_1: I will! Let the zealots fear our coming!
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_SYSYTEM_A2_000_2: I cannot join my cause to yours...
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_HAMUJIGAH_000_052: Well said! Yours is a true warrior's heart!
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_HAMUJIGAH_000_053: Though we differ in many ways, the foe that we would topple is the same. Let us vow death to the Flamefangs! Theirs is a fire that cannot be suffered to burn!
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_HAMUJIGAH_000_054: I am saddened by this outcome. But I understand that you have your own path to walk. Though we part ways in this moment, know that my offer remains unchanged.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_SYSTEM_200_000: You have achieved Neutral reputation with the Brotherhood of Ash.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_SYSTEM_200_001: Amalj'aa society quests are now available from Fibubb Gah at the Ring of Ash.
TEXT_BANAMA002_01218_SYSTEM_200_002: Furthermore, you may now purchase wares from the Brotherhood of Ash vendor.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_HAMUJIGAH_000_001: Do you know of Forgotten Springs, the Miqo'te settlement found to the south in the Sagolii Desert?
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_HAMUJIGAH_000_002: We have just received urgent word from Loonh Gah. She reports that a hunting party from the U tribe village was ambushed by a sizable Amalj'aa force.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_HAMUJIGAH_000_003: Those that were not massacred outright were dragged away by the raiders. They have likely already been tempered. Loonh Gah mentions, however, that one of the Miqo'te was nimble enough to evade capture and flee into hiding.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_HAMUJIGAH_000_004: We have no alliance with the U tribespeople. But we cannot close our eyes to an act perpetrated by the very foe we so greatly despise. For the chance to strike a blow at our enemy, we will go to war for Forgotten Springs.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_HAMUJIGAH_000_005: Be my spear, honored ally, and I shall hurl you into the midst of Zanr'ak. Loonh Gah awaits reinforcements to the southeast. Join your strength to hers, and do what must be done to rescue this lone, courageous Miqo'te ranger.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_LLOONGAH_000_011: Ugh, gods be good! When I requested reinforcements, I did not expect the warleader to send you!
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_LLOONGAH_000_012: And, just as before, you are too slow to respond! While I sat here, grinding my teeth in frustration, I watched as the Flamefangs discovered the ranger's hiding spot and hauled her off to their encampment.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_LLOONGAH_000_013: The encampment is their forward base, and, as such, the place is awash with alert and wary soldiers. The two of us would fare poorly against such numbers.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_LLOONGAH_000_014: ...Without a cunning plan, that is. You, my eager outsider, will have the use of my mount to sow a trail of chaos amongst their ranks.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_LLOONGAH_000_015: Listen carefully. The Amalj'aa like to stockpile the oil that they use to light their watchfires and such. Seek out the barrels, and tap the drake's head─that is the command for him to spit a gout of flame.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_LLOONGAH_000_016: The resulting explosions should be enough of a distraction for me to slip in and free the captured Miqo'te. Once you've freed yourself of angry Amalj'aa, meet us beyond the edge of the camp where the desert begins.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_LLOONGAH_000_021: Are you slow of mind as well as of foot? Get back on the drake and incinerate those barrels!
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_MIQOTEFEMALE_001_02:
Thank you, I was certain my time had come...
The lizardmen fell upon us so swiftly, we had not the time to react. Your companion, the one who freed me, she seems so very familiar...
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_LLOONGAH_000_031: Even riding a drake, you still somehow managed to arrive last. I thought perhaps you had been caught in an explosion and burned to a crisp. A pleasant thought, but apparently not the case.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_MIQOTEFEMALE_000_03: (-U'napa-)U'loonh!? Could that really be you? We had thought you long perished...
(-U'napa-)No, I am sure of it! Your voice is unmistakable! I recall the many days we spent laughing and chatting in the springs!
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_LLOONGAH_000_035: I don't know you or your damnable springs. I am Loonh Gah, a warrior of the Brotherhood of Ash.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_LLOONGAH_000_036: My people are the Amalj'aa, proud and strong. You have the wrong Miqo'te.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_LLOONGAH_000_037: I am heading back to camp. See this hunter safely home before you return to the Ring of Ash.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_MIQOTEFEMALE_001_11: No escort will be necessary. I am a hunter of the U tribe─if I cannot cross the sands alone, I do not deserve to return at all.
...I would, however, have you visit the Springs in any case, adventurer. There is more to your friend─to U'loonh─that you should know.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_MIQOTEFEMALE_000_04: We meet again, adventurer. I needed to tell you that your companion is, without a doubt, the little Loonh I used to know. There must be some pressing reason for her subterfuge.
Many of our tribe were close with U'loonh─they may help you to understand why U'loonh hides behind that mask, and how you might best help her.
Speak with the huntresses around the Springs. They may help you to understand why U'loonh hides behind that mask, and what─if anything─can be done to help her.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_MIQOTEA_000_051: U'loonh? Of course I knew her─she was my blood sister. We were both daughters of the former nunh, though our mothers were not the same.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_MIQOTEA_000_052: You find my choice of tense confusing? She is dead, stranger. Slain alongside her mother more than five years ago. I did not witness the incident myself, but I will never forget the sudden pain of their loss...
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_MIQOTEA_000_053: Five long years, yet my memories of her remain so clear...
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_MIQOTEB_000_061: It is not uncommon to hear of skirmishes between our people and the Amalj'aa.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_MIQOTEB_000_062: The lizardmen do not respect our territory, and they interfere with our hunts. The desert suffers for their presence.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_MIQOTEA_000_063: We of the U tribe do not hold favorable relations with the Amalj'aa. They are a dangerous nuisance, and the Sagolii would be better for their absence.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_MIQOTEC_000_071:
It is said that a hunting party was set upon by the Amalj'aa. Many of my kin have not returned from the sands...
Must the tragedies of the past be so faithfully repeated?
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_MIQOTEA_000_073: You have heard of the party of hunters that was slaughtered at the hands of the lizardmen? Though we often clash with the Amalj'aa, there hasn't been an incident on this scale for more than half a decade...
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_MIQOTED_000_081: U'loonh? Yes, I remember the name. She was a quiet girl, too timid to even slap at the biting desert flies. The lizardmen took her away from us, and for that I shall never forgive them.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_MIQOTEA_000_082: Were little Loonh alive today, what a beautiful sleek huntress she might be.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_LLOONGAH_000_091: You are late. I might have thought you delayed by a Wellwick worm, but the cloying pity in your eyes tells the tale. Do they mourn for me in Forgotten Springs? Hmph.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_LLOONGAH_000_092: Look at me, adventurer. This is an Amalj'aa battlemask, given to me by the warleader himself. It is worn only by those who have chosen the path of the warrior.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_LLOONGAH_000_093: You likely heard stories from the rangers, of how I was taken or killed during an Amalj'aa raid all those years ago. They are right...and they are wrong. I know not how I survived the attack, but it was Hamujj Gah who found me as I stumbled through the desert, barely conscious and badly wounded.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_LLOONGAH_000_094: He gazed down upon my battered face, and gave me a simple choice: “Linger here and die, or come with me and fight.”
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_LLOONGAH_000_095: It was then that I made the decision to discard my past─my family, my tribe, my very identity. I was reborn into the Brotherhood of Ash, existing for no other purpose but to feed the fires of my vengeance.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_LLOONGAH_000_096: This mask is a symbol of my resolve; it represents my transformation into an Amalj'aa soldier, strong and proud.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_LLOONGAH_000_097: Hmph. I tell you this not to justify my deceit, but to dam the flood of your foolish questions before it begins. Now, stow your unwanted sympathy, and make your report to the warleader!
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_HAMUJIGAH_000_101: Honored ally, with your continued aid, the Brotherhood of Ash will rekindle the glory of our past.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_HAMUJIGAH_000_102: As once did our ancestors, we shall forge of steel our bodies and spirits, and greet death with honor. To no gods will we beg, nor against the meek raise arms.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_HAMUJIGAH_000_103: We are warriors, walkers of the path of righteous battle. We do not kneel to claim our strength. Live by these words, and your soul, too, shall burn as brightly!
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_SYSTEM_200_000: You have achieved Recognized reputation with the Brotherhood of Ash.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_SYSTEM_200_001: New Amalj'aa society daily quests are now available from Narujj Boh at the Ring of Ash.
TEXT_BANAMA003_01219_SYSTEM_200_002: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from the Brotherhood of Ash vendor.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_HAMUJIGAH_000_001: Fortune is with us, honored ally. A Brotherhood scout has chanced upon a convocation of our hated foe, the Flamefangs, and surreptitiously learned of their insidious scheming. They plan to pull the strings of their tempered puppets, and orchestrate another kidnapping raid.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_HAMUJIGAH_000_002: It is the intelligence provided by these tempered spies that affords the Flamefangs such a wealth of victims. This cannot be allowed to continue! We must gouge out their hidden eyes, and blind them to the movements of their prey!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_HAMUJIGAH_000_003: You are no stranger to Little Ala Mhigo, I trust? Though it appears a haven for travelers and merchants, it is naught but a rotting corpse riddled with flame-addled maggots.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_HAMUJIGAH_000_004: We are fortunate, then, that you may walk among them unchallenged. Go to Little Ala Mhigo, honored ally, and do that which our Amalj'aa soldiers cannot: root out the tempered, and make of it a haven in truth.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_GISILBEHRT_000_021: ...What's this? You claim Little Ala Mhigo has been infiltrated by tempered agents?
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_GISILBEHRT_000_022: I wish I could refute you, but I have had my suspicions... It explains how the Amalj'aa are able to set such well-timed ambushes. With spies inside the settlement, 'twould be an easy feat to learn the schedules of visiting merchants and the like.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_FMUMETSUTAIB_000_02: Commander, sir! We've just received reports of Amalj'aa kidnappers attacking a caravan of travelers! They're dragging their captives off into Zanr'ak even as we speak!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_GISILBEHRT_000_024: Again!? Damn those blasted lizards! This is the fifth time this moon!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_GISILBEHRT_100_024:
<sigh> Most of my troops are still recovering from the last engagement...
Sergeant, I need you to assemble a squad and chase down those kidnappers. Take whoever can swing a blade!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_GISILBEHRT_000_025: Care to lend a hand, adventurer? I've naught but raw recruits for this mission, and your presence may make all the difference. Pray join my soldiers out in the field as soon as you can.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_GISILBEHRT_000_026: I've marked the destination of my troops on your map. Swiftly now! Go crack some beastman skulls!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_FMUMETSUTAIA_000_03: Who are─ Ah, Gisilbehrt sent an adventurer to wipe our arses, did he? Well, you're too late! With these soldiers down, his entire unit is in tatters!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_FMUMETSUTAIA_100_03: Bwahahaha! All it took was the right word in the right ear, and away they scrambled. It was like leading lame phurbles to slaughter!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_FMUMETSUTAIB_000_03: (-Flame Sergeant-)You... You're one of the newer recruits... You swore an oath to the Immortal Flames!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_FMUMETSUTAIA_100_03: An oath? Pah, my loyalty belongs to none but Lord Ifrit Himself. And the Flamefangs are generous to those who serve well.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_FMUMETSUTAIA_000_03: The Immortal Flames of Little Ala Mhigo are now naught but the walking wounded─the Amalj'aa will be able to raid with abandon! And the soldiers we've captured this day will make fine additions to the Lord of the Inferno's army!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_FMUMETSUTAIA_001_03: Hm? You're still here? You think to punish me? Ahahaha, that's rich!

I have allies lingering nearby. And very soon, the main company of the Flamefangs will be arriving to take possession of the “spoils.” If you lay a hand on me, you'll be making some very powerful enemies!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_FMUMETSUTAIA_100_03:
You─ You can't be serious!
Flamefangs! To me!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_FMUMETSUTAIA_100_04: H-How did you...? Who are you!?
Th-This was not supposed to h-happen! They were meant to detain you until the main company arrived!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_FMUMETSUTAIA_000_04: Nooo! You stay away from me!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_LLOONGAH_000_043: ! What in the seven hells is going on here!?
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_ZAGOZZTHE_000_044: (-Barbarous Amalj'aa-)Gahaha! Our net has caught some rare fish, indeed.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_ZAGOZZTHE_000_045: (-Barbarous Amalj'aa-)The Brotherhood of Ash. They shame the Amalj'aa with their petulant refusal to submit to Lord Ifrit's cleansing fire.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_ZAGOZZTHE_000_046: (-Barbarous Amalj'aa-)They are naught but ghosts of a fading past─so lacking in strength they resort to consorting with the slave races.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_ZAGOZZTHE_000_048: And I know of you as well...Loonh Gah. Such an intriguing costume you wear! Have you enlisted in the army of my people?
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_LLOONGAH_000_049: Enough games, lizardman! What have you done with the captives!?
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_ZAGOZZTHE_000_050: Those that proved...intractable...were slaughtered. The Flamefangs do not countenance the rebellion of cattle. The rest are already far beyond your reach─unless, of course, you intend to assault Zahar'ak itself.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_ZAGOZZTHE_000_051: Hahaha... You “civilized” people make such endearing squawks and squeals as your hot blood sizzles on the desert sands. Though years have passed, I yet remember your mother and her bleating cries for mercy!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_LLOONGAH_000_053:
Ngh! Ugh...
I've never felt...such heat...
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_ZAGOZZTHE_000_054: Gahahaha! Is this the extent of the resistance I am to face? Is this the vaunted strength and resolve of the Brotherhood? I wield the unquenchable flames of Lord Ifrit Himself, and you seek to extinguish them with a thimbleful of spit!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_ZAGOZZTHE_000_055: Return to Hamujj Gah and tell him this: this world has no use for spent ashes. He and his followers shall be scattered before the searing winds of Zanr'ak's glorious ascension!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_FMUMETSUTAIA_000_05:
<pant> <pant> <pant> ...Leave me...
I'm done for... Please...make the report...to Commander Gisilbehrt...
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_GISILBEHRT_001_060: Gods, , I can scarce believe it! A tempered spy within our own ranks!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_GISILBEHRT_001_061: My men, killed or taken... The lizardmen wanted more than merchants: they were after the Immortal Flames from the very beginning! And I all but bloody served them up on a silver platter!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_GISILBEHRT_001_062: I...I beg of you, adventurer: save the soldiers that yet live from a fate worse than death. Meanwhile, I'll see what I can do to salvage the tatters of my command...
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_HAMUJIGAH_000_061: I thank you for your report, honored ally. This Zagozz Teh you encountered is the fetid maw that drives the Flamefangs. His sole purpose is to bolster the numbers of tempered.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_HAMUJIGAH_000_062: Each new fire-seared slave feeds the inferno of their god's powers, and, in turn, the flames of Ifrit's altars bless the zealots of Zanr'ak with unholy strength.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_HAMUJIGAH_000_063: The miserable sparks of their ambition must be stamped out! Go, honored ally, and break the captives free of their cages. Slay the gaolers in the encampment to liberate the keys!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_HAMUJIGAH_000_071: You have dealt our foe a crippling blow, mighty ally. My warrior's blood sings at the thought of the confusion and devastation you have brought to Zahar'ak.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_YADOVVGAH_000_072: (-???-)Loonh Gah, be still! What enrages you so?
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_LLOONGAH_000_073: You know damn well what! That was the animal that savaged my mother! I'll tear out his heart and string him up by his entrails!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_HAMUJIGAH_000_074: Know yourself, young warrior. You are not yet ready to face the likes of Zagozz Teh. Should you confront your enemy now, you will die a whimpering cur's death.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_LLOONGAH_000_075: What are you saying, Warleader!? Is it...is it because I am Miqo'te? Will I forever be too weak to match Amalj'aa strength!?
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_HAMUJIGAH_000_076: Foolish child! I say only that you lack martial wisdom. You imagine slights where none exist!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_YADOVVGAH_000_077: Warleader! Loonh Gah's kin must be avenged! I shall fight at her side. Let us rouse the Brotherhood, and smash this Flamefang snake once and for all!
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_HAMUJIGAH_000_078: No. Against their assembled ranks we would but invite our own destruction. And our laws are clear.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_HAMUJIGAH_000_079: Loonh Gah, this is a blood vendetta. None may aid you in its resolution. Only through the glory of victory shall the shame of your defeat be expunged.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_HAMUJIGAH_000_080: If you've the spirit to rail and curse, then use it to build your strength. For strength is all that will aid you now.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_HAMUJIGAH_000_082: It is said that the drake will drop its own offspring into a ravine to watch it claw its way up. So it is with the Amalj'aa.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_PRISONER_001: (-Freed Flame Recruit-)I didn't think... I had made my peace with the gods. My thanks.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_PRISONER_002: (-Freed Merchant-)You're freeing me? It was an Immortal Flame who captured me in the first place; I no longer know whom to trust...
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_PRISONER_003: (-Freed Ala Mhigan-)I lose my home to the Empire, and then my freedom to the beastmen? The gods must truly despise me.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_PRISONER_004: (-Freed Adventurer-)I was stretched out on me bedroll, gazin' up at the stars, when some bugger bashed me in the noggin. Next thing I know, I'm wakin' up in a cage. Say, ye happen to know the way to Little Ala Mhigo?
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_SYSTEM_200_000: You have achieved Friendly reputation with the Brotherhood of Ash.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_SYSTEM_200_001: New Amalj'aa society daily quests are now available from Yadovv Gah at the Ring of Ash.
TEXT_BANAMA004_01220_SYSTEM_200_002: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from the Brotherhood of Ash vendor.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_YADOVVGAH_000_001: Loonh Gah is gone! She had no duties that would take her from the camp this day.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_YADOVVGAH_000_002: I fear she rides for Zahar'ak, and her chance at Zagozz Teh's head! The warleader must be told!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_HAMUJIGAH_000_011: She is gone? The impatient whelp! Reckless action is not martial courage. To charge into battle without certainty of one's self or one's enemy is to court disaster.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_HAMUJIGAH_000_012: Loonh Gah is beyond our help now. This is her battle, and her battle alone. Amalj'aa law forbids intervention in such vendettas.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_HAMUJIGAH_000_013: If she wishes to perish in a blaze of false glory, then that is the path she has chosen. Loonh Gah's decisions define her as a warrior, and thus will end her tale.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_YADOVVGAH_000_020: Hamujj Gah will do nothing!? We have trained Loonh Gah since she was barely more than a hatchling! There must be something we─
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_YADOVVGAH_000_021: Honored ally! Though I risk bringing shame upon myself and the Brotherhood, I beg you hear my plea!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_YADOVVGAH_000_022: As an Amalj'aa, I am bound by our laws and customs...but you are not. Pray follow Loonh Gah into Zahar'ak and see she survives this madness!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_001_025: Where are you, Zagozz Teh? Your doom is come!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_001_026: Adventurer!? Why are you here? Did you follow me? I told you, I don't need─ Hmph. Since you are here, perhaps you can prove useful.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_001_027: There is a cage yet deeper within the stronghold. I thought that perhaps...it might be... Well, just free the prisoner, yes?
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_001_028: The key is held by Monabb Chah. He is the Flamefangs' second-in-command, and not to be underestimated! Zagozz Teh is mine, but you will have your share of the glory. Now, go!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONMOTHER_000_033: (-White-haired Miqo'te-)I know why you're here! Filthy kidnappers! You've come for my little Loonh, haven't you!?
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONMOTHER_000_034: (-White-haired Miqo'te-)Well, you can't have her! No one can have her! She's been promised to the Lord of the Inferno!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONMOTHER_000_036: (-White-haired Miqo'te-)Who is that? No! No, I know you people-snatchers and your dirty tricks! Now, get out before you scare my little Loonh! Out! Out, I said!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_ZAGOZZTHE_000_038: Gahahaha! There is naught quite as touching as the reunion betwixt mother and child. I can scarce contain my tears of bittersweet joy!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_000_039: Zagozz Teh! You'll pay for what you've done to her...and to me!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_ZAGOZZTHE_000_040: Some of the tempered, such as this one, are exposed overlong to the sacred flame. They become the walking witless, barely aware of their own existence!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_ZAGOZZTHE_000_041: Is Lord Ifrit's power not magnificent? Come, now. It is time you were purified in the raging blaze of His blessing!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_000_042: Come back and face me, coward!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_000_043: I go now to put an end to that monster's abominations once and for all. But if I'm to have any chance of victory, I will need you to first destroy Ifrit's beacons. Honor and pride, adventurer.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_ZAGOZZTHE_000_061: Gahahaha! You are as a lost kitten that has wandered into the drake's lair. Surrender this doomed vendetta. Submit to Ifrit's will...as your mother did before you!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_ZAGOZZTHE_000_064: Argh, the pain! How is this possible!? My spells are drawn from the searing furnace of Ifrit's might!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_000_065: Wrong. Your power was drawn from the beacons, and those altars of suffering are no more!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_000_066: Without your precious blessing, there's naught to protect you from the sting of my arrows!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_ZAGOZZTHE_000_067: M-Mercy! Mercy, I beg you! The will of our god is overwhelming! Spare my life, and I shall become your slave instead!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_000_068: Pitiful creature. If any bring shame to the Amalj'aa, Zagozz Teh, then it is you.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_000_069: Your power is broken and my vengeance complete─no more of my arrows need be stained by your coward's blood. Crawl back under your rock, lizard!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_HAMUJIGAH_000_073: You forsook all that is sacred to a true warrior of the Amalj'aa, Zagozz Teh. For your cowardice and cruelty, the only reward is death!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_HAMUJIGAH_000_074: I beheld the entire confrontation, Loonh Gah.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_HAMUJIGAH_000_075: You fought with honor, and with courage! Such was my proud exultation, the dagger flew unbid from my hand─how unfortunate, then, that Zagozz Teh stood in its path. It appears that perfect martial detachment yet eludes even me...
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_000_076: Were you watching, Mother? You have been avenged.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_HAMUJIGAH_000_081: With the Flamefangs defeated, the Amalj'aa within Zanr'ak will return to cowering behind their campfires.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_HAMUJIGAH_001_081: And though the embers of Ifrit's blessings yet smolder, we shall fight that fire with the flames we ourselves nurture─a strength born from within!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_HAMUJIGAH_000_082: But I need not speak to you of strength, for you, perhaps more than any, have neared the peak of perfection. You have earned the highest praise and deepest gratitude of my people.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_HAMUJIGAH_000_083: Even should our races clash in blood-drenched savagery, you, honored ally, will always be welcomed by the Brotherhood of Ash.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_000_084: I have seen my mother safely to Forgotten Springs.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_000_085: It is unheard of for tempered to ever recover from their primal-induced madness, but it is my hope that she will at least find a measure of peace in our old home...
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_000_086: Oh, and a word with you, adventurer.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_000_087: I questioned your resolve, and you have answered me as well as any Amalj'aa warrior would. You have my respect...
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_000_090: Well, this feels strange. I─ Why are you staring?
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_000_091: I cannot help the way I look! My brethren must think me hideous!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_HAMUJIGAH_000_092: The road calls you, honored ally!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_HAMUJIGAH_000_093: Though misfortune seeks to waylay us, let us not stray from the path of the strong!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_000_095: My thirst for vengeance is satisfied, but it is too late for me to leave the Brotherhood. I am too steeped in Amalj'aa custom, my skin too stained with ash.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_LLOONGAH_000_096: Fare you well, adventurer. May victory follow in your footsteps!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_HAMUJIGAH_000_097: Your deeds have been etched within the chambers of my soul, honored ally. Though the road might call you onwards, may the strength you have gained with the Brotherhood serve you well in the battles to come!
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_SWIFT_000_101: Commander Gisilbehrt submitted a detailed report, . It seems my decision to assign you this duty was the correct one.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_SWIFT_000_102: With the Amalj'aa fanatics thus quelled, Thanalan may enjoy a measure of peace for a time.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_SWIFT_000_103: And though we are never in short supply of beastman-related problems, I believe you've earned a respite from the chaos. Enjoy the rest while you may, .
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_SYSTEM_200_000: You have achieved Trusted reputation with the Brotherhood of Ash.
TEXT_BANAMA005_01221_SYSTEM_200_001: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from the Brotherhood of Ash vendor.
TEXT_BANAMA101_01222_FIBUBBGAH_000_001: The zealotry of Ifrit's devotees knows no bounds. They perpetrate all manner of foolish and honorless acts in the name of calling forth the Lord of the Inferno.
TEXT_BANAMA101_01222_FIBUBBGAH_000_002: It is fortunate, then, that our own counter-strategies are many and varied. We need only read the ashes to divine the most promising tactic, before marching off to do battle with our foes.
TEXT_BANAMA101_01222_FIBUBBGAH_000_003: Our divinations, however, require a goodly supply of iron tortoise shells. We also require a store of fire sprite cores, for no ordinary fire will otherwise burn hot enough to consume the natural armor of those shambling hills.
TEXT_BANAMA101_01222_FIBUBBGAH_000_004: Honored ally, would you aid the hunt for iron tortoises and wildfire sprites, and gather the materials for our rituals? These adversaries should prove sufficiently worthy to maintain your warrior's edge while you await more momentous engagements.
TEXT_BANAMA101_01222_FIBUBBGAH_000_011: Honored ally, would you aid the hunt for iron tortoises and wildfire sprites, and gather the materials for our rituals? These adversaries should prove sufficiently worthy to maintain your warrior's edge while you await more momentous engagements.
TEXT_BANAMA101_01222_FIBUBBGAH_000_021: Do you have the materials for our divinations?
TEXT_BANAMA101_01222_FIBUBBGAH_000_022: Yes, these treasures of Thanalan will be put to good use. Our mystics will be well pleased with your contributions.
TEXT_BANAMA101_01222_FIBUBBGAH_000_023: These prophetic rituals were once traditional among all Amalj'aa...but the old ways are being forgotten. Once the omens have been scried and our battle-path decided, we shall find further need for your assistance, adventurer.
TEXT_BANAMA102_01223_FIBUBBGAH_000_001: The shadows of Zahar'ak scouts fall upon the boundaries of the Ring of Ash. Though they probe for a weakness in our defense, they will find that the wall of the Brotherhood stands solid against their incursions.
TEXT_BANAMA102_01223_FIBUBBGAH_000_002: We shall teach these incautious fools what swift and final judgment awaits any who seek to seize the lizard's tail!
TEXT_BANAMA102_01223_FIBUBBGAH_000_003: Go forth, honored ally, and cut short the reconnaissance efforts of the Amalj'aa thaumaturges and lancers that you find.
TEXT_BANAMA102_01223_FIBUBBGAH_000_004: When their brethren spy the carcasses strewn across the approaches to Zanr'ak, they shall know that the borders of the Brotherhood are not to be lightly tested.
TEXT_BANAMA102_01223_FIBUBBGAH_000_011: The Zahar'ak Amalj'aa test the borders of our domain. Slay their scouts─the thaumaturges and the lancers─and teach them what awaits those who seek to seize the lizard's tail.
TEXT_BANAMA102_01223_FIBUBBGAH_000_021: Your measured violence has been witnessed, honored ally. Already, the Zahar'ak cravens eye the horizon with mounting fear.
TEXT_BANAMA102_01223_FIBUBBGAH_000_022: But we will not seek to harry them too far─that may serve to stiffen their resolve. No, first we allow the terror to take root and grow...
TEXT_BANAMA103_01224_FIBUBBGAH_000_001: We of the Brotherhood of Ash are proud soldiers all. Yet even the greatest soldier can starve without sustenance, or be crippled by injury.
TEXT_BANAMA103_01224_FIBUBBGAH_000_002: We bear our battle wounds as badges of honor, but a festering cut can take one's life as surely as the blade of one's foe. A true warrior neglects not the arts of healing.
TEXT_BANAMA103_01224_FIBUBBGAH_000_003: My task for you, honored ally, is simple yet needful: gather from the desert plants of Zanr'ak the rejuvenating sap we use to salve our hurts.
TEXT_BANAMA103_01224_FIBUBBGAH_000_004: Though our foes make no use of such remedies, they will nevertheless be loath to relinquish them to you. Have a care you do not sustain such injuries that you fail to return!
TEXT_BANAMA103_01224_FIBUBBGAH_000_011: Gather the clear sap of the Zanr'ak desert plants, and aid us in keeping our warriors hale.
TEXT_BANAMA103_01224_FIBUBBGAH_000_021: Welcome, honored ally. Have you the sap we require?
TEXT_BANAMA103_01224_FIBUBBGAH_000_022: Yes, this will allow our wounded to return to the front lines of battle where a glorious death awaits. No true warrior wishes to wither away on a sickbed...
TEXT_BANAMA104_01225_FIBUBBGAH_000_001: For we Amalj'aa, Zanr'ak is more than merely dust and rock─it is sacred ground. The preservation of this holy land is our duty and our privilege.
TEXT_BANAMA104_01225_FIBUBBGAH_000_002: One of the greatest threats to its delicate balance are the voracious bronze tortoises. These insatiable creatures wander as their appetite leads them, feeding without surcease. Slaughtering them brings little respite, for they multiply at a seemingly unnatural pace.
TEXT_BANAMA104_01225_FIBUBBGAH_000_003: No, honored ally, I would have you dispatch their matriarch─the mighty Lacovie. It is she that spawns her shell-backed children in such uncontrollable numbers.
TEXT_BANAMA104_01225_FIBUBBGAH_000_004: To draw out the mother, however, you must first endanger her offspring. Slay the lesser tortoises, and the matriarch will soon appear. With her crushing weight and snapping jaws, you will find Lacovie a worthy adversary.
TEXT_BANAMA104_01225_FIBUBBGAH_000_011: Slay the bronze tortoises that ravage Zanr'ak, and Lacovie will come seeking vengeance. May glory and honor guide your arm.
TEXT_BANAMA104_01225_FIBUBBGAH_000_021: With the death of Lacovie, you have slain a great threat to our holy land. It should be many years before another tortoise attains her size and claims the matriarch's name.
TEXT_BANAMA104_01225_FIBUBBGAH_000_022: But we must not grow complacent. The sky-fires that seared the realm have shaken the foundations of all that we knew to be true...
TEXT_BANAMA104_01225_TORTOISE_BALLOON_00: Lacovie has come to avenge her offspring!
TEXT_BANAMA105_01226_FIBUBBGAH_000_001: The honorless snakes of Zahar'ak care naught for the righteous glories of battle. They would sooner injure their foes with cowardly traps than risk an equal confrontation.
TEXT_BANAMA105_01226_FIBUBBGAH_000_002: The traps of which I speak often make use of barrels stuffed with firesand─a substance which, when ignited in sufficient quantities, can launch a merchant's wagon two full spear-lengths into the air. The victims of such shameful tactics are left dazed and vulnerable, if not slain outright.
TEXT_BANAMA105_01226_FIBUBBGAH_000_003: Does your blood not seethe at the thought? Then I task you with removing the source of this ignominy─the firesand itself. But I would not have you risk life and limb in its destruction.
TEXT_BANAMA105_01226_FIBUBBGAH_000_004: By the bridge to the west of here, one of our brethren awaits you. He is a tamer of drakes, and has promised to lend you a creature from his stables to aid you in your noble efforts.
TEXT_BANAMA105_01226_MOUNTAMALJAA_000_01: My brother, Fibubb Gah, has told me of his plan. You will have command of one of my scaly children and the fiery destruction she breathes. Climb onto her back, honored ally, and direct her to the barrels you wish to incinerate.
TEXT_BANAMA105_01226_FIBUBBGAH_000_021: The barrels of firesand must be destroyed. Speak with the drake whisperer, and he will provide you with the means with which to safely dispose of your targets.
TEXT_BANAMA105_01226_MOUNTAMALJAA_000_02: Should you need to dismount, the drake will return here to me. I will hold her in readiness until you are prepared to continue your mission. Now go, and bring ravenous fire to the servants of the flame.
TEXT_BANAMA105_01226_FIBUBBGAH_000_031: The echoing reports of exploding barrels were as triumphant cries to my ears. I am afraid, however, that the loss of the firesand will simply spur our enemy into ever more shameless acts of cowardice. We must stand ready!
TEXT_BANAMA106_01227_FIBUBBGAH_000_001: Tell me, honored ally, have you seen the ominous beacons the zealots of Zahar'ak light across the land? These unnatural flames are talismans of foul sorcery that amplify the blessings of the Lord of the Inferno.
TEXT_BANAMA106_01227_FIBUBBGAH_000_002: These symbols of servitude, of groveling weakness, cannot be allowed to taint the sacred domain of Zanr'ak a moment longer!
TEXT_BANAMA106_01227_FIBUBBGAH_000_003: If you truly wish to stand with us against our honorless kin, then I would ask your aid in extinguishing the beacons. Take with you this ash─it has been ritually prepared to fully smother the noxious fires of our foe.
TEXT_BANAMA106_01227_FIBUBBGAH_000_004: Be warned, however, that the beacons will not be unguarded. Our weakling brethren will be loath to surrender even a sliver of their undeserved might.
TEXT_BANAMA106_01227_FIBUBBGAH_000_011: Take the smothering ash and extinguish these beacons of unseemly servitude!
TEXT_BANAMA106_01227_FIBUBBGAH_000_031: The land itself breathes easier in the absence of those foul flames. You continue to show yourself a worthy ally of the Brotherhood.
TEXT_BANAMA106_01227_FIBUBBGAH_000_032: Our despicable kin, however, will not long countenance the loss of their magnified blessings. All too soon, new beacons will be lit, and we shall be glad of your aid once more.
TEXT_BANAMA107_01228_FIBUBBGAH_000_001: Honored ally, the Brotherhood of Ash has toiled to create a new weapon to use against our enemies─bone ash imbued with spiritual energy by the sacred chants of our mystics.
TEXT_BANAMA107_01228_FIBUBBGAH_000_002: It is our hope that the purifying properties of the ash will serve to cleanse the tempered of Ifrit's malign influence. This remedy has, however, yet to be tested.
TEXT_BANAMA107_01228_FIBUBBGAH_000_003: It is with bitter fortune, then, that we learned of a raid to the south. It seems that a hunting party from Forgotten Springs was ambushed by a superior force, and dragged before the Lord of the Inferno for tempering.
TEXT_BANAMA107_01228_FIBUBBGAH_000_004: I ask that you locate these unfortunate Miqo'te, and sprinkle upon each a pinch of the ash.
TEXT_BANAMA107_01228_FIBUBBGAH_000_005: Be sure to pacify the rangers sufficiently first, otherwise our unwilling subjects will simply shake off the ash before it has time to take effect.
TEXT_BANAMA107_01228_FIBUBBGAH_000_011: Find the tempered Miqo'te, and sprinkle a pinch of sacred ash upon each one to determine the remedy's efficacy. Do not forget to subdue your opponents thoroughly before attempting to use the ash!
TEXT_BANAMA107_01228_TEMPERED_000_016: Lord Ifrit! Your servant needs You!
TEXT_BANAMA107_01228_FIBUBBGAH_000_021: So...it seems the sacred ash failed to have the desired effect. Our mystics will be most disappointed.
TEXT_BANAMA107_01228_FIBUBBGAH_000_022: But the Brotherhood of Ash does not buckle at the slightest sign of hardship! We shall learn from this failure, and redouble our efforts to concoct a cure. You may yet be the first to reclaim a tempered mind from the abyss of madness.
TEXT_BANAMA108_01229_FIBUBBGAH_000_001: The madness of our Zahar'ak kin knows no bounds. Seeking to swell the numbers of tempered, they prey upon the rangers of Forgotten Springs with ever greater frequency.
TEXT_BANAMA108_01229_FIBUBBGAH_000_002: They bring shame upon the Amalj'aa with every new servant bound to Ifrit's will! We are honor-bound to rescue these unfortunate Miqo'te before the ritual of tempering is begun.
TEXT_BANAMA108_01229_FIBUBBGAH_000_003: The hated Flamefangs will pay in blood for these transgressions. I bid you make swift passage into Zanr'ak, and unleash righteous wrath upon their ranks!
TEXT_BANAMA108_01229_FIBUBBGAH_000_004: Seek out the ones known as ravagers─these soldiers hold the keys you will need to free the captives from their cages. Go now, and put an end to this insanity!
TEXT_BANAMA108_01229_FIBUBBGAH_000_011: The ravagers possess the keys you will need to open the cages. Go swiftly now, before the Miqo'te captives are brought before the demented god of the Flamefangs!
TEXT_BANAMA108_01229_PRISONER_002: (-Freed Ranger-)I'm free!? Stand aside, adventurer, the sands are calling me!
TEXT_BANAMA108_01229_PRISONER_003: (-Freed Ranger-)Oh, praise the Twelve! I'd thought this the end!
TEXT_BANAMA108_01229_PRISONER_004: (-Freed Ranger-)They'll never shackle me again. I would sooner die...
TEXT_BANAMA108_01229_FIBUBBGAH_000_021: The Miqo'te are captive no longer? Truly, you safeguard our honor with your every deed. It is well that the fates saw fit to send us such an accomplished warrior.
TEXT_BANAMA108_01229_FIBUBBGAH_000_022: With every victory, we come closer to restoring the heritage that was lost. Stay with us, honored ally, and you will be repaid for the glory you win in our name.
TEXT_BANAMA109_01230_FIBUBBGAH_000_001: The Brotherhood of Ash strives to return our people to the selfsame glory our ancestors once knew. The fallen Amalj'aa, however, grind our honor into the dust with every misguided and ignoble step they take.
TEXT_BANAMA109_01230_FIBUBBGAH_000_002: They swagger about like spoiled children, carrying weapons stripped from Miqo'te captives as if they were hard-won trophies of war...when in fact they are naught but garish reminders of craven ambushes and common pillaging.
TEXT_BANAMA109_01230_FIBUBBGAH_000_003: It is said that the arms of the U tribe are passed down from one generation to the next─that these weapons are revered as highly as the teachings of their ancestors. Though we of the Brotherhood follow a different path, it is anathema to us that the honor of the Miqo'te should be so spat upon.
TEXT_BANAMA109_01230_FIBUBBGAH_000_004: These Amalj'aa brigands and scavengers have not earned the right to their spoils. Search their camps, and reclaim all there is to be found. And when you have picked their caches clean, recover the rest from their bloody corpses.
TEXT_BANAMA109_01230_FIBUBBGAH_000_011: Your enemies this day are the brigands and scavengers of the fallen Amalj'aa. Slay these swaggering fools for their affronts, and recover the ancestral weapons of the Miqo'te!
TEXT_BANAMA109_01230_FIBUBBGAH_000_021: Have you returned with the arms of the U tribe?
TEXT_BANAMA109_01230_FIBUBBGAH_000_022: Yes, the weapons of the Miqo'te are distinct from any the Amalj'aa would craft. I will return these treasures to their Forgotten Springs heirs, and salvage some measure of honor for my people.
TEXT_BANAMA109_01230_FIBUBBGAH_000_023: Honored ally, once more you show a true warrior's spirit. Words are as wind, but your deeds mark your path into greatness.
TEXT_BANAMA110_01231_FIBUBBGAH_000_001: Be they ten thousand strong, the mewling whelps of Zahar'ak could not stand before us without the invigorating strength of their deity's flames.
TEXT_BANAMA110_01231_FIBUBBGAH_000_002: They carefully capture the Lord of the Inferno's searing exhalations, and harness them for their unholy rites.
TEXT_BANAMA110_01231_FIBUBBGAH_000_003: The god-touched fires are then ensconced within towering altars, which radiate Ifrit's blessings upon all within reach.
TEXT_BANAMA110_01231_FIBUBBGAH_000_004: These flaming beacons must be destroyed! The Brotherhood of Ash will take from our vile kin every symbol of their undeserved strength!
TEXT_BANAMA110_01231_FIBUBBGAH_000_006: I entrust this task to you, honored ally. But be forewarned: the sentinels that guard these beacons stand closest to the source of their power, and will prove to be most fierce adversaries.
TEXT_BANAMA110_01231_FIBUBBGAH_000_011: Destroy these flaming beacons, honored ally! The symbols of our honorless kin's madness cannot be suffered to exist!
TEXT_BANAMA110_01231_FIBUBBGAH_000_012: A worthy display of courage, honored ally. May our enemies know that even their precious beacons be not safe from our wrath!
TEXT_BANAMA110_01231_FIBUBBGAH_000_013: ...But lust for power is not so easily dampened. Until our war is won, I fear we will need to break these infernal altars again and again...
TEXT_BANAMA201_01232_NARUJIBOH_000_000: I see panic among the ranks of the Zahar'ak fools. It is your deeds, honored ally, that have sown these seeds of discord.
TEXT_BANAMA201_01232_NARUJIBOH_000_001: Even the priests who command our enemies have begun to show themselves in plain sight. The disruptions to their summoning preparations do not sit well with them.
TEXT_BANAMA201_01232_NARUJIBOH_000_002: Let us further stir the pot, fellow warrior. I bid you slay the members of Ifrit's clergy─the Zanr'ak thaumaturges─and their bodyguard pugilists, as well.
TEXT_BANAMA201_01232_NARUJIBOH_000_003: Seize from their lifeless shells what ritual tools and offerings they carried. Leave their brethren nothing with which to perform their unholy rites.
TEXT_BANAMA201_01232_NARUJIBOH_000_011: Hunt down the Zanr'ak thaumaturges and pugilists and take from them their ritual materials. With a single act, we thin our foe's numbers and hamper their unholy rites.
TEXT_BANAMA201_01232_NARUJIBOH_000_021: These weaklings that beseech a god for strength, and earn nothing through honorable battle, deserve nothing! Slaughter Ifrit's priests, and seize from them their ritual tools.
TEXT_BANAMA201_01232_NARUJIBOH_000_022: You pull the fangs off our enemy, honored ally. The thaumaturges were foolish to so reveal themselves.
TEXT_BANAMA201_01232_NARUJIBOH_000_023: Every mistake they make shall cost them dearly. And should they endeavor to fashion new tools for their rites? Well, I have the perfect warrior to once more unleash into their midst.
TEXT_BANAMA202_01233_NARUJIBOH_000_000: With their propensity for kidnapping innocents in the name of Ifrit, the Flamefangs have earned their place as our most despised enemy. It is their power and influence that we most avidly desire to crush.
TEXT_BANAMA202_01233_NARUJIBOH_000_001: I would have you hone your martial skills against the likes of Zanr'ak lancers and Amalj'aa archers, and thin the ranks of the soldiers who answer to Flamefang authority.
TEXT_BANAMA202_01233_NARUJIBOH_000_002: No assault into the heart of enemy territory is without its risks, but I trust Hamujj Gah has chosen his ally well.
TEXT_BANAMA202_01233_NARUJIBOH_000_010: Single out the Zanr'ak lancers and Amalj'aa archers, and weaken the forces subject to Flamefang command.
TEXT_BANAMA202_01233_NARUJIBOH_000_020: Though I am often confounded by the features of other races, your expression cannot be mistaken. Victory over one's foes gives one a most distinct air of satisfaction.
TEXT_BANAMA202_01233_NARUJIBOH_000_021: You have faced the enemy in his own domain and triumphed. We are fortunate indeed to have been delivered such a competent soldier.
TEXT_BANAMA203_01234_NARUJIBOH_000_000: Every evening after the sun has sunk below the horizon, there has been frenzied activity at the chief Zanr'ak altar. Our scouts report some manner of ritual involving a growing number of well-crafted weapons.
TEXT_BANAMA203_01234_NARUJIBOH_000_002: Considering the single-minded ambitions of our enemies, I assume they are attempting to imbue these armaments with the blessings of their god. We cannot allow such weapons to be brought against us.
TEXT_BANAMA203_01234_NARUJIBOH_000_003: Though I would sooner smash their tainted altar into a thousand pieces, I will settle for wresting from them the efforts of their misguided prayers. Honored ally, would you undertake this task, and seize these flame-sanctified weapons from the stores of our twisted kin?
TEXT_BANAMA203_01234_NARUJIBOH_000_004: Once we have the blessed armaments in our possession, our mystics will unlock the secrets of their power and learn how to dispel the enchantments. This new threat will not long plague us.
TEXT_BANAMA203_01234_NARUJIBOH_000_010: Scour the grounds of the Zanr'ak encampment and altar, and liberate the flame-sanctified weapons from the stores of our vile kin.
TEXT_BANAMA203_01234_NARUJIBOH_000_020: Honored ally. I trust you have returned with the armaments of our foes?
TEXT_BANAMA203_01234_NARUJIBOH_000_021: Yes, the heat of their searing enchantments is palpable even to a simple warrior such as me. Hah! The lengthy nighttime rituals of the Zahar'ak Amalj'aa come to naught! Rest now, warrior─you have done well.
TEXT_BANAMA204_01235_NARUJIBOH_000_000: Attend me, honored ally. Our Zahar'ak foes yet shelter the potent flames of Ifrit, and fuel their endless rites with his unholy fire.
TEXT_BANAMA204_01235_NARUJIBOH_000_001: Once more do they erect blazing beacons within their camp, in a bid to forever dwell under the heat of their deity's savage blessing. How many times must we topple these foul talismans?
TEXT_BANAMA204_01235_NARUJIBOH_000_002: We have not the numbers to prevent their constant reappearance. Thus, again, I must turn to you for aid.
TEXT_BANAMA204_01235_NARUJIBOH_000_003: I would have you slip inside the boundaries of the encampment with this smothering ash, and extinguish all the beacons you can find.
TEXT_BANAMA204_01235_NARUJIBOH_000_004: The Flamefangs have, however, grown wary of our incursions, and posted veteran sentinels to guard against our attacks. Expect your efforts to be met with furious retaliation.
TEXT_BANAMA204_01235_NARUJIBOH_000_010: As of this moment, our scouts report four beacons within the Zanr'ak encampment. Take with you the sacks of smothering ash, and put out these flames spawned of Ifrit's searing breath!
TEXT_BANAMA204_01235_NARUJIBOH_000_020: The unholy flames of Ifrit no longer wink at us in the darkness. You have once more deprived our foe of a potent source of strength.
TEXT_BANAMA204_01235_NARUJIBOH_000_021: I wish only that your victory were more permanent─the Flamefangs will respond, doubtless with their characteristic zealotry. But the Brotherhood of Ash cannot─will not─be swayed from its path!
TEXT_BANAMA204_01235_POP_BALLOON: You violate the sacred flame, unbeliever!
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_NARUJIBOH_000_000: The Miqo'te of Forgotten Springs have grown desperate in their ongoing conflict with the Flamefangs. They have spread their forces too thin in an effort to protect their hunting grounds.
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_NARUJIBOH_000_002: The U tribe will not accept aid from us, but we cannot allow their ill-considered tactics to result in ever more tempered slaves.
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_NARUJIBOH_000_003: I have devised a solution to this quandary: as there are various problems that would arise from a direct confrontation, I propose that we employ the unbearable heat of a drake's breath to drive the rangers back to their settlement.
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_NARUJIBOH_000_004: Such a measure will not cow the seasoned hunters for long, but it will at least prevent the Flamefangs from swelling their ranks until we have had chance to enact further plans.
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_NARUJIBOH_000_005: Speak with our master of drakes at the edge of the Sagolii, and heed his instructions well.
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_MOUNTAMALJAA_000_01: You are ready to ride forth, honored ally? My drake is at your service. Rattle the nerves of these foolish Miqo'te before they are snatched up by the next raiding party that happens along.
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_NARUJIBOH_000_020: Ride forth on the mount supplied to you by the master of drakes, and seek out the Miqo'te rangers. A gout of flame at their feet should be enough to send them scrambling for home. Better to suffer a little singed fur than endure the madness of tempering.
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_MOUNTAMALJAA_000_02: Should you need to dismount, the drake will return here to me. I will hold her in readiness until you are prepared to continue your mission. Now go, and deprive the Flamefangs of their prey.
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_MIQOTEA_000_030: (-Straight-backed Ranger-)Ow, ow, ow! Gods-be-damned drake! I'll put an arrow down your throat...next time!
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_MIQOTEB_000_040: (-Sweet-smelling Ranger-)Yeowch! My tail! You singed my beautiful tail!
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_MIQOTEC_000_050: (-Sharp-sighted Ranger-)Ugh, the heat sears my eyes! Get away from us! Away!
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_MIQOTED_000_070: (-Quick-witted Ranger-)Ack! Who the blazes are you!? The nunh will hear of this!
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_MIQOTEE_000_080: (-Noble-featured Ranger-)Ugh, what's this? Are tempered slaves given drake mounts now!?
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_MIQOTEF_000_090: (-High-strung Ranger-)Ow, where did you come from!? The desert sands are hot enough without drake-fire!
TEXT_BANAMA205_01236_NARUJIBOH_000_061: The Miqo'te have retreated from the sands? That is well. Spilling blood without cause will not further our agenda. I thank you, honored ally.
TEXT_BANAMA206_01237_NARUJIBOH_000_000: Compared to the seething ranks of the Flamefangs, the Brotherhood of Ash is a small force indeed. Thus must we seek to attain the pinnacle of strength if we are to triumph against our foe's numerical advantage.
TEXT_BANAMA206_01237_NARUJIBOH_000_001: It is not a matter of merely honing our martial prowess─equal consideration and effort must be afforded our weapons, as well as our mounts.
TEXT_BANAMA206_01237_NARUJIBOH_000_002: It is to our cavalry drakes that I would turn your attention. The flames they breathe can be greatly intensified by feeding them the incendiary glands of a more mature creature.
TEXT_BANAMA206_01237_NARUJIBOH_000_003: Such glands as we require can be harvested from the battle drakes of Zanr'ak─a breed coveted for their unusual strength and ferocity.
TEXT_BANAMA206_01237_NARUJIBOH_000_004: Before engaging these desert demons, however, I suggest you first acquire the oil of the lizardsbane plant. Cast the substance at a battle drake's snout, and the creature will be crippled by nausea. That said, do not expect one to simply roll over and submit to your ungentle ministrations.
TEXT_BANAMA206_01237_NARUJIBOH_000_005: Return to us as swiftly as you are able, and feed the glands to our mounts while the organs are yet fresh!
TEXT_BANAMA206_01237_NARUJIBOH_000_010: Gather the oil of the lizardsbane plant, and use it to weaken the battle drakes. I do not otherwise suggest you engage the volatile creatures.
TEXT_BANAMA206_01237_NARUJIBOH_000_011: Once you have harvested the incendiary glands, hurry back to the Ring of Ash and feed the organs to our cavalry drakes!
TEXT_BANAMA206_01237_NARUJIBOH_000_020: The contented purring of our drakes tells me you have succeeded in your task. I look forward to witnessing the blazing results of your efforts.
TEXT_BANAMA207_01238_NARUJIBOH_000_000: Do you know, honored ally, what is most distasteful to the Amalj'aa?
TEXT_BANAMA207_01238_NARUJIBOH_000_001: Simple water. As a people with an affinity for flame, we require very little of the liquid compared to other races. In fact, ingesting too much water can be as deadly to us as imbibing poison.
TEXT_BANAMA207_01238_NARUJIBOH_000_002: Among the Amalj'aa, any who drinks water in excess is considered a fool. And, in the same vein, dousing an opponent with the substance constitutes the gravest form of humiliation. Have you perhaps divined my intent?
TEXT_BANAMA207_01238_NARUJIBOH_000_003: I mean to subject the Flamefangs to the most crushing manner of defeat! Their flickering spirit for battle will not withstand the insult you shall deliver!
TEXT_BANAMA207_01238_NARUJIBOH_000_004: Seek out the strongest Flamefangs in Zanr'ak, and, at the moment they bow to your superior might, pour upon their heads a deluge of freezing water.
TEXT_BANAMA207_01238_NARUJIBOH_000_010: Subdue our Flamefang foes, and douse their addled heads with water. Such complete and utter defeat will smother what little fighting spirit they have!
TEXT_BANAMA207_01238_AMALJAAENEMYC_000_0: Damn you! The shame of it...
TEXT_BANAMA207_01238_AMALJAAENEMYD_000_0: Is this water!? Blah! Bluh! Bleh!
TEXT_BANAMA207_01238_NARUJIBOH_000_020: You seem surprised, honored ally. Did the intensity of their reactions surprise you? You may as well have soaked them with burning oil, such was their shame!
TEXT_BANAMA207_01238_NARUJIBOH_000_021: The mood of our camp is much lightened thanks to your deeds. Though we could not witness their defeat directly, such victories do much to improve morale!
TEXT_BANAMA208_01239_NARUJIBOH_000_000: Though we work tirelessly to sabotage the plans of the Flamefangs, we cannot prevent every raid or ambush. The flow of kidnapping victims into Zahar'ak has been endless of late...
TEXT_BANAMA208_01239_NARUJIBOH_000_001: Our demented kin brazenly stalk the lands around Camp Drybone and Little Ala Mhigo, snatching travelers from the roads be it dusk or dawn, or under the unblinking glare of the midday sun.
TEXT_BANAMA208_01239_NARUJIBOH_000_002: The Flamefangs have grown so adept at their detestable trade that they are forced to take their prisoners first to the Zanr'ak encampment, there to be kept in makeshift cages until Ifrit's clergy are ready to receive them.
TEXT_BANAMA208_01239_NARUJIBOH_000_003: Our latest reconnaissance informs us that Zanr'ak is host to a group of captives even as we speak. If we do not act swiftly, the ranks of the tempered will soon welcome a new wave of recruits.
TEXT_BANAMA208_01239_NARUJIBOH_000_004: I bid you ambush the Flamefang ravagers for the keys they hold, and free those unfortunate souls before it is too late.
TEXT_BANAMA208_01239_NARUJIBOH_000_010: Seize the keys from Flamefang ravagers, and liberate the prisoners from their cages!
TEXT_BANAMA208_01239_PRISONER_001_001: (-Freed Prisoner-)I never dared to hope that help was coming. Please... There may be others...
TEXT_BANAMA208_01239_PRISONER_001_002: (-Freed Prisoner-)Thank you! Oh, thank you! I had all but resigned myself to being a beastman slave!
TEXT_BANAMA208_01239_PRISONER_001_003: (-Freed Prisoner-)Well, if you ain't a sight for sore eyes, . Ain't never been so happy to see a 'venturer!
TEXT_BANAMA208_01239_PRISONER_001_004: (-Freed Prisoner-)<sob> Thank the gods! And you, of course! But mostly the gods!
TEXT_BANAMA208_01239_NARUJIBOH_000_020: Prying those prizes from the very maw of the Flamefangs was no simple task. It is no mystery to me why the warleader chose to place his trust in you.
TEXT_BANAMA208_01239_NARUJIBOH_000_021: Your deeds grow more impressive with each passing day, honored ally. I am inspired to work harder on my own martial improvement.
TEXT_BANAMA209_01240_NARUJIBOH_000_000: Greetings, honored ally. Have you heard the murmuring around the camp? It seems a bedraggled merchant has wandered close to the Ring of Ash after escaping a Flamefang attacker.
TEXT_BANAMA209_01240_NARUJIBOH_000_001: Our scout reports that the single ambusher appeared more interested in the trader's cargo─a number of boxes that drew our addled kin's undivided attention. I strongly suspect that only a haul of crystals would outweigh the value of a potential tempered slave.
TEXT_BANAMA209_01240_NARUJIBOH_000_002: If this is true, then we cannot allow the contents of those boxes to reach the Zahar'ak Amalj'aa and their summoning rituals! ...And considering the circumstances of his misfortune, I think it best that you be the one to approach this trader and confirm my suspicions.
TEXT_BANAMA209_01240_MERCHANT_001_005: Oh, thank Nald, an adventurer! I have just suffered an attack at the hands of an Amalj'aa ruffian! I managed to escape with my life, but the brute made off with my cargo of crystals!
TEXT_BANAMA209_01240_MERCHANT_001_006: The last I saw of the fiend, he was stumbling off to the south with my boxes precariously balanced one atop the other. I can't imagine he made it very far... Perhaps you might still catch the vile brigand!
TEXT_BANAMA209_01240_MERCHANT_000_010: I'm ruined. Ruined! Why did I choose this route!? Why did I not listen to the warnings!?
TEXT_BANAMA209_01240_MERCHANT_000_011: You rescued my cargo of crystals!? Huzzah! A wonder you are, , a gods-blessed wonder! How...how did you carry all those boxes, anyway? I shall have to retrieve my wagon before I can be on my way...
TEXT_BANAMA209_01240_MERCHANT_001_012: The Immortal Flames cautioned me about the rising number of Amalj'aa attacks, but I thought perhaps I could slip through their lands unnoticed. What a perfect fool I was...
TEXT_BANAMA209_01240_NARUJIBOH_000_020: I will not send you into enemy territory on the strength of a suspicion. Speak with this unlucky merchant and learn what cargo he carried.
TEXT_BANAMA209_01240_NARUJIBOH_000_030: So, my suspicions were correct. And you have returned the crystals to the trader? I thank you for averting this disaster.
TEXT_BANAMA209_01240_NARUJIBOH_000_031: We are fortunate for your aid, honored ally. I fear the intervention of the Brotherhood would have only exacerbated matters...
TEXT_BANAMA210_01241_NARUJIBOH_000_000: Our fanatic kin are nothing if not persistent. Once more they seek to focus and intensify the blessings of their deity.
TEXT_BANAMA210_01241_NARUJIBOH_000_001: They have constructed sturdy beacons in Zanr'ak, and consecrated these towering talismans with Ifrit's fire.
TEXT_BANAMA210_01241_NARUJIBOH_000_002: You will need more than a handful of ash to smother such roaring flames, honored ally. The time for subtlety has passed! Use whatever weapons you have at your disposal, but bring these structures crashing down!
TEXT_BANAMA210_01241_NARUJIBOH_000_004: As ever, the Flamefangs will seek to deny you at every turn. Engage them if you must, but do not lose sight of your true task.
TEXT_BANAMA210_01241_NARUJIBOH_000_010: Find the infernal beacons in Zanr'ak, and leave of them nothing but smoking ruin!
TEXT_BANAMA210_01241_NARUJIBOH_000_020: I judge by the smell of smoke and blood that your task was a success. Even my stubborn kin must now feel a flicker of doubt in the strength their vaunted blessings bestow upon them.
TEXT_BANAMA210_01241_NARUJIBOH_000_021: You, an outsider, have accomplished much for the Brotherhood. We are fortunate indeed to have you as our honored ally.
TEXT_BANAMA301_01242_YADOVVGAH_000_000: Honored ally, the greed of our foes has led them into grave error.
TEXT_BANAMA301_01242_YADOVVGAH_000_001: In his frantic quest to gather victims for tempering, Zagozz Teh has allowed certain of his personal bodyguards to join the Flamefang raiding efforts.
TEXT_BANAMA301_01242_YADOVVGAH_000_002: Never again will his elite soldiers be so vulnerable! I urge you to strike now, and remove these pieces from the board.
TEXT_BANAMA301_01242_YADOVVGAH_000_003: You will find the high-ranked lancers and archers prowling the canyons of Zahar'ak, awaiting the call to action. Spare these fools neither words nor mercy.
TEXT_BANAMA301_01242_YADOVVGAH_000_004: This day is a day for blood! May the fortune of battle be yours.
TEXT_BANAMA301_01242_YADOVVGAH_000_010: Hunt down the Flamefang elites, and leave them bleeding in the dust. Zagozz Teh will pay for his mad ambition.
TEXT_BANAMA301_01242_YADOVVGAH_000_020: You have dealt a telling blow, honored ally. The enemy has been deprived of some of his sharpest fangs.
TEXT_BANAMA301_01242_YADOVVGAH_000_021: But the wounded cur is most like to bite. Be on guard, and prepared to move at a moment's notice!
TEXT_BANAMA302_01243_YADOVVGAH_000_000: For many moons has the Brotherhood skirmished with the rank and file of Zahar'ak. In recent days, however, the ritual priests themselves have begun to appear about the enemy camp.
TEXT_BANAMA302_01243_YADOVVGAH_000_001: If the superior members of Ifrit's clergy have deigned to join the grunts on the front line, then matters are soon to escalate. Yet though their presence signifies trouble for the region, it also provides us with a worthy target.
TEXT_BANAMA302_01243_YADOVVGAH_000_002: Leave the hatchlings for lesser soldiers, honored ally─your quarry awaits deeper within Zahar'ak.
TEXT_BANAMA302_01243_YADOVVGAH_000_003: Seek out the high-ranking thaumaturges and their pugilist lackeys, and cut down a fistful of each. Such slaughter should prove fatal to any scheme they had hoped to enact. May fortune find you in battle!
TEXT_BANAMA302_01243_YADOVVGAH_000_010: Blow past the rank and file, and howl directly into the heart of Zahar'ak like an avenging wind! Sever a few fingers from the grasping hand that is Ifrit's high clergy!
TEXT_BANAMA302_01243_YADOVVGAH_000_020: You return at the crest of a wave of confusion, honored ally. Our foe is left bloodied and gasping, wondering at the demon who left behind such unexpected carnage.
TEXT_BANAMA302_01243_YADOVVGAH_000_021: Our plans to debilitate the enemy continue apace─in no small part thanks to your glorious victories.
TEXT_BANAMA302_01243_YADOVVGAH_000_022: Reports of your exploits stir the souls of our soldiers, mighty warrior. The warleader was shrewd to recruit your steel-clad spirit to our cause.
TEXT_BANAMA303_01244_YADOVVGAH_000_000: Honored ally, our sniveling, god-coddled enemy once more seeks to wield a strength they have not earned!
TEXT_BANAMA303_01244_YADOVVGAH_000_001: The “sacred flame” they shelter harbors the might of Ifrit, and any weapon infused with its blessing becomes a force of infernal destruction.
TEXT_BANAMA303_01244_YADOVVGAH_000_002: Should these inferno-imbued arms find their way into the hands of the common soldiery, we will be hard-pressed to meet their blows with simple steel.
TEXT_BANAMA303_01244_YADOVVGAH_000_003: Our scouts report that a batch of such weapons was recently transported to the front lines and left all but unattended. Why do they not wield them? Do they squabble over which weakling is the more deserving? I know not.
TEXT_BANAMA303_01244_YADOVVGAH_000_004: I know only that the fates have awarded us the chance to seize a potential threat by the throat. You need only steal into Zahar'ak, and snatch the weapons from under their bickering snouts!
TEXT_BANAMA303_01244_YADOVVGAH_000_010: The flame-infused weapons are being held deep within Zahar'ak. Though bloodshed will likely be unavoidable, do not be distracted from your true purpose!
TEXT_BANAMA303_01244_YADOVVGAH_000_020: Have you carried out the task with which you were entrusted? The weapons, honored ally, do you have the weapons?
TEXT_BANAMA303_01244_YADOVVGAH_000_021: So, this is how it feels to hold the heat of Ifrit in one's hand...
TEXT_BANAMA303_01244_YADOVVGAH_000_022: Hmph. My kin are weak to yield to such temptation. I will see these abominations destroyed at once.
TEXT_BANAMA304_01245_YADOVVGAH_000_000: I have for you a challenge this day: among the feeble ranks of the Flamefangs there is a unit of soldiers of unsurpassed strength.
TEXT_BANAMA304_01245_YADOVVGAH_000_001: Even amidst their own allies, these sadistic veterans inspire more terror than respect. As soldiers, they are perhaps the only opponents who might truly compete with the Brotherhood of Ash on even ground.
TEXT_BANAMA304_01245_YADOVVGAH_000_002: Honored ally, I would have you face these elites...and their commander. If you can succeed in wresting from him his treasured Flamefang choker, the glory of your deed shall know no bounds.
TEXT_BANAMA304_01245_YADOVVGAH_100_003: The disbelieving cries of our foe will be as the sweetest birdsong─assuming you succeed. This will be a true test of your martial ability.
TEXT_BANAMA304_01245_YADOVVGAH_000_005: Kill the commander of these elite soldiers, and bring to me the bauble he treasures. Such a towering victory will steal our enemies' belly for battle as surely as a blade to the innards.
TEXT_BANAMA304_01245_YADOVVGAH_000_010: Well, honored ally? Have you succeeded in my challenge? Does the commander of the Flamefang elites lie dead?
TEXT_BANAMA304_01245_YADOVVGAH_000_011: Yes! This is his precious necklace! The fangs of the choker must be pried from the flesh, thus the certainty of your deed is indisputable.
TEXT_BANAMA304_01245_YADOVVGAH_000_012: You have triumphed where even the most skilled of the Brotherhood might have failed. I bow to your prowess, mighty warrior!
