TEXT_BANAMA305_01246_YADOVVGAH_000_000: Outnumbered as we are, our strategies must be brutal and efficient. Though I would gladly wring the necks of our detestable enemies one by one, we can weaken their entire force by striking at their supplies.
TEXT_BANAMA305_01246_YADOVVGAH_000_001: Behind the gates of Zahar'ak, there are locked caches of foodstuffs and flame-touched weapons. Let us not be concerned with keys─take a drake and burn their stores to the ground!
TEXT_BANAMA305_01246_YADOVVGAH_000_004: Our master of drakes awaits you, honored ally.
TEXT_BANAMA305_01246_MOUNTAMALJAA_000_01: My drake's volatile breath will have those caches blazing within moments. Have a care not to be caught in the flames.
TEXT_BANAMA305_01246_YADOVVGAH_000_020: Ride a cavalry drake into Zahar'ak, and reduce their supply caches to ash!
TEXT_BANAMA305_01246_MOUNTAMALJAA_000_02: Should you need to dismount, the drake will return here to me. I will hold her in readiness until you are prepared to continue your mission. Now go, and let me see the pillars of smoke rising from our enemies' camp.
TEXT_BANAMA305_01246_YADOVVGAH_000_030: You have incinerated their stores? Hah! No matter how powerful their precious deity, an army is only as strong as its supply lines─this, they will learn.
TEXT_BANAMA305_01246_YADOVVGAH_000_031: Your victories continue to mount, honored ally.
TEXT_BANAMA306_01247_YADOVVGAH_000_000: Have you met with the fortune-tellers of Zahar'ak in battle, honored ally? Each of these mystics carries a ritual tool known as a wildfire idol.
TEXT_BANAMA306_01247_YADOVVGAH_000_001: It is an iron statuette forged in the sacred flames of Ifrit, and possessed of a potent aura that invigorates any of the faithful that draw near. Though we have seized several of these idols before, their god-tempered nature rendered them irritatingly difficult to destroy.
TEXT_BANAMA306_01247_YADOVVGAH_000_002: But if we are to deny our hated enemy every advantage, then destroy them we must! I have thought long on this matter, and the mindless, raging nature of Ifrit's blessings might be made to work in our favor.
TEXT_BANAMA306_01247_YADOVVGAH_000_003: Our demented kin also draw strength from the fires of the Inferno altar. Casting wildfire idols into its flames will cause the blessings to feed one upon the other, igniting a conflagration violent enough to ensure their mutual destruction.
TEXT_BANAMA306_01247_YADOVVGAH_000_004: Is your task clear, honored ally? Hunt down the Zahar'ak fortune-tellers and relieve them of their ritual tools.
TEXT_BANAMA306_01247_YADOVVGAH_000_005:
Bear the idols to the Inferno altar, and hurl them into the flames!
...Be sure to stand back from the explosion, honored ally. I would not have you perish in such a foolish manner.
TEXT_BANAMA306_01247_YADOVVGAH_000_010: Make your way into the depths of Zahar'ak and slay the fortune-tellers for their wildfire idols.
TEXT_BANAMA306_01247_YADOVVGAH_000_011: Take the ritual tools and cast them into the Inferno altar. The flames of their blessings will feed upon each other, consuming with mindless hunger until nothing but ash remains!
TEXT_BANAMA306_01247_SYSTEM_001_030: The potent energies of the wildfire idols cause the flames of the Inferno altar to rage out of control!
TEXT_BANAMA306_01247_YADOVVGAH_000_020: Was my plan a success? Ah, the fortunes of battle favor the bold!
TEXT_BANAMA306_01247_YADOVVGAH_000_021: Again, the illusion of my addled kin's strength is revealed. When power is not earned, there is no control. You have proven the truth of that, honored ally.
TEXT_BANAMA307_01248_YADOVVGAH_000_000: Amalj'aa are warriors in death, as in life. For this reason, it is custom to be buried with one's weapons─
TEXT_BANAMA307_01248_YADOVVGAH_000_002: Weapons such as these, which were taken from the graves of the Flamefangs. Aye, by this sacrilege we have brought great shame upon their fallen. But I would not have it end there.
TEXT_BANAMA307_01248_YADOVVGAH_000_003: Make monuments of that which was stolen for all Zahar'ak to see! Show that no glory awaits them─in this life or the next.
TEXT_BANAMA307_01248_YADOVVGAH_000_010: There is no greater disgrace than that which has been inflicted upon the dead. Should you be taken, you will receive no quarter.
TEXT_BANAMA307_01248_YADOVVGAH_000_020: The Flamefangs weep for their dishonored brothers! They curse us; they hate us. More importantly: they fear us!
TEXT_BANAMA307_01248_YADOVVGAH_000_021: Break a warrior's body, and he will thirst for vengeance. Break his spirit, and he will clamor for peace. Judge my methods distasteful if you will─but know that I seek to end this conflict, not prolong it.
TEXT_BANAMA307_01248_POP_MESSAGE: A mournful cry echoes across the desert...
TEXT_BANAMA308_01249_YADOVVGAH_000_000: The Brotherhood thrives, and the Flamefangs cower. Share in our glory, honored ally, for you have labored much for our cause.
TEXT_BANAMA308_01249_YADOVVGAH_000_001: But share too in our sorrow, for more men and women have been taken to swell the ranks of our enemies.
TEXT_BANAMA308_01249_YADOVVGAH_000_002: The zealots will brook no further delay. The captives will be tempered ere long if we do not act.
TEXT_BANAMA308_01249_YADOVVGAH_000_003: Stalk the guards who hold the keys to the cages. Lie in wait for their arrival and slay them with impunity!
TEXT_BANAMA308_01249_YADOVVGAH_000_004: When finished, move with all haste to free the captives. Let not the Flamefangs delay you, for every second is precious.
TEXT_BANAMA308_01249_YADOVVGAH_000_005: This occasion calls for subterfuge, not bravado. Slake your bloodlust another day.
TEXT_BANAMA308_01249_YADOVVGAH_000_010: Remember that time is of the essence. Move in shadow and strike only when necessary. The welfare of the prisoners takes priority above all else!
TEXT_BANAMA308_01249_YADOVVGAH_000_020: There is no honor in facing a mindless slave in battle. That you have spared us this loathsome task is of great comfort to me.
TEXT_BANAMA308_01249_YADOVVGAH_000_021: The cowardice of the Flamefangs is beyond all measure─beyond all forgiveness! That they offer themselves willingly is pathetic; that they sacrifice others is sickening...
TEXT_BANAMA308_01249_PRISONER_003: (-Surprised Captive-)I...I never believed I'd... Thank you!
TEXT_BANAMA308_01249_PRISONER_005: (-Impressed Captive-)What!? How in the seven hells did you─ Gah, there's no time for this!
TEXT_BANAMA308_01249_PRISONER_006: (-Enraged Captive-)I'll kill them all, I swear! They were fools to cross an Ala Mhigan!
TEXT_BANAMA308_01249_PRISONER_007: (-Disbelieving Captive-)This is a dream, right? You're not real...are you?
TEXT_BANAMA309_01250_YADOVVGAH_000_000: With every innocent we save, with every unholy beacon we destroy, the Brotherhood's reputation grows, and that of the Flamefangs worsens.
TEXT_BANAMA309_01250_YADOVVGAH_000_001: There is dissent even within their ranks─hatchlings who whisper of leaving Zahar'ak to pledge their spears to our cause.
TEXT_BANAMA309_01250_YADOVVGAH_000_002: Bah! Theirs is a fickle loyalty, borne on the winds of summer. They would betray us at first hardship.
TEXT_BANAMA309_01250_YADOVVGAH_000_003: These fair-weather fools are a disgrace to all Amalj'aa. They must be taught the value of honor.
TEXT_BANAMA309_01250_YADOVVGAH_000_004: The hatchlings expect to meet with one of the Brotherhood. Instead, they will meet with humiliation at your hands! Beat them senseless and douse them with water!
TEXT_BANAMA309_01250_YADOVVGAH_000_010: The words of these hatchlings ring false in my ears. Show them the folly of their ways by subjecting them to the ultimate insult!
TEXT_BANAMA309_01250_AMALJAAENEMYC_000_0: You will regret this! I have powerful allies!
TEXT_BANAMA309_01250_AMALJAAENEMYD_000_0: Forgive me! I beg of you, please!
TEXT_BANAMA309_01250_YADOVVGAH_000_020: Good, good! The hatchlings have learned what their vacillation has wrought. Perhaps now they understand what it means to be a warrior!
TEXT_BANAMA310_01251_YADOVVGAH_000_000: The beacons of the Flamefangs are a blight upon Zahar'ak─none more so than those which bear the Lord of the Inferno's name.
TEXT_BANAMA310_01251_YADOVVGAH_000_002: Each one is a symbol of power and prestige. By destroying them, we will deprive the zealots of both.
TEXT_BANAMA310_01251_YADOVVGAH_000_003: Know that your mission will not be easy, for the beacons burn in the heart of Zahar'ak, defended by the most devoted followers of Ifrit.
TEXT_BANAMA310_01251_YADOVVGAH_000_004: Moreover, the abominations defend themselves with ware sorcery, hurling flame at anything they deem to be a threat.
TEXT_BANAMA310_01251_YADOVVGAH_000_005: Few are capable of undertaking such a dangerous task, but I am confident that you will bring much glory to the Brotherhood.
TEXT_BANAMA310_01251_YADOVVGAH_000_010: When the howls of the zealots echo throughout Zahar'ak, I will know that the beacons are no more.
TEXT_BANAMA310_01251_YADOVVGAH_000_020: The wind carried word of your success, honored ally. How the ground quaked, how the Flamefangs wept!
TEXT_BANAMA310_01251_YADOVVGAH_000_021: Every victory brings us closer to the day of reckoning, when our sworn enemies will lie broken at our feet!
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_VORSAILE_000_001: Ah, now here is a  who inspires confidence.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_VORSAILE_000_002: It heartens me to see you stride into the Adders' Nest today, for I have a task of considerable breadth and even greater import─a task that calls out for a competent adventurer.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_VORSAILE_000_003: Allow me to elaborate. In recent weeks, my eye has been drawn to unusual movements among the sylphs, those charming-yet-troublesome beastmen with whom we share our forest home.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_VORSAILE_000_004: In hopes of shedding light on their intentions─be they malicious or benign─I dispatched a young researcher to Little Solace to investigate further. The fellow goes by the name of Voyce─mayhap you have heard of him? It would seem he is rather accomplished in his field.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_VORSAILE_000_005: He set out a fortnight ago, and has been sending regular reports ever since─that is, until some three days past. Though he was quick to assure me that his prodigious intellect and survival skills would ensure his safety, I cannot help but fear he has come to harm.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_VORSAILE_000_006: Such is my request to you: travel to Little Solace and inquire as to the well-being of our man. Seek out the sylph Olmxio, who has oft acted as an intermediary between our peoples. Now go in safety, and in haste. The forest holds many dangers─these days more than ever.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_OLMXIO_000_011: Walking one walks with strength and purpose, yes. But this one is a busy one─state one's case, and state it quickly.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_OLMXIO_000_012: Scholar? Walking one is looking for smart one, yes? This one knows no smart one. This one does know bumbling, stumbling one, but what business would any one have with that one?
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_OLMXIO_000_013: Stumbling one's whereabouts? Why, right over─hm? Wherever did that one bumble off to?
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_OLMXIO_000_014: Bumbling one likely stumbled off to see elder one. Stumbling one is always bothering elder one with silly questions. Bothersome one's blathering makes less sense than babbling brook, this one thinks.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_FRIXIO_000_021: Ah, brave one returns to these ones! This one is honored. Word of brave one's deeds comes often to Little Solace. These ones are honored to call brave one friend. Hm? Brave one is searching for scholarly one?
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_FRIXIO_000_022: Brave one cannot possibly mean...that one? This one has met many walking ones, and that one has all the wits of a wingrat.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_FRIXIO_000_023: Three days ago, witless one stumbled off to the Sylphlands, babbling something about research.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_FRIXIO_000_024: This one knows little of research, but this one does know that the Sylphlands are no place for walking ones─and witless walking ones that much the less.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_FRIXIO_000_025: Yes, these ones' ancient home is now the domain of touched ones, and those ones mean danger for these ones and walking ones alike. This one tried to stop witless one, but witless one's ears are stuffed with beeswax.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_OLMXIO_000_031: Bumbling one set off for the Sylphlands!? Bumbling one is even dumber than this one thought.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_OLMXIO_000_032: Touched ones will greet bumbling one with boom and sizzle. Then bumbling one will be crispy one. This one thinks it for the best. These ones will have one less worry.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_OLMXIO_000_033: Walking one would go in search of that one? This one is confused. Take this one's word─that one is not worth the trouble.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_OLMXIO_000_034: ...Walking one is certain? <sigh> Then this one will not stand in walking one's way. But heed this one's warning: be wary, or dead ones will number two.
TEXT_BANSYL001_01252_FRIXIO_000_035: Brave one would travel to the Sylphlands? <sigh> This one hopes brave one is not foolhardy one. Something is not right in our home these days. Listen to the trees, brave one. Elemental ones warn of danger...
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_OLMXIO_000_001: Walking one will truly go in search of bumbling one? This one thought walking one was making joke, like the time this one stole bumbling one's undergarments.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_OLMXIO_000_002: This one does not understand what walking one is thinking. This one would leave bumbling one to bumble on one's own. But oh well...to each one one's own.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_OLMXIO_000_003: This one saw bumbling one stumble off toward Larkscall, between this place and touched ones' home. Bumbling one is probably there shivering in stockings─if bumbling one found stockings anyway, which this one doubts.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_OLMXIO_000_004: Be warned, walking one. The trees have eyes, and report to touched ones. Walking one should not rush too quickly to bumbling one's aid, lest walking one fall into nasty trap.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_SYLPHENEMY_000_011: (-Fawning Sylph-)Walking one scribbles letters! Maybe walking one is smart one that every one was talking about?
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_DILUXIO_000_012: (-Menacing Sylph-)Smart one? Hah! Smart one would not stumble so stupidly into these ones' domain.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_VOYCE_000_013: S-Someone help meeeeee! They'll e-e-eat me alive!
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_DILUXIO_000_014: (-Menacing Sylph-)Shush, stupid one. These ones have no need for eating─or did stupid one not read that in stupid one's paper stacks? Stupid one is even stupider than this one thought.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_DILUXIO_000_015: (-Menacing Sylph-)Now answer this one! Stupid one tries to sneak into these ones' home and kidnap Chosen One's podling, yes? Stupid one will confess, or stupid one will be shocky-sizzly one!
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_VOYCE_000_016: The Ch-Chosen One? P-Podlings...? What are─
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_DILUXIO_000_017: (-Menacing Sylph-)Aha! Did this one know it or did this one know it!?
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_VOYCE_000_018: B-But this one...er, I was just repeating what you─
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_DILUXIO_000_019: (-Menacing Sylph-)Silence! This one hears sneaking one! What one goes there!?
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_SYLPHENEMY_000_020: (-Servile Sylph-)This one knows, boss one! This one has seen walking one in Little Solace! Walking one is strong, not like stupid one!
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_DILUXIO_000_021: (-Menacing Sylph-)Bah! This one will deal with stupid one another day. Let these ones be off.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_VOYCE_000_031: Oh, friend! How can I ever repay you? Why, I thought I was a goner for sure!
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_VOYCE_000_032: Whatever do you suppose got into those sylphs? The bestiaries describe them as such a carefree, fun-loving folk, and my rather limited firsthand experience has been the same.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_VOYCE_000_033: But do tell, to whom do I owe this debt of gratitude? An adventurer, dispatched by the Order of the Twin Adder on behalf of little old me, you say? Hah hah, bless the commander, always looking out for his charge!
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_VOYCE_000_034: While I'd like nothing more than to continue this conversation, would you mind terribly if we did so back at Little Solace? This place is giving me the heebie-jeebies!
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_VOYCE_000_041: Oh, hullo! I say, it's good to see you in one piece, friend. Oh, but where are my manners? I've not even properly introduced myself!
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_VOYCE_000_042:
Voyce, Gridania's foremost scholar of sylphic customs and lore, at your service! ...Well, at least that's what I told the commander when I volunteered for this mission. Just between you and me, I'm actually rather new to the field.
But I've long been fascinated by the cute little critters, and I thought this the perfect opportunity to make a name for myself.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_VOYCE_000_043: Which reminds me! I was just thumbing through one of the tomes I, ah, borrowed from Stillglade Fane, when I came across a particularly fascinating passage of a legendary sylph who is said to possess such power that she controls the very fate of her people.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_VOYCE_000_044: Now, I realize this might sound crazy, but I couldn't help but wonder if this might be the selfsame “Chosen One” that that frightful sylph was─
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_FRIXIO_000_045: ...Chosen One. Yes, well does this one know the legend.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_FRIXIO_000_046: Chosen One...the one who embodies the spirit of all trees that ever have lived or ever will live in these ones' forest home.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_FRIXIO_000_047: Once every ten hundred years does Chosen One sprout forth, to lead these ones into a new era before returning to slumber. Birth and rebirth, such is the cycle of these ones' civilization.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_VOYCE_000_048: Ten hundred years, eh? So if the last recorded sighting of the Chosen One was...yes...that would mean that the next rebirth would occur in...ah, just give me a moment now...
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_OLMXIO_000_050: Elder one! Could it be that rebirth of Chosen One is nigh, and touched ones are plotting something?
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_VOYCE_000_051: Huh! Well, I'll be! I believe our sylph friend here has the right of it!
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_OLMXIO_000_052: This one does not like this at all. Something must be done.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_VOYCE_000_053: Something─yes, something indeed must be done! And yet many questions of import remain to be answered. Such as, where might we find this Chosen One? And what is the true nature of the power she holds?
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_VOYCE_000_054: ...And most importantly of all, where, pray tell, did I misplace my underclothes!? I know not if this is related to the coming of the Chosen One, but the Twelveswood is terribly...<cough>...chilly these days.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_VOYCE_000_055: But regardless, I swear now that I shall remain at Little Solace until these mysteries are unraveled! 'Twas not by dumb luck that I was chosen for this task. No, the esteemed leaders of my nation...<cough>...knew that...
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_VOYCE_000_056:
No, they knew that... <groan>
...My, it is rather cold, isn't it? If you'll allow me a moment's respite...
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_OLMXIO_000_061: This one is worried. If Chosen One falls into the hands of touched ones, it could mean the end for these ones.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_OLMXIO_000_062: This one must see to the safety of Little Solace. The search for Chosen One, this one would trust to walking one.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_OLMXIO_000_063: Coughing one spouts big words, but has not the strength to save these ones─this can be seen by any one. And so this one turns to walking one. Will walking one help these ones?
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_SYSYTEM_Q1_000_1: Offer your aid to the sylphs of Little Solace?
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_SYSYTEM_A1_000_1: You can count on this one!
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_SYSYTEM_A2_000_2: You'll have to ask another one.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_OLMXIO_000_064: Thank you, walking one! Walking one is true friend to these ones! This one will not forget friendly one's kindness.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_OLMXIO_000_065: This one thought walking one was a friend. Was this one wrong? If these ones' fate depends on coughing one, these ones are as good as dead ones.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_VOYCE_000_000_070: D-Don't just stand there! Can't you see I'm in d-danger here!?
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_VOYCE_000_000_080: Yes, we must search for the...<cough>...Chosen One! Ah, just as soon as my...<cough>...throat clears up.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_SYSTEM_200_000: You have achieved Neutral reputation with the sylphs of Little Solace.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_SYSTEM_200_001: Sylph society quests are now available from Tonaxia at Little Solace.
TEXT_BANSYL002_01253_SYSTEM_200_002: Furthermore, you may now purchase wares from the sylphic vendor.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_VOYCE_000_001: Friend, you must listen! I was just perusing my tomes before, when I came across a most fascinating passage.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_VOYCE_000_002: Are you perchance familiar with how baby sylphs are born? Perhaps I can put it in layman's terms. You see, sylphs come into this world in the form of a bulb, not unlike certain types of flora.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_VOYCE_000_003: But these bulbs will not sprout into a sylph of their own volition. No, they must first be incubated within a special pod─forming what is known as a “podling”─and given sufficient warmth and nutrition. Then, and only then, will a newborn sylph emerge.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_VOYCE_000_004: This got me to thinking... Those frightful sylphs who accosted me said something about a podling, yes? I didn't put it together then, but...
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_VOYCE_000_005: Yes, surely the Chosen One slumbers as a podling even as we speak...a podling which they assumed I had come to steal! This must be why they acted so threatened by my presence!
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_VOYCE_000_006: We should continue our search in the Sylphlands straightaway. That is to say, you should continue it. I mean, I'd go with you, of course! It's just, uh... <cough> <cough> ...Still feel so weak... <cough> Ahem. I'm sure Olmxio would agree. You should go see what he thinks.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_OLMXIO_000_011: Bumbling one said what!? Chosen One yet exists as a podling? Why did bumbling one not tell this one sooner!? There is no time to lose!
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_OLMXIO_000_012: Walking one must become running one, and retrieve Chosen One's podling from the Sylphlands with all haste!
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_OLMXIO_001_012: This one can help. This one uses see-through magic, so that walking one becomes hidden one.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_OLMXIO_000_013: But be careful─see-through magic will not last long. If touched ones see walking one, walking one is in trouble. Now hurry, and find Chosen One!
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_DECRIPT_000_006: The fragrant blooms you will encounter on the way will extend the duration of the incantation. Seek them out if the spell's power begins to wane.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SYSTEM_100_020: It is not safe to perform this action while visible. Return to Olmxio to have the incantation cast anew.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SYLPHENEMYA_000_021: Phew, this one is exhausted! Who knew that a podling could be so heavy?
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SYLPHENEMYB_000_022: (-Irritable Sylph-)Lazy one should feel honored, to be trusted by boss one with super-secret mission!
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SYLPHENEMYA_000_023: Yes, yes...this one is honored, but also tired. So this one hides podling in super-secret place, will carry to boss one when arms and wings are strong again.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SYLPHENEMYB_000_024: (-Irritable Sylph-)But boss one said not to let podling out of sight for even one eye-blink!
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SYLPHENEMYA_000_025: Yes, yes... This one was just going to go get it... Now, ah...where did this one put it, again?
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SYLPHENEMYA_000_027: Was it near entrance to these ones' home, or...? Ah, this one cannot remember! Oh, what has this one done!? Boss one will pluck this one's wings out one by one!
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SYLPHENEMYB_000_028: (-Sluggish Sylph-)These ones must search! If these ones do not find Chosen One quickly, this one will not survive boss one's wrath!
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SYSTEM_100_030: Cool, crisp air fills your lungs, giving your arms and legs new strength!
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_NOTRECOVER_000_002: You are not carrying the specified object. Return to the starting point and reattempt the delivery.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_DECRIPT_100_003: Carry the podling back to Little Solace while your arms and legs still have strength. Be wary of attacks from enemies. Should you find yourself tiring, seek out patches of moongrass, which will restore your strength.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_VOYCE_000_041: Could it truly be...the Chosen One's podling? Good show, friend!
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_VOYCE_000_042: Why, it is every bit as beautiful as I would have expected from the tales, and thrice the size!
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_FRIXIO_000_043: Brave one has done it! These ones cannot thank brave one enough!
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_FRIXIO_000_044: By keeping Chosen One out of the hands of touched ones, brave one has saved these ones─no, every one in Eorzea─from a thundery demise!
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_VOYCE_000_045: Oh, let us not engage in hyperbole, friend sylph! Chosen One or no, she is just a wee babe, after all.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_FRIXIO_000_046: Foolish one has four eyes, yet not a one of them sees!
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_FRIXIO_000_047: Has foolish one learned nothing from those paper stacks? From the moment Chosen One emerges from cradle, Chosen One holds the power of a thousand thousand of these ones.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_FRIXIO_000_048: ...Power to command primal one with the ease by which walking ones draw breath.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_FRIXIO_000_049: What does four-eyed one think would happen if Chosen One's powers fell into hands of touched ones? Lord Ramuh would come down from the heavens, and walking ones' precious Gridania would go boom!
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_VOYCE_000_050: A primal in Gridania!? H-How frightful! Why, we really must do something about this!
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_FRIXIO_000_051: Does four-eyed one need four ears as well!? That is why this one sent brave one in search of Chosen One! <sigh>
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_FRIXIO_000_052: What matters is that Chosen One is safe now. Under these ones' care, Chosen One will be raised in Little Solace, where Chosen One will know only peace and gentleness.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_FRIXIO_000_053: If raised properly, Chosen One's great powers will bring comfort and solace, not destruction. This one─all of these ones─will see to that.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_FRIXIO_000_054: But brave one must be wary. These ones' enemy will not give up so easily. Should touched ones return for Chosen One, this one would ask for brave one's aid.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_VOYCE_000_060: I say, it's one eye-opening experience after the next with these sylphs! I really must take all this down... Now, where did I put my journal?
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SYLPHENEMYA_000_070: Phew! This one needs a─hm? Walking one!? Walking ones are not welcome in this place!
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SYSTEM_200_000: You have achieved Recognized reputation with the sylphs of Little Solace.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SYSTEM_200_001: New sylph society daily quests are now available from Ponnixia at Little Solace.
TEXT_BANSYL003_01254_SYSTEM_200_002: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from the sylphic vendor.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_OLMXIO_000_001: Ah, friendly one. This one would ask a favor.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_OLMXIO_000_002: Bumbling one spends all day sleeping on paper-stack pillow, yes? So this one thought to put that one to work.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_OLMXIO_000_003: This one gives bumbling one needle and thread, but bumbling one pricks finger and starts screaming and sobbing. This one's head still hurts.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_OLMXIO_000_004: So this one finds simpler task, asks bumbling one to go collect leaves for Nathaxio. Simple, yes? But bumbling one does not return. This one has had enough of bumbling one's bumblings, but Nathaxio is concerned. Friendly one should go talk to concerned one.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_SYLPHFRIEND_000_011: This one is Nathaxio, leafcrafter. Walking one is sent by Olmxio, yes? This one is thankful.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_SYLPHFRIEND_000_012: Olmxio placed four-eyed one in this one's care, asked this one to find work that four-eyed one would not bumble. So this one sent four-eyed one in search of leaves of great shelter tree.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_SYLPHFRIEND_000_013: This one casts see-through spell on four-eyed one for safe return. But  and that one is nowhere to be seen.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_SYLPHFRIEND_000_014: This one suspects that four-eyed one is see-through no more, and shakes and shivers behind tree somewhere. <sigh> Four-eyed one is useless, but does not deserve to die. Please find four-eyed one, friendly one.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_VOYCE_000_041: Oh, friend! Ever a sight for sore eyes, you are!
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_VOYCE_000_042: Pray forgive me. I was just on my way back from collecting leaves for my dear friend Nathaxio─and I must say I harvested quite a haul─when I, ah...somehow lost my way.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_VOYCE_000_043: Next thing I knew, my transparency spell had worn off, and...ah, that means all those nasty forest critters can see us, yes? What say we return to Little Solace, and quickly at that?
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_OLMXIO_000_051: Hm? Friendly one is back so soon? Is Chosen One safe and sound?
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_OLMXIO_000_052: ...What? Friendly one only now returns to this one? Saved bumbling one but moments ago? This cannot be.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_OLMXIO_000_053: Friendly one was here moments ago. Told this one that friendly one would go look after...
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_OLMXIO_000_054: Gah! How could this one be so foolish!? This one has terrible feeling! Must see elder one at once!
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_FRIXIO_000_061: ...Are this one's eyes to be believed!?
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_FRIXIO_000_062: Chosen One's podling, stolen from this one's care?
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_FRIXIO_000_063: B-Brave one steals Chosen One from us? But...why? Was brave one fooling these ones all along?
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_DILUXIO_000_064: (-???-)This one thinks grey-haired one needs new spectacles.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_VOYCE_000_065: Why, I'll be, friend! You never told me you had a twin !
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_DILUXIO_000_066: (-???-)This one is surrounded by fools. Makes this one's task all the easier...
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_DILUXIO_000_068: Foolish ones are foolish indeed to try to outwit this one. But worry not, foolish ones─Chosen One's podling is safe in hands of this one.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_DILUXIO_000_070: Ah, the podling trembles with power! The time of rebirth draws near!
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_DILUXIO_000_071: Yes, at long last, this one will finally reclaim the forest for these ones. With Chosen One's power, these ones will be pushed aside by walking ones no longer!
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_DILUXIO_000_072: Yes, this one will teach Chosen One the way of almighty one, Lord Ramuh. This one will teach Chosen One of all those who are enemy to these ones─walking ones, steel ones, treacherous ones...
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_DILUXIO_000_073: ...This one will destroy every one! Muahahaha!
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_OLMXIO_000_081: If Chosen One is born in Diluxio's care, it is not just these ones who will suffer─every one will be in danger...
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_OLMXIO_000_082: These ones must find Chosen One...but where to look? Curses! If only walking ones had sent real smart one instead of bumbling four-eyed one!
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_OLMXIO_100_082: But this one will think of something. Brave one, please help defend these ones' home against touched ones' attack. These ones have no one else to turn to.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_FRIXIO_000_090: As elder one, it is this one's duty to protect these ones from harm. This one must think of something...
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_VOYCE_000_100: I can't thank you enough for saving my skin again, friend. I say, the sylphs seem restless today. What do you suppose has them all aflutter?
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_VOYCE_000_110: I can hardly believe what has happened... I don't even know how they got the podling! Must have been when my back was turned. To think that my unmindful behavior has brought such tragedy to these poor creatures.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_SYSTEM_200_000: You have achieved Friendly reputation with the sylphs of Little Solace.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_SYSTEM_200_001: New sylph society daily quests are now available from Moxia at Little Solace.
TEXT_BANSYL004_01255_SYSTEM_200_002: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from the sylphic vendor.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_OLMXIO_000_001: Friendly one! This one has good news and horrible, miserable, terrible news. Which does friendly one want to hear first?
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_OLMXIO_000_002: Friendly one would hear good news? Good news is that these ones finally found nasty one Diluxio and the podling!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_OLMXIO_000_003: Horrible, miserable, terrible news is that the sprouting ritual has begun. Chosen One will be born in nasty one Diluxio's care!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_OLMXIO_000_004: Does brave one understand what this means? These ones do not have “mother” and “father” like walking ones. When little one sprouts forth from podling, first face of these ones that little one sees─that one becomes nurturing one to little one.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_OLMXIO_000_005: If these ones do not do something, nasty one Diluxio will become Chosen One's nurturing one. Touched ones will wield power of Lord Ramuh to destroy these ones' home, walking ones' nations...every one! Elder one looks for friendly one. Please go quickly!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_FRIXIO_000_040: Brave one has been friend to these ones time and time again. This one would ask of brave one...one final favor.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_FRIXIO_000_041: Brave one must steal into heart of touched ones' lair, rescue podling from nasty one Diluxio before Chosen One sees that one's face. Never have these ones needed brave one more.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_042: Elder Frixio! This one would go too!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_043: This one has been a fool! This one's half-hearted designs on playing hero have brought only trouble and anguish to Little Solace. This one would make it up to...uh, you ones! This one does not want to end his days as a bumbling one!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_OLMXIO_000_044: Bumbling one talks funny. Funny-talking one should be silent one.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_045: This one begs of you ones! This one has learned one's lesson! Please one! Give this one just one more chance one!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_OLMXIO_000_046: Shush! Funny-talking one's funny-talk makes this one's head hurt.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_FRIXIO_000_047: Funny-talking one's good intentions are not lost on this one. Yet well-meaning one is still bumbling one, and bumbling one would only put brave one and oneself in danger. Listen to this one: stay in this place, out of trouble.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_048: But this one... This one...this one... Aaaaaaaaaaaahhh!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_OLMXIO_000_49: Finally, these ones can have some peace and quiet.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_FRIXIO_000_050: Listen well, brave one. Diluxio and touched ones perform sprouting ritual at the Seedbed, deep in the heart of the Sylphlands. The journey will not be easy, even for brave one, but...
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_052: (-???-)Yes, feast your eyes on this glorious plumage! Let your spirits be lifted by my rousing call! Kwuh...<cough>...Kwurrr...<cough>...Kweee-eeeh!!! Ah, now that's much better.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_053: (-Voco-)Voyce? Who is this “Voyce”? I am Voco, prince among chocobos, fleetest foot in the Twelveswood, and I am honored to accompany this brave adventurer on  quest to save all of sylphkind!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_FRIXIO_000_055: Alas, poor bumbling one... It would seem that one's mind has turned to feathers.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_056: (-Voco-)Why do you tarry, adventurer? With each passing moment, the threat to this realm grows! Yes, Voco must press on ahead, with or without you! Fear not, Chosen One, for Voco will rush to your aid! Kweh!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_FRIXIO_000_057: It appears brave one's task will be even more difficult than this one imagined. This one begs of brave one─do try to keep feathery one from making a bumbling mess of everything.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_058: Kweh! The forest is a frightening place, , but take heart! Voco, prince of chocobos, fleetest foot in the Twelveswood, shall...kweh? Wh-What was that noise!?
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_100_058: To the Seedbed! Kweh, kweh, kweeeh!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SYSTEM_000_059: Voco has scurried off. Return to the starting location and reunite with your feathered companion to begin the journey again.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SYSTEM_100_059: You have lost sight of Voco. Retrace your steps to find them, then escort them safely to the Seedbed.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_059: (-Voco-), look before you! Your loyal steed has guided you to the Seedbed! The Chosen One awaits!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SYSTEM_001_059: You have reached your destination, and may end the escort mission if you so choose.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SYSTEM_002_059: If you do so, any party members who have not reached the destination with you will have their mission judged a failure.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SYSTEM_003_059: Be sure to confirm the whereabouts of your party members before ending the mission.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_DILUXIO_000_061: Ah, excellent! Walking one is just in time.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_DILUXIO_000_062: Walking one shall witness the birth of the one who heralds the end of the world as walking one knows it!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_DILUXIO_000_063: These ones have lived in the shadow of walking ones long enough! Chosen One shall choose this one to lead these ones into a new era!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_DILUXIO_000_064: New era has no place for imperial ones, walking ones, or traitorous ones who call those ones friend. All who are not these ones shall perish, and dead ones' blood shall water these ones' forest home!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_DILUXIO_000_067: Oh, do stick around, feathered one. After this one deals with walking one, roasted feathered one will make good feast for these ones.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_DILUXIO_000_068: Now, where was this one? Yes...say your prayers, doomed ones! Ahahaha!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SYLPHENEMY_000_069: (-Fawning Sylph-)Boss one! Look out! Feathered one is...
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_DILUXIO_000_070: Feathered one is walking one!? What is the meaning of this!?
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_071: Ho hah! Yes, 'twas me, after all! You'll not be calling this one a stupid one anymore, methinks!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_072: With me, friend! We must see the Chosen One back to Little Solace! Ah, how invigorating! Yes, these legs will carry me forever!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_DILUXIO_000_073: How could this one be fooled by stupid one!?
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_081: <pant> Friend... I tried, but... My legs will carry me...<pant>...no further.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_082: I beg of you... <pant> <pant> See the Chosen One back to...<pant>...safety.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_083: Weep not for me...friend... I am but a bumbling one who bumbled until the...<cough>...end...
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SYSTEM_100_080: Cool, crisp air fills your lungs, giving your arms and legs new strength!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_NOTRECOVER_000_001: You are not carrying the specified object. Return to the starting point and reattempt the delivery.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_DECRIPT_100_003: See the sylph podling back to safety in Little Solace. Be wary of attacks from enemies. Should you find yourself tiring, seek out patches of luminous moongrass, which will restore your strength.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_091: Oh, friend! How delighted I am to see you safe and sound!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_092: Myself? No worse for the wear, thank you! It really is quite curious, but, relieved of the burden of the podling, my recovery was remarkably hasty...
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_093: Yes, I daresay I've learned much from my numerous near-death experiences. Stay clear of the Sylphlands! Leave the heavy lifting to adventurers! And, most importantly, keep a close eye on one's journal...and one's undergarments!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_094: Now, what say we sit back and witness the dawning of a new era for sylphkind?
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_FRIXIO_000_095: In all the years this one has lived, never once did this one imagine that one would see this day...
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_MIKO_000_096: (-Chosen One-)This one asks... Who is the calling one?
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_FRIXIO_000_097: This one is Frixio, elder of Little Solace. This one would welcome Chosen One to these ones' family.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_FRIXIO_000_098: This one would build a home of peace and tranquility for these ones, if Chosen One would join this one.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_MIKO_000_099: (-Chosen One-)If that is elder one's wish, this one is born to answer...
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_FRIXIO_000_100: Such words are succor to this one's heart, Chosen One.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VORSAILE_000_111: Hail, friend! Your timing could not be better─I just received a report from Voyce relating your exploits in Little Solace in considerable detail.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VORSAILE_000_112: Why, to think that young man not only solved a thousand-year-old sylphic prophecy, but single-handedly fought off a veritable legion of malevolent sylphs to rescue the Chosen One and secure a future of peace and prosperity for all of sylphkind. Brains and brawn─yes, it is clear I picked the right man for the task.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VORSAILE_000_113: Hahaha, worry not! The brave lad gave credit where due. Yes, he clearly explained that his heroics would have been impossible without your clever chocobo ruse, and insisted that I guerdon you for your supporting role. Pray stay a while in Gridania and rest your legs.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_120: What is the delay, ? Let us make for the Seedbed! Kweh!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_130: See the podling back to safety, friend...and weep not for this one's...sacrifice...
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_140: Friend, this one is beside himself in gratitude for all that you have done. Yes, this one shall draft a full report, that Commander Heuloix and all in Gridania may know of brave one's bravery!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_141: Hm? Yes, it would appear that the local tongue has rubbed off on this one. All the better, I say, for the sylphs are starting to warm to this one's presence. Why, for the first time today I found my undergarments and journal exactly where I had left them!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_FRIXIO_000_150: The future of these ones depends on brave one. Please! Brave one must not let these ones down.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_FRIXIO_000_160: Thanks to brave one's bravery, Chosen One chooses this one as nurturing one. Together, these ones shall build a future of peace and tranquility for all of these ones' kind.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_FRIXIO_000_161: These ones will always remember brave one as a friend. These ones and walking ones will live in harmony together.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_VOYCE_000_170: Could that be...kweh!? Yes, , it is the Chosen One's podling!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_DILUXIO_000_180: Stupid feathery one! Bring Chosen One back to this one, now!
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SYSTEM_200_000: You have achieved Trusted reputation with the sylphs of Little Solace.
TEXT_BANSYL005_01256_SYSTEM_200_001: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from the sylphic vendor.
TEXT_BANSYL101_01257_TONAXIA_000_000: Walking one at hut-house is always kind to these ones! This one would repay walking one's kindness.
TEXT_BANSYL101_01257_TONAXIA_000_001: These ones harvested many eat-plants, but these ones do not eat! This one would not be wasteful one.
TEXT_BANSYL101_01257_TONAXIA_000_002: This one would decorate hut-house with eat-plants, make hut-house pretty place! But this one is busy one. Would kind one go in this one's place?
TEXT_BANSYL101_01257_ROLFE_000_020: Blast! Well, I'll be, they've done it again! ...Hm?
TEXT_BANSYL101_01257_ROLFE_000_021: What's that? It was you who “decorated” my home with overgrown weeds at the sylphs' request? <sigh> Oh dear...
TEXT_BANSYL101_01257_ROLFE_000_022: Look, I appreciate the sentiment, but I'd appreciate it a fair sight more if the next gift from our forest friends was delivered straight to my doorstep...and didn't taste of dirt, at that.
TEXT_BANSYL101_01257_TONAXIA_000_010: Decorate hut-house with eat-plants, let walking one know it is gift from these ones. Kind one will do this for this one, yes?
TEXT_BANSYL101_01257_TONAXIA_000_030: Friendly one returns! Walking one was pleased, yes?
TEXT_BANSYL101_01257_TONAXIA_000_031: Walking one wants next gift delivered to doorstep? But what would be the fun in that? Tee hee!
TEXT_BANSYL102_01258_TONAXIA_000_000: This might be this one's most ingenious trick ever! This one cannot wait to see walking one's face when this one─oh?
TEXT_BANSYL102_01258_TONAXIA_000_001: Trick? This one said nothing of the sort. This one thinks walking one's ears are the ones playing tricks.
TEXT_BANSYL102_01258_TONAXIA_000_002: But perhaps walking one could help this one gather some valuable ingredients...since walking one seems to have free hands.
TEXT_BANSYL102_01258_TONAXIA_000_003: This one requires one phial of morbol bile, one rotten treant acorn, and two phials of ziz venom─the stinkier, the better! Why, walking one asks? That is...ah, a secret.
TEXT_BANSYL102_01258_TONAXIA_000_004: Larkscall is full of stinky ones. Walking one will find everything this one needs there.
TEXT_BANSYL102_01258_TONAXIA_000_010: This one requires one phial of morbol bile, one rotten treant acorn, and two phials of ziz venom─the stinkier, the better! Why? Did this one not say it was a secret?
TEXT_BANSYL102_01258_TONAXIA_000_011: Larkscall is full of stinky ones. Walking one will find everything this one needs there.
TEXT_BANSYL102_01258_TONAXIA_000_020: Well, did walking one find what this one needs from stinky ones?
TEXT_BANSYL102_01258_TONAXIA_000_030: Perfect! Yes, this will be the stinkiest trick ever! Tee hee hee!
TEXT_BANSYL102_01258_TONAXIA_000_031: Do not worry, walking one, this one will not play it on walking one. As long as walking one keeps doing what this one says. Tee hee!
TEXT_BANSYL103_01259_TONAXIA_000_000: Woe, woe is this one! The peck of pumpkins that this one picked was purloined by a pack of pernicious ones! Or rather, this one dropped the sacks when startled by those ones.
TEXT_BANSYL103_01259_TONAXIA_000_001: The flesh of ripened devil gourds produces a most striking yellow dye for weaving. Without it, these ones' cloth will be reduced to dreary rags!
TEXT_BANSYL103_01259_TONAXIA_000_002: This one dropped gourds in Larkscall, near touched ones' home.
TEXT_BANSYL103_01259_TONAXIA_000_003: Walking one must hurry and collect the gourds before touched ones carry them all away!
TEXT_BANSYL103_01259_TONAXIA_000_010: Walking one must hurry to Larkscall and retrieve this one's gourds before touched ones carry them all away!
TEXT_BANSYL103_01259_TONAXIA_000_020: There were five sacks of gourds, yes? Please tell this one you found them all!
TEXT_BANSYL103_01259_TONAXIA_000_030: This one's gourds! Walking one is such strong and helpful one─nothing like another walking one this one knows. This one cannot believe these two are both walking ones.
TEXT_BANSYL103_01259_TONAXIA_000_031: This one will weave beautiful dress for helpful one someday. But today, this one is busy one!
TEXT_BANSYL104_01260_TONAXIA_000_000: <sob> Will this one never see this one's dear friends again?
TEXT_BANSYL104_01260_TONAXIA_000_001: Walking one! Listen! Touched ones played terrible, terrible trick─tricked scary gapemaws into swallowing this one's friends whole!
TEXT_BANSYL104_01260_TONAXIA_000_002: Poor, poor ones. Walking one must save poor ones before they become dinner ones!
TEXT_BANSYL104_01260_TONAXIA_000_003: Sweet smell of sap will open gapemaw's big mouth! Walking one, please, save this one's friends from belly of trouble!
TEXT_BANSYL104_01260_TONAXIA_000_010: Sweet smell of sap will open gapemaw's big mouth! Walking one, please, save this one's friends from belly of trouble!
TEXT_BANSYL104_01260_SYLPHA_000_020: Oh, thank you! Were it not for walking one, this one would have been compost for sure! Tee hee!
TEXT_BANSYL104_01260_SYLPHA_000_021: Touched ones will pay for this! This one will have this one's revenge!
TEXT_BANSYL104_01260_SYLPHA_000_022: Phew! What a relief. Belly of gapemaw is stinky and smelly. This one suggests walking one stay away.
TEXT_BANSYL104_01260_TONAXIA_000_030: This one's friends are safe! How can this one ever thank walking one?
TEXT_BANSYL104_01260_TONAXIA_000_031: When walking one first came, this one saw only new target for tricks. Now, this one sees a true friend!
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_TONAXIA_000_000: These ones have many friends in the forest, but no better friend than mossy ones.
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_TONAXIA_000_001: Mossy ones are old ones─as old as the forest itself. Mossy ones are as big as trees, and twice as strong.
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_TONAXIA_000_002: Mossy ones keep these ones safe. When mossy ones go ka-choo, touched ones become scaredy ones.
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_TONAXIA_000_003: Does walking one want to become friends with mossy ones, too? Mossy ones look scary, but are gentle ones.
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_TONAXIA_000_004: Cheerful one in Larkscall tends to mossy ones. If walking one wants to make friends with mossy ones, walking one should go there.
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_TONAXIA_000_005: Cheerful one in Larkscall tends to mossy ones. If walking one wants to make friends with mossy ones, walking one should go there.
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_NYXIA_000_010: Walking one! Touched ones are trying to play tricks on these ones! Touched ones spread stinkweed all over these ones' forest!
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_NYXIA_000_011: Walking one wants to make friends with mossy ones? This one is glad! Walking one should sit on top of mossy one, chase after touched ones. When mossy one goes ka-choo, touched ones become fast-flying ones, go flying back home.
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_NYXIA_000_012: If walking one falls from mossy one, walking one should return to this one. Walking one will be riding one again.
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_NYXIA_000_015: Walking one wants to make friends with mossy ones? This one is glad!
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_NYXIA_000_016: When mossy one goes ka-choo, touched ones go fluttering back home.
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_NYXIA_000_030: Oh, thank you, walking one! Mossy one likes walking one, too─this one knows. Walking one and mossy one will be good friends.
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_SYLPHENEMY_000_050: (-Spiteful Sylph-)Ick! This one is stinkier than stinkweed!
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_SYLPHENEMY_000_051: (-Cruel Sylph-)Stop it! This one just took a bath!
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_TONAXIA_000_040: Welcome back, friendly one. Hm? Walking one made friends with mossy one, and scared away touched ones too?
TEXT_BANSYL105_01261_TONAXIA_000_041: Walking one is becoming more and more like one of these ones every day. Be careful, or walking one might start sprouting wings. Tee hee!
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_TONAXIA_000_000: This one is frightened! This one saw touched ones dancing strange dances and singing scary songs.
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_TONAXIA_000_002: This one knows not what scary ones are up to, but knows it is no good. Walking one must stop those ones!
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_TONAXIA_000_003: These ones will help. Mysterious one knows mysterious magicks that will keep walking one safe. Walking one should talk to mysterious one.
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_ZEXIA_000_010: Walking one will stop scary ones from working scary magicks, yes?
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_ZEXIA_000_011: Walking one must steal touched ones' scentpowders and sparklebeads.
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_ZEXIA_000_012: This one will make walking one see-through one, keep walking one safe.
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_TONAXIA_000_020: Walking one must steal scentpowders and sparklebeads from Larkscall, stop touched ones from working nasty magicks. Walking one should speak to mysterious one before setting off, become one that touched ones cannot see.
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_DECRIPT_000_001: A sylphic incantation is about to render you transparent. Hurry and steal the touched sylphs' hex baubles before the magic is lifted.
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_DECRIPT_000_002: The incantation will expire in thirty-five seconds. If you become visible, you will be unable to complete your task. Return to the mysterious sylph and have the spell cast anew.
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_DECRIPT_000_003: The fragrant blooms you encounter on the way will extend the duration of the incantation. Seek them out if the spell's power begins to wane.
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_ZEXIA_000_030: Sweet-smelling flowers make magic stronger. Walking one should remember!
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_NOTRECOVER_000_001: It is not safe to perform this action while visible. Return to the mysterious sylph to have the incantation cast anew.
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_GUARD_000_001: (-Wary Sylph-)Sneaky ones abound, but no one will get by this one!
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_GUARD_000_002: (-Wary Sylph-)Scentpowders and sparklebeads are...gone!? Uh-oh, this one is in trouble...
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_TONAXIA_000_040: Walking one returns! Did walking one steal scentpowders and sparklebeads from touched ones?
TEXT_BANSYL106_01262_TONAXIA_000_041: No more magic for touched ones, tee hee! This one wishes one could see the look on touched ones' faces. Walking one is friend to these ones once more.
TEXT_BANSYL107_01263_TONAXIA_000_000: Scary steel ones come to the forest, stomping flowers and snapping trees!
TEXT_BANSYL107_01263_TONAXIA_000_001: The forest is no place for steel ones, but these ones have not the strength to face strong, scary steel ones! Will walking one chase off steel ones?
TEXT_BANSYL107_01263_TONAXIA_000_002: This one can help. This one made stink bombs from bigmouth one's stink-juice. Any nose-having one will run away from the stink, this one is certain.
TEXT_BANSYL107_01263_TONAXIA_000_003: Walking one must throw stink bomb at any steel one walking one sees─but be careful! Strong steel ones may fight back!
TEXT_BANSYL107_01263_TONAXIA_000_010: Walking one must find steel ones, then use stinky-juice stink bomb to drive them from these ones home!
TEXT_BANSYL107_01263_IMPERIALA_000_015: Seven hells! What is this stench!?
TEXT_BANSYL107_01263_IMPERIALC_000_017: Did a morbol just empty its innards? I feel ill...
TEXT_BANSYL107_01263_IMPERIALD_000_018: Hah, I drank swill worse than this last night! You'll not escape alive!
TEXT_BANSYL107_01263_TONAXIA_000_020: Steel ones are gone from forest? This one is beside oneself in gratitude!
TEXT_BANSYL107_01263_TONAXIA_000_021: Steel one brought giant, spiky one? This one has lost many friends to those ones. This one is frightened.
TEXT_BANSYL107_01263_TONAXIA_000_022: This one is fortunate to have strong friend like walking one. Promise this one that strong one will stay and keep these ones safe.
TEXT_BANSYL107_01263_POP_MESSAGE: The imperial soldier has summoned a magitek vanguard!
TEXT_BANSYL108_01264_TONAXIA_000_000: Friendly one, please! These ones are in terrible, terrible danger!
TEXT_BANSYL108_01264_TONAXIA_000_001: This one's friends saw steel ones in the forest! Saw giant, spiky ones ripping trees out of the ground! Those ones barely escaped alive!
TEXT_BANSYL108_01264_TONAXIA_000_002: The forest is not safe for these ones with spiky ones crashing and smashing, and there is nothing this one can do.
TEXT_BANSYL108_01264_TONAXIA_000_003: Friendly one is strong one, yes? Friendly one must smash spiky one, make spiky one go away.
TEXT_BANSYL108_01264_TONAXIA_000_004: Friendly one will do this, yes? Bring back piece of spiky one, let these ones know that there is nothing to fear.
TEXT_BANSYL108_01264_TONAXIA_000_020: This one hears no more crashing and bashing. Does this one dare to dream?
TEXT_BANSYL108_01264_TONAXIA_000_021: What is this? Friendly one smashed spiky one into bits and pieces?
TEXT_BANSYL108_01264_TONAXIA_000_022: This one is in awe of friendly one's strength! This one must show this to all these ones, let all know that friendly one is hero to these ones!
TEXT_BANSYL109_01265_TONAXIA_000_000: Friendly one! Wait...is friendly one really friendly one? This one cannot trust any one anymore!
TEXT_BANSYL109_01265_TONAXIA_000_001: Why? Because touched ones have learned sneaky skin-changing spell! Sneaky ones change skin, then jump out and hurt these ones! This one is afraid to leave Little Solace.
TEXT_BANSYL109_01265_TONAXIA_000_002: ...Friendly one does not hurt this one. Good, this one can trust friendly one, give friendly one see-boom.
TEXT_BANSYL109_01265_TONAXIA_000_003: See-boom will let friendly one see through changed skin, see sneaky ones' sneaky selves.
TEXT_BANSYL109_01265_TONAXIA_000_004: Friendly one will search for sneaky ones, yes? Bring an end to sneaky ones' sneaking?
TEXT_BANSYL109_01265_TONAXIA_000_010: Friendly one will use see-boom to bring an end to sneaky ones' sneaking, yes?
TEXT_BANSYL109_01265_OLDMAN_000_015: Ah, so this is Larkscall, primeval home of the august sylphs! This one...er, this old man has never seen such beauty!
TEXT_BANSYL109_01265_OLDWOMAN_000_015: Greetings, walking─ah, adventurer. Would you be so kind as to show this old lady to Little Solace?
TEXT_BANSYL109_01265_SUIMMER_000_015: Ah, nothing like a wade in a forest stream. The crisp, cool waters send a most pleasant shiver up my wings─er, spine?
TEXT_BANSYL109_01265_RUGAO_000_015: Many weapons for sale have I. Stabby ones, slicy ones, pokey ones, prickly ones...
TEXT_BANSYL109_01265_SYLPHENEMY_000_017: But this one's disguise was perfect!
TEXT_BANSYL109_01265_SYLPHENEMY_000_018: Walking one is no fun! Die, boring one!
TEXT_BANSYL109_01265_SYLPHENEMY_000_019: Walking one should mind one's own business!
TEXT_BANSYL109_01265_TONAXIA_000_020: Oh, thank you, friendly one! Maybe that will teach sneaky ones that these ones are not so easily fooled.
TEXT_BANSYL109_01265_TONAXIA_000_021: This one has no doubt that touched ones are planning more sneakiness. Pray do not leave these ones yet, friendly one.
TEXT_BANSYL110_01266_TONAXIA_000_000: Something smells rotten, and this one can bet touched ones are behind it!
TEXT_BANSYL110_01266_TONAXIA_000_001: This one saw touched ones planting stinkstools in Larkscall. Touched ones want to make a stink to keep walking ones out of the forest, this one knows.
TEXT_BANSYL110_01266_TONAXIA_000_002: What are those ones thinking!? Touched ones would stink up these ones' own home to keep out other ones!?
TEXT_BANSYL110_01266_TONAXIA_000_003: Please, friendly one! Slice up stinky ones before the entire forest is covered in stink!
TEXT_BANSYL110_01266_TONAXIA_000_010: Please, friendly one! Go to Larkscall and slice up stinky ones before the entire forest is covered in stink!
TEXT_BANSYL110_01266_TONAXIA_000_020: Ahhhhhh! This one's nose tells this one that friendly one has saved these ones again. There is no end to this one's gratitude.
TEXT_BANSYL110_01266_TONAXIA_000_021: Touched ones once loved the forest as these ones did, but no more. This one feels sad for touched ones.
TEXT_BANSYL201_01267_PONNIXIA_000_000: Touched ones are up to no good again. Steal beaked ones out of nest, teach beaked ones to be nasty to these ones.
TEXT_BANSYL201_01267_PONNIXIA_000_001: This one went to pick flowers near the Sylphlands, and nasty beaked one almost pecked off this one's head!
TEXT_BANSYL201_01267_PONNIXIA_000_002: This one has never been so angry. This forest should be for every one! Please, friendly one, stop touched ones and nasty beaked ones.
TEXT_BANSYL201_01267_PONNIXIA_000_010: Please, friendly one! Go to the Sylphlands and stop touched ones and nasty beaked ones.
TEXT_BANSYL201_01267_PONNIXIA_000_020: Friendly one has this one's thanks. Perhaps someday this one can teach beaked ones to be friendly ones...
TEXT_BANSYL202_01268_PONNIXIA_000_000: Does walking one know what these ones love even more than milkroot? Milkroot mixed with dreamslime! Dreamslime makes milkroot thrice as fun, tee hee!
TEXT_BANSYL202_01268_PONNIXIA_000_001: But this one isn't having much fun today. Why? Because touched ones are herding slimy ones and hoarding all the dreamslime!
TEXT_BANSYL202_01268_PONNIXIA_000_002: Walking one must punish touched ones and steal dreamslime─teach touched ones not to be greedy ones!
TEXT_BANSYL202_01268_PONNIXIA_000_003: ...Or just find slimy one and bring dreamslime to this one, so this one can forget one's worries.
TEXT_BANSYL202_01268_PONNIXIA_000_005: Touched ones are herding slimy ones and hoarding all the dreamslime! Walking one must teach touched ones not to be greedy ones. Or just find slimy one and bring dreamslime to this one, so this one can forget one's worries.
TEXT_BANSYL202_01268_PONNIXIA_000_010: This one is having no fun, no fun at all! Did friendly one find dreamslime for this one?
TEXT_BANSYL202_01268_PONNIXIA_000_012: Friendly one brings dreamslime! At long last, this one can be smiling one again!
TEXT_BANSYL202_01268_PONNIXIA_000_013: These ones have many worries these days. Without milkroot and dreamslime, these ones would be frowning and brooding ones, and what would be the fun in that? Tee hee!
TEXT_BANSYL203_01269_PONNIXIA_000_000: Just when this one thought touched ones couldn't get any nastier! Does friendly one smell something funny in the air?
TEXT_BANSYL203_01269_PONNIXIA_000_001: This one saw touched ones scattering strange powder on stinkshrooms, making nasty stink even stinkier! These ones cannot stop sniffling and sneezing.
TEXT_BANSYL203_01269_PONNIXIA_000_002: Please, friendly one! Wash nasty one's nasty powder off of stinkshrooms, before all of these ones become sickly ones.
TEXT_BANSYL203_01269_PONNIXIA_000_005: Please, friendly one! Wash powder off of stinkshrooms, before all of these ones become sickly ones.
TEXT_BANSYL203_01269_PONNIXIA_000_010: This one's nose has stopped tingling. Friendly one has cleaned stinkshrooms of their stink, yes?
TEXT_BANSYL203_01269_PONNIXIA_000_011: These ones breathe a sigh of relief. Ahhhhhh, does friendly one not too love the sweet smells of the forest?
TEXT_BANSYL204_01270_PONNIXIA_000_000: As if this one didn't have enough trouble with touched ones! Some of these ones enjoy milkroot and dreamslime a little too much, and are making a mess of these ones' home!
TEXT_BANSYL204_01270_PONNIXIA_000_001: Tipsy ones will not listen to this one, but will listen to a good bashing and splashing─this one knows. Walking one will help, yes?
TEXT_BANSYL204_01270_PONNIXIA_000_002: Tipsy ones stagger and stumble around Little Solace in drunken stupor. If walking one hears strange babbling and smells strange stink, that means tipsy one is just around the corner!
TEXT_BANSYL204_01270_PONNIXIA_000_005: Friendly one must find tipsy ones, give tipsy ones good bashing and splashing!
TEXT_BANSYL204_01270_PONNIXIA_000_006: If walking one hears strange babbling and smells strange stink, that means tipsy one is just around the corner!
TEXT_BANSYL204_01270_SYLPHENEMY_000_010: That'sh the best─hic!─milkroot thish one's ever had.
TEXT_BANSYL204_01270_SYLPHENEMY_000_011: Thish one'sh a mossy one! Mossy one comin'─hic!─through!
TEXT_BANSYL204_01270_PONNIXIA_000_020: This one has no end of gratitude for friendly one. This one hopes tipsy ones have learned a lesson: too much milkroot makes crazy one out of any one.
TEXT_BANSYL204_01270_POP_MESSAGE_000: A half-crazed sylph staggers drunkenly in your direction!
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_PONNIXIA_000_000: Touched ones grow more dangerous by the day! What are these ones to do?
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_PONNIXIA_000_001: This one saw touched ones setting blast-bombs in Larkscall! Can friendly one believe it?
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_PONNIXIA_001_002: In seeking to protect the forest, touched ones only destroy it. This one weeps.
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_PONNIXIA_001_003: But tears will not save these ones' home. These ones must turn to our friends, mossy ones. Brave one is also friend to mossy ones, yes?
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_PONNIXIA_001_004: Mossy ones' ka-choo will blow touched ones' blast-bombs away. Amiable one in Larkscall knows friendly mossy one with big ka-choo. Brave one will make friends with that one, yes?
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_PONNIXIA_000_005: Mossy ones' ka-choo will blow touched ones' blast-bombs away. Amiable one in Larkscall knows friendly mossy one with big ka-choo. Brave one will make friends with that one, yes?
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_NYXIA_000_010: Ah, has friendly one come back to play with mossy one? Both ones are glad, this one and mossy one.
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_NYXIA_000_011: Touched ones have brought blast-bombs!? How frightful! Friendly one must be careful.
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_NYXIA_000_012: If walking one falls from mossy one, walking one should return to this one. Walking one will be riding one again.
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_NYXIA_000_015: Ah, has friendly one come back to play with mossy one? Both ones are glad, this one and mossy one.
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_NYXIA_000_016: Touched ones have brought blast-bombs!? How frightful! Please be careful, friendly one. This one could not bear to see this one's friend hurt.
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_NYXIA_000_030: (-Amiable Sylph-)Mossy one may look scary, but mossy one has gentle heart...until mossy one sees some one hurt mossy one's home. Then mossy one gets angry. Trust this one─no one wants to see mossy one angry.
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_SYLPHENEMY_000_050: These ones have angered mossy one! These ones must flee!
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_SYLPHENEMY_000_051: Our blast-bombs! Meddling one will pay for this!
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_PONNIXIA_000_040: Brave one and mossy one ka-chooed the blast-bombs out of Larkscall? Brave one is a true friend to the forest.
TEXT_BANSYL205_01271_PONNIXIA_000_041: This one misses playing with mossy one. Perhaps next time, this one will go oneself!
TEXT_BANSYL206_01272_PONNIXIA_000_000: This one cries for the forest. Long ago, the great sporeshooter in the Sylphlands spit out cleansing spores that kept the air of these ones' home pure and pristine.
TEXT_BANSYL206_01272_PONNIXIA_001_000: That was until touched ones worked nastiness, placed sick-making thing inside. Now sporeshooter spits out clouds of sickspores that make these ones choke and gag.
TEXT_BANSYL206_01272_PONNIXIA_000_001: But did touched ones stop there? Of course not! Touched ones use power of flash and boom to make sporeshooter spit out slews of sick-making spores. Those ones' mischief must be stopped before the whole forest shrivels and dies.
TEXT_BANSYL206_01272_PONNIXIA_000_002: This one will give brave one scalebombs. First, friendly one must take these and make flashboom sticks go boom.
TEXT_BANSYL206_01272_PONNIXIA_001_002: Then, brave one must remove sick-making thing from sporeshooter. Friendly one should pour clean water on shiny one inside, till it shines clear again.
TEXT_BANSYL206_01272_PONNIXIA_000_003: Brave one does all this, sporeshooter will stop spreading sickness. Only then can these ones breathe easy again.
TEXT_BANSYL206_01272_PONNIXIA_000_005: Friendly one must take scalebombs this one made and make flashboom sticks go boom.
TEXT_BANSYL206_01272_PONNIXIA_000_006: Then, brave one must pour clean water on shiny one inside, remove sick-making thing from sporeshooter. Only then can these ones breathe easy again.
TEXT_BANSYL206_01272_PONNIXIA_000_010: Brave one need not say a word. Yes, a single breath tells all this one needs to know!
TEXT_BANSYL206_01272_PONNIXIA_000_012: Ahhh! Thanks to brave one, nastiness is gone, and the forest once again smells of fresh leaves and flowers. This one is forever in brave one's debt.
TEXT_BANSYL206_01272_SYSTEM_001_020: The poisonous spores disperse and the air around you clears!
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_PONNIXIA_000_000: Brave one returns, and this one's spirits soar. This one would once more ask brave one's aid, yes.
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_PONNIXIA_000_001: Brave one knows moonspore, yes? Moonspore is big, beautiful one. In dark and scary Sylphlands, moonspore brings sweet smells and bright lights.
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_PONNIXIA_000_002: Touched ones prefer shadows, care not for moonspore. Touched ones give clear-water only to stinkspores and gapemaws. Moonspore flickers and fades.
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_PONNIXIA_000_003: Brave one must steal clear-water from touched ones. Give to moonspore, make forest brighter and safer for all ones. These ones will help, yes. Brave one must speak to mysterious one. Brave one will not be seen.
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_PONNIXIA_000_005: Brave one must steal clear-water from touched ones. Give to moonspore, make forest brighter and safer for all ones. These ones will help, yes. Brave one must speak to mysterious one. Brave one will not be seen.
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_ZEXIA_000_010: Walking one will water moonspore? Walking one is friend to these ones, indeed. Stand still─this one will hide walking one from sight.
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_ZEXIA_000_011: Sweet smells make magic stronger. Walking one should remember this, if walking one wishes not to be seen.
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_ZEXIA_000_012: Walking one must steal clear-water from touched ones, give to thirsting moonspore. Three phials moonspore must drink.
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_ZEXIA_000_013: Ponnixia awaits word of walking one's success. This one wishes walking one luck.
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_ZEXIA_000_015: Sweet smells make magic stronger. Walking one should remember this, if walking one wishes not to be seen.
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_ZEXIA_000_016: Walking one must steal clear-water from touched ones, give to thirsting moonspore. Three phials moonspore must drink.
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_ZEXIA_000_017: Ponnixia awaits word of walking one's success. This one wishes walking one luck.

TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_DECRIPT_000_002: The incantation will expire in thirty-five seconds, after which time you will be unable to complete your task. Return to the mysterious sylph to have the spell cast anew.

TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_PONNIXIA_000_020: Thanks to brave one, moonspore shines on in the darkness, and these ones may yet bring touched ones back to the light. These ones owe brave one much.
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_SYLPHENEMY_000_030: (-Hostile Sylph-)The forest is no place for walking ones. Begone!
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_SYLPHENEMY_000_031: (-Hostile Sylph-)Hm? Clear-water is no more!? <sigh> Back to the spring for this one...
TEXT_BANSYL207_01273_SYSTEM_000_100: Invigorated by the crisp water, the moonspore shimmers and shines bright.
TEXT_BANSYL208_01274_PONNIXIA_000_000: These ones just found a walking one lying on the ground near the Sylphlands. Walking one was covered in blood.
TEXT_BANSYL208_01274_PONNIXIA_000_001: This one spoke with walking one. Walking one was attacked by coin-boxes in the Sylphlands, walking one said. “Coin-boxes?” this one thought.
TEXT_BANSYL208_01274_PONNIXIA_000_002: This one thinks sneaky ones are using sneaky magic to trick adventuring ones. This one is tired of sneaky ones' tricks.
TEXT_BANSYL208_01274_PONNIXIA_100_003: This one does not want to see any more walking ones hurt. Brave one must take these see-booms, show coin-boxes for the sneaky ones they are.
TEXT_BANSYL208_01274_PONNIXIA_000_005: This one does not want to see any more walking ones hurt. Brave one must take these see-booms, show coin-boxes for the sneaky ones they are.
TEXT_BANSYL208_01274_PONNIXIA_000_006: Kill three sneaky ones, and those ones will not bother walking ones anymore. Those ones are weak of heart, this one knows.
TEXT_BANSYL208_01274_SYLPHENEMY_000_017: Walking one will pay for this!
TEXT_BANSYL208_01274_SYLPHENEMY_000_018: Meddling one will not leave this place alive!
TEXT_BANSYL208_01274_SYLPHENEMY_000_019: Bah! Walking one is no fun at all!
TEXT_BANSYL208_01274_PONNIXIA_000_020: Oh, thank you, brave one! Brave one's fellows will no longer be lured by sneaky ones into danger.
TEXT_BANSYL208_01274_PONNIXIA_000_021: Tee hee! Nothing gives this one greater pleasure than foiling those ones' silly schemes.
TEXT_BANSYL209_01275_PONNIXIA_000_000: Tee hee! Tee hee hee hee! Yes, this will be this one's best prank ever! Hee!
TEXT_BANSYL209_01275_PONNIXIA_000_001: Oh, forgive this one! After thinking up an ingenious way to get back at touched ones, this one could not conceal this one's glee.
TEXT_BANSYL209_01275_PONNIXIA_000_002: Touched ones keep stealing these ones' pumpkins, yes? Well, this one has made a pumpkin that goes boom! Yes, touched ones who try to steal this are in for a blast! Hee!
TEXT_BANSYL209_01275_PONNIXIA_000_003: One of these ones is helping carry pumpkin-booms into the Sylphlands, but pumpkin-booms are heavy, and that one is not strong one. Brave one will help that one, yes?
TEXT_BANSYL209_01275_PONNIXIA_000_004: Brave one must be careful. Brave one must walk slowly, so brave one does not go boom. Tee hee!
TEXT_BANSYL209_01275_PONNIXIA_000_005: One of these ones was helping carry pumpkin-booms into the Sylphlands, but pumpkin-booms are heavy, and that one is not strong one. Brave one will finish the job, yes?
TEXT_BANSYL209_01275_PONNIXIA_000_006: Brave one must be careful. Brave one must walk slowly, so brave one does not go boom, too. Tee hee!
TEXT_BANSYL209_01275_RECOVER_000_001: Cool, crisp air fills your lungs, giving your arms and legs new strength!
TEXT_BANSYL209_01275_NOTRECOVER_000_001: You are not carrying the specified object. Return to the starting point and reattempt the delivery.
TEXT_BANSYL209_01275_DECRIPT_100_003: Carry the pumpkin bombs to the specified destinations in the Sylphlands while your arms and legs still have strength. Be wary of attacks from enemies. Should you find yourself tiring, seek out patches of luminous moongrass, which will restore your strength.
TEXT_BANSYL209_01275_PONNIXIA_000_010: Oh, thank you, brave one! This one just wishes one could see the look on touched ones' faces when pumpkins go boom, tee hee! Brave one and this one make a good team, yes?
TEXT_BANSYL210_01276_PONNIXIA_000_000: <sigh> Touched ones are making a stink again, planting stink-spores across the Sylphlands.
TEXT_BANSYL210_01276_PONNIXIA_000_001: The stink spreads, trees wither and die, and these ones' forest friends turn sick and angry. If some one does not put a stop to this, the forest will soon be uninhabitable by any one.
TEXT_BANSYL210_01276_PONNIXIA_000_002: Brave one must slice up stink-spores and save the forest from a foul fate!
TEXT_BANSYL210_01276_PONNIXIA_000_003: But brave one must be wary! Wherever stink-spores go, planting ones and stink-crazed creatures are sure to follow.
TEXT_BANSYL210_01276_PONNIXIA_000_005: Brave one must slice up stink-spores and save the forest from a foul fate!
TEXT_BANSYL210_01276_PONNIXIA_000_006: But brave one must be wary! Wherever stink-spores go, planting ones and stink-crazed creatures are sure to follow.
TEXT_BANSYL210_01276_PONNIXIA_000_010: These ones thank you, brave one. Since brave one arrived here, the dark cloud hanging over the Sylphlands has begun to lift, little by little.
TEXT_BANSYL210_01276_PONNIXIA_000_011: ...But there is still much work to be done. Pray do not abandon these ones, brave one.
TEXT_BANSYL301_01277_MOXIA_000_000: This one enjoys milkroot as much as any one. But naughty ones...some naughty ones enjoy milkroot a little too much. Turns naughty ones' minds to muck.
TEXT_BANSYL301_01277_MOXIA_000_001: Those ones forget once being like these ones, and become naughtier and naughtier. These ones' words no longer reach naughty ones.
TEXT_BANSYL301_01277_MOXIA_000_002: So these ones must cut this problem off at the─tee hee─root! Harvest milkroot before it falls into naughty ones' hands.
TEXT_BANSYL301_01277_MOXIA_000_003: Naughty ones' favorite milkroot comes from sappy ones and cluster ones. Brave one has seen those ones, yes? Brave one must bring back six bundles of the freshest, milkiest milkroot─just so this one knows the job is done. Tee hee hee!
TEXT_BANSYL301_01277_MOXIA_000_010: Brave one will chop down saplings and clusters, yes? Brave one will bring back six bundles of milkiest milkroot? This one will be waiting with wings aflutter. Tee hee hee!
TEXT_BANSYL301_01277_MOXIA_000_020: <sniff> <sniff> ...Does brave one have something for this one?
TEXT_BANSYL301_01277_MOXIA_000_021: <sniff> What lovely, milky milkroot! Tee hee! Yes... <sniff> ...This is the milky-wilky-milkiest milk-woot this one has ever milky-wilkied! Tee hee hee!
TEXT_BANSYL301_01277_MOXIA_000_022: Naughty ones...? <sniff> Is brave one a naughty one? This one can be naughty, too, tee hee!
TEXT_BANSYL302_01278_MOXIA_000_000: Oh no, what is this one to do!? This one's friends will become  for chompy ones!
TEXT_BANSYL302_01278_MOXIA_000_001: Oh, brave one, please listen! These ones went to Sylphlands to play a trick on naughty ones, but alas! It is these ones who were tricked.
TEXT_BANSYL302_01278_MOXIA_000_002: Naughty ones captured this one's friends, and fed them to nasty chomping ones! And if that was not bad enough, naughty ones smeared chompy ones' mouths with sticky-stick, making it impossible for any one to open!
TEXT_BANSYL302_01278_MOXIA_000_003: Only with slippery-slip can sticky mouths of chompy ones be opened, but naughty ones guard supply closely. If this one got too close, this one would only suffer the same fate as other ones!
TEXT_BANSYL302_01278_MOXIA_000_004: Screeching ones, snarling ones, sighing ones─these are naughty ones that did nasty deed. Brave one, please, save this one's friends from the bellies of beastly chompy ones.
TEXT_BANSYL302_01278_MOXIA_000_010: Screeching ones, snarling ones, sighing ones─these are naughty ones that did nasty deed. Brave one, please, save this one's friends from the bellies of beastly chompy ones.
TEXT_BANSYL302_01278_MOXIA_000_011: Brave one, please! Find the slippery stuff and save this one's friends from the bellies of those beastly chomping ones!
TEXT_BANSYL302_01278_SYLPHA_000_020: Phew! This one thought this one was chompy-food for sure!
TEXT_BANSYL302_01278_SYLPHB_000_021: Ick! Look at all this sticky-stick. This one needs a wash.
TEXT_BANSYL302_01278_SYLPHC_000_022: This one...is alive? Walking one has this one's thanks.
TEXT_BANSYL302_01278_MOXIA_000_030: Sticky ones have returned to Little Solace safe and sound! Thank you, brave one. Sometimes this one wishes that these ones needed to eat─then these ones could chomp down on chompy ones to return the favor. Tee hee!
TEXT_BANSYL303_01279_MOXIA_000_000: O, ancient ones, kindly ones... <sob> Forgive these ones...
TEXT_BANSYL303_01279_MOXIA_000_001: Does brave one know? Since long before walking ones walked this place, these ones have kept the company of the trees. The gentlest of the trees were the ancient ones. The ancient ones watched over these ones, and kept these ones safe.
TEXT_BANSYL303_01279_MOXIA_000_002: ...Then touched ones began to fill the forest with clouds of poison and hate. Ancient ones turned to gnarled, twisted ones, and once-gentle branches came crashing and lashing at these ones, that ancient ones once did love and protect.
