TEXT_BANSYL303_01279_MOXIA_000_003: It is too late to save ancient ones, but there is still a way to save what ancient ones once were. First, though it pains this one's heart, this one must ask brave one to end ancient ones' suffering.
TEXT_BANSYL303_01279_MOXIA_000_004: After doing so, this one asks brave one to bring back ancient ones' seed-corns, along with three phials of deepspring water.
TEXT_BANSYL303_01279_MOXIA_000_005: The springs by the Seedbed or the Hanging Barbs should suffice, this one thinks, but be wary─naughty ones abound.
TEXT_BANSYL303_01279_MOXIA_000_010: This one asks that brave one bring back ancient ones' seed-corns, along with three phials of fresh water from deep spring. So will the cycle of life begin anew.
TEXT_BANSYL303_01279_MOXIA_000_020: Did brave one bring the...<sniffle>...acorns and water that this one seeks?
TEXT_BANSYL303_01279_MOXIA_000_021: Brave one is strong indeed to quiet the ancient ones. This one is most grateful.
TEXT_BANSYL303_01279_MOXIA_000_022: These ones must never forget the ancient ones' kindness, but it is time for the cycle of life to begin anew. Yes, this one is certain.
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_MOXIA_000_000: Touched ones have played many pranks on these ones before, but this is the nastiest one yet!
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_MOXIA_000_001: Brave one, please listen! This one heard that touched ones are using skin-changing spell and disguising ones' selves as walking ones!
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_MOXIA_000_002: Skin-changed ones will go to Gridania and say terrible, awful things about these ones!
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_MOXIA_000_003: Brave one has used see-boom before, yes? Brave one must unmask touched ones before army of walking ones turns pointy-sticks against these ones!
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_MOXIA_000_010: Brave one has used see-boom before, yes? Brave one must unmask touched ones before army of walking ones turns pointy-sticks against these ones!
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_SYLPHVORSAILE_000_0: Well met, adventuring one! In the name of the Order of the Twin Adder, I command you to raze the miserable settlement of Little Solace to the ground and slay every last one of the insufferable sylphs who reside there. This one will reward you well for your services!
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_SYLPHDOORMANLOTUS_0: The Elder Seedseer is convinced that all the perils facing Gridania are the doing of those horrible sylphs of Little Solace. May this one show you in?
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_SYLPHBEATINE_000_01: Undamaged lumber is in short supply these days, thanks to the mischief of those nasty beastmen from Little Solace! How will we keep up the buildings of our nation? This one daresays that the sylphs of Little Solace are Gridania's true enemy.
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_SYLPHGEVA_000_015: Yes, there's no material so light and durable as sylph hide! What's more, there are so many of the damned critters that one need not worry about letting a square here or there go to waste. Adventurer! Go to Little Solace and bring me back, oh, four score or so, or this one will turn you into a subligar!
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_SYLPHFUFUCHA_000_01: Why, just the other day, the sylphs of Little Solace tore up a whole bed of vegetables and left them to rot at the guild's doorstep. They will not be content until our people go starving, this one is certain.
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_SYLPHMAISENTA_000_0: Bah! This one's entire stock of goods was stolen by those nasty sylphs from Little Solace! Won't adventuring one go slaughter the lot of those ones?
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_SYLPHNICOLIAUX_000_: Oh, an adventurer! Listen, a friend of mine left two days ago for Little Solace and never returned. I'll wager it's those sylphs who did him in. They may look harmless, but they're not to be trusted, I tell you!
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_SYLPHENEMY_000_016: Bah! Meddling one will pay for this!
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_SYLPHENEMY_000_018: Walking one will regret this day!
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_SYLPHENEMY_000_019: This one will pluck seeing one's eyes out!
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_MOXIA_000_020: Oh, thank you, brave one! This one is most relieved to be spared the brunt of touched ones' false talk.
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_MOXIA_000_021: Yet this one fears that these ones have not seen the last of it. This one shudders to think at how sneaky ones will employ sneaky magicks next.
TEXT_BANSYL304_01280_POP_MESSAGE: The impostor's true identity is revealed!
TEXT_BANSYL305_01281_MOXIA_000_000: Brave one is back to see this one, yes? Tee hee! This one sees how brave one looks at this one's wings. Tee hee! Brave one need not be such a shy one...
TEXT_BANSYL305_01281_MOXIA_000_001: ...F-Forgive this one! Ever since coming back from Sylphlands, this one feels tipsy.
TEXT_BANSYL305_01281_MOXIA_000_002: Why? Touched ones fill forest air with mist of milkroot, this is why! These ones cannot draw near without one's head becoming a muddled mess.
TEXT_BANSYL305_01281_MOXIA_000_004: Brave one feels nothing from milkroot, yes? Perfect! Brave one must take bottles of burny-goo, burn touched ones' mist-makers and stop those ones from making more mist.
TEXT_BANSYL305_01281_MOXIA_000_005: Touched ones will not take kindly to meddling ones. Brave one must take care not to be seen─mysterious one near entrance to Sylphlands will see to that.
TEXT_BANSYL305_01281_ZEXIA_000_010: Walking one need say nothing. This one knows why walking one comes to this one.
TEXT_BANSYL305_01281_ZEXIA_000_011: Walking one remembers, yes? If walking one starts to be seen, walking one should seek out sweet-blooms. Sweet-blooms are walking one's friend.
TEXT_BANSYL305_01281_MOXIA_000_020: Brave one must take bottles of burny-goo, stop mist-makers from making more mist.
TEXT_BANSYL305_01281_DECRIPT_000_001: A sylphic incantation is about to render you transparent. Hurry and destroy the milkmist makers before the magic is lifted.
TEXT_BANSYL305_01281_DECRIPT_000_002: The incantation will expire in thirty-five seconds, after which time you will be unable to complete your task. To have the spell cast anew, return and speak with the mysterious sylph.
TEXT_BANSYL305_01281_DECRIPT_000_003: The fragrant blooms you encounter on the way will extend the duration of the incantation. Seek them out if the spell's power begins to wane.
TEXT_BANSYL305_01281_NOTRECOVER_000_001: It is not safe to perform this action while visible. Return to the mysterious sylph to have the incantation cast anew.
TEXT_BANSYL305_01281_MOXIA_000_030: Mist-makers are no more, yes? Brave one is a true friend to these ones. But just a friend, yes? Brave one should not dwell overmuch on what this one said before...
TEXT_BANSYL306_01282_MOXIA_000_000: Once, touched ones were kind like these ones. Now, fear of walking ones and steel ones has clouded touched ones' eyes.
TEXT_BANSYL306_01282_MOXIA_000_001: Touched ones plant stink-clouds to keep intruder ones out of the forest. Stink rots the forest, and warps the hearts of the trees, four-legged ones, and even touched ones themselves.
TEXT_BANSYL306_01282_MOXIA_000_002: Touched ones are killing the forest, but touched ones do not see.
TEXT_BANSYL306_01282_MOXIA_000_003: This one once planted fresh-blooms to heal the forest, but touched ones have grown too strong, and too many.
TEXT_BANSYL306_01282_MOXIA_000_004: Brave one will do what this one cannot, yes? Plant fresh-blooms where the breeze will carry clean, sweet air throughout Sylphlands?
TEXT_BANSYL306_01282_MOXIA_000_005: But be wary! Touched ones like to chop down fresh-blooms, so brave one must chop up touched ones before doing the planting. Tee hee!
TEXT_BANSYL306_01282_MOXIA_000_010: Brave one will plant fresh-blooms and bring clean, sweet air to Sylphlands, yes? But be wary! Touched ones like to chop down fresh-blooms, so brave one must chop up touched ones before doing the planting. Tee hee!
TEXT_BANSYL306_01282_WARUIKO_000_010: Gah, intruder one! Intruder one will die!
TEXT_BANSYL306_01282_MOXIA_000_020: Welcome back, brave one. <sigh> Touched ones are sad ones, does brave one not think? So long have touched ones lived in darkness and stink that light and sweet-blooms become scary to those ones.
TEXT_BANSYL306_01282_MOXIA_000_021: It will not be easy to bring those ones back home, but this one must not give up. It is these ones' good fortune to have a trusted friend.
TEXT_BANSYL307_01283_MOXIA_000_000: Brave one has seen podlings, yes? To say it in a way that a walking one can understand, podlings are where these ones' little ones come from.
TEXT_BANSYL307_01283_MOXIA_000_001: These ones bring podlings to a place called the Seedbed, deep in the forest. Given light and warmth, podlings ripen.
TEXT_BANSYL307_01283_MOXIA_000_002: When podling is fully ripened, these ones bring podling back to Little Solace, and...pop! Out comes a little one. Tee hee! Cute little ones always bring a smile to this one's face.
TEXT_BANSYL307_01283_MOXIA_000_003: Yet smiles are not so many these days. The Seedbed where podlings must slumber lies deep in Sylphlands, where touched ones are many.
TEXT_BANSYL307_01283_MOXIA_000_004: Touched ones steal podlings from these ones, raise little ones to be touched ones. This one weeps for little ones that will know nothing but shadows and stink.
TEXT_BANSYL307_01283_MOXIA_001_005: Usually, one of these ones goes to carry back podlings, but touched ones are too many. A podling is ready to sprout, but touched ones will not let these ones near the Seedbed. Will brave one go and bring podling back?
TEXT_BANSYL307_01283_MOXIA_000_010: This one begs of brave one. Brave one must help these ones bring little one back to safety!
TEXT_BANSYL307_01283_MOXIA_000_011: These ones and brave one will work together. Brave one will go to Seedbed, carry podling back to these ones. These ones will bring podling back to Little Solace, where little one will be born.
TEXT_BANSYL307_01283_RECOVER_000_001: Cool, crisp air fills your lungs, giving your arms and legs new strength!
TEXT_BANSYL307_01283_NOTRECOVER_000_001: You are not carrying the specified object. Return to the starting point and reattempt the delivery.
TEXT_BANSYL307_01283_DECRIPT_100_003: Carry the podling back to Little Solace while your arms and legs still have strength. Be wary of attacks from enemies. Should you find yourself tiring, seek out patches of glimmering moongrass, which will restore your strength.
TEXT_BANSYL307_01283_KARIYADOSHIRUF_000_: Walking one will go to Seedbed, yes? Find podling, bring to this one? Walking one must walk gently─inside podling, little one slumbers.
(-Little Solace Sylph-)Walking one is strong indeed to survive the journey from the Seedbed. This one will carry podling back to Little Solace from here.
Little one will be safe, thanks to walking one. There is no end to this one's gratitude.
TEXT_BANSYL307_01283_MOXIA_000_020: Brave one will be happy to hear that little one sprouted from podling not moments ago. Because of brave one, little one is safe, and these ones smile again.
TEXT_BANSYL307_01283_MOXIA_000_021: But touched ones will not give up so easily...this one knows. These ones would ask brave one to protect little ones again.
TEXT_BANSYL308_01284_MOXIA_000_000: <sniffle> ...Oh, trusted one. Please forgive this one. This one has a difficult favor to ask of trusted one.
TEXT_BANSYL308_01284_MOXIA_000_001: For many years, these ones kept a great tusked one named Kafre as a pet. Kafre is strongest of tusked ones, gives these ones great joy at tusk-fighting festivals.
TEXT_BANSYL308_01284_MOXIA_000_002: Alas! Kafre has escaped these ones' care, and now charges madly across Sylphlands, turning fearsome tusks on all in one's path. Is this touched ones' doing, or did Kafre tire of these ones' company? This one cannot say.
TEXT_BANSYL308_01284_MOXIA_000_003: This one does not want to harm tusked one, but Kafre...<sniffle>...must be stopped. Will trusted one perform sad deed?
TEXT_BANSYL308_01284_MOXIA_000_020: Ah, trusted one. Tell this one, is Kafre...<sob>...no more?
TEXT_BANSYL308_01284_MOXIA_000_021: Trusted one broke off a tusk and Kafre ran away squealing? These ones' tusked friend still lives? Oh, this one could not have hoped for happier tidings!
TEXT_BANSYL308_01284_MOXIA_000_022: Is it too much to hope that Kafre will return to these ones someday as a gentle one? This one can but dream.
TEXT_BANSYL309_01285_MOXIA_000_000: Nasty ones hang about Hanging Barbs, skulking and sneaking. This one is not sure what nasty ones are plotting, but this one is sure it is nothing good.
TEXT_BANSYL309_01285_MOXIA_000_002: This one wants to stop nasty ones' nastiness, but this one would rather not hurt nasty ones─after all, nasty ones were like these ones not so long ago. What is this one to do?
TEXT_BANSYL309_01285_MOXIA_000_003: That was when this one was struck with the idea of this one's lifetime. Can walking one guess what this one did? No? This one made fuddle-bomb from shiny scales and milky milkroot!
TEXT_BANSYL309_01285_MOXIA_001_003: It explodes into a cloud so milky that nasty ones will become tipsy ones and forget all about doing nastiness. This one knows─fuddle-bomb exploded in this one's face once, and this one completely forgot what this one was making. Tee hee!
TEXT_BANSYL309_01285_MOXIA_000_004: Walking one must travel to Hanging Barbs and fling fuddle-bombs at nasty ones' homes, so nasty ones will be nasty no more!
TEXT_BANSYL309_01285_MOXIA_000_010: Brave one must travel to Hanging Barbs and fling fuddle-bombs at nasty ones' homes, so nasty ones will be nasty no more!
TEXT_BANSYL309_01285_SYLPHENEMY_001_030: Where is this one? What was this one doing? Does this one even care? This one thinks not─tee hee!
TEXT_BANSYL309_01285_SYLPHENEMY_001_031: This one is in the mood for dancing! And prancing! What one wants to dance with this one?
TEXT_BANSYL309_01285_SYLPHENEMY_001_032: Tee hee! Tee hee hee! Tee hee hee hee hee hee hee─hic!─hee.
TEXT_BANSYL309_01285_SYLPHENEMY_001_033: This one is feeling sleepy. This one is going to go home and take a nap.
TEXT_BANSYL309_01285_MOXIA_000_020: Nasty ones are now happy ones, dancing ones, and sleepy ones? Brave one has done well! This one could not be more pleased.
TEXT_BANSYL309_01285_MOXIA_000_021: This one's fuddle-bombs may yet make peace between these ones and those ones. But these ones cannot do this alone. These ones count on brave one for one's help!
TEXT_BANSYL310_01286_MOXIA_000_000: This one takes one's eyes off touched ones for one moment, and what do touched ones do? Plant stinky ones all over the Hanging Barbs!
TEXT_BANSYL310_01286_MOXIA_000_001: Trusted one knows stinky ones, yes? Stinky ones bite and gnash, and spit sickening spores to boot. Nasty things, those ones are.
TEXT_BANSYL310_01286_MOXIA_000_002: What's more, touched ones have trained stinky ones to attack walking ones on sight! Is there no end to those ones' mischief?
TEXT_BANSYL310_01286_MOXIA_000_003: No, these ones are not safe with stinky ones lurking about. Will trusted one squash stinky ones so that these ones can play in the Barbs again?
TEXT_BANSYL310_01286_MOXIA_000_004: Stinky ones are no match for trusted one. This one knows.
TEXT_BANSYL310_01286_MOXIA_000_010: Trusted one will squash stinky ones so that these ones can frolic in the Barbs again, yes? Be careful, stinky ones have been trained by touched ones to attack walking ones on sight.
TEXT_BANSYL310_01286_MOXIA_000_020: This one is glad to see trusted one safe!
TEXT_BANSYL310_01286_MOXIA_000_021: Stinky ones are no more? This one knew that trusted one could be trusted, tee hee!
TEXT_BANSYL310_01286_MOXIA_000_022: This one knows not what touched ones are thinking. Touched ones destroy the forest for every one, including ones' selves.
TEXT_BANSYL310_01286_MOXIA_000_023: This one tried to say so, but this one's words do not reach those ones. Are those ones truly lost...?
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_TRACHRAET_000_001: ! I know not what brings ye to Maelstrom Command this day, but I can 'ardly fault yer timin'. Aye, we've a situation on our 'ands, we do.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_TRACHRAET_000_002: Not days ago, a convoy of ours was ambushed en route to Limsa, and a goodly shipment of saltpeter plundered from our very 'ands. The scurvy dogs responsible for the act struck swiftly and under darkness, so we've yet to figure out who they are─much less bring them to justice.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_TRACHRAET_000_003: Saltpeter, as ye may know, is a key ingredient in fashionin' firesand. Whatever our foe might be plottin', like as not it involves an 'earty share o' fiery death and destruction.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_TRACHRAET_000_004: Command has dispatched an elite regiment to the field to investigate, but clues 'ave proved 'arder to come by than an 'alf-decent pint of ale at sea.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_TRACHRAET_000_005: Leadin' the investigation is a good comrade of mine. While I'd like nothin' more than to lend me strength to 'er search, I can't very well shirk me duties 'ere.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_TRACHRAET_000_006: If ye find yerself itchin' for adventure, ye could do worse than to make for Swiftperch and seek out one Lieutenant Skaetswys. Just say that Trachraet sent ye.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_TRACHRAET_000_007: A dear old comrade of mine leads the search for our missin' shipment of saltpeter. If ye be itchin' for adventure, make for Swiftperch and seek out one Lieutenant Skaetswys. Just say that Trachraet sent ye.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_010: Llymlaen take the lot of ye! Ye'd 'ave me believe that there's not a single piece of evidence in this entire godsforsaken 'amlet!?
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_011: And who might you be? An adventurer come on behalf of ol' Trachraet? Who said I was lookin' for 'elp, anyway?
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_012: Trachraet did? Hah! I'll 'ave ye both know that it's all clear skies and smooth sailin' 'ere. Aye, I was just about to file my report to─
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_013: ...Eh, I ain't foolin' no one. A good tonze o' saltpeter's been snatched from our 'ands, like as not by someone who'd use it to sink our fair Limsa to the bottom o' the sea. All right, I'll share with ye what me men 'ave gleaned, though I warn ye─it ain't much.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_014: Given the scope o' the act, we believe it was a coordinated effort by a well-trained group. What's more, given the sheer speed with which the scurvy thieves vanished from our sight, I reckon that they 'ave knowledge o' passages unknown to us.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_015: I 'ad me 'opes up that my men would've found somethin', but they 'ad no such luck. What say ye? Care to take a look around and see if ye can find the evidence me 'alf-blind and thrice-daft subordinates couldn't?
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_016: To steal off with all those crates with even our best men catchin' nary a glimpse... We're dealin' with a criminal band o' surpassin' skill an' chicanery.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_KOKKADANA01320_000_: <sigh> I'm in for a demotion for sure. How will I ever face me wife and kids again...?
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_KOKKADANB01320_000_: Me eyes never left the wagon─I swear on me mother's grave! Well, I mean...maybe they did. Just for a moment... But Aleport was in clear sight! Can ye blame me for thinkin' we were safe?
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_030: , was it? Well? Find any evidence that could shed some light on our investigation?
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_031: Hmmm...what 'ave we here? A pickaxe, and a rather sorry-lookin' one, at that. Do ye reckon this was left behind by the perpetrators?
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_032: In my time with the Maelstrom, I've confronted just about every pirate, brigand, and 'ighwayman in these parts, but I've not known any of 'em to employ a tool like this.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_033: No, I'd wager more than a round at the Wench that our band o' grubby little thieves ain't no ordinary men. Aye, it's all becomin' clear to me...
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_034: ...And yerself, no doubt. Tell me, ─might ye be thinkin' what I'm thinkin'?
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_Q1_000_000: Are you thinking what Skaetswys is thinking? The culprit is...
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_035: None other! Aye, only a Roegadyn of abundant physical and mental talents─such as meself─could fashion and employ such an exquisite piece o'...
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_036: ...Do ye 'ave barnacles where yer brains should be, adventurer!? 'Cause if yer so much as implyin' that I staged the robbery meself, ye'll be takin' a long walk off a short pier the second you set foot back in Limsa!
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_037: ...I knew ye were a sharp one. Aye, the moment I laid eyes on that pickaxe ye found, me mind was convinced.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_038: The primitive make o' this tool, an all-too-'ealthy interest in explosives─all signs point to those rat-faced rapscallions bein' behind all this.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_039: It's so bloody obvious now that I could almost kick meself─and me good-for-nothin' men─for not comin' to this conclusion sooner.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_040: But this is 'ardly a time for whingin'. No, we must strike quickly if we mean to reclaim what's ours.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_041: Camp Overlook is our front line o' defense against those tunnel-burrowin' thieves. If anyone 'as a notion o' where they've taken the saltpeter and 'ow they plan to use it, it'll be Commander Bloeidin.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_042: I'm off to deliver me report, but I've an 'unch our job has only begun. What say you come along, ? You're the first capable  I've worked with today.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_KOBOLDA01320_000_04: Release me at once─free me, unhand me, release me!
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_BLOEIDIN_000_050: Hm? Make it quick, adventurer. As ye can see, I've got me hands full with our little friend here.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_KOBOLDA01320_000_05: This is an outrage─a farce, an atrocity, an outrage! This is an insult, and we kobolds will not stand for it. No, no, stand no more!
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_BLOEIDIN_000_052: Ye'll not have legs to stand on if ye don't quit blabberin' an' spill the truth about whatever it is ye scurvy rats are plottin'!
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_KOBOLDA01320_000_05: Plotting? There is no plotting! No, no, we plot nothing─naught, nil, nothing!
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_BLOEIDIN_000_054: Enough! Unlike you and yer ilk, I've a workin' pair of eyes and at least half me wits about me. Ye think I've not seen you lot blastin' and scurryin' around U'Ghamaro of late!?
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_BLOEIDIN_000_056: Skaetswys? Aye, it's a treat to see me old trainee, but I fear a brewin' kobold plot demands me attention...
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_057: 'ere and I just might be able to 'elp ye with that, Commander. I trust ye've 'eard the news of our missin' shipment of saltpeter?
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_KOBOLDA01320_000_05: So soon she knows!? This cannot be! No, no, it cannot be!
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_BLOEIDIN_000_059: Hah, I knew it! Yer endless tongue-waggin' has finally dug yer own grave!
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_KOBOLDA01320_000_06: It was not us! No, no, not us. It was them─yes, yes, them!
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_061: What nonsense is this? Beady eyes, frizzy tail, a penchant for causin' us trouble─a kobold's a kobold!
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_KOBOLDA01320_000_06: This is not so! No, no, not so! There are kobolds, and then there are kobolds, and then there are kobolds still. It is the low ones who stole your precious saltpeter─the ones who live down, beneath, below!
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_BLOEIDIN_000_063: Beneath and below? ...Come to think of it, me scouts did mention a particularly scraggy band of kobolds what seem to have made their home at the cliff base.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_KOBOLDA01320_000_06: Yes, yes! That is the place! That is the home, the home of the 789th. They are the worst─the worst of the worst. They are most stinky─smelly, scummy, stinky─and ugly, too!
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_065: Commander! As the presidin' officer in this investigation, I request permission to go below and investigate the so-called 789th. Furthermore, I would enlist this adventurer to join me─'s proven  capable, and it would seem we go up against a worthy foe.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_BLOEIDIN_000_066: As ye please, Lieutenant. But I warn ye, be careful down there. The sight of a kobold won't strike fear into anyone's heart, but their bite─and their bombs─are a fair sight worse than their bark.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_067: Understood, Commander─we'll not let ye down. And with that, I take my leave. Till sea swallows all!
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_068: Well, ? Are ye ready to take on the scurviest band o' kobolds in La Noscea? Ye'd best be, because I'm countin' on ye to make yerself useful.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_BLOEIDIN_000_069: Kobolds might look like little more than overgrown wharf rats, but their minds are as sharp as their claws. If you ever find yerself surrounded by 'em, ye'd best be ready for the fight o' yer life.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_KOBOLDA01320_000_07: No good can come from dealing with the 789th. No good, no good at all. Ignore my words, and you are a fool─a dunce, a , a fool.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_081: One, two...aye, three crates o' saltpeter. It would seem our kobold informant spoke true.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_088: Are ye just goin' to stand there squeakin' at me all !? Fight with 'onor, or die like the rats ye are!
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_GIGU_000_089: (-Unimposing Kobold-)Ah, er...are there no alternatives─ch-choices, options, alternatives? Such as perhaps...surrender? Yes, yes, surrender! We surrender!
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_KOBOLD01320_000_091: (-789th Order Kobolds-)Yes, yes, we surrender─yield, submit, surrender!
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_100: I 'aven't an inklin' as to the whys and wherefores, but it seems the notorious 789th is keen to return their plunder without so much as a fight.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_101: I, for one, wouldn't 'ave been opposed to crackin' a few kobold skulls, but considerin' the strained relations between Limsa and the little buggers these days, who can argue with good diplomacy?
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_102: Anyroad, I'll report back to Commander Bloeidin and arrange for the transport o' the supplies─aye, and with a reliable escort this time.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_SKAETSWYS_000_103: In the meantime, why don't ye ask around and see what ye can learn about our new neighbors? After all, they don't seem 'alf as imposin' as I expected─their leader least of all... Best of luck, . Till sea swallows all!
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_GIGU_000_104: Is the scary woman gone yet? Oh please, please say she is! You must forgive Gi Gu. Yes, Gi Gu and his friends naughty─wicked, nasty, naughty!
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_GIGU_000_110: Y-You are still here!? We have surrendered, yes? Yielded, submitted, surrendered? You will not hurt us, yes?
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_GIGU_000_111: ...Phew. I am relieved─reassured, relaxed, relieved. And who I am, you ask?
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_GIGU_000_112: I am Gi Gu, and Gi Gu is foreman of the 789th. Leader in name, yes, but no more. No, no, no more. For in truth, no one listens to Gi Gu. Gi Gu is ignored─invisible, insulted, ignored...incompetent, too.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_GIGU_000_113: The 789th stole your precious boompowder? Yes, yes, we did. And yet, we had good cause for doing so─an excuse, a reason, a cause.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_GIGU_000_114: Ours is a peaceful order by nature. The 789th troubled no one, and no one troubled us. No, not until now. Now we are driven from the tunnels, exiled to this place that stinks of soil and seawater.
TEXT_BANKOB001_01320_GIGU_000_115: But you are a stranger, and I ramble too much, too soon. No, no, I will speak no more. Go now, and leave Gi Gu to his suffering─his pain, his shame, his suffering.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_000: You are still here, yes? Yes, yes, you are. You would hear the sad tale of Gi Gu and the 789th? Then listen, listen and weep─sob, cry, weep.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_001: You think you people have it tough? You know nothing. No, nothing at all. Ours is a world of kobold-eat-kobold. Yes, ours is a constant struggle─a labor, a toil, a struggle for survival.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_002: Dig and dig, we do─dig for ore and riches. Dig well, and we are rewarded. Better digs are given us, and more weight do our words carry. Dig poorly...and we are shunned─reviled, scorned, shunned.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_003: You know that kobold orders have numbers, yes? Yes, yes, you know. The smaller the number, the greater the order. You find this curious, but this is the kobold way.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_004: How many orders, you ask? Yes, yes, how many? Seven hundred and eighty-nine we have, and not one more. We exist at the backside of kobold society─the bottom, the rear, the backside.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_005: And so from the tunnels we are driven. Dig more, find more, make more wealth for your betters. Then you can come home, they say. But this dry vein holds no treasures. No, no, nothing. Meanwhile, our kin in U'Ghamaro hoard treasures so great that they toss gold away─toss it away like garbage.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_006: Yes, their trash is our treasure! Any moment now, we will be judged on our haul, but our sack is empty─barren, bare, empty. You must go down to the dig and bring back something, anything for us. I beg of you─yes, yes, even the shabbiest scraps will do!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_010: From dawn till dusk, dusk till dawn we dig, and yet our barrows are empty─bare, barren, empty. We are not welcome down below, but you, you will find something for us, yes? Yes, yes, you must!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_011: Could it be? Yes, yes, it could! Why, these dirty lumps─chunks, scraps, lumps─exceed our haul from the past three moons! You have my thanks, adventurer, and my gratitude.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_012: Oh, but you must not leave so soon! No, no, longer you must stay─persist, sojourn, stay. Until Zo Ga has come and gone!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_013: Who is Zo Ga, you ask? Zo Ga is a giant among kobolds─a beast, a brute, a giant! So smart, so smart and strong is Zo Ga, that his order surges to the top of the ranks. Zo Ga would lead us all into a new era of prosperity...or so Zo Ga claims.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_014: But this is a sham. Yes, Zo Ga cares only for Zo Ga. Weak you are? Zo Ga will use you, then throw you away. Yes, Zo Ga stomps all over us─tramples, stamps, stomps. This is why you must stay, adventurer! Stay, and watch over us from the shadows.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_015: The ground trembles─quakes, shakes, trembles! Zo Ga will soon arrive! You must hide and watch over us from the shadows!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_KOBOLDGALA01321_000: (-Comely Kobold Lass-)This place reeks─stinks, smells, reeks!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_KOBOLDGALB01321_000: (-Fetching Kobold Lass-)You said you were takin' us to a steam bath! You're a big fat liar─a cheat, a fraud, a liar!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_ZOGA_000_023: (-Swaggering Kobold-)Stop your bloody squealing! Work before pleasure─or do you want to join the riffraff in their rotten trash heap? No, no, I thought not.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_024: G-Greetings, Zo Ga! How kind of you to visit our humble dig! I must say, you're looking especially impressive today─imposing, overpowering, overwhelming, overbearing, ah...
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_ZOGA_000_025: Yeah, yeah, and you're looking as scruffy as ever...whatever your name was.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_ZOGA_000_026: But enough talk─my time's worth more than your sorry hide. Now let's see what you've got for me...
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_ZOGA_000_027: Is this your monthly haul, or what popped out of your arsehole this morning? Once a sluggard, always a sluggard─stragglers, sloths, sluggards, the lot of you!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_028: The 789th are no sluggards, Zo Ga. No, no, not a one! Every day do we toil in the mines─slave, sweat, toil from dawn, dawn until dusk! Yes, we set down our pickaxes only to eat, to eat and sleep...
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_ZOGA_000_029: Eat...? Sleep...? It seems we have a misunderstanding here─a mistake, a misconception, a misunderstanding...
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_ZOGA_100_029: Sleep? Food? These are luxuries─comforts, indulgences, luxuries.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_ZOGA_000_030: And luxuries, yes, luxuries are for kobolds who can dig their own weight. You earn nothing, you deserve nothing, you are nothing! No rations for a month or until you increase your haul a hundredfold, whichever comes last!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_031: B-But, Zo Ga! We are already weak─weak, weak and hungry! Cut off our food supply, and we will starve, wither, die...
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_ZOGA_000_032: Then die─yes, yes, die! Each day you live, you breathe our air and eat our food, and give nothing in return! You're a parasite, Gi Gu─a leech, a sponge, a parasite. Your very existence keeps us from achieving our potential!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_ZOGA_000_033: But I can think of one way you might be of use. Yes, yes, the shriveled carcasses of you and your lot could feed our furnaces─fodder, fuel, feed for your betters!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_034: Y-You cannot mean what you say, Zo Ga! No, no, this must be some cruel joke─a jest, a...
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_ZOGA_000_035: The only joke around here is you, Gi Gu. I'll not repeat myself this time─a hundredfold! An onze less, and you'll be the first to burn─singe, sizzle, burn!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_ZOGA_000_036: Let's go, ladies. Yes, yes, the stench of sloth─sloth and stupidity─in this dump is making me sick.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_ZOGA_000_039: Remember, ladies: this is the fate of those who don't dig their own weight. Now, I do believe it's time for that steam bath. Heh heh heh...
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_050: Oh, woe is me─misery, misfortune, woe!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_SKAETSWYS_000_051: What in the seven 'ells just 'appened? I come back from Camp Overlook, only to see some overstuffed kobold struttin' around like 'e owns the place.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_052: You are not so wrong. No, no, your words are true. Zo Ga leads the 13th, yes, and has many friends and followers in U'Ghamaro. His power grows with each day. With each day, one less kobold challenges the word of Zo Ga. Soon none will be left to oppose him. No, no, not a one.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_SKAETSWYS_000_053: So what're ye sayin'? That yer just goin' to let that self-styled tyrant walk all over ye?
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_054: Y-Y-Yes? We have no choice─no recourse, no refuge...
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_SKAETSWYS_000_055: What kind of an answer is that!? Ain't ye got a shred o' dignity in yer whole body!?
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_SKAETSWYS_000_057: Look, I don't know yer kobold 'ierarchies from an 'ole in the ground. What I do know is that if anyone talked to me like that, I'd go to the seventh 'ell and back to cut 'im down to size.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_058: But you are strong─bold, brave, strong─and I am...
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_SKAETSWYS_000_059: Llymlaen 'ave mercy! I can't stand to look at the sorry lot of ye! Are ye kobolds, or dormice!?
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_SKAETSWYS_000_060: Look... Ye might not 'ave the spine to stand up for yerselves, but  'ere and I sure as 'ells do. Ain't that right, ? Just tell us where we can find this Zo Ga!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_061: You know not what you say! No, no, you know nothing. It is pure madness to oppose Zo Ga─folly, insanity, madness!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_SKAETSWYS_000_062: The only thing what's drivin' me mad is yer endless wailin'!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_SKAETSWYS_000_063: That settles it! I'm not leavin' this stinkin' 'ole till Zo Ga falls on 'is 'ands and knees before me beggin' for mercy─no ifs, ands, or buts about it!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_SKAETSWYS_000_077: I tell ye, until this day, I'd 'ave sooner skewered a kobold than befriended one, but you lot are just too pathetic to let lie. But don't get too comfortable! If ye don't shape up, I'll throw ye into Zo Ga's furnace meself!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_070: Zo Ga does not suffer opposition lightly. No, not in the least. If we cross him, he will crush us. We are doomed─cursed, damned, doomed!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_071: Oh, adventurer, do not leave us! No, no, you must not go! The Roegadyn woman frightens me even more than Zo Ga─horrifies, terrifies, frightens!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_072: But we have no choice. No, no, we have none. You will protect us from Zo Ga's bullying, yes? Yes, yes, you will...?
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_073: Oh, adventurer, you are too kind─gracious, generous, kind! Yes, yes, kind, and possessing the strength of a hundred kobolds!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_074: Yes, yes, a hundred kobolds! You do not need Gi Gu's help. No, no, you do not! Good luck fighting Zo Ga, adventurer! I await word of your triumph, your victory, your success!
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_075: ...Gi Gu knew it. Gi Gu is alone─abandoned, forsaken, alone.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_GIGU_000_076: Leave us to our misery, adventurer. Yes, we will find some way to manage, we will. But first, Gi Gu needs a nap...
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_SYSTEM_000_080: You have achieved Neutral reputation with the 789th Order.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_SYSTEM_000_081: Kobold society quests are now available from 789th Order Dustman Bo Zu.
TEXT_BANKOB002_01321_SYSTEM_000_082: Furthermore, you may now purchase wares from the 789th Order vendor.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_GIGU_000_000: Oh, adventurer, do honor me with your company for a moment. Yes, yes, let us speak for a while. You have been an absolute godssend to our order─a savior, a saint, a godssend!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_GIGU_000_001: Our barrows have been overflowing with ore since you arrived. Yes, yes, full to the brim. At this pace, a moon from now, you may be speaking to─dare I dream?─788th Order Pickman Gi Gu!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_GIGU_000_002: We shall be the butt of kobold society no more─no, no, never again! Keep up the diligent work, adventurer!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SKAETSWYS_000_003: Can a kobold get any more pathetic!? Maybe if ye got off yer arse and 'elped  for once, ye could dream a little bigger!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_GIGU_000_004: B-But, surely you know the old kobold saying? Yes, yes, slow and steady─
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SKAETSWYS_000_005: Bah, enough of yer blatherin'! ─ye must come with me, and quickly!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SKAETSWYS_000_006: Why, ye say!? I'll tell ye why─Camp Overlook is under attack by the nastiest 'orde o' kobolds I've ever laid eyes on!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SKAETSWYS_000_007: And that's not the least of it. Word 'as it they've got some newfangled weapon that's got Commander Bloeidin and 'is men tearin' their beards out.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SKAETSWYS_000_008: I'm off to join the defense. We can count on ye as well, aye, ?
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_GIGU_000_009: A kobold attack? How terrifying─frightful, horrifying, terrifying! What is it that angers them so? Yes, yes, I wonder...
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_GIGU_000_010: Lucky we are that you are attacked, and not us. Yes, yes, we are fortunate indeed. Well, ah...good luck up there, adventurer!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SKAETSWYS_000_020: There ye are, ! We drove the buggers off, but I fear the damage 'ad already been done...
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SKAETSWYS_000_021: Saw the kobolds' new weapon with me own eyes, I did. A right vicious breed o' bomb that could blow a good-sized vessel out o' the water.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SKAETSWYS_000_022: The sheer 'ate in the beastmen's eyes got me to wonderin'─do ye reckon this is somehow our fault, ?
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SKAETSWYS_000_023: No sooner do we start lendin' our strength to Gi Gu and 'is sorry lot than Camp Overlook suffers its worst kobold assault in years.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SKAETSWYS_000_024: Aye, call it me mariner's intuition, but I'd wager a pirate's booty that Zo Ga is at the 'elm of all this.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SKAETSWYS_000_025: I must remain behind and tend to me comrades. I ask of ye, ─return to Gi Gu and see if me suspicions are true.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SKAETSWYS_000_026: Camp Overlook can't bear to suffer another attack like the last. , get yerself back to Gi Gu and see what that sorry excuse for a kobold knows about this new breed o' bomb.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_KOKKADANA01322_000_: Me ears! The blast was so deafenin' I fear I'll never again hear the sound o' the sea...
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_KOKKADANB01322_000_: I'm no new recruit─aye, I've seen me share o' bombs in me days. Nothing in me worst nightmares could 'ave prepared me for what we faced...
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_KOKKADANC01322_000_: S-Such strength! If this is the new face of our foe, we're as good as done for...
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_GIGU_000_040: Great losses, your camp suffered? This is a pity─a shame, a crime, a pity. Good thing it was not us. Yes, yes, we are lucky indeed.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_GIGU_000_041: A secret new weapon? Such rumors have come our way before. Yes, yes, one of our acolytes overheard Zo Ga speaking of just such a thing.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_GIGU_000_042: You should seek him out. Yes, yes, you must speak to Ba Go. But I warn you, he is an odd one─curious, eccentric, odd...
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_GIGU_000_043: Worry not that Ba Go has been relegated to this forsaken order; his alchemical prowess knows few equals. Once he was a favorite of Zo Ga. Yes, yes, his prized researcher. But then he became a bit too attached to his work...
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BAGO_000_050: Ba Go has been awaiting you─expecting, anticipating, awaiting. Zo Ga's furnace is firing, and you seek Ba Go's aid? Yesss, yesss, you do!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BAGO_000_051: Zo Ga's furnace spits out bombs of prodigious power. Brilliant bombs─breathtaking, beautiful, brilliant! And Ba Go is an old friend of Zo Ga. Yes, yes, old friends, we are...
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BAGO_000_052: But Ba Go will help you. Yes, yes, he will. Why? Because Ba Go enjoys nothing more than watching things go kaboom─kablam, kapow, kaboom! Hahaha! Heeheahhahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BAGO_000_053: Ba Go knows the way to the 13th Order's workshop deep in the bowels of U'Ghamaro. Yes, yes, Ba Go knows of a hidden passage─secret, secluded, hidden.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BAGO_000_054: The passage is guarded closely─guarded night and day. Yet Ba Go has friends in high places. Yes, yes, he does.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BAGO_000_055: Ba Go will gather his lovelies─his beauties, his dears, his lovelies. You will go ahead, to northern Iron Lake, and seek out one Ga Zi. Yes, yes, you will.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BAGO_000_056: My lovelies─my beauties, my dears, my lovelies─it is time to come out and play. Yes, yes, the time for madness and mayhem is nigh! Haha! Heeaheaheahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_DOKANKUN_000_060: Shush! Last time someone woke Zo Ga from his , he had the offender mine an entire ore vein with his fingernails. Yunz wouldn't want that to happen, nuh-uh, nuh-uh.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_DOKANKUN_000_061: Ba Go told me to expect yunzes. Zo Ga's workshop is on the other side of this exhaust pipe. Yunz'll go quickly and quietly─silently, soundlessly, quietly, that sort of thing─and tell no one that I's opened the door, yunz listening?
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_DOKANKUN_000_062: Then begone─run, flee, begone, that sort of thing. If Zo Ga catches me talking to an adventurer, bwom bwom, and yunz won't be seeing Ga Zi no more. Nuh-uh, nuh-uh.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_DOKANKUN_000_063: Ba Go may be surrounded by simpletons, but he knows his craft, uh-huh, uh-huh. Used build his beauties for Zo Ga himself. Yes, that was before the fumes began to take their toll, and he got a bit unbalanced, unhinged, touched in the head.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BAGO_000_070: Ba Go has come, and his lovelies with him. Yes, yes, we have arrived. And yet...what is this? Ba Go hears Zo Ga's lackeys scurrying about.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BAGO_000_071: Ba Go's lovelies are trembling in fear─shivering, shaking, trembling. This will not do─no, no, it will not. You must see to Zo Ga's men before we have our fun. Yes, yes, you must...
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BAGO_000_072: What a shiny furnace─smooth, shimmery, shiny! And what booming, beautiful bombs it must make. Yes, yes, a great invention indeed...
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BALOON_000_081:
You will not leave this place!
No, no, not alive!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BAGO_000_090: Are you ready, my lovelies? Yes, yes, you are... Take them, and gently place them in the furnace─sweetly, tenderly, gently. Then stand back quickly. Yes, yes, with haste.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BAGO_000_091: Take my lovelies, and gently place them in the furnace─sweetly, tenderly, gently. Then stand back quickly. Yes, yes, with haste.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BAGO_000_100: Ahhh, nothing like the smell of a burnt-out furnace in the morning! Or was it the evening? Does it even matter? No, no, it does not.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BAGO_000_101: Ba Go cannot bear to be parted from his lovelies any longer. His heart weeps─cries, sobs, weeps. Yes, yes, we must leave as we came.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BAGO_000_105: This is the way to the surface. Ba Go will return to his lovelies. Yes, yes, he will.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_GIGU_000_110: Are my ears to be believed, adventurer? Zo Ga's furnace sputters─fizzles, smokes, sputters. This is your and Ba Go's doing? Yes, yes, it is!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SKAETSWYS_000_111: Brilliant work, ! With their source of ammunition knocked out o' commission, I reckon the 13th Order won't be comin' back to wreak 'avoc on Camp Overlook any time soon.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SKAETSWYS_000_112: But we've only begun to fight! Aye, we'll not rest until Zo Ga and 'is lickspittles 'ave been driven from U'Ghamaro entirely. Who's with me!?
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BIBI_000_113: Gi Gu! Have you gone mad─barmy, balmy, mad!?
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_GIGU_000_114: B-Bi Bi! What a lovely surprise─a pleasure, a delight, a surprise!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_GIGU_000_116: Oh, my beloved Bi Bi! How I have longed─yearned, pined, longed─to look upon your delicate whiskers, your dainty paws...
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BIBI_000_117: Gi Gu! You and your friends sabotaged Zo Ga's prized furnace, yes? You cannot fool me. No, no, I can see it in your eyes!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SKAETSWYS_000_118: Aye, the girl's a sharp one...
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BIBI_000_119: Zo Ga is on a rampage─a fury, a frenzy, a rampage! He says he'll find the culprit, and toss him into a vat of acid. He will kill you, Zo Ga─yes, yes, he will!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_GIGU_000_120: <gulp> But I'm too young to die! Yes, yes, I am!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BIBI_000_121: Then you must abandon this madness and flee this place─run, take flight, flee!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_GIGU_000_122: Y-Yes, yes, I think I will. It was nice knowing you all. Good-bye, good luck, farewell─
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SKAETSWYS_000_123: Gah! Are ye out o' yer bloody mind!? Ye've come this far, and yer just goin' to leave yer comrades behind? Take one cowardly step, and I'll skewer ye where ye stand!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_GIGU_000_124: Y-Yes, of c-course! I-I will stand and do battle─clash, brawl, battle!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BIBI_000_125: <sigh> You have not changed one bit, Gi Gu. No, no, you are as weak and wishy-washy as ever. Can you not make up your own mind?
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_GIGU_000_126: You are right, Bi Bi. Yes, yes, you are! I will fight, and then run─no, no, run and then fight...?
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BIBI_000_127: I've seen enough of this. Yes, yes, I am through with you. Do what you want, and do it alone─abandoned, unaccompanied, alone.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_GIGU_000_128: Wait, Bi Bi! No, no, you must not go! <sigh> Oh dear, I'm in trouble now...
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SYSTEM_000_130: You have achieved Recognized reputation with the 789th Order.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SYSTEM_000_131: New kobold society daily quests are now available from 789th Order Craftsman Bo Gu.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_SYSTEM_000_132: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from the 789th Order vendor.
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_BAGO_000_140: Yes, nothing like the smell of napalm in the morning─or was it the evening? But who can even tell down here in the depths!? Haha! Heaheahehaehahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB003_01322_DOKANKUN_000_150: Ba Go told me to expect yunzes. Zo Ga's workshop is on the other side of this exhaust pipe. Yunz'll go quickly and quietly─silently, soundlessly, quietly, that sort of thing─and tell no one that I's opened the door, yunz listening?
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SKAETSWYS_000_000: Just the  I was 'opin' to see. I fear ill tidin's drift in from Camp Overlook. Zo Ga and 'is scurvy crew 'ave been quiet─too quiet for the commander's likin', if ye catch me drift.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SKAETSWYS_000_001: Aye, our scouts 'ave reason to believe that they've recovered from their recent setback, and are gatherin' strength for a retaliatory strike.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SKAETSWYS_000_002: I'd speak to Commander Bloeidin meself, but it'd seem 'e's none too pleased with me efforts on the 789th Order's behalf.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SKAETSWYS_000_003: If I know the commander, 'e's far more like to cut an adventurer like yerself some slack. Ye'll travel to Camp Overlook in my stead, won't ye?
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SKAETSWYS_000_004: I fear for the safety of me comrades, but Commander Bloeidin's more likely to gut me than greet me if I show me face at Camp Overlook. You'll go in me stead, won't ye?
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BLOEIDIN_000_010: Oi, . You haven't happened to see my favorite lieutenant around, have you?
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BLOEIDIN_000_011: I'm afeared dear Skaetswys has steered us right into the eye of a storm. <sigh> Our creed might be “till sea swallows all,” but I wouldn't mind if it swallowed her first...
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BLOEIDIN_000_012: Anyroad, you've been workin' with her up till now, right? Good! That means you can help clean up this mess! Now listen, and listen well.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BLOEIDIN_000_013: Me scouts just returned from U'Ghamaro─it seems our friend Zo Ga was so enamored of yer little prank that he's united the most powerful orders in the tunnels under his black flag.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BLOEIDIN_000_014: That's right─scores upon scores o' the buggers haulin' sulphur, saltpeter, and the gods know what else to all corners o' the mountain.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BLOEIDIN_000_015: Aye, there's no doubt in me mind─the bombs that they brandished the last time were only the start of it.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BLOEIDIN_000_016: You and Skaetswys started this by castin' yer lot with the 789th─now ye can get us out o' this. Whatever it takes to keep Zo Ga off our backs until we can bolster our defenses, ye make it happen. Understood?
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BLOEIDIN_000_017: I've seen enough of those bilge rats and their bloody alchemy to last me a lifetime. I'm countin' on ye to clean up this mess, .
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SKAETSWYS_000_020: So it's as I feared. Zo Ga's taken the 'elm at U'Ghamaro, and is brewin' a most nasty sort of revenge.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SKAETSWYS_000_021: But the commander's right. Our fingerprints are all over this mess, so it's our duty to 'elp wipe it up. Yes, we must─
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_GIGU_000_022: Oh, woe is me─misfortune, misery, woe! Please help me, adventurer! Yes, yes, you must!
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SKAETSWYS_000_023: Gah! What are ye yappin' about this time!?
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_GIGU_000_024: My beloved Bi Bi─my dear, my darling, my beloved. She said she would meet me hours ago, but she is nowhere to be found! No, no, nowhere at all!
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_GIGU_000_025: She said she would come by way of the Kobold Dig. If she was caught by Zo Ga, I shudder to think what would happen─tremble, shiver, shudder. You must save her! Yes, yes, you must!
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SKAETSWYS_000_026: You spineless coward! She's yer girl─go yer bloody self!
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SKAETSWYS_000_027: Bah, I'd 'ave better luck squeezin' ale from a stone than talkin' sense into this one. Let's go, .
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_GIGU_000_028: Oh, Bi Bi, be safe. Yes, yes, you must. Without you, I am lost─adrift, astray, lost!
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SKAETSWYS_000_029: Let's go, . With any fortune, this Bi Bi can shed some light on Zo Ga and 'is dark designs.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_KOBOLDA01323_000_04: (-Kobold Outlaw-)Looking for trouble, are you? Yes, yes, you are!
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_KOBOLDB01323_000_04: (-Kobold Outlaw-)We'll gut you─slice you, slash you, gut you!
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BIBI_000_050: Free at last! You are Gi Gu's adventurer friend, yes? Yes, yes, you are.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BIBI_000_051: Hmph! I knew that coward wouldn't have the courage to save me himself. He is useless─hapless, hopeless, useless!
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BIBI_000_052: So scared was I! Yes, yes, I was petrified. I came to deliver these plans, and─hm? The plans! They are gone─missing, vanished, gone!
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BIBI_000_053: What plans? Why, the plans for Zo Ga's new furnace! I must find them, or Zo Ga will punish me. Yes, yes, his wrath knows no bounds!
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BIBI_000_060: Oh, whatever shall I do? Without those plans, I'm as good as dead─slaughtered, butchered, dead!
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BIBI_000_061: Could it be!? Yes, yes, you have found them! This is twice you have saved me, adventurer. So brave you are─daring, dauntless, brave. So different from a certain kobold I know... So different from...me.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BIBI_000_062: Harsh I am to Gi Gu─unkind, unfeeling, harsh─but the truth is, I too lack the heart to stand up to Zo Ga. Yes, yes, I too am a coward.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BIBI_000_063: I too am an alchemist, you see. A skilled one, yes, yes, I am. So what did Zo Ga do? He threatened to exile the 175th from U'Ghamaro unless I did his dirty work.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BIBI_000_064: A furnace, he wanted, but not just any furnace. No, no, a fiery, fearsome, formidable one. A furnace to end all furnaces.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BIBI_000_065: I have no wish to serve Zo Ga. No, no, none at all. What I truly wish is to be happy with Gi Gu─cheerful, content, happy. And yet...and yet...
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BIBI_000_066: ...I simply cannot stand to see him grovel so! No, no, I cannot bear it. I am no better, this I know, but Gi Gu is different. Yes, Gi Gu is a leader of kobolds!
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_BIBI_000_067: I beg of you, adventurer. Yes, yes, I do. Take this to Gi Gu, that it might stir his heart─rouse, shake, stir. If this fails, there is no hope for him. No, no, none at all.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_GIGU_000_070: <sniff> Bi Bi, my beloved─my fair, my darling, my beloved. Will I never gaze upon you again?
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_GIGU_000_071: My Bi Bi is safe? Oh, joy─glee, happiness, joy! And what is this...? A letter?
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_GIGU_000_072: ...What!? Threatening my beloved Bi Bi!? This time Zo Ga has gone too far! This is unforgivable─inexcusable, unpardonable, unforgivable!
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_GIGU_000_073: I will not take this sitting down. No, no, I will take this letter straight to Ba Go, and have him do something immediately!
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_GIGU_000_074: Bi Bi shall see that I am a kobold of action─decision, resolve, action!
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_GIGU_000_075: Gi Gu and the 789th will be a laughingstock no more. No, no, no longer!
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_GIGU_000_076: The scary woman you call friend─she will stand up to Zo Ga with us, yes? Yes, yes, she will.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SKAETSWYS_000_080: Hm, well, I suppose some sign o' life out of 'im is a start.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SKAETSWYS_000_081: Though it'd 'ave been nice if somethin' 'ad put the wind in 'is sails before the poor kobold lass got kidnapped. I swear, what she sees in that one...
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SKAETSWYS_000_082: Don't get me wrong, now─I've fallen for me share of milksops and cravens in me day, always 'opin' they'd make somethin' of 'emselves... An' each time, those selfsame 'opes were betrayed.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SKAETSWYS_000_083: To tell ye the truth, I've 'ad more than me fill of 'elpin' the 'opeless. But one thing's clear─if Zo Ga's plot comes to fruition, it won't just be Gi Gu and 'is lot that pay the price.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SKAETSWYS_000_084: Aye, I say we cut that big bully down to size─not simply for the kobolds' sake, but for our own! Are ye with me, !?
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SYSTEM_000_090: You have achieved Friendly reputation with the 789th Order.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SYSTEM_000_091: New kobold society daily quests are now available from 789th Order Dustman Bo Bu.
TEXT_BANKOB004_01323_SYSTEM_000_092: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from the 789th Order vendor.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_000: Aiyeeeeee! We must flee this place, adventurer─run, dash, flee for our lives!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_001: Why? Because Bi Bi said so, and dare I disobey my dear Bi Bi again? No, no, I dare not.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_002: Why must we flee? She tried to tell me, but I was too horrified to listen─terrified, petrified, horrified! If you would know more, find her and ask yourself. I will be holding my paws over my ears. Yes, yes, I will.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_003: It is not like my Bi Bi to panic so. No, no, it is rare indeed. Whatever has happened, it must be dire─grim, dreadful, dire!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_BIBI_000_010: Adventurer! D-Did you not flee with Gi Gu!? You must leave this place. No, no, it is not safe for─
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_ZOGA_000_012: Well, well...looky what we have here. Stragglers, eh─laggards, strayers, stragglers...
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_KOBOLDGALA01321_000: (-Comely Kobold Lass-)Ewww, a hairless one! Just looking at  makes me want to retch─gag, heave, retch!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_ZOGA_000_014: Bi Bi. I warned you what would happen if you betrayed me, but did you listen? No, no, you didn't...
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_015: ! Are ye─ <gulp> This doesn't look good...
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_016: Z-Zo Ga, please listen─hear, hark, listen!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_ZOGA_000_017: Gi Gu! You and your mangy lot weren't content with a bunch of spongers─leeches, scroungers, spongers. No, no, you would drag down your betters to your sorry standing.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_018: N-No, Zo Ga! No, no, this is not so!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_ZOGA_000_019: Shut your maw! I see the adventurer standing beside you. You are a traitor to the tunnels─a turncoat, a treasonist, a traitor!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_020: Please, Zo Ga! I...I only wanted to go home!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_ZOGA_000_021: Oh, I have a new home for you. Yes, yes, I do... It's cozy, and oh-so-warm─scorching, scalding, warm. Yes, you'll make fine fuel for our flames...
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_ZOGA_000_023: You disappoint me, Bi Bi. Yes, yes, you do. By my side, you could have had power and riches beyond your wildest dreams. Yet you cast your lot with this weakling─this sop, this doormat, this weakling.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_BIBI_000_024: Please, Zo Ga! I will do anything you say! Yes, yes, anything at all! Just spare poor Gi Gu's life!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_025: Bi Bi! No, no, you must not!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_ZOGA_000_026: Anything, you say? Anything at all...? Now here's an astute girl─smart, sharp, astute. Zo Ga can find a job for you. Yes, yes, I can...
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_ZOGA_000_027: A skilled alchemist, you are. Yes, yes, and quite the looker, too. You will slave in my workshop by day and keep me warm by night. Yes, you will.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_ZOGA_000_028: And if I ever catch you slacking off, I'll feed you to the furnace and blast your whole order into the sea. Bwahahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_BIBI_000_029: Gi Gu... Promise you will come for me─swear, vow, promise...?
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_035: That Zo Ga... Talk about gettin' too big for yer britches. Still, I fear for the kobold lass's well-bein'...
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_040: Bi Bi! This is unfair─unreasonable, unjust, unfair!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_041: And it's yer bloody fault as much as anyone's! If ye moved yer legs and paws 'alf as much as ye do yer mouth, maybe ye could 'ave saved the girl from 'er fate.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_042: Bi Bi... <sniff> You speak true─verily, assuredly, true. At last─long, long last─I see the error of my ways. Yes, to save his love, Gi Gu will follow wherever you go.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_043: Finally, yer talkin' some sense! Now, round up yer best men─we're off to U'Ghamaro to take the battle to Zo Ga.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_044: What!? Y-You cannot be serious. This is madness─craziness, lunacy, madness!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_045: “Follow wherever ye go,” eh!? Bloody worthless, ye are! What in the seven 'ells does Bi Bi even see in ye!?
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_046: B-But...you do not understand... No, no, you do not see. Round up my best men? No, no...no kobold will follow a leader as pathetic as me. I am alone─helpless, hopeless, alone.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_BOZU_000_047: It is you who speaks madness, Gi Gu─craziness, lunacy, madness. You know nothing. No, no, nothing at all.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_BOBU_000_048: Listen to us, Gi Gu. Yes, yes, listen well. We are with you─we have always been with you.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_BOGU_000_049: Bo Zu and Bo Bu speak true. Are we jealous of Bi Bi's love for you? Yes, yes, we are. But you are our leader, and you have always led us well. Wherever you go, we will follow faithfully─dutifully, loyally, faithfully.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_050: Bo Zu... Bo Bu... Bo Gu... But I am...I am─
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_051: Yer the leader of the 789th, that's what ye are, and it's 'igh time ye bloody acted the part! Yer friends are countin' on ye, and Bi Bi all the more so! The choice is yers to make─now, what do ye say!?
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_052: I...I will go. Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, YES! Just wait, my precious Bi Bi─Gi Gu is coming to save you!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_053: Music to my bloody ears! I guess men─er, kobolds─can change, after all.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_054: Now listen up!  and I will storm U'Ghamaro from the fore and create a diversion. Gi Gu─ye'll sneak into the workshop the back way and put Zo Ga's new furnace out of commission. Yer fruitcake of a friend Ba Go should be able to furnish us with the tools for the task, aye?
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_055: Amidst all the smoke and clatter, we'll find Bi Bi and return 'er to safety. Now listen, Gi Gu─ and I stand with ye, but this is yer battle. The life and livelihood of you, yer friends, and yer love─it's all in yer grubby paws. Got it? Good! Now let's hear yer battle cry!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_056: <gulp> I... I... Mammyyyyyyyyy! F-Forgive me. You will speak to Ba Go for me, yes? I need a moment to reflect─meditate, contemplate, reflect.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_057: You will go to Ba Go and ask him to ready our tools, yes? I need a moment to gather my strength─my courage, my power, my strength.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_058: Looks like our words finally got through to gutless ol' Gi Gu. It's about bloody time, I say!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_059: Ready yerself, ─there'll be some fireworks in U'Ghamaro tonight. Aye, I've been waitin' for a mission like this ever since I joined the Maelstrom.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_BAGO_000_070: You and Gi Gu will make things go boom? Make mayhem─madness, massacre, mayhem? Ba Go will help. Oh, yesss, yesss, he will!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_BAGO_000_071: Ba Go will give you the biggest, burstingest of Ba Go's beauties. They make very big booms, they do. Yesss, yesss, indeed!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_BAGO_000_072: Zo Ga's workshop...no, no, not just his workshop. All of U'Ghamaro will be reduced to rubble─wreckage, ruin, rubble!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_BAGO_000_073: You will distract Zo Ga's lackeys, help Gi Gu do his deed, yes? Ba Go has a present for you as well─a gift, a boon, a present.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_BAGO_000_074: Take these lovely, lovely little ones. Their size may be trifling, but do not be fooled. No, no. Set them off in succession, and they will make lovely, lovely sparks. Yesss, yesss, they will.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_BAGO_000_075: Ba Go has waited long, long for this day. You will take my lovelies and make big booms and blasts? Make U'Ghamaro go boom, yes?
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_076: Gi Gu has been thinking─pondering, contemplating, thinking. Maybe we can just call this off and stay home, stay safe? No, no, we can't?
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_081: Ye've brought the bombs, aye, ? Good! Let's begin. Ye've got more experience 'andlin' these things than I, so I'll leave the technical side to you. I'll keep lookout for Zo Ga and 'is scurvy 'enchmen.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_080: Aye, that should do the trick 'round 'ere. Now to delve a bit deeper. Follow me!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_091: I'll keep watch, just as before. When yer done plantin' the bombs, ye just say the word.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_090: Looks like our job 'ere is done. The rest is up to Gi Gu─a right 'orrifyin' thought, that.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_100: Zo Ga's workshop lies right beyond this door, and I've already taken the liberty of knockin' out the doorman and relievin' 'im of 'is key. Let's 'op to it, then, eh, ?
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_110: Adventurer! You have come to see Gi Gu do his job, yes? Yes, behold─gaze, regard, behold!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_111: Ah, that should do it, probably...possibly...maybe? You are proud of Gi Gu, yes? Yes, yes, you should be!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_112: Oh, if only Bi Bi could see me now! Yes, she would be smitten─swooning, struck, smitten!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_113: Wh-What was that noise!? Oh, adventurer, we must flee─run, fly, flee─before scary, scary Zo Ga finds us!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_114: What's keepin' that bloody Gi Gu!? That worthless pile o' shite best 'ave found the furnace. 'Cause if 'e's off cowerin' in some corner instead...
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_120: That craven kobold did 'is job, eh? It's a bloody miracle! Now let's get out of 'ere before the whole place comes tumblin' down.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_121: Gi Gu's job is done. Now, we must leave before Zo Ga returns or we are dead for sure─doomed, deceased, dead!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_130: Back to the dig! Yes, quickly, swiftly, briskly!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_ZOGA_000_131: Gi Guuuuuu! I will crush you─smash you, squash you, crush you!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_ZOGA_000_132: In all my years, I have never suffered such indignity! You are finished, Gi Gu! Yes, yes, your bones will feed my furnace!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_133: Stand back, adventurer. No, no, no further.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_134: This is... This is my battle─my fight, my struggle, my battle.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_ZOGA_000_135: Feel the pain, Gi Gu! The hurt...the suffering...the pain!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_136: Ow! Ow! Have mercy, Zo Ga. Yes, yes, have mercy!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_ZOGA_000_137: There will be no mercy for you, Gi Gu! No, no, not ever! You will feel the full brunt of my wrath─my anger, my rage, my wrath!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_ZOGA_000_139: Die─perish, croak, die─like the worthless dreg you are!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_ZOGA_000_141: A sucker for punishment, eh? Yes, yes, you are...
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_BIBI_000_142: Zo Ga! Please stop this─I beg you, beseech you, implore you!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_BIBI_000_143: Gi Gu has suffered enough. Yes, yes, he has.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_BIBI_000_144: You are strong, Zo Ga. Yes, strong and skilled with the pick. You should be leading us to greater heights! Why waste your strength on poor, weak Gi Gu!?
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_148: Yes, yes, be silent! Shut up! Close your bloody maw!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_152: Stand back! Hands off! Get lost! Yes, yes, all of you! I never asked for your help─no, no, not a one of you! This is Gi Gu's battle!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_100_152: See this, Zo Ga? Yes, yes, you do! This is Ba Go's life's work─his magnum opus! It brims with the power to blast you and the whole 13th Order into dust─debris, detritus, dust!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_153: This is for all those years of oppression─insult, abuse, oppression! Yes, yes, Zo Ga...you have walked over Gi Gu for the last time!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_154: Zo Gaaaaaa! I'll see you, see you in the seventh hell!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_ZOGA_000_155: Wh-What!? Gi Gu, what have you...!?
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_160: Thank you, my friends─my comrades, my allies, my friends. It is you─yes, yes, all of you─who gave me the courage to fight that battle. Yes, a battle I should have fought long ago.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_161: Hahaha! I 'ad me doubts, I must admit, but I'm 'appy to say ye proved me wrong. And you, ─this wouldn't 'ave been possible without ye.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_162: With Zo Ga out of the way, the kobolds of U'Ghamaro should quiet down─a development which should please Commander Bloeidin and the Red Swallows. Spent more time in those tunnels than I'd 'ave liked, but all's well that ends well.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_164: Bi Bi! You have come! You are proud of me, yes? Yes, yes, what do you think of your Gi Gu now!?
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_BIBI_000_165: You...you are horrible─terrible, miserable, horrible! I've never been told such hurtful things─no, no, never! What happened to the sweet Gi Gu I used to know!? Good-bye, Gi Gu...<sniff>...farewell...
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_166: I cannot win. No, no, not with her.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_167: But do not worry about Gi Gu─do not fret, do not fuss, do not worry.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_168: Yes, for my battle with Zo Ga has given me new courage─strength, confidence, courage.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_169: I will win back Bi Bi's heart, yes. I will increase our productivity a hundredfold. I will not rest─slack, slumber, rest─until the 789th becomes the 1st!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_170: I will do all this─yes, all this and more! Yes, yes...<yawn>...as soon as I awake from my nap.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_171: ...Perhaps I spoke too soon. Anyroad, there's little more that we can do, . I'll stop off at Camp Overlook. Would ye mind goin' on ahead to Maelstrom Command?
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_172: Aye, the Red Swallows should be right pleased to 'ear of Zo Ga's demise. I'll deliver the news to Commander Bloeidin. In the meantime, what say ye to reportin' back to Maelstrom Command?
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_GIGU_000_173: Gi Gu is relieved that the battle is over─at ease, at peace, relieved. Yes, yes, I think it is time for a well-deserved rest...
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_TRACHRAET_000_180: ! I feared we'd lost ye to the tunnels.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_TRACHRAET_000_181: To think that a single missin' shipment would lead ye on such a circuitous journey through the bowels of U'Ghamaro. I shudder at the thought.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_TRACHRAET_000_182: And yet, though there is still a long road ahead, I daresay yer efforts 'ave gone far in leadin' us down the path o' peace with the kobolds.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_TRACHRAET_000_183: Aye, ye've done Limsa proud this day, my friend─accept this as remuneration for yer deeds. On behalf of the Maelstrom and the Admiral 'erself, I commend ye!
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_200: Never 'ad much of a fondness for kobolds, but after gettin' to know the little buggers better, I must say they're not all 'alf bad. Aye, there may be 'ope for an understandin' between our peoples yet... Mind ye, I wouldn't 'old me breath waitin'.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SYSTEM_200_190: You have achieved Trusted reputation with the 789th Order.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SYSTEM_200_191: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from the 789th Order vendor.
TEXT_BANKOB005_01324_SKAETSWYS_000_210: Zo Ga's workshop is just beyond this door. Come, ─we'd best go and make sure Gi Gu isn't off cowerin' in a corner somewhere.
TEXT_BANKOB101_01325_BOZU_000_000: Zo Ga is true to his word. He has halved─yes, yes, cut in two─the 789th's ration allotment as punishment for our low yield. I am starving─ravenous, famished, starving! What, oh what, is a hungry kobold to do?
TEXT_BANKOB101_01325_BOZU_000_001: Work harder, you say? But that sounds so tiring─grueling, taxing, tiring. I have a better plan. Yes, yes, a better plan, I have. Scraps of ore near Iron Lake, I saw. I was too tired to pick them up, but not you. No, no, not you.
TEXT_BANKOB101_01325_BOZU_000_002: You should gather them and take them to Camp Overlook, yes, yes. Tell the officer there you stole them from the naughty, naughty kobolds. As reward, you'll get tasty food, which you can bring to Bo Zu. Then we'll feast─gobble, gorge, feast!
TEXT_BANKOB101_01325_BOZU_000_003: No food yet? Do hurry─my belly is rumbling─grumbling, mumbling, rumbling. You bring ore to Camp Overlook, then bring back food in return. You will do this for Bo Zu, yes? Yes, yes, you will.
TEXT_BANKOB101_01325_KOKKADAN01_100_010: What's that? Plundered some precious metals from the kobolds that ye'd donate to our cause?
TEXT_BANKOB101_01325_KOKKADAN01_000_010:
Aye, the Maelstrom is fortunate indeed to 'ave capable allies like─
...Byregot's buttocks! These must be the sorriest dregs of ore I've ever 'ad the misfortune of layin' me eyes on.
TEXT_BANKOB101_01325_KOKKADAN01_000_011: Yer reward!? How about this: I'll give ye some leftover scraps from last night's dinner, and you'll promise to go away and not waste any more of me time. Deal?
TEXT_BANKOB101_01325_KOKKADAN01_000_012: Beggin' for slop doesn't become ye, friend. If this adventurin' thing doesn't work out for ye, the Maelstrom is always lookin' for a few good . It's a hard life, but at least ye always know where yer next meal is comin' from.
TEXT_BANKOB101_01325_BOZU_000_020: You have brought my meal!? Yes, yes, tell me you have! Bo Zu's belly rumbles, rumbles so loud that it almost caused a cave-in─a collapse, a rockfall, a cave-in!
TEXT_BANKOB101_01325_BOZU_000_021: Oh, this will be a meal to savor─relish, delight, savor! Yes, yes, it is as Gi Gu always says─no treat is tastier than that earned by the efforts of others.
TEXT_BANKOB102_01326_BOZU_000_000: The unfairness─injustice, iniquity, unfairness of it all!
TEXT_BANKOB102_01326_BOZU_000_001: While the 789th goes famished─starving, hungry, famished─Zo Ga and his cronies feast! Feast on lunchpots packed, yes, so packed with tasty treats that a single one could feed our entire dig for a week.
TEXT_BANKOB102_01326_BOZU_000_002: Should Zo Ga and his hardworking cronies get all the rewards? No, no, a hundred times no! Yes, our tummies are rumbling─grumbling, mumbling, rumbling─as much as theirs!
TEXT_BANKOB102_01326_BOZU_000_003: Why, I have a notion─a thought, a mind, a notion─to walk right over to Iron Lake and snatch one or three for myself. But walking is hard work. Yes, yes, and your legs are so much  than mine...
TEXT_BANKOB102_01326_BOZU_000_004: You will walk to Iron Lake and bring back three of Zo Ga's luscious lunchpots, yes? I am beside myself in drooling anticipation─dribbling, driveling, drooling anticipation!
TEXT_BANKOB102_01326_BOZU_000_010: Do I smell what I think I smell? Yes, yes, I believe I do!
TEXT_BANKOB102_01326_BOZU_000_011: Freshly plucked lava toad legs? Earthworms that still wriggle and squirm? This is more than a meal, it is a feast─a banquet, a spread, a feast for the senses!
TEXT_BANKOB102_01326_BOZU_000_012: Does sampling the delights of his peers inspire Bo Zu to work harder? No, no, never! Why would it, when I have  friends like you?
TEXT_BANKOB103_01327_BOZU_000_000: Oh, I've done it this time! Yes, yes, I have. He will roast me─burn me, scorch me, roast me alive!
TEXT_BANKOB103_01327_BOZU_000_001: Who will? Ba Go will, with cackles, cackles and glee, for I snacked on the fingers of some of his beauties. Yes, yes, I did. But who can blame poor, hungry Bo Zu? Not you─no, no, not you.
TEXT_BANKOB103_01327_BOZU_000_002: Please, adventurer! You must bring fiery fingers to Ba Go's workshop before he comes hunting for Bo Zu. You would not want to see poor Bo Zu burn, would you? No, no, you...probably shouldn't answer that.
TEXT_BANKOB103_01327_BOZU_000_003: Please, adventurer! You must bring fiery fingers to Ba Go's workshop before he comes hunting for Bo Zu. You would not want to see poor Bo Zu burn, would you? No, no, you...probably shouldn't answer that.
TEXT_BANKOB103_01327_BAGO_000_020: My beauties, dismembered again! I will burn every last hair from Bo Zu's body─yes, yes, Bo Zu will sear, sizzle, burn!
TEXT_BANKOB103_01327_BAGO_000_021: Fire fingers, you bring? To me, you say, from Bo Zu? Hah! That is a good laugh─cackle, chortle, laugh. In many, many years I have not seen Bo Zu lift a paw in the name of honest work. No, no, not a one.
TEXT_BANKOB103_01327_BAGO_000_022: I will not so easily forgive Bo Zu─no, no, never─but my poor, fingerless beauties demand my attention. Deliver to Bo Zu a warning─a caution, a threat, a warning. The next time he snacks in my workshop will be the last!
TEXT_BANKOB103_01327_BOZU_000_030: Oh, thank you, adventurer! Ba Go said what!? <gulp> Tell me you jest─joke, tease, jest.
TEXT_BANKOB103_01327_BOZU_000_031: But Bo Zu has learned his lesson. Besides, fire fingers are not easy on Bo Zu's belly─no, no, they make Bo Zu's belly burn. Yes, yes, Bo Zu's mind understands, but will his belly listen? This Bo Zu does not know...
TEXT_BANKOB104_01328_BOZU_000_000: Riddle me, puzzle me, answer me this, adventurer: what is the difference between six-thirty-nine and seven-eighty-nine? Fifteen tens, and no more. No, no, not a one more.
TEXT_BANKOB104_01328_BOZU_000_001: Yet the 639th thumb their nostrils at us like we are lesser kobolds─inferior, lower, lesser. Bo Zu will not stand for this, and neither will you. No, no, neither will you!
TEXT_BANKOB104_01328_BOZU_000_002: You must give the 639th's blustering boss a good pounding─a hammering, a battering, a pounding. You will find him around Iron Lake, though you may have to beat up a few of his men to draw his attention. Yes, yes, that is the way.
TEXT_BANKOB104_01328_BOZU_000_003: The good-for-nothing 639th thumb their noses at us like we are lesser kobolds─inferior, lower, lesser. Bo Zu will not stand for this, and neither will you. No, no, neither will you!
TEXT_BANKOB104_01328_BOZU_000_004: You must give the 639th's blustering boss a good pounding─a hammering, a battering, a pounding. You will find him around Iron Lake, though you may have to beat up a few of his men to draw his attention. Yes, yes, that is the way.
TEXT_BANKOB104_01328_BOZU_000_010: Smashing, bashing, dashing work! Now those cretins know that fifteen tens make no matter. No, no, what matters is how strong an adventurer you know.
TEXT_BANKOB104_01328_BOZU_000_011: Just watching you makes me feel strong─sturdy, stout, strong─strong enough to pummel that puffed-up taskmaster myself! But I will let you do it. Yes, yes, it hurts much less that way.
TEXT_BANKOB104_01328_POPMESSAGE_000_000: A burly kobold swaggers to the scene!
TEXT_BANKOB104_01328_BALLOON_000_020:
You'll answer for this, overdweller.
Yes, yes, you'll pay!
TEXT_BANKOB105_01329_BOZU_000_000: They're going to blow─burst, blast, blow! Who? Three of Ba Go's beauties, yes, yes, that is who!
