TEXT_BANKOB105_01329_BOZU_000_001: And not just any beauties─no, no, they are the mothers of all beauties. Ba Go's very first creations. Ba Go spends too much time with his newest creations, and their mothers are not happy─no, no, not happy at all.
TEXT_BANKOB105_01329_BOZU_000_002: They escape to Iron Lake, where they seethe with anger─fume, swell, seethe─and Ba Go is too smitten with his newfound lovelies to notice. You must cool their ire, yes, and bring their cores back to me. You bring them to me, and I bring them to Ba Go, that gentler beauties may be born.
TEXT_BANKOB105_01329_BOZU_000_003: Three of Ba Go's beauties have escaped to Iron Lake. Yes, they seethe with anger─fume, swell, seethe─and Ba Go is too smitten with his newfound lovelies to notice. You must cool their ire, yes, and bring their cores back to me, that gentler beauties may be born.
TEXT_BANKOB105_01329_BOZU_100_020: You return with the cores─yes, yes you do?
TEXT_BANKOB105_01329_BOZU_000_020: You have my gratitude, adventurer─my thanks, my appreciation, my gratitude. The last time Ba Go's beauties escaped, they almost burned poor Bo Zu's nose off. Yes, yes, they did.
TEXT_BANKOB105_01329_BOZU_000_021: Bo Zu thinks Ba Go has more beauties than he knows what to do with. Maybe these cores are better kept here─yes, kept safe and quiet in the hands of Bo Zu...
TEXT_BANKOB105_01329_POPMESSAGE_000_000: The breeding bomb fumes with jealousy!
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_BOZU_000_000: Those scoundrels─rogues, knaves, scoundrels! This is unforgivable! No, no, it will not be forgiven!
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_BOZU_000_001: For so long─yes, so many moons─did they rival us at the bottom of the ranks─the hind, the rear, the bottom. Now, they have risen all the way to 596th!
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_BOZU_000_002: And do you know how they have done this? Through─<gasp>─effort! Effort, and honest work! The utter gall─nerve, insolence, gall!
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_BOZU_000_003: Even now, they dig, dig day and night at a vein that affords ore by the tonze─more ore than 789th sees in a year! This shameless ambition must be stopped! Ba Go will know what to do. Yes, yes, you must seek Ba Go. Ba Go always knows.
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_BOZU_000_004: Even now, the 596th digs, digs day and night. Their industriousness makes me sick─ill, queasy, sick! But Ba Go will know what to do about this. Ba Go, he always knows.
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_BAGO_000_010: Bo Zu would make big booms at the 596th Order Dig, send them plummeting down the ranks─diving, plunging, plummeting? Ba Go likes this plan. Yes, yes, likes it much.
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_BAGO_000_011: And you will help? Ba Go likes you too. Yes, Ba Go likes you so much he will lend you some of his beauties. And you will treat them gently─sweetly, kindly, gently.
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_BAGO_000_012: Ba Go will also give you smolder stones. Find something you want to go boom, place smolder stones close. Then step back. Yes, yes, stand clear. Release Ba Go's beauties, and savor the smell of chaos─relish, enjoy, savor.
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_BAGO_000_013: But Ba Go does not help you without a condition. No, no, after beauties go boom, you must enter the flames and come out with one of their cores.
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_BAGO_000_014: Ba Go needs all the cores he can get to build more beauties, make more things go boom. Yes, yes, make many, many booms! Heahehe! Heaahheahahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_BAGO_000_015: Find something you want to go boom, and place smolder stone close. Then step back. Yes, yes, stand clear. Release Ba Go's beauties, and savor the smell of chaos─relish, enjoy, savor.
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_BAGO_000_016: From the chaos, you will bring back a core for Ba Go. With it, Ba Go will build more beauties, make more things go boom. The more booms, the happier is Ba Go. And you want to keep Ba Go happy. Yes, yesss, you do! Heahehe! Heaahheahahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_BAGO_000_020: Ba Go's beauties make beautiful, beautiful booms, yes? And you have present for Ba Go? Yes, yes, you do.
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_BAGO_000_021: Such a lovely, lovely core. Yes, Ba Go's next batch of beauties will be beautiful indeed, won't they? Yesss, yesss, they will!
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_BAGO_000_022: You're still here? Go, go, go back to Bo Zu, and leave me to my lovelies─my beauties, my darlings, my lovelies.
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_BOZU_000_030: The adventurer has done well, well has  done. Blasts and bursts were heard all the way from here. Yes, yes, they were heard!
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_BOZU_000_031: The 596th will learn that hard work is futile─pointless, fruitless, futile. Well will they learn the lesson─yes, the lesson we learned long ago.
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_BOZU_000_032: Should they ever forget this lesson, you must return to play teacher─mentor, instructor, teacher. This you can do, yes? Yes, yes, Bo Zu can trust you.
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_POPMESSAGE_000_001: There is a rush of heat from among the embers!
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_KOBOLD01330_000_040:
(-596th Order Scout-)You! Yes, you!
What are you doing there!?
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_KOBOLD01330_000_041:
(-596th Order Scout-)We toiled long and hard for those!
Labored, troubled, toiled!
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_KOBOLD01330_000_042:
(-596th Order Scout-)Leave those alone! Yes, yes, do not touch!
Zo Ga will crush us, smash us, squash us!
TEXT_BANKOB106_01330_BALLOON_000_050:
What's this!?
What, what, I say!
TEXT_BANKOB107_01331_BOZU_000_000: Those cheats─tricksters, fraudsters, cheats! They must pay for this. Yes, yes, pay they must, and pay they will!
TEXT_BANKOB107_01331_BOZU_000_001: Who are they? The 639th is who! Once, they were as devoted to idleness and indolence as us─yes, yes, they were. Now, they dig and dig. Dig for riches, and for the favor of Zo Ga!
TEXT_BANKOB107_01331_BOZU_000_002: They use new rock eater to open walls, find metals so shiny they would blind Bo Zu's eyes. A shameless display of effort─brazen, flagrant, shameless! No, no, Bo Zu will not stand for this.
TEXT_BANKOB107_01331_BOZU_000_003: I will teach them that hard work does not pay. I, meaning you. Yes, yes, you and Ba Go. The two of you will know what to do.
TEXT_BANKOB107_01331_BOZU_000_004: I will teach the 639th that hard work does not pay. I, meaning you. Yes, yes, you and Ba Go. The two of you will know what to do.
TEXT_BANKOB107_01331_BOZU_000_010: Bo Zu would make 639th's new rock eater go boom? So it is with Bo Zu. No respect for the work of others─no esteem, no regard, no respect.
TEXT_BANKOB107_01331_BOZU_000_011: Ba Go does not like Bo Zu─no, no, not in the least─but he does like making things go boom. Yesss, yesss, he does!
TEXT_BANKOB107_01331_BOZU_000_012: Ba Go will give you the most potent of his beauties─yes, yes, he will. Place these fire rocks near the rock eater, and let Ba Go's beauties do the rest. Oh, and remember to stand back─far, far, back. Or maybe─mayhap, possibly, maybe─you want to go boom, too? Heaheahehaehahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB107_01331_BOZU_000_014: Ba Go will give you the most potent of his beauties─yes, yes, he will. Place these fire rocks near the rock eater, and let Ba Go's beauties do the rest. Oh, and remember to stand back─far, far, back. Or maybe─mayhap, possibly, maybe─you want to go boom, too? Heaheahehaehahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB107_01331_BOZU_000_030: The sound of the digger going boom woke me up from my nap. Never─no, never─have I been happier to have my rest disturbed─disrupted, interrupted, disturbed!
TEXT_BANKOB107_01331_BOZU_000_031: Bo Zu bears no ill will for the 639th─no, no, none at all. I only wish for them to remember the merits of sluggardy─idleness, sloth, sluggardy. Is this so much to ask?
TEXT_BANKOB108_01332_BOZU_000_000: Bo Zu has been a sluggard─a loafer, a slacker, a sluggard. But Bo Zu would be a sluggard no more─no, no, no more!
TEXT_BANKOB108_01332_BOZU_000_001: Gi Gu says that the 639th finds shiny metals─yes, yes, the shiniest. Could this be true? The 639th was once as shabby as us─ratty, scruffy, shabby.
TEXT_BANKOB108_01332_BOZU_000_002: If the 639th can find shinies, then why not me? Yes, yes, why not me? Bo Zu can strike it rich, too!
TEXT_BANKOB108_01332_BOZU_000_003: But I would know for certain─for true, for sure, for certain. You will go to the dig, yes? Bring back proof of the 639th's accomplishments for Bo Zu? Yes, yes, this you must do!
TEXT_BANKOB108_01332_BOZU_000_004: I would know for certain─for true, for sure, for certain. You will go to the dig, yes? Bring back proof of the 639th's accomplishments for Bo Zu? Yes, yes, this you must do!
TEXT_BANKOB108_01332_BOZU_000_010: Adventurer brings back shinies, yes? From the 639th to Bo Zu?
TEXT_BANKOB108_01332_BOZU_000_011: See how it sparkles─shines, glimmers, sparkles! The 639th has dug up a fortune. Yes, yes, they strike true!
TEXT_BANKOB108_01332_BOZU_000_012: Surely...they will not miss a shiny─no, no, not a shiny or two. Thank you─yes, thank you, adventurer! For today, wealth has also come to Bo Zu!
TEXT_BANKOB109_01333_BOZU_000_000: Adventurer, how glad, glad I am to see you come. Ba Go is having a situation─a plight, a predicament, a situation─and what is trouble for Ba Go is trouble for us all. Bo Zu does not know much, but this Bo Zu knows. Yes, yes, I know.
TEXT_BANKOB109_01333_BOZU_000_001: Bo Zu would like nothing more than to help his friend Ba Go─nothing, nothing at all. But Bo Zu's help is unwelcome─unsought, undesired, unwelcome. This makes Bo Zu sad, but what can Bo Zu do? Only send you─yes, yes, Bo Zu will send you.
TEXT_BANKOB109_01333_BOZU_000_002: Bo Zu would like nothing more than to help his friend Ba Go─nothing, nothing at all. But Bo Zu's help is unwelcome─unsought, undesired, unwelcome. This makes Bo Zu sad, but what can Bo Zu do? Only send you─yes, yes, Bo Zu will send you!
TEXT_BANKOB109_01333_BAGO_000_010: Bo Zu sent you to me, he did? You will not eat my beauties' fingers and make my workshop go boom-boom like that one did? No, no, you will not?
TEXT_BANKOB109_01333_BAGO_000_011: Then maybe you can be of assistance─help, aid, assistance. With some of my beauties did I have a disagreement─a spat, a fight, a disagreement. Fled my workshop, they did, fled to Iron Lake where they seethe and sizzle and speak ill of Ba Go.
TEXT_BANKOB109_01333_BAGO_000_012: You will tell them Ba Go is sorry for what he said, yes? They are not getting fat─no, no─they are as slender, slim, and beautiful as ever. They will come back to Ba Go, yes? Ba Go implores of them─begs, beseeches, implores.
TEXT_BANKOB109_01333_BAGO_000_013: You will go to Iron Lake and bring runaway beauties back to Ba Go, yes? Tell them Ba Go is sorry for everything he said? Ba Go is nothing without his beauties...<sniff>...no, no, nothing.
TEXT_BANKOB109_01333_SYSTEM_000_015: The pygmy bomb is fuming with rage. Soothe it and convince it to return home to its master.
TEXT_BANKOB109_01333_SYSTEM_000_016: The pygmy bomb is not amused. Soothe it and convince it to return home to its master.
TEXT_BANKOB109_01333_BAGO_000_020: My beauties...my beauties return! Oh, glorious day! Ba Go was lost without you─wayward, astray, lost. Yes, yes, he was!
TEXT_BANKOB109_01333_BAGO_000_021: Ba Go was a fool─a dolt, a dimwit, a fool! Foolish Ba Go will do anything you desire! Yes, yes, just promise you will never leave Ba Go's side ag─hm? Can't you see we are having a personal moment here, adventurer? Yes, yes, go back and bother Bo Zu.
TEXT_BANKOB109_01333_BOZU_000_030: <sigh> That is Ba Go for you─no eye for anything but booms and beauties. He may not call Bo Zu friend, but does this change Bo Zu's feelings? No, no, never.
TEXT_BANKOB109_01333_BOZU_000_031: I cannot speak for Ba Go─no, no, I cannot─but Bo Zu will not forget your kindness. Yes, Bo Zu will always remember who to ask when he needs something done. Yes, yes, I will!
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_BOZU_000_000: Shiny metals are not easy to find─no, no, hide from Bo Zu's pick, they do. When I tire of working, I fill my sack with rocks and rubble instead. Does inspector notice? Not until Bo Zu is far away─far, far in the distance. Yes, Bo Zu is sharp like that─smart, quick, sharp.
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_BOZU_000_001: 411th Order metalworkers are not so sharp. No, no, they are dull indeed. They would smelt my ore in their furnace. Do they not realize the perils of such an action─the dangers, the risks, the perils?
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_BOZU_000_002: No, no, their recklessness must be stopped─halted, disrupted, stopped─and now. Fortunately, Bo Zu knows exactly what must be done─precisely, specifically, exactly.
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_BOZU_000_003: We must use Ba Go's beauties to make furnace go boom. That will teach the futility of expecting real work from Bo Zu─the pointlessness, the fruitlessness, the futility. Yes, yes, that will teach them to let Bo Zu be Bo Zu.
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_BOZU_000_004: We must use Ba Go's beauties to make furnace go boom. That will teach the futility of expecting real work from Bo Zu─the pointlessness, the fruitlessness, the futility. Yes, yes, that will teach them to let Bo Zu be Bo Zu.
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_BAGO_000_010: Bo Zu would make furnace go boom, hide his trickery? Ba Go cares not for the dustman's fate─no, no, cares not at all─but needs no excuse for fiery fulminations. Yes, yes, Ba Go will help you.
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_BAGO_000_011: Ba Go will introduce you to his most buxom beauty. Beautiful indeed she is, yes, if a bit testy─ill-tempered, irascible, testy.
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_BAGO_000_012: You would be wise to escort her to your destination with speed─haste, quickness, speed. Yes, yes─you will be wise, or you will be the one to go boom. Haha! Heaheaheahehahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_BAGO_000_013: And your task does not end when the furnace blows its top─no, no, it has only begun. You must bring Ba Go's beauty back, bring back what remains of her─her essence, her soul, her core.
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_BAGO_000_014: But be forewarned─advised, cautioned, forewarned─Ba Go's beauties often have a mind of their own. Yes, yes, they do...
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_BAGO_000_015: You must bring Ba Go's beauty to your destination with speed─haste, quickness, speed. Yes, yes─you will go quickly, or you will go boom. Haha! Heaheaheahehahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_BAGO_000_016: But your task does not end when the furnace blows its top─no, no, it has only begun. You must bring Ba Go's beauty back, bring back what remains of her─her essence, her soul, her core. But be forewarned: she has a mind of her own. Yes, yes, she does.
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_BAGO_000_017: Adventurer is looking ashen─dusty, smoldery, ashen. Ba Go's beauty went boom on adventurer? Yes, yes, she did? Haha! Heahehaheaehahaha! Ba Go will give adventurer another beauty, if adventurer would make more booms. Yes, yes, more booms!
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_BAGO_000_018: Adventurer returns empty-handed? Yes, yes,  does? Adventurer would suffer same fate as Bo Zu? No, no,  would not? Then adventurer should retrace  steps─retread, repeat, retrace─and return with Ba Go's beauty.
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_BAGO_000_020: Where is she? Yes, where is Ba Go's beauty?
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_BAGO_000_021: Ba Go's beauty returns─yes, yes, she does. Many booms were had, yes? Many shouts, many cries, many screams?
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_BAGO_000_022: And who are you again? You are who? Bo Zu's friend? Go back to Bo Zu, and tell him next time he bothers me, he will be the one to go boom. Heahehahehaehahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_BOZU_000_030: The 411th's furnace is no more? Bo Zu thanks you for your aid. You are a friend to slugs and slubbers everywhere─an ally, a patron, a friend.
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_BOZU_000_031: Yes, yes, Bo Zu can look forward to many, many days of rest─rest and relaxation. You will linger close by, yes─stay, sojourn, linger? Today is a happy day, happy indeed!
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_POPMESSAGE_000_001: There is a rush of heat from among the embers!
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_SYSTEM_000_040: You are not carrying the specified object. Return to the starting point and reattempt the delivery.
TEXT_BANKOB110_01334_SYSTEM_100_052: Transport the limpet bomb to the specified location at Iron Lake before it detonates. Be wary of attacks from enemies, which will sap your strength. Should you fail to complete the task in time, the bomb will explode and you will suffer damage.
TEXT_BANKOB201_01335_BOGU_000_000: Adventurer, oh, adventurer, we are in trouble, yes, trouble─a pickle, a mess, trouble! Inspectors from the 271st Order are coming to see that all is well with this dig.
TEXT_BANKOB201_01335_BOGU_000_001: Pointless it is to turn diligent now, yes, yes. But the adventurer can distract the inspectors, make them too busy being dead to pry into our business!
TEXT_BANKOB201_01335_BOGU_000_002: Bo Gu has been thinking in between breaks and lunches─plotting, scheming, thinking! This bang toss of Bo Gu's own making, the adventurer will toss as the skulking inspectors pass near─sniffing, prying, skulking!
TEXT_BANKOB201_01335_BOGU_000_003: After the toss comes a bang, yes, yes! The inspectors will come running, the running inspectors will come! Then, confusion─havoc, tumult, confusion! A quick slice and dice, and no more inspection!
TEXT_BANKOB201_01335_BOGU_000_004: Adventurer will set off the bang toss! When the inspectors come running, ambush them, yes, yes! Much ambush will there be, of those who dare come to look and see!
TEXT_BANKOB201_01335_BOGU_000_020: Oh, the adventurer knows the art of the kill─slice, dice, kill! Bo Gu should not have worried, no. Inspectors deserve to die again for making Bo Gu's nights sleepless!
TEXT_BANKOB201_01335_BOGU_000_021: How welly-well that went─clean, smooth, welly-well. Much better than putting nose to grindstone or cooking the books. Bo Gu feels much better about the next inspection! We will kill again, yes, yes!
TEXT_BANKOB201_01335_BALLOON_000_030: Who's setting off bombs on company time? Who!?
TEXT_BANKOB201_01335_BALLOON_000_032: What's the meaning of this─the gist, intent, meaning!?
TEXT_BANKOB202_01336_BOGU_000_000: Zo Ga do I hate, yes, yes, that Zo Ga is truly worthy of my loathing. It is unfair─inequitable, deranged, unfair─that he should have so much gil for all that work he does. Ugh!
TEXT_BANKOB202_01336_BOGU_000_001: Now I hear he has recruited a pickman of note─renown, respect, note! This Be Ze is not like miners of our dear 789th, no. This one has struck vein after vein of soft and shiny gold! Gold is his gift, yes, yes.
TEXT_BANKOB202_01336_BOGU_000_002: They say he'll not work for just any fugleman. They say he serves only kobolds of great acumen. Well, they can go sup on hot candle wax and die in the privy! With this master pickman serving him, Zo Ga will prosper─flourish, thrive, prosper!
TEXT_BANKOB202_01336_BOGU_000_003: We cannot allow this, no, no. But lucky for us, a dead master has no gifts! No difference between clever dead and dafty dead, except it vexes more to lose a good thing. Yes, Zo Ga will be vexed─chagrined, annoyed, vexed!
TEXT_BANKOB202_01336_BOGU_000_004: The adventurer is not convinced,  is not persuaded to this cause. Will the adventurer take the gil but not do the deed? A proof, yes, yes, a proof you shall bring!
TEXT_BANKOB202_01336_BOGU_000_005: Loathsome Zo Ga paid Be Ze a healthy sum─yes, yes, one Titan mythrilshield─when the pesky pickman joined his dig, a gift he gave him for the seams he would find. The adventurer will bring this coin─perhaps covered in innocent ichor?
TEXT_BANKOB202_01336_BOGU_000_010: The adventurer returns from the slaughter, from the killing  is coming! Does  bring a token─sign, proof, token?
TEXT_BANKOB202_01336_BOGU_000_011: The proof, yes, yes! As good as your word you have been, yes, you are to be trusted with murders most foul! Perhaps even Zo Ga himself someday...
TEXT_BANKOB202_01336_BOGU_000_012: Horrible, he is, that Zo Ga! Burrows in the richest seams like a tick at a teat, and won't share with us who come late and do no work!
TEXT_BANKOB202_01336_BOGU_000_013: But the adventurer has given me some food for thought...food, yummy food. Everything Zo Ga has can go splat or boom, smooth or chunky. There is much hope, yes, yes, Zo Ga has much cause for concern!
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_BOGU_000_000: Bo Gu's bad knee is hurting so─aching, throbbing, hurting. Bo Gu cannot go hither and thither , no inclination have I to move an ilm, no!
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_BOGU_000_001: This causes a problem, a problem we must solve, yes. 789th Order Acolyte Ba Go was promised help, I swore to do a service for him. The adventurer will not let Ba Go and Bo Gu down? No, the adventurer will not!
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_BOGU_000_002: Bo Gu's poor elbow, the gout─what? The adventurer is unkind, all knees are elbows for the children of Titan! A good job you must do for the acolyte now, to make up for questioning my honesty─improbity, mendacity, honesty!
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_BOGU_000_003: The adventurer must do for Acolyte Ba Go what Bo Gu cannot, yes, yes! We must protect my poor, gouty joints lest they burst like rotten fruit─plorp, splat, burst!
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_BAGO_000_010: Ba Go knew someone would be shirking─dodging, malingering, shirking, Ba Go knows everything. Yes, yes, Ba Go has special powers. Haha! Heehea!
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_BAGO_000_011: Ba Go had a dream, a sweet dream about limbs that go boom. Ba Go wants an arm of a hot grenade. The grenades don't like Ba Go, though, they are scared of Ba Go's experiments─affrighted, daunted, scared...
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_BAGO_000_012: So Ba Go made a brazier out of castoffs. Ba Go knows how it feels to be used and discarded─a friend he is to cast-offs, haha! And this brazier you will light while Ba Go waits right here.
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_BAGO_000_013: Use this live coal on the steel brazier at Iron Lake, yes, yes. To Iron Lake you will go to make a bonfire, and draw the warm grenades. Haha! Heeheahhahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_BAGO_000_014: Now the pretty part, yes, yes. You'll slay the warm grenades in a blistering fray, make a nice hot zone for the hot grenade. When it comes, lop off its arm, its arm I must have, yes, yes. Why are hot grenades drawn to a hot mess? Why do the Qiqirn suck eggs?
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_BAGO_000_015: A steel brazier at Iron Lake, you must light it with this bit of smoldering coal, yes, yes. The bonfire will draw cranky warm grenades, make things hot and red─crimson, bloody, red...
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_BAGO_000_016: It's the hot grenade Ba Go wants, the hot grenade will come when the mayhem's primed. Do you want to die in a fire? No, no? Then don't ask nicely, just cut off its arm─chop, slice, cut!
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_BAGO_000_020: Does Ba Go have long to wait? Is the hot grenade arm coming soon? Haha! Heeheahhahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_BAGO_000_021: An arm of the hot grenade, a limb that goes boom, yes, yes. Heeheahhaha, you're not scared of Ba Go and his lovelies, are you? Bo Gu is, though, Ba Go can tell. The craftsman knows that Ba Go has funny dreams about him...
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_BOGU_000_030: We helped the acolyte, our promise is kept, yes, yes. And the adventurer is unscathed─unsinged, conscious, unscathed! If only Bo Gu hadn't eaten that bad shrimp, and been able to fetch the arm himself!
TEXT_BANKOB203_01337_BOGU_000_031: Eh? Ignorant adventurer! Shrimp causes gout, everybody knows, yes, yes. Dangerous, nasty things they are, and I work hard to keep them out of others' reach. Now Bo Gu must bid you farewell, the  gong will sound, and there is precious little food to go around!
TEXT_BANKOB204_01338_BOGU_000_000: That Zo Ga, he is up to his usual tricks again, always innovating is Zo Ga. His dig will begin using two new bomb incubators, yes, yes, new─latest, shiny, new.
TEXT_BANKOB204_01338_BOGU_000_001: An incubator is oh-so-convenient, an iron goose laying bomb after bomb, yes, yes. Zo Ga has all the glory, Zo Ga has all the long-thumbed sows, but will Zo Ga have all the bombs? No, no!
TEXT_BANKOB204_01338_BOGU_000_002: The furnaces are at Iron Lake, but not for long! The adventurer will destroy them─wreck, ruin, destroy! Down with Zo Ga, down with progress, yes, yes!
TEXT_BANKOB204_01338_BOGU_000_003: The adventurer will wreck the incubators, to Iron Lake  will go to strangle the iron geese, yes, yes!
TEXT_BANKOB204_01338_BOGU_000_030: Surprised and furious Zo Ga must be─livid, seething, furious! What doom Zo Ga would visit upon the adventurer were he to catch ─maiming, concubinage, doom!
TEXT_BANKOB204_01338_BOGU_000_031: More surprises we'll spring on Zo Ga, yes, yes! The adventurer is crafty─nimble, sly, crafty. Soon, Zo Ga will have nothing, naught will he have!
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_BOGU_000_000: We are the bottom of the barrel, each a riff and together a raff, yes, yes. So far down are we from where Zo Ga and his ilk hold court that it is dizzying─disquieting, vertiginous, dizzying!
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_BOGU_000_001: They might say our idleness is the cause, they might point to our love of shortcuts─they are dead wrong and I just might get literal with the “dead” part! The cause of it all is the 13th's prototype alchemy furnace, yes, yes!
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_BOGU_000_002: Does the adventurer know Ba Go's friend, the alchemist Ga Zi? Ga Zi is with the 13th, Ga Zi knows their workshop welly-well, most familiar is this alchemist with the furnace.
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_BOGU_100_002: The adventurer could talk with this Ga Zi, yes, yes. Make  agreeable to Ga Zi, and learn ways to wreak lovely havoc on the workshop─chaos, ruination, havoc!
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_BOGU_000_003: The adventurer must speak to Ga Zi, find ways to throw a spanner into the works, yes, yes. Bring the 13th Order workshop to its knees, yes, yes!
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_GAJI_000_020: Yunz want to muck up the 13th's workshop? Can hardly say no to a friend of Ba Go, refuse that Ba Go and I's might have an accident─an oops, a kaboom, an accident, that sort of thing.
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_GAJI_000_021: I's a 13th, that don't mean a worm squeeze. Bugger Zo Ga and his five bells 'tween “glows out” and first gong, uh-huh, uh-huh. Yunz go wreck up that prototype furnace, bugger that thing good.
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_GAJI_000_022: I's going to tell yunz how: soon as yunz get in the workshop, open the pressure valve, uh-huh, uh-huh. The valve'll open right up, not going to be a problem, that valve. Then hustle this bomb arm inside, yunz got all that?
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_GAJI_000_023: That buggering furnace's going to overheat but good, shrapnels going to be coming at yunz so just kill 'em right. I's got a good idea, yunz be on the lookout for the big shrapnel, uh-huh, uh-huh. Slay that bugger and yunz can take its core.
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_GAJI_000_024: Won't be just another core, nuh-uh, nuh-uh. That there's going to be a rare bomb core, yunz'll know it by a green sort of glow. Give it over to Ba Go, Ba Go will take it. Yunzes are making out with this caper─profiting, cleaning up, making out, that sort of thing.
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_GAJI_000_025: Yunz get moving, bugger up that prototype furnace in the 13th Order workshop and kill all that shrapnel. Get the big shrapnel core, uh-huh, uh-huh.
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_BAGO_000_030: Haha, heehea, what do you want with Ba Go? Busy, busy is Ba Go...but never too busy for things that go kaboom─bwom, bang, kaboom...
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_BAGO_000_031: What is this? Is Ba Go seeing something new? Yesss, yesss, you have presented Ba Go with a new lovely! The core of a big shrapnel, haha! Heeheahhahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_BAGO_000_032: Ba Go likes Ga Zi now, Ga Zi is safe again. You are puzzled─perplexed, bemused, puzzled. Ba Go has no friends, no, no. Ba Go has his lovelies!
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_BAGO_000_033: Little green beauty must have a little bath now, you will go shoo─away, hie, shoo! Go tell Bo Gu that you destroyed the furnace. Haha! Heeheahhahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_BOGU_000_040: Adventurer, oh, adventurer, what fun─merriment, jollity, fun! Zo Ga has been tearing about, in absolute panic he is in, trying to repair the furnace!
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_BOGU_000_041: He will never fix it, no, no. He will waste all day, and spend all night brooding over the lost day! His bedwarmer he will use roughly, and the next day he will find the bed a cold place, yes, yes...
TEXT_BANKOB205_01339_POPMESSAGE_000_001: There is a rush of heat from among the embers!
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_BOGU_000_000: Adventurer, oh, adventurer! We have been most ill used! I was recovering supplies from the 13th Order workshop─retrieving, salvaging, recovering─and I was attacked by cobalt golems!
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_BOGU_000_001: After the recent trouble, those supplies are wasted on the 13th, yes, yes. But the golems are too powerful, oh-so-unkillable─never subdued, ever-regenerating, oh-so-unkillable. Bo Gu fought valiantly but he was forced to withdraw!
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_BOGU_000_002: The adventurer can handle a golem or two, yes? Yes, yes. Maybe even two and some─more, several, and some! Go to the 13th Order workshop and smash the swaystone─that interfering rock must be blown to bits!
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_BOGU_000_003: The stone holds sway over the golems, the golems are its to command. Destroy the stone with this wee waymaker, and any fallen golem shall stay down!
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_BOGU_000_004: The 13th has Ga Zi posted as sentry, he'll not bar our way, no, no. Ga Zi will allow the adventurer to make free with the workshop!
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_BOGU_000_005: What will happen to the supplies without our welly-well meddling? I shudder to think of the scavengers─marauders, filchers, scavengers! The adventurer must brave the 13th Order workshop and smash the swaystone!
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_GAJI_000_010: Yunz here to make trouble for Zo Ga? That's what I's like to hear, uh-huh, uh-huh. The swaystone, though─that's tough to bugger up. Won't get nowhere up its crack, yunz won't, not with that piddly bomb.
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_GAJI_000_011: Those stones, they's always clenched, yunz get that? That's how to hold sway over something, golems or kobolds, uh-huh, uh-huh. Yunz got to pry it open first. Beating on its golems'll do that.
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_GAJI_000_012: Yunz take out a few golems, slip that bomb in when the stone's roughed up but good─moused up, weakened, roughed up, that sort of thing.
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_GAJI_000_013: A swaystone needs softening up before yunz can bugger it up, yunz won't do much with the waymaker otherwise, nuh-uh, nuh-uh. Beat on the golems but good, that'll loosen up that rock, yunz listening?
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_GAJI_000_014: So what I's saying is, yunz take out a few golems and slip that bomb in when the stone's roughed up but good, and bwom!─'splosion, fire in the hole, bwom, that sort of thing.
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_BOGU_000_020: I smell gunpowder stink, I see smears of slickens...my senses are keen, yes, yes! Does this mean the adventurer has shattered the swaystone?
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_BOGU_000_021: Happy, happy news! The stone gone, the golems so-very-killable! The 13th Order's supply can be salvaged now─saved, rescued, salvaged!
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_POPMESSAGE_000_000: You feel a stony gaze fixed upon you!
TEXT_BANKOB206_01340_SYSTEM_000_900: The swaystone is not sufficiently weakened. Dispatch more cobalt golems to ready the stone for the waymaker bomb.
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_BOGU_000_000: That Zo Ga is at it again! Upgrading the prototype furnace I heard, yes, upgrading─tweaking, improving, upgrading. A nice day I was having, a warm worm of a day it was, and now it's gone sour─tart, curdled, sour!
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_BOGU_000_001: Oh, this is absolutely intolerable, unbearable to the honor of Bo Gu and his comrades. Zo Ga boasts he has forgotten more about efficiency than other orders remember, yes, yes! The braggart admits he is senile─past it, gaga, senile!
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_BOGU_000_002: Doddering Zo Ga's advantage is most unfair─unjust, unmerited, unfair! The adventurer must correct this rank inequity in the most expedient way, by blowing the 13th's alchemy wain sky-high!
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_BOGU_000_003: Such a course is expedient and wise, for a certain someone cannot go long without a good kabloom, no, no. The adventurer will seek the help of 789th Order Acolyte Ba Go, Ba Go will assist and sate his appetite for destruction, yes, yes.
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_BOGU_000_004: 789th Order Acolyte Ba Go will help, Ba Go enjoys blowing things sky-high, yes, yes. Perhaps too much─excessive, inordinate, too much...but the adventurer will make no mention of this, no, no!
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_BAGO_000_010: Bo Gu sent you, yes? Bo Gu is afraid Ba Go will have one of his little spells soon. An alchemy wain, you say? Which beauties will dance in that ball, Ba Go wonders─muses, mulls, wonders. Aha! The smart bombs, the advanced smart bombs! Haha! Heeheahhahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_BAGO_000_011: Three bright coals to mark the wain, make a handsome prince of the unlovely drudge. Ba Go's little beauties will rush to him, plant on him their fiery kisses─frenzied, ardent, fiery. Haha! Heeheahhahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_BAGO_000_012: You'll check the embers afterwards, though the beauties will be angry─fuming, seething, angry. A bomb core you must retrieve─Ba Go will not have his beauties seen in dishabille, no, no.
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_BAGO_000_013: You want to get into the 13th Order workshop, sneak in without cutting and flaying? Ga Zi will let you in, yes, yes. He has his reasons, does Ga Zi. Haha! Heeheahha!
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_BAGO_000_014: Take the smart bombs to the ball, yes, yes. Only one dance though, then you must go among the embers and bring home a bomb core. She will pout, for too long has she stayed home, but you know what to do with wayward beauties...haha!
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_BAGO_000_020: Did my beauties enjoy the ball? Did the prince dance with them? Did he burn─blackening, twisting? I smell screams. Heeheahhahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_BAGO_000_021: Look at her, a babe in arms again. Ba Go will take good care of his beauty, nurse and bathe and feed her he will. Make new beauty of her─fresh, terrible, new!
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_BAGO_000_022: Good of you to escort my beauty home, yes, yes. You are wanted by Craftsman Bo Gu, your report he will want to hear. Much kaboom there was. Heeheahhaha!
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_BOGU_000_030: Just deserts, deserved and delivered! May Zo Ga singe his arse on what's left of the wain, yes, yes!
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_BOGU_000_031: The adventurer is a friend to the 789th, the right kind of diligence and disregard for others' property has . Together we shall go far─the distance, all the way, far. This I must think deeply on, yes, yes.
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_POPMESSAGE_000_001: The embers are suddenly alive with danger!
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_KOBOLD01341_000_040: (-13th Order Watchman-)This is Zo Ga's workshop, you ain't Zo Ga, no, no. So it follows, someone who ain't Zo Ga's got no business here!
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_KOBOLD01341_000_041: (-13th Order Watchman-)Here now, where did you come from anyway? Seems to me this is an inside job─black treachery, dissension in the ranks, an inside job!
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_KOBOLD01341_000_042: (-13th Order Watchman-)Intruder, yes, yes! None who breach the 13th Order Dig shall live to tell, no, no!
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_BALLOON_000_050: Our alchemy wain! You'll die for this─drop, croak, die!
TEXT_BANKOB207_01341_GAJI_000_060: Yunz want to muck up the 13th's workshop? Can hardly say no, seeing as how I's done my share of gumming up the works there. Go on through, yunz got to do what yunz got to do, uh-huh, uh-huh.
TEXT_BANKOB208_01342_BOGU_000_000: Shiny things they have in the 13th Order Dig, nice things they hide from the rest of us. Surely this is not right, no, no.
TEXT_BANKOB208_01342_BOGU_000_001: There are watchmen in the 13th Order, Zo Ga's favorites, much loved by the fugleman, yes, yes. These watchmen have hidden pretty things in the workshop─alluring, inviting, pretty!
TEXT_BANKOB208_01342_BOGU_000_002: Silverpots they are, absolutely oozing with worth and gorgeousness. And watchmen conceal them, how suspicious and ungenerous! The adventurer must seize their contents, and teach Zo Ga a lesson, yes, yes!
TEXT_BANKOB208_01342_BOGU_000_003: 13th Order Alchemist Ga Zi will guide you. Yes, yes, Ga Zi was the one who saw the silverpots.
TEXT_BANKOB208_01342_BOGU_000_004: Zo Ga and his watchmen have silverpots hidden in the 13th Order workshop, treasures they would conceal from Bo Gu and his deserving comrades! The adventurer will bring away the silverpots─spirit, whisk, bring them away!
TEXT_BANKOB208_01342_BOGU_000_010: Adventurer, oh, adventurer! Did you find shiny things? Yes, are the precious silverpots' contents in our hands?
TEXT_BANKOB208_01342_BOGU_000_011: Hem and haw, haw and hem. This is alchemical, yes, yes. But beyond that? Bo Gu is knowledgeable, but not an expert in alchemy, no, no.
TEXT_BANKOB208_01342_BOGU_000_012: What exactly this is, I do not know. What is it worth? Worth hiding─stashing, secreting, hiding! So, worth a lot, yes, yes.
TEXT_BANKOB208_01342_BOGU_000_013: Nobody likes to miss such a thing─the loss of these mystery packets they will bemoan. Anything that vexes Zo Ga gladdens us─elates, heartens, gladdens!
TEXT_BANKOB208_01342_POPMESSAGE_000_000: You feel a watchful gaze─and murderous intent!
TEXT_BANKOB208_01342_BALLOON_000_020: This area is forbidden to outsiders, yes, yes!
TEXT_BANKOB208_01342_GAJI_000_030: Yunz got designs on the 13th's workshop? Bo Gu thinks there's a treasure in those silverpots I spotted─gems, exotic poisons, treasure, that sort of thing. Go and bugger up the place good now.
TEXT_BANKOB209_01343_BOGU_000_000: Bo Gu cannot stand the 13th, no. Always using big words, hiding in their workshop making booms and bangs, bangs and burns that make big trouble for Bo Gu.
TEXT_BANKOB209_01343_BOGU_000_001: The only smart one around here is Ba Go. And Ba Go does not care for us─no, no. Ba Go cares only for his beauties, and for Ba Go.
TEXT_BANKOB209_01343_BOGU_000_002: Bo Gu would show the 13th that their wits mean nothing. No, no, wits will not stop you from getting sliced─chopped, diced, sliced─by an overdweller. Yes, an overdweller like you...
TEXT_BANKOB209_01343_BOGU_000_003: But Bo Gu does not believe in senseless violence─no, no. So you will break into the workshop, yes? Call them fathead and four-eyes, yes, and other nasty names. They get angry, then you kill them.
TEXT_BANKOB209_01343_BOGU_000_006: Ga Zi will let you into the workshop, yes, yes. Ga Zi is of the 13th, but cares little for his puffed-up peers. Yes this, Bo Gu knows.
TEXT_BANKOB209_01343_BOGU_000_004: Bo Gu would show the 13th that their wits mean nothing. No, no, wits will not stop you from getting sliced─chopped, diced, sliced─by an overdweller.
TEXT_BANKOB209_01343_BOGU_000_005: You will break into the workshop, yes? Call them fathead and four-eyes, yes, and other nasty names. Then they get angry, then you kill them.

Our secrets are not for overdweller eyes!
Overdweller must die─yes, yes, die!
TEXT_BANKOB209_01343_KOBOLD_000_012: No, no! Zo Ga d-didn't tell me I'd have to fight!
TEXT_BANKOB209_01343_BOGU_000_020: Oh, thank you, adventurer! That will teach Zo Ga a lesson─a message, a moral, a lesson. Yes, no matter how smart you might be, there is always someone smarter than you.
TEXT_BANKOB209_01343_BOGU_000_021: We make a good team, yes─you and me, me and you. With Bo Gu's brains and your brawn, there is nothing─no, no, nothing─we cannot do!
TEXT_BANKOB209_01343_GAJI_000_030: Bulgebrains in the workshop make fun of Ga Zi, say he talk funny─strange, odd, funny, that sort of thing. Yunz want to slap some sense into them, Ga Zi won't get in yunz's way, nuh-uh, nuh-uh.
TEXT_BANKOB210_01344_BOGU_000_000: The 88th is making trouble again─yes, yes, making cobalt for Zo Ga. More cobalt means more golems, golems that crash our dig, crush Bo Gu's handiwork.
TEXT_BANKOB210_01344_BOGU_000_001: And is this all? No, no, the worst is yet to come. The 88th makes mighty, bellowing furnaces for Zo Ga. With any more power at his disposal, Zo Ga will become a tyrant─a despot, a dictator, a tyrant of the tunnels.
TEXT_BANKOB210_01344_BOGU_000_002: But Bo Gu has a plan─an idea, a notion, a plan. A plan to dismantle a furnace, and shift the blame─transfer, redirect, shift.
TEXT_BANKOB210_01344_BOGU_000_003: Zo Ga loses his furnace, and his former friends at the 88th suffer his fury. Kill two coblyns with one stone.
TEXT_BANKOB210_01344_BOGU_000_004: But I am a simple craftsman, and my tools are not up to the task. No, no, we─and by we, I mean you─must seek the aid of Ba Go.
TEXT_BANKOB210_01344_BOGU_000_005: Bo Gu has a plan─an idea, a notion, a plan to dismantle a furnace. But I am a simple craftsman, and my tools are not up to the task. No, no, we─and by we, I mean you─must seek the aid of Ba Go.
TEXT_BANKOB210_01344_BAGO_000_010: Overdweller would make booms, yes? Overdweller's timing is most auspicious─fortunate, opportune, auspicious. Yesss, yeeesss, it is...
TEXT_BANKOB210_01344_BAGO_000_011: As we speak, Ba Go puts the finishing touches on one of his beauties. She is a fiery one, yes, if a touch...fickle.
TEXT_BANKOB210_01344_BAGO_000_012: You would be wise to deliver her to your destination quickly, unless you wish to bear the brunt of her flames of passion. Ba Go does not think you would want this, no, no...
TEXT_BANKOB210_01344_BAGO_000_017: Adventurer is looking ashen─dusty, smoldery, ashen. Ba Go's beauty went boom on adventurer? Yes, yes, she did? Haha! Heahehaheaehahaha! Ba Go will give adventurer another beauty, if adventurer would make more booms. Yes, yes, more booms!
TEXT_BANKOB210_01344_BOGU_000_030: Bo Gu could hear the booms from here, hear booms and see smoke. And this is not the end of the fireworks─no, no. Just wait until Zo Ga learns that his underlings have failed him so.
TEXT_BANKOB210_01344_BOGU_000_031: Lucky we are that Ba Go and his beauties are on our side. Yes, at least for now...

TEXT_BANKOB301_01364_BOBU_000_000: Friend, you must stop him! Yes, yes, you must bring an end to his most heinous experiments─hideous, hateful, heinous.
TEXT_BANKOB301_01364_BOBU_000_001: Whose experiments? Bo Bu will not say. No, no, the name must not be so much as whispered─not spoken, not uttered, not whispered.
TEXT_BANKOB301_01364_BOBU_000_002: I say only this─yes, yes, this alone: he is a bedesman of the 59th Order. Known for creating terrible, terrible things, he is─things that prowl the tunnels thirsting for our ore. Yes, yes, our ore and our flesh!
TEXT_BANKOB301_01364_BOBU_000_003: He is favored by Zo Ga, yes, yes, he is, for his creations feed on the weak and the suffering. It is but a matter of time─minutes, even moments─until our dig is overrun! You will help us, yes, yes?
TEXT_BANKOB301_01364_BOBU_000_004: I beg of you, friend─you must put an end to the experiments of this hateful holy one. We would live in fear of his ghastly creations no longer. No, no, no longer!
TEXT_BANKOB301_01364_BOBU_000_010: Did you triumph over the baleful bedesman─succeed, prevail, triumph?
TEXT_BANKOB301_01364_BOBU_000_011: Felled, felled is our foe, and carnage-crazed coblyns trouble our dig no more! Huzzah─hurrah, hooray, huzzah!
TEXT_BANKOB301_01364_BOBU_000_012: He who must not be named will rise again. Rise, rise, he will. But until then, you have won us a respite from danger─a rest, a reprieve, a respite.
TEXT_BANKOB301_01364_BOBU_000_013: Well do I understand Gi Gu's fears─yes, yes, I do. Zo Ga is a fearsome foe, but will Bo Bu throw up his paws in surrender? No, no, perhaps the others, but not Bo Bu!
TEXT_BANKOB302_01365_BOBU_000_000: Zo Ga is not so great─not so high, not so mighty, not so great. No, no, Zo Ga himself is no stronger than me or you─you or I.
TEXT_BANKOB302_01365_BOBU_000_001: So why does Zo Ga get his way, you say? An astute question─sharp, keen, astute.
TEXT_BANKOB302_01365_BOBU_000_002: Zo Ga has many friends in U'Ghamaro─lackeys, minions, friends. Yes, yes, powerful friends.
TEXT_BANKOB302_01365_BOBU_000_003:
When Zo Ga says, “Dig!” they say, “How deep?”
When Zo Ga says, “Kill Bo Bu!” they say, “How dead?”
TEXT_BANKOB302_01365_BOBU_000_004: Without his friends, Zo Ga will be a shadow of himself─a husk, a shell, a shadow. The 789th will have a fighting chance. Yes, yes, we will!
TEXT_BANKOB302_01365_BOBU_000_005: Without his friends, Zo Ga will be a shadow of himself─a husk, a shell, a shadow. The 789th will have shred of hope. Yes, yes, a fighting chance!
TEXT_BANKOB302_01365_BOBU_000_010: Somewhere, Zo Ga clenches his fists in rage─anger, fury, rage. Yes, yes, you have done well. Well you have done.
TEXT_BANKOB302_01365_BOBU_000_011: The revolution begins, begins slowly but surely. Soon, Zo Ga will stand alone─abandoned, adrift, alone─and we will have our revenge. Yes, yes, revenge will be ours!
TEXT_BANKOB303_01366_BOBU_000_000: Stupid Bo Zu─brainless, witless, stupid Bo Zu! That plate was my prized possession. Yes, yes, my treasure!
TEXT_BANKOB303_01366_BOBU_000_001: At this dig, we do not eat well. No, no, we are near to starving. But some of us hold out hope that better days still await us. It is for the feasts to come─and come they will─that I fashioned that plate from a doblyn shell─crafted, shaped, fashioned with care...
TEXT_BANKOB303_01366_BOBU_000_002: And what does Bo Zu do? He swallows my work whole─engulfs, ingests, swallows! I care not how hungry you are─no, no, not at all─surely you can tell the difference between food and food-vessel.
TEXT_BANKOB303_01366_BOBU_000_003: You will take boom toss, yes? Scare doblyns from the shadows, cut shells from their backs? I must give Bo Zu a good talking to─a pummeling, a beating, a talking to.
TEXT_BANKOB303_01366_BOBU_000_004: You will take boom toss, yes? Scare doblyns from the shadows, cut shells from their backs? I must give Bo Zu a good talking to─a pummeling, a beating, a talking to.
TEXT_BANKOB303_01366_BOBU_000_030: You return from the depths with the shells I seek, yes? Yes, yes, say you do.
TEXT_BANKOB303_01366_BOBU_000_031: Such exquisite shells─beautiful, elegant, exquisite! These will make lovely plates, indeed. Yes, yes, the finest utensils our dig has seen.
TEXT_BANKOB303_01366_BOBU_000_032: Bo Zu suffers from stomach pains most severe─wrenching, stinging, severe. That will teach him a lesson. Yes, yes, teach him not to take others' handiwork for his dinner.
TEXT_BANKOB303_01366_POPMESSAGE_000_000: With a chitter and a clack, the shadows shift before your eyes...
TEXT_BANKOB304_01367_BOBU_000_000: Zo Ga is so strong? Zo Ga is so smart? Hah! I think not. No, no, Zo Ga is neither strong nor smart.
TEXT_BANKOB304_01367_BOBU_000_001: Tools make the kobold, and Zo Ga is simply rich enough to afford the best─wealthy, well-heeled, rich. This is all Zo Ga is, all he is and nothing more.
TEXT_BANKOB304_01367_BOBU_000_002: To wit: Zo Ga supplies his alchemists and acolytes with saltpeter so pristine you can see right through, through to the other side. Why, if our Ba Go had access to the same, I shudder to think of the destruction he could wreak─chaos, damage, destruction.
TEXT_BANKOB304_01367_BOBU_000_003: Which gives Bo Bu an idea, yes, a notion. You will borrow─yes, steal, pilfer, borrow─the finest shards of saltpeter from Zo Ga's workshop of horrors. Bring to Ba Go as a present from you and me. Much lauded and applauded, we shall be!
TEXT_BANKOB304_01367_BOBU_000_004: Do you have holes in your head, to forget so soon? You will borrow─steal, pilfer, borrow─the finest shards of saltpeter from Zo Ga's workshop. Bring to Ba Go, as a present from you and me. Much lauded and applauded, we shall be!
TEXT_BANKOB304_01367_BAGO_000_010:
Yes, yesss? Ba Go is busy, very busy with─
...Hmmm? A present for me and my lovelies?
TEXT_BANKOB304_01367_BAGO_000_011: The nerve─the gall, the audacity, the nerve! Bo Bu thinks my beauties pale before Zo Ga's, he does? Perhaps Bo Bu would like to serve as my next test subject, yes? Feel their power firsthand, yes?
TEXT_BANKOB304_01367_BAGO_000_012: I will take the saltpeter this time, yes. But you tell Bo Bu that he can shove the rest of the stuff where the sun don't shine. Woe, woe is Ba Go! Will no one ever understand my genius─my brilliance, my gift, my genius?
TEXT_BANKOB304_01367_BOBU_000_020: Speak not a whisper, friend─no, no, not a word. I could hear Ba Go screaming and shrieking in joy all the way from here.
TEXT_BANKOB304_01367_BOBU_000_021: Yes, yes, any day now will he offer to take me on as his apprentice─his student, his pupil, his apprentice. Aspiring 789th Order Acolyte Bo Bu─it rings nicely to the ear, no?
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_BOBU_000_000: Great, great balls of fire, gas, and smoke! Blast and burst and boom they make, and there is no end, no end to them.
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_BOBU_000_001: Zo Ga's alchemists have built a furnace, yes, a furnace foul. Bombs, bombs, and more bombs it belches forth. Ba Go's bombs are friendly to us─yes, blowing off only the occasional finger. But Zo Ga's creations have tempers foul─cruel, filthy, foul.
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_BOBU_000_002: I am scared to draw near for fear of losing more than a finger─yes, yes, a paw, an arm, a head. But Ba Go will know what to do. Yes, yes, Ba Go always knows.
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_BOBU_000_003: Zo Ga's fomenting furnace must be destroyed─dispatched, deconstructed, destroyed─but I am scared to draw near. Yes, yes, my limbs I hold too dear. But Ba Go will lead you. Yes, yes, Ba Go will show you the way.
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_BAGO_000_010: Not all explosives are created equal─no, no. Ba Go's beauties heave at the sight of Zo Ga's hideous creations─retch, spew, heave. Ba Go's whiskers get singed, yes, they do, and Ba Go loves his beauties even more.
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_BAGO_000_011: You would squelch the ugliness at the source? Be a friend to beauties and to Ba Go? Easily is this done. The furnace needs only a good smashing─a crashing, a thrashing, a smashing.
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_BAGO_000_012: But you will be an even greater friend to Ba Go. Yes, you will scour the embers and slay. Scour, scour, and slay you will, until you meet the most dazzling beauty of all. You will take her arm, no questions asked, and deliver it to Bo Bu.
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_BAGO_000_013: Why to Bo Bu, and not to Ba Go? Because Ba Go is busy─occupied, engaged, busy! Bo Bu will hold it for me quietly until I ask, or he will burn, burn, for the bother! Now go, go, and ask no more questions of Ba Go!
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_BAGO_000_014: After Zo Ga's furnace is no more, you will scour and slay, scour and slay, until you meet the most dazzling beauty of all. You will take her arm, no questions asked, and deliver it to Bo Bu. Why to Bo Bu? Because Ba Go is busy! Now go, and do not question Ba Go!
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_BOBU_000_030: Many burstings and blastings Bo Bu heard. Is Zo Ga's bomb-belching furnace no more?
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_BOBU_000_031: A sign of success─triumph, victory, success? Yes, less bombs a-blasting pleases Bo Bu, pleases us all─hm?
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_BOBU_000_032: A present you would entrust to me, meant for Ba Go? Oh, you are kind, yes, kind indeed!
TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_BOBU_000_033: I will deliver it to our resident genius straightaway, with speed, yes, all speed. “Bo Bu, your loyalty is laudable─commendable, praiseworthy, laudable. Gladly, yes, gladly, will Ba Go take you as his apprentice.” Yes, yes, Bo Bu can hear his words now!

TEXT_BANKOB305_01368_POPMESSAGE_000_001: There is a rush of heat from among the embers!
TEXT_BANKOB306_01369_BOBU_000_000: My glasses, my cap, the fur off my back─yes, yes, what I would not give to join the 13th Order for a day!
TEXT_BANKOB306_01369_BOBU_000_001: Do not take me wrong! No affection for Zo Ga do I bear─no love, no fondness, no affection. No, no, it is only my stomach that harbors such ambitions.

TEXT_BANKOB306_01369_BOBU_000_003: Bo Bu would never think of betraying his friends─no, no─but loyalty is much more easily maintained on a full stomach, yes? Yes, yes, we both know this is so.
TEXT_BANKOB306_01369_BOBU_000_004: The alchemist Ga Zi serves Zo Ga, but not willingly. Yes, perhaps he could be persuaded─convinced, enticed, persuaded─to share a secret or two about his master's food stash. You are curious too, yes? You will go, yes?

Now, that bugger Zo Ga likes his yum-yums, so his stashes might be guarded a bit more heavily. But that's yunz's problem, uh-huh, uh-huh.

TEXT_BANKOB306_01369_BOBU_000_021: C-Could it be...!? Yes, yes, it could! A gold wriggler, still wriggling with life. A meal fit for kobold kings, but today it is for Bo Bu!

TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_BOBU_000_000: Sneaky, shifty Zo Ga will stop at nothing to tighten his grip on the tunnels. No, no, his twisted ambition knows no bounds.
TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_BOBU_000_001: Zo Ga knows his mining abilities are ordinary─average, middling, ordinary. And so he monopolizes the richest veins, bleeds them dry before others can so much as sniff the treasures within.
TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_BOBU_000_002: Machinists of the 86th make new rock eaters for Zo Ga, but they are not to blame. No, no, Zo Ga threatens to take their food if his bidding is not done.
TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_BOBU_000_003: Every tunnel, every vein Zo Ga opens, one path, one dream is closed to us. You will speak to Ba Go and see what can be done. You will─yes, yes, you must!
TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_BOBU_000_004: Every tunnel, every vein Zo Ga opens, one path, one dream is closed to us. You will speak to Ba Go and see what can be done. You will─yes, yes, you must!

TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_BAGO_000_011: But will Ba Go say no to making booms in Zo Ga's tunnels? No, no, Ba Go who says no would not be Ba Go. So Ba Go gives you brightstones and beauties. You have seen these before, yes? Yes, yes, you know what to do.
TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_BAGO_000_012: Put down brightstones, stand back, and let beauties fly free. Beauties fly, fly into the light, and Zo Ga's metal beast goes boom. Zo Ga's friends will not be happy, but Ba Go will be! Haha! Haheaheaheahaeheah!
TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_BAGO_000_015: Put down brightstones, stand back, and let beauties fly free. Beauties fly, fly into the light, and Zo Ga's metal beast goes boom. Zo Ga's friends will not be happy, but Ba Go will be! Haha! Haheaheaheahaeheah!
TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_BOBU_000_030: You have done well, friend! A blast and a boom, and the playing field is leveled─flattened, evened, leveled. Yes, yes, now skill and smarts will win out over chicanery.
TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_BOBU_000_031: It is only a matter of time─moons, days, time─until Bo Bu rises to his rightful position of power. Yes, yes, before long you will be calling me 1st Order Exemplar Bo Bu!
TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_KOBOLD01370_000_040: (-13th Order Patrolman-)This is Zo Ga's! Keep your dirty paws off!
TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_KOBOLD01370_000_041: (-13th Order Patrolman-)Hands off! Don't touch! Keep back!
TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_KOBOLD01370_000_042: (-13th Order Patrolman-)Overdweller! I'll bring your head to Zo Ga on a platter─a dish, a plate, a platter!
TEXT_BANKOB307_01370_BALLOON_000_050:
You won't return alive!
No, no, you won't!
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_BOBU_000_000: I know it, I sense it, I feel it in my bones. Master Ba Go has a task for his trusted apprentice Bo Bu!
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_BOBU_000_001: A trying task he has, and yet he fears for Bo Bu's safety─worries, frets, fears. Yet he worries for nothing. Yes, yes, for naught!
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_BOBU_000_002: For Bo Bu is ever loyal and brave─courageous, valiant, brave! Bo Bu shrinks not from his duty─no, never─but sends you straight to Ba Go in his stead. Yes, friend, go forth! Go forth and do Bo Bu proud!
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_BOBU_000_003: Bo Bu shrinks not from his duty─no, never─but sends you straight to Ba Go in his stead. Yes, friend, go forth! Go forth and do Bo Bu proud!
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_BAGO_000_010: You return to Ba Go, yesss? Excellent. Ba Go feared that Bo Bu would come stumbling in─bungling, bumbling, stumbling. All talk and no action, that one.
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_BAGO_000_011: But you have served Ba Go well before, and you will serve Ba Go again. Yeeesss, yesss, you will.
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_BAGO_000_012: Ba Go would build his most lethal beauties yet, yet Ba Go lacks for the materials he needs. A soulstone and a doblyn shell, though not any will do, no, no!
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_BAGO_000_013: The stone and shell Ba Go seeks must be taken straight from the guardians of depths most dark─shadowy, murky, dark. Slay golem and doblyn underlings, and their masters will come─yes, oh yes, will they come! Heahehaheahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_BAGO_100_013: When you have what I seek, deliver it to Bo Bu. If he can tell me what it is, he may serve me, yes. If he cannot, I shall set his whiskers alight─aflame, ablaze, alight.
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_BAGO_000_014: Ba Go would build his most lethal beauties yet, yet Ba Go lacks for the materials he needs. A soulstone and a doblyn shell, though not any will do, no, no!
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_BAGO_000_015: The stone and shell Ba Go seeks must be taken straight from the guardians of depths most dark─shadowy, murky, dark. Slay golem and doblyn underlings, and their masters will come─yes, oh yes, will they come! Heahehaheahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_BOBU_000_030: You have come to the aid of Master Ba Go, yes, yes?
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_BOBU_000_031: Incredible─astounding, amazing, incredible! Why, these are the most spectacular...whatsits...that Bo Bu has ever seen!
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_BOBU_000_032: I shall bring them to Master Ba Go at once, and he shall rejoice! Yes, yes, he will be beside himself with joy at seeing his prize pupil deliver these remarkable...things!
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_BOBU_000_033: Yes, no doubt he will be quick to share with me the fruits of his latest research─the results, the products, the fruits! I am in for a hair-raising experience, yes, yes, I am!
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_POPMESSAGE_000_000: Ancient slabs of stone spring to life around you!
TEXT_BANKOB308_01371_POPMESSAGE_000_001: With a chitter and a whir, the creature is upon you!
TEXT_BANKOB309_01372_BOBU_000_000: In numbers there is strength─power, puissance, strength. Zo Ga knows this well, surrounds himself with those at his beck and call─those of strong body and weak mind.
TEXT_BANKOB309_01372_BOBU_000_001: Bo Bu knows one of these, yes. One of these is roundsman of the 59th. A nasty roundsman, he is. All who speak his name have their tongues plucked out. Now, no kobold speaks his name─no, not a one.
TEXT_BANKOB309_01372_BOBU_000_002: But Zo Ga handles this brute. Yes, yes, as Zo Ga handles everything, with riches─treasure, wealth, riches.
TEXT_BANKOB309_01372_BOBU_000_003: Bo Bu watches, and gets a notion─an idea, a thought, a notion. You beat back roundsman, take coin from his pocket, yes?
TEXT_BANKOB309_01372_BOBU_000_004: Bo Bu takes coin, finds nasty, greedy roundsman of his own. Coin lures power, power lures more power, and soon Bo Bu stands atop the mountain! Yes, yes, Bo Bu fulfills his destiny─his fate, his fortune, his destiny!
TEXT_BANKOB309_01372_BOBU_000_010: The roundsman makes his rounds no more? You bring coin as proof of your triumph, yes?
TEXT_BANKOB309_01372_BOBU_000_011: The roundsman is driven back to his dig─beaten, battered, driven─and Bo Bu is a rich kobold? All is right, all is right on the mountain.
TEXT_BANKOB309_01372_BOBU_000_012: Yes, yes, this single coin marks the first step of Bo Bu's rise to power. Worry not, adventurer, for Bo Bu will not forget─no, no, never forget your humble contribution.
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_BOBU_000_000: You must listen, yes! Our dig is in grave peril─danger, risk, peril!
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_BOBU_000_001: Zo Ga? No, no, our own acolyte's fury do we face! Ba Go's rage seethes─simmers, smolders, seethes─threatening to raze us all!
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_BOBU_000_002: What angers Ba Go so? I do not know─no, into the flames of his anger I dare not go. But you, yes you may face the fires and emerge unscathed─intact, unharmed, unscathed!
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_BOBU_000_003: I would know what angers Ba Go so, but no─into the flames of his anger I dare not go. You, yes you may face the fires and emerge unscathed─intact, unharmed, unscathed!
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_BAGO_000_010: Flame will devour all─swallow, consume, devour! Neither friend nor foe─no, no, none shall escape my rage!
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_BAGO_000_011: My beauties! My poor, poor beauties! <sob> My most dazzling─magnificent, ravishing, dazzling─beauties have been spirited away to Zo Ga's loathsome forge, where they toil and trouble in ignominy!
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_BAGO_000_012: Zo Ga must pay for this─yes, yes, Zo Ga must suffer! It may not be possible to bring back Ba Go's beauties whole...but they can at least be used to leave a present for Zo Ga─a gift, a memento, a present.
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_BAGO_000_013: Ba Go's beauties rage and seethe from within Zo Ga's fiery prison. You will free them, yes, and channel their rage to Zo Ga's most precious machineworks. You will move quickly─hastily, speedily, quickly─or you will be the one to suffer their wrath. Hehaeheahheahahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_BAGO_000_014: But then, you will still not be done! Again must Zo Ga be made to suffer! Zo Ga's furnaces, once numbered two, will number none. Nothing, nothing, none.
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_BAGO_000_015: Ba Go will reunite with his beauties, and all will be quiet and calm, yes. Or you will fail, and the whole mountain will fall to Ba Go's wrath─crash, crumble, fall!
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_BAGO_000_016: Zo Ga must suffer for his villainy. It may not be possible to bring back Ba Go's beauties whole...but they can at least be used to leave a present for Zo Ga─a gift, a memento, a present.
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_BAGO_000_017: Ba Go's beauties rage and seethe from within Zo Ga's fiery prison. You will free them, yes, and channel their rage to Zo Ga's most precious machineworks. You will move quickly─hastily, speedily, quickly─or you will be the one to suffer their wrath. Hehaeheahheahahaha!
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_BAGO_000_018: But then, you will still not be done! Again must Zo Ga be made to suffer! Zo Ga's furnaces, once numbered two, will number none. Nothing, nothing, none.
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_BAGO_000_020: You return with the cores that make up Ba Go's beauties? Yesss, yesss, for your own sake, I hope you do!
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_BAGO_000_021: As lovely as ever, you return to Ba Go! And you left a lovely gift for Zo Ga─yeeesss, yeeesss, you did!
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_BAGO_000_022: ...But what are you still doing here!? Can you not see that my beauties demand my attention? Go play with Bo Bu and leave me, begone, get out!
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_BOBU_000_030: You need say nothing, no. Ba Go's words are heard even here, much to Bo Bu's comfort.
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_BOBU_000_031: My master's rage cools from a boil to a slow burn, a simmer. Bo Bu will stay away for now, just to be certain─safe, sure, certain.
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_BOBU_000_032: For when angered, Ba Go is more fearsome than a score, a hundred, a thousand of Zo Ga's strongest. Bo Bu's heart rages with the anger of a thousand of Ba Go's beauties. Zo Ga will pay for angering my master, for putting all our lives in danger.
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_POPMESSAGE_000_001: There is a rush of heat from among the embers!
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_SYSTEM_000_040: You are not carrying the specified object. Return to the starting point and reattempt the delivery.
TEXT_BANKOB310_01373_SYSTEM_100_053: Take the bomb into hand and carry it to your destination before it detonates. Be wary of attacks from enemies, which will sap your strength. If you fail to complete the task in time, the bomb will explode and you will suffer damage.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_RASHAHT_000_000: Your hearing must be exceptional, . Hm? If you did not overhear the linkpearl report, then why─ Well, no matter.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_RASHAHT_000_001: You are here now, and we could certainly use your aid. I have just received word that raiders have sunk a civilian vessel in the Strait of Merlthor.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_RASHAHT_000_002: One of our warships is en route as we speak...though I fear there will be little left for them to find.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_RASHAHT_000_003: I am uncomfortably familiar with tales of pirates looting─and even commandeering─their targets, but to sink the ship entire? An excessively brutal act, even for a buccaneer.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_RASHAHT_000_004: No, I'd wager cold hard coin that those thrice-damned fishbacks are behind this─them and their Serpent Reaver lackeys. The Sahagin have much to answer for...
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_RASHAHT_000_005: Vengeance will be forthcoming, but let us first focus on rescuing what poor souls we may. While the warship scours the waters, I would have you head to eastern La Noscea and look for any survivors washed up on the sands of Bloodshore.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_RASHAHT_000_006: One of my soldiers, Private Wilfalk, has been deployed to coordinate the search. Speak with him when you arrive, and he will direct your efforts to where they are most needed. May Llymlaen guide your steps.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_RASHAHT_000_007: I'd prefer naught more than to gut a few score fishbacks and leave their corpses rotting on the beach, but our rescue efforts must come first. Make your way to Bloodshore and search the shallows for survivors!
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_WILTFALK_000_010: Yer the one Commander Rhiki said to expect, then? I'm Wilfalk, a private in the commander's Foreign Levy.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_WILTFALK_000_011: As ye can see, there ain't much for me to coordinate. The fishbacks made a good mess o' that ship─seems barely a handful o' the poor buggers what were sailin' on it made it ashore alive.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_WOMAN01374_000_012: (-Bedraggled Woman-)<cough> <cough> Where...am I? Where is Robyn? Where is my son!?
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_WILTFALK_000_013: Now ye just calm yerself down, goodwife. We'll have yer boy back in yer arms afore ye can spit up another lungful of seawater.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_WILTFALK_000_014: The tide's been merciful to a fortunate few like the goodwife here, an' carried them all the way to the beach.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_WILTFALK_000_015: Here. Ye'll be needin' some o' me medical supplies for the bleedin' an' the injured. Take a walk along the coast, now, an' help them as ain't beyond helpin'.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_WILTFALK_000_016: Ye didn't spy any little ones amongst the survivors, did ye? A shame, it is. A damn shame...
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_WOMAN01374_000_017: (-Bedraggled Woman-)Have you seen my little Robyn? I was certain I held him tightly as we fell into the water. So very, very tightly...
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_VICTIMA01374_000_02: I... I made it? One moment we was sailin' along, happy as ye please...the next, I was strugglin' to keep me head above the waves...
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_VICTIMB01374_000_02: <cough> <pant> Thank you...thank you... Which of the seven heavens is this? Bloodshore? Oh...
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_INJURERA01374_000_0: Ugh... Wave slammed me into the rocks... They cut me up some, I think. Is it bad...?

My thanks. I feel much stronger now.
...All I remember is an impact like bloody thunder, and the deck lurching beneath my feet. Then they came aboard.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_INJURERB01374_000_0: Argh! Me shoulder! It burns! Don't take me arm, I'm beggin' ye!
Ah, I can feel me fingers again. Those gutless fishbacks! They were over the rail and swingin' afore I could stammer out a prayer to the Navigator.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_WILTFALK_000_030: Ye've saved some lives this day, . 'Tis a terrible thing what happened, but ye take what solace ye can in the little victories.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_WILTFALK_000_031: ...Not that any amount o' solace'll have me forgivin' those blasted fishbacks. Ye expect attacks on the navy─that's what we signed up for─but sinkin' a civilian ship with women an' children aboard... The Sahagin have ice water for blood, I tell ye.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_WOMAN01374_000_032: (-Bedraggled Woman-)<sob> No... Not my little Robyn...
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_WILTFAL_000K_033: Me condolences, goodwife, I know how hard this must─
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_WILTFALK_000_037: What, ye didn't get yer fill o' slaughter out on the strait!? If ye want to finish the job ye started, then ye'd best start with me!
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_WOMAN01374_000_042: (-Bedraggled Woman-)Oh, my dear Robyn, you're safe! Thank the Twelve above!
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_WILTFALK_000_043: The lad's alive!? What manner o' fishback trickery is this!?
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_ROBYN_000_050: I'm fine, if a bit wet! I thought I would sink right to the bottom of the sea, but then some nice fishmen came and saved me!
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_ROBYN_000_051: They were naught like the scary ones that came after our ship! But the stories say that all the fishmen are nasty... Isn't that odd?
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_ROBYN_000_052: Um, might I ask you a favor?
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_ROBYN_000_053: I found this necklace at the bottom of the little boat the nice fishmen used to carry me to the shore. I'm certain it must be one of theirs!
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_ROBYN_000_054: I'd take it back to them myself, but I don't think my mum would like that... Could you maybe return it for me?
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_ROBYN_000_055: The last I saw, they were swimming towards western La Noscea. That must be where they live! I wonder if their houses are made of seaweed!
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_ROBYN_000_056: Please don't hurt those fishmen─they're some of the nice ones! Even if they did smell a bit like rotting crabmeat... Heh heh.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_WOMAN01374_000_057: (-Bedraggled Woman-)My precious boy...I thought him lost to the sea. I shall praise the mercy of the Navigator morn and eve for the rest of my days.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_WILTFALK_000_058: Why would the fishbacks save the child of their enemy? It makes not a lick o' sense. Those heartless bottom-feeders are up to somethin'. Somethin' devious...
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_SAHUAGINGATEMAN0137: What is the meaning of this tressspass!? I should ssskewer you where you ssstand, finless one!
Pshhh! You carry the necklace of Clutchfather Novv! How is it that you possess this cherished treasure?
...You come at the behest of the child he sssaved? Sssuch unusual manners for a shhhorewalker.
Pshhh... You may pass. Ssseek out Clutchfather Novv and be shhhure to keep your tone respectful─he is the elder of our clan.
Pshhh... You shhhow courage, finless one. Few shhhorewalkers would so boldly approach our settlement. Go, ssseek out Clutchfather Novv and make no trouble.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_NOVV_000_070: Pshhhahaha. Rare it is to sssee a shhhorewalker in our midst. I am Novv, clutchfather to this clan of ssspawnlings. Ah, the finless child bid you return my necklace, did he?
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_NOVV_000_071: Pshhh? No, I had no ssspecial reason for sssaving the boy. Only that for the Sahagin─as it is for you shhhorewalkers─offspring are considered the most preciousss of treasures.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_NOVV_000_072: All that reside here are bound by ties of blood. All are the children of the clutchfather.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_NOVV_000_073: Only ssslightly less precious to me than my ssspawn is the trinket you bring. It was a gift─a commendation from our beloved matriarch. I thank you for returning it to me.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_NOVV_000_074: We have a sssaying: “The favor of one is repaid by the gratitude of the clutch.” Pshhh... I welcome you to our home.
TEXT_BANSAH001_01374_NOVV_000_075: Perhapsss a modest banquet is in order. I do not know, however, if our ssspread will agree with your shhhorewalker ssstomach! Pshhhahaha!
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_000: Pshhh... You witnessed the aftermath of the attack in the Ssstrait of Merlthor? Yesss, it was indeed perpetrated by Sssahagin.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_001: The individuals resssponsible are called the Coral Tridents. They reside in the Sssapsa Ssspawning Grounds, and are known among our people as a volatile and fanatical faction.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_002: We had hoped to prevent them from ever reaching that vessel, but alasss, the current was not in our favor. Foolishness... Their actions only invite further violence through retaliation.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_003: And what of Novv and his clutch, you ask? We live apart from the ssspawning grounds, and pursssue a ssseparate agenda.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_004: I do not claim to underssstand the ssstructure of your civilization, but for us Sahagin, each clan of clutchmatesss is led by a single clutchfather.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_005: The Indigo Matriarch─what you might call our “queen”─bessstows each clutch of her eggs upon only the bravest and most ssseasoned warriors. It is then a clutchfather's duty to raise and inssstruct his charges in the ways of our people.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_006: Pshhh... But for this cycle to continue, the matriarch must have a sssecure environment in which to bear her offssspring. That is why we chose to make this land our home.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_007: It is unfortunate, then, that the Sssapsa Ssspawning Grounds have become the locus of sssuch conflict. If only more shhhorewalkers were like you, and ssspent a moment to understand our sssitua─
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_009: Pshhh... What have I taught you, Seww? A Sssahagin does not flail and sssplash about so─he rolls with the waves, and rides the currentsss.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_SEWW_000_010: Forgive me, Clutchfather, I─ Pshhh. It is Pyuu, our sixth-youngeshhht brother.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_SEWW_000_012: Pshhh! He has left the nurshhhery without permishhhion! He shhhpoke of talking shhhense into the Coral Tridents!
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_013: Pshhh... His brain is as sssoft as his ssspawnling ssscales. And this at a time when I cannot afford to take my eyes off the ressst of the clutch.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_014: Though our ssstance towards each other is not yet clear, shhhorewalker, I would ask a boon of you: sssave my foolish ssson. Seww here will have more to say on the sssubject, I am sure.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_015: Let us ssspeak more on the fate of our peoples when you return. Seww will explain where you are likely to find my disssobedient offssspring...or what remains of him, at least.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_SEWW_000_020: You have no shhhcales, and yet the clutchfather shhheems to trust you. I shall do the shhhame.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_SEWW_000_021: As you just heard, my brother Pyuu has taken it upon himshhhelf to educate the Coral Tridents.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_SEWW_000_022: He is one of our more impetuous shhhpawnbrothers, and yet young─he does not realize the peril he puts himshhhelf in! The Tridents will not listen to Pyuu's reasoning. They will laugh as they impale him on their shhhpears!
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_SEWW_000_023: Please, bring Pyuu back shhhafely to the nurshhhery. By now, he must be some distance across the Landbase, closer to North Tidegate.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_SEWW_000_024: Pshhh! Pyuu likely believes himshhhelf the clutchfather's shhhpecial emishhhary. I fear his reception will be far less diplomatic than he anticipates!
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_PYUU_000_040: Ressscued by a shhhorewalker... What am I to tell Clutchfather Novv? Hm? Ssspawnbrother Ssseww bid you come to my aid?
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_PYUU_000_041: Pshhh... I do not underssstand these Coral Trident warriors. I ssscarce opened my maw before they proceeded to beat me bloody!
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_PYUU_000_042: The clutchfather always sssays that the currentsss of discussion carry us to enlightenment, but it ssseems the words of a ssspawnling count for little and less.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_PYUU_000_043: I sssimply wanted to put into practice what my clutchmatesss and I had been taught. Now, I shhhurely face a punishhhment in addition to my beating...
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_050: Welcome back, shhhorewalker. You are kind to endanger yourssself, though you owe us no sssuch loyalty. Pyuu will be appropriately disciplined for his reckless actionsss.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_051: Now, more than ever, the Sssahagin must act with caution and wisdom. Many of our people reside peacefully within our city in the Indigo Deep, but our civilization faces a sssteady and treacherousss decline.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_052: We must venture onto land to sssecure ssspawning grounds to lay our eggs, and build nurssseries to raise our young. It is an essential element of our breeding cycle─an inssstinct too powerful to ignore.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_053: Our traditional ssspawning grounds were, however, annihilated in the Calamity. Thus were we forced to seize this new location─the region the finless ones call “wessstern La Noscea.”
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_054: Pshhh... It is not sssurprising that the shhhorewalkers view our sssudden aggressive expansion as naught more than an invasion. But this ssseemingly unprovoked attack on their territory is, in truth, a desperate ssstruggle for sssurvival.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_055: Without this land, without a place to rear offspring, the Sssahagin race is doomed. We are in no position to wage war againssst the shhhorewalkers! We mussst attempt a parley, and learn to exist ssside by ssside!
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_056: The Coral Tridentsss, as you have no doubt realized, do not comprehend the meritsss of a diplomatic approach. They ssseek only to control the weak of mind─those like their brutal Ssserpent Reavers─and ssslaughter all others who oppose them.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_057: Pshhh... Do not missstake me as a traitor to my kind─I hold no love for finless ones. I shhhed no sssalty tears when the great Leviathan is sssummoned and the Lord of the Whorl gathers new drowned shhhorewalkers to His fold.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_058: But conflict with your peoples is not the answer to our woes! We mussst look beyond the present, and enshhhure calmer waters─waters in which the future of our race can thrive.
TEXT_BANSAH002_01375_NOVV_000_059: Shhhorewalker, your arrival is a precious gift. I would have you become the first ssstone in the bridge I hope to build between our peoples...and the rock which bluntsss the mindless ssspears of the Coral Tridentsss. I pray you, lend us your aid.
