TEXT_BANSAH106_01384_FYUU_000_003: Travel to Moonshhhade Isle, and firssst ssslay the pugils for their fleshhh. If you then place these morsssels on the sssand, the sssnippers will sssoon emerge from their burrows to feed.
TEXT_BANSAH106_01384_FYUU_000_004: Pshhh... Pahh's elbssst know the way to the isle─you need only remain upright in the sssaddle.
TEXT_BANSAH106_01384_FYUU_000_005: Travel to Moonshhhade Isle, and use the fleshhh of freshhhly ssslain pugils to lure the sssnippers from their burrows. The shhhells are quite large, ssso you need only gather one or two. Pshhh... Make it two.
TEXT_BANSAH106_01384_FYUU_000_006: Pshhh... Pahh's elbssst know the way to the isle─you need only remain upright in the sssaddle.
TEXT_BANSAH106_01384_TAMER01376_000_010: Pshhh... Moonshhhade Isle? My elbssst will carry you there with her eyes closed.
TEXT_BANSAH106_01384_Q1_000_000: Ride the elbst to Moonshade Isle?
TEXT_BANSAH106_01384_POPMESSAGE_000_000: A ravenous crustacean emerges from beneath the sand!
TEXT_BANSAH106_01384_FYUU_000_010: Pshhh... How fares your grand hunt for sssnipper shhhells?
TEXT_BANSAH106_01384_FYUU_000_015: Yesss, these are fine ssspecimens, indeed. Though difficult to crack, the resulting sssplinters are uncommonly shhharp and rigid─perfect for ssspearheads. Thank you, shhhorewalker.
TEXT_BANSAH106_01384_FYUU_000_016: Learning to thrussst, and gauging dissstance to prey─these are ssskills all Sssahagin mussst learn. The hardessst part of teaching the hatchlings, however, is making shhhure they do not impale themssselves or each other...
TEXT_BANSAH107_01385_FYUU_000_000: Pshhh... There are many duties that occupy my time here in the nursssery, not the leassst of which is keeping the hatchlings fed.
TEXT_BANSAH107_01385_FYUU_000_001: And though there are many fishhh to be had in the nearby waters, it would be nice to expose my little ssspawnbrothers to more of what the sssea has to offer.
TEXT_BANSAH107_01385_FYUU_000_002: Pshhh... If you could head over to Moonshhhade Isle and gather an armful of whitecap clams, it would do much for your ssstanding with the clutch.
TEXT_BANSAH107_01385_FYUU_000_003: The clams are a delicacy, you sssee, but we mussst often fight off other predators to claim them. Are you up to the tasssk?
TEXT_BANSAH107_01385_FYUU_000_004: Pshhh... For this vital errand, I am shhhure Pahh will be glad to offer you the ssservices of his ssswiftest elbssst.
TEXT_BANSAH107_01385_FYUU_000_005: Head over to Moonshhhade Isle, and gather as many whitecap clams as you can find. Jussst be on the lookout for other predators ssseeking to contessst your claim!
TEXT_BANSAH107_01385_TAMER01376_000_010: Pshhh... You go to Moonshhhade Isle for clams!? Ah, I can already tassste that sssucculent clam flesh...
TEXT_BANSAH107_01385_Q1_000_000: Ride the elbst to Moonshade Isle?
TEXT_BANSAH107_01385_POPMESSAGE_000_000: An uragnite contests your claim on the clams!
TEXT_BANSAH107_01385_FYUU_000_020: Have you been to Moonshhhade Isle? Let me sssee your haul.
TEXT_BANSAH107_01385_FYUU_000_025: Pshhh! Thisss is a rare bounty! You have made many friends within the clutch this day.
TEXT_BANSAH107_01385_FYUU_000_026: I will drop these clams in a rock pool to keep them freshhh. Cook them? No, no, they mussst be eaten raw, shhhorewalker!
TEXT_BANSAH108_01386_FYUU_000_000: Pshhh! The Coral Tridentsss have taken command of a trading vessel! They certainly wasssted no time in sssending a messenger to boassst of their achievement to their brothers in the ssspawning grounds...
TEXT_BANSAH108_01386_FYUU_000_001: If this prideful revelry is allowed to continue, it will only encourage others to follow their example.
TEXT_BANSAH108_01386_FYUU_000_002: I propose that you board the captured shhhip, and knock sssome humility into these merchant-hunting fools. Shhhow them that not all shhhorewalkers are sssuch easy prey!
TEXT_BANSAH108_01386_FYUU_000_003: Begin your “demonssstration” with the rank and file on deck, and their leader will sssoon appear to challenge you. His defeat at your hands shhhould have the desired effect.
TEXT_BANSAH108_01386_FYUU_000_004: Pshhh... The merchantman is yet in open water, so you will need to ride an elbssst to reach it. Take the wind from their sssails, finless one!
TEXT_BANSAH108_01386_FYUU_000_005: Take an elbssst and make your way to the merchantman. Once you are over the rail, engage the lesser warriors firssst. Their leader will sssoon make his presence known, and then you can complete your lesson in humility.
TEXT_BANSAH108_01386_TAMER01376_000_010: The captured merchantman? It's far from the ssspawning grounds, and that is good─my elbssst needs the exercise.
TEXT_BANSAH108_01386_01376_Q1_000_000: Ride the elbst to the merchantman?
TEXT_BANSAH108_01386_FYUU_000_020: Pshhh... Your lesson was a success? The tale of their humiliation will be apparent to all when they ssslink back to shhhore, beaten and bloody.
TEXT_BANSAH108_01386_FYUU_000_021: Thisss incident reminds me of a recent experience: after a particularly bountiful fishhhing expedition, I gorged myself on my catch.
TEXT_BANSAH108_01386_FYUU_000_022: It wasn't until after I had finishhhed my gluttonous feassst that I noticed the remains of a mildly poisonousss bottom-feeder. I was sssick for days, and have been careful to sssort my hauls ever sssince.
TEXT_BANSAH108_01386_FYUU_000_023: Pshhh! No! I do not mean to compare you to a bottom-feeder! Forget the ssstory! I thank you for your aid, shhhorewalker!
TEXT_BANSAH108_01386_POPMESSAGE_000_000: A surfclaw chief appears and challenges you!
TEXT_BANSAH108_01386_BALLOON_000_030:
This shhhip is ours, shhhorewalker!
The Tridentshhh are invincible!
TEXT_BANSAH109_01387_FYUU_000_000: Pshhh... The piracy of the Coral Tridentsss continues unabated─they have ssstruck another trading vessel.
TEXT_BANSAH109_01387_FYUU_000_001: The merchantman's captain and crew were able to essscape in a landing ssskiff, but they were forced to abandon their shhhip─and its cargo─to their attackers.
TEXT_BANSAH109_01387_FYUU_000_002: I am of a mind to sssee this cargo returned to the shhhorewalkers. Pshhh... Perhapsss it is time you practiced a little piracy of your own! Ssspeak with Pahh and borrow an elbssst─his ssseabeast will sssoon catch up to your burdened target.
TEXT_BANSAH109_01387_FYUU_000_003: Take an elbssst, and make your way to the Trident-infesssted merchantman. Let us sssee what cargo you can retrieve for the shhhorewalkers.
TEXT_BANSAH109_01387_TAMER01376_000_010: Pshhh... The captured merchantman? My elbssst will have you sssnapping at its rudder before you've sssettled in the sssaddle.
TEXT_BANSAH109_01387_Q1_000_000: Ride the elbst to the merchantman?
TEXT_BANSAH109_01387_FYUU_000_020: Shhhorewalker, were you able to sssteal back the cargo?
TEXT_BANSAH109_01387_FYUU_000_025: Pshhh... Thank you. We will deliver these cratesss ourssselves.
TEXT_BANSAH109_01387_FYUU_000_026: The crew of the merchantman may be alarmed by our appearance, but we mussst make an effort to teach them that not all Sssahagin desire conflict and chaosss.
TEXT_BANSAH109_01387_POPMESSAGE_000_000: A watchful surftooth sentry attempts to prevent you from taking the crate!
TEXT_BANSAH109_01387_BALLOON_000_030: Pshhh! You will not have our shhhpoils!
TEXT_BANSAH109_01387_BALLOON_000_031: Pshhh! I'll take your thieving hands!
TEXT_BANSAH110_01388_FYUU_000_000: Pshhh... Ill news, finless one. My watchful ssspawnbrothers witnessed a group of young Trident warriors sssneaking around the coassstline in an attempt to bypass the defenses of the tidegates.
TEXT_BANSAH110_01388_FYUU_000_001: Assuming they have been successful, these impatient infiltrators will have already taken up position in the shhhadows around the shhhorewalker camp. Now they await but the opportunity to ssstrike.
TEXT_BANSAH110_01388_FYUU_000_002: If you are quick about tracking them down, perhapsss you can convince them to abandon this folly before any real damage is done.
TEXT_BANSAH110_01388_FYUU_000_003: Should they refuse to heed your warnings, then do what mussst be done. I will not long grieve for kin that place our entire race in jeopardy.
TEXT_BANSAH110_01388_FYUU_000_005: Pshhh... Sssearch the shhhorewalker encampment beyond the tidegates for these eager fools. If they do not abandon their ssscheme upon being dissscovered, then use whatever force is necessary to end this incident before it is begun.
TEXT_BANSAH110_01388_MOBA01388_000_010: Our ssscheme is uncovered? Pshhhahaha! Then yours shhhall be the firssst blood I ssspill!
TEXT_BANSAH110_01388_MOBB01388_000_020: Pshhh... Any who oppose the will of the Tridentshhh mushhht fall!
TEXT_BANSAH110_01388_MOBC01388_000_030: You think to command me, finless one!? I will teach you to tessst the might of the Sssahagin!
TEXT_BANSAH110_01388_MOBD01388_000_040: Are you sssun-touched, shhhorewalker? We will abandon our purpose when the sssea runs dry!
TEXT_BANSAH110_01388_FYUU_000_060: Pshhh... Ssso, the infiltrators all lie ssslain? I expected as much, but I had hoped they would listen to reason.
TEXT_BANSAH110_01388_FYUU_000_061: Perhapsss if my kin continue to fail in this manner, they will one day reconsssider their warmongering ways...
TEXT_BANSAH201_01390_HOUU_000_000: Pshhh... My eyes and ears among the waves shhhay the Coral Tridents fetched shhhorcerers from the Indigo Deep.
TEXT_BANSAH201_01390_HOUU_000_001: With shhhuch potent healers in their ranks, they will shhhurely launch an even greater onshhhlaught. This we cannot have...not me, not my shhhpawnbrothers, and certainly not the clutchfather.
TEXT_BANSAH201_01390_HOUU_000_002: Shhhorewalker, you must persuade these shhhorcerers to depart. Pshhh... I do not understand why they would not shhheek to shhhtay closer to home.
TEXT_BANSAH201_01390_HOUU_000_010: Pshhh... Wade in the waters of the Shhhapsa Shhhpawning Grounds and turn back the Coral Tridents' new healers. They shhhould never have left the Indigo Deep...
TEXT_BANSAH201_01390_HOUU_000_020: The waves brought news of your shhhuccess. We are in your debt. How you manage in the shhhea without any...anything is beyond me. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH201_01390_HOUU_000_021: Without the aid of shhhorcerers, the Coral Tridents dare not shhhtrike in force. The clutchfather will find the water shhhweeter for it.
TEXT_BANSAH202_01391_HOUU_000_000: We cannot shhhwallow whole the Coral Tridents, but we can nibble at that which makes them shhhtrong. Many creatures they use for their fell purpose, among them elbst. Shhhorewalker, might you aid ushhh in removing thishhh threat?
TEXT_BANSAH202_01391_HOUU_000_001: There are in the Shhhapsa Shhhpawning Grounds elbst young and frisky. They will not be easy to shhhlay, but shhhlay them you must...
TEXT_BANSAH202_01391_HOUU_000_002: Doing so will bring down the wrath of their shhhire, the big flipper. This is the shhhtud for the Tridents' elbst stable, and with it gone, the breeding will shhhtop.
TEXT_BANSAH202_01391_HOUU_000_003: Take this milky vitriol and use it on the big flipper. Even your shhhorewalker arms are no match for the hide of a mature elbst... The shhhea forgives only the shhhoftest and the hardest. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH202_01391_HOUU_000_010: First, shhhtrike at the young Shhhapsa elbst in the shhhpawning grounds.
TEXT_BANSAH202_01391_HOUU_000_011: The big flipper will rushhh to their defense. This milky vitriol you shall use to shhhlay him and end the Tridents' breeding stable.
TEXT_BANSAH202_01391_HOUU_000_020: Pshhh... You have done well to dispatch the elbst. A nibble there, a nibble here... It keeps us shhhafe from the Tridents' warring ways.
TEXT_BANSAH202_01391_HOUU_000_021: They had but one shhhtud, procured at great cost, or so the waves tell me. There will be no elbst hatchlings for a while. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH202_01391_HOUU_000_022: You shhhorewalkers have no elbst; you have grounded gulls instead. Shhhtrange it shhheems to ride a gull that cannot even fly, but the clutchfather teaches us that there are as many ways as there are grains of shhhand.
TEXT_BANSAH203_01392_HOUU_000_000: It is a fact that the Shhherpent Reavers aid the Coral Tridents to attack trading shhhips... They guide the Tridents right to where the shhhips will be moshhht vulnerable.
TEXT_BANSAH203_01392_HOUU_000_001: The Reavers and these prey may be shhhorewalkers both, but...it lies ill with me and my shhhpawnbrothers when the Tridents profit in any way. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH203_01392_HOUU_000_002: These Reaver shhheamen who bespeak the Tridents...they are due to shhhojourn from the Shhherpent's Tongue to the Shhhapsa Shhhpawning Grounds. Shhhuitable for an ambush, I think...right at the approach to the grounds...
TEXT_BANSAH203_01392_HOUU_000_010: Pshhh... Lay an ambush at the approach to the Shhhapsa Shhhpawning Grounds... It shhherves us both to see those Reaver shhheamen shhhilenced.
TEXT_BANSAH203_01392_HOUU_000_020: The Reavers shhhleep with the fishes? Good... They will guide no more Trident attacks. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH203_01392_HOUU_000_021: Shhhodden or dry, I say shhhorewalkers are not to be trusted. I weep not for any shhhorewalker shhhips lost, but...the clutchfather shhhpeaks of keeping our eye on the prize...
TEXT_BANSAH203_01392_HOUU_000_022: War is the enemy, and these ties between the Tridents and shhhorewalker pirates lash the shhhea to greater tumult... Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH203_01392_BALLOON_000_030: We'll make mincemeat out o' ye!
TEXT_BANSAH203_01392_BALLOON_000_031: A landlubber, aye? Drag ye into the sea, we will!
TEXT_BANSAH203_01392_BALLOON_000_032: I'll see ye to a watery grave!
TEXT_BANSAH204_01393_HOUU_000_000: Pshhh... Pshhh... The Coral Tridents have built new shhhiege engines. A whelk on the wheeled base built by the Shhherpent Reavers. Just one will devastate shhhorewalker defenses, but there are shhheveral...
TEXT_BANSAH204_01393_HOUU_000_001: I have heard tell of these shhhellfish. An incredible shhhight it is shhhaid to be, the energy bolts they throw lighting up the Indigo Deep in a shhhearing flash.
TEXT_BANSAH204_01393_HOUU_000_002: The ballistas have only just been unloaded, but to the front they will go, and shhhoon. They must be destroyed now before they can be used. I shhhudder to think of the devastation they will wreak. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH204_01393_HOUU_000_003: It falls to you to wreck the ballistas. They will be guarded and I fear bloodshed cannot be avoided. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH204_01393_HOUU_000_010: Pshhh... Destroy at least two of the fresh whelk ballistas in the Sapsa Spawning Grounds. There will be guards, but...do what you mushhht.
TEXT_BANSAH204_01393_HOUU_000_020:
Pshhh! Your return can only mean the ballistas have been─
...What's thishhh, you shhhay? More were there than even I shhhaid? These are ill tidings, shhhorewalker.
TEXT_BANSAH204_01393_HOUU_000_021: I would like to think your actions have instilled shhhome amount of fear in the Coral Tridentshhh, and that is what we need. If even a closely guarded weapon is not shhhafe, how shhhafe can their warriors be? But shhhtill, it would shhheem we yet have a long way to go...
TEXT_BANSAH205_01394_HOUU_000_000: Pshhh... A shorewalker trading vessel was raided by Shhherpent Reavers. The cargo was arms and armor, and a great deal of it.
TEXT_BANSAH205_01394_HOUU_000_001: Though clumsy in the shhhea, your shorewalker arms are devastating on land. They cannot be allowed to pass into the Coral Tridents' hands. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH205_01394_HOUU_000_002: Put the crates of stolen armaments to the flame, shorewalker. All you need are these flint shhhtones, for they are volatile things. Be warned, the Coral Tridents may be in the area. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH205_01394_HOUU_000_010: Pshhh... Take these flint shhhtones and put the shhhtolen armaments in the Shhhapsa Shhhpawning Grounds to the flame. The Coral Tridents must not have them.
TEXT_BANSAH205_01394_HOUU_000_020: You burned every last crate? Good. Good. Unnatural thing, fire. It shhheems pointless to fight water. It needs no fuel... Yes, it is patient.
TEXT_BANSAH205_01394_HOUU_000_021: You shhhorewalkers have no patience, it shhheems to me. You interfere with trees and earth, forcing the wood and metal into arms. You are impatient and cruel...and very lonely. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH205_01394_HOUU_000_022: That last quality of your kind...it moves me. That is a shhhurprise. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH205_01394_BALLOON_000_032: Our armaments! How dare you meddle!
TEXT_BANSAH206_01395_HOUU_000_000: Pshhh... We ventured onto land shhholely to shhhecure a place for the Indigo Matriarch to shhhpawn.
TEXT_BANSAH206_01395_HOUU_000_001: But the shhhpawning grounds remain untamed, for too many of our people see more honor in a shhhpear than a mattock. Shhhuch is our need that we must turn to a shhhorewalker for aid...
TEXT_BANSAH206_01395_HOUU_000_002: Chief among our concerns is the gas shhhprayed from the local barnacles. Their noxious fumes would harm our eggs. The moshhht effective way of dealing with thishhh is to stuff their shhhpraying orifices with moon jellyfish.
TEXT_BANSAH206_01395_HOUU_000_003: But beware the Shhhapsa pugils while you shhhtopper the barnacles. They do not take kindly to shhhtrangers manhandling their favored shhhnacks. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH206_01395_HOUU_000_005: Pshhh... The gas shhhprayed by noxious barnacles harms our eggs. You must shhhtuff their orifices with jellyfish, and make the Shhhapsa Shhhpawning Grounds safe...
TEXT_BANSAH206_01395_HOUU_000_006: But beware the Shhhapsa pugil. They regard the barnacles as you shhhorewalkers would shhheep, and do not like them to be molested. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH206_01395_HOUU_000_020: The barnacles are shhhtoppered? Good... I was beginning to fear that the shhhpawning itself may be in peril. I am grateful. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH206_01395_HOUU_000_021: If we do not shhhpawn, it is the end for our people. What use to shhhtride off to war if there are no shhhpawnlings to return to, no matriarch to continue the line? But young males never listen. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH206_01395_POPMESSAGE_000_000: You detect an angry, hungry presence!
TEXT_BANSAH207_01396_HOUU_000_000: Pshhh... Have you heard of the strategoi of the Shhhapsa Shhhpawning Grounds? They are leaders among Shhhahagin warriors, possessed of great influence.
TEXT_BANSAH207_01396_HOUU_000_001: Alas, the Shhhcarlet Shhhea Devil has been inflaming their pride with visions of easy victory. Shhhubtle and shhhly are the Coral Tridents. If nothing is done, their aggression will soon lead to all-out war with you shhhorewalkers...
TEXT_BANSAH207_01396_HOUU_000_002: The strategoi must see that the shhhorewalker is a foe shhhkilled and dangerous. You will fight the most boastful among them. Worr the Whalefin is his name, and he must die this day. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH207_01396_HOUU_000_003: Worr has a coral band, given him as an ally shhhworn of the Coral Tridents. Bring me this bauble as proof that Worr died as shhhamefully as he lived. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH207_01396_HOUU_000_010: Pshhh... Shhhlay Worr the Whalefin and seize from him the coral band of the Tridents.
TEXT_BANSAH207_01396_HOUU_000_011: Pshhh... Worr's coral band, by all that's indigo! The clutchfather always chooses wisely... Little did I expect a shhhorewalker to best the Whalefin.
TEXT_BANSAH207_01396_HOUU_000_012: A strategos is a leader of minds as well as shhhpears. Worr's defeat at a shhhorewalker's hands is an object lesson that will shhhpread throughout the Shhhapsa Shhhpawning Grounds. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH208_01397_HOUU_000_000: Pshhh... The waves bring news of shhhorewalkers held captive by the Coral Tridents. They are of the Maelstrom─mere recruits.
TEXT_BANSAH208_01397_HOUU_000_001: They are certain to be “drowned”─their minds twisted by Leviathan's aweshhhome powers. Unleshhh something is done, the Maelstrom may feel it necessary to shhhtrike back. Go to their rescue, shhhorewalker.
TEXT_BANSAH208_01397_HOUU_000_002: Deep within the shhhpawning grounds, you will find them lying insensate. The gas shhhpewing forth from the Tridents' paralysis pots comes from noxious barnacles, and it renders them helpleshhh.
TEXT_BANSAH208_01397_HOUU_000_003: Pshhh... Use these shhhtoppers to plug the pots stationed by the recruits. They should come to shhhortly thereafter once the air clears.
TEXT_BANSAH208_01397_HOUU_000_004: Use the shhhtoppers on the paralysis pots to restore the captive shhhorewalkers to their shhhenses. But beware the Coral Tridents along the way... Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH208_01397_KOKKA01397_000_008: Llymlaen... Halone... Thaliak... I...I can't remember which god to call to...
TEXT_BANSAH208_01397_KOKKA01397_000_010: Ungh... I'm not... What's...? What in the Navigator's name am I doing? We have to get out of here!
TEXT_BANSAH208_01397_KOKKA01397_000_011: Wh-Where am I!? What is this!? We were attacked! Taken by the Sahagin! Must! Report!
TEXT_BANSAH208_01397_KOKKA01397_000_012: What a dream! Home, before the Calamity. Had it pretty good, didn't I? But my home's with the Maelstrom now... I'd better get back.
TEXT_BANSAH208_01397_KOKKA01397_000_013: Adventurer, you have saved my sanity! Those cursed fishbacks would part me from mine own mind!
TEXT_BANSAH208_01397_HOUU_000_030: The captive shhhorewalkers swim free? Good... The drowned have their place, for Lord Leviathan must have His due, but...
TEXT_BANSAH208_01397_HOUU_000_031: Shhhorewalkers are a vengeful people. For every Maelstrom won for Lord Leviathan, there will be retribution in kind and more. Not worth the trouble, I shhhould think. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH208_01397_SAHUAGIN01397_000_0: (-Shelfclaw Guard-)Pshhh! You dare take what belongs to Lord Leviathan!?
(-Shelfclaw Guard-)Another shhhoul that shhheeks to be drowned! Your innermost wish I shhhall grant!
(-Shelfclaw Guard-)The Coral Tridents take no prisoners! Well, except this lot. But never you mind that─prepare to die!
TEXT_BANSAH209_01398_HOUU_000_000: Pshhh... You know of Moonshade Isle, yeshhh? It is one of the favored fishing grounds of my people, including we of Novv's Clutch.
TEXT_BANSAH209_01398_HOUU_000_001: Shhhadly, the Coral Tridents know this as well. They shhhend the Shhherpent Reavers to the gentle isle to shhhcatter the fish and bedevil the fishers.
TEXT_BANSAH209_01398_HOUU_000_002: The Reavers shhhkulk on the island, for they mean to shhheize it for themselves. Our shhhpawnbrothers go hungry as long as these foul pirates are unchallenged. Will you dispatch the Reavers and unchain Moonshade Isle?
TEXT_BANSAH209_01398_HOUU_000_003: You will need an elbst to reach the isle. Shhhpeak with the shhheabeast tamer Pahh and all shhhall be well. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH209_01398_HOUU_000_004: Speak to Pahh the shhheabeast tamer. You must take an elbst to Moonshade Isle and cast out the Shhherpent Reavers. Pshhh...
TEXT_BANSAH209_01398_TAMER01376_000_010: Moonshade Isle? Very myssstical place... It has a very ssspecial energy. One of my elbssst will take you, shhhorewalker.
TEXT_BANSAH209_01398_01376_Q1_000_000: Ride the elbst to Moonshade Isle?
TEXT_BANSAH209_01398_HOUU_000_020: Pshhh... You have done well for our shhhpawnbrothers. Shhhleek they will grow, with no pirates to keep them from the waves. The shhhorewalker pirates are hateful to my eyes... I rejoice in their demise.
TEXT_BANSAH209_01398_HOUU_000_021: The clutchfather counsels us to fight only when we cannot shhhwim away. But what of times like this? If we shhhwam away, our brothers would be left to starve, unschooled in the ways of the fisher. The way is as unclear as a shhhea much churned...
TEXT_BANSAH209_01398_BALLOON_000_030: The fish ain't bitin' today! Or tomorrow!

TEXT_BANALL020_01468_GAVIN_000_005: It need not be said that any threat facing our sylph friends is potentially a threat to Gridania, as well. Pray make for Little Solace and look into the matter that concerns Master Voyce so.
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_VOYCE_000_000_010: Wh-What's this!? My copy of A Brief Historie of the Twelveswood has been replaced by a tome detailing two hundred and forty varieties of beastkin feces!
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_VOYCE_000_000_011: Wh-Why, ! Whatever are you doing here!? I sent for you? Now that you mention it, perhaps I did! Ahahahahaha!
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_VOYCE_000_000_012: What is the matter? What is the matter, you say!? A veritable peck of podlings, pilfered from Little Solace while I was taking...ah, a brief respite from my research.
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_VOYCE_000_000_013: You must help me, friend! Why, were Elder Frixio to find out that this happened under my watch─
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_FRIXIO_000_000_015: This one is heartened by brave one's presence. If there is one thing that can be said for bumbling one, it is that bumbling one has strong and trustworthy friends.
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_FRIXIO_000_000_016: This one fears it is exactly as bumbling one says. Little ones that these ones had raised with care...little ones soon to sprout to life, gone! Every last one...
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_VOYCE_000_000_017: As you well know, friend, podlings are young sylphs in their pre-birth state. Why, this is no mere act of theft, but sylph-napping on an unprecedented scale!
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_FRIXIO_000_000_018: Little ones are the future. Without little ones, there will be no one to carry on these ones' vision of peace.
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_VOYCE_000_000_019: The touched ones are behind this, no doubt! Having failed to capture the Chosen One, now they would rear an entire generation of hate-filled, treacherous sylphs! We must stop them!
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_VOYCE_000_000_020: And by we, I mean brave  here! You will venture to the Sylphlands and rescue the little ones from the hands of their would-be kidnappers, yes? Yes, you must!
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_VOYCE_000_000_025: ! You must hurry to the Sylphlands and catch the touched ones in their vile act. Not for me, my friend─for the little ones!
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_FRIXIO_000_000_026: It pains this one's heart to burden brave one once more, but these ones have nowhere else to turn. Please, brave one, deliver little ones to safety.
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_SILVIA_000_000_031: (-Mysterious Girl-)No,  does not. Otherwise,  would not be looking where  is looking.
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_SILVIA_000_000_032: (-Mysterious Girl-)That which you seek will not be found here. For this is not the idle mischief of malevolent sylphs. Oh, no─this is but the prelude to a dark and dastardly plot that threatens to shake Eorzea to its very core.
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_SILVIA_000_000_033: (-Mysterious Girl-)My name? You could call me Sylvie.
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_SILVIA_000_000_034: But you will have no occasion to do so. For I shall pursue our kidnapper, and you shall return and see to your own concerns. That is, if you know what's good for you...
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_SILVIA_000_000_035: Farewell, friend. Our paths will not cross again. I must...hurry...yes, hurry to La Noscea...before tragedy strikes again...
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_FRIXIO_000_000_036: Brave one returns, but little ones are nowhere to be seen... Were these ones too late to─hmmm? It is not touched ones, brave one says?
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_FRIXIO_000_000_037: A green-haired walking one? Dark plots? Brave one's words concern this one, yet this one holds out hope that little ones may yet be saved...
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_VOYCE_000_000_040: Ah, there you are, friend! I trust that you gave those nasty sylphs their due and returned the little ones to safety?
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_VOYCE_000_000_041: What's that, you say? It was not the touched ones that did the deed, and 'twas a mysterious green-haired maiden that shared this knowledge with you!?
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_VOYCE_000_000_042: Wh-Whoever could be behind this unconscionable crime!? Perhaps the answer lies in one of my tomes...
TEXT_BANALL020_01468_VOYCE_000_000_043: “On the medicinal properties of goobbue feces...” Oh, this won't do at all. Woe, woe is me!
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_VOYCE_000_000_000: It would appear that there is more to the disappearance of the podlings than I originally suspected. But where to turn next? Allow me to apply the scientific method to analyze the situation.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_VOYCE_000_000_001: The girl Sylvie said that the touched ones were not responsible for the crime. As the sylphs of Little Solace would have no reason to kidnap their own, we can safely deduce that the perpetrator is not a sylph at all! Do you follow me thus far?
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_VOYCE_000_000_002: You also say that the girl mentioned La Noscea, and that she must travel there “before tragedy strikes again”...? Good gods! Are you thinking what I'm thinking!?
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_VOYCE_000_000_003: Pirates! Yes, pirates have stolen the podlings to sell on the black markets! Those scurvy, thieving scoundrels!
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_VOYCE_000_000_004: Fortunately for us all, I just so happen to have an acquaintance in the area. A colleague, I should say─he is a naturalist specializing in marine life.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_VOYCE_000_000_005: He goes by the name Guston─primarily, I suspect, because that is his actual name. You'll likely find him at the Drowning Wench. He often said his ideas flow most readily after a pint of Baderon's best.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_VOYCE_000_000_006: You simply rescue the little ones from the clutches of those dastardly pirates! Seek out my colleague Guston in the Drowning Wench. He knows La Noscea almost as well as I know the Twelveswood!
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_GUSTON_000_000_010: The seas are angry today, friend, the waves ten spars 'igh if they were a fulm. Ye'll be stayin' in port if ye know what's─hm? Not a sailor, but an adventurer, ye say?
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_GUSTON_000_000_011: Sent by Voyce, ye say? Llymlaen take me─I journeyed 'alfway 'cross the realm in the 'opes o' riddin' meself of that barnacle-brained lubber!
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_GUSTON_000_000_012: Fortunately for you and yer bunglin' friend, ye've caught ol' Guston in a good mood. So entertain me: what's that bloody fool gotten 'imself into this time?
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_GUSTON_000_000_013: ...Is this supposed to tell me somethin'? This letter looks like it was penned by an 'alf-drunk chocobo! If ye'd be so kind, spare me the 'eadache and give me the details yerself.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_GUSTON_000_000_014: A mass kidnappin' o' baby sylphs, and that bloody 'alf-wit thinks it was pirates what done the deed!? Bwahahaha! That sounds...just crazy enough to be true.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_GUSTON_000_000_015: I was at the docks not a few bells ago when I spied an unfamiliar face. The man 'ad just acquired a vessel, it seemed, and if me ears 'eard true, was lookin' to sail for 'Alfstone amidst a fierce fog.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_GUSTON_000_000_016: A scholar with a face like mine ain't gonna be one to judge by appearances, but I didn't like the cut o' this man's jib, if ye gather me meanin'.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_GUSTON_000_000_017: Mind ye, I didn't speak to the blighter meself. Me son Robyn 'ad a few words with 'im, though, and didn't seem to enjoy the experience none.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_GUSTON_000_000_018: If ye'd speak with 'im for yerself, ye'll find 'im at the docks. Seems 'is adventure under the sea 'asn't dampened 'is passion to follow in 'is old man's footsteps.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_GUSTON_000_000_019: Me son Robyn 'ad a few words with the blighter. If ye'd speak with 'im yerself, ye'll find 'im at the docks like as not.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_ROBYN_000_000_020: Hey, I remember you! You're the adventurer who returned that necklace to the nice fishmen for me!
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_ROBYN_000_000_021: You did return it, didn't you? They were so nice to me, after all. I just had to do something nice for them, too.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_ROBYN_000_000_022: Wonderful! I knew I could count on you. What's that, you say? Father told you about some strange man at the docks?
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_ROBYN_000_000_023: Aye, I saw him, I did. He was wearing some strange metal mask. At least I hope it was a mask─it looked more like a part of his face.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_ROBYN_000_000_024: He said he had a score to settle with Novv. Novv...? Novv...
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_ROBYN_000_000_025: Of course! I didn't remember until I saw your face, but the nice fishmen that saved me...one of them was named “Novv”! I'm sure of it!
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_ROBYN_000_000_026: Are the nice fishmen in danger? P-Please tell me you'll go and make sure they're safe. And bring them this─tell them it's a thank-you gift from Robyn.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_ROBYN_000_000_027: Someday I'll be a researcher like my dad. I'll live with the fishmen, and they'll show me deep-sea secrets that no one's seen before!
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_NOVV_000_030: Pshhh... Are my eyesss to be believed!?
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_NOVV_000_031: Yesss,  returnsss! What brings my shorewalking spawnling back to the clutch?
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_NOVV_000_032: Oh-ren-jez? Thisss is a true delight. Ever sssince the last batch you brought, my ssspawnlings clamor endlessly for more.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_NOVV_000_033: A present from the finless child? This pleases me greater ssstill. Yes, perhapsss a new generation brings hope for peace between our peoples...
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_SEWW_000_034: Pshhh! Clutchfather! I need your counshhhel!
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_NOVV_000_035: Pshhh... Do you ssso quickly forget, Seww? A Sssahagin does not thrash against the currentsss─he is one with the water, flowing as it flows.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_SEWW_000_036: Forgive me, Clutchfather, I─ Pshhh! It is Bouu, our youngeshhht brother!
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_SEWW_000_038: Pshhh! H-He...he was shhhpearfishing at Moonshhhade Isle, and then...and then he was gone, shhhpirited away by a shhhorewalker!
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_NOVV_000_039: Pshhh... Why...? All I and my spawnlings ssseek is to live in peace...
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_NOVV_000_040: . You were the first finless one to prove yourssself a friend to my clutch. I would asssk you to accompany me to Moonshade Isle.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_NOVV_000_041: I have no desire to turn my ssspear against the shhhorewalkers. But I shall defend my ssspawnlings with my life. Travel on ahead, friend─I shall ssswim along shortly.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_NOVV_000_045: Pshhh... Our more sssavage brethren oft herd finless ones to the depths, drowning their souls before the Lord of the Whorl. Does this shhhorewalker who sssteals my spawnlings have equally sssinister aims?
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_SEWW_000_046: Pshhh! There is no time to spare! The shhhorewalker steals away with young Bouu as we shhhpeak!
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_SEWW_000_047: The shhhwiftest way to Moonshade Isle is to take one of Pahh's elbshhhts...but you know this, yes? Hurry, my !
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_TAMER01376_000_048: Pshhh... Your concern for our ssspawnbrother is most touching, finless one. May my finest elbssst guide you true!
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_TAMER01376_000_049: Pshhh. Bouu is but a defenseless ssspawnling, finless one. Prepare as you mussst, but pray do so ssswiftly!
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_SEWW_000_050: Pshhh! Over there! Do you see!?
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_SEWW_000_051: Curshhhes! While we had our fins full with those shhhmall fry, he's fled clear out to shhhea!
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_SEWW_000_052: Bouu is among the youngeshhht of us─his gills have not yet taken form, and his limbshhh have been bound by the finleshhh one. If he is cast into the waters, he will drown like a shhhorewalker!
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_NOVV_000_054: Pshhh! I have come for my child, finless one!
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_NHAZAAJAAB_000_056: (-Menacing Miqo'te-)...So you have. Most impeccable timing, if I say so myself. Heh heh heh...
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_NHAZAAJAAB_000_066: (-Menacing Miqo'te-)...Hmph. So much for the mighty Sahagin. For all your prideful posturing, in the end, you are naught but beasts. Know your place, and spare yourself any further suffering.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_SEWW_000_067: Pshhh! Be shhhtrong, Clutchfather! Your son comes for you!
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_SEWW_000_068: These waters are too deep for a shhhorewalker. Leave the clutchfather's reshhhcue to me─return to the nursery and tell my shhhpawnbrothers to prepare to tend to his wounds.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_NOVV_000_080: Pshhh... Worry not, . It is but a fleshhh wound, and worse have I sssuffered.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_NOVV_000_081: No, it is the dishhhonor of failing to protect my child that cuts truly deep.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_NOVV_000_082: This masked shhhorewalker who would sssteal my child from me─he will anssswer for his crimes. Yes, I must...pshhh... I must ressst for a while.
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_SEWW_000_083: Kidnapping my spawnbrother, shhhtriking at the clutchfather...that furred finless one makes a mockery of us all! I will not shhhuffer this dishonor!
TEXT_BANALL030_01469_SEWW_000_084: And yet...such shhhtrength! How can we hope to shhhtand against such a foe? Pshhh...
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_NOVV_000_000: Pshhh.... You may lack for gills, but you are as much my child as any of those I have spawned. It is as your clutchfather that I would bessseech your aid.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_NOVV_000_001: I know not what that masked shhhorewalker means to do with Bouu, but I fear for the boy's life. I would leave this moment in pursssuit, but I am not young, and my wounds are slow to heal. My ─pray rescue your brother in my ssstead.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_NOVV_000_002: There is a sssaying among our people: the shark that swallows a Sahagin will choke on its ssscales. Though my clash with the kidnapper might have appeared a one-sided affair, I assure you it was not entirely so.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_NOVV_000_003: After I tumbled into the waves, I struck at the villain's skiff with my spear. Even in my weakened state, I was able to open a sssizable hole in its bottom. The vessel will flood before long, if it has not already.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_NOVV_000_004: The fiend will have no choice but to dock at the nearessst port for repairs. And there is only one sssuitable location in western La Noscea. Pshhh! You will find our man at Aleport─you can be sure of it!
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_NOVV_000_005: Go forth, O strongest of my ! Your ssspawnbrother's life hangs in the balance!
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_NOVV_000_006: Pshhh... You must pursssue the fiend to Aleport, my . Your ssspawnbrother's life hangs in the balance!
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SYSTEM_000_008: A survey of the skiff reveals nothing unusual.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SYSTEM_000_009: You notice a small hole in the skiff's bottom, identifying it as the kidnapper's vessel.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SILVIA_000_010: (-???-)Again  comes, unaware that what  seeks has already been swept away by the tide.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SILVIA_000_011: Just couldn't leave well enough alone, could you, stranger? Ah, well. I suppose it matters little now.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SILVIA_000_012: I know who it is you seek...for I seek him as well. I also know that our man left Aleport not bells ago, and none in town can speak as to his whereabouts.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SILVIA_000_013: First he came for sylphs, then for Sahagin. Yes, it is clear enough. The wheels are in motion, and they will not stop until every beast tribe has been crushed beneath...
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SILVIA_000_014: He must be stopped─and I will be the one to stop him!
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SILVIA_000_015: Why, indeed? If I had an answer, it would make our search that much the easier. Alas, the Ebon Claw's motives are as inscrutable as that red eye...
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SILVIA_000_016: ...So you saw him as well. Clad all in black, with a face of metal and that red eye burning in the darkness...
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SILVIA_000_017: They call him the Ebon Claw, as those who speak his birth name are said to be not long for the world. To what dark end he preys upon the beast tribes, I cannot say─only that he cannot be allowed to continue.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SILVIA_000_018: If you would know more of our quarry, seek out Baderon at the Drowning Wench.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SILVIA_000_019: I must move quickly...before tragedy strikes again...
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_BADERON_000_020: Well, if it ain't me favorite regular, ! 'Ave ye come for a pint or a tale─mayhap both?
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_BADERON_000_021: Bugger me with a spear, an' tell me ye didn't just say what I think ye said!
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_BADERON_000_022: I told ye not to tell me that, . Aye, just 'earing those words sends a shiver up me spine...
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_BADERON_000_023: ...The Ebon Claw. Nhaza'a Jaab─though I'd suggest you avoid speakin' that name if ye prefer yer 'ead attached to yer body. One o' the five deadliest sellswords in Eorzea, by my measure.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_BADERON_000_024: Not that yer like to 'ave 'eard of 'im. Prefers to keep to the shadows, ye see. Smugglin', assassination, extortion─the dirtier the job, the more it titillates the man.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_BADERON_000_025: Believe it or not, 'e started out as an adventurer not unlike yerself. Some reckoned 'e'd be just the 'ero the realm was lookin' for. But doin' good didn't seem to satisfy 'im none, and it didn't take 'im long to turn to the dark side...
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_BADERON_000_026: Yer as strong and sure a  as I know, and that's why I give ye this advice: keep a wide berth o' that man. I'd 'ate to see ye end up like...
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_BADERON_000_027: ...Which reminds me, . Someone stopped by the Wench not long ago, askin' if I'd seen ye about.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_BADERON_000_028: An officer of the Maelstrom, no less. I believe 'e said 'is name was Trachraet.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_BADERON_000_029: The burly bloke didn't share any details, but it seemed a matter o' some urgency. Ye'd best get along to Maelstrom Command and see what the fuss is.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_BADERON_000_030: Can't say for sure what Trachraet wanted, but it sounded like a matter o' some urgency.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_TRACHRAET_000_030: Thank the Navigator! Just the  I was lookin' to see!
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_TRACHRAET_000_031: Ye remember Lieutenant Skaetswys, no doubt? Aye, she leaves quite an impression. And it would seem you left quite an impression on 'er, as well─she asked for ye specifically by name.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_TRACHRAET_000_032: It would seem there's another storm brewin' at the 789th Order Dig, and she reckons she needs yer steady 'and to navigate through. As fer the nature o' the storm, that ye'll 'ave to 'ear straight from 'er.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_TRACHRAET_000_033: Just between you and me, sometimes I can't 'elp but think that lass goes out of 'er way to look for trouble.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SKAETSWYS_000_040: , I thought ye'd never come! We've got a crisis on our 'ands 'ere, and I ain't just talkin' about this oversized bilge rat's aversion to anythin' resemblin' honest work!
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SKAETSWYS_000_041: I tell ye, after all you and I did to end Zo Ga's reign o' terror, ye'd think 'e'd make the slightest effort to raise 'is order from the arse end o' kobold society, wouldn't ye? Well, ye'd be wrong!
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SKAETSWYS_000_042: But that's neither 'ere nor there. The reason I wanted ye goes beyond this lot o' loungers─we've got a catastrophe facin' all o' koboldkind! I tell ye, these days it's out o' the bomb's nest, into the cauldron!
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SKAETSWYS_000_043: What sort o' crisis, ye ask? Scores o' kobolds from the mines just up and disappearin'! Aye, one moment they're there, an' the next they're gone! Who─or what─could possibly be responsible for this!?
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SKAETSWYS_000_044: Gwahahaha! Ye got me, . I always thought the realm would be better off without these good-for-nothin'─are ye out o' your bleedin' gourd?
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SKAETSWYS_000_045: Aye, the rumors from the Shroud and La Noscea 'aven't escaped me ears. Beastmen spirited away from their 'omes. But one question remains: why?
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SKAETSWYS_000_046: From the sound of it, ye've already done some investigatin' of yer own. I'll see what I can get out of Gi Gu and the rest o' these laggards. What say you survey the scene o' the crime?
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SKAETSWYS_000_047: Word 'as it that an inspection team from the 175th were ambushed right from the 'eart o' the Kobold Dig. The 175th's a friendly lot─ye remember Bi Bi, no doubt?─I reckon they won't be stingy with information.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SKAETSWYS_000_048: With this kidnapper about, I thank the Twelve I wasn't born a beastman. But I must confess─I 'aven't been this excited since the two of us teamed up to bring down Zo Ga!
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_PICKMAN789GIGU_000_: The 789th's favorite adventurer returns! You will be pleased to hear that we have been working hard─yes, yes, very hard, indeed. Gi Gu simply must share with you his latest discovery!

After days of hard research─yes, yes, very hard─Gi Gu has taught himself how to sleep with his eyes open─peeled, wide, open! We can nap as often as we like, and the inspectors will be none the wiser! Gi Gu is quite the genius, yes?
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_KOBOLD175A_000_060: Bi Bi! Where did he take Bi Bi!? Where...!?
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_KOBOLD175B_000_062: It stings─burns, sears, stings! I set my strongest bombs against him, but they could do nothing. No, no, nothing...
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_KOBOLD175B_000_063: I've seen no overdweller so strong. No, no, not ever!
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_KOBOLD175C_000_064: I...I saw it all. Yes, yes, I did. He grabbed Bi Bi with one arm, pressed steel against her neck. It was too much to watch─too distressing, too painful, too much!
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_KOBOLD175C_000_065: I was too scared─yes, yes, too cowardly to come out of hiding. But the overdweller girl─yes, yes, the girl with green hair. She chased him─followed him, pursued him, chased him to the south!
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_KOBOLD175C_000_066: The overdweller girl chased the kidnapper to the south. Oh, our dear Bi Bi─our precious, our beloved, our dear Bi Bi!
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SILVIA_000_071: D-Don't touch me! I...I can stand on my own.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SILVIA_000_072: My deductions were flawless... I knew the kobolds were next... I waited, waited to strike, and yet... I could do nothing...
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SILVIA_000_073: Nhaza'a Jaab─the Ebon Claw. I should have known I would be no match for that monster...
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SILVIA_000_074: My strength wanes... At this rate, I shall be... I...I must go...
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_PICKMAN789GIGU_000_: Wh-What is happening here!? How is Gi Gu supposed to nap with all this disruption─disturbance, disorder, disruption!?
Wh-Who is this overdweller girl!? What is she doing here!? And where can Gi Gu go to nap in peace─quiet, silence, peace!?
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SKAETSWYS_000_081: Ugh, 'ow in the bloody 'ells should I know!? Now quit yer blatherin'─the poor lass's wounded!
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SILVIA_000_082: W-Worry not for me... Please... You must stop him...
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SILVIA_000_083: Nhaza'a Jaab...the Ebon Claw...sword to the underworld...
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SILVIA_000_084: And yet he is but a blade for hire... No...another...<cough>...pulls the...<wheeze>...strings...
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SILVIA_000_086: He must...<cough>...be stopped... Ixal...Amalj'aa...no beastman is...<wheeze>...
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_PICKMAN789GIGU_000_: Is she dead─expired, perished, dead!? Oh no, no─this cannot be! Bring my pickaxe! Gi Gu shall give the overdweller girl a proper burial!
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SKAETSWYS_000_089: Fool! She's not dead─but you will be if you don't stop yer bloody whinin'!
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SKAETSWYS_000_090: The girl still lives, but she'll need an 'ealer's 'and an' a clean bed, neither of which she'll find 'ere. I'll see 'er to Camp Overlook.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_PICKMAN789GIGU_000_: Does the overdweller imply that we are...unclean!? Gi Gu takes umbrage at your remark─offense, insult, umbrage! Why, Gi Gu took a bath just last year! Yes, yes, he did!
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SKAETSWYS_000_092: Worry not for the girl. She'll be safe at Camp Overlook. Our priority now should be rescuin' Bi Bi from her kidnapper.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_PICKMAN789GIGU_000_: My beloved Bi Bi was kidnapped!? Why─yes, yes, why did you not tell me sooner!? What is the ransom? Gi Gu has two chunks of ore and a handful of sulphur!
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SKAETSWYS_000_094: ...Somehow I don't think that'll be enough. Besides, I 'ave a feelin' it ain't just riches our man is after.
TEXT_BANALL040_01470_SKAETSWYS_000_095: It would seem poor Bi Bi's life is at stake...again. We'll need to move quickly, . I need ye to share with me anything and everything ye know o' the man─we'll get to the bottom o' this together.
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SKAETSWYS_000_000: If we're to 'ave any 'ope o' savin' poor Bi Bi, we 'ave to move quickly. Let's put our minds together, . What can we deduce about the kidnapper's means of escape?
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SKAETSWYS_000_001: Ye found poor Sylvie collapsed in front of a sheer cliff face, with no way out save that by which ye came. 'Twas there that the scoundrel's footprints led ye, and it was there that they ended.
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SKAETSWYS_000_002: There's only one direction our man could've fled, and that's up! Which leads us to our next question─just 'ow? I've got my theory...but what about you?
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_Q1_000_000: How did the kidnapper take to the sky?
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SKAETSWYS_000_003: Aye, ye've figured us out. We Roegadyn can sprout wings from our backs at will, allowin' us to soar through the skies with the greatest o'... I tell ye, , sometimes I can't tell if yer actually that daft, or ye just think yer funny.
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SKAETSWYS_000_004: Come on, now. The answer's plain as day to anyone with 'alf their wits about 'em. But fine, I'll spell it out for ye─the kidnapper 'ad an airship!
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SKAETSWYS_000_005: ...Aye, it's the most logical conclusion. Access to an airship would've afforded our man a quick an' easy escape route.
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SKAETSWYS_000_006: If any suspicious vessels took off from the Kobold Dig, I can promise ye it wouldn't escape the eye o' Commander Bloeidin. To Camp Overlook, , and quickly!
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SKAETSWYS_000_007: While yer there, might ye pay a visit to that lass Sylvie, as well? Loath as I am to disturb 'er rest, I reckon she, too, might 'ave some knowledge to share...
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SKAETSWYS_000_008: If there's one thing I know about airships, I know that they cost a fair bit o' coin. Whoever's 'ired our man, it would seem 'e's rather generous.
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_PICKMAN789GIGU_000_: I haven't slept since I heard about Bi Bi─no, no, not a wink! Work!? How am I supposed to work when I'm so drowsy─sleepy, somnolent, drowsy!?
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_BLOEIDIN_000_010: Well, look who the tides brought in! Let me guess─Skaetswys has got you runnin' her errands, has she?
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_BLOEIDIN_000_011: Aye, I figured as much. She's never been one to pay much mind to the convenience of others. Why, not long ago she came rushin' in here with a poor lass who looked like she was on her last legs.
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_BLOEIDIN_000_012: Does this look like an infirmary? I've barely enough beds for my own wounded! She's lucky we had an empty tent─she's been restin' in there ever since.
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_BLOEIDIN_000_013: I sent one of my men to bring her some food earlier, but she's been refusin' all visitors. A shy one, I reckon, but she's not goin' to heal if she doesn't eat─and we can't keep her here forever. Hm? A suspicious airship?
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_BLOEIDIN_000_014: Come to think of it, one of my lookouts did say something about an unidentified vessel takin' to the sky. It didn't appear to be a threat, so we elected not to pursue.
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_BLOEIDIN_000_015: It flew off to the east, over the Strait of Merlthor toward Aldenard. As for its final destination, your guess is as good as mine.
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_BLOEIDIN_000_016: I've never seen anyone quite like that lass Skaetswys brought in. Wherever she hails from, I just hope she hasn't brought any trouble with her...
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SYSTEM_000_020: Sylvie speaks from within the tent, her voice faint...
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SILVIA_000_000_022: (-Sylvie-)...is that you? Do not worry... My wounds already heal...
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SILVIA_000_000_023: (-Sylvie-)Forgive me... When first we met... I dismissed your aid... I...I was a fool...
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SILVIA_000_000_024: (-Sylvie-)Where I am weak...you are strong... But it is more than strength... Your heart is full of acceptance and understanding... It is this that has won you the trust of beastmen the realm over...
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SILVIA_000_000_025: (-Sylvie-)Yes, there can be no doubt now... You are the champion we seek... The champion we need...
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SILVIA_000_000_026: (-Sylvie-)We are no match for the Ebon Claw... But you...you are... You must put an end to his plot... Before...before everything is lost...
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SILVIA_000_000_027: (-Sylvie-)He will strike at the Ixal next...I am certain of it... You must hurry...hurry to Ehcatl...and lend Chief Totoloc your aid...
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SILVIA_000_000_028: (-Sylvie-)I know that you have no reason to trust me... That I have not even told you who I am...
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SILVIA_000_000_029: (-Sylvie-)I am sorry, ...there are some secrets a girl must keep... But I promise you one thing... I...I am a friend...
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SILVIA_000_000_030: (-Sylvie-)I shall share the truth with you before long... I promise... For now, I beg of you... Please... Please trust me...help me...
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_00: Who is this, Sezul wonders...and then Sezul sees! Return to us,  does! In joy does Sezul squawk! Squawwwkkk!
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_TATARAMU_000_000_04: Now there's a sight for sore eyes...and tired hands! What brings you back to the humble environs of Ehcatl? Keen to get back to the forge, are you?
As you know, an engineer's work is never done. Even though the Dezul Qualan is yet breaking her own records, I'd wager my latest propulsion designs will send her higher still!
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_IXALA01471_000_000_: (-Ehcatl Nine Dropper-)Squawk, Sezul! Squawk! Squawk! Squawwwkkk!
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_00: Too squawky, your squawkings are! Settle down, you must! What ruffles your feathers so? Tell Sezul, you must.
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_IXALA01471_000_000_: (-Ehcatl Nine Dropper-)Attacked! Attacked, we were! At our logging grounds, airship struck! By featherless neuker, it was helmed! Neuker! Squawk!
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_TATARAMU_000_000_04: A-An attack!? But we have done nothing to incur such aggression!
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_IXALA01471_000_000_: (-Ehcatl Nine Dropper-)Bravely, we fought! To distant skies, featherless one's airship fled. Black smoke and flames, it spewed! Squawk in joy and triumph, we did! Squawwwk!
(-Ehcatl Nine Dropper-)Sneaking around our logging grounds, featherless neuker was! Peeping and prying, prying and peeping! Drive him back, we did! Squawk!
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_TATARAMU_000_000_04: A raid on Ixali logging grounds... Under normal circumstances, I would suspect the Gods' Quiver responsible, but I've not known them to come by sky. But if not the Gridanians, then who...?
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_A2_000_002: It must be the man I'm after!
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_TATARAMU_000_000_05: D-Did I hear you right, !? You're in pursuit of a dangerous criminal who has been traveling the realm, abducting beastmen wherever he goes!?
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_00: Abductions, you say!? Squawk! By featherless neuker, proud Ixali wings bound!? Pay for this dishonor, he will! Squawwwk!
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_TATARAMU_000_000_05: Our first step is to find the kidnapper, a process in which my expertise should serve us well. The rogue airship was damaged in battle, yes? If you could recover even the smallest fragment from the vessel, , I am quite confident I could use it to track our foe.
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_IXALA01471_000_000_: (-Ehcatl Nine Dropper-)Squawk! Not far from Hyrstmill, battle was fought! Any neuker droppings, there you will find! Pluck neuker's hair-feathers one by one, we will! Squawk!
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_TATARAMU_000_000_05: An attack by an unidentified airship? , you must travel to the scene of the battle in my stead. Even the smallest fragment of the vessel you could find would go far in deducing our foe's destination.
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_00: Squawk! Sealed his fate, our enemy has! If single feather is plucked from fledglings, much vengeance, we shall have!
TEXT_BANALL050_01471_TATARAMU_000_000_06: What news, ? Were you able to find aught of the assailant's vessel?
Well, hullo, what have we here? A piece of an airship's outer hull, is it? Let me take a closer look...

Most uncommon markings, but I swear I've seen them somewhere... Ah, but of course! Why, this is a Garlond Ironworks Model 1569-II! Fine vessels, though most will go their lives without seeing one. Only a few were ever manufactured.
Hahaha! You needn't act too impressed, . When your father is chairman of Highwind Skyways, you'd have to go well out of your way not to pick up a few tidbits of airship minutiae.
I will put in an inquiry with Advisor Colson. A quick perusal of the records should serve to identify the rogue vessel's current owner.
Yes, , it is but a matter of time before the curtain is cast open and the mastermind behind these crimes is revealed for the scoundrel he is!
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_TATARAMU_000_000_00: That this kidnapper you pursue pilots his own personal airship─and a Garlond Ironworks 1569-II, at that─is fascinating...and more than a bit frightening.

It hardly needs be said that such a vessel would be beyond the purchasing power of all but the wealthiest Eorzeans. Your quarry─or whoever is paying for his services─likely has nigh-limitless riches at his disposal.

But have faith, . Some of the most capable men in the employ of Highwind Skyways are tracking the rogue vessel as we speak. Whoever is behind these abductions, his identity will not remain secret much longer.
I have arranged for Advisor Colson to meet you at the airship landing in Ul'dah. Whatever knowledge my colleagues have gleaned in the meantime, it will be yours.
Your foe is backed by the power of coin, but you have something much stronger on your side─the power of justice! Safe travels, and may you serve that beastman-napping scoundrel his due!
I have arranged for Advisor Colson to meet you at the airship landing in Ul'dah. Whatever knowledge my colleagues have gleaned in the meantime, it will be yours.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_00: Suffer the same as Ixal, others do? Spirited away by airship, furry and flying creatures are? An outrage, this is! Have his revenge, Sezul will! Squawk!
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_COLSON_000_000_010: Ah, 'tis a pleasure to see you again, . Master Tataramu told me you would be coming.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_COLSON_000_000_011: I am pleased to inform you that we were able to retrieve the records requested by the young master with a minimum of trouble. I have taken the liberty of compiling the relevant findings.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_COLSON_000_000_012: ...Ahem. Yes, the Garlond Ironworks Model 1569-II. According to the records, only four were ever produced. A shame, really...it was a marvel of airship design. Unfortunately, unrelenting attacks from Garlean forces that year made for less-than-ideal manufacturing conditions.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_COLSON_000_000_013: But I digress. At the time, two of the vessels were purchased by the sultanate, while the other two entered Highwind Skyways' own fleet. Of our two vessels, one remains in operation to this day, but the other... This is where the records take an odd turn.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_COLSON_000_001_013: The records claim that it was decommissioned after suffering extensive damages, then sold off to a trading company known as the “Laughing Alchemists.”
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_COLSON_000_000_014: As the ship was heavily damaged, it was sold under the condition that it would be stripped for parts. Yet this was but a verbal agreement─we have no proof that the Laughing Alchemists carried out their end of the bargain.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_COLSON_000_000_015: Ahem... “Service with a smile, and prices so low the Traders will be laughing Their heads off! Seek out the Laughing Alchemists for a hilariously good deal!” ...Such are their words. I cannot be certain, but there is something about this transaction that does not sit well with me.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_DOUZINDANB01472_000: The fugitive has been sighted in the vicinity of Emerald Avenue!
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_DOUZINDANA01472_000: Bloody hells! Seal the gates, and block off all entrances to the Hustings Strip! I don't want to see either of your ugly faces until the beast is in chains!
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_COLSON_000_000_019: What's this? A fugitive in the streets?
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_DOUZINDANA01472_000: You there! We've received reports that a beastman has breached the city gates, and prowls the streets thirsting for blood!
All civilians are encouraged to seek shelter indoors until we bring the fugitive to justice. Venture outside at your own peril!
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_COLSON_000_000_022: A beastman rampaging unchecked within the city walls? That is a frightful prospect indeed.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_COLSON_000_000_023: In any event, I have shared all that I have to share, and should be returning to my duties. Pray give the young master my regards, and tell him I would be most interested in having a look at that new airship of yours.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_DOUZINDAND01472_000: The fugitive was last sighted fleeing down Emerald Avenue. Be on your guard─he's known to be armed!
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_DOUZINDANE01472_000: Ruby Road Exchange, all clear! The fugitive has been identified as an Amalj'aa! I repeat, the fugitive is an Amalj'aa!
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_DOUZINDANF01472_000: Beastman? I haven't seen no beastman. I reckon he's scared o' me.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_DOUZINDANG01472_000: Show yourself, scalekin! I'll fashion a suit of mail out of your bloody hide!
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_YADOVVGAH_000_040: (-Amalj'aa Runagate-)Have I been found at last!? It gives me no pleasure to crush the life from your bones, but you leave me no choice! Say farewell to your loved ones, slavering cur, for your next breath shall be your─
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_YADOVVGAH_000_041: (-Amalj'aa Runagate-)...Do my eyes see true!? Yes, they do! Honored ally! I am beside myself with joy at this fated reunion!
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_YADOVVGAH_000_042: (-Yadovv Gah-)Do not look so perplexed! It is I─your brother and comrade-in-arms, Yadovv Gah!
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_YADOVVGAH_000_043: (-Yadovv Gah-)I can see the doubt in your eyes. You wonder what brings me so far from the Ring of Ash. I can assure you that I meant no harm to your kind, this I swear!
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_YADOVVGAH_000_044: (-Yadovv Gah-)Far from it. No, it is my own brothers that are in danger. Mere hatchlings, stolen from us by a faceless foe. A sniveling cur too cowardly to meet us on the field of battle!
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_YADOVVGAH_000_045: (-Yadovv Gah-)I pursued him here to Ul'dah, and this was my mistake. No sooner did I arrive than did they call me fugitive, criminal, or worse. They claim I visit violence on innocents, when in truth I have not hurt a flea!
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_YADOVVGAH_000_046: (-Yadovv Gah-)But they will not listen to reason, and I have no means of escape! Gah! Have I no recourse but to become the murderer that they would have me be!?
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_SILVIA_000_000_047: No! You must not say such things!
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_YADOVVGAH_000_048: (-Yadovv Gah-)Who... Who are you to tell me so!?
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_SILVIA_000_000_049: It seems you've been busy since we last met, . Do not worry for me─my wounds have healed.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_SILVIA_000_000_050: I cannot tell you who I am...only that I am a friend. You have no desire to harm innocents, this I know. You must follow me─I know a way out of the city walls.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_YADOVVGAH_000_051: (-Yadovv Gah-)Though we have just met, I sense honesty and courage in your words. I will follow you. Do not lead me astray.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_YADOVVGAH_000_052: (-Yadovv Gah-)The fates have reunited us for a reason, honored ally─there can be no doubt of it. The warleader awaits you at the Ring of Ash. Pray honor us with your presence again.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_HAMUJIGAH_000_060: ...Honored ally. The fates smile on us today. You return to the Ring of Ash from afar, and we are stronger for your presence.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_HAMUJIGAH_000_061: I have heard from Yadovv Gah how you and your friend saved his life in Ul'dah. I fear that the fault in sending him to such unwelcoming environs was my own. The Brotherhood is in your debt once more.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_HAMUJIGAH_000_062: When the threat of our mortal foe, the Flamefangs, was quenched by your hand, Zanr'ak regained a measure of peace. And yet I fear that these halcyon days were short-lived.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_HAMUJIGAH_000_063: Not days ago, an uninvited guest came to the Ring of Ash from the skies, bearing a fearsome blade and ill intentions. Fighting with a fury that belied his slight frame, he quickly subdued the strongest of our kin and absconded with a bevy of hatchlings.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_HAMUJIGAH_000_064: The shame! The dishonor! Have the proud Amalj'aa fallen so far that they allow their young to be stolen from them like a sack of popotoes!?
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_HAMUJIGAH_000_065: My kin are shocked and shamed by this loss, but we are still Amalj'aa! Unlike Ifrit's addled slaves, we have not forgotten how to fight for ourselves; the Brotherhood of Ash are warriors, and warriors do not abandon their sons.
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_HAMUJIGAH_000_066: Yadovv Gah tells me that you, too, pursue this same man. Join us in battle once more, honored ally, that the craven whelp will answer for his dishonorable acts, and feel the rage of a thousand fists crushing his bones into dust!
TEXT_BANALL060_01472_YADOVVGAH_000_067: The Brotherhood of Ash welcomes your return, honored ally. Doubtless there are many stirring tales of battle we could trade, but such revelry will have to wait for another day. The warleader would speak with you at once.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_HAMUJIGAH_000_000: We of the Brotherhood devote our lives to the pursuit of true martial perfection, as you well know. Yet is it enough for a single Amalj'aa to achieve the limits of his strength?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_HAMUJIGAH_000_001: No, the martial prowess we achieve is passed down from father to son, father to son. So does our strength grow through generations, those that follow reaching heights of puissance their forefathers never knew.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_HAMUJIGAH_000_002: This sniveling cur that would break this chain does us the ultimate dishonor. He will answer for the abduction of our young, and he will answer in blood.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_HAMUJIGAH_000_003: Honored ally, you and Yadovv Gah must go forth and find this wretch. Go forth in courage, and know that when the time comes, your warleader will fight at your side, and our strength will be as one, a towering fist of rage to crush the life from our foe.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_HAMUJIGAH_000_004: Aside from Loonh Gah and yourself, I thought your kind weak in body and spirit. And yet I am told that the fiercest warriors among our kin were no match for this man. Is the peak of martial perfection yet so far from our grasp!?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_YADOVVGAH_000_010: Honored ally, I am in your debt. The Ul'dahns' hatred for our kind runs even deeper than I imagined. Had the Brass Blades found me before you and your friend did, I fear I would have been forced to do...terrible things.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_YADOVVGAH_000_011: You have spoken with the warleader. Every moment the hatchlings remain in their abductor's clutches, our dishonor grows. We must take the fight to him, and do so with speed! And yet, we know not where he has fled.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_YADOVVGAH_000_012: ...But perhaps your enigmatic friend does, for she has left for you a message. She would speak with you in Ul'dah, where I fear my kind are not welcome. You will go and hear her tale, yes?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_013: (-???-)And here I thought you one of us, !
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_014: Running off without so much as a word? Is this how you treat a friend and ally? Your ancestors would turn in their graves!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_015: I overheard your talk with the warleader. You pursue a foe the likes of which we have never seen─a man who embodies the essence of martial perfection for which we strive. Only a fool would pursue him alone!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_016: On my honor as a warrior of the Brotherhood of Ash, I, Loonh Gah, would face him with you.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_YADOVVGAH_000_017: What is this madness, Loonh Gah!? The fiercest of our kin were bested easily by this man! If he has reached the peak of martial perfection, you have only begun your journey up the mountain!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_018: And how will I ever reach my potential save by trying my skills against a worthy foe!? Besides,  travels to Ul'dah, does  not? You said it yourself. You would not be welcome there, but I─Amalj'aa within, but Miqo'te without─can move freely among its people.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_019: I will hear no further challenges. Let us be off, ! This foray into the heart of civilization puts me ill at ease...but no matter! The battle that awaits us stirs the passions deep within my soul!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_YADOVVGAH_000_020: Loonh Gah's passion I will not deny, but her wisdom is often lacking. The warleader would not be pleased to hear of her true intentions. I shall devise a suitable justification for her absence.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_YADOVVGAH_000_021: Still, when that one has steeled her will, few if any in the Brotherhood can stop her. See that she does not come to harm, honored ally. Your friend awaits you at the Gate of Nald.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_YADOVVGAH_000_022: Loonh Gah thinks herself a seasoned warrior, but to us, she is still but a hatchling. A hatchling with a bright future, but a hatchling nonetheless. Keep her safe, honored ally, that her burning flame is not quenched prematurely.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_030: You come, and you bring a strong ally. This is inspiriting, indeed.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_031: The sylphs, the Sahagin, the kobolds, the Ixal...and now the Amalj'aa. Our best efforts could not thwart the tragedy that strikes at each of Eorzea's beast tribes. And yet all is not lost...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_032: For with each heinous act, the shadow that conceals our villains is lifted... Nhaza'a Jaab, the Ebon Claw... The Laughing Alchemists... The mastermind behind this dark plot will elude us no longer!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_033: But first, , there is something I must tell you, and someone you must meet. When you are ready, come to the Gate of Thal.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_035: So this is Ul'dah─truly, every ilm as glorious as the stories say! Though these walls are so high, I must confess to feeling a bit...closed in.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_041: .... Doubtless you wonder what this place is...who I am. Finally, the time has come that I may tell you. Allow me to welcome you to...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SHANGAMESHANGA_000_: (-???-)...The head offices of the Ashcrown Consortium─Eorzea's greatest purveyor of all things crystal!

I have the pleasure of being Shanga Meshanga, chairman and president of said consortium, and I have the honor of making your acquaintance. 'Tis rare that I am so blessed as to meet a like-minded soul.
Our dear Sylvie has told us all about your efforts to build trust and goodwill between Eorzeans and the five beast tribes. An admirable aim, and one I share.

The beastmen may be fearsome of appearance and eccentric in character, but are they truly so different from you and I? This is why I founded the Consortium. In purchasing crystals from amiable tribes in return for vital resources they require, I aim to aid them in becoming self-sufficient.
In this way, I hope to foster a lasting friendship between our peoples.
...It does not hurt that this arrangement has proved quite profitable, as well. If I performed these acts simply out of the goodness of my heart, I'm like to see my Ul'dahn citizenship revoked!

All jesting aside, it goes without saying that few in the sultanate share my fondness for beastmen─and so I keep up appearances as a common trader. I would ask that you keep all that I have told you in the closest of confidence.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_048: Forgive me for having kept you in the dark, . As a humble assistant to Master Shanga, I did not feel it was my place to speak of the Consortium's true aims.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SHANGAMESHANGA_000_: A bit too humble, I say. Though Miss Sylvie joined our ranks only recently, she has shown a remarkable commitment to the ideals we espouse. I consider her amongst the Consortium's most valuable members. She has proven particularly capable in the investigation of the beastman abductions.

If you would know the truth, these crimes are nothing new. The Consortium has been investigating similar reports from the beast tribes for some time, but to no avail. But over time, they grew more frequent, more bold...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_051: I will never forgive them... Never...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SHANGAMESHANGA_000_: , was it? You are a rare ─one that sylph, kobold, Sahagin, Amalj'aa, and Ixal alike will look in the eye and call friend.
Far and wide has the Ashcrown Consortium searched, but I believe we have found our champion. Join us, friend, that we might bring this menace who would prey on innocent beastmen to justice.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_054: Without you, our cause is lost. We...are lost... You will join us, won't you, ?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_055: I thank you. Not long ago, a messenger arrived on behalf of Momodi at the Quicksand. It would seem she would speak with you about an important matter.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_056: I do not understand all that was spoken, but it matters little. What matters is that we are one step closer to exacting vengeance on our hated foe!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_057: Pray forgive me for treating you so coldly when we first met, . I...am slow to trust others, but you have proven yourself a true friend.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_058: Master Shanga speaks true, I am sure of it. You will be the champion the Consortium has long sought, and together we will save the beast tribes of Eorzea from a grim fate!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_MOMODI_000_000_060: There you are, . These three have been askin' all over for you!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_TATARAMU_000_000_06: It heartens me to see you well, . I was afraid the kidnapper had stowed you away on an airship somewhere!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SKAETSWYS_000_062: Lieutenant Skaetswys o' the Maelstrom, reportin' fer duty! I meant to bring Gi Gu along, but 'e gave me some excuse about 'avin' lost 'is walkin' shoes...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_VOYCE_000_000_063: A pleasure to see you again, good ! Thinking that my academic expertise might avail you in your search for the kidnapper, I decided to make the trip to Ul'dah.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_VOYCE_000_000_064: Elder Frixio and the others danced wildly when I told them I might not return to Little Solace. I fear the overwhelming sorrow and loss at my departure has driven the poor things to madness. And yet, I knew it was my calling to join you!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_065: These three will join us in battle, adventurer? Such allies are welcome indeed! Though we might do without the skinny fellow with the spectacles...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_TATARAMU_000_000_06: Since we last met, I did my own research into the Laughing Alchemists of whom Advisor Colson spoke. Sadly, reliable information on this organization is not easily come by...
What would they stand to gain from a mass abduction of the realm's beastmen? Their motives are a mystery wrapped in an enigma...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SKAETSWYS_000_068: ...As are the current whereabouts of their 'ired blade. I've got a feelin' that whatever they're plottin', we've got precious little time to put a stop to it.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_VOYCE_000_000_069: Yes, it is clear that time is of the essence. In my estimation, the best course of action would be for us to split up and pursue different angles that might afford us further clues. Would we all be in agreement?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_TATARAMU_000_000_07: I will pay a visit to the airship landing. By speaking to the deckhands and examining the records, perhaps I can ascertain the destination of the Laughing Alchemists' vessel.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SKAETSWYS_000_071: I 'eard from my superiors o' beastman abductions reported last year. No one thought much of 'em at the time, but in light o' recent events, I reckon they warrant a closer investigation.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_VOYCE_000_000_071: I have a friend or two at the Alchemists' Guild. Perhaps they might be able to shed light on the Laughing Alchemists and their shady dealings.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_072: I shall pursue this man they call the Ebon Claw. He is hiding right under my nose. I can smell it, and feel it in my bones!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_TATARAMU_000_000_07: Excellent, my friends! Whatever information we come upon, we will share with  here. Now let us get to work! Our beastman friends are counting on us!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_MOMODI_000_000_074: Quite a motley crew o' friends you have there, . And yet for some reason, when I look at you, I can't help but feel the strangest sort o' confidence. Whoever it is you're goin' after, I certainly wouldn't want to be him!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_TATARAMU_000_000_08: You couldn't have come at a better time! I was just perusing the arrival and departure records, and sure enough, a series of entries quickly caught my eye.
To wit, numerous requests for emergency landing clearance for a vessel registered to one Memeriga, chairman of the Laughing Alchemists!
These entries grow more frequent over the past six moons or so, corresponding precisely with the recent outbreak of beastman abductions.

Memeriga... I have heard the name before, and heard things I would rather forget. A man of great wealth, few can─or are willing to─say how he came by his fortunes. Some rumors say he deals in black market weapons, some suggest far worse. In some circles, they even call him “the Deathmonger.”
I think we can safely say that we've found the man pulling the strings behind these beastman abductions. But two questions remain: to what end, and where might we find him?
Our friends have finished their investigations, as well? Splendid! Let us return to the Ashcrown Consortium offices and plot our next course of action.

From providing deadly force to both sides of a bloody conflict to selling beggars and orphans as glorified slave-soldiers─Ul'dah has its share of unscrupulous merchants, but none have made dealing in death their business quite like Memeriga.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SKAETSWYS_000_091: There ye are, ! Ye'll be 'appy to 'ear that I was able to...acquire...the records of all reported cases o' beastman disappearances over the past year.
