TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SKAETSWYS_000_092: 'Ow, ye ask? Let's just say that Skaetswys 'as more than a few friends, an' not all o' them are as worthless as Gi Gu and 'is sorry lot.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SKAETSWYS_000_093: Anyroad, 'ere's one case that caught me eye. Dated six moons ago or thereabout. An 'undred-odd sylph corpses unearthed in northern Thanalan, cause o' death unknown.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SKAETSWYS_000_094: 'Ad the bodies belonged to Ul'dahn citizens, ye can bet yer bottom gil this story would've graced the front page o' the Mythril Eye. But beastmen? Doubtless they'd turned 'ostile and were dispatched by some well-meanin' adventurers─or so was the reasonin' at the time.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SKAETSWYS_000_095: But recent events put this incident in a whole new light. Sylphs in Thanalan? Aye, that's more than a mite suspicious. As was the state o' the bodies─not a single external wound. Poison, perhaps?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SKAETSWYS_000_096: I'm no agent of enquiry, but I'd wager there's more than a passin' connection between this and the recent beastman abductions. We'll just 'ave to see what clues the others turn up, and work from there.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SKAETSWYS_000_097: Already spoken with the others, 'ave ye? Well, then I reckon it's time we made our next move. Let's gather back at the Ashcrown Consortium and put our 'eads together.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SKAETSWYS_000_098: We don't see too many sylphs where I come from, but from what I 'ear they're a fun-lovin', 'ard-workin' folk. Surely they deserved better than to die forgotten in a faraway land...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_VOYCE_000_000_100: Oh, adventurer! I was wondering when you might show up. I've been perusing the pages of the guild ledger for all purchases made by the Laughing Alchemists.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_VOYCE_000_000_101: Quite an assortment of rare and curious ingredients, I must say. Eighty hunks of rotted voidsent flesh, twenty bulbs of the narcissus phantasmus, fifty ponzes of lost soul entrails...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_VOYCE_000_000_102: As much as this may shock you, friend, the alchemical arts fall somewhat outside my otherwise extensive area of expertise. An alchemist acquaintance of mine, however, informed me that the sale of such items on the open market is strictly prohibited.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_VOYCE_000_000_103: As he told it, they have been known to be employed in the practice of certain...forbidden arts─the precise nature of which he seemed unwilling to relate in detail.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_VOYCE_000_000_104: Forbidden arts... Elder Frixio forbade me from ever adorning myself in chocobo feathers again─by the gods!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_VOYCE_000_000_105: Have the Laughing Alchemists devised an elixir to turn beastmen into beastbirds!? If so, I daresay we have a crisis of colossal proportions on our hands!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_VOYCE_000_000_106: The others have finished their investigations? Wonderful! Come, friend! Let us hurry back to the Ashcrown Consortium before all of Eorzea is trampled under the feet of an army of crazed chocobeasts!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_VOYCE_000_000_107: I know not what the Laughing Alchemists mean to do with their avian army, but the mere thought strikes fear into the very depths of my soul...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_110: ! Through the twisted, tortuous streets of this city I have tracked our quarry. And at long last, I have found his lair!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_111: Within the garish chambers of this place, the Platinum Mirage, the craven cur slumbers, using his misbegotten riches to shelter himself from our vengeance!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_112: I demanded entrance so that I might meet the fiend in single combat, but that fool child over there had the gall to refuse me entry!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_113: “We cannot confirm your membership without looking upon your face, milady,” she said. “Do come back when you have removed that ridiculous costume and have dressed a bit more formally.”
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_114: ...Costume!? This battlemask is a symbol of my rebirth and resolve! It represents my transformation into an Amalj'aa soldier, ever strong and proud. I would die before removing it from my face for so petty a reason!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_115: ...Besides, these are the only garments I own. Well, ? You are more familiar with “civilized” life than I. How might I best approach this?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_116: You have spoken to all the others? Excellent. We should return to the Ashcrown Consortium and plot our next course of action.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_117: Is my appearance truly so...unusual...to the people of this nation? Do they not know a true warrior when they see one!?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_ESSYLT_000_118: Welcome to the Platinum Mirage, Ul'dah's oasis of fortune. Be aware that entrance is limited to members, and that our dress code is strictly enforced.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_120: . The others have yet to return, but I fear our time grows short. Did they share with you their findings?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_121: ...I see. All signs point to the Laughing Alchemists and their chairman, Master Memeriga, as being the mastermind behind these terrible crimes.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_122: What's more, he has been involved in shady dealings with the Alchemists' Guild, procuring various prohibited substances known to be used in forbidden arts...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_123: In a seemingly unrelated event, the corpses of countless sylphs were unearthed in Thanalan six moons past, dead most likely from poison. Since that day, beastman abductions have been reported with increasing regularity across the realm.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_124: ...I hoped against hope that it would not come to this, but the evidence is overwhelming. Yes, they call the man Deathmonger─it would seem he has decided to truly earn the name.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_125: Necromancy, ! The man has a mind to raise an undead army, born from the souls of our beastman friends!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_126: We must find him at once and put a stop to his madness! You say that his hired blade has taken up lodgings at the Platinum Mirage.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_127: Fortunately for us, Master Shanga is a member in the highest of standing. He should have no trouble securing entrance for us. Which leaves only the matter of Loonh Gah and the dress code...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_100_127: I know not if this will meet your friend's liking, but it should serve its purpose just the same.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_128: I shall be along in due time. Nhaza'a Jaab...you will pay for your crimes against my loved ones...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_129: That dress should serve to secure Loonh Gah's passage into the halls of the Platinum Mirage.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_130: I shall be along in due time. Nhaza'a Jaab...you will pay for your crimes against my loved ones...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_140: . I have been keeping close watch on the entrance to this place. The craven cur has yet to show his face─I suspect that he still cowers within the comforts of his chambers.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_141: Did you speak with Sylvie? Was she able to secure us passage within? The battle calls me, adventurer! I can contain my rage no longer!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_142: Hmmm...? What are these flimsy rags, and why do you show them to me?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_144: I...I am a warrior of the Amalj'aa! I would sooner see the flesh rent from my bones than clothe myself in these...s-soft, supple fabrics.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_146: Many moons have I lived, yet never have I suffered such dishonor! Were the lives of my brothers not at stake, I would rend these rags in my hands and leave this dreadful place in an instant!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_147: Very well, adventurer! I will wear these coward's tatters! But you must swear on your life that none back at home shall hear word of this madness!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_148: Must you gape at me so? As if my shame did not cut deep enough already!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_149: There had best not be anything else. ...There is something else, isn't there?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_151: This battlemask was bestowed to me by the warleader himself! It is a symbol of my passion and pride─it marks me as a Brother of Ash! You may just as well ask me to rip the very flesh off my face! On this I shall not yield...the battlemask stays!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_152: Gahhh! The shame...the indignity. Forgive me, Warleader...!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_153: It is for the lives of my brothers, for vengeance against our foe, and for the pursuit of martial perfection that I subject myself to this dishonor!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_154: You are a friend, but say one word and it will be your last.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_155: Now let us go. Our fated battle with a mortal foe awaits within.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_160: I have never seen anything like this... It is a veritable palace!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_162: I do not recall summoning whores. Ul'dahn customs are so crude...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_163: Silence, fiend! You will pay for your crimes!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_164: Nhaza'a Jaab! We have uncovered your master's dark plot! The Deathmonger would slay beastmen en masse and raise an army of the dead, and you lend your strength to this heinous cause!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_165: Oh, that nonsense? Yes, now that you mention it, I do believe that was his silly little plot. Have you come here to stop me?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_166: “Nonsense”? “Silly”!? Is the mass murder of thousands of innocent beastmen so humorous to you!? I know your type too well─you see beastmen as little more than feral savages!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_167: I do? Well, well, this is quite a surprise. I have always strived to maintain equal disdain for all beings weaker than myself. That would be everyone...in case you haven't been paying attention.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_168: If Master Memeriga would raise an army of zombie beastmen and conquer the realm, he can have it. I seek one thing and one thing alone...an equal.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_170: I have traveled the realm a hundred times over and crossed blades with the greatest warriors Eorzea has known, and yet none─not a one!─can match my powers!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_171: No, it is not for fame, not for riches, not for glory I fight. For once─just once!─I would know the thrill, the passion of facing a worthy foe on the field of battle! To smell the sweet stench of my impending death before emerging triumphant as I have always done!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_172: Y-You...you would see thousands of innocents die just to satisfy your depraved thirst for thrills? If anyone here should be called “beast,” it is you!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_173: My poor, misguided little girl... Death is but the blissful terminus of the lives of the weak. Come, and I shall show you its sweet embrace...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_174: When my friends vanished six moons ago, I asked myself why... What had they done to deserve such a fate? With the help of  and  friends, I began to put the pieces together...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_175: Beastmen... You... Memeriga would raise a legion of the undead─a limitless supply of deathless warriors that he could auction off to the highest bidder. Why, it's a veritable license to mint gil!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_176: But where would he find his dead? Exhuming the bodies of Eorzeans would quickly attract unwanted attention. But beastmen─seen by so many as a scourge to the realm─yes, who would miss a beastman or two, or two hundred, or two thousand!?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_178: Brava, brava... Spoken with such passion. If I didn't know better, I'd say you were a beastman yourself...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_179: I... This... This one... You... Clawed one...killed this one's friends...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_181: Are my eyes to be believed!?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_182: (-Silbexio-)Answer me, clawed one! Where is master one!? Where can this one find this one's friends!?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_183: I could tell you, but I don't think Master Memeriga would be too pleased. And he is rather generous with his coin, you see...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_TATARAMU_000_000_18: Whatever the Deathmonger is paying you, we'll double it!
...No, we'll triple it! Would you prefer your payment in gil? Jewels and gemstones, perhaps?
This is no mere idle bluff. I swear it on the name of my father, chairman of Highwind Skyways─mayhap you've heard of them?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_187: Bwahahaha! Gwahahahahahaha! You speak madness! But this is my kind of madness!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_188: ...Perhaps I have found worthy rivals, after all. Master Memeriga set forth for the Invisible City. Doubtless the experiments have already begun.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_VOYCE_000_000_189: G-Good heavens! So the poor beastmen are being transformed into chocobos as we speak!? We must stop them!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_190: ...That is all I will say. Your offer is tempting, little man, but I have riches enough to last a lifetime. If you would face my blade, however, your presence is more than welcome.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SKAETSWYS_000_191: If it's a fight ye want, it's a fight ye'll get! An' this one'll be yer last!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_192: Yes, yeeesss...that's the spirit! I expect nothing less than a bloody feast for the soul and senses. Do try not to disappoint me, now...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_TATARAMU_000_000_19: I believe our business is done here. Let us leave this place.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_200: Forgive me, . This is the second time I have deceived you. I...no, this one...is a sylph of Little Solace.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_201: This one's true name is Silbexio. The walking one Sylvie is a creation of this one's skin-changing magicks.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_202: This one learned the ways and words of the walking ones. This one would walk among the walking ones and talk as walking ones talk, that these ones and walking ones might grow to understand each other.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_203: Others felt as this one did. Together, these ones left Little Solace behind, seeking out the cities of walking ones. But these ones' journey was cut short. Laughing ones saw through these ones' disguises. These ones were ambushed in Thanalan.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SKAETSWYS_000_204: The sylphs slain in Thanalan... Gods, ye were one of 'em!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_205: ...Yes. This one escaped, but others were not so fortunate. It was then that this one made a vow. This one would bring Laughing ones to justice. This one assumed the form of walking one Sylvie, came to this place, and befriended kindly one Master Shanga.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_206: Master Shanga is kindly one, but Master Shanga is still walking one. This one was afraid to reveal this one's true face. So this one toiled in secret, pursuing clawed one at every turn...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_TATARAMU_000_000_20: The acts of these vile men would throw a spanner into all of our efforts in building trust with the beastmen. Let us hurry to the Invisible City and put an end to their plot once and for all!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_LLOONGAH_000_208: The Invisible City...a desolate place home to naught but the lost souls of ages long past. Whyever would this Memeriga choose such a remote place to work his dark magicks?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_VOYCE_000_000_209: ...Doubtless a ghost town on the outskirts of civilization is exactly what the Laughing Alchemists had in mind. Why, just think of what would happen if something went awry with the experiment.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_VOYCE_000_000_210: An army of undead beastchocobos running amok in plain view of the populace!? There would be panic!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_TATARAMU_000_000_21: ...Er, yes, that sounds about right. Anyroad, the time for talking is through─it is time for action. We will inform the leaders of each of the respective beast tribe settlements, , and join you at the Invisible City shortly after.
...And, ah, yes. I've been instructed to give you this.
I was told it was an explosive of sylphic make, enhanced somewhat by one Ba Go of the 789th Order, and then further modified for optimal throwing by the Ehcatl Nine.
Think of it as a collaborative effort by all of our beastman friends. I trust it will serve you well. Now let us go forth and put an end to Memeriga's mad plot!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_MEMERIGA_000_000_21: Who are you!? We are conducting a top secret experiment here! Begone from here before I turn you into a zombie...or worse!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_216: This one has been waiting for brave one. Disguises will avail this one little here. This one will remain in this form and conserve strength for the battle ahead.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_217: Walking ones who guard this place are some of deadliest swords in the realm, hired by Laughing one at great cost. This will not be an easy fight, not even for brave one. Is brave one ready to do battle?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_218: This one is ever heartened by brave one's resolve. Quietly, now, that Laughing ones might be caught by surprise.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_MEMERIGA_000_000_22: (-Memeriga-)How many times do you have to stir that pot!? I'm not paying you by the hour, in case you've forgotten!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_ALCHEMIST01273_000_: (-Laughing Alchemist-)Heh heh heh... Forgive me, Master Memeriga. It shall not be long until the reagents are fully dissolved. Then our preparations will be complete...in theory.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_MEMERIGA_000_000_22: (-Memeriga-)What do you mean, “in theory”!? I'm not paying you to theorize, I'm paying you to build me an army!

(-Memeriga-)Bwahahaha! Yes, it will not be long now! An army of undead beastmen at my beck and call─the greatest military force Eorzea has ever known! Untold riches─no, even the very domination of the realm is within my grasp!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_225: Memeriga! This one has come for this one's friends!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_MEMERIGA_000_000_22: (-Memeriga-)Well, look who's here. If it isn't the little girl who's been fluttering about the realm, poking her nose into my business. Or did you think you could fool me with your silly little disguises?

(-Memeriga-)...It matters not. You and your friends are too late. The potion is all but complete, and there will be nothing to stop me! Your laughably “precious” companions will die, and their souls will serve me for eternity! Bwahahaha!
(-Memeriga-)...But do not mourn their fate, little girl...for you shall join them. Kill them all─but do try to be gentle about it.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_HAMUJIGAH_000_231: (-???-)Treacherous fiends. Purveyors of villainy. The vengeance of heaven is slow, but certain. You shall answer for your treachery this day.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_MEMERIGA_000_000_23: (-Memeriga-)Who is this that dares oppose me!?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_HAMUJIGAH_000_233: I am the flame that quenches the shadow! The fist that crushes villainy! I am the warleader of the Brotherhood of Ash, Hamujj Gah, and my name shall be the last you utter with your dying screams!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NOVV_000_234: I am Novv! The ssspear from the dark depths. Clutchfather first, and warrior sssecond.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_00: Squawwwk! Sezul Totoloc of Ehcatl Nine, I am! How to count, Ehcatl Nine know not. How to fight, Ehcatl Nine know well! Forfeit, your life is!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_FRIXIO_000_000_236: This one is Frixio, elder of Little Solace. Laughing ones' crimes against little ones will not be forgiven!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_PICKMAN789GIGU_000_: Pickman Gi Gu of the 789th is here! ...And Gi Gu has, er, forgot his line─slipped his mind, drew a blank, forgot!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_PICKMAN789GIGU_001_: Y-Ye gads! Those sparks almost took out Gi Gu's eye─burned, blew up, took out an eye! Gi Gu told Ba Go to go easy on the saltpeter...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_FRIXIO_000_000_240: Laughing one's days of profiting in other ones' misfortune have come to an end. Return captured ones and surrender at once!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_MEMERIGA_000_000_24: (-Memeriga-)Hah! As if a band of bumbling beastmen could stop me! You fools seal your fate...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_243: ...And so the stage is set. Marvelous...simply marvelous!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NOVV_000_244: You besssted me once, but this time you shall not be so fortunate. Feel my ssspear, shhhorewalker!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_MEMERIGA_000_000_24: (-Memeriga-)What are you waiting for, you fool!? Kill them! Kill them all! Have you forgotten how much I'm paying you!?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_246: Keep your riches, Memeriga. I fight, but not for you.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_247: Yes, let hatred and fear consume you. Come at me, let me taste the thrill of battle, and I will treat you to death's sweet embrace!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_248: This is the distraction these ones needed! This one will go off and find the captured ones. Brave one must take scalebomb and destroy the cauldron!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_250: This one shall go in search of the captured ones. Walking one must destroy Laughing ones' cauldron before it is too late!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_MEMERIGA_000_000_25: Gwahahaha! Kill them! Kill them all! They shall rise again as my eternal slaves!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_MEMERIGA_000_000_26: (-Memeriga-)Wh-What have you done!? That cauldron was made of solid mythril! Do you have any idea how much I paid for it!?
(-Memeriga-)Five billion, six hundred million, eight hundred and seventy thousand gil! You've ruined me! Ruined meeeeeeeee!!!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_262: Ahahaha! Yes, yesss! Let your hatred fuel you! Let me taste the rage that burns within you! Thrill me! Excite me! Delight me!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_263: ...And in return, I shall see your death is all the sweeter.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NOVV_000_264: Your overconfidence will be your downfall, shhhorewalker...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_HAMUJIGAH_000_265: The battle drums pound, calling me to the fray. Lend me your strength, Elder.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_00: Squawk! Now, the time is! This, you must take!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_PICKMAN789GIGU_000_: And here's an extra boost─a push, a shove, a boost!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_273: This...this feeling... I grow weak... The world around me grows dark... I... I...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_MEMERIGA_000_000_27: (-Memeriga-)Wh-Where do you think you're going!? That's my airship, you fool!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_NHAZAAJAAB_000_275: Ahahaha! I shall remember this day, my friends! You have proven yourselves worthy rivals, but do not think that you have won! No, I shall return to have my revenge!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_PICKMAN789GIGU_000_: What's this? Gi Gu thought his bombs were all gone─used up, depleted, gone. Oh, well...here goes nothing!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_278: Laughing one's crimes have been reported to the highest authorities by the Ashcrown Consortium. This one suggests Laughing one goes quietly.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_279: Laughing one's crimes are grave, and riches will not save Laughing one this time. Laughing one will have much time to reflect on one's misdeeds as one rots in gaol.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_290: Brave one...no, brave ! This one...this one has no words to express depths of this one's gratitude...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_291: Nomexio... Flaxio... Is every one watching? Laughing ones are no more... Finally...after so long...every one can rest in peace...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_FRIXIO_000_000_292: ...This one has been watching Silbexio. Yes, watching very closely.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_293: Elder one...? Elder one remembers this one?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_FRIXIO_000_000_294: How could this one forget? This one remembers the day Silbexio left Little Solace as if it were yesterday...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_FRIXIO_000_000_295: This one's heart was heavy. Yet deep down, this one knew. If any one could survive the harsh world outside the forest and build peace with walking ones, it is Silbexio, strong of will and pure of heart.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_FRIXIO_000_000_296: Silbexio was alone for so long...but no longer. Other ones will welcome Silbexio back to Little Solace as a hero to all sylphkind.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_297: Elder one is too kind... This one is not strong... This one is...is...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_FRIXIO_000_000_298: Say no more, Silbexio. Silbexio must save strength for the journey home.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_FRIXIO_000_000_299: ...Brave one. Brave one is friend not only to these ones, but to gilled ones and winged ones and scaled ones and furry ones, too. It is brave one that has brought all ones together.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_FRIXIO_000_000_300: This one will always remember this day. This day, this one learned what can be accomplished when ones of all shapes and sizes come together as one.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_301: This one is forever in brave one's debt. This one would return one last time to the Ashcrown Consortium. Brave one will come, too, yes?
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_310: Welcome back, . I was Sylvie when we first met, and it is as Sylvie I would express my gratitude to you now.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_311: When I left Little Solace behind, I was a wide-eyed child, my mind and heart filled with wild fancies.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_312: Your people and ours are not so different! We have our differences, but with time and open dialogue, yes─it is only a matter of time before we can all live in harmony!
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_313: ...Then my friends were captured, murdered in cold blood by Memeriga's lackeys. I saw the meaningless hurt and hatred directed at beastmen here in Ul'dah. The depths of hatred I felt for your kind...I could not put them into words.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_314: Then I met people like Master Shanga...and you. I saw man and beastman working, fighting together for the greater good. Slowly but surely, it all came back to me. It would not be easy, but perhaps my dream could still be achieved...
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_315: Observing the battle at the Invisible City, I know now more than ever that this is true. The bonds forged today will burn strong, a beacon of hope for all that would look beyond their differences to join their neighbor in the fight for a better tomorrow.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SILVIA_000_000_316: I know not if our paths will cross again, but I know this: Eorzea is a better place for your presence. Farewell, ...and thank you.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SYSTEM_000_400: You have achieved Allied reputation with the Brotherhood of Ash, the sylphs of Little Solace, Novv's Clutch, the 789th Order, and the Ehcatl Nine.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SYSTEM_100_400: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from the vendors of all five allied societies.
TEXT_BANALL070_01473_SYSTEM_000_401: Through your efforts, your allies of all shapes and sizes have forged bonds of friendship that promise to remain strong through the years. You are truly a hero to societies across the realm!
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_SCARLET_000_001: Our scouts out at E-Tatt's Spire have sent word that the Ixal are attacking their position.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_SCARLET_000_002: They report that they have already weathered a sudden strafing run by one of the birdmen's blasted war balloons, and casualties were high.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_SCARLET_000_003: Have you ever seen these beastman dirigibles? The Ixal stock them with explosive munitions, and rain hell on their targets below.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_SCARLET_000_004: Even should they float within bow range, the balloon skins are thick and difficult to penetrate...though it can be done.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_SCARLET_000_005: Thus the spires we constructed throughout the Twelveswood are Gridania's first line of defense against assault from the air. 'Tis frustrating indeed, then, that recent conflicts have left them undermanned.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_SCARLET_000_006: I need you to head into the North Shroud immediately, and lend your strength to the garrison at E-Tatt's Spire. I am certain Captain Guithrit will appreciate the help.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_SCARLET_000_007: Report to Captain Guithrit at E-Tatt's Spire and lend your aid to the defense efforts. We cannot allow the Ixal to blind our nearest eye in the North Shroud!
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_GUITHRIT_000_010: Lieutenant Scarlet sent you, you say? Praise Nophica! Though I believe the worst of the danger has passed, what few soldiers I command are both wounded and weary.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_GUITHRIT_000_011: 'Twas a well-placed shaft that was our salvation─a private's arrow managed to punch a hole clear through the balloon's air bladders, forcing the Ixali vessel to flounder down into the trees. Hah! You could hear the squawking from here!
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_GUITHRIT_000_012: I must admit, however, to feeling a moment of dread at the thought of that war balloon slipping past and drifting over the city walls... Thank the gods─and a certain private─that such a fate did not come to pass.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_GUITHRIT_000_013: Nevertheless, we are in no shape to repel the Ixal should they prove able to press the attack. Pray head north into Peacegarden and see what has become of their downed craft.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_GUITHRIT_000_015: I have been told that these Ixali balloons are filled with some manner of buoyant gas rather than air. We would do well not to underestimate the cunning of creatures capable of such ingenious inventions...
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_GUITHRIT_000_030: Did you find the downed balloon? Was the vessel yet sound?
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_GUITHRIT_000_031: Hmmm... I am not sure if this came from the birdmen's craft, or is part of another contraption entirely. There can, however, be no doubt that it is of Ixali design.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_GUITHRIT_000_032: War balloons, such as the one you saw, were invented by the Ixal to assert their dominance over the skies. These vessels allow them to avoid our ground-based patrols, and infiltrate the Twelveswood with impunity.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_GUITHRIT_000_033: And the beastmen use them not only for acts of war, but also to haul away the trees felled by their ever-expanding logging operations.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_GUITHRIT_000_034: 'Twas to combat this unwelcome and destructive presence that we built guard towers throughout the forest...though I imagine the Ixal were quite displeased to find our borders thus reinforced.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_GUITHRIT_000_035: In fact, the primary purpose of this day's attack may well have been the destruction of E-Tatt's Spire itself. I am torn, . We must not weaken our defenses here, but I would be certain our enemy does not lurk nearby, awaiting an opportunity for sabotage.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_GUITHRIT_000_036: I would ask you to once more visit the crash site, and search the surrounding area for signs of our foes. I pray that my concerns are naught more than the anxious workings of a tired mind...
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_GUITHRIT_000_037: Pray return to the site of the fallen Ixali vessel, and search for signs of our birdman enemies. For your sake, as well as ours, I hope that you find none...
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_IXAL01486_000_040: (-Unruly Ixal-)Squaaawk! Get away from there, no-feathers! Ours to dismantle, war balloon is!
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_IXAL01486_000_041: (-Unruly Ixal-)Touch what is ours, you must not! Rights of salvage, yes? Rights of salvage!
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_04: (-???-)Enough! So much screeching and cawing when threatened nothing, featherless one has!
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_IXAL01486_100_043: (-Unruly Ixal-)Hold part we sought, no-feathers does! Search through wreckage for nothing, we did!
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_04: Weak-bellied fledgling! Calm down, you will! Speak with featherless one, Sezul shall.
Hmmm... Could you be artisan? No, clothing all wrong, it is. Garb for honest work, it is not.
Squawk! Raise your weapon not! Ixal, we are, but not same kind that attack your tower.
Balloon part you took... Value to you is little, yes? Have it from you, we would.
Not by force, no! And not for nothing. We make deal, yes? Inside gate, you come. Show you our work in return, Sezul shall!
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_IXAL01486_000_049: (-Unruly Ixal-)But, Chief! Mean to let featherless one inside, you cannot! Spread our secrets,  will!
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_05: Squaaawk! Question chief, you will not! Sezul's decision, it is! Shut screechy beak, before plucked and strung from nearest tree branch, you are!
Fierce look, featherless one has. Look forward to next meeting, Sezul does.
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_IXAL01486_000_052: (-Unruly Ixal-)Listen well, no-feathers. If chief's trust you betray, flay skin from worthless bones, we shall!
TEXT_BANIXA001_01486_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_06: Brave you are to walk into Ixal den! Know such camp existed, you did not, eh? Now, have that balloon part and your name, Sezul would...
Yes, yes! Squawk! Searched long for this, we have! Thank you, !
Know you what this is, hm? It is special stone, used for making instrument to read speed of wind. Only found in Xelphatol, very rare! Even clever Sezul cannot build such instruments without it!
Squawk? Seem confused, you do. You wonder why Sezul not go to Xelphatol and fetch stone himself, yes?
Tell you why, Sezul will! We are not like Ixal of Natalan and other places. No fighting with forest people. Outcast, we are!
Call ourselves “Ehcatl Nine”! Impressive, yes? ...Had nicer sound than “Ehcatl Twenty-or-so.”
But one purpose, we have: to fly free like wind!
For war with forest people, or pleasing greedy goddess, we care not! Fixed on the heavens, our eyes are!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_00: Hm? A strange face you make, . Burning with questions, you are, yes?
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_A1_000_002: ...What are you trying to do here?
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_00: Make myself clear, I did not, eh? Only natural, your suspicion is. Many Ixal would simply kill featherless one, and leave corpse for vultures.
But think like bird-brained Natalan zealots, clever Sezul and his crew do not! Endlessly wasteful, this war with forest people is! Waste of time! Waste of resources!
Ehcatl Nine is group of thinkers─of crafters. This place, Ehcatl, is place for building dreams!
To fly higher than any other is Ehcatl Nine's dream. But before we can fly, make wings, we must!
Good at making things, you are, yes? Know  when see one, Sezul does. Way of moving. Way of looking. Caw, caw, caw! Clothing had Sezul confused at first, though!
Creating much better than destroying, yes? Both Ixal and featherless ones agree on that, they can!
Have  create something for Ehcatl Nine, Sezul would. Build many things, we can, but not everything is possible in remote camp like this!
You know of place called “Fallgourd Float,” yes? Fine crafting facility, they have! Perfect for making airship hull interior components!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_01: Sturdy metal frame is component Sezul needs. Support hull from inside and become vessel's spine, it will!
Potent adhesive agent is component Sezul needs. Strengthen hull integrity and keep vessel from falling apart, it will!
Leather-backed plywood is component Sezul needs. Make for strong and durable hull, it will!
Placed order for raw materials with Qiqirn merchant in Fallgourd Float, Sezul has.  need only speak to junkmonger. Spend own coin, you need not!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_02: Squawk! A surprise for you, Sezul has! Protect and support hands when crafting tricky airship components, these gloves will!
Even clever  needs help from time to time, eh? Come back soon, featherless one!
Squaaawk! Featherless fool! How can  make components without proper equipment!? Lose precious gloves again, and beat  to within ilm of life with nail-spiked plank, Sezul will!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_KIKIROON01487_000_0: Master merchant welcomes well-come customer! Birdman chief tell master merchant of chief makings!
You take things for making, and go to place for making things! You find making place at side of inn, not inside!
Master merchant thinks you have no time for thinking─birdman chief seems ready to burst at seams. Hildeyerd will give you helpful help!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_HILDEYERD_000_030: Hello there, adventurer! Come now, I can hardly hear you! I said, “Hello there”!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_HILDEYERD_000_031: What's this? You wish to make use of our workshop? Well then, seeing as you're a first-timer, allow me to give you a brief explanation of what we seek to accomplish here.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_HILDEYERD_000_032: As I'm sure you are aware, Eorzea is populated with a plethora of artisans who create a range of wonderful wares. This workspace was created with just such a diversity of  in mind.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_HILDEYERD_000_033: No matter your profession, our facility is designed to allow simply anyone to bring in their materials and produce goods that demand an exquisite degree of precision and polish.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_HILDEYERD_000_034: Our small operation here at the Bobbing Cork is only temporary until we secure a more permanent residence, but I assure you that everything is fully functional! Now, what exciting project has brought you to me this fine day?
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_HILDEYERD_000_035: What have we here... Ah! Such a strange coincidence that you should happen to arrive bearing the very same rare materials that─
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_036: (-???-)Hildeyerd! Have you any word on my delivery?
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_037: (-Lalafellin Youth-)Hm? And who might this  be? ...And why does  hold the component materials that I ordered!?
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_038: (-Lalafellin Youth-)This is outrageous! You cannot simply swoop in and snatch up the wares I reserved a moon in advance!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_HILDEYERD_000_039: Please, Master Tataramu─you misunderstand! This adventurer brought along these materials .
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_040: Just “brought them along,” did !? Poppycock! What would a gil-grabbing mercenary need with airship hull component materials!?
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_041: Only a master engineer with the highest level of skill would be capable of utilizing the potential of such specialized items─and I highly doubt that anyone besides myself would have a use for them!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_042: I shall be gracious, however, and allow that you are some manner of artisan. Pray tell: exactly what do you intend to craft with those materials?
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_043: ...I am, of course, ignoring the fact that your efforts will invariably result in a botched job and wasted resources!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_HILDEYERD_000_044: Master Tataramu! This is hardly gentlemanly conduct!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_045: Hmph! Shall I offer to view the finished product, then? Go ahead, . Craft your wares, and I shall appraise the “quality” of your work─free of charge.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_HILDEYERD_000_046: Master Tataramu! I shall become cross with you if you continue in that tone! ...Here are your materials, . I'm sure whatever you create will be absolutely splendid!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SYSTEM_000_050: Should you choose to assist the Ehcatl Nine in their engineering efforts, you will be called upon to make use of special crafting facilities.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SYSTEM_000_051:
The first step in using one of these crafting facilities is to present the raw materials to the workshop supervisor. After preparing the workspace, the supervisor will then return to you the exact amount of materials required for your specific task.
You will next be allotted a certain amount of time in which to complete the synthesis.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SYSTEM_000_052: Should your synthesis efforts prove unsuccessful, speak with the workshop supervisor once more to retrieve excess materials and renew your access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SYSTEM_000_053: To begin the crafting process, open the Crafting Log from the main menu, followed by Special Recipes. Next, select Allied Society Quests, then lastly Ixal Quests to locate the desired recipe.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_HILDEYERD_000_055: I'm sure you'll do just fine! Remember: I'll be right here if you need anything!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_056: Craft away, . I'll be waiting to appraise the results of your “expertise.”
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_HILDEYERD_000_057: Finished crafting, have you? Well, don't keep the client waiting─run along and deliver your handiwork! Now, I doubt that you'd be so clumsy as to misplace your precious creations, but on the off chance that you do, know that I still have the excess materials in my keeping.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_060: All done, are we? Now, let's have a look at the travesty you've made out of─ Gods be good!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_061: I can scarce believe it! The craftsmanship is exemplary! And you say this component is to be used in the construction of an airship? I cannot even imagine what type of hull you mean to build!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_062: Tell me, adventurer: who commissioned this work from you? I must know!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_HILDEYERD_000_063: A what!? Why, that's incredible. ...Not to mention fascinating. Though I must wonder how one came to commission an adventurer for airship parts...
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_064: Hm. A curious reluctance. What harm can come of revealing a client who builds airships? Unless...
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_065: There was an odd rumor making the rounds amongst the engineers at the company. They say a group of Ixal had carved out a secret camp in the Black Shroud, and were conducting trials for some kind of secret weapon...
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_066: I had thought it idle gossip at the time, but 'twould appear the tale held merit, after all! Your Ixali master seeks to craft an airborne vessel of war!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_067: I will not allow it! Transforming the wonder of air travel into a means for delivering death is blasphemy of the highest order!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_HILDEYERD_000_068: But, Master Tataramu! What do you mean to do!?
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_069: Isn't it obvious!? I'm going to march right into that secret camp and give those blasted birdmen a good telling off! You'd best stay out of my way!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_HILDEYERD_000_070: But you cannot simply... <sigh> When it comes to airships, I'm afraid Master Tataramu's passion overpowers his capacity for common sense.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_HILDEYERD_000_071: I wonder if he even has any idea where he's going...
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_HILDEYERD_000_072: Here, you'd best take your finished component and complete the delivery. Your appraiser appears to have forgotten it in his haste to rush off and chastise the Ixal.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_HILDEYERD_000_074: Hm? Just who is Master Tataramu? I could tell you, but that wouldn't be very exciting now, would it? Perhaps you might ask him yourself.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_HILDEYERD_000_076: He's not a bad person, you know. A trifle enthusiastic about airships, but ordinarily a most straightforward and reliable fellow. And considering the location of your client, I imagine you'll be meeting him again rather soon...
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_08: Squawk, squawk! Returned, you have! Able to craft component, you were?
Made this, you did? Hm. Hm, hm... Yes! Serve us well, this will! Begin construction on hull, we can!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_083:
<pant> <pant> <huff> <huff>
I...<pant>...finally...<huff>...found you! I never realized...<pant>...just how big...<huff>...this forest was...
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_085: N-Never mind who I am! 'Tis you who are on trial here! Are you not the Ixali master who seeks to build a death-dealing airship and bring war and destruction to Gridania!?
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_086: Have you no respect for the virtuous field of engineering your uncouth plan will irretrievably sully!? Weapons on an airship!? Simply monstrous!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_08: Squawk! Mind your tongue, you shall! Making airship with weapons, Sezul is not! Been telling tall tales, someone has!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_088: Do not try to deny it! I have seen how the Ixal stole our technology to build those horrendous war balloons! Your kind know naught but killing and mayhem!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_08: Squawk! Blather too much, angry one does! Sees not enough! Look at design under own feet, you should!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_090: This schematic... It contains elements of both dirigible and airship... I've never seen the like!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_09: Hybrid vessel Dezul Qualan, it is! Fly very high, it shall! Ceiling altitude of five thousand yalms!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_092: Five thousand yalms!? That's impossible─an unattainable fantasy!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_093: Why, even Master Garlond's Enterprise cannot reach such heights! You speak of visiting the heavens themselves!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_09: Yes! The heavens! Rap on gods' front door, we shall! Knock, knock!
Ayatlan... Floating continent of legends, it is! High, high above clouds. Place where Sezul's ancestors once lived!
Return to Ixal's lost paradise, we shall! All-consuming goal of Sezul's people, it once was!
But this dream...shared now by too few, it is. Rather worship mad goddess Garuda and squabble with featherless ones, Natalan Ixal would...
Waste of life, Sezul says! Help Ehcatl Nine build balloon-airship hybrid and reach for distant sky, other Ixal should!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_099: What an incredible idea... You have such vision...such zeal!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_100: Sezul, I...I have misjudged you! You must let me work with you! I will see this dream of yours become reality!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_10: Squawk? Wish to join Sezul's crew, do you? Possess some skill at crafting, do you, yes?
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_102: Y-Yes! I have studied airship design most extensively! And though my practical experience is admittedly limited, I vow that there are none who match my passion for the craft!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_10: Important, passion is. But knowledge, too, you must have. Hmmm. Work you as hard as others, Sezul will. Be spared for your size, you will not!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_104: Thank you, sir, you won't regret this! Tataramu, at your service!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_HILDEYERD_000_130: What's this? You've misplaced your commission? Oh dear, well you shall simply have to make use of our facilities again! Misfortune is no excuse for failing a delivery!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_IXALDAILYR401498_00: Lost precious crafting gloves, no-feathers has!? No respect for Ixal wares, you have!
One more pair, you will be given! Lose them again, and feel pain of ten thousand deaths, you shall!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_10: And what of ? Impressed with work, Sezul is!
Enjoy crafting with Sezul's gloves, did you? Like second skin, yes? Protect hands, but allow artisan to make delicate and difficult movements, they do!
Agree to help Ehcatl Nine build Dezul Qualan, and let  keep gloves, Sezul will.
What say you, featherless one? Sprout wings and fly with us, yes?
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_13: Squawk! Feathers of the spirit, we share!
Hard to imagine to look at us now, it is... But an age when Ixal flew on power of their own wings, there once was!
Sad, then, that wrath of elementals, we incurred. Hmmm. Banished from forest, and stripped of gift of flight, we were!
With younglings hatched outside of forest, something wrong there was. Stunted, their feathers were. But lose desire to soar, Ixal never did!
In place of lost wings, great balloons Sezul's forefathers made. Such ingenuity! Seek to continue their legacy, Ehcatl Nine does!
But forgotten joy of crafting own wings, Natalan Ixal have. Grovel instead to goddess, they do. Grovel and beg.
Fools! Grant them new wings, Garuda never will! Seek only to increase her might, the goddess does! Always more sacrifices! Always more crystals!
Nothing more than slaves, Natalan Ixal are! But not Ehcatl Nine, no!
Soar once again, we shall. Within Dezul Qualan, our salvation─our waking dream─lies!
Work hard, and see history written,  shall!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_11: Thought to share Ehcatl Nine's dream, Sezul did. Hmmm. But for everyone, the distant skies are not, eh?
Force you against your will, Sezul will not. Farewell, ! Rather than destroy, remember to build, you must!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_TATARAMU_000_115: Adventurer... , is it? I apologize for my earlier outburst─I spoke out of turn. I hope that you can forgive me, and that you choose to lend your formidable skills to this wonderful endeavor!
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SYSTEM_000_500: Thanks to your efforts, construction of the Dezul Qualan's hull has begun! Continue assisting the Ehcatl Nine to see the airship hybrid reach completion.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SYSTEM_000_120: You have achieved Neutral reputation with the Ehcatl Nine.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SYSTEM_000_121: Ixal society daily quests are now available from Yazel Ahuatan the Able at Ehcatl.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SYSTEM_000_122: Delivery quests are also available from the Ehcatl Nine manciple.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SYSTEM_000_123: Furthermore, you may now purchase wares from the Ehcatl Nine vendor.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_SYSTEM_000_124: In the case that you misplace your Ehcatl wristgloves, a new pair can be purchased from this same vendor.
TEXT_BANIXA002_01487_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_00: Squawk! ! A task for you, Sezul has!
In Sezul's crew, mechanical engineer by name of Bozol Eduan, there is.
Left camp to acquire component materials for engine, Bozol did...but return, he does not. Without vital part for propulsion system, continue with construction, we cannot! Squaaawk!
Have  search for missing Bozol and drag him back here, Sezul would. Hmmm. Went somewhere to south, engineer did... Yes! Somewhere south!
Rare among Ixal, Bozol is. Very good with machines! Solely responsible for engine design and development!

Missing engineer is even more important than engine component, Sezul thinks! Even with needed part, install engine into vessel, we cannot! Attempted to add such propulsion system to balloon, no one ever has!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_BOZOLEDUAN_000_011: Squawk! Stay back! Hm? Come at Chief Totoloc's orders, you have?
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_BOZOLEDUAN_000_012: N-No! Away with you! Be caught by others, featherless one will!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_IXALBOSS_000_013: (-Ixali Chieftain-)Caw, caw, caw! Yet try to flutter free, do you? Hard to fly on broken wing, yes? ...Finished our game with you, we have not!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_BOZOLEDUAN_000_014: Enough fun, you have had! Miss your fawning presence, your goddess will!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_IXALBOSS_000_015: (-Ixali Chieftain-)Squawk! Such insolent screeching! Make self target for torment, you do!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_IXALBOSS_000_016: (-Ixali Chieftain-)Enough pointless resistance! Time to rejoin flock and devote yourself to Divine Garuda, it is!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_IXALBOSS_000_017: (-Ixali Chieftain-)Squawk? Where did you come from, no-feathers? This one's pet, are you? Cease your glaring, or snap your arm, too, chieftain will!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_IXALBOSS_000_018: (-Ixali Chieftain-)Go. Return to sniveling Sezul and give him message, you shall! Cease this skulking about in forest, he must! Or find himself and crew buried beneath boughs, he will!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_IXALBOSS8_000_019: (-Ixali Chieftain-)Answer now to goddess, all Ixal do. Divine Garuda... Terrible and beautiful Garuda...
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_BOZOLEDUAN_000_030: <pant> <pant> ...Glad that they tired of their sport, I am...
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_BOZOLEDUAN_000_031: Based at logging grounds, that chieftain is. Taken actions of Ehcatl Nine as personal insult, he has...
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_BOZOLEDUAN_000_032: Ugh... Bozol's arm... Useless, it is! Ruined Bozol for his craft, they have...
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_BOZOLEDUAN_000_033: Wish to rely on featherless one, Bozol does not...but take these materials, you must!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_BOZOLEDUAN_000_034: Necessary for crafting high-quality engine component, they are! Squawk!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_BOZOLEDUAN_000_035: Without component, ceruleum propulsion engine remains incomplete! Build extreme heat-resistant steel housing, we must!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_BOZOLEDUAN_001_035: Without component, ceruleum propulsion engine remains incomplete! Coat parts with rust-resistant agent, we must!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_BOZOLEDUAN_002_035: Without component, ceruleum propulsion engine remains incomplete! Build vibration-absorbing cushioning, we must!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_BOZOLEDUAN_002_036: Without component, ceruleum propulsion engine remains incomplete! And without propulsion system, no better than fancy balloon, vessel will be!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_BOZOLEDUAN_000_037: Artisan, you are, yes? Leave this task in your hands, Bozol shall!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_BOZOLEDUAN_000_038: At place your people call “Treespeak Stables,” find well-equipped workshop, you will. Unlike Bozol, need for sneaking in and using at night, you have not...
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_BOZOLEDUAN_000_039: Squawk! Burn like fire, Bozol's arm does! Go! Featherless one must do what Bozol cannot...
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_BOZOLEDUAN_100_039: Squawk! Burn like fire, Bozol's arm does! Go! Featherless one must do what Bozol cannot...
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_SEZULTOTOLOC_200_03: Later than late, Bozol is... Known for stopping to pick berries and pick wildflowers, he is not. Smell treachery, Sezul does!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_NELLEMOND_000_040: Greetings! The crafting facility here at Treespeak Stables is primarily for the purpose of forging tools for the stablehands, but our doors─assuming we had any─are open to all!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_NELLEMOND_000_041: Ah, I see you have some quality materials you wish to process. Our workshop may not be located in the fanciest of establishments, but I will personally vouch for the integrity of each and every piece of equipment!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_NELLEMOND_000_042: Now, having inspected your materials, I believe I have calculated the optimum amount required to craft the component you have in mind. I shall hold on to the excess while you work your synthesizing magic!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_NELLEMOND_000_043: The use of the crafting facility here at Treespeak Stables is entirely free of charge! Pray put concerns of sordid coin from your mind and concentrate on your wondrous creation!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_NELLEMOND_000_044: Your crafting endeavor was a success? Then you must waste no time in returning to your client. Ah, and should something unfortunate befall your commission─accidental loss, theft, act of primal─you always have the option of retrieving from me the remaining materials and trying again!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_06: Squawk! Worried for , Sezul was! Returned and explained all, Bozol did! Snapping of bones! Nasty chieftain's threats! Prevent  from crafting component, Sezul feared he would...
Very good, very good... Owe  two beakfuls of gratitude, Sezul does: first for finding Bozol, and second for crafting engine component!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_SEZULTOTOLOC_100_06: Being tended for injury, Bozol is. Shortsighted thugs!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_06: They can pray all day to goddess, but grow back flying feathers, it will not! Yet air in abundance, they have! Right there, between their own ears! Squawk!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_TATARAMU_000_063: This goddess... You speak of worshipping the primal Garuda, yes?
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_06: Worship, yes... No means of mechanical propulsion, have balloons. Slave to whims of wind, they are.
To control direction of their vessels, make use of enchanted “airstones,” they do. Infused with blessings of Garuda, these artifacts are!
Stone creates wind; wind moves balloon. Simple concept, but efficient and effective, it is not! And always costly, “gifts” of goddess are!
Squawk! Feathered demon! Promise Ixal much, goddess does. But work only to satisfy Garuda's cruel desires, Sezul's people do. Answer their fervent prayers, goddess never will!
That is why Ehcatl Nine broke ties with Garuda! Rely on own skill and perseverance, we shall! Prefer to adopt featherless ones' technology, we do!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_TATARAMU_000_069: That explains the hostile attitude of the logging grounds chieftain─he sees the Ehcatl Nine as heretics and betrayers of their own kind...
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_07: Yes! Think us worst kind of Ixal, they do! Caw, caw, caw! But also intend to lie at feet of Tataramu's chieftains, we do not! Fly, we shall! Fly beyond the clouds!
Yet take much more time now, it will. Wait until Bozol's arm is healed, we must. Draft technical designs for Dezul Qualan, no one else can...
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_TATARAMU_000_072: Sezul! If you need someone to draft airship designs, then I am your Lalafell!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_07: Training, you say you have. But what of patience? Hmmm? Of dedication? Regret making offer lightly, you will!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_TATARAMU_000_074: I am as serious as I have ever been! In fact, I have already started drafting improvements to your engine assembly. By incorporating my ideas, I believe you can reduce the weight of the propulsion system by twenty percent while still retaining its current power output!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_07: Toy with our dream, you must not! Should Tataramu's designs be flawed, use skin for covering vessel's wings, Sezul will!
...Hmmm. Tataramu draws designs, and  crafts components. Very odd indeed, Sezul's crew has become!
Squawk! So be it! Now official members of Ehcatl Nine, you are! Continue reaching for sky, we shall!
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_SYSTEM_000_500: Thanks to your diligent efforts, construction of the Dezul Qualan's tail assembly has begun! Continue assisting the Ehcatl Nine to see the airship hybrid reach completion.
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_SYSTEM_000_100: You have achieved Recognized reputation with the Ehcatl Nine.
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_SYSTEM_000_101: New Ixal society daily quests are now available from Methuli Cattlan the Hard at Ehcatl.
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA003_01488_SYSTEM_000_201: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_000: Ho there, ! Construction of the airship proceeds apace! Our beastman colleagues have even agreed to implement several of my proposals!
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_001: However inadvertent it was, I must thank you for introducing me to this opportunity.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_002: That I should have the chance to contribute to such a revolutionary project... 'Tis exactly the sort of thing I dreamed of as I pored over countless tomes on aeronautic principle and design!
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_003: There is, however, one small issue that has arisen to thwart us...
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_004: In order to properly integrate my innovations, we require certain materials to build a custom engine jointing component─materials that are notoriously difficult to procure.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_005: I had hoped it would not come to this, but I must call upon the aid of an acquaintance of mine.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_006: , would you be so kind as to deliver this letter to a gentleman by the name of Colson? I am certain that he will agree to prepare the materials...and keep the entire matter discreet.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_007: Now, Colson is often out and about on company business, but speak with Hida at the airship ticket counter in Gridania, and she will point you towards his latest appointment. My apologies, . I do not mean to treat you as a lackey, but I'd prefer to avoid the city for the time being...
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_008: I almost wish I could see Colson's face when he learns what I am building...not to mention with whom I am building it!
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_HIDA_000_010: Welcome to the airship landing. ...I'm sorry, was there aught else I might help you with, ?
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_HIDA_000_011: You wish to meet with Advisor Colson? Delivering a letter from “Tataramu,” you say...? <gasp> Surely you don't mean Master Tataramu!?
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_HIDA_000_012: Y-You've seen him!? I-Is he hale and unharmed!?
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_HIDA_000_013: You must take yourself directly to Quiver's Hold! Chansteloup will wish to speak with you in person!
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_HIDA_000_014: You will find Advisor Colson there as well, assisting with the investigation. Swiftly now please, !
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_HIDA_000_015: Pray head directly to Quiver's Hold and report to Chansteloup! He will surely drop everything to hear what you have to say!
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_CHANSTELOUP_000_020: I'm sorry, , but I cannot assist you at this time─the Gods' Quiver is fully engaged with investigating a most important case.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_CHANSTELOUP_000_021: Every resource at our disposal has been allocated towards locating Chairman Tatabaru's missing son.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_CHANSTELOUP_000_022: Even now, the chairman's chief aide, Advisor Colson, awaits within Quiver's Hold─no doubt eager to berate the First Bow for our lack of progress.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_CHANSTELOUP_000_023: Hm? Colson is the person you've come to see? Then I must ask you to mind your words. I can't have you antagonizing the esteemed representative of Highwind Skyways.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_CHANSTELOUP_000_024: If you must speak with Advisor Colson, then pray do so with the utmost respect. Highwind Skyways is not a company to be trifled with...
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_000_030: Yes, yes, I am Colson, but this is hardly the time for─ Hm? A letter for me? Let's have it, then, ! Time is of the essence, you know, especially at my age...
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_000_031: Great gods! This is signed by Master Tataramu! How came you by this document!? Is the young master well!?
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_000_032: What's that, you say!? Ensconced in the company of Ixal!? Then we've not a moment to lose! Should it cost me my very life, I shall see him freed from their ravenous clutches!
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_000_033: We'll need to form a rescue party... Yes, the finest Gods' Quiver marksmen, reinforced by a small army of Skyways retainers! Be brave, Master Tataramu! Those beastmen will soon rue the day they dared lay talons on my young charge!
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_Q1_000_001: What will you say to soothe him?
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_000_034:
This no longer concerns you, ! We must immediately─
...Wait, what? You mean to say that Tataramu is safe?
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_000_035: ...He's there of his own free will? Building an airship with the Ixal!? Wait, wait, wait! Perhaps we must needs begin afresh.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_000_036: As you are obviously aware, my name is Colson, and I am the chief technical advisor for Highwind Skyways and aide to Chairman Tatabaru. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_000_037: What you may not have known is that the man who asked you to deliver this letter is the chairman's only son...and the sole successor to a veritable airship empire.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_000_038: Some few days ago, Master Tataramu accompanied me here to Gridania as part of his continuing education on company practices. Much to my surprise and alarum, however, the young master suddenly disappeared from under my very nose.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_000_039: Well, I was naturally beset by all manner of horrible imaginings! With no ransom demand or other clue to his whereabouts, I had no choice but to task the Gods' Quiver with turning the entire city upside down!
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_000_040: Suffice it to say, your news has lifted a terrible weight from my old shoulders. I know not how I would have faced the boy's father had events unfolded otherwise.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_000_041:
...And yet, the contents of this letter still manage to vex me.



Dear Colson,
Enclosed is a list of materials I would have you prepare for my
companion. I require them for a most exciting project!
                                            Fond regards, Tataramu
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_000_042: Not one word of apology or even the slightest hint of contrition! My lectures on the privilege and responsibility of position appear to have fallen on deaf ears.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_000_043: And as for this list... I'm assuming these are materials for some manner of high-quality jointing component? A mounting frame for the ceruleum engine, yes?
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_001_043: And as for this list... I'm assuming these are materials for some manner of high-quality jointing component? Treated rubber gaskets to prevent ceruleum leakage, yes?
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_002_043: And as for this list... I'm assuming these are materials for some manner of high-quality jointing component? A leather-bound frame to absorb engine vibration, yes?
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_002_044: And as for this list... I'm assuming these are materials for some manner of high-quality engine jointing component?
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_000_045: Hmmm. I am sorely tempted to refuse this impertinent request, considering the trouble the young master has caused... But I am also intrigued.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_000_046: Here. Take this promissory note and hand it to the supervisor of the Fallgourd Float crafting facility. She will provide you with everything you require to craft Tataramu's component.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_000_047: Though I yet harbor some concerns, I will trust that Master Tataramu is content to work alongside these Ixal for now...
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_COLSON_000_048: Master Tataramu is as a grandson to me─I have watched that boy nurture a love for airships since the day he was born. Pray see to it that no harm befalls him...
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_HILDEYERD_000_050: Hello again, adventurer! Come now, I can hardly hear you! I said, “Hello again”!
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_HILDEYERD_000_051: Oh my! This note has the seal of Highwind Skyways! ...Though I suppose it only stands to reason─there are few other organizations that could afford the items you're requesting.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_HILDEYERD_000_052: Here you are, then! Everything is in order for you to begin crafting!
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_HILDEYERD_000_053: I'm sure you'll do just fine with those expensive materials! Remember: I'll be right here if you need anything!
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_HILDEYERD_000_054: Finished crafting, have you? Well, don't keep the client waiting─run along and deliver your handiwork! Now, I doubt that you'd be so clumsy as to misplace your precious creations, but on the off chance that you do, know that I still have the excess materials in my keeping.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_060: ! You were gone so long I was beginning to worry! Were you able to deliver my letter to Colson?
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_061: Yes! This is exactly what I had in mind! Jointing components like this one are almost impossible to obtain without the clout of a company like Highwind Skyways behind you.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_062: But with your expertly crafted component now in hand, we should have no trouble integrating my improved engine housing into the Dezul Qualan. I can already feel the bracing chill of the wind on my face! Hear the cries of the birds! See the folk below, rushing about like tiny─
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_063: Ahem. Pray excuse my little flights of fancy. Terrible habit of mine. So, ... I suppose you heard from old Colson who I really am, then?
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_064: Yes, 'tis true: my father is the chairman of Highwind Skyways, the expansive airship service that links the great cities of Eorzea.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_065: Destined as I am to one day take the company's helm, people everywhere seek to curry my favor as they would some merchant prince.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_066: ...A pity then that my “royal” status does not excuse me from an unrelenting procession of dreary lessons at home. I am forced to study mercantile practices, business strategies...all that I might maximize the profits of airship travel.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_067: But I have not the slightest interest in making coin. I've had enough of ledgers and lectures! Thus was I so reluctant to leave this little sanctuary.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_068: I want to design airships, not manage a fleet of them! I want to be valued not for my station or my purse, but for the skills I have labored to acquire!
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_069: Mayhaps you hear naught but the whining of a spoiled child... Yet I swear to you, I would renounce my inheritance in a twinkling if I could!
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_TATARAMU_000_070: Oh for the wings of a wondrous airship to carry me further, faster, and higher than ever before! That is my dream! That, and naught else!
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_07: And mean nothing to us, Tataramu's wealth does. Better off smelting down coins and making nails, Sezul thinks!
Squawk, squawk! Seize this passion, and let it sustain you, you must! Construction of Dezul Qualan will take all that Tataramu has, and more!
Chosen an easy path, Tataramu has not. No, not easy. But always fair master, crafting is! Great reward for great effort!
Launch our vessel upon ocean of clouds, we shall! Launch it towards gates of Ayatlan! Ready to fly is Tataramu, yes?
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_SYSTEM_000_500: Thanks to your diligent efforts, the engine housing has now been integrated into the Dezul Qualan's tail assembly! Continue assisting the Ehcatl Nine to see the airship hybrid reach completion.
