TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_SYSTEM_000_101: New Ixal society daily quests are now available from Rozol Cattlan the Prudent at Ehcatl.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_SYSTEM_000_102: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from the Ehcatl Nine vendor.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA004_01489_SYSTEM_000_201: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_00: Squawk! Have need of 's help, Sezul does!
So close! So close, we are! Taking shape before our very eyes, Dezul Qualan is!
Hull for body. Engine for heart. Next, fashion muscle to transfer power to wings, we must!
Developed by featherless ones, ceruleum technology was. Very advanced! First Ixal in history to design and build our own engine, we are!
Function perfectly, main engine components do. Flawless was Tataramu's design! And abundance of materials for upcoming task, we have.
But tiny problem, there is! ...Maybe not so tiny! Squawk!
Machine tool for cutting transmission parts, we have not!
Many intricate gears and cogs harness power produced by engine. Propel propulsion system, they do!
With one precision gearwheel...then make lathe to grind such parts, we could.
Our best hope,  is! Beg! Borrow! Steal! But have that gearwheel, we must!
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_01: Only featherless ones have item we seek! Rest on 's shoulders, fate of Dezul Qualan does!
Make new lathe, we must! With precision gearwheel, then craft intricate transmission parts, we can!
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_020: I was listening in on Sezul's lamentations. 'Twould seem we are in need of a new lathe...or failing that, a part that will allow us to build one.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_021: A gearwheel such as the one we seek must be of the highest degree of workmanship─should it be warped by even the smallest fraction, that imperfection will be reflected in the turning of the lathe and make the crafting of precision components impossible.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_022: No, it must be one made to extremely exacting specifications. I speak of the difference of a single hair's width here.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_023: In the entire realm of Eorzea, I could count on the fingers of one hand the master artisans who are capable of forging such a piece.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_024: And even should we be so fortunate as to secure the services of such a talented individual, we must consider the time it would take to craft the gearwheel... Our project might languish for weeks, if not months!
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_025: 'Twould be far better were we to focus on obtaining an existing gearwheel. ...And then somehow convincing the owner to part with it. Hmmm...
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_026: A lathe, a lathe... Now where have I seen a lathe before? ...Ah, yes, I have vague memories of seeing one in my grandfather's workshop. Which was...somewhere outside the city.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_027: , that's it! You must return to Gridania and speak with Colson once more.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_028: He's been with Highwind Skyways since the beginning. If anyone were to know what's become of my grandfather's lathe, 'twould be Colson!
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_029: He will likely be in or around the Carline Canopy─the old man is never far from the airships when not attending to business!
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_030: Colson is an old hand at my father's company, and was well acquainted with my grandsire. He may remember what became of the tools from Grandfather's workshop...not to mention where the workshop actually was.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_COLSON_000_040: Yes, yes, I remember you─my eyesight may be failing, but my mind is yet sharp, thank you very much. You're the  Master Tataramu employed as his delivery . Surely the materials I provided you with were sufficient, yes?
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_COLSON_000_041: Hm? The young master wishes to know what became of the lathe from his grandfather's workshop? Well now, that does bring back memories.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_COLSON_000_042: It must be nigh on fifty years ago now that I began my apprenticeship with Tatanora, a famous adventurer and businessman.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_COLSON_000_043: I still recall the day he conceived his revolutionary enterprise: he proposed the idea of building passenger balloons that shared the principle─if not the purpose─of Ixali dirigibles.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_COLSON_000_044: His company was the very first air travel service in the realm, and marked the birth of Highwind Skyways.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_COLSON_000_045: Of course, it was not until around thirty years later, when Cid Garlond brought airship technology to Eorzea, that flights between cities became a regular occurrence.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_COLSON_000_046: Those were the days, though... If I close my eyes I can still see the workshop─can still hear our excited optimism as Tatanora and I worked tirelessly on the construction of that first balloon...
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_COLSON_000_047: Ahem. Pray excuse an old man his reminiscing. What were we speaking of? Ah yes, “lathes.”
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_COLSON_000_048: I believe the lathe Master Tataramu refers to was the one we used in the old Fallgourd workshop.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_COLSON_000_049: ...But I'm afraid the place was shut down and dismantled for lumber after Tatabaru assumed management of the company. It was the end of an era, after all.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_COLSON_000_050: I wonder if there are any still in Fallgourd who remember that time... Perhaps you might try speaking with the employees of the Bobbing Cork?
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_COLSON_000_051: “Spread your wings and soar”... That is the Skyways slogan. When I first heard Tatanora utter that phrase, I knew at that moment what my life's work would be.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_COLSON_000_052: All that I am now began in that workshop─shaped by my craft even as I shaped wood and metal. I find myself hoping the lathe you seek has somehow survived...
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_AELUUIN_000_060: Welcome to the Bobbing Cork, friend. Will you be needing a room? ...No? You've come for a drink and some gossip, then?
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_AELUUIN_000_061: ...A “lathe”? I'm afraid I'm unfamiliar with the term. Some manner of tool from the old Skyways workshop that used to stand here in Fallgourd?
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_AELUUIN_000_062: A pity our previous owner has moved on─ten years I've worked here, but never have I heard talk of any such workshop.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_AELUUIN_000_063: Hmmm. Well, I may know naught of any lathe, but we do have a mountain of unclaimed possessions that we've been adding to since the dawn of bloody time.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_AELUUIN_000_064: The inn has the largest storeroom in town, you see, and it's the favored reliquary for all manner of unwanted or forgotten artifacts that once belonged to either residents or customers.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_AELUUIN_000_065: Only just this morning I thought to clear some space by throwing away the oldest and dustiest relics. You're more than welcome to sift through the pile outside and take whatever you wish.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_AELUUIN_000_066: You'll find a pile of unclaimed goods outside by the side of the inn. I hope the gods smile upon you and you find what you seek.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_070: ! Is that what I think it is...?
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_071: The gearwheel from the lathe! I came to Fallgourd on the barest of remembrances, but I'm certainly glad I did!
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_072: The workshop itself is gone, but some things are too precious to simply fling onto a midden heap. One of the artisans must have saved it.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_073: My grandfather was always well respected, you see, and even in his later years he would take me to see the workers practicing their trade.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_074: “Listen well, Tataramu,” he would say. “Coin has its uses, but aught of true value is bought with passion and persistence! To reach the highest skies, you must spread your wings and soar!”
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_075: His words of wisdom were as the sweetest lullabies to me as a child. 'Twas likely his influence that encouraged me to pursue my love of airship design.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_076: ...Hm? What's this? The face of the gearwheel is engraved with a dedication of some kind.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_077:
For my dear friend, Dezul Qualan.
On these wings I pledge our everlasting bond.

                                           Tatanora
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_079: ! Let us return to Ehcatl and deliver this treasure to Sezul without delay. There are certain questions to which our Ixal colleague may hold the answers...
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_09: Squawk! Nervously waiting for 's return, Sezul was! Releasing decidedly unblessed wind, bowels were!
Caw, caw, caw! Yes! Exactly what we need, this gearwheel is!
Good. Good, good, good! Edging much closer to reality, dream of Dezul Qualan is!
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_093: Sezul, there is something I would ask you.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_09: Pale, Tataramu looks. Nervous belly like Sezul? Ask permission to use latrine trench, Tataramu need not!
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_095: Ah, no, I─ Perhaps you should just read the inscription on the gearwheel.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_09: Hm? Inscription? Ah, see tiny words, Sezul did not!

For my dear friend, Dezul Qualan.
On these wings I pledge our everlasting bond.

                                           Tatanora
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_098: “Tatanora” is my grandsire. He is the man who founded Highwind Skyways, forty-six years ago. And I'm fairly certain we've all heard that second name before...
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_100: Care to share the source of your amusement, Sezul?
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_10: Too perfect, it is! Destined to fall into our hands, this gearwheel was!
Dezul Qualan... Outcast and genius! First chief of Ehcatl Nine! Master balloon maker...and Sezul's respected mentor!
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_103: Your mentor!? Then, the name of our hybrid airship...?
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_10: Yes! One and same! Think of better way to honor chief's memory, Sezul could not!
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_107: I speak of an old rumor. 'Twas said that Grandfather's company was built on his “appropriation” of beastman aeronautics─that all the balloons he flew were naught more than base imitations of Ixali-made vessels.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_108:
'Tis a rumor that was officially denied. And any mention has been thoroughly expunged from written records on the assertion that even unfounded claims of stolen beastman technology would unduly harm Highwind Skyways' reputation.
I had thought it merely the rumblings of rivals, sick with envy at Grandfather's success.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_10: Yes! Envy, it was! Squawk! Envy that led your ancestors to steal our genius! Thieves! Thieves and liars!
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_11: Caw, caw, caw! Pulling Tataramu's tailfeathers, Sezul was! Judging by words on gearwheel... Stolen from us, this knowledge was not.
Friends, they were! Shared craft with Tataramu's grandfather, Dezul Qualan did.
See it clearly, Sezul can. Two dreamers gazing into vast sky, one feathered and one not. Not so different are past and present, eh?
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_114: Fate has had a hand in our meeting, it would seem. I am honored to continue the friendship our elders began, Sezul Totoloc.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_11: <sniff> Squawk! Dust in Sezul's eye, there is! Back to work! Swiftly now, or find tongue shortened on new lathe, Tataramu will!
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_TATARAMU_000_130: The friend Grandfather names on that gearwheel... Surely it cannot be coincidence...?
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SYSTEM_000_500: Thanks to your diligent efforts, Sezul's crew can now use their new lathe to craft the gears and cogs that will transfer power from the engine to the wings! Continue assisting the Ehcatl Nine to see the airship hybrid reach completion.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SYSTEM_000_120: You have achieved Trusted reputation with the Ehcatl Nine.
TEXT_BANIXA005_01490_SYSTEM_000_121: New Ixal society daily quests are now available from Tazel Meyean the Lettered at Ehcatl.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_TATARAMU_000_000: Greetings, . With the ceruleum engine now integrated, the Dezul Qualan is entering the final stages of construction!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_TATARAMU_000_001: Not long now...not long at all. Once this airship is proven skyworthy, the field of aeronautics will never be the same again!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_TATARAMU_000_002: There is, however, another favor I would ask of you. Are you familiar with Gerolt, the master weaponsmith who resides in Hyrstmill?
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_TATARAMU_000_003: We will have need of his legendary smithing talents if we are to complete our steering mechanism─the helm of the Dezul Qualan. Only he can properly combine and align the necessary components.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_TATARAMU_000_004: Pray take these materials to Gerolt, and request that he aid us in our endeavor!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_TATARAMU_000_005: Gerolt is the preeminent weaponsmith of this age─with his handiwork aboard, the Dezul Qualan will fly as straight as the truest blade!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_GEROLT_100_010: What d'ye want now? That Jalzahn bloke come callin' again, did he? Well, I ain't got the patience for no mystic rubbish today. Me head feels like a kettle what some bastard's tryin' to pound the dents out of!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_GEROLT_200_010: Bloody hells! Ain't ye supposed to be trainin' with that toy I made for ye? Off with ye! Me head feels like a kettle what some bastard's tryin' to pound the dents out of!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_GEROLT_000_010: Take yer business elsewhere, adventurer. I'm busy enough, an' me head feels like a kettle what some bastard's tryin' to pound the dents out of!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_DRAKE_000_011: Pay no mind to Master Gerolt, good . His temper is as short as his night of carousing was long...
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_DRAKE_000_012: Now, what do you have that needs mending? A kettle? A cookpot? ...Nothing of the sort?
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_DRAKE_000_013: Hm. Well, if you don't mind dealing with an apprentice, I should be happy to hear the details of your request.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_GEROLT_000_014: Damn you, Buscarron... That cheap swill of yers'll be the death of me!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_DRAKE_000_030: Now, then, , what manner of task has brought you to our humble forge?
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_DRAKE_000_031: ...Ah, a custom-made helm to fit a new breed of airship. Tricky. I can understand why you would seek Master Gerolt's expertise.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_DRAKE_000_032: Though he is first and foremost a forger of weapons, the masterpieces he creates demand a flair for innovation and an eye for the minutest of details. Should he turn his hand to crafting your vessel's helm, then I can promise you that the end result will be of unparalleled quality.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_DRAKE_000_033: As you have witnessed, however, the master's present demeanor falls somewhere short of amenable. Beyond the threat of debt collection, there is little that will convince him to take up his hammer...
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_DRAKE_000_034: Are you, yourself, not an artisan of some skill? Then allow me to suggest that you take a portion of these materials and craft the finest helm spokes you can manage.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_DRAKE_000_035: Are you, yourself, not an artisan of some skill? Then allow me to suggest that you take a portion of these materials and mix some batches of the finest protective varnish you can manage.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_DRAKE_000_036: Are you, yourself, not an artisan of some skill? Then allow me to suggest that you take a portion of these materials and craft the finest helm handles you can manage.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_DRAKE_000_037: Are you, yourself, not an artisan of some skill? Then allow me to suggest that you take a portion of these materials and craft the finest helm components you can manage.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_DRAKE_000_038: The sight of such painstaking workmanship should serve to stir the embers of professional curiosity in Master Gerolt's soul. Despite his grumbling, he is not one to back down from a challenge!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_DRAKE_100_038: Here, I shall return your materials. Consider the tools of our meager workshop to be at your disposal!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_DRAKE_000_039: Some finely crafted components─say, four or so─may be just what is needed to shake Master Gerolt from his obstinate mood. I am certain he will agree to at least hear your request!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_DRAKE_100_039: You have completed your components? Then pray show the results to Master Gerolt. Should you somehow misplace your handiwork between here and there, then I shall be happy to once again lend you the use of our facilities.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_GEROLT_000_040: Ugh, thank the gods. That drink-demon smitty's stopped usin' me head as an anvil... Eh? Still bloody here, are ye? I swear to the seven hells...
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_GEROLT_000_041: What's this, then? Made these while I was tryin' not to puke on me apron, did ye? Fine bit of work.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_GEROLT_000_042: I never pegged ye for an artisan. But even with this level of skill, ye still felt the need to come to ol' Gerolt, eh?
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_GEROLT_000_043: So, what's the job? Ye want me to take this handiwork of yers an' make a steering mechanism for yer flying boat, is that it? Hmmm.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_GEROLT_000_044: Alright, I'll do it. I know that fire in yer eyes, and bugger me if I don't respect it. ...Might be as I'll need some time to get the work done, though.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_GEROLT_000_045: I don't fancy makin' finicky adjustments until the fog of booze is good an' gone. Once I'm satisfied it's ready, though, I'll have the finished parts delivered to yer shipyard.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_GEROLT_000_046: Can't say as I got up this mornin' expectin' to make parts for an airship! But don't ye worry none─once I take a job, I make sure it's done right. The kettles can bloody well wait!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_DRAKE_000_047: Ah, that Master Gerolt accepted your commission is most wonderful! Perhaps in his revived enthusiasm, he might deign to share with me another small morsel of his trade. I believe I've learned all there is to know about repairing cookware...
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_TATARAMU_000_200: , you're back! ...Master Gerolt agreed to the task? Excellent, excellent! I can think of no other major barriers preventing us from completing the Dezul Qualan!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_MARCENARY01491_000_: (-Trained Sellsword-)All blades stand ready to begin the extraction!
(-Trained Sellsword-)Spare no mercy for these feathered savages.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_20: Squawk!? Who comes barging into Sezul's camp!?
Remember inviting armed thugs to , Sezul does not!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_MARCENARY01491_000_: (-Trained Sellsword-)Save your indignation, beastman! You'll roast for kidnapping Master Tataramu!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_20: Kidnapping!? See you any shackles around his ankles? Free as a bird, Tataramu is!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_TATARAMU_000_208: How did you even find me here...? How many times must I tell you to leave me be!?
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_21: Father? Ah, chief of Highwind Skyways clan, you must be!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_TATABARU_000_212: This is the workshop for which you've caused so much fuss? There are no proper tools, no materials. Why, it barely qualifies as a dumping ground for our factories' refuse.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_TATABARU_000_213: What is it you wish to do, boy? If you want to tinker with airships, the company has them in abundance. I'll have Colson arrange for one of those new Garlond Ironworks models to be docked in a spare hangar...
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_TATARAMU_000_214: No, Father! You don't understand! This is not some game or idle pursuit!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_20: Squawk! Call my camp ground for dumping refuse, do you!? Shove ceruleum hose up chairman's backside, Sezul would! ...If already there, broomstick wasn't!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_TATABARU_000_216: ...What foul company you've been keeping. These birdmen have obviously deceived you─do you honestly believe such brutish creatures capable of building a functional airship?
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_TATARAMU_000_217: You are the one guilty of deceit! The Ixal are the reason we were able to take to the skies in the first place! Why do you insist on hiding the truth?
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_TATARAMU_000_218: Are you so afraid of damaging the company's reputation? Or are you simply too proud to admit that we borrowed the knowledge of “beastman savages”?
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_TATARAMU_000_219: Fear and pride can only weigh us down! Only by casting aside such ballast can we truly reach the heights of which we are capable!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_TATABARU_000_220: I'll not stand here and be lectured by my own child! Cease this impudence at once!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_HIGHWINDSAECRETARY_: (-Private Clerk-)Sir, we really must be away. There are those two items of business in Limsa Lominsa that require your attention, followed by a dinner engagement with Councillor Turstin at the Coral Tower...
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_TATABARU_000_222: Yes, yes, we are almost done here.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_TATABARU_000_223: Bring my son. If he decides to struggle, there is no need to be overly gentle. ...A small dose of discipline will do him good.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_TATARAMU_000_224: Father! You cannot do this! Please, listen to me...
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_22: Harm Tataramu, you will not! Stab you first with feathers, then pluck you, then roast you, Sezul will!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_05: Squaaawk! Gone, Tataramu is! Taken! Strangled and stomped on, his dreams were!
For first time in Sezul's life, wish to harm featherless one, Sezul does! Share with them secrets of balloons, and now think they own skies, they do!
Dezul Qualan stays grounded! Integrate final components, we cannot!

Patience, now. Wait and hope for Tataramu's return, we must. Occupy ourselves with crafting needed parts. But if chairman sets foot into Ehcatl Nine's camp again...stuff into sack and beat bloody with tree branch, Sezul will!
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_SYSTEM_000_500: Thanks to your diligent efforts, the Dezul Qualan now has a functional steering mechanism. Continue assisting the Ehcatl Nine to see the airship hybrid reach completion.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_SYSTEM_000_100: You have achieved Respected reputation with the Ehcatl Nine.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_SYSTEM_000_101: New Ixal society daily quests are now available from Duzal Meyean the Steady at Ehcatl.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_SYSTEM_000_102: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from the Ehcatl Nine vendor.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_SYSTEM_000_103: This vendor also offers wares in exchange for the Ixali oaknots you obtain in the course of your adventures.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_POPMESSAGE_000_300: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA006_01491_SYSTEM_000_400: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_00: Squawk... Greetings, . Mood of the camp, dampened, it is. Dark and dreary.
Lie dormant, Dezul Qualan does... Like deflated balloon. Fly without Tataramu's touch, it cannot.
Rely on Tataramu, we did. More than Sezul realized. Become heart of Ehcatl Nine, Tataramu has!
Despise this helpless feeling, Sezul does! Ask  to visit Gridania and parley with Highwind Skyways, Sezul would! Squawk!
Only fledglings sit and screech and do nothing! Tataramu needs to fly, and give him that chance, we will!
Caw, caw, caw! So serious, Sezul has become... Bring small featherless one back to us,  must...
Go to place of airships in Gridania and speak with company member. Find where Tataramu has been caged,  must...
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_HIGHEINDSECRETARY_0: I'm sorry, were you addressing me? If you've a business proposal or seek employment, then I must ask that you first make an appointment through the official company represen─
Hm? You wish to know Tataramu's whereabouts? ...I assume you are referring to Master Tataramu?
Forgive me, but I must inquire as to your relationship with the chairman's son. I fail to see how someone of your apparent─
...Argh! It's you! You were there in that filthy Ixali camp!
You're the one who conspired with those betaloned savages to kidnap Master Tataramu! Well, I'm certainly not about to share any information with a disreputable ruffian such as you! Shoo! Begone!
<groan> ...Now I shall be late in boarding the chairman's flight to Coerthas! He has a very important meeting at the Observatorium with very important people!
You again! How ever did you know where to─ Ah. Well, I'll not stumble like that a second time!
Now, keep quiet! Chairman Tatabaru is engaged in extremely delicate negotiations and is not to be disturbed! ...Hm? You're still asking after Master Tataramu?

Ugh. Will you not be silent? If you absolutely must know, the young man accompanied us here as part of his continuing education in company management. His chambers are guarded by our loyal─not to mention lethal─retainers, so you can forget any plans to spirit him away again!

Do NOT disturb the chairman! He is in the middle of a very sensitive and highly confidential parley that could decide a future airship route to Ishgard! The fortune of the company may very well rest upon its outcome!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATABARU_000_024: The role of the Observatorium in maintaining a Coerthas airship route cannot be underestimated.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATABARU_000_025: As such, I would value any opinions or concerns House Durendaire might have with regards to the establishment of such a route.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_PORTELAINE_000_026: I must say, your proposal is intriguing. As you have rightly ascertained, the very nature of the Observatorium places us in a unique position to oversee your company's endeavor.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_030: Oh! ! What are you doing here!?
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_031: Sezul sent you...? Broken without me, you say? ...I never imagined that the absence of my skills would be so keenly felt!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_032: I am flattered, but...as dearly as I would love to stroll out the door with you, I'm afraid things aren't that simple.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_033: My father dragged me along on the pretense that I would be “learning the trade,” then confined me to this room. I'm practically a prisoner!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_034: Did you see the guards on your way in? Should I attempt to take even one step across the threshold, those company-bought thugs will stop me in my tracks.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_035: Hmmm. There must be a way past them that doesn't involve outright violence...
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_036: ...I have it! You must needs speak with Templeton, the Skywinds employee stationed here at the Observatorium.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_037: He's aided us with component crafting before, and is one of the few people in the company I might consider an ally. Wily he may be, but it is that exact trait that will serve us now!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_038: I must escape this room without creating too much of a commotion. Speak with Templeton at the Observatorium's crafting facility─we have need of his crafty mind.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TEMPLETON_000_050: Ah, good day to you, adventurer! What may poor Templeton do to serve you on this cold and miserable day? Which, come to think of it, fairly well describes every day on this godsforsaken, croc-infested stretch of icy hell. ...Hm? Looking to break Master Tataramu from his confinement, are you?
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TEMPLETON_000_051: Well now, I'm sure I couldn't possibly lend my assistance to such a shady undertaking! And I certainly wouldn't suggest the use of a particularly potent sleeping potion! <wink> <wink>
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TEMPLETON_000_052: Our sellswords have grown fond of drinking mulled wine in an effort to forget their freezing extremities, and I'm sure they wouldn't question the appearance of another bottle on the table. 'Twould hardly be your fault if they overindulged and found themselves snoring under the table till morning!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TEMPLETON_000_053: Ahem! Away with you and your nefarious schemes! ...And be sure to pass on my regards to the chairman's son!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TEMPLETON_000_054: Loyal and steadfast, that's old Templeton for you! Surely Master Tataramu wouldn't wish to leave such a valuable servant to wither and shrink in this snow-choked wasteland forever!?
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_060: ! What news!? Was Templeton able to offer a solution to our dilemma? ...He gave you what!? A sleeping potion!?
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_061: Well, I hope his concoction has no lasting ill effects... If past experience is aught to go by, those retainers should be well into their cups by now. I'll sneak past as quickly as I dare and meet you outside!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_070: So far, so good, it would seem! Now, let's return to Sezul's camp before my father concludes his negotiations!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_COLSON_000_071: A word with you, Master Tataramu.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_072: Colson! Wh-When did you arrive in Coerthas? I-It is good to see you!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_COLSON_000_073: I know what you're planning, lad, and you know what will happen should you go through with it. Your father will not tolerate this defiance!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_074: You've taken his side? I had thought that you, at least, would support me in this...
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_COLSON_000_075: Pray take a moment to consider your father's perspective: he only wants what is best for the future chairman of Highwind Skyways. The world you stand to inherit is not the world in which the rest of us live.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_COLSON_000_076: There are commoners...and there are kings. We are all born into our fates and the responsibilities they bring.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_077: I am no prince! I am but the privileged brat of an airship empire!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_078: And how did that empire come into being!? Highwind Skyways merely copied the balloons of the Ixal, and hopped a little into the air!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_079: I care not for our company's reputation or its profits! Fortune? Prestige? Its aims are so low!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_080: Sezul and his Ehcatl Nine are reaching for the heavens! They have grand dreams, and a passion unlike any I've seen before!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_081: They seek to restore their lost wings, and, godsdammit, I would help them! I would share in that vision, soar in that same sky! That is all I wish for...
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_COLSON_100_082: I will speak with the chairman myself. I will convince him of the depth of your desire...as you have convinced me.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_COLSON_000_084: I have underestimated you, young sir. Those eyes...that mask of determination... It is like witnessing a decades-old memory come to life.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_COLSON_000_085: There can be no doubt that your grandfather's blood runs hotly in your veins...
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_COLSON_000_087: Quickly now─off with you! The longer I stand here in the biting cold, the more my hip starts to ache. Oh, for the fervent heat of youth! Heh heh heh...
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_088: Come, . We have kept Sezul waiting long enough!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_TATARAMU_000_100: Chief Totoloc! Your designer has returned!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_10: Squaaawk! Fogged up for no reason, goggles did! Not tears of joy, no! Humidity!
Listen well, Tataramu! Make up for lost time, we must! Work and work until Dezul Qualan is complete! Until hands ache and sweat turns to blood!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_IXALBOSS01488_000_1: (-???-)Found you! Found camp, we have! Reeking pile of dung hidden in forest!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_IXALBOSS_000_100: (-Ixali Chieftain-)Knew you were sneaking about, we did. But know why, we did not until now!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_IXALBOSS_000_109: (-Ixali Chieftain-)Preening feathers for forest people... Making unsanctioned balloon! Crime against goddess and our people, you have committed! Harsh, your punishment will be!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_IXAL01492_000_110: (-Ixali Wings-)Break it all! Burn it down!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_IXALBOSS_000_111: (-Ixali Chieftain-)Leave you to stew in fear, we shall! Hear of this treachery, our Natalan brothers will! Squawk!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_IXAL01492_000_112: (-Ixali Wings-)Pluck their feathers! Snap their bones!
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_11: Found us, they have... Sezul knew this day would come...
Squawk! Too soon! Too soon, it is! If but complete Dezul Qualan, we can...
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_SYSTEM_000_500: Thanks to your diligent efforts, the construction of the Dezul Qualan is almost complete. With the return of Tataramu, a few final adjustments are now all that stand between the Ehcatl Nine and the distant skies...
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_SYSTEM_000_120: You have achieved Honored reputation with the Ehcatl Nine.
TEXT_BANIXA007_01492_SYSTEM_000_121: New Ixal society daily quests are now available from Jezul Ahuatan the Second at Ehcatl.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_00: Squawk! Day to be remembered, this is! At last... At long last...
Complete Dezul Qualan, we will! Rejoice! Cry! Soil self in excitement! Caw, caw, caw!
Matter of attaching and calibrating final components, it is! Then up, up, up into the sky before Natalan fanatics arrive!
Task for , Sezul has. Final task to craft finishing component!
Take these materials to Fallgourd Float,  must. Expect 's finest work, Sezul does!
Go! Craft highest-quality component,  must! Prepare airship for test flight, we will! Squawk! Begun to tick, final count until launch has!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_006: ! The Dezul Qualan is almost ready to fly! <sniff> I am sorry, I cannot... I am just so ecstatic...
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_HILDEYERD_000_010: Hello there, adventurer! Come now, I can hardly hear you! I said, “Hello there”!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_HILDEYERD_000_011: Ah, I see you're seeking to craft your final airship component! I recognize the materials, but I would not dream of attempting the synthesis myself. ...I'm certain that you will have no trouble, of course!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_HILDEYERD_000_012: Here are your materials back! The facility is yours!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_HILDEYERD_000_013: Remember: I'll be right here if you need anything!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_HILDEYERD_000_014: Finished crafting, have you? Well, don't keep the client waiting─run along and deliver your handiwork! Now, I doubt that you'd be so clumsy as to misplace your precious creations, but on the off chance that you do, know that I still have the excess materials in my keeping.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_02: ! Quickly, now, quickly! Have that final component, we must!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEZULTOTOLOC_100_02: Yes! Exactly what we need, this is! Final piece of Dezul Qualan!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_IXA01493L_000_021: (-Ehcatl Nine Dropper-)Ch-Chief! Chief Totoloc! Terrible news, there is!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_IXA01493L_000_023: Heard from our little bird in Natalan, we have! War balloon pilots have begun priming airstones, Tuzal says!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_02: Yes, seek to harness blessings of Garuda, they do. Stones provide propulsion for balloons... Signal preparations for coming sortie, this does!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_IXA01493L_000_026: Squawk! Sent details of assault, Tuzal has! Fly here to Ehcatl and destroy Dezul Qualan, balloon squadron will!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_02: Squawk, squawk! Thick-skulled zealots! “Obey goddess or face annihilation,” they say! Shriveled and dead, their souls are!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_028: The Ehcatl Nine is a gathering of crafters, not warriors. And this camp is defenseless against attacks from the air! We're doomed, aren't we!?
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_IXA01493L_000_029: Speak truth, little no-feathers does! Everything we have worked for... Go up in smoke, it will!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_03: Cease your screeching, fledgling! Need to think... Cripple this attack somehow, we must!
! Not so final was final task! Ask one more boon of , Sezul would! Dangerous mission for one true warrior among us...
Stop war balloons from ever taking off,  must! But swiftly, now, swiftly! Once they are airborne, soon float beyond our reach, they will!
Make haste for Natalan, in snowy Coerthas─make contact with Tuzal Toltan! Know how to sabotage assault, he will!
handles fanatics! Rest of Ehcatl Nine, continue with preparations for maiden flight! Huddle in nest and wait to die, we will not!
Gifted artisan,  is. But need 's skill in battle more, Ehcatl Nine now does! Hear pitiful wails of beaten dung-for-brain Ixal from here, Sezul would!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_036: Do they truly intend to destroy the Dezul Qualan? I just don't understand it! Please, ! You cannot let this happen!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SPYIXAL_000_040: Featherless one is reinforcements promised by Ehcatl? Shhh! Keep voice down, you must! Wish to attract attention of these vicious air-skulls, we do not!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SPYIXAL_000_041: Thank your gods balloon squadron has not yet left ground. Flotation bladders are filled and ready, but take much time, preparation of airstones does.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SPYIXAL_000_042: Charged by power of vortex array, stones are. Once stones are fully primed, load them onto balloons and take off, air-skulls will...
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SPYIXAL_000_043: Before that happens, disable vortex array, we must─no power means no propulsion. Simple enough, yes?
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SPYIXAL_000_044: Tools for sabotage, Tuzal has: corrupted crystal shards! Insert these into turrets of vortex array and disperse elemental wind currents, they will!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SPYIXAL_000_045: But begin with primary turret, you cannot! Disable secondary turrets first! Very important! Delicate and dangerous work, disrupting flow of elemental power is!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SPYIXAL_000_046: Look, featherless one! See you this glowing device? One of three secondary vortex turrets, it is. Try inserting shard, yes?
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SPYIXAL_000_047: Secondary vortex turret, this glowing device is. Insert corrupted shard and disable it, you must!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SPYIXAL_000_050: Good! Very good! Understand how it is done now, featherless one does, yes?
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SPYIXAL_000_051: Within Natalan, two more of these, you will find! Sabotage both remaining secondary devices, then seek out primary turret!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SPYIXAL_000_052: Once main turret is down, cease feeding power to airstones, vortex array will! Then hurry back to Ehcatl and witness trial flight, we can!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SPYIXAL_000_053: Disable two remaining secondary devices, then sabotage primary vortex turret. Vortex array will lose power, and return smiling to Ehcatl, we can!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SPYIXAL_000_060: Squawk! Robbed balloons of propulsions, featherless one has! But sense something amiss, Tuzal does.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SPYIXAL_000_061: Report to Chief Totoloc, Tuzal will. Remain in Natalan, and keep eye on air-skulls, featherless one.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SPYIXAL_000_062: ...No, better option, there is. From top of Observatorium, observe both lands of Coerthas and Black Shroud at same time, featherless one can!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SPYIXAL_000_063: Send small featherless one to join you, Tuzal will. Welcoming of sneaky Ixal at tower, they are not! Squawk!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_200: Where have you been, !? Have you not heard!?
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_201: There was another of those vortex turret devices hidden in a ravine in Natalan! 'Twould seem the Ixali “air-skulls” were craftier than Tuzal gave them credit for... Let us continue to the roof and see what we can see!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_202: There was only the one war balloon that managed to prime its airstone, but I'm afraid one is all that those zealots will need. Without ballistas, or even archers, the Ehcatl Nine can do naught to prevent their fanatic kin from dropping explosive munitions right into the camp...
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_205: Blast and bother it all! I feel so helpless! Why must fate be so cruel...?
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_IXALBOSS_000_206: (-Ixali Chieftain-)Squawk! Bring balloon directly over unbelievers' dung heap! Smash and burn their little toy, we will!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_IXAL01493_000_207: (-Ixali Wing-)Ch-Chieftain! Alone up here, we are not!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_209: Good gods, it's the Blackjack! I'd know my father's ship anywhere!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_210: Father! What madness are you planning!?
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATABARU_000_211: Hmph. That boy's whims will be the death of me.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATABARU_000_213: Hahaha! What did I tell you!? Sturdy Skyways construction! That beastman blimp never stood a chance!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_HIGHWINDSAECRETARY_: (-Private Clerk-)P-Please, Chairman! You endanger yourself and the company's future both! Ugh, I believe I shall be sick...
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATABARU_000_215: Oh, pipe down, will you! I haven't felt this alive in years! And besides, Highwind Skyways has a more than competent successor. Let us arrange a meeting with him now, shall we?
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_HIGHWINDSAECRETARY_: (-Private Clerk-)But what of your appointments!? The Syndicate awaits our arrival in Ul'dah, and following that you have an engagement with Master Gegeruju in Costa del Sol...
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_219: Hm? He's using the signal lamp...
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_222: Ha! He could just use a linkpearl, but Father would insist on doing things the hard way. Come on, , let us be off!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_065: Welcome back, ! With the Natalan Ixal grounded for the moment, we should have some breathing room to put the finishing touches on the Dezul Qualan!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_30: Squawk! To featherless ones, this day belongs! From Tuzal about midair ramming, Sezul heard!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATABARU_000_302: ...Colson had a few words with me. I had thought myself too old for one of his lectures, but apparently I was wrong.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATABARU_000_303: I've heard that the Ixal are a people who lost their wings─a people whose greatest wish is to once more fly freely amongst the clouds. ...And that the invention of their balloons was a step towards reclaiming that which they once had.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATABARU_000_304: But perhaps we were the ones who truly lost the freedom of flight.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATABARU_000_305: Tataramu... When I look upon your face now, I am reminded of words I've not thought of in years.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATABARU_000_306: “Spread your wings and soar”... That was the slogan coined by our company's founder─by your grandfather.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_30: Caw, caw! Caw, caw, caw! Stop! Split Sezul's sides, you will!
Caw, caw, caw─<cough> <cough> ...Squawk! “Spread your wings and soar, you must!” Dezul Qualan's favorite saying, it was!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_310: Your mentor said that!? Then it was not only your technology that Highwind Skyways borrowed, but your philosophy as well!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATABARU_000_311: Chief Totoloc, I wish to apologize for the disrespect I have shown you. Without the contributions of the Ixal, my company would not be where it is today.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATABARU_000_312: My father, Tatanora, owed his success to the knowledge he learned under the tutelage of Dezul Qualan. On behalf of Highwind Skyways, I extend my fullest gratitude to you and your people.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_31: Squawk! Enough! Make Sezul squirm in front of fledglings, Tatabaru will!
Brought dream within Ehcatl Nine's grasp, chairman's son has─brought Ehcatl Nine within reach of Ayatlan!
Tataramu! Time to launch our bird into sky, yes!?
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_318: Commencing trial flight preparations for the Dezul Qualan! All crew members begin pre-flight inspections!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATABARU_000_319: 'Tis a beautiful vessel... My boy was hiding some truly revolutionary ideas in that obsessive head of his. Like grandfather, like grandson...
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATABARU_000_321: I believe you are owed a debt of gratitude as well, adventurer. 'Twas due in no small part to your actions that the dream of my son and his Ixali colleagues now stands to become reality.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_32: Dezul is watching even now, Sezul thinks... Arrive on paradise's doorstep soon enough, we will!
Spread our wings and soar, we shall!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATABARU_000_324: I feel I have lived the last decade of my life with my eyes shut...and I have you and your friends here to thank for opening them.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATABARU_000_325: I am honored to be able to witness the efforts of your labor come to fruition.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_32: Twenty winters ago, hop into balloon and vanish into the wide blue skies, Sezul's mentor did. Ride air currents up to heights where Dezul awaits, we now can!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_HIGHWINDSAECRETARY_: Our main offices are in an uproar about the chairman's sudden change in schedule... To the hells with it! I would see this amazing airship fly!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_070: My dear ... Oh, the gratitude I would endlessly heap upon you! There are no words to express the joy I feel in this moment.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_071: But perhaps I am being premature─why, the ship has yet to even leave the ground! I must focus on the task at hand, and be sure that every bolt is tightened and every knot secured.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_072: ...There is, in actual fact, one more request I would make of you─the absolutely final one, I promise! This is a figurehead I've been working on...
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_073: I'd like you to take the rest of the materials and craft the finishing component: some high-quality rivets. We wouldn't want the Dezul Qualan losing her figurehead mid-flight now, would we?
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_074: I'd like you to take the rest of the materials and craft the finishing component: a batch of high-quality protective coating. We wouldn't want the Dezul Qualan's figurehead to be damaged by high winds now, would we?
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_075: I'd like you to take the rest of the materials and craft the finishing component: some high-quality leather-strapped brackets. We wouldn't want the Dezul Qualan's figurehead flying apart mid-flight now, would we?
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_076: I'd like you to take the rest of the materials and craft the finishing component. 'Tis only fitting that your craftsmanship binds the Dezul Qualan's figurehead together!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_077: Here are the items you'll need. Pray present them to Sezul and see that we have his blessings on the design!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_078: A figurehead is not strictly necessary, but the ship seems incomplete without one, don't you agree?
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_08: Hm? Missed chance to empty bladder,  has! Unless wish to miss inaugural flight test,  does!
...Squawk? Figurehead component materials? Familiar design, this is! When did Tataramu learn to craft traditional flying charm...? Hmmm.
Feathers of figurehead serve to remind Ixal of ancestors, and ward balloon against capricious nature of sky, they do!
Impressed with Tataramu's foresight, Sezul is. Have Sezul's blessings to complete figurehead,  does!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEZULTOTOLOC_100_08: Crafting this component is simple matter, yes? Be sure, then, to pour all 's skill into task!

Finish part and return to Tataramu before final inspections are complete,  must! See figurehead proudly attached for test flight, Sezul would!

TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_091: Thank you, this will do perfectly. I think I'm ready... Ready to entrust my life to the Dezul Qualan, and aim for the highest skies.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_092: We are all but done with the last round of inspections. 'Twould be safest if you were to withdraw several steps─only the gods know how this will unfold!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_40: Squawk! Ehcatl Nine! Arrived at long last, moment of truth has! To Ayatlan, we fly!

TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATABARU_000_412: Keep her steady, Tataramu! Ride the wind─don't fight against it!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_413: Extend wings to full trim! Release primary and tertiary ballast!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_414: Ugh! The ship won't turn! Come now, Dezul Qualan, is this all you have!?
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_415: Fly, damn you! We built you better than this!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_IXALBUKAE_000_420: (-Tuzal Toltan the Unseen-)Spotted Dezul Qualan from Natalan vantage point, Tuzal has! Indicate altitude of five thousand yalms, instruments do!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_IXALBUKAE_000_421: (-Tuzal Toltan the Unseen-)Soar like bird, it does! Soar like bird...
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_100: ! The test flight was a complete success! 'Twas a shaky start, but the Dezul Qualan and I both returned unharmed!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_101: And we reached our target altitude of five thousand yalms─that's higher than any Eorzean airship has ever flown! A new aeronautic record! ...Unofficial, though it may be.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_102: Despite its impressive performance, however, the Dezul Qualan still cannot achieve that which Sezul dreams: to climb above and beyond the clouds and arrive on the legendary shores of Ayatlan...
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_103: But we'll continue to improve and tweak our prototype, and one day we will catch a glimpse of that floating paradise! There is no record that cannot be broken!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_104: ...By the by, . There is something I've been meaning to ask you for the longest time.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_105: I know why I am here, but whatever brought you to the Ehcatl Nine's camp?
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_Q1_000_000: What brought you to the Ehcatl Nine's camp?
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_A1_000_002: Well, one thing led to another, and...
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_106: You... Your original mission was to respond to an Ixali threat!? I do believe you've gone above and beyond and somewhere quite far to the left of the call of duty!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_107: I daresay the Twin Adder officer who enlisted your services is by now rather alarmed by your prolonged absence. Perhaps you should report back to Gridania and put her mind at ease...
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_TATARAMU_000_108: I mean to remain in Ehcatl, and help Sezul and his crew expand the field of aeronautics. Pray visit if you will and lend a helping hand!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_10: Listen to Sezul, ! To have dream is not enough─chase it, you must! Stand still for , it will not!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SEZULTOTOLOC_000_11: Sound like philosopher, Sezul does! Caw, caw, caw! Maybe chosen wrong profession, Sezul has!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SCARLET_000_120: Yes, ? What can I do for─ Oh! The attack on E-Tatt's Spire!
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SCARLET_000_121: The captain mentioned that he'd sent you out to investigate further, but I'd completely forgotten you were still─ Er, that is to say, the Ixal appear to have abandoned their plans to assault our towers. Excellent work, !
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SCARLET_000_122: We must, however, remain alert and at the ready. The thought of those war balloons drifting over the city walls is one of our citizens' greatest fears─a nightmare that we must never allow to become reality.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SCARLET_000_123: I shall likely have need of your services in the days to come, so pray keep your skills honed and your blades sharp.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SCARLET_000_124: ...Did you hear the news, by the way? There was some excitement here in Gridania while you were off trampling the underbrush.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SCARLET_000_125: The son of Highwind Skyways chairman Tatabaru suddenly vanished into thin air. Folk were crying foul play, though no body or blood was in evidence. Hm? He's already been found? Well, perhaps now things can return to normal...
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SYSTEM_000_130: You have achieved Sworn reputation with the Ehcatl Nine.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SYSTEM_000_131: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from the Ehcatl Nine vendor.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_POPMESSAGE_000_500: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA008_01493_SYSTEM_000_600: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_YAZELAHUATAN_000_00: Squahaha! An able crafter, featherless one is? Not so able as Yazel, I think! Yet prove me wrong, you may, and aid Ehcatl in so doing!
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_YAZELAHUATAN_000_01: An emergency release valve, for use with an airship bladder, we require! A simple task for a featherless one skilled as you, Yazel trusts.
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_YAZELAHUATAN_000_02: Tanning agents for treating materials used to craft an airship bladder, we require! A simple task for a featherless one skilled as you, Yazel trusts.
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_YAZELAHUATAN_000_03: Leather and canvas used to craft an airship bladder, we require! A simple task for a featherless one skilled as you, Yazel trusts.
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_YAZELAHUATAN_000_04: A skilled  and listener both, Yazel hopes you are, for the aid of a featherless chatterbox, you require, to use these materials. Squa-hawk! For this component, the facilities of Dametta, you must utilize.
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_YAZELAHUATAN_000_05: The ramblings of the chatterbox, you must endure, if to Yazel you wish to prove yourself able. Squa-hawk!
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_DAMETTA_000_060: Oh my, you wish to use these facilities? They are lovely, aren't they? I do my utmost to keep them in tip-top condition, you know! Regular cleaning and maintenance is far more essential than most people realize.
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_DAMETTA_000_061: However, as much as I'd love to let you do so, I must ask that you do something in exchange. Worry not, it's nothing too difficult! Just a simple favor. I do have to clean up after you, you know!
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_DAMETTA_000_062: Know you of opo-opos? Dreadful little scamps, always stealing my Mun-Tuy beans. One in particular has given me no end of trouble, and I will suffer it no longer! Pray use these ripe beans to lure him out from his lair near E-Tatt's Spire and end his reign of terror! And, though it's a grisly thing to ask, I must insist that you return with proof of the deed─a fang, or a claw, or something of that nature. Nothing too large, mind you. I don't want it as a trophy to hang on my wall. I'm not a monster!
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_DAMETTA_000_070: Truth be told, I've no real desire to see proof of the deed. However, I've been deceived before─not to imply that you're a liar like that adventurer was, of course!
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_DAMETTA_000_071: You see, he came through the other day and, like you, he wished to use these facilities. I told him─as I told you─that I would gladly permit him to do so, if only he first dealt with a certain opo-opo. So off he went for the better part of a day, eventually returning to report that the deed was done! Naturally, I was beside myself with joy, and I went to bed that night thinking that the opo-opo was no more and all was right with the world.
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_DAMETTA_000_072: Needless to say, I was very cross when I awoke to find my stores pilfered yet again, and the ground stained with copious amounts of saliva─incontrovertible evidence that my sworn enemy yet lived! I made up my mind then and there to give that adventurer a piece of my mind─especially once I learned he had spent that afternoon drinking in a pub instead of tracking my opo-opo.
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_DAMETTA_000_073: But despite learning of his nefarious deeds, I never was able to track him down, which was surprising given how queer a fellow he was! He had onions tied to his belt, which I don't need to tell you is very unusual. When I asked him about them, he said it was the style at the time he was growing up, and he'd always had a fondness for his grandfather's ways...
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_SYSTEM_100_073: As Dametta struggles to recall if the onions were white or yellow, your mind begins to wander...
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_POP_MESSAGE: The opo-opo sprays saliva in your general direction!
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_DAMETTA_000_090: As I told you before, you are more than welcome to make use of these facilities─provided you deal with that dastardly opo-opo first. Oh, and as a precaution, I must ask that you present your materials for inspection as well. You would be shocked by what some people have tried to make here!
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_DAMETTA_000_091: My word, is that really... Oh gods, I can't bear to look at it! Take it from my sight and dispose of it─but not in the river! Now then, deep breaths... Though unusual, I don't believe your materials could be used for evil ends. Here you are. You'll note I didn't return them all─there are several times the required materials, it would seem. Whoever entrusted this task to you left a note in the bag: “To featherless neuker, give only required parts. In case of failure, retain spares.” Hmmm... What in the world is a “neuker”?
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_DAMETTA_000_100: Oh, do you require more time with the facilities? By all means, take as long as you like! And if you require additional materials, let me know. I have plenty here for the “featherless neuker.”
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_DAMETTA_100_100: Is that the finished product? I...I have no idea what that is, but it looks splendid! I'm sure your client will love it! Ah─it so happens there was another note in the bag: “Retain spare parts, in case featherless neuker loses component en route.” He really doesn't trust you, does he?
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_YAZELAHUATAN_000_13: Squahaha! Returned, the one who would prove  able is! Bladder component,  has brought?
...Squa-hawk! Able indeed, featherless one is! Within you lies great potential, as Chief Totoloc said.
Potential in Yazel too, the chief once saw. Not wrong in either case, it is more than clear to me! Squawk!
TEXT_BANIXA101_01494_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_YAZELAHUATAN_000_00: Squa-hawk! The one who too would be able, come,  is! Then to Yazel, lend a hand, that we might both escape the claws of the Hard!
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_YAZELAHUATAN_000_01: Pluck my posterior bare, she shall, if rings of metal for the bladder lining we do not provide!
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_YAZELAHUATAN_000_02: Pluck my posterior bare, she shall, if water-resistant paint for the bladder lining we do not provide!
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_YAZELAHUATAN_000_03: Pluck my posterior bare, she shall, if leather-backed plywood for the bladder lining we do not provide!
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_YAZELAHUATAN_000_04: Able to craft this component himself, Yazel is, were it not for Ehcatl's dearth of facilities. Squa-hawk! Those of Hyrstmill, suffice they shall, but welcome within their walls, Yazel is not. With featherless chatterbox, featherless  should speak.
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_YAZELAHUATAN_000_05: Highly unattractive, Yazel's posterior would be, if plucked bare of feathers. For the sake of Ixali maidens, with my materials and the featherless chatterbox's facilities, craft the component we require! Squa-hawk!
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_DAMETTA_000_060: I know that look─you've a mind to use these facilities, don't you? It's hardly the first time, suffice it to say. I find it quite flattering, actually─and who wouldn't? That the facilities I've worked so hard to maintain are in such high demand is high praise indeed!
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_DAMETTA_000_061: However! That same demand means that I cannot allow unrestricted access, I'm sorry to say. Oh, don't look at me like that! Can you imagine the state they would be in if I let every traveler have the run of the place? It'd be no better than a pigsty!
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_DAMETTA_000_062: But worry not! You may use them if you take this lunch to Paulemont at E-Tatt's Spire. A simple delivery should be no trouble for a strapping adventurer like yourself! Oh, and do remember to bring me any empty containers he may have. I reuse them, you see. One must never be wasteful!
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_DAMETTA_000_070: Paulemont never leaves his post, so I've no doubt you'll find him at E-Tatt's Spire. Nevertheless, I pray you don't take too long to deliver it! Meals are always best served fresh!
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_DAMETTA_000_071: Such a dedicated Wailer, Paulemont is─and kind, too! I used to send him Mun-Tuy tonic, and do you know what he did? He shared it with his comrades when supplies ran low!
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_DAMETTA_000_072: Just between you and me, he's quite handsome too! Much more than my husband, that's for sure. Oh, but don't go getting any ideas─I'd never do anything indecent. But a woman has eyes, you know!
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_DAMETTA_000_073: Like the other day, when a horde of ravenous opo-opos burst through the gates and began raiding our storehouses, a party of courageous adventurers came to our defense. So strong and skilled they were─and fetching too! One young man in particular had such lovely arms, and for a moment I couldn't help but imagine them wrapped around me...
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_SYSTEM_100_073: As Dametta continues to wax poetic about various men, your mind begins to wander...
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_PAULEMONT_000_080: Gods save me, today's the day, isn't it? She'll be here any moment...
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_PAULEMONT_000_081: Is that from Dametta? I, uh... Thank you! Here, don't forget this! No need for her to come all this way to fetch an empty sack, am I right?
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_PAULEMONT_000_090: All things considered, it could be far worse. At least she's not forcing that gods-awful tonic on me anymore.
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_DAMETTA_000_100: I do so hope Paulemont wasn't disappointed that I couldn't deliver his meal in person. I trust you've brought the empty sack? Oh, and as a precaution, I must ask that you present your materials for inspection as well. You would be shocked by what some people have tried to make here, believe me!
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_DAMETTA_000_101: My word, would you look how spotless it is! Nothing more satisfying than seeing that your man─ahem, that your friend didn't leave a single crumb. Ahem. Ah, yes, your materials! Though unusual, I don't believe they could be used for evil ends. Here you are. You'll note I didn't return them all─there are several times the required materials, it would seem. Whoever entrusted this task to you left a note in the bag: “To featherless neuker, give only required parts. In case of failure, retain spares.” Hmmm... What in the world is a “neuker”?
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_DAMETTA_000_110: Oh, do you require more time with the facilities? By all means, take as long as you like! And if you require additional materials, let me know. I have plenty here for the “featherless neuker.”
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_DAMETTA_100_100: Is that the finished product? I...I have no idea what that is, but it looks splendid! I'm sure your client will love it! Ah─it so happens there was another note in the bag: “Retain spare parts, in case featherless neuker loses component en route.” He really doesn't trust you, does he?
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_YAZELAHUATAN_000_13: Feathered, my precious posterior yet is, but not for long if featherless  does not deliver bladder lining component!

Squa-hawk! A gift to the Ehcatl, your craftsmanship is, and a gift to Ixali maidens, Yazel remains! Ah─ Squahaha! Naught more than jest, my words are, of course. Never would Methuli harm his tailfeathers, Yazel knows.
(A buzzard to be feared, the Hard is. Ware her claws, lest you suffer her wrath as I have!)
TEXT_BANIXA102_01495_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA103_01496_YAZELAHUATAN_000_00: Squaaawk! Able though I am, cursed with terrible fortune, I am too! Lost to Garuda-worshipping buzzards, materials for constructing urgently required starboard hull components are!
TEXT_BANIXA103_01496_YAZELAHUATAN_000_01: Precious materials for constructing the hull, lost to our enemies in Treespeak! Squa-hawk!
TEXT_BANIXA103_01496_YAZELAHUATAN_000_02: Precious materials for preparing an essential finish for the hull, lost to our enemies in Treespeak! Squa-hawk!
TEXT_BANIXA103_01496_YAZELAHUATAN_000_03: Precious materials for preparing leather-backed plywood for the hull, lost to our enemies in Treespeak! Squa-hawk!
TEXT_BANIXA103_01496_YAZELAHUATAN_000_04: Retrieve the materials myself, I would, but able lover, Yazel is─not able fighter. Featherless  and fighter both, you are, and more than capable of recovering materials.
From storage pots, retrieve the materials, then for crafting, to Treespeak Stables you must go. Open to all featherless, the facilities there are. Squahaha! Need for special favors, there is not.
TEXT_BANIXA103_01496_YAZELAHUATAN_000_05: Materials enough for two components, you must recover! Without components, Yazel will fall out of favor. Able to suffer much, Yazel is, except that!
TEXT_BANIXA103_01496_POP_MESSAGE: With a cacophony of squawking, the enemy appears!
TEXT_BANIXA103_01496_BALOON_000_081: Squaaawk! Friend of Ehcatl, you die!
TEXT_BANIXA103_01496_NELLEMOND_000_090: Greetings, friend! Our doors─assuming we had any─are open to all! You wish to process those materials, yes? Hmmm... If you would first permit me to conduct an inspection...?
TEXT_BANIXA103_01496_NELLEMOND_000_091: Ah, my concern was for naught. These materials are both quality and plentiful! In fact, I have calculated the optimum amount required to craft the components you have in mind. I shall hold on to the excess while you work your synthesizing magic! Pray let me know if you require any replacements.
TEXT_BANIXA103_01496_NELLEMOND_000_100: The use of the crafting facility here at Treespeak Stables is entirely free of charge! Pray put concerns of sordid coin from your mind and concentrate on your wondrous creation!
TEXT_BANIXA103_01496_NELLEMOND_100_100: Your crafting endeavor was a success? Then you must waste no time in returning to your client. Ah, and should something unfortunate befall your commission─accidental loss, theft, act of primal─you always have the option of retrieving from me the remaining materials and trying again!
TEXT_BANIXA103_01496_YAZELAHUATAN_000_13: Squaaawk! Suffer the barbs of his comrades, the Able cannot! Bring me the starboard hull components, you must!
Squa-hawk! Safe, my reputation is! To featherless , much and more is owed!
Rejoin the ranks of the buzzards, I wish not to do. Much more beloved by maidens, Yazel is, as able revolutionary!
TEXT_BANIXA103_01496_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_YAZELAHUATAN_000_00: Ill tidings, featherless ! Waylaid by featherless ones, our carrier has been! Squa-hawk! Trapped at best, dead at worst, Yazel fears!
Of the essence, time was, so risky route near Treespeak Stables I bade him take. Larboard hull component materials, to Ehcatl, he was to bring.
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_YAZELAHUATAN_000_01: For the plates to construct the hull, materials precious and strong. Nearly depleted, our supply is!
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_YAZELAHUATAN_000_02: For the finish to prepare the plating, materials precious and essential. Nearly depleted, our supply is!
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_YAZELAHUATAN_000_03: For the leather-backed plywood to construct the hull, materials precious and light. Nearly depleted, our supply is!
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_YAZELAHUATAN_000_04: If yet alive, likely in hiding, the carrier is. Know you for friend, he may not, so “With the Wind,” to him you must whisper. Words of power, they are, known only to Ehcatl and their allies. Squa-hawk!
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_YAZELAHUATAN_000_05: Simple enough, the retrieval of materials is, if the carrier is fallen. However, if yet alive, words of power, you must say to him. “With the Wind,” forget it not. Squa-hawk!
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_IXALGATHERER01497_1: Squaaawk! Featherless neuker! Back, you must stay, or...or a second time, I will demand!
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_SYSTEM_100_061: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter the password “With the Wind” to let the Ehcatl Nine carrier know you are a friend.
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_IXALGATHERER01497_0: Squawawk!? With the wind, featherless neuker is!? Relieved and contrite, I am! All neukers, look alike to me, they do. As a friend of Ehcatl, recognize, I did not!
Deliver the materials in my stead, I would ask, but that alone, suffice it will not. Too late, this shipment is; completed components, we must now deliver. Squawk!
Open to all featherless, the facilities of Treespeak Stables are. There, craft three larboard hull components, featherless friend can. Other recourse, we have not!
Afraid, I am, but patient, I am too. When featherless ones leave, chance to escape, I shall seize. Wait not for me, friend of Ehcatl─craft larboard hull components, you must!
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_NELLEMOND_000_090: Greetings, friend! Our doors─assuming we had any─are open to all! You wish to process those materials, yes? Hmmm... If you would first permit me to conduct an inspection...?
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_NELLEMOND_000_091: Ah, my concern was for naught. These materials are both quality and plentiful! In fact, I have calculated the optimum amount required to craft the components you have in mind. I shall hold on to the excess while you work your synthesizing magic! Pray let me know if you require any replacements.
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_NELLEMOND_000_100: The use of the crafting facility here at Treespeak Stables is entirely free of charge! Pray put concerns of sordid coin from your mind and concentrate on your wondrous creation!
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_NELLEMOND_100_100: Your crafting endeavor was a success? Then you must waste no time in returning to your client. Ah, and should something unfortunate befall your commission─accidental loss, theft, act of primal─you always have the option of retrieving from me the remaining materials and trying again!
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_YAZELAHUATAN_000_13: Squaaawk! Without component materials, soon halt, construction of the Dezul Qualan will. Disastrous for Ehcatl─and Yazel, this would be!
Squa-hawk! Materials, I expected, yet components, you have brought!?
My mind, waylaid courier and featherless crafter did read! Squahaha! Initiative, Yazel values much in his allies.
Who better than able allies to prove Yazel's own ableness, I say!? Rise ever higher, I will, with the aid of featherless  and  ilk!
TEXT_BANIXA104_01497_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_TAZELMEYEAN_000_000: Squawk! Featherless one wishes to help lend shape to my genius, yes? Starboard wing, I make. Make components for this, you will.
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_TAZELMEYEAN_000_010: What components, you ask? Framework for wing, light and strong for better efficiency. Four sets of highest quality, I need.
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_TAZELMEYEAN_000_020: What components, you ask? Aetheric coating for wing, ideal for conducting wind energy. Four sets of highest quality, I need.
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_TAZELMEYEAN_000_030: What components, you ask? Aetheric sailcloth for wing, ideal for trapping wind energy. Four sets of highest quality, I need.
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_TAZELMEYEAN_000_040: For crafting, special materials, you need. To obtain them, trade with Black Rabbit trader at Fallgourd Float, you must.
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_TAZELMEYEAN_000_041: To him, fifteen pristine oak branches and five pristine oak logs, you give. Find these near Proud Creek, you can. When materials, you have, use crafting facility at Fallgourd to make components, you can.
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_TAZELMEYEAN_000_050: Squawk! Featherless one help lend shape to Tazel's genius. Bring me four starboard wing components of highest quality, you will.
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_GARDENER1498_000_06: Here to collect the materials on Tazel's behalf? Then I trust you have the wares for the exchange.
<gasp> The flowing grain... The delicate fragrance... These are some of the finest specimens of oak I have ever seen!
As agreed upon, here are the materials that were requested. A pleasure doing business!
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_HILDEYERD_000_070: Hello again, adventurer! Come to avail yourself of our fine facility, I take it? Let's have a look at the materials you've brought.
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_HILDEYERD_000_071: Ooh, yet another curious collection of odds and ends, and a goodly amount besides. So that they don't get in your way while you work, I'll hold on to any excess materials until you need them. The crafting space is ready for your use. You may begin whenever you like.
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_HILDEYERD_000_100: Remember, I'm holding on to the excess materials. If the synthesis doesn't go well and you have need of them, you need but ask me.
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_HILDEYERD_100_100: Finished crafting, have you? Well, don't keep the client waiting─run along and deliver your handiwork! Now, I doubt that you'd be so clumsy as to misplace your precious creations, but on the off chance that you do, know that I still have the excess materials in my keeping.
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_TAZELMEYEAN_000_130: Ah, featherless one returns. Starboard wing components of highest quality, I trust you have?
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_TAZELMEYEAN_000_131: Squawk! Precisely to specifications, they are! Most impressed, I am! With my genius and your deft hands, to infinity and beyond, we will go!
TEXT_BANIXA401_01498_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.

TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_TAZELMEYEAN_000_010: Squawk! Make four components for larboard wing, you must: frameworks for wing, crafted to finest finish. Vital to vessel performance, they are.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_TAZELMEYEAN_000_020: Squawk! Prepare four components for larboard wing, you must: vials of aetheric coating for wing, crafted to finest finish. Vital to vessel performance, they are.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_TAZELMEYEAN_000_030: Squawk! Make four components for larboard wing, you must: bolts of aetheric sailcloth for wing, crafted to finest finish. Vital to vessel performance, they are.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_TAZELMEYEAN_000_040: Perfection exists not─only striving for it, there is. Keep experimenting and improving designs, I shall. For this, many components are needed.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_TAZELMEYEAN_000_041: By connection of Tataramu, secured materials, I have. From independent merchant at Fallgourd Float, collect them you must.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_TAZELMEYEAN_000_042: To merchant, fifteen small granite rocks and five large granite rocks, you give. Find them west of Peacegarden, you can. When materials, you have, use crafting facility at Fallgourd to make components, you can.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_TAZELMEYEAN_000_050: Squawk! Components for larboard wing, I need. Vital to vessel performance, they are.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_MINER_000_060: You must be the adventurer that Master Tataramu mentioned. You've brought the wares for the exchange, I trust?
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_MINER_000_061: Ah, yes, quality chunks of granite, as promised! My thanks, friend. I hope the materials serve you well.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_MINER_000_062: Doubtless you already know this, but you can make use of the crafting facility at the Bobbing Cork. Speak with Hildeyerd, the woman in charge, and she'll take care of you. Now then, if you'll excuse me, I have other business to attend to.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_HILDEYERD_000_070: Hello again, adventurer! Come to avail yourself of our fine facility, I take it? Let's have a look at the materials you've brought.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_HILDEYERD_000_071: Ooh, yet another curious collection of odds and ends, and a goodly amount besides. So that they don't get in your way while you work, I'll hold on to any excess materials until you need them. The crafting space is ready for your use. You may begin whenever you like.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_HILDEYERD_000_100: Remember, I'm holding on to the excess materials. If the synthesis doesn't go well and you have need of them, you need but ask me.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_HILDEYERD_100_100: Finished crafting, have you? Well, don't keep the client waiting─run along and deliver your handiwork! Now, I doubt that you'd be so clumsy as to misplace your precious creations, but on the off chance that you do, know that I still have the excess materials in my keeping.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_TAZELMEYEAN_000_130: Crafted larboard wing components of finest finish, featherless one has? Then show them to Tazel, you must!
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_TAZELMEYEAN_000_131: Squawk! Precisely produced, they are! Featherless one after Tazel's own heart, adventurer is! For perfection, together we strive!
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_SYSTEM_200_200: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANIXA402_01499_SYSTEM_000_900: To complete this quest, you will need to change your class to miner by equipping a pickaxe to your main hand.
TEXT_BANIXA403_01500_TAZELMEYEAN_000_000: Squawk! Conceived new control mechanism for starboard wing, I have. Test my design, I would. To proceed, component of highest quality, I need.
TEXT_BANIXA403_01500_TAZELMEYEAN_000_010: Set of precision cogs, it is. Prepare it for me, you must.
TEXT_BANIXA403_01500_TAZELMEYEAN_000_020: Heavy-duty grease, it is. Prepare it for me, you must.
TEXT_BANIXA403_01500_TAZELMEYEAN_000_030: Set of heavy-duty joint parts, it is. Prepare it for me, you must.
TEXT_BANIXA403_01500_TAZELMEYEAN_000_040: Materials for crafting? Hoarded by Ixal of logging grounds. Inside treasure pots, they are kept. Take from no less than three, you must.
TEXT_BANIXA403_01500_TAZELMEYEAN_000_041: Attempt to stop you, screechy ones will. Knock them around, you can...but if you die, come for your bones, I won't. When materials, you have, use crafting facility at Fallgourd to make component, you can.
TEXT_BANIXA403_01500_TAZELMEYEAN_000_050: Squawk! Conceived new control mechanism for starboard wing, I have. Test my design, I would. To proceed, component of highest quality, I need. Make it, you shall.
