TEXT_BANIXA403_01500_TAZELMEYEAN_000_130: Alive and well, featherless one returns. Crafted component of my desire, you have, yes? Quickly show Tazel, you must!
TEXT_BANIXA403_01500_TAZELMEYEAN_000_131: Squawk! Precisely to specification, it is! Test my design, now I can! My thanks, you have!

TEXT_BANIXA404_01501_TAZELMEYEAN_000_000: Squawk! Unbelievable, it is! Control components for larboard wing, I made, but function as intended, they did not.
TEXT_BANIXA404_01501_TAZELMEYEAN_000_010: Precision cogs used to make wing move, they are. Highest-quality replacements, I need.
TEXT_BANIXA404_01501_TAZELMEYEAN_000_020: Heavy-duty grease used to make wing move, it is. Highest-quality replacements, I need.
TEXT_BANIXA404_01501_TAZELMEYEAN_000_030: Heavy-duty joint parts used to make wing move, they are. Highest-quality replacements, I need.
TEXT_BANIXA404_01501_TAZELMEYEAN_000_040: Alas, easy to obtain, materials are not. Take them from Ixali logging grounds, we must.
TEXT_BANIXA404_01501_TAZELMEYEAN_000_041: Deep inside, near balloon landing, Ehcatl brother hides. Password “Wings Unbending,” to him you say. Help you obtain materials, he will. When materials, you have, use crafting facility at Fallgourd to make components, you must.
TEXT_BANIXA404_01501_TAZELMEYEAN_000_050: In Ixali logging grounds, Ehcatl brother hides. Password “Wings Unbending,” to him you say. Help you obtain materials, he will. When materials, you have, use crafting facility at Fallgourd to make components, you can.
TEXT_BANIXA404_01501_IXALSPY01501_000_06: Business here, you have not! If you value your featherless hide, turn around and walk away, you will!
TEXT_BANIXA404_01501_SYSTEM_100_061: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter the password “Wings Unbending” to get the Ehcatl Nine silencer's cooperation.
TEXT_BANIXA404_01501_IXALSPY01501_000_06: Squawk! Password of Ehcatl Nine, you know? Then as  to me, you are.
Ah, for component materials, you have come? Good fortune, you possess!
Already taken many, you see. Entrust them to you. Use them well, you must!
Done, your business here is. Strangers once more, we must be. Take materials to Fallgourd, you will.

TEXT_BANIXA404_01501_TAZELMEYEAN_000_130: Ah, safely returned, featherless one is. Tell me, materials we need, you have found? Components I asked for, you have made?
TEXT_BANIXA404_01501_TAZELMEYEAN_000_131: Squawk! Perfect to last detail, they are! Function as intended, they should! My thanks, you have!

TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_TAZELMEYEAN_000_000: Squawk! Dreadful, it is! Materials stolen by thieves!
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_TAZELMEYEAN_000_010: To be used in transmission unit, they were─shafts for transferring power to wings. Without them, take to skies, vessel cannot. Remain grounded, dreams of Ehcatl Nine will.
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_TAZELMEYEAN_000_020: To be used in transmission unit, they were─low-friction coating for driveshaft. Without it, smooth transfer of power, impossible is. Remain grounded, dreams of Ehcatl Nine will.
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_TAZELMEYEAN_000_030: To be used in transmission unit, they were─joints for driveshaft. Without them, be mounted onto vessel, driveshaft cannot. Remain grounded, dreams of Ehcatl Nine will.
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_TAZELMEYEAN_000_040: Being borne by caravan, materials were. Ransacked by Qiqirn rats, caravan was. Information on vile vermin, Miah Molkot will have. Find her at Eugenia's Spire, you will.
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_TAZELMEYEAN_000_041: Alas, scourge of Ixal, that feral feline is. Go within hundred paces of her, we dare not. Track down and reclaim materials in our stead, you must. When materials, you have, use crafting facility at Fallgourd to make transmission components, you can.
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_TAZELMEYEAN_000_050: Information on Qiqirn rats, Miah Molkot will have. Track down and reclaim materials in our stead, you must. When materials, you have, use crafting facility at Fallgourd to make transmission components, you must.
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_MIAHMOLKOT_000_060: You seek Miah Molkot, great bane of the birdmen? I am she. How might I serve you, adventurer? Caught sight of little birdies that want for feathering, mayhap?
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_MIAHMOLKOT_000_061: ...The Qiqirn rats that ransacked an Ixali caravan? Reports say they fled north of here after the deed was done. Why do you ask?
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_MIAHMOLKOT_000_062: ...You don't mean to reclaim the stolen wares for the Ixal, do you? But of course not. You asked about the Qiqirn out of curiosity...right? Right!
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_MIAHMOLKOT_000_065: After ransacking the Ixali caravan, the Qiqirn rats fled north of here. I will assume you asked about them out of curiosity, not because you mean to help the sworn enemy of Gridania. Carry on, then.
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_KIKIROON1_000_070: Good loots! Good loots sell good! Sell for many sparklies!
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_KIKIROON1_000_071: Squeeeak!? My loots is mine! Get dirty man-hands off my loots!
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_KIKIROON2_000_070: Loots become sparklies! Sparklies become tasty chicken egg!
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_KIKIROON2_000_071: Squeeeak! Friend of bird!? Kill ambusher! Make ambusher dead!
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_KIKIROON3_000_070: So little loots... Me want more loots...
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_KIKIROON3_000_071: Squeeeak! You come to loot my loots!? Me loot your loots!

Now, I doubt that you'd be so clumsy as to misplace your precious creations, but on the off chance that you do, know that I still have the excess materials in my keeping.
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_TAZELMEYEAN_000_130: Featherless one, I hail. Materials taken by Qiqirn, you have recovered? With them, transmission components of finest finish, you have made?
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_TAZELMEYEAN_000_131: Squawk! Sublime components, missing materials have become! Take to high heavens, dreams of Ehcatl Nine will!
TEXT_BANIXA405_01502_TAZELMEYEAN_000_132: Good and noble heart, featherless one has. Unique among your kind, you are. Much and more to life than bloodletting, there is.

TEXT_BANIXA406_01503_TAZELMEYEAN_000_000: Squawk! Almost complete, my revolutionary heat vent unit is. Four components of highest quality, I need.
TEXT_BANIXA406_01503_TAZELMEYEAN_000_010: Pipes for passing fiery-hot air, they are. Strong and resistant to heat. Craft components at Hyrstmill, you must.
TEXT_BANIXA406_01503_TAZELMEYEAN_000_020: Rubber lining for pipes, it is. Strong and resistant to heat. Craft components at Hyrstmill, you must.
TEXT_BANIXA406_01503_TAZELMEYEAN_000_030: Composite material for casing, it is. Strong and resistant to heat. Craft components at Hyrstmill, you must.
TEXT_BANIXA406_01503_TAZELMEYEAN_000_040: Featherless one Tataramu says, at hamlet is weaponsmith of great skill. Suitable crafting facility and abundant materials, he has.
TEXT_BANIXA406_01503_TAZELMEYEAN_000_041: With his fledgling, name of Drake, you must speak─get permission to use facility and materials. As payment, bring him dullahan plate. Maybe three pieces. Get them from fiends around Proud Creek, you can.
TEXT_BANIXA406_01503_TAZELMEYEAN_000_050: Working on revolutionary heat vent unit, I am. Four components of highest quality, I need. Craft components at Hyrstmill, you must.
TEXT_BANIXA406_01503_DRAKE_000_060:
Greetings, good . Are you here to collect your kettle?
...Begging your pardon? You wish to use our facility? I-I'm afraid I must consult my master...
TEXT_BANIXA406_01503_DRAKE_000_061: You would give us these pieces of plate as payment? Gods know we can't have too much good steel for our kettles. Master Gerolt shall have no cause to complain, I should think.
TEXT_BANIXA406_01503_DRAKE_000_062: Our humble facility is at your disposal, and likewise the supplies you say you need. The steel you brought more than covers the costs.
TEXT_BANIXA406_01503_DRAKE_000_065: If you have need of additional materials, do not hesitate to ask me. The steel you brought is of excellent quality and more than covers the costs.
TEXT_BANIXA406_01503_DRAKE_100_100: You have finished your work, ? I assume that you will be on your way. Should you later find that you still have need of our facility and supplies, know that both are at your disposal.
TEXT_BANIXA406_01503_TAZELMEYEAN_000_130: Welcome here, featherless one is. Four high-quality components for heat vent unit, you have made? Then quickly show Tazel, you must.
TEXT_BANIXA406_01503_TAZELMEYEAN_000_131: Squawk! Nothing to be desired, workmanship leaves! Most impressed, I am! Fly free like wind, soon Ehcatl Nine will!

TEXT_BANIXA201_01504_METHULICATTLAN_000_: You there, no-feathers! Helpful you are, yes? Have you craft high-quality components for gyrodrive of airship, Methuli would.
Know you Hyuran woman, name of Hildeyerd? Chief of crafting facility at Fallgourd Float, she is. For task, make use of her facility, you must.

Have you go there, Methuli would, and craft frame for gyrodrive. Three sets of these, we need. Essential to workings of airship, they are. But one problem, we have: materials for crafting arrived not.

Have you go there, Methuli would, and prepare grease for use in gyrodrive. Three portions of these, we need. Essential to workings of airship, they are. But one problem, we have: materials for crafting arrived not.

Have you go there, Methuli would, and craft wooden patterns for shaping metal plates for gyrodrive. Three sets of these, we need. Essential to building of airship, they are. But one problem, we have: materials for crafting arrived not.
Intercepted by buzzards of logging grounds, shipment was, and taken to Alder Springs. Retrieve materials from storage pot, you must, then use them to make gyrodrive components at Fallgourd Float.
Taken to Alder Springs, materials were. Retrieve materials from storage pot, you must, then use them to make gyrodrive components at Fallgourd Float.

TEXT_BANIXA201_01504_METHULICATTLAN_000_: Ah, no-feathers is returned! Good tidings for Methuli, you have? Better yet...good components for gyrodrive?
Squawk! Outdone yourself, you have! Most excellent parts, these are! One day, from many malms above, laugh at minions of greedy goddess, we will!
Ixal though you are not, far better than obnoxious buzzards of logging grounds, you are. Count you as  of Ehcatl, I do.

TEXT_BANIXA202_01505_METHULICATTLAN_000_: Squawwwk! Pluck Methuli dead! Stolen materials for airship rigging, Qiqirn have!
Essential for connecting air bladder and hull, rigging is. Without it, airship fly without us.

What materials taken? Fibrous metal for making of sturdy cable. Kept in storage pot, it was. After taking pot, flee to Alder Springs, thieving rats did. Go there and retrieve contents, no-feathers must.

What materials taken? Oils for making special grease, used when weaving fibrous metal into cable. Kept in storage pot, they were. After taking pot, flee to Alder Springs, thieving rats did. Go there and retrieve contents, no-feathers must.

What materials taken? Fibrous plants for making special rope, used to bind rigging cables together. Kept in storage pot, they were. After taking pot, flee to Alder Springs, thieving rats did. Go there and retrieve contents, no-feathers must.
With materials, have you make two sets of high-quality rigging components, Methuli would. Go to Fallgourd, you must, and ask permission of Hildeyerd to use crafting facility.
Rigging materials taken by Qiqirn to Alder Springs. Retrieve them from storage pot, you must. With materials, have you make high-quality rigging components at Fallgourd, Methuli would.
TEXT_BANIXA202_01505_KIKIROON01505_000_0: (-Qiqirn Coddler-)We loot loots fair and square! Give back our loots!

TEXT_BANIXA202_01505_METHULICATTLAN_000_: Retrieved materials, you have, and made components, too? Excellent! Quickly, show them to Methuli, you must!
Squawk! Such fine work, Methuli rarely sees! Methuli gives compliments more rarely still, but very skillful with hands, no-feathers is!
Small wonder it is that Chief Totoloc regards you well. With your help, no limit to what Ehcatl Nine can achieve, there is!

TEXT_BANIXA203_01506_METHULICATTLAN_000_: Urgent need of high-quality deck component, we have! No-feathers can craft, Methuli knows!
Quality nails for securing planks and plating, crafted from special metal─stolen metal!
Quality pitch for caulking deck seams, distilled from special materials─stolen materials!
Quality oakum for caulking deck seams, prepared with special materials─stolen materials!

...Actually, stolen not most appropriate word. Shale golem in Alder Springs made angry by death of clay golem took them, Methuli is told. As trophy? Who knows. Fathom workings of golem minds, Methuli does not.
Sure to summon shale golem once more, death of clay golems is. Yet ware him, you must! Dangerous if not weakened, shale golem is.
Doused with dissolving agent, he is nothing to fear. Recover materials, I ask, then take to Fallgourd Float for crafting.
Craft high-quality deck component, you cannot, until materials reclaimed. Slay clay golem, then shale golem, you must.

TEXT_BANIXA203_01506_METHULICATTLAN_000_: Deck component, you have for me?
Done well, no-feathers has! Much impressed, Methuli is, by no-feather's crafting and combat skills!
A well-rounded individual, Methuli also aspires to be! When inscrutable golems will try to steal your materials, no one knows!
TEXT_BANIXA203_01506_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.

TEXT_BANIXA204_01507_METHULICATTLAN_000_: Begone, no-feathers! Driven mad by incompetent carrier, Methuli is! Squawk!
Wait...solution to problem, no-feathers could be! Skilled with hands and swift with legs, no-feathers is!
Craft high-quality component for engine casing, Methuli would ask, but yet to arrive, materials have.
Prepare high-quality rust-resistant agent for engine casing, Methuli would ask, but yet to arrive, materials have.
Craft high-quality leather-bound frame for engine casing, Methuli would ask, but yet to arrive, materials have.
Lost in woods, carrier is─near Spriggan Dig, most like. Many times before this has happened to buzzard. “High as Honor,” to him you must first say. Know you as a friend, only then he will.
Lost near Spriggan Dig, all too often incompetent buzzard becomes. Near there, begin your search. Tell him “High as Honor”─prove yourself friend.
TEXT_BANIXA204_01507_IXALGATHERER01597_1: With you, away! Powerful magicks, I wield! Prepared to defend myself, I am!
TEXT_BANIXA204_01507_SYSTEM_100_061: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter the password “High as Honor” to let the Ehcatl Nine carrier know you are a friend.

Thankless job, carrier is. So much anger and vitriol if ever any delay. Pluck this, buzzard that...

TEXT_BANIXA204_01507_METHULICATTLAN_000_: Worthless buzzard, you found? Then engine casing component, you crafted?

TEXT_BANIXA501_01509_FYRBRYDA_000_062: If that suits you, journey to the Tangle and use moth pupae to catch us two tangle skippers. The gall from their bellies is known to stave off the pox, and a recent outbreak has tapped the hamlet's supply.

TEXT_BANIXA501_01509_FYRBRYDA_000_091: Hm... Not as large as I had hoped, but these skippers will have to suffice. As for your materials...though obviously of questionable origin, I have found naught the guild has deemed forbidden. Proceed, then.

TEXT_BANIXA501_01509_DUZALMEYEAN_000_130: Caw! Think me the fool, do my brethren. Expect perfection from featherless one, you cannot, they say. Make me look the fool, you must not, or make you look the corpse, I shall. Caw!

TEXT_BANIXA501_01509_DUZALMEYEAN_000_132: Friend... Make me look the fool, you did not. Yet a fool would I be, should I not again seek your aid. Hear from me soon, you shall. Until that time, caw!

TEXT_BANIXA505_01513_DUZALMEYEAN_000_130: Caw! Growing anxious, Duzal is, for perfectly crafted components of featherless one. Disappoint me, you will not, yes?
TEXT_BANIXA505_01513_DUZALMEYEAN_000_131: Many similarities with my own work, there are, and within the differences, great possibilities, Duzal sees. A path to perfection, your work will pave.
TEXT_BANIXA505_01513_DUZALMEYEAN_000_132: Through the combination of the Ixal's and featherless ones' techniques, many new innovations, we will discover! Surpass even Dezul Qualan, we yet may! Caw!
TEXT_BANIXA505_01513_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.

TEXT_BANIXA301_01514_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_00: Sqwak sqwak! Featherless one! Sqwak! Our chieftain, speaks highly of you, he does. Sqwak! Trust you, I don't! Yet, trust you, I must! Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA301_01514_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_01: The Dezul Qualan, a cockpit, she needs─a fine cockpit with a fine exterior and strong wind-shielding! Sqwak! Keeps bugs from beaks, it shall! Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA301_01514_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_02: The Dezul Qualan, a cockpit, she needs─a fine cockpit with a fine exterior and bold colors! Sqwak! Let the Nine's enemies know we come, it shall! Sqwak! Let our ancestors know we fly once again, it shall! Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA301_01514_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_03: The Dezul Qualan, a cockpit, she needs─a fine cockpit with a fine exterior and thick lining of cloth and leather. Sqwak! Keep out the biting cold, it shall! Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA301_01514_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_04: Require much care in crafting, do such things. Proper equipment, one must have. Yet proper equipment, have you not. Sqwak! Upon favored Nine, though, does luck smile. Such equipment, close it does lie. At the Observatorium, it does lie, watched over by featherless one such as you. Templeton─a man most corrupt. Sqwak sqwak!

Rotten, he is─like fallen apple! Like flyblown corpse! Feed his greed, you must. Sqwak! Feed with saint carp! Sqwak! A moth-craving saint carp from river of Coerthas. Feed his greed, and facilities, yours, they shall be! But remember, first, his game, you must play. Materials, he must inspect. Approval, he must give. Sqwak sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA301_01514_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_05: Sqwak sqwak! Money, time is! Sqwak! Hurry and feed Templeton's greed, you must. Feed with saint carp! Saint carp from river of Coerthas. Cravers of moths, carp are. Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA301_01514_TEMPLETON_000_070: Sure, one might say 'tis better to be in here by a warm fire than out in the cold chopping wood with the commonfolk, but what good is a fire, I ask, without, say, a freshly caught carp to roast over its coals?
TEXT_BANIXA301_01514_TEMPLETON_000_071: Why, a freshly caught carp to roast over these coals! How very thoughtful of you! The astrologians will be as pleased as punch!
TEXT_BANIXA301_01514_TEMPLETON_000_072: What? You believed these tender morsels for myself? Pah! It pains me to learn you think so little of good Templeton, my . A slice of fat carp on the plates of the right persons, and it won't be long before I'm transferred out of this frozen wasteland to somewhere the sky is blue and the sea bluer.
TEXT_BANIXA301_01514_TEMPLETON_000_073: Very well, then. Feel free to use the facilities as you see fit. Just try not to damage anything. A lot of unnecessary paperwork that would be. Ah, and I suppose you shall be wanting these materials returned, as well. Hm? Did I inspect them thoroughly? I don't know. Did it appear that I did? Good then! <wink> <wink>
TEXT_BANIXA301_01514_TEMPLETON_000_100: If you need aught else, feel free to ask. I'll be right here charring this carp to perfection.
TEXT_BANIXA301_01514_TEMPLETON_100_100: It appears you've completed that contraption of yours. I shall not ask what it is for if you promise to remove it from here at once. It would be simply tragic if one of my supervisors were to walk in and I had to tell them of how you threatened to bludgeon me with a frozen carp─two frozen carp─if I didn't allow you access to our equipment. <wink> <wink>
TEXT_BANIXA301_01514_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_13: Sqwak sqwak! Come, have you, with components sought? Or failed, have you, like featherless neuker you are? Sqwak!
Your work...acceptable, it is. Perhaps more than... Perhaps not. The engineers, pleased they will be. Perhaps... Sqwak...
Bah! Sqwak! Merely one job among many, this was! Sqwak sqwak! Place trust in featherless neuker, I still do not......yet understand why chieftain does...I may...or may not! Sqwak sqwak!

TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_00: Sqwak sqwak! The Dezul Qualan, a cockpit, she needs─a fine cockpit with a fine interior held together with fine rivets! Sqwak! Keep cockpit from falling back to forest, they shall! Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_01: Sqwak sqwak! The Dezul Qualan, a cockpit, she needs─a fine cockpit with a fine stained interior! Sqwak! Keep cockpit from rotting away in humid climes, it shall! Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_02: Sqwak sqwak! The Dezul Qualan, a cockpit, she needs─a fine cockpit with a fine interior and a finer pilot's seat! Sqwak! Covered in fine leather, it should be! Keep pilot's tailfeathers properly cushioned, it shall! Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_04: Materials for components, I have not. Sqwak! Materials for components, flown to Observatorium by a carrier of the Nine, they were. Awaiting you at Locks of Skyfire, he is. Sqwak! But a featherless neuker he will not suffer. Whisper the Nine's sacred words, you must. Whispered once by the very Lady of the Vortex, they were─now fall! Now fall! Now fall! Sqwak!

With materials in hand, components you must craft. Sqwak! Require much care in crafting, do such things. Proper equipment, one must have. Yet proper equipment, have you not. Sqwak! Upon favored Nine, though, does luck smile. Such equipment, close it does lie. At the Observatorium, it does lie, watched over by a featherless neuker such as you. Templeton─a man most corrupt. A man most ruthless. Sqwak sqwak!

Cold, his blood is─like ice! Feed the fire of his greed, you must. Sqwak! Feed with pine lumber! Sqwak! Scraps from Lodge of Timberlord. Scraps from Roiteloin. Feed the fire his of greed, and facilities, yours, they shall be! Sqwak sqwak! But remember, his game, you must play. Materials, he must inspect. Approval, he must give. Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_05: Sqwak sqwak! Money, time is! Sqwak! Hurry and collect materials, you must─from Ehcatl Nine carrier! Forget not words to whisper! Now fall! Now fall! Now fall! Sqwak!
Then, hurry and feed the fire of Templeton's greed, you must! Feed with scraps of pine lumber! Sqwak! Scraps from Lodge of Timberlord. Scraps from Roiteloin. Sqwak sqwak!
Feed the fire his of greed, and facilities, yours they shall be! Sqwak sqwak! But remember, his game, you must play. Materials, he must inspect. Approval, he must give. Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_IXALGATHERER01515_0: Sqwerk!? Speak with neukers, I must not. Wait for sacred words, I shall. Sqwerk!
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_SYSTEM_100_061: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter the password “Now Fall” to let the Ehcatl Nine carrier know you are a friend.
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_IXALGATHERER01515_0: A featherless neuker, the knotcounter sent!? Desperate times, these are, even for mighty Nine! Sqwerk!

Listen now, sqwerk! Goods from homeland, I carry. Over mountains high and chasms deep, have these items come! For you, they have come! Use them well, you will, or your throat, I shall slit and your blood, I shall sip. Sqwerk!
Over mountains high and chasms deep, have those items come! For you, they have come! Use them well, you will, or your throat, I shall slit and your blood, I shall sip. Sqwerk! Sqwerk!
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_ROITELOIN_000_080: Might you have come for the wood scraps? Master Tataramu said someone would be along, but I never expected it would be so soon.
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_ROITELOIN_000_081: The days have become a blur as of late, for the longer I tend to the growing of trees, the less significant mere days, weeks, even moons have become. Prithee tell Master Tataramu that I appreciate his generous donations to the replanting efforts, and that I anticipate his next visit, whenever that may be.
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_ROITELOIN_000_085: Leaving so soon? Might you reconsider? I get so very few visitors here at the Timberlord's Lodge. It is difficult to even remember the last time I spoke with someone other than my good friends the owls.
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_TEMPLETON_000_090: So cold...so cold...so bloody godsdamned COLD! Oh, I apologize for that unsightly outburst. It is just that it is so gods. Damned. Bloody. COLD! Oh, there I go again. Perhaps it is this nasty temper that has condemned me to a life of frozen privies and a shriveled sack.
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_TEMPLETON_000_091: Why, if this isn't a neatly tied bundle of lumber scraps! And just as I was beginning to feel the old sack tighten another notch!
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_TEMPLETON_000_092: The Skyways cannot expect a man to risk life and limb guarding priceless crafting materials with his stones drawn up all the way into his belly, now, can they? Your selfless generosity has ensured the safety of the facilities for another turn of the sun...or at least until the lumber scraps are gone.
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_TEMPLETON_000_093: Very well, then. Feel free to use the facilities as you see fit. Just try not to damage anything. A lot of unnecessary paperwork that would be. Ah, and I suppose you shall be wanting these materials returned, as well. Hm? Did I inspect them thoroughly? I don't know. Did it appear that I did? Good then! <wink> <wink>
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_TEMPLETON_000_100: If you need aught else, feel free to ask. I'll be right here coaxing my stones from their place of hiding.
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_TEMPLETON_100_100: It appears you've completed that contraption of yours. I shall not ask what it is for if you promise to remove it from here at once. It would be simply tragic if one of my supervisors were to walk in and I had to tell them of how you threatened to set the facilities ablaze if I didn't allow you access to our equipment. <wink> <wink>
TEXT_BANIXA302_01515_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_13: Sqwak sqwak! Come, have you, with cockpit components sought? Or failed, have you, as I suspected? Sqwak!
Your work, amazing it i─ Ah... Sqwak! Erk... Ah, amazing...ly acceptable, it is! Yes. Sqwak... Sqwak!

Pains me, it does, to reach for hand of featherless ones. Sqwak! But perhaps this pride...that which held back my kin for so long, it is. Perhaps over is the time to dwell on past. A simple dilemma, it is not. A simple answer, I shall not find. And so place full trust in you, I still cannot. Some trust in you...perhaps... Perhaps not... Sqwak!

TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_00: Sqwak sqwak! The Dezul Qualan, ballast, she needs─fine ballast to see her back to land. Fine ballast to see her back to sea! Fine ballast held fast by fine braces of iron! Sqwak! Keep ballast from falling down and airship falling up, they shall! Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_01: Sqwak sqwak! The Dezul Qualan, ballast, she needs─fine ballast to see her back to land. Fine ballast to see her back to sea! Fine ballast filled with spirits of wine! Sqwak! Keep ballast from turning to ice, it shall! Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_02: Sqwak sqwak! The Dezul Qualan, ballast, she needs─fine ballast to see her back to land. Fine ballast to see her back to sea! Fine ballast held in bladders of cloth and leather! Sqwak! Keep ballast from seeping through hull, they shall! Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_04: Materials for components, I have not. Sqwak! Materials for components, purchased by tiny Tataramu, they were. From a featherless peddler at the Observatorium, they were. Awaiting your arrival, peddling neuker is. Sqwak sqwak!

Once in hand, craft components, you must. Sqwak! Require much care in crafting, do such things. Proper equipment, one must have. Yet proper equipment, have you not. Sqwak! Such equipment, though, close it does lie. At the Observatorium, it does lie, watched over by a featherless one such as you. Templeton─a man most corrupt. Yet a man most bumbling. Sqwak sqwak!

Too exposed, his wrongdoings are! Help hide his trickery, you must. Help cover his featherless arse, you must. Sqwak! Cover with beard of croc! Sqwak! Beard of Skyfire croc. With shearing knife, yours it shall be! Sqwak! Cover his arse, and facilities, yours, they shall be! Fail, and gone, they shall be. Sqwak sqwak! Materials, he must inspect. Approval, he must give. Appearances, we must keep. Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_05: Materials for components, I have not. Sqwak! Materials for components, purchased by tiny Tataramu, they were. From a featherless peddler at the Observatorium, they were. Awaiting your arrival, peddling neuker is. Sqwak sqwak!

Bribe for bumbling neuker, I have not. Knife for shearing croc beards, I have. Shear a croc beard, you must. Bring to neuker, you must. Cover his arse, and facilities, yours they shall be! Fail, and gone, they shall be. Sqwak sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_DUVICAUROIX_000_060: Here to toss the snow with a winter-drunk sutler? Sorry, , but I haven't the time for fun today. I'm waiting on a swivin' little rotter who was supposed to be here hells' bells ago to take on a package of questionable questionables.
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_DUVICAUROIX_000_061: Oh, you're the swivin' little rotter. Well, then, pardon the lack of a proper greeting, but I'm not holding on to this pile of bird shite any longer. Take it away quick afore I call the knights over and have you arrested for possession of unholy idols. And tell that Tataramu he can shove any future deliveries straight up his windward passage.
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_DUVICAUROIX_000_065: I am not one to deny a man my services for such reasons as race or creed...but an Ixal is no man, so I have no qualms with turning my red nose to those filthy flying rats, even if doing so'll see my pathetic purse lighter than it already is.
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_TEMPLETON_000_090: Do you ever wonder why I'm always standing? It's because everything in this frozen hell is colder than a heretic's heart, that's why! Anywhere I sit, I'm likely to freeze my royal arse right off, and I've grown quite attached to Her Rosy Highness as of late.
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_TEMPLETON_000_091: Why, how convenient! A feral croc beard! Did you know these whiskers can be woven into a cloth that will protect the buttocks from cold? I suppose it could protect other parts of one's person from cold, as well, but an arse can be especially susceptible to wintry climes.
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_TEMPLETON_000_092: Very well, then. You are free to use the facilities here as you see fit. Just try not to damage anything. A lot of unnecessary paperwork that would be. Ah, and I suppose you shall be wanting these materials returned, as well. Hm? Did I inspect them thoroughly? I don't know. Did it appear that I did? Good then! <wink> <wink>
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_TEMPLETON_000_100: If you need aught else, feel free to ask. I'll be right here readying Her Royal Rumpness to conquer every single icy stone from here to Snowcloak.
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_TEMPLETON_100_100: It appears you've completed that contraption of yours. I shall not ask what it is for if you promise to remove it from here at once. It would be simply tragic if one of my supervisors were to walk in and I had to tell them of how you threatened to smother me with a musky croc beard if I didn't allow you access to our equipment. <wink> <wink>
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_13: Sqwak sqwak! Waited overlong, I have. Ballast component or disappointment, do you bring? Sqwak!

The component! Sqwak! And of a quality, it is! Cease to amaze, you do not, featherless one. Therefore, cease to request aid, we shall not. Sqwa qwa qwa qwa! An Ixali joke, that was. Free to laugh, you are. Go on. Go on! Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA303_01516_SYSTEM_200_200: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANIXA304_01517_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_00: Sqwak sqwak! Featherless one! Your hands, they are soft. Why you must rely on clumsy weapons, herein lies reason. Ixali claws, superior in battle, do they make us. Yet same claws, in crafting, inferior do they render us.
TEXT_BANIXA304_01517_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_01: Sqwak sqwak! The Dezul Qualan, an instrument panel, she needs─a fine panel with fine counters and needles! Sqwak! Keep readings accurate, they shall! Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA304_01517_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_02: Sqwak sqwak! The Dezul Qualan, an instrument panel, she needs─a fine panel treated with fine oils! Sqwak! Keep cogs whirring, they shall! Keep gears grinding, they shall! Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA304_01517_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_03: Sqwak sqwak! The Dezul Qualan, an instrument panel, she needs─a fine panel with fine levers and knobs! Sqwak! Keep pilot in control, they shall! Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA304_01517_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_04: Require much care in crafting, do such things. Proper equipment, one must have. Yet proper equipment, have you not. Sqwak! In the hands of the wicked, it does lie. At the Observatorium, it does lie, watched over by featherless one such as you. Templeton─a man most malfeasant. Sqwak sqwak!

Lusty for coin, he is. Lusty like Ul'dahn! Lusty like beggar! Scratch his lusty itch, you must. Sqwak! Scratch with biast claw! Sqwak! Biast claw from monsters in the west. Scratch his lusty itch, and facilities, yours, they shall be! But remember, first, his game, you must play. Materials, he must inspect. Approval, he must give. Sqwak sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA304_01517_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_05: Sqwak sqwak! Money, time is, sqwak!
Scratch Templeton's lusty itch, you must. Sqwak! Scratch with biast claw! Sqwak! Biast claw from monsters in the west. Scratch his lusty itch, and facilities, yours, they shall be!
TEXT_BANIXA304_01517_TEMPLETON_000_070: Oh, whatever will I do? Without that biast claw, whatever will I do!?
TEXT_BANIXA304_01517_TEMPLETON_000_071: Why, if it isn't a biast claw! How apropos! Me minus that appendage would have left me stuck in a pickle without a paddle...or something like that.
TEXT_BANIXA304_01517_TEMPLETON_000_072: You see, I promised a certain sutler I'd sell him one...before recalling I had little talent at, well, slaying things and such. And hence my dilemma─without that claw, not only would I appear the fool in the eyes of that swiving sutler, but I'd also be forced to use my own coin to purchase that cask of red I'm having delivered later this evening. But lo, my dilemma is solved!
TEXT_BANIXA304_01517_TEMPLETON_000_073: Very well, then. You are free to use the facilities here as you see fit. Just try not to damage anything. A lot of unnecessary paperwork that would be. Ah, and I suppose you shall be wanting these materials returned, as well. Hm? Did I inspect them thoroughly? I don't know. Did it appear that I did? Good then! <wink> <wink>
TEXT_BANIXA304_01517_TEMPLETON_000_100: If you need aught else, feel free to ask. I'll be right here buffing the biast...claw.
TEXT_BANIXA304_01517_TEMPLETON_100_100: It appears you've completed that contraption of yours. I shall not ask what it is for if you promise to remove it from here at once. It would be simply tragic if one of my supervisors were to walk in and I had to tell them of how you threatened to pierce mine optics with this deadly claw if I didn't allow you access to our equipment. <wink> <wink>
TEXT_BANIXA304_01517_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_13: Sqwak sqwak! For components I wait. For excuses, I do not! Money, time is! Sqwak!

Sqwak! Yet another sound piece, you bring... Yet confounded, I remain. Mistrust the featherless ones, we did. For so long, we did. In our hearts, much hate, do we still harbor. Despite recent relations, do we still harbor. Sqwak...

Yet, still, your hand, you lend. Your judgment, you refuse. Sqwak! To recognize this quality within you, wise was the chieftain. Sqwak! Why, it is that chieftain, he is, and but counter of knots, I remain.
