TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_00: Sqwak sqwak! Duzal Meyean the Steady! Duzal Meyean the Steady! Comes, he does. Soon, he does! Looking for imperfections, he is. Looking for blood, he is. My blood, he is! If my blood, he has, your blood, I claim!
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_01: Sqwak sqwak! Now, the Dezul Qualan, an aerodynamo, she needs─a fine dynamo with fine shielding! Sqwak! Keep the internal gyroscope from cold and rust, they shall! Keep flyers from falling, they shall! Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_02: Sqwak sqwak! Now, the Dezul Qualan, an aerodynamo, she needs─a fine dynamo with fine lubricant! Sqwak! Keep the internal gyroscope gyrating, they shall! Keep flyers from falling, they shall! Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_03: Sqwak sqwak! Now, the Dezul Qualan, an aerodynamo, she needs─a fine dynamo with fine dampeners! Sqwak! Keep the internal gyroscope from vibrating, they shall! Keep flyers from falling, they shall! Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_04: Require extreme care in crafting, do such things. The Steady is watching, he is! Proper equipment, one must have. Yet proper equipment, have you not. Sqwak! In the hands of the slothful, it does rest. At the Observatorium, it does rest, watched over by featherless one such as you. Templeton─a man most corrupt. A man most indolent. Sqwak sqwak!

Idle, he lies. Like a swine in the sty, he lies! Like a corse in a crypt, he lies! Tempt this shiftless sluggard, you must. Sqwak! Tempt him with the promise of eternal indolence. Tempt him with your willingness to work, and facilities, yours, they shall be! But remember, first, his game, you must play. Materials, he must inspect. Approval, he must give. Sqwak sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_05: Sqwak! Money, time is! Sqwak! Tempt Templeton, you must. Sqwak! Tempt him with the promise of eternal indolence. Tempt him with your willingness to work, and facilities, yours, they shall be! Sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_TEMPLETON_000_070: Another shifty-eyed adventurer here to take advantage of poor Templeton, are we? Well, I'll have you know, I am a veritable rock! Unmoved by the ungentlemanly jostlings of the world's ne'er-do-wells! Unbroken by the pounding pleas of hollow-hearted heels!
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_TEMPLETON_000_071: Unless, there is something in it for me, of course. A rolling stone gathers no moss, but why would I want moss when I could have things?
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_TEMPLETON_000_072: And one thing I could use right now is a pair of healthy adventurer legs to carry this important timetable up an ungodly amount of stairs. Though, I suppose a pair would be two things... Pah! Semantics!
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_TEMPLETON_000_073: Present the document to Jocea at the apex of the astroscope tower and return with her signature so that I may know that you did not simply run over to the pub and kill a bell or three. What? Where's the trust? I did not get to where I am today by placing my faith in every vagrant and vagabond that came a-rap-tap-tapping at my door.
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_TEMPLETON_000_80: I would take the timetable to Jocea myself but...those stairs─there's just so many of them. Now if she worked in the cellar...
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_JOCEA_000_090: An unknown face. Or perhaps simply a face forgotten. Far too many people pass through the tower to remember all of them. Have you business with me?
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_JOCEA_000_091: Ah, the timetable I requested. I was beginning to wonder when that do-nothing dullard from the Skyways would bring it to me. And why does it not surprise me that he found someone to see to the task for him?
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_JOCEA_000_092: You say he wants my signature as proof of your delivery? Absolutely not! Who knows what he will use it for! ............Not leaving, are you? Very well, then. I shall sign...but with my off hand. And only my initials! Now off with you!
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_JOCEA_100_093: If he is dissatisfied with the signature, tell him...tell him...I cut my hand on the parchment and could barely hold the quill and─ Why must I, too, be caught in this pathetic web of deceit!? Off with you and don't come back!
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_TEMPLETON_000_090: You didn't actually walk up all those stairs, did you?
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_TEMPLETON_000_091: You did, didn't you! And here I was all ready to let you use the facilities anyway! Go on then. Get at it. Just try not to damage anything. A lot of unnecessary paperwork that would be. Ah, and I suppose you shall be wanting these materials returned, as well. Hm? Did I inspect them thoroughly? I don't know. Did it appear that I did? Good then! <wink> <wink>
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_TEMPLETON_000_100: If you need aught else, feel free to ask. I'll be right here practicing my hand at these initials...
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_TEMPLETON_100_100: It appears you've completed that contraption of yours. I shall not ask what it is for if you promise to remove it from here at once. It would be simply tragic if one of my supervisors were to walk in and I had to tell them of how you threatened to...er...cut my finger on this parchment and slowly bleed me to death if I didn't allow you access to our equipment. <wink> <wink>
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_ROZOLCATTLAN_000_13: Sqwak! The aerodynamo component, you have completed! Inspect first, I must. My neck─our necks─in danger, they are. Sqwak!

...



......



............Passable, your work is. Pleased, Duzal will be. Saved, our necks are. Headed, you may remain...for now, sqwak!
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA305_01518_SYSTEM_200_200: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_DUZALMEYEAN_000_000: Caw! Reliable hands, I seek. Feathered, featherless, I care not. My brethren, I love, but all talons, they are. Grace, they have not. Perfection, they cannot achieve.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_DUZALMEYEAN_000_010: Tasked with crafting of Dezul Qualan's steering mechanism, we were. But perfect, mechanism is not. Stiff, the control levers are, like withering autumn treant past its prime.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_DUZALMEYEAN_000_020: Tasked with crafting of Dezul Qualan's steering mechanism, we were. But perfect, mechanism is not. Horrible sounds, it makes, like wild hoglets in mating season. Problem lies in lubricating oil, I suspect.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_DUZALMEYEAN_000_030: Tasked with crafting of Dezul Qualan's steering mechanism, we were. But perfect, mechanism is not. Stuck, the control levers become, like bones in craw after hearty feasting.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_DUZALMEYEAN_000_040: Materials, we have secured, but facilities, we have not. Seek Fyrbryda in Revenant's Toll, you must. Though spurned, an Ixal is, welcome to use gifts of art and knowledge, featherless ones are.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_DUZALMEYEAN_000_050: To the Diamond Forge, you must go. To Fyrbryda, you must speak. The gifts of art, she tends. Guide you to perfection, she shall. Caw caw!
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_FYRBRYDA_000_060: There is work to be done, so I will not waste time mincing words. My rules here are simple. Follow them, and you are free to use the facilities for as long as you need.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_FYRBRYDA_000_061: Rule one─aught that passes through those doors must be inspected. I will have no contraband within my walls. Period. Rule two─you make a contribution of my choice to the Revenant's Toll chapter of the Adventurers' Guild. No questions asked. No exceptions.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_FYRBRYDA_000_062: If that suits you, journey to Camp Revenant's Toll─or what's left of it─and force the group of Coerthans who've pitched camp in the ruins to leave. Normally, we wouldn't mind, but they're said to be belligerent, threatening anyone passing through the area.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_FYRBRYDA_000_063: If it doesn't, you can leave, and allow countless innocent men and women to suffer at their hands.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_FYRBRYDA_000_070: Journey to Camp Revenant's Toll and see that the Coerthans return to whence they came. Do this, and the facilities are yours to use as you see fit.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_POP_MESSAGE: The Coerthan draws his weapon and attacks!
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_BNPC01519_000_100: Another damned adventurer!? I've had enough of your meddling!
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_BNPC01519_000_110: Piss off, adventurer! We're not leaving until we have what we came for!
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_BNPC01519_000_120: Leave? Hah! I'm not leaving...and neither are you!
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_BNPC01519_000_130: Why should I leave because you say so? What about what I want─like you dead at my feet!?
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_BNPC01519_000_140: Heh, what's another body for the crows? We've come too far to turn back now!
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_FYRBRYDA_000_090: I have no doubt your powers of persuasion were enough to resolve the situation. Now then, show me your materials.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_FYRBRYDA_000_096: As for your materials...though obviously of questionable origin, I have found naught the guild has deemed forbidden. Proceed, then.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_FYRBRYDA_000_110: If you require more time or materials, do not hesitate to ask, for today I am in your debt. I did not mention it before, but my nephew was one of many assaulted by the Coerthans. He will rest easy now knowing those terrible men have been slain, as will I.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_FYRBRYDA_100_100: I suppose this is farewell. If aught should happen to your work while on the road, do not hesitate to return here for additional materials, for this day I am in your debt. You see, the story of my nephew...it was a lie. In truth, it was I who suffered at the hands of those men. I prayed for retribution, and through you I finally claimed it.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_DUZALMEYEAN_000_130: Show me the components, you must! Perfection of featherless one's crafting, I would see. Caw!
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_DUZALMEYEAN_000_131: Disappoint, your work does not. Obvious now, the problem is, when looking at featherless one's crafting.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_DUZALMEYEAN_000_132: Overconfident, I was. Overlook flaws in design, I did. But closer to the skies, we are, thanks to your creations. Caw caw!
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA506_01519_SYSTEM_200_200: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_JEZULAHUATAN_000_01: Squawk! A friend in need, you are interested in being? Component for escape flyers, you will make! Good quality? Best quality! All that hold together the harness, those bits of metal are going to be. Skimp on strength, you will not─or squawkka-wak! An unscheduled jump, you will take!
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_JEZULAHUATAN_000_02: Squawk! A quick gil, you want to earn? Bring some quality emulsion, you can! The silk of the escape flyers, we will dab and soak! Good quality, we must have─or squawkka-wak! Dab and soak featherless one with an emulsion most foul, we will!
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_JEZULAHUATAN_000_03: Squawk! Feathered gratitude, you dream of having? Quality silk, the featherless weave, I know. Bring some tight-woven, you can! Bear, this silk must, the loft of air. If rip-rip-rip it does, then squawkka-wak! Rip-rip-rip a new cloaca for you, we will!
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_JEZULAHUATAN_000_04: A sutler, there is, up Camp Dragonhead way. Materials, she has. Told us of her, that runt, he did─know the one, you do, sqqquawk! Stubborn, the sutler you will find!

A trade, she seeks. Three snow smelt, you will fish for her from the Dragonhead latrines. Moth pupae, the smelt will like. Repulsive, the waters are, squawkka-wak! Strange featherless ones. Why not eat the pupae instead, I wonder.
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_JEZULAHUATAN_000_05: Squawk! Your goal, you do not forget! Craft quality escape flyer component, you will. To Camp Dragonhead, you go, then sqqquawk! Bring here the component, you must.
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_FISHER01520_000_070: What can I do for you? Oh, you're one of Tataramu's friends, are you? Bless His Tininess, he does get around. He told you I wanted some fish for trade, I take it?
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_FISHER01520_000_071: Hmmm, very nice. Fat and sweet-fleshed indeed. Don't look so queasy─'twas some wily fishers that took to calling it our “latrines.” The best fishing hole in these parts now, thanks to most folk keeping away.
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_FISHER01520_000_072: Time for me to hold up my end of the bargain─your materials. You can make free use of the crafting facility at Camp Dragonhead. Just have a word with Norbettaux.
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_FISHER01520_000_080: Talk to Norbettaux. He'll let you use the crafting facility at Camp Dragonhead.
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_NORBETTAUX_000_090: Ah, the one that Master Tataramu vouched for. Welcome to our humble facility! I see that you are not without your aches and sorrows─but there is no ill that crafting cannot cure!
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_NORBETTAUX_000_091: I understand that it is no ordinary item you wish to craft. To tell the truth, I tire of crafters whose ambit of skill can be measured between the thumb and forefinger. You may count on my assistance!
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_NORBETTAUX_000_092: Put this away and pull that forward and...all is in readiness! Here are the materials you need─the excess I will retain for safekeeping. The facility is at your disposal, my good crafter!
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_NORBETTAUX_000_100: If you should lack for material or wish to use the facility again, simply come and find me. Any friend of Master Tataramu is a friend of mine!
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_NORBETTAUX_100_100: I see you're done with the crafting. Ready for delivery, I presume? Not that such a misfortune is common or likely, but if you should mislay the fruits of your labor, this crafting facility─and your excess materials─will always be available for you.
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_JEZULAHUATAN_000_13: Sqqquawk! The components, have you? Escape, we will have? Or squawkka-wak, all plunge to earth?
Squawk! Best quality! A wise choice, Chief Totoloc did make. If fail, an escape flyer does, then squee-squee, on your account, it is not. Excellent craftsmanship, you have!
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_SYSTEM_200_200: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANIXA601_01520_SYSTEM_000_900: To complete this quest, you will need to change your class to fisher by equipping a fishing rod.
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_JEZULAHUATAN_000_01: Squawk! Quality spare tank components, you can make? Solid metal and durable, they must be. No holding of cider, this is for, but─sqqquawk─spare ceruleum.
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_JEZULAHUATAN_000_02: Squawk! Time to prepare components, you have? Gasket sealant, required for the spare ceruleum tanks, for us you can make. No pressing reason, we have─but a gasket in claw, better than two on order is!
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_JEZULAHUATAN_000_03: Squawk! A helping claw, you will extend? Short of sturdy barrels for ceruleum, we are. Arrived, they did, from a cut-rate cooper and...squawkka-wak! Get, you do, what you pay for!
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_JEZULAHUATAN_000_04: An understanding, we have, with a sutler at Camp Dragonhead. The materials, provide them, he can. Trade for them─only trade, he will. Like him, I do, for one so featherless. Somber as a raven, he is. Trust for gil, he has not.

Hiss at me, he did; fierce as goose, he was. “Gil is naught but a construct,” said he. Full of quarrel, you featherless ones are. Fifteen ruby spruce branches and five logs of the same, this sutler wants. Gather them with ease, you can, up Camp Dragonhead way.
Point to the crafting facility and no more, he will. Squee-squee, dance to tune played by the small and sly one, the sullen sutler will not!
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_JEZULAHUATAN_000_05: Sqqquawk! Those tank components sooner rather than later, I do want. Expect your delivery, I do. Bite my claws, I shall.
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_PLANTMERCHANT01520_: Brrr... Even the weather's conspiring to put me out of business. That's right, just freeze your arse off till you've nothing to even sit on. That's the way of it with gods an' heroes. Leave a working man without an arse to call his own.
One of Tataramu's pals? Hmph. Here's your material, over there's where you'll find Norbettaux. The crafting facility's his business, so don't bother me about it.
What's the matter, the cold take your wits? Off with you─the crafting facility's not my watch.
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_NORBETTAUX_000_090: Ah, the one that Master Tataramu spoke of. Welcome to our humble facility! I see that you've spent some time in the woods today─but the real work begins now!
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_NORBETTAUX_000_091: Ah, this is your material? Let me weigh out what you need...ample, ample. A dyspeptic he may be, but that sutler is scrupulous down to the last onze. Now then, the facility is at your disposal, my canny crafter!
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_NORBETTAUX_000_100: I shall store the excess material for your benefit. You need but come and find me if you run short, or wish to use the facility again.
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_NORBETTAUX_100_100: Done with the crafting and ready to deliver, if I'm not mistaken. I need hardly remind you of such a trivial fact, but this crafting facility─and your excess materials─will always be available should you feel an unaccountable need to redo this task. Any friend of Master Tataramu is a friend of mine!
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_JEZULAHUATAN_000_13: Squawk, my components, you have? Build the spare tanks this turn, we can?

Squee-squee, fast delivery, this is─and great work, it is! Praise you as claw that grips, Chief Totoloc would. No harrying, you need. No cheating, you do. Squawk! Fortunate, I am, to have your service.
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_SYSTEM_200_200: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANIXA602_01521_SYSTEM_000_900: To complete this quest, you will need to change your class to botanist by equipping a hatchet to your main hand.
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_JEZULAHUATAN_000_00: No regard, we Ixal give. Earn all respect, you must, squawk! Try to cheat this, many featherless ones do. Won some regard, you have. But mistake it for more than it is, you do? Squee-squee, iron, not steel, it is.
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_JEZULAHUATAN_000_01: Forge the regard and make it steel, you must. Two good refabrication components, we need. Go up and up, our airships must. With metal light as feathers, climb, we will...and squawkka-wak, rise with us, you will.
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_JEZULAHUATAN_000_02: Built up, it must be, for regard to become respect. Think this, I do, working much in resin. Armored in coat upon coat, our airships are. More of this refined resin, we require. Squawk! Count on you, I might?
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_JEZULAHUATAN_000_03: Fly easier, an Ixal does, when favorably known, he is. Same with featherless one, it is? Squawk! Reinforced plywood, you will craft? Lightweight, it must be, and first-rate quality. Gain a few more malms of altitude, we must─all of us, squawkka-wak!
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_JEZULAHUATAN_000_04: Word, I have sent, to a sprightly sutler up Camp Dragonhead way. Trade you all the material, he will. Squee-squee, trust his opinion of other featherless, I do not. A serious bone in his body, there is not.

Lost his best prospector, did this sutler. Happy to supply the materials, he is, in exchange for fifteen regular and five high-quality chunks of furite. Keen-keen-keen eyes for minerals, this sutler has! Play not the charlatan with him or─squawkka-wak! Find furite, you will, around Camp Dragonhead.
A friend of Ehcatl, the sutler is. Present, you must, the furite and your respects. Find at Camp Dragonhead, you will, the sutler and facilities for crafting both.
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_JEZULAHUATAN_000_05: Sqqquawk! A pair of refabrication components, you will bring? Else to rust, turn, that iron regard will.
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_MINERALMERCHANT0152: Is that snow? How lucky I am to have fur-lined boots and a kettle of soup on the hob. And even a bit o' ham! Just call me the king of winter!

Good day to you, ! Here for those crafting materials? Here we go! Ah, look at that, had me some barley under there. That's going in the soup. I do love barley in my soup. You're welcome to a bowl, should you grow weary! Tell Norbettaux that goes for him, too!
Just half a handful of barley, it thickens up so! And a chunk of ham, have to live a little...
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_NORBETTAUX_000_090: Ah, yes, Master Tataramu's referral! Welcome to our humble crafting facility! I assure you, the fires of crafting burn hotter than any snowstorm can counter!
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_NORBETTAUX_000_091: Sprightly as ever, our friend is. His soup is legendary─and his blueberry slumps almost infamous! Let me just tidy up the facilities...
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_NORBETTAUX_000_092: There now, everything is ready for your use. Here are your materials─I'll hold the excess for safekeeping─and there's that!
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_NORBETTAUX_000_100: If you run out of material, simply come and fetch me! I shall be about.
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_NORBETTAUX_100_100: When the crafting's done, delivery must follow! Should anything go missing in the blizzard, take heart─simply return to this crafting facility and start again. Any friend of Master Tataramu is a friend of mine!
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_JEZULAHUATAN_000_13: Squee-squee... Not long, did that take. Refabrication components, I spy, if mistaken, I am not?
Squawk! No argument from me, you will have. Components, good! But what I said, forget it not. Win the regard, wait for the respect. Forged over many turns, it must be─else, false it is. Sqqquawk!
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_SYSTEM_200_200: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANIXA603_01522_SYSTEM_000_900: To complete this quest, you will need to change your class to miner by equipping a pickaxe to your main hand.
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_JEZULAHUATAN_000_00: One thing after another, always it is! So hard to find good products, why must it be? An urgent need of three replacement isolator components, I have. Squawkka-wak! Trust that favor-monger, I do not! But owe him this time, I must. Three more chits of mine, he will have, squawk!
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_JEZULAHUATAN_000_01: Another way, there is not. Shake itself to pieces, the ceruleum propulsion engine will, without a frame made from quality parts. Go squawkka-wak, the Dezul Qualan would, before the ground, it left!
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_JEZULAHUATAN_000_02: Separate life and death, rubber dampers do. No dampers for the Dezul Qualan's engine, squawk? Burst every blood vessel in your feet, the vibrations would.
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_JEZULAHUATAN_000_03: Once, a ceruleum engine off its mount, I saw. Terrible sight, it was─rip-rip-rip through everything, it went. Held in place, the engine must be. The most important component, the mount is. Sqqquawk! Most important!
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_JEZULAHUATAN_000_04: No material, there is. Material scare-city, the featherless claim, squawk! Nothing by any other name, nothing, it is! Of quality material, these isolator components must be made. Or squawkka-wak, the result is, and much crumpling, there will be.
No choice, I had. A humble request to Tataramu, I made. The materials for three components, he has found, in spite of the great...scare-city. With you, he will speak.
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_JEZULAHUATAN_000_05: Say it thrice, I must? Urgent need of those isolator components, we have. Sqqquawk, the crafting skills, you already have. Found the material, that imp Tataramu has.
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_TATARAMU_000_060: I'm sure Jezul has filled you in on my special...access? It took some doing, but I've located the material for your isolator components.
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_TATARAMU_000_061: That is, of course, the good news. The bad news is that the location in question is Coerthas. I do hope you enjoy traveling. The mountains are quite beautiful this time of the year.
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_TATARAMU_000_062: You have an appointment with a trader at the Gates of Judgement. No names, as he abhors the unnecessary exchange of information. Here is a sack of gil to pay him. Very exacting people, Ishgardians. Did you know they will drag a man to gaol over a single missing gil?
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_TATARAMU_000_063: But your sole concern is to secure the materials and craft those isolator components, I am sure. The crafting facility at Camp Dragonhead─do say hello to Norbettaux from me─is a much more pleasant destination than an Ishgardian scaffold, you'd agree.
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_TATARAMU_000_065: Your material awaits in Coerthas, at the Gates of Judgement. What is it the poets say? “The holdfast in the highlands, the corridor of Coerthas; have you felt the silence where all joy has fled, yet something rills and laughs at dusk?”
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_ISHMERCHANT01523_00: Tataramu's ? You made me wait longer than I'd like. The gil first, or I'll name our little friend a liar and you a dead .
This is good. Take your material and have the joy of it─and should there be questions later, it comes not to me, understand? Ishgard has no liking for trade with outlanders...
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_ISHMERCHANT01523_10: Even a trade with the great and wealthy Highwind Skyways. Not officially─but in the shadow of the Gates of Judgement, no man may judge another, for here, a man judges himself.
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_ISHMERCHANT01523_00: How do you judge yourself, Highwind's ? For now, I will take my gil, you will take your material, and back we shall go to where our betters want us. But I think that you are one I would consent to meet again.
Take your material and go. We may meet again one day, but today, there are other duties each of us must attend to.
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_NORBETTAUX_000_090: I've had word of your coming from Master Tataramu─welcome to our humble crafting facility! Had a long journey? No rest for the crafty, I take it.
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_NORBETTAUX_000_091: Remarkable that you were able to secure materials in the midst of this shortage─but I wouldn't dream of prying into your affairs. I am only too happy that I can be of assistance...
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_NORBETTAUX_000_092: The facility is fit for use─it does take a while to warm up. Here are your materials─not a single defect, of course. I'll hold the excess for safekeeping. Do let me know if you need anything else. We are as friends, you and I!
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_NORBETTAUX_000_100: If you should run short of materials or are in need of more time with the facilities, come and see me. I am always here, it seems.
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_NORBETTAUX_100_100: All done with the crafting? Oh, that looks marvelous! I am sure your client─whoever he or she is─will be delighted! And of course, this crafting facility is ever ready to assist again should there be any problems with the components.
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_JEZULAHUATAN_000_13: A welcome sight, you are─squawk! Survive, you did, your brush with the Ishgardians? Brought me the components, you have?

Squee-squee... Well sourced, well made! Footprints in blood, I shall not see. Not on ceilings and not on floors... Trust the imp wholly, I do not. When say that, I do, trust me well. Trust you, though, I do. Good crafter you are, promises you keep. Squawkka-wak!
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA604_01523_SYSTEM_200_200: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANIXA605_01566_JEZULAHUATAN_000_00: Good, your crafting hands are? Squee-squee... Sluggish are our ships, more than I like...and more than is liked by Chief Totoloc. Need top-top-top hyperconductor components, we do.
TEXT_BANIXA605_01566_JEZULAHUATAN_000_01: Not complicated, you would think. Just improve aetheric conduction in metal plates, say some. Know─squawk!─they do. Tricky-tricky is wind-aspected aether. Special material, this process requires.
TEXT_BANIXA605_01566_JEZULAHUATAN_000_02: Increase conduction for wind-aspected aether, a certain type of emulsion will. Hardly believe the ingredients needed, you would. Squee-squee...
TEXT_BANIXA605_01566_JEZULAHUATAN_000_03: Tricky matter, it is...squee-squee. Using hyperconducting matter in components, an elegant solution it is. But sqqquawk! Easy feat to obtain such things, it is not.
TEXT_BANIXA605_01566_JEZULAHUATAN_000_04: A slug of semi-stable ectoplasm from St. Daniffen's fire, you will need. This creature, you know? Dwell in the Ogre's Belly, they do. Lie to you, I will not. Squawkka-wak! Before the end, killings, there will be.

At your fighting weight, you are? Difficult, it is, with featherless ones. Thewy, you must be. Swarm, the Ogre's Belly does, with will-o'-the-wykes. Slay one, you must, then squawkka-wak! Come charging, St. Daniffen's fire will. Kill quick-quick-quick, then wring out the ectoplasm, you must.
Is common, the rest of the material. Supply your needs for two components, the crafting facilities at Camp Dragonhead will. Be sure of that, you can. Squawk! Reliable, Norbettaux is.
TEXT_BANIXA605_01566_JEZULAHUATAN_000_05: Craft those hyperconductor components, you will? Settled, the stomach is? Sqqquawk! The material you need, take from a St. Daniffen's fire, you can. In the Ogre's Belly, the creature dwells. Is a bit nasty, the milking, squawkka-wak...but no other good choices, there are.
TEXT_BANIXA605_01566_POP_MESSAGE: You see the baleful glow of St. Daniffen's fire!
TEXT_BANIXA605_01566_NORBETTAUX_000_090: Welcome to our humble crafting facility! You're a touch pale─a rigorous bout of gathering, I take it? Crafting will put the roses back in those cheeks in no time!
TEXT_BANIXA605_01566_NORBETTAUX_000_091: Hm, a curious sort of material you've brought... Best not to know more, I think. The crafting facility has a goodly stock of many materials. Help yourself to whatever you need.
TEXT_BANIXA605_01566_NORBETTAUX_000_100: Do come calling if you need more material, or need to spend more time using the facilities.
TEXT_BANIXA605_01566_NORBETTAUX_100_100: How marvelous, you've finished! I must say, that was one of the odder materials I've seen in a while, but now you have some fine-looking components to deliver. Do feel free to return if the components do not pass the client's muster─your visits are always a welcome diversion!
TEXT_BANIXA605_01566_JEZULAHUATAN_000_13: Not bad, you look. Bad dreams, you will have? Sqqquawk, happy I am to see you alive. Lost are many, for a squirt of ectoplasm...but complete, the components are?
General conduction...good, it is. Wind-aspected conduction...good, it is! Squawkka-wak! Not the limit, the sky is! Fly better-better-better, the ships will. Top-top-top, these components are!

Fight, you can, and craft, you can, but more important─work, you can! For the Second of Ehcatl, the same is required. Sqqquawk! But only about the skills, it is not. The will to use them, it is─use high and low, day in and day out...squawkka-wak!
TEXT_BANIXA605_01566_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA605_01566_SYSTEM_200_200: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANIXA606_01567_JEZULAHUATAN_000_00: For the best, we hope, yet for the worst, we must prepare. Buzzard who forsakes prudence for speed, woe betide him! Sqqquawk!
TEXT_BANIXA606_01567_JEZULAHUATAN_000_01: Primary aerodynamo, we have, but auxiliary aerodynamo, we require as well. Nearly complete, ours is, yet squawkka-wak! High-quality shielding, we lack.
TEXT_BANIXA606_01567_JEZULAHUATAN_000_02: Primary aerodynamo, we have, but auxiliary aerodynamo, we require as well. Nearly complete, ours is, yet squawkka-wak! High-quality sealant, we lack.
TEXT_BANIXA606_01567_JEZULAHUATAN_000_03: Primary aerodynamo, we have, but auxiliary aerodynamo, we require as well. Nearly complete, ours is, yet squawkka-wak! High-quality dampeners, we lack.
TEXT_BANIXA606_01567_JEZULAHUATAN_000_04: For want of materials, this component, we cannot prepare. Worse yet, held by the buzzards of Natalan, they are! In silver pots for safekeeping, squirreled away, these materials have been. Need them not, the buzzards! Hold them solely to torment us, they do! Sqqquawk!

But no longer, I say─no longer! Squee-squee... Friend and warrior, featherless one is, yes? Then agree to liberate the materials from their confines, you will! Next, to the crafting facilities of Camp Dragonhead, you will go. Appreciated, materials would be, but preferred, component is!
TEXT_BANIXA606_01567_JEZULAHUATAN_000_05: Liberate the materials from their confines, you will! Then craft component in Camp Dragonhead, you must!
To sneak into Natalan, you can attempt, but charge and squawkka-wak, if all else fails!
TEXT_BANIXA606_01567_NORBETTAUX_000_090: Master Tataramu's associate, I presume? Welcome to our humble facility! What manner of materials will you be working with this fine ?
TEXT_BANIXA606_01567_NORBETTAUX_000_091: Pried from the clutches of the Ixal in Natalan? The things we do for materials! 'Twas prudent of you to bring excess as well─I shall hold on to it for safekeeping. As for you, my friend─craft away!
TEXT_BANIXA606_01567_NORBETTAUX_000_100: If you should lack for material or wish to use the facility again, you need only say so.
TEXT_BANIXA606_01567_NORBETTAUX_100_100: Finished already? Then I shan't detain you! Godsspeed to you, my friend! Should you require aught else─say, additional time with the facility, or your excess materials─know that both will always be available for you.
TEXT_BANIXA606_01567_JEZULAHUATAN_000_13: Squee-squee! Afeared, I was, that dead, you were─yet stand you here, alive and well! Our coveted component, you have brought as well?
In our talons, the auxiliary aerodynamo component is, at long last! Final testing, we can soon commence!

Much effort for small gain, think featherless one? Sqqquawk! Require great risks, great goals do, even if the benefit obtained in so doing is small-small-small. Perfect, the Dezul Qualan must be, and to that end, inconsequential, no improvement is!
TEXT_BANIXA606_01567_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA606_01567_SYSTEM_200_200: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_JEZULAHUATAN_000_00: What next will Ehcatl ask for, featherless one wonders? Squee-squee... Quality decorative plating components, we seek this time. Of the utmost importance, soaring through the heavens in style is!
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_JEZULAHUATAN_000_01: Ornamentation for the hull of the Dezul Qualan, we seek, to further demonstrate our superiority to buzzards below! Sqqquawk!
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_JEZULAHUATAN_000_02: Paints for the hull of the Dezul Qualan, we seek, to further demonstrate our superiority to buzzards below! Sqqquawk!
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_JEZULAHUATAN_000_03: Ornamentation for the hull of the Dezul Qualan, we seek, to further demonstrate our superiority to buzzards below! Sqqquawk!
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_JEZULAHUATAN_000_04: Yet held by the selfsame buzzards, the materials we seek are! Requests to share, they would squawkka-wak! Accomplish nothing, diplomacy will!
On subterfuge, we shall rely! Deep within their ranks, a brother of Ehcatl lurks. Secured our materials, he has, but leave Natalan, he dares not. Render infiltration moot, we will have him not!

Behind enemy lines, you must go! Locate our brother, you shall! Yet play the part of foe, he must, unless a friend, he knows you to be. “Amid the Flowers,” to him you must say, lest to maintain fiction, slay you, he shall!
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_JEZULAHUATAN_000_05: With our brother in Natalan, featherless one must meet! “Amid the Flowers,” to him you must say, else a violent death, at his hands you shall meet!
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_IXALSPY01568_000_06: Featherless ones!? Within Natalan!? Die, you shall, for this trespass!
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_SYSTEM_100_061: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter the password “Amid the Flowers” to let the Ehcatl Nine silencer know you are a friend.
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_IXALSPY01568_000_06: Come share a dream! Friend of my friends, for you, I have been waiting!
Linger, you cannot. Materials, take to Camp Dragonhead for crafting. With you, I cannot be seen, else forfeit, our lives shall be.
To Camp Dragonhead, you must fly! With you, I cannot be seen, else forfeit, our lives shall be!
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_NORBETTAUX_000_070: Welcome to our humble facility! You needn't say a word. You're expected, you see. You need but show me the materials to begin.
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_NORBETTAUX_000_071: You must be very brave to venture so deep into Natalan─far braver than I, that much is certain! Now then, without further ado, your materials─the excess I will retain for safekeeping.
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_NORBETTAUX_000_100: If you require aught else, you need but say the word. Additional materials, additional time with the facility─either I would be more than happy to provide.
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_NORBETTAUX_100_100: A bit flamboyant for my tastes, but so long as the client is satisfied, who am I to judge? Safe travels, my friend, and remember that should disaster strike and you need to recreate your components, I will be here.
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_JEZULAHUATAN_000_13: None the worse for wear, you are! With our brother, you met? Our components, you have brought!?
Squee-squee... Fail us, I knew you would not! The envy of all Ixal, the Dezul Qualan shall be!
With the wind, we shall fly! High as honor, we shall soar! With wings unbending, we shall roam free! To the earth, our enemies shall fall! Amid the flowers of Ayatlan, we shall live our dream!
Chief Totoloc, thus spoke he! Ehcatl Nine, thus shall we be! Squaaawk!
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_POPMESSAGE_000_200: You now have access to the crafting facility.
TEXT_BANIXA607_01568_SYSTEM_200_200: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANIXA099_01569_PROCUREMENTIXAL_000: Squark! Our supplies, dwindling, they are! A featherless one, we seek. A featherless one to fill our houses of wares! Master Rozol demands swiftness, he does! Ever prudent, he is!
TEXT_BANIXA099_01569_SYSTEM_000_002: This quest differs from normal story quests in that to complete it, you must deliver a bevy of requested items.
TEXT_BANIXA099_01569_SYSTEM_100_002: Delivering requested items will earn you points which will bring you closer to meeting the specified quota. The quest is complete only when you have met that quota.
TEXT_BANIXA099_01569_SYSTEM_101_002: The Ehcatl Nine require many different types of items to maintain their daily operations. You may choose which items to deliver based on your ability to procure them.
TEXT_BANIXA099_01569_SYSTEM_000_003: Further questions regarding delivery quests should be directed to the Ehcatl Nine manciple.
TEXT_BANIXA099_01569_SYSTEM_000_004: A current list of items required by the faction can be viewed by speaking with the Ehcatl Nine foreman, or by selecting Timers located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_BANIXA099_01569_PROCUREMENTIXAL_000: Squark! Which items are dwindling, you ask!? Why, all, featherless neuker! But some more than others. Which some more than others? Know, this one does not! Know, the foreman does!
TEXT_BANIXA099_01569_WAREHOUSEIXAL_000_0: Squawk! Squawk! Long is my list! Deep is our need!
TEXT_BANIXA099_01569_SYSTEM_100_020: Each item delivered will earn you points towards meeting your quota. Only when the quota is met will the quest be deemed complete.
TEXT_BANIXA099_01569_SYSTEM_110_020: Moreover, each individual delivery will earn you experience points for the class indicated to the left of the item name in the Ehcatl Nine Delivery Quest menu.
TEXT_BANIXA099_01569_WAREHOUSEIXAL_000_0: Squawk! Squawk! More do we need! More must you bring! Master Rozol eyes us, he does. Ever eyes us, he does!
Squawk! Squaaawk! Met is your quota! Crates, they are full! Report to the manciple, you must. Hurry, you must!
Squawk! Squawk! Squawk! Met is your quota! Through is your labor! Report to the manciple, you must. Linger, you mustn't!
TEXT_BANIXA099_01569_PROCUREMENTIXAL_000: Squark! A featherless neuker, you came. A featherless friend, you left! Hear of your deeds, the chieftain shall! Squark!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SONUVANU_000_000: Like nourishing rains after long summer drought, netherling's return may bring succor in our time of need.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SONUVANU_000_001: Zundu spies send word of activity in Ok' Vundu Mok, deep within Vundu territory. Such news bodes ill for Ok' Zundu.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SONUVANU_000_002: We would know more of this coming storm, but spies struggle to slip past watchful gazes of Vundu guards.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SONUVANU_000_003: Netherling's strength and courage is always reliable, and Sonu asks  to brave enemy territory and bring news of what stirs in Ok' Vundu Mok.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SONUVANU_000_004: Once again netherling proves  is stout ally of the Zundu. Zephyr winds at your back speed your way!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SONUVANU_000_009: Ok' Vundu Mok floats far above Ok' Zundu. Without wings like sanuwa to soar through skies, netherling cannot even reach their gates.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_ZOUHYOUBANU02164_00: There is nowhere to run! Traitorous Gundu, punishment is nigh!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_011: (-Petal-crowned Vanu-)Traitorous!? We but seek freedom from cruelty of Vundu!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_ZOUHYOUBANU02164_00: Nonsense! Like sanuwa, Gundu live only to serve almighty Vundu!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_013: (-Petal-crowned Vanu-)No more! Gundu cast off Vundu reins! Gundu are free! Gundu are free!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_MUNAVANU_000_014: (-Elderly Vanu-)Stand back, Linu Vali! Muna Vanu teaches Vundu difference between Gundu and sanuwa!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_ZOUHYOUBANU02164_00: Foolish greybeak! Even clumsy paissa laughs at your challenge as he tumbles into cloud sea! Such weaklings are not worthy foes. Cower before us!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_MUNAVANU_000_016: Such...such power! Fear cuts deeper than boreal winds!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_ZOUHYOUBANU02164_00: A netherling─and one unmoved by our sundrop dance!?
What insolence! Cast netherling into cloud sea!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_MUNAVANU_000_020: Muna Vanu's gratitude is boundless as cloud sea. Thank you, netherling.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_030: Even most violent gale could not topple you. To stand as totem against Vundu sundrop dance...
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_031: Sundrop dance is ancient tradition of Vanu Vanu. It is display of strength and vigor, both individual and tribe. Vanu custom is to dance before battle, that enemies weak of will may yield, preventing needless bloodshed.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_032: ...Forgive my rudeness. I, Linu Vali of the Gundu tribe, am grateful for zephyr winds that bring netherling to our side to stand against the Vundu.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_033: Vundu invade Gundu lands and curse our totems, but Gundu spirit will not break! All still oppose the Vundu's many misdeeds!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_034: Summoning the White, conquering other tribes, attacking netherlings─all are affronts!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_035: We seek freedom from Vundu rule. But Vundu are greedy as they are cruel, and answer our pleas with violence.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_036: Vundu talons reach far and cut deep. Many flee to distant isles to escape their wrath...yet netherling ventures deep into the Vundu homeland. Why?
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_037: Netherling is come from Ok' Zundu? Sonu Vanu himself asks netherling to investigate?
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_038:
We hear naught of Zundu after Vundu invade our lands. That they are yet free...
Netherling, Linu Vali humbly requests that you escort us to Sonu Vanu, that we might beseech the Zundu for aid.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_039: Tribe will remember netherling's kindness for many moons to come! Now, let us depart to Ok' Zundu before the Vundu return.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SONUVANU_000_050: So rumblings in Ok' Vundu not sign of impending storm, but Gundu uprising.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SONUVANU_000_051: And now the Gundu seek protection from their pursuers...
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_052: May zephyr winds forever guide you, Chief Sonu. I, Linu Vali, daughter of Uunu Vanu, do greet you warmly.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_053: My companions are Muna Vanu, former attendant to my father, and Luna Vanu, merchant of our village.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SONUVANU_000_054: Your father and I spend many hours cloudfishing. When news of his death at Vundu claws reaches Ok' Zundu...the fiercest monsoon cannot wash away my sorrow.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_055: Forgive us our imposition, Chief Sonu, but the Gundu suffer too long under the Vundu─better to run than to remain slaves. But Vundu are relentless, and we face terrible reprisals, if not for this netherling.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SONUVANU_000_056: There is no need to apologize. Zundu welcome you with open arms. Tell me, how fares your brother?
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_057: Alas, when Linu Vanu calls for Gundu independence, Vundu imprison him in skycage and hang from island, as example to others. We attempt to free him but fail, and Vundu pursue us until we meet netherling.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SONUVANU_000_058: It saddens Sonu to learn this. But we are nevertheless grateful that you arrive safely to Ok' Zundu. You and yours are welcome to rest at Nakki Island for as long as you like.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_059: Sonu Vanu, your kindness is boundless as cloud sea!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SANUVANU_000_060: Chief Sonu, pray do not act in haste! What will others say when they learn of this arrangement?
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SANUVANU_000_061: Islands more precious than rain during summer drought. Some still resent netherlings for risking island to hunt the White.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SONUVANU_000_063: Now is not the time to turn our backs on another tribe. We must do all in our power to help─for the sake of Chief Uunu and his people.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SANUVANU_000_064: Have we food to feed them? Wood to build them homes? How much must the Zundu sacrifice for these refugees?
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_065: The island is more than enough. Like seedling which takes root in rich soil and grows strong, so too will new Gundu settlement flourish on this great gift from the Zundu.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SONUVANU_000_066: Such a sight would surely fill Chief Uunu with pride. Nakki Island lies to the west of Ok' Zundu. Go forth and build a new home for your people!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SONUVANU_000_070: The Gundu will need much assistance in the days ahead. Sonu prays you lend them a helping hand.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SANUVANU_000_071: Chief Sonu is too generous by half. It will fall to Sanu to quell the anger of our fellow tribesmen.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_080: Linu Vali's fortune is great indeed, to meet netherling who defeats the White.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_100_080: And an island for the Gundu to start anew... The skies themselves could not grant such gifts!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_081: However, it seems no Vanu inhabit this island since before Linu Vali's hatchling days. Listen─sound you hear not rolling thunder, but incessant buzzing of midge swarms.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_082: Thunderstorm might even be more welcome than midges. One bite from midge and Vanu itch until feathers fall off. But midges have no taste for netherling blood.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_083: Netherling must help before midges cause sleepless nights for tribe! There, ride on the wings of sanuwa, and with its forceful breath drive the midge clouds from the trees.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SYSTEM_100_083: Ride the sanuwa and use its Buffet ability to drive the midge clouds from the trees.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_085: If sanuwa proves too much for netherling, speak with Luna Vanu to mount it once again. Worry not, even Vanu fall from sanuwa when first learning how to fly.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LUNAVANU_000_086: Sanuwa may seem wild at first, but Luna spends many moons training this one. Treat her gently, and the skies are yours to explore!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SYSYTEM_000_090: The midge cloud is blown away!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_100: Ah, the midges hum no longer. But even so, doubt still remains...
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_101: Although Linu makes promises of building new home for tribe, the uncertainty of the road ahead fills her with doubt. Linu Vali is nothing but delicate hen, with arms thin as branches and legs dainty as a gaelicat's...
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_102: It is true, netherling─just look! One day, Linu hopes to become strong enough to send the mightiest Vanu running in fear. But like rain in monsoon season, change comes fast and without warning. Linu possesses not the courage to lead...
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_103: Make no mistake, none are more loyal than Muna Vanu and Luna Vanu, but their feathers are old and grey. Linu cannot ask them to shoulder so heavy a burden. Without Brother, and the many still under Vundu rule, Linu knows not which path to take...
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_104: But in the black of night a beacon of light guides us. Linu speaks of you, netherling!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_105: Please, work with us to help build a new home for Gundu! Do so, and netherling lives on through generations of Gundu storytellers!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SYSYTEM_A1_000_111: Like towering totem pole, netherling supports Gundu.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SYSYTEM_A2_000_112: Alas, netherling must return to  tribe.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_120: A thousand thanks, netherling! Your words clear the fog of doubt from Linu's heart.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_121: This is worthy of celebration! Celebration of the mighty netherling...? Linu Vali is embarrassed to ask, but...what is netherling's name?
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_122: ? Such an odd-sounding name... Do all members of the netherling's tribe call themselves ? Ah, speaking of names, new Gundu village must have one worthy of grand Vanu settlement!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_123: “Nakki” is ancient Vanu word for winds blowing from west, and also name of this island. Hmmm... To honor tribe of Gundu, village's name is “Ok' Gundu Nakki”!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_124: The village has a name, and there is nothing left now but to begin building it! , speak to Muna Vanu to learn what we need.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_LINUVALI_000_125: My heart fills with disappointment, but Linu understands. Although our time together ends here, Linu wishes netherling the best of luck.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SYSTEM_000_150: Linu Vali and the other Gundu have begun developing Ok' Gundu Nakki!
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SYSTEM_000_200: You have achieved Neutral reputation with the Gundu.
TEXT_BANVAN001_02164_SYSTEM_000_201: Vanu Vanu society quests are now available from Muna Vanu at Ok' Gundu Nakki.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_000: As the rising sun does each morning, 's arrival brings a smile to Linu's face! Soon I depart to old home, Ok' Gundu, and netherling's support would be most welcome.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_001: Rumors of Vanu who still live among the village's remains spread like seeds in wind. Linu thinks it may be fellow Gundu.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_002: Linu cannot leave members of tribe to mercy of Vundu. Time is of the essence─we must find the lost Vanu before they do.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_003: 's skills for finding lost things is renowned, and Linu Vali asks  to aid in search. Much time passes since Gundu flee from village, and Linu doubts the Vundu still search in large numbers.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_004: Linu Vali waits at entrance to Ok' Gundu. May zephyr winds bring  there safely!
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_RANUVALI_000_008: Ah, the netherling is come. Linu Vali says much and more of prowess!
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_010: Linu's intuition proves correct! As soon as she begins searching village, Ranu Vali comes running towards her with smile like nestling reunited with mother.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_RANUVALI_000_011: Netherling, honor of meeting is Ranu Vali's. Vundu are not to be feared if one who lays low the White walks with us.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_012: Ranu's skill at botany is the pride of whole Gundu tribe. Even when rain runs dry and the sun burns hot, her crops do not wither. Linu proudly wears crown of flowers Ranu makes for her!
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_013: Ranu tells of another Gundu, Eenu Vanu, who leaps to island below to escape Vundu pursuers. Eenu is stout and strong─surely he is unharmed.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_014: We remain here as lookouts. , search islands below for any sign of Eenu Vanu.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_020: Vundu may return at any time. , make haste in search for Eenu Vanu.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_RANUVALI_000_021: Eenu leaps down to island below, but from here Ranu sees no traces of him.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_EENUVANU_000_030: A...netherling? Eenu Vanu knows not what to make of this...
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_EENUVANU_000_031: What? Linu Vali sends netherling? Like double rainbow, her coming brings joy! Come, let us go to meet her.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_RANUVALI_000_035: Eenu Vanu's skill at hiding matches skill at cloudfishing!
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_EENUVANU_000_036: Linu Vali tells much of netherling's great feats. To have the one who fells the White by our side... Next time, Eenu invites  for cloudfishing!
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_040: Linu Vali thanks  for  help. Eenu Vanu is Gundu's most esteemed cloudfisher. Now tribe can feast on most succulent fish in cloud sea!
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_ZOUHYOUVANU02165_00: There! Even cowardly paissa cannot hide forever!
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_042: These Vanu are...Gundu!? Like trained sanuwa you are at the Vundu's every beck and call. Only cowards follow so blindly!
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_ZOUHYOUVANU02165_00: Honu Vanu, chief of Vundu, evoker of the White, illuminates true path like full moon in midnight sky. But for rebellious Vanu, there is only punishment!
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_044: , wait! Now is not time for fighting─now is time for sundrop dance!
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_ZOUHYOUVANU02165_00: Hahaha, skies weep in embarrassment at pathetic dance! Even unpainted totem pole presents more fearsome display! Behold, a dance of true might!
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_RANUVALI_000_050: Our former friends look at us as enemies... Too many accept Vundu rule without thought, without question.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_EENUVANU_000_051: Although they are now no better than Vundu puppets, to see friends turn against us troubles Eenu greatly.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_060: Linu owes  many apologies. Once, she dances with ferocity of summer squall. But now, remembering vicious Vundu attack on village fills Linu with fear, leaving her unable to dance as before.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_061: Linu once takes pride in sundrop dance, but now her pride is gone, and she feels as a newborn hatchling, shivering in the cold without its mother's body for warmth.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_062: But that we are safe is a blessing, at least. Let us return to Ok' Zundu. Sonu Vanu will certainly be eager to meet Ok' Gundu Nakki's new residents.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_070: Chief Sonu, Linu Vali introduces Ranu Vali, one of Gundu's most skilled botanists, and Eenu Vanu, one of our tribe's eminent cloudfishers.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_SONUVANU_000_071: Ok' Gundu Nakki grows, and along with growth comes change. Sonu is eager to see what the future holds for your village.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_SANUVANU_000_072: Sanu hears rumors of the Gundu's difficulties feeding its members. How do you hope to survive with even more beaks to feed?
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_073: Sanu, Gundu are no mere nestlings. Ok' Gundu Nakki does more than survive─it thrives. All Zundu are welcome to visit and see for themselves.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_SONUVANU_000_075: As lightning heralds coming of nourishing rains, Ok' Gundu Nakki's new residents will bring sustenance to their village.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_SANUVANU_000_076: The Vanu of Ok' Zundu cry out in discontent. What to do, what to do...
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_080: , in truth, the rumors Sanu Vanu hears are not wrong. Tribe does have difficulty feeding everyone. But now, we can grow and catch our own food, without relying on the generosity of others.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_081: Nevertheless, there are those in Ok' Zundu who say Chief Sonu gives too much, and think us Gundu to be nothing but a burden.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_082: Islands in cloud sea are precious indeed. It is no wonder that some feel an outsider undeserving of such a gift.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_083: So, all in Ok' Gundu Nakki must work tirelessly to make village prosper. Both to show gratitude to Sonu, and also to quell voices of doubt. Now that tribe can fend for itself, the Zundu doubtless take notice.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_LINUVALI_000_084: Linu's sundrop dance may lack vigor of past, but until the day Brother returns to us, she must lead her tribe in his stead.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_SYSTEM_000_100: Ranu Vali and Eenu Vanu take up residence at Ok' Gundu Nakki, increasing the village's food stores.
TEXT_BANVAN002_02165_SYSTEM_000_200: You have achieved Recognized reputation with the Gundu.

TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_000: , many from Ok' Zundu come to share in Ranu Vali and Eenu Vanu's wisdom. Like trees in grove, our roots become more intertwined each passing day.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_001: Ranu shares the secrets of Gundu botany, and Eenu spends long hours exchanging advice with Zundu cloudfishers.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_002: Linu swells with pride at success of village, but shame still nags at her like single midge buzzing in ear. If she cannot perform sundrop dance in heat of battle, then she is no more use to village than newborn hatchling...
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_003: But now is not the time for self-pity! Ranu Vali's friend from Ok' Zundu tells intriguing story around cooking fires.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_004: While delivering tribute to Vundu, Ranu's friend notices group mercilessly beating Vanu wearing Gundu colors. Another Gundu approaches the group, shouting, “No more violence!” But the Vundu mock his pleas, and chase him from the village.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_005: Linu Vali has an old friend, Ginu Vanu, who says same thing ever since nestling days. , we must help him before he faces punishment for his words.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_006: does not fear violent Vundu youths. Please, come to Vundu Ok' Bendu with Linu Vali. With 's help, we bring friend back safely to Ok' Gundu Nakki!
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_010: Linu sees no Vundu patrolling area, but we must act quickly─like storm during monsoon season, they are never far away. Here, take bones of sanuwa, . Linu carves mark only her and Ginu Vanu recognize.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_011: When Ginu sees mark, he knows that Linu comes to rescue him. Place bones throughout Vundu Ok' Bendu in trail leading to hiding spot, and he follows!
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_012: Ginu Vanu spends many moons under brutal rule of Vundu, and he may fear consequences of being captured. But when Linu Vali tells him of Ok' Gundu Nakki, the promise of a new home gives him courage to come with us.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_013: , place bones around Vundu Ok' Bendu, and guide Ginu Vanu back to us. Linu Vali keeps watch for any Vundu patrols.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_015: The mark is secret only Linu Vali and Ginu Vanu know. Place bones, and he comes.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_020: The bones guide Ginu Vanu to us! And now, we wait!
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_GINUVANU_000_022: Hahaha. As ever, Linu scares easily as nestling lost in dark. When Ginu sees marks on bones, he knows his friend is come!
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_023: Ginu, to meet again brings Linu great joy! He looks healthy as crops after nourishing spring rain.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_024: Linu flees along with other Gundu, and this netherling rescues us from capture. Thanks to  help, tribe receives gift from Zundu: a new island to call home.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_025: Ginu Vanu, return with us to Ok' Gundu Nakki, and share knowledge of Gundu carpentry to make our modest village grand! Do not fear,  guides us safely back.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_GINUVANU_000_026: If Ginu says no, he is more foolish than Vanu who plants seeds during drought. No matter how modest village is, it is surely preferable to suffering longer under Vundu abuse!
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_GINUVANU_000_027: A Vundu patrol! Quickly, hide before they pluck our feathers and throw us in skycages!
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_028: Wait! Linu practices sundrop dance day and night, and now the time comes to prove herself. But the Vundu look fierce, and Linu cannot hope to strike fear into their hearts without inspiration... , show Linu the dance of your tribe!
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_029: Rouse Linu's strength with your mighty dance, and she will send the Vundu fleeing! Quickly!
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_035: Rouse Linu's warrior spirit with your dance, ! There is not much time!
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_040: Linu feels the warrior spirit within her─coursing through her entire body! Now, , witness the awesome power of Linu Vali's dance!
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_041: Haha, they run like cowardly korrigans! 's dance reawakens Linu Vali's ferocity, and brings forth true might of her sundrop dance!
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_042: Come, let us return to Ok' Zundu and speak with Sonu Vanu, before patrol returns.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_GINUVANU_000_045: No more violence! We must run or face wrath of Vundu scouts!
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_050: Chief Sonu, today Linu Vali brings before you Ginu Vanu, greatest builder of the Gundu tribe, and a dear friend.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_SANUVANU_000_051: Ah, many Vanu tell stories of great Gundu architecture, and today a renowned builder stands before us! Sanu has much interest in hearing Ginu Vanu's wisdom!
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_SANUVANU_000_052: ...Ah, Sanu apologizes for his interruption. Forgive me, Chief Sonu.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_SONUVANU_000_053: Hahaha, there is no need for apologies. Like the most precious of crystals, Gundu culture possesses many facets. All Zundu have much to look forward to as our tribes grow closer.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_SONUVANU_000_00055: Many Vanu admire the techniques of Gundu crafters. With time, Ok' Gundu Nakki may become a village to rival the greatest in Vanu history.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_SANUVANU_000_056: The traditions and techniques of the Gundu crafters are of great interest to Sanu. He looks forward to discussing much with them in the future.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_060: Ok' Gundu Nakki is alive with the sound of celebration! And Linu Vali finally dances. Like skies on clear summer day, she is free from worry.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_061: Occasion calls for hearty feast! Linu Vali eats until stomach can hold no more, and then practices dance until sun itself smiles in approval.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_062: Alas, Ok' Gundu Nakki still lacks a leader─a strong chief. Brother is yet trapped in skycage, hanging somewhere in vast cloud sea.
TEXT_BANVAN003_02166_LINUVALI_000_063: Although Brother's whereabouts remain a mystery, Linu Vali swears to find him one day. , when that day comes, the Gundu may call on your aid once more.

TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_000: , at last the time to rescue Brother is come!
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_001: Zundu capture overly bold Vundu spy, and like flood after rains, answers pour from his beak after interrogation. Spy speaks of Brother, and says the Vundu plan to move him to a skycage hanging in the Cromlech.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_002: We must act now, while the Vundu do not expect us. Such a chance may not come again! Make haste to the Cromlech!
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_010: They sneer at Linu's dance... , if not for you, the Vundu throw Linu Vali into lonely skycage!
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_011: Attackers lying in wait when Linu Vali arrives... Scheming Vundu hope to ambush any Gundu that come to rescue Brother!
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_012: But they know not our strength. Brother hangs below; Linu Vali hears his voice calling out. But such flimsy skycage cannot hold two Vanu, even if one is dainty as Linu Vali.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_013: is light as butterfly in comparison─skycage holds fast under  weight! Here, give Brother this horn, and sanuwa answers call.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_014: On wings of steed he rides to freedom. , hurry before more Vundu arrive!
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_020: Give the horn to Brother so he can fly from the skycage.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVANU_000_030: Linu hears Sister's voice, and the sounds of pitched fighting. And now a netherling stands before me? What is the meaning of this?
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVANU_000_031: Ah... Well, Linu Vanu is glad to have such a skilled fighter on his side. And you say Sister has a gift for me?
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVANU_000_032: A sanuwa horn? With this, Linu rides sanuwa to freedom, and to family! Come, netherling!
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVANU_100_040: Heh, Vundu! Linu Vanu will not return to your skycages!
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_042: Vundu cowards scatter as leaves before ferocious autumn gale!
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_043: Our bonds strengthen our dance. Few possess the will to stand fearless against dancers moving in concert, with allies and family.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVANU_000_044: Netherling, naught but ill fate befalls our tribe since Vundu conquer our land. Your rescue is like single star shining in darkness, and for that Linu thanks you.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVANU_000_045: Sister, for moons did Linu Vanu worry for your safety, alone in skycage. To see you safe brings more comfort than the first rays of light at dawn. How does Linu Vali escape the Vundu for so long?
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_046: For that, we must also thank .  has strong ties with the Zundu, and in their kindness they grant the Gundu refugees an island to rest on, far away from the Vundu.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVANU_000_047: Ah, bold as they are, even Vundu do not risk truce and encroach on Zundu territory. But...such kindness from the Zundu? Linu Vanu wonders what they intend...
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_048: Brother, all in Ok' Gundu Nakki eagerly await their chief's return. But first, let us make our introductions at Ok' Zundu. And from there, our new home!
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVANU_000_050: Chief Sonu, may zephyr winds blow always at your back. I, Linu Vanu, son of Chief Uunu, greet you warmly.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_SONUVANU_000_051: Ah, Linu Vanu looks much like his father! Your tribe faces many adversities, but that you are safe gives them hope. Sonu believes that Linu leads Ok' Gundu Nakki to greatness.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVANU_000_052: It seems the Vundu spare Ok' Zundu─no building bears the scars of their wrath. Linu hears Ok' Zundu buys this peace with offerings. Linu supposes that is proper path for tribe lacking the strength, or courage, to face their enemies.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_SANUVANU_000_053: Linu Vanu oversteps his bounds! He dares to insult our tribe!?
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_SONUVANU_000_054: Sanu Vanu, let Linu speak. The Gundu stand against the Vundu, and they take everything from his tribe, even turning friends against one other. The Zundu choose a different path, and Linu is free to think as he likes about our choices.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVANU_000_055: True warriors fight for their freedom, and for their tribe! Only cowards give gifts to appease their enemies!
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_SANUVANU_000_056: C-Cowards!? Watch your words, Linu Vanu!
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_058: Ok' Gundu Nakki is gift from Zundu tribe. Without Zundu generosity, Gundu remain homeless, wandering cloud sea like sanuwa hatchling looking for mother. Brother brings shame to insult our benefactors!
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVANU_000_059: Sister scolds Linu Vanu!? She becomes bolder with the passing of moons...
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVANU_000_060: But perhaps she is right. Sonu Vanu, please forgive Linu Vanu's rudeness.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_SONUVANU_000_061: Linu Vanu, Sonu understands reasons for doubt. Now, let us move forward, and build further upon the friendship our two tribes share.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_SANUVANU_000_062: Surely Chief Sonu knows that Vundu discovery of Ok' Gundu Nakki is but a matter of time. When dark clouds bring Vundu to inquire about Zundu's role in their protection, what then does Chief Sonu do?
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_SONUVANU_000_063: When the storm comes, Sonu Vanu trusts judgment of tribe to weather all safely through it.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_SONUVANU_000_070: Right down to his personality, Linu Vanu is as if hatched from same egg as father.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_SANUVANU_000_071: Linu Vanu could learn much from his sister's manners...
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_080: , with Brother's arrival, Ok' Gundu Nakki has chief at last!
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_081: Burden of responsibility lifts from Linu Vali's shoulders. However, although Linu wants nothing more than to polish her beak and talon, make feather arrangements, and practice her sundrop dance, there is still unease in the village...
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_082: Brother's dislike for the Zundu is plain, and it does not bode well for the future of our two tribes.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_083: Others in Ok' Gundu Nakki share his distaste. Some say that the Zundu are weaklings for not opposing the Vundu openly.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_084: Linu understands their misgivings, but they must look beyond that. If the Zundu do not buy freedom with tributes, then the Vundu conquer them as well. They would hold all islands in their talons, and all would answer to their rule.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_085: Linu must make the others understand this. The Zundu and Gundu must work together, for the benefit of both our tribes.
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_LINUVALI_000_086: Linu Vali has a plan to bring tribes together in friendship. She has plans for 's role too. Speak with Linu Vali again when time comes!
TEXT_BANVAN004_02167_SYSTEM_000_100: Linu Vanu has been appointed chief of Ok' Gundu Nakki, and construction of the Chief's Roost has been completed.

TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVALI_000_000: , it is as Linu Vali fears. Ever since Brother visits Chief Sonu, the relationship between Zundu and Gundu is tense.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVALI_000_001: We must do something before tension grows into animosity, disrupting all Gundu and Zundu work together for.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVALI_000_002: Linu thinks upon problem for many sunrises, and decides that Gundu shall hold a feast for Zundu!
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVALI_000_003: To treat friends to banquet is meaningful act among Vanu. When we gather around blazing cooking fires, all grudges wash away like tears in rain.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVALI_000_004: Linu is to prepare fish for the main course, so she goes to Voor Sian Siran, to make a catch even Eenu Vanu envies. Food that the cook catches with her own talons is all the more delicious!
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVALI_000_005: However, as essential as the fish is the seasoning! And Linu wants to impress, so she asks  to gather a mineral most precious: Abalathian rock salt.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVALI_000_006: Vundu hold the cloud sea's entire supply, so  must venture deep within Ok' Vundu Vana to where their storehouses lie. Search them, and bring back most pure chunk you can find.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVALI_000_007: Linu needs time─and concentration─to make suitable catch, so she asks that  gives the rock salt to Brother. Watch, , Linu returns with cloud sea's most succulent fish!
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVANU_000_010: Greetings, netherling. Sister says to expect something from you, although she says not what it is...
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVANU_000_011: Abalathian rock salt? And as cloudless as clear summer skies! To obtain such a mineral is no easy task. What does Sister hope to use this for?
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVANU_000_012: A feast? And Sister prepares the main dish, no less? Ah, it is just like her to put on a brave face. But as mist after spring rain, her courage is often fleeting...
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVANU_000_013: But it is not Linu Vanu's place to doubt her. It is because of my rudeness at Ok' Zundu that she goes to such trouble. It is shameful that my actions burden her so.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVANU_000_014: Sister changes, it is plain to see. Not long ago, she clutches at Linu's feathers, fearful to wander too far from my gaze. But now, her conviction to build our new home spurs growth, so much that Linu sometimes does not recognize her. I thank you for standing by Sister's side during this time, netherling.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVANU_000_015: Alas, although Sister is no longer frightened nestling, to leave her alone in the wilds brings Linu Vanu worry. For all Sister's conviction, still she is delicate, with arms like branches of birch tree. Endymions stalk the skies, and beasts worse still skulk in the waters...
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVANU_000_016: As chief, Linu Vanu must watch over village. Netherling, pray visit Voor Sian Siran and see that she is safe.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVANU_000_020: Linu Vanu worries for Sister's safety. Netherling, make way to Voor Sian Siran and ensure she is unharmed.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVALI_000_030: ...thank you for rescuing Linu yet again.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVALI_100_030: Cloudfishing requires patience, and focus... Linu's surroundings fade into background, until there is only the fishing line and lure. Linu does not hear the cloudworm steal upon her...
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVALI_000_031: Maybe the worm smells Linu's catch. Fish is so plump, leftovers from feast feed tribe for moons! Come, , let us return to Ok' Gundu Nakki before meat spoils!
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVANU_000_035: Ah, to see Sister safe is comforting. As she becomes more daring, Linu Vanu's concern for her only grows.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVALI_000_040: Brother gives Linu Vali rock salt  takes from Vundu. With such rich seasoning, fish will be the talk of Ok' Zundu for moons to come!
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVALI_000_041: And now, Linu Vali cooks! Of course,  is welcome to feast as guest of honor!
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVANU_000_042: Does Sanu know why Honu, chief of Vundu, wears such ornate mask?
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_SANUVANU_000_043: The mask is symbol of his power, no?
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVANU_000_044: Chief Honu wants others to believe so, but Linu knows true reason. He masks the feathers on his head, which are thinner than newborn hatchling's! Hahaha!
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_SONUVANU_000_045: Many times Chief Uunu and Sonu sit around fire such as this. Sonu still remembers well the power of his dance. He moves with the intensity of the sun itself, and drives all darkness into hiding.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVALI_000_046: Linu wishes to one day dance with Father's vigor. Both to honor his memory, and to protect Ok' Gundu Nakki!
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_SONUVANU_000_047: Linu Vali may still be young, but Sonu knows she will become a great member of the Gundu tribe. Maybe one day, she becomes chief!
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVALI_000_048: Chief Sonu makes Linu Vali blush! Linu is but a nestling still!
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_SONUVANU_000_049: Hahaha. It is but a joke, Linu.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_LINUVALI_000_050: All Zundu praise feast, particularly the fish! We look forward to sharing many meals together in coming moons. Of course,  is welcome to sit alongside the cooking fires with us any time.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_SYSTEM_000_100: Ok' Gundu Nakki's principal structures have been completed, and the Zundu have sent flowers in celebration!
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_SYSTEM_000_200: You have achieved Respected reputation with the Gundu.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_SYSTEM_000_201: New Vanu Vanu society daily quests are now available from Muna Vanu at Ok' Gundu Nakki.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_SYSTEM_100_201: You will receive an experience point bonus upon the completion of Vanu Vanu society daily quests.
TEXT_BANVAN005_02168_SYSTEM_100_300: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Muna Vanu as a reputation rank bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
