TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_000: , black winds bring terrible news! The Vundu learn of Ok' Gundu Nakki's existence!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_001: Chief Honu storms into Ok' Zundu and demands that Chief Sonu surrenders us back to the Vundu!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_002: If Chief Sonu does not do as Honu commands, he threatens to smash our villages into splinters and toss the remnants into the clouds!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_003: Chief Sonu calls us to Ok' Zundu to discuss this turn of events, and he requests that  come as well. Quickly, to Ok' Zundu!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_005: Something must be done before Vundu bring ruin upon us! Hurry to Ok' Zundu, where Chief Sonu awaits.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVANU_000_006: Gundu could not escape searching eyes of Vundu forever. Come, netherling, there is much to discuss at Ok' Zundu.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SANUVANU_000_007: Vundu greed knows no bounds; it is as vast as the appetite of the White. Chief Sonu is anxious to discuss their threats. Speak to him, netherling.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_010: Chief Sonu, Ok' Zundu faces destruction because of the Gundu. For that, Linu Vali offers a thousand apologies to every Vanu of Ok' Zundu.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SONUVANU_000_011: Linu Vali, the fault lies not on the Gundu. As inevitable as floods that follow enduring rains, the Vundu's greed eventually swallows all. But we will not stand idly by. The time to fight back is come.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SANUVANU_000_012: Chief Sonu, the Zundu will not accept this! We cannot ignore the might of the Vundu. Our tribe will not fight battle they cannot win.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SONUVANU_000_013: Hmmm... A chief cannot ignore the voices of his tribe. If the Zundu do not fight as one, then Sonu sees no way through these troubled mists.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVANU_000_014: The Zundu cower in their huts before Vundu tempest─predictable! Very well, surrender us to Chief Honu. Joyous he will be to receive an offering from his slaves!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SANUVANU_000_015: S-Slaves!? Enough of Linu Vanu's slights!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVANU_000_016: The Zundu only fight if victory is assured!? Even paissa calls them cowards! Gundu fight until the last Vanu! A warrior's death brings more honor than bondage!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_017: Brother, be calm! You must think! Even if Zundu join us, to take up arms against the Vundu means certain death. But fighting is not the only way─we will send them fleeing with the sundrop dance!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVANU_000_018: Sister, do you not remember? When Vundu attack Ok' Gundu, they stand stoic as totem poles before the dances of our fiercest warriors. It is useless!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_019: Do not forget, many Gundu betray their own that day, robbing us of the strength unity brings. But now we fight for a new home, and freedom. Let us dance as one, and drive the Vundu before us!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SANUVANU_000_020: Linu Vali, that is no easy task. The Zundu live peacefully for countless moons, and they forget what it is to fight. If they dance before Chief Honu, and he casts his baleful gaze upon them, it is Zundu who run.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SANUVANU_000_021: Still, there may be a way. Perhaps if the Zundu see a mighty warrior's sundrop dance, then as rain breathes life into a wilting flower, their courage will be born anew.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SONUVANU_000_023: Ah, but does a mighty warrior not stand before us? The one who cast the White Himself down from the skies. Certainly  can rouse their vigor!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_024: Chief Sonu is right! 's dance kindles Linu Vali's courage, washing away the fear from her heart!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_025: , learn the sundrop dance, and show the Zundu a netherling's fury!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_026: Linu Vali teaches  the steps. But first, all who wish to learn the dance must submit themselves before our ancestors. Worry not, Linu guides you along the way. Come, , meet Linu at entrance to Ok' Zundu.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVANU_000_027: Ah, the time is come for Sister to lead. Linu Vanu may be chief, but sometimes he wonders who is most fitting to sit in the Chief's Roost...
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVANU_000_030: Linu Vanu may be chief, but now is time for Sister to lead.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SONUVANU_000_031: Sonu anticipates netherling's dance more than the coming of spring. Go, and master the sundrop dance!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SANUVANU_000_032: Will our tribe agree to this?
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_040: , we must first visit the ancestral statues. Two of them tower over islands in cloud sea, in the shape of great Vanu Vanu─the first of our kind.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_041: must dance atop the statues, laying bare  spirit to the judgment of our ancestors. Only with their approval can  earn the right to the sundrop dance.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_042: Here lies the first statue: the mother of all Vanu. Go, , and dance atop the statue with zeal!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_045: Dance atop the statue with all the power you can muster!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SYSYTEM_000_048: You lose yourself in the dance, and lay bare your spirit to the Vanu Vanu ancestors!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SYSYTEM_000_049: Submit your spirit to the Vanu Vanu ancestors with a rousing dance.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_050: The violent winds of a monsoon gale could not match the ferocity of 's dance. One more statue remains: the father of all Vanu. Linu awaits at Vundu Ok' Bendu!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_060: Climb atop the statue and show the father of all Vanu your dance. Do not hold back─the statue stands strong against the most thunderous stamps. Go, , Linu Vali watches from here.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_065: The father of all Vanu awaits your dance. Linu Vali watches from here.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SYSYTEM_000_068: You lose yourself in the dance, and lay bare your spirit to the Vanu ancestors!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SYSYTEM_000_069: Submit your spirit to the Vanu Vanu ancestors with a rousing dance.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_070: Such a dance! And with it, the ancestors of the Vanu know full well the constitution of your spirit. Does  not feel them smiling down in approval?
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_071: No? Hmmm... Perhaps only Vanu can feel the warmth of their smiles. Nonetheless, it is time to return to Ok' Zundu. Come, !
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_080: submits  spirit before the ancestors, and earns the right to the sundrop dance. Pay attention, for it is easy to miss the subtlety of its movements among its fury. Learn it well, and reawaken the Zundu's courage!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_ZUNDUYOUNG02169_000: (-Zundu Youth-)Such power! Such strength! Netherling moves with fury of raging typhoon!
(-Zundu Youth-)Magnificent! The White Himself cowers among the clouds!
(-Zundu Youth-)We will dance! Zundu will dance!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SONUVANU_000_085: Netherling's dance rivals even Chief Uunu's in its wrath! The dark mists lift, and path we must walk becomes clear.
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SONUVANU_000_086: Gundu and Zundu shall dance as one, and put the Vundu to flight!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_LINUVALI_000_087: The Vundu will flee like frightened gaelicats!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SYSTEM_000_095: You have learned the emote Sundrop Dance!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SYSTEM_000_100: A Gundu totem pole has been built in Ok' Gundu Nakki to show reverence to the tribe's ancestors!
TEXT_BANVAN006_02169_SYSTEM_000_200: You have achieved Honored reputation with the Gundu.

TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_LINUVALI_000_000: , scouts spot Vundu marching towards Ok' Zundu! The time is come to stand against them!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_LINUVALI_000_001: But before we depart to confront the Vundu, Linu has one last request of . Go to the Gundu totem pole and offer your sundrop dance.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_LINUVALI_000_002: Gundu build totem pole to show reverence towards ancestors. If  offers  dance, they may grant us strength for the ordeal ahead. Go, and present your mightiest sundrop dance!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_LINUVALI_000_005: Go before the Gundu totem pole and perform the sundrop dance, so that our ancestors may grant us their blessing.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SYSYTEM_000_008: The earth quakes and the trees rustle before your sundrop dance. The Gundu ancestors look favorably on your display, and grant your allies strength.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SYSYTEM_000_009: Stand before the totem pole, and ask for the favor of the Gundu ancestors by performing the sundrop dance.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_LINUVALI_000_010: Thank you, . The Gundu ancestors see fit to grant us their blessing, and impart their bravery and ferocity. Like the morning sun rising boldly over mountaintops, we set out with confidence in our victory!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_LINUVALI_000_011: , Linu thanks you once again. Linu treasures all that  does for Ok' Gundu Nakki.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_LINUVALI_000_012: Alas, this struggle is between Vanu, and Vanu alone. There is no telling when it ends, or how violent it becomes. Linu insists too much on  already, and cannot ask  to risk life and limb.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_LINUVALI_000_013: Today, only Vanu will set foot on the field of battle. , go to Ok' Zundu and tell Chief Sonu that our preparations are complete. Then, await there for our victorious return.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_LINUVALI_000_015: Today's fight is between Vanu, and only Vanu. , tell Chief Sonu that preparations are complete, and then await there for us to return victorious.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_LINUVANU_000_016: Netherling, thank you for bestowing on us the blessing of our ancestors. Now it is Gundu's turn to protect our friends, our freedom, and our future!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_RANUVALI_000_017: Netherling's sundrop dance washes away fear from Ranu's heart.  is the dance of heroes!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_EENUVANU_000_018: Netherling's courage impresses as always.  dance reminds Eenu of great skyfish soaring confidently among the cloud sea. Eenu's heart stirs with fury, and he trembles in anticipation of the dance!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_GINUVANU_000_019: Never does Ginu imagine a netherling performs sundrop dance!  dance worthy to perform at Hall of the Fallen Plume! Ginu Vanu abhors violence, but Vundu run in fear at his dance!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SONUVANU_000_030: Ah, so the Gundu stand ready. As do the Zundu. We are ready to face our fates.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SONUVANU_000_031: Netherling, often do we rely on your support, and Sonu would make one last request of you. Watch over our battle with the Vundu.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SONUVANU_000_032: If the Vundu stand unmoving against our dance, and we must resort to blades and talons, our tribes may not survive the day. If this happens, Sonu asks netherling to remember tale of our last stand. Pass it down so none forget our valor. This task, I entrust you with.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SONUVANU_000_033: And now, the time to depart is come. Sonu will leave with the rest of his tribe, to meet the Vundu to the northeast. Go there, netherling, and wait.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SONUVANU_000_040: Our fate awaits to the northeast. Go there, netherling. We will not be far behind.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SANUVANU_000_041: Today, Zundu's bravery shakes mountains and splits skies! The Vundu will run back to their village like paissa fleeing from hungry sanuwa!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_LINUVALI_000_042: Many thanks, , for speaking to Chief Sonu. Now we depart, to face the Vundu.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_HONU_000_050: Zundu dare to leave safety of village!? Surrender the Gundu rebels now, and perhaps Vundu only demand triple tribute for next ten moons!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_HONU_000_051: Uunu Vanu's children are as foolish as him! Very well! Before sharing your father's fate, bask in the fury of true warriors!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_LINUVALI_000_052: Focus! Do not let the Vundu intimidate you! Dance as one!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_HONU_000_053: Heaven! Earth! Cower before us! Scatter to the winds!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_LINUVALI_000_054: Do not falter! Back into formation─ Dance!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_HONU_000_055: Netherling! Today you answer for your affront to the White!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_LINUVALI_100_057: Zundu! Gundu! Join with netherling, make  strength yours!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_HONU_000_058: They dance with one heart─as one sundrop! Impossible! R-Retreat!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SONUVANU_000_059: The sun shines down upon our victory today! Netherling, Gundu, and Zundu dance as one, and the Vundu flee before us!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_LINUVANU_000_060: Remember the sight of Chief Honu running in fear! Remember his frightened yelp, like hatchling crying for its mother!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SANUVANU_000_061: Vundu bluster and bellow, but their courage wilts before our dance.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_LINUVALI_000_062: Once again, , our tribes owe you debt of gratitude deeper than cloud sea. Gundu welcome you always.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_LINUVALI_000_063: From this day, Vundu think twice before threatening our tribes. Gundu are finally free to rebuild!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_LINUVALI_000_064: Now, the time for celebration is come! At Ok' Gundu Nakki, we feast!
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SYSTEM_000_100: As a symbol of Zundu's solidarity with the Gundu, the Zundu have sent a totem pole illustrating the Zundu's history.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SYSTEM_000_101: Additionally, several Vanu Vanu have fled from the Vundu and taken up residence at Ok' Gundu Nakki.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SYSTEM_000_200: You have achieved Sworn reputation with the Gundu.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SYSTEM_100_200: You will receive an experience point bonus upon the completion of Vanu Vanu society daily quests.
TEXT_BANVAN007_02170_SYSTEM_000_201: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from Luna Vanu.
TEXT_BANVAN101_02171_MUNAVANU_000_000: If we position scouts here...and here... Oh, ! Muna Vanu does not hear your approach! Perhaps netherling can lend  strength to Gundu?
TEXT_BANVAN101_02171_MUNAVANU_000_001: Zundu say they see Vundu scouts nearby. Our tribe must patrol its territory, but has not the warriors to do so. Please, help us find evil Vundu scouts and drive them away!
TEXT_BANVAN101_02171_MUNAVANU_000_002: Vundu land borders Zundu land northeast of here. Please search that area. Find their scouts and show Vundu full fury of Gundu!
TEXT_BANVAN101_02171_MUNAVANU_000_020: ! Word reaches Muna Vanu of your exploits! Gundu descend upon vile Vundu wretches with force of violent gale!
TEXT_BANVAN101_02171_MUNAVANU_000_021: Vundu scouts grow more daring each day. We hear of them hunting in Zundu territory─eating Zundu food!
TEXT_BANVAN101_02171_MUNAVANU_000_022: Netherling's work helps us repay debt to Zundu. But now we owe debt to you, . Fear not. Gundu do not forget your help.
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_MUNAVANU_000_000: ! Gundu have need of your strength once more. Tribe wants for kindling and firewood. Nearby netherling knights have plenty of firewood. Netherling knights also have eye for delicious Vanu delicacies...
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_MUNAVANU_000_001: Muna Vanu wishes to make delectable catsfoot chew to trade with netherlings, but lacks most important ingredient. Catsfoot chew without catsfoot is like blue sky without sun!
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_MUNAVANU_000_002: But do not fear─it blooms wild all around Ok' Zundu. Muna Vanu prepares other ingredients now. , please gather three sprigs of catsfoot.
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_MUNAVANU_000_010: Zephyr winds bring  back to Muna Vanu. Does netherling harvest catsfoot?
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_MUNAVANU_000_011: Yes! These are perfect─ripe and fragrant! With these, I make delicious treat, warm and bright as sun rising over new day. Mix this...and this...and dash of that...
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_MUNAVANU_000_012: ...And complete! Look, ! Do you ever see more beautiful sight? Do you ever smell more beautiful a fragrance?
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_MUNAVANU_000_013: Please, take catsfoot chew to place netherlings call Camp Cloudtop. Deliver to man called Caribault.
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_MUNAVANU_000_014: Caribault trades with Gundu. He loves Gundu food, and will trade much firewood for this. May tailwinds speed netherling to him.
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_CARIBAULT_000_020: You want firewood, do you? Well I'm not in the habit of giving stuff away for free. What have you got to trade for it?
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_CARIBAULT_000_021: Ohohoh! I daresay this is authentic Vanu catsfoot chew! I think you have yourself a deal.
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_CARIBAULT_000_022: They're made from wildflowers, you know, and the texture is just sublime. I can't get enough of these things─you must tell me where you got it!
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_CARIBAULT_000_023: Whatever the case, I'd be more than happy to trade. We have more firewood than we know what to do with right now. Take as much as you like─hells, take as much as you can!
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_CARIBAULT_000_024: I've always wanted to know how they get this incredible spongy texture... They're so chewy!
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_MUNAVANU_000_030: Greetings, . Muna Vanu welcomes you back. Do netherling knights share firewood with Gundu?
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_MUNAVANU_000_031: Many thanks for this. In Sea of Clouds, trees and wood are as precious as water in driest desert. Even Gundu of old Ok' Gundu often trade with netherlings for wood in days past.
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_MUNAVANU_000_032: Vanu snacks are always appreciated as gifts─and valuable for trading. Memories of old Ok' Gundu are soft and familiar, like stone worn smooth by wind and rain.
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_MUNAVANU_000_033: With these memories, Muna Vanu prepares treats just as they were, with finest wildflowers and freshest wamouracampa meat, so that netherlings love them as much as they always have.
TEXT_BANVAN102_02172_MUNAVANU_000_034: Thank you for your assistance, . One day Muna Vanu treats you to feast in gratitude─with perfectly prepared catsfoot chew!
TEXT_BANVAN103_02173_MUNAVANU_000_000: , Muna Vanu has request to make. Endymions make nests upon Zundu nests! Please remove nests and rid us all─Gundu and Zundu alike─of threat of endymion attack!
TEXT_BANVAN103_02173_MUNAVANU_000_001: Endymions make nests as high as possible─removing them is dangerous and takes much time. But gust of wind from sanuwa blasts away whole nest─scatters to wind like spores of wild mushroom.
TEXT_BANVAN103_02173_MUNAVANU_000_002: Luna Vanu provides  with sanuwa. Use powerful, buffeting blast of wind from it to destroy four endymion nests!
TEXT_BANVAN103_02173_LUNAVANU_000_010: Always it is pleasure to see ! Muna Vanu tells Luna of plan to destroy endymion nests. Please, blow them away like kindling before gale!
TEXT_BANVAN103_02173_LUNAVANU_000_011: Even Vanu nestlings fall from sanuwa sometimes. It is no surprise that  does too. Luna Vanu prepares fresh sanuwa.
TEXT_BANVAN103_02173_MUNAVANU_000_020: has whole tribe's thanks! With  efforts, beasts' nests are gone and Vanu Vanu nestlings may rest easy once more.
TEXT_BANVAN103_02173_MUNAVANU_000_021: Endymion is more dangerous than raging anzu. They swoop down like fell wind and carry off young Vanu Vanu! Nests must be removed before vicious beasts grow too strong.
TEXT_BANVAN103_02173_MUNAVANU_000_022: When Muna Vanu is but mere nestling, endymions do not prowl Sea of Clouds. But in recent years, dangerous creatures blow in from northern seas. Each year is worse─more threatening─like swelling storm on horizon...
TEXT_BANVAN104_02174_MUNAVANU_000_000: approaches, strong as typhoon that wrenches full-grown trees from bedrock. Our tribe wishes to borrow  strength.
TEXT_BANVAN104_02174_MUNAVANU_000_001: Gundu food supplies dwindle. But Ok' Vundu stocks grow fat like their wives. Surely Vundu not notice some few missing pots. Please gather food for us from their larders. Without them, Gundu may not survive next season.
TEXT_BANVAN104_02174_MUNAVANU_000_002: They store everything in pots. Bring back four of them, so tribe does not go hungry.
TEXT_BANVAN104_02174_MUNAVANU_000_020: Does netherling return with Vundu pots?
TEXT_BANVAN104_02174_MUNAVANU_000_021: Many thanks, .  truly has gift for stealth, stealing into camp like silent evening breeze. Now, let us see what fat Vundu chief feasts on...
TEXT_BANVAN104_02174_MUNAVANU_000_022: Ohoho! Dried leeches! They look delicious as wriggling, writhing worms, fresh-plucked from soil after heavy rains.
TEXT_BANVAN104_02174_MUNAVANU_000_023: Vundu claim that soil now─that land...but only after stealing it from Gundu! With no lands in which to hunt, we have no choice but to levy our share from their takings─by force, if we must. Muna Vanu fears Gundu ask  for help again in future.
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_MUNAVANU_000_000: Hello and good , . Gundu welcome  always! Luna Vanu has request to make of netherling, but departs before giving details.
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_MUNAVANU_000_001: Village still wants for steady supply of meals. No doubt he asks you to help secure reliable source of food. But perhaps it is best if you ask him yourself.
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_LUNAVANU_000_010: Ah, so  comes to help Luna Vanu?  is welcome sight at ideal time, like rain falling on newly planted crops!
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_LUNAVANU_000_011: Luna Vanu requests that netherling bring chigoe larvae for tribe to feast on. These bugs are supremely delicious and very nutritious. But they are fast like lightning and not easily caught.
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_LUNAVANU_000_012: But sanuwa can blast chigoes from nest with terrible gusts of wind. , take to skies on trusty mount. Luna Vanu waits beneath nest to catch dazed bug before it flees.
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_LUNAVANU_000_013: Chigoes build nests in hollows of gnarled, old trees. Such trees dot island netherlings call the Gauntlet. Mount sanuwa, and meet Luna Vanu there.
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_LUNAVANU_000_022: Luna Vanu helps  mount sanuwa again if  falls from steed─just ask. Now, onward to the Gauntlet, and feast of delicious bugs!
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_SYSTEM_000_020: Deep within the hollow, you hear the sound of an insect scurrying about. Speak with Luna Vanu to ride a sanuwa and use its Buffet ability to blast the creature from the hole.
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_LUNAVANU_000_021: We make beautiful catch, ! Plump and juicy... But two more nests remain. Please, hurry to next tree!
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_SYSTEM_000_030: Deep within the hollow, you hear the sound of an insect scurrying about. Speak with Luna Vanu to ride a sanuwa and use its Buffet ability to blast the creature from the hole.
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_LUNAVANU_000_031: Another great catch, ! Only one nest now remains!
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_SYSTEM_000_040: Deep within the hollow, you hear the sound of an insect scurrying about. Speak with Luna Vanu to ride a sanuwa and use its Buffet ability to blast the creature from the hole.
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_LUNAVANU_000_041: Thank you, ! We catch veritable feast for tribe! Let us return to village, and tell Muna Vanu of our success.
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_MUNAVANU_000_050: Welcome back, . Luna Vanu tells Muna Vanu of your work. Each day, tales of your boundless generosity ripple through Ok' Gundu Nakki like rolling thunder echoing across Sea of Clouds.
TEXT_BANVAN105_02175_MUNAVANU_000_051: Muna Vanu hears prey you help catch is large and delicious─sweeter than honey! Luna Vanu shares with tribe, and all is gone within seconds. Please accept my apologies on his behalf. He should share with netherling, too.
TEXT_BANVAN106_02176_MUNAVANU_000_000: Water... Ok' Gundu has no water. Throats of villagers parched like sun-bleached stones. Rainfall is rare thing when above clouds themselves, but spring crystals well with moisture, pouring forth like endless waterfall. Such crystals would quench our tribe's thirst.
TEXT_BANVAN106_02176_MUNAVANU_000_001: They grow large at place netherlings call Voor Sian Siran. Knights of Camp Cloudtop use spring crystals as water source, as once did Gundu, but to harvest them without permission would risk sparking hostilities.
TEXT_BANVAN106_02176_MUNAVANU_000_002: But  is netherling, and can speak with leader of camp to get permission to harvest crystals! Please, speak with knights and gather three spring crystals for Gundu.
TEXT_BANVAN106_02176_LANIAITTE_000_010: The Gundu need spring crystals, do they? I don't see any problem with helping yourself to them. There are more than enough to provide us all with sufficient water.
TEXT_BANVAN106_02176_LANIAITTE_000_011: To be honest, I can't see why they feel the need to ask permission first. They have all lived up here a great deal longer than we have! In any case, I appreciate the courtesy. Please extend my thanks to them.
TEXT_BANVAN106_02176_LANIAITTE_000_015: By far the best place to get your hands on spring crystals is over at Voor Sian Siran. It's some ways east of here.
TEXT_BANVAN106_02176_LANIAITTE_000_030: You seem to be on very good terms with the Gundu,  . With all the work you are doing for them, I daresay you'll find yourself very much in their good graces before long. If only our relationship with them were so genial.
TEXT_BANVAN106_02176_MUNAVANU_000_040: Gundu eagerly await return of . Does netherling bring spring crystals?
TEXT_BANVAN106_02176_MUNAVANU_000_041: Such beautiful crystals they are! Large and clear, like great, majestic lake. Ok' Gundu Nakki's crops go unwatered no longer, and beaks no longer go dry and parched!
TEXT_BANVAN106_02176_MUNAVANU_000_042: To gather water in Sea of Clouds is no easy task. Gundu collect rainwater, but sky is fickle with its generosity. And so we must resort to spring crystals.
TEXT_BANVAN106_02176_MUNAVANU_000_043: Thank you again for reaching out to netherlings on Gundu's behalf. Our warriors and thinkers have talons full in dealing with cruel Vundu menace. But thanks to , we have foundation on which to build relationship with knights of Camp Cloudtop.
TEXT_BANVAN107_02177_MUNAVANU_000_000: , Gundu food stores run dangerously low, but zephyr winds bring perfect opportunity. Anzu lay eggs on island netherlings call the Nidifice, ripe for the taking.
TEXT_BANVAN107_02177_MUNAVANU_000_001: Please, gather three eggs for village's food stores. Be delicate like gentle breeze, however─Vanu cannot eat eggs if shells shatter to pieces!
TEXT_BANVAN107_02177_MUNAVANU_000_010: Welcome back, . Does netherling bring anzu eggs?
TEXT_BANVAN107_02177_MUNAVANU_000_011: To brave fearsome anzu and gather eggs so soon...  is truly courageous, like sapling standing strong against great storm.
TEXT_BANVAN107_02177_MUNAVANU_000_012: Anzu eggs are so delicious, many Vanu eat them shells and all! But eggs netherling gifts us shall be pickled in vinegar, that they may last, and feed tribe well when stores grow low.
TEXT_BANVAN107_02177_MUNAVANU_000_013: Only strongest Gundu warriors stand fearless against anzu. Your bravery is testament to your loyalty. Long will Gundu remember your aid.
TEXT_BANVAN108_02178_MUNAVANU_000_000: Dancing and shouting long into night, wine pouring into gullet endlessly, like waterfall pouring into bottomless hole! Vundu youth have no respect! No respect at all!
TEXT_BANVAN108_02178_MUNAVANU_000_001: Please forgive Muna Vanu's frustrations, netherling. But since we leave Ok' Gundu, Vundu scoundrels strut into former village, party long into night. They think Gundu weak─they think we do nothing!
TEXT_BANVAN108_02178_MUNAVANU_000_002: These nestlings must learn that Ok' Gundu still belongs to us! But still they are nestlings. To harm them would bring full wrath of Vundu tribe upon us. To scare them is best, and nothing scares young ones like blast of wind from full-grown sanuwa!
TEXT_BANVAN108_02178_MUNAVANU_000_003: Vundu youths still skulk about old Ok' Gundu, southeast of here. Luna Vanu prepares sanuwa. Speak with him to borrow one, then go to land that was once our home, and drive these shameless savages from it.
TEXT_BANVAN108_02178_LUNAVANU_000_010: Luna hears of irreverent Vundu youths and their disrespect of our former lands. Please, take my strongest sanuwa and show shameless nestlings that Gundu are no joke!
TEXT_BANVAN108_02178_LUNAVANU_000_011: As greatest sanuwas are strong and spirited, so too are they hard to ride. Return to me should you need mount another beast. Now, go! Go and show Vundu scoundrels our strength!
TEXT_BANVAN108_02178_YOUNGVANUA02178_000: Heheheheh! Chief's wine is hard to steal─closely guarded─but delicious like sweetest nectar!
Aaahhh! ...Wh-What!? You cannot shame warrior of Ok' Vundu like this! When village chief hears of netherling's crimes, force of all Vundu falls upon you like hurricane!
TEXT_BANVAN108_02178_YOUNGVANUB02178_000: Hmmm? Who is this? Perhaps ghost of cowardly Gundu, haunting lost home? Hahahah! ...No. Begone, ugly netherling.
Waaaaahhh! What great storm is this? Fierce like lightning! Powerful like...netherling riding sanuwa!? What trick do scheming Gundu play!?
TEXT_BANVAN108_02178_YOUNGVANUC02178_000: Uuughhh... Head booms like chief's drum at great festival...  pierces eyes like warriors' sharpest spears... Chief's wine is powerful stuff...
Weeeaaahhh! ...Netherling!? To use sanuwa to buffet sleeping Vanu is mean and cowardly! Vundu elder soon hears of your crimes!
TEXT_BANVAN108_02178_MUNAVANU_000_030: Beautiful work, ! Thank you for chasing away foolish Vundu nestlings. They do not forget this lesson soon, I suspect.
TEXT_BANVAN108_02178_MUNAVANU_000_031: To not fight as you are accustomed, but to use sanuwa instead is hassle, no doubt. But spilling blood of nestlings would be too much.
TEXT_BANVAN108_02178_MUNAVANU_000_032: Using powerful buffet of wind from sanuwa is much better. For we Vanu Vanu, buffet from sanuwa is great humiliation, but Muna Vanu hopes these Vundu nestlings can learn from this experience.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_MUNAVANU_000_000: Lately, we hear no news of Vundu movement, . But Muna Vanu knows they are always searching, always spying. We need your help. Please find out what they scheme─what evil plan they hide.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_MUNAVANU_000_001: Netherling knights south of here send scouts out regularly. They intently watch all Vanu Vanu─Vundu, Gundu, Zundu─as griffin looks over land from its perch.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_MUNAVANU_000_002: But they are friendly with you, netherling. Speak with them on behalf of Gundu─and share with us what news they have of sinister Vundu plans.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_RONTREMONT_000_010: You want to know what the Vundu are planning? They have been sending out a frightful number of scouts of late. All signs suggest they are searching for something, though for what, I cannot say.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_RONTREMONT_000_011: This is about the Vundu, is it? Their warriors have been training ceaselessly. A betting man might say they're preparing for war. We even stepped up our patrols somewhat as a precaution.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_RONTREMONT_000_012: You are asking about the Vundu, I take it? You know, we have not heard a peep from them for some time. If you ask me, they were on the wrong end of some tribal dispute or another.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_RONTREMONT_000_013: Clear though it is that the Vundu are plotting something, when it comes to the particulars, your guess is as good as mine.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_RONTREMONT_000_014: We try to keep abreast of the goings-on here as well we can, but when we see something like this brewing, there is not much more we can do but gird ourselves and hope for the storm to pass us by.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_RONTREMONT_000_015: Those Vundu must have really been given what for. They are going quite out of their way to avoid drawing any attention to themselves.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_HARMIETTE_000_020: I really can't say much about the Vanu Vanu, I'm afraid... No, I tell a lie─though I didn't see them myself, one of the other knights mentioned seeing them at Voor Sian Siran.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_HARMIETTE_000_021: Now, I'll admit I didn't see them myself, but the chap who did is a reliable man.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_ROSESKNIGHT02179_00: I didn't see no Vanu Vanu meself, but I've heard folk sayin' they were spotted down at Voor Sian Siran. If ye want to be sure, ye'd do well to head out and take a look yerself.
If ye want to know more about the Vanu Vanu, ye'll have to go to Voor Sian Siran and see for yerself.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_GUARDVANU02179_000_: Unchanging as still night air... Still no sign of pathetic Gundu. Search takes far too long─would be sooner to wait for grass to fall from sky and rain to grow from dirt!
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_GUARDVANU01_000_041: Unchanging as still night air... Our battle with Gundu is yet to start. Chief makes us wait and prepare and wait yet more. How long would he have us delay!?
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_GUARDVANU01_000_042: Unchanging as still night air... But do Gundu and Zundu have such...such power that chieftain would fear them? Or perhaps chief's caution is borne of wisdom, not cowardice.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_SYSTEM_000_043: There is no sign of the Vundu here. Perhaps you will have more luck from a different vantage.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_MUNAVANU_000_050: Dependable as sun rising each morn,  returns─and brings with  valuable information about Vundu treachery, yes?
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_MUNAVANU_000_051: Maybe Vundu have eyes on Gundu lands. Maybe they do not. To lower our guard would be folly, but it brings comfort to know tribe may live without fear of impending Vundu attack─for now.
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_MUNAVANU_000_052: That Vundu still train and prepare means they are not yet ready to attack, giving Gundu time to prepare defense. This time affords us chance to perfect mighty sundrop dance!
TEXT_BANVAN109_02179_MUNAVANU_000_053: Vundu now tremble in fear─quivering like soaked gaelicat in frigid winter gale. Still we must be wary, but we have bought our peace for a time.
TEXT_BANVAN110_02180_MUNAVANU_000_000: Molting season for Vanu Vanu approaches fast, . Feathers from all Vanu Vanu─chief and nestling alike─fall like leaves from autumn trees. Feathers that remain sit haphazard and uneasy─and very uncomfortable! Tribe needs many combs to deal with flurry of down and feathers─many more combs than it has!
TEXT_BANVAN110_02180_MUNAVANU_000_001: Perhaps  can help us. Ok' Zundu is renowned for their combs, strong and long-lasting. But Gundu lack goods to trade for combs.
TEXT_BANVAN110_02180_MUNAVANU_000_002: All Vanu Vanu love taste of freshly caught wamouracampae. Flesh from beasts commands high price─sufficient to supply combs for whole tribe.
TEXT_BANVAN110_02180_MUNAVANU_000_003: But wamouracampae are sly and wily. To draw them from nests is not easy. Find wet straw to south of here─wamourae cannot resist its scent. Burn straw near the beasts' nest, and wait for them to come searching for aroma's source.
TEXT_BANVAN110_02180_MUNAVANU_000_004: Netherling, please kill two wamouracampae and trade for combs. Two give enough meat to barter for a village's worth of combs. Trade from none other than Guna Vanu─he has best combs in all of Ok' Zundu. And remember: most delicious meat of wamoura is from abdomen!
TEXT_BANVAN110_02180_GUNAVANU_000_010: You seek combs for Gundu? Guna Vanu happily gives combs, but first must ask to see what netherling offers in trade.
TEXT_BANVAN110_02180_GUNAVANU_000_011: Wamouracampa flesh!? And such succulent, juicy flesh... Tonight, Guna Vanu's family eats like village chief! Please, take as many combs as you need!
TEXT_BANVAN110_02180_GUNAVANU_000_012: Wamouracampa flesh netherling offers has supreme scent, and is soft like fluffiest summer cloud. Please give thanks to Gundu!
TEXT_BANVAN110_02180_MUNAVANU_000_020: Ah,  returns at last. Does  bring combs for our molting feathers?
TEXT_BANVAN110_02180_MUNAVANU_000_021: Truly beautiful! And strong, too! With these, tribe's feathers lie neat and tidy.
TEXT_BANVAN110_02180_MUNAVANU_000_022: Timing of  is perfect. In mere days, our feathers start to shed. Loose feathers left alone are so itchy Muna Vanu cannot well describe it!
TEXT_BANVAN110_02180_MUNAVANU_000_023: But good combing removes old feathers and leaves fresh feathers in place. Coat shines and shimmers like pond surface in evening sun, and catches eyes of nice young Vanu Vanu ladies...
TEXT_BANVAN110_02180_MUNAVANU_000_024: Ah, Muna Vanu speaks too much. But know that combs are crucial to Vanu way of life. And in molting season, so many combs are broken, even the most well-prepared run out sometimes.
TEXT_BANVAN201_02181_MUNAVANU_000_000: Greetings, netherling. Muna Vanu is concerned about Ranu Vali, who prepares the land for crops. He often sees her with ruffled feathers as she sows seeds, but no juicy bounties of fruit.
TEXT_BANVAN201_02181_MUNAVANU_000_001: Muna offers to help her, but she asks for netherling's assistance instead. Maybe netherling helps sow seeds, too?
TEXT_BANVAN201_02181_RANUVALI_000_010: Ranu Vali is glad netherling came. There is lots to do and scarce to work with for preparing village land for tilling. As of this sun, earth of Ok' Gundu Nakki is dry as dhalmel bones, impossible to grow crops.
TEXT_BANVAN201_02181_RANUVALI_000_011: See here? How it blows away like dust in breeze? Ranu tries sowing and sowing, but soil is not favorable for almonds, or lemons, or even sanuwa relief patch!
TEXT_BANVAN201_02181_RANUVALI_000_012: Even so, Ranu still has hope, remembers soil of old village. Very rich for tilling, very reason why ancestors settle on that spot. If netherling brings ancestors' chosen soil to Ok' Gundu Nakki, Ranu is certain that village grows sweetest lemons in Sea of Clouds!
TEXT_BANVAN201_02181_RANUVALI_000_013: But chosen soil alone will not bear fruit! Wind crystals of Last Step, those touched by fire are also very important for treating barren soil. Might netherling bring those as well? Ranu is very grateful in advance, like dry plains awaiting approaching rainstorm.
TEXT_BANVAN201_02181_RANUVALI_000_014: Wind crystals must be able to balance right amount of soil. Three wind crystals good for about three sackfuls of Gundu soil. Ranu Vali is counting on netherling!
TEXT_BANVAN201_02181_RANUVALI_000_020: Was netherling able to find ancestral soil and wind crystals? Ranu can feel sowing season drawing near on breeze...
TEXT_BANVAN201_02181_RANUVALI_000_021: Yes, ancestors' chosen soil smells exactly as Ranu remembers as nestling! Feels so soft and moist as fresh spring shower!
TEXT_BANVAN201_02181_RANUVALI_000_022: Ranu Vali was worried about leaving Ok' Gundu soil far behind. Dry, dusty land of Ok' Gundu Nakki felt foreign under her feet. But thanks to netherling, little piece of former village returns and island will truly feel like Gundu land!
TEXT_BANVAN201_02181_RANUVALI_000_023: Now real work begins! Ranu must treat dry Ok' Gundu Nakki soil with wind crystals, then mix fertile earth from old Gundu village into crop patch, so two homes become one.
TEXT_BANVAN201_02181_RANUVALI_000_024: Hmmm...it will take a while to sow seeds. Gundu and netherling must wait patiently. But when juicy fruit ready for harvest, taste moves  like mountain!
TEXT_BANVAN202_02182_MUNAVANU_000_000: Buzzing, buzzing in Muna's ear! Vanu know no misery like swarming clouds of midges!
TEXT_BANVAN202_02182_MUNAVANU_000_001: But Vanu not only ones to suffer insects' storm. Muna sees seedling crops wither as well, green leaves of Ranu Vali's garden patch chewed up like battered leaves caught in tornado's path. He wants netherling to ask her if crops can withstand insects' wrath.
TEXT_BANVAN202_02182_RANUVALI_000_010: Ranu Vali burns herbs day and night, but midges continue feasting on Ok' Gundu Nakki's crops! Strong Gundu can endure small annoyances, but when insects eat up all village's food, even strong Gundu become weak!
TEXT_BANVAN202_02182_RANUVALI_000_011: Sure as sun, Ranu knows pesky vilekin not from Ok' Gundu Nakki. Midges must be riding on wind stream, blown here from remote areas near Ok' Zundu. For sake of growing field, Ranu pleads with netherling to find midge breeding grounds and get rid of them using sanuwa's breath!
TEXT_BANVAN202_02182_RANUVALI_000_012: If netherling does not own sanuwa, ask Luna Vanu to borrow village one. With swarms bothering every Vanu in village, he will not refuse netherling's request.
TEXT_BANVAN202_02182_RANUVALI_000_013: Ask Luna Vanu to borrow sanuwa and get rid of midge pests in surrounding islands. Oh no, there are so many on my plants!
TEXT_BANVAN202_02182_LUNAVANU_000_020: Netherling wishes to borrow sanuwa to get rid of midges? Luna also tires of swatting noisy clouds, he is happy to lend  village sanuwa! This one grows especially angry with pests, will blow them away with fiercest gale!
TEXT_BANVAN202_02182_LUNAVANU_000_021: If netherling wishes to ride sanuwa, let Luna know. His sanuwa upset with buzzing midges as much as any Vanu, bluster them so greatly their wings fall off!
TEXT_BANVAN202_02182_RANUVALI_000_022: Sanuwa is very important for dissolving midge clouds. Ask Luna Vanu to borrow sanuwa for saving Gundu crops.
TEXT_BANVAN202_02182_SYSTEM_000_025:
The midges seethe in a cloud, producing a loud humming sound. 
Speak to Luna Vanu in Ok' Gundu Nakki to ride a sanuwa and use its breath to disperse the swarm.
TEXT_BANVAN202_02182_RANUVALI_000_030: Ranu Vali's ears hear only sound of breeze rustling leaves now. Surely this is sign that pests will soon trouble Ok' Gundu Nakki's crops no more. Her gratitude towards netherling's effort is boundless!
TEXT_BANVAN202_02182_RANUVALI_000_031: Netherling might not know, but midges breed easily in small pools where rainwater collects. If there are no villages around to make sure insects don't thrive, midge clouds swell like storm clouds, and appetite grows.
TEXT_BANVAN202_02182_RANUVALI_000_032: Tiny insects fly too fast for Vanu to swat away with thick talons, but sanuwa's gusty breath is very strong, kills pesky midges easily. Netherling should remember next time midges irritate .
TEXT_BANVAN203_02183_MUNAVANU_000_000: Muna Vanu notices Eenu Vanu does not seem himself. Even as fishing line twitches and jerks, he looks off into distance as if storm gathers on horizon. Netherling, please help solve Eenu Vanu's troubles before food stores run dry as summer desert.
TEXT_BANVAN203_02183_EENUVANU_000_010: Oh... Greetings, netherling. Eenu is somewhat troubled about fellow Zundu cloudfisher. Often we swap advice on fishing spots where zephyr winds blow strongest.
TEXT_BANVAN203_02183_EENUVANU_000_011: Eenu shares secret of fishing cliffs near sacred ground of Neverreap, and friend goes alone. But cliffs are home to ferocious beasts, and greedy Vundu cloudfishers swarm the area like midges to wisent dung.
TEXT_BANVAN203_02183_EENUVANU_000_012: Even though friend says he is not afraid of such things, Eenu worries about danger of fishing alone in Vundu territory, and has not heard from him since last sunrise. Would netherling check on his well-being?
TEXT_BANVAN203_02183_EENUVANU_000_013: Eenu must stay and catch village's next meal, but netherling need not fear going alone─ looks strong enough to scare away Vundu, beast, and fish!
TEXT_BANVAN203_02183_VANUFISHER02183_000: Bah, even small gust of wind sends Eenu Vanu into fit of worry! Hush now, netherling. Zephyr winds bring fat cloudfish nibbling on my line!
Noisy netherling scares away big catch! ...Oh? Paissas try to steal my fish? If clumsy paissa startles me, I fall into cloud sea! Netherling deserves show of thanks for saving me from hungry paissas!
Fat cloudfish escapes from line, but soon zephyr winds bring him back to me. Tell Eenu that I linger a little longer, then return to swap stories over campfire.
TEXT_BANVAN203_02183_EENUVANU_000_030: Paissas sneak up behind him to steal fish!? Eenu thought Vundu cloudfishers more threatening, but he did not know even paissas can be dangerous.
TEXT_BANVAN203_02183_EENUVANU_000_031: Cloudfishers concentrate very hard on big catch, and sometimes forget surroundings. A surprise at wrong time can prove fatal, but death by ungainly paissa...thought mortifies Vanu worse than forgetting sundrop dance!
TEXT_BANVAN203_02183_EENUVANU_000_032: He will return to village soon? Good. Next time, Eenu goes with friend so he is not alone at mercy of sneaky paissas. He thanks netherling for saving friend from terrible fate.
TEXT_BANVAN203_02183_VANUFISHER02183_000: Zephyr winds sure to bring fat cloudfish back to me. Tell Eenu Vanu I return to village soon to show him biggest catch of day!
TEXT_BANVAN204_02184_MUNAVANU_000_000: Muna's stomach stirs like tornado, but tires of crunchy roasted insects. He wants nice plump cloudfish! Might netherling ask Eenu Vanu when next catch comes to Ok' Gundu Nakki?
TEXT_BANVAN204_02184_EENUVANU_000_010: Hmm...village wants fattened fish, but fish are hard to come by lately. Village's fish float on wind streams blowing from east, but Vundu tribe snatching up the great hauls near sacred ground of Neverreap as soon as fish grow plump! By the time cloudfish reach Ok' Gundu Nakki on wind stream, numbers dwindle.
TEXT_BANVAN204_02184_EENUVANU_000_011: Like biting midges, pesky Vundu cloudfishers must be driven away! Eenu knows netherling is very good at ruffling Vundu feathers. He asks netherling to ride sanuwa to Ok' Vundu Vana, use sanuwa's blustery breath to scare fish down wind stream, away from greedy cloudfishers!
TEXT_BANVAN204_02184_EENUVANU_000_012: Eenu is sure Luna Vanu will let netherling ride one of his sanuwa if there is promise of nice cloudfish. Go, full stomachs of Gundu tribe depend on netherling!
TEXT_BANVAN204_02184_EENUVANU_000_013: Vundu cloudfishers think not about fish of tomorrow, only care about day's catch. With their greed, soon no fish at all!
TEXT_BANVAN204_02184_LUNAVANU_000_020: Netherling wants to ride Luna's sanuwa? Scare juicy fish away from Vundu? Of course, of course! This one has most blustery breath, sure to break cloudfisher concentration!
TEXT_BANVAN204_02184_LUNAVANU_000_021: Whenever netherling wants to ride sanuwa to annoy Vundu, let Luna know.
TEXT_BANVAN204_02184_EENUVANU_000_022: Vundu don't even eat whole fish! Only take bite from juiciest part and throw away! Wasteful as trying to barter with rain...
TEXT_BANVAN204_02184_VANUFISHERA02184_00: Netherling braves Vundu village to witness greatness of cloudfishers? Well, come no closer! Takes many moons to find best fishing spot, only genius cloudfishers present biggest fish to Vundu chief for favorable status!
Netherling cloddish as witless paissa! Best fishing spot in Ok' Vundu made barren by sanuwa's rancid breath! Ruined! Foolish netherling, now I must start search all over!
TEXT_BANVAN204_02184_VANUFISHERB02184_00: I know not what netherling does in Ok' Vundu, but warn  not to step in front of favorable zephyr wind. Soon I will catch hearts of all buxom females in village with promise of loads of plump fish!
TEXT_BANVAN204_02184_VANUFISHERA02184_00: Uwaaah! Look what netherling has done! Sanuwa's forceful gust knocks fish back into wind stream! Long hours, sweet promises to females blown away in single gale... Netherling will rue this day!
TEXT_BANVAN204_02184_EENUVANU_000_040: Sanuwa pelts cloudfishers and cloudfishers stomp and shout at netherling? Eenu wishes he could see cloudfishers' faces! Damaging Vundu fisher pride and fish returning to wind stream is like old Vanu saying: striking two paissas with single lightning bolt!
TEXT_BANVAN204_02184_EENUVANU_000_041: Eenu's gratitude is boundless. By next sun, Ok' Gundu Nakki will be overflowing with fat cloudfish!
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_MUNAVANU_000_000: Ah, ! Once again your help is sorely needed. Ginu Vanu is troubled with construction of huts. Perhaps netherling might ask what is delaying work?
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_GINUVANU_000_010: Yes, construction takes much too long. But materials are terrible! Walls hold together with wood joints and tiny bones. But tiny bones are brittle, snap like twig under dhalmel's heel. We need good nails to hold walls.
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_GINUVANU_000_011: Netherling knights make hard, metal nails. Will netherling trade with them? Ginu Vanu suggests bartering with tsanahale meat.
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_GINUVANU_000_012: But tsanahale flesh spoils quickly. Flavor is gone in mere hours, like fleeting blossom of blooming daylily. Netherling must hunt tsanahales and deliver meat while still fresh.
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_GINUVANU_100_012: Healthiest and most delicious tsanahales are wary of any who approach. To find best prey, good bait is needed. To south of Ok' Gundu Nakki, find wamoura, favorite snack of tsanahales.
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_GINUVANU_000_013: Use meat of wamoura to catch them on small island netherling knights call Provenance. Meat from one tsanahale will give much for trade. But with meat from two, netherling knights cannot refuse.
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_GINUVANU_000_014: Netherling can find scraps of wamoura meat to south of here. Many tsanahales will swarm, like moths to flame, but two should be enough.
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_GINUVANU_000_015: Yes, netherling knights will be very pleased. And huts need many, many nails. Be quick, netherling. Tsanahale meat must not spoil!
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_GINUVANU_000_020: Netherling can find scraps of wamoura meat to south of here. Many tsanahales will swarm, like moths to flame, but two should be enough.
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_GINUVANU_000_021: Yes, netherling knights will be very pleased. And huts need many, many nails. Be quick, netherling. Tsanahale meat must not spoil!
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_FABRELLET_000_030: You wish to trade for nails on behalf of the Gundu? If the exchange is fair, I see no reason not to oblige them. What do they have to offer?
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_FABRELLET_000_031: Fresh meat from the tsanahale! It's been too long since the camp has seen anything so rich and flavorful. You have a deal. Should they have need of more supplies, tell them they're more than welcome to trade with us again.
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_FABRELLET_000_032: A reprieve from the salted meats delivered from Ishgard is always welcome. I can only hope the Gundu choose to trade with us more often.
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_GINUVANU_000_040: Were netherling knights happy to take meat? Do they accept trade for metal nails?
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_GINUVANU_000_041: Oh! Ginu Vanu did not expect to get so many! Now Gundu huts will be strong like great oak, weathering even fiercest storms.
TEXT_BANVAN301_02185_GINUVANU_000_042: Many thanks, netherling. If we need more supplies, Ginu Vanu will remember tsanahale meat fetches high price from netherling knights.
TEXT_BANVAN302_02186_MUNAVANU_000_000: Like rays of sun, fortune shines upon Muna Vanu.  comes at most opportune time. Ginu Vanu needs help with building new hut and could make use of netherling's skills. Speak with him and see what must be done.
TEXT_BANVAN302_02186_GINUVANU_000_010: So, this is Gundu's new home? Hmmm...Ginu Vanu thinks village needs something extra. Like rainbow cloud in summer sky, Ok' Gundu Nakki should catch eyes of all Vanu.
TEXT_BANVAN302_02186_GINUVANU_000_011: That is why Ginu Vanu plans to build a majestic hut of stone, and needs the sturdiest there is─rocks from groundsreaper golems. Please netherling, travel to islands far in the east, and collect their rocks for the Gundu's new hut.
TEXT_BANVAN302_02186_GINUVANU_000_012: Rocks from groundsreapers make great hut. It shines like single ray of sun through stormy clouds.
TEXT_BANVAN302_02186_GINUVANU_000_020: Hut of stone tower over all like redwood among maple, taller than any other village's. But Ginu Vanu cannot start without groundsreaper rocks.
TEXT_BANVAN302_02186_GINUVANU_000_021: Smooth, and very little weathering. Netherling does well─these stones make perfect hut.
TEXT_BANVAN302_02186_GINUVANU_000_022: Groundsreapers are children of islands. For thirst they drink rain. For sustenance they breathe clouds and eat soil. Then, after many years, they return to ground and become one with earth, like rejoining family.
TEXT_BANVAN302_02186_GINUVANU_000_023: Netherling brings stones from very young groundsreapers. They hold firm against wind and drink rain to stay strong. Where storm would damage normal hut, this hut grows like tree basking in sunlight.
TEXT_BANVAN302_02186_GINUVANU_000_025: Impressive, yes? Ginu Vanu cannot make big house of metal like netherlings, but huts in Ok' Gundu Nakki will be just as good. Just as tough.
TEXT_BANVAN303_02187_MUNAVANU_000_000: Muna Vanu is young hatchling no longer, but somehow hunting must─ Oh, ! Of course. Muna Vanu should have called netherling sooner.
TEXT_BANVAN303_02187_MUNAVANU_000_001: Ginu Vanu seeks hunter to help gather materials for hut building. Speak with him and see what supplies are required.
TEXT_BANVAN303_02187_GINUVANU_000_010: Netherling will collect building supplies for Ginu Vanu? Huts must stand tall and strong like great oak, but Ginu Vanu doesn't want wood. No, Ginu Vanu wants bones of dhalmel.
TEXT_BANVAN303_02187_GINUVANU_000_011: But netherling must look for strong, healthy dhalmels at Last Step. If dhalmel is too old, bones will be frail. If dhalmel is still calf, well...Ginu Vanu doesn't want bones from baby. Bring back femurs and shinbones, then Ginu Vanu can build great hut.
TEXT_BANVAN303_02187_GINUVANU_000_012: Dhalmels always graze at Last Step. Should be easy to find. But remember: no bones from elderly dhalmels or baby calves. Ginu Vanu needs clean conscience for building.
TEXT_BANVAN303_02187_GINUVANU_000_020: Netherling find bones from strong, healthy dhalmels?
TEXT_BANVAN303_02187_GINUVANU_000_021: Oh! Netherling does great work! Slain dhalmels must still be in prime to have bones so stout.
TEXT_BANVAN303_02187_GINUVANU_000_022: Femur of dhalmel is very tough, and shinbone is flexible─perfect for building frame of new hut. Vanu always prefer them over wood.
TEXT_BANVAN303_02187_GINUVANU_000_023: Homes made with these bones will stand strong and tall─worthy of dhalmels whose sacrifice made these huts possible.
TEXT_BANVAN304_02188_MUNAVANU_000_000: Thank goodness netherling is here. Ginu Vanu tells Muna Vanu of grave problem with lack of dye to paint huts.
TEXT_BANVAN304_02188_MUNAVANU_000_001: He has plan for retrieving ingredients, but maybe too risky for Gundu. Netherling may be more suited to the task.
TEXT_BANVAN304_02188_GINUVANU_000_010: As sunshine assists in drying dampened wings, netherling has also come to assist Ginu Vanu? He welcomes netherling's enthusiasm!
TEXT_BANVAN304_02188_GINUVANU_000_011: Soon Ginu Vanu completes building of Gundu huts, but they are missing something very important. Huts must be painted with beautiful colors, made from special dye.
TEXT_BANVAN304_02188_GINUVANU_000_012: When Ginu Vanu comes to Ok' Gundu Nakki, he brings only the essential building tools he could carry, few resources to make paint. But Vundu village is big, lots of huts, which means lots of spare dye. Ginu Vanu thinks if netherling strikes quick like lightning, Vundu will never know  takes them.
TEXT_BANVAN304_02188_GINUVANU_000_013: Entering Vundu territory dangerous for Gundu, but Ginu Vanu needs three pots of dye or huts will not be finished. Hurry now, beautiful huts count on netherling!
TEXT_BANVAN304_02188_BALLOON_000_020: (-Vundu Warrior-)Stop, netherling! Lay down dye pot or lay down life!
TEXT_BANVAN304_02188_GINUVANU_000_030: Zephyr winds bring netherling back sooner than expected. Did netherling find dye pots in Vundu village?
TEXT_BANVAN304_02188_GINUVANU_000_031: Ginu Vanu will do great work with these. Breathing life into home will be easy task with such vibrant color.
TEXT_BANVAN304_02188_GINUVANU_000_032: Netherling may not know, but every tribe has special color to represent Vanu spirit. Our Zundu friends use fiery red, and thanks to netherling, Ginu Vanu will use dye to make Gundu hut color a light azure hue, like calm sky on cloudless day.
TEXT_BANVAN304_02188_GINUVANU_000_033: Finally Gundu has tribe color to make house into home. Thank you, netherling. Painting with colors of wind, Ginu Vanu will put heart and soul into finishing Gundu huts.
TEXT_BANVAN401_02189_02189_MUNAVANU_000_: The winds bring strange tidings from Ok' Zundu, netherling. Rumors of the world cloaked in darkness, according to Zundu legend.
Linu Vanu is as perplexed about this as rain falling in sunlight, and seeks netherling's help to make sense of it.
TEXT_BANVAN401_02189_02189_LINUVANU_000_: Netherling, Linu hears strange whispers about nestlings of Ok' Zundu. They are restless, swirling with stories of return of a beast of legend─beast that rides the wind with great wings and brings everlasting night.

Linu is curious about such rumors. Zundu tribe has feathers and talons same as Gundu, but eyes see different beasts and beaks tell different tales through the ages. Linu knows little of this airborne creature which cloaks Sea of Clouds in midnight shade.
Might netherling venture to Ok' Zundu to hear nestlings' tale and bring it back to Linu?
Linu wishes to know more about Zundu legend. If legend is true, then Gundu should also respect and fear this flying beast.
TEXT_BANVAN401_02189_02189_ZUNDU02189_00: Clouds grow darker day by day, netherling. Feathers of great flying beast of Zundu legend attack nestlings! As grass thirsts for rain clouds, nestlings know that the beast thirsts for show of fighting spirit. If booming display of might does not satisfy beast, it punishes tribe, world cloaked in shade forever!
We ask Gunu Vanu, Bringer of Shade, for help, but he believes nestlings not. He tells us great beast's feathers do not stir, even though feathers bite us on tail end!

Nestlings no match for biting feathers, but netherling looks strong, fearless! If netherling displays mighty dance, maybe great flying beast becomes full like storm cloud filling with rain! Come, I take you, northeast of Ok' Zundu!
Right here! Right here! We saw feather here when playing in the sun! Wait and see!
Netherling's fighting spirit is so powerful that feathers stay their biting! But this is not only place nestlings see feathers. Come, I will take netherling to another place!
There! They appear at cliff's edge while nestlings pick flowers! Now, show feathers netherling's dance of wrath!

Netherling's display of might is savage as stinging hailstorm. Great flying beast surely trembles with joy! I shower netherling with thanks, and return to tell others of new legend seen with own eyes.
TEXT_BANVAN401_02189_02189_LINUVANU_000_: Netherling has returned, but Linu Vanu already hears of soft chattering of Zundu nestlings' new hero. It would seem netherling has driven away the beast of midnight shade!
Netherling has Linu's gratitude for helping Zundu nestlings. Sometimes tribe elders disregard nestling worries, but  shows belief from small beaks has small truths.
Thanks to netherling, Linu also understands trouble that comes with feathers' presence. Gundu tribe also keeps careful watch on Ok' Gundu Nakki for signs of legendary beast's feathers.
TEXT_BANVAN402_02190_02190_MUNAVANU_000_: Oh...? Forgive Muna, netherling. He did not see you approach. His head feels clouded like thick fog after receiving news from former homeland about ancestral burial ground.
Muna fears forefathers' memory has been blackened like darkest night... What to do...
TEXT_BANVAN402_02190_02190_LINUVANU_000_: Netherling asks about gloomy fog following Muna Vanu? Linu explains, for gloom is his as well. After leaving Ok' Gundu, Vundu shamans enter old village, spilling curses upon totems at ancestral resting places. Now ancestors cannot rest peacefully, disturbed by totems' dark chanting.
Linu and Muna regret not our cause for independence, yet ancestors' memory dusted with foul magicks is terrible affront to any Vanu's honor. Cursed totems are worse than no totems at all!
Perhaps netherling can raise Muna's spirits. Linu tells  where ancestral grounds are in Ok' Gundu so  can destroy sullied totems.
Linu asks netherling to destroy totems in Ok' Gundu. Then both the living and the dead can rest peacefully.
Netherling silences offending totems? Then  protects ancestors' honor. Linu is sure that when Muna Vanu hears, fog enveiling him clears away.

Fate of ancestors' resting place is uncertain, may take moons before new totems built to replace lost ones. But Linu is relieved in knowing spirits of ancestors now sleep peacefully as soft spring breeze.
TEXT_BANVAN403_02191_02191_MUNAVANU_000_: Does netherling notice hole in Muna's sash, like crescent moon peeking out from clouds in shame? Muna tries to spear plump cloudfish, but spears sash instead!
Perhaps Linu Vanu can make new sash for Muna. But Muna is too ashamed of own sash to ask himself. Might netherling talk to Linu Vanu in his stead?
TEXT_BANVAN403_02191_02191_LINUVANU_000_: Ah, yes. Linu also notices own sash needs tending. Vanu have great pride in traditional sash, its shimmering silk is mark of craftsmanship.

But truth be told, Gundu work hard in mud and dust to establish new home. Sashes Gundu escape with become worn, and start to smell foul like rain-soaked wisent. Maybe if Vundu see unkempt sashes, they think Gundu not prosperous on Ok' Gundu Nakki, try to prey on weakness.
Linu asks netherling to harvest wamoura cocoons in the east with which to weave new sashes. Four cocoons should glean enough silk to replace all sashes in tribe.
We must show Vundu that our village shines after their maltreatment, like rainbow after thunderstorm.
Linu asks netherling to harvest wamoura cocoons in the east with which to weave new sashes. Four cocoons should glean enough silk to replace all sashes in tribe.
Does netherling bring silk cocoons Linu asks for? He discovers another loose thread in own sash...
Ah...soft and white as puffed cloud; round as full moon on winter night. Netherling brings Linu such beautiful cocoons!
From these, Linu pulls strands of silk to weave into brilliant sashes. Vundu surely tremble with jealousy like leaf in gale when they lay eyes upon shining Gundu of Nakki!

Ah, did netherling by chance feel any wiggling from cocoons? If so, then Linu is lucky, for wamoura grubs are special snack when weaving. Very juicy and tender, slides down gullet smoothly. Netherling should try sometime!
TEXT_BANVAN404_02192_02192_MUNAVANU_000_: Ah, netherling graces us with  presence!
Ginu Vanu has been looking for netherling. He busily prepares nests for first roost and says he is in need of netherling's strong, firm grip and movement fast as lightning.
TEXT_BANVAN404_02192_02192_GINUVANU_000_: Netherling always comes at right time, like raindrops falling on wilted leaves. Will  help Ginu with very important task?

Ginu is so very busy, fluffing up newly built nests for new life on Ok' Gundu Nakki. He needs netherling to bring him gaelicats to complete nests. But make sure cats are unharmed. They must be happy, full of life! If netherling brings dead gaelicats, Ginu feels downpour of sadness.

Ginu gives you Gundu tribe's secret dried herb to catch flying cats easily. If netherling holds this under gaelicat's nose, it becomes happy...very happy. Five cats should be enough for Ginu to complete nests. Now, go, netherling! Zephyr winds at your back!
Only gaelicat knows why herb makes him happy. Clear as sunlight, Ginu knows herb has no effect on him.
TEXT_BANVAN404_02192_02192_SYSTEM_000_04: The stray gaelicat bristles its fur.
TEXT_BANVAN404_02192_02192_GINUVANU_000_: Has netherling brought what Ginu asks? No scratches? No bruised wings?
Ah, yes! Gaelicats roll warmly like distant thunder on summer night! Much thanks to netherling for bringing good stock!
What do gaelicats have to do with building nests, netherling asks? Tradition! When nests complete for roosting, start of new life follows the path wind blows.

Gaelicats are lucky, know very well of which wind bodes good fortune. So Ginu releases gaelicats back to sky to show which way nest should face. If cats fly west, nest faces west! If cats scatter to four corners...well, any direction is good direction!
TEXT_BANVAN501_02193_02193_MUNAVANU_000_: Prevailing winds bring  to Muna Vanu once more. Ranu Vali seeks help. Please seek Ranu Vali, and offer help.
TEXT_BANVAN501_02193_02193_RANUVALI_000_: Like cloud bringing shade on scorching summer day,  is truly welcome sight! You are perfect one to help with Ranu Vali's work!
Ranu Vali needs korrigans─needs netherling to pull them from soil where they sprout. Easy work, but we Vanu cannot handle horrible sound of korrigans screaming in agony when leaving ground.
Please go to Last Step, and uproot mandragoras there. Four is sufficient.
Korrigans are at Last Step. Please dig up four for Ranu Vali.
Many thanks, ! Without netherling's help, Ranu Vali struggles like starflower in summer storm, but you harvest korrigans without difficulty!
Ranu Vali treats wives of Ok' Zundu to traditional Gundu feast. Netherling's gift of korrigans, when sliced and marinated in honey, provides finishing touch that completes perfect Gundu banquet!
TEXT_BANVAN502_02194_02194_MUNAVANU_000_: Perhaps if Muna Vanu plucks off own feathers, then─ Oh! ! Your arrival is as unexpected─and welcome─as refreshing summer shower!
Gundu wish to honor kind Zundu with gift of appreciation. But we have no materials to decorate gift worthy of such charitable tribe.
But netherling can help!  and trader Luna Vanu can gather materials so Muna Vanu can make gift that honors tribe.
TEXT_BANVAN502_02194_02194_LUNAVANU_000_: Muna Vanu thinks to use own feathers for decorations!? Muna Vanu's feathers are dull and tattered─might just as well use thatch!
We need soft, fluffy feathers, with colors brilliant and iridescent as rainbow after midday summer shower. Hmmm... Feathers of gastornis are most ideal.
If netherling travels to Cloudtop and gathers three gastornis feathers, Luna Vanu is very grateful! Beasts need not be slain─feathers can be found in nests of gastornis.
Feathers of gastornis are most brilliant and lustrous. Find them at Cloudtop.
Netherling returns! Does  have beautiful gastornis feathers?
Luna Vanu is right to rely on . Feathers of Muna Vanu are hard and dull, like long-dead tree. But these feathers are soft and colorful, like sprightly young sapling, resplendent with fresh blossoms!
These feathers let us make mask more beautiful than field, lush and rampant with wildflowers. I make beautiful gift to show true appreciation for Zundu!
TEXT_BANVAN503_02195_02195_MUNAVANU_000_: Greetings . Tribe requires netherling's aid in task only  can carry out. Go to Linu Vanu to learn details of task.
TEXT_BANVAN503_02195_02195_LINUVANU_000_: Hello again, . Linu Vanu wishes once again to borrow your aid in matter of grave import. Gundu wish to develop relations with netherling knights.
Tribe wishes to form bonds much like it has with Zundu, to help bring prosperity in this new independence. Linu Vanu wishes to present gift to them.
Sadly, any Gundu who goes now receives cold greeting. But you are trusted, and can deliver catsfoot chews as gifts from our tribe. Please, deliver these gifts to Laniaitte at Camp Cloudtop.
Linu Vanu wishes he could be there when netherlings receive gifts. Take them to Laniaitte at Camp Cloudtop.
Linu Vanu hopes for day he can deliver gifts in person. Until that day, we must place confidence in netherling's capable hands.
TEXT_BANVAN503_02195_02195_LANIAITTE_000: Gifts for the Rose Knights, you say? From the Gundu?
Thank you for these,  . They look─and smell─absolutely delicious!

I could never eat this all myself. The troops out on patrol are far more deserving of it. Please, do me one small favor and take it out to them. I have no doubt at all that they would be glad for the sustenance.
The knights have been out on patrol for some time now. They would all appreciate something to eat─especially something as delicious as authentic catsfoot chews.
TEXT_BANVAN503_02195_02195_NEMUSOU02195_: ...Wha─ Just resting my eyes, sir! ...Oh, you're not the commander! What? You have something for me?
A gift from the Gundu!? And food, too! Thank the gods. Now I'll have the energy to get through the rest of my shift without dozing off.
That catsfoot chew was just delicious! But a full belly always makes me feel so sleepy... <yawn>
TEXT_BANVAN503_02195_02195_OKUSOU02195_0: These patrol routes are far too long. We all end up so tired and hungry before we're finished, that if we ran into something dangerous, we'd be in no state to fend it off!
What, what? A gift from the Vanu Vanu? I do hope it's food. I hear Vanu cuisine must be tasted to be believed! ...And uh, besides, an army marches on its stomach, you know!
What did you say this was called? “Catsfoot chew”? Whatever the case, it's utterly marvelous. Do tell me where I can get more!
TEXT_BANVAN503_02195_02195_HIMASHOU02195: The unparalleled honor of a sentinel─tirelessly guarding the Rose Knights from the greatest threats of the realm... Gods I'm so bored.
Hm? The Gundu have sent me a gift? Well, it smells decent enough. And it'll provide some distraction from the mind-numbing drudgery of watching nothing happen all day.
I know it's a good thing that these patrols are so uneventful, but it's just so boring─it's driving me crazy.
TEXT_BANVAN503_02195_02195_LINUVANU_000_: Ah, so gifts now rest in bellies of netherling soldiers?  has my heartfelt thanks.

Netherling knights seem to love our food. So Linu Vanu makes catsfoot chews with ancient recipe passed down through generations. Fragrance is more heavenly than smell of newly cropped grain, or fresh-woven cloth drying in afternoon sun, and flavor is even better!
Gundu tribe thanks you again. Relationship between Camp Cloudtop and Gundu grows ever closer thanks to your efforts.
TEXT_BANVAN504_02196_02196_MUNAVANU_000_: Hmmm... But who is skilled enough to... Oh,  arrives at perfect moment!
Muna Vanu has need of paissa─lively one, full of spirit. But catching paissa takes time, and I have responsibilities to tribe and cannot spare such time.
, please catch paissa for Muna Vanu. Best way is to dig hole. Paissa falls right into hole and cannot get out. Many paissas roam west of Ok' Gundu. Hunt there, and catch prey alive in this sack.
TEXT_BANVAN504_02196_02196_SYSTEM_000_04: You slip the struggling paissa into the sack.
TEXT_BANVAN504_02196_02196_MUNAVANU_000_: returns! Does  catch fit and sprightly paissa?
Yes! Yes! Many thanks! Fluffy like summer storm cloud, sprightly like zephyr wind. Muna Vanu wins for certain now, cannot lose with this perfect paissa!
Ah... Perhaps Muna Vanu gets carried away. Friend from Ok' Zundu lays challenge in paissafight, and to lose brings shame to all Gundu!

Although we owe Zundu great debt, we cannot let them win. Honor of whole tribe depends on fight! I train this paissa to defeat Zundu paissa─
without mercy.
TEXT_BANVAN601_02197_02197_MUNAVANU_000_: Hup, hup, hup... Oh! ! Muna Vanu embarrasses himself! He does not realize netherling watches him like this!

We must all perfect mighty sundrop dance, and ideal dance requires good rhythm. We practice daily, but Muna Vanu's responsibilities grow and grow, like weeds upon untended field. With no time to practice, Linu Vanu berates me, says my timing is poor!
He berates us all, but  performs sundrop dance as skillfully as our fiercest warriors. Better, even, than Muna Vanu! Please, help us. Speak to Linu Vanu and see what can be done.
TEXT_BANVAN601_02197_02197_LINUVANU_000_: Arrival of  is as welcome as cool breeze on hot summer afternoon. Netherling offers to help Gundu yet again? An offer most welcome.
To demonstrate power, we perform sundrop dance. We let Vundu see that we are force to be reckoned with. But lately dances lack strength, lack coordination, lack power. Gundu nestlings lose heart...

But if they see netherling perform sundrop dance with spirit and fervor, they are inspired to greatness! Find nestlings stationed at Hengr's Crucible, and show them all marvelous sundrop dance. Inspire them!
Our nestlings lose hope. But if they see netherling's supreme sundrop dance, they will know─if netherling can perfect dance, then they, with blood of Gundu coursing through veins, can perfect it too.
TEXT_BANVAN601_02197_02197_GUNDUA02197_0: Hup, hup, hah...? Hiyah...? No, no, no... How can I practice sundrop dance when I cannot remember moves!? If only I have example to follow...
This dance─it is perfect! Netherling's moves are smooth and certain, like flowing water. I am inspired! I too shall perfect sundrop dance and strike fear into hearts of savage Vundu!
TEXT_BANVAN601_02197_02197_GUNDUB02197_0: <huff> Stupid...<huff>...sundrop dance...<pant>... I never want to practice it again!
Netherling's dance is powerful and beautiful, like tornado on evening horizon. If I dance like this, girls of Ok' Gundu Nakki cannot hold themselves back!
TEXT_BANVAN601_02197_02197_GUNDUC02197_0: Left wing...up. Right wing...down... Motion is easy, but how can dance have power? How can I give dance spirit?
Yes! Yes! Netherling's dance wells with power and spirit. I follow your example, and shall become inspiration to Gundu.
TEXT_BANVAN601_02197_02197_GUNDUD02197_0: Like this...? No. Like...this! Hmmm. That is not it either. Why must sundrop dance be so difficult!?
Like rays of sun, illuminating islands at dawn, netherling's energy shines strong and clear! I think I have it. I think I understand the dance! I make new start, at new practice place.
TEXT_BANVAN601_02197_02197_LINUVANU_000_: Enthusiasm of  inspires and motivates nestlings of Ok' Gundu Nakki. They practice sundrop dance with newfound zeal!

has Linu Vanu's gratitude. We do not have as many warriors as Vundu. We cannot afford to fight directly. But if all Gundu warriors perform sundrop dance with same ardor as netherling, no tribe dares challenge us!
TEXT_BANVAN602_02198_02198_MUNAVANU_000_: Greetings, ! Linu Vanu searches for you!
No doubt he wishes to ask netherling's help. Please seek Linu Vanu, and find out what he wants.
TEXT_BANVAN602_02198_02198_LINUVANU_000_: How fortunate─just as Linu Vanu seeks ,  arrives! I wish to borrow skills of netherling that perfected mighty sundrop dance!
We hear rumors that the Vundu train powerful warriors, whose command of sundrop dance rivals even our greatest dancers. This must not be! This menace must be stopped before it grows too strong.
Please seek out Vundu dancers and show them full glory of Gundu sundrop dance. Make them know folly of daring to eclipse us!
Go to Vundu village! Show them mighty sundrop dance and let them cower, like new-hatched nestlings trembling before booming thunderstorm!
TEXT_BANVAN602_02198_02198_VUNDU02198_00: This is Vundu land─begone! Netherling like you has no right to stand before mighty Vundu sundrop dancer!
Wh-What!? Mere netherling masters sundrop dance!?  piercing gaze, sharper than claws of fiercest anzu...  commanding presence, overpowering like devastating gale...
I can stand it no longer!
Hmph! What brings netherling to Ok' Vundu? Foolish thing like you─who knows not even the sundrop dance─is not safe here.
But─but netherlings cannot perform so flawless a dance! It is not possible!
style is impetuous!  defense is impregnable! I must retreat!
Netherling approaches, but does not attack? Does  plan to challenge great Vundu with sundrop dance!?
Such masterful dancing. I cannot believe it! Its power washes over me like endless torrent from vast waterfall!
I cannot suffer this to be! Rage wells within me like great blazing furnace! Wait here, netherling! I return with most monstrous weapons I own and destroy you!
TEXT_BANVAN602_02198_02198_LINUVANU_000_: Word spreads fast, ─faster than herd of frightened dhalmels. Linu Vanu hears of netherling's victory over Vundu savages!
Through netherling's unrivaled power, Vundu threat is quashed before it can cause us real problems.
You have Linu Vanu's thanks, , and thanks of whole Gundu tribe. Linu Vanu fears even he might not stand up to netherling's fearsome sundrop dance... He must practice dancing himself, he thinks.
TEXT_BANVAN603_02199_02199_MUNAVANU_000_: ! Linu Vanu leaves word that he wishes to speak with you. He seems worried. Please speak with him when you can spare time to aid our tribe once more.
TEXT_BANVAN603_02199_02199_LINUVANU_000_: Ah, , dependable as always, you have come to hear my plea.

Yesterday, Linu Vanu releases gaelicat to skies, to divine omens and peer into Gundu's future. But gaelicat lurches and falls from sky like great gaelicat-shaped stone! Portent is real and clear as morning sky: Gundu ancestors─ great heroes all─look down in shame and fury at tribe's lack of devotion.

We must appease honored warriors of Gundu legend. We must calm their rage. Please, make offering before great Gundu totem at ruins of old village. Place weeping wildwort before totem and perform sundrop dance, that ancestors may smile upon us once more.

Weeping wildwort hangs head in shame, just as Gundu do. It shows tribe's penitence for our neglect. Gather these flowers at the Cromlech, place them before Gundu totem, and rouse ancestors from slumber with passionate sundrop dance.
Weeping wildwort shows tribe's remorse. Sundrop dance shows tribe's strength and resolve─to honor our dead with our lives.
Find weeping wildwort at the Cromlech. Find Gundu totem at ruins of old Ok' Gundu. Offer fresh wildwort to ancestors and rouse them with a mighty sundrop dance.
TEXT_BANVAN603_02199_02199_SYSTEM_000_04: The ancestors await the sundrop dance to seal this sign of oblation.
TEXT_BANVAN603_02199_02199_LINUVANU_000_: Many thanks, . Your offering calms fiery hearts of mighty Gundu forebears.

But after netherling leaves, Linu Vanu thinks further on topic of gaelicat. Come to think of it, strong smell of cloudcrawler surrounds gaelicat! Perhaps it does not bring dark omens, but is merely drunk on cloudcrawler...?
TEXT_BANVAN604_02200_02200_MUNAVANU_000_: Danger of Vundu attack looms always, . Threat hangs about Ok' Gundu like dark mist around tall, majestic mountain.
We need netherling's help. Please, speak with Linu Vanu and lend him your strength in protecting our people from attacks.
TEXT_BANVAN604_02200_02200_LINUVANU_000_: Vicious Vundu savage! Threatening our hunters─chasing us from our land!
Please, , show this thug what it means to be driven from his own home.
Luna Vanu awaits with sanuwa, eager to help strike back against Vundu aggressions. Mount it and use its buffet to drive away the Vundu brute.
Speak with Luna Vanu and borrow sanuwa. Buffet Vundu brute with gale winds and blast him from his own home!
TEXT_BANVAN604_02200_02200_LUNAVANU_000_: So  is here for sanuwa to exact revenge on Vundu? Here, netherling─take Ok' Gundu Nakki's fastest and strongest sanuwa.
TEXT_BANVAN604_02200_02200_VUNDU02200_00: Behold my mighty sundrop dance! Like shooting star, leaping through sky!
Bah! Netherling dares interrupt my display!? I am not stopped so easily!
This time, I stand strong and firm, like great tree, rooted in ground for generations gone, and generations to come!
Gaaahhh! I am no pathetic nestling! I do not surrender in face of mere breeze! Sanuwa buffet against sundrop dance is like shooting arrows at lightning bolt!
You dare challenge my pride as Vanu Vanu!? Fool!
Phaaahhh! I must get out! I must get right out of here!
TEXT_BANVAN604_02200_02200_LINUVANU_000_: On wings of victory,  returns! Even most stubborn Vundu oaf cannot stand for long against full force of sanuwa's buffet!
Now our hunters may keep eyes on prey, and not peering over shoulder in fear of Vundu.

And of course, they should practice sundrop dance. If they learn from your example, one day they display dance so overwhelming that even mightiest Vundu warrior flees like nestling before enraged anzu!
