TEXT_BANVAN008_02225_LINUVALI_000_000: , Ok' Gundu Nakki thrives more than ever. To think about the hardships  helps us through...
TEXT_BANVAN008_02225_LINUVALI_000_001: Linu Vali knows words are wind, but she thanks you with all her heart!  is as sibling born in same nest!
TEXT_BANVAN008_02225_LINUVALI_000_002: Linu Vanu wishes to express thanks to  as well. Go to him, he is eager to share his words.
TEXT_BANVAN008_02225_LINUVALI_000_005: Linu Vanu wishes to thank  for guiding Gundu safely through the storm. Go to him, he is eager to speak with you!
TEXT_BANVAN008_02225_LINUVANU_000_010: Ah, , it brings Linu Vanu joy to see you again. For moons does Linu Vanu seek metaphor to express thanks for netherling's actions...
TEXT_BANVAN008_02225_LINUVANU_000_011: But moon sets and sun rises time and again, and still proper words do not come.
TEXT_BANVAN008_02225_LINUVANU_000_012: However, now that  stands before me, it is clear!
TEXT_BANVAN008_02225_LINUVANU_000_013: A netherling such as  is more precious than double─no, triple─rainbow stretching all the way across cloud sea!
TEXT_BANVAN008_02225_LINUVANU_000_014: From this day onward,  will be welcome in Ok' Gundu Nakki as a most honored guest!
TEXT_BANVAN008_02225_SYSTEM_000_100: You have achieved Bloodsworn reputation with the Gundu.
TEXT_BANVAN008_02225_SYSTEM_100_100: You will receive an experience point bonus upon the completion of Vanu Vanu society daily quests.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_000: <click> <click> Great hunter, we are honored that you have returned to our humble hive. There is something which weighs heavy on our mind. Very heavy.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_001: We have a newcomer to Loth ast Vath. He has not yet proved himself useful, and so he has no name.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_002: So determined is he to find his place, that he left the sanctuary to forage in the forests of the east. He has not returned.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_003: It has been difficult as of late, very difficult. We have grown hungry, and food remains scarce─the Onemind has seen to that.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_004: This nameless one means well, but he is highly curious with his newfound senses. This makes him vulnerable. The forest is the domain of the hunters, and his intentions may be misunderstood, for men have not the means to tell Vath from Gnath at a glance.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_005: Will you not lend us your assistance in finding him? Will you travel to the hunters of the east and ask if they have seen him?
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_006: <click> <click> Kind hunter, generous hunter, you have our gratitude. Please make haste, so that the weight on our mind can be lifted.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_008: If you find the nameless one, tell him you were sent by us. He will know you came from Loth ast Vath.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_GRIMOLD_000_009: I was hoping for a fine bird, and lo and behold, I capture a bloody Gnath instead.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_010: <click> <click> Yes, we are the nameless one. Have you been sent by the storyteller?
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_011: Tell your hunter friend to release me at once. We are not of the Onemind. We are Vath!
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_GRIMOLD_000_012: I don't care if he's a two-headed bandersnatch, he isn't going anywhere. I'm detaining him for stealing our resources.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_GRIMOLD_000_013: Normally, I'd say we're more lenient than the Gnath in terms of territory, so long as they don't hunt in excess or attack us.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_GRIMOLD_000_014: But then this overgrown vilekin comes and gobbles up all the gysahl greens we laid in our traps. Enough bait to keep a drove of chocobos sated for days, gone! With nothing to show for it!
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_015: So hungry, we were! We could not help ourselves. Unable to hunt, unable to forage... We are no different from a parasite. <click> <click> If only we could find a way to release ourselves. From this pitiful way of life.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_017: You misunderstand! Spare us our life! It is all we have!
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_MARCECHAMP_000_018: ...Aye, spare it he will. Stop tormentin' the poor creature, Grimold. He doesn't know any better.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_MARCECHAMP_000_019: We ain't savages, but we ain't charitable neither. You'll have to pay us back for the greens you ate. An' seeing as you don't have anythin' on you of value, it looks like you'll have to work off your debt.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_MARCECHAMP_000_020: Hmmm... Last I checked, we're runnin' a mite low on arrow shafts. Harvest me some melia branches an' we'll call it square, eh?
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_021: <click> <click> Very well. Release us, and we shall do as you say.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_MARCECHAMP_000_022: 'Course I ain't fool enough to let him go off alone. I'd ask that you see to it that the beastman don't flee from his debt. An' if he does, I'll have every hunter from here to the Hundred Throes after him for thievery. Understand?
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_023: Ah, we are free! Much appreciated, hunter. Now then, to the Smoldering Wastes.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_GRIMOLD_000_025: Gnath, Vath, what difference does it make? Pests, all of 'em.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_MARCECHAMP_000_026: Our hunters have more important things to do than gather branches in the wilderness. If the beastman fulfills his end of the bargain, I'll consider his debt repaid.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_030: Well then. The storyteller must be waiting for us. We make for Loth ast Vath.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_034: <click> <click> ...Yes, we know. If we flee, we will never again be able to move freely. To the Nonmind, independence is all.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_035: If we take too long, the hunters will surely come after us. Kind hunter, will you help us?
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_036: We will not ask you to bear the entire burden. One sapling should be enough. We will gather the rest on our own.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_039: We shall search on our own. We are not a parasite.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_041: Many thanks for this. Now let us return to the hunters' camp and be done with it.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_MARCECHAMP_000_050: Well, call me a chocobo's uncle, I'm impressed. You've given me more than your debt called for! These branches'll make for fine arrows.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_MARCECHAMP_000_051: We've usually got to send a whole party of hunters to gather this much, what with the meliae's thrashin' about and the Gnath lurkin' in the brush. Heh, even with those scrawny arms an' legs, you proved more useful than I thought.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_MARCECHAMP_000_053: Aye, I would say so. To be honest, I didn't expect you to come back with so much. Or to come back at all, for that matter.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_054: We too will be honest. We thought to flee, but this hunter persuaded us to stay. But we...we were useful?
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_MARCECHAMP_000_055: Hahaha! I said you were, didn't I? In fact, I tell you what. Since you brought me more than a fortnight's worth, I'll even throw in a small reward: a sack of gysahl greens to take home to your kin.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_056: <click> <click> A reward!? You mean, more of those tasty greens? For being useful?
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_057: We tried to find a way to be useful at Loth ast Vath. We tried, but we could not find our purpose.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_MARCECHAMP_000_058: Well, we hunters ain't like to turn away an extra pair of hands, beastman or not. An' we offer fair pay to adventurers willin' to take on the more dangerous tasks. Ain't that right, ?
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_059: “Adventure-er”? There are those who travel to the wilds of their own accord? Risk life and limb all for the sake of these...“rewards”?
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_060: Such excitement, such fortune! We want to become an adventurer!
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_MARCECHAMP_000_061: Can't say I've come across an adventurer who requested gysahl greens as a reward, but we'd be willin' to compensate for honest work. If it's food you're after, I'm sure we could arrange for some spare cuts of meat, too.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_062: <click> <click> More crunchy greens and juicy flesh! Enough to feed our colony! We will relay this to the storyteller at once!
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_MARCECHAMP_000_065: Enthusiastic little bugger, ain't he? Come to think of it, we've only traded with the Vath sporadically, but they don't seem like such a bad lot. Maybe this'll work in both our favors.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_070: Thank you hunter, for bringing our nameless brother back. We hope he was not a burden on you.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_071: is no hunter, Storyteller.  is an adventurer! And we are a burden no more! Look at what we have brought you.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_072: <crunch> What strange-looking plants...yet they have such a delightfully bitter taste.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_073: We have other good news. We have found our purpose. We will become an adventurer, too. If we work hard, the hunters promised to reward us with food. Food for the colony!
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_074: You mean the hunters of the east? We thought it safer to limit contact with them. But they gave you such delicious rewards...hmmm.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_075: <click> <click> You have done well, nameless one. With your newfound purpose, we are sure you will ease the hunger of your brothers and sisters.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_076: But trading with the hunters will not solve all of our woes. Much more is required for our survival. Yes, much more.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_IDATEN_000_077: Our colony is falling into disrepair. We need metals for our defenses. We need clay for our walls. The Onemind knows this. They seek to impoverish us.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_IDATEN_000_078: A few of our Nonmind brothers tried to steal such things from Loth ast Gnath. They never returned. The Overmind rages at what he sees as boldness. Even though we are mere leeches, partaking of tiny drops of their blood. Tiny drops.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_079: <click> <click> Even leeches do not loathe their own host as much as we. It is shameful that we must still rely on the Onemind to survive.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_080: You can rely on us, Storyteller! We shall travel the realm and offer our services in exchange for resources. We will bring back precious rewards from beyond.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_081: Travel the realm? You mean to cross the hunters' borders to lands beyond? Nameless one, it is too dangerous.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_082: <click> <click> Fear not. It is what adventurers do! To explore unknown lands, meet their peoples, obtain greater rewards. Strengthen the colony!
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_083: <click> <click> ...You speak strongly of your purpose. Very well. Should you succeed, we can sever ourselves from the Onemind completely. We can truly become our own masters.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_084: <click> <click> But do not become a pest, seeking work where there is none. The hunters may take offense at your eagerness to obtain rewards. How will you know when your services are required?
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_085: An Adventurers' Guild? A place to exchange information and gather requests from others?
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_086: Nameless one, no such place exists here. If this is your solution, you must start your own. But I am certain you will not be alone; some of your brothers and sisters still want for purpose. Seek them out.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_087: <click> <click> An Adventurers' Guild! There is much to do. But first, we will introduce you to our brothers. Come, come!
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_STORYTELLER_000_088: That nameless one has changed much from when he first came here. He was so timid and he hardly spoke. For every Vath that finds his purpose, our sanctuary comes closer to weaning itself from the Onemind.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_IDATEN_000_089: <click> <click> We wonder... Will the Adventurers' Guild mean we welcome outsiders? What a strange concept. We thought a colony is built to protect us from the outside.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_AKINDO_100_000: <click> <click> We tried to peddle like the vendor once. He mocked our wares, calling them no better than stones and sticks. So we took that name. We do not know if our wares are as useful as his. We only know that we enjoy peddling.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_090: <click> <click> This is the stickpeddler. He peddles sticks. He lost his connection with the Overmind near the same time as we did. There was one other, but we do not see him.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_AKINDO_000_091: You mean the keeneye? He saw shadows fly across the colony. He was hungry, and said he would hunt the shadows east toward the river.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_AKINDO_000_092: He could not have gone far, for he fears the water. Fears it much. He would not cross the river unless it was near the bridge.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_093: Wise Vath know to avoid the bridge, for ferocious dragons often lurk near it. Could it be they were the shadows that the keeneye saw?
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_094: Brave adventurer, could you check the bridge while we search the area for the keeneye? He could be in trouble!
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_095: But do not slay dragons if you see them. Dead dragons will invite reprisals. We will lend you one of our kongamato. We have fitted it with a contraption which sprays a putrid smoke which irritates, but does not wound. Yes, irritates. We got too close to it once. Most irritating.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_096: The kongamato are unaccustomed to fleshling riders. If you fall off, talk to the stickpeddler. He will help you get back on. Now let us find the keeneye!
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SYSTEM_000_097: Ride the kongamato to the bridge and use its spray on any ferocious dragons you see.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_AKINDO_000_099: Be careful. The kongamato may throw you if startled.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_DRAGONPUPPYA02255_1: <cough> <cough> Gah, it burns! I don't like this game anymore!
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_DRAGONPUPPYB02255_1: <sputter> Ahhh, why do you do this?
None shall pass! None shall pass!
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SYSTEM_100_220: The dragon younglings are playfully guarding the bridge. Speak with the Vath stickpeddler to ride a kongamato and use its Fumigate ability to drive the creatures away.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_AKINDO_100_020: The kongamato must wear masks for protection from the putrid smoke. It is a shame, for their faces are quite endearing. Yes, quite endearing!
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SEARCHER_100_021: <click> <click> We thought we were finished. We could not hope to slip past one dragon, let alone two.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_100: <click> <click> He is the keeneye. So he named himself, for he never tires of discovery. He returned to the hive soon after you departed to search the bridge.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SEARCHER_000_101: <click> <click> We are grateful to you for your assistance. We enjoy exploring the lands near the colony, but we were careless in our search for curious things.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SEARCHER_000_102: Our nameless brother tells us he will open an Adventurers' Guild in Loth ast Vath. It was not long ago that we too yearned for purpose, and we will gladly join him in his mission.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_103: Then it is decided. The keeneye will help us find many opportunities for adventure. Many opportunities!
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_104: But our guild is not yet complete. We are unsure of the actual trade of adventuring. How to find things, how to fight things... We cannot do it without an experienced teacher. Kind adventurer, will you teach us your ways?
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_Q1_000_105: Will you guide the nameless one as a mentor?
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_108: <click> <click> Wonderful, wonderful! From now on, we shall call on you as a master of the craft...Master!
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_110: Leave the construction of the guild to us. The keeneye will be on the lookout for our hunter friends and any requests they may have.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_111: But there are very few adventurers to carry out the tasks now. Very few. In fact, only you. We were hoping you could show us how it is done.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_112: The storyteller told me he is most pleased with your deeds to our colony. Consider us friends! And from now on, let us work together. For the guild!
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_109: <click> <click> And now that we have found purpose, we...no...I...shall be nameless no longer! As I long to have so deft an arm in adventuring, I shall call myself...Deftarm!
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_NANASHI_000_113: <click> <click> ...We understand. Perhaps we should find a new purpose. Forgive us.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SYSTEM_000_200: The nameless one is now called the Vath deftarm, and an Adventurers' Guild has been constructed in Loth ast Vath. The hunters of Tailfeather are now clients of the Adventurers' Guild!
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SYSTEM_000_210: You have achieved Friendly reputation with the Vath.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SYSTEM_000_211: Vath society quests are now available from the Vath keeneye.
TEXT_BANGNA001_02255_SYSTEM_100_212: Furthermore, you now have access to a selection of wares from the Vath stickpeddler.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_000: <click> <click> It seemed like it took days for the sun to set when I had no purpose. Now I barely notice until the braziers are lit! Our guild is so busy!
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_001: Master is so generous to help us with our clients' tasks. After the guild was constructed, we did not know where to begin. But we watched you, and we learned many things.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_002: We traded for cannons with rewards we reaped. For our colony's defense. Although they are not new, they should work well enough. But there is a problem. We have no firesand to use them if they are needed.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_003: I sought to find sulphur─to make our own stock. But the Onemind has claimed all of the deposits for themselves. And they guard them fiercely. Very fiercely.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_004: I asked Marcechamp where else I could procure firesand. He spoke of a group of fleshlings who slay dragons for glory─dragonslayers. They live far in the south, in the land the hunters call Coerthas. Do you know of them?
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_005: He said these dragonslayers use cannons much like ours. But bigger. Much bigger! Bigger cannons must mean lots of firesand, yes? Will you come with me to speak with them?
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_006: <click> <click> Thank you. This will be a long journey for me. Very long. I must prepare. Let us meet at the edge of the forest.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_010: <click> <click> I am nervous, Master. I have never traveled beyond the borders of the hunters' camp. What awaits us in the south?
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_020: <click> <click> ...Forgive me, Master. Their voices, they frighten me.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_021: My head aches. They drown out my own thoughts. I lose the will to move.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_022: No. It is no excuse! All adventurers face many trials. This is my own to overcome. We must press on to Coerthas!
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_030: What a beautiful land! Everything looks so clean! But my body shivers, as if I had fallen in a river.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_031: To feel cold all of the time─what an unpleasant feeling. Yes, most unpleasant. Let us hurry and find the leader of these dragonslayers.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_JANTELLOT_000_040: An apprentice? Well, well. So, where is this aspiring adventurer?
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_JANTELLOT_000_041: By the Fury, an enormous armed crab! I knew this day would come! 'Tis my reckoning for the many nights I buttered and supped upon its kin. No matter─I have no regrets!
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_042: What a strange greeting. <click> <click> I am the Vath deftarm, an adventurer who will perform any task you require. But I request firesand as my reward.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_JANTELLOT_000_043: Hahaha, I must be dreaming. A talking crab, and one requesting firesand at that! You speak as if we have aught to spare.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_JANTELLOT_000_044: Yet if this is a waking dream, then I might as well entertain this crab's offer. Slay the lesser dragons which plague our camp at present, and firesand you shall have.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_JANTELLOT_000_045: There's little glory for us in slaying such frail fiends. Yet you, as a greenhorn, might find it a suitable challenge.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_046: But I have never killed a dragon before... Even a small one. <click> <click>
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_JANTELLOT_000_047: You said you would perform any task, did you not? I gave you my conditions. Go on, rid us of the dragon nuisance!
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_048: How about a bundle of sapling branches for arrow shafts instead? Surely you are in need of quality arrows to take care of your foes yourself?
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_JANTELLOT_000_049: We have no need for primitive sticks when we can procure the finest arrows from Ishgard. If you will not do as bade, then I have no use for you.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_070: What should I do? I cannot kill a dragon. I could not even face the Onemind. Perhaps I cannot be useful after all...
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_074: <click> <click> But he asks an impossible task! How is one of my size able to rid his camp of an entire horde of─
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_075: But of course! Killing the dragons is beyond my skills. But driving them away is the Vath's specialty!
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_076: Master, I have a plan. Could I ask you to prepare a fire outside of the camp? I will return once I have found the herbs I need.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_JANTELLOT_000_077: Herbs? For burning? I have heard tales of smoke screens used to keep dragons at bay, but never seen it done. I suppose you will need some firewood.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_JANTELLOT_000_079: Now I find myself wondering if enormous talking crabs taste the same as silent ones. Hmmm... Tastes like crab, talks like people...
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_JANTELLOT_000_050: Our scouts have spotted a group of lesser dragons approaching from beyond the ridge. Now then, where is that apprentice of yours?
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_051: <pant> <pant> I found them, I found them!
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_052: Set these withered herbs ablaze. It will create a thick smoke that offends the senses of dragons nearby. They will have no choice but to retreat.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_JANTELLOT_000_053: This had better work. If I find you have wasted my time, I shall be most displeased.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_JANTELLOT_000_060: By the Fury, it does work! The little bastards flitted away with their tails between their legs!
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_JANTELLOT_000_061: My apologies for doubting you, adventurer. We shall take as many herbs as you can offer─and you will receive due compensation, of course. Firesand, was it?
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_062: <click> <click> Yes, oh yes! It is my pleasure to serve. If you have other tasks for us, please send word to our guild. In the west.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_JANTELLOT_000_063: You have a guild! Excellent, excellent. If it means the Convictors will be spared their time to concentrate on the larger threats at hand, you can count on our patronage.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_JANTELLOT_000_080: It may take some convincing to get the other Convictors to accept the Vath's incense. Its smell is quite potent. Mayhap if we place it near the latrines...
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_085: I am glad I did not give up. Although it felt like slaying the dragons would be less work. My legs grew so cold in the snow. I feared they might freeze and snap!
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_086: <shiver> Let us return home. I must speak with the storyteller about our new client.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_STORYTELLER_000_090: <click> <click> The deftarm? He has not returned to the colony yet. He was not with you?
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_STORYTELLER_000_091: <click> <click> We wonder where he is... The Adventurers' Guild requires his attention.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_100: <click> <click> Forgive me my lateness, Master. I was...unsure of the path.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_STORYTELLER_100_120: <click> <click> While stockpiles of firesand will prove useful for urgent situations involving dragons, we hope such a day never comes. A day when we must use the cannons more than once.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_110: We have secured much firesand for our cannons. Much firesand. The colony's defense will be guaranteed as long as we maintain relations with the dragonslayers.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_UDEKIKI_000_111: How vast this world is! And I am hungry to see more of it. But for now, the guild needs tending. Our clients have many tasks for us. Until next time, Master!
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_SYSTEM_000_200: The Convictors are now clients of the Adventurers' Guild!
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_SYSTEM_000_210: You have achieved Trusted reputation with the Vath.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_SYSTEM_000_211: New Vath society daily quests are now available from the Vath keeneye.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_SYSTEM_100_100: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from the Vath keeneye as a reputation rank bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_SYSTEM_100_101: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from the Vath keeneye. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_SYSTEM_100_105: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from the Vath stickpeddler.
TEXT_BANGNA002_02256_SYSTEM_100_000: In order to undertake the next allied society main quest, you must first complete the main scenario quest “A Great New Nation.”
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SYSTEM_100_000: In order to undertake this quest, you must first complete the main scenario quest “A Great New Nation.”
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_000: <click> <click> Well met, Master. Look how the Adventurers' Guild has grown! Our roster is filled with eager Vath, and our clients demand much more of us! Your contribution has been most welcome. Most welcome, indeed.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_001: Though we no longer suffer from hunger, our safety is not yet guaranteed. The muskets we have stolen from the Gnath have become unreliable. They rust and break easily. What kind of adventurer fights with such poor weapons?
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_002: Our hive is young. We lack the proper metalworks to forge better muskets. The Vath with such a purpose have been hard at work securing proper resources. But it will take a long time. Too long. In the meantime, we must make do in other ways.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_003: I thought to ask Jantellot. But he admitted he is not well versed in musket-making. He spoke of the goblins, said they know a great deal about metalworks. But he said they are constant travelers with no true home. It is difficult to discern when they will pass through the forelands.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_004: <click> <click> Idyllshire? A goblin settlement in the hinterlands? How fortunate that you would know of such a place. Master, surely you could introduce me?
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_100_005: What excitement I feel, knowing I can travel on another journey! I am itching at the chance. I will prepare right now. Polish my musket, clean my mandibles... Meet me at the border in the west, guarded by the stone door, beyond the domain of the dragons.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_010: <click> <click> Jantellot said the goblins are not like man. Could they be likened to dragons, I wonder? With gnashing teeth and─
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_020: Their voices were toneless. But alluring. They repeated their message. Over and over. “Halt your travels.”
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_021: Why do they try to interfere? It frustrates me. But I will not let them win. I will keep on, to the hinterlands.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SLOWFIX_000_025: An adventurer named “Deftarm”? How strange! A gobbie name if Slowfix has ever heard one. Where is he?
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_030: <click> <click> Master, allow me to explain! He came out of nowhere and attacked, with a knife! I had no choice but to shoot.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_031: “Illuminati”? He was not from the goblin settlement we seek? Somehow, I am relieved. His savageness reminded me of the Onemind. I was worried all goblins were like him.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_032: I was taken aback by his face. It was so... <click> <click> No, never mind. Perhaps it is best not to say.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_100_035: <click> <click> Do goblins have mouths to speak? Or do they also communicate through the mind?
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SLOWFIX_000_040: Shkohhh... Shkohhh... Behind you, uplander! Massive crawlybug armed with deadly weapon!
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SLOWFIX_000_041: Shkohhh... Not crawlybug, but walkybug? Seeks gobbie metalworkings? Happy to oblige, we are, but Slowfix is not the gobbie with whom uplander should trade tongueflaps. Seek Drydox!
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_100_042: Dry...dox? What purpose does one have, with a name like that?
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SLOWFIX_000_045: Reputation of Idyllshire grows large, with walkybugs come to make busydeals with gobbieflock!
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_DRYDOX_000_050:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Uplander needs hand-lending? Drydox never tires of giving out busytasks!
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_DRYDOX_000_051: Ahhh, a walkybug! It has been many years since Drydox saw your kind.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_052: I call myself the Vath deftarm. I am an adventurer, just like Master. You have met “walkybugs” like me before?
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_DRYDOX_000_053: Before founding free nation in Idyllshire, gobbieflock traveled far and wide. When Drydox was small gobbie, walkybugs wielding boomsticks attacked our tent-ring.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_054: I see. It must have been the Onemind who attacked you. But I mean you no harm. I have come to befriend the goblins.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_055: <click> <click> But I did not expect you to be such strange-looking creatures!
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_DRYDOX_000_056: Pssshmph! Did Drydox ear-catch walkybug right? Cannot tell skull from sittyparts, and he says gobbies look strange?
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_057: My apologies. I did not mean to be rude. Slowfix tells me you can make muskets. Very good muskets. Muskets are what I seek. Like this one.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_DRYDOX_000_058: Walkybug wants boomstick like this one? Even baby gobbie with blindyfold can craft better boomstick. For jinglyshine, Drydox will craftybuild best boomstick. Gives wordbond!
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_059: “Jinglyshine”? I know not what that is. So I do not have any. I came to offer my services in exchange for...boomsticks.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_DRYDOX_000_060: No jinglyshine!? So walkybug wants boomstick as questprize? Hmmm...very well. Collectors' Quarter is filled with debris. If Deftarm wants boomsticks, Deftarm must go and clear away!
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_061: <click> <click> I decline. Clearing away rocks is no duty for an adventurer. Adventurers fight monsters. Procure items of great worth!
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_A1_000_063: I've had far worse requests than this, you know.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_A1_000_064: Go and pick up the damn rocks.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_065: <click> <click> Is adventuring not supposed to be glorious? I thought it was supposed to be glorious.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_066: But you are right, Master. I am fortunate to have been given a task to perform. Clearing rocks is a worthwhile duty.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_DRYDOX_000_067: Uplander, can Drydox trust you with checkwork? Make certain that walkybug clears Collectors' Quarter with fastness!
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_DRYDOX_000_069: Drydox thinks walkybug would be better off returning with jinglyshine for boomsticks. Many, many rocks still litter Collectors' Quarter.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_070: <grunt> If Master has done <pant> simple tasks like these on  own, I can do it...<grunt>...too.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_071: <pant> <pant> It's no use. It won't budge. And my arms are tired. Perhaps a snack will rejuvenate me.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_DRYDOX_000_072: Pshhh... Drydox grows impatient and comes to checkwork. Shkohhh... What is this stinkysweet smell? It makes Drydox's belly do whirlyturns!
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_073: <slurp> <slurp> These are <slurp> nanka eggs. Succulent and juicy they are. Would you like one?
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_DRYDOX_000_074: Yes, yes! But first, Drydox must remove mask─no sneakypeekers!
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_DRYDOX_000_075: Shkohhh... Tastyfresh, tastyfresh! Like party in mouth with all gobbieflock invited! More stinkeggs, more stinkeggs!
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_076: <click> <click> Perhaps we can...alter the deal. If you craft boomsticks and metalworks for the Vath, I shall bring you more nanka eggs. Mountains of nanka eggs.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_077: What a relief that the goblins enjoy the same tastes as we. Let us return to the storyteller right away. Make the final arrangements.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_DRYDOX_000_079:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Gobbies have much respect for sweatworking.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_STORYTELLER_000_080: <click> <click> The deftarm is not here. Did you not see him on the main road?
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_STORYTELLER_000_081: This bodes ill. He acts strange lately. We worry he may have strayed, to heed the whispers of the Onemind.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_STORYTELLER_000_082: Be wary of the deftarm, hunter. Our connection to the Overmind has been sundered, but all Vath have a lingering link to the Onemind. Some have a stronger link than others.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_STORYTELLER_100_082: You must have seen his struggle with the whispers as we have. The Onemind's thoughts against his. It is like a hundred voices humming in unison. He is overwhelmed and cannot act.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_STORYTELLER_000_083: To be truly freed from the threat of the Onemind, his sense of self must be powerful. Powerful enough to overcome their whispers.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_STORYTELLER_000_084: If he doubts his purpose, the link may grow stronger. He will forget himself and return to Loth ast Gnath.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_STORYTELLER_000_085: <click> <click> But we cannot let that happen! He is our brother! He is Vath!
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_STORYTELLER_000_086: <click> <click> The Onemind must be beckoning him towards their hive. He cannot have gone far. Great hunter, you bring him back to his senses!
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_STORYTELLER_000_089: He is young, but his will to become an adventurer is strong. We are certain he will respond to his master's voice. Swiftly now, towards Loth ast Gnath!
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SYSTEM_100_095: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter “Deftarm!” to call out to your pupil.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_101: Yes, that is who I am! The Vath deftarm! I am an adventurer!
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_102: <click> <click> But what am I doing so far from the colony? I shall hurry back at once.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_STORYTELLER_100_105: <click> <click> So you were able to reach him. We are relieved.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_110: <click> <click> I spoke with the storyteller. He explained what is happening to me. About why I lose my way. About why I struggle to fight the Onemind.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_111: I am sorry for staying silent, Master. I thought I could overcome this on my own. I thought if I declared my purpose, the voices of the Onemind would vanish. Instead, they have grown louder.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_112: <click> <click> Oh, my mind, it is full of questions! Heavy questions. I fear many things. But I fear losing myself the most.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_UDEKIKI_000_113: I know! Perhaps the Onemind still calls me because my purpose is not strong enough! I must do whatever it takes, to become a capable adventurer. Accept more tasks on my own, reap more rewards! Then the Onemind will whisper no longer.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SYSTEM_000_200: The goblins of Idyllshire are now clients of the Adventurers' Guild!
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SYSTEM_000_210: You have achieved Respected reputation with the Vath.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SYSTEM_000_211: New Vath society daily quests are now available from the Vath keeneye.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SYSTEM_100_212: You will receive an experience point bonus upon the completion of the Vath society daily quests.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SYSTEM_100_220: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from the Vath keeneye as a reputation rank bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SYSTEM_100_221: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from the Vath keeneye. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANGNA003_02257_SYSTEM_100_225: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from the Vath stickpeddler.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_000: <click> <click> Where am I? Who am I?
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_001: ...Fooled you, Master! <click> <click> What a strange feeling, to say that to someone so trusting! Is this what it means to deceive? I felt thrill and guilt at the same time.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_002: But fooling aside, I wanted to tell you my thought. A daring thought. I cannot do it without your help. You know our walls are made of clay, yes? They require constant tending. Layers upon layers must be slathered over time. The walls of our hive have not hardened like steel, like Loth ast Gnath. Thin walls mean thin defenses.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_003: We succeeded in stealing stockpiles from deep inside Loth ast Gnath, until they became aware of our bold ventures. Now we no longer wish to live as their parasites. We must find our own beds.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_004: So we listened to the Onemind. And followed. They seem to have found other beds of clay, in a domain even more dangerous─near the dragon tower. Too dangerous for them to take. My thought was, we could try asking the dragons for permission. To extract the clay ourselves.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_005: This thought was too daring! Much too daring! I did not consider it at first, knowing the dragons are at war with the Gnath. While the Nonmind take care to avoid senseless bloodshed, we are not entirely guiltless. Not guiltless. Yes. We kill dragons, too.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_006: Traveling to the dragon tower on my own would mean certain death. They would surely take me as an enemy. But I remembered something I heard in my travels. Master, you have spoken to the dragons before, yes? You could escort me to them to ask for permission.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_007: Should I succeed in my quest, we can wean ourselves from Loth ast Gnath entirely! Sustain ourselves! It is worth a try. I will prepare for this daring quest.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_010: <click> <click> I...I do not think any Nonmind has come as close to the dragon tower as I. Were you not with me, I fear I would soon be dust. And now, to go closer... <gulp>
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_VIDOFNIR_000_020: Well met, friend of Ysayle. Thou wished to speak with me?
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_VIDOFNIR_000_021: How perplexing. What compellest thee to bring a Gnath before me?
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_022: <click> <click> G-Great dragon, merciful dragon, f-forgive my intrusion. It was I who asked Master for an audience. I am not of the Gnath. I am an exile, cast away from the colony. I am V-Vath.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_023: Th-The Vath have no appetite for hostilities near our home. We f-fear the dragons! I came to entreat, to beseech you for help.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_VIDOFNIR_000_024: Boldly spoken, Vath. What wouldst thou ask of me?
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_025: I, the Vath deftarm, only seek to secure clay from the sediment beds in your lands. To fortify our walls. Should our walls crumble, the Onemind will surely seize our colony for their own. They could beset your tower with ease.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_026: The Gnath of the Onemind are foe to us. Just as they are to you. Great dragon, will you allow our humble colony to harvest the clay within your domain?
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_VIDOFNIR_000_027: The clay is of little worth to us. Be that as it may, I cannot yet grant thy request.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_VIDOFNIR_000_028: Words will not serve as proof. By thy deeds shalt thou demonstrate that thou standest apart from the swarm.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_VIDOFNIR_000_029: Face our enemy. Slay the Gnath.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_VIDOFNIR_000_031: Thou art troubled by the thought?
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_032: ...No. <click> <click> Great dragon, I shall do as you ask.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_VIDOFNIR_000_033: He is indeed unlike his kin. Yet how will he fare, once forced to confront his fear...
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_VIDOFNIR_000_034: If thou art truly friend to him, thou wouldst do well to follow and observe. Assist him with his task, if thou must, but be warned: if he slayeth not a single Gnath, we will know.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_VIDOFNIR_000_039: Mayhap thou hast ample cause to keep faith with this “Vath.” But we do not. Not yet, at least.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_050: <click> <click> Oh, this is not good. Not good at all. I cannot possibly fight the Onemind. What have I gotten myself into?
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_A1_000_053: An adventurer does not flee from battle.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_054: This is not about being an adventurer! You do not understand how it feels, Master! You are not Vath!
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_055: This is not like the other requests. If I do not prove myself, the dragons will devour me! <click> <click> Oh, I wish to be left alone...
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_041: These whispers. All at once. A hundred voices buzzing, buzzing... I cannot move.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_042: No! I am...myself! I live...for my purpose...!
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_044: Quiet. So quiet... Could it be?
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_045: I did it! I subdued the Onemind's power! I have conquered the foe!
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_060: <click> <click> They will torment me no longer. I am sure of it, Master. My sense of self is strong enough to withstand them!
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_061: The white dragon is trusting of Master's word. Perhaps this is enough to allay her suspicions.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_070: <click> <click> Great dragon, I have done as you asked. I have slain the Onemind, with my own musket. Master can testify to it.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_VIDOFNIR_000_071: There is no need. From atop the tower did we bear witness to thy deed. Thou hast proven thyself and thereby earned the right to harvest clay from our lands.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_072: Great dragon, the Vath are ever grateful! Should your kin be in need of our assistance, our guild shall come to your aid.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_VIDOFNIR_000_073: Thine offer shall be remembered, Vath. We desire only peace, and any opportunity to strengthen our bonds would be welcome.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_074: <click> <click> The Vath shall be careful when crossing the stone tower. We will mark ourselves properly, and use a single path. This do we swear. Great dragon, I humbly take my leave of you.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_VIDOFNIR_000_079: Until we learn to discern between Gnath and Vath, we must needs take care before engaging trespassers.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_080: <click> <click> Storyteller, what news I have for you! I have secured beds of clay for the colony! I treated with the great white dragon of the stone tower. She gave us consent to take clay from their domain. All of the clay!
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_IDATEN_000_081: You treated with the dragons!? <click> <click> On your own!?
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_STORYTELLER_000_082: Ha! Did you hear that, Fleetfoot!? We are parasites no more! And established relations with dragons besides! Deftarm, you have done it!
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_STORYTELLER_000_083: <click> <click> But how were you able to accomplish such a thing? Why would the great white dragon spare your life?
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_084: <click> <click> Master has met the great white dragon before.  introduced me. She was fearsome, with enormous fangs and claws! But generous. Very generous. I completed her trial. I slew the Gnath, and their voices vanished. I no longer hear them.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_STORYTELLER_000_085: Is this true? Did you see him fell the Gnath? He did not succumb to the link?
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_STORYTELLER_000_086: This is auspicious news indeed, to become truly of the Nonmind. And you were fortunate to have such a compassionate master with you. Without  gracious guidance, such a valiant mission could have turned into a tragic one.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_087: <click> <click> I am overjoyed. Yes, overjoyed! We have much cause to celebrate. Nothing can stand in the way of─
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_TSUNAGITOMESHIMONO_: (-???-)<clack> <clack> Malignant flesh. Scourge of our body.
(-???-)<clack> <clack> You forget your place. You are ever bound to us. Ever bound to the Overmind. All are naught but vessels to hold our volition.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_STORYTELLER_000_092: <click> <click> Have you been using the deftarm this entire time!?
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_TSUNAGITOMESHIMONO_: (-The Overmind-)<clack> <clack> Deformations, heed well these words: your existence irritates us. We will suffer it no more.
(-The Overmind-)Once, you were inconsequential. Anomalies, sure to perish when abandoned to the wilds.
(-The Overmind-)<clack> <clack> This, we allowed. But you survived. You came together. You thrived─at our expense. Corrupted flesh, sapping us of our strength.
(-The Overmind-)We are not without mercy. You will be granted one chance. Return to the colony. Rejoin. Repent.
(-The Overmind-)Refuse, and be purged. <clack> <clack> Consider your last decision as Vath. We will not wait much longer.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_098: <click> <click> Curse the Overmind! Taking over my thoughts as he pleases! We will never obey!
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_IDATEN_000_099: <click> <click> He means to destroy us; we must not take his words lightly. There are not enough Nonmind nor cannons to withstand a full invasion. Their numbers are far too great.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_100: <click> <click> Then we have no choice but to flee. Leave the colony behind. We have learned much from our guild. We can survive elsewhere.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_STORYTELLER_000_101: <click> <click> Do what you will. But we are not leaving Loth ast Vath.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_102: You cannot mean to stay behind, Storyteller? To flee means to live!
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_STORYTELLER_000_103: We will stay. We are the storyteller. Our purpose is to tell our story. Without this sanctuary, there will be no new stories to tell, no storytellers to continue after us.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_STORYTELLER_000_104: Without Loth ast Vath, there will be no Nonmind left to feel the joy of individuality as we have. The Overmind will make certain of that. If I abandon the colony, I abandon my true purpose─to help all Vath in need.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_105: <click> <click> ...Forgive me, Storyteller. I had forgotten who saved me. It would be shameful to ignore others who would share my same fate. Most shameful.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_IDATEN_000_106: All of us yet draw breath because of the colony. We have become too accustomed to our freedom to submit again to the Overmind. We too will stay and fight, to protect our own.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_UDEKIKI_000_107: So we are to go to war? Is there no other way? <click> <click> No, there must be. I will find it. I must think.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_SYSTEM_000_200: The dragons of Anyx Trine have become clients of the Adventurers' Guild!
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_SYSTEM_000_210: You have achieved Honored reputation with the Vath.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_SYSTEM_000_211: New Vath society daily quests are now available from the Vath keeneye.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_SYSTEM_100_000: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from the Vath keeneye as a reputation rank bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_SYSTEM_100_001: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from the Vath keeneye. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANGNA004_02258_SYSTEM_100_005: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from the Vath stickpeddler.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_000: Master, I only wished to help Loth ast Vath. A well-meaning wish. But now it seems it will ruin us. With my travels, I have greatly angered the Overmind. I have brought this misfortune upon our colony.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_001: It is my duty to rectify it. I thought long and hard, and there is only one way to avoid war. I will destroy the Overmind himself.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_002: Without his guidance, the Onemind will know not what to do. They will grow confused. So confused. They cannot go to war without a leader to command them, yes?
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_003: <click> <click> So I will give myself up to Loth ast Gnath. Willingly. For the Overmind to come out of his nest, to cure me of individuality. In that moment, I will strike. If I submit myself to the Onemind's thoughts, he should not suspect. Should not. Should not...
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_004: Master, when the storyteller spoke of true purpose, it caused me to reconsider my own. Perhaps becoming an adventurer was not my purpose at all.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_005: Creating the guild, traveling to distant lands to secure resources, treating with the dragons... Perhaps these were to serve a greater purpose: to protect my colony.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_006: I will not shirk this duty. My sense of self is strong enough. I will be victorious. As I was at Anyx Trine.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_007: Master, I cannot ask for your help this time. The storyteller will have need of you here, at the colony. Should I fail in my task, all Vath must prepare themselves for war.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_008: Forgive me. These are...difficult things for me to say. Very difficult. But I must. So...farewell for now!
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_STORYTELLER_100_010: You look troubled, great hunter. Is there something amiss?
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_STORYTELLER_000_010: <click> <click> The fool! The Overmind will gladly welcome him into his arms!
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_IDATEN_000_011: Even should he strike down the Overmind, it will be for naught! When one falls, another rises! So it has ever been!
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_STORYTELLER_100_011: Great hunter, we are vulnerable to the Overmind, but his thoughts hold no sway over man. Only you can pursue him.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_IDATEN_100_012: But Storyteller, even should  find the deftarm, there are too many drones in the hive for them to escape. Too many! The Overmind could command them all to strike at once!
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_STORYTELLER_000_012: We must try to reach him before that happens. If the deftarm enters the hive and is cleansed of his individuality, the Onemind will grow confident. Very confident indeed. His recklessness will only spur them to swifter action.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_STORYTELLER_100_013: Let us hope there is still time. I will try to summon the others, those who may be willing to help us. Hurry, great hunter, to Loth ast Gnath!
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_STORYTELLER_000_015: I make for the hunters' camp at once. Do not let the deftarm reach the hive!
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_IDATEN_000_016: We shall remain here and prepare our colony for the worst. Go!
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_TSUNAGITOMESHIMONO_: (-???-)<clack> <clack> It is done. He is cured.
You come in vain, fleshling hunter of gods. Sense of self no longer exists in this one. He is ours once more. One with the many, in harmony.
Harmony that you could never hope to achieve. Your division breeds chaos. Murder. War. You do not understand peace.
<clack> <clack> Would that you could learn. Could link. Our harmony is beyond your kind. All submit to a single thought here. We do not quarrel.
<clack> <clack> But you, fleshling. You sow discord. You nurture deformity. You would murder the many.
<clack> <clack> If you thirst for blood, hunter, then sate it with one of your own! Leave our hive at once!
<clack> <clack> You do not understand. The Nonmind's senses of self fester and corrupt the whole. The Nonmind threatens the natural order.
This one's presence is poison! Anathema! We feel it growing, gnawing. Present yet apart. Defiant.
No longer. It ends. Corrupted flesh must be destroyed. Before it grows and claims us.
<clack> <clack> We know your strength, warrior. We know your thirst. Grant him his death─or will you let him grant you yours?
<clack> <clack> What is this? The seams... They tear... Impossible.
No. We are the many. And you are one. Even if you stray, you cannot escape. You will obey.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_VATHSTORYTELLER_000: <click> <click> You forget that the Vath yet have allies! Powerful allies!
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_MARCECHAMP_000_067: Give 'em hell, Deftarm! You're stronger than this!
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_JANTELLOT_000_068: You are an adventurer, are you not? Pull yourself together!
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_DRYDOX_000_069: Pssshkoh... Without Deftarm, who will Drydox share stinkeggs with!?
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_TSUNAGITOMESHIMONO_: <clack> <clack> Whose thoughts are these!? Silence... Silence!
The link...it bends to his voice...to his will... One speaks louder than many!
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_073: Master? Storyteller? I know you all...and you know me!
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_074: Yes, I am the Vath deftarm! Adventurer and protector of my colony!
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_TSUNAGITOMESHIMONO_: <clack> <clack> None would dare assault us. None! You know not what you have done... Withdraw!
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_VATHSTORYTELLER_000: <click> <click> Those who have always followed the will of the Overmind know nothing of other powerful bonds in this world.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_078: <click> <click> I felt a great fear in him. Greater than his hate. I believe the Onemind will avoid us for some time.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_079: <click> <click> I felt such emptiness. As they feel. There were no shapes, no flavors, no moods. There were no questions, no answers. Only a single command: to obey. I could not accept such a world.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_080: I was able to regain myself, thanks to all of you. But now I feel so...exhausted. Let us return home, to the guild.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_STORYTELLER_100_085: <click> <click> To have reached the deftarm when we did was most fortuitous indeed. Were he lost to the Onemind completely, I fear our allies would be hesitant to intervene in a war between Gnath and Vath.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_IDATEN_100_086: <click> <click> It seems the Gnath are the ones who are truly alone now. So lonely. Such pity we feel for those without others.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_090: My friends. I cannot thank you enough for coming to my aid. I─
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_MARCECHAMP_000_091: “Friends”? Now don't go thinkin' it's 'cause I'm soft. 'Cause I ain't. The hunters have been dependin' on the steady flow of arrow shafts from your guild. It'd be too much trouble to go back to fetchin' 'em ourselves.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_JANTELLOT_000_092: That putrid incense supplied by the guild may make my eyes water, but it keeps the Convictory blessedly free of dragons.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_DRYDOX_000_093:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Gobbies cannot get enough of guild's stinkeggs! Drydox gets shiveryshakes without them!
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_094: <click> <click> I never realized that the guild had become so important to so many people.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_STORYTELLER_000_095: <click> <click> Loth ast Vath no longer lives as a parasite, thanks to the Adventurers' Guild. Our sustainability is guaranteed as long as there are those willing to accept our help.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_STORYTELLER_000_096: The Onemind believed that we were alone, that we only survived by clinging to each other. That was their conception of a colony. To welcome strangers into the hive is unthinkable to them, and our advantage.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_STORYTELLER_000_097: Unlike the Overmind, we can forge alliances with others to enrich our colony. They cannot ascertain our strength, and that is cause for them to leave us be. Much cause indeed.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_098: <click> <click> The Nonmind have much to be thankful for. It seems we have become too useful to those around us. We are sure to repay our wonderful allies' kindness in whatever way we can. Even so, I yearn to experience more─to explore new lands and meet new people.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_099: I have learned much from your lessons. But it is time to be my own master. I have burdened you long enough.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_100: I know that I have much to learn, and that try as I might, I can never be as strong as you. I must develop my own strengths, and see to the guild and its future adventurers. But I hope someday to join you!
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_UDEKIKI_000_101: <click> <click> Your pupil will make you proud! Wait for me, Master!
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_SYSTEM_000_200: You have achieved Sworn reputation with the Vath.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_SYSTEM_100_201: Furthermore, you will receive an experience point bonus upon completion of the Vath society daily quests.
TEXT_BANGNA005_02259_SYSTEM_100_205: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from the Vath stickpeddler.
TEXT_BANGNA006_02260_UDEKIKI_000_000: <click> <click> Master, what a pleasant surprise. Even though you are so busy with your own quests, I am glad you always stopped by to help me with the Adventurers' Guild. I could not have done it without you.
TEXT_BANGNA006_02260_UDEKIKI_000_001: Our colony thrives, Master. Our new brothers and sisters are inspired by the guild's beginnings and your generous help. Many now seek my tutelage to become adventurers themselves. They seek me as the one who learned from you.
TEXT_BANGNA006_02260_UDEKIKI_000_002: I would say more, but you know I am no good with these things. No good at all. The words come out strange. But the storyteller wanted to see you, too. I think he could tell you better than I.
TEXT_BANGNA006_02260_UDEKIKI_000_005: The storyteller wished to speak with you about something important. Yes, important. Please seek him out.
TEXT_BANGNA006_02260_STORYTELLER_000_010: <click> <click> Kind hunter, generous hunter, you have contributed to our humble hive more than you know. And for that, we are truly grateful.
TEXT_BANGNA006_02260_STORYTELLER_000_011: The Overmind now knows of our strength. We are certain he will do all in his power to keep his hold on the Onemind. But there will always be those who stray; there will always be Vath.
TEXT_BANGNA006_02260_STORYTELLER_000_012: More Vath means more individuals, those with different minds and feelings. We cannot hope to agree on everything, but we accept this divergence. Even if it leads us to clash amongst ourselves, it is worth our freedom.
TEXT_BANGNA006_02260_STORYTELLER_000_013: Through our colony's trials to preserve our existence, we will continue to tell our story. And we do not forget those who joined us in our struggles.
TEXT_BANGNA006_02260_STORYTELLER_000_014: We had no choice when we were linked to the Overmind. But now, we choose to strengthen our bonds with you, hunter. You may ever consider us your brothers and sisters.
TEXT_BANGNA006_02260_SYSTEM_000_100: You have achieved Bloodsworn reputation with the Vath.
TEXT_BANGNA006_02260_SYSTEM_000_101: You will receive an experience point bonus upon completion of the Vath society daily quests.
TEXT_BANGNA301_02261_SEARCHER_000_000: Well come, great hunter. Not long ago we received a request from the fleshlings of Tailfeather. Yes, a few bells past they asked that we procure melia branches. Would you go out and gather them for us?
TEXT_BANGNA301_02261_SEARCHER_000_001: Meliae prefer soil in the Smoldering Wastes best. Here, let me mark your map with location of good budding grounds. Three places, three chances to find melia branches. <click> <click> If you see them, defeat them quickly, then bring back what you find.
TEXT_BANGNA301_02261_SYSTEM_100_000: You survey the area, but find no sign of the meliae.
TEXT_BANGNA301_02261_SEARCHER_000_010: The great hunter returns. Did you find meliae? Did you find flexible, pliable melia branches?
TEXT_BANGNA301_02261_SEARCHER_000_011: Branches from two meliae? One would be plenty, but with two the fleshlings will be very pleased. These branches make great arrows for chocobo hunting, or so fleshlings say. <click> <click> They seem to enjoy making arrows. Yes, many arrows.
TEXT_BANGNA301_02261_SEARCHER_000_012: Until now meliae were only a nuisance. Their limbs bear no fruit, their bark inedible. Hunting in the Smoldering Wastes was bothersome. Now meliae have value thanks to the hunters.
TEXT_BANGNA301_02261_SEARCHER_000_013: For the Vath, nanka eggs always have great value. They are a delicacy. A very tasty treat. <click> <click> We offered them to the hunters, but they say our eggs are putrid. Such strange fleshlings they are. Yes, very strange.
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_SEARCHER_000_000: Requests from fleshlings grow stranger by the day. <click> <click> Tailfeather hunters ask us for herbs, but not for eating or salve-making. Fleshlings want to make smoke for recreation.
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_SEARCHER_000_001: They say inhaling smoke has a pleasing effect, but we do not understand. Smoke is for driving away dragons or vermin. This use of smoke seems very strange. Yes, much too strange.
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_SEARCHER_000_002: We do not understand, but you are a fleshling too. You understand this practice of smoke breathing, yes? <click> <click> This is why we ask that you gather the hunters' herbs.
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_SEARCHER_000_003: You can find herb sprouts in the Smoldering Waste, but we do not need many. Three herb sprouts will do nicely. Yes, very nicely.
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_SEARCHER_000_010: Welcome back, great hunter. Was your journey successful? Did you find herb sprouts?
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_SEARCHER_000_011: Yes, yes. This will do nicely. Now, what did the fleshlings say to do? <click> <click> First, dry them with fire shards, like so. Then chop into fine pieces, and... There, it is done.
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_SEARCHER_000_012: All that remains is delivery. Might I ask that you take them their herbs? We think it better they receive packages from one who understands this smoke breathing.
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_SEARCHER_000_013: The order was from two hunters, Loupard and Grimold. They complained other shipments took much too long. They are always waiting. <click> <click> Please hurry. We fear they will grow irritable if we take too long.
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_LOUPARD_000_020: Good day to you, . What brings you to Tailfeather?
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_LOUPARD_000_021: Ah, the herbs I ordered from the Vath! What a welcome surprise. Goodness knows it's practically impossible to find anything like this out here. It's been a while since I've had anythin' to ease the nerves after a long day of huntin'.
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_LOUPARD_000_025: Back when the Sharlayans were still here, they cultivated the stuff in their conservatories. After they packed up and left, though, the plants made their way into the wilds and, well, here we are.
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_GRIMOLD_000_030: Ugh, what in the seven hells is taking them so long? Oh, hey there. You wouldn't happen to be coming from Loth ast Vath, would you?
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_GRIMOLD_000_031: You're a lifesaver, truly. I was beginning to think they'd forgotten. Truth be told, their stock isn't very good, but beggars can't be choosers. The merchants who pass through here would easily charge three times as much for something only marginally better.
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_GRIMOLD_000_035: I thought about growing my own, maybe even turning a little profit. Then I remembered where the stuff grows, out in the heart of the Smoldering Wastes, and thought better of it.
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_SEARCHER_000_041: Ahem. Excuse us. We were curious of this smoke breathing and wished to try it. Learning new fleshling customs is usually helpful, but this we are not so sure. Smoke is too smelly. Yes, much too smelly. It clings to clothing and shell, and incites terrible coughing.
TEXT_BANGNA302_02262_SEARCHER_000_042: Perhaps we used too much smoke? Hmmm...we are not sure. <click> <click> We must remember to warn hunters of terrible smell and coughing.
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_SEARCHER_000_000: Great hunter! Please, you must help! We received terrible news from Tailfeather. The hunters suffer from a vermin infestation. They say the crops of tasty greens are in danger! <click> <click>
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_SEARCHER_000_002: The tasty greens are precious to the Vath. Yes, very precious. Our brothers and sisters will starve without them. The kintamer has fitted our kongamato with canisters of repellent to drive off the pests. Go quickly, great hunter. Fly to Tailfeather and spray the crops!
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_MUSHIKAI_100_010: The kongamato is ready to spray the tasty greens. <click> <click> Be careful, the pest repellent is very pungent. I spilled it once. The smell was much too strong for me. Yes, much too strong.
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_MUSHIKAI_100_015: Oh, did you fall? <click> <click> Fear not, great hunter. Kongamato can be fickle─yes, very fickle─but they always return home to us. Hang on tight, and be mindful of the repellent.
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_LOUISONET_100_017: What the─ <cough> <cough> By the gods, it's everywhere! My eyes are burning! I take it this was meant for the crops? <cough> Well, I think you missed a spot. But please, I beg you, mind your aim!
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_LOUISONET_100_018: Oh gods, why!? <cough> <cough> I think I'm going to be ill. At least the bugs are gone now.
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_LOUISONET_100_019: Ah, before you go, mind making a trip into the Chocobo Forest? Those bugs have been eating up our greens every chance they get, and we have two traps out there using them as bait. The last thing we need is our traps to be empty before the chocobos find them.
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_LOUISONET_100_025: How am I supposed to grow anything with these godsdamned bugs eating everything?
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_SYSTEM_100_100: Insects are swarming about the gysahl greens. A repellent of some kind is needed to drive them away.
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_LOUISONET_100_020: Where'd that strange, giant insect of yours go? Don't tell me you've changed your mind about helping. We desperately need those traps.
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_SYSYTEM_100_030: The insects swarming the gysahl greens have been driven away!
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_SEARCHER_000_020: Are the vermin gone? The tasty greens are safe? This is good news. Yes, very good news.
TEXT_BANGNA303_02263_SEARCHER_000_021: Hunters are always so thankful. At least, we think so. Louisonet once said, “Bugger me if that's not the best trick I ever saw.” We don't quite understand. Bugs are bad for the tasty greens, yes? <click> <click> Why does he wish to be a bug?
TEXT_BANGNA304_02264_SEARCHER_000_000: Ah, great hunter. The perfect fleshling for the task at hand.
TEXT_BANGNA304_02264_SEARCHER_000_001: Since we began helping the hunters in Tailfeather, there has been much coming and going between our two settlements. <click> <click> Yes, much coming and going.
TEXT_BANGNA304_02264_SEARCHER_000_002: But this draws unwanted attention from the forest. Wild animals are drawn to the road, attacking our brothers and the fleshlings. The road is no longer safe for traveling.
TEXT_BANGNA304_02264_SEARCHER_000_003: There are three places where most attacks occur. I will mark them on your map. Yes, three places that must be checked. <click> <click> Please look carefully, and slay any beasts you find.
TEXT_BANGNA304_02264_SEARCHER_000_010: Great hunter returns, uninjured! We were right to hire fleshlings for this task.
TEXT_BANGNA304_02264_SEARCHER_000_011: To be honest...we knew this task called for bear hunting, but they are so savage, towering high on their hind legs! <click> <click> They are much too dangerous. Yes, much too dangerous.
TEXT_BANGNA304_02264_SEARCHER_000_012: We received this request a few days ago, but we waited. We knew waiting for fleshlings─like you, great hunter─would be the best plan. We will try better in the future. Yes, next time we will try to be braver like you.
TEXT_BANGNA305_02265_SEARCHER_000_000: Thank goodness you are here. <click> <click> We have received a request from Tailfeather, and we fear only you can complete it.
TEXT_BANGNA305_02265_SEARCHER_000_001: They ask for special paste and loam, but these are not found in Loth ast Vath. No, only the Gnath colony has what they seek. Please, you must sneak into the colony and take them for us. Three bags of each should be all we require.
TEXT_BANGNA305_02265_SEARCHER_000_002: Be warned, great hunter. The Gnath have strengthened their defenses. We tried to sneak in, but there were too many guards. <click> <click> It will be difficult to enter with so many guards on patrol. Yes, very difficult.
TEXT_BANGNA305_02265_SEARCHER_000_010: Welcome back, great hunter. Were you able to find the special paste and loam?
TEXT_BANGNA305_02265_SEARCHER_000_011: This is it! You have done well. Yes, very well. <click> <click> These are a special food, reserved for elite soldiers of the Onemind, but fleshling hunters seem to misunderstand their purpose.
TEXT_BANGNA305_02265_SEARCHER_000_012: The paste will be given to chocobo chicks for rearing. We were not allowed to eat this paste, but it is said to be very nourishing. I suppose chocobo chicks will benefit from its nutrients.
TEXT_BANGNA305_02265_SEARCHER_000_013: The loam is the most nutritious of all. Yes, very nutritious. We find it strange the hunters will use this for planting gysahl greens, rather than eating. Fleshlings call it by another name. Manure, was it...? <click> <click>
TEXT_BANGNA305_02265_SEARCHER_000_014: We cannot remember. Still, we thank you, great hunter. When next great task comes, we will be sure to call.
TEXT_BANGNA401_02266_SEARCHER_000_000: Lately, the Convictors invest much of their gil in the construction of larger cannons. <click> <click> However, they are not satisfied with their performance. Not satisfied at all.
TEXT_BANGNA401_02266_SEARCHER_000_001: To fire a single round, three times the normal amount of firesand is required. This is far too much! We offered to help our friends find a better alternative. So, between commissions, we spent much time experimenting.
TEXT_BANGNA401_02266_SEARCHER_000_002: Finally, success! <click> <click> We created a new firesand mixture much more potent than the old! But there is a problem. During our research, we exhausted our supply of some essential components.
TEXT_BANGNA401_02266_SEARCHER_000_003: We need three bags of redsand from Avalonia Fallen and three pieces of deadwood from the Smoldering Wastes. Please, great adventurer, can you go and fetch them for us?
TEXT_BANGNA401_02266_SEARCHER_000_010: You have returned! <click> <click> Did you bring the redsand and deadwood?
TEXT_BANGNA401_02266_SEARCHER_000_011: After your long journey, you must be keen to know more about this process! You see, redsand, when combined with the charcoal produced from this deadwood in the precise ratio will─
TEXT_BANGNA401_02266_SEARCHER_000_012: Oh, how foolish of us! It is not our place to share such valuable secrets, even with a friend... <click> <click> We will only say that the resulting compound has the ability to increase the explosive power of firesand.
TEXT_BANGNA401_02266_SEARCHER_000_013: You look surprised. Why, mighty hunter, you should know best of all that ingenuity is the greatest by-product of individuality! We can accomplish much by continuing to explore the world around us and trading our newfound knowledge with your kind!
TEXT_BANGNA402_02267_SEARCHER_000_000: Adventurer, your timing is most fortuitous. <click> <click> The Convictory has just sent us a request. They ask for their standard shipment of silver dew. Please go and collect four sprigs of these precious plants for us.
TEXT_BANGNA402_02267_SEARCHER_000_001: Silver dew is plentiful in Avalonia Fallen. However, take heed. Recently, the Onemind has been driven into a frenzy. Many have been observed harvesting these herbs. They will not take kindly to your presence.
TEXT_BANGNA402_02267_GNATHDRONEA02267_10: (-Outloth Steeldrone-)Vile fleshling! <click> <click> How dare you steal our dew!
TEXT_BANGNA402_02267_GNATHDRONEB02267_10: (-Outloth Steeldrone-)<click> <click> Leave now, fleshling, or die where you stand!
TEXT_BANGNA402_02267_SEARCHER_000_010: You have finally returned! <click> <click> Do you have our silver dew?
TEXT_BANGNA402_02267_SEARCHER_000_011: Oh, they are beautiful! You, on the other hand, appear much more disheveled than when we last spoke. Did you cross paths with our Onemind brothers?
TEXT_BANGNA402_02267_SEARCHER_000_012: Their obsession with this herb is very concerning, great hunter. We fear they intend to wage war on the dragons with it. If we are correct, our Onemind brothers will not stop until the land is stripped of all silver dew.
TEXT_BANGNA402_02267_SEARCHER_000_013: We can ill afford this to happen. <click> <click> Were it to vanish, our guild would crumble to dust. Our sanctuary walls would soon follow. We must begin cultivating our own to prevent this from ever coming to pass.
TEXT_BANGNA403_02268_SEARCHER_000_000: How strange, you fleshlings. We talk with you, we trade with you, yet we do not understand. Why do you love this thing called “wine” so much? It dulls the senses. We do not like this.
TEXT_BANGNA403_02268_SEARCHER_000_001: Why, you ask? The Convictory once requested we procure a crate of wine. We knew not where to find it, so we made our own, improvising as necessary with...<click> <click>...special ingredients.
TEXT_BANGNA403_02268_SEARCHER_000_002: They are insatiable. The orders come, and though we work hard, we cannot meet demand. We run low on supplies. Great hunter, please help us.
TEXT_BANGNA403_02268_SEARCHER_000_003: Your generosity knows no bounds! The key ingredient for our wine is the caelumtree fruit─a juicy fruit found in the Chocobo Forest. Please bring back three. The best fruits lie on the forest floors. They are the most ripe.
TEXT_BANGNA403_02268_KIHEI02268_100_030: Ah, a fellow traveler, is it? Tell me, have you, too, come for the Vath's exquisite caelumtree wine? If not, it's something you absolutely must try!
TEXT_BANGNA403_02268_SEARCHER_000_010: We smell fruit! <click> <click> Wonderfully ripe fruit!
TEXT_BANGNA403_02268_SEARCHER_000_011: The fragrant scent─it tells us these caelumtree fruits are at their peak flavor. They will make for a fine batch, indeed! This will take but a moment to prepare. Er... <click> <click> Please excuse us.
TEXT_BANGNA403_02268_SEARCHER_000_013: All done! Now, we must let it ferment. This will take time. Our restless friend over there, however, cannot wait so long. He says he is here to collect the wine we were to deliver to the Convictory. It is a good thing we anticipated his arrival! Please take this bottle to him.
TEXT_BANGNA403_02268_KIHEI02268_100_020: I couldn't go a moment longer without it, so I've traveled all this way, my good . Is it ready? Please, please tell me it's ready!
TEXT_BANGNA403_02268_KIHEI02268_100_021: Ah, there it is─the wine of all wines. There isn't another drink like it! The flavors─the sweetness, the acidity, and the hint of some sort of exotic spice, perhaps─they play across the length of your tongue and trail into the pit of your stomach, leaving you warm and content.
TEXT_BANGNA403_02268_KIHEI02268_100_022: I wonder what exactly it could be that lends the wine such a unique flavor. Whenever I ask, the Vath always seem hesitant to tell me. <sigh> I suppose it's a silly question, anyway. It's glaringly obvious something this good can only be crafted with the finest of ingredients!
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_SEARCHER_000_000: Adventurer, our guild's silver dew is popular. So popular. <click> <click> Demand grows daily and our stores grow thin. Soon we will not have enough to light our censers, let alone send to the Convictors.
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_SEARCHER_000_001: This worry has spurred us to cultivate our own. The fleshlings of Tailfeather have helped us to do so, but our plants are lacking in their most vital property: the scent which drives the dragons away!
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_SEARCHER_000_002: If our incense is ineffective, our reputation will suffer! All our silver dew must be tested. There is much to be done. Mighty hunter, please take these bundles and evaluate their quality for us.
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_SEARCHER_000_003: The best test subjects are dragons. There are many in the Smoldering Wastes. If you find one, use the kongamato to spray them with our silver dew. Please be sure to repeat this three times. If they are repelled by the smell, we will know our customers will be satisfied!
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_SEARCHER_000_004: <click> <click> The kintamer can help you load a kongamato with your silver dew, so you should go and speak with him.
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_MUSHIKAI_100_010: Troubling news. Very troubling. Much of our crop is substandard. We hope this bundle is not. <click> <click> There, this kongamato is ready. She is now equipped with the silver dew. Bring back good news, hunter!
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_MUSHIKAI_100_011: You fell off? <click> <click> Yes, we remember when we first learned to ride a kongamato. It is difficult. Very difficult. We will help you back on, great hunter! Maybe you will have better luck this time.
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_DRAGONA02269_000_01: <cough> <cough> What is this? The smell...it is unbearable!
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_DRAGONB02269_000_01: How dare you spray this offensive smoke in my face for a second time! <sneeze> It will be hours before my eyes stop watering and I can rid myself of the rancid taste!
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_DRAGONC02269_000_01: This shall not be forgotten! <wheeze> Lest you should do so again, be warned─I will tear you─<cough>─tear you apart!
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_DRAGONC02269_100_01: My stomach growls with hunger, and yet there is no food in sight...
