TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_SYSTEM_100_100: The gaunt wyvern's piercing eyes rake the lands below in search of food. Ride forth on the mount supplied to you by the Vath kintamer and use its Fumigate ability to blast the creature with silver dew scent.
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_SEARCHER_000_020: The silver dew was effective in driving off dragons? This is very reassuring to hear! <click> <click> We will include it in today's shipment!
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_SEARCHER_000_021: While the supply of silver dew we cultivate is meager, we hope to one day grow enough to fill all our commissions!
TEXT_BANGNA404_02269_SEARCHER_000_022: We think that things will at least go more smoothly than the time we tried to plant our own tasty greens. <click> <click> We should have realized sooner this was not a good idea. The delightful crunchy plant is too delicious for us to resist!
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_SEARCHER_000_000: Your fleshy skin and warm blood gives you strength in the ice and snow, whereas our shells do little to stave off the cold. Yes, to such climates fleshlings are well suited, but in Coerthas even your kind must wrap themselves in furs.
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_SEARCHER_000_001: Yes, the Convictors ever have need of warm pelts. Yet we do not know which beasts are best suited for this purpose, or if what we would provide will even suffice.
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_SEARCHER_000_002: We have enlisted Grimold's help. We will split the reward. However, he requires assistance. <click> <click> Great hunter, please go to him.
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_GRIMOLD_000_010: Ah, so the buggers had enough common sense to send me someone with hands instead of claws? What a relief! Between the two of us, I reckon we should be able to finish this quickly.
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_GRIMOLD_000_011: Now, in these parts, the only beast with a hide thick enough to withstand Coerthan climates is the bandersnatch. Luckily for us, I know just how to catch one.
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_GRIMOLD_000_012: Here─take these scraps of meat. Soon as you lay them out, the beasts ought to catch the scent. You'll have all the bandersnatches you could ask for before you can count to three.
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_GRIMOLD_000_013: I'll stay here and see to the more mundane preparations once you've finished. I imagine you're as eager as I am to get this over with, so I'll let you be on your way!
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_GRIMOLD_000_015: First time, eh? It's simple. You just lay the bits of meat on the ground, all in different places. If you're lucky, a lone bandersnatch will turn up. Worst case scenario, you'll have three staring you down─nothing you can't handle, I'm sure.
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_GNATHDRONEA02270_10: (-Outloth Steeldrone-)The fleshling lures us with the sweet scent of blood!? <click> <click> Unforgivable!
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_GRIMOLD_000_020: Oho, you're back already, and without a scratch on you! So do tell, have you got anything to show for it?
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_GRIMOLD_000_021: You mean to say you could've brought back three, but a starved Gnath beat a bandersnatch to the bait? It's a bloody good thing I left the hunting to you, eh? A hungry bandersnatch is one thing, a ravenous Gnath is quite another.
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_GRIMOLD_000_022: The Vath, the Gnath─I can't for the life of me tell the two apart! Thinking he's a friendly face, I'd have approached him for myself! Hells' bells, what a pathetic way to go!
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_GRIMOLD_100_023: Well, I'll take things from here. If you could set the pelts over there, I'll make sure they're processed and will deliver them to the Convictory myself. Oh, and before I forget─here's your half of the payment.
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_GRIMOLD_100_025: It's all they ever talk about, so I'm sure the Vath are anxious to have you return with their payment. I wouldn't keep them waiting for too long, else they'll likely work themselves into a frenzy.
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_SEARCHER_100_030: You have finally returned! <click> <click> How was the hunt?
TEXT_BANGNA405_02270_SEARCHER_100_031: After smelling juicy flesh, one of the Onemind made an appearance and threatened you!? How terrifying! But more than that, we are glad we did not send one of our brothers on this task. He would have eaten everything up before the traps were even baited!
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_SEARCHER_000_000: He is late. Much too late. <click> <click> Oh, fleshling. Perhaps you can help.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_SEARCHER_000_001: The farwalker was to deliver a cart of goods to Idyllshire, but he is taking too long. We fear something has happened. Perhaps something to do with the Onemind.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_SEARCHER_000_002: Our link to the Onemind is very faint, like a whisper. Very hushed. Very quiet. <click> <click> The farwalker's link to the Onemind is not so quiet. He may grow confused and forget himself. He may return to the Onemind!
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_SEARCHER_000_003: Please, travel south toward the hinterlands and search for him. If he does not seem himself, call out his name. He must not forget who he is.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_GOURIKI_000_010: Thank goodness you have come. We were startled by a low-flying wyvern, and the cart toppled over. Now our jars are everywhere. <click> <click> So messy, so very messy. The keeneye sent you to help carry jars, yes?
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_GOURIKI_000_011: Return to the Onemind? Never! With so many broken jugs, however, returning home also seems unpleasant. The keeneye will be angry. Yes, very angry. <click> <click> I think a few jugs may still be in one piece. We can deliver the unbroken ones. Will you retrieve them for us?
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_GOURIKI_000_012: We would go get them, but the dragons... We will wait here and ready the cart.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_GOURIKI_000_015: We should not stay here long. It is too dangerous. <click> <click> Yes, much too dangerous. Please hurry while I ready the cart.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_SYSTEM_100_000: The remnants of black, slimy eggs have spilled through the cracks of the broken jar.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_GOURIKI_000_020: Good, very good. <click> <click> There are still more jars, yes? If I deliver more jars, perhaps the keeneye will not be so angry. Could you bring back one more?
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_GOURIKI_000_025: Delivering two jars would be much better than one. Yes, much better than one jar. Please check for any more unbroken jars.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_GOURIKI_000_030: Thank you, fleshling. The goblins in Idyllshire are expecting many nanka eggs. Yes, many eggs. <click> <click> We only have two jars, but this should be plenty.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_GOURIKI_000_031: The keeneye will still be furious, though. He may try to remove us from the guild. We would lose purpose.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_GOURIKI_000_032: Hmmm, the keeneye was worried about the Gnath, yes? Afraid that we returned to the Onemind? Would you...would you tell him we were attacked, and you saved us from the Onemind?
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_GOURIKI_000_033: The keeneye trusts you very much. Yes, very much. <click> <click> He would believe if you told him. Tread slowly back to Loth ast Vath, and think of a great story. We will finish our delivery to Idyllshire.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_GOURIKI_000_035: We are sure the keeneye will believe you. Yes, very sure. Think of a good story on your way back.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_SEARCHER_000_040: Ah, so we were right! The Onemind tried to reclaim the farwalker. Thank you for saving him.
TEXT_BANGNA501_02271_SEARCHER_000_041: Sadly, the farwalker is not the only one with a stronger link to the Onemind. <click> <click> The links will fade in time, but we must be careful.
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_SEARCHER_000_000: Why are goblins always so hungry? When they speak to us, they only speak of food. <click> <click> We are always sending them nanka eggs, but it is never enough. Now they come to the forelands scavenging for more. They are a gluttonous sort. Yes, very gluttonous.
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_SEARCHER_000_001: They say freshly caught nanka eggs taste best, so they are always by the river. If they are not eating nanka eggs, they are scavenging. Now they complain of bugs constantly biting them. The river attracts bugs with a nasty bite.
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_SEARCHER_000_002: They insist on staying, asking for our repellent to keep bugs away. <click> <click> Will you take the repellent to them?
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_SEARCHER_000_003: We say take, but you need only spray them with our kongamato. One spray and they should stay safe. Bugs hate our repellent very much. You can find the goblins down at the southern end of Avalonia Fallen.
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_MUSHIKAI_100_010: The keeneye told us you will be spraying the goblins. <click> <click> The repellent is loaded and ready. Be gentle with the kongamato. They are good mounts, but very testy. We are always gentle. Yes, very gentle.
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_MUSHIKAI_100_015: Did you fall? Or maybe the kongamato bucked too hard? <click> <click> Let us help you back on. Be careful not to overwork the kongamato. Its face does not show, but they are sensitive. Yes, very sensitive.
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_GOBLINA02272_000_02:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
The bugs are gone! No more scratchybites! Thank you, uplander!
Will uplander take spray to the river? Gobbieflock is searching for nanka eggs, but bugs are everywhere! Hard to work with so many scratchybites.
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_GOBLINA02272_100_02:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Scratchybites from bugs are horrible! Can uplander make them go away?
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_SYSTEM_100_100: The goblin is being troubled by insects. Mount a kongamato from Loth ast Vath and use its Fumigate ability to drive them away.
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_GOBLINB02272_000_03:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Ah, the buzzing stopped. Thank you muchly, uplander. Now we can gather eggs in peace.
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_GOBLINC02272_000_03: The nibblebugs, they're leaving! Now we can find lots of nanka eggs. Mmm...soft, sticky nanka eggs.
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_GOBLINB02272_100_03:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Scratchybites hurt muchly! Maybe gobbies should go home?
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_GOBLINC02272_100_03:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Cannot see through clouds of nibblebugs. Where are the tasty nanka eggs?
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_SEARCHER_000_040: Welcome back, great hunter. The goblins should be all right for now. If they ever have their fill of nanka eggs, maybe someday they will ask for something else. <click> <click> They never seem to get full. Always eating.
TEXT_BANGNA502_02272_SEARCHER_000_041: Then again, more goblins visiting Loth ast Vath could mean fewer deliveries to Idyllshire. We can trade goods here instead. This may not be so bad after all.
TEXT_BANGNA503_02273_SEARCHER_000_000: Welcome, uplander...<click> <click> We need hand-lending muchly for request from Idyllshire. Yes, very muchly.
TEXT_BANGNA503_02273_SEARCHER_000_002: <click> <click> Were we convincing? We talk with the goblins so much as of late, we thought we would study their speaking. It is interesting. Yes, very interesting. But I digress. The goblins ask us for more of their favorite food─nanka eggs.
TEXT_BANGNA503_02273_SEARCHER_000_003: You will need to slay nankas heavy with eggs to ensure they are fresh. For that, you need bait. We place traps in the waters of the Hundred Throes to collect nail shrimp. They are a favorite of the nankas during spawning season.
TEXT_BANGNA503_02273_SEARCHER_000_004: Take the shrimp and lay it in the Whilom River. Nankas plump with eggs will come to eat. Then you can slay them for soft, delicious eggs. <click> <click>
TEXT_BANGNA503_02273_SEARCHER_000_010: Did uplander succeed? <click> <click> Did shrimp lure in any nankas?
TEXT_BANGNA503_02273_SEARCHER_000_011: Good, good. We are thankful for lenthand from uplander. Yes, very thankful.
TEXT_BANGNA503_02273_SEARCHER_000_012: <click> <click> We apologize. Goblin speech is much more fun than we thought. Thank you for hunting the nankas for us. Fortunately, those of the Onemind do not eat nanka eggs. It would be much too difficult to hunt them otherwise. Much too dangerous.
TEXT_BANGNA503_02273_SEARCHER_000_013: They eat the same thing every day. Always the same boring food. We get to discover new, delicious foods like nanka eggs! That is why we are glad to be free. To have choice.
TEXT_BANGNA503_02273_SEARCHER_000_014: There are still many not used to having choices, but we are glad to see them try, to see them make decisions. Soon they will also understand the wonderful flavor of nanka eggs. <click> <click>
TEXT_BANGNA504_02274_SEARCHER_000_000: Tell me, great hunter, what do you think of the masks goblins wear? <click> <click> Quite whimsical, yes? We try not to laugh when we see them. It is very hard not to snicker. Yes, very hard.
TEXT_BANGNA504_02274_SEARCHER_000_001: The goblins say they are stuffed with various herbs, and change them often to suit their moods. They use many combinations of herbs for their masks, and now they ask for help collecting them.
TEXT_BANGNA504_02274_SEARCHER_000_002: We were asked to find ten varieties of herbs, but we have split up the work. <click> <click> Too much work for one alone. Yes, too much work. Will you gather two of the herbs for us?
TEXT_BANGNA504_02274_SEARCHER_000_003: You can find Danner sage and Whilom mint south of here in Avalonia Fallen. Three leaves of each should be all we require.
TEXT_BANGNA504_02274_GOBLIN02274_000_005:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
We need ingredients to make special blend of smelling herbs, but the Vath are so slow!
TEXT_BANGNA504_02274_SEARCHER_000_010: Your timing is perfect, great hunter. One of the goblins has come for the herbs. <click> <click> We fear they are growing impatient. Do you have the herbs?
TEXT_BANGNA504_02274_SEARCHER_000_011: Excellent. Now we add these to the others, and... There. The package is ready.
TEXT_BANGNA504_02274_SEARCHER_000_012: We need you to deliver the herbs. Normally we would ourselves, but their masks...
TEXT_BANGNA504_02274_SEARCHER_000_013: <click> <click> We are sure we will offend them with our laughter. Yes, very sure. Vath cannot help but chuckle when seeing their masks up close. They are too funny. You are used to their masks, yes?
TEXT_BANGNA504_02274_GOBLIN02274_000_020: We can't wait anymore. Gobbies need smelling herbs for masks!
TEXT_BANGNA504_02274_GOBLIN02274_000_021: Oh! Smelling herbs made with this will sell for much, much jinglyshine! Thank you.
TEXT_BANGNA505_02275_SEARCHER_000_000: Ah, great hunter. I could not have asked for a more qualified fleshling. A group of hunters came from Idyllshire not long ago, and have need of your skills.
TEXT_BANGNA505_02275_SEARCHER_000_001: They seek treasure in the ruins of Anyx Trine. The land surrounding the tower has many artifacts. Very old, very ancient. <click> <click> The hunters requested an escort, but they were too hasty. Yes, much too hasty.
TEXT_BANGNA505_02275_SEARCHER_000_002: They have gone ahead to Anyx Trine. We fear they may be in danger. A fleshling of your caliber should have no problem finding them. There should be four hunters. Please, go and make sure they are all safe.
TEXT_BANGNA505_02275_TREASUREHUNTERA0227: I take it you're that escort we were askin' for from them overgrown antlings. I was hopin' for a bit of action to be honest, but there's nary a dragon to be found. <sigh> And sadly no treasure. Sure hope the others are havin' better luck.
Thought I heard someone shoutin' a few minutes ago. Maybe they found somethin'.
TEXT_BANGNA505_02275_TREASUREHUNTERB0227: I've struck it rich! Wait till the others see this. If you're the escort from Loth ast Vath, I'm afraid you've wasted your time coming. Haven't had a spot of trouble all day.
Did you hear that just now? It sounded like a scream.
TEXT_BANGNA505_02275_TREASUREHUNTERC0227: Ahhh! Wait, you're that escort aren't you? Thank the Twelve! I told the others we should've waited. “It'll be fine,” they said. “What's the worst that could happen?” they said. I'll tell you what─dragons, and lots of 'em!
They've been chasin' us all day. When we get out of here, I swear I'll─ Ahhh! What's that!?

Are they gone? Phew. Thanks for comin' when you did. You're a lot tougher than the Vath made you out to be. The others are probably still lookin' for treasure, but between you and me, I'd rather find a way out of here.
No need to wait on us. You head on back to the guild and give them my thanks. We don't plan on stickin' around here much longer.
TEXT_BANGNA505_02275_SEARCHER_000_040: Welcome back, great hunter. Did they find what they are looking for? <click> <click> We still do not understand why they consider such things to be treasure. It is all much too old. Anything they find will have stopped working a long time ago.
TEXT_BANGNA505_02275_SEARCHER_000_041: Risking their lives for long-forgotten junk. Fleshlings are such an odd sort. Yes, very odd. Perhaps someday we too will come to understand the use for old, derelict things.
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_SEARCHER_000_000: Mighty hunter, there is a matter at Anyx Trine that requires immediate attention. <click> <click> There has been an outbreak of parasitic fleas in their tower.
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_SEARCHER_000_001: These pests are a particularly vicious breed. Even the hardest of scales will provide little protection against them, and already several dragons are in need of treatment.
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_SEARCHER_000_002: While it is an easy task of spraying the afflicted dragons with vilekin repellent, many of our brothers and sisters are wary of approaching these great beasts at the best of times. The thought of facing an irritated one is terrifying.
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_SEARCHER_000_003: The kintamer has already equipped several kongamato with the necessary canisters. The repellent within is extremely effective and will kill any fleas upon contact. <click> <click> Please fly to Anyx Trine, and help the dragons for us!
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_MUSHIKAI_100_010: Someone rises to the challenge! <click> <click> Take this kongamato. She is prepared to face the fleas head-on!
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_MUSHIKAI_100_015: Do not worry, great hunter! <click> <click> Let us help you remount your kongamato!
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_DRAGONA02276_000_02: You are a welcome sight, adventurer. Had you appeared any later, a great many of us would have turned to fire to solve our dilemma.
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_DRAGONB02276_000_02: Ah, what a relief! The itching has finally subsided. May this be the last we see of these wicked fleas!
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_DRAGONC02276_000_02: The dull prickling has vanished. Thank you, adventurer. <sigh> Perhaps, the young ones will now be convinced of the importance of better maintaining our towers.
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_DRAGONA02276_100_02: The horrible prickling sensation─it is beyond excruciating. Each bite taken from your flesh gnaws away at your sanity.
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_DRAGONB02276_100_02: If only we had hands or claws with which we could reach around to scratch our backs with.
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_DRAGONC02276_100_02: It itches. It itches so badly. Is there nothing that can relieve this agony!?
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_DRAGONA02276_100_02: While this vilekin repellent burns my nose and eyes, it is far preferable to the alternative of hosting these despicable creatures for days to come.
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_DRAGONB02276_100_02: I have had many a close call in battle, yet never had I felt so hopeless. I suppose the true terrors of this world are not always the ones readily seen.
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_DRAGONC02276_100_02: It is unthinkable that our lovely home has been overrun by such nasty critters. It is something that would never have happened when I was younger.
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_SYSTEM_100_100: Several dragons just outside the tower look to be in a great deal of pain.  Ride forth on the mount supplied to you by the Vath kintamer and use its Fumigate ability to shower the distressed dragons in vilekin repellent.
TEXT_BANGNA601_02276_SEARCHER_000_030: You have done it yet again! Your courage is most admirable! While we may no longer be of the Onemind, our inherent fear of dragonkind is not so easily forgotten. Memories of the long history we share have instilled within us a great fear of their kind. TEXT_BANGNA602_02277_SEARCHER_000_000: Greetings, adventurer! We are most happy to see you. <click> <click> We are facing much trouble with a package we must deliver.
TEXT_BANGNA602_02277_SEARCHER_000_001: You see, this package is addressed to a dragon by the name of Uhm Ala. He is said to reside in Anyx Trine. Aside from this, we only know that he is yellow of scale.
TEXT_BANGNA602_02277_SEARCHER_000_002: No matter how hard we try, we cannot identify the intended recipient. There are too many dragons with yellow scales! So every day we return, claws heavy, and no closer to delivering our package.
TEXT_BANGNA602_02277_SEARCHER_000_003: We think maybe an expert adventurer like yourself can easily recognize him! Please, great hunter, take this to him. Uhm Ala must be very eager to receive his order.

TEXT_BANGNA602_02277_OOMALA_100_042: I, Uhm Ala, reduced to such methods. How humiliating that I must conceal my condition. But now, with this repellent, I am free from this burden at last.
TEXT_BANGNA602_02277_OOMALA_000_045: A single spritz of this vilekin repellent and these insufferable pests will finally know my pain.
TEXT_BANGNA602_02277_SEARCHER_000_050: We do not know how to thank you, adventurer. You are most kind. Without your help Uhm Ala would never have received his parcel! All the dragons─they are near impossible to tell apart.
TEXT_BANGNA602_02277_SEARCHER_000_051: Then again, we are also often told that we all look alike. <click> <click> We find this very funny considering every one of us looks so very different!
TEXT_BANGNA603_02278_SEARCHER_000_000: Adventurer, we have an urgent request. <click> <click> A mother dragon cannot find her child. She begged our assistance with the search, and so we dispatched many of our brothers and sisters─but to no avail.

TEXT_BANGNA603_02278_SEARCHER_000_002: We need someone strong and swift like you, adventurer. <click> <click> The mother is most anxious to find her baby. Please go to Anyx Trine and speak with her.

You certainly have a knack for this, kupo! Mogek will be most pleased. Hurry back and show him your wonderful work.
TEXT_BANMOG201_02294_MOGEK_000_030: There you are! Did they find anything suitable for our work on the walls?
TEXT_BANMOG201_02294_MOGEK_000_031: Oh my! This is more than suitable. With this, the walls will gleam as they haven't in a thousand years, kupo! I'll have the Mogmenders get to work right away.
TEXT_BANMOG202_02295_MOGEK_000_000: As the most brilliant moogle of the Mogmenders, I took it upon myself to devise a plan to recruit more helping paws. All I need now is a certain charismatic character to put my plan into action. That would be you, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG202_02295_MOGEK_000_001: We moogles are all play and no work when time allows for it, but none can resist the allure of kupo nuts, even if it means arduous work. And that is how I will rally the moogles to help with construction!
TEXT_BANMOG202_02295_MOGEK_000_002: Mogmul was hesitant, though, concerned those already working would lose their share. Being the magnificent moogle that I am, however, I amassed an ample supply without dipping into their stock.
TEXT_BANMOG202_02295_MOGEK_000_003: Now, what I want you to do is travel to Moghome, and see who would be willing to help us for a sizable sum of kupo nuts. The mere mention of the words should be more than enough to motivate them, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG202_02295_CANDIDATEMOOGLEA002: I'm so bored... <sigh> If only I had something to do.
Nuts, you say? All I can eat if I help the Mogmenders? I'll do it, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG202_02295_CANDIDATEMOOGLEB002: Aren't cloud mallows the fluffiest? If only I could make my pom that soft and fluffy.
Kupo nuts? For free!? My fluffy pom will have to wait, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG202_02295_CANDIDATEMOOGLEC002: I'm so hungry, kupo. What I wouldn't do for even a handful of kupo nuts...
Free kupo nuts for helping the Mogmenders? Who could say no to that!
TEXT_BANMOG202_02295_CANDIDATEMOOGLED002: Look at that sky. To think we're just tiny, fluffy specks in the great expanse of it all. Really makes you think, doesn't it?
Oh, free kupo nuts! Well I certainly don't need to think about that, kupo! Which way to the Mogmenders?
TEXT_BANMOG202_02295_SYSTEM_000_018: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter “free kupo nuts” to persuade the moogles to help with construction.
TEXT_BANMOG202_02295_MOGEK_000_020: Moogles have been flying in from every which way asking for work. I've never seen them so eager! Hehehe, but you and I both know they're really just here for my nuts, kupo.
TEXT_BANMOG202_02295_MOGEK_000_021: Hm? You wish to know how I procured enough for all the volunteers? Why, I borrowed them from Chieftain Moglin's secret reserves, of course.
TEXT_BANMOG202_02295_MOGEK_000_022: So secret, in fact, that he's all but forgotten they exist. Even if he should remember, I'm certain he would agree our work in Zenith is a suitable use for them. At least, I hope so...
TEXT_BANMOG203_02296_MOGEK_000_000: Tell me, , have you ever heard of sparkling mallows? At the very least I'm sure you've seen them. Twinkling balls of fluff dotting the landscape here and there. We plan to use them to spruce up the monument grounds, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG203_02296_MOGEK_000_001: I sent someone to gather a few, but alas, they've yet to return. You would think picking a few plants would be an easy task.
TEXT_BANMOG203_02296_MOGEK_000_002: I'm sure it's nothing serious, but I would be remiss not to be certain, which is why I need you to travel to Sohm Al and see if anything is wrong.
TEXT_BANMOG203_02296_WEEDINGMOOGLE02296_: Hey! You're that crafting adventurer, right? Thank goodness you're here. I can't finish harvesting these sparkling mallows now that my hatchet's ruined, kupo!
I worked really hard, and I'd hate to upset the Mogmenders back home. Do...do you think you could help me fix it?
The head of the hatchet bent somehow, making it impossible to cut down the mallows. A master  like you shouldn't have a problem making a new one.
The head of the hatchet practically snapped off when I struck the base of the mallow. A master  like you shouldn't have a problem fixing it.
The blade has grown so dull it won't even cut grass let alone a cloud mallow. I was hoping you could make oil for sharpening.
Thankfully, I have spare material for repairs right here. When you've crafted what we need, take it to the moogle floating just over there, and he'll make my tools as good as new, kupo!
I'm counting on you, adventurer. We need a lot of sparkling mallows for the monument, and the Mogmenders won't get any if I can't get back to work.
Excellent, excellent! My friend over there can handle the rest, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG203_02296_TOOLMOOGLE02296_000: <sigh> What am I to do with all these broken hatchets, kupo.
Hello there. Before you say anything, I know why you're here. He broke another hatchet, didn't he? <sigh> Well, let's have a look then.
Oh! You made new parts to fix it, kupo! That's awfully kind of you. I'll have him back to work in no time.
If Mogek asks, tell him that work is proceeding as planned.
Thanks again for your help, kupo! Tell Mogek he doesn't have to worry about the sparkly mallows.
TEXT_BANMOG203_02296_WEEDINGMOOGLE02296_: Soon we'll have more than enough sparkling mallows for the monument, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG203_02296_MOGEK_000_030:
Welcome back!
Ah, so his tool was broken. Trouble, just as I suspected.
TEXT_BANMOG203_02296_MOGEK_000_031: ...Hm? You must have misheard me, my dear friend. I didn't say “I'm sure it's nothing serious,” I said “I'm sure it's something serious.” Why else would I send you to help them, kupo?
TEXT_BANMOG204_02297_MOGEK_000_000: The Mogmenders have been working tirelessly towards the restoration of Zenith. So much so, in fact, I fear they may inadvertently work themselves to exhaustion.
TEXT_BANMOG204_02297_MOGEK_000_001: Which is why I'd like you to help them using one of our cloud mallows, kupo! Though their fluffiness pales in comparison to the fabulously soft fur of yours truly, their ability to relieve fatigue is unsurpassed.
TEXT_BANMOG204_02297_MOGEK_000_002: All you have to do is give it a good shake to sprinkle a few mallow puffs on anyone nearby. They'll soon be reinvigorated and ready to continue working. You're likely to find them lazing about not far from here at Zenith and up north at the Rookery.
TEXT_BANMOG204_02297_MOGEK_000_003: Speak with the moogle just over there to borrow one, then ride the breeze until you find them.
TEXT_BANMOG204_02297_MOUNTCONTROLMOOGLE0: Mogek told me you'd be coming. You're sure to have a comfortable trip. Just be careful, though. Some find them to be too comfortable. I myself have fallen asleep riding them more times than I care to admit, kupo.
Oh no, did you fall off? I bet you were napping at the helm. Never fear, we've all nodded off at least once atop these cushioned carriers. Take care, and stay alert, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG204_02297_SYSTEM_000_012: The moogles are lounging about, unwilling to work. Perhaps a few puffs of cloud mallow could motivate them to resume their duties.
TEXT_BANMOG204_02297_TIREDMOOGLEA02297_0: Still so much to do... My spirit is willing, but my poor little arms feel spongy and bruised, kupo...
Huh!? I... I feel my strength returning!
Hey-ho! I've got my second wind. No time for complaints, you two. That monument won't build itself, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG204_02297_SYSTEM_000_023: The moogles rush off with renewed vigor, clamoring about the joys of working!
TEXT_BANMOG204_02297_TIREDMOOGLEB02297_0: Ugh...so tired. But we have to finish...
Oh! It's so soft, and fuzzy! I'm feeling fresh and fired up, kupo!
Let's get back to work, boys. My pom is full to bursting with energy, and I won't let it go to waste!
TEXT_BANMOG204_02297_SYSTEM_000_033: The moogles rush off with renewed vigor, clamoring about the joys of working!
TEXT_BANMOG204_02297_MOGEK_000_040: It would seem my plan was a success. Now the Mogmenders can labor with the strength of a hundred moogles each, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG204_02297_MOGEK_000_041: From dawn till dusk, and perhaps till dawn again, they'll sing the praises of a hard day's work. We should be back on schedule in no time at all.
TEXT_BANMOG301_02298_MOGEK_000_000: , tell me, have you ever been to the Monsterie? While many, like me, assume it to simply have been a quiet place of worship, Whei Ahf says that the erstwhile sanctuary also once served as a stone fabrication facility.
TEXT_BANMOG301_02298_MOGEK_000_001: We decided to do a bit of exploring, and a cursory search of the place yielded serviceable equipment once used in the production of decorative tilework.
TEXT_BANMOG301_02298_MOGEK_000_002: The stonemasons have already set to work, clattering about our good fortune, but with all the trouble we've faced of late, I would prefer to leave nothing to chance. Please, , bring me some peace of mind and make sure nothing is amiss.
TEXT_BANMOG301_02298_CRAFTSMOOGLE02298_0: Hello, ! Did you, too, come to look upon the Monsterie after hearing the great dragon's regaling tales? Well, here it is─everything he promised and more, kupo!
With the tools we found here, we've produced more tiles in an hour than we last did in a day! All this progress has us eager to continue, but we've exhausted the last of the veneer we had.
Now that you're here, however, our problem is as good as solved, kupo! Please, if you would, make us some metal trim for our tiles?
Now that you're here, however, our problem is as good as solved, kupo! Please, if you would, make us some hardwood moldings for our tiles?
Now that you're here, however, our problem is as good as solved, kupo! Please, if you would, make us a glaze that we might add shine to our tiles?

Once you've finished, we'd be most grateful if you could deliver the product directly to my assistant, who is just beyond this archway. Ever since we used the last of our supply he's been inconsolable, lecturing any within earshot on the importance of properly managing supplies.
Thankfully, we do not want for raw materials! Here, take as much as you like, kupo!
Oh, yes! This is certain to brighten even my assistant's mood! Before he sees fit to fly over and deliver yet another speech, please see that the veneer you crafted for us reaches him.
TEXT_BANMOG301_02298_FLOORMATERIALMOOGLE: We're out! Completely out! Give it another day and we'll soon be falling behind schedule again!
Honestly! If anyone had bothered to listen, we could have doubled─no, tripled─the day's output. <sigh> But now production's at a complete standstill, with little to no hope of starting again, kupo.
I-Is that what I think it is!? Ha ha! Why, I could just hug you! Thank you, ─you've really saved our poms with this one!
Well, I've certainly learned my lesson─not a single soul shall be allowed to touch these without my explicit permission. Not a single soul, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG301_02298_CRAFTSMOOGLE02298_0: With your help, all the tiles for the monument will be finished in next to no time, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG301_02298_MOGEK_000_030: ! Thank the gods you've returned unharmed! I was beginning to worry I would have need to send one of my Mogmenders after you.
TEXT_BANMOG301_02298_MOGEK_000_031: Ahaha! How refreshing it is to hear that the only trouble was a simple shortage of materials. It seems I need worry no longer─our luck has, at long last, taken a turn for the better, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG301_02298_SYSTEM_000_032: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANMOG302_02299_MOGEK_000_000: , have your travels ever taken you to a place called Tharl Oom Khash?
TEXT_BANMOG302_02299_MOGEK_000_001: It is no secret the ruins hold some of the clearest crystals in the realm─crystals so pure they are often considered to be the perfect catalysts. As such, I sent some Mogmenders to harvest them.
TEXT_BANMOG302_02299_MOGEK_000_002: They should have returned by now, with chests overflowing, kupo. The reason they haven't, I imagine, is because they have run into trouble. <sigh> Great adventurer, might you go and see what the problem is?
TEXT_BANMOG302_02299_DIGGINGMOOGLE02299_: Kupooo! Thank the gods above Mogek finally sent help!
It's terrible, kupo! We were so fixated on mining crystals that we didn't realize just how thick the air was with aether, until it struck down over half of our squad!
While this puts us in a tenuous position, a few of us have yet to feel its full effects. If we proceed with caution, we might still be able to fulfill Mogek's request!
This is where you come in! Please, if you could craft metal casings for our chests to shield us from the crystals, we would be most grateful.
This is where you come in! Please, if you could craft leather cases for the interiors of our chests to shield us from the crystals, we would be most grateful.
This is where you come in! Please, if you could make a wax sealant which might prevent any aether within the chests from leaking out, we would be most grateful.
Everything you need should be right here, but if there is something you can't find, please don't hesitate to ask!
Yes, yes, of course! Take however much you need, kupo!
This will certainly do the trick! Thank you, ! Now, do you see the moogle over by our wooden chests? He is charged with organizing our trip back, so please deliver the shielding to him.
TEXT_BANMOG302_02299_COLLECTIONMOOGLE022: Aether sickness is absolutely miserable, kupo! If only we had realized what was happening to us sooner we wouldn't be in this mess.
So dizzy, kupo... Unless we make haste, I, too, will soon be joining those of our ranks who lay listless on the ground. <groan> How am I to transport the crystals back to Mogek in this condition?
What's this? A protective guard for our chests, you say? Oh, thank you! Thank you, adventurer─we are saved, kupo!
With this to shield us from the crystals' aether, we should have no problem taking these back!
TEXT_BANMOG302_02299_DIGGINGMOOGLE02299_: Now, to work out how we will transport those that are indisposed out of these ruins...
TEXT_BANMOG302_02299_MOGEK_000_040: I admit, the possibility of Mogmenders becoming affected by aether sickness completely slipped my mind, kupo. It seems the fault, in this case, lies with me.
TEXT_BANMOG302_02299_MOGEK_000_041: We moogles are more adept at manipulating our aetheric flow than most. However, as this is less an acquired skill and more a natural talent, we are more like to succumb to overexposure.
TEXT_BANMOG302_02299_MOGEK_000_042: While there is no denying this was an unfortunate turn of events, I am happy to see that the Mogmenders appear, at least, to be learning the value of hard work!
TEXT_BANMOG303_02300_MOGEK_000_000: Thank the gods you're here! All  the construction moogles have been pelting me with complaints regarding the shipments they've been receiving from the stonemasons.
TEXT_BANMOG303_02300_MOGEK_000_001: It would appear that, while each of the stone blocks that arrive at the site have been polished to a shine, no two are the same! This has made it nearly impossible for the rocks to be stacked, much less used for construction.
TEXT_BANMOG303_02300_MOGEK_000_002: The masons need someone to guide them, and I can think of none better than the master . Please, , show the stonemasons of Zenith how sculpting is truly done!
TEXT_BANMOG303_02300_CRAFTSMOOGLE02300_0: What is this!? The blocks we have been dispatching are not all uniform? Oh, this is not good, kupo! Not good at all!
I don't understand how such a thing could happen... My masons have been working tirelessly, meticulously chipping away at their stones, even as their pom-poms droop with exhaustion.
Unless... Oh, dear! Is it possible, that in their haste to begin production, they forgot to consult with one another? That would certainly account for the differing shapes and sizes.
, it seems Mogek was right to send you! We are in desperate need of your assistance.
Perhaps if you were to produce a file, with which we could grind down some of our larger blocks, we will be able to standardize all of the rocks in our shipments!
Perhaps if you were to produce a wooden mallet, which we could use with our chisels to pound down our larger blocks, we will be able to standardize all of the rocks in our shipments!
Perhaps if you were to produce an abrasive, with which we could use to grind down some of our larger blocks, we will be able to standardize all of the rocks in our shipments!
I'll have my masons bring them for you, so if you find yourself running low on materials, don't hesitate to speak up, kupo!

I am so glad this matter has been brought to my attention. It would seem we─ Ah! My apologies,  for not noticing sooner. I shall have them brought to you immediately. You there, go and fetch the requested materials at once, kupo!
, you've been gifted with a touch the gods themselves would envy! My masons have been waiting with bated breath to gaze upon your finished work, and I'm certain they shall not be disappointed!
TEXT_BANMOG303_02300_STONEMOOGLE02300_00: I can't see, kupo! I must move in closer to observe the master's movements, kupo!
We have come to look upon the master's work, kupo!
Y-You are truly amazing─so swift and precise, kupo! I have never seen anything like it! How does one become such a great crafter?
TEXT_BANMOG303_02300_A1_000_001: One must always pay attention to the details.
TEXT_BANMOG303_02300_STONEMOOGLE02300_00: Your wise words have served to motivate us even further. We shall return to work and try again and again until we get it right!
TEXT_BANMOG303_02300_CRAFTSMOOGLE02300_0: While it will likely take a tremendous amount of time and practice to become as adept as you, we shall never give up, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG303_02300_STONEMOOGLE02300_00: Thank you, adventurer! With your help, we have finally created a set of three stone blocks that are the exact same size, kupo! We shall get started on the next ones, so please take these to Mogek for approval.
I think we have seen much improvement, and it is all thanks to you, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG303_02300_MOGEK_000_050: Good , ! Pray tell, how did the lessons go?
TEXT_BANMOG303_02300_MOGEK_000_051: What wonderful news! While they certainly have their work cut out for them, I feel this is the last bit of trouble we'll be seeing from the stonemasons.
TEXT_BANMOG303_02300_MOGEK_000_052: Just look at these samples─they're absolutely magnificent! I'm certain even the construction moogles will be impressed by the precision with which they have been cut, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG303_02300_SYSTEM_000_053: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANMOG304_02301_MOGEK_000_000: , I suspect trouble is afoot. Do you spy that group of Temple Knights yonder? They have been whispering amongst themselves, casting furtive glances this way and that for the past hour, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG304_02301_MOGEK_000_001: A hush falls over the group every time I approach, and try as I might, I cannot overhear so much as a single word. Maybe they would be willing to open up to a great adventurer like you! Yes, maybe you can discover what the problem is, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG304_02301_HILDEATH_000_010: Oh, hello there, adventurer! What has you looking so grim?
TEXT_BANMOG304_02301_HILDEATH_000_011: Hahaha! Trouble? I suppose one might call it that, though it's far from the sort your friend Mogek seems to have in mind.
TEXT_BANMOG304_02301_HILDEATH_000_012: You see, my knights and I have traveled all this way to rekindle our friendship with the residents of Moghome. Master Tarresson told us of the moogles' love of pranks, and we figured we could start by playing a little trick on them.
TEXT_BANMOG304_02301_HILDEATH_000_014: Unfortunately, our plan has hit a stumbling block─we have been struggling for the past hour trying to fit this smoke bomb into our fake kupo nut. I don't suppose you would know how to go about this?
TEXT_BANMOG304_02301_HILDEATH_000_015: Unfortunately, our plan has hit a stumbling block─we have been struggling for the past hour trying to fit this smoke bomb into our fake kupo nut. I don't suppose you would know how to go about this?
TEXT_BANMOG304_02301_HILDEATH_000_016: Unfortunately, our plan has hit a stumbling block─we have been struggling for the past hour trying to fit this smoke bomb into our fake kupo nut. I don't suppose you would know how to go about this?
TEXT_BANMOG304_02301_ISHGARDENGINEERB023: Hildeth, while our capable friend here sees to the kupo nut issue, I shall go and search out the perfect place to lay our trap.
TEXT_BANMOG304_02301_HILDEATH_000_018: Wait! ...Bah! He always does that. <sigh> Back to the matter at hand, then. All the items you require should be here. Once you fit the smoke bomb into the casing, please take it to the lad who just rushed off.
TEXT_BANMOG304_02301_HILDEATH_000_019: Thank the gods you came when you did! Who knows how long we would have been stuck here fiddling with this thing, otherwise.
TEXT_BANMOG304_02301_HILDEATH_000_020: It's done, you say!? Fantastic! If you could see that it gets to our sapper, I would be most grateful.
TEXT_BANMOG304_02301_ISHGARDENGINEERB023: My hands are quivering with excitement! I can hardly wait to see how our wonderful plan will unfold!
Have you brought the fake kupo nut with you? You reckon it looks convincing?
By the gods, it's beautiful! Even Mogek would have difficulty telling it apart from a real one. Now, let's see. I think we had best place it right about...here!
All set! Let us duck behind some bushes to await our quarry.
TEXT_BANMOG304_02301_HILDEATH_000_034: With you helping us along, I'm certain nothing can go wrong! Why, this might even be the greatest prank the moogles will ever see!
TEXT_BANMOG304_02301_DECEIVEDMOOGLE02301: What an odd place for kupo nuts to be lying about. Oooh! Some poor soul must have forgotten them! Hehehe!
Yes, yes, kupo! If whoever left them here can't be bothered to come back, then it wouldn't be stealing to take them ourselves, nor a crime to sneak a small taste...
<cough> <cough> An exploding kupo nut!? To think we would fall for such an amateurish prank─soon as we recover we must begin plotting our revenge, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG304_02301_ISHGARDENGINEERB023: Adventurer, did you see that!? Please, tell me you did! Bahaha! What an astounding success! Then again, it would have been more of a surprise if it wasn't. The smoke bomb─it was engineered using the blueprints of those developed to immobilize dragons.
Even so, we couldn't have done it without you, my friend! If it were not for your dextrous fingers, the moogles would never have fallen for it. Ahahaha!
TEXT_BANMOG304_02301_MOGEK_000_060: You have finally returned, kupo! I trust you have news regarding the matter we discussed earlier?
TEXT_BANMOG304_02301_MOGEK_000_061: Pranks, kupo!? So, that's what all the fuss was about! Wonderful, simply wonderful. Haha! Mischief-makers are always welcome─especially those as talented as our new friends!
TEXT_BANMOG304_02301_SYSTEM_000_062: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANMOG401_02302_MOGEK_000_000: Oh, ! It's horrible! Nidhogg's minions are harassing the Mogmenders again, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG401_02302_MOGEK_000_001: You have done us a great kindness in the past, staving off our enemies, but now they assail us at every opportunity and work is at a standstill.
TEXT_BANMOG401_02302_MOGEK_000_002: I say we fight fire with fire, or in this case, dragons with dragons, kupo! If we beseech the aid of Whei Ahf I'm sure he will help us. No doubt you'll need to speak with his dragonling companion first. Time is of the essence, friend. Please hurry!
TEXT_BANMOG401_02302_WYVERNRECEPTION0230: Well come,  of man. What business brings you here?
The Mogmenders are under attack? Then I shall summon Whei Ahf immediately.
Nidhogg's brood still harry the moogles? You need say no more.
TEXT_BANMOG401_02302_SYSTEM_000_013: Minions of Nidhogg have the moogle cornered and could strike at any moment. Perhaps the mighty bellow of Whei Ahf could drive these beasts away.
TEXT_BANMOG401_02302_ATTACKEDMOOGLEA0230: Phew. For a moment there I thought my pom was popped, kupo! Thank you.
(-Whei Ahf-)Our work here is finished. Come, let us search for others who may be in danger.
TEXT_BANMOG401_02302_SYSTEM_000_023: The enemies flee in terror before the might of Whei Ahf!
TEXT_BANMOG401_02302_ATTACKEDMOOGLEB0230: I'm...I'm alive? I'm alive, kupo! Now to make sure I stay that way!
(-Whei Ahf-)It is most fortunate he was unharmed, but I sense there are yet moogles to be saved.
TEXT_BANMOG401_02302_ATTACKEDMOOGLEC0230: But I have so much left to live for! So many kupo nuts left to eat!
Oh, thank goodness. I think I need to lie down, kupo.
(-Whei Ahf-)Hmmm... I no longer sense minions of the brood in the vicinity. Let us return to Bahrr Lehs.
TEXT_BANMOG401_02302_MOGEK_000_050: The mighty hero returns, kupo! You'll be happy to know all of the Mogmenders are accounted for. They're a bit shaken, but nothing a good day's rest cannot fix.
TEXT_BANMOG401_02302_MOGEK_000_051: I should hope the brood will not return, but if they do, you can be sure we will call on you and Whei Ahf once more.
TEXT_BANMOG402_02303_MOGEK_000_000: ! Perfect. We are sorely in need of one with your gift for negotiation.
TEXT_BANMOG402_02303_MOGEK_000_001: With every passing day we find the stones that must be moved for construction to be larger and larger. The Mogmenders are at their wit's end, kupo! Thankfully, Whei Ahf has agreed to introduce us to dragons willing to help.
TEXT_BANMOG402_02303_MOGEK_000_002: That is, of course, if we can agree on proper payment. There is little we can offer at present, and the Mogmenders are like to be intimidated by the dragons' imposing presence. We need someone who can look them in the eye and strike a fair deal.
TEXT_BANMOG402_02303_MOGEK_000_003: No doubt they're at Zenith discussing terms even as we speak. Please hurry, before we're up to our poms in debt, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG402_02303_NEGOTIATEMOOGLEA023: Oh, I wasn't expecting Mogek to send anyone. No need to worry, though. A pact has been made, and the dragons will soon be ready to work, kupo!
Except, well...they have no interest in what we had to offer.
Instead, they ask for metal covers fitted for their claws, kupo! They say their claws are chipped, and must be kept safe until they regrow.
Instead, they ask for nests of sorts made of soft materials, that they may rest easy whenever they come to Zenith.
Instead, they ask for ointments to heal their wounds. Though dragons are wont to sleep when injured, they wish to experience the healing arts of man.

I fear none of us have the skill to produce goods suitable to their high standards. I know this is sudden, but we could really use your help, kupo! When you've crafted the offerings, take them to my assistant.
If you're running low on materials, just say the word and I'll track down more. Don't take too long, though. My assistant can only placate the dragons for so long, kupo.
That was fast, kupo! And not a moment too soon. The dragons are growing restless. Take them the offerings, quickly!
TEXT_BANMOG402_02303_NEGOTIATEMOOGLEB023: If you would kindly wait just a short while longer, we have our very best moogles working to prepare your payment.
TEXT_BANMOG402_02303_PARTTIMEDRAGONA0230: Such puny creatures. These massive stones you speak of are but pebbles to us.
TEXT_BANMOG402_02303_PARTTIMEDRAGONB0230: The pact has been made, moogle. If you cannot provide what was agreed upon, then we will take our leave.
TEXT_BANMOG402_02303_NEGOTIATEMOOGLEB023: Oh, thank goodness. A real . The day may yet be saved, kupo! Please tell me you have what the dragons have demanded of us.
Yes, yes, I am sure they will be most pleased.
O mighty dragons, I humbly offer this as payment for your services. I hope it meets with your expectations.
TEXT_BANMOG402_02303_PARTTIMEDRAGONA0230: Hmmm... Well done. Perhaps there is merit in working with you moogles after all.
TEXT_BANMOG402_02303_PARTTIMEDRAGONB0230: You have honored the pact, and so we shall do the same. Our strength is yours.
TEXT_BANMOG402_02303_NEGOTIATEMOOGLEB023: Phew. I shudder to think what would've happened if they didn't approve. Thanks, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG402_02303_NEGOTIATEMOOGLEA023: I daresay we wouldn't be able to finish the plaza without them. With the dragons handling the heavy lifting, things should move along much more smoothly, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG402_02303_MOGEK_000_040: The Mogmenders tell me a certain someone's help was vital in negotiating with the dragons. Naturally, I assumed they meant yours truly. Imagine my embarrassment when I remembered I'd sent you on that errand! Well done, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG402_02303_MOGEK_000_041: I really cannot thank you enough. Do you have any idea how many moogles it would take to carry even one of those boulders? Neither do I. Just trying to imagine it leaves me exhausted.
TEXT_BANMOG402_02303_MOGEK_000_042: But with dragons handling the more strenuous labor, the Mogmenders can give more attention to detail. I daresay the monument may even turn out more marvelous than me, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG402_02303_SYSTEM_000_043: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANMOG403_02304_MOGEK_000_000: Did you know the landlords of old built a crafting facility at the Rookery? At least that's what the dragons have told me. What a time to be alive that must have been, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG403_02304_MOGEK_000_001: There is much to be gained by having such a place to work, which is why I've set the Mogmenders to work scouring the area for salvageable equipment. I'm sure their work would go faster with your help.
TEXT_BANMOG403_02304_MOGEK_000_002: As to specifically how you can assist, you'll have to speak with the Mogmenders to see what still needs fixing.
TEXT_BANMOG403_02304_CRAFTSMOOGLE02304_0: You must be that master artisan I've heard so much about, kupo! Welcome, welcome!

Here on this very spot─or rather, down the stairs there near those dreadful wyverns─landlords astride skylords would descend from on high. Such transport was possible thanks to special equipment made here in the Rookery.
The facilities that produced this equipment have fallen into disarray from centuries of neglect, but never fear. When we finish here they will be good as new, kupo!

Though, your talents would be wasted on the few tasks I have at present. Hmmm. Perhaps you should speak with my fellow Mogmender. He's conducted a rather thorough survey of the grounds and should know what is most in need of repair.
I have no jobs worthy of your skill, but I'm certain my companion just over yonder will have a task or three for you, kupo.
TEXT_BANMOG403_02304_WORKUNDERMOOGLE0230: So many parts, so little time. What are we to do, kupo?
TEXT_BANMOG403_02304_RECEIPTMOOGLE02304_: The Rookery is truly a sight to behold. Or at least, it will be when we finish, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG403_02304_WORKUNDERMOOGLE0230: Come for work, have you? Well you're in luck, kupo! I have checked every nook and cranny of the Rookery, and let me tell you, I would much rather build the whole thing from scratch than repair what the landlords left behind.
At present, I'm working on a few old fabric-shearing machines. Nothing but lumps of rust if you ask me. I can try to salvage pieces from them, but I need you to fashion a new set of blades.
At present, I'm working on a few old fabric-shearing machines. Nothing but lumps of rust if you ask me. I can try to salvage pieces from them, but I need you to fashion components for a new roller.
At present, I'm working on a few old fabric-shearing machines. Nothing but lumps of rust if you ask me. I can try to salvage pieces from them, but I need you to whip up some grease for the gears.
If you're lacking materials, you need only ask. When you've finished, take what you have to my assistant.
No need to be shy. I'm here to help, kupo! Just let me know if there's anything else you need.
You've finished? Splendid! Hurry over to my assistant and deliver those parts. One less task on his list should brighten his day.
TEXT_BANMOG403_02304_RECEIPTMOOGLE02304_: Hm? What's that about the shearing machines?
New parts! Kupopopo! We could do well to have a few more workers like you around. Many thanks, friend.
TEXT_BANMOG403_02304_WORKUNDERMOOGLE0230: We've still a long way to go, but mark my words: the landlords of old would be jealous if they could see what we have planned, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG403_02304_CRAFTSMOOGLE02304_0: <sigh> What I wouldn't give to see the Rookery as it once was.
TEXT_BANMOG403_02304_RECEIPTMOOGLE02304_: Step by step, stone by stone. That's how we'll get the job done.
TEXT_BANMOG403_02304_MOGEK_000_040: Back so soon? If only the others could work with such haste. Then again, recreating equipment from a thousand years ago is no small feat.
TEXT_BANMOG403_02304_MOGEK_000_041: It will be worth it in the end, though. Those facilities will soon be of great use in our work. I can feel it in my pom, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG404_02305_MOGEK_000_000: Aha! There you are! Speak of the crafter and  shall appear, kupo! The Mogmenders are hard at work on a fountain for the plaza, and the moogle in charge has asked for you by name.
TEXT_BANMOG404_02305_MOGEK_000_001: No doubt he's waiting for you by the fountain even as we speak. Well, don't just stand there gawping at my pom. Off you trot!
TEXT_BANMOG404_02305_DESIGNMOOGLE02305_0: Thank goodness. I was beginning to think you wouldn't come. I am happy to announce the fountain's base is all but complete, kupo. Before we proceed, however, I thought it prudent to consider how it might weather the ages once we finish.
The Lost Landlord, for example, was constructed over a thousand years ago. Yet the ravages of time have left not even a scratch on it. Our fountain must be just as resilient, if not more so, kupo!

That's why I set my best moogles to uncovering how such a colossal monument has survived all these centuries. Though I can't say what they'll find, my pom tells me this task will require one of your expertise. Better safe than sorry, I always say.
Speak with the Mogmenders down at the Lost Landlord and see what they've discovered. I'm counting on you, . Without a solid foundation there can be no fountain.
I don't know what they plan on making down there, but whatever it is, I doubt it will be much trouble for a crafter like you, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG404_02305_PONDMOOGLE02305_000: Can you believe this structure was built over a thousand years ago?
TEXT_BANMOG404_02305_RECEIPTMOOGLE02305_: If I wasn't floating under its shadow, I wouldn't believe a tower this old could stay in tip-top shape.
TEXT_BANMOG404_02305_PONDMOOGLE02305_000: You must be my new crafting assistant. Good, good. I was just reading over the results of my analysis. If my data is correct─and I'll bet a sack of kupo nuts it is─we should be able to preserve our fountain much in the same way the landlords did this one.
However, it will require a water filter of the highest quality. That's where you come in, kupo!
First, I need you to acquire logs from the petrified birch trees in Ohl Tahn. Three should suffice, I think. When you've brought them back we can begin.
The trees you find there may appear queer at first glance, but I assure you they are what we need. As I said before, no need to trouble yourself with more than three logs.
TEXT_BANMOG404_02305_PONDRESEARCHMOOGLE0: Welcome back, my wingless assistant. I trust you found lumber suitable for our work?
Yes, these will do nicely. I need but pulverize the wood like so, and...kupo! It's ready.
Now, I want you to follow these plans for the water filter, and coat the component with this reagent made from the petrified birch logs. It should help prevent corrosion.
Now, I want you to follow these plans for the water filter, and use this filler made from the petrified birch logs. It should serve to prevent leaking.
Now, I want you to follow this recipe using powder from the petrified birch logs to make a reagent that should keep the water filter from corroding.

The logs you brought back were more than enough, but if you lack for other materials I would be more than happy to prepare more, kupo! When you've finished, my assistant will see to storing what you made.
Is something the matter? Should you need anything please don't hesitate to ask, kupo.
Hmmm. Yes, everything seems to be in order. Take that over to my assistant for safekeeping. It shouldn't be long now before we can resume work on the fountain at Bahrr Lehs, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG404_02305_RECEIPTMOOGLE02305_: I was told someone would be delivering a component for the fountain. I take it that's you, kupo?
Oh my, what wonderful work! Making you his assistant was a wise choice indeed. Our fountain is sure to be even better than this one!
I'll keep this safe until we begin construction. You can count on me, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG404_02305_PONDRESEARCHMOOGLE0: Thanks to you, building a fountain that will last for the next thousand years should be as child's play.
TEXT_BANMOG404_02305_DESIGNMOOGLE02305_0: This will be the greatest fountain the Churning Mists has ever known. Just you wait and see, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG404_02305_MOGEK_000_050: And so the master  returns. No doubt the new fountain will stand for two─no, three thousand years, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG404_02305_MOGEK_000_051: This is history in the making, my friend. Centuries from now, man, dragon, and moogle alike will look on it in wonder, all thanks to you.
TEXT_BANMOG404_02305_SYSTEM_000_052: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANMOG405_02306_MOGEK_000_000: Say, , you've spent a fair amount of time in the ruins dotting the Churning Mists, yes? Did you know they once used special conduits powered by the magicks of dragons?
TEXT_BANMOG405_02306_MOGEK_000_001: As luck would have it, we recently found three at the Monsterie still intact, kupo! What were they used for? That's what we mean to find out.
TEXT_BANMOG405_02306_MOGEK_000_002: The quickest way to do so would be to reactivate them, and that will require the aid of our good friend Whei Ahf. I would go myself, but I'm much too busy. Yes, that's it. Busy! Now then, off you go.
TEXT_BANMOG405_02306_WYVERNRECEPTION0230: Hello,  of man. What business brings you here?
Statues powered by dragons? Yes, I have heard stories. If the moogles wish to reawaken them, far be it from us to refuse. Allow me to call Whei Ahf.
TEXT_BANMOG405_02306_SYSTEM_000_012: The dragon statue pulses faintly with a mysterious light. Have Whei Ahf use his Roar to see if it reacts.
TEXT_BANMOG405_02306_WYVERNRECEPTION0230: Are there statues yet to be awakened? I will call Whei Ahf at once.
TEXT_BANMOG405_02306_SYSTEM_000_020: The magicks in the stone statue stir, awakened by Whei Ahf's roar!
TEXT_BANMOG405_02306_WYVERN02306_000_021: (-Whei Ahf-)It is done. I am surprised after all these years they still respond to the dragon's call. The landlords were more clever than I thought. Come, let us find the others.
TEXT_BANMOG405_02306_SYSTEM_000_030: The magicks in the stone statue stir, awakened by Whei Ahf's roar!
TEXT_BANMOG405_02306_WYVERN02306_000_031: (-Whei Ahf-)This one too remembers the dragon's call. Hmmm...I sense there is yet another statue nearby. We must awaken it.
TEXT_BANMOG405_02306_NEARMOOGLE02306_000: <snore> Please, mother...just one more kupo nut...
TEXT_BANMOG405_02306_SYSTEM_000_040: The magicks in the stone statue stir, awakened by Whei Ahf's roar!
TEXT_BANMOG405_02306_WYVERN02306_000_041: (-Whei Ahf-)This statue marks the last. I know not what manner of device is driven by their power, but it will soon be roused to action. Of this I am certain.
TEXT_BANMOG405_02306_NEARMOOGLE02306_000: Kupopopo! I'll be good, I promise! Huh? Phew, it's only you. I was sleep─I mean, resting my eyes when I heard a terrible roar. But never mind that, the statue is glowing! Did you do this? I'll have to inform the Mogmenders at once.
You won't say anything about what you saw to Mogek, will you? He'll have my pom if he hears I was sleeping on duty again, kupo.
TEXT_BANMOG405_02306_MOGEK_000_050: You've returned, and in one piece, kupo! We've tried to accompany Whei Ahf on trips such as this in the past, but the magic in his roar is so powerful. It's enough to pop one's pom!
TEXT_BANMOG405_02306_MOGEK_000_051: I confess that even my magnificent pom could not bear the might of his bellowing cry. I was in bed for at least a week.
TEXT_BANMOG405_02306_MOGEK_000_052: Thankfully we have you to assist with dragon duties now. Such a lucky one you are. If only I had a pom as durable as you─wait, I'd nearly forgotten you don't have a pom! I suppose you're not so lucky after all, kupo.
TEXT_BANMOG501_02307_MOGEK_000_000: , just the person I needed to talk to! Or someone else needs to talk to, rather. A moogle from Moghome has a request and asked for you personally should I see you around the plaza.
TEXT_BANMOG501_02307_MOGEK_000_001: When I inquired what for, he said it was a secret, so I am not sure what it could be. But you'll oblige him regardless, won't you?
TEXT_BANMOG501_02307_CRAFTSMOOGLE02307_0: I've been waiting for you, kupo! I wanted to speak with you away from the plaza because we are preparing something special. It's a surprise!
You see, the Temple Knights spend night and day helping us out with the reconstruction efforts, so I wanted to do something nice for them in return.
At first, I thought to show Moghome's appreciation by playing a trick on them, but as it turns out, Temple Knights don't take too kindly to that sort of camaraderie.
Instead, we will give them a taste of our homemade cuisine, but we are missing some finishing touches that I wanted you to help us with as an exceptional .

We are preparing a dish of stewed mushrooms and vegetables from around the Churning Mists. We grill the vegetables over an open flame before adding them to the pot, and need skewers to do so. Could you make us some, kupo?

We are preparing a dish of stewed mushrooms and vegetables from around the Churning Mists. We need containers to pour the mogstew into that won't slosh around before delivery. Could you make us some, kupo?

We are preparing a dish of stewed mushrooms and vegetables from around the Churning Mists. However, we need seasonings that appeal to the tastes of man, as the vegetables can be quite bitter. Could you make us some, kupo?
Let me know if you need any materials, kupo!
When you are finished, please hand them to my friend over there, who will prepare the mogstew for delivery.
TEXT_BANMOG501_02307_HILDEATH_000_020: The plaza is becoming quite a remarkable place, don't you agree? And it is all thanks to the collective efforts of both man and moogle.
TEXT_BANMOG501_02307_RECEIPTMOOGLE02307_:
A little of this...♪
A little of that...♪
And a whooole lot of that...♪
Did you bring what we need?
Thank you very much! And now for the coup de grâce...
Ta-daaa! Mmmm, can you smell that heavenly aroma? ...But I'm a bit worried that the artisans might not take a single bite if a moogle presented it to them. We still have our reputation for trickery.
How about I have you deliver it to Hildeth for me, kupo? She'll be less suspicious if it's from you.
No tricks, I promise! Although I can't be blamed should they find a stray white hair or two in their food. It's unavoidable, I'm afraid.
TEXT_BANMOG501_02307_CRAFTSMOOGLE02307_0: I hope they find the mogstew tasty. We spent nearly a fortnight gathering all of the ingredients, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG501_02307_HILDEATH_000_041: Wow, that smells divine. What is the occasion, if I may ask?
TEXT_BANMOG501_02307_HILDEATH_000_042: A token of gratitude from the moogles? What a kindly─wait, is this safe to eat?
TEXT_BANMOG501_02307_HILDEATH_000_043: No, no, I trust you checked. This will be a refreshing break from hard biscuits, to be sure.
TEXT_BANMOG501_02307_HILDEATH_000_044: Moogles are surprising creatures. We've been trying to adapt ourselves to their culture, but it appears they too have been thinking the same. Please tell them we have gladly accepted this token.
TEXT_BANMOG501_02307_HILDEATH_000_045: I'll be the one to distribute the helpings of vegetables amongst the sappers. Although I will tell them beforehand that it came from the moogles, just as a precaution.
TEXT_BANMOG501_02307_RECEIPTMOOGLE02307_: Hooray! They enjoyed my cooking! Perhaps next time I'll try a kupo nut pudding, nice and moist.
TEXT_BANMOG501_02307_CRAFTSMOOGLE02307_0: You know what they say: the way to man's heart is through their stomach, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG501_02307_MOGEK_000_050: Welcome back, . Did you find out what the moogles at Moghome wanted?
TEXT_BANMOG501_02307_MOGEK_000_051: Ah, so they wished to surprise the Temple Knights with a sampling of Moghome cooking. I must say I thought to do the same, but I was worried that our food would not suit their sophisticated tastes. After all, we moogles aren't known for having a diverse diet.
TEXT_BANMOG501_02307_MOGEK_000_052: Even so, they seem to be satisfied with the gesture all the same. Perhaps someday I'll be able to try a bite of the Temple Knights' cooking, too. I've always wanted to, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG502_02308_MOGEK_000_000: Right on time, ! I have need of your keen eye. You see, the more enterprises the Mogmenders take on, the more crystals we must stockpile for crafting. We accepted help from an eager moogle of Moghome who will gather crystals so we can maintain our pace.
TEXT_BANMOG502_02308_MOGEK_000_001: While we are grateful for an extra set of paws, this young one has no experience, kupo. Likely he cannot even tell a crystal from a glass shard. I would like you to assist him in finding a sample crystal. He is expecting you at the summit of Sohm Al.
TEXT_BANMOG502_02308_GATHERINGMOOGLE0230: Mogek told me to wait here for a crystal expert, so I suppose that would be you. Pleasure to make your acquaintance, kupo!

I'm afraid to say I don't know very much about what kind of crystals the Mogmenders want. I was told kupa trees like the ones at the Landlord Colony are a viable source, but I wouldn't even know which ones are ripe for harvest.
Mogek and I agreed this would go much swifter if a master such as yourself informed me of the precise location of the trees that have crystals ripe for harvest. Then I'll handle the rest, kupo!
Don't worry, I'll stay riiight here, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG502_02308_SYSTEM_000_020: You have found a crystal of fine quality for synthesis!
TEXT_BANMOG502_02308_SYSTEM_000_021: You have found a crystal, but it is of unsuitable quality for synthesis.
TEXT_BANMOG502_02308_GATHERINGMOOGLE0230: Did you have any luck, kupo?
So this is what one looks like. Wherever did you find it?
Well then, I'm off to gather my first crystals. You have my thanks, kupo!
If all goes well, this could be the start of a new life for me. Maybe I could get my own set of mining tools, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG502_02308_MOGEK_000_040: I suppose you were able to teach him what a well-chosen crystal looks like. Good, good.
TEXT_BANMOG502_02308_MOGEK_000_041: It's strange, isn't it? That it was the dragons who first taught man how to gather the crystals from the kupa trees, and now in turn, the moogles are learning from man, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_MOGEK_000_000: We are on the verge of a breaking discovery, kupo! You remember our mission to restore the Rookery to its proper capacity, yes?
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_MOGEK_000_001: Well, one of our moogles was investigating the stone dragons around the perimeters and found they were no mere ornaments. Unlike other statues, these ones faintly glow. We think they served a more useful purpose.
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_MOGEK_000_002: We want to see if they react in the presence of dragon magicks, and for that we need Whei Ahf! Could you summon him to roar upon the statues?
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_WYVERNRECEPTION0230: Yes, we know of those statues! Father told me about them once.
He said there are many mysterious stone sculptures that seem to respond to dragon magicks under certain conditions, although we are unsure why or how.
Perhaps Whei Ahf knows better how to awaken them. Wait here and I shall call him for you.
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_NEARMOOGLE02309_000: What secrets do you hold, kupo?
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_SYSTEM_000_015: The dragon statue pulses faintly with a mysterious light. Have Whei Ahf use his Roar to see if it reacts.
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_WYVERNRECEPTION0230: Where is Whei Ahf? Did he leave you behind? Here, I shall call him again for you.
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_SYSTEM_000_020: The magicks in the stone statue stir as if awakened by Whei Ahf's roar.
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_WYVERN02309_000_021: (-Whei Ahf-)These statues are indeed from a bygone age. Yet something is strange. Why does this statue carved by man respond to a dragon's roar in the present? Come, let us continue until all have been roused.
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_SYSTEM_000_030: The magicks in the stone statue stir as if awakened by Whei Ahf's roar.
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_WYVERN02309_000_031: (-Whei Ahf-)I am reminded of the elders' stories. Of how our kind used to bear man across the heavens, as I bear you now.
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_SYSTEM_000_040: The magicks in the stone statue stir as if awakened by Whei Ahf's roar.
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_WYVERN02309_000_041: (-Whei Ahf-)Ah, could it be possible that these statues respond to the presence of our solidarity?
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_SYSTEM_000_050:
The magicks in the stone statue stir as if awakened by Whei Ahf's roar.
You hear a sound of heavy stone scraping in the distance.
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_NEARMOOGLE02309_000: What was that strange noise just now?
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_WYVERN02309_000_052: (-Whei Ahf-)Perhaps the true functions of these statues have been lost to time. The men and dragons of the peaceful age had been known to make instruments that were mutually useful to both.
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_WYVERN02309_000_053: (-Whei Ahf-)I leave it to you moogles to investigate whether it can be useful to you as well. For now, my throat is spent. Let us return.
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_NEARMOOGLE02309_000: I wonder if they unlocked some mechanism or utility we can use in our construction.
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_MOGEK_000_060: The statues did react then? Excellent, kupo! We will send out an exploration party at once to see if any of the structures around the Rookery have changed.
TEXT_BANMOG503_02309_MOGEK_000_061: The men and dragons before the time of the great war must have had a truly unique bond to create such devices. If they are watching from the heavens, I am certain they would be happy you and Whei Ahf are bearing the torch, so to speak, kupo.
TEXT_BANMOG504_02310_MOGEK_000_000: <sigh> Why do I even bother sometimes...
TEXT_BANMOG504_02310_MOGEK_000_001: A group of moogles said they were going to take a break from the restoration effort and explore the area around the Shiva statue south of here. But they appear to be taking too long for my tastes. Might you check on them and see what they are up to?
TEXT_BANMOG504_02310_CRAFTSMOOGLE02310_0: The Mother of the Sheave... So beautiful...
Oh, pardon me, kupo! I was so entranced by such majesty that I didn't see you standing there. Every time I lay eyes on her, I cannot help but feel inspired.
How many years would it take to carve a statue of this size, I wonder? Ten? Twenty? One hundred? Regardless, it is a display of dedication worthy of the highest respect.
Someday I wish to be respected as a moogle sculptor, and that's why my mind is made up, kupo! I too shall hone my skills and create a statue as grandeur as this one! ...With a little help, of course.
You have an eye for detail, right? Do you think you could craft me a small metal statue in the likeness of a valiant moogle? I want to use it as a model for my much bigger mog monument, kupo!

You have an eye for detail, right? Do you think you could use your expertise to fashion me a small statue in the likeness of a valiant moogle? I want to use it as a model to practice for my much bigger mog monument, kupo!

You have an eye for detail, right? Do you think you could mold me a small resin statue in the likeness of a valiant moogle? I want to use it as a model to practice for my much bigger mog monument, kupo!

While I would love to see you work, I do not have any materials on hand, unfortunately. But my brother is a peddler who deals in odds and ends at the summit of Sohm Al. If you mention I sent you for my work, he should be willing to give you materials, free of cost.
Be sure to craft the statuette as intricately as you can. After all, it could become the model of a monument that could stand for a thousand years, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG504_02310_MERCHANTMOOGLE02310: Welcome, welcome! If I have anything you desire, just say the word, kupo!
He wants to carve what? Did he hit his pom or something? My brother is talented, to be sure, but he's no master! Even a sculpture my size would take him more than a fortnight, kupo!
I'm rather doubtful that he could create such an enormous piece. But since you came all this way, I suppose I'll have to indulge him. Here.
You know what they say, practice makes perfect, kupo! If only my brother would take the same advice before declaring such lofty goals.

Fantastic work, kupo! Take it to my brother. I'm certain he is still living in his little dream world next to Shiva. It seems like he spends hours gazing at it when he's not working on the reconstruction.
TEXT_BANMOG504_02310_CRAFTSMOOGLE02310_0: Did you finish making the model?
Wow, it's so lifelike, kupo! The details in the fur...The veins on the wings... If I didn't know better, I would say you've had quite the career as a sculptor yourself.
Thank you so much for making me such an elaborate piece. You can tell Mogek that I've found my true calling in life. With this in hand, I'll be a master sculptor in no time, kupo!
I'm so excited, kupo! Although it would probably be best to start with a small boulder, kupo. Hmmm...
TEXT_BANMOG504_02310_MERCHANTMOOGLE02310: I'm not saying it's completely out of the question, but my brother tends to get in over his head sometimes. Surely he knows that the Mother of the Sheave was carved by more than one person, right?
TEXT_BANMOG504_02310_MOGEK_000_050: I see, so he decided he would rather dedicate his time to sculpting. Well, I for one have no qualms with it. Not every moogle is suited to be a Mogmender, you know.
TEXT_BANMOG504_02310_MOGEK_000_051: Besides, if he is successful in his mission, then perhaps magnificent moogle statues will be scattered around the Churning Mists, kupo! I am glad you were able to support him in his dream, no matter how big or small.
TEXT_BANMOG504_02310_SYSTEM_000_052: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANMOG505_02311_MOGEK_000_000: They're late, kupo! So very late!
TEXT_BANMOG505_02311_MOGEK_000_001: The sappers said that they would send for sundries that we cannot provide ourselves. The shipment should have arrived at the Rookery by now, but we have not received any word for a while. Where could they be?
TEXT_BANMOG505_02311_MOGEK_000_002: Oh, I hope that their airship did not run aground─or worse, run afoul of Nidhogg's brood. Could you go and take a look for me, kupo?
TEXT_BANMOG505_02311_ISHGARDSOLDIER02311: Ho there, adventurer! I am in need of your assistance. We were in the midst of unloading our cargo when these dragons showed up and surrounded the airship! We quickly carried off what cargo we could. I have my spear, yet I would rather not provoke the ire of a dragon mother, wherever she may be.
Needless to say, this had led to a considerable delay... You have dealt with your fair share of dragons, I am sure. Will you go and ask them what they want with our ship?
They don't look all that dangerous, but you can never be too sure.
TEXT_BANMOG505_02311_DRAGONPUPPY02311_00: How does it stay afloat? Why does it not flap its wings? What is that big ball on the top?
of man, tell us. What is this strange contraption?
Air...ship? So this is how man flies without wings? But it is so strange-looking!
Can I have an airship? Can I, please? I promise to take care of it!
TEXT_BANMOG505_02311_ISHGARDSOLDIER02311: They want what? Do I look like the bloody Saint of Nymeia to you?
Bah. If the beasts are anything like Ishgardian children, once they've made up their minds, they won't let up.
I have no time for this nonsense. You look as though you are good with your hands. Here, take these scraps of metal and hammer them together yourself.
I have no time for this nonsense. You look as though you are good with your hands. Here, take these scraps of hard leather and cobble them together yourself.
I have no time for this nonsense. You look as though you are good with your hands. Here, take these scraps of hardened resin and mold them together yourself.
The sooner you can give them their airships, the sooner we can have the cargo delivered.
I thought I already gave you some scraps? Chop-chop! I have no patience for these meddlesome pups.
What are you looking at me for? Go on, give them to the dragons so we can be on our way.
TEXT_BANMOG505_02311_DRAGONPUPPY02311_00: What is that? Could it be...?
Oh, thank you, thank you  of man! They are so lovely!
