Come now, my friends, let us go and play knights and wyrms!
TEXT_BANMOG505_02311_SYSTEM_000_041: The dragonets toss their airships off the edge of the isle. As gravity overtakes their maiden voyages, the laughing pups swoop down after them and disappear into the clouds below.
TEXT_BANMOG505_02311_ISHGARDSOLDIER02311: Well, they seem to be satisfied with your handiwork.

Though I must say their demands were most unexpected. To think that we might have bared steel against beings with desires no different than children. Anyhow, I thank you for your assistance, adventurer.
That's that, then. You can relay to our sappers that they should have their deliveries made once we get the rest of the cargo off the airship.
TEXT_BANMOG505_02311_MOGEK_000_060: A group of dragonets surrounded the airship? Sounds like it could have been a recipe for disaster, kupo. You and I already know that dragonlings mean no harm, but I suppose ordinary men may still see them as a threat. It was good that you were there to prevent any further escalation.
TEXT_BANMOG505_02311_MOGEK_000_061: I hear dragonets remain their same inquisitive selves for decades before they become fully grown dragons. If you think about it, when that Temple Knight's son becomes a man, he will likely see the same exact bright-eyed pups his father had, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG506_02312_MOGEK_000_000: Oh, what to do... I know they mean no harm, but must the dragons use our construction sites as dozing spots? It's starting to slow our progress, kupo.
TEXT_BANMOG506_02312_MOGEK_000_001: If only it were as simple as giving them a little nudge. I hear dragons do not take kindly to those who dare disturb their sleep... Ah, but wait! What if they were to wake of their own accord? Surely they would not be angry with us then, yes?
TEXT_BANMOG506_02312_MOGEK_000_002: I have an idea! Why don't you ride a cloud mallow and shake it over the dragons that they might sneeze themselves awake? It would be better to have an adventurer like you do it in case there are any mishaps, kupo.
TEXT_BANMOG506_02312_MOUNTCONTROLMOOGLE0: I heard, I heard. I'll be sure to give you one with lots of loose florets. It should take no more than a shake to make the fluff fly, kupo!
Did you fall off the cloud mallow, kupo? Here, try this one. It is not quite as fluffy as the last, but it will have to suffice.
TEXT_BANMOG506_02312_SYSTEM_000_012: A dragon is napping peacefully. Return with a cloud mallow and sprinkle mallow puffs on it to rouse it from its dream.
TEXT_BANMOG506_02312_HOLYDRAGONA02312_00: Slowly, now... Carefully, now... No sudden movements or loud noises...
Oh... Am I in your way? Forgive me, I was unaware. I shall find another place to rest.
Phew... The next one is blocking the road to the northeast! Let's go, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG506_02312_HOLYDRAGONB02312_00: <sneeze> So, that dreadful season is upon us.
Damnable spores. <sniffle> Enough. I move for fair skies.
TEXT_BANMOG506_02312_HOLYDRAGONA02312_00: That leaves one more to awaken. Our last stop is the Rookery, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG506_02312_HOLYDRAGONC02312_00: <sneeze> What, where am I? I must have...
What a curious dream I had. A pity it had to end so abruptly. No matter, I shall take wing and think on its meaning.
TEXT_BANMOG506_02312_HOLYDRAGONA02312_00: Is that...dragon snot on my fur? Ewww! One of the unexpected hazards of accepting this job, I suppose. Ugh, I'll have to go and clean this off. Anyway, many thanks for your help, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG506_02312_MOGEK_000_050: Oh, thank goodness. I was beginning to worry they would never wake up, kupo. Dragons are prone to sleeping much longer than you or I.
TEXT_BANMOG506_02312_MOGEK_000_051: Had we left those dragons be, who knows how long they might have slept? They could have delayed our work for moons, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG506_02312_MOGEK_000_052: I do feel a little guilty for disturbing their naps, but it was for the greater good. I am sure they would understand. Now it's time to get back to work, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG601_02313_MOGEK_000_000: You'll have noticed the stone buildings of the Churning Mists are caked with centuries of mold and grime. While some might say this gives them character, I'm not sure it makes for the healthiest environment.
TEXT_BANMOG601_02313_MOGEK_000_001: I entrusted the task of scouring the buildings to some moogles at Zenith. Having done so, they soon requested more adept hands─yours, kupo! They will explain everything there.
TEXT_BANMOG601_02313_MATERIALGETMOOGLE02: You've come to the right place, kupo! We are the cleaning team Mogek sent to scrape the structures. Yet I suppose you are wondering why our wyvern friend is here.

We were given metal rasps from the Temple Knight sappers, but they wore down too quickly. It was by chance that we found something else to use: coarse dragon scales, which have proven to be surprisingly resilient.

Fortunately, this molting wyvern has happily volunteered to help. However, we are having trouble removing the scales from the molt as our paws are less suited than your fingers to the task. Can you do it for us?
Although he seems a bit shy. He asked us himself if we would do this in a secluded location.
TEXT_BANMOG601_02313_WYVERN02313_000_014: If it is scales that you want, I have more than enough to give. My skin itches terribly so.
TEXT_BANMOG601_02313_RECEIPTMOOGLE02313_: Wyverns don't shed their scales very often, so we are very lucky to have him help us, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG601_02313_SYSTEM_000_020: Bits of dead skin drift through the air as you pluck handfuls of scale flakes from the molt on the wyvern's back. He breathes a sigh of relief.
TEXT_BANMOG601_02313_WYVERN02313_000_021: Ahhh, that feels much better than scraping my back against the crags.
TEXT_BANMOG601_02313_WYVERN02313_000_022: Shall I take my leave, then? I hope to conclude before my brothers come looking for me.
TEXT_BANMOG601_02313_MATERIALGETMOOGLE02: Let's see what you've got, kupo!
Great work, kupo! They'll snap off far too easily if they are brittle, but these ones will do nicely! That being said, we have one more favor to ask of you.
As a talented artisan, could you show us how to affix these scales to flat, metal shafts to make the rasps?
As a talented artisan, could you show us how to affix these scales to shafts of hardened leather or wood to make the rasps?
As a talented artisan, could you show us how to whip up an adhesive sticky enough to affix the scales to these metal shafts for the rasps?
My friend over there will be the one to collect them. Thanks again for the help, kupo!
If you need more materials to practice with, I'll have them ready for you. Sometimes it takes more than one attempt to get it right when making new tools, kupo!
That was a lot simpler and quicker than I expected, kupo! I will keep your method in mind when making more.
TEXT_BANMOG601_02313_RECEIPTMOOGLE02313_: Thank you, thank you. I'll gather the others. The buildings of the Churning Mists will be sparkling in no time, kupo!
Soon the buildings will be molting their old skins, too!
TEXT_BANMOG601_02313_MATERIALGETMOOGLE02: Sometimes I find myself envious of man's hands. Then I try to visualize having them, and see nothing but part moogle, part horrible beast.
TEXT_BANMOG601_02313_MOGEK_000_050: There you are, kupo! I was surprised to hear from one of the wyverns that she was flying past Zenith and saw the moogles using their old scales to make better rasps.
TEXT_BANMOG601_02313_MOGEK_000_051: Well, you know what they say, a dragon's trash is a moogle's treasure, kupo! ...Actually, no, no one really says that. But for the moment it's true, right?
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_MOGEK_000_000: Oh, good, good! I wanted to speak to you while Whei Ahf is away. You see, he has done so much for us, and we wanted to give him a worthy gift.
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_MOGEK_000_001: If you didn't know already, Whei Ahf is quite the connoisseur of cloudfish, kupo! We sent one of our best mogfishers to search for the perfect catch to present to him, but he seems to be taking his time, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_MOGEK_000_002: Sooo could you possibly...you know? Kupo?
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_MOGWON_000_003: Well if it isn't ! Those training supplies you made for us proved so durable, we're planning to pass them down to the new recruits, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_FISHINGMOOGLE02314_: Drats! Foiled again! And that was my last lure, too...
Oh, hello there. Say, you're , aren't you? My younger brother Mogwon never tires talking of your craftsmanship.

Perhaps the fates have conspired to bring you here. For hours I get not so much as a nibble until my last lure is snatched away, and a moment later an expert artisan like yourself appears before me. Please, lend me your help, kupo!
I beg you craft me a new fishing lure. One made of metal that catches the light so splendidly that even I would be drawn to its radiance!
I beg you craft me a new fishing lure. One that bears such a striking resemblance to a small cloudfish that even I would get confused!
I beg you mold me bait in the shape of a cloudfish. One so tasty that even I would be tempted to take a bite!
If you need materials, go and visit Mogwon in Asah. He would gladly hand over some for you to use.
I'll wait for you right here, kupo! Fishermoogles are used to being patient.
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_DRAGONPUPPY02314_00: Whei Ahf is out hunting right now. But do visit again if you are in need of his wings.
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_MOGWON_000_020: My brother lost another lure? Well, normally I'd complain, but this time, I'm sure you'll create one of exceptional quality so that he'd be more careful with it.
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_MOGWON_000_022: Do you need more materials? By all means, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_MOGWON_000_023: Are you all set then? My brother may be a mogfisher, but I'm sure he's eager to get back to reeling in his catches.
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_FISHINGMOOGLE02314_: I tried finding some worms to use as bait without much success. Have you finished making the lure?
Beautiful work, kupo! Why, if I didn't know it was a lure, I'd love and cherish it as a pet, kupo!
Well then, I shall try it out at my best spot and see what I can hook! No following me, now! A master mogfisher never reveals his secrets!
...Of course, I would be an idiot not to try out Tharl Oom Khash, where all the boastful catches are found. Let us meet there after I try out this new lure. I'll try not to disappoint, kupo!
This tackle you made for me is superb, kupo! As soon as I lowered my fishing pole over the cliffside, my line wouldn't stop trembling!

Out of all of my catches, I believe this one is the finest. As a mogfisher, I've seen all manner of common cloudfish, but this particular one is unknown to me. To a dragon, that would be a rare treat, right?
Huzzah, I did it! My finest catch yet, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_DRAGONPUPPY02314_00: Well come,  of man, did you wish to speak to Whei─
<gasp> What a succulent-looking fish! ...For Whei Ahf, I imagine? I shall summon him for you right away.
This adventurer and the moogles have something for you.
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_WYVERN02314_000_053: Such a delicacy I have not seen in an age. Wherefore the reason for this lavishness?
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_WYVERN02314_000_054: ...I am truly humbled by this gift, and I will be sure to take my time in savoring it. Pray give my thanks to the moogles.
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_DRAGONPUPPY02314_00: Whei Ahf gave me a taste of that cloudfish you gave him. I have never eaten anything so delicious! Next time, will you bring me one, too?
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_FISHINGMOOGLE02314_: Every mogfisher has a preferred lure, and this one is quickly becoming my favorite, kupo! Each time I reel it in, a new surprise is wriggling on the end!
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_MOGWON_000_057: <grumble> Although I hope my brother knows that our resources in Asah aren't unlimited. He can't just expect me to give him materials for tackle every time he loses one. This has to be the fifth time, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_MOGEK_000_060: I'm so glad you had a direct hand in helping us express gratitude to Whei Ahf for his assistance to the Mogmenders. We couldn't have done it without you, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_MOGEK_000_061: I am also somewhat relieved that Whei Ahf recognized it. The mogfisher said he wasn't sure what kind of fish it was, so it would be a disaster if it was poisonous.
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_MOGEK_000_062: At any rate, thank you so much for your help! Until next time!
TEXT_BANMOG602_02314_SYSTEM_000_063: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_MOGEK_000_000: There you are! I have a somewhat unconventional task for you. As you know, the restoration of Zenith is a massive undertaking and it requires gathering an immense amount of resources.
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_MOGEK_000_001: Unfortunately, Moguppo tells me that the moogles under his command, who have been mostly loafing around, are now ignoring his requests entirely. He asked me to intervene personally, but I think they need to be taught a harsher lesson.
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_MOGEK_000_002: I want you to go to these moogles in my stead and give them the harshest, most extreme orders you can come up with. And if they don't do as bade, I will see that they face dire consequences.
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_MOGEK_000_003: You can make up whatever consequences you like, but be as intimidating as possible, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_INSTRUCTIONWAITINGA: Gather ninety-nine birds' nests or else he'll have you squeeze my pom off!? Uwaaah! Not my pom, kupo! Anything but my pom!
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_INSTRUCTIONWAITINGB: Y-You can't be serious, kupo!? How am I supposed to gather that many wadjet spines? It's not like they'll just let me climb on their backs and─ Gah, don't stare at me like that, kupo! Okay, I'm going, I'm going!
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_INSTRUCTIONWAITINGC: Hello there─ Huh? Mogek says I'm to gather wind crystals while searching for one hundred and one moogles hiding throughout the Churning Mists or else? Or else what? N-Never mind. That tone says it all, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_MOGUPPO_000_013: <sigh> We're beginning to run out of wind crystals, kupo...
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_MOGUPPO_000_020: Hmmm... That's strange. I thought they would have returned by now.
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_MOGUPPO_000_021: Oh, I am certain they are slacking off again, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_MOGUPPO_000_022: Could you find them and make sure that they are gathering materials as instructed?
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_MOGUPPO_000_023: Where did they go to get those wind crystals? The moon?
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_INSTRUCTIONWAITINGA: H-Here you are, ninety-nine passerine nests. Oh, please, please, please don't pop my pom, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_INSTRUCTIONWAITINGC: Here are the wind crystals. <pant> And I could only find thirty-four hiding moogles, kupo... <pant> F-Forgive me.
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_INSTRUCTIONWAITINGA: Hooray, I'm saved! Ninety-nine passerine nests on the shelf. Ninety-nine passerine... Ahahaha. Ha. <sob>
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_INSTRUCTIONWAITINGB: I get it. <sniffle> I've learned my lesson. <sob> Moguppo is so much nicer about his requests.
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_INSTRUCTIONWAITINGC: <pant> I don't know what moogle in their right mind would think this was a good idea. <pant>
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_MOGUPPO_000_040: Well, where were they? Did they even do what they were told?
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_MOGUPPO_000_041: They gathered all of these on their own? What? How?
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_MOGUPPO_000_042: This is incredible. You're like a moogle whisperer, kupo! You can tell Mogek that we have enough raw materials for now. Thank you, !
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_MOGUPPO_000_043: You should teach me your methods sometime, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_MOGEK_000_051: Wow, they actually did everything you bade them to?
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_MOGEK_000_052: Remarkable isn't it? That they change their tune when they have an adventurer giving them orders rather than our sweet little Moguppo.
TEXT_BANMOG603_02315_MOGEK_000_053: Although I must admit, I wish I could have seen the looks on their faces myself, kupo. <giggle>
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_MOGEK_000_000: Welcome back, . Not too long ago Hildeth requested your assistance, which is why I was pointing you that way.
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_MOGEK_000_001: It probably has to do with the work the sappers are doing, but I told her I would send you along if I saw you, kupo.
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_HILDEATH_000_010: , . I would prefer if we kept our voices down. We sappers are arranging something for the moogles.
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_HILDEATH_000_011: As you know, they recently have been providing us with much-needed sustenance, giving us the strength to continue to toil night and day on the restoration. We wanted to repay that kindness by giving them a taste of a traditional Ishgardian stew.
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_HILDEATH_000_012: I thought to beseech your help, as when preparing a banquet, one always finds something missing. It takes quite a while for supplies to reach the Churning Mists from Ishgard, and we wish to serve the food to them before the ingredients spoil.
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_HILDEATH_000_013: Upon checking the supplies, we realized utensils from Ishgard are somewhat unwieldly for moogle paws. Perhaps you could use your skills to craft smaller spoons?
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_HILDEATH_000_014: Upon checking the supplies, we had forgotten to include essential accessories. Perhaps you could use your skills to make trays and serviettes?
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_HILDEATH_000_015: Upon checking the supplies, we realized we are unsure what moogles would actually drink as an accompaniment to the meal. Perhaps you could use your skills to make something they would enjoy?
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_HILDEATH_000_016: I hear you are acquainted with Mogwon in Asah. If you mention my name to him, I am sure he would hand over materials for you to use.
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_HILDEATH_000_017: Although I would still be discreet. Obviously, it is a surprise, and Mogwon tends to be inquisitive.
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_HILDEATH_000_018: I wonder, do moogles even eat meat? I've only ever seen them partake in kupo nuts, vegetables, and wine. Perhaps I should ask the cook to leave it out of the recipe in case it makes them sick. Hmm...
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_WORKINGMOOGLE02316_: One, two! One, two! No rest for the Mogmenders, kupo! Those nails aren't going to hammer themselves!
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_GATHERINGMOOGLE0231: Phew... Gathering crystals really saps your strength, kupo. My arms are so sore.
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_MOGWON_000_030: Huh? Are you sure Hildeth doesn't need something a little stronger and heavier for building materials? She often asks me for resources in bulk.
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_MOGWON_000_031: Hmmm... Well, if it's for the Temple Knights, I suppose there's no need to question it. Here you are, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_MOGWON_000_032: You should take those to Hildeth right away. She gets a scary look on her face when her orders are delayed, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_MOGWON_000_033: My apologies, kupo. It's just my responsibility to make certain the materials are being used in ways that benefit the projects.
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_HILDEATH_000_040: I take it you were able to prepare the finishing touches?
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_HILDEATH_000_041: Excellent. And with that, the meals are complete and ready to be handed out.
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_HILDEATH_000_042: Deliver these to the hardest-working moogles you can find. Oh, and Mogwon as well. And let me know if they enjoy it.
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_HILDEATH_000_043: I know it seems like so few bowls for how many moogles are working, but we want to be sure that it suits their tastes first. There's no use in ordering enough ingredients to feed all if it will only be wasted.
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_WORKINGMOOGLE02316_: What are you just standing there for? We've got a job to do, kupo!
Wow, this is unexpected! I suppose a small lunch break wouldn't hurt so long as we pick up the pace afterwards. Thank you very much, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_MOGWON_000_052: Oh, you're back. Does Hildeth require more resources?
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_MOGWON_000_053: Aha! I knew she was planning something, kupo! This looks positively toothsome!
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_GATHERINGMOOGLE0231: <pant> Where is the moogle to relieve me from duty? I really could use...<pant>...a break.
Hildeth had you bring this food all the way over here for me? Wow, I feel so honored, kupo! Thank you, adventurer!
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_WORKINGMOOGLE02316_: It even has a little spoon just for me, kupo! No need to dig in with my bare paws. Although I am somewhat tempted.
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_MOGWON_000_057: Mmm, I can't wait to try it, kupo! This makes up for all of the headaches my team has been giving me lately.
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_GATHERINGMOOGLE0231: After a couple bites of that stew, I feel like I could bring in an entire cartload of crystals, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_HILDEATH_000_059: It appears the moogles are enjoying our culinary creation, so we hope to make this a regular occurrence. We will make more when the next shipment comes in, so be assured that every Mogmender will eventually be able to try a taste.
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_MOGEK_000_070: What is going on? I just saw a moogle fly by with a delicious-looking sauce dribbled all over his coat.
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_MOGEK_000_071: Hildeth is having trays of food handed out to some of the Mogmenders? But, but, what about me, kupo? I didn't receive one! Are there any left?
TEXT_BANMOG604_02316_MOGEK_000_072: <sigh> Oh, it's fine. It's not like I told you I wanted any. People forget, I suppose. It was just, you know, a little dream of mine to dine on proper Ishgardian cuisine, but oh well... <sniffle>
TEXT_BANMOG605_02317_MOGEK_000_000: It's good to see you, kupo! I have a favor to ask. We've been learning new techniques for mining wind crystals from the Temple Knights, and two of our mining moogles were sent to try out their methods. But I haven't seen so much as a shard delivered yet.
TEXT_BANMOG605_02317_MOGEK_000_001: I'm not privy to what's going on over there, so I was wondering if you could go and see what's keeping them? They said they would set up their extraction site on a small floating islet underneath Ohl Tahn.
TEXT_BANMOG605_02317_BORINGMOOGLEA02317_: Well met, adventurer! I assume Mogek sent you to check on us? We seem to be in a bit of a pinch, kupo.
The Temple Knight sappers told us the wind crystals within the center of floating isles are much more potent than ordinary crystals, and suggested drilling holes to mine them from the inside out.

But we've had a little accident, kupo. You see, the Temple Knights lent us a treadwheel crane with which to haul load from the center of the isle, but in bringing it to this spot piece by piece, my apprentice dropped one of the cargo boxes and it disappeared through the clouds, kupo!
We can't retrieve it and even if we could, I'm certain the components in that box would be nothing but dust by the time we found it. We require replacement parts posthaste.
You will help us, right? You can make us a metal sheave that won't break under the weight of hundreds of ponzes worth of crystals?
You will help us, right? You can make us parts for the belt and wheel strong enough to withstand the weight of hundreds of ponzes worth of crystals?
You will help us, right? You can mix us pots of grease with which to lubricate the pulley?
I've brought with me some items which you can use to make replacement components. When you've finished, bring them to my apprentice so that he may start putting the treadwheel together.
Here are the materials. I hope you can replace the missing elements speedily─the demand for wind crystals is never quite sated and I'm sure Mogek is already becoming impatient, kupo.
If you've finished creating the components, please give them to my apprentice over there. He'll be the one to put the crane together, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG605_02317_BORINGMOOGLEB02317_: Curse these little paws, kupo! If only I had been more careful...
Are the components ready? Can it really be fixed?
Oh, thank you! Thank you so much, kupo! I swear on my pom that I will never drop another box in my life. You can tell Mogek that we're all set here, kupo!
We will be able to commence our mining in no time, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG605_02317_BORINGMOOGLEA02317_: Phew... You really saved us there. Oh, but let's keep this as a secret. No use having the Temple Knights fret over spilled nut milk. With your master mending skills, you might even have improved the original crane, right?
TEXT_BANMOG605_02317_MOGEK_000_040: Welcome back, ! I take it you were able to resolve the problem?
TEXT_BANMOG605_02317_MOGEK_000_041: Excellent, kupo! New mining techniques are always welcome, especially now that we know the wind crystals in the center of the isles are of better quality. I can't wait to see the delivery of the first loads.
TEXT_BANMOG605_02317_MOGEK_000_042: But I hope those two take great care with every step. The Temple Knights warned us to extract the crystals in moderation, else the isle loses its buoyancy and falls right out of the sky, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGEK_000_000: Hello, . I need your help. It's about Mogwon. The last I saw him, he looked as if he was going to pull out all of his fur in frustration.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGEK_000_001: If moogles could go bald, he would be the first, kupo! Might I trouble you to go to Asah and ask what is troubling him?
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGWON_000_010: Thank you for coming, ! I trust Mogek sent you to inquire about the progress here in Asah? While Bahrr Lehs is nearing completion, I can't say I am content with our pace here.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGWON_000_011: Thank you for coming, ! I trust Mogek sent you to inquire about the progress here in Asah? While the plaza at Bahrr Lehs has been completely restored, I can't say I am content with our pace here.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGWON_000_012: In fact, there is one moogle in particular who is not only a lackluster bricklayer, but a master procrastinator! He always has some sort of excuse for why he can't be bothered to put hammer to nail. I've tried everything!
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGWON_000_013: He doesn't like to listen to me, but he might lend an ear to a fellow mender, an elite one at that. Perhaps you can try giving him some words of encouragement?
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGWON_000_014: He's not hard to miss. He's always hiding behind the buildings so that I can't clearly see what he's up to.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGWON_000_015: I've begged and pleaded and even tried working up some tears, but nothing worked. Maybe he'll listen to you.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_SULKINGMOOGLE02318_: Up, down, turn around, breathe in, breathe out, breathe in...
Shhh! Can't you see I am doing my preparatory routine? A mender must be of sound mind and body, and that is achieved through profound contemplation. I must have peace and quiet!
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_SYSTEM_000_021: The malingering moogle flutters away, muttering under his breath.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_SYSTEM_000_022: The malingering moogle is apparently one tough kupo nut to crack. Search for and try to psych him up.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_SYSTEM_000_023: Despite your best efforts, the moogle continues to ignore you. Perhaps if you were to psych him up, it would put a spring into his step.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_SULKINGMOOGLE02318_: You again, kupo? I told you, if you disturb me, then I won't be able to focus and then no work will get done today! Now I have to start all over again.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_SYSTEM_000_031: The malingering moogle scoffs at you as he flutters away.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_SYSTEM_000_032: An expert  does not deserve this kind of treatment. Find the moogle once more and slap some sense into him.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_SYSTEM_000_033: Despite your best efforts, the moogle continues to ignore you. Perhaps if you were to slap him, he would pay attention.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_SULKINGMOOGLE02318_: D─Did you just... What... H-How can  slap, kupo!?
Mogwon says I'm the one slacking off? For a moogle who does nothing but delegate all day, he has some nerve, kupo! If he's so fixated on pushing me around then he can forget it! Hmph!
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGWON_000_051: You slapped him? Wow, and I thought I had some pent-up frustrations. While I appreciate your enthusiasm, it appears to have had the opposite effect. Hmmm...maybe Master Tarresson was right about trying a more traditional method.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGWON_000_052: Bribery! If you crafted him a shiny new tool, surely he would feel obligated to put more effort into the restoration?
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGWON_000_053: Bribery! If you fashioned him a fancy set of work equipment, surely he would feel obligated to put more effort into the restoration?
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGWON_000_054: Bribery! If you whipped up an ointment to soothe his paws, surely he would feel obligated to put more effort into the reconstruction?
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGWON_000_055: He may not deserve it, but an angry mender is worse than a lazy mender.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGWON_000_056: If you need any materials, let me know. Oh, and be sure to tell him it's from me when you give it to him.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGWON_000_057: We have plenty of materials on hand, you need only say the word, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGWON_000_058: Wow, you've really outdone yourself, kupo! This will perk him up for sure.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_SULKINGMOOGLE02318_: Oh no, it's Mogwon's personal moogle admonisher! Go away, kupo!
A present? <gasp> Why, it's beautiful! I...I don't know what to say, kupo!
Mogwon had this made just for me? Well, uh, aren't I feeling embarrassed. After all those things I said, too...

...Well, I suppose I could approach my mending with a liiittle more gusto, kupo! Mogwon can be demanding at times, but to give me such a nice gift shows he truly cares. Thank you for bringing it to me.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGWON_000_074: Worked like a charm, kupo! Master Tarresson calls this the “stick and krakka root” method. He said that it is used to train chocobos to behave themselves, but it is apparently effective on moogles, too.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_SULKINGMOOGLE02318_:
Never will I be fancy-free!♪
No one swings their hammer as dutifully as me!♪
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGEK_000_080: Did you find out what was bothering Mogwon?
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGEK_000_081: Somehow I'm not surprised, there's one in every bunch.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_MOGEK_000_082: Although it is unexpected that a moogle as serious as Mogwon would take advice from Master Tarresson. I shudder to think what other tricks he might learn.
TEXT_BANMOG606_02318_SYSTEM_000_083: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANMOG607_02319_MOGEK_000_000: , the Mogmenders and I had a splendid idea! Do you recall how crystals are strengthened when bathed in the roar of dragons?
TEXT_BANMOG607_02319_MOGEK_000_001: Well, consider the kupa tree, rich in aether and a natural source of crystals. If Whei Ahf were to roar at one, surely it would bear even better crystals, yes?
TEXT_BANMOG607_02319_MOGEK_000_002: We would like to test this theory, so could you summon Whei Ahf and ask him to roar upon a kupa tree? Oh, and while you're at it, might you also stop by one of the clusters we gather and have him roar on it as well?
TEXT_BANMOG607_02319_WYVERNRECEPTION0231: Well met,  of man. What is your business here?
And so you are requesting the help of Whei Ahf once more. Give me a moment, I shall call him over.
TEXT_BANMOG607_02319_SYSTEM_000_012: The crystals within the kupa tree trunk softly glow with aetheric energy. Return with Whei Ahf and use his Roar ability to nurture its growth.
TEXT_BANMOG607_02319_SYSTEM_100_012: The enormous crystal cluster softly glows with aetheric energy. Return with Whei Ahf and use his Roar ability to nurture its growth.
TEXT_BANMOG607_02319_NEARMOOGLEA02319_00: Right here, right here! We need Whei Ahf to stand right here and roar, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG607_02319_NEARMOOGLEB02319_00: Oooh, this crystal is sooo big, kupo...
TEXT_BANMOG607_02319_WYVERNRECEPTION0231: Oh, where can he be? Please wait here for a moment.
TEXT_BANMOG607_02319_NEARMOOGLEA02319_00: Look how it glows! Surely the crystals are stronger now, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG607_02319_WYVERN02319_100_021: (-Whei Ahf-)There was one more that you would have me bellow my magicks upon, yes?
TEXT_BANMOG607_02319_NEARMOOGLEA02319_00: I'm eager to see what happens, but I fear it is like waiting for a flower to bloom...
TEXT_BANMOG607_02319_NEARMOOGLEB02319_00: The aether in the cluster is changing, I can feel it! I'll have to be careful not to get sick...
TEXT_BANMOG607_02319_WYVERN02319_100_031: (-Whei Ahf-)And with that, it would seem my work here is done. I am glad to have been of some help to you,  of man. Now let us return.
TEXT_BANMOG607_02319_NEARMOOGLEB02319_00: I'm already starting to feel a little woozy, kupo. Maybe I should...move back a bit.
TEXT_BANMOG607_02319_MOGEK_000_040: You're back, kupo! I'm glad that I didn't see any explosions in the distance. I was a little worried that the magicks of dragons might be too potent in the presence of all that aether.
TEXT_BANMOG607_02319_MOGEK_000_041: It makes me reflect on how fortunate we are to have you and Whei Ahf assist us like this. If it weren't for you two, I don't think the Mogmenders would have made it half as far as they have.
TEXT_BANMOG607_02319_MOGEK_000_042: I suppose it just goes to show that no moogle is an island, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MASON_000_000: Godsdamned moogles! They'd lose their bloody pom-poms if they weren't attached to their heads! “I can't find my nuts, kupo! Find my pebbles, kupo!” You want to know where your pebbles are!? Well I'll tell you, right after I shove them up your bleedin'─
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MASON_000_001: Oh! You...you're not one of them!? Thank the gods! Finally someone capable of sensible conversation!
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MASON_000_002: You see, I was sent here at the Temple Knights' behest to teach stonemasonry to these...creatures. However, as soon as I arrived they bombarded me with menial tasks, and before long I found myself traipsing aimlessly across the Churning Mists.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MASON_000_003: I'll endure it no longer! It's time I bid good riddance to this place and its inhabitants! , I'm loath to ask you to suffer such wretched company, but could you inform the one named Mogkul that I shan't be returning? I dare not go myself lest my temper get the best of me!
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGKUL_000_010: Well met, adventurer! The Pomguard remains vigilant as ever! What brings you to Moghome? A sudden craving for kupo nuts?
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGKUL_000_011: Another stonemason has gone home, kupo? <sigh> At least this one bothered to inform me, in a manner of speaking.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGKUL_000_012: I suppose I can't blame him for leaving. He was only trying to help us repair Zenith. They're sent here to survey the area and teach us what they know of working stone.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGKUL_000_013: Alas, the moogles are more concerned with who can concoct the cleverest trick than who can build the sturdiest wall. They don't do it out of malice. It's just an impulse, like breathing or hiding! But the Ishgardians don't view it that way...
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGKUL_000_014: So far, this is the ninth stonemason that's left us. I fear Ser Handeloup may be regretting his decision to help. As a representative of Moghome, I must offer him an apology and an explanation. Adventurer, will you guide me to Ishgard so I might mend this situation?
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGKUL_000_015: What a relief, kupo! I tend to get terribly lost when traveling on my own. I trust your preparations are complete? Excellent, then let us be off!
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_HANDELOUP_100_020: If it isn't Mogkul and ! An unexpected visit, but a welcome one, for I had been hoping to speak with you of our stonemasons. Each one has returned within a fortnight, more wroth than the last. They claim the moogles are proving to be less...receptive to their teaching than they had anticipated.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGKUL_110_020: Ser Handeloup, my deepest and most sincere apologies, kupo! The others only meant to make the stonemasons feel welcome by including them in their mischief. They never meant to anger. I swear on my honor as a Pomguard that it will not happen again!
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_HANDELOUP_000_021: Hmmm... For the sake of friendly relations, I'm more than willing to put this misunderstanding behind us and begin anew. Alas, we have already sent you every stonemason we can spare, and I fear there is little hope in convincing any of them to return to Moghome.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_022: (-???-)You haven't sent every stonemason, my dear Handeloup.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_HANDELOUP_000_023: Lord Tarresson!? What...what brings you to the Congregation?
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_024: Let us dispense with the titles, shall we? And surely you can surmise why I am here. Every one of those thin-skinned milksops was a pupil of mine. How would it reflect upon me if I let their negligence bring this project to ruins?
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_025: Besides, this task came to us directly by the Holy See, and failure would result in my family becoming a laughingstock for generations to come. So you see, for both personal and familial honor, I must take up my hammer and succeed where my students have failed.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_026: Alas, I am well past my prime. The hammer weighs heavy in my hand, and my mind dulls with age. Alone, I fear I might fall victim to the clever deceptions of the moogles, or my body might crumble under the stress of so much physical labor. Perhaps with the help of a young, stout adventurer...
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_100_026: One who has won the respect of the moogles, one who is well versed in their ways. Only with such a partner could this old man possibly hope to keep his honor from being sullied. Do you know any such adventurers, friend? Pray tell me you do...
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_027: What courage! Did you see that, Handeloup? This strapping young  put  name forward without a second thought! Truly, you have brought solace to this tired old man's heart, my dear .
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGKUL_000_028: ...Kupo? I'm not sure I understand. Are you saying both you and the adventurer will help us?
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_029: Indeed, my furry little friend, you shall be well taken care of! Now, our first order of business should be to gather all who are involved in the restoration. Mogkul, I entrust that task to you.  and I shall not be far behind.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_030: Before we depart, however, we have some work of our own to complete. You see, I mean to show the moogles that they are not the only ones with a penchant for trickery! Come, meet me at the Jeweled Crozier and we can begin preparations.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_HANDELOUP_000_031: Once again, it would seem our burdens have become yours. My apologies. For what it is worth, the Temple Knights will provide you with any aid you might require.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_HANDELOUP_000_032: For now, I suppose it would be best to follow Tarresson's lead. He is a wise man, although his methods can be somewhat unorthodox at times.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MATHYE_000_033: So you're here with Lord Tarresson? Rest assured you'll have my full cooperation. I wouldn't dare go against his wishes.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_040: There you are! Before we begin, I would draw upon your knowledge of the moogles. Namely, I wish to know what foods they are partial to, for I believe therein we shall find the means to deceive them.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_041: Hmmm... So their makeshift economy revolves around these kupo nuts? Why, this plan practically crafts itself. Our next course of action is plain, and I believe you are just the  to rise to the challenge.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_042: For your hands speak volumes that your words do not. They are the hands of a practiced artisan, much like my own! There is no need for humility, my friend, you are among peers. And as your peer, I would be honored to call upon your aid!
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_043: I ask that you craft me a kupo nut. Not a real one, mind you, but a fake which could fool even the most discerning moogle. As I have never laid eyes on a kupo nut myself, I must entrust this task to you. I require only one, which I shall use to make more.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_044: I believe a nut made of steel shall suffice. Firm and sturdy, it will weather the harsh elements during the trip from Ishgard. Here, I believe these materials should prove sufficient.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_045: I believe with judicious use of wood, leather, and cloth, you should be able to craft a fake that perfectly captures the uneven texture of the wild nut. Here, I believe these materials should prove sufficient.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_046: I believe with the proper application of dye and wax you can craft a kupo nut that will both look and feel like the real thing! Here, I believe these materials should prove sufficient.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_047: Now, I know full well that even the master has  failed attempts, and so have instructed Mathye here to provide you with more materials should you require them.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_SYSTEM_000_048: To proceed with the quest, use the materials provided by Tarresson to craft a fake kupo nut.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_SYSTEM_000_049: Should your synthesis efforts prove unsuccessful, speak with Mathye once more to receive another set of materials.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_SYSTEM_000_050: To begin the crafting process, open the Crafting Log from the main menu, followed by Special Recipes. Next, select Allied Society Quests, then lastly Moogle Quests to locate the desired recipe.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_SYSTEM_100_050: If synthesis proves too difficult, you may consider purchasing a better primary tool or gear from Evrardoux or Norlaise in the Jeweled Crozier.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MATHYE_000_051: If you require more materials to complete your work, just ask. Lord Tarresson has assured me he will take care of all payments.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_HANDELOUP_000_052: Once again, it would seem our burdens have become yours. My apologies. For what it is worth, the Temple Knights will provide you with any aid you might require.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_060: How goes your work, ? There is no need to rush. I would not want a masterpiece to be marred by a hasty hand.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_061: So this is a kupo nut? Although I am not a moogle, I am certain that if I was, my stomach would be rumbling at the sight. Impressive, considering the meager materials we had on hand.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_062: No doubt you are wondering what I plan to do with this. Do not worry, I would not dare spoil the surprise for you. For now, just know that I intend to make more. It may take some time, so pray go on ahead to the plaza near Zenith. I shall meet you there.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_HANDELOUP_000_063: Tarresson departed for the Churning Mists a short while ago. He said to wait for you in the plaza near the base of Zenith. Pray make your way there as soon as you are ready.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MATHYE_000_064: Any crafter that has Lord Tarresson's approval has mine as well. If ever you wish to sell your work, return here and I'll be sure to give you a fair price.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGKUL_000_065: Where are Mogzin and the others, kupo?
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_070: Welcome to Bahrr Lehs, . Truth be told, this place is in even worse shape than I was led to believe. Well, I suppose even a fortress begins with but a single stone.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGKUL_000_071: My apologies, Lord Tarresson. I urged the Mogmenders to meet us here, but they all claimed to be busy with something or other. It may be a while before they arrive...
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_072: "Tarresson“ will suffice, my dear Mogkul. And there is no need for apologies. From my understanding, the Mogmenders have laziness in abundance. While we are waiting, answer me one question: who among them is easiest to trick?
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGKUL_000_073: That would be Master Mogzin, without a doubt, kupo. He was put in charge of the Mogmenders on account of his deft paws, but he falls for their tricks more often than not. One time he spent three days playing hide-and-seek while the others gorged on kupo nuts.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_074: Such deviousness! I doubt I can surpass so clever a ploy! Nonetheless, I must try. Mogkul, I believe  and I can take over the reins from here. We shall have the Mogmenders hard at work ere long.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGKUL_000_075: You mean to outtrick the Mogmenders, kupo? Fascinating, I had no idea you played tricks on each other down below. Of course, I look forward to hearing of your victory! Oh, I do hope he hides his pebbles...
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_076: When building a wall, we are taught that a single ill-placed brick can cause a whole structure to collapse. I believe this Master Mogzin may be our figurative loose brick. Now, let us seek him out. He cannot be far.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_077: Could this be Mogzin? His bandana certainly sets him apart from the others. Listen. Is he muttering to himself?
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGZIN_000_080: Nine...nine stonemasons, kupo. Surely they are praising my cleverness in Ishgard. How should I trick the next one? Oh, I know! A rare sickness which strikes once every hundred years, and causes our pom-poms to─
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_081: Master Mogzin of the Mogmenders, I presume? I am Tarresson, freshly arrived from Ishgard. Forgive me for eavesdropping, but I overheard mention of a sickness. Is there aught I need worry about?
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGZIN_000_082: Y-You're here already!? I mean, er, yes, a terrible, incurable sickness has spread throughout Moghome! One last seen over a thousand years ago! Once afflicted, our wings grow heavier than...than stones! We can do nothing but lie on the ground helpless until it passes.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_083: I see... Such unfortunate timing. Well, I suppose we must postpone our work for now. May you and yours be in good health soon. 'Tis a pity, truly. Whatever shall I do with all these kupo nuts?
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGZIN_000_084: Did you say kupo nuts!? Here? Now!?
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_085: Why, yes. I brought a veritable feast, which I meant to share with the Mogmenders as a gesture of goodwill. Alas, we shall have to wait. A sickness which comes once every thousand years surely requires proper─
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGZIN_000_086: Did I say “sickness!?” Perhaps I was mistaken. Yes, yes, perhaps they weren't sick after all. Just...napping! How embarrassing! Luckily for you, however, that means the rest of the Mogmenders are hale and hearty. I'll summon them, and meet you at Bahrr Lehs forthwith!
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_087: <sigh> By the gods, I was hoping for a bit more sport than that. Perhaps if he said kupo nuts were a miraculous cure to this epidemic, I could have pretended to believe him. Well, what's done is done. Come, let us away to Bahrr Lehs and meet our new companions.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGMUL_000_088: You truly know the way to a moogle's heart: through his stomach! Now, where are those kupo nuts?
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGEK_000_089: I told Master Mogzin his story was unbelievable. If it didn't work the first three times, it won't work the fourth time, I said. Now, I would thank you very much to present me with the kupo nuts, to teach Master Mogzin a valuable lesson in honesty.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGZIN_000_090: Mogek and Mogmul are at the ready, kupo! The others will be here before long, I'm sure!
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGZIN_000_100: As promised, I've gathered my most skilled Mogmenders! Now, I believe there was talk of a feast?
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_101: Indeed, they have the paws of true artisans. Now, for the feast! Let me start off our relationship by offering this bounty to you.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGZIN_000_102: They look so plump and so juicy, kupo! And all this for a little effort. As master of the Mogmenders, I declare first privileges!
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGZIN_000_103: That's...that's not how a kupo nut tastes! It's a fake! How could something that looks so delicious be so disappointing...
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_104: My dear Mogzin, it seems the tables have turned! Indeed, these nuts were wrought by man, not born of nature. Even better than the real thing, yes? Well, besides the taste, of course.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGZIN_000_105: They're all fake? There's not even a real one tucked away inside, kupo? Perhaps we should check once again, just to be sure...
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGZIN_000_106: Hmmm... I daresay these would fool even Chieftain Moglin, and no one has ever been able to trick him! Truly works of art, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_107: This is but a small sampling of our capabilities, friends! I have built towers and raised walls that rival the largest in the Churning Mists. Yes, even Zenith!
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGZIN_000_108: You mean...you can make kupo nuts even larger than these? Larger than Zenith!?
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_109: Perhaps I could, if I had the inclination. However, I offer you something better. Pledge your paws to me and I shall teach you how to craft aught you can imagine. Alas, I will make this offer only once. So, what say you?
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGZIN_000_110: Anything we can imagine, kupo? Of course! We swear on our pom-poms to be diligent pupils! Why, I'm ready to start repairing Zenith this very moment!
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_111: That's the spirit I like to see! But we have a long road ahead of us, my moogle menders. Before we start work on the palace proper, I believe we would do well to begin by repairing this very plaza. What you learn here shall form a solid foundation for what is to come.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGMUL_000_112: I know the kupo nuts were fake, but my stomach still rumbles at the thought of them. If I were able to make my own, just imagine the moogles I'd trick.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGEK_000_113: You may have fooled Master Mogzin, but who hasn't? I knew the kupo nuts were fake from the moment I saw them. You'll have to try harder to trick the Mogmenders' most brilliant moogle. Perhaps if you used real kupo nuts next time...
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_TARRESSON_000_114: I daresay we have earned their respect, and all we had to do was play by their rules for a short time. We have achieved what I hope will be the first success of many more to come.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGZIN_000_120: Well, now that things have settled, I do believe formal introductions are in order. I am Mogzin, master of the Mogmenders.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGZIN_000_121: I never knew what a crafter was capable of until I saw those fake kupo nuts. With even a fraction of such skill, I've no doubt that we could restore Zenith to its former glory!
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGZIN_000_122: Still, I can't help but wonder what we could have accomplished had we listened to the other nine stonemasons... Oh well, I suppose there's no use racking my pom-pom over the past! Besides, you and Tarresson are so much more kind and patient than the others.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGZIN_000_123: You do plan to stay and teach us, right? We'll work every day until our paws are sore and our cheeks are flushed. I promise you that, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_A1_000_001: Together we'll rebuild Bahrr Lehs, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGZIN_000_130: Truly, kupo? The others will be overjoyed to hear it!
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGZIN_000_131: Mogmenders! Let us go forth, tools in paw, and make Zenith shine once more!
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_MOGZIN_000_140: I...I understand, kupo. For what it's worth, I promise to mend my ways from here on out. If you change your mind, I'll be waiting here.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_SYSTEM_000_150: Thanks to your efforts, the restoration of Bahrr Lehs has begun! Continue assisting the Mogmenders to see repair of the plaza completed.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_SYSTEM_000_151: You have achieved Neutral reputation with the Mogmenders.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_SYSTEM_000_152: Moogle society quests are now available from Mogek the Marvelous in Bahrr Lehs.
TEXT_BANMOG001_02320_SYSTEM_000_153: Furthermore, you may now purchase wares from Mogmul Mogbelly.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_000: , Tarresson has been looking for you, kupo! There's an important matter we must discuss at once!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_001: I wonder what he plans to do about those moogles...
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_TARRESSON_000_010: , there you are! I must say, the attitude of the Mogmenders is much improved. They have mastered the basics of stonemasonry more quickly than I had anticipated, and remain ever eager to learn. Once the rubble has been cleared, we can begin rebuilding.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_TARRESSON_000_011: Therein lies our problem, however. I am afraid we lack the numbers to remove the debris on our own. I requested aid from the moogles of Asah, but have yet to receive a response. Doubtless they are trying to avoid any kind of hard work.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_TARRESSON_000_012: And so I would task you, my dear Mogzin, with bringing them here. I give you leave to use whatever trick you can conceive of to get those malingering moogles to Bahrr Lehs.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_013: You want me to fool moogles? I've never done that, kupo. Not successfully anyways...
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_TARRESSON_000_014: Do not be so quick to lose heart! You fail only because your ideas are half-formed, marred by compromise and poor planning. You must persevere in your efforts if you wish to succeed. It is as the words of my house state: “By the hundredth blow.”
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_TARRESSON_100_014: For a single strike of the chisel merely scratches a stone's surface. It is only with constant effort that stones give rise to bricks, to walls, and at last an impregnable fortress. Such is the power of will. Of perseverance. Of determination!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_015: Will, perseverance, determination... I...I will remember, kupo! Yes, I'll craft a trick so cunning they'll sing songs of it throughout Moghome!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_TARRESSON_000_016: Aye, that's the spirit! You are a leader, and it is past time you took charge. Show the others that the Mogmenders are not to be trifled with!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_TARRESSON_000_017: However, while I have great faith in Mogzin, he still has yet to meet his full potential. Which is why I must ask you to accompany him, . Ensure he does not slip back into his old ways. Give that pom-pom of his a firm shake if you sense his will is wavering.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_018: I'm sure there will be no need for that, kupo! Nevertheless, I would certainly appreciate the company! Well then, shall we be off? We should begin by speaking with Mogupp, the moogle in charge over at Asah.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_019: There he is, kupo! He doesn't look to be up to any mischief. Perhaps there is a perfectly reasonable explanation for why help hasn't arrived after all.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_TARRESSON_000_020: I know our Mogzin has grown, but I fear he still needs guidance. And I believe you are exactly the one to give it to him. For my part, I shall begin preparations to greet our new hands.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGUPP_000_030: Oh, if it isn't Master Mogzin! And the adventurer I've heard so much about! Hmmm, I seem to recall a request of some manner from the Mogmenders... Oh yes, you required extra paws to help move the rubble?
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_031: That's correct, kupo. The request was made some time ago, and still not a single moogle has arrived at Bahrr Lehs. We can't hope to make any progress without them!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGUPP_000_032: Ah yes, who could forget such an unusual name? Of course I dispatched several moogles the moment the missive came, but I'm afraid I may have sent them to the wrong location. Awfully hard to pronounce that name, you see. Why, I suppose they could be anywhere now. And without the provisions for a long journey...
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGUPP_000_033: Oh, how dreadful, kupo! All alone among those wild beasts, hungry and afraid! Curse my clumsy tongue! Curse it! Could...could you help me find them? Please, bring them something to sate their hunger, and I'm certain they'll be most willing to help!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_034: ...Of course! An understandable mistake. I can scarce pronounce half the names I hear. Don't worry, Mogupp, my companion and I will have the errant moogles back here and safe posthaste.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_035: It wouldn't serve to go searching blindly, however, lest we become lost ourselves. No, we must discuss our strategy beforehand. , let's confer down below.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGUPP_000_036: I can see it now, their pom-poms shivering in fear... Please, you must do something! I'd never be able to live with myself should they come to harm, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_040: Little does Mogupp know, I've already fallen for this trick! Twice! Why trouble yourself to get your own food when a gullible moogle will deliver it right to you? It would be a brilliant ploy if it wasn't so overused!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_041: And now, we have our chance to... What did Tarresson say? Ah, turn the tables! If we can trick them into going to Bahrr Lehs, I daresay they'd stay just as a sign of respect. Mogupp and his lackeys are a clever bunch, though... How could I possibly get the better of them?
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_042: If only we could use those fake kupo nuts. But by now every moogle in Moghome and beyond has heard of them! And rightly so; they are truly masterpieces! Certainly not something I could ever hope to surpass...
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_043: And there's no shame in that! Yes, why reach for the skies when a kupo nut is hanging just within reach? Besides, Asah is far from Moghome. I wager Mogupp and the others have heard nothing of your fake nuts. Well then, I believe the matter is settled!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_A1_000_002: Don't make me give your pom a squeeze!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_050: Tarresson's words? You're right, I must make my own trick! I almost did it again, didn't I? Well, not this time. This time I'll be the one laughing. This time Mogupp will be the one too embarrassed to show his face at the harvest fête!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_060: No, not my pom, kupo! I remember, I remember Tarresson's words. Just keep your hands right where they are! I'll come up with my very own trick. I'll make Mogupp think twice before trying to trick me again!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_070: ...Thank you, . Tarresson was right to have you accompany me. If you were not here, I would've given up before I remembered a special something that just might serve as the perfect tool for our trick. A very special something.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_071: I haven't got any myself, though─certainly not in the quantity required. But there is one moogle who might... , come with me to Moghome, so we can seek out the counsel of the alchemist Moghan. Yes, it's all falling into place, kupo...
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_080: , my apologies! I had to pick something up from Bahrr Lehs on the way. I hope I didn't keep you waiting long, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGHAN_000_081: The mighty adventurer graces us with  presence again, kupo! Oh, and greetings to you as well, Mogzin. What brings you two all the way from Bahrr Lehs?
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_082: Mogupp is up to his old tricks, but I mean to take the upper paw this time, kupo! For that, I require your most potent medicine. Most potent. Oh, and on a completely unrelated note, I brought you a gift.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGHAN_000_083:
Well, I certainly can't just give you─
<gasp> Kupo nuts! And larger than any I've ever seen, even more so than those of Chieftain Moglin's secret reserve!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_084: You've always been a stout supporter of the Mogmenders. I just thought I should express my gratitude.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGHAN_000_085: Of course, of course, I understand, kupo. I wouldn't dare decline a gift from you, Mogzin. It is only a gift, yes?
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_086: Why Moghan, you wound me. I would never intend for it to be anything else.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGHAN_000_087: Ahem, kupo. Lifting stones is dangerous work, and it would be dreadful if anyone was injured, especially so far from home. You shall have your medicine, Mogzin. Practice caution, however. Use too much, and you may do more harm than good.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_088: I promise to be responsible, kupo! , I believe we are finished here. I'll meet you back at Asah, after I finish some final preparations. I'll try not to be late this time!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGHAN_000_089: I've a medicine for whatever ails you, but you'd have to be awfully sick to use the medicine I gave Mogzin.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_100_090: Finally, you're here! Mogupp looks so smug, doesn't he?
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGUPP_000_110: How goes the search? I've looked up and down, under every rock and behind every bush, and can find no sign of the poor moogles! All this searching has made me terribly thirsty, by the way. Now I know how the others must feel. It's tearing me apart, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_111: Mogupp, enough. I surrender! I must say, your every trick is more impressive than the last. This one was so impressive, in fact, that I brought a bounty of kupo nut milk to give to everyone!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGUPP_000_112: Hahaha, Mogzin's been outsmarted again, kupo! You really must stop making this so easy. There's no sport in it any more. However, we'll gladly accept these libations as a just reward for our ingenuity! Time to call the others!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_113: Did you see, kupo? Mogupp is none the wiser. He thinks that's just regular kupo nut milk, but we know better! Oh, I can scarce believe that I, Mogzin, am finally about to trick moogles. Come, , Mogupp will soon get his just deserts!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_120: , quickly! Mogupp and the others are just about to partake of my special milk.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGUPP_000_121: Mogzin has been tricked again, and not for the last time! In his humbleness, he has rewarded our surpassing cleverness with a bounty of kupo nut milk! Drink deep, my friends, and bask in victory!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGUPP_000_122:
Ah, there's nothing like a nip of milk after a─
After a... What is...?
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGUPP_100_122: Kupo...po...? Impossible... Mogzin, he couldn't have...
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_123: Hehehe! What's in the milk, you ask? A few pinches of the crushed cloud mallow seeds. In large enough quantities, they put moogles into a deep sleep.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_124: Once they're dozing soundly, I need only whisper in their ears to complete my plan! Look, , and bear witness to a Mogmender's guile!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_125: A working moogle is a happy moogle, kupo.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGUPP_000_126: A working moogle...is a happy moogle, kupo...
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_127: From sunup till sundown, you'll work up a sweat with nary a frown.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGUPP_000_128: From sunup, till sundown...we'll work up a sweat, with nary a frown...
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGUPP_000_129: What ho, friends! Isn't it a perfect day for backbreaking labor? Who needs rest? Not I, kupo! Who wants to sweat? Me, me!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_130: Victory, kupo! I doubt Mogupp will dare try to trick me again after this! And now to reap the rewards. Let's return to Bahrr Lehs and see what moogles hard at work can accomplish.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGUPP_000_131: A working moogle is... Joy... Sweat... So much sweat... My pom-pom, it burns... From sunup, till sundown...
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_TARRESSON_000_132: Whatever you two have gotten up to, it appears to have had quite the effect. The moogles marched right into the plaza and set to work rather vigorously. Ah, but are they resting already?
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_140: , it's terrible! We'll never get the rubble cleared, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_141: Mogupp and the others began working eagerly at first, but they collapsed after carrying only one rock between them! I know they aren't used to hard work, but this beggars belief!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_142: Perhaps all is not lost, however. When a moogle's in such a sorry state the only cure I know of is more cloud mallow! And I believe you can help with that, ! Mount a mallow and sprinkle some puffs on these moogles, and their poms should perk right up!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_143: Just ask the moogle guarding it to ride. I'll be looking to the skies. Perhaps a few errant puffs will blow my way, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_145: Who knows how long they'll be lying here if we don't give them a little nudge? Quickly, ride the cloud mallow and shower them with puffs!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_FLUFFMOG02321_000_1: Say no more, I know exactly why you're here. Just shake your rump a bit and rain mallow puffs on the poor moogles, and they'll be back in tip-top shape! Hop on─I'm sure the mallow can support your weight!
Did you fall off the cloud mallow? They are impossible to tame, aren't they? Not to worry, you'll master it eventually!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_SYSTEM_000_155: Mogupp and his band of moogles can lift no more. Ride the cloud mallow and shower mallow puffs onto them to restore their vigor.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGUPP_000_160: Ahhh...I seem to recall...being tired? Impossible! Inconceivable! Why, I daresay I could clear the rubble myself! A working moogle is a happy moogle, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGUPP_000_162:
From sunup till sundown, we'll work up a sweat with nary a frown!
Master Mogzin is a master trickster, kupo! But even though I know I've been duped, I'm not angry at all! There's no reward greater than the soreness that comes with hard work!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_FLUFFMOG02321_000_1: I trust your journey on the cloud mallow was as enjoyable as it looked. If you ever wish to ride again, I'll be here, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_170: The mallow puffs seemed to do it, kupo! If they keep up this pace then the rubble should be cleared in no time!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_171: And what's more, now that I've hoodwinked a moogle I'm sure to earn some respect around here. I am the master of the Mogmenders, after all!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_172: Tarresson, , if not for your support I would've given up long ago. To see my efforts succeed at last... I've never felt this sense of accomplishment before! You have my thanks!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_TARRESSON_000_173: Brilliant, my dear Mogzin! Remember my words, and your conviction shall show through in the quality of your craftsmanship.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_MOGZIN_000_174: I will, I most certainly will! Tarresson, your words will guide me in both my works and my studies!
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_SYSTEM_000_180: Thanks to your efforts, the rubble has been cleared from Bahrr Lehs. Continue assisting the Mogmenders to see repair of the plaza completed.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_SYSTEM_000_190: You have achieved Recognized reputation with the Mogmenders.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_SYSTEM_000_191: New moogle society daily quests are now available from Mogek the Marvelous at the plaza.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_SYSTEM_000_192: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Mogek the Marvelous as a reputation rank bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_SYSTEM_000_193: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Mogek the Marvelous. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANMOG002_02321_SYSTEM_000_194: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Mogmul Mogbelly.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_000: , you're back, and at the perfect time! Tarresson and I were just discussing how to move forward with the restoration. You're welcome to join us, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_001: At first we were at an impasse, but I believe we may have found a solution, kupo! Of course, another opinion is always welcome!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_TARRESSON_000_010: , how kind of you to join us. We were just discussing how to proceed with the restoration. The Mogmenders are ready for a new challenge, and I have a mind to set them to work on the plaza's outer wall. And what would a challenge be without an insurmountable obstacle?
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_TARRESSON_000_011: They lack the strength to even lift the wall's heavy bricks a fulm, let alone stack them on top of each other. In Ishgard, we would use levers and pulleys to get the job done, but I am afraid their design is unfit for moogle proportions.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_TARRESSON_100_011: Short of creating an entirely new system─which is outside the realm of my expertise─the solution to this problem eluded me. That is, until the master Mogmender himself had a brilliant suggestion. Mogzin, if you will?
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_012: Certainly, kupo! I proposed calling upon the dragons for help! I've seen them grasp vast boulders in their mighty claws! It should be a simple task for them to stack the bricks on top of each other.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_TARRESSON_000_013: An ingenious idea, yes? And one which fills me with anticipation, for I have never seen a dragon's might put to constructive use. It would seem, as well, that Mogzin already knows who to ask.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_014: That's right, kupo! I happen to count a dragon among my many friends! He's strong, too. Much stronger than any moogle I've met. Tarresson, , wait here. I'll seek him out straightaway!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_TARRESSON_000_015: Mogzin certainly is full of surprises, wouldn't you agree? His idea to call upon the dragons required no urging from me. For now, I suppose we would do best to wait here and trust our moogle friend to return in due time.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_020: We are returned, kupo! , Tarresson, meet Ohl Deeh!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_OHLDEEH_000_021: So these are the ones in need of my strength? They are so...wingless. Nonetheless, any friend of Mogzin is a friend of mine. I am at your service!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_TARRESSON_000_022: By the Fury, if you were not Mogzin's friend, I would be trembling in my boots! Ohl Deeh, I was made to believe you could hurl boulders through the skies with but a flick of your powerful claws. Is that true?
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_OHLDEEH_000_023: Of...of course! Do not think me some weakling! I am a dragon, and the blood of the great wyrm Hraesvelgr courses through my veins! In just three centuries, even the most colossal stone will be as a pebble in my claws.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_TARRESSON_000_024: Did you hear that? We need only wait three centuries. Fortunately, I have no pressing engagements for the next three hundred years. What about you, Mogzin? Have you the time to spare?
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_025: N-No, certainly not, kupo! Oh, there must be another way...
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_026: Ah, I know! Ohl Deeh, we have a surplus of foodstuffs thanks to Mogmul's shrewd management. Eat your fill, and before long you'll be as big and strong as Hraesvelgr... Right?
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_OHLDEEH_000_027: Mogzin, Mogzin, Mogzin. You are always so shortsighted. How many times must I tell you the quickest solution is not always best?
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_100_027: But don't you understand? We can't wait three hundred years! By that time the poms of every moogle in Moghome will have gone to dust!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_OHLDEEH_110_027: Hmph. My apologies. I sometimes forget how very fragile you moogles are. I suppose we will have to entreat my older brother for help, then. Let me warn you, however, that he can be a bit...trying at times. But worry not, for I am certain we can sway him to help us one way or another.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_028: Thank you, Ohl Deeh! I knew we would find a way! However, I know there's still more work to be done. Soon I'll be able to add “persuading a dragon” to my list of accomplishments!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_100_028: But as they say, there is strength in numbers. , pray accompany me, as it may lend more weight to our request.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_OHLDEEH_000_029: Well then, let us be off! My brother, Whei Ahf, usually spends his time deeper within Zenith. I will go ahead and see if I can soften him up before you arrive.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_TARRESSON_000_030: Hmmm... I can only hope Ohl Deeh's brother possesses the strength we require. Just in case, I shall try to think of some other way we might solve this conundrum.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_OHLDEEH_000_031: Say hello to Whei Ahf, . Mind your manners around him.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_032: Look at him, kupo! Whei Ahf looks at least twice as strong as Ohl Deeh! I'm certain lifting those stones will prove no difficulty to him!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_WHEIAHF_000_040: My brother has requested I hear your plea, and I shall not deny him.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_041: We are grateful for this audience, kupo. You see, we mean to rebuild the walls of Bahrr Lehs. Alas, our tiny paws can barely grip the massive stones, let alone lift them. That is why we require a dragon's strength. Your strength.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_WHEIAHF_000_042: Ah, yes, we have heard tell of moogles playing at being stonemasons. This I know.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_WHEIAHF_000_043: I care not how or where you conduct your games, or whom you choose to imitate. However, I will not be made party to such whimsy.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_044: Whei Ahf, with all due respect, you are mistaken! This is no game, kupo! We're pouring our heart and soul into repairing Bahrr Lehs─and it is only the beginning!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_OHLDEEH_110_044: Brother, Mogzin tells the truth! He is wholly devoted to this task. He's even forsworn trickery! Please, I implore you to give him and his people a chance.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_WHEIAHF_000_045: ...One chance, then, to show me the depth of your conviction.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_WHEIAHF_100_045: If you truly are a crafter, then craft something for me. That which cannot speak, yet can be heard. Present it to me, and my strength shall be yours.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_046: What? I-I mean yes, of course! , let us return to Bahrr Lehs, so we can begin work on Whei Ahf's request forthwith!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_WHEIAHF_000_047: That which cannot speak, yet can be heard. Bring that to me, and I shall lend you my strength. This I swear.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_OHLDEEH_000_048: See, I knew Brother would be reasonable. Now, off you go to craft... What was it, again?
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_TARRESSON_000_049: The dragon has given you a trial, has he? With you and Mogzin working to crack Whei Ahf's riddle, I'm sure you shall have the solution shortly.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_050: I don't know what to make of Whei Ahf's words. Something that can't speak, but can be heard? Oh, my pom aches from trying to wrap it around his riddle. Hmmm... Perhaps I should just trick him. It can't be much more difficult than tricking a moogle!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_051: I jest, I jest, kupo! Worry not, I won't rest until I've deciphered his strange request. , let's put our poms together. Together, we can chip away at the question until the answer takes shape before us!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_052: What could it possibly be, kupo? , you've traveled to all manner of places. Surely a worldly adventurer such as yourself can offer some insight.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_A1_000_001: Perhaps it's not an object, but a demonstration of skill he seeks?
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_A1_000_002: Well, some folks say that dragons have an insatiable lust for treasure...
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_060:
A skill? Well, we moogles excel at trickery...and lounging in the sun...and seeing how many kupo nuts we can fit into our mouths at once. No, no, that can't be─
Wait, I know, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_100_060: What would a nap or a kupo nut eating competition be without musical accompaniment? We make even the most mundane event come alive with our horns and harps! And an instrument doesn't speak, but it can certainly be heard!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_070:
Treasure? Well, we value nothing more than our kupo nuts...and the shiny tools made by the landlords...but I don't see─
Wait, there's another treasure, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_100_070: That's right! The horn we use to call upon the great Hraesvelgr! A horn which cannot speak, but indeed can be heard!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_081: So it's an instrument Whei Ahf wants! Now, I've always been partial to tooting the horn myself, so I believe crafting one should prove simple! However, I would entrust you with a separate task.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_090: A quality mouthpiece, while small, is indispensable if we want the sound to impress. And I would trust no one but you to craft a proper one! Mogmul should have any materials you require. I await your masterpiece, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_100: Please, craft me a grip, which is most vital to ensure none drop the horn while giving it a mighty blow! Mogmul should have any materials you require. I await your masterpiece, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_110: Grease to polish the horn to a mirror shine should provide that stunning final touch! Mogmul should have any materials you require. I await your masterpiece, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_114: The horn is a basic instrument, but that doesn't mean I won't try my best! And with your help I'm sure a good horn will turn into a great one!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGMUL_000_120:
You've come here for materials? Very well, that will be thirty kupo nuts please!
Hahaha, you should see the look on your face! It was merely a jest! Please, take as much as you require. Free of charge, of course!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGMUL_000_124: If perchance you find yourself low on materials, you need only return here for more, kupo! That is, if I am not absent. My stomach is rumbling and I may have to take my next meal sooner rather than later.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGMUL_100_124: Oh my, what have we here, kupo? If I didn't know any better, I'd say that looks just like a kupo nut. Hmm...or maybe I'm just horribly hungry.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_130: Are you finished, kupo? I've completed the horn, and all I require is your final flourish!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_131: This is even better than I could've hoped, kupo! Any moogle will surely be proud to toot on the horn─even Chieftain Moglin!
