TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_132: Nevertheless, I must take care when applying the final touches. Go on ahead and meet with Ohl Deeh and his brother. I will be close behind, horn in paw!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_OHLDEEH_000_133: Ah, there you are. Honestly, I thought you would be longer. Of course, I have solved my brother's riddle already, but I am curious to see what you've come up with!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_135: With this horn, I'll prove to Whei Ahf the strength of my conviction and the depth of my determination. It needs to be just right... , go ahead to where the dragon siblings await. I'll meet you there shortly, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_140: Whei Ahf, we thought long and hard on your words, and have brought that which you seek. Behold, a Mogmender masterpiece!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_OHLDEEH_100_140:
Why, that is just a horn! Why would Brother want that? Of course a horn cannot─
Oh, I see! How clever, Mogzin! And the craftsmanship is even better than we had hoped.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_WHEIAHF_110_140: Do not feign knowledge, Ohl Deeh. You did not know the answer. As for you, Mogzin...was this horn truly wrought by your hands?
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_120_140: Indeed, kupo! I put every onze of my skill into its construction! Every onze...as well as a dash of 's skill for good measure.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_WHEIAHF_000_141: A horn does not speak, yet it can be heard from even the highest peaks. It would seem my trial was simple before the combined efforts of man and moogle. I am impressed. Accept my apologies for doubting you.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_OHLDEEH_000_142: That means you'll help Mogzin!? Splendid! But Brother, I still don't understand why a horn is so important to you.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_WHEIAHF_000_143: How much you have yet to learn─though I am sure you were taught once before that our songs are as roars to their ears, so alien and unfathomable.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_WHEIAHF_100_143: So it was that Hraesvelgr bequeathed a magick to men, that they fashion sacred instruments to join in the chorus. The horn entrusted to the moogles is but one of these works.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_WHEIAHF_110_143: If you would have my aid, you must wield an instrument worthy of calling upon my kind. I believe this horn will do nicely.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_143: An instrument to summon a dragon!? It's that good, kupopo!? I've never...I mean, no one has ever praised something I've made! This feeling is better than eating three kupo nuts at once!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_144: I-I apologize. I got a little carried away! Now, where were we? Oh yes! Whei Ahf, allow me to escort you to Bahrr Lehs!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_OHLDEEH_000_145: When you presented that tiny horn to Brother, I was sure he'd laugh you out of Zenith. I suppose I still have much to learn about riddles and puzzles.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_WHEIAHF_000_146: My word is my bond, and my wings are your wings.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_147: To create something with my own paws is an amazing feeling, kupo! Absolutely amazing!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_TARRESSON_000_150: Now this is what I envisioned when Mogzin spoke of dragons. I applaud your success, my friend, although I did not doubt you for a second. Mogzin certainly seems to be in high spirits. Higher than usual, even. Did your meeting with Whei Ahf go that well?
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_TARRESSON_000_151: Ah, now I see. My dear Mogzin, how does it feel? To labor over your creation, to pour every onze of your vim and brio into it, and for that effort to be recognized and earn you accolades. Tell me true: can you think of aught better?
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_000_152: No, no, I can't, kupopo! This is even more thrilling than when I tricked Mogupp!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_TARRESSON_000_153: Hahaha, and now you understand why we crafters slave away for our art. Yes, “we,” for I daresay you are now as much a crafter as  or myself. Still, do not think your journey over already. You have much to learn yet in the way of technique.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_MOGZIN_100_153: Me, a crafter, kupo!? I...I don't know what to say, except that I'll try my utmost not to disappoint!
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_TARRESSON_000_154: And you must be Whei Ahf, whose trial spurred Mogzin's growth. I am Tarresson, and I offer my humble greetings and thanks. Well then, shall we begin? For perhaps the first time in a thousand years, man and dragon shall work together to build, not destroy.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_WHEIAHF_000_155: Although I am too young to have known the peace our ancestors once shared, I am honored to work alongside you. May our bonds be strengthened through our labor.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_SYSTEM_000_500: Thanks to your efforts, the outer walls of Bahrr Lehs have been restored. Continue assisting the Mogmenders to see repair of the plaza completed.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_SYSTEM_000_200: You have achieved Friendly reputation with the Mogmenders.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_SYSTEM_000_201: New moogle society daily quests are now available from Mogek the Marvelous at the plaza.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_SYSTEM_100_202: You will receive an experience point bonus upon the completion of the moogle society daily quests.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_SYSTEM_000_203: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Mogek the Marvelous as a reputation rank bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANMOG003_02322_SYSTEM_000_204: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Mogek the Marvelous. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_000: , I thought that was you! Tarresson has decided where next to focus our efforts, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_001: My paws are itching for more work, and Tarresson's next idea sounds like the most challenging yet!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_000_010: Thanks to the efforts of Whei Ahf, Bahrr Lehs is now well fortified against any ne'er-do-wells who might wish to deface it. Well, that's what I would say if there was aught in it to deface! I believe now is the most opportune time to start the core of our─
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_OHLDEEH_000_011: (-???-)Mogzin, Tarresson, ! Gullinbursti, he...<huff> <puff>...he has spoken, and he is livid!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_000_012: Ohl Deeh, my friend, calm yourself. What matter do you speak of? Who is this Gullinbursti?
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_OHLDEEH_000_013: He's an ancient dragon, more ancient than most. In passing he asked after the Mogmenders, and became enraged when I told him of your work here. He demanded I tell you to cease at once! I thought he was only curious, I swear! Please don't be cross with me!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_000_014: <sigh> Just when things were going so well. Still, I suppose we can count it as a blessing that he did not drive us away by force. Doubtless he is capable. Perhaps the fact he has not means there is yet hope for reconciliation.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_100_014: Let us parley with Gullinbursti, if for no other reason than to make it clear that we bear no ill will towards him. , Mogzin, I would ask that you accompany me. Ohl Deeh, pray deliver us to where this ancient dragon resides.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_OHLDEEH_000_015: Certainly! Hopefully Gullinbursti will listen to reason. With luck, hopefully we can put this incident behind us soon enough.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_016: For the life of me, I cannot fathom a reason any dragons would be angry with us... Well, I suppose there was that one time I stuck a stone up a dragon's nostril. He was sleeping so deeply, I couldn't resist! You'd do the same, I'm sure.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_000_017: So this is Gullinbursti? Indeed, he has an air of wisdom about him. Much the same as yours truly, I would like to think.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_OHLDEEH_000_018: Here we are! I'd suggest going before Gullinbursti with a measure of humility. He has no patience for arrogance.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_COLORDRAGON_000_020: So you are the children of man who seek to undo my efforts to keep Bahrr Lehs forgotten? Enough. Cease this affront, and return from whence you came.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_000_021: Merciful Gullinbursti, I fear this is a dreadful misunderstanding. It is not by our own volition that we endeavor to repair the plaza. No, we are here at the behest of the moogles, and in fact our role is merely to teach them of stonemasonry. Naught more.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_000_022: As you are doubtless aware, the moogles are bound by an ancient accord with Hraesvelgr to guard and maintain Zenith. As it happens, several of Hraesvelgr's own brood are even now lifting stones in a show of support. Forgive me my boldness, but do you mean to put a stop to such efforts?
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_COLORDRAGON_000_023: Bold indeed. You are right. I cannot oppose the will of Hraesvelgr. If there is truth in your words.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_100_023: It's true, kupo! If you require proof, just visit the plaza yourself! And you only need to ask Hraesvelgr about the covenant we share!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_000_024: My dear Mogzin, pray let me handle this matter. We must tread carefully; I would very much like to leave this parley without any singed hairs.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_100_024: Mighty Gullinbursti, I believe a dragon of your strength would have no difficulty driving us from the plaza and razing it to the ground. But I also believe you are wise. Too wise to act rashly, without knowledge of our intentions or our sincerity.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_COLORDRAGON_000_025: Perhaps. If you would prove your worth, then so be it. Restore the splendor of ages past to Bahrr Lehs, and I shall oppose you no longer.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_026: That's it? We're already well on our way, kupo! Rest assured Bahrr Lehs will be restored in no time!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_COLORDRAGON_000_027: Will it? Long ago, the plaza held a fountain, from which flowed an unending stream. To build such a thing now would be an impossible feat.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_000_028: I would expect no less than to be tasked with the impossible. To construct a fountain on barren land seems an unsolvable riddle! Do not fear, however, for we will find a way, as we have many times before. Won't we, Mogzin?
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_029: Naturally, kupo! We'll show you the worth of the Mogmenders!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_100_029: Excellent! Well then, my dear Gullinbursti, we shall set to work at once! In the meantime, I trust you will see fit to allow our repairs to resume unimpeded.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_COLORDRAGON_100_029: Very well, child of man. I shall tolerate your presence for the time being.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_030: We'll find a way to get water, I'm sure of it, kupo!!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_OHLDEEH_000_031: I've never seen someone stand so fearlessly against Gullinbursti, not even Brother! With age comes a sharp wit!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_COLORDRAGON_000_032: Why do you remain? You will have no help from me. For now, I shall wait.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_000_040: While not the ideal outcome, there is naught for it but to turn our attention to the task at hand. Not only must we build a fountain, but we must also secure a source of water.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_000_041: Gullinbursti is well aware of the fact that we are surrounded by dust and wind-worn brick, which is why he expects us to fail. But we shall prove him wrong!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_000_042: It would be best to first seek the wisdom of those most familiar with the land. Tell me, Mogzin and Ohl Deeh─how do you go about securing water for your peoples?
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_043: Truth be told, I've never thought too deeply about it, kupo. If our throats are dry, or if the flowers are drooping, we just go to the springs north of Moghome.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_OHLDEEH_000_044: When we wish to wash the dirt from our scales, we tumble into the nearest cloud, and when our throats are parched, we slake our thirst with the blood of our prey.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_000_045: Hmmm, the springs of Moghome are entirely too far away, and somehow I doubt a fountain of blood is what Gullinbursti has in mind. How about you, ? Any ideas?
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_A1_000_001: Perhaps we could make use of a spring crystal?
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_A1_000_002: Why search for a water source when we could make one?
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_000_050: Spring crystals? The name rings familiar... Ah, now I remember! Crystals wet to the touch, yes? If I recall correctly, they are harvested in quantity from the Sea of Clouds, and are used to keep the barrels of Camp Cloudtop filled to the brim.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_000_060:
Make one? But how would we─
Ah hah! , my , I could kiss you! Of course, the Rose Knights of Camp Cloudtop. They keep their stores of water plentiful with the spring crystals found in abundance throughout the Sea of Clouds.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_OHLDEEH_000_061: Such an ingenious solution! Gullinbursti may be stubborn, but even he should be impressed.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_100_061: I believe he would, my dear Ohl Deeh. That settles it then: we must procure spring crystals. Of course, it would be preferable if we did not have to travel all the way to the Sea of Clouds. Can they be found near here?
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_OHLDEEH_110_061: We are in luck, because I often fly over a crystal that seems to have water trickling from its surface. I have a suspicion this might be one of these spring crystals you speak of.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_062: All that's left is to gather them, then! Ohl Deeh, show me where they are, and I'll bring back as many as I can carry. Gullinbursti will know our worth, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_000_064: Well, I cannot deny Mogzin's enthusiasm. However, neither he nor Ohl Deeh have actually seen a spring crystal up close, and it would be a shame if what they brought back was unusable. Follow them, so you might judge the crystal's quality.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_065: Oh, , I didn't know you were following us, kupo! Look, there's water trickling from this crystal. Surely this is what we seek, yes?
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_OHLDEEH_000_066: Here it is! Now, all we have to do is carry it back with us. Luckily there are three of us, so that should prove no difficulty!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_000_067: While I trust Mogzin and Ohl Deeh, I gather you are more qualified to judge the quality of any spring crystals you may find. Follow them, and bring back any crystals you deem suitable.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_SYSTEM_000_070: Water trickles forth from the crystal in thin rivulets, each running dry before reaching its base. It seems there is little hope that this can be used as a supply for the fountain.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_SYSTEM_000_073: Water trickles forth from the crystal in thin rivulets, each running dry before reaching its base. It seems there is little hope that this can be used as a supply for the fountain.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_OHLDEEH_000_080: From the skies, I could not tell that this crystal was so dry. But worry not, for you are in the company of a dragon!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_OHLDEEH_000_081: When I unleash my mighty roar, this crystal will awaken, and water will gush forth from it like a geyser!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_OHLDEEH_000_082: I simply need some time to gather my strength. One century should do the trick. Brother was around that age when he learned to roar.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_OHLDEEH_000_084: You cannot wait even one hundred years!? I pity you, truly. Well, I suppose we must ask Brother for his help again. I am certain this time we can skip the trial.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_086: So you're going back to Zenith? I'll wait here and protect the crystal from thieves and monsters, kupo.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_OHLDEEH_000_088: , welcome! I have already explained everything to Brother!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_WHEIAHF_000_090: Well met. My brother tells me you wish to borrow my strength again.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_WHEIAHF_000_091: You mean to awaken a crystal? A simple matter. Very well, you have my wings.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_WHEIAHF_000_092: Climb atop my back, and guide me to this crystal. Ohl Deeh, you stay behind. , if we should become separated, return here and my brother shall summon me.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_OHLDEEH_000_095: Not used to riding dragons, are you? It is a good thing Brother was clever enough to have me remain here, then. Wait here and I'll call him.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_SYSTEM_000_096: The thin streams of water leaking from the crystal look as if they will dry up at any moment. Speak with Ohl Deeh to ride Whei Ahf, and use his Roar ability to awaken the spring crystal.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_100: Look! The water is spouting forth, kupo! This crystal will make the perfect source for our fountain. Now, we just need to break off a few shards...
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_101: (-Whei Ahf-)I am relieved. I could have just as easily shattered the crystal by mistake. Fortunately, I did not.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_102: I've gathered the largest shards I could find! Now let us be off to Zenith, and we'll show Gullinbursti that Bahrr Lehs will shine once more!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_104: Gullinbursti will have no choice but to let us build in Bahrr Lehs now, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_000_105: Mogzin has already gone to speak with Gullinbursti? Ah, it is good to see him taking the initiative. I daresay he can manage this on his own, but of course if you were by his side it would put my mind at ease.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_OHLDEEH_000_106: Have you ever seen a spring crystal so vibrant? I knew Brother could do it!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_110: Gullinbursti, we've done it! The fountain in Bahrr Lehs will flow as gloriously as before, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_COLORDRAGON_000_111: So, you have secured a water source?
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_112: It was a team effort, kupo!  suggested we use spring crystals, and Ohl Deeh told us where to find one. We've gathered more than enough shards to keep the fountain flowing indefinitely!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_COLORDRAGON_000_113: I know of these crystals. But do not attempt to deceive me. There are none with the strength of which you speak.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_114: There were none, kupo! But through will, perseverance, and determination, we were able to find a solution!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_COLORDRAGON_000_115: Those words... Ah, it is nothing. Proceed, moogle.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_116: With Whei Ahf's mighty roar, we awakened a spring crystal, and now have enough water to make five fountains! Surely our deeds have proven that we are worthy to continue our work.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_COLORDRAGON_000_117: Impressive, little one. However, your story tells only of the deeds of man and dragon. What has your kind contributed?
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_118: There is still much work to be done, and the spring crystal is but one component. From here on out, it's the responsibility of the Mogmenders to see the fountain completed, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_COLORDRAGON_000_119: Your words bespeak confidence, and more importantly, sincerity. Very well, you may remain in Bahrr Lehs.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_COLORDRAGON_000_121: Rising from the fountain was once a statue. A monument to friendship and peace. You will see it restored to Bahrr Lehs.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_122: A statue? We've never built something like that. What if it proves beyond our abilities, kupo?
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_COLORDRAGON_000_123: Then I shall make the plaza dust and rubble once more.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_COLORDRAGON_000_124: Well, it appears we have no choice but to succeed, then! Gullinbursti, the statue we raise will be even better than you remember, I promise!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_COLORDRAGON_000_125: There is something unique about that one. Do you not agree?
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_000_126: Mogzin looks in even higher spirits than usual. I take it your meeting with Gullinbursti went well, then?
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_OHLDEEH_000_127: Mogzin and I used to spend our days hiding in imaginary palaces within the rubble. And now his imagination is coming to life! He has come quite far, I must say.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_COLORDRAGON_000_128: What can be wrought by the hands of man, moogle, and dragon? I am eager to see.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_MOGZIN_000_130: A monument to friendship and peace, and our latest challenge, kupo! I suppose we can consider this the Mogmenders' first commission! I must admit I'm a bit nervous─our reputation is at stake!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_TARRESSON_000_131: So the dragon has requested further work be done to the plaza? Mogzin, I have no doubt you and the Mogmenders shall rise to this challenge as you have risen to many others. Remember the wisdom I have tried to impart to you!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_COLORDRAGON_000_132: I won't disappoint you, Tarresson! Even if it looks like there is no way forward, I'll find one! Now, let's begin work on the fountain!
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_SYSTEM_000_500: Thanks to your efforts, the fountain of Bahrr Lehs has been restored. Continue assisting the Mogmenders to see repair of the plaza completed.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_SYSTEM_000_200: You have achieved Trusted reputation with the Mogmenders.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_SYSTEM_000_201: New moogle society daily quests are now available from Mogek the Marvelous at the plaza.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_SYSTEM_100_202: You will receive an experience point bonus upon the completion of the moogle society daily quests.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_SYSTEM_000_203: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Mogek the Marvelous as a reputation rank bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANMOG004_02323_SYSTEM_000_204: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Mogek the Marvelous. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGZIN_000_000: I can't believe them, kupo! Of all the times for trickery! Why, if they were here, I'd give them a piece of my─
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGZIN_000_001: Oh, ! Once again, fate is working against us. Sometimes it seems as though we can't lift even a single brick without something going wrong! Let's all put our poms together, and hopefully we can find a solution!
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGZIN_000_002: I've heard you have plenty of experience with matters of this sort. Perhaps you can lend us your expertise in searching for lost things, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_010: Just when I had forgotten how entertaining the moogles' antics could be, this happens. You see, we are expecting a shipment of supplies from the Temple Knights, but their delivery is long overdue. Mogzin here suspects foul play.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGZIN_000_011: That's right, kupo! With the Mogmenders busy at Bahrr Lehs, I asked the moogles at Asah to help transport the supplies. Unfortunately, I fear they may have hid them, or worse. Our only choice is to find the moogles in charge and question them ourselves!
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_012: Give them a good talking to, Mogzin! As the leader of the Mogmenders, you must make it clear that you will not tolerate such trickery! I have faith the supplies will be here at Bahrr Lehs before long.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGZIN_000_013: Of course, Tarresson! I'll give them a scolding they won't soon forget! Perhaps I'll even make them carry the supplies themselves!
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_014: Ah, look at him. Off to rebuke an irresponsible moogle, as a father would a disobedient child. However, as we are expecting a good many crates, another pair of young strapping legs to carry them certainly would not hurt. Go and assist him should he require it.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_015: Mogzin will certainly be grateful for your company when he sees the size of the crates. Besides, it would bring me comfort to know you were by his side.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TRANSPORTER_000_016: You must be that adventurer who's helping the Mogmenders! I'm terribly sorry for hiding the supplies, kupo. I couldn't help myself. It's like there's some other moogle living inside my pom, and he made me hide them up there, and over there, and down there...
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGZIN_000_020: , what're you doing here? Did Tarresson send you to accompany me again?
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGZIN_000_021: He really must learn to let me handle my own affairs, kupo! Look here, I gave this moogle such a verbal thrashing that he's agreed to show me where he hid the supplies, and has even forsaken trickery for good! Completely and utterly contrite, he is!
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGZIN_000_022: Alas, I'd rather not spend my time reprimanding others. There's still so much to be done at Bahrr Lehs. But lately, I've felt that no matter how many hours we labor for, we never get any closer to completion...
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGZIN_000_023: Ah, but worry not, ! I've no intention of giving up, kupo! One blow at a time, we'll chisel away at Bahrr Lehs until the glory of its past is restored!
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGZIN_000_024: For now, I suppose I should see to the unenviable task of collecting the rest of the supplies. , I know much more important matters demand your attention, but could you deliver this crate to Bahrr Lehs? With any luck, we'll see each other again shortly!
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGZIN_000_025: Now, show me where you hid them! Quickly, there's no time to waste, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_030: You are returned, and sooner than I expected. Is Mogzin not with you?
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_031: Aye, these are certainly the supplies we ordered. How kind of Mogzin to shoulder the burden of finding the rest. While he is occupied, there is a matter I would like to discuss with you.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_032: As you have doubtless noticed, Mogzin has become an admirable crafter in his own right. In fact, the zeal with which each and every Mogmender approaches their work has been naught short of astonishing. However, despite their best efforts, their progress leaves something to be desired.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_033: Curious as to why, I observed the Mogmenders at work, and one thing that struck me was the feebleness of their blows. Now, this is no fault of the moogles. It is not due to laziness that they strike so lightly. No, I believe the tools are to blame.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_034: The moogles cannot grip their tools firmly, and they do not have our thewy arms. Tools made for us are entirely unsuitable for them. But what if we were to furnish them with tools attuned to their aetheric energy?
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_036: Which brings us to the supplies. With them we shall make wind-aspected tools, which I believe the Mogmenders will be able to swing as mightily as we swing our own tools! I would give you the honor of helping me craft the first one!
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_040: I only ask that you craft a hammer head. I have procured a material known as aurum regis, possessed of superior aetherial conductivity. Use it to make a well-balanced head so the tool is not clumsy in our furry friends' paws.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_050: I ask that you craft a simple, but essential part: a hammer's handle. Ensure that its shape is suited to a moogle's paws. Afterwards, I shall apply a specially made varnish which will enhance the aetherial conductivity of the tool.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_060: I would have you prepare a special varnish, whose unique ingredients shall enhance the aetherial conductivity of the tools, enabling our furry friends to wield them with little effort.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_061: Before you begin, however, bring the crate of supplies to Mogmul. As always, you are free to take whatever you feel is necessary to complete your task.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_062: Well, we had best get to it then. I shall begin work on the remaining parts at once. I look forward to holding the finished product in my hands!
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGMUL_000_070: The others think I have the easiest job in the Mogmenders, but they're wrong! Have you ever flapped your wings in place for hours on end? No? Then you have no idea how hungry it makes you, kupo! But I must do my duty. What supplies do you require this time?
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGMUL_000_071: Ah, so these are the errant supplies? Any kupo nuts? I thought not. In that case, feel free to take anything you need!
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGMUL_000_072: Oh, did you run out of materials? As always, you are welcome to anything you require. Of course, I'll always accept offerings of kupo nuts, as thanks for my service.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGMUL_100_072: Well, you've certainly outdone yourself this time, kupo! If only I had a kupo nut half so splendid as the work you create.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_080: Are you finished already? Of course, I expect only the most superb craftsmanship from you.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_081: Ah, yes. This is a masterpiece, of that there can be no doubt! Now, we only need take what I have made and...
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_082: Look, , have you ever seen a hammer so mighty, so majestic, so...miniature!? Ah, there is nothing like crafting something so fine with your own hand. Of course, I could not have done it without you, my friend.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGZIN_000_083: , Tarresson, I am returned! And with all the missing supplies, no less! <sniff> What's that smell? Have you been crafting?
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_084: Indeed we have, my dear Mogzin! A special present, for our favorite Mogmender. I believe you will be most pleasantly surprised.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGZIN_000_085: Ohhh, I'm not falling for that again! I still remember the taste of disappointment when I bit into those fake kupo nuts! What is it this time, leather cloud mallow?
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGZIN_000_086: , you too? Hmmm, perhaps you are telling the truth after all. Very well, show me your present. Just in case, I shall gird my pom for the worst!
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGZIN_000_087: This hammer, it's...different from the others.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_088: Both  and I poured our hearts and souls into it, so I hope you are able to make good use of it. I believe this hammer─and other tools like it─will bring a marked improvement to the Mogmenders' work. How does it feel, Mogzin?
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGZIN_000_089: It's so light, and fits in my paws perfectly. Were those other tools just for practice? Why, I feel as if I could chip away at stone all day and night, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_090: I am full glad to hear that. Truth be told, I know that you and the other Mogmenders were growing frustrated at your lack of progress. With this, I believe you will be able to produce work at the speed and quality I know you are capable of.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGZIN_000_091: I...I apologize. You shouldn't have had to go to such great lengths on our account. Nevertheless, you have my thanks, and the thanks of every single Mogmender!
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_TARRESSON_000_092: That is why we are here, is it not? To teach you and yours all we know, so that one day you might repair Zenith without guidance from a doddering old fool. So, there is no need to thank us, much less apologize. We shall be content to see you produce grand works!
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_MOGZIN_000_093: And so we shall, kupo! I daresay this moment marks a new age for the Mogmenders!
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_SYSTEM_000_500: Thanks to your efforts, the moogles have brand-new tools to work with. Continue assisting the Mogmenders to see repair of Bahrr Lehs completed.
TEXT_BANMOG005_02324_SYSTEM_000_200: You have achieved Respected reputation with the Mogmenders.

TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_MOGZIN_000_000: Where could  be... Where could  be? Oh, there you are, ! Tarresson's ready to discuss how to begin building the statue, but we dare not start without you, kupo! Now, let's see what he has to say!
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_MOGZIN_000_001: Gullinbursti will be moved to tears by our work! Can dragons cry, kupo? Ah, never mind all that. I suppose we shouldn't get ahead of ourselves. Let's first discuss where to begin!
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_010: , how good of you to join us! Once Ohl Deeh graces us with his presence we can begin our discussion. Ah, here he is now.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_OHLDEEH_000_011: Greetings. For what purpose did you summon me here? Do you require my strength once more?
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_012: Indeed, Ohl Deeh, we would avail ourselves of your legendary strength. All of our work thus far has brought us to this decisive moment, and without your stout wings I fear we will have little hope of success!
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_OHLDEEH_000_013: Then of course my wings are yours! I would never stand idly by as my friends struggle! No task is too large for me!
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_MOGZIN_000_014: I knew we could count on your support, kupo! Finally, we are ready to begin work on the Mogmenders' first official commission: the statue requested by Gullinbursti!
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_015: A monument to friendship and peace, now lost to time. With their new tools, the Mogmenders are working with more vigor than I have ever seen. I believe they are more than ready to rise to this challenge!
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_MOGZIN_000_016: We are ready, kupo! Ready to build a statue! A statue of...of what, exactly?
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_017: It is the answer to that question which I have been contemplating, my dear Mogzin. Unfortunately, we have no pictures, no stories, and no remnants on which we can base the statue's form. We know only that it stood more than one thousand years ago, during the age when dragon and man lived together in harmony.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_MOGZIN_000_018: Could it be a kupa tree? Or an enormous cloud mallow? Hmmm...
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_OHLDEEH_000_019: Do not be daft, Mogzin! The statue likely depicted dragon and man. Brother once told me many such sculptures used to dot the land.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_020: Ohl Deeh, I must say I had much the same thought. What better subjects could there have been to immortalize a bond which, at the time, must have seemed unbreakable?
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_MOGZIN_000_021: Even so, there's still so much we don't know! How were they posed? How many were there? No statues remain to draw inspiration from! Tarresson, do any survive down below?
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_030: Well, there is the relief at Falcon's Nest, but that work is much too recent to be of use. However, there may be another way.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_040: Perhaps, but I fear they might prove difficult to procure. Unfortunately, there are still those who think simply glimpsing such an image would be grounds to accuse one of heresy. However, there may be another way.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_050: Our mutual friends, the Temple Knights, have spent generations chasing heretics. Doubtless they have seized at least a few of their idols during their ceaseless struggle.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_051: , there is much work for us to do here at Bahrr Lehs. I would ask you to journey to Ishgard and ask our dear Handeloup if he can part with an idol. I have confidence he will oblige your request.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_052: However, if perchance he is hesitant to do so, hand him this letter. I believe it shall prove to be adequately convincing.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_MOGZIN_000_053: And what of us? While  is away, what should we do? Continue our stonemasonry practice?
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_054: No, my dear Mogzin, there are preparations to be made. Speak with Mogmul, and ready the stone we will use for the statue. Ohl Deeh, pray help Mogzin with his duties.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_055: For my part, I shall begin drawing up plans for the statue's base. Well then, I look forward to meeting again. May we all return with good news!
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_056: Make haste to the Congregation, and ask if Handeloup can spare an idol. If he insists on being difficult, simply hand him the letter I gave you. Trust me, it shall suffice.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_HANDELOUP_000_060: You require an idol seized from the heretics? Ah... My apologies, , but such a request is not within my power to grant.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_HANDELOUP_000_070: Pray understand that much as I would like to offer you a helping hand, there are some matters where my reach is limited.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_HANDELOUP_000_071: A letter from Lord Tarresson? ...He writes that the figures in question were taken unlawfully from the Churning Mists, and that the moogles, as caretakers of the ancient ruins therein, are obliged to petition their return.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_HANDELOUP_000_072: A rather more bureaucratic approach than I anticipated, but I would expect no less from a lord of House Dzemael. As skilled with his words as he is with a hammer and chisel.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_HANDELOUP_000_073: He has not told you? That cunning old fox is none other than Tarresson de Dzemael─formerly Count Tarresson de Dzemael. Although he has long since stepped down, he still does not scruple to intercede in various affairs.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_HANDELOUP_100_073: In any event, his reasoning is sound, and I see no harm in following his plan. Speak with my man Vaincannet. He will provide you with what you need.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_HANDELOUP_000_074: It seems the restoration is proceeding apace. Your duty is almost at an end, . I hope it has been a worthwhile journey so far.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_VAINCANNET_100_074: You require an idol, yes? I believe this one should do─they all look the same to me. Dreadfully ugly, isn't it? Well, I suppose there's no accounting for taste.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_MOGZIN_000_075: We've found the perfect stones, kupo! Have you returned with something we can use? Oh, I can't wait until we begin building!
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_OHLDEEH_000_076: If you need any more help carrying stones, I'm the dragon for you! I can do that all day!
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_080: You are returned! Was Handeloup willing to oblige our request?
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_081: This is an object of heresy and untold evil? It seems harmless enough to me, and the craftsmanship is superb! I do believe this will provide the perfect model for our statue. Excellent work, my friend!
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_082: However, I cannot help but notice you no longer have the letter I wrote. I suppose that means Ser Handeloup told you who I am, that a simple epistle would sway a man of his standing.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_083: Well then, let me apologize for the belated introduction. I am Tarresson de Dzemael, erstwhile count of my house. I am happy to say my son now enjoys that burden, leaving me to spend my days as I please.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_084: I try to stay busy, of course, and our project here has been a boon in that regard. However, do not think this some whim born of idleness. No, this is how I wish to live out my twilight years. As my true self. As a craftsman.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_085: House Dzemael was built upon a foundation of mastery. Mastery of wood, steel, and stone. From a young age I strove to learn the techniques of my forefathers. Alas, once I became count, I was forced to trade my hammer and chisel for quill and parchment.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_100_085: A count's craft is to uphold the honor of his house, his tools, his wit, and his wiles. I was bound to the eternal struggle for glory and prestige, and as the months bled into years my days as an artisan faded into half-forgotten memory.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_086: It was in this single-minded state I raised my sons, teaching them naught of the joy of crafting. Perhaps by imparting my knowledge to others, I am in some small way trying to alleviate that regret...
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_087: Hahaha, I have gone on too long again! Truly, I thank you for listening to this old man's ramblings. Now, let us return to the task at hand! The statue must be built, and I have a job perfectly suited to your skills.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_090: Our sculpture will require sturdy metal beams to support the weight of the stone. Although they will remain unseen by most, they are nevertheless among the most vital components.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_100: A sculpture must be polished to a mirror sheen if it is to be remembered. And to that end, I would have you make the materials required to do so.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_110: What purpose would our efforts serve if the sculpture we build cannot withstand the elements? To prevent that from happening, I would ask that you prepare a coating to shield our work from the harsh winds and rains of this region.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_120: As always, Mogmul shall provide you with aught you require. Bring your completed work to Mogzin, and we shall make use of it at once!
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_MOGZIN_000_121: You're helping us with the statue, kupo? Brilliant! Truth be told, a task this large is a bit intimidating. Still, I look forward to the day when the Mogmenders can face such a project without fear!
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_TARRESSON_000_122: Well, I believe we all have our work to do. Receive your supplies from Mogmul, and bring your finished work to Mogzin.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_MOGMUL_000_130: Did you see them moving those huge stones, kupo? Just watching them made my belly rumble. But I will do my duty! Until the statue is complete, I'll be here to give you whatever you need!
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_MOGMUL_000_131: The Mogmenders have plenty of supplies to spare, so there's no need to worry about running out. Just say the word and I'll fill your bags with anything you need, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_MOGMUL_100_131: I've learned to expect only greatness from you, and you've never disappointed, kupo! All who have aided in making this possible, both past and present, are surely glad to have a crafter like you to work their materials.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_MOGZIN_000_140: , it goes without saying, but the Mogmenders are grateful for all your help so far, kupo! Just a little bit more, and we'll have finished. So, let's see what you've made!
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_MOGZIN_000_131: You've certainly outdone yourself this time! Gullinbursti will surely be in awe at the quality of our work! And now, all that's left is to build, build, build!
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_MOGZIN_000_300: We've done it, kupo! Can you feel it? This must be how the landlords and skylords felt the moment they built this plaza ages ago. I can only imagine what Gullinbursti's reaction will be!
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_COLORDRAGON_000_301: Little ones, how fares your work? If it is too difficult, simply say so. I shall allow you to return home before I raze this place to the ground.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_MOGZIN_000_302: On the contrary, Gullinbursti, you could not have arrived at a more opportune time! The statue is complete, and I daresay even more majestic than it was before. Behold!
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_COLORDRAGON_000_303: I have not seen this statue in a long time. Yes, it is as it was. Almost.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_COLORDRAGON_000_304: Your work is...adequate. As promised, I shall leave you be. Continue in peace.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_MOGZIN_000_305: Almost? Adequate? But why would he say that, kupo?
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_SYSTEM_000_500: Thanks to your efforts, the statue has been erected in Bahrr Lehs. It would seem your work is complete, but Gullinbursti's cryptic words suggest otherwise.
TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_SYSTEM_000_200: You have achieved Honored reputation with the Mogmenders.

TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_SYSTEM_000_202: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Mogek the Marvelous as a reputation rank bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.

TEXT_BANMOG006_02325_SYSTEM_000_204: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Mogmul Mogbelly.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_000: , I'm glad you're here, kupo. There's a matter I've been meaning to discuss with everyone since Gullinbursti's departure, and now is as good a time as any!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_001: Oh, I'm a little nervous, but I won't be happy with myself if I don't bring it up now. Come on, let's get this over with.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_TARRESSON_000_010: We are all gathered, it would seem. Now, my dear Mogzin, what was it you─ Oh, I see you have summoned Ohl Deeh as well! Very good, very good!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_OHLDEEH_000_011: Mogzin, I was just admiring our craftsmanship. An accomplishment to be proud of, certainly! Now, what was it you wanted? Are we to help plan the celebration?
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_TARRESSON_000_012: The celebration, yes! Now that the statue is complete, there is naught to do but ensure the statue stays polished. It is time for a well-deserved rest! Do you not agree, my dear Mogzin?
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_013: No, no, not at all, kupo! With all due respect, Tarresson, our work is far from complete. I believe you know this already─you were there when Gullinbursti saw the statue!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_OHLDEEH_000_014: I was there as well, Mogzin. Did Gullinbursti not grant us leave to remain in Bahrr Lehs? We could not have asked for more! Mogek and Mogmul have already begun preparations for a feast...
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_015: You need to look past his words, Ohl Deeh! Didn't you find his reaction strange? He seemed thoroughly unimpressed by our efforts. Something is amiss, I'm certain!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_016: We─no, I─cannot be content to leave the statue in its current state. I'll not rest until it's perfect. Not only in Gullinbursti's eyes, but in mine as well!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_TARRESSON_000_017: Hahaha! Well said, my dear Mogzin, well said! I knew you would not be satisfied with mediocrity! Truly, your growth as a crafter has been naught short of astounding. You are truly an inspiration!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_018: I...I don't know what to say, kupo. Thank you!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_019: So that means you agree with me, yes? Then as we have many times before, let's work together to find out what's wrong! We've already come this far─just a little bit further and we can enjoy the satisfaction of seeing our work complete at last!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_OHLDEEH_000_020: But how are we to know where the fault lies? The possibilities are endless!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_TARRESSON_000_021: Well, I believe we did well by casting dragon and man as the subjects. Hmmm, perhaps the composition of the figures was not to his liking?
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_022: If we had made such a fundamental error, I doubt he would suffer the statue to remain. No, it must be something else. Something we're not seeing...
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_TARRESSON_000_024: Let us take a different tack and ask ourselves why Gullinbursti demanded the statue be built in the first place. Why was it so important to him?
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_OHLDEEH_000_025: I had wondered that myself. I know little of Gullinbursti besides the fact he is much older than Brother. He is quite reclusive, although I have been told he was not always that way.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_026: Hmmm, and we only know him by his demands. Ohl Deeh, surely there are other dragons that are friendly with him. Perhaps they could offer insight into his motives!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_OHLDEEH_000_027: Perhaps. It might serve us best to speak with the other ancient dragons.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_TARRESSON_000_028: Are there any you could introduce us to, Ohl Deeh?
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_OHLDEEH_000_029: Of course! There's Vedrfolnir, who I happen to count among my many friends! Perhaps we could also try visiting Vidofnir, though I am not certain she would grant us audience.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_030: You are friends with Vidofnir!? Why, you're just full of surprises, kupo! Our next step is settled. , allow me to accompany you to the surface and speak with Vidofnir. Master Tarresson, Ohl Deeh, visit Vedrfolnir and find out if he knows anything about Gullinbursti.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_031: Let us meet back here to share our findings. Until then!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_VIDOFNIR_000_040: Well met, warrior of warriors. What brings you and yours to Anyx Trine today?
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_VIDOFNIR_000_041: Gullinbursti... Yes, I know him. For many moons didst he labor to build the very plaza you now endeavor to repair.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_042: Gullinbursti helped to build Bahrr Lehs!? Then why would he raze it to the ground?
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_VIDOFNIR_000_043: For brothers robbed of a mother's love. 'Twas bitter reminder and testament to man's ancient sin─of Ratatoskr's sacrifice upon the altar of mortal greed.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_VIDOFNIR_000_045: Old wounds are slow to heal, and mayhap his discontent is rooted in the past.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_VIDOFNIR_000_046: Look to the plaza's ruins if you would know more.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_047: But all that's left of the old Bahrr Lehs are the piles of─ Wait, that's it, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_048: , we need to go back at once! There may be remains in the rubble we've cleared! Perhaps they will provide the clue we seek! Vidofnir, you have my sincerest thanks for your counsel!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_OHLDEEH_000_049: You are returned! Have you come to help us sort through the rubble?
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_TARRESSON_000_050: We do our utmost to repurpose the stones we unearth, but some are not suitable, and so we pile them here. I suppose we should have taken a closer look...
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_VIDOFNIR_000_051: The warrior of warriors would serve as the crafter of crafters? How curious.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_060: Here's where we keep the stones that are unfit for reuse, kupo. Ohl Deeh, Tarresson, are you looking for remnants of the old plaza too?
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_TARRESSON_000_061: Indeed we are. Vedrfolnir only offered as much information as he deemed necessary─a quality that comes with age. It was clear, however, that the pieces of old Bahrr Lehs may hold the answer we seek.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_062: We had much the same experience. Well, there's nothing for it but to dig, dig, dig, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_063: Surely somewhere within these heaps of rubble is a clue to Gullinbursti's past...
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_SYSTEM_000_070: You dig through the heap of rubble, but find nothing that could be of use.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_080: Any luck? I've found nothing but old rocks, kupo.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_081: What is this? This...this looks like the writing of the landlords, kupo! Alas, I can't read it. What does it say, ?
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_TARRESSON_000_082: How fares your search? Have you found aught that might be of use?
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_083: Tarresson, look!  found these fragments engraved with what looks to be the script of the landlords.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_TARRESSON_000_084: Brilliant! Let me have a look. Ohl Deeh and I found several similar fragments, but for the life of me I cannot make out their meaning. Perhaps they are but small pieces of a larger whole.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_TARRESSON_000_085: Let us see... Like this? Or like this? Hmmm, the elements have not been kind to these stones─I can scarce tell if the letters are upside down or right-side up...
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_OHLDEEH_000_086: Stop fooling around! What does it say? What does it say!?
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_TARRESSON_000_087: Do not rush me, Ohl Deeh! I must focus! Here, I think I have it.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_TARRESSON_000_088:
“Unity and brotherhood, now and forevermore.
Marinche de Faurechort, Moggon, Gullinbursti”.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_TARRESSON_000_089: A man, a moogle, and a dragon. Doubtless they were the architects of this place.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_OHLDEEH_000_090: You mean more than a thousand years ago there lived a moogle crafter, just like Mogzin? It appears the plazas of past and present have more in common than we thought!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_091: So, it was this tablet which was truly important to Gullinbursti.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_TARRESSON_000_092: Indeed. To him, the statue was more than a monument to friendship and peace. It was a monument to his friendships as well.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_093: And so we shall make it our duty to restore this tablet! Come on, it's time to put chisels to stone!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_TARRESSON_000_094: Faurechort... If my memory is not mistaken, then that name... Well, when we have finished, I believe some research will be in order.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_OHLDEEH_000_095: I never took Gullinbursti for the sentimental sort. Anyway, I will try to convince him to return by the time you have finished. I look forward to seeing the reconstructed tablet!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_100: The Mogmenders' first commission will soon be complete! That is, if you would entertain one final request.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_110: The tablet requires a proper mounting, one which will hold fast against the harsh elements of the region. I would task you with making it!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_120: The tablet must shine brightly, that all who view the names engraved upon it might remember forever. I would task you with preparing materials for polishing!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_130: The letters must be darkened with ink, so they might withstand the corroding elements for many years to come. I would task you with making that ink!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_150: Lastly, I would like to thank you for your support, not only on behalf of the Mogmenders, but all the Moghome moogles! If not for you and Tarresson, Bahrr Lehs would still be nothing but dust and rubble.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_151: Once more we trust in your steady hand. I know you will impress!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_152: Mogmul will give you any supplies you need. Once your masterpiece is finished, hand it to Tarresson and we can complete our work!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_153: What will I do, you ask? Let's just say I have one final trick to play. A parting trick, if you will. I'll be getting it ready while you do your crafting.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_154: Ah, that look in your eyes! You can't wait to find out what it is, can you? Worry not─I assure you it will be my best one yet!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_TARRESSON_000_155: I take it Mogzin has told you what needs crafting? And also of this so-called “trick” of his? By the Fury, what could he be planning?
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGMUL_000_160: Mogzin's been by and told me to expect you, kupo! Take anything you want, anything! Once you've finished I can finally eat!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGMUL_000_161: You've run out of supplies? Fear not, the Mogmenders' storehouses are open to you. Please hurry though─I'm about to faint from hunger.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGMUL_100_161: Oh, your work is so magnificent I could cry! Not even the most perfect of kupo nuts has moved me so. But perhaps if I stuffed enough of them into my mouth... I know what I'm doing next, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_TARRESSON_000_170: Have you completed Mogzin's request? <sigh> To think, this may be the last time I gaze upon your work. It has been an honor, my friend.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_TARRESSON_000_171: I must say, the quality of your craftsmanship has always been reliable! Come, let us call the Mogmenders. At last, Gullinbursti will acknowledge the depth of our skill!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_300: Preparations for our trick are complete, kupo! All we have left to do now is attach the tablet!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_301: (-Engraved Tablet-)Unity and brotherhood, now and forevermore.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_100_301:
(-Engraved Tablet-)Mogzin, 
Tarresson de Dzemael, Ohl Deeh
Marinche de Faurechort, Moggon, Gullinbursti
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_COLORDRAGON_000_302: Whei Ahf and Ohl Deeh were insistent I come. I pray it is worth my time.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_COLORDRAGON_000_303: Hah hah hah! Very good, very good!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_COLORDRAGON_000_304: I remember the day we finished building. I remember Moggon's indignant protests. “Where is the moogle statue!? You make me so mad...kupo.” And so on. It would seem his wish is now fulfilled.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_305: I take it everything meets with your satisfaction? Even the moogle statue?
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_COLORDRAGON_000_306: It does. You have my blessings and my thanks. I shall keep the skies of Bahrr Lehs safe, to prove my words true.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_MOGZIN_000_307: Did you hear that, kupo!? Gullinbursti approves! Gullinbursti approves! Finally, through will, determination, and perseverance, the Mogmenders have completed their first major project!
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_SYSTEM_000_200: You have achieved Sworn reputation with the Mogmenders.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_SYSTEM_000_201: You will receive an experience point bonus upon completion of the moogle society daily quests.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_SYSTEM_000_202: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from Mogmul Mogbelly.
TEXT_BANMOG007_02326_SYSTEM_000_210: You have learned the emote Moogle Dance!
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_MOGZIN_000_000: , everyone's been asking for you, kupo! You'd better speak with Ohl Deeh and Master Tarresson to see what they want.
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_MOGZIN_000_001: Master Tarresson and Ohl Deeh are eager to speak with you, kupo! I wonder what they want?
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_TARRESSON_000_010: There you are, ! Do not look so tense, my friend. For once this does not concern our difficulties repairing the plaza.
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_TARRESSON_000_011: On the contrary, I simply wish to offer you my sincerest gratitude for your help thus far. You have given this old man a meaningful way to spend his days, and thanks to the efforts of all and sundry, I have recaptured a piece of my family's history.
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_TARRESSON_000_013: Yes, my family. For although House Dzemael is now renowned for its skill at stonemasonry, that was not always the case. No, as recently as three centuries ago, we were but humble crafters.
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_TARRESSON_000_014: It was not until a lord of House Dzemael married the daughter of a minor lord─whose house was known for its deep knowledge of architecture─that the first brick of our renown was laid. That maiden's family name was Faurechort.
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_TARRESSON_000_015: A name which rings familiar, yes? One of the three original architects of Bahrr Lehs: Marinche de Faurechort. His blood courses through the veins of every son and daughter of House Dzemael, and his teachings have enriched our lives.
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_TARRESSON_000_016: To think that after more than a thousand years, ancestor and descendant would be joined by the same work of art. Nymeia must surely be smirking at Her own cleverness. Regardless, I am grateful for whatever whims of fate have led me to this moment.
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_TARRESSON_000_017: Ah, but enough of sentimentality! I have come to a decision. Until the day I draw my last breath, I shall continue on here and guide the Mogmenders. Of course, you are always welcome should you wish to offer a helping hand.
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_TARRESSON_000_018: I never did feel entirely comfortable among the stiff nobility of Ishgard, and I doubt I shall be sorely missed. Certainly many will bid good riddance to me, but it does not matter. The feeling shall be mutual!
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_OHLDEEH_000_020: , greetings! Quite the impressive work, wouldn't you agree?
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_OHLDEEH_000_021: When Mogzin first told me about Bahrr Lehs, I was sure nothing would ever get done. I certainly never dreamed he would go so far as to receive Gullinbursti's praise!
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_OHLDEEH_000_022: If not for you and Tarresson, Mogzin would still be caught up in trying to avoid work. I thank you for keeping by his side through all of this, and I look forward to seeing what works the Mogmenders produce in the future.
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_OHLDEEH_000_023: As for me, I have no pressing engagements for the next hundred years, after which I will go into hibernation. Until then, I plan on remaining here to help with the repair of Zenith. If you find yourself back here sometime within the next century, be sure to say hello!
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_OHLDEEH_000_024: After all of our hard work, I've come to understand why Gullinbursti felt so attached to this place. Perhaps in a thousand years, I'll look upon Bahrr Lehs with a similar fondness.
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_MOGZIN_000_030: You're back, kupo! Now that you've heard everyone else's thanks, it's my turn! Thank you!
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_MOGZIN_000_031: The Mogmenders still have much work ahead, and soon we'll begin repairing Zenith proper.
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_MOGZIN_000_032: No doubt we'll face difficulties that'll make repairing this plaza look as simple as painting a pebble. But the experience we've gained here will see us through!
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_MOGZIN_000_033: The Mogmenders will never forget how much you helped us, and we will forever remember the power of will, perseverance, and determination!
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_MOGZIN_000_034: Of course, if you ever find yourself missing our company, or if you're just in the mood for some honest labor, we'll always welcome you among our ranks, kupo!
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_SYSTEM_000_100: You have achieved Bloodsworn reputation with the Mogmenders.
TEXT_BANMOG008_02327_SYSTEM_000_101: Furthermore, you will receive an experience point bonus upon completion of the moogle society daily quests.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_DRYDOX_000_000:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Uplander comes at perfect time. Deftarm was just here, looking for uplander. Something about new busydeals that Deftarm would be making─busydeals for which Deftarm is needing uplander's aid.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_DRYDOX_000_001: Must be big busydeals, thinks Drydox, because Deftarm was running here and there like wild wildebeest. Uplander is master to Deftarm, yes? Uplander should make quickfeet to village of walkybugs, help pupil.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_DRYDOX_000_005: Deftarm was waving his arms around like this, so Drydox gives wordbond: Drydox will send uplander to walkybug village, and quickly! Uplander does not want to make falseteller of Drydox, yes?
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_000_010: <click> <click> Master! You return, and not a moment too soon! I have come upon a tremendous opportunity to further expand our Adventurers' Guild, and I would seek your aid in seeing it to fruition.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_000_011: I was consulting with Vidofnir some days ago, when she spoke to me of another tribe that might benefit from our services. I believe she called them...moggles? Muggles? Something like that, at least.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_000_012: As she told it, these furry creatures make their home in the Churning Mists, where they now toil day and night to rebuild a great and ancient plaza, with the aid of dragons and men. Surely such an industrious tribe would have much in common with myself and my compatriots. Very much indeed!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_000_013: Yes, I simply must make the acquaintance of these─what were they called again?
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_000_014: Ah, yes! Moogles! I trust that a great adventurer like yourself is on good terms with these moogles, Master? You will introduce me to them, yes?
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_000_015: <click> <click> A thousand thank-yous, Master! The success of our guild has brought much prosperity to our colony, but a true hero does not rest on his laurels! This is a lesson I have learned from observing you, Master. Yes, one of many.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_000_016: Master and student, striking out on adventure once more─my heart pounds in anticipation! Let us make for the Churning Mists without delay. I shall race you there!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_000_020: <click> <click> I have never been above the clouds before, Master. The sight is simply breathtaking! So breathtaking!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_000_021: That said, these “moogles” are curious creatures. How do they stay airborne on such tiny wings? And whatever purpose do those glowing spheres attached to their heads serve? Very curious indeed... At any rate, if they are in need of an adventurer, I am happy to offer them my aid!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_MOGZIN_000_030: Kupopo? You would introduce to us a pupil of yours, you say? I thought I was your only pupil! Could it be that I'm not as special as I thought I was, kupo?
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_MOGZIN_000_031: Not a pupil in the art of crafting, but of adventure? And like myself, he is not of your kind? Color me confused, but if this pupil of yours can help to lighten our load, I see no reason to refuse his aid, kupo!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_MOGZIN_000_032: Kupopo! Whatever have we here? Those hard scales, those claws...that puny body. Are you some kind of lesser dragon, kupo?
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_000_033: <click> <click> I am no dragon, and I am certainly not lesser! I am the deftarm of Loth ast Vath, an adventurer come to offer my services. In return for due recompense, I will perform any task you desire─no matter how perilous. What say you, my moogle friend?
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_MOGZIN_000_034: Kupopo? You don't look like any adventurer I've ever seen, but hard workers are always welcome at Moghome. That said, we are a community of builders. If you lack crafting skills, I feel I can only offer you menial tasks─collecting rubbish, cracking kupo nuts, et cetera. It's not a glamorous job, but someone has to do it, kupo!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_000_035: <click> <click> Collecting... <sigh> Very well. Consider your kupo nuts as good as cracked.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_MOGZIN_000_036: Did you see how quickly he agreed to take on those tedious tasks? I've taken a liking to this one already! We'll have to prepare a very special welcome for his return─in true moogle fashion! Kupopopo～♪
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_MOGZIN_000_037: But I almost forgot! Tarresson wanted a word with you, . Why don't you pay him a visit? Now, I must be off to prepare a special surprise for our new friend!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_100_039: <click> <click> I am an adventurer, not some common─ah, forgive me, Master. What I meant to say is that my task is not yet done.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_TARRESSON_000_040: Ah, . 'Tis a pleasure to see you again. I see that it is not merely the moogles and the dragons who hold you in the highest of esteem. Yes, I knew you were different from the moment I first laid eyes upon you.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_TARRESSON_000_041: If you will indulge this old man once more, there is a small favor I would ask of you as well. It concerns our mutual friend Ohl Deeh.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_TARRESSON_000_042: 'Twould seem Gullinbursti has taken him under his tutelage in hopes of teaching him to roar like a mighty dragon, but the little one's efforts have yet to bear fruit.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_TARRESSON_000_043: I tried to reason with him─why, by his own admission, even the greatest of dragons often need a hundred years to muster their strength─but the stubborn lad was having none of it.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_TARRESSON_000_044: He insisted that he could not afford to wait. For you see, he means to show off his roar to his dear friend Mogzin─and he has recently learned that moogles are not blessed with the longevity of dragons.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_TARRESSON_000_045: He made me promise to keep this a secret from Mogzin, but he said nothing of you. Might you be so kind as to offer him a few words of encouragement? I am certain they would carry more weight coming from a brave adventurer than a mere artisan such as myself.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_TARRESSON_000_048: You will pay Ohl Deeh a visit and rally his spirits, will you not, friend? It would mean ever so much to the lad.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_OHLDEEH_000_050: Oh, . What brings you to Bahrr Lehs? Let me guess: you, too, have come to watch the puny, pathetic Ohl Deeh bring disgrace and dishonor to the name of dragons everywhere. <sigh>
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_SYSTEM_000_051: Ohl Deeh is clearly not his typically confident self. Mayhap there is something you might do to lift the dragonet's spirits?
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_OHLDEEH_000_055: What if I never learn to roar like Brother and Gullinbursti? Am I doomed to live out my years as a worthless runt?
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_SYSTEM_000_056: Ohl Deeh is clearly not his typically confident self. Mayhap there is something you might do to lift the dragonet's spirits?
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_OHLDEEH_000_070: ! But of course you speak true! A proud dragon does not stew and sulk when there is work to be done! Just watch: the next time we meet, my roar will be as mighty as that of Hraesvelgr himself! I do hope Gullinbursti is not cross with me for running off...
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_SYSTEM_000_075: Despite your best efforts, Ohl Deeh remains mired in his deep malaise. Is there aught else you might do to rally his spirits?
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_TARRESSON_000_080: Ohl Deeh's back to his old self, you say? Warms this old man's heart to hear it. I knew I chose the right  for the job. Truly, you stand as a model to dragon, moogle, and man alike.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_TARRESSON_000_081: Speaking of which, your pupil has yet to return from his task. I'm sure he won't be much longer, but in the meantime, I daresay you've earned yourself a rest. Why not warm yourself by the fire while we wait?
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_TARRESSON_000_085: You've done enough work for the time being, friend. Why don't you go warm yourself by the fire while we wait for your pupil to return.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_000_090: <click> <click> My arms ache fiercely. Very fiercely. I thought I had long since left this shell-breaking busywork behind, but it would seem that only “crafters” are trusted with important tasks in this place.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_000_091: Do not ask me, mind you, what those important tasks might be. These moogles spend more time flying about and pulling each other's poms than doing anything resembling actual labor! <sigh> But forgive me my griping, Master. I will go report to Master Mogzin.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_000_092: <click> <click> I am done with my task. The rocks that littered your plaza will plague you no more, and your kupo nuts are cracked and fit for consumption.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_000_094: <click> Do you have nothing to say? I said that I picked up your damn─er, those accursed rocks and cracked every last kupo nut. Every last one!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_MOGZIN_000_095: Surprise! Did my oh-so-clever creation fool you? Your exasperated expression tells me that it did, kupo!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_MOGZIN_000_096: I planted the fur hair by hair, and added a few tufts of cloud mallow to make the pom float! I daresay it's as lifelike as I am, kupo!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_MOGZIN_100_096: The only difference is the hammer in its hand. But no one notices, kupo! Yes, I can say without a doubt that this will go down in moogle history as one of Mogzin's most prodigious pranks ever!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_MOGZIN_000_097: Oh, and good work, by the by! Next time we have some rubbish that needs picking up or kupo nuts that need cracking, rest assured you'll be the first one we call, kupo!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_000_098: <click> <click> I...I have never been so insulted in my life! I toil and trudge from  for you, and you repay me with this mockery!? I take umbrage at this. Great umbrage!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_MOGZIN_000_099: Wh-Whatever is the matter? Surely you have heard that it is through our clever pranks that we moogles show our appreciation and affection for our fr─
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_000_100: <click> <click> Enough! I came here to lend my aid as an adventurer, not play errand boy for a group of slackers who wouldn't know what hard work was if it came up and ripped those ridiculous poms off their heads!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_MOGZIN_000_101: Slackers, kupo!? I'll have you know that we Mogmenders have restored Bahrr Lehs to a glory not seen in generations! You take that back, kupo! Take it back this instant!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_OHLDEEH_000_102: Friends! You must come quickly! Gullinbursti has gone mad! Wh-Why, he nearly torched an unwitting Temple Knight! I scarcely escaped with my own life!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_TARRESSON_000_103: What is this!? A dragon seized with anger bodes ill indeed. Come, ! Mogzin! We must look into this at once!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_000_104: A-An angry dragon...? I... But no─the deftarm will not falter! Wherever you go, Master, I will follow! Lead the way!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_SYSTEM_100_108: This masterfully crafted mannequin holds Mogzin's old hammer in its remarkably lifelike paw.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_OHLDEEH_100_109: Have mercy, Gullinbursti! I promise to be a better student from now on!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_TARRESSON_100_110: Worry not. The man got the breath knocked out of him, but he still lives.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_100_111: <click> <click> Never before have I sensed such anger... Such rage... The urge to run consumes me, but I must resist...!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_MOGZIN_000_110: What is the meaning of this, Gullinbursti!? You promised to keep Bahrr Lehs safe from harm. Now you would turn against us and our friends, kupo!?
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_OHLDEEH_000_111: Have mercy, Gullinbursti! Surely these men and moogles have done nothing to incur your ire!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_TARRESSON_000_112: ...Something is gravely amiss! I see naught but pure animal rage in the dragon's eyes.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_OHLDEEH_000_113: Please stop this, Gullinbursti...I beg of you!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_KOUHEI02382_000_114: Th-Thank you...<pant>...my friends. I owe you my life.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_MOGZIN_000_115: What in the name of the Good King happened here, kupo!?
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_KOUHEI02382_000_116: <pant> <pant> I am not entirely sure myself... I had just arrived to seek Gullinbursti's wisdom concerning the restoration effort, when all of a sudden, we were set upon by a masked man brandishing an imposing firearm.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_KOUHEI02382_000_117: <pant> <pant> Gullinbursti was struck by a bullet in the course of the battle, after which the man made a swift retreat. Just when I thought we were safe, the dragon turned upon me with a terrifying gaze and unleashed a mighty roar. The next thing I knew...I was lying right where you found me.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_OHLDEEH_000_118: Inconceivable! The Gullinbursti I know would never act with such mindless savagery! This masked assailant you speak of did something to our friend─I just know it! I'll see that he suffers for his deeds!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_MOGZIN_000_119: Calm yourself, Ohl Deeh. If we put our poms together, we'll get to the bottom of this in no time. Now, why don't the two of us go in search of Gullinbursti, kupo?
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_TARRESSON_000_120: Not so fast, my dear Mogzin. We must tend to this man's wounds, and besides─'twould be unwise to dash off without forming a proper plan of attack. Let us return to Bahrr Lehs for the moment, and consider our next course of action with due care.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_OHLDEEH_000_125: The madness in those eyes...that was not the Gullinbursti I know! That masked man is behind this somehow─I'm certain of it!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_TARRESSON_000_126: I cannot say for sure what madness has taken Gullinbursti, but it bodes ill for our well-being here. We must take action, and swiftly. And yet first, we must needs formulate a plan.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_UDEKIKI_000_127: <click> <click> This is a troubling development, indeed. But we'll get through this─won't we, Master? After all, we are adventurers, are we not? Yes, adventurers we are!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_MOGZIN_000_130: Well, one thing is clear: this is no time to be bickering amongst ourselves, kupo! We must put our poms together and figure out what has become of Gullinbursti!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_OHLDEEH_000_131: Indeed, indeed! I refuse to accept that he turned on us of his own accord. We must find him and free him from this madness!
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_TARRESSON_000_132: Indeed we must, little one. And yet, we must also find out precisely what fate has befallen our friend─and what we might do to cure him─lest any future encounters prove perilous indeed. Aye, I believe our first course of action should be to track down this masked assailant, that we might ascertain the truth behind all that has transpired.
TEXT_BANALL110_02382_MOGZIN_000_133: Wise counsel, indeed! And yet that sounds like a positively perilous proposition in its own right, kupo. Who might we know that would be up to the task...?
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_OHLDEEH_000_000: The madness in those eyes...that was not the Gullinbursti I know! That masked man is behind this somehow─I'm certain of it!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_002: <click> <click> Have you ever seen a dragon so angry, Master? I had not until now, and...I am scared.
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_MOGZIN_000_005: . I would beseech the aid of you and your deft-armed disciple, kupo. Pray pursue this masked marauder, and find out the truth behind the madness that has taken Gullinbursti!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_006: <click> <click> Now this is a task worthy of an adventurer! Mark my words, my moogle friend─Master and I will track down this mysterious and dangerous foe!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_MOGZIN_000_007: A thousand thank-yous, kupo! Might I suggest that you start by asking around here in Bahrr Lehs? Perhaps some of them have heard or seen something of the man we seek.
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_MOGZIN_000_008: As for myself and Ohl Deeh, we will see what we might learn about Gullinbursti's current whereabouts. Tarresson, might I trouble you to watch over the plaza while we are away?
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_TARRESSON_000_009: You would suggest that a greybeard like myself can offer naught else to your cause? Ohoho, but I jest. Rest assured that you will find not a single stone out of place on your return. Go in safety, friend Mogzin!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_010: At last, Master, a task worthy of our skills! Let us split up, see what we can learn about this masked villain. I shall question the moogles in this area. Would you be so kind as to speak to those gathered around the fountain? We can meet up here when our tasks are done. Share what we have learned.
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_015: Have you spoken to the moogles and knights around the fountain? As for me, my own investigation is still in progress. Let us meet up here when we have learned all there is to learn.
