TEXT_BANALL120_02383_TARRESSON_000_016: In my younger days, I would have been ill content to stay behind while my companions were out adventuring, but today? These old bones could use a respite, and between you and this deftarm, Mogzin and Ohl Deeh, I know that the matter is in capable hands.
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_MOG02383_000_020: D-Did I see a masked man, you ask? Did I ever, kupo! He strolled in brandishing that fearsome firearm of his and started picking off lesser dragons left and right! Th-Then when the coast was clear, he dashed off toward old Gullinbursti's place!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_MOG02383_000_021: Wh-Why didn't I follow him!? I prefer my pom attached to my head, thank you very much! If you're going after him, I'd encourage you to be very, very careful. I don't know what he's up to, but I can assure you it's no good, kupo!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_KOUHEI02383_000_022: A masked man? Sure, I saw him. Exchanged a few words with him, for that matter. He asked if I knew of any particularly ancient and formidable dragons in the area, so I directed him to Gullinbursti.
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_KOUHEI02383_000_023: Gullinbursti's been attacked, you say!? The Fury take me! I do hope that wasn't my fault...
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_MOG02383_000_025: I-If you do come across that masked man, ah, you didn't hear anything from me! S-Say it's a promise...pretty please, kupo?
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_KOUHEI02383_000_026: Everyone in these parts knows Gullinbursti. If I hadn't been the one to tell the masked man, he would have found out from one of my colleagues in due time. If anything, I saved them the trouble and anguish of being the one responsible. Surely you agree?
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_030: <click> <click> ...I see. So it would seem this masked marauder set his sights on Gullinbursti for his power and puissance. Interesting. Very interesting!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_031: From my own questionings, I have learned that our quarry has since been sighted in Sohm Al. It would seem he has already left the Churning Mists behind. We must give chase, yes, and return to the surface!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_032: On the way, I would pay a brief visit to Loth ast Vath. I would share this news with the storyteller, and see what wisdom he might share with us. And with that, let us see whose legs are faster─I shall race you there, Master!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_STORYTELLER_000_040: <click> <click> The deftarm? I have not seen him. Could it be that the Onemind once again calls out to him? But no. Even were it so, that one's mind has grown too strong. Still, I worry. Pray find him, that our minds may rest easy.
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_STORYTELLER_000_045: <click> <click> The deftarm will never again fall prey to the whispers of the Onemind. This I know, and believe without doubt. Still, I worry for his safety. Pray find him, adventurer.
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_DRYDOX_000_046:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Drydox was hunting for nanka eggs when walkybugs calling themselves “the Onemind” sneakystepped up from behind, started shooting their shootysticks. Deftarm came, saved Drydox from becoming holey-cheese.
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_050: <click> <click> Forgive me, Master. On my way to Loth ast Vath, I found Drydox here in distress, surrounded by the Onemind. I did only what any adventurer would do. What any adventurer must do!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_DRYDOX_000_051:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Drydox was hunting for nanka eggs when walkybugs calling themselves “the Onemind” sneakystepped up from behind, started shooting their shootysticks. Deftarm came, saved Drydox from becoming holey-cheese.
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_052: There was something...strange about these Onemind, Master. They were not the Onemind I know. The Onemind, you too have seen. They strike with perfect precision. But these ones...they set upon us with a savage and almost uncontrollable rage. Strange, very strange...
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_DRYDOX_000_053: Now that deftarm mentions it, Drydox heard sound before walkybugs attack. It went boom, but it was not the boom of walkybug shootysticks. No, it was much, much scarier. Drydox heard it from the forest as well...
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_054: Did you hear that, Master!? There can be no doubt of it─our quarry is up to something here as well! We must make for the forest! Yes, to Tailfeather!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_055: Worry not. I will tell the Storyteller that we are safe from harm. Please go visit Marcechamp and see if all is well. I will join you with all speed!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_DRYDOX_000_056: Deftarm looks as happy as Drydox does when she finds a trove of nanka eggs! Drydox is happy for Deftarm, but worries for his safety. Uplander will be careful too, yes?
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_STORYTELLER_000_058: <click> <click> Relieved I am to hear the deftarm is safe, but it would seem you pursue a far more menacing foe. Still, I trust that he will be safe with a great hunter like you at his side.
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_MARCECHAMP_000_060: Oho, look who's back. What brings you to Tailfeather, friend? That Deftarm got you on another wild chocobo chase, I reckon?
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_061: <pant> <pant> We chase something far more frightful than chocobos, Marcechamp!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_062: I come on behalf of the moogles of Moghome. I ask you: have you encountered a masked man brandishing a gun in this forest?
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_MARCECHAMP_000_063: 'Fraid I have indeed, as much as I'd like to say otherwise. See, the man's been makin' quite a name for himself in these parts─and it ain't a good one. Had the misfortune of runnin' into him myself not hours ago.
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_064: He came here, you say!? Where did he go!? You must tell me, Marcechamp! I must know!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_MARCECHAMP_000_065: Listen to me, Deftarm, and listen well. If you know what's good for you, you'll walk out of here the way you came, and forget anythin' and everythin' you ever heard or saw about that man.
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_MARCECHAMP_000_066: The man you're after is an adventurer, but not one o' the nice ones like your master here. Aye, he's nothin' short o' the most ruthless assassins our realm has ever seen─a cold-blooded killer who's never met a job too dirty or dangerous for his likin'. Nor one he has failed to carry out with lethal perfection.
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_067: An adventurer, you say!? Why, who better to pursue this man than Master and myself! Yes, this is our duty! Our calling!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_MARCECHAMP_000_068: Did you hear a single bloody word I─!? <sigh> Sometimes I don't even know why I bloody try...
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_069: Worry not, Marcechamp! Your words of warning have not fallen on deaf ears! But I am the deftarm, and I must do what needs be done! Is that not so, Master!?
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_MARCECHAMP_000_070: Heh. If you're itchin' to get your head blown off your shoulders, who am I to stop you? Your man was last seen headin' for the western highlands of Coerthas. Just don't come cryin' to me when the hunter becomes the hunted!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_071: <click> <click> Thank you, friend, and worry not! Between Master and myself, we will be more than a match for this masked menace!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_072: Mind you, Master, I do not wish to rely overmuch on your aid. I accepted this job from the moogles, and I intend to see it done with my own hand. That said, I would ask you to accompany me for...moral support. You understand, yes?
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_073: Excellent! And with that, let us be off to Coerthas! Perhaps our friend Jantellot will have some news for us upon our arrival. Yes, surely he will!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_MARCECHAMP_000_075: Just between you and me, ... This man's dangerous─no doubtin' that─but so long as you stick by the deftarm's side, I reckon the two o' you will come out of it with no more than a couple o' scratches. Just don't let your guard down, eh?
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_JANTELLOT_000_080: Ah, 'tis you. Forgive me, but a pressing matter requires my undivided attention at the moment. If you need something of me, pray return on the morrow.
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_081: <click> <click> Please listen, Jantellot! For a pressing matter requires our attention as well! Yes, very pressing!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_082: On behalf of the moogles of Moghome, we have come to Coerthas in pursuit of a certain adventurer. He wears a mask on his face and wields a pistol in his hand. Perhaps you have seen such a man?
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_JANTELLOT_000_083: Seen him, you say!? Aye, I caught a glimpse... I arrived just in time to see him nigh blast the head off one of my loyal men before commandeering our brand-new manacutter and flying off in it to the Fury knows where!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_JANTELLOT_000_084: You will forgive me if I am somewhat on edge. We scrimped and saved what little coin we could muster, and waited months on end until this vessel was available...only to see it spirited away from us the selfsame day! All while I could do nothing but look on like a helpless half-wit!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_JANTELLOT_000_085: At least I emerged from the episode unscathed, which is more than I can say for my subordinate. Serves him right, though. Maybe when his wounds heal he'll think twice before picking a fight with a hardened criminal in a caelumtree wine-induced stupor.
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_JANTELLOT_000_086: You heard me right─ridiculous mask or no, that man isn't one to be trifled with. I know not how well these moogles are paying you, but I highly doubt that the reward is worth your life.
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_087: <click> <click> This is not a matter of coin, but one of trust and duty! What is an adventurer worth if his word counts for nothing? Nothing, I say! Yes, the deftarm will see this job done! Now tell me, which way did the masked man go?
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_JANTELLOT_000_088: Bwahaha! You have spirit, I will give you that. Adventuring sounds to be a thankless job, but I wish you the best in it. Your man─and my manacutter─were last sighted heading for the Sea of Clouds. Do try to stay alive, won't you?
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_089: <click> <click> Thank you, friend, and worry not for me! The deftarm has the courage and conviction of a hundred of your men! We will see this merciless marauder brought to justice!
TEXT_BANALL120_02383_UDEKIKI_000_090: <click> <click> You don't suppose this masked man truly is as dangerous as our friends suggest, do you, Master? I cannot help but feel like they are underestimating our abilities. Anyhow, let us confer in private and form a plan of attack.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_JANTELLOT_000_000: Were it me, I'd want nothing to do with that man, but I suppose adventurers like yourself do not have the same luxury. I know that you are more than capable of holding your own on the field of battle─to say the least─but still...do be careful out there.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_005: <click> <click> What say you, Master? Reaching the Sea of Clouds is as simple as traveling northeast and hopping on the back of a kongamato, but wherever should we go from there? Is there anyone in that distant land that might aid us in our quest?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_006: The...Vanu Vanu? Of the island of Ok' Gundu...Nakki? These names and sounds are unfamiliar to me. To have won the trust and friendship of a tribe I have not so much as heard of, let alone seen! Once again I am beside myself with admiration, Master.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_007: As your devoted pupil, I am eager to earn their trust as well. To the Sea of Clouds, Master! I shall race you there!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVANU_000_009: returns to us as warm spring breeze after long winter. And you could not have come at a better time! For  we shall feast!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_010: <click> <click> Master! You must save me! I had just arrived on these shores when these monstrous bird creatures captured me! I think they mean to eat me!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVANU_000_011: You honor us with your return, . We will celebrate your arrival with a great feast. Look here! Funny wamouracampa stumbles into our trap like clumsy paissa falling into sinkhole.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVANU_000_012: A strange one it is, but surely tasty. Bring shell-cracker! Linu Vanu shall knead its meat into his specialty catsfoot chew!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVANU_000_013: Your pupil, you say!? Oh, forgive me, ! Linu Vanu owes you apologies as innumerable as the stars in the night sky! Release the netherling's bite-sized friend at once.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVANU_000_014: ...I see. Linu Vanu shares your struggle and your pain, and wishes he could be of aid, but such a person is not known to Linu Vanu or the Gundu. Deeply sorry is Linu Vanu.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVANU_000_015: It is with shame and heavy heart that Linu Vanu speaks of his own worries, but Linu Vanu fears for his sister. Linu Vali departs Ok' Gundu Nakki in search of ideas for new dance. Linu Vanu waits and waits, but she does not return. Linu Vanu fears storm clouds are brewing...
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_017: <click> <click> Master! If the masked man is behind this, this Linu Vali may be in grave danger! Very grave! We should go quickly, yes?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVANU_000_018: and apprentice are like shining sun to chase away the clouds of Linu Vanu's anxious heart. If Linu Vanu knows his sister, you are like to find her in Voor Sian Siran. Go in safety, my friends.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_019: <click> <click> Thank you for saving me, Master. I am unfamiliar with this “catsfoot chew,” but I would prefer not to be chewed up all the same. I must say, I find these Vanu Vanu somewhat intimidating. Anyhow, let us be off to Voor...whatever it was.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVANU_000_025: and apprentice are too kind to assist Linu Vanu in search for Linu Vali. Go in safety to Voor Sian Siran, and please tell your friend that he need not worry about being eaten...at least not by Linu Vanu.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_030: Oh, ! Your presence is ever like a gentle breeze on a summer's day. Whatever brings you back to the home of the Vanu Vanu?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_031: Oh, but if that isn't the most succulent-looking wamouracampa Linu Vali has ever seen!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_032: H-How many times must I say it!? I am not a wamoura-anything, and I am most certainly not to be eaten! I am the Vath deftarm, and I am an adventurer! Please tell her, Master!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_033: A thousand pardons, friend Deftarm! Linu Vali's nose was deceived by your most inviting aroma. Do not worry, you are safe with Linu Vali. That said, I fear I have seen and heard nothing of this masked man of whom you speak.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_034: Linu Vali did not mean to cause Brother to worry. Linu Vali simply came here to practice her new dance. Linu Vali would show it to you, but she fears that there is not much yet to be worthy of showing...
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_035: ...But of course! Surely you have encountered a new dance in your travels, ? A dance unlike any seen by Gundu or your kind? If you know such a dance, pray show it to Linu Vali, that it might be as a lightning bolt of inspiration!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_038: Surely you have encountered a new dance in your travels, ? A dance unlike any seen by Gundu or your kind? If you know such a dance, pray show it to Linu Vali, that it might be as a lightning bolt of inspiration!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_039: <click> <click> Dancing? I do not mean to doubt you, Master, but surely there are more important matters that demand our attention.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_040: No...no, those motions do not move Linu Vali. Surely you have seen a more...exotic dance? One the likes of which no Gundu has ever seen?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_041: Yes...yes! Vigor and vitality wells up from within Linu Vali like a fount gushing skyward from the earth! This is the bolt of inspiration I have so long sought! With this, Linu Vali will create a dance that will go down in Gundu history!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_042: <click> <click> What is it with this dancing!? And you, Master! Forget these overgrown birds─I would have thought you of all people would understand the seriousness of our task! We are never going to find that masked man bouncing around like fools!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_043: A thousand pardons, friend. Neither  nor Linu Vali meant to offend. We sympathize with your plight, but pray understand: to we Vanu, dance is not foolishness, oh no! It is an act as sacred as life and death. If it does not help you in your quest, Linu Vali is sorry, and yet...
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_044: <click> <click> Shhh! Master, over there! I cannot believe I am saying this, but if my eyes see true, that is...!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_045:
<click> <click> I knew it! It's him!
You there! Who are you, and what have you done to Gullinbursti!?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384__NHAZAAJAAB_000_046: (-Menacing Miqo'te-)Hmph... Can a man not enjoy a bath in peace?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384__NHAZAAJAAB_000_047: (-Menacing Miqo'te-)Then again, I know better than to expect common courtesy from beastman brutes. Even those who are wont to travel with more...civilized types.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_NHAZAAJAAB_000_048: An adventurer, are we? One would think you'd have learned to keep better company. And to keep a wide berth of Nhaza'a Jaab, the Ebon Claw. But you'll learn soon enough, won't you? Oh yes, you will...
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_NHAZAAJAAB_000_049: Well, well! Now there's a face I never thought I'd see again. Though I suppose you would say the same of Nhaza'a Jaab...wouldn't you, old friend? Mayhap you've come to thrill and delight me? For old times' sake?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_050: I asked you a question, vile rogue! What did you do to the dragon Gullinbursti!? You will give me an answer, or...or I, the deftarm, will beat one out of you!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_NHAZAAJAAB_000_051: Heh heh heh...a brute and a beast you may be, but you have spirit. If you did not repulse me so, I might almost like you. Here is your answer: I did my job...and nothing more.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_NHAZAAJAAB_000_052: A simple task: to scour the Churning Mists for a mighty dragon, and pierce his scales with a single bullet. A bullet that would warp his mind and twist his heart, destroying any semblance of the noble creature he once was, until all that remained was a brute consumed with pure, animal rage. A beautiful thing, is it not?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_053: Wh-What...what madness is this!? The hearts of others are not yours to control!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_NHAZAAJAAB_000_054: Curious words coming from one of your kind. Go back to your hive, Gnath. You were never meant to possess a mind of your own.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_055: <click> <click> Y-You know nothing of me! I am the Vath deftarm─an adventurer just like the master who trained me! I have tracked you, I have found you, and I will see you answer for your deeds!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_NHAZAAJAAB_000_056: Hmmmmmm? Hah...hah...bwahahahahahahahahaha! Oh, but my ears must be playing tricks on me! For a moment there, I thought I heard the witless antling say he was an adventurer!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_057: S-Silence! I am more of an adventurer than you will ever be! Now answer me! What master do you serve, and what does he mean to do with Gullinbursti!?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_NHAZAAJAAB_000_058: I “serve” some imperial lackwit whose name I could not be bothered to remember. A fool's coin is worth as much as any man's, you see, and they tend to part with it more easily than most. Now, would you mind lowering your weapon? As you can see, I am unarmed...though I suppose I should know better than to expect decency from an animal.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_NHAZAAJAAB_000_060: ...All too easy. Didn't your master teach you not to trust me?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_061: <click> <click> You...you do not fight with honor!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_NHAZAAJAAB_000_062: You're a quick learner...though not quick enough, I'm afraid. Now, we know what this can do to a dragon... I wonder what it might do to a Gnath?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_NHAZAAJAAB_000_063: Or a Vanu Vanu, or even... Oh, yes...!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_064: N-No! Leave my friends alone, or I...I will rend the flesh from your bones!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_NHAZAAJAAB_000_065: Ahahahahaha! Yes, yesss! Let me taste your fear and your hatred! Your rage and despair! Despise me! Abhor me! Delight me!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_ZOUHYOUVANU02384_00: (-Gundu Warrior-)Who goes there!? Who dares intrude on Gundu lands!?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_NHAZAAJAAB_000_068: ...And just when I was starting to get in the mood. But perhaps we might enjoy ourselves another way...?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_ZOUHYOUVANU02384_00: (-Gundu Warrior-)M-My...my head... M-My body... My arms...they...ngggaaaAAAHHHHHH!!!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_NHAZAAJAAB_000_070: Oh dear...it seems your friends aren't so friendly anymore. Well, do have fun killing each other. There's somewhere I must be.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_071: Quickly, ! Join Linu Vali, and together we will dance them away!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_072: The sundrop dance does not reach them! Linu Vali knows not if she is ready, but there is no other way. Watch, ! Watch and move with Linu Vali!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_ZOUHYOUVANU02384_00: (-Gundu Warrior-)Wh-What...what madness has taken us!? F-Forgive us, Linu Vali! We meant no harm!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_075: Linu Vali knew she could count on . Even without practice, 's motions match Linu Vali in perfect harmony, like we are  from the same nest.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_076: and Linu Vali─netherling and Gundu─dance as one. Different beings we are, but together we lift each other to new heights, and shine radiant light through the darkness. In honor of this, Linu Vali would name her new dance moonlift dance. A fine name, would you agree?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_077: <click> <click> I mocked you, but your dance has proved stronger than I could ever be. When confronted with my greatest challenge yet, it is I who made a mockery of myself...
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_080: Thanks to you, , moonlift dance is now complete, and is a shining success. When the storm has passed, we will hold a great celebration at Ok' Gundu Nakki, and together we will dance.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_090: <click> <click> F-Forgive me, Master... For all you have taught me, I could do nothing against our foe. And he has eluded us again. Whatever shall we do?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_091: Do not lose heart, friend. For now, let us return to Ok' Gundu Nakki. Brother is surely worried for us, and Linu Vali would put his heart at ease.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_095: Linu Vali told Brother all about our encounter with the masked man, and how Linu Vali and  chased the threat away. Brother is eager to see our moonlift dance with his own eyes.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVANU_000_096: A thousand thank-yous, . Not only have you rescued Linu Vali from grave danger, you have joined in the creation of a dance that will go down in Gundu history. Your presence is like an ever-steady sunbeam shining through the trees to warm our feathers.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_100: <click> <click> Wherever shall we go now, Master? Shall we go after that masked man? Perhaps we might begin by tracking down the master he serves...
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_101: Or perhaps we should return to Moghome, and share what we have learned with Master Mogzin? Doubtless he is eager to know...
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_103: Well, look what we have here! A cuddly little gaelicat and a fledgling chick! Have you wandered from your nest to join Linu Vali and her friends in dancing our new dance?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_MOGZIN_000_104: Cat!? Who are you calling a cat!? I am Master Mogzin of the Mogmenders, the renowned guild of craftsmoogles that repaired the ancient plaza of Bahrr Lehs. Perhaps you have heard of us, kupo?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_OHLDEEH_000_105: And I am no fledgling! Do you not see these resplendent scales? I am Ohl Deeh, a mighty and powerful dragon! Cower in my wake!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_OHLDEEH_000_106: And just what are you supposed to be? Why, I have never seen such a portly, pudgy bird in my life!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_107: You do me too great an honor with your words, friend. My cheeks turn as red as a fiery sunset. I am Linu Vali of the Gundu, and I bid you welcome to Ok' Gundu Nakki.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_108: <click> <click> I do not think he meant that as a...never mind. Master Mogzin, Ohl Deeh─what brings you to this place?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_MOGZIN_000_109: We traveled far and wide, over mountains and across the skies, in pursuit of Gullinbursti! Our journey took us here, but just when we thought we had him, he evaded our paws, kupo!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_OHLDEEH_000_110: We may have lost him, but we have now found you! I daresay today is not a total loss.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_MOGZIN_000_111: Speaking of which, how did you and your pupil fare in your search for the masked man? Were you able to learn the truth of what he did to Gullinbursti?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_MOGZIN_000_112: A weapon that can twist and warp the hearts of dragons and beasts!? What a positively frightful proposition! The mere thought of it makes the fur on my back stand on end, kupo!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_MOGZIN_000_113: We did catch up with Gullinbursti, but he was even less receptive to our words than before. He only let out a mighty roar, then soared off to the northeastern skies in a rage. It was almost as if something were calling him there. As much as it pains me to say it, I fear he may be gone for good, kupo.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_OHLDEEH_000_114: P-Preposterous! Gullinbursti was as kind and noble a dragon as I have ever known! Surely there is a way to reach him and restore him to his senses!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_115: <click> <click> I must agree with Ohl Deeh. I saw it with my own eyes, I did. When Master and Linu Vali danced together, the rage of the mad Gundu was quick to subside.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_116: Yes, Linu Vali swears this is true. As dance can reach the heart of us Vanu Vanu, surely there is a way to call out to your dragon friend, too!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_117: <click> <click> That's right! I know not yet what it might be, but we must try! Gullinbursti has clearly been summoned to some strange land by that masked man's vile master. We must set out to the northeast, and hurry to his side!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_118: ...Wait, friend. You do know what lies northeast of here, yes? It is Azys Lla, the land of nightmares where all Vanu are forbidden to tread.
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_LINUVALI_000_119: It is with great shame that Linu Vali says she can accompany you no further. And after all  has done for Linu Vali...
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_120: Think nothing of it. Nothing at all! This was a task for Master and I from the beginning, and Master and I will see it done. Is that not right, Master?
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_MOGZIN_000_121: Such powerful words, kupo! I have the utmost confidence in you. A-And with that...I do believe I'll be heading back to Moghome. My hammer is made for crafting, not fighting, after all...
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_122: <click> <click> You are going home!? What foolishness is this!? You care for your friend Gullinbursti, do you not!? Surely there is some way you could be of service without fighting! Any way at all!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_OHLDEEH_000_123: That's right, Mogzin! I thought you were a friend to dragons! To Gullinbursti, and to me!
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_MOGZIN_000_124: I...I am sorry. But you will be better off without me. You must...believe me, kupo...
TEXT_BANALL130_02384_UDEKIKI_000_125: Does that moogle have no shame!? It would seem I was right about him after all! He is a lazy do-nothing! A slacker, and nothing more!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_000: Say it is not so! I thought Mogzin was a friend to dragons. To Gullinbursti, and to me...
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_LINUVANU_000_002: Would that Linu Vanu accompany you in your quest, . But Azys Lla is no place for us to tread. Vanu tradition leaves no room for doubt, and tradition must be obeyed.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_UDEKIKI_000_005: <click> <click> I know not what awaits us in this strange land, nor if we are up to the task, but as adventurers, we must press on with courage. Yes, great courage!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_UDEKIKI_000_006: Do you fancy your wings faster than my kongamato, Ohl Deeh? I suppose we shall see! The last one to Azys Lla is a rotten nanka egg!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_007: Hah! You think that overgrown gnat of yours is any match for the wings of a mighty dragon!? Prepare to taste the sting of humiliation!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_100_008: The mighty Ohl Deeh bested by a glorified insect!? Inconceivable! Mark my words: in a hundred years, I will have my revenge!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_UDEKIKI_000_010: <click> <click> An island made of metal and machinery? It is strange to me, Master. Very strange. However are we to find Gullinbursti in such curious and forbidding environs?
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_011: Worry not, my fearful, faint-hearted friend! This land may be unfamiliar to you, but not to me and my kind! Yes, I can feel the presence of mighty dragons all around us!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_012: We need only stop one and ask politely if they have seen aught of Gullinbursti. Surely they would not be averse to lending a fellow dragon their wisdom. You are fortunate indeed that I have accompanied you here, are you not? Yes, I daresay you are!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_UDEKIKI_000_015: <click> <click> The dragons in these parts are unobliging. Very unobliging. Perhaps it would be best if I remained silent and left the asking to Ohl Deeh.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_020: What is the meaning of this!? My fellow dragons turn upon us one after the next without listening to a word I have to say!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_021: It is as if they've all been driven mad like poor Gullinbursti! Is there no dragon in this land who will listen to reason?
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_022: But of course! Tiamat! Why did I not think of this myself!? Yes, yes, I understand about her torment and all, but I am sure she'll not be averse to helping a future mighty dragon such as myself! Let us be off!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_TIAMAT_000_030: (-Tiamat-)Ah, the child who doth walk with my father. What bringeth thee and thine back to my forsaken abode?
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_TIAMAT_000_031: (-Tiamat-)...I see thou dost travel with a child of mine own. Speak, child. What dost thou seek, to visit me in my lair of desolation and woe?
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_032: O, great mother of dragons! Many a tale of your suffering and sacrifice have I heard from my friend  here!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_033: I understand your agony and woe─truly, I do─and I will let you return to your torment, but my friends and I were just wondering... Might a dragon by the name of Gullinbursti come this way? He's a friend of ours, you see. Quite large, and red, and─
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_TIAMAT_000_034: (-Tiamat-)The name is not known to me, but yes, child. I have seen thy friend. A sorrowful sight he was─tearing through the skies, racked with wroth, as if his mind were no longer his own.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_TIAMAT_000_035: (-Tiamat-)He is not the first, and I fear he will not be the last. For it would seem there is one in these lands who wields an ancient power...one that can bring even mighty wyrms to heel.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_036: C-Curse it all! Is there nothing we can do!? Is Gullinbursti already lost to us!?
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_TIAMAT_000_037: (-Tiamat-)Abandon not hope, my child. The mind of a dragon is not so feeble as that. There is yet a way to bring your friend back. This, I can assure you.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_038: But how!? We have tried everything, and to no avail! What else is there we can do!?
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_TIAMAT_000_039: (-Tiamat-)'Tis simple, child. Thou needest but call out to him with a roar summoned from the very depths of thine heart. That─and that alone─will stir your friend's heart, and return him to what he once was.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_040:
But I...!
No, wait...I see. When we last saw Gullinbursti, I called out to him with words. But mere words could not reach him...
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_TIAMAT_000_041: (-Tiamat-)Thou dost see true. Now, tarry not in this den of woe, but fly swiftly to the floating island that lies northeast of here, and to thy friend's side. Free him from his misery...and leave me to mine own.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_042: I shall do my best! Thank you, Mother Tiamat! And please try not to suffer too much, won't you!?
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_UDEKIKI_000_043: <click> <click> I cannot help but feel like we could have shown a bit more compassion to that poor dragon, but I suppose we had little choice. Yes, little choice. In any event, we know our destination now, so let us be off.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_TIAMAT_000_044: (-Tiamat-)I am reminded of days long past, when mine own were yet young... Go forth, child of man, that this young one might be spared a similar fate...
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_045: Look, I've found him! He may look angry, but just wait until he hears my roar! He'll be the Gullinbursti we know and love in no time. I am certain of it!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_UDEKIKI_000_050: <click> <click> It's Gullinbursti! And he's not alone... Come, Master, let us make that villain pay!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_DRUSUSMARESORANUS_0: (-Overbearing Imperial-)Ahahaha! That's Allagan technology for you! One clean shot, and even a mighty dragon can be brought to heel! Now I need only fit this neurolink about his neck, and he will be my loyal dog, ever at my beck and call!
Then the fools at the Academy will know! They will gasp in awe, then hang their heads in shame and chagrin! Until they die, they will rue the day they underestimated Drusus mal Soranus!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_053: Gullinbursti! Can you hear me!? It is I, your proud pupil Ohl Deeh!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_UDEKIKI_000_054: You villains! What have you done to Gullinbursti!?
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_NHAZAAJAAB_000_055: Followed us here, have you? That's almost...impressive. As for your friend, he's simply taking a little nap. Fortunately for you, I might add...
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_DRUSUSMARESORANUS_0: Wh-Who are these intruders!? Did you lead them here!? N-Never mind! I'll double─no, triple─your pay! Exterminate them at once!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_NHAZAAJAAB_000_057: Thank you for the offer, but...I think I'll decline. Why, you've already given me something of far greater value. This toy, for one...and some most amusing playmates.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_NHAZAAJAAB_000_058: What say you, beastman adventurer!? Will you face off against your dragon friend in a battle to the death? Feel your wounds, taste your tears, and fight until your puny body can give no more!? Oh, nothing would delight me more!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_DRUSUSMARESORANUS_0: Wh-What do you think you're doing? Hand over my bracelet! Without it, I... I...!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_060: Stop this madness, Gullinbursti! I beg of you!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_UDEKIKI_000_061: Stay your hand, Master! There is still good in him! Through the anger and rage, I know his mind is fighting to break free!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_062: Gullinbursti! Please, you must listen to me!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_MOGZIN_000_063: (-???-)I say, Gullinbursti! Stop this at once, kupo!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_066: Gullinbursti! Thank the heavens... And it was I─it was my roar that brought him back? And yet M-Mogzin... Say it is not so...!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_COLORDRAGON_000_067: You... You are the one who did this to me...
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_NHAZAAJAAB_000_068: ...Heh. And I'm just as happy to do it again.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_UDEKIKI_000_069: <click> <click> Not if we have anything to say about it! Right, my friends!?
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_MOGZIN_000_071: Once again, my marvelous mannequin comes to the rescue! Though I must say, I was hoping to make a more dramatic entrance, kupo.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_UDEKIKI_000_072: <click> <click> I, for one, thought it most impressive. Very impressive! Thank you, friend Mogzin, for coming to our aid.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_073: Another mockery!? And here I was about to shed a tear for you! You owe me an apology, I say!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_LINUVANU_000_074: Forgive me, my friends. I did much thinking, and while the importance of tradition cannot be ignored, I could not very well send my truest friends into the eye of the storm alone.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_LINUVALI_000_075: You have ever been a rainbow of hope and succor to us, friends. It seemed only fair that we returned the favor in kind.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_NHAZAAJAAB_000_076: For a gaggle of brutes, you have been a most entertaining diversion. Enjoy your victory, short-lived as it may be! For I shall return, and you can be sure I will not forget this day...!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_UDEKIKI_000_077: <click> <click> ...Not so fast. I do not call myself the deftarm for nothing!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_MOGZIN_000_080: To tell the truth, I followed you all the way here, concealing myself with magicks as we moogles are wont to do. You see, kupo, I realized the only way I could help was with my pranks. And to deceive our foe, I first had to deceive you. You will forgive me...yes?
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_UDEKIKI_000_081: <click> <click> Without your pranks, we would not have triumphed today. I am sorry, very sorry, for ever suggesting it was any less than a remarkable art.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_MOGZIN_000_082: Oh, thank you, kupo! And the way you shot down that airship! Pray forgive me for asking an adventurer of your skill to haul rocks and crack kupo nuts!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_083: Well, now! If we're all going to sit around heaping praise on one another...do not forget that it was none other than I who brought Gullinbursti back to us! Mogzin, you saw my most triumphant and mighty roar, did you not!?
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_MOGZIN_000_084: Roar? After Gullinbursti roasted my mannequin, I was so frightened that I averted my eyes and plugged my ears for the rest of the battle. Did I miss something, kupo?
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_085: Did you miss something!? I've half a mind to roar you into oblivion, you noodle-brained moogle!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_COLORDRAGON_000_086: I owe you all a debt of gratitude this day. Many years have I lived, but never have I seen so many and multivarious beings come together for a common cause. It inspires me to strive for the same.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_COLORDRAGON_000_087: And you, Ohl Deeh. 'Twould seem it was your roar that freed me from my madness. You have grown strong, and in so short a span. Impressive, indeed.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_088: Just you watch! In another three hundred years, I'll be bigger and stronger than you will ever be!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_COLORDRAGON_000_089: And I will welcome that day, young one. Now, let us bid farewell to this accursed land and return home.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_OHLDEEH_000_090: Fear not if you don't remember the way, Gullinbursti. Just stay close by my side─I'll see you home safely!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_UDEKIKI_000_091: <click> <click> Shall we return as well, Master?
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_LINUVALI_000_092: My friends! If you are not in a great hurry, pray stop over in Ok' Gundu Nakki on your way!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_LINUVALI_000_093: The feast we had planned is long overdue, and I daresay that now, there is all the more reason to celebrate! Let us dance until the , and back again!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_UDEKIKI_000_095: <click> <click> I have heard, Master. They say that this village, too, was born as a result of your efforts? If you would not mind telling it, I would very much like to hear that story one day. Very much indeed.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_MOGZIN_000_096: They say that there is a settlement of moogles in the Sea of Clouds. I'm afraid of journeying too far on my own, but...perhaps next time, we might go there together, kupo?
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_LINUVALI_100_097: ! Linu Vali rejoices to see you come! For  we dance until we can dance no more!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_LINUVALI_000_100: All of Ok' Gundu Nakki waits in eager anticipation to see our moonlift dance. If  is ready, Linu Vali is ready as well. Let the festivities begin!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_LINUVALI_000_101: Come now, my friends! Let us dance this dance together, that we might build a double rainbow to span the skies!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_MOGZIN_000_102: Leave it to me! We moogles know a thing or two about dancing! Come to think of it, this dance seems somehow...familiar, kupo?
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_UDEKIKI_000_103: <click> <click> Wh-What!? I fear these legs are not made for dancing. Clumsy, they are. Very c-clumsy...
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_LINUVALI_000_104: That was a feast and a dance for the ages, my friends! And never would this day have come if it were not for  and the bonds  has forged among us all. May they ever hold strong!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_MOGZIN_000_105: But of course, kupo! Let us dance together, Linu Vali, and make mirth and merry for many years to come! And we are happy as well to share the art of pranks and artifice with the Vath, who understand us oh-so-well!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_UDEKIKI_000_106: <click> <click> Just you watch! Next time, I will devise a trick so devious that it will make the pom on your head spin! They can spin, yes?
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_UDEKIKI_000_107: Master, it was an honor and a pleasure to adventure with you once more. I thought I knew the world, but I see now that it is wider and vaster than I ever imagined. Still, I feel I have seen and grown much through this journey...
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_UDEKIKI_000_108: You will always be my master, but I feel as if─little by little─I am becoming your peer. Forgive me for being forward, but might I call you... from time to time?
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_UDEKIKI_000_109: .... A most impressive name, indeed! Clearly you were always destined for great things. Yes, very great. I am honored to call myself your pupil. Until our next adventure!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_SYSTEM_000_200: You have achieved Allied reputation with the Gundu, the Vath, and the Mogmenders.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_SYSTEM_000_201: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from Luna Vanu, the Vath stickpeddler, and Mogmul Mogbelly.
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_SYSTEM_100_201: You have learned the emote Moonlift Dance!
TEXT_BANALL140_02385_SYSTEM_000_202: Through your efforts, your allies of all shapes and sizes across Ishgard have forged bonds of friendship that promise to remain strong through the years. You are truly a hero to societies across the realm!
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_FATHER02973_000_000: Where's that blasted boat? It should've been here by now...
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_FATHER02973_000_001: Oh! Sorry, didn't see you there. My daughter is late returning from Kugane, you see, and I thought to come and look for her.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_FATHER02973_000_002: I can't imagine the Confederacy giving her any trouble; she's always been good about putting money aside for the Ruby Tithe... Oh gods! What if the Red Kojin caught sight of her?
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_FATHER02973_000_003: My dear, sweet Shihoumi. She only meant to bring home a bit of old furnishings to give comfort to our village. I don't know what I'd do if anything should happen to her.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_FATHER02973_000_004: I know this is sudden, but...you've the look of a  who can handle a bit of danger. Would you be willing to look for my daughter? She should be traveling close to the shore of Sakazuki.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_FATHER02973_000_009: Oh, Shihoumi... I pray you are safe.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_KABUTO_000_009: Stay back, or taste my steel!
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_A1_000_001: I was sent here by a fisherman from Isari.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_A1_000_002: I've come from Isari in search of Shihoumi.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SHIHOUMI_000_012: A fisherman from Isari? By any chance did he send you in search of his daughter? If so, I suppose it is me you are searching for. My name is Shihoumi.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SHIHOUMI_000_013: From Isari, you say? Was it my father who sent you for me?
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SHIHOUMI_000_014: My ship was attacked by the Red Kojin, but I was saved by this warrior of the Blue. Would that we could have saved the cargo on board.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SHIHOUMI_000_016: Wait! Your kindness is greatly appreciated, but you cannot mean to go against the Red Kojin. Not alone.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SHIHOUMI_000_017: Please, , you have to go after him!
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SHIHOUMI_000_018: He was gravely injured in my rescue. 'Twould be suicide for him to face them in his condition!
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SHIHOUMI_000_019: We barely escaped the Red Kojin with our lives. He has no chance against them with those injuries.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_BALLOON_000_028: These treasures belong to the Red!
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_KABUTO_000_030: How could I fall for such an obvious trap...
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SON02973_000_032: Oh, thank goodness you're both all right!
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SHIHOUMI_000_034: I...I'm sorry. You both were gone for so long I began to worry, and...
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_KABUTO_000_035: Do not misunderstand. I am not angry. I meant only to say this place is dangerous.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_KABUTO_000_036: But the Red are gone now, and your cargo is safe. Everything is there, yes?
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SHIHOUMI_000_037: One...two... Yes, yes, this seems to be all of it.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SHIHOUMI_100_037: The others will be so happy when they see these goods. Thank you so much!
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_KABUTO_000_038: Then my work here is finished.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SHIHOUMI_000_039: Wait, please. Would you at least tell me the name of the gallant Kojin who rescued me?
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_KABUTO_000_042: (-Kabuto-)You, brave warrior. What is the name of the  who rescued me?
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SHIHOUMI_000_044: I haven't much, but please, let me repay you both for your kindness.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_KABUTO_000_045: (-Kabuto-) saved my life. For another to repay my debt of gratitude would be a stain on my honor.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SHIHOUMI_000_046: I...I see... Then at the very least, let me give you something. Most of these goods are worn or broken, but if anything here is to your liking, by all means.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SHIHOUMI_000_048: Repairing them is part of my training as a craftsman. Thankfully the merchants of Kugane are willing to part with such wares for relatively little. Still, I hope there is something here that pleases you.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SHIHOUMI_000_050: Ah, that is a karakuri puppet. Would that I knew who made it or how. Fixing it was quite the challenge. Still, the children back home will love─
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SHIHOUMI_000_052: Oh. That is a...fine choice. Yes, a fine choice indeed. Far be it from me to deny the Kojin who saved me his reward.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_KABUTO_000_053: (-Kabuto-). Meet with me at the entrance to Tamamizu. There, I will present you with a token of my thanks.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SHIHOUMI_000_054: A peculiar one, isn't he? Certainly not the best with words, but his heart is pure and sword true.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SHIHOUMI_000_055: Thank you again for your help. Delivering these home should be easy enough on my own. Take care, and safe travels.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_BUNCHIN_000_059: There you are! You disobeyed me to go and search for treasures again, didn't you?
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_BUNCHIN_000_061: What's this? Ah, . A welcome surprise. I hope Kabuto has not given you too much trouble.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_KABUTO_000_062: saved my life, and so I wished to present  a token of my gratitude. I did not realize you were acquainted. Perhaps I should take my leave...
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_BUNCHIN_000_063: Wait, Kabuto! Where are you going? What of your gift to ?
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_KABUTO_000_064: So you did not come to speak with ?
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_BUNCHIN_000_065: I was not even aware  was here!
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_BUNCHIN_000_066: I came here searching for you. How many times must I tell you not to go searching for treasure on your own? The Red are running amok in the Ruby Sea, you know this.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_KABUTO_000_067: Yes, I went alone, and yes, I was saved by , but I believe it was fate. It brought us together and rewarded me with a karakuri puppet.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_BUNCHIN_000_068: I will not deny you are a gifted fighter, but it would be foolish to mistake today's happenstance for good fortune. Though I suppose you have done worse in more favorable situations.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_KABUTO_000_069: Before we continue, I wish to add today's find to the treasure vault.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_BUNCHIN_000_070: You seem puzzled, . Ah! You must think he means to travel to the Isle of Zekki. Allow me to explain.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_BUNCHIN_000_071: As you are well aware, the Isle of Zekki has been home to the most prized relics of both the Red and the Blue since time immemorial.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_BUNCHIN_000_072: Though the Red guard it fiercely, they can no longer subsist on the plunder of the imperials. Now they demand that we join in their work as mercenaries and raiders. Naturally we refused, and so they deny us entry to the vault.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_BUNCHIN_000_073: Rather than take up arms against our brothers, we have taken it upon ourselves to create a new treasure vault, here in Tamamizu.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_BUNCHIN_000_074: To that end we have devoted a great deal of effort to searching far and wide for treasures with which to fill our vault. If certain individuals would learn not to wander off on their own, I could take comfort in knowing said efforts are not wasted.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_KABUTO_000_075: The others would only slow me down...
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_BUNCHIN_000_076: You will have to forgive Kabuto─he is as stubborn as his shell is thick. But you are not here to listen to our quarrels. Come, let us make our way to the treasure vault.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_MAKURA_000_080: Kabuto, you've returned! What wondrous treasure have you brought us today?
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SHIKITAHE_000_081: You can't possibly expect to fill the vault on your own. Such a task is much too great, even for you. Let us help, brother.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_BUNCHIN_000_083: Oh my! You never mentioned the puppet was a Kojin. Such detail, such craftsmanship. The kami will surely be pleased with a treasure so fine.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_TSUKUMO_000_086: (-???-)No one walks alone, Kabuto. To turn your back on your brothers and sisters would be folly of the greatest order.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_BUNCHIN_000_087: A tsukumogami!? Oh great, divine spirit, we are humbled by your presence.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_TSUKUMO_000_088: (-???-)Raise your heads and be proud! You have done well to gather such a glorious bounty.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_TSUKUMO_000_089: (-???-)But the task before you is too great for a single Kojin. Kabuto, you must lead your brothers and sisters. Lead them to ever greater treasures and prosperity!
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_KABUTO_000_091: I am honored. Truly, I am. I swear on my honor our vault will overflow with riches, but I need no help to─
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_TSUKUMO_000_092: (-???-)Silence! You will form a company of treasure seekers, starting with .
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_KABUTO_000_094: Please, divine one. There is no need to burden  with─
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_TSUKUMO_000_095: (-???-)Such insolence! You call yourself a warrior, but your prowess pales before the might of .
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_TSUKUMO_000_096: (-???-)Was it not you who said it was fate that brought you together?
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_TSUKUMO_000_098: (-???-)You must accept that to which fate has bound you, Kabuto, and do so with all your heart.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_TSUKUMO_000_099: (-???-)Henceforth, you and yours will be known as the Divine Circle. Who else shall join you in this endeavor?
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_KABUTO_000_100: Well, there is Zukin, Makura, and Shikitahe. I mean, that is... If it isn't an inconvenience...
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_TSUKUMO_000_101: (-???-)Where is your backbone, Kabuto? The duty placed upon you is both sudden and daunting, so your uncertainty shall be forgiven─but only this once.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_TSUKUMO_000_102: Furthermore, until you prove your resolve to be unbending and your mind focused, I, Tsukumo, will oversee your operations personally!
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_TSUKUMO_000_103: And with that, our team is assembled. Let us set forth and seek out the untold riches of the realm that even the Red Kojin will burn with envy!
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SYSTEM_000_200: The Blue Kojin have begun making contributions to the treasure vault in Tamamizu.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SYSTEM_000_201: You have achieved Friendly reputation with the Kojin.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SYSTEM_000_202: Kojin society quests are now available from Zukin at Tamamizu.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SYSTEM_000_203: Furthermore, you may now purchase wares from Shikitahe.
TEXT_BANKJN001_02973_SYSTEM_000_204: In order to undertake the next allied society main quest, you must first complete the main scenario quest “A Silence in Three Parts.”
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_SYSTEM_000_000: In order to undertake this quest, you must first complete the main scenario quest “A Silence in Three Parts.”
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_KABUTO_000_001: Good. You are here. We are preparing to embark on a search for treasure.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_003: I was certain he would follow through, but alas. He wishes to invite you on our expedition, but perhaps we should begin by explaining where we are going, and why.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_004: Shikitahe's pirate associates in Yanxia have informed him of a treasure that may prove suitable for our vault.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_005: If what we have been told is true, the owner of said treasure can be found somewhere near Namai. Our mission is to befriend this individual and see if there is aught we can do to trade for this oddity, whatever it may be. Now, let us be off!
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_009: There you are. While waiting for you to arrive we took it upon ourselves to question the villagers. This gentleman was about to tell us more about the treasure we seek.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_VILLAGERS02974_000_: This Kojin here tells me you are here looking for artifacts of great worth. Forgive me if I misunderstand, but what could be more valuable than a talking doll?
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_KABUTO_000_010: This villager claims to have knowledge of what we seek.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_VILLAGERS02974_000_: I can only tell you what I have heard. Whether or not there is truth to it, you must decide for yourselves.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_012: If I may ask, what exactly is this treasure?
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_VILLAGERS02974_000_: Gahhh! Ahem. Forgive me. I had forgotten it can speak. I do not mean to question your decision to come here, but I sincerely doubt any treasure you find will compare to this doll.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_014: That may well be true, but our aim is to create a collection. To that end we came here following the rumors of a treasure here in Namai.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_VILLAGERS02974_000_: No doubt a burdensome quest if every piece must be a curiosity such as you. Sadly, I cannot say what this treasure is. Only that its owner is of the Namazu.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_016: How can you be certain what they possess is of any worth?
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_VILLAGERS02974_000_: He has been seen carrying something about the Glittering Basin with the greatest of care─but only briefly. Upon realizing he is not alone, he leaves with all haste.
He speaks with no one, and so we are left to wonder what it is he guards so dearly. If you mean to approach him, it will not be easy.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_019: How are we to strike a deal with such a seemingly skittish character?
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_A1_000_001: We must find something the Namazu is willing to trade for.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_A1_000_002: We must find a way to trap the Namazu.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_020: That he might stay and consider an exchange instead of running away... Yes, an excellent idea.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_021: Hmmm. I suppose that may work. A way to hold him still long enough to explain we mean no harm.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_KABUTO_000_022: Then let us begin our search.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_023: Not so fast, my friend. Even if he were to appear before us here and now, we have naught with which to barter. Our time would be better spent learning about this Namazu.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_KABUTO_000_024: We have already inconvenienced  greatly. We must not keep  away from  other duties.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_025: Sympathy for a comrade? Well, I suppose it would be prudent to know where the Namazu can be found when we are ready to bargain. Very well. Let us find an ideal location to better survey the area.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_029: Kabuto is surveying to the north. Would you take a look to the south and tell us if you see anything?
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_KABUTO_000_029: Still no sign of the Namazu.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_SYSTEM_000_030: Search your surroundings for the Namazu. You may move the camera as well as zoom in and out. Target the Namazu and inspect him with .
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_031: But where is he headed? We must find a better vantage point.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_039: That Namazu is definitely up to something. But what?
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_SYSTEM_000_039: Search your surroundings once more for the Namazu. You may move the camera as well as zoom in and out. Target the Namazu and inspect him by pressing .
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_101_039: This must be where he buried the treasure! At last we can see what it is he guards so dearly.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_040: Ah, so it is a vase we are after.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_041: The only question remaining now is why must he act in secret? The answer may be our key to approaching him.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_042: The Red Kojin!? So we are not the only ones come in search of treasure.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_043: Quickly, Kabuto, tuck me away and get down there. We have to stop them!
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_000_049: More bandits!? Oh, what a horrible, horrible day!
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_100_050: The Namazu is safe, but they've taken the vase! We have to get it back.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_000_050: (-Nervous Namazu-)Please, please, just leave me alone.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_051: No need to fear, friend. We are here to help.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_HIRUMAKI_000_052: (-Cruel Kojin-)You hear that? The bungling Blue and his wet nurse want to help.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_SYAGI_000_053: (-Colossal Kojin-)No need to worry your pretty little shell. We've only come to retrieve what is by rights ours, and he was more than willing to give it to us.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_000_054: (-Nervous Namazu-)Give it to you!? You're a liar, and I still have the lumps to prove it!
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_000_055: (-Nervous Namazu-)You're here to help, yes, yes? Then you can start by teaching those brutes a lesson.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_HIRUMAKI_000_056: (-Cruel Kojin-)This treasure belongs in the vault, you know this to be true. Now stand down.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_HIRUMAKI_000_058: (-Cruel Kojin-)Ho, how curious! Before he spoke as a whining child, but now he speaks as a would-be warrior?
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_HIRUMAKI_000_059: (-Cruel Kojin-)Lay down your sword and surrender. If you do, we may consider allowing you to work as one of our mercenaries.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_KABUTO_000_060: I...I would rather die than serve you Red brutes!
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_SYAGI_100_060: (-Colossal Kojin-)Watch your tongue! You stand in the presence of General Hirumaki of the Red!
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_HIRUMAKI_101_060: Now, now, Shaugi. Let's not be rash with this would-be warrior. Given the right incentive, I'm sure he and his brothers could be convinced to join us.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_061: Never. Not for all the treasure in the world!
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_HIRUMAKI_000_062: Ugh. Again with your whining. Perhaps the Blue are not worth having as mercenaries after all.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_HIRUMAKI_000_063: Though I could be convinced. Mark my words: when next we meet, I will have you on your knees begging to join us.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_064: Those fiends! Do they think we will let them simply walk away?
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_066: Yes, well, though your Kojin savior here is indeed brave, he is not the best with words. I step in on occasion to speak on his behalf.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_100_066: But enough of that. Kabuto, you must follow them!  and I will be right behind you.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_000_068: Thank you for saving me. Would that we had met on better terms. My name is Gyokei.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_069: , go and assist Kabuto. I will be along shortly with our new friend here.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_079: I fear Hirumaki may be too much for Kabuto on his own. Go quickly and help him.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_000_079: No need to worry. Your doll is safe with me. Yes, yes, very safe.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_KABUTO_000_080: He had reinforcements lying in wait. I managed to fend them off, but he got away.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_082: What of the vase? Were you able to take it back from them?
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_000_084: No need to concern yourself. No, no. I'm actually glad to be rid of it.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_085: As Gyokei tells it, there is a rather unpleasant story behind that vase.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_000_086: Indeed there is. It was not until after I came into possession of it that I learned of the misfortune that befell each of its previous owners.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_000_087: When the birds first began to follow me, I thought nothing of it─but then their droppings came. Every day, a torrent, a maelstrom of dung from the heavens! I grew suspicious, and soon after I learned the vase had been cursed by its maker.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_000_088: I made every effort, took every opportunity to get rid of it, but whether I dropped it into the ocean or abandoned it on a mountainside, it always found its way back to me. As did the storms...
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_000_089: Eventually I learned of a way the curse may be broken. It involves a small ritual which must be performed while alone. Otherwise the misfortune would spread, and we mustn't have that. No, no.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_000_090: But if the Red Kojin want it they can have it!
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_091: I see. Truly the world is full of strange treasures. In any case, I suspect the curse will soon come to an end.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_092: They will be taking the vase to the Kojin's treasure vault on the Isle of Zekki. Once enshrined within, it will be purified by the myriad kami inside. The vase will haunt you no longer.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_000_093: Oh, thank goodness. I must repay you for your kindness. Come, come. If there is anything you would ask of me, name it.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_A2_000_002: I only ask for your friendship on behalf of the Kojin.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_095: How modest of you. Well, go on Kabuto. The decision is yours.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_KABUTO_000_096: Well, the Blue Kojin are seeking allies, and...erm...
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_097: What a noble gesture, putting the needs of the Kojin before yourself.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_000_098: But of course! You are mostly merchants and traders, yes, yes? That suits my plans perfectly. I was looking for partners with whom to do business.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_100_098: Forgive me for interrupting, but I could not help but notice you have quite the charm.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_000_099: What!? I-I'm flattered, truly. But I don't think it would work between a Namazu and─
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_100: It is old, but it has an exquisite shine. Yes, that is indeed a marvelous chime that dangles about your neck.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_000_101: Oh, my chime? Of course, of course! What else could you have meant.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_100_101: Ahem. You have a good eye, Tsukumo. These chimes are the pride and joy of the Namazu. Why, I've worn this one about my neck since my first nameday.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_102: With a brilliant shine matched only by that of your kind-hearted soul, no doubt.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_000_103: Please, stop, before you make me blush. Tell you what. As a show of good faith between soon-to-be partners in trade, how would you like one of these chimes?
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_000_104: Not mine, of course, but I'm certain I can find one for you.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_GYOKEI_000_106: Then I'm off to check my storehouse. When I find one, I will send it to Tamamizu posthaste.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_107: That went rather well, would you not agree? With Gyokei safe and a splendid chime promised to our vault, I believe our work here is done. Let us return to Tamamizu for a well-earned respite.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_109: Despite our success, Kabuto seems surprisingly downcast. He won't speak to me, but perhaps you can break his silence.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_111: Bunchin was overjoyed to hear of our new trade partner in Gyokei. It would seem we are off to a spectacular start.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_113: I would say you more than helped, my friend. We would still be in Yanxia if not for your sharp eyes. In contrast, what would you say of Kabuto's performance this day?
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_A3_000_001: He brought honor to the Blue Kojin.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_114: Indeed he has. Though Hirumaki escaped, Gyokei's life was spared and soon our treasure vault will benefit from his generosity.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_115: You seem displeased. I will concede he did fail to apprehend Hirumaki, but he saved Gyokei's life, and we have gained a new trading partner. Surely that is commendable, no?
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_KABUTO_000_116: I have much to learn. The difference in strength between  and me is still too great.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_116: To acknowledge your limitations is the first step in overcoming them. Others may think you proud, but I can see there is more to you than that.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_TSUKUMO_000_117: You care deeply for the well-being of your people, though you have had few opportunities to demonstrate this. You have great potential, Kabuto, and I believe you may yet make a fine leader.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_SYSTEM_000_200: Gyokei is now a trading partner with the Blue Kojin, and has pledged a contribution to the treasure vault.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_SYSTEM_000_210: You have achieved Trusted reputation with the Kojin.
TEXT_BANKJN002_02974_SYSTEM_000_211: New Kojin society daily quests are now available from Zukin at Tamamizu.

TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_SYSTEM_000_000: In order to undertake this quest, you must first complete the main scenario quest “Here There Be Xaela.”
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_KABUTO_000_001: . Your timing is fortuitous as always.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_KABUTO_000_002: We recently received word of an artifact in the Azim Steppe worthy of the vault. As I am unfamiliar with lands beyond the Ruby Sea, I would ask you accompany me.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_003:
Well said, Kabuto. I knew you had it in you.
Your assistance would be greatly appreciated, . Being such a well-traveled adventurer, I suspect you would be much better suited to guide us.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_004: Excellent! Then we will meet you in Reunion.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_009: There you are. A beautiful place, is it not? Would that the winds were not so strong. I feel as though I could be whisked away at any moment.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_PERSONA02975_000_00: A hardened warrior, I see. There's no need to deny it─the stench of blood and battle is unmistakable.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_PERSONB02975_000_00: Hmmm. You've the look of a warrior. Yes, one who might know an able-bodied man or two worthy of the Buduga. Perhaps you could introduce me?
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_PERSONC02975_000_00: Admiring my bow, are you? You will find no better in all the Steppe. A lesser weapon would bring shame to the Oronir.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_KABUTO_000_010: There are Au Ra everywhere. It calls to mind Sui-no-Sato.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_011: I was concerned you would only retreat further into your shell being so far away from home, but I am glad to be mistaken. At any rate, we must not waste any more time.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_012: I will accompany Kabuto and see what we can learn here in Reunion. You should have a look about as well and see if you can learn aught of this treasure.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_PERSONA02975_000_02: A great treasure? Do you mean the bow belonging to that Qestiri boy? I've heard he can pierce the very heavens with it.
I only know that the bow belongs to a boy of the Qestir tribe. Would that I had such a weapon.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_PERSONB02975_000_02: Yes, I've heard of the young Qestiri boy and his bow. Uchikin is his name.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_PERSONB02975_100_02: Though I love a good rumor, I suggest you speak with him yourself to learn the truth.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_PERSONB02975_000_02: If you would know the truth of Uchikin and his bow, it would be best to see it for yourself.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_PERSONC02975_000_02: A boy with a bow that can pierce the heavens? Hmph. I've heard the rumors, but who would believe such nonsense. I guarantee you his bow pales in comparison to mine.
The rumors are just that─rumors. His bow is likely plainer than the horns on my head.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_029: You missed a rather amusing conversation. I never imagined meeting anyone who speaks less than Kabuto.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_KABUTO_000_030: . How did you fare? I spoke with the Au Ra of the Qestir tribe. Well, I tried to. I was met only with silence.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_031: A pity you were not there. Kabuto speaking with a man of fewer words than himself is something that must be seen to be believed.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_KABUTO_000_032: How is it they can govern Reunion yet never speak?
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_A1_000_001: They gained the trust of their brethren through actions, not words.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_A1_000_002: They have an august presence that commands respect.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_KABUTO_000_033: Indeed. Words mean nothing without action to prove their worth.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_KABUTO_000_034: Indeed. I doubt such authority is earned with empty words.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_KABUTO_000_035: Though I know not how, their silence spoke volumes. It said that we should judge this treasure with our own eyes.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_036: That would certainly be the fastest way to ascertain the truth of the stories that brought us here. Speaking of stories, were you able to learn anything from the residents of Reunion, ?
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_037: A boy of the Qestir tribe. I see. Persuading him to relinquish a weapon of such value seems unlikely, but at the very least we should seek him out.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_038: We are like to find him faster if we split up. , would you try searching south of Reunion? Kabuto and I will go north.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_SYSTEM_000_041: Uchikin stifles his tears as he points southeast. Bereft of his bow, you surmise it was stolen. The culprit likely made off in the direction Uchikin is pointing.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_A2_000_001: Don't worry. I'll retrieve your bow.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_SYSTEM_000_044: Uchikin seems immensely grateful for your aid. You should leave now before the thief gets away.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_SYSTEM_000_049: Uchikin points to the southeast. You should leave now, lest the thief get away.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_BALLOON_000_052: You will pay for your meddling!
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_KABUTO_000_059: That bow. Is that what I think it is?
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_059: We failed to find the bow, but did manage to track down Uchikin's father. I can only hope your search was more fruitful.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_SYSTEM_000_059: Uchikin's father seems glad to see you have retrieved his son's bow.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_062: They both seem quite pleased to have the bow returned.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_063: Where did you find it? We were just preparing to search the area with Uchikin's father.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_KABUTO_000_064: The Red Kojin!? I didn't expect them to come this far in search of treasure.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_065: Come now, Kabuto. If we were able to learn of this great treasure, it stands to reason they might come to know of it as well.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_KABUTO_000_066: That said, this bow doesn't appear to be particularly unique, though it does seem easy for a child to wield.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_068: So that is the way of it. The bow is for Uchikin's training.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_KABUTO_000_069: Then it was not the bow but Uchikin's natural prowess that spurred the rumors?
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_100_070: I suspect Uchikin was not all that talented when he began practicing.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_071: Take a closer look at the bow. Its size is perfect for him, and the draw weight seems to be such that he can handle it with ease. Moreover, it appears to be far from new, meaning Uchikin has put a great deal of care into maintaining it.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_072: I think it was crafted by his father as a gift. And because Uchikin enjoyed the bow so much, he labored tirelessly to master it. It is indeed a treasure─in Uchikin's eyes.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_100_073: Well, there you have it. And who are we to ask him to part with something so precious? No, I believe there is nothing left for us here.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_076: I think he means to grant us leave to barter in Reunion.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_100_076: You would welcome trade with the Blue Kojin?
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_100_077: Thank you, sir. Thank you! Trade here in the Azim Steppe will prove more valuable than any single treasure.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_KABUTO_000_078: Again we have gained a new ally thanks to you.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_079: Your resourcefulness never ceases to amaze. Isn't that RiGht...KaBu...
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_081: ...Hm? Where was I? Ah yes, your resourcefulness. There is much we have to learn from you, .
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_082: Why do you all stare at me so? Is something the matter?
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_KABUTO_000_083: You suddenly stopped moving, as if devoid of life.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_084: Nonsense. You must be imagining things. I assure you I am perfectly fine.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_100_084: Uchikin's father wants us to follow him. No doubt there are still details of our new trade agreement that must be decided upon.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_085: Kabuto and I can handle matters from here. Once we have finished our business in Reunion, we will meet you back in Tamamizu.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_089: I told Kabuto there is nothing to worry about but he refuses to listen. Perhaps you can make him listen to reason.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_KABUTO_000_090: Talks with the Qestir went well. While returning home, however, Tsukumo began acting strangely again.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_091: For the last time, Kabuto, I am fine. I was merely tired from the long journey.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_092: But enough about me. We should be celebrating a job well done. Trade with Reunion will open up new opportunities for the Blue Kojin, and the Qestir have taught us a lesson on the importance of one's actions. I hope it is one you took to heart, Kabuto.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_KABUTO_000_093: I have. It was inspiring to see how they could manage all of Reunion yet never speak.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_KABUTO_000_094: Yet I still find myself relying on  more than I should.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_095: What happened to the confident Kojin I saw in the Azim Steppe? This is no way for the leader of the Divine Circle to behave. Is that not so, ?
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_A3_000_001: The others are counting on you, Kabuto.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_A3_000_002: I have faith in you, Kabuto.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_TSUKUMO_000_097: My apologies, , but it seems we will have need of your assistance a while longer.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_SYSTEM_000_200: The Qestir of the Azim Steppe have invited the Blue Kojin to barter in Reunion, and offered a contribution to the treasure vault.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_SYSTEM_000_201: You have achieved Respected reputation with the Kojin.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_SYSTEM_000_202: New Kojin society daily quests are now available from Zukin at Tamamizu.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_SYSTEM_000_203: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Zukin as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_SYSTEM_000_204: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Zukin. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANKJN003_02975_SYSTEM_000_205: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Shikitahe.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_001: . Might I ask a favor of you?
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_002: I recently acquired a suit of armor. It was heavily worn and thus required repairs. I have entrusted a smith in Kugane with its restoration.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_003: I would go alone to retrieve it, but I worry about the voyage. Twice now the Red Kojin have interfered in our plans.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_004: I fear they will strike again.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_TSUKUMO_000_005: If they do, he nEeDs YoUr HeLp.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_006: <sigh> His condition has yet to improve, but we can discuss that later. Come, let us make for Kugane.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SHIHOUMI_000_009: ! It's so good see you. Thank you again for your help in the Ruby Sea.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_010: Good, you're here. It would seem the forge has entrusted Shihoumi with my armor. A curious twist of fate, no?
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SHIHOUMI_000_011: ! My, what a pleasant surprise. It's so good to see you again.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_TSUKUMO_000_012: And a pleasure to sEe YoU aGaIn aS wElL.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_TSUKUMO_000_014: Ah, of course. We have not been pRoPeRlY iNtRoDuCeD. I am TsUkUmO, a kami called forth from the tReAsUrE vAuLt In TaMaMiZu.
