TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SHIHOUMI_000_015: I have read everything I could about the Kojin and their beliefs since we parted ways. The texts spoke of kami that inhabit the treasures in their keep, but I never imagined them to be real.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_TSUKUMO_000_016: Well, as you can see, they are mOrE tHaN mErE sToRiEs... Ahem. But that is not why we are here. We've come to InQuIrE aBoUt ThE aRmOr We EnTrUsTeD tO yOu FoR rEpAiRs.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SHIHOUMI_000_017: Yes, of course. As a fledgling craftsman I pour my heart into all my work, and this armor was no exception. But I've already delivered it to Hells' Lid as instructed in your letter.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_018: Letter!? We sent no letter... This must be the work of the Red Kojin!
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SHIHOUMI_000_019: Oh no! Is there anything we can do?
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_TSUKUMO_000_020: No need to fear. We NeEd OnLy StOp ThEm BeFoRe ThEy─
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SHIHOUMI_000_021: Oh dear. He seems to have stopped.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SHIHOUMI_000_023: Hmmm. Has Tsukumo always behaved so strangely?
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_024: Only for the past few moons. Do you think you can fix him? I would rather he stay with you when  and I face the Red Kojin.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_026: To face them is to face death. You would only slow us down.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SHIHOUMI_000_028: Please, calm yourself, Tsukumo. Kabuto means only to keep you from harm. By the time he returns, I promise you will be good as new.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_029: Come, . We must hurry to Hells' Lid and intercept the delivery before it reaches the Red.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SHIHOUMI_000_039: Please take care out there. I will do my best to have Tsukumo repaired by the time you return.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_049: My apologies. I shouldn't have rushed ahead.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_COURIER02976_000_05: Thank the gods you came when you did. Those red-shelled bastards nearly made off with this here package.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_051: I'm afraid this delivery was a trap of their creation. This armor is mine, you see, and I made no request to have it delivered. Only to have it repaired by the armorer in Kugane.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_052: But as it is here, and repairs are complete, I would be more than happy to relieve you of your duty.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_COURIER02976_000_05: You're kidding? Well, if it means I don't have to lug this crate back, by all means. I wouldn't stay around here long, though; those Red Kojin could show up again at any moment.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_100_053: For a blessing we have foiled their plans, and the courier was unharmed.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_101_053: Still, I find it strange the Red Kojin knew of this armor.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_HIRUMAKI_000_054: (-Dreadfully Familiar Voice-)Incompetent, the lot of them. I suppose I'll have to handle this myself.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_HIRUMAKI_000_055: Well, well, if it isn't the cowardly Kojin from Yanxia. Have you come to beg, then?
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_056: You cannot have this armor, Hirumaki─it belongs to the Blue!
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_HIRUMAKI_000_057: Hmph. Why would I concern myself with that pile of scrap when you've already given us so much?
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SYAGI_000_058: Defeating you here and taking it would have been simple enough. We never dreamed you would leave it in Kugane for us.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_HIRUMAKI_000_059: Yes, truly a gift of the divine.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_HIRUMAKI_000_061: If you would have the doll returned, the Blue Kojin will serve. Your obedience may even grant you access to the vault.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_062: You would have us debase ourselves for you? Barter with blood and blade as you do? Never!
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SYAGI_000_063: I suppose you mean to take this back with a fair trade? Hah! Your pretty words will buy naught but a quick death.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_HIRUMAKI_000_064: We will be waiting for you on the Isle of Zekki. Come to serve, or to die. The choice is yours.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_065: The Red often deal in lies and deception. That vase was likely empty. But if what they say is true, Shihoumi may have come to harm.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_066: Would you go and check on her? I will deliver this armor home, then see to the truth of Hirumaki's threats.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_069: Don't worry about me. Shihoumi's safety must come first.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SHIHOUMI_000_070: Oh . If only you had returned sooner.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_A1_000_001: So it's true, then? The Red Kojin have Tsukumo?
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SHIHOUMI_000_071: I am afraid so. They came not long after you left. There was nothing I could do.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SHIHOUMI_100_072: Shortly after you left the Red Kojin came and took Tsukumo. There was nothing I could do.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SHIHOUMI_000_073: I know how much it meant to Kabuto, and yet I failed him when he needed me most.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_074: (-Familiar Voice-)You needn't worry. All that matters is you are safe. What's more, we recovered the armor.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SHIHOUMI_000_075: Kabuto! I'm sorry to have caused you so much worry. Were you able to save Tsukumo?
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_076: Unfortunately, no. Hirumaki's forces overwhelmed me as he made his escape.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_077: But we know where they are keeping him. I promise you: we will get him back.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SHIHOUMI_000_078: If you would stand against them, I will furnish you with any arms and armor you require. It's the least I can do.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_079: I would be honored, as would my brothers if you would have the Blue Kojin as patrons henceforth.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SHIHOUMI_000_080: Yes, of course! I only wish I was able to repair poor Tsukumo. When he is safely returned, I promise to do all I can to fix him.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_082: , meet me in Tamamizu. I would discuss strategy with you.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SHIHOUMI_000_089: I pray the kami see Tsukumo back to you safely.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_090: I told Shihoumi what she needed to hear, but I know you understand the hardships before us.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_091: My people know little of the ways of war, and our numbers are few. Failure is assured if we face the Red head-on.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_A2_000_001: We at least have to try.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_A2_000_002: Hirumaki must pay for what he's done.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_093: Easier said than done, my friend.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_BUNCHIN_000_094: (-Angry Voice-)Kabuto! I heard from the others. How could you let them take Tsukumo away from you!?
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_095: Elder! We were just planning a strategy to rescue him. I thought it best if  and I sneak in and─
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_BUNCHIN_000_096: And say nothing to the rest of the Divine Circle? To those who look to you for guidance?
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_BUNCHIN_000_098: Now is not the time for false bravado. If you would go to the Isle of Zekki and face the Red, you will not do so alone.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_BUNCHIN_000_099: You must speak with the Divine Circle─no, with all of the Blue. Sound a call to arms, and lead them into battle.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_KABUTO_000_101: If that is the elder's wish, then I fear I have no other choice.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SYSTEM_000_200: The forge in Kugane has accepted the Blue Kojin as patrons, and has repaired the armor that now rests in the treasure vault.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SYSTEM_000_201: You have achieved Honored reputation with the Kojin.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SYSTEM_000_202: New Kojin society daily quests are now available from Zukin at Tamamizu.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SYSTEM_000_203: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Zukin as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SYSTEM_000_204: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Zukin. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANKJN004_02976_SYSTEM_000_205: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Shikitahe.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_001: I'm afraid you've arrived early, . There is still much to do before preparations are complete.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_002: Yet I cannot stop thinking about Tsukumo's capture. Why strike in Kugane rather than here in Tamamizu? There is little we could have done to stop them had they tried.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_003: Unless... What if this was not the work of the Red as a whole, but a plot by Hirumaki to satisfy his own greed?
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_004: Defeating him would be the key to rescuing Tsukumo.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_005: The problem, however, is he is always so heavily guarded.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_006: Our plans and preparation will all be for nothing unless they can be drawn away.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_007: As ever your aid is greatly appreciated.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_008: Nevertheless, we cannot deny their numbers. Sheer strength alone will not grant us victory.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_009: The other members of the Divine Circle intend to create a distraction to draw them away, but even then we are still outmatched.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_010: <sigh> How am I to sway my brothers to join us? Even the mere mention of the Isle of Zekki is enough to turn them away.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_A1_000_001: You must convince them with your actions.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_A1_000_002: You must convince them with a thorough explanation of your plan.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_011: My actions...? Ah, like the Qestir of the Azim Steppe.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_012: Hmmm. That sounds like what Tsukumo would do. He always had a way with words.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_013: If that is what you believe, then I suppose it is worth a try.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_014: Erm... Would you be willing to accompany me? Not to speak with everyone, of course. Only until I've gained my nerve.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_VOLUNTEER02977_000_: Aren't you the one aiding the Divine Circle in their search for treasure? You've done fine work for the Blue. Yes, fine work indeed.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_020: Ah, . Your presence is greatly appreciated. Ahem. Now then.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_VOLUNTEER02977_000_: Are you well, Kabuto? It's rather unlike you to call on anyone for help. I suppose next Makura will tell us the striped rays are drowning.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_022: Tsukumo has been taken by the Red, and I mean to rescue him.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_VOLUNTEER02977_000_: So it is true! I had hoped it was only a rumor. But what are we to do? We are not fighters, Kabuto. You would be leading turtles to slaughter.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_024: I realize that, which is why I will not ask you to fight. But I do have a plan that requires your help.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_025: You are perhaps the greatest swimmer the Ruby Sea has ever known, and your knowledge of its currents is unmatched. That is why I would ask you to lead their soldiers on a chase─distract them that I might do battle with their leader alone.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_VOLUNTEER02977_000_: A chase, you say? Hmmm. It should be simple enough to drag those sea slugs through the waves. It might even prove fun.
Very well. Give me time to prepare and you will have your diversion.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_028: He listened. He listened and agreed to help! No doubt your presence helped to convince him.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_029: But I cannot ask you to be present for everyone. Wait with the elder while I speak with the others.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_BUNCHIN_000_029: Kabuto has taken to recruiting our brothers for his attack on the Isle of Zekki? It seems he has learned much from his time away from Tamamizu.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_030: I never realized talking could be so tiresome.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_BUNCHIN_000_031: I take it you have spoken with everyone, then. Fear not. Your cause is just, and from what  has told me, your plan is sound.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_BUNCHIN_000_032: We need only wait for the others to assemble.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_0033: It would seem my words have fallen on deaf ears. Come, . We must save Tsukumo on our own.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_BUNCHIN_000_034: You are too quick to judge your brothers, Kabuto. Take another look.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_MAKURA_000_035: Sorry to keep you waiting. I thought it prudent we have proper weapons should we be forced to confront the Red, so I made a short trip to visit the Qestir.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_036: You traveled all the way to Reunion for weapons!?
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_SHIKITAHE_000_037: I paid a visit to the forge in Kugane, and the young smith─Shihoumi, I believe is her name─insisted she be brought here to prepare for Tsukumo's return. She seemed quite adamant about seeing to his repairs.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_038: Shihoumi! I had nearly forgotten. I know not how to repay you.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_ZUKIN_000_039: When a brother is in need, we help. It's as simple as that.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_MAKURA_000_040: Just so. In fact, you'll find more of our brothers are waiting for you outside. Everyone is prepared to do their part to see Tsukumo returned safely.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_ZUKIN_000_041: Which is why I scouted ahead, lest we have any unwanted surprises. I overheard the soldiers on watch speaking of Hirumaki.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_ZUKIN_000_042: They say he's been gloating over his latest plunder, keeping it on display at the Air of the Opulent. It has to be Tsukumo.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_043: Then I know where I must go.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_044: As I mentioned before, your task will be to circle about the island and draw the attention of as many soldiers as you can.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_100_044: While they're distracted,  and I will sneak onto the island through the Dive.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_BUNCHIN_000_045: Today we shall prove the Blue are not to be trifled with.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_BUNCHIN_000_049: You needn't worry about me. I may be old, but with age comes great wisdom. I know enough of battle to handle myself in the field.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_050: You're here. Good. Everyone is in position.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_051: When we reach the Air of the Opulent, I will see to Hirumaki while you retrieve Tsukumo.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_060: There! It's Hirumaki, and he has Tsukumo!
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_SHIKITAHE_000_061: The soldiers are all taking to the water. Now is your chance.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_062: Thank you. All of you. I promise this opportunity will not be wasted.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_063: Fall back and join the others.  will handle the rest.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_MAKURA_000_064: Understood. Good luck, and may the kami keep you safe.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_ZUKIN_000_065: We have faith in you, Kabuto.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_HIRUMAKI_000_066: So you've come after all. Shaugi, why don't you entertain our guests?
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_067: Come, . He stands no chance against the both of us.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_HIRUMAKI_000_070: I've had enough of your meddling! I will rip your heads from your shoulders and mount them on the walls of the vault!
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_HIRUMAKI_000_072: Is that the best you can do?
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_HIRUMAKI_100_072: This is your last chance. Join me or die along with the rest of the Blue.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_REDZAKO02977_000_07: (-Red Kojin Soldiers-)General Hirumaki has fallen! Retreat! Retreat!
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_BUNCHIN_000_079: Quickly. We must take him back to Tamamizu.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_089: I apologize if I've worried you. I am fine, but there is still no change in Tsukumo.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_090: He's remained lifeless since he last spoke on the Isle of Zekki.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_SHIHOUMI_000_092: I'm sorry. There doesn't seem to be anything wrong with him, physically.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_SHIHOUMI_000_093: I could grant him movement, but only such as an ordinary karakuri puppet might have.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_094: Tsukumo is no ordinary puppet. He is of the divine!
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_095: . You have dealt with matters of magic before, yes? Do you know of anything that might restore Tsukumo?
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_A2_000_001: But why? He has already served his purpose.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_A2_000_002: But why? Have you forgotten Tsukumo's parting message?
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_096: How can you say that? There's still so much we've yet to do.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_097: His parting message? You say that as if his intention was to leave.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_098: What's this? Did it fall from Tsukumo's altar?
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_SHIHOUMI_000_099: How could I have overlooked such a thing while examining him? Hmmm. It bears a striking resemblance to materia...
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_SHIHOUMI_000_100: Of course! Materia is essentially spiritual energy in crystallized form. It was likely used to make Tsukumo's core.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_BUNCHIN000_101: Are you saying it was this materia that gave him life?
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_SHIHOUMI_000_102: Precisely. And I have an idea as to how we may still put it to use. Would you sit down for a moment?
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_SHIHOUMI_000_104: It suits your helmet quite nicely.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_105: Thank you, Shihoumi. I will treasure it always.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_106: Tsukumo. You lent your voice when I could not find my own, your courage when I had only cowardice.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_107: Thanks to you, I now understand the strength that comes from the bonds I share with others.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_108: Before I might have thrown this materia away, but now...
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_000_109: Now I would honor Tsukumo's memory by protecting the vault, and the allies that have helped us fill it.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_SYSTEM_000_200: Thanks to your concerted efforts with Kabuto, Tsukumo now rests peacefully in the treasure vault.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_SYSTEM_000_201: You have achieved Sworn reputation with the Kojin.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_SYSTEM_000_202: Furthermore, you will receive an experience point bonus upon the completion of the Kojin society daily quests.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_SYSTEM_000_204: New Kojin society daily quests are now available from Zukin at Tamamizu.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_BATTLETALK_0: The path is clear. Come, this way!
What is he doing here?
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_BUNCHIN_BATTLETALK_: I brought treasures from the vault to aid you. Align yourself with the kami within and they shall grant you their blessings.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_BATTLETALK_0: I... I've never felt such power! With this we should have all we need to stop any in our way.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_BUNCHIN_BATTLETALK_: Makura waits for you within bearing more of our treasures. Go now, and may the kami protect you.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_BATTLETALK_0: Onward, to the Air of the Opulent!
By the kami! They should be out in the water, not here fighting. We have to help them!
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_VOLUNTEER02977_BATT: That seems to be the last of them. We'll keep the way clear. Hurry and save Tsukumo!
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_MAKURA_BATTLETALK_0: Before you go, come and partake of this treasure's blessing.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_BATTLETALK_0: Thank you. I fear we will need it for what lies ahead.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_MAKURA_BATTLETALK_0: Go quickly now. We will keep them at bay for as long as we can.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_BATTLETALK_0:
Thank you, Makura.
Come, . We mustn't waste this opportunity.
Curses! I wasn't expecting such numbers.
If they would stand against us, then we have no choice. Lead on, .
Draw them together, and I will deliver the finishing blow!
Reinforcements!? Distract them that I might strike again.
There's no end to them! I fear I only have strength enough for one last attack.
Well done. Now let's get moving. It shouldn't be much farther.
I...can't move. , help!
I'm free! Now to dispense with these red-shelled fiends.
The Air of the Opulent is just ahead. Once inside you mustn't let down your guard.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_MAKURA_BATTLETALK_0: Wait, Kabuto! We've prepared one last treasure to aid you in your fight against Hirumaki.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_BATTLETALK_0: With this last blessing we should have all the strength we need. Let's put an end to Hirumaki and his schemes.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_SYAGI_BATTLETALK_00: How dare you raise your blade against General Hirumaki. Yours will be a slow and painful death!
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_BATTLETALK_0: If we're to save Tsukumo he has to be stopped.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_SYAGI_BATTLETALK_00: Hmph. Let's see how you handle this!
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_BATTLETALK_0: Quickly! We must destroy these spheres before they burst.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_SYAGI_BATTLETALK_00: We will suffer your intrusion no longer!
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_BATTLETALK_0: To me, ! We must bear this attack together.
Gah! For a blessing I survived, but I dare not suffer another alone.
It will take more than some feeble spring shower to defeat us, Shaugi.
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_SYAGI_BATTLETALK_00: I've had enough of this wet nurse of yours. Begone with you!
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_BATTLETALK_0: His strength is waning, . Keep it up!
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_SYAGI_BATTLETALK_00: Fools! You cannot defeat the Red!
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_BATTLETALK_0: The water spouts─they're protecting him!
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_SYAGI_BATTLETALK_00: Enough games. This time I will end you!
TEXT_BANKJN005_02977_KABUTO_BATTLETALK_0: It seems the tide has turned in our favor.
No... Not like this...
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_000: . I was hoping you would visit.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_001: Things have not been quite the same since we lost Tsukumo, but I've taken his words to heart. My every waking moment has been devoted to seeking treasures for our vault.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_002: We've made great progress, but the others insist I take a break if only for a short while.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_003: Rather than sit idle here in Tamamizu, I thought my time would be better spent visiting the good people of Othard who made contributions to the treasure vault.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_004: It will be a wonderful trip, made all the better by your company. If you would join me, come to Yanxia. I plan to start by paying a visit to Gyokei.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_009: It's been too long since I've come to Yanxia. Judging by the lack of birds overhead, he's no longer plagued by that cursed vase.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_GYOKEI_000_010: My, what a surprise. I trust all has been well since your last visit, yes, yes?
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_011: Quite well, thank you. Trade with you and the other Namazu has been a boon. I came today to offer you thanks on behalf of the Blue Kojin.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_GYOKEI_000_012: No, no, it is I who should be thanking you. Once more I can enjoy sunny days and blue skies clear of birds and their unsavory gifts. Yes, yes, life has never been better.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_013: Ah, so the curse was lifted as Tsukumo predicted. A pity he could not come with us to hear the good news.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_GYOKEI_000_014: Tsukumo? Who is that? It sounds more like a flavorful dish than a person.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_015: Come now, Gyokei. Surely you remember the talking doll that accompanied me when we first met?
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_GYOKEI_000_016: What a silly, silly Kojin you are. As if I would forget something so remarkable as that. There was no such thing present when I met the two of you, no, no.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_017: What in the kami's name is going on?
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_A1_000_001: Perhaps the stress of that day affected his memory.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_018: I suppose that's possible. It's not uncommon for one's memory to become hazy when thinking back on traumatic experiences.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_019: I suppose being attacked by Hirumaki was a rather traumatic experience. Perhaps the stress of it all has affected his memory.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_020: When a foe is truly formidable, even I cannot clearly recall what happened when we exchanged blows.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_021: At any rate, it would be unkind to make him relive his meeting with the Red.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_022: We won't keep you any longer, Gyokei. Take care, and may the blessings of the kami be upon you.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_GYOKEI_000_023: Farewell, my friends. Next time I will go to visit you in Tamamizu, yes, yes.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_024: What say we visit Reunion next? Uchikin is likely a master of marksmanship by now.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_GYOKEI_000_029: If you happen to come across that talking doll Kabuto spoke of, I would like to see it very, very much.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_029: The road to the Azim Steppe was longer than I thought. I can scarcely believe Makura traveled all this way before our battle on the Isle of Zekki.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_SYSTEM_000_029: Uchikin's father welcomes you with a warm smile. He seems quite glad for your visit.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_031: It is good to see you both. Talk of your prowess is still hot on the lips of every merchant in Reunion. Your father must be proud.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_033: Please, there is no need to thank us. No, it is I who should be thanking you. If not for your generosity, we never would have had the means to rescue our dear Tsukumo from the Red Kojin.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_034: That...was a bow to thank us, yes? Would that Tsukumo were here. He was quite adept at interpreting your expressions.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_036: Does that mean you don't remember Tsukumo? A talking doll no higher than my knee, in the likeness of a Kojin?
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_038: First Gyokei and now these two. I don't know what's going on here but it can't be good.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_039: Perhaps we should go and visit Shihoumi. Surely she of all people would remember Tsukumo.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_040: Thank you for your time, but we must be leaving. Blessings of the kami be upon you.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_SYSTEM_000_047: Uchikin seems very apologetic. Unable to recall Tsukumo, perhaps he believes he has given offense.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_SYSTEM_000_049: Uchikin's father gestures enthusiastically, as if to wish you safe travels.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_049: Shihoumi was the one who offered me Tsukumo as a gift. That she could forget him is unthinkable.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_SHIHOUMI_000_050: , . Kabuto. To what do I owe the pleasure of this visit?
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_051: I realize this is sudden, but... Do you recognize the jewel on my helmet?
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_SHIHOUMI_000_052: Of course. I was the one who set it for you.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_053: Oh, thank the kami! Then you also remember Tsukumo, the doll from whence it came?
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_SHIHOUMI_000_054: You mean the karakuri puppet I gave you as a gift for rescuing me?
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_SHIHOUMI_000_056: Yes, I remember. It was so old and worn. I was honestly quite surprised you were so taken with it. The way you would clutch it in your arms, and you named it Tsukumo. I thought it was quite touching.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_SHIHOUMI_000_057: Though I must say, it was quite peculiar to see materia produced from a doll. It usually comes from arms or armor after a great deal of use.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_058: But you claimed this is what brought Tsukumo to life!
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_SHIHOUMI_000_059: What? I said no such thing. I know not whose spirit gave form to that materia, but I fear affixing it to your helmet has clouded your memory.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_060: No! Tsukumo was alive, I tell you! He was always there to say what I could not, and he helped me establish relations with a great many people.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_SHIHOUMI_000_061: I'm sorry, Kabuto. I do not question this puppet meant a great deal to you, but if it truly was able to walk or talk, I was not witness to it.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_062: Have I gone mad, ? How can no one remember? After everything we've accomplished.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_063: Do you suppose my brothers have forgotten him as well? No one has spoken of Tsukumo since the battle on the Isle of Zekki, but I'm beginning to suspect it's not to save me grief.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_064: Sorry to have troubled you. I only meant to come and give thanks for the puppet and your wonderful work on my helmet. Take care, Shihoumi.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_SHIHOUMI_000_065: I pray the kami guide you to the answers you seek.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_066: Let us return to Tamamizu. I would have a word with the elder.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_SHIHOUMI_000_069: There must be something special about that puppet to excite Kabuto so. If only I could remember what...
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_069: The mere thought of my brothers forgetting Tsukumo is too much to bear.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_BUNCHIN_000_070: What brings the two of you here? By all rights you should be resting, Kabuto.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_071: A question has been weighing on my mind for some time now, and...well...
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_MAKURA_000_073: There you are! I've assembled the Divine Circle as you asked. What is it you wished to discuss?
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_074: Thank you all for coming. No one has spoken of him since he was lost to us, but I wished to speak with you all about Tsukumo.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_BUNCHIN_000_075: Tsukumo...? Ah, do you mean the puppet you enshrined in the treasure vault?
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_076: So you do remember! I was beginning to fear everyone had forgotten the founder of our fellowship.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_BUNCHIN_000_077: What are you saying, Kabuto? It was you who formed the Divine Circle.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_078: No... No, it was Tsukumo. Why can none of you remember?
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_079: I didn't think to ask, seeing as you accompanied me on my travels about Othard, but now I fear I must.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_080: Tell me true, ─do you remember Tsukumo?
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_081: Oh, what a relief. I thought I was losing my mind.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_BUNCHIN_000_082: Curious that only the two of you can recall Tsukumo as more than a mere doll.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_BUNCHIN_000_083: But perhaps this is not without reason. I believe the kami was meant to guide you on a journey of enlightenment. A journey only you were meant to remember.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_BUNCHIN_000_084: Yet it seems our friend  here possesses a rare gift, one that allows  to recall that which others cannot.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_085: That can't be! I've seen him speak with you. With all of you.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_BUNCHIN_000_086: Curious that only you can recall Tsukumo as more than a mere doll.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_BUNCHIN_000_087: But perhaps this is not without reason. I believe this spirit was meant to guide you on a journey of enlightenment. A journey only you were meant to remember.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_088: You needn't mince words, Elder. You think this all a figment of my imagination, don't you?
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_BUNCHIN_000_089: Not at all. In fact, I had a similar experience many years ago. At the time I assumed no one would believe me, and so I have kept it to myself all this time.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_BUNCHIN_000_090: There are myriad kami in this world, each with their own will, their own purpose. In the end, it would seem this kami was meant not for the Divine Circle, but for you.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_MAKURA_000_092: I would be lying if I said I wasn't jealous. Oh, what I wouldn't give for such divine guidance.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_BUNCHIN_000_093: This is not the time for envy, Makura, but praise. The kami saw fit to make Kabuto a fine leader, and the Blue have gained new allies because of it.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_094: Truth be told, I can scarcely believe how far I've come. Looking back I can see how foolish I was to think protecting my brothers meant having to push them away.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_095: Tsukumo taught me the bonds we share are worth more than any treasure.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_BUNCHIN_000_096: Heed well the lessons you have learned here, Kabuto. I sense the path before you leads to a great many things.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_097: Wherever the path may lead, we will walk it together. It's what Tsukumo would have wanted.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_KABUTO_000_098: Our quest for treasure begins anew. For the Blue!
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_SYSTEM_000_100: You have achieved Bloodsworn reputation with the Kojin.
TEXT_BANKJN006_02978_SYSTEM_000_101: You will receive an experience point bonus upon completion of the Kojin society daily quests.
TEXT_BANKJN301_02979_ZUKIN_000_000: The Red, ─they have fallen upon one of our caravans!
TEXT_BANKJN301_02979_ZUKIN_000_001: By the grace of the kami, we were able to protect the goods, but the Red brigands remain at large. I need you to join us in hunting them down.
TEXT_BANKJN301_02979_ZUKIN_000_002: Once you have found and given them a trouncing, smear this all over them. Golden aspic, it is called, and it is made by─actually, 'tis best that you do not know. The point is it smells foul, and will serve to teach the offending Reds a lesson.
TEXT_BANKJN301_02979_ZUKIN_000_003: Even as we speak, one of our sisters is scouring the Isle of Bekko for them. Seek her out first, and she will tell you more.
TEXT_BANKJN301_02979_KOJINFEMALE02979_00: The Red brigands struck fast, but they fled even faster. If you would search the northern shoreline, I will see to the rest of the isle.
And as Zukin will have told you, after you subdue the villains, you are to smear golden aspic all over them. Do not forget this step.
TEXT_BANKJN301_02979_BALLOON_000_011: Hmph! And I was so close to the water!
TEXT_BANKJN301_02979_BALLOON_100_013: What the─ Uhhh... I'm going to be─ Hurrrgh!
TEXT_BANKJN301_02979_ZUKIN_000_030: Ah, you are returned. Were you able to find and punish the Red in the manner prescribed?
TEXT_BANKJN301_02979_ZUKIN_000_031: Haha, well done, my friend! Our comrades shall be pleased to learn that you have dealt with the brigands!
TEXT_BANKJN301_02979_ZUKIN_000_032: The poor sods will reek for a good while, and until such time as the odor fades, they are like to be spurned by their own. A fine lesson, yes?
TEXT_BANKJN302_02980_ZUKIN_000_000: , we've received an urgent order of pearls from the East Aldenard Trading Company! There's no time to waste─you must go and harvest them at once. I shall mark the location on your map.
TEXT_BANKJN302_02980_ZUKIN_000_001: Ah, but before you strike out, there is an important rule you must observe. To preserve the natural order, the elder has decreed that no more than three oysters may be prised open in a single harvest. That is to say, choose well.
TEXT_BANKJN302_02980_ZUKIN_000_002: Once you have three pearls, pray bear them directly to the Ruby Price, where the company's associate awaits. The kami speed your way, my friend!
TEXT_BANKJN302_02980_MERCHANT02980_100_0: You are come from the Kojin, you say? Dare I hope you have the pearls? Our client is in considerable haste...
Well, what delightful little pearls, small yet captivating! Yes, I believe they shall make a most elegant ring! Phew, this should serve to satisfy the mistress...
Why, these are paragons among pearls, such as might be described in tomes! Yes, they shall make a fetching set of earrings! Phew, this should serve to satisfy the mistress...

By the gods, never have I laid eyes upon such enormous pearls! Oh, I can picture it now, the centerpiece for a sumptuous choker that shall be the talk of the town... The mistress shall doubtless be pleased!

Lest you wonder, the order comes from an Ishgardian noblewoman, a regular client of ours. She requested an adornment, specifying that it must feature the finest pearls...and that it must be ready on the morrow.
As much as we appreciate her custom, did she not stop to consider that her request might be unreasonable? ...Ack, I shouldn't be complaining openly. Please forget I said any of this.

On behalf of the East Aldenard Trading Company, I give you my profuse thanks. Here is your payment, with a little extra for your troubles. The company is fortunate to have dependable suppliers such as you and yours.
My thanks again, good . The company is fortunate to have dependable suppliers such as you and yours.
TEXT_BANKJN302_02980_ZUKIN_000_010: I've awaited your return, . Were you able to make the delivery in a timely fashion?
TEXT_BANKJN302_02980_ZUKIN_000_012: ...So that was the way of it. We can choose our friends, but not our customers. Such is business. At any rate, we fulfilled our obligation and were duly compensated. And we have you to thank for it.
TEXT_BANKJN302_02980_ZUKIN_000_013: In case you weren't aware, 'tis no easy thing to harvest fine pearls. Yet by your account, you did so quite effortlessly.
TEXT_BANKJN302_02980_ZUKIN_000_014: Pearls are a gift from the kami, and this is proof that they favor you. When next we receive an order for pearls, I know to whom I shall turn!
TEXT_BANKJN303_02981_ZUKIN_000_000: It is time, . As one of the Divine Circle, you must undertake the rite of purification, that you might deepen your bond with the kami of the hunt.
TEXT_BANKJN303_02981_ZUKIN_000_001: To this end, you will require a special kind of holy water called Sui-no-Mamizu. This can be had from a priestess of Sui-no-Sato.
TEXT_BANKJN303_02981_ZUKIN_000_002: Once you have the water, return hither to Tamamizu and present yourself before the consecrated shell yonder. There you must sprinkle the water and offer a prayer to the kami.
TEXT_BANKJN303_02981_SUIWOMAN02981_000_0: Ah, you must be the  of whom the Kojin spoke. I have your water. Take it, and may you find favor with the kami.
TEXT_BANKJN303_02981_UROKUZU_000_015: Come to undertake the rite, have you? Go ahead and sprinkle the Sui-no-Mamizu, then say a prayer to the kami.
TEXT_BANKJN303_02981_SYSTEM_000_025: You are purified from head to toe. Now you may pray to the consecrated shell.
TEXT_BANKJN303_02981_SYSTEM_000_026: This does not appear to be the right spot. Try sprinkling the water again near the consecrated shell.
TEXT_BANKJN303_02981_SUIWOMAN02981_000_0: You have the water. Shouldn't you be heading back to Tamamizu?
TEXT_BANKJN303_02981_SYSTEM_100_025: This appears to be the right spot to sprinkle the Sui-no-Mamizu.
TEXT_BANKJN303_02981_UROKUZU_000_030: Good, good. 'Tis important to give thanks. The kami will surely smile upon your treasure-hunting endeavors.
TEXT_BANKJN303_02981_UROKUZU_000_031: Though you are not Kojin, you respect our ways as your own. Full glad am I to know a shell-less one such as you.
TEXT_BANKJN303_02981_UROKUZU_000_035: Purifying yourself is but half of the rite. Now you must pray to the kami.
TEXT_BANKJN303_02981_ZUKIN_000_040: The rite is complete? That is well. As you know, we Kojin seek out treasure that we might strengthen our bond with the kami.
TEXT_BANKJN303_02981_ZUKIN_000_041: And by the rite, we entreat he who abides in the shell to facilitate this bond. By honoring him, we may seek with greater success, thereby honoring all.
TEXT_BANKJN303_02981_UROKUZU_000_045: Though you are not Kojin, you respect our ways as your own. Full glad am I to know a shell-less one such as you.
TEXT_BANKJN304_02982_ZUKIN_000_000: Fancy going for a little swim, ? If you have a moment to spare, Makura could use your help with the rays. They look after us, and so we must look after them.
TEXT_BANKJN304_02982_MAKURA_000_010: Ah, , I've been waiting for you. I need you to take one of our rays out for a good feed─a reward for all of its toils.
TEXT_BANKJN304_02982_MAKURA_000_011: Now, the fellow loves few things more than krill, and you'll find swarms of them close by. Please have him feed till he's had his fill.
TEXT_BANKJN304_02982_MAKURA_000_012: Should you become separated from the ray, worry not─he is trained to return here. Happy feeding, then, and let Zukin know when you're done!
TEXT_BANKJN304_02982_SYSTEM_000_020: The ray sucks in a copious amount of seawater and krill.
TEXT_BANKJN304_02982_SYSTEM_000_021: The ray sucks in a copious amount of seawater and krill.
TEXT_BANKJN304_02982_SYSTEM_000_022: The ray sucks in a copious amount of seawater and krill.
TEXT_BANKJN304_02982_MAKURA_000_025: There you are! The ray returned without you, and he's been champing at the bit to get back to his krill.
TEXT_BANKJN304_02982_SYSTEM_000_026: There is a large swarm of krill. You make a mental note of the spot for feeding the ray.
TEXT_BANKJN304_02982_ZUKIN_000_030: Welcome back, . I understand you treated the ray to a veritable banquet. This will doubtless do wonders for its spirit.
TEXT_BANKJN304_02982_ZUKIN_000_031: Makura tells me the creature is very fond of you, and who could blame it? When next it needs a good feed, I trust we can rely on you again.
TEXT_BANKJN304_02982_MAKURA_000_035: Our little ray returned with a belly full of krill and a grin from gill to gill! Thank you so much, !
TEXT_BANKJN305_02983_ZUKIN_000_000: As you will doubtless appreciate, treasure hunting is hungry work. To help us keep up our strength, Kaioke will cook a hearty meal, and for this he requires several red-hot carapaces.
TEXT_BANKJN305_02983_ZUKIN_000_001: If each one of us could procure but two, we will have enough in no time. Here, take this oyster meat. You can use it to lure out voracious gasame at Hells' Lid.
TEXT_BANKJN305_02983_ZUKIN_000_002: Other gasame may well be drawn to the bait, but not all will yield the carapace we need. Take care, and good luck!
TEXT_BANKJN305_02983_ZUKIN_000_020: Ah, you are returned. Have you obtained your share of carapaces?
TEXT_BANKJN305_02983_ZUKIN_000_021: Oho, such big, fiery shells! This shall be a proper feast!
TEXT_BANKJN305_02983_ZUKIN_000_022: Turn these over and fill them with ingredients, and in no time we'll have a tasty and nourishing gasame stew! Ahhh, the mere thought of it makes my mouth flood...
TEXT_BANKJN305_02983_ZUKIN_000_023: You will enjoy it, too, I do not doubt. But as popular as it is, you must forgive us should it run out before you get a taste!
TEXT_BANKJN306_02984_ZUKIN_000_000: The key to a man's heart is through his stomach, . With this in mind, I would ask your help in maintaining an important partnership.
TEXT_BANKJN306_02984_ZUKIN_000_001: I have here two pots of our finest pickles, which I would gift to the sentries at the Coral Banquet. Pray see to it they are delivered.
TEXT_BANKJN306_02984_RIKUFU_000_010: You are far from home, adventurer. What business have you here?
TEXT_BANKJN306_02984_RIKUFU_000_011: Hah, if it isn't Kojin pickles! I had been looking forward to this! My thanks, friend!
TEXT_BANKJN306_02984_RIKUFU_000_012: Zukin has been sending us pickles on a regular basis. They bring much welcomed flavor to an otherwise bland day.
TEXT_BANKJN306_02984_MIDROVER02984_000_0: If you require something, please make it quick. I'm on patrol.
Well now, more pickles from the Kojin! There's been more contact between us of late, and I must say I appreciate these little gestures.
Please send them my thanks along with this message: should we turn up aught of note, they'll be the first to know.
Now, if you'll excuse me, I must be moving along.
TEXT_BANKJN306_02984_RUGAROVER02984_000_: You better have a good reason for distractin' me on watch! Might be as I drink hard, but I work hard as well! <hic>
Oh, shite, pickles from the Kojin!? You're a good sort, adventurer! A bloody good sort! <hic>
Let me tell you, these pickles and rice wine are a match made in heaven! Gah, this watch can't end soon enough! <hic>
Oh, I know─I'll move quicker! That way the watch'll end sooner! Haha, what a bloody brilliant idea! <hic>
TEXT_BANKJN306_02984_ZUKIN_000_030: Delivered the pickles, have you? Tell me, how did our Confederate friends respond?
TEXT_BANKJN306_02984_ZUKIN_000_031: ...So we continue to be held in good standing. That is well. A little kindness indeed goes a long way.
TEXT_BANKJN306_02984_ZUKIN_000_032: In the past, we Kojin would purchase such treasures as the Confederacy seized in lieu of the Ruby Tithe. By maintaining amicable relations, we have first pick of the merchandise. A fine arrangement, I'm sure you'll agree.
TEXT_BANKJN401_02985_ZUKIN_000_000: , might I ask a favor? Itomaki, one of our younglings, left in search of treasure near the wreck of the Kobayashi Maru and has yet to return.
TEXT_BANKJN401_02985_ZUKIN_000_001: Could you tell her to come back before she finds herself in any real trouble?
TEXT_BANKJN401_02985_SYSTEM_100_009: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing the word “Itomaki” to call out to the lost Kojin.
TEXT_BANKJN401_02985_ITOMAKI_000_010: (-???-)Hello? Did someone call my name? Erm...I don't suppose you could help me find my way to Tamamizu?
TEXT_BANKJN401_02985_SYSTEM_000_011: You hear a voice that seems to belong to the would-be treasure hunter. Search the area for Itomaki.
TEXT_BANKJN401_02985_ITOMAKI_000_020: Are you here to help me? I came here in search of treasure, but the currents seem to have shifted a bit and I'm afraid to say I'm rather lost.
TEXT_BANKJN401_02985_ITOMAKI_000_021: I managed to find this treasure, and judging by the craftsmanship, it seems rather valuable. Surely Zukin won't be so cross with me when he sees this! So, which way is the village?
TEXT_BANKJN401_02985_ITOMAKI_000_022: Unfortunately, I couldn't find so much as a rusted teaspoon. Oh well, I'm sure that Zukin will be pleased to see me safe and sound, treasure or no. Probably. So, which way was it?
TEXT_BANKJN401_02985_ITOMAKI_000_023: Oh, I see! Now that you mention it, that does look like the way home, doesn't it? Not to worry, I'll be back in two shakes of a gyuki's tail! Good-bye for now!
TEXT_BANKJN401_02985_ZUKIN_000_030: You found her, you say? You have my thanks, . She is only seventy summers old─nowhere near experienced enough to navigate the ever-changing Ruby Sea by herself.
TEXT_BANKJN401_02985_ZUKIN_000_031: She can barely make it from one side of the village to the other without asking for directions. <sigh> I daresay she will go wandering off again soon.
TEXT_BANKJN402_02986_ZUKIN_000_000: In our dealings with the Namazu, we have discovered that one of their favorite foods is the meat of the fearsome gyuki.
TEXT_BANKJN402_02986_ZUKIN_000_001: However, the Namazu struggle to acquire said meat by themselves. Shrewd in business they may be, but adept hunters they are not. Might I call upon your services once more?
TEXT_BANKJN402_02986_ZUKIN_000_020: So, was the hunt a success?
TEXT_BANKJN402_02986_ZUKIN_000_021: Kami have mercy! If size and stench are the measures by which Namazu judge their meat, I would say they will be more than satisfied.
TEXT_BANKJN402_02986_ZUKIN_000_022: Man and Kojin alike tend to be repulsed by such pungent, sinewy fodder, but the Namazu have no such aversions.
TEXT_BANKJN402_02986_ZUKIN_000_023: Trade in this otherwise worthless meat will help forge stronger ties with the Namazu and provide much-needed capital. Perhaps we can rely on your gyuki-slaying skills in the future?
TEXT_BANKJN403_02987_ZUKIN_000_000: , would you be able to assist one of the village elders? He swam all the way to Onokoro to trade with the locals, but he has been getting somewhat forgetful lately.
TEXT_BANKJN403_02987_ZUKIN_000_001: Although we are on good terms with the local pirates, there may be some who would take advantage of him. I would be grateful if you could assist him in his duties.
TEXT_BANKJN403_02987_OLDTURTLE02987_000_: Good day to you, most valued of customers! I have brought your order, as instructed.
Kami strike me down! Are you not the one awaiting delivery? Please forgive me─I fear my eyesight is beginning to fail me.
TEXT_BANKJN403_02987_OLDTURTLE02987_100_: Mean you to say that you will deliver these jars in my stead? Truth be told, I feel like I have been wandering around in circles trying to find my clients.
TEXT_BANKJN403_02987_OLDTURTLE02987_000_: I remember that they both have flowing, shimmering hair, but their names escape me. I shall return to Tamamizu forthwith, and let the others know that you have offered to help.
TEXT_BANKJN403_02987_OKMID2987_000_012: Good day to you! So you've come in place of the usual bloke to deliver my order, have you?
TEXT_BANKJN403_02987_OKMID2987_000_013: I've been waiting for this! It's a special lotion that takes the edge off the blazing sunshine. You see, in the mountains where I grew up, we're not used to having the sun beating down on us all day.
TEXT_BANKJN403_02987_OKMID2987_000_014: Without this I'd end up all red and crispy, like a boiled coralshell! Be sure to let the folk back in Tamamizu know this stuff works wonders!
TEXT_BANKJN403_02987_OKAURA2987_000_015: Is that my order? Oh, so you're the one doing the deliveries today?
TEXT_BANKJN403_02987_OKAURA2987_000_016: Have you seen this before? It's a traditional Kojin remedy for jellyfish stings, but it works just as well on you and me. Nowadays, we don't go fishing without it.
TEXT_BANKJN403_02987_OKAURA2987_000_017: Could you pass on my regards to the merchant? I know he's getting on a bit, but I hope he's well enough to carry on with his usual rounds.
TEXT_BANKJN403_02987_OKRUGA2987_000_018: What's this? My order from Tamamizu? Not who I was expecting, but I'll be glad to get it all the same.
TEXT_BANKJN403_02987_OKRUGA2987_000_019: Yes, yes! My luscious locks have been crying out for this miraculous formula! Rubbing a dollop of this into my hair gives it the most wonderful shine.
TEXT_BANKJN403_02987_OKRUGA2987_000_020: You know, I thought it would never arrive. Has that doddery old salesman fallen on his back and can't get up? Send him my thanks, would you?
TEXT_BANKJN403_02987_ZUKIN_000_040: Oh, back so soon? And you found the customers, you say? I am glad the delivery was successful, even if it did require considerable intervention on your part.
TEXT_BANKJN403_02987_ZUKIN_000_041: Our elderly entrepreneur wanted to express his gratitude, but has already sped off on another pressing engagement. I hope I am that sprightly when I reach his age!
TEXT_BANKJN404_02988_ZUKIN_000_000: There's something I would like you to investigate. I have had a report of an unusual object bobbing up and down on the waves. Apparently, it is giving off an unusual scent too.
TEXT_BANKJN404_02988_ZUKIN_000_001: It is probably nothing, but we should look into it all the same. The smell might be caused by it dissolving into the water, so we should put it into a waterproof bag to help keep it intact.
TEXT_BANKJN404_02988_ZUKIN_000_002: I would recommend showing it to Makura once you get back. She has a keen sense of smell, and will hopefully be able to tell us what it is.
TEXT_BANKJN404_02988_MAKURA_000_005: An unidentified fragrant object you say? Floating on the waves? If that's what I think it is, we had best retrieve it posthaste!
TEXT_BANKJN404_02988_MAKURA_000_011: Not quite what I was hoping for, but I'm sure we can find a use for it. I half expected it to be ambergris.
TEXT_BANKJN404_02988_MAKURA_000_012: While the fragrance is certainly pleasing, it's definitely not ambergris.
TEXT_BANKJN404_02988_MAKURA_000_013: This is it! Ambergris! Our devotion to the kami has been rewarded!
TEXT_BANKJN404_02988_MAKURA_000_014: Although we do not treat ambergris as “treasure” as such, it is nonetheless very rare and precious to the Kojin.
TEXT_BANKJN404_02988_MAKURA_000_015: Allow me to explain. Ambergris is said to be formed inside a dragon's gut─I jest not─and is sometimes found floating on the Ruby Sea.
TEXT_BANKJN404_02988_MAKURA_000_016: We have no method for ascertaining when or where it can be found. Owing to its scarcity, we treat it with the utmost care. It is used to produce incense like no other.
TEXT_BANKJN404_02988_MAKURA_000_017: I'll show this to the others and we'll decide how it should be used. If you come across anything similar, I would very much like to examine it!
TEXT_BANKJN404_02988_ZUKIN_000_020: Makura seemed very interested by your findings. Did I hear her mention ambergris? She would use it to make incense and whatnot, but that seems like a waste to me. Think of how much it would fetch at market!
TEXT_BANKJN404_02988_ZUKIN_000_021: Well, once again, your help in our investigations is much appreciated.
TEXT_BANKJN405_02989_ZUKIN_000_000: Hells' Lid is as unwelcoming a place as you are ever likely to find. Were it not for its abundance of shellfish, we would avoid it entirely.
TEXT_BANKJN405_02989_ZUKIN_000_001: Most of the creatures there will only turn to attack if we draw too close. However, the analas go to great lengths to hunt us down. Their ferocity is known throughout the Ruby Sea.
TEXT_BANKJN405_02989_ZUKIN_000_002: It is to you we must turn. Venture into their territory, slay any that confront you. A show of force should send the rest slinking back to their dens.
TEXT_BANKJN405_02989_ZUKIN_000_019: You are looking rather singed around the edges! Did the analas prove troublesome?
TEXT_BANKJN405_02989_ZUKIN_000_020: Glad tidings indeed. By your account, we have the shores of Hells' Lid to ourselves again. The area is safe for harvesting shellfish, for the time being at least.
TEXT_BANKJN405_02989_ZUKIN_000_021: Not only are they good for eating, but they are also used in the production of mother of pearl-inlaid pots. The Namazu gladly pay large sums for them, only to jump inside and stay there for hours on end.
TEXT_BANKJN405_02989_ZUKIN_000_022: Why? Perhaps the kami know, but I do not. I do know, however, that the analas will not be content to remain in their lairs like the Namazu in their pots. Should they emerge once more, we may require your aid.
TEXT_BANKJN406_02990_ZUKIN_000_000: Can I interest you in a new method of treasure hunting? Makura will explain all.
TEXT_BANKJN406_02990_MAKURA_000_010: Glad you could join us! My clever little ray has learned a new trick.
TEXT_BANKJN406_02990_MAKURA_000_011: You might have seen striped rays with their faces in the sand, looking for food. Normally they just swallow water and filter out the krill, but the tastiest morsels can be found under the seabed.
TEXT_BANKJN406_02990_MAKURA_000_012: There's a lot more than sediment and ray snacks down there though. This little one has learned how to search for treasure while he's at it! Why don't you take him out there and give it a try?
TEXT_BANKJN406_02990_MAKURA_000_013: The ray's been taught to come back here if you get separated. Once you've finished, Zukin will take care of the rest. Good luck!
TEXT_BANKJN406_02990_SYSTEM_000_020: The ray finds treasure beneath the sediment.
TEXT_BANKJN406_02990_MAKURA_000_025: I was wondering when you'd be back. Our friend seems eager to continue the search!
TEXT_BANKJN406_02990_MAKURA_000_026: There are a few spots nearby that may be worth a closer look.
TEXT_BANKJN406_02990_SYSTEM_000_027: This seems like a promising location. Ride the ray, and use his Inhale ability to search for treasure.
TEXT_BANKJN406_02990_ZUKIN_000_030: The ray's belly seems fit to burst. I advise you to stand back when he regurgitates everything. Hopefully there will be some treasure in there along with all the sand and muck.
TEXT_BANKJN406_02990_ZUKIN_000_031: Makura and her ray toiled for many days and nights to perfect that technique. Their efforts have paid dividends, as we are now able to recover many precious items that would otherwise remain undiscovered.
TEXT_BANKJN501_02991_ZUKIN_000_000: Mating season for striped rays is upon us. Their courtship rituals are long and complex, and begin with the male propelling a stream of sweet-smelling bubbles at an eligible female.
TEXT_BANKJN501_02991_ZUKIN_000_001: However, the females often reject attempts to impress them. The males become despondent as a result, so the ray handlers must encourage them to keep trying until they find a mate.
TEXT_BANKJN501_02991_ZUKIN_000_002: Over by Sui-no-Sato is a male ray who is reluctant to continue with the rituals. Perhaps you could assist his trainer?
TEXT_BANKJN501_02991_SYSTEM_000_011: Search for the female striped ray. You may move the camera, as well as zoom in and out. Target the female striped ray and launch bubbles with .
TEXT_BANKJN501_02991_ATTENDANT02991_000_: Oh, what a pity! That was a fine attempt, but she's just not interested. She seems to turn away all the males though, not just our little friend here.
That was very nicely done, but he might need to try a few more times before she pays him any attention.
Look at that! This is the first time I've seen her show so much interest! She's ignored every other male until now.
Well, it looks like she's had enough for now. We'd better call it a day as well.
TEXT_BANKJN501_02991_ATTENDANT02991_100_: Our young friend here has made a lot of progress. His technique is slowly improving. Perhaps it won't be long before he finds a match!
TEXT_BANKJN501_02991_ATTENDANT02991_000_: Oh, are you here to help? I have spent all day training him, but he has become sullen and uncooperative. I think a fresh approach might do him some good. Would you like to try?
TEXT_BANKJN501_02991_ZUKIN_000_022: It would appear that the ray responded well to your instruction. The handler tells me that if he perseveres, he will find a mate sooner or later.
TEXT_BANKJN501_02991_ZUKIN_000_023: Striped rays are essential to our way of life, but pairing the males and females can be a little troublesome. In most cases, the males must attempt the mating ritual over and over before they succeed.
TEXT_BANKJN501_02991_ZUKIN_000_024: Since you have a knack for this, we may benefit from your help in the days to come.
TEXT_BANKJN501_02991_SYSTEM_000_025: The male stares into the distance. With the female gone, he seems at a loss.
TEXT_BANKJN501_02991_ATTENDANT02991_000_: We will stay here and continue practicing. I am sure that Zukin will be interested to hear how everything went. Fare you well!
TEXT_BANKJN502_02992_ZUKIN_000_000: One of our members has found three coffers washed ashore on Shoal Rock. They appeared to be of Eorzean make, but more he could not glean, for they were tightly sealed by some mechanism unknown to us.
TEXT_BANKJN502_02992_ZUKIN_000_001: We have some experience in opening locked chests, but not those made in western lands. I daresay you would be able to puzzle it out, however. Would you care to look into the matter?
TEXT_BANKJN502_02992_ZUKIN_000_021: You found these? Let me see... Old western currency, and minted from precious metals besides. Thank you for bringing these to me!
TEXT_BANKJN502_02992_ZUKIN_000_022: What? Coffers that spring to life, snapping viciously? Could they be evil spirits, lying in wait for hapless treasure seekers? Or tsukomogami run amok, perhaps? This is indeed cause for concern.
TEXT_BANKJN502_02992_ZUKIN_000_023: In any event, full glad am I to see you uninjured. Though danger was not on my mind when I asked your aid, I was right to turn to a hardy adventurer such as you.
TEXT_BANKJN503_02993_ZUKIN_000_000: Your efforts to aid the Kojin of the Blue have brought prosperity to our humble village. Our wares are known far and wide. Trade with the Namazu and Qestir has been especially profitable.
TEXT_BANKJN503_02993_ZUKIN_000_001: But even as we enjoy new relations, we do not forget the old. The people of Isari traded with us when no one else would, and we continue to trade with them to this day.
TEXT_BANKJN503_02993_ZUKIN_000_002: And today, there are some items that want for collection at the village─their payment for goods we provided them with earlier. Our merchants have been very busy, and struggle to find time to make regular visits there.
TEXT_BANKJN503_02993_ZUKIN_000_003: The items in question were still being prepared when last we visited, but they should be ready by now. Let me see─dried fish, a wooden bucket, and a fish basket. Will you visit the village in our stead?
TEXT_BANKJN503_02993_ISARIOLDMAN02993_00: You're here from Tamamizu, you say? I've got these dried fish for you to take back.
Our Kojin friends always request this. As I hear it, they don't have the right conditions where they live to make sun-dried goods themselves.
TEXT_BANKJN503_02993_ISARIOLDMAN02993_10: There are two things we have plenty of around here: fish and sunshine. All I do is put the two together. Well, that and the fishing part beforehand. Speaking of which, I'd best get back to it. Bye now!
TEXT_BANKJN503_02993_ISARIWOMAN02993_000: The Tamamizu traders sent you, did they? They brought us some lovely coral the other day, but the bucket we promised them wasn't ready then. It's finished now though!
My poor old Da was bedridden, and couldn't work for a while. But those Blue Kojin, good folk through and through, didn't mind the delay one bit.
TEXT_BANKJN503_02993_ISARIWOMAN02993_100: Brought a tear to my eye, it did... Anyway, Da got it done as soon as he was out of bed. Give them our thanks!
TEXT_BANKJN503_02993_ISARIMAN02993_000_0: What's that? A fish basket for who? ...Ahhh, the Kojin! That's right, I was supposed to give them one!
TEXT_BANKJN503_02993_ISARIMAN02993_100_0: With the Empire buggering off and leaving us to our waters, demand for fishing gear is higher than ever! I'd run out of baskets just before the traders came to collect theirs.
TEXT_BANKJN503_02993_ZUKIN_000_020: Were you able to collect the goods?
TEXT_BANKJN503_02993_ZUKIN_000_021: Yes, these will do nicely. You may notice that none of these things are worth much. So why do we trade for these wares? The reason is simple.
TEXT_BANKJN503_02993_ZUKIN_000_022: Isari suffered a great deal under the Empire, with fishing and trade heavily restricted. This is our way of helping, by asking only that which they can afford to give. We shall continue to support them, as they support us.
TEXT_BANKJN504_02994_ZUKIN_000_000: I have a new assignment for you, . As you know, we have recently opened trade agreements with the Qestir.
TEXT_BANKJN504_02994_ZUKIN_000_001: And I have a mind to impress─offer them something that only we Kojin and those blessed by the kami can provide. A precious treasure found deep in the Turquoise Trench.
TEXT_BANKJN504_02994_ZUKIN_000_002: There you will find several glowing crystals of immense proportions. When small pieces come loose, they form what we call “lunar orbs,” which resemble the moon itself. Will you help us gather them from the depths?
TEXT_BANKJN504_02994_ZUKIN_000_020: How fare you in the search?
TEXT_BANKJN504_02994_ZUKIN_000_021: Beautiful! Is it not fascinating how they are formed into such perfect little spheres? Shaped by ocean currents, perhaps. And see how brightly they shine! We could use these to light the village at night.
TEXT_BANKJN504_02994_ZUKIN_000_022: The Qestir worship Nhaama, goddess of the moon and dusk. I expect they will gladly pay large sums for these lunar orbs. Many thanks for your cooperation!
TEXT_BANKJN505_02995_ZUKIN_000_000: Mother of pearl is used in many of our crafts, as you may have seen. The rarely seen diamond oyster is a prime source, and a whole host of them have suddenly appeared on the Isle of Bekko.
TEXT_BANKJN505_02995_ZUKIN_000_001: One of our craftsmen has gone to open up the shells and gather the contents on-site. However, diamond oysters are notoriously hard to open, so perhaps he would benefit from an extra pair of hands?
TEXT_BANKJN505_02995_KAISURI02995_000_01: Oh! I've seen you before! You are a friend of the Divine Circle, yes? And now you are here to help me? Must be my lucky day.

I'm after the mother of pearl inside those oysters, but the damned things won't open! Hard as diamonds they are! They certainly live up to their name. I've tried prising them apart, dropping rocks on them, but no joy.

The only thing I haven't tried is explosives. A bit of gentle persuasion, and they should pop right open! I hate to admit it, but I'm scared I might do myself a mischief. I don't suppose you could give it a try?
Once a bomb is set to blow, remember to give it a wide berth! We don't want bits of adventurer being blasted all over the place, do we now?
I will be standing here supervising, well out of harm's way. All right then, off you go!
TEXT_BANKJN505_02995_KAISURI02995_000_02: Nicely done! The oysters are a bit more “obliterated” than I would've liked, but fragments of mother of pearl are better than nothing at all. Many thanks!
Gathering all those bits of shell is rather a daunting task. I'm just trying to motivate myself to actually get started.
TEXT_BANKJN505_02995_ZUKIN_000_030: All finished? ...Explosives, you say? I am no expert in mother of pearl, but I do not imagine it takes well to being blown up like that. However, I will defer to our artisan friend on this occasion.
TEXT_BANKJN505_02995_ZUKIN_000_031: His works sell very well in Kugane, you know. If he finds a way to increase production, there might be enough to sell to markets farther afield too. Once more, you have my gratitude.
TEXT_BANKJN506_02996_ZUKIN_000_000: All kinds of things come floating in on the waves. A lot of the time, it's just worthless junk, but some days we do find the odd treasure. If the kami are good, today could be one such day.
TEXT_BANKJN506_02996_ZUKIN_000_001: We've spotted the remains of an accident at sea, , drifting on the surface a malm or so from the village. It costs nothing to look, and it might even be valuable!
TEXT_BANKJN506_02996_ZUKIN_000_020: Ah, , you have returned. Did you find anything interesting?
TEXT_BANKJN506_02996_ZUKIN_000_021: Let me see. Barnacle-encrusted flotsam, rotting wood covered in greyish slime...and a precious treasure, beautifully aged, fit for a kami!
TEXT_BANKJN506_02996_ZUKIN_000_022: What's that? It all looks like rubbish? Yes, that is what most shell-less ones say. Many people misunderstand us, and think we just enjoy collecting junk. However, we know how to look beyond mere appearances.
TEXT_BANKJN506_02996_ZUKIN_000_023: Of course, the shape and color are important, but there is also the way it ages with the passing of time, taking on divine properties. Let me tell you, no one knows treasure better than me!
TEXT_BANKJN601_02997_ZUKIN_000_000: , you are familiar with giant clams, yes? They have an appetite to match their prodigious size, and are known to indiscriminately devour random objects that drift by.
TEXT_BANKJN601_02997_ZUKIN_000_001: I would be grateful if you could seek out these clams, prise them open, and bring back the slick debris you find inside. Four such pieces should suffice.
TEXT_BANKJN601_02997_ZUKIN_000_020: Ah, there you are, and with your arms intact. Just as well─we may still have need of them. But come, let us see what the clams have rendered up.
TEXT_BANKJN601_02997_ZUKIN_000_021: Yes, these are precisely what I sought! You have done well, my friend.
TEXT_BANKJN601_02997_ZUKIN_000_022: When a foreign object settles inside a shell, it gradually develops a hard and lustrous coating. While such articles are not as valuable as a well-formed pearl, they are not without worth. Nor is it unheard of for clams to be holding treasures!
TEXT_BANKJN602_02998_ZUKIN_000_000: Ah, , the very  I was seeking. There is a task I would have you perform in the name of trade relations.
TEXT_BANKJN602_02998_ZUKIN_000_001: Take these live ruby shrimp and release them along the shore of Sakazuki. This will lure out tatsunoko, whose roe you may then harvest.
TEXT_BANKJN602_02998_ZUKIN_000_002: Once you have the roe, pray deliver it to the cook at the Ruby Price. He will know what to do with it. My thanks in advance, .
TEXT_BANKJN602_02998_COOK02998_000_020: Looking for the cook? You've found him. What is it you require?
TEXT_BANKJN602_02998_COOK02998_000_021: Oho, if this isn't tatsunoko roe, and some of the freshest I've seen! Compliments of Zukin, you say? Well, how thoughtful of him!
TEXT_BANKJN602_02998_COOK02998_000_022: In case you didn't know, tatsunoko roe is a rare delicacy. I'll be able to prepare such a treat for our troops as they seldom enjoy! Now, such kindness shouldn't go unacknowledged...
TEXT_BANKJN602_02998_COOK02998_000_023: One of the finest wines I have in my stores. Please give it to Zukin along with my regards. And with that, I take my leave─I have a feast to prepare!
TEXT_BANKJN602_02998_ZUKIN_000_030: ...Our gift was so well received that we received one in return? Wonderful!
TEXT_BANKJN602_02998_ZUKIN_000_031: <sniff> Ah, this is truly a fine rice wine. We've not the means to brew our own, so it is doubly appreciated. My thanks for handling the task, .
TEXT_BANKJN602_02998_ZUKIN_000_032: Ever since we began trading with Kokajiya, travel to Kugane has become a regularity. This in turn led to more opportunities for contact with the Ruby Price.
TEXT_BANKJN602_02998_ZUKIN_000_033: For now, the fortification serves simply as a convenient waypoint, but ere long it will become a destination in its own right. Our efforts to establish new trade channels continue to flourish, and we owe no small part of our success to you.
TEXT_BANKJN603_02999_ZUKIN_000_000: The Red's recent activities give me cause for concern, . They have begun moving their imperial weaponry out of storage. There can be no doubt─they are planning an assault, and we may well be the targets.
TEXT_BANKJN603_02999_ZUKIN_000_001: To see that this does not come to pass, I have a mind to sabotage these weapons. We have some Confederate explosives that would be suitable for this purpose, but they are not made for large Kojin hands.
TEXT_BANKJN603_02999_ZUKIN_000_002: And so we must turn to you. I ask that you infiltrate the Red stronghold, the Isle of Zekki, and use the explosives to destroy the imperial crates that you see lying about. May the kami bless you and keep you!
TEXT_BANKJN603_02999_ZUKIN_100_002: , I've awaited your return with bated breath! Tell me you were able to destroy the weapons!
TEXT_BANKJN603_02999_ZUKIN_000_003: Oh, the relief! Thanks to you, we may rest easy for a while. But that is not to say we can afford to slacken our vigil.
TEXT_BANKJN603_02999_ZUKIN_000_004: Even assuming the Red are defanged for now, they can easily acquire more weapons from their imperial masters. We may well have need of your prowess again.
TEXT_BANKJN604_03000_ZUKIN_000_000: We had some old treasure chests that were lying around, gathering dust. With some creativity on my part, I was able to convert them into octopus traps. And they work exceptionally well, if I may say so myself.
TEXT_BANKJN604_03000_ZUKIN_000_001: Now, I've a mind to gift the good folk of Kokajiya with a fresh catch, and I should be grateful if you could go out and inspect the traps.
TEXT_BANKJN604_03000_ZUKIN_000_002: I've laid three over by the wreck southwest of here. One is bound to have caught an octopus by now. My thanks in advance, .
TEXT_BANKJN604_03000_SYSTEM_000_010: There is nothing in this chest.
TEXT_BANKJN604_03000_SYSTEM_000_011: There is a mess of writhing tentacles in the chest!
TEXT_BANKJN604_03000_ZUKIN_000_020: Ah, there you are. Did the kami bless us with a catch?
TEXT_BANKJN604_03000_ZUKIN_000_021: Oho, such a large and lively octopus! Our blacksmith friends shall be pleased!
TEXT_BANKJN604_03000_ZUKIN_000_023: By the way, did I mention that older chests wreathed in weeds make the best traps? Well, they do. You may wish to remember this for your future reference.
TEXT_BANKJN605_03001_ZUKIN_000_000: , we have a situation! A band of Red have made off with merchandise due to be delivered to Kokajiya...and that isn't the worst of it.
TEXT_BANKJN605_03001_ZUKIN_000_001: Seeking to reclaim the stolen articles, one of our hot-headed brothers struck out for the Isle of Zekki, but he is slow to return. I fear for his life. Please, find him and bring him back safely!
TEXT_BANKJN605_03001_BALLOON_000_011: You will pay for your trespass!
TEXT_BANKJN605_03001_HOTTURTLE03001_000_: Y-You are of the Divine Circle? My thanks!
Were it not for your timely intervention, our merchandise would have been lost, never mind my life. But come, let us quit this place ere more Red appear.
TEXT_BANKJN605_03001_ZUKIN_000_020: , pleased am I to see you hale and whole. Our hot-headed brother, too, returned a short while ago, none the worse for his ill-conceived foray, and with the merchandise intact.
TEXT_BANKJN605_03001_ZUKIN_000_021: While it is enough that none of us came to harm, I am grateful that we will be able to fulfill our trade obligations. You have my humblest thanks.
TEXT_BANKJN606_03002_ZUKIN_000_000: , we're having trouble with some of our young rays. Though small in size, they are incurably willful, and keep wandering beyond our territory in spite of repeated chidings. Even now, they roam the Crab Pots, heedless of the dangers.
TEXT_BANKJN606_03002_ZUKIN_000_001: Loath though I am to do this, they want for discipline, and I would have you be the one to impose it. Please track down the three rays, give them a bit of a drubbing, and then feed them these pellets─a bitter punctuation to the lesson.
TEXT_BANKJN606_03002_ZUKIN_000_002: Lest you feel bad─do not. It is for their own safety. They must be made to understand that the outside world is fraught with peril.
TEXT_BANKJN606_03002_ZUKIN_000_010: Ah, there you are. How fared the disciplinary effort?
TEXT_BANKJN606_03002_ZUKIN_000_011: My thanks, . The lesson ought to keep the little ones in line for the foreseeable future.
TEXT_BANKJN606_03002_ZUKIN_000_012: Though it may not be apparent at present, they are some of the finest rays we have bred. We would see them realize their potential, and at times this necessitates a firm hand.
TEXT_BANKJN606_03002_ZUKIN_000_013: To be sure, willfulness is not an inherently negative trait. It is but a shade of determination, which we hope to foster in them.
TEXT_BANKJN606_03002_ZUKIN_000_014: With any luck, no further such discipline will be necessary, but in the event that it is, I trust you will be willing to assist us again.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_MRAHZNUN_000_001: Greetings, . I'm glad to see you looking hale and hearty.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_MRAHZNUN_000_002: We're fortunate that you returned unscathed from that business involving the Percipient One. Thanks to you and M'zhet Tia, the Qalyana have been keeping away from it.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_MRAHZNUN_000_003: Speaking of the Ananta, a messenger from the Vira came by not long ago looking for you. Sarisha has some matters she'd like to discuss with you. Perhaps you could pay her a visit?
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SARISHA_000_010: Welcome, . Allow me to once again expresss our gratitude for your heroic deeds.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SARISHA_000_011: Your vanquishing of the Qalyana's vile sssimulacrum of Sri Lakshmi is worthy of the utmossst praise. While I am reluctant to have to ask for your aid yet again, there is a matter of persssonal importance I wish to discusss with you.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SARISHA_000_012: To think that the Qalyana should sssummon that mockery of Sri Lakshmi for a second time makes my blood boil. Our village owes much to your bravery, and yet I am compelled to request your aid once again.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SARISHA_000_013: My beloved daughter Alpa is a member of the Resissstance. Though she is young and unskilled in the ways of war, she labors tirelesssly for the freedom of Gyr Abania.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SARISHA_000_014: Now that the Garleans have relinquished their grip on the region, many Vira who ssserve in the Resissstance will be called back to Vira Nilya. As my daughter, Alpa's presence is required above all others.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SARISHA_000_015: One day, Alpa will inherit the mantle of broodmother, and there is much I must teach her. Despite our newfound freedom, many trials await in the days to come for all the peoples of Gyr Abania. We need not only ssstrong leaders, but able sssuccessors to lead us into the future.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SARISHA_000_016: I have written a letter for Alpa explaining why she must return to Vira Nilya at once. However, I anticipate that her sssuperiors will be against her leaving on sssuch short notice.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SARISHA_100_016: As a friend to the Resistance, you would be able to persssuade them to release her from ssservice. Will you grant us your cooperation?
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SARISHA_000_019: Please give thisss letter to Alpa. She is stationed in Rhalgr's Reach. I pray for a sssatisfactory outcome.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_MRAHZNUN_000_020: Have you spoken with the Vira broodmother? The messenger was quite insistent that you visit sooner rather than later.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_030: Yes, I am Alpa. A misssive from Mother, you say?
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_032: She wants me to leave the Resistance and return to Vira Nilya? This is absssurd!
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_033: I'm pleased that she has such high expectations of me, but I've still got work to do here with the Resissstance!
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_JOLHMYN_100_034: First things first. Haven't you got anything to say to the one who brought you the letter?
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_035: You're right. Where are my manners? I am very grateful to you for delivering this messsage.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_036: Ah! You're , conqueror of Cassstellum Velodyna, aren't you?
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_JOLHMYN_000_037: Of course, I recognized you straightaway.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_JOLHMYN_000_038: It's a pleasure to finally meet you in person. The name's J'olhmyn, and I report to Alpa here, believe it or not.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_039: I sssuppose I should explain why I don't want to go back, ssseeing as you've traveled all this way.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_040: Although I have asssumed the title of battlemaid, fighting isn't exactly my forte. I'm much better at metalworking, and since joining the Resistance, I have been placed in command of a small group of blacksmiths.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_041: While the others were out capturing Velodyna, I was here in the Reach crafting armaments. If only I could have been there with them!
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_042: I am proud of the work we do sssupporting our soldiers, but I want to be more involved. That's why I've come up with a plan to turn Castellum Velodyna into a Resistance fortress, with the newly formed Velodyna Gatekeepers in charge!
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_JOLHMYN_100_043: Alpa went straight to our commanding officers and volunteered for the post of captain. It was certainly a surprise to hear they'd agreed to it! But she was only given permission on the grounds that I be assigned as her second-in-command.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_100_044: And she's been nagging me conssstantly ever since! Anyway, my blacksmiths are mainly made up of Ananta, since we excel at forging weapons and armor. On the other hand, most of the frontline units include both Ananta and ssstriders.
