TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_200_044: Our superiors were concerned that even though I'm a member of the Resistance, I've ssspent most of the time among my own kind. J'olhmyn's here to teach me the ways of the other peoples of Gyr Abania.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_JOLHMYN_200_044: Although officially she's the one leading the unit, I'm here to act as her mentor.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_JOLHMYN_300_044: <sigh> She's still got a lot to learn about us “ssstriders” though. The other day, she tried to take off my uniform!
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_400_044: Are you ssstill going on about that? I thought you were getting ready to shed your skin so I tried to help you out of your clothes.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_JOLHMYN_400_044: How many times do I have to tell you? We don't molt like Ananta, you bumbling ninny─ I just had an itchy back, that's all! And I'm quite capable of getting undressed by myself!
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_500_044: Ahem! Let's not get into all that again. Ssso, where were we? Ah, the letter.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_044: I will send word to Mother to tell her why I'm not going home. I'm sssorry to have involved you in all this.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_046: While you're here, there's something I'd like to ask you. Would you be able to meet us at Velodyna?
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_047: Thank you so much! J'olhmyn and I will wait for you at the castellum.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SARISHA_000_050: Please ensure that my daughter returns to her rightful place.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_JOLHMYN_000_055: Looking for Alpa? You're in luck─she's right here.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_060: You're here! I hope you had a sssafe journey. As I mentioned earlier, the Resistance wishes to repurpose this place as a new stronghold.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_061: The bridge is very important, ssstrategically ssspeaking, and is mainly used by Allied forces going to and from Gridania. But now that the imperial forces have been driven out, we can expect more civilian traffic in the future.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_062: That said, if ten score legionaries suddenly showed up and demanded their bridge back, we'd be hard-pressed to hold them off with the forces we have ssstationed here now.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_063: Tell me, , what do other peoples do at times like thisss?
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_A2_000_001: The Grand Companies recruit fool adventurers like me...
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_A2_000_002: In Ishgard, the Temple Knights petition adventurers to undertake leves.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_065: What a fantastic idea! Adventurers could cover our lack of enlisted sssoldiers, at least for the time being. Let's spread the word that the Velodyna Gatekeepers are offering work!
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_082: There's not a moment to lose! You're an adventurer─ You'll sssign up to help, won't you?
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_Q3_000_000: Will you lend your strength to the Velodyna Gatekeepers?
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_A3_000_001: I sssuppose I can lend you my ssstrength.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_100_082: A thousand thousand blessings upon you!
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_200_082: I understand. If that is your decision, we won't keep you here. But if you have a change of heart, you know where to find usss.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_100_066: Ah! Sssomeone's coming! Wait─ Is that who I think it is?
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SARISHA_000_069: I read your messsage, Alpa. You have formed the Velodyna Gatekeepers and been made their captain?
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_070: That's what I wrote, isn't it? I've got an important asssignment and I intend to see it through!
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SARISHA_000_071: Oh? And what is thisss “important asssignment” of which you ssspeak?
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_100_072: I'm responsssible for converting this place into a full-fledged Resistance fortress! It's vital to the defense of both Gridania and Gyr Abania!
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SARISHA_000_072: Alpa, you possesss many virtues, but ssstrength in battle is not among them. Yet you believe you are capable of leading this endeavor?
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SARISHA_100_072: Very well. The entire region ssstands to benefit from ssstrengthened borders, our village included.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SARISHA_200_072: But remember, Alpa. You are my heir. You cannot shirk this responsibility forever. You may remain here on one condition.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SARISHA_300_072: It will sssoon be time for me to shed my skin. When it is over, I shall return to inssspect this stronghold. If your work is found to be unsssatisfactory, nothing you say or do will stop me from taking you back to Vira Nilya.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_073: Fine! Have it your way! When you sssee what I've done with this place, you'll regret ever doubting me!
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SARISHA_000_074: I look forward to it. Until we meet again, fare you well.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SARISHA_100_074: It ssseems my debt to you continues to grow. Please, grant my daughter your counsssel. Though she is rash and impulsive, her spirit burns brightly.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_JOLHMYN_000_075: So, if we succeed, Velodyna will provide Vira Nilya with greater security. If we fail, the village gets its future successor back. Your mother certainly knows how to negotiate.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_076: We won't fail. I'll do everything in my power, and more, to sssucceed!
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_JOLHMYN_000_078: If you say so, captain! Right, what needs doing first?
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_079: If we're going to hire adventurers, we need to choose the right person for each job. We need to think about payment too.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_JOLHMYN_000_080: Got it. I'll tell Eshana, Madhura, and the others to start getting things organized.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_000_081: I knew I could rely on you! There's still a good deal of time before Mother sheds her ssskin so let's use it as best we can. Put up the banners─they'll show everyone that this castellum is now under the jurisdiction of the Velodyna Gatekeepers!
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_ALPA_100_081: I hope we can count on your help too, !
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SYSTEM_000_083: The Velodyna Gatekeepers have taken command of Castellum Velodyna.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SYSTEM_000_084: You have achieved Friendly reputation with the Vira.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SYSTEM_000_085: Vira society quests are now available from Eshana at Castellum Velodyna.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_SYSTEM_000_086: Furthermore, you may now purchase wares from Madhura.
TEXT_BANANA001_03036_JOLHMYN_000_090: Alpa's champing at the bit to get started, so don't keep her waiting any longer!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_100_001: Oh, there you are, . We've just received a report from Eshana.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_JOLHMYN_200_001: "At present, the broodmother's skin is smooth.“ Wait─What in Rhalgr's name is this?
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_300_001: Good news, that's what. While it's sssmooth, we still have time before she needs to molt. Once it starts to dry, we'll know the day of the inspection is approaching.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_JOLHMYN_400_001: Well, I'll take your word for it! As much as I'd love to spend all day talking about your mother's skin, isn't there something else we were going to discuss?
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_001: Yesss, there is. A problem's come up and I could use your advice. The castellum is under threat of demolition!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_JOLHMYN_100_002: Hold your chocobos─nothing's been decided yet. Perhaps you should start from the beginning for 's sake.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_002: As you know, this was originally an imperial sssupply depot. That great big tower in the middle was built as an airship dock, which we now use for surveying the surrounding area. You can see for malms from up there!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_JOLHMYN_000_003: The trouble is, some of the Resistance members think we should blow the whole thing up! “It's a constant reminder of the days of imperial rule!” they say, but they're letting sentiment cloud their judgment─it's too important to lose.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_JOLHMYN_000_004: They're also forgetting that we don't have the time or resources to build a new bridge. And while we mull things over, there's no telling what those lunatics will do!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_JOLHMYN_050_004: Suffice it to say, we're in a bit of a bind.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_100_004: We can't let anyone tear it down. If the castellum is destroyed, it would mean the end of the Gatekeepers. I'd have no choice but to return to Vira Nilya.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_005: Luckily, I have an idea. We Vira decorate our villages differently to the Qalyana's, which makes them easy to tell apart.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_006: We should be able to do the same thing with this place. If we make something to symbolize that the castellum is part of Ala Mhigo, we won't need to do anything drastic like rebuilding it from scratch.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_JOLHMYN_000_007: You know, that's not such a bad idea! But what exactly did you have in mind?
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_008: It needs to be traditional─something distinctly Ala Mhigan. To be honest, I don't know much about ssstriders and their culture. Do you have any suggestions, J'olhmyn?
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_JOLHMYN_000_009: I suppose the most obvious thing would be the griffin on the Ala Mhigan flag, but that's no good.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_JOLHMYN_000_010: It was also the symbol of the royal family, which includes the mad king Theodoric, of course. I don't think people would appreciate being reminded of him. Sorry Alpa, nothing else springs to mind.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_011: Hmmm... Many peoples live throughout Gyr Abania, and we'll struggle to please them all. We would benefit from an outsider's opinion, sssomeone unbiased towards the needs of any particular group.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_100_011: They'd need to know a lot about local hissstory too. , can you think of anyone?
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_A1_000_001: There's an Adder officer at Castrum Oriens who springs to mind.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_A1_000_002: Sssorry, no one I know fitsss the bill.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_013: That's a shame. I thought you would've met sssomeone on your travels. Try thinking a bit harder!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_014: Tahla Molkoh? Right! It's decided. We'll meet you there.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_TAHLAMOLKOH_000_020: The mighty Griffin's Bane has descended upon Castrum Oriens once more!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_TAHLAMOLKOH_100_020: We really appreciate your help with that whole Black Rose debacle. We've only just finished cleaning up the mess left behind by the Qalyana.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_021: Did she just say “Griffin's Bane”? What does that mean?
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_JOLHMYN_000_022: A title, I'd wager. Maybe we ought to call  that too?
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_TAHLAMOLKOH_000_023: Really now! There's no need to be so coy about it. I can think of no better tribute to your remarkable feats of heroism!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_024: I think we'll stick to just “” for now. Anyway, I'm Alpa, captain of the Velodyna Gatekeepers. You might be wondering what brings us here. We'd like to asssk your opinion.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_TAHLAMOLKOH_000_025: While I cannot guarantee I'll be able to provide the assistance you seek, I'll do my utmost to help nevertheless.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_026: I heard you know a lot about Ala Mhigan hissstory...
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_TAHLAMOLKOH_000_027: I see your point. Visitors to Ala Mhigo probably won't think highly of being ushered through a former imperial stronghold upon arrival. I agree that it should celebrate Ala Mhigo's unique culture.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_TAHLAMOLKOH_000_028: A griffin design should meet your requirements.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_JOLHMYN_000_029: That was our one and only idea. We were worried that using the crest of the old royal family would dredge up a lot of unpleasant memories.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_TAHLAMOLKOH_000_030: If it were a single griffin, that may be the case. However, I propose using a pair of griffins.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_TAHLAMOLKOH_100_031: Once they find a mate they become inseparable. In Gyr Abanian heraldry, a pair of griffins rampant has represented undying loyalty since time immemorial.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_032: In that case, I should use my metalworking skills to craft two griffin sculptures!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_033: Thanks for your advice, Tahla! Come and visit us at the castellum sssometime!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_TAHLAMOLKOH_000_034: It would be my pleasure! I wish you the best of luck.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_JOLHMYN_000_035: I'll start gathering metal for the statues. It might take me a while, especially if we're making two of them. Alpa, you go and find other Ananta to help with the crafting.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_JOLHMYN_100_035: , would you be able to bring us a griffin? I imagine it would be hard to sculpt one without seeing the real thing from up close. Probably best to use a tamed one though.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_JOLHMYN_000_036: Giff the griffin handler over at the Reach ought to be able to sort something out. If I were you, I'd start by having a word with him.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_000_050: What can I do for you?
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_000_051: Eh? You've got a friend who wants to “borrow” a griffin? Who do you want me to take it to?
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_000_052: Alpa? The leader of those damn fools hells-bent on preserving Velodyna? Hmph. You ask me, they ought to blow the bloody thing to smithereens and be done with it!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_000_053: But, well...since it's you that's asking, I suppose I can oblige. Go on ahead─I'll meet you there with the griffin.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_TAHLAMOLKOH_000_055: So Griffin's Bane is tasked with procuring an actual griffin? I hope you'll treat this one better than the last!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_000_060: Sorry to keep you waiting, ─I got a bit delayed on the way over. Anyway, here's the griffin as requested.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_061: It's beautiful! The statues should turn out wonderfully if I fashion them in the image of this fine ssspecimen.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_100_061: Statues? What are you talking about?  didn't mention that!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_200_061: I want to decorate the entrance with a pair of griffin sssculptures to welcome travelers into Ala Mhigo. They'll be based on your griffin!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_300_061: You mean to say me and my griffin came all the way here for some bloody statues? You snot-nosed little gobshite─sod off back to Vira Nilya so we can smash this bridge down!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ESHANA_410_062: Show sssome respect! She is our captain. We will not allow you to ssspeak to her like that.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_420_062: Captain, eh? I don't see how anyone could take orders from her─she's just a child!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ESHANA_430_062: Listen well, ssstrider. When I first volunteered for the Resissstance, every unit I tried to join rejected me. For all my determination, I simply lack the ssstrength needed for frontline warfare. I had no purpose, nowhere to go but back to my village.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ESHANA_440_062: That was until Alpa asked me to work as a weaponsssmith. She showed me that I do not need to be a fighter to contribute.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ESHANA_450_062: She may be young, but she has earned our loyalty.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_470_062: I couldn't give a Qiqirn's arse! I'm only here because  asked me. <sigh> Let's just get this over with.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_480_061: You'll help? I won't forget this!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_500_061: If you're going to make a statue of a griffin, you'd better do a good job of it. They look impressive enough when they're standing still, but have you ever seen one buffet its prey with a blast of wind? Now that's something special.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_600_061: No, I haven't! I'd like to experience these buffeting winds for myself.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_700_061: Is...is this some sort of joke?
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_800_061: Do I look like I'm joking?
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_900_061: The girl's gone stark raving mad! If she wants to have this griffin attack her with the force of a hurricane, that's her business─just leave me out of it!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_100_062: Fine. You're not the only one around here capable of riding a griffin! , I hear you're quite experienced with chocobos and whatnot. Why don't you give it a try? Hit me with a buffet of wind!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_200_062: We should probably find somewhere else to do this. Our comrades might find being asssaulted by bellowing winds a bit distracting, to put it mildly. I'll be waiting by the gates.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ESHANA_000_063: Ha ha ha! She never ceassses to amaze me.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_000_065: Once you're on the griffin, coax it into sending a gust of wind in the direction of that youngling. Just try not to overdo it, all right?
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_000_066: If you dismount at any point, come back here. I'll get you back in the saddle.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_67: I'll be fine! It takes more than a little wind to rattle an Ananta.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_100_070: That's it! Make it send a blassst this way!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_071: <pant> That was a lot stronger than I was expecting! Unfortunately, I couldn't help closing my eyes right at the vital moment.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_400_071: It was only a glimpse but I definitely saw it!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_500_071: I think one more time should be enough!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_600_071: Get ready for one last buffet!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_900_071: I saw it as clear as day! Now I know how its prey must feel!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_950_072: That will do nicely! All right, , you can get down now!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_073: I'd better get to work while it's ssstill fresh in my mind.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_000_075: You want to get back on? The griffin's ready.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_000_081: With this incredible statue, no one will doubt that Ala Mhigo is on the path to regaining its former glory.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_000_082: You've achieved what I thought was impossible. You've transformed this imperial fortress into something our countrymen can be proud of.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_083: Heh heh! I'm quite pleased with the results myself!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_000_084: To say I'm impressed would be an understatement. I'd heard the Ananta used magic to shape metal, but to see it for myself... It was breathtaking.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_100_084: If you think that's impressive, wait until we finish the other one!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_200_084: I'm sure you know better than most what a pair of griffins represents.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_000_085: Everlasting friendship... By Rhalgr, that's perfect! And to think I was going around saying we should tear this place down! Now I realize what a waste that would've been.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_086: Well, I'm glad you sssee things our way. Besides, we couldn't have done this without your griffin!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_087: Such a majestic creature... If the Gatekeepers had one of these, we could sssoar through the sky, casting a watchful eye over the highways and canyons below.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_000_088: I was just about to suggest the same thing. Alpa─would you allow us to station a unit of griffin riders here at the castellum?
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_000_089: Now that the Garleans have been driven out, we've been at something of a loose end. You Gatekeepers have been working hard to keep the border safe, so we should do our bit too. You have our full cooperation!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_091: The griffin riders are always welcome here!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_JOLHMYN_000_092: That all turned out rather well, wouldn't you say? Now that Giff has changed his tune about the bridge, the rest are sure to follow.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_ALPA_000_093: Yesss, but we've still got a lot of work ahead of us. , I'm sure there'll be more chances for you to help in days to come!
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_SYSTEM_000_094: A pair of griffin statues have been added to Castellum Velodyna.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_SYSTEM_000_095: You have achieved Trusted reputation with the Vira.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_SYSTEM_000_096: New Vira society daily quests are now available from Eshana at Castellum Velodyna.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_SYSTEM_000_097: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Eshana as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_SYSTEM_000_098: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Eshana. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_SYSTEM_000_099: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Madhura.
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_SYSTEM_000_100: In order to undertake the next allied society main quest, you must first complete the main scenario quest “The First of Many.”
TEXT_BANANA002_03037_GIFF_100_120: I was keeping an eye on things from a safe distance. But Thal's balls─I didn't think you'd actually go through with it!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_SYSTEM_100_001: In order to undertake this quest, you must first complete the main scenario quest “The First of Many.”
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_100_001: Good to sssee you, ! You know, I'd say our work is progresssing quite nicely. There's still time left, but even if Mother were to arrive tomorrow, I think she'd be impresssed!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_100_001: Isn't it a bit early to be saying that?
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_150_001: The work needs to be finished before she comes back. We'd have a hard time convincing your mother with the place as it is now.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_200_001: Of course, the castellum is no longer under threat of demolition, and the griffin statues are very nice. But it's still more or less the same as when we arrived.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_200_001: What about the old ssstorerooms we converted into overnight lodgings?
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_300_001: Yes, I was just getting to that. As you doubtless know from personal experience, , this whole area is crawling with dangerous creatures, many of which are more active at night.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_400_001: Adventurers and soldiers can hold their own against them, but merchants and returning refugees are easy targets. We'll be seeing a lot more of them now that the Garleans have withdrawn.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_000_005: That's why I suggested that we put down some beds in the old storerooms. I haven't actually had a look yet, but I'm sure Alpa took care of it. There are probably a few things that need improving, though.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_100_005: If we ask someone who's actually spent the night here, we can get their opinion.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_006: That visitor from Gridania who ssslept here should still be about. Why don't we ssstart with him?
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_011: Having stayed overnight in our lodgings, would you say you ssslept well?
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_MERCHANT03038_000_0: I wasn't expecting to find anywhere to stay and I was full glad to be offered shelter. Otherwise, I'd have been traveling in the dark with only the beasts breathing down my neck to keep me warm!
Having said that, I think it's a bit soon to be calling them “lodgings.” I would've appreciated something to lie on besides the floor.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_014: The floor? I heard that travelers preferred to sssleep in proper beds so I had some brought over from Vira Nilya.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_MERCHANT03038_000_0: A bed? I didn't see anything like that.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_100_015: Alpa? You did give them something to sleep on, didn't you?
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_016: Of course I did! Maybe it would be quicker if I just showed you. Wait here.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_017: You had one of these in your room, didn't you?
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_MERCHANT03038_000_0: I did. Do you mean to say I'm supposed to sleep on that?
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_100_019: That's it! Put it down over here!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_020: This is how we Ananta go to sssleep─ We just coil up like this and we're perfectly comfortable.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_000_021: You scaly-pated imbecile! Do you think we can “just coil up” like that? Get up, would you?
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_MERCHANT03038_100_0: And on that note, I bid you all farewell.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_200_022: It's partly my fault, I suppose. I should've made sure that Alpa knew what a guest room actually is first.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_000_023: To be honest, it's been a while since I stayed in a decent inn myself, so I'm probably not in any position to give proper advice. Any thoughts?
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_A1_000_001: We could head to a village with one and ask around?
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_A1_000_002: Nothing builds character like a cold, hard floor, I say.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_025: I doubt our guestsss will be in the mood for any character-building after a long journey. Any other ideas?
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_100_025: Come to think of it, there are several inns for travelers in Ala Ghiri.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_027: Good idea. We might find sssomeone who can come here to tell us what this place is misssing.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_000_028: Let's head to the inns in Ala Ghiri.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_030: I think I sssaw that merchant a few moments ago. He can't have gone far.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_000_035: You think we should ask him? No, not a good idea. Merchants tend to be a bit wary of us military types.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_WEIDHERI_000_040: Advice on accommodation? Sorry, I'm needed here for the time being. Might be worth asking around though.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JNAIROH_000_041: You want me to go all the way to Castellum Velodyna? I'd love to help, but I've got my hands full here as it is.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GERBOD_000_042: Lodgings, you say? You ought to try askin' people who used to work in Goodblade. 'Course, it's naught more than rubble now, so the old residents are lookin' to apply their trades elsewhere.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GERBOD_000_043: A bloke called Gales used to run an inn there and he took pride in his work. You should find him still mopin' around there.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_045: How goes the sssearch? I'm not having much luck.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_000_050: It turns out that everyone's busy trying to get Ala Ghiri back on its feet. They might have some useful information, though. Let's keep trying.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_055: They can't all be busy, can they?
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_056: A man named Gales? And he was an innkeeper? Perfect! Let's go and look for him!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_WEIDHERI_000_057: Actually, I could use a hand here if you're free!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JNAIROH_000_058: Sorry I couldn't be more helpful.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GERBOD_000_059: If you're heading over to Goodblade, watch your backs. There's all sorts of horrible things lurkin' about.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GALES_000_060: What brings you to Goodblade? Or rather, what's left of it...
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GALES_000_062: Oh, I see. You say my advice may prove beneficial? It's very kind of you to ask, but I should warn you─failure seems to follow me everywhere I go...
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_100_063: He's a ray of sunshine, isn't he?
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GALES_100_063: Since the fall of Goodblade, I've tried working elsewhere. It never seems to last long because everyone takes such a disliking to me. I can't say I blame them. I'm no good to anyone.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_064: But we heard you were a first-rate innkeeper! You should put that experience to good use by helping usss!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GALES_000_066: <sigh> If you say so. I'm just worried that I'll go all the way to the castellum only for you to change your minds and turn me away. It would be just my luck...
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_067: We wouldn't do that. We need you! Let's head for the cassstellum. I'll explain more on the way.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_000_075: Hopefully he'll be just what we're looking for!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GALES_000_090: Oi! You scrawny little turd! Are these supposed to be guest rooms!? It's an insult!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GALES_000_092: You're bloody right something's amiss! Why would anyone torture themselves by sleeping in this shitehole? That bed's not fit for a chocobo! And that's another thing─ Where are the chocobos meant to stay?
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_100_092: So this is why he has trouble keeping a job...
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_093: All right, Gales, I hear you loud and clear! I'll do whatever it takes to turn this place around!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GALES_000_094: You know bugger all about how to treat guests, but you've got the right attitude! Let's get to work!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GALES_000_095: Like I was saying, there's nothing for chocobos at all, so we'll start with that. We need a stable and troughs for food and water. Oi! You over there! Is there any wood or metal we can use?
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_000_096: Not really, no. I know a few places we might be able to get some, though.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_100_096: I'll arrange to have some timber collected. , there should be some piles of scrap metal over at Castellum Corvi.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_000_097: Don't worry─I'm not expecting you to lug it back here by yourself. The other Gatekeepers can take care of that. I just need you to prepare it for transport.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_000_098: We should have a marid crush it underfoot to break it into smaller pieces. If you speak with Dakshina, she should be able to get one ready. She's just outside the gate.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_100: Gales is looking things over as we ssspeak. I was about to ask his opinion, but he seems a bit...different from before.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_000_105: It's hard to picture anyone being satisfied with Alpa's lodgings, never mind a professional.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_DAKSHINA_000_106: We Ananta have lived alongssside marids for generations. Do not fear. Their enormousss size belies their gentle nature.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_DAKSHINA_000_110: You wish to ride the marid? For what purpossse?
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_DAKSHINA_000_111: I sssee...crushing a few sssteel plates should pose no difficulty for a marid. They are even ssstronger than they look.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_DAKSHINA_000_112: Should you be ssseparated from the marid, it will return to me of its own volition. Once the work is complete, you may disssmount as you please.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_000_115: Even a tamed marid can be dangerous if startled, so don't make any sudden moves or loud noises!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_100_115: Once we're finished, you'll hardly recognize the place!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GUARDSOLDIER03038_0: What strength! I wouldn't want to get on a marid's bad side, that's for sure.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GUARDSOLDIERTTWO030: We'll carry the scrap back to Castellum Velodyna. You can go ahead and wait with Gales and the others.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_SYSTEM_000_125: This scrap metal must be broken into smaller pieces before it can be carried away. Ride the marid and use its Trample ability to prepare the raw materials for transport.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_DAKSHINA_000_122: Do you wish to ride the marid again?
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GUARDSOLDIER03038_0: J'olhmyn's explained the situation. We'll stay out of your way, so go ahead!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GUARDSOLDIERTWO0303: You get started. We'll deal with the scrap once you're done!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GALES_000_140: It'll be here soon? I can't wait! I'll make the best chocobo stables you've ever bloody seen!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GALES_100_140: But first, I'll get Alpa to make some beds! And if she buggers it up, I'll have her guts for garters!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GALES_000_141: So, what do you think? Not bad, eh?
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_142: I made all the sheets myself too! Weaving is another ssspecialty of the Ananta, you know. Compared to the headdresses and clothing we usually make, this was sssimple!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_143: To be honest, there's no point having a ssskill if you don't know what to do with it. That's why I'm glad Gales is here. I'd be lossst without his advice!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GALES_000_144: But I'm equally clueless when it comes to the Ananta! I've lived in Gyr Abania my whole life and I know next to nothing about them!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GALES_000_145: We may have our differences, but we share a common tongue. We can learn a lot from each other.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_147: You've really made a difference here, . I'm sure I'll need your help when more people start passing through our gates.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_148: That reminds me─ I should try out one of the new beds!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GALES_000_149: When I first met Alpa and heard she was captain of the Velodyna Gatekeepers, I didn't know what to expect. It was worth the journey though.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_100_149: (I'm glad he's calmed down a bit...)
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_000_150: Ah! I guess it's not as sturdy as it looks...
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_100_150: <sigh> I just hope her mother doesn't show up now...
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GALES_000_151: After what happened to Goodblade, I thought I was finished. Alpa asking me to come here could be the fresh start I've been looking for.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_SYSTEM_000_152: Guest rooms have been added to Castellum Velodyna.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_SYSTEM_000_153: You have achieved Respected reputation with the Vira.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_SYSTEM_000_154: New Vira society daily quests are now available from Eshana at Castellum Velodyna.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_SYSTEM_000_155: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Eshana as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_SYSTEM_000_156: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Eshana. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_SYSTEM_000_157: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Madhura.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_ALPA_100_151: I think you'll be pleasantly sssurprised!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_JOLHMYN_000_160: Hopefully the wood I brought was up to snuff.
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GUARDSOLDIER03038_0: I always knew marids were strong but I've never seen anything like that before!
TEXT_BANANA003_03038_GUARDSOLDIERTWO0303: Let us handle this. I think Gales and the others could use your help.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_000_001: Oh, there you are, . We have the latest report on Mother's molting. J'olhmyn, if you'd be ssso kind?
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_JOLHMYN_100_001: "The broodmother's skin has become dry and slightly rough.“
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_100_002: She'll be shedding her ssskin before long.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_000_002: I'm not worried though. Even if Mother were to arrive now, I think the castellum would pass muster. The guest rooms we made have proven quite popular!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_JOLHMYN_100_002: Yes, but you're forgetting one thing. What about that poor sod who's taken ill? Your mother might find his moaning and groaning a bit off-putting...
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_200_002: I was just about to mention that. An Ala Mhigan fellow on his way home from Gridania stayed overnight, but he's come down with sssomething. We can't tell what's caused it, but he's in a terrible state.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_JOLHMYN_000_004: At first, we thought the shortness of breath and flushed cheeks were just signs of fatigue. We normally give medicinal tea in cases like this, but that hasn't seemed to work.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_100_004: We'll have to try sssomething else.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_005: Hark! Is that the sound of damsels in distress? Fear not! Your cries of despair will not go unanswered! For the future nunh of the M tribe, M'zhet Tia, has arrived!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_006: What are you doing, J'olhmyn? Is that any way to treat your would-be savior?
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_JOLHMYN_000_007: Savior? You can “save” me the trouble of trouncing you again by buggering off and never coming back!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_008: Unghhh... Not quite the welcome I was expecting. Wait─is that you, ?
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_A1_000_002: I'm amazed you're not dead yet.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_010: And you're looking well too! You know, when I signed up to assist the Gatekeepers, I didn't expect to see you here!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_011: Ha ha! Amazing people is my specialty! So you're helping the Gatekeepers too, eh? It's true what they say. Great minds think alike!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_100_012: Ssso that's how you know each other...
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_013: Know? Our bond goes beyond that of mere acquaintances. Why, we're like !
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_000_014: If you're , it's clear to see which one got all the brains. Is he always this ssstupid?
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_015: Ahem! I think we can discuss my virtues some other time. Captain Alpa, am I to understand a man has been struck down with a fever of some kind? If so, I may have useful information to impart.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_017: This unfortunate soul is lovesick! I'm absolutely certain of it!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_018: J'olhmyn! Your violent outbursts notwithstanding, I must admit you possess a rather charming demeanor. Perhaps your convalescent guest has fallen for your feminine wiles and cannot bring himself to part from you!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_JOLHMYN_000_019: My “feminine wiles”? I'm a soldier. Hardly the sort that has secret admirers.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_020: Now, now! There's no need to be shy. If you ask me, you're the belle of the Resistance!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_000_021: M'zhet, what were you saying about our guest being “lovesick”? What kind of love makes you sssick?
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_022: The romantic kind, of course! A love that unites those destined to spend eternity together, awakening their true potential. There is nothing it cannot conquer!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_023: But don't take my word for it. I will demonstrate the power of love! Come to Pike Falls and bear witness to its splendor.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_030: Remember these? That's right─they're grenades left behind by the Garleans.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_100_030: I want you to throw them at me just like last time!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_000_031: Ssstop this nonsense! You'll get yourself killed!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_032: Killed? I think not. I have the power of love on my side! Watch closely everyone─especially you, J'olhmyn. These explosions will be like water off an eft's back!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_033: (I nearly died the last time I tried this, but you needn't worry! I've definitely removed enough of the powder. Yes, no doubt about it.)
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_034: , I'm ready. Just keep flinging those grenades, even if I tell you stop!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_JOLHMYN_000_040: I have no idea what's going on, but there's one thing I'm certain of: he's the biggest idiot I've ever met. And I've met a lot of idiots.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_051: Ack! Gah! (Did I forget to take out some of the powder?) I'm perfectly fine! Let's try that again, !
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_000_052: I don't think thisss is going to end well...
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_100_056: What are you throwing it at me for? That ssstings, you know!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_JOLHMYN_000_058: Stop that, would you? M'zhet's the one with a death wish around here, not me!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_059: (At least we know that taking out some of the powder results in a nonlethal explosion!)
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_100_070: That had a bit more “bang” than I was expecting. Could you try throwing another one?
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_JOLHMYN_000_071: This seems like quite a dangerous way to prove the power of love. Why don't you just write a poem or something?
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_072: Nnngh... That one was a full-sized explosion as well! , stop for a moment!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_000_055: Are you really going to throw that?
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_JOLHMYN_000_060: That looked really painful. Is the next one ready?
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_100_080: Forget what I said at the beginning! I really do want you to stop!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_081: No... I had so much to live for...
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_092: I cannot die here! Not today, not like this. The M tribe needs me!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_000_093: Hooray! He's alive! And it's all because of the power of love!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_JOLHMYN_000_094: Did the power of love really protect you from being blown to pieces? Perhaps your feelings for me are genuine after all...
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_095: What!? No, no! You've got it all wrong! One day I'll be nunh, and I'll have to serve the needs of every eligible woman in the tribe. I can't commit to just one girl!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_JOLHMYN_000_096: So that means the reason you survived has nothing to do with love. It must be something else... Well, even if you did have eyes for me, I'd poke them out with my spear.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_GALES_000_097: Ah, there you are, Alpa. A certain matter has come to light and─
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_A2_000_001: A lonely tia doomed to a life of solitude.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_A2_000_002: A misguided fool whose attempts to impress J'olhmyn failed miserably.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_GALES_000_101: There's no need to be ashamed. You're not alone. My attempts to woo members of the fairer sex always end in disaster... I'll never find a wife at this rate.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_102: Gods be good! A man can reach your age and still be a bachelor?
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_GALES_000_103: In my line of work, I meet women from far and wide. But as soon as I try to talk to them, they run a malm.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_104: The same thing happens to me! Except in my case, I think they find my exuberant nature a tad overwhelming... Come friend, let us share our woes!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_JOLHMYN_000_105: Why do I get the feeling this was a complete waste of time? And we're not an ilm closer to helping our bedridden patron. Perhaps we should consult a proper chirurgeon.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_000_106: Now that you mention it, M'zhet's injuries might need some attention too. Although he ssseems rather well considering...
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_JOLHMYN_000_107: Forget about him, he'll be fine. He's got Gales's shoulder to cry on now. Let's go to the Reach and ask Orella. She'll know what to do.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ORELLA_000_110: Would I be correct in guessing this isn't a social call?
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ORELLA_000_111: I can't say for sure, but it sounds like he's fallen victim to pleurisy.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ORELLA_000_112: The medicine he needs is fairly simple to make, but unfortunately my supply of lightning cap mushrooms has been exhausted. I'll need you to gather some from East End. Once I've got my things together, I'll go straight to Velodyna.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_000_113: Understood! J'olhmyn, stay with Orella and keep her sssafe!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_000_115: You've met Orella before, haven't you?
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_JOLHMYN_000_120: Sadly, Alpa counts as one of Orella's “regulars.” She's forever eating things she finds lying around and then wondering why she gets a stomachache. Orella's medicine usually sorts her out though.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_GALES_000_125: I can't believe I've found someone whose lack of romantic experience rivals my own!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_126: To think that Gales is still single after all these years! What is the world coming to?
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ORELLA_000_130: While the disease is not life-threatening, I'm sure our patient would prefer that we avoid any unnecessary dillydallying.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_JOLHMYN_100_130: No harm will come to Orella or her expensive-looking medical supplies as long as she's with me!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_000_140: <pant> I'm lucky you arrived when you did. I know I'm not much of a fighter, but I didn't expect to be beaten by those ssstraggly-looking beasties!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_000_141: Ssstill, I managed to get the lightning caps! We'd better get these to Orella right away!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_000_150: Ah, there you are. I've handed the mushrooms to Orella, who is brewing her concoction as we ssspeak. All we can do now is wait.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_100_150: What's taking Orella so long? I hope everything's all right...
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_100_150: Have a little faith, Alpa! Ah, here they come now!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ORELLA_000_151: You'll be pleased to hear that the treatment was a success.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_TRAVELLER03039_000_: That medicine worked wonders! One moment I'm at death's door, and the next I'm right as rain! Nothing can stop me finishing the last leg of my journey now.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ORELLA_000_155: Just don't overexert yourself, do you hear? It's still too early to say you've fully recovered. If you get so much as a runny nose, be sure to come and see me.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_100_155: Orella, we appreciate you coming all the way here. Eshana will arrange an essscort back to the Reach.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_156: Well, I'd say that came to a satisfactory conclusion!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_158: But I could've sworn he showed signs of being lovesick...
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_TRAVELLER03039_000_: That I'm in love! I've never beheld such grace, such elegance, such...unfathomable beauty! Surely, she is an incarnation of Menphina herself!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_JOLHMYN_000_162: That's very flattering, but you're embarrassing me!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_TRAVELLER03039_000_: My fever may be gone, but I yet yearn for your healing touch to ease my aching heart! Orella, my love, wait for meeeeee!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_000_165: Don't get downhearted! “Plenty more sea in the fish” and all that!
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_000_166: If you ask me, this “love” thing all seems rather sssilly. As far as I can tell, it leads to a lot of unnecessary bother.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_000_167: In just a short ssspan of time, we've had a guest fall ill, I've nearly been eaten by carnivorous plants, and M'zhet has been blown up and beaten several times.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_ALPA_100_167: I'd say it's high time this place had its own infirmary. We should get it ready before Mother returns.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_MZHETTIA_100_170: My, my! While Gales and I were exchanging sob stories, it looks like you've been rather busy.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_GALES_200_170: M'zhet has such a cheerful outlook despite losing his father at such a young age. My own problems pale in comparison.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_SYSTEM_000_180: Castellum Velodyna now has its own infirmary.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_SYSTEM_000_181: You have achieved Honored reputation with the Vira.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_SYSTEM_000_182: New Vira society daily quests are now available from Eshana at Castellum Velodyna.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_SYSTEM_000_183: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Eshana as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_SYSTEM_000_184: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Eshana. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANANA004_03039_SYSTEM_000_185: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Madhura.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_002: I don't know how to thank you for all your help. The castellum has become everything I'd hoped for! Travelers and Resistance members alike have been sssinging its praises!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_003: As long as nothing untoward happens, I'm confident that it'll pass mussster with Mother.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_100_003: That reminds me. How's your mother's molting coming along?
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_200_003: Eshana informs me that the upper layer of skin is beginning to ssseparate. There's not much time left.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_300_003: Well, we're set to pass the inspection with flying colors, so there's nothing to fear! Unless some unforeseen catastrophe occurs...
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_MERCHANT03040_000_0: Ananta... <pant> They're fighting among themselves, over in Virdjala! It looked like they were out for blood, so I ran for my life!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_100_007: J'olhmyn! If you'd kept your mouth shut, this would never have happened!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_100_007: I suppose I was tempting fate a bit, but you can't blame me for it!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_008: Why does this have to happen now? If Mother finds out that Ananta are causing trouble near Castellum Velodyna, she'll hold me responsssible! J'olhmyn, ─follow me!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_010: Battlemaids of the Qalyana! If any of you are still alive, sssay something!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_011: By Sri Lakshmi, it's a masssacre... There's no time to waste. We should search for survivors. , try the southern part of the valley. J'olhmyn, come with me.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_000_015: What in Rhalgr's name happened here?
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_KARYANASOLDIER03040: Are you here to kill me? No, it would ssseem not...
There has been a ssschism within the Qalyana. I and those of like mind no longer wish to devote ourselves to the false Sri Lakshmi.

We believe the Qalyana should work with the Vira for the future of Gyr Abania, instead of sssequestering ourselves away from the world. Many of usss voiced our opposition, but the dreamers heard not our pleas.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_000_025: And when you tried to break from the tribe, they hunted you down?
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_KARYANASOLDIER03040: Yesss, ssstrider. Most of us were ssslain. Those who sssurvived the ambush are being pursued as we ssspeak.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_000_027: What do you make of this, Captain?
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_028: This is troubling indeed... There are so few routes through the valleys that anyone passing is bound to be caught up in the fighting. Those killers won't think twice about cutting down anyone who ssstands between them and their prey.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_029: I can't allow this ssslaughter to continue! The Qalyana and we Vira have our differences, but they are still our sisters!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_000_030: Then it's up to us to beat some sense into those dreamers.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_031: No. This is an Ananta affair, and I cannot involve the Gatekeepers. I'll deal with it myself.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_000_032: Alpa! Have you forgotten why we're here in the first place?
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_A1_000_002: Why do you think J'olhmyn and I are here?
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_035: Stop being obtuse and sssay what you mean, or get out of my way!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_000_036: We're here because a merchant begged the Gatekeepers for help. You yourself said the dreamers won't think twice about cutting down innocents. This is our problem!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_000_037: It's the Gatekeepers' duty to keep the peace. If that means intervening in tribal disputes, then so be it! Isn't that right, ?
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_041: The dreamers are ssstill out there looking for you. Go to Castellum Velodyna and tell the Gatekeepers that Alpa sssent you. No harm will come to you.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_KARYANASOLDIER03040: Youngling of the Vira, you have my gratitude.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_042: J'olhmyn, ! The other sssurvivors need our help. Let's move!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_KARYANADESERTERS030: The pursssuers have tracked us down, but we have no ssstrength left to fight. Thisss is the end...
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_100_060: It's not over yet. We're here to help!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_061: That'sss right! You're under the protection of the Velodyna Gatekeepers now!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_062: It's time to show them what we're made of!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_065: Why must the dreamers go to such lengthsss?
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_000_070: I'm glad we got here in time, but it looks like we've still got work to do!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_110: To think they'd appear in such numbers... They're relentlesss!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_MZHETTIA_000_112: There you are, ! Thought you'd steal all the glory for yourself, eh? You're not the only hero around here!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_TAHLAMOLKOH_000_113: Although I only came to admire the griffin statues, I shan't stand by while my friends are in danger! It's time for Tahla Molkoh, the Invisible Adder, to bare her fangs!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_000_114: "Invisible Adder“? Is that because the others ignore you?
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_115: M'zhet! Tahla! I've never been so happy to see you two!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_116: Hear me, dreamers of the Qalyana! Your crimes are beyond redemption, beyond forgivenesss! It's time for you to pay!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SARISHA_000_080: Alpa! We were on our way to inssspect your facilities when we heard the cries of battle. I might have guessed the Qalyana were involved, but I never expected to find you here!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SARISHA_000_081: What is the meaning of thisss?
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_082: Mother, lisssten to me! These Qalyana are not our enemies!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SARISHA_000_084: If these Qalyana do indeed reject the false Sri Lakshmi, I would hear it from them.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SARISHA_000_085: Tell us the truth of thisss day.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_KARYANASOLDIER03040: Our own sssisters turned against us because we dared to seek another way. Were it not for the intervention of your daughter and her comrades, we would have been ssslaughtered. But while none of us are gravely injured, our sssorrow is beyond words...
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SARISHA_000_087: ...Sisters, you are welcome to stay with us in Vira Nilya for as long as you need. You will have food and shelter and time to think on your futures.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_KARYANASOLDIER03040: That you would show your sworn enemies such kindness...
However, it is with profound regret that we must refuse your most graciousss offer. Our minds were made up before your arrival.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SARISHA_000_090: Pray tell, what will you do?
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_KARYANASOLDIER03040: Alpa, brave and benevolent daughter of the Vira! Please, allow usss to join the Velodyna Gatekeepers!
We were raised to fear the ssstriders─told they could not be trusssted. And so we turned away from the world and placed our hopes in a false god.
But when you and your comrades came to our rescue, we saw the error of our ways. We need not─nay, cannot live apart.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_095: That's what my work with the Gatekeepers has taught me. There are many peoples that call Gyr Abania home. I just want to make it a sssafer place.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_096: Of course, we all have our own opinions and beliefs, but our goals are the sssame, and that's what matters. We'd be happy to have you!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_KARYANASOLDIER03040: Then we will commit ourssselves to your cause.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SARISHA_000_098: It ssseems you have grown a great deal, Alpa.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_099: Are you sure? I'm ssstill about the same length as before.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_000_100: I don't think it was supposed to be taken literally...
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SARISHA_000_101: Ha ha ha! She is still rather ssslow on the uptake, I see. It is jussst one of her many quirks, as I am sure you have noticed.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SARISHA_000_102: I must return to the village and share these recent developments with the brood. In the meantime, you should await my arrival at Velodyna. I still intend to look over the castellum.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_122: I should report everything to my sssuperiors and request permission to accept the new Qalyana recruits.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_000_123: Alpa, are you sure about this? This could all be a ploy to infiltrate the Resistance.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_124: If it is, it's a needlessly contrived one. Besssides, we're not about to hand them the keys to the place. We'll train them like any other recruits, and if they betray our trussst, we'll deal with it then and there.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_000_125: Fair enough. All the same, I'll keep a close eye on them.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_200_125: Anyway, it looks like Mother's arrived for the inspection. This is the moment I've been dreading...
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SARISHA_200_122: The time has come to sssee the fruitsss of your labor.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SARISHA_300_122: I take it everything is in order.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SARISHA_400_122: If I find your efforts to be insufficient, you are coming ssstraight back to Vira Nilya. Is that clear?
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SARISHA_600_122: I will be looking over every ilm of this place. Nothing will essscape my notice.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SARISHA_700_122: My inssspection is complete. There is no denying that you have made...significant changes.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SARISHA_800_122: Of course, this place is no stranger to change. The stone bridge once built by Ala Mhigans was plated in blackened sssteel by the Garleans, becoming a sssymbol of oppression. Now, it is the turn of the Ananta to leave our mark.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SARISHA_900_122: For better or worse, it ssstands as a tessstament to the history of Gyr Abania. Now, representatives of the various peoples of this land have united as the Velodyna Gatekeepers and transssformed this stronghold. It bodes well for the future.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SARISHA_920_122: Even before my arrival, you had already demonssstrated the qualities required of a leader. You fought to defend members of the Qalyana and have established a bond of trust with them─an achievement that many considered impossible.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SARISHA_930_122: You have learned much and grown to become a leader worthy of the highest praise and ressspect. As broodmother, as your mother, this makes me proud indeed.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_940_122: I don't know what to sssay...
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SARISHA_950_122: Thisss concludes my visit. I hope you will all continue to sssupport Alpa in her endeavors. Until we meet again.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_100_126: She's not the only one that feels that way. You've come a long way, Alpa. It looks like you won't be needing me as your mentor anymore!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_200_126: Now, now, J'olhmyn! You're not getting off that easily! I still need a sssecond-in-command, don't I? This place may have passed Mother's test but our work is far from over.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_000_126: As soon as we get permission for the Qalyana recruitsss to join, we'll need a garrison for them. We should start the preparations right away!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_000_130: I really had my hands full trying to keep Alpa safe. I'm just glad it's over.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_MZHETTIA_000_135: Did you see me? I think I'm starting to get used to this fighting lark!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_TAHLAMOLKOH_000_140: I never get tired of looking at Alpa's griffin statues. They're so majestic, so dynamic!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_KARYANASOLDIER03040: Alpa fought to sssave us and offered asssylum here at Castellum Velodyna. We would give our lives for her.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SYSTEM_000_150: Permission to accept the Qalyana refugees has been granted and a new Ananta garrison has been built at Castellum Velodyna.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SYSTEM_000_151: You have achieved Sworn reputation with the Vira.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SYSTEM_000_152: Furthermore, you will receive an experience point bonus upon completion of the Vira society daily quests.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_SYSTEM_000_155: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Madhura.
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_BATTLETALK_000: Don't be alarmed! We're not your enemies!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_KARYANAENEMY03040_B: These traitors are in league with the Vira! Ssslay them all!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_BATTLETALK_000: We are sssisters! Why must we fight?
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_KARYANASOLDIER03040: Any wounded must fall back! We will hold off their asssault!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_KARYANAENEMY03040_B: We have tarried long enough. Thisss ends now!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_KARYANASOLDIER03040: We cannot repel sssuch an onslaught...
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_BATTLETALK_002: Get back! Leave this to the Gatekeepers!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_KARYANASOLDIER03040: Why would you go ssso far to protect usss?
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_BATTLETALK_002: Don't worry about that now! Jussst get out of here!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_BATTLETALK_: Some of them are going for Alpa! I'll draw their attention away from her. You finish them off!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_MZHETTIA_BATTLETALK: M'zhet Tia, son of M'aht Nunh has entered the fray! Who wants to taste my steel?
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_KARYANAENEMY_BOSS_B: This one has ssspirit! But know this─only death awaits those who defy us!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_TAHLAMOLKOH_BATTLET: I'll handle these smaller ones! Griffin's Bane, the leader is all yours!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_JOLHMYN_BATTLETALK_: At least you know your limits, Tahla! I'll go with !
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_ALPA_BATTLETALK_003: She must be their commander. Watch out─she's not like the others!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_TAHLAMOLKOH_BATTLET: She's gathering aether! We have to stop her before it's too late!
TEXT_BANANA005_03040_MZHETTIA_BATTLETALK: For mere underlings, they certainly put up a fight!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_100_001: Oh, there you are! You're jussst in time.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_000_001: I'm hosssting a feast for a few friends of the Gatekeepers. It's a small show of thanks for all your sssupport.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_000_002: Of course, you're all invited, but I'll need sssome help.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_100_002: Gales, could you take care of the food and drink?
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_GALES_000_005: Leave it to me. You can expect the finest cuisine Eorzea has to offer!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_200_002: , could I ask you to deliver these invitations?
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_000_003: There's one for M'zhet Tia and another for Tahla Molkoh.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_000_004: In the meantime, J'olhmyn and I will ssstart getting the place ready.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_MZHETTIA_000_010: Ah, ! Up for another adventure, eh?
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_MZHETTIA_000_011: Ha ha! Alpa's full of surprises! And I assume J'olhmyn will be there too?
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_MZHETTIA_000_012: I wouldn't miss it for the world! I'll meet you there soon.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_TAHLAMOLKOH_000_013: Greetings! What brings you to Castrum Oriens today?
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_TAHLAMOLKOH_000_014: A banquet? It sounds a lot more fancy than the mess hall grub I'm used to.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_TAHLAMOLKOH_000_015: Before I attend, I must consult my tomes on Gyr Abanian etiquette. I shall join you anon.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_000_020: This is my first time hosssting a dinner party. I didn't invite many people in case it all goes horribly wrong!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_000_030: According to J'olhmyn, my cooking “looks like it's been scraped off a tavern floor,” whatever that's supposed to mean...
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_JOLHMYN_000_025: (Alpa's really been getting into the role of captain lately. Don't tell her I said this, but I'm quite impressed!)
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_GALES_000_026: It's been a while since I had the opportunity to demonstrate my culinary prowess. I'm rather looking forward to it!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_100_041: Did you hear that? It sounds like there's a commotion outssside the gate. I'd better deal with this before the meal.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_JOLHMYN_300_041: Just between you and me, Alpa's really come into her own since that incident with the Qalyana. Why don't you go and see for yourself?
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_JOLHMYN_200_041: Sometimes it's nice to just forget about our duties and wash down a hearty meal with a bottle or three of arak. It sounds like we've got work to do first, though!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_TRAVELLER03041_100_: I was passin' through the woods when some sort of monster grabbed me from the bushes! Damn near pulled my arm off! I didn't stick around to see what it was, I just made a run for it!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_200_042: You're in the care of the Gatekeepers now. Ressst well. We will look into this.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_300_042: J'olhmyn, help him to the infirmary and see that his chocobo is looked after.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_400_042: There may be others who've been attacked. Send a griffin rider to survey the area!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_JOLHMYN_000_100: Understood! Come along, sir. The chirurgeons will take care of that arm.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_600_042: Normally I'd ask you to assist in culling wild beasts, but we can handle thisss.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_500_042: It can't have gone far. Let's move out!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_JOLHMYN_000_101: That poor bloke and his chocobo should be fine now. There don't seem to have been any other casualties, so let's just wait for Alpa to get back.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_700_042: We finally found the culprit. It didn't put up much of a fight.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_A2_000_002: Not afraid to get your hands dirty, are you?
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_800_042: Ha ha, high praise indeed coming from you!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_900_042: I'm only trying to lead by example. I can't delegate everything, you know!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_JOLHMYN_950_042: In the beginning, I wasn't sure you'd make much of a captain. But much to my surprise, you're not all that terrible!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_990_042: Hmph! A backhanded compliment if ever there was one, but I'll take it.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_200_043: Anyway, we have a few things to prepare for the feast. Our guests will be here sssoon.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_JOLHMYN_400_043: Not sure what happened, but he looks a bit worse for wear.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_KARYANASOLDIER_500_: To be in the presence of Captain Alpa and the Warrior of Light is an honor indeed.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_GALES_600_43: It sounds like trouble's brewing again... I'd better carry on with my work and leave this “commotion” to you and Alpa.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_100_043: The meal is almossst ready. I hope you're hungry!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_000_042: Although you're not officially members of the Velodyna Gatekeepers, J'olhmyn and I want to show our appreciation for your support.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_TAHLAMOLKOH_000_043: I am very grateful for your kind invitation, though I must admit, I am rather unaccustomed to formal dining.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_MZHETTIA_000_044: Formal? Forget about that! Just eat, drink, and be merry!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_GALES_000_045: Drink, eh? We have more than enough if you're interested in a little contest.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_MZHETTIA_000_046: Ah... Spirits don't really agree with me...
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_JOLHMYN_000_047: Come on, M'zhet! Show us what the “future nunh of the M tribe” can do!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_MZHETTIA_000_048: Well, since you put it like that, how can I refuse? Gales─I accept your challenge!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_GALES_100_049: I have a case of vintage arak from Ala Ghiri to get us started.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_100_050: There's ssso much food, we'll need Gales and M'zhet to tear themselves away from their drinking game to help carry it.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_JOLHMYN_000_052: Evidently not. I think I've lost my appetite.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_GALES_000_053: Don't just stand there! Get a mop!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_TAHLAMOLKOH_100_053: Ye gods! How did he get it on the ceiling!?
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_000_054: It looks like they're a bit preoccupied...
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_000_055: Ahem! I'd like to sssay a few words.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_000_056: When I was made captain of the Gatekeepers, I had no idea what I was getting myssself into. It wasn't easy at first, but I couldn't be more delighted with how everything has turned out!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_ALPA_000_057: Of course, we couldn't have done any of this without your sssupport. If you ever need anything at all from the Gatekeepers, consssider it done!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_MZHETTIA_000_058: The same goes for you! My blade is ever at your service!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_GALES_000_059: I've turned my life around, and it's all thanks to the Gatekeepers! It would be my pleasure to carry on working here.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_TAHLAMOLKOH_000_060: I have the perfect title for you. How does the “Grand Guardian of Gyr Abania” sound?
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_JOLHMYN_000_062: I think I'll stick around as your second-in-command, if you don't mind!
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_A1_000_001: We're all very proud of you, Alpa.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_A1_000_002: You're lucky to have such great friends. Especially me.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_SYSTEM_000_080: You have achieved Bloodsworn reputation with the Vira.
TEXT_BANANA006_03041_SYSTEM_000_081: You will receive an experience point bonus upon completion of the Vira society daily quests.
TEXT_BANANA301_03042_ESHANA_000_000: The Velodyna Gatekeepers have done excellent work thus far monitoring our borders, but Alpa fears they grow complacent for lack of any serious threatsss.
TEXT_BANANA301_03042_ESHANA_000_001: In the hopesss of motivating them, I thought we might revive one of the Ananta's more ancient traditions─divinationsss.
TEXT_BANANA301_03042_ESHANA_000_002: To divine the fortunes of war, custom dictates one versssed in its art gather three precious stones required for the ritual. I can think of none better than you for this task.
TEXT_BANANA301_03042_ESHANA_100_002: When you have procured the gems we require, deliver them to the Ananta whissspermaid.
TEXT_BANANA301_03042_ANANTAREADER03042_0: To read the fortunes of war I require three prophetic ssstones. No more, no lesss. Bring them to me and all shall be revealed.
You are returned. Have you the prophetic ssstones I require?
These shall do nicely. Now, let us sssee what the future holds for the Velodyna Gatekeepers.
Great peril awaits in the days ahead. Calamity born from carelessness. They would do well not to lose focusss lest this future come to pass.
Ah! I see great successs for the Gatekeepers! The efforts of their training shall be returned three─nay, four-fold!
TEXT_BANANA301_03042_ANANTAREADER03042_1: Ahem. My apologies. 'Tis not often fortune sssmiles so favorably upon us.
TEXT_BANANA301_03042_ANANTAREADER03042_0: Ah! Great fortune awaits the Gatekeepers! An unexpected windfall for the benefit of all!
TEXT_BANANA301_03042_ANANTAREADER03042_1: Ahem. Forgive me. It has been too long since fortune has sssmiled upon us so favorably.
TEXT_BANANA301_03042_ANANTAREADER03042_0: Hmmm... The future is riddled with uncertainty, but I sssense the potential for discord within our ranksss. Geniality is more important now than ever.
I foresee a fortuitous meeting. Newly formed ties should be treated with the greatessst of care. In doing so we shall not want for allies in times of strife.
The power of the stones is spent, and thusss the vision ends.
I would stay, but my sisters in Vira Nilya have need of my insssight. Pray tell Eshana what I have seen.
TEXT_BANANA301_03042_ESHANA_000_020: Welcome back, . What did she have to say of our future? What fortune awaitsss the Gatekeepers?
TEXT_BANANA301_03042_ESHANA_000_021: Interesting... I will make certain my sssisters hear of this and act accordingly. The word of a whissspermaid is not to be taken lightly.
TEXT_BANANA301_03042_ESHANA_000_022: Though not always clear, their divinations remain in our thoughts, guiding our actions in the hopes of a desirable outcome. I daresay you too would do well to adhere to her words. It may prove to your benefit.
TEXT_BANANA302_03043_ESHANA_000_000: As I'm sure you recall, the battle to reclaim Castellum Velodyna was quite fierce. Naturally, the bridge did not remain unssscathed, and it is our resssponsibility to tend to its repair and maintenance. The problem, however, is we lack the proper materials to do so.
TEXT_BANANA302_03043_ESHANA_000_001: The Garleans erected this bridge using materials not often found in this region, but the cermet plating from their war machines has ssserved well in our work. If you could retrieve, say, three sheets of this plating, your effortsss would be greatly appreciated.
TEXT_BANANA302_03043_ESHANA_000_020: Were you able to find any machina worthy of sssalvaging?
TEXT_BANANA302_03043_ESHANA_000_022: Truth be told, I find the architecture of this place to be quite crude, but for a blessing it is comprised mostly of metal. It makes for good practice of our metal-shaping magicksss.
TEXT_BANANA302_03043_ESHANA_000_023: Even still, it will take no sssmall amount of plating to see these repairs to completion. I sssuspect we will have need of your help again soon.
TEXT_BANANA303_03044_ESHANA_000_000: You are truly a sssight for sore eyes, my friend.
TEXT_BANANA303_03044_ESHANA_000_001: Our ssscouts recently had the misfortune of spotting a monstrous slug near Dimwold. Their grotesque appearance and corrosive slime─it is enough to make one ssspew.
TEXT_BANANA303_03044_ESHANA_000_002: They mussst be dealt with, but I am ashamed to confess the Gatekeepers are ill-sssuited to fight them. The mere sight of them is enough to make mossst convulse. And those who manage to approach are then irreparably scarred by their acidic ssslavering.
TEXT_BANANA303_03044_ESHANA_000_003: Please, I beg of you─go to Dimwold and rid us of this blight on the land.
TEXT_BANANA303_03044_ESHANA_000_010: Is it done, then? Is the ssslug no more?
TEXT_BANANA303_03044_ESHANA_000_011: You have my humblessst thanks. If the Gatekeepers should encounter another, you can be certain we will call for you again.
TEXT_BANANA304_03045_ESHANA_000_000: In an effort to improve relationsss with Gridania, Captain Alpa has proposed a joint initiative to revitalize the Percipient One and cleanse the sssurrounding land.
TEXT_BANANA304_03045_ESHANA_000_001: The Gridanians have offered to provide elixirs that will purify the sssoil, and we, for our part, have prepared a tonic to guard the rootsss from rot and decay.
TEXT_BANANA304_03045_ESHANA_000_002: Pray take these two vials of tonic to the Percipient One and pour them onto its rootsss.
TEXT_BANANA304_03045_ESHANA_000_020: You are returned. The deed is done, then?
TEXT_BANANA304_03045_ESHANA_000_021: Excellent. It has been many moons since we have had need of sssuch a potion. Its preservative properties allow plants to thrive in even the harshessst of conditions.
TEXT_BANANA304_03045_ESHANA_000_022: Never did I imagine it would serve to nurture the Percipient One. To return to its former glory will take time, as well as additional treatments of our tonic.
TEXT_BANANA304_03045_ESHANA_000_023: I trussst we can count on your aid when we have need of it again.
TEXT_BANANA305_03046_ESHANA_000_000: Do you not find the heat of this bridge insssufferable? Ah, perhaps not. You ssstriders have shoes to protect your legs.
TEXT_BANANA305_03046_ESHANA_000_001: As the sssun rises in the sky, so too does the heat of this bridge. By high noon, it is like treading across hot coals. My sssisters suffer burns from merely ssstanding guard. Something mussst be done!
TEXT_BANANA305_03046_ESHANA_000_002: Might I trouble you to collect mosssling clumps from East End? Even two would more than suffice. You can find them along the banksss of Timmon Beck.
TEXT_BANANA305_03046_ESHANA_000_010: There you are. Were you able to find any mossslings?
TEXT_BANANA305_03046_ESHANA_000_011: My sssisters will be pleased to see these. With a little work, they will make for fine towels.
TEXT_BANANA305_03046_ESHANA_000_012: You would be hard-presssed to find material more absorbent. Towels made from this can easily last through a full day's work to keep our ssskin cool.
TEXT_BANANA305_03046_ESHANA_000_013: Would that they did not wear out so quickly. Should we have need of more, and I am certain we will, I hope we can count on you again for asssistance.
TEXT_BANANA306_03047_ESHANA_000_000: ! We recently received word of a carrier bessset by beasts near East End.
TEXT_BANANA306_03047_ESHANA_000_001: If they are in our employ, the sssituation is all the more dire. They would not be soldiers, but villagers hired from a nearby sssettlement.
TEXT_BANANA306_03047_ESHANA_000_002: Please, you must go and help them before it is too late.
TEXT_BANANA306_03047_CARRIER03046_000_01: The Gatekeepers sent you? Oh, thank the heavens. You can be sure they'll hear of what you've done here.

I thought the roads safe, what with the imperials gone and all. Seems I've gravely underestimated the dangers still lurking about here in the wild. Well, I won't make that mistake on my next delivery.

I knew the job wasn't without risk so long as the imperials are about. Guess I was so caught up worrying about them I'd forgotten there's more than soldiers to be wary of. Well, I won't make that mistake on my next delivery.
TEXT_BANANA306_03047_CARRIERB03046_000_0:
Thank you , thank you!
...The Gatekeepers sent you? I'll have to thank them too when I return to the castellum.
With the imperials gone I had hoped to do my part in rebuilding, but so far I've proven little more than a nuisance to those who need me most. I promise to be more careful in the future.
I had hoped to someday help combat the imperials...yet here I am unable to contend with a simple delivery. I promise to be more careful in the future.

TEXT_BANANA503_03060_SYSTEM_000_021: Do not let the dharas reach the ore, or the mission will end in failure.
