TEXT_BANANA503_03060_LEADER03060_000_027: You did it! The dharas have all crumbled into the rock whence they came!
TEXT_BANANA503_03060_LEADER03060_000_028: Our friends of the border guard hold you in high esteem, and small wonder. Thank you, adventurer, and please pass my regards to Eshana.
TEXT_BANANA503_03060_ESHANA_000_030: So the dharas are no more? Excellent work, . You have done all of us a great ssservice.
TEXT_BANANA503_03060_ESHANA_000_031: That Resistance camp keeps watch over the route to the Peaks. Though our companies be different, we do not hesitate to cooperate with one another for the common good.
TEXT_BANANA503_03060_LEADER03060_000_035: My thanks again for your help with the dharas. Please pass my regards to Eshana.
TEXT_BANANA504_03061_ESHANA_000_000: Now that you have grown accussstomed to riding marids, there is a task I would asssk of you.
TEXT_BANANA504_03061_ESHANA_000_001: We have been sssuffering an outbreak of ants. They are drawn to kitchen ssscraps from the lodgings, and are causing our patrons no end of grief, getting into their unmentionables among other unpleasant places.
TEXT_BANANA504_03061_ESHANA_000_002: If we are to have any ressspite from these pests, we must ssstrike them at their nest. I would have you do the honors upon one of our trusssty marids.
TEXT_BANANA504_03061_ESHANA_100_002: If we are to have any ressspite from these pests, we must ssstrike them at their nest. I would have you do the honors again upon one of our trusssty marids.
TEXT_BANANA504_03061_ESHANA_000_003: Speak with Dakshina, our maridkeep, and she will furnish you with further inssstructions.
TEXT_BANANA504_03061_DAKSHINA_000_010: I have been expecting you, ant-ssslayer. Your task is sssimple: hop on a marid, ride it over to Virdjala, and have it trample ants. We have placed bait there to lure them out.
TEXT_BANANA504_03061_DAKSHINA_000_011: Once you have finished the task, feel free to disssmount your marid. It will make its own way back here.
TEXT_BANANA504_03061_DAKSHINA_000_025: Want to get back on the marid, do you? Very well.
TEXT_BANANA504_03061_ESHANA_000_030: I could feel the marid's mighty ssstomping all the way here. That should keep us free of antsss for a time.
TEXT_BANANA504_03061_ESHANA_100_030: I could feel the marid's mighty ssstomping all the way here. That should keep us free of antsss for a time.
TEXT_BANANA504_03061_ESHANA_000_031: Ours is a harsh land with little to sssustain life, and the creatures only do what they must to sssurvive. That being said, we cannot well allow them to overrun the area.
TEXT_BANANA504_03061_ESHANA_000_032: The people's sssafety is our priority, and today you have done your part to ensure it. Pleassse accept this as token of our appreciation.
TEXT_BANANA504_03061_DAKSHINA_000_035: Judging by the sssticky mess on the marid's feet, I sssee you have dealt with the antsss. Go on and report back to Eshana.
TEXT_BANANA505_03062_ESHANA_000_000: Sssimple though our lodgings may be, running it has been anything but. Laundry, in particular, has been the bane of my existence.
TEXT_BANANA505_03062_ESHANA_000_001: This filthy bedsheet, for inssstance. Just looking at it makes me want to collapssse into a weeping heap. Might I prevail upon you to wash it in my stead?
TEXT_BANANA505_03062_ESHANA_000_002: For the location, I would recommend Mirage Creek. The waters there are gentle and prissstine. Once the sheet is clean, bring it back and I shall sssee to the drying.
TEXT_BANANA505_03062_SYSTEM_000_010: With the selfsame strength that has felled many a god, you succeed in washing away the worst of the filth. However, the bedsheet is far from what could be considered clean.
TEXT_BANANA505_03062_SYSTEM_000_011: You dutifully resume working on the bedsheet, wringing and scrubbing with white-knuckled tenacity until it regains a semblance of its original color. However, some stains remain in evidence.
TEXT_BANANA505_03062_SYSTEM_000_012: Through sheer perseverance, you succeed in purging the sheet of all dirt and grime. It looks like it could have just come off the loom.
TEXT_BANANA505_03062_SYSTEM_000_013: Through sheer perseverance, you succeed in purging the sheet of all dirt and grime. However, the punishment has caused the cloth to warp...
TEXT_BANANA505_03062_SYSTEM_000_014: Through sheer perseverance, you succeed in purging the sheet of all dirt and grime. However, the punishment has caused the cloth to shrink...
TEXT_BANANA505_03062_ESHANA_000_020: I pray the sheet did not trouble you overmuch. Thank you, ─I shall take it off your handsss now.
TEXT_BANANA505_03062_ESHANA_000_021: ...My, this is amazing! However did you manage to make it so clean? Lessst you wonder, the cloth is of my own weaving. To see it thus ressstored gives me great joy.
TEXT_BANANA505_03062_ESHANA_000_022: Filthy as it had become, full ready was I to give up on it. But thanksss to you and your unwavering determination, it may serve me for years to come...or until it becomes filthy again.
TEXT_BANANA506_03063_ESHANA_000_000:
You are the light that guidesss us, comrade. As such, I would have you prepare the lampsss we use for night patrol.
...Was that funny? I tried to jessst as you striders do.
TEXT_BANANA506_03063_ESHANA_000_001: But jests aside, I need you to hunt sarcosuchus and harvessst their lard. Two pails' worth should sssuffice.
TEXT_BANANA506_03063_ESHANA_000_002: Here, take these cuts of gazelle meat and lay them along the Velodyna River. The sssmell should lure out the greediest, fattest creatures.
TEXT_BANANA506_03063_ESHANA_000_010: Ah, our guiding light returnsss. Tell me, were you able to obtain the sarcosuchus lard?
TEXT_BANANA506_03063_ESHANA_000_011: Excellent. With this much lard, we shall have sssufficient light for a good many patrolsss. The refined oil burns long and ssstrong, and we Ananta have used it for our torches and bonfires since ancient timesss.
TEXT_BANANA506_03063_ESHANA_000_012: And that is not all of its applicationsss. The refining process leaves behind a by-product that makes a nourishing sssalve. There is no better cure for dry skin and scales.
TEXT_BANANA506_03063_ESHANA_000_013:
So you sssee, not only are you the light that guidesss; you are also the sssalve that beautifiesss.
...How was that? Are my jests improving?
TEXT_BANANA601_03064_ESHANA_000_000: . I have need of your assistance in preparing supplies quite vital to me and my sssisters.
TEXT_BANANA601_03064_ESHANA_000_001: As you know, we Ananta take great pride in the appearance of our skin, and the lussstrous sheen of our scales. We require a special salve for our tails, which are prone to scarring from our ceaselesss patrols of the area.
TEXT_BANANA601_03064_ESHANA_000_002: Before I can distribute any to my sssisters, however, we must ready ingredients to make more. It requires a great deal of time to produce, you see, and I would not have our ssstores empty the next time we are in need of treatment.
TEXT_BANANA601_03064_ESHANA_000_003: I would ask you to travel to East End and procure four leaves of fish mint, a medicinal plant which grows at the base of the trees there. When you've found them, pray deliver them to Jagranti. She is the head of our medical station.
TEXT_BANANA601_03064_JAGRATI_000_005: Would that I could go and retrieve more herbs for our medicine, but I cannot leave this place unattended.
TEXT_BANANA601_03064_JAGRATI_000_010: Eshana requires salve for our sssisters? Then she knows we must first have more herbs.
TEXT_BANANA601_03064_JAGRATI_000_011: Ah, this is more than enough. Thank you. I'll set to making more sssalve right away.
TEXT_BANANA601_03064_JAGRATI_000_012: For now give her this. It is the last of our reserves until I can make more. This will take time of course, but it should be ready before we have need of it.
TEXT_BANANA601_03064_ESHANA_000_020: You are returned. Was Jagranti able to provide you with any sssalve?
TEXT_BANANA601_03064_ESHANA_000_021: Wonderful. My sssisters will be relieved to have this.
TEXT_BANANA601_03064_ESHANA_000_022: Care for our tails is more than a matter of beauty, after all.
TEXT_BANANA601_03064_ESHANA_000_023: A tail marred with scars for usss is like a pair of boots riddled with holes for you ssstriders. We can have no hindrances if we are to respond quickly to an emergency.
TEXT_BANANA601_03064_JAGRATI_000_025: Take that salve to Eshana. Our ssstores should be replenished before we have need of it again.
TEXT_BANANA602_03065_ESHANA_000_000: You do not fear heightsss, do you? We have need of one who can scale the rock formations of Virdjala to procure dianthus.
TEXT_BANANA602_03065_ESHANA_000_001: Tea made from their petals is incredibly effective at reducing fatigue. Alpa thought to offer it to travelers ssseeking lodgings after a long journey.
TEXT_BANANA602_03065_ESHANA_000_002: The problem, however, is the flowers are quite delicate, and should they be bruised, their curative properties are greatly diminished.
TEXT_BANANA602_03065_ESHANA_000_003: Luckily for usss, a traveling alchemist taught us how to create a botanical growth formula.
TEXT_BANANA602_03065_ESHANA_000_004: Sssprinkle this upon the flowers and they will remain unharmed when plucked.
TEXT_BANANA602_03065_SYSTEM_000_010: You find the flower Eshana spoke of, and it is in full bloom. At a glance you can tell the petals are dreadfully delicate.
TEXT_BANANA602_03065_SYSTEM_000_011: The delicate petals of the flower seem hardened by Eshana's growth formula.
TEXT_BANANA602_03065_ESHANA_000_020: Were you able to find the flowers?
TEXT_BANANA602_03065_ESHANA_000_021: It seems the growth formula was more effective than I had hoped. A pity such beauty must be sssacrificed to make our tea.
TEXT_BANANA602_03065_ESHANA_000_022: The recipe was taught to us by a merchant of Ul'dah. A peculiar fellow who insssisted on trading for our shedded skin. Rather than barter for gold, we sssettled on information beneficial to our work here.
TEXT_BANANA602_03065_ESHANA_000_023: There is much knowledge to be shared with travelers coming and going between Gyr Abania and the Shroud. I pray we can count on your aid to ensure their sssafe passage.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_ESHANA_000_000: Ah, . We're in the midssst of preparing a shipment of goods to the M tribe. Might I trouble you for assistance in their delivery?
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_ESHANA_000_001: Normally we would deliver them by cart, but the contentsss of the containers are quite fragile.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_ESHANA_000_002: We've had no choice but to assemble a band of carriers to sssend them by hand, taking care not to run afoul of the beasts that roam these lands.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_ESHANA_000_003: Speak with the Resistance guard at the eastern end of the bridge. He will tell you what needs to be carried and to where.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_WATCHER03066_000_01: Eshana sent you to help with moving the goods, did she? Well the help's certainly welcome. We've got plenty of packages but too few hands to carry them.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_WATCHER03066_100_01: Think you could handle the satchel there on top of the boxes?
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_WATCHER03066_000_01: You'll be taking it to the Peering Stones. A merchant of the M tribe should be expecting you near the entrance.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_PEDDLER03066_000_01: Excuse me, . Did you happen to come from Castellum Velodyna? I'm expecting a shipment from the Ananta who hold the bridge there, but they've yet to arrive.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_SYSTEM_000_012: Deliver the fragile package to the Miqo'te merchant awaiting you at the specified location at the entrance of the Peering Stones.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_SYSTEM_000_013: You will have two minutes and fifteen seconds to complete the task. Should you fail, return to the starting location and begin anew.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_SYSTEM_000_014: Be wary of attacks from enemies, which will sap your strength.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_WATCHER03066_000_01: If you could deliver that satchel there on top of the crates, you'd be helping us more than you know. A merchant from the M tribe will be waiting for you at the entrance to the Peering Stones.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_PEDDLER03066_000_02: A package from the Ananta? Oh, yes, of course! Pray forgive me, I was expecting a soldier from the Resistance.
To be honest I'm surprised they have any merchandise to sell. Nearly everything they have is sent to the soldiers fighting on the front line.
To be honest I'm surprised they have any merchandise to sell. Nearly everything they have is sent to Ala Mhigo to help with the restoration.
Still, their goldwork and textile goods are quite popular. It's surprisingly easy to reap large profits despite the great sums we pay for their wares.

But I've kept you long enough. Once everything is accounted for it's off to the markets with me. When you return to the castellum, pray tell Eshana I will visit soon to thank her personally, as well as deliver their share of our earnings.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_WATCHER03066_100_02: Thanks again for your help, . Now you'll want to take that satchel over to the Peering Stones. A merchant from the M tribe will be waiting for you at the entrance.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_WATCHER03066_000_02: Back, are we? I was afraid this might happen. Well, there's plenty more to carry, so grab another satchel. Do try to be a little more careful with this one, okay?
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_SYSTEM_000_026: Deliver the fragile package to the Miqo'te merchant awaiting you at the specified location at the entrance of the Peering Stones.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_SYSTEM_000_027: You will have two minutes and fifteen seconds to complete the task. Should you fail, return to the starting location and begin anew.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_SYSTEM_000_028: Be wary of attacks from enemies, which will sap your strength.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_PEDDLER03066_000_02: A few more boxes and I'll be ready to leave to the markets. When you return to the castellum, pray tell Eshana I will visit soon to thank her personally, as well as deliver their share of the profits.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_ESHANA_000_030: Ah, you are returned. I trust the shipment was sssafely delivered?
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_ESHANA_000_031: Thank goodness. I was concerned they might leave without our wares.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_ESHANA_000_032: Time with the Resissstance has taught us not everything must be done on our own. It can be advantageousss to work with others, all contributing their unique abilities to accomplish a common goal.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_ESHANA_000_033: Through the M tribe we can sell our wares. And through adventurers sssuch as yourself, we can more easily secure our livelihood.
TEXT_BANANA603_03066_ESHANA_000_034: Thusss can the Gatekeepers afford to focus their efforts on helping others in need. We all have our part to play if we are to ensure a better tomorrow for Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_BANANA604_03067_ESHANA_000_000: , our ssscouts, they've been attacked! Left for dead by sssome territorial predator!
TEXT_BANANA604_03067_ESHANA_000_001: The messenger who limped into camp sssays they were ssset upon along their patrol route in Virdjala.
TEXT_BANANA604_03067_ESHANA_000_002: They're in need of immediate attention, and I have no other sssoldiers to sssend. Quickly, take this healing sssalve and find our injured comrades!
TEXT_BANANA604_03067_SOLDIERA03067_000_0: Wait, what is that you're smearing on...oh. Oh! The pain is gone!
Thank you! I think...yes, I can make it back on my own now.
TEXT_BANANA604_03067_SOLDIERB03067_000_0:
<gasp> Well, that's it then.
I'm done for...
My thanks─you've dragged me back from death's doorstep! I've walked this route a time or two and thought I knew what to expect... I'll be more careful on my way back to the castellum.
TEXT_BANANA604_03067_SOLDIERC03067_000_0: I don't know what was in that ointment, but it seems the bleeding's stopped. I'd best report in. My thanks!
TEXT_BANANA604_03067_ESHANA_000_020: Thank you, ─all the ssscouts are accounted for.
TEXT_BANANA604_03067_ESHANA_000_021: Were you perhapsss curious about the sssalve I had you use? It is an old Ananta remedy that numbs the wound and clotsss the blood...for a time.
TEXT_BANANA604_03067_ESHANA_000_022: As sssuch, these ointmentsss are perfect for emergency treatment out in the field. For long term healing, however, the ressstorative alchemies of your people are far sssuperior.
TEXT_BANANA604_03067_ESHANA_000_023: The Gatekeepers will, of course, ssseek to employ the bessst combination of both. Thank you again for your ssswift assistance.
TEXT_BANANA605_03068_ESHANA_000_000: Greetings, . No pressing emergencies at the moment, but the infirmary could use a hand if you're willing.
TEXT_BANANA605_03068_ESHANA_000_001: There's a problem with bugs, you sssee─the biting, ssstinging kind. Our sssentries finish their watches covered in weltsss, and we cannot ignore the effect thisss may have on morale.
TEXT_BANANA605_03068_ESHANA_000_002: Even the ssstrongest incense won't keep all the insssects away, but mudssstone can be ground into a passste that sssoothes the worssst of the itching. Might you bring me three or ssso chunksss? You'll find despositsss of the ssstuff in the waters of Mirage Creek.
TEXT_BANANA605_03068_ESHANA_000_010: Were you able to locate any mudssstone depositsss?
TEXT_BANANA605_03068_ESHANA_000_011: Yesss, these should do nicely. Once applied, the balm worksss to alleviate any irritation almossst immediately.
TEXT_BANANA605_03068_ESHANA_000_012: It is a traditional remedy of ours, passed down through generations.
TEXT_BANANA605_03068_ESHANA_000_013: We do alssso have an alchemical sssalve made by your people which heals the bites themssselves, but it is in short sssupply. I would rather sssave it for the mossst sssevere cases, and rely on mudssstone for daily use.
TEXT_BANANA606_03069_ESHANA_000_000: Greetings, . As you know, my sssisters and I often employ the bow as our weapon of choice.
TEXT_BANANA606_03069_ESHANA_000_001: Without a sssteady sssupply of arrows, however, the bow becomes little more than a frail ssstaff. If you would do usss the honor, I would asssk that you gather one of the materials used to conssstruct our ammunition.
TEXT_BANANA606_03069_ESHANA_000_002: A fine arrow needs a ssstraight shaft, of course, but it is the fletching which guides the missile far and true. We've found the feathers taken from the ssso-called “regal” gagana to bessst keep their shape...when we can get them.
TEXT_BANANA606_03069_ESHANA_000_003: This breed of gagana ssstalks the Ssstriped Hills, and are fearsssome birds indeed. Ssslay a pair of them, and pluck from their hides as many undamaged feathers as you can.
TEXT_BANANA606_03069_ESHANA_000_011: Yesss, these are perfect! As a huntress, my fingers already ache to loose the arrows made with sssuch feathers.
TEXT_BANANA606_03069_ESHANA_000_012: We go through many missiles during our duties on the border, and will always need more materials. I will be sure to call on you again when our ssstock of feathers is running low.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_SYSTEM_000_001: The Namazu before you is twitching vigorously.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_SYSTEM_000_002: Though it seems to be in a bad way, it is unmistakably alive and will probably survive without your intervention.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_A1_000_001: Offer your prayers and move along.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_005: I am not dead─far from it! And do not pretend that you thought I was!
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_006: How unfair of you to assume that aiding me would lead you to undertake a series of arduous tasks. I assure you that I require your assistance only this once.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_007: You see, fate─destiny!─guided me to the Azim Steppe.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_008: But as I wandered this unfamiliar land, I became increasingly lost...and dry. Parched! Until I found I could no longer take even a single step...
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_009: Random passerby, you will be traveling to Yanxia, yes? You will find that I am most portable. Quite suitable for sacks. I ask only that you convey me to Gyorei at Yuzuka Manor.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOREI_000_020: My, my, what an oddly shaped bag you have!
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOREI_000_022: Gyoshin! How did you come to be so desiccated?
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOREI_000_023: No, no, never mind that─I will bring water posthaste!
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_025: There is nothing like a deep draught of the One River's water. Another half-dozen jugs and I will be most fully refreshed!
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOREI_000_026: First you might explain where you have been! And what of this traveler─have you no words for ? Such an ill-mannered Namazu I have never seen!
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_027: Oh, yes, yes. Slipped my mind entirely. Ahem! Thank you, thank you, random passerby!
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_028: I am Gyoshin. Namazu artisan, crafter of crafts. My deftness of fin is second to none.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOREI_000_029: Yes, yes, he would be almost admirable were he not so careless. Why, not a fortnight ago he wandered into the path of a falling vase and was knocked utterly unconscious.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_030: Indeed, that is how I came by this head wound. It was most excruciatingly painful. And though I made a full recovery and have been in perfect health ever since...
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_031: I began to have unusual dreams. Yes, yes. Dreams of my greatest grandsire standing before me, shrouded in light...
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_032: He revealed that every seven hundred and seventy-seven years, we must hold a seven-year celebration commemorating the birth of our tribe. Should we fail to do so, the Namazu will be most gruesomely annihilated once seven years pass. Seven years!
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOREI_000_033: And so you immediately set forth on a journey to our homeland at the head of the One River? Without so much as a thought towards preparation?
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOREI_000_034: How reckless can you possibly be? Though I do not doubt it was distressing to you, a dream is no more than a dream. Yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: (-Intellectual-sounding Voice-)...Hasten not to judge, for profound truth may lie in even visions of the night.
None other than I, renowned member of the literati, Seigetsu the Enlightened!
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_038: Oh, it's just Gyofun. Always with his face buried in a book─a walking tome with whiskers, our Gyofun─
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Speak not that name, no, no! I cast it aside long ago, for I have searched my soul and found my true name─Seigetsu the Enlightened! Seigetsu the Enlightened! How many times must I tell you!?
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_040: Yes, yes, your soul has a lot to say, I am aware. Did you need something?
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: This. This is why I detest imbeciles... But I will waste no further words on you and your deficiencies, for a matter of greater import demands our attention: the festival.

In the course of my scholarly endeavors, I encountered a dated manuscript entitled The Epic of Ganen, which mentions an event that took place centuries past along the upper One River. This “unforgettable spectacle,” as the author describes it, was a festival held by our own ancestors.
It is written that this festival marked our people's first step toward enlightenment─the advent of a civilized Namazu society. Even you must understand the significance.

Though I suspect your “vision” is a by-product of a few too many blows to the head, reviving this tradition is an excellent idea. At long last, the Namazu will emerge from the darkness of ignorance─our cultural renaissance has arrived!
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_045: I have no idea what that means and am not sure if I care, but if you are offering to help, then I graciously accept.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOREI_000_046: Well, well, I see there is no stopping you. I will accompany you, then─but I must insist that we bring another. One with more than a passing familiarity with the region.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOREI_000_050: Gyoshin is liable to wander off a cliff if left to his own devices. As a friend, I cannot let him make this journey alone. No, no.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: You are insatiably curious as to why my orbital structure differs from that of my brethren, are you not? It is merely a physical manifestation of my surpassing intellect. I call it...the Gaze of the Enlightened.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_060: So, so, how much do you know about the Steppe?
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: My word, not only have you spent many a day there, but you also claimed victory in the Naadam on behalf of the Mol? Surely there is no guide more qualified to lead us.
I can only pity you, mired in the depths of ignorance as you are. Listen well: the Azim Steppe is home to valorous warriors known as the Xaela.

Were we to enter and carry on with our festival preparations unannounced, we would undoubtedly be skewered and served as hors d'oeuvres. Or perhaps steamed and served in a buuz, as that is a rather more common delicacy among the Steppe's tribal peoples...
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_065: I would rather not be served either way, thank you!
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: That is precisely why we are fortunate to have encountered . We need only for  to escort us to the khatun of the Mol, whom we can petition for permission to hold our festival.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_067: I see, I see. In that case, please lead us there! I am sure that my explanation of our mission will be quite convincing. Most persuasive.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_CIRINA_000_068: It is lovely to see you again, khagan. I was delighted when I heard that the elder gods spoke of your return. Though I must admit that I am unsure what to make of their description of the companions you are meant to introduce to us today.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_TEMULUN_000_070: I bid you welcome, khagan. Glad are we to see that the gods have brought you to us once again. And I see you are in the company of Namazu?
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_071: Hello, hello! We, well, you see...
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_TEMULUN_000_072: I know what you seek. We have already readied a location for your celebration.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_073: H-How did you know? Clairvoyance? Witchcraft!?
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_TEMULUN_000_074: I but heed the whispers of the gods. They spoke of two disciples of creation traveling hither to hold a great celebration─one of whom would be a Namazu.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Astounding. Are you perchance one of the Mol's esteemed udgan? I read of them in Narrow Road through the Deep Grass.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOREI_000_076: Wait, wait. Gyoshin must be the Namazu in question, but who is the second disciple of creation?
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_A2_000_001: I'm something of an artisan myself.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_A2_000_002: I've been known to dabble in gathering.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_078: One shock after another! You manage such delicate work without fins?
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_079: One shock after another! You can locate things without barbels?
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_080: Well, physical inadequacies notwithstanding, I am sure that you would be a great help. Will you assist us? Please, please?
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_A3_000_002: Not just no, no, but hells no, no.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_TEMULUN_000_082: Do you recall what I once told you? Stars flock to you. Cherish their light.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_TEMULUN_000_083: These little ones too were drawn to your side. Lend them your radiance. If not today, then someday soon, for all asterisms have meaning.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_084: Then it is decided! Everything is settled!
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_TEMULUN_000_085: Indeed. I will have you shown to the grounds we have prepared.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_MOLGUIDE_000_086: In the west stand the rocky cliffs of the Towering Still, erstwhile home of the Dhoro. Their abandoned structures have fallen into disrepair, but with some effort they can be repurposed.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_087: You are too kind, most considerate. I can hardly wait to see!
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_MOLGUIDE_000_090: The festival grounds can be found on the plateau above. Your Namazu comrades have already made their way there. Shall I show you to them?
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_TEMULUN_000_095: No one star brings light to the void alone. In number do they rise and overcome the night. Remember this, and weave a constellation to guide others as they forge their own paths through the dark.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_CIRINA_000_100: Lamb or dzo are the most common fillings, but I suddenly find myself remembering how delicious buuz are when made with catfish.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOREI_000_105: A river flows below the cliffs, so at least we need not worry for want of water.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: As the famed wanderer Hoelun notes in Narrow Road through the Deep Grass, the Dhoro are a proud but reclusive people who eschew almost all contact with outsiders. Perhaps Dhoro Iloh's surroundings will yield some indication as to why.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_115: These pavilions are rather dilapidated, quite decrepit, but I will have them fixed up in no time.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_120: A wonderful location! Yes, yes. These pavilions are rather dilapidated, quite decrepit, but I will have them fixed up in no time.
TEXT_BANNAM000_03096_GYOSHIN_000_121: Yes, yes, I am itching to get to work! ...Though the actual itching may be my fins drying out again. Who wants to carry me down to the river?

TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_GYOSHIN_000_005: There is much to be done, yes, yes. Fortunately, I brought along my lucky hammer, lucky saw, lucky needle, lucky headknife, lucky anvil...
TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: I worry not for the grounds. Gyoshin lacks many things, but zeal is not among them. Attire, however...
TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_GYOSHIN_000_011: ...Are you implying something about my fashion sense?
TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Oh, to be so ignorant! What you fail to realize is that festivals are not mere entertainment, but rather divine rituals. It is simply unacceptable to wear one's usual apron, couture notwithstanding.
According to Hibarisai's An Account of Myself, the people of Hingashi traditionally don happi, colorful vestments resembling coats, on such occasions.

I can produce an illustration based on what I have gleaned from my readings. However, creating the happi themselves is quite another matter. Alas, where my intellect excels, my dexterity leaves something to be desired.
TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_GYOREI_000_015: How fortunate that I am a dab fin at sewing, then. Yes, yes. I can make your design a reality.
TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_GYOREI_000_016: But considering the volume of detail work required, another pair of fins would be ideal. Can I count on your assistance, ?
TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_GYOREI_000_017: Thank you, thank you! Gyofu─er, Seigetsu the Enlightened, can you decide what to delegate?

TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_GYOSHIN_000_045: I shall have the grounds ready in no time, no time at all!
TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_GYOREI_000_050: You have what we need? I thought you might still be stuck in unwilling conversation with Seigetsu the Enlightened.
TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_GYOREI_000_051: Gyoshin has made significant progress as well─and with nary a gaping wound to show for it!
TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_GYOREI_000_052: I expect that everything will be ready shortly, yes, yes, so please take this opportunity to rest.
TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_SYSTEM_000_053: You and Gyorei have made happi fit for a festival.
TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_SYSTEM_000_054: Gyoshin has made progress in repairing the pavilions.
TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_GYOSHIN_000_055: These pavilions should be suitable housing for our large cohort of volunteers. Yes, yes. According to my vision, we must aim to attract seven hundred and seventy-seven participants to avert complete and total annihilation─which means we have only seven hundred and seventy or so to go!
TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_GYOSHIN_000_056: With these festive happi, I am sure we will recruit the rest in no time. Please, please continue to lend us a fin in the coming days!
TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_SYSTEM_000_057: Only seven years remain until the Namazu are forever wiped from the face of Hydaelyn...
TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_SYSTEM_000_058: But today, their ambitious plans to defy this fate are in motion. What will become of them?
TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_SYSTEM_000_059: You have achieved Friendly reputation with the Seven Hundred Seventy-Seven.
TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_SYSTEM_000_060: Namazu society quests are now available from Seigetsu the Enlightened at Dhoro Iloh.
TEXT_BANNAM001_03097_SYSTEM_000_061: Furthermore, you may now purchase wares from Gyosho.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_001: Festival preparations are nearly complete, yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_002: Our task is now to find enthusiastic participants. So long as we have at least seven hundred and seventy-seven, our survival is assured! With our current number, we require only seven hundred and sixty-eight more.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_003: ...Hm? You have a foreboding feeling? How curious! But never mind that. I require your help in recruiting volunteers, yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_004: It had slipped my mind until this moment, but I remember now that you are rather well known amongst the Namazu. Quite famous!
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_005: You fixed Gyorin's finances, along with...other feats that I need not recall just now. The important part is that you are respected, and therefore can recruit many, many Namazu.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_006: It will not take much time at all, no, no. Simply trek back to Yuzuka Manor, seek out Namazu that have no pressing duties, approach each and every one, and provide them with happi while explaining what participation in the festival entails.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_007: We will continue preparations here in the meantime. Yes, yes. See you shortly, I am sure!
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_010: Let me see... We require seven hundred seventy-seven happi...and we have twelve, so that means... Hm, do you think we need more fabric?
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYORIN_000_020: Why, ! Fancy seeing you here! Have you come to look upon my fabulous apron?
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYORIN_000_021: Oh, how gorgeous, how stunning! I can wear this happi, you say? And it will be my very own? Then yes, yes, I certainly will participate in this festival of yours.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYORIN_000_022: With so many attendees, there are bound to be business opportunities as well. Yes, yes. I may just bring some of my wares with me. Somehow I still have quite a few persimmons in stock...
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYORIN_000_025: I will pack my surplus of persimmons and meet you there, yes, yes!

TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_DRUNKNAMAZU_000_031: Wear this for a fes-tea-val? Yes─<hic>─yes! Lead the way!
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_LEISUREDNAMAZU_000_: Breathe in, breathe out... Breathe in, breathe out... Breathe in, breathe out... Good heavens, my life is dull. Maybe I will sleep, yes, yes, perchance to dream...
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_LEISUREDNAMAZU_100_: ...You want to speak to me? You must be mistaken.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_LEISUREDNAMAZU_000_: You are really, truly inviting me to a festival? Finally, a reason to live! I will don this happi forthwith and join you at the Azim Steppe.
O glorious day! Glad am I that I kept breathing, yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_040: Ah, there you are, ! Our preparations have gone swimmingly, yes, yes. I was on the point of calling everyone to a meeting. Just a moment, please!
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_041: I would like to express my sincere gratitude. My heartfelt appreciation. Without you, I could never have come this far. No, no.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_042: It is only because you were willing to follow me, to travel here to the Azim Steppe, that we are here today. Because you were willing to join fins─er, hands─that we can now complete this project together.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_043: Before the participants arrive, I just wanted to tell you, to let you know, how much I appreciate you. Please, join us in celebration. Our efforts have borne fruit, and the fated festival is here at last!
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: So...if I may inquire, what manner of activities does said festival entail?
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOREI_000_047: What of your vision? Did our greatest grandsire say nothing of what sort of festival we are meant to be having?
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_048: Now that you mention it, I cannot say he did. No, no. I suppose I have been so focused on preparing the festival site that I completely, utterly forgot to think ahead. Oh dear!
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: How irresponsible... However, I anticipated that it might come to this, so I made an effort to peruse writings relevant to our purpose.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_050: Wonderful! Excellent work, Gyofu─I mean, Seigetsu the Enlightened. Yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Yes, well. The nature of our forebears' festivities, per my research, is, to put it concisely...
Alas, the Namazu of eld had no system of writing, and no secondary sources detailing their festival appear to have survived the passage of the centuries.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_054: That is the least informative information you could have possibly provided, Gyofun!
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Why you, you...you have no right to talk! Ahem. Though it is true that I was unable to learn anything regarding our people's particular traditions, my research was hardly for naught.

A seminal publication in the field of cultural anthropology, The Chrysanthemum and the Dango, states that festivals involve performative prayer and expressions of gratitude, and are intended to celebrate a given culture's gods or ancestors.
Thus, we may assume that our forebears' festival would have celebrated our worthiest of ancestors, the Big One.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_058: ...I still have no idea what we are meant to do! No, no. Could you get to the point before we shrivel up and die?
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: I will enlighten you if you cease your constant interruptions! Now, as I was saying, there are myriad festivals across Othard, but at the most fundamental level, all revolve around ceremonial offerings.
Considering the primitive Namazu's lifestyle, there is a high probability the offering would have consisted of something found in the river or thereabouts. Do you follow?
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_061: We need a...fish? For an offering. And...I hope nothing else you said was important.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_062: , Gyorei, your help in this will be most important. Quite essential. Follow me over there, yes, yes, before Gyofun starts talking again.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOREI_000_065: Despite their many, many differences, Gyoshin trusts in Gyofun's knowledge.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_080: We can use this space to build an altar for our offering. Yes, yes. All of this derelict masonry is ripe for the remodeling.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_081: So I need you to make some sturdy altar pieces, and fast. Like the wind! The materials are in the crate by the pavilion. You can take more as needed, yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_082: So I need you to make some exquisite, lovingly detailed altar pieces. The materials are in the crate by the pavilion. You can take more as needed, yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_083: So I need you to make some extremely flammable, alarmingly combustible components for the altar's bonfire. The materials are in the crate by the pavilion. You can take more as needed, yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_084: So I need you to collect skystones for the altar's base. You will find them south of Chakha Zoh, yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_085: In the meantime, I need you to collect scarlet flax for the decorative draperies. You will find it south of Chakha Zoh, yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_086: In the meantime, I need you to collect the offering itself. One steppe barramundi, please! You can find them at Dotharl Khaa if you are willing to part with a bit of salmon roe, yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_087: Time to put our whiskers to the grindstone! Turn what you have over to Gyorei when finished, please. She is most insistent on keeping anything heavy, flammable, or easily broken away from me, for some reason.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_088: Have you run out of materials? Never fear, the crate is here! ...Well, it is actually over there. But it is full of stuff, yes, yes.

TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOSHIN_000_091: Ready already? Then please give what you have to Gyorei for safekeeping.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOREI_000_100: You have the goods, yes, yes? No, no, the other goods. The ones Gyoshin asked for.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_GYOREI_000_101: Thank you, thank you! Gyoshin seems to be progressing quite quickly as well. The altar will be complete any moment now, and then we can begin the festival proper.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_SYSTEM_000_102: Working side by side with the Namazu, you have completed the altar. Festivities in honor of the Big One have begun!
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_SYSTEM_000_103: In seven years, the One River was fated to experience a fish famine, depriving the Namazu of their primary food source. Many would have died.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_SYSTEM_000_104: However, continuous fishing of large predatory fish for use as offerings over the course of seven years will allow smaller fish to flourish, creating a healthy ecosystem and ensuring bountiful catches for the foreseeable future.
TEXT_BANNAM002_03098_SYSTEM_000_105: Unbeknownst to all, the Namazu will be spared the grievous tragedy that could have consumed them, and their fate continues to change for the better.

TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_001: , ! There is something I wish to discuss. Wait here while I gather the others.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_002: Our joint efforts have borne fruit, and more and more Namazu come from Yanxia to join us every day. We are surely nearing seven hundred seventy-seven participants by now. Yes, yes... Though I admit I lost track after nine. I only have so many fins and whiskers to count with, you know.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_003: Alas, my sleep remains troubled. Restless. Every night, I dream of nothing but the Big One.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOREI_000_004: My, my, is the Big One so unsatisfied with our offerings?
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_005: I wish I knew. Perhaps an offering in and of itself does not a festival make. If we had the wrong idea, then, then...
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_006: ...We will die in seven years. Seven years!
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_007: Please at least feign distress over our plight!
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Gyoshin's absurd night terrors notwithstanding, he is right in that an offering does not constitute a festival. The addition of a ceremony with more cultural aspects would not go amiss.
True, primitive festivals were not particularly artistic endeavors. But from their base origins did they evolve. Prayer transformed to divination, and ritual to spectacle.

Thus did the shaman become ever more significant to society, and come to wield power similar to that of a chieftain or king. And these shamans, in turn, imbued festivals with yet more ostentation─the better to catch the public eye, you see.

Ceremonial accoutrements became ever more elaborate, while the scale of the events expanded exponentially. This series of escalations culminated in the development of extravagant festival processions!
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_012: ...Summarize your suggestion. Briefly. Three sentences or less.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: <sigh> Per The Chrysanthemum and the Dango, some festivals in Hingashi are known for their parades. These parades involve carrying objects called mikoshi. We should attempt to imitate them.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_014: See, you can do it if you try. If you expend the effort. Now do that from the start next time.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_015: So, so, ! You recall how I am most portable, yes, yes? I must away to Kugane, to see a mikoshi and its construction firsthand. Go ahead and stuff me in your bag again, if you please.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOREI_000_020: You take care, now. Yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_030: <wheeze> That bag is most full of sharp objects. And quite cluttered. I can hardly believe I escaped that rubbish-packed purgatory alive.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_031: ...I did not intend to say that out loud. No, no. What I meant was, “thank you!” Yes, yes, of course.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_032: So, this is Kugane! The vivid colors, the brilliant hues! My artistic soul is all astir!
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SHIPWRIGHT_000_033: (-???-)Oi, ye Namazu bastard! Mighty lovely to see ye here. Now prepare fer a beatin'!
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SHIPWRIGHT_000_034: Thought ye'd run off with me money, did ye? Well ye won't be runnin' nowhere when I'm through with ye!
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_035: W-Wait, wait! Who are you and why, why are you yelling?
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SHIPWRIGHT_000_036: Don't go playin' silly buggers with me! Ye owe me fer a ship. If I ain't seein' no coin from ye, I'll take it outta yer hide!
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SHIPWRIGHT_000_037: Eh? This here's “Gyoshin,” not that swindler Gyodo?
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SHIPWRIGHT_000_038: Well blow me down! My mistake, little fish fella.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_039: I am just relieved that this was resolved without “beatin'.” I would much prefer to view the mikoshi with my hide intact. Yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SHIPWRIGHT_000_040: Yer interested in mikoshi? A Namazu after me own heart!
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SHIPWRIGHT_000_041: Ye might not have heard, but it's shipwrights like us what build mikoshi here in Kugane. I'd hate to leave ye with a bad impression, so how 'bout I teach ye what I know by way of apology?
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_042: I would be most delighted! Very pleased!
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SHIPWRIGHT_000_043: Just head on over to the ol' Ofunakura, then, and I'll show ye everything there is to know.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_050: I never imagined we would receive instruction in mikoshi-crafting so soon after arriving in Kugane. No, no. How fortunate that I was nearly murdered!
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SHIPWRIGHT_000_060: Alright, so what ye need to know first is that mikoshi are meant to be carriages fer the kami. 'Course kami usually reside in shrines, where we earthly folk go to pray, but they also feel right at home in mikoshi. Which means mikoshi are basically small shrines, ye ken?
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SHIPWRIGHT_000_061: And since we carry 'em for festival parades, they need to be portable. So we attach some poles, and there ye have it─a proper mikoshi.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SHIPWRIGHT_000_062: Now, Namazu like yerself have a short reach. And are all...round, like. So ye'll need to put some thought into what ye should attach to yer mikoshi to make it easy to carry.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_063: I see. This has been quite informative. Most enlightening.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SHIPWRIGHT_000_064: I'll give ye this diagram as well, so go out there and build the best mikoshi yer little flippers can manage.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_065: I love diagrams! Am most fond of design documents, indeed. Let us return to Dhoro Iloh posthaste. I will walk this time... Not to cast any aspersions on the state of your bag, no, no.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SHIPWRIGHT_000_070: I suppose I'll head back to searchin' for that Gyodo now. But I'll make sure I've got the right Namazu afore I go a-pummelin'.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOREI_000_075: I do hope your journey to Kugane was educational. Yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_080: I have meditated on how to build a mikoshi suitable for Namazu needs.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_081: It will require some complex adjustments, some tricky alterations, but nothing my deft fins cannot handle.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_082: Now, I need you to make some mikoshi pieces. They must be extravagant. Most fancy! The materials you need should be in the crate by the pavilion, so just throw some together. Carefully.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_083: Now, I need you to make some mikoshi pieces. They must be extravagant. Most fancy! The materials you need should be in the crate by the pavilion, so just throw some together. Carefully.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_084: Now, I need you to make some components for the finishing touches. Colorful paints, yes, yes. The materials should be in the chest by the pavilion, so just whip some up. Slowly, so as not to splatter.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_085: Now, I need you to fetch me some dawn dust for the ornamentation. You will find deposits northeast of the Dawn Throne. Yes, yes. Try not to get any in your eye! It is quite painful, I can personally attest.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_086: Now, I need you to fetch me some duskglow cocoons for the ceremonial rope. You should find a few in the vegetation patches northeast of the Dawn Throne. Yes, yes. Watch out for jutting twigs! They are most unpleasant when encountered face-first, I can personally attest.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_087: Now, I need you to fetch me a water fan for decoration. You can catch them in Azim Khaat, so long as you have salmon roe to lure them. Yes, yes. Take care not to fall in! It is surprisingly easy to do, I can personally attest.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_088: Gyorei will collect the components. Yes, yes. We will commence assembly once everything is in her capable fins.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_089: There should be extra materials in the crate. Rummage through as you please.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_100_089: There should be extra materials in the crate. Rummage through as you please.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_110_089: There should be extra materials in the crate. Rummage through as you please.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_200_089: Gyorei will collect the components, yes, yes. And then we will assemble the mikoshi!

TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SYSTEM_110_091: You sift through the cornucopia of crafting materials and retrieve all you require for your work.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_092: This will make for a most magnificent, fabulously fancy mikoshi! Now if you could just walk three ilms that way and speak to Gyorei, she will add your work to our growing stock.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOREI_000_100: I hope Gyoshin's task gave you no trouble. He does tend toward the unreasonable. Yes, yes. That said, I am excited to see the finished product!
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_101: Yes, yes! Our work is complete. A magnificent mikoshi, fit for the Big One!
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_102: Shining at the top is our greatest grandsire, as I saw him in my vision. I have included several deeply significant, most meaningful bells to emphasize his importance.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_103: I also added cloudsbreath to the shrine so that it will float atop the shoulders of even the roundest individuals. Yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_104: It is time to begin the parade! But we will not start without you. No, no. We will commence once you are ready. When you tell me you are prepared.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOREI_000_105: Why, the mikoshi is so beautiful I cannot bear to look away! How fortunate that I do not blink.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_111: According to that violent yet helpful shipwright, in some regions a participant is appointed to ride the mikoshi and represent the kami. We would be honored if you accepted this role!
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_112: Guide the bearers around the festival grounds, and make sure to cheer “wasshoi” as loud as you can in front of the onlookers. Or just sneeze with gusto─I find the effect is quite similar, yes, yes. Let me know how it goes!
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_115: I will summon the bearers again. Take care not to tumble off like a sack of Gyorin's increasingly ripe persimmons!
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_NAMAZUSIGHTSEER_000: What in the world is that?
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_NAMAZUSIGHTSEERB_10: So then I said, “that's what you get for not checking the jar before you climb inside it,” yes, yes...
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOREI_100_106: So many Namazu are volunteering to carry the mikoshi! I wonder if we can cram them all in...
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_107: Wasshoi! Wasshoi! Wassh─ Ow! I think I pulled something...
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOREI_000_108: Oh dear. This is what happens when he gets overexcited. , please go and entertain the attendees while I deal with this.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SYSTEM_000_109: The Namazu are waiting to witness a sensational spectacle. Speak with Gyoshin to mount the mikoshi, and perform a rousing Wasshoi before the Namazu spectators.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_NAMAZUSIGHTSEER_000: Wasshoi! Wasshoi! What am I doing? I do not know! I do not care! Whee!
We must have a turn holding that wasshoi hut! Onward!
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_NAMAZUSIGHTSEERB_00: I want to carry the...whatever it is! Right now! Immediately!
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_130: That was an inspiring sight! Most captivating. I myself felt a strong urge to join the mikoshi bearers, yes, yes, but Gyorei advised I channel my passion into crafting─for the safety of all involved.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_131: That is when I remembered that the designs from Kugane included plans for a “float.” There is no better outlet for my inspiration, no, no!
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_GYOSHIN_000_132: ...Which is to say that I am about to build a float right now. Watch me. And do not blink!
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SYSTEM_000_133: Working side by side with the Namazu, you have completed the mikoshi. ...And a float! Parades honoring the Big One are underway.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SYSTEM_000_134: In seven years, there was fated to be a violent feud between Namazu factions over the right to use prime fishing spots along the One River. Many would have died.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SYSTEM_000_135: However, carrying the mikoshi together in frequent parades over the course of seven years will bring the Namazu closer together, forging unbreakable bonds between clansmen.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SYSTEM_000_136: Unbeknownst to all, the Namazu will be spared the grievous tragedy that could have consumed them, and their fate continues to change for the better.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SYSTEM_000_137: You have achieved Respected reputation with the Seven Hundred Seventy-Seven.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SYSTEM_000_138: New Namazu society daily quests are now available from Seigetsu the Enlightened at Dhoro Iloh.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SYSTEM_000_139: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Seigetsu the Enlightened as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SYSTEM_000_140: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Seigetsu the Enlightened. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANNAM003_03099_SYSTEM_000_141: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Gyosho.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_001: <gasp> ! Once more I would consult you on festival matters. Issues of dire import! Stay right there.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_002: The parade was most delightful! So fun it was almost scary, yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_003: I paraded with such enthusiasm that I eventually lost all sense of time, all awareness of night and day...and when I came to, I was unconscious!
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOREI_000_004: ...I do not think that is how that works. No, no.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_005: Just imagine my shock when I saw my greatest grandsire before me once again! That is when I realized that I was asleep, dreaming.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: And now we must endure several sentences' worth of warnings regarding the inevitable annihilation of the Namazu, correct? Entirely lacking in plot development, each iteration of this story is no different from the last. Were this a work of fiction, I would hurl it into the nearest river!
However, never shall it be claimed that Seigetsu the Enlightened lacks foresight. Having observed these events repeat themselves once, I naturally prepared for another instance.
Now, festivals are culture made manifest, and, as posited in The Rise and Fall of Civilization: Volume VI, culture spreads.
Cultural knowledge is disseminated via migration and commerce, and that knowledge takes root as new elements in foreign cultures.
I see you moving to interject, Gyoshin! Close your gaping maw for a few more moments, and yes, I shall condense my conclusion to three sentences or fewer.
Our forebears' festival took place here many hundreds of years ago.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_KOFUINSEIGETSU_100_: Contemporary nomads doubtless witnessed said event.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_KOFUINSEIGETSU_110_: They must have incorporated knowledge of it into their own cultures!
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Go forth, Gyoshin! Pay visit to the Xaela and learn what traditions they keep, and you may well return with a wealth of ideas as to what our own festival lacks.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_013: Is it me, or is his enthusiasm a bit much? Anyway, I would very much like to call upon the Xaela, but there is the issue of being skewered, of being steamed in a buuz. Though considerably less so if you accompany me. Yes, yes?
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_014: Let us start with the least likely to skewer. Introduce me to the most friendly among the Mol, and I will inquire about their traditions.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOREI_000_015: This festival is shaping up to be quite the abomina─I mean, amalgam of traditions. Yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_025: I feel quite awkward, most nervous under this lady's rapt gaze. Could it be...love?
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_TEMULUN_000_026: It is good to see Dhoro Iloh put to use with such enthusiasm.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_CIRINA_000_030: (Mmm, catfish buuz... I can nearly taste it...)
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_CIRINA_100_030: Oh, ! What can I do for you?
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_CIRINA_000_031: Is that so? I would be glad to speak with you about our festival traditions, if you believe such knowledge might be of use to you.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_CIRINA_000_032: In our tribe, children of a certain age participate in a ceremonial race through the grasslands on horseback.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_CIRINA_000_033: For a nomadic people such as ourselves, horses are not only vital to our mobility and livelihood, they are like family. We tend to these dear companions with the utmost care.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_CIRINA_000_034: The speed of these horses, and the skill of the Mol children who guide them─these are what we offer the gods. How we show our gratitude for the richness of the land we are so blessed to live upon.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_035: I would never have expected a festival to take the form of a horse race. No, no. But it is most intriguing. Thank you for your insight!
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_036: You are also acquainted with the Oronir, yes, yes? To the Dawn Throne!
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_CIRINA_000_040: Such a delicious-looking fellow. Are they all so plump?
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_045: I feel rather unsettled, quite put off by this towering man's gaze. I hope he ate recently.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_MAGNAI_000_050: Come to pay me your respects, have you? I hope you are not so foolish as to have brought that bloated creature as a gift.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_MAGNAI_000_051: You believe that I can be of service to you?
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_MAGNAI_000_052: ...I suppose I can spare a few moments to enlighten you, though I do not expect you to comprehend the splendor and significance of Oroniri tradition.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_MAGNAI_000_053: The Oronir's most sacred custom is a tournament in which we determine who among us is the most─and least─worthy to lead. It is a contest which pits brother against brother in the traditional art of Azim Bökh. In this way, we demonstrate our strength to the tribe and to Father Azim.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_MAGNAI_000_054: Were the opportunity to arise, khagan, I expect you would conduct yourself well in the tournament. The malformed fishman, however, would be put flat on his back in the space of a breath.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_055: Why, I never! That sort of conduct will win you no friends. Nor bring you any luck with the ladies, no, no! Still, I suppose you did divulge a tradition of some interest, so I am grateful to you. A little. Not really.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_056: I would like to speak to the Dotharl before we return. It goes without saying that you must be there to prevent any untoward consumption of my flesh. Yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_MAGNAI_100_060: ...“Luck with the ladies”? Pah. What does a fishman know of such matters? Nothing! Nothing at all!
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_MAGNAI_000_060: ...“Luck with the ladies”? Pah. What does a fishman know of such matters? Nothing! Nothing at all!
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_065: I feel quite alarmed, rather terrified by this lady's piercing gaze. I sense skewerous intent!
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_SADU_000_070: You. Is this khun chuluu yours? Its vacant stare vexes me.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_SADU_000_071: ...I see. So they are the ones who claimed Dhoro Iloh for this...festival? And they seek knowledge of our traditions for this end? Very well. They are no threat, so there is no risk.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_SADU_000_072: The Dotharl are warriors and hunters both. Those born into this world could not survive otherwise.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_SADU_000_073: Thus do we use archery to demonstrate to the Dusk Mother that we are worthy of her legacy.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_SADU_000_074: We loose arrows at distant targets in a contest of truest aim. That is our tradition, simple as it is.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_075: A festival like a game? How interesting! This has been most illuminating, yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_076: I think that is enough mortal peril for one day. We have sufficient information to get started, so let us return to Dhoro Iloh.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_SADU_000_080: The khagan holding court with a host of khun chuluu! Will wonders never cease?
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_090: We made it! I am showing Gyorei my haleness. The intact state of my flesh.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOREI_000_100: I am pleased to see you whole, yes, yes. What did you learn?
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_101: Many, many things! Between horse races, Azim Bökh, and archery, the Xaela's festivals are most competitive. Quite fierce.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Unsurprising, given the nature of the Naadam. Without structured competitions, I daresay the Xaela would struggle to contain their base aggressive instincts. Their savagery would doubtless drive them to extinction, be it through internal or external conflicts.

I should like to indulge in further anthropological research, but I suppose your findings are sufficient for us to proceed. In essence, it seems that successful festivals involve engaging activities. We will require many if we are to entertain all seven hundred seventy-seven participants.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_104: Yes, yes! It will be quite an undertaking. A massive task, requiring division of labor. But if Gyorei handles horse racing, you host an Azim Bökh tournament, and myself and  arrange for archery, we will have three whole activities for our attendees to enjoy!
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_KOFUINSEIGETSU_100_: As you wish. Though I am loath to deprive you of my insight, I must work from the pavilion with full access to my research materials if I am to learn the rules of Azim Bökh in their entirety. I advise you all to think twice or thrice about any ideas you may have in my absence. Especially Gyoshin.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_105: Rude. Anyway, you can craft a metal grip fit for a ceremonial bow, yes, yes? I have stuffed all the materials in the crate in advance. Open it with care.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_106: Rude. Anyway, you can craft a limb decoration fit for a ceremonial bow, yes, yes? I have stuffed all the materials in the crate in advance. Open it with care.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_107: Rude. Anyway, you can make varnish fit for a ceremonial bow, yes, yes? I have stuffed all the materials in the crate in advance. Open it with care.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_108: Rude. Anyway, if you bring me some mondite from the deposits south of Reunion, I can craft the arrowheads. Perhaps even safely! Yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_109: Rude. Anyway, if you bring me a straight shoot from the vegetation south of Reunion, I can craft the arrows. Perhaps even safely! Yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_110: Rude. Anyway, if you can catch an arrowhead snail in Dotharl Khaa, I can craft the arrowheads. Perhaps even safely! Yes, yes. I recommend you attract one with salmon roe. Everyone loves salmon roe.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_111: Simply turn what you have over to me when finished, and I will complete the project most swiftly. With promptness!
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOREI_000_112: Hm? The crate remains replete with supplies, if you are in need. Yes, yes... Pardon me, I am attempting to work out how a Namazu might ride a horse.

TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOREI_220_112: Hm? Please provide your materials to Gyoshin. Yes, yes... Pardon me, I am attempting to work out how a Namazu might ride a horse.

TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_SYSTEM_110_114: You sift through the cornucopia of crafting materials and retrieve all you require for your work.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOREI_120_114: Maybe we could use some sort of adhesive to affix them to the saddle... Oh! Thank you for taking care of that. Gyoshin will handle the bow and arrow assembly.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_120: Bows and arrows require more pieces than I expected. Yes, yes. I am pleased to have such a challenge!
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_121: Thank you, thank you! I can craft a suitably ceremonial bow and arrows with this.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_122: I also have something to show you. I constructed it while awaiting your return...
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_123: A most sturdy yet intricate target at which to aim! You love it, yes, yes?
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOREI_000_124: Your craftsmanship is impressive as always. Yes, yes. But should it not stand up?
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_125: ...Oh. I suppose I was absorbed in the design and completely, utterly forgot to make a stand. Yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Gyoshin, has it never occurred to you that your difficulties are of your own making? Honestly. It would be more efficient to employ you to hold the target.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_127: I do not trust your motive for making that suggestion. No, no!
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: I assure you, your concern is unfounded. We need but assign the infallible  the role of marks for you to emerge uninjured. Yes, yes, I daresay.
Assume your positions! , you may collect the ceremonial bow and arrows from Gyorei behind the pavilion.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_135: You will take care not to hit me, yes, yes? Do you promise? Do you swear?
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOREI_000_140: This is the perfect cure for Gyoshin's carelessness. Yes, yes. He is most full of cares now.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOREI_000_141: Here are your ceremonial bow and arrows. Take aim at the target Gyoshin holds and fire away!
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_SYSTEM_000_142: The archery event has begun! Take aim at Gyoshin's target, zoom in to avoid accidents, and fire with .
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_143: W-Wow! Your aim is dead-on! Impeccable! ...Can I leave now?
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_144: This arrowhead is most...piercing. A sign of...quality craftsmanship...yes...<gurgle>
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOREI_000_145: Again, again! I am confident that you will get the hang of it with another shot or two!
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOREI_000_150: I am proud of how you handled that bow. Yes, yes!
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_160: Being on the business end of an arrow has never been an aspiration of mine. Not one of my goals in life. No, no.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_GYOSHIN_000_161: Still, I am quite confident we are prepared to host archery contests like the frightening Dotharl lady described. Attendees will be delighted with the complete and total accuracy of our reproduction, yes, yes. Now let us see if the other two activities are ready!
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_SYSTEM_000_162: Working side by side with the Namazu, you have successfully incorporated Xaela traditions into the festival. The horse racing, Azim Bökh, and archery competitions are now open to attendees!
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_SYSTEM_000_163: In seven years, the Namazu were fated to become the primary source of sustenance for starving Xaela, who would face food shortages after a fierce cold snap. Many would have died.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_SYSTEM_000_164: However, continuous practice of nomadic festival traditions over the course of seven years will promote mutual understanding between the Namazu and Xaela, averting the slaughter.
TEXT_BANNAM004_03100_SYSTEM_000_165: Unbeknownst to all, the Namazu will be spared the grievous tragedy that could have consumed them, and their fate continues to change for the better.
