TEXT_BANNAM506_03120_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Most excellent. You see, there is a reason we have needed to replace our altar offerings with such frequency. Shall I enlighten you as to why?
Thieves. A certain number of ill-natured and gluttonous Namazu have been stuffing their faces with our festival fare.
Thus did I requisition the creation of such offerings that would fill the bellies of these voracious vandals with naught but remorse. A civilized solution, do you not agree?

But even the average Namazu is unrepentant in his appetite! No matter how many are repulsed by our culinary artifice, there will always be another tempted by the prospect of a surreptitious snack! We must stand ready to restock our supply...
TEXT_BANNAM506_03120_SYSTEM_000_050: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANNAM507_03121_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: The mikoshi you helped us construct has made quite an impact on our people. We are currently in the process of building several more, but I fear their worth is significantly reduced if there are no bearers to parade them around...

Thankfully, in this case, my people are a simple breed. By merely demonstrating the majestic spectacle of our mikoshi in their immediate vicinity, they will soon clamor for the honor of bearing the load.
Go now to Gyotaku, . Claim a mikoshi, and soar across the steppe to where our gatherers toil on the edges of Nhaama's Retreat. The allure of your resounding “wasshoi” will not be denied!
TEXT_BANNAM507_03121_GYOTAKU_000_020: Ready for your mikoshi? Up you go, then! Give those boys and girls a good “wasshoi” from me!
TEXT_BANNAM507_03121_GYOTAKU_000_021: When the others returned with the mikoshi, I had thought your task successfully completed. But it seems you simply hopped down...or tumbled off. Here, why don't you try again, and keep a tighter grip this time, yes, yes?
TEXT_BANNAM507_03121_DAILYNAMAZUO03121A_: How colorful and festive! When do we ever get to scatter confetti with wild abandon?
TEXT_BANNAM507_03121_DAILYNAMAZUO03121B_: All we earn from this job is dry skin and skinned fins! We should head back and sign up to be mikoshi bearers!
TEXT_BANNAM507_03121_DAILYNAMAZUO03121C_: Oh, have you come to lift our spirits!? Banish the drabness? There truly is nothing worth collecting around here...
TEXT_BANNAM507_03121_DAILYNAMAZUO03121D_: Just Namazu-colored sand...and more Namazu-colored sand. I can't take this anymore! I quit! “Mikoshi bearer” is my true calling!
TEXT_BANNAM507_03121_DAILYNAMAZUO03121E_: Oho! What a lively crew! Rambunctious! And here we are working our fins to the gristle...
TEXT_BANNAM507_03121_DAILYNAMAZUO03121F_: Why don't we join the mikoshi bearers and enjoy ourselves for a change? Anything's better than grubbing in the mud! Yes, yes!
TEXT_BANNAM507_03121_DAILYNAMAZUO03121G_: We Namazu were hatched to enjoy life─not slave away at these dreary chores! I want an exciting job like the mikoshi bearers!
TEXT_BANNAM507_03121_DAILYNAMAZUO03121H_: Me too! This gathering nonsense can sink in the river for all I care!
TEXT_BANNAM507_03121_SYSTEM_000_028: These Namazu are busy harvesting supplies for the festival. Speak with Gyotaku at Dhoro Iloh to mount a mikoshi, and perform a rousing Wasshoi for the Namazu gatherers.
TEXT_BANNAM507_03121_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: The effect of your demonstration has been all but instantaneous─we have already accepted several applications for our bearer positions. <sigh> The fact that my kin are so easily influenced is a blessing on occasion.

I have it on good authority, however, that the physical labor of a mikoshi bearer takes a terrible toll on the body. We shall have shirkers and deserters aplenty within the week, and will soon be calling again upon your powers of persuasion...
TEXT_BANNAM508_03122_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Upon browsing the illustrated works of The Three Divine Flavors, I came to the realization that our festival is lacking that which is served to spectators at many a traditional celebration: a signature dish.
If we are to elevate our civilization and draw crowds to the festivities, then we must endeavor to emulate this culinary custom!

As we are to provide this delicacy for the palates of Namazu and non-Namazu alike, it stands to reason that you must participate in the preparatory stages. Go now, and present yourself to our apprehensive culinarian on the outskirts of Reunion.
TEXT_BANNAM508_03122_DAILYNAMAZUO03122_0: I'm so glad you've come! I have an idea for our festival dish, but I only know how to cook for Namazu. I'll need to borrow your talents─and possibly your tasting tongue!
Right, then. Today we'll be making a Namazu roast with a twist! The roast is ordinarily just a baked fish we eat on feast days, but this time it'll be steeped in a broth of “civilized” flavor.
For your part in our cooking collaboration, I'd like you to make me two marinade pots. All the materials you need should be in the supply crate.
For your part in our cooking collaboration, I'd like you to make me two drop lids to aid in the marinating process. All the materials you need should be in the supply crate.
For your part in our cooking collaboration, I'd like you to make me two jars of marinade─something you might taste in a city of culture! All the materials you need should be in the supply crate.
For your part in our cooking collaboration, I'd like you to acquire two chunks of crystal-clear rock salt. The finest! Seigetsu's research suggests deposits can be found to the south of Reunion.

For your part in our cooking collaboration, I'd like you to acquire two sprigs of fragrant steppe herbs─all the better to season our fish! Seigetsu's research suggests such herbs can be found to the south of Reunion.

For your part in our cooking collaboration, I'd like you to acquire a Nhaama's claw─this mollusk will provide the base stock for our marinade. So many rivers and streams to choose from, but try your luck in Nem Khaal first. Oh, and I hear they snap right down on salmon roe!
As for the glorious fish itself, I have it ready already! In a pail! Once you've brought me what I asked for, I can have it steeped and roasted in a moment. A mere twinkling!
As I said, any materials you find in the crate are yours to make use of. Except for my cooking utensils! You keep your fins off those!

TEXT_BANNAM508_03122_YESUI_000_051: You wish me to taste this...dish? I'm not the bravest of gourmands, but I'll not offer insult by refusing your gift.
TEXT_BANNAM508_03122_YESUI_000_052: This...this is heavenly! The, uh, “presentation” does little to entice the appetite, yet I would sell it at my stall for the taste alone! Maybe cover it with a cloth or some such!
TEXT_BANNAM508_03122_YESUI_000_053: <cough> <cough> Ugh. Never have I experienced such conflicting flavors! And why does it look as if it were crushed under a stone? Is...is this what the Namazu call cooking!?
TEXT_BANNAM508_03122_YESUI_000_054:
Ah, the lowing of the dzos is especially haunting today. Praise be to the Dawn Father and the Dusk Mother for bringing this beautiful world into existence!
...Forgive my rambling─I meant only to distract my mind from the sudden roiling of my belly.
TEXT_BANNAM508_03122_YESUI_000_055: Ahem. I thank you for introducing me to this unique experience. Send my regards to the Namazu, if you would.
TEXT_BANNAM508_03122_YESUI_000_056: Though a single mouthful was exciting enough, I will endeavor to finish this roasted delicacy of yours. Perhaps if I keep my eyes closed...? Uh, my thanks to your Namazu friends!
TEXT_BANNAM508_03122_DAILYNAMAZUO03122_0: Did you have Yesui sample our roast? Once she's tasted the fish, please report her verdict directly to Seigetsu!
TEXT_BANNAM508_03122_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: How fared the inaugural tasting of our Namazu roast collaboration?

...Could hardly bear to look upon it, you say? Hmm, I had not considered presentation as important as the taste. But we must not be discouraged─trial and error is a fundamental process through which all budding civilizations must suffer.

When we do finally perfect our signature dish, gourmet pilgrims will surely flood our festival, and our fins shall overflow with pecuniary tribute. Stand with us, , and bask in the dawn of a culinary revolution!
TEXT_BANNAM601_03123_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: I say, . I happened upon the most curious of traditions in my study of Northward Bound: A Spiritual Journey. This most illuminating of tomes recounts a ritual held on the outskirts of Ilsabard wherein townsfolk, mounted atop ceremonial floats, would assail passersby with produce from their very own storehouses!

Upon further reading, I discovered it is to celebrate a bountiful harvest. So bountiful, in fact, there is a surplus to shower upon the masses. Though the number of casualties seems to increase with each passing year, one cannot deny their pure intentions. Indeed, it is a tradition of beneficence. One we Namazu would do well to adopt on our path to enlightenment.

Alas, we have no harvests to boast of, let alone any surplus. Which is why we will use fincrafted goods instead. If you would consent to help in our preparations, pray travel east to the Path of the Craven. You will find one of my kin there gathering supplies.
TEXT_BANNAM601_03123_DAILYNAMAZUO03123_0: Another helping hand sent by Seigetsu the Enlightened? Tell me, what hidden shame has he threatened to bring to light? Your secret's safe with me. Yes, yes.

TEXT_BANNAM601_03123_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Preparations here are coming along nicely. Have you anything to contribute?
Ah, excellent. Our store of wares is not yet sufficient for the event, but soon we will be ready.

TEXT_BANNAM602_03124_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Ah, what fortuitous timing. You recall our recent rehearsal for the archery game taught to us by the Dotharl, yes? Simple though it may be, I took it upon myself to modify their techniques to better suit our soon-to-be refined tastes.
Indeed, I have done all I can so that even the likes of Gyoshin should have no trouble participating, yet it seems my kin are wholly inept at this seemingly facile skill.
To remedy this problem, I would have them bear witness once more to your exceptional marksmanship. Gyobi awaits you at the shooting gallery, hopefully with pen and paper to take notes.
TEXT_BANNAM602_03124_GYOBI_000_010: Thank you for coming. We're all quite excited to see your skill with a bow. Yes, yes, delighted. I realize I'm the only one watching, but...I'm quite sure that's how the others feel.

Though there still remains the matter of finding a bow that isn't unwieldy in our fins.
Or perhaps we needn't use a bow at all. We could use something smaller, like a pistol! But first I must find volunteers to serve as targets...
TEXT_BANNAM603_03125_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Over the Horizon describes a most peculiar festival from the west wherein tribesmen jump from atop cliffs with no promise of safety save for a bit of rope tethered to their waists.
Truth be told, even I balked at the thought of undertaking such a death-defying feat. Imagine my surprise when a number of my kin stepped forward, eager for an opportunity to prove their bravery.
Even now the thought of such a death-defying feat leaves my whiskers all aquiver. Imagine my surprise to see a number of my kin step forward, eager for yet another opportunity to prove their bravery.

In fact, one of them is at the Dawn Throne this very moment, preparing to jump from its dizzying heights. Would you go and see that he is duly prepared? This is one celebratory practice I would rather not see go awry.

I must give this some thought. Should any of my kin be willing to undertake yet another test of courage, however, I should hope you will be ready to assist us again.

At our present pace, I daresay we'll be keeping the Dotharls' bellies full for quite some time. Should our chef be beset by troubles again, I hope we can count on your help.

TEXT_BANNAM605_03127_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Thank goodness you're here. I know not how, but a number of my kin appear to have been bewitched. They stand about uttering nonsense all day, eyes rolled into the backs of their heads.

From my readings of Unbeaten Tracks in Yanxia, however, I believe I have discovered a means to rouse them from this inexplicable stupor. Apparently, the sudden flash and sound of firecrackers has been known to return cognitive function to those suffering from symptoms much like those I've seen in the others.
Might I ask you to carry out this ritual and return them to their senses?
They were last seen wandering about the Sea of Blades. Use these firecrackers, but try not to hurt them─they still have work to do!
TEXT_BANNAM605_03127_DAILYNAMAZUO03127A_: My knees feel weak, and my arms so heavy. I can't go on. No, no. Not another step.
TEXT_BANNAM605_03127_DAILYNAMAZUO03127B_: Everything keeps spinning... Round and round, in endless circles.
TEXT_BANNAM605_03127_DAILYNAMAZUO03127C_: My stomach keeps twisting and turning. It's all I can do not to heave.
TEXT_BANNAM605_03127_DAILYNAMAZUO03127A_: Wh-What...? How did I get here? Strange... I suddenly feel refreshed. Reinvigorated and ready to work. Well, I better be off. Yes, yes.
TEXT_BANNAM605_03127_DAILYNAMAZUO03127B_: Who─oh! Oh dear. I know how this looks... Actually, I don't, but I'm sure it's not good. I promise this won't happen again, no, no.
TEXT_BANNAM605_03127_DAILYNAMAZUO03127C_: Thank you, thank you. I feel so much better now. Yes, yes. If you'll excuse me, I need to be heading back to Dhoro Iloh.
TEXT_BANNAM605_03127_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: The others returned not long ago, full of vim and vigor, ready to get back to work. Those fireworks were more effective than I had hoped.

I realize before I said they appeared bewitched, but surely you don't believe such a thing could happen, do you? What's more likely is they stole sips of the sacred tea we have saved for one of our myriad celebrations.
Which means we have discovered a cure for inebriation─yet another leap toward a more civilized Namazu society!
TEXT_BANNAM606_03128_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: You recall the Azim Bökh, yes? The fierce wrestling competition held by the Oronir tribe.
Well, they have been gracious enough as to teach us the fundamentals of the sport, and it goes without saying they must be duly compensated for their generosity.

As the saying goes, he who sows courtesy reaps friendship, and theirs would be most valuable to the Namazu. As we speak, one of my kin labors tirelessly to prepare a gift worthy of the Oronir's beneficence. Might I ask you to go and ensure his work is proceeding apace?
You'll find him toiling away at the Dawn Throne. When the gift is finished, no need to bring it here for inspection. I have every confidence it will turn out wonderfully under your supervision.
TEXT_BANNAM606_03128_DAILYNAMAZUO03128_0: Seigetsu sent you to help? That high-whiskered braggart! Does he not think I can't handle this on my own?
Well... I suppose I could use an extra pair of fins─er, hands.

I actually planned to make a number of things for the Oronir. Yes, yes, several gifts to show our appreciation. If you could take some of the supplies from this crate and craft a pair of vases for me, I can handle the rest.

I actually planned to make a number of things for the Oronir. Yes, yes, several gifts to show our appreciation. If you could take some of the supplies from this crate and craft a pair of satchels for me, I can handle the rest.

TEXT_BANNAM606_03128_ORONIRWOMAN03128_00: If you have business, I'm afraid it must wait.
If you have business, I'm afraid it must wait.
TEXT_BANNAM606_03128_ORONIRWOMAN03128_10: This is from the Namazu, you say?
TEXT_BANNAM606_03128_ORONIRWOMAN03128_00: I am honored to know they believe my teachings merit such a reward.
Ah, obsidian! This will serve us well in fashioning arrows and spears.
Ah, flatweed! Even in small quantities it is a very potent medicinal herb. I shall use it wisely.
Ah, an appleseed! It has been too long since I've made meals with such a savory ingredient.
I presume their leader, Seigetsu, is responsible for this gift? Pray, give him and all the Namazu of Dhoro Iloh my thanks.

To be honest, I was unsure what to make of their request at first. Even now I wonder how they might attempt to imitate the art of Azim Bökh. But they listen to my words earnestly and their intentions seem genuine. Perhaps someday their efforts will bear fruit.
Pray, give my regards to the Namazu of Dhoro Iloh. I look forward to teaching more of them of Azim Bökh.
TEXT_BANNAM606_03128_DAILYNAMAZUO03128_0: Our instructor seemed quite pleased with the gift. Yes, yes. Her expression was very cheerful.
TEXT_BANNAM606_03128_KOFUINSEIGETSU_100_: So, how did the Oronir receive our gift?
TEXT_BANNAM606_03128_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Wonderful. Then it is safe to say our lessons can continue.
Perhaps someday, with enough training, we can even compete against them in the Azim Bökh!
Imagine if we won. We could become leaders of the Oronir clan. N-Not that we would intentionally usurp power from their leader. That would be absurd... <ahem>
TEXT_BANNAM607_03129_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: You wouldn't happen to know a young man by the name Honoroit Banlardois, would you? I recently happened upon travel literature chronicling his journeys through the Sea of Clouds. Quite the riveting read.

In his writings he speaks of the Vanu Vanu, an indigenous beast tribe of the region who practice a most peculiar sport involving paissas. It is a fierce competition granting great honor to its victors. So moved was I by their enthusiasm for this pastime that I made straightways for Kugane to seek out paissas of our very own.

Though costly, I succeeded in acquiring several. The problem, however, is they appear to be completely and utterly indolent. If not for their breathing one might mistake them dead animals strewn about for some ill-conceived grotesquerie.
We need something to spur them into action. Or at the very least, active enough to be recognized as amongst the living.

One of our festival volunteers has gone north to Ceol Aen in search of materials to create something─anything─that might rouse the paissas from their torpidity. Would you go and see if there is aught you can do to assist him?
TEXT_BANNAM607_03129_DAILYNAMAZUO03129_0: Ah, a helping hand from Seigetsu? It is greatly appreciated, yes, yes. A most welcome sight indeed.
I was tasked with creating something that may draw the paissas' interest, but I haven't a clue where I might begin.
If I were a paissa, I imagine I'd do anything for a korrigan doll. Do you suppose you can make one? If there's anything you might need, I guarantee you'll find it in this crate. Yes, yes.

If I were a paissa, I imagine something with a refreshing, invigorating scent would get me up and about. Like steppe wildgrass, perhaps. I'd be ever so grateful if you could bring back the most fragrant, sweet-smelling wildgrass you can find. And you won't have to go far, no, no. Ceol Aen is rich with it!

When you've finished, you can deliver it to Gyoka. He's been tasked with caring for the paissa.
If you're short on materials, there's no need to be shy. You're more than welcome to my supply crate. Yes, yes.

Oh my, how lovely! It looks like you're ready to see Gyoka, then. Well, don't let me keep you. Take care.
TEXT_BANNAM607_03129_GYOKA_000_034: At first I was thrilled that I would get to look after the paissas. “At last,” I thought, “a new endeavor to occupy my time.” <sigh> But the paissas refuse to do aught but lay about and sleep. I consulted Seigetsu and he too was at a loss as to how we might motivate them.
TEXT_BANNAM607_03129_GYOKA_000_040: Some would say I'm the most perceptive of the Namazu. Yes, yes. My eyes are quite sharp. It's only natural that I'd be chosen to serve as referee for the paissa competition.
TEXT_BANNAM607_03129_GYOKA_000_041: But there can be no competition if they remain so sluggish. <sigh> If only there was some way to light a fire under them... N-Not literally, of course.
TEXT_BANNAM607_03129_GYOKA_000_042: <sigh> Why is it so hard to keep the paissas in good spirits...
TEXT_BANNAM607_03129_GYOKA_000_043: Oh! I remember you. Does this mean Seigetsu sent you with more goods for the paissas?
TEXT_BANNAM607_03129_GYOKA_000_044: Thank you, thank you. They're sure to love this. Yes, yes. This is certain to get them moving.
TEXT_BANNAM607_03129_GYOKA_000_045: Tell Seigetsu that all will be well. For now, at least. And when you're finished, I'd be more than happy to show you the paissas if you'd like.
TEXT_BANNAM607_03129_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: You needn't say a word. Even from here I could see Gyoka jumping with joy.

Perhaps now we can entice the paissas to do more than loaf about. These competitions can be quite fierce, if the accounts in my readings are anything to go by. If you care to see for yourself, I would suggest speaking with Gyoka.
TEXT_BANNAM607_03129_SYSTEM_000_055: Thanks to your efforts, the paissas have regained their fighting spirit. You may speak with Gyoka at any time to go and observe the paissa competition.

TEXT_BANNAM608_03130_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: The Oronir in their munificence have seen fit to teach us another of their traditions: a ritual dance to curry favor with the gods before competing in the Azim Bökh.

Needless to say, those seeking to participate in our wrestling competition have been sent to the Dawn Throne to master this dance. But that was three days ago, and I'm certain they lack the common sense to stop dancing without being told.

Assuming they've yet to shuffle off their mortal coils to dance for the gods in person, I thought it prudent we send provisions to bolster their strength. Our apothecary is preparing them as we speak. Would you check on him and see that he has everything he needs?
TEXT_BANNAM608_03130_DAILYNAMAZUO03130_0: At last, a pair of helping hands.
Try as I might, I simply cannot finish this elixir without a still. I don't suppose you could fashion one for me? This crate should have all you need. Yes, yes.
Try as I might, I simply cannot finish this elixir without a strainer. I don't suppose you could fashion one for me? This crate should have all you need. Yes, yes.

At any rate, take this to my brethren atop the Dawn Throne, and give them my regards.

A drink, you say? Why, that would be lovely.
It's delicious! Rough on the tongue, yet sweet with the earthy aroma of mud. Yes, yes. Like a taste of the One River.
I haven't felt this good in ages. Now if you'll excuse me, I have a dance to master.

Refreshments? Seigetsu never said anything of breaks, but I am quite parched. Yes, yes.
Oh my, how invigorating! I can feel my legs again. Perhaps now I can finally stay in step.
Tell Seigetsu to expect a dance unlike any he's ever seen upon our return. Yes, yes.

TEXT_BANNAM608_03130_KOFUINSEIGETSU_100_: How fare our would-be competitors? They've given up the ghost, haven't they?
TEXT_BANNAM608_03130_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Oh, so you reached them in time. Well done. One might say they practiced overmuch, dancing for days and nights without cease. Considering their ineptitude for learning, however, I would argue such a lengthy lesson is good for them.
Why, they might even develop some semblance of work ethic, which can be applied to all that we do. Imagine if all the Namazu followed suit.
Yes, I can send more of my brothers and sisters to practice at the Dawn Throne. I foresee another delivery of provisions in the near future.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_APPRENTICE03161_000: Ah,  ! Hancock sent me to look for you─I'm glad to have found you so close by.
He said he needs to meet with you, but wasn't clear on the details. I suppose he'd rather explain it to you in person.
Would you mind taking a moment to speak with him? He's over at the harbor.
Thank you! Just make your way to Pier #2, if you please. I'll let Hancock know he can find you there.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HANCOCK_000_010: , my friend! Good to see you again.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HANCOCK_000_011: Thank you for coming to meet me─though I confess that I knew you would. You are such an agreeable sort, always ready to help your friends and close acquaintances...
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HANCOCK_000_012: There's no need for such facial exertion─my request is a straightforward one.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HANCOCK_000_013: As it happens, I've been asked to escort a few members of the Ala Mhigan Resistance on a tour of Kugane. It seems they are interested in seeing the fortifications that have allowed Hingashi to survive as an isolationist nation for so long.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HANCOCK_000_014: I've never met them, and it occurred to me that the presence of someone such as yourself, who has an established rapport with the Resistance, might smoothen our introduction. What say you?
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_A1_000_001: Right you are, my bosom companion!
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_A1_000_002: If I just have to stand there, fine.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HANCOCK_000_016: Good to hear! Particularly as they'll be here any moment.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HANCOCK_000_017: By my estimation, they should be disembarking just about now.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HANCOCK_000_019: Esteemed members of the Resistance, welcome to Kugane! Allow me to introduce myself. I am Hancock of the East Aldenard Trading Company, and I will be your guide to this fair city.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_ALPA_000_020: I appreciate your coming to meet usss! I'm Alpa, captain of the Velodyna Gatekeepers.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_021: And I'm J'olhmyn, Alpa's second-in-command. Pleasure to meet you.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_022: Is that you, ? Fancy meeting you here, of all places!
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_ALPA_000_023: What a pleasant sssurprise! Are you here to show us around?
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HANCOCK_000_024: Now that is an excellent proposal, Miss Alpa! I'm certain the two of you would feel more at ease seeing the city with someone you know. Don't you agree, ?
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HANCOCK_000_025: In that case, I shall leave the role of guide to you. Meanwhile, I can secure accommodations for our guests.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_026: I get the feeling that you didn't have much choice there... Sorry about all this.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_ALPA_000_027: If it's alright, I'd like to visit the castle first. I'm eager to see its fortifications!
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HANCOCK_000_030: If you would be so kind as to wait at the pier, I shall join you anon.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_041: It does look nice, but I can't imagine it's much use as a fortress. Too decorative.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HOKUSHIN_000_042: What unusual attire! I can see you are not native to Kugane. May I ask where you hail from?
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HOKUSHIN_000_043: By the kami, that tail is real? Are you a mermaid!?
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_ALPA_000_044: Don't be absssurd! I'm no mermaid, I'm an Ananta.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_045: There are many like Alpa in Ala Mhigo, our homeland. There's no need to be alarmed.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HOKUSHIN_000_046: Ah, so you are of a Western race, then. Pardon me─I jumped to conclusions. It can be somewhat dull guarding the gate here─particularly as only an utter fool would try to break in─so I sometimes let my imagination get the best of me.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_ALPA_000_047: It's alright─no offense taken. But if you have a moment, would you mind telling us more about this castle? I'm curious as to how a single guard at the gate is sufficient to keep it sssecure.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HOKUSHIN_000_048: Of course. I'm no expert, but I will gladly teach you what I know. Consider it an apology for my rudeness.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HOKUSHIN_000_049: The central keep that towers above us is of a complex and strategic make, incorporating myriad defensive elements.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HOKUSHIN_000_050: As you can see, the most prominent part of the facade features regular openings from which to unleash a veritable hail of arrows or musket rounds. We call these sama, and they make it nigh on impossible for an enemy to approach from the front.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HOKUSHIN_000_051: Similarly, those unlucky souls who attempt to scale the walls are like to be met by tumbling boulders or boiling oil released by those manning the many brattices.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HOKUSHIN_000_052: Should one somehow manage to infiltrate the castle proper, he will find it a trial to get out again, for the pathways inside are like a maze by design.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_ALPA_000_053: To think sssomething could be so elegant in both form and function! I'm impressed.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HOKUSHIN_000_054: All that said, the castle has been taken before.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HOKUSHIN_000_055: Not too long ago, an unscrupulous sort named Kageyama and his underlings managed to sneak in during one of the bugyo's galas, taking advantage of the stream of people entering the castle.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HOKUSHIN_000_056: Which mainly goes to show that all of the clever defenses in the world mean nothing if you fail to check who's coming through the front door.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HOKUSHIN_000_058: That said, I don't believe in relying on fortifications overmuch. Get complacent enough and your enemy will walk right in through the front door. Which is why I'm here, incidentally.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_ALPA_000_057: A most inssstructive tale. Thank you!
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HANCOCK_000_060: I had a feeling that I would find you here.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HANCOCK_000_061: Your accommodations are ready. Since your journey was a long one, I recommend that you stop for a soak in Kugane's famed hot springs before you continue your sightseeing. I can personally vouch for their efficacy in soothing body and soul.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_062: In that case, how could we refuse?
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HANCOCK_000_063: That's settled, then! Just make your way to the Bokairo Inn at your leisure. I must return to the Ruby Bazaar, but I've ensured that you will find everything in order.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_ALPA_000_064: My first Hingan hot springs! I hope you'll join us, .
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HOKUSHIN_000_065: She really is like a faerie tale mermaid come to life. The other bathers are in for a surprise...
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HANCOCK_000_075: I leave our guests in your capable hands!
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_ALPA_000_080: This inn is spectacular─I've never seen anything like it. And to think that we can just go right in!
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_ALPA_000_081: I wish I could show it to Gales...though it might be safer not to.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_ALPA_000_082: Anyway, J'olhmyn went inside to change ages ago, but it doesn't seem like she's coming out any time soon. She does wear an awful lot of armor...
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_ALPA_000_083: Why don't we have a look around while we wait for her? There's no harm in that, right?
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HOKUSHIN_000_085: Come to think of it, it's possible that our tales of mermaids were based on sightings of Ananta to begin with.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_HANCOCK_000_090: I leave our guests in your capable hands!
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_ALPA_000_100: Seeing it has only made me want to get in more...
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_ALPA_100_100: J'olhmyn won't mind if we meet her in the water, right? Right. So let's go─unless you need some time to change into your bathing suit as well? I hear it's customary to wear one, at least in Kugane.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_Q3_000_000: Enter the hot springs in your current garb?
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_ALPA_000_106: Thisss feels wonderful! I'm so glad we came to Hingashi.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_107: It is nice to properly relax once in a while.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_CUSTOMERA03161_000_: Look there! Is that a mermaid?
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_CUSTOMERB03161_000_: That tail, those scales... Unmistakably a mermaid! I can't believe they've been real this whole time! And right here in our hot springs!
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_ALPA_000_110: This is ridiculousss─I'm clearly no fish.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_111: Haha! I suppose people who've never seen an Ananta just don't know what else to make of you.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_CUSTOMERA03161_100_: Well, I never! Mermaids in the bath!
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_NHAZAAJAAB_000_113: (-Menacing Miqo'te-)What's this, a Seeker? And one with most...unfortunate features, at that.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_NHAZAAJAAB_100_113: What's this, a Seeker? And one with most...unfortunate features, at that.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_114: Not as unfortunate as your manners. And I would say something about the creepy mask, but I reckon the face beneath is even worse.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_NHAZAAJAAB_000_115: Now, am I meant to believe that you don't recognize me, Nhaza'a Jaab? You certainly have the look of an Eorzean, but perhaps my legacy has not yet reached whatever drab little corner of the realm you call home.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_NHAZAAJAAB_000_116: Hmm, yes, on closer inspection I can see that our Far Eastern friends simply mistook serpent for fish. Not that it matters for my purposes, of course. I can hardly believe that I came upon a convincing substitute so soon...
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_ALPA_000_118: What are you doing!? Get your hands off of me!
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_120: I swear, you masked maniac, if you've done something to Alpa...
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_NHAZAAJAAB_000_121: It's funny... I thought only to make a bit of coin on my travels through this foreign land, but it seems the beastmen and I are simply meant to be.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_NHAZAAJAAB_000_122: In any case, I'll be helping myself to this one. I welcome a challenge, so feel free to hunt me down...if you can. Hah...hah...bwahahahahahahahahaha!
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_130: Hells take that Nhaza'a! And what is he, anyway? I can't believe he managed to snatch Alpa right out from under us!
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_131: No, now's not the time. Our first priority needs to be tracking them down. Thankfully, if the locals' reactions so far are anything to go by, I'm sure they stood out. We can start by asking around.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_TOWNSPEOPLE03161_00: A...“Miqo'te,” ma'am? I'm afraid I don't quite know what you mean.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_141: Oh, right. I'm talking about someone with ears like mine. Male. A bit odd in the...facial area. He might've been behaving strangely, too. Does that ring a bell?
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_TOWNSPEOPLE03161_00: Ah, so you folks are called “Miqo'te”! I've seen quite a few of you around Kugane of late. And there was a man fitting that description over by the Short Pier, when I passed by not too long ago.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_143: I guess we're headed seaside then. Thanks for your help!
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_145: Did you see a Miqo'te pass through? It's important!
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_150: This is...not what I was expecting, in a variety of ways.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_151: Now that we've found him, I suppose we ought to make sure that he doesn't die. We're going to need him to wake up first, though. I don't know─maybe poke him in the face?
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_TOWNSPEOPLE03161_00: “Miqo'te.” What a charming name for a people! And they do have the nicest ears.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_SYSTEM_000_160: The Miqo'te before you is slumbering vigorously. Though he seems to be in a bad way, he is unmistakably alive and will probably survive without your intervention.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_170: ...And you're sure he's not already dead?
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_171: In that case, we'll have to get creative. And I have just the thing! Well, he does, anyhow.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_172: Just as I thought─he never leaves home without his Mark XLII grenades. I assume he took the time to remove some of the powder after his...prior experiences, so they should be safe enough. Lob one in his general direction, would you?
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_100_172: I'll stand back a bit. Just in case.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_175: Feel free to do whatever it takes to wake him up. Nothing like a robust jab to the eyes to get the blood pumping, that's what I always say.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_MZHETTIA_000_181: I believe I at last truly grasp the meaning of the phrase “a rude awakening.” Which is to say, ow.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_MZHETTIA_000_182: Make no mistake, I am delighted to see you, ─but I would appreciate it if you would put a little more thought into your method of greeting next time. I was having such a nice dream, too...
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_183: I can't say I expected quite that large of an explosion. I thought for sure you'd remember to take the powder out this time.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_184: But why are you here, anyway?
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_MZHETTIA_000_186: Your attire is rather less...present than usual!
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_187: Ah. Now that you mention it, I did forget to put my uniform back on, didn't I?
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_188: More importantly, though, we have a serious problem on our hands!
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_189: M'zhet? Are you listening to me?
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_MZHETTIA_000_190: Yes, I'm listening! And definitely making a normal amount of eye contact!
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_MZHETTIA_000_191: But never mind that─Alpa's been kidnapped! I saw her being carried away by a man with the most peculiar mask...
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_MZHETTIA_000_193: Uh...yes? Yes. As it happens, I stowed away on your ship to get here. And that went perfectly smoothly, thank you very much, until you two disembarked and ran off, leaving me without a clue where to go.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_MZHETTIA_000_194: As I was wandering about aimlessly, as one does, I saw the masked man with Alpa in tow. I called out to them, and he hit me! Without so much as a warning!
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_MZHETTIA_000_195: Before I fully lost consciousness, however, I witnessed something vital─he and Alpa boarding a small boat.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_MZHETTIA_000_196: I'm positive they were headed out to sea.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_197: Then there's not a moment to waste! We'll board a ship at once. You too, M'zhet.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_MZHETTIA_000_198: Of course─I would never abandon Alpa in her time of need! In fact, I shall begin scanning the seas in search of any passing vessel that can carry us away right this moment. Feel free to, say, put on a coat while I do!
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_200: I encourage you to pelt him with those bombs as hard as you can. We don't have time to be gentle─Alpa's trail is getting colder by the moment.
TEXT_BANALL210_03161_JOLHMYN_000_210: It looks like M'zhet did remember to take some powder out─not that you knew that when you decided to test it on me! You could have blasted my suit clean off!
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_001: Grrr... Just wait till I get my hands on that Nhaza'a Jaab! At least we have some idea where he's heading with Alpa, thanks to M'zhet.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_002: I've decided to reward him by not pushing him into the sea, even though he's making it so very tempting. More importantly, where do you reckon we should start our search?
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_003: They likely passed by the Ruby Price? Well, what are we waiting for?
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_MZHETTIA_000_005: (“Just compliment her like a normal person”? It's my first time seeing her wear anything but armor! What do you want from me?)
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_050: Right. Now that we're here, let's split up and ask whether anyone has seen a masked Miqo'te and a “mermaid” about.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_MZHETTIA_000_051: An excellent plan! Aaah, it's nice to have everything back to normal.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_052: This had better not be about my attire again... If you hadn't noticed, Alpa has been kidnapped by a masked maniac, so go find some eyewitnesses before I change my mind about drowning you!
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_MZHETTIA_000_053: I never did get to tell her that her swimsuit was fetching, but at least I managed not to make a fool of myself!
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_GUARDA03162_000_055: Keep your distance─we wouldn't want you carelessly firing the cannon. Only I get to do that.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_GUARDB03162_000_060: Nothing to report! At least not to you─I don't even know you.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_MZHETTIA_000_065: Finding Alpa is my first priority! What, can't you tell?
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_GUARDA03162_000_100: A man wearing a sinister mask?
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_GUARDA03162_000_101: He certainly hasn't passed through here. I would know─I've been looking for suspicious persons to fire at all .
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_GUARDB03162_000_103: Hahaha, very funny! You Westerners and your jokes...
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_105: Let me know if you learn anything. Unlike some people, locating Alpa is my only concern right now.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_MZHETTIA_000_110: This is infuriating! No sign of any boats captained by brutish Miqo'te, nor whispers of one having passed by previously. Now I see why J'olhmyn is so annoyed!
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_GUARDA03162_000_175: Still no sign of your masked man...
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_GUARDA03162_000_180: But if he does pass through here, you can be certain that I'll blast him without hesitation!
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_GUARDB03162_000_190: Hahaha, it's even funnier the second time! But seriously, get out of my sight or I'll hurl you into the ocean.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_151: You too, huh? It seems we've hit a dead end here. I haven't the slightest idea what to do now, though...
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_153: What has he gotten himself into this time? Come on, !
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_MZHETTIA_000_154: What is the meaning of this!? First you burst out of the water like some sort of sea monster, and now you threaten me with a blade? I don't even know who you are! Or what you are!
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_KABUTO_000_155: You know not what you stole from me, but you shall come to regret it! Tsukumo is more precious than any treasure. Return him at once!
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_MZHETTIA_000_156: Help me, ! I'm being beset by this...er, turtle? Man? Turtle man!
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_KABUTO_000_158: Or not a coincidence at all, since you two seem to know each other. In which case, you have my apologies. I should not have drawn my blade without preamble.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_MZHETTIA_000_159: Think nothing of it! As the future leader of the M tribe, I was not at all alarmed by your sudden, menacing advance. Not in the least!
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_MZHETTIA_000_160: I'm M'zhet Tia, by the way. And any friend of 's is a friend of mine!
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_KABUTO_000_161: I am honored to meet you. My name is Kabuto, and I lead the Blue's Divine Circle.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_162: The name's J'olhmyn─I'm with the Velodyna Gatekeepers in Ala Mhigo. Can I ask why you were on the point of skewering M'zhet?
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_KABUTO_000_163: Ah. In my haste, I unfortunately mistook him for a thief who recently snatched Tsukumo from my helmet.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_MZHETTIA_000_164: What, precisely, is this “Tsukumo”? You seem rather keen on getting it back.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_KABUTO_000_165: Tsukumo is my dearest companion and guide, who once walked beside me as a karakuri puppet blessed with a soul. He is now present only as materia, but continues to watch over me.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_166: Wait, wasn't Nhaza'a holding something that looked an awful lot like materia when we saw him at the hot springs? Could that have been Tsukumo?
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_167: If so, it would mean that he robbed Kabuto before kidnapping Alpa─and that we almost certainly won't find him on the Ruby Sea.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_169: If it were me, I wouldn't want to risk my prize being retaken by its rightful owner─and fending Kabuto off would be a sight more difficult with Alpa in tow. I'd put money on Nhaza'a having made for land as quickly as possible.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_KABUTO_000_170: A reasonable conclusion. Assuming he was headed for Othard, the most direct route would have taken him through the village of Isari.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_171: To Isari we go, then! We'll follow your lead, Kabuto.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_200: What a charming little fishing village. Would that we were here for some relaxing sightseeing.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_201: But we have a villain to catch and a captain to save, so let's get to it! Meet me back here once you've gathered as much information as you can.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_KABUTO_000_205: I must retrieve Tsukumo at all costs.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_MZHETTIA_000_210: How to best explain the situation... Perhaps I should start with Alpa. So, Alpa is an Ananta─wait, so an Ananta is a sort of person, like a mermaid, but not really...
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_ISARIVILLAGERA03162: A masked man carrying a mermaid? Frankly, I'm not even sure I could imagine such a sight, and I certainly haven't witnessed it.

I did see a man with a curious mask, though. He made landfall in a small boat, and I assume departed on foot soon thereafter, as I haven't seen him since. I'd wager that he made for the Azim Steppe or Yanxia, like most who pass through here.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_ISARIVILLAGERB03162: A suspicious man, and a mermaid with 'im?
No, there ain't many suspicious sorts coming 'round our little village. And you'll pardon me for sayin' so, but it don't seem likely that a mermaid would keep such company.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_ISARIVILLAGERC03162: Hmm... I haven't seen your mystery man, but I can tell you that mermaids have been a subject of some discussion around here as of late.

You see, local legend has it that somewhere out there, far from the sight and grasp of the ordinary man, are what we Hingans call the “Three Wonders,” mermaid's flesh being one. It is said to grant life eternal, be that for better or for worse.

A few moons past, a young lady born to one of Kugane's oldest─and wealthiest─families proclaimed that, should any gentleman presume to ask for her hand in marriage, she would accept nothing less than all Three Wonders as a dowry.

It's a fool's errand, certain enough─we Hingans love our faerie stories as well as any folk, but we know the Three Wonders are no more than fantasy. You have to admire her clever ploy to remain unwed, though, which is why it's the talk of the land.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_260: We need to cast a wide net, so let's spread out and speak to everyone. Make sure to really grill the local fishermen.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_300: Now that we're all back, let's share what we've learned. Hopefully between the four of us we'll have heard enough to go on.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_301: Hmm, so though Nhaza'a was indeed sighted, no one can confirm which direction he departed in. And, if your source is correct, Alpa is no longer with him. Did he stash her somewhere before landing in Isari? And where is he now?
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_KABUTO_000_302: The Three Wonders may provide a clue. According to folklore, the treasures are Merflesh, the Jewel of Fair Souls, and the Philosopher's Fin.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_303: I shudder to think of the young lady being forced to marry Nhaza'a of all people, but based on his thefts so far, it does seem like he is collecting the Wonders─or treasures with passing similarity to them, at least.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_KABUTO_000_304: Indeed. If Tsukumo is his substitute for the Jewel of Fair Souls, and your Alpa is meant to be the source of Merflesh, that leaves only one.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_MZHETTIA_000_305: “Flesh” certainly implies a level of dismemberment that I'm not comfortable with. We have to stop him!
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_JOLHMYN_000_306: Yes, I realize that! If you have any brilliant ideas as to how, now's the time─we can't allow him to stay one step ahead of us.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_ISARIVILLAGERA03162: Assuming your masked man is the same one I saw, he likely headed for the Azim Steppe or Yanxia.
I wish he'd had the mermaid with him, too─that must have been a sight to see!
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_ISARIVILLAGERB03162: Nope, I ain't never in my life seen a man like the one in your tale. Sounds right unsavory.
An' the thought of a mermaid bein' with him is downright unbelievable! They ain't about to hang around with riffraff.
TEXT_BANALL220_03162_ISARIVILLAGERC03162: I hear she is a maiden of extraordinary beauty, born into wealth and power. And if the tales of her setting her suitors to such an impossible task are true, she's sharp as they come, as well.
It makes no difference, though. The Three Wonders are the stuff of legend, and legend alone, so none will have her hand, no matter how they pine.
So don't get any ideas, you hear?
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_JOLHMYN_000_001: We can say with some certainty that Nhaza'a has made for either Yanxia or the Azim Steppe, where he can only be up to no good...but it's also likely that Alpa has been imprisoned somewhere between here and Kugane. So which should we seek?
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_002: I would be happy to ask the other members of the Divine Circle to search for your friend. There are no finer seekers of treasure on the Ruby Sea, and it would free us to continue tailing the thief.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_JOLHMYN_000_003: Hmm... While I would prefer to see to Alpa's safety myself, I can't deny that I'm at a distinct disadvantage in these lands. It probably would be better to leave the search to those more familiar with the area, while we pursue Nhaza'a.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_MZHETTIA_000_004: He's after the─what was it, now─“Philosopher's Fin,” correct?
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_JOLHMYN_000_005: If our assumptions are right, that's the only one left. And we know he's not too particular as to whether he lays hands on the real thing...
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_JOLHMYN_000_006: , do you have any idea what could pass for the Philosopher's Fin at a glance?
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_A1_000_001: A fin from Seigetsu the Enlightened? He sure talks enough.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_A1_000_002: A fin from Gyokei? He seems an easy-to-kidnap sort.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_008: A Namazu who speaks, and articulately at that. Yes, he does sound like a prime candidate.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_009: However, one could easily call all of the Namazu who have mastered the common tongue “finned philosophers.” We cannot count on our villain to be so selective─nor do we know if he makes for Dhoro Iloh, or rather Yuzuka Manor.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_010: What you say is true, but one could easily call all of the Namazu who have mastered the common tongue “finned philosophers.” We cannot count on our villain to be so selective─nor do we know if he makes for Yuzuka Manor, or rather Dhoro Iloh.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_JOLHMYN_000_011: Well, if potential finned philosophers can be found in either location, I suppose we'll have to split up and cover both.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_JOLHMYN_000_012: I'll take Yuzuka Manor. M'zhet can come with me, if only so that I can keep him from accidentally injuring anyone...himself included. Anyway, I'm sure the locals will be able to point us in the right direction.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_013: Then we will hasten for Dhoro Iloh. I only hope that we arrive in time.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_015: I will chase Tsukumo's captor to the ends of Hydaelyn if I must.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_050: I had heard word of the festivities taking place here, but I wasn't aware they would be so...extraordinary.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_GYOSHIN_000_051: By the Big One! Our comrade-in-fins! You are here to assist with our new project, yes, yes? Our latest, greatest event?
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: I interpret that as, “I haven't the foggiest idea of what you speak,” so allow me to explain─thoroughly! We are currently planning our most ambitious event to date: an exceedingly cultured performance based on the beloved carol of eld, “Grey Kings of Orient.”
We have spread word of our upcoming masterpiece far and wide, from Kugane to Yanxia, so doubtless a great many will be in attendance.
By the by, sir, it is rare to see one such as yourself here on the Steppe. Am I correct in assuming that you are an ambassador of the Kojin tribe? And how might I address you?
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_055: My name is Kabuto. I am indeed a Kojin of the Blue, and the leader of the Divine Circle.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_056: We typically pursue treasure, but our quarry today is a villain whom we suspect is searching for the Philosopher's Fin. We have traveled here to stop him before anyone comes to harm.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Oho, are you perchance speaking of the Philosopher's Fin as detailed in New Records of Ancient Matters? One of the Three Wonders? Fascinating! But why seek it on the Azim Steppe? I am quite certain the records make no mention of location.

Ah, so naturally, having spoken to , you concluded that I would most readily be identified as the source of the requisite fin, esteemed as I am. Indeed, there could hardly be a more obvious choice for “finned philosopher.”
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_GYOSHIN_000_059: Wait, wait... I seem to recall from our many, many discussions that the philosopher will not be played by you, Gyofu─Seigetsu the Enlightened. We decided on Gyorei for that role, remember? And we already made the costume to fit her!
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_060: The role of philosopher? Perhaps we should hear more of this new event of yours.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Oh, very well. In our upcoming performance, we reenact the journey to the West made by three kings in days of yore. Gyorei has been chosen to dress as the philosopher-king.

One would think that the Namazu best suited for said role would be I, Seigetsu the Enlightened, most erudite and learned among us, renowned author of A Meditation on the Metaphysics of Merrymaking, but Gyoshin continually insists...
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_063: That's it! Nhaza'a must have heard about the performance, and learned that it would include a philosopher. That is why he made for the Azim Steppe.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_064: If he also knows that she has been selected for the role of “philosopher-king,” Gyorei will be in grave danger. Where is she now?
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: If I recall correctly, she spoke of traveling to the Dawn Throne to retrieve ritual offerings from the Oronir's stock. We've been running low, as someone keeps partaking without authorization...
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_066: Then we must make for the Dawn Throne at once! With me!
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_GYOSHIN_000_067: I was not really following that, no, no. But I am most confident that Gyorei's fins should remain attached to Gyorei. She needs those!
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: It's all well and good for Gyoshin to sprint off to Big-One-knows-where, but it is hardly advisable for me to leave the festivities unsupervised. I will remain here, and inform Gyorei of the situation should she return.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_JOLHMYN_000_070: So these are Namazu? Seeing them in person, I have to say that they're pretty cute. Unnerving, pungent, and weird...but cute.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_MZHETTIA_000_075: These fellows' mannerisms are utterly charming! Yes, yes!
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_MZHETTIA_000_080: Oh dear, they appear to be rubbing off on me. Do you ever have that problem, ? No, no?
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_GYOREI_000_100: Goodness, how kind of the Oronir to share so much food with us! It will take more than a few Namazu to eat through all of this. Thankfully.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_GYOREI_000_101: Oh, hello! Can I help you with something, yes, yes?
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_NHAZAAJAAB_000_102: I'm supposed to believe that's the face of a philosopher? But I suppose a fin's a fin. And the client won't know any better, so in you go!
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_GYOREI_000_103: What is the meaning of this? Let me out!
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_GYOSHIN_000_106: He really was after Gyorei's fins! And now he has both of them!
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_GYOSHIN_000_110: I will protect Gyorei's appendages, yes, yes!
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_111: We must find Gyorei before Nhaza'a does.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_GYOSHIN_000_150: He put her in a barrel! The horror! The indignity! What do we do?
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_151: We should speak with our comrades at Yuzuka Manor. They need to hear this, and may have an idea of where Nhaza'a would take his ill-gotten treasures. Can you contact them, ?
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_JOLHMYN_000_152: (-J'olhmyn-)Nothing to report here. Have you had any luck?
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_JOLHMYN_000_153: (-J'olhmyn-)...He's kidnapped a Namazu named Gyorei? That's not good─he's got all three of the Wonders in hand, then.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_JOLHMYN_000_154: (-J'olhmyn-)But if we are to assume that his sudden quest for the Three Wonders and the young lady's wedding dowry are connected, there's a good chance that he will revisit Kugane at some point─whether to present the items to her, or to her would-be suitor.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_JOLHMYN_000_155: (-J'olhmyn-)He would have to retrieve Alpa beforehand, of course, meaning that we finally have a chance to get ahead of him. We can return to Kugane first, and be ready to snare him when he arrives.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_JOLHMYN_000_156: (-J'olhmyn-)Let's rendezvous in Kugane, at, say...ah, the Bokairo Inn! I'll see you there.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_158: Lay a trap in Kugane? It could work, but we will need to return posthaste.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_GYOSHIN_000_159: We should tell Gyof─Seigetsu the Enlightened first. I am sure that he will have many, many thoughts on the situation. Maybe even a helpful one!
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_160: Very well, we will speak with him before we depart. He is doubtless worried about Gyorei, and it would be unkind to leave him wondering.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_165: Does his wickedness know no bounds?
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_GYOSHIN_000_200: I will find Seigetsu the Enlightened and be right back!
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Gyoshin has apprised me of the ill news. And you intend to apprehend the culprit in Kugane?
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_202: Yes, if we travel fast enough, we should succeed in reaching the city before Nhaza'a Jaab does.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_GYOSHIN_000_203: I always have my travel hammer, travel awl, travel spinning wheel, and travel anvil packed just in case. I am most prepared. Ready to go, yes, yes! The sack will be a tight squeeze with both of us, but if you put Seigetsu in headfirst, and me tailfirst...
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KOFUINSEIGETSU_000_: Stop right there, Gyoshin. Exactly what are an artisan and a member of the literati meant to do against an opponent who has foiled even ? For us to blunder in without a stratagem would be the height of folly.

No, these two ought to journey ahead to Kugane, lest Nhaza'a arrive sooner than expected. Meanwhile, I shall devise an infallible plan based on the principles laid forth in The Smart of War. We shall join them anon.
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_GYOSHIN_000_206: I do not know what those principles are. Not even a little bit, no, no. But I will do as you say if you think that it will help get Gyorei back...
TEXT_BANALL230_03163_KABUTO_000_210: Let us inform Seigetsu the Enlightened and be on our way.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_001: It might serve us to have a clearer idea of Seigetsu the Enlightened's plan, but we can wait no longer to depart. Come, we should hasten to the Bokairo Inn.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_GYOSHIN_000_005: Maybe I should pack two hammers after all. Yes, yes...
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_JOLHMYN_000_050: You two made good time! We left for Kugane just after I spoke with you, and only arrived a short while ago ourselves.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_051: Have you been able to learn anything of Nhaza'a?
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_JOLHMYN_000_052: We were successful in returning to Kugane ahead of him, though not by much. He's already made port.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_JOLHMYN_000_053: We saw dockworkers hauling a large barrel and squirming sack from his skiff─under his close watch, unfortunately─so whatever his plans are, they're likely already in motion.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_054: The prisoners! Where has he sent them?
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_JOLHMYN_000_055: There's a large vessel docked at Pier #1─it seems Alpa and Gyorei have been taken aboard. I have M'zhet keeping an eye on the situation.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_056: I saw that ship when we arrived. It's unmistakably the Kuroboro Maru. If I recall correctly, the merchant Kageyama purchased it for a hefty sum some time ago.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_JOLHMYN_000_057: Kageyama, you say? And who might that be?
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_058: A man easily as vile as Nhaza'a Jaab himself. He once conspired to take Kugane Castle, holding the bugyo hostage as he made ludicrous demands. Though thwarted, he used his wealth and influence to escape justice.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_059: I am not familiar with the details, but according to rumor, he has a history of using wealth to make each and every one of his problems disappear.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_060: He has taken to using this tactic recently, it is said, in pursuit of a bride, spending more gil than most will ever see in his attempt to snare the perfect woman.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_JOLHMYN_000_061: A bride, hmm? Well, I think we've found Nhaza'a Jaab's esteemed employer.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_MZHETTIA_000_062: (-M'zhet-)Hello, ? It is I! You know─your favorite Miqo'te? Dashing good looks, ladies' man, future nunh of the M tribe?
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_MZHETTIA_000_063: (-M'zhet-)Yes, well, I'm afraid that we have a problem. One that requires your immediate attention─that's why I contacted you. It's vital that you hear this as soon as possible.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_MZHETTIA_000_064: (-M'zhet-)I've been dutifully keeping watch by the Kuroboro Maru, and Alpa and the Namazu have just been brought out on deck. We don't have much longer until our “mermaid” becomes “mermaid's flesh”!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_MZHETTIA_000_065: (-M'zhet-)I would love to continue this little chat we're having, but I rather think you should come to the harbor right away!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_067: This is our last chance, then. We must stop Nhaza'a once and for all!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_070: The others should have arrived before we did. I assume that they have occupied themselves by gathering information throughout the city in the meantime.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_MZHETTIA_100_100: There you are! We must hurry!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_MZHETTIA_200_100: Alpa is a dear friend, and I won't have her turned into mince by some scheming─and rather unattractive, I must say─villain!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KAGEYAMA_000_102: And the Jewel of Fair Souls.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KAGEYAMA_000_103: With this, she can no longer deny me! And what a pretty thing she will be, beside me at our matrimonial feast. I can taste it now...
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_NHAZAAJAAB_000_104: I couldn't possibly care less about what you intend to do with the goods, so long as I am fairly compensated. And speaking of payment, I think it's time that we finish up here.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_NHAZAAJAAB_100_104: I need only carve the meat...
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_NHAZAAJAAB_000_106: Finally caught up, have you? Though I doubt you have much more to offer this time around!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_MZHETTIA_000_108: That was dirty! What, afraid you couldn't defeat her in a fair fight?
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_NHAZAAJAAB_000_109: I merely prefer to spend my time on foes that are actually worthy─or at least suitably entertaining. But if any of you believe you will present a greater challenge, then by all means...
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_110: Very well. I will defeat you myself, and have you return Tsukumo here and now.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_GYOSHIN_000_111: (-???-)I see them! They are most visible!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_NHAZAAJAAB_000_115: Pity. I was just beginning to feel a twinge of excitement, but I see I must take my leave.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_NHAZAAJAAB_000_116: Ahahahahaha! Farewell, Eastern beastmen! This little chase has been most amusing. Perhaps you may entertain me again someday.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_MZHETTIA_000_117: Not this time... As the future nunh, and a friend to J'olhmyn and Alpa both, I cannot let these crimes go unanswered!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_MZHETTIA_000_118:
Trust me, sometimes you have to learn the hard way...
How to treat a lady!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_MZHETTIA_000_120: Oh, now we find the one with no powder.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_MZHETTIA_100_120: Gwahahahahahaha! So much for your parlor trick!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_MZHETTIA_000_121: Gwahahahahahaha! As if explosives would save the adventurer's gaggle of misfits yet again.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_121: Now we only need ensure that Kageyama meets with justice at the hands of the Sekiseigumi.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_MZHETTIA_000_122: That...may pose a problem. Where has that eel slipped off to?
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_123: He makes for Kogane Dori! , with me!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_MZHETTIA_000_124: We can meet at the Bokairo Inn afterward─I will carry the wounded there. We're counting on you!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_150: You need not push yourself, Alpa. You have only just been freed from what must have been a very trying ordeal.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_ALPA_000_151: I'll be fine. As captain of the Velodyna Gatekeepers, I can't let evil go unpunished!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KAGEYAMA_000_153: What? How did you─ Well, no matter. You may have followed me this far, but no further!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KAGEYAMA_000_154: Paupers of Kugane! Behold my loose change!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_156: Pardon me, sir, but if you could move a bit to the left... Ma'am, it is imperative that we capture this villain... <sigh> They're not listening.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KAGEYAMA_000_157: Hahaha! Just look at them, scrounging at my feet! It pays to be wealthy!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KAGEYAMA_000_159: You're wasting your time, little mermaid! I'm a master of monetary manipulation, and no one is easier to control than coin-starved commoners!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KAGEYAMA_000_160: What is the meaning of this!?
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_PASSERBYA03164_000_: (-Disappointed Townsperson-)Oh, cruel fate, why do you mock me?
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_162: Well done. But why a fish?
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_ALPA_000_163: I saw one on the Namazu's strange contraption earlier. It was so cute, I just couldn't stop thinking about it.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_165: I believe it's time that you accepted your fate.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_HANCOCK_000_166: Yes, I think that's quite enough escape attempts for one day. You've made it perfectly clear who the villain here is. Right, my Sekiseigumi friends?
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KAGEYAMA_000_167: You can't do this to me! I have a woman to coerce! A matrimonial banquet to consume!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_168: It seems that the matter is resolved at last. Shall we go and inform the others?
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_YAMABIKO_000_170: That was quite the ruckus earlier. And where did all the Namazu come from?
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_ALPA_000_200: The innkeep was kind enough to call a doctor, but it ssseems that no one has more than minor injuries.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_ALPA_000_201: And apparently, there's no better treatment for scrapes and bruises than the Bokaisen Hot Springs! I guess we'll just have to visit them again!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_Q1_000_000: Enter the hot springs in your current garb?
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_ALPA_000_203: Let's continue where we left off before we were so rudely interrupted, shall we?
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_ALPA_000_205: What? You have absolutely nothing to apologize for! Not now, not ever!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_JOLHMYN_000_206: It's my duty to protect you, and I failed utterly. Then it took so long to free you...and I couldn't even manage that without help.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_ALPA_000_207: Maybe not, but the rescue wouldn't have succeeded without your leadership─not to mention how you saved me from being sliced in two. You may not be able to do everything yourself, but I couldn't ask for a better sssecond-in-command.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_ALPA_000_209: I'm grateful to everyone else too, of course. , Kabuto, Gyoshin, M'zh─
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_MZHETTIA_000_211: Never fear, it is I, M'zhet! I discovered this floating in the sea after Nhaza'a disappeared. How do I look? Rakish?
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_JOLHMYN_000_212: I'm throwing that back in the sea, and you along with it!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_JOLHMYN_100_212: Just when you think he's learned something...
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_213: If I may ask, Gyoshin, how did you know to find us on the Kuroboro Maru?
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_GYOSHIN_000_214: It was easy to spot you from above! I knew that stuffing the mikoshi with all of the cloudsbreath in our stores was the right choice, yes, yes.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_JOLHMYN_000_215: My, how convenient. And I'm glad that you made it out safely too, Gyorei.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_GYOREI_000_216: Thanks to all of you! Being trapped in a barrel was harrowing, and fraught with splintery peril, yes, yes. But it was worth it for a chance to enjoy these hot springs together!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_GYOSHIN_000_218: What is that gem in your helmet? It is most unusual. Quite unique!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_219: This is the soul of my dear friend Tsukumo, more valuable than any treasure in the whole of the Ruby Sea.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_220: He is what Nhaza'a stole from me, and I am truly grateful to you for helping me retrieve him.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_221: As Gyorei said, despite our tribulations, I feel fortunate to have met you all. I hope that we can continue to strengthen our friendship now that we're all safe and sound.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_GYOSHIN_000_222: Then please come to our festival, yes, yes! We can strengthen our friendship and all of our assorted limbs by carrying a mikoshi together!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_ALPA_000_223: And if you're ever in Eorzea, come to Ala Mhigo! The Velodyna Gatekeepers will give you the grand tour, and you can stay at the cassstellum...
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_SYSTEM_000_250: You have achieved Allied reputation with the Kojin, the Vira, and the Namazu.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_SYSTEM_000_251: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from Shikitahe, Madhura, and Gyosho.
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_SYSTEM_000_252: You have learned the emote Gratuity!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_SYSTEM_000_253: Through your efforts, your allies of all shapes and sizes across Ala Mhigo and the Far East have forged bonds of friendship that promise to remain strong through the years. You are truly a hero to societies across many realms!
TEXT_BANALL240_03164_KABUTO_000_225: I paid visit to Shihoumi. Thankfully, she was able to place Tsukumo back where he belongs.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_HUMEGIRL03683_000_0: <sob> It happened again... I had another scary dream...
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_MYSTELGIRL03683_000: M-Me too! In mine, a bunch of toys became a monster and chased me all over!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_ELFBOY03683_000_003: What!? I had the exact same dream! This...this can't be a coincidence. The pixies─I'll wager they're behind it!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_HUMEGIRL03683_000_0: Those beings in Il Mheg the grown-ups say we must never go near?
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_ELFBOY03683_000_005: Aye, them. Mammy said that, if you're naughty, they'll come into your dreams and drag you off to a world of nightmares!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_MYSTELGIRL03683_000: Truly!? O-Oh no, I haven't been doing my chores! I must hurry home and finish them!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_007: Hmmm, it seems they were right... What a dilemma this is...
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_008: And to think that they pin the blame on us! We like fun dreams, not scary ones! Hmph!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_A1_000_001: I'll have no mischief on my watch!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_010: Give a pixie a fright, sneaking up like that! And how can you even see me, anyway!?
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_011: ...Wait, I know you─you're the new king's sapling! I've been wanting to meet you since forever!  is your name, is it not?
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_012: (-Tyr Beq-)My name is Tyr Beq, and I'm the leader of the Dreamspinners! Oh yes, I'm an expert at spinning dreams, and for this they call me the Weaver─though “weird” and “eccentric” are often thrown around too. But whatever others say, there's no place I love more than children's fun-filled dreams!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_013: (-Tyr Beq-)But...there's a problem: we've recently been shut out of the dreams. At around the same time, I received word that children were being racked by nightmares. So I came here to investigate...and it's just as I had feared.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_014: (-Tyr Beq-)Ah, I suppose a few things bear explaining. Simply put, someone's trying to ruin our precious Lyhe Mheg─the Garden of Dreams─and they must be stopped!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_015: (-Tyr Beq-)You know, this problem concerns mortals as well. And as an upstanding member of your kind, it pains you to see your fellows suffer from nightmares, doesn't it?
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_016: (-Tyr Beq-)But of course it does! And that's why you'll lend me your aid!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_017: (-Tyr Beq-)Without further ado, then, let's set to work solving this problem! Come with me to the place called Sullen west of here. We're going to rendezvous with another ally.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_020: Ooh, you came! You really came! Hee hee, it's true what they say─the king's sapling is as kind as  is strong!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_021: Right then, our ally should be around here somewhere...
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_022: In case you were wondering, it's a porxie─those pig-like familiars─and one that has a fondness for nightmares. My Nu Mou acquaintance who alerted me to the strangeness in the children's dreams has sent it to aid us.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_025: (-Prodigious Porxie-)Well, of course I'm enormous. It would be impossible to contain all my cuteness otherwise.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_027: Ah, but where are my manners? Ezel II, dream devourer extraordinaire, at your service. You show me a nightmare, and I'll show you a feast! <snort>
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_028: Now, you will be wondering: what is a familiar doing without its master? Well, by virtue of the hat that my creator bestowed upon me, I am my own master!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_029: Yes, yes, you're no ordinary porxie. Good for you. Now, I trust you know about the trouble that's afoot?
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_030: Oh, I more than know about the mass nightmares that have been plaguing mortals. I already have a suspect in my sights.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_032: My investigation leads me to believe that a certain pixie bereft of color is our culprit. Of late, they have been sighted fluttering about most suspiciously in the vicinity of Lyhe Ghiah.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_034: Now, this pixie has the ability to manipulate dreams directly, without even entering Lyhe Mheg. With such power, they could seal away the garden's gates completely.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_035: What!? But...to be able to do that, you have to be at least the equal of Titania!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_036: <snort> You're confused, mortal, and small wonder. But rather than trying to explain, it would be quicker to simply show you.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_037: After all, by keeping company with the Weaver, you've already stepped into the place between dreams and reality. Come.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_040: Do you see that little girl there, moaning and muttering in her sleep? The stench of a nightmare pervades her, unnatural in its potency.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_LAKELANDGIRL03683_0: Please... Please give me back my doll... <sob> It's all I have left of Mother...
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_042: From what I know, the child is an orphan of Holminster Switch. Though she was adopted, she struggles to fit in with her new family and feels alone.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_043: Tell me, mortal. In what times do you experience nightmares?
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_044: All men are driven by certain needs. When severely deprived of a need, their hearts come to harbor a void in which torment quickens. This torment then assumes terrible forms in dreams and takes root in the dreamer's heart.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_045: Tragic enough that this little girl lost her mother, but she also had her doll─her source of solace─taken from her by her stepbrother. It is a heartrending tale. Yes, truly heartrending... <slurp>
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_046: Ahhhhhh! This stinky sweet aroma! I can't resist it anymore!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_047: Uh... I'm going to look away...
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_048: If you'll excuse me, friends, it is time for me to do what I do best!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_049: As far as I know, porxies can't hide themselves from mortal sight. If the little girl wakes up and sees Ezel slavering over her, she's liable to get a good fright.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_070: Yes, very flavorsome... <burp> And now the child is free of...free of... Uhhh...
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_072: The nightmare...it's richer than anything I've ever eaten... Ohhh, my belly... I think─hurk─I think I'm going to throw up...
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_073: What!? You can't! We'd be back to where we started!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_075: Y-You... Who are you? Judging by your color, you're not from Lydha Lran.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_ANLAD_000_076: Who am I? Hm... I suppose An Lad will suffice for a name.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_077: So, An Lad... You have lots of power, that much is plain. Are you the one plaguing the children with nightmares?
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_ANLAD_000_078: ...Plaguing? We simply share in each other's misery.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_ANLAD_000_079: That child understands me─understands my loneliness. So I sealed the gate, that she might be my friend─and mine alone.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_ANLAD_000_080: There's nothing you can do. No mere familiar can remove the dream I've sown. Even if it could, the dream will always return, for the child's own heart embraces it.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_081: Not good... If she can't break free of the dream's hold, her mind will inevitably be consumed! She would die!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_082: Ahhh, what a pain this is! It doesn't bother me so much what happens to a few mortals. But it does bother me to have our precious garden ruined!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_083: <sigh> I hate to use my powers this way...but I have an idea. If it's the child's own heart that embraces the nightmare, then we'll just have to change it!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_084: Ezel! You can bring that nightmare back up, but first we have to get somewhere far away from here.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_085: , I need your help too! Come on!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_ANLAD_000_086: Why? Why must you torment me?
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_087: Now then, ─for better or worse, you're about to see why they call me the Weaver! Here I go!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_089: This is where you come in, ! Vanquish that nightmare creature!
