TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_090: Hurry, strike it down! It shouldn't be any trouble for the king's sapling!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_091: Unnngh... I've done my part... The rest is up to you!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_100: My, you truly are strong! The king chose their sapling well!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_101: Now then, your victory will have changed the ending to the child's dream. She'll awaken feeling as though she has conquered her fears.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_102: Had you not felled that nightmare, it would inevitably find its way back to the child. Excellently done, !
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_103: Right, let's hurry back to Sullen and see how she fares. Ezel and I will hide and leave the talking to you.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_104: Huzzah, you did it! And my belly is right as rain again!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_LAKELANDGIRL03683_0: Huh? Where am I...? Did I fall asleep?
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_LAKELANDBOY03683_00: There you are! I've been looking all over for you! Mother's worried, so hurry up and go home!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_LAKELANDGIRL03683_0: B-Brother! I'm sorry, it seems I dozed off...
There's...there's something I want you to know. It's been lonely. I didn't know how to fit in. What to say and what to do...
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_LAKELANDBOY03683_00: Wh-What's this all of a sudden? You haven't so much as spoken a dozen words to us before, much less talked about your feelings...
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_LAKELANDGIRL03683_0: I know... I was too scared to. And I don't know why, but I feel I have the courage now. To say how I feel.
There's one other thing. The doll... It was a present from my mother. She gave it to me so I wouldn't be lonely.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_LAKELANDBOY03683_00: Is that the way of it? I'm...I'm sorry. I didn't realize how important it was to you. I only meant to tease you, is all.
I'll give it back, all right? So come on, let's go home together.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_LAKELANDBOY03683_10: It seems you've been watching over my sister. Thank you.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_LAKELANDGIRL03683_1: Please take care...and see you again!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_121: Hm, that went rather well! Mortals are surprisingly impressionable things!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_122: I see, I see... By eliminating the child's nightmare, we wrought a positive change in her reality, thereby eliminating the void in which her torment resided.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_123: Something like that! An Lad appeared to be drawn to the torment in her heart. With it gone, they have no more reason to plague her.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_124: And with that, we may begin reclaiming our precious Lyhe Mheg...
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_125: No matter what, I'll keep it safe. I promise you, Titania...
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_126: Tee hee! You're even more adorable when confused! For now, let's just say you've done me a great service.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_127: By way of thanks, it's only fitting that I invite you to our playground. Come to Lydha Lran and seek out my friend Thon Sul. They'll show you the way in!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_128: Having played an instrumental part in our success, it goes without saying that I'm invited as well!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_129: Go on! See how she is!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_100_129: Tyr Beq says I'm liable to frighten the little girl, but this can't be true, surely? These adorable ears and snout, these winsome curves─I was designed to delight!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_THONSUL_000_130: Ah, , I presume. I've been expecting you.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_THONSUL_000_131: You should know, it's quite risky for a mortal to enter the Garden of Dreams while wide awake. You might not be able to fall asleep ever again. That could be interesting too, I suppose?
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_THONSUL_000_132: Aaanyway! By order of Tyr Beq, one of the esteemed founders of Lyhe Mheg, I bid you welcome!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_141: Welcome, , welcome! You stand within an illusory space created by our magicks. Normally, it's filled with fun things, but it's been empty like this since the gates were sealed off...
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_142: The gates lead to the dreams of mortals in various regions of Norvrandt, you see. They allow us to interact with dreams─to shape them and rollick in them.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_143: <sniff> <sniff> A sinister magic hangs over the gates. The work of An Lad, I shouldn't doubt.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_100_144: H-How did you get in here!?
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_145: Why, Thon Sul showed me in, of course. And even if I weren't your distinguished guest, my cuteness doubtless would have won them over! <snort>
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_146: You're not nearly as cute as you think you are... But all right, you can stay. Now, where was I?
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_147: Right. With that little girl freed from her nightmares, I sense that the magic over the gates has weakened, slightly but surely.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_148: This is because An Lad has lost interest in the girl, I'm sure of it. We should be able to open one of the gates again─the one leading to Lakeland.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_149: Hm-hmmm... I grasp the situation now, but I daresay our mortal friend is confused. Permit me to summarize it all for  benefit.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_150: An Lad has identified mortals across Norvrandt who strongly share their torment, and planted nightmares in them. In order to prevent interference, they sealed off the gates to the locales beyond.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_151: These mortals under An Lad's hold have spread their influence to those around them, giving rise to the phenomenon of mass nightmares.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_A2_000_001: Why do you suppose An Lad is giving people nightmares?
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_A2_000_002: Pixies do things for fun. An Lad seems different.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_152: It is quite a mystery. Indeed, knowing An Lad's motivation will be the key to our efforts, and rest assured I shall continue sniffing about for answers. <snort>
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_153: All right, that's enough talking. Let's do something fun for a change!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_154: , I'm going to lend you my power. What I want you to do is stand before the gate yonder, and reach out to it─while holding an image of Lakeland in your mind!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_THONSUL_100_155: Hm? Want to go to Lyhe Mheg, do you?
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_160: With that, we've reopened the first gate! We only have a few dream bubbles, though, so we can't do much here yet...
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_161: The bubbles hold the memories of mortals' fun and happy dreams. They're used to fill our garden with all sorts of delightful things, and we can never have enough of them!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_162: On that note, we could still use your help, . We went through a lot to reopen the gate─we have to make sure that it stays opened!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_SYSTEM_000_163: By freeing the little girl in Sullen from her nightmares, you and yours have reclaimed the dreams of those in Lakeland.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_SYSTEM_000_164: Tyr Beq appears eager to restore Lyhe Mheg to its former fun-filled glory, and for this they require your aid...
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_165: Right, let's continue this back outside. I'll arrange it so you can always return here─just let Thon Sul know whenever you want to come and go!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_166: So this is the Garden of Dreams... I have been wanting to visit for a long time.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_170: Well, there you have it, ─Lyhe Mheg. It's a bit bare at the moment, I know, but we'll collect more dream bubbles and we'll fill the place with fun things again.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_171: What of the gates to the other regions? Shouldn't we try to reopen them as well?
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_172: Oh, we should and we will. But first, we need to focus on the one that's already open.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_173: As it stands, Lakeland is still vulnerable to An Lad's influence. In order to keep them and their nightmares away, we must keep the mortals happy─by filling the region with lots of fun dreams!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_174: So you see, , there's still much to be done. Won't you keep helping us so that mortals and pixies can have a place to play together?
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_Q3_000_000: Lend your aid to Tyr Beq?
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_A3_000_001: As long as you don't play tricks on me.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_A3_000_002: I'm sorry, but it sounds dangerous.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_175: Huzzah! Thank you, ! Rest assured I wouldn't dream of playing tricks on you. After all, I'm a good Titania-fearing pixie!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_176: Awww... Well, let me know if you change your mind. If you're worried that I'll play tricks on you, don't be. After all, I'm a good Titania-fearing pixie!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_177: Without further ado, then, let's get to work bringing smiles to the people of Lakeland!
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_179: For your part, I want you to gather lots of dream materials─items that we can enchant and use to rebuild Lyhe Mheg.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_TYRBEQ_000_180: Lakeland is home to many lonely orphans, so objects that would alleviate loneliness would be ideal. My thanks in advance, !
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_EZELII_000_181: I too shall continue my investigation! This porxie will not hover idly by while stomach-churning nightmares plague the land! <snort>
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_SYSTEM_000_190: You have achieved Friendly reputation with the Dreamspinners.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_SYSTEM_000_191: Pixie society quests are now available from Uin Nee in Lydha Lran.
TEXT_BANPIX001_03683_SYSTEM_000_192: Furthermore, you may now purchase wares from Jul Oul.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_000: ! Thanks to you, Lakeland is now brimming with fun and happy dreams! Though there's still much to do, Lyhe Mheg has begun to regain its former shine, and for that I'm truly grateful.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_001: My best friend and I, we built the place together, you see. But they're gone now, and it falls to me to look after our precious garden.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_002: Oh, right! The little girl whose nightmare we vanquished─she's having a dream right now. Would you like to go and see her together?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_004: Um, actually, I wasn't asking... <sigh> Never mind... When you're ready, speak to Thon Sul as before, and they'll show you in.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_LAKELANDGIRL03683_0: Oh, you're the hero from my dream! The one who defeated the monster controlling my doll! You're so brave and strong, just like the Warrior of Darkness!
Ever since I had that dream, I haven't been afraid to say how I feel. Well, it might still be a little bit embarrassing...but my heart feels so much lighter now.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_012: That is well, child! It's poison for the soul to keep your feelings pent up inside!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_LAKELANDGIRL03683_0: Oh dear, is it that time already? I'd like to stay and talk some more, but I have to wake up soon. Thank you, all of you! Till next time!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_014: Well, how strange to receive thanks from a mortal... It's not a bad feeling!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_015: While the children dream, we call them to Lyhe Mheg to play with us. Rest assured we send them back alive and well!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_016: That such a thing should be possible... The Weaver is no idle epithet!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_020: <snort> I've been thinking, friends. With things settled in Lakeland, perhaps we may now turn our attention to those suffering from nightmares in other regions?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_021: Yes, I think it's a good time now. What do you say we take ourselves to Kholusia next?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_022: No objections from me. Now, based on previous observations, An Lad plants a potent nightmare within a chosen individual, who in turn spreads it to those around them.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_023: That little girl was one such person─the source of the nightmares in Lakeland. We must look for her counterparts in Kholusia and elsewhere, and likewise aid them.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_024: I see, I see! And I trust you can track down these people with your keen sense of smell?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_025: But of course! ...Is what I would like to say, but it has become...complicated. <snort>
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_026: In order to prevent further interference, it seems An Lad has taken to employing magicks to veil the scent of the nightmare at the source.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_027: The result being, though I can sense the general area where nightmares are concentrated, I can't readily identify the individual from which they all emanate.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_028: First you can't keep the nightmare down, and now you can't even find them? Bah! What use are you!?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_029: Come, come, let's not lose faith so soon!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_100_029: It just so happens I know someone who can help us─my creator. Let us go to Pla Enni and seek their counsel together.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_110_029: When the little girl wakes up, she'll forget having met us. But I'm sure she'll feel all warm and fuzzy inside!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_030: This is my esteemed creator, Lugg Aenc. On the subject of the heart and the mind, I know none more versed than they.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_031: Master Lugg Aenc, I am returned. If it please you, these are my companions. We seek your sage counsel on the matter of the pale pixie.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_LUGGAENC_000_032: Ah, if it isn't Ezel II, the namesake of my beloved teacher! Pleased am I that you still think me your master!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_LUGGAENC_000_033: <gasp> Y-You are the hero who set free our fallen king! A-A fitting payment─such a valorous deed calls for a fitting payment!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_034: Ah, Lugg Aenc... Just another Nu Mou at the end of day...
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_035: With all due respect, Master, we have need of haste. As you are aware, we are on a quest to eliminate nightmares, but the pale pixie has veiled the scent with magicks. Is there no way to lift its effects?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_LUGGAENC_000_036: Hmmm, I'm afraid lifting such magicks will be no easy feat. However, I believe we may greatly narrow down the search by considering the circumstance of the pale pixie's birth.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_037: Their birth, you say? There's always more of us appearing, so I hadn't given it any thought.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_LUGGAENC_000_038: To state a commonly held belief, 'tis said that a pixie is born when the soul of a mortal who died in childhood gathers new aether to itself. Are we following thus far?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_LUGGAENC_000_039: Having originated from a life ended too soon, such a soul is often unstable, and is defined by the needs that once drove its owner─needs that are highly susceptible to the influence of outside aether.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_LUGGAENC_000_040: This brings me to my hypothesis. Should a soul defined by unfulfilled needs take on aether laden with extremely adverse emotions...
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_041: ...It may give rise to a nightmare-spawning pixie such as An Lad!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_042: What ill luck to be born like this...
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_043: If this hypothesis is correct, we may confirm that An Lad is drawn to those who are tormented by the same unfulfilled needs. And as a pixie, it is in children most of all that they would see kindred souls.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_044: I can say from experience that there's a strong connection between needs and dreams. And in the case of Kholusia, most dreams are to do with food.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_045: Food, you say? It's decided, then! We search for children in Kholusia whose hearts are hounded by hunger!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_046: As I mentioned, An Lad has veiled the scent of the source, but the nightmares are concentrated in Wright. Our task, then, is to find a child there who suffers from nightmares yet gives off no scent. Let's set out at once!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_LUGGAENC_000_047: A-A moment! Given the service you have performed for us, we owe you a tremendous debt. I cannot feel at ease until it is repaid. Is there no service I can offer you?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_LUGGAENC_000_048: N-Nothing at all? Hmmm, in that case... You are staying at Lydha Lran, yes? If it would not be considered overly bold, I shall take myself there. My familiars are at your disposal should you need them.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_049: Lugg Aenc here is the Nu Mou acquaintance I mentioned, the one who alerted me to the nightmares. We meet every so often to trade things like the fae lamps they need to make porxies.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_LUGGAENC_100_049: Yes, an extract of this mushroom should serve...
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_050: <sniff> <sniff> Mmmmmm, yes... This village positively reeks of nightmares. There can be no doubt─the source is here, spreading their influence to those around them.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_FOSTERPARENT03684_0: D-Did that pig just talk? And did it say something about nightmares?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_A1_000_001: It's a familiar that hunts nightmares.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_FOSTERPARENT03684_0: Truly? Then...perhaps you can help me. A child I recently took in, he's been having terrible nightmares. I don't know what to do...
The boy was originally from a nearby village. His parents abandoned him and went to try their luck in Eulmore. It's sad, I know, but I'm afraid it's not an uncommon story in these parts.
Anyway, for a long while he was alone and had to fend for himself. He was on the brink of starving to death when I found him and brought him here.
I managed to nurse him back to health, but the experience seems to have scarred him. He refuses to eat unless he's ripe to collapse, out of fear that the food will run out.
I thought I saw him playing on the north side of the village earlier, but like as not he's fallen asleep. He always seems tired these days.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_058: Thank you for sharing this with us, madam. Rest assured we shall do all that we can. <snort>
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_059: I daresay this is a promising lead! Come, let us search for the child!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_FOSTERPARENT03684_0: A flying, talking pig... What will they think of next?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_061: I'll stay hidden and leave the talking to you and Ezel.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_WRIGHTBOY03684_000_: Unnngh... No... Get away from me... Get away...
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_071: Tossing and turning in his sleep, yet not a whiff of a nightmare... I believe we've found our source!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_072: To be so hungry yet be unable to eat... No child deserves to suffer so.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_073: Rest easy now, lad! We shall vanquish your nightmare!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_074: Let me get this straight: he's hungry, but he refuses to eat even though there's food? I don't understand mortals sometimes... Anyway, we all remember what to do, yes?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_075: Uhhh... I...I don't know─hurk─how long I can hold it in... Q-Quickly, this way!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_100_081: Ewww, that is disgusting! Hurry and put it out of my misery!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_082: It's harder work...<huff>...bringing it back up... <wheeze>
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_090: Ugh, cannot unsee... That thing's going to haunt my dreams...
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_091: But it will haunt the young boy's no more! Let us hasten back to Wright and see how he fares!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_092: My belly has recovered, I am happy to report!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_WRIGHTBOY03684_100_: What the...? Do I know you? It feels as though I've met you before. Both you and the flying pig...
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_102: How do you feel, my boy?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_WRIGHTBOY03684_000_: It's strange... I was having a terrifying dream, but it suddenly turned happy. Then I woke up, and my stomach─it doesn't feel like it's in knots anymore.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_FOSTERPARENT03684_0: Well, now... What dream was it that you saw?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_WRIGHTBOY03684_000_: It's kind of hazy...but there was a great, gluttonous monster that ate everything. I was fighting it and losing. But then someone appeared and helped me, and together we defeated it!
...Um, Mother? I'm starving. Can I have something to eat?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_FOSTERPARENT03684_0: B-But of course, my dear boy! You can have as much as you like!
We mightn't have anything fancy, but we grow enough here to feed everyone. You needn't fear ever going hungry. So come, let's go home. I'll even bake you a sweet!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_WRIGHTBOY03684_000_: ...It was you, wasn't it? The hero who helped me in my dream? Thank you! Thank you so much!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_112: Hmph, we would ask you the same question! Why won't you have fun with dreams like a normal pixie?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_114: You really don't know? If you're not making mischief, what is it that you're trying to do? What's your purpose?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_ANLAD_000_115: What's my purpose? I don't know. I merely follow my heart.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_ANLAD_000_116: Since being born, there are two dreams I see. One where I can never reach someone I love. And another where I'm crying alone in a cramped old castle.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_ANLAD_000_117: When I awaken, I'm driven by a burning desire for them. For that someone, though their face is a blur. And for Lyhe Mheg, oh-so-nostalgic Lyhe Mheg...
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_118: What do you mean? Why Lyhe Mheg? And who's this someone?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_120: Well, that was certainly perplexing... But in any case, we've accomplished our mission here. So come, my friends! Another gate wants for opening in Lyhe Mheg!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_130: We've been waiting for you, . If truth be told, An Lad's words still weigh on my mind...but I daresay we've earned a moment of fun!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_131: Oh yes, we're going to open another gate, and we're going to put the bubbles we've gathered to use!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_132: And how does one use these bubbles exactly?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_133: Tee hee! What was it that you said, Ezel? Better to show than to explain or some such?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_134: Right, , I want you to do the honors again! This time, hold an image of Kholusia in your mind!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_135: There you are! Come, come, let us open the next gate!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_SYSTEM_000_100: By freeing the little boy in Wright from his nightmares, you and yours have reclaimed the dreams of those in Kholusia.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_SYSTEM_000_101: Furthermore, using the dream bubbles, Tyr Beq has created a house of treats and an array of play equipment!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_136: Tee hee! Surprised, yes? Feel free to stay and play as long as you like. We'll be waiting for you outside!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_140: There you are, ! I trust you had fun! Amazing what you can do with happy dreams and a touch of pixie magick, right?
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_EZELII_000_141: This porxie, for one, is thoroughly impressed! You truly live up to your reputation as a founder of Lyhe Mheg!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_142: You know, , if you liked it in there, you're welcome to make Lyhe Mheg your home.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_143: Oh yes, forever and ever and ever...
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_TYRBEQ_000_144: Tee hee! Right, now that we've reclaimed Kholusia, we must work to fill it with lots of happy dreams. If you're willing to help, Uin Nee yonder will set you some tasks!
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_SYSTEM_000_150: You have achieved Trusted reputation with the Dreamspinners.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_SYSTEM_000_151: New pixie society daily quests are now available from Uin Nee in Lydha Lran.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_SYSTEM_000_152: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Uin Nee as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_SYSTEM_000_153: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Uin Nee. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANPIX002_03684_SYSTEM_000_154: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Jul Oul.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_000: You know, , we've known each other for a while now. I was thinking, perhaps it's time we started living together. I could build us a lovely house in Lyhe Mheg, fill it with whatever your heart desires... What do you say?
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_A1_000_001: A certain faerie king won't be pleased.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_001: O-Of course! Titania! Y-You didn't think I'd forget about them, did you?
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_002: It was just a jest! Yes, a jest! I-I'd never dream of taking you from our king, whose beauty is equaled only by their benevolence... <gulp>
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_003: Awww, you're as hard to win over as they say. And there I was actually being a little bit serious...
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_004:
Well, if you have a change of heart, do let me know. At your word, I'll make Lyhe Mheg your forever and ever home.
...Tee hee, I jest, I jest!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_005: T-Truly? Huzzah, huzzah! Come, let's begin living together at once! I'll make Lyhe Mheg your forever and ever home!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_007: ...A-Actually, it was just a jest. Yes, a jest. I'd never dream of taking you from our king, whose beauty is equaled only by their benevolence... <gulp>
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_008: So, Tyr Beq, I've been wondering how the boy in Wright is faring. Is there any chance we might meet him in Lyhe Mheg?
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_009: If you're worried about him, sure, I can check if he's asleep and bring him to us.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_WRIGHTBOY03685_000_: After you left, everyone in the village brought me lots of tasty things. I ate so much, I felt like I was going to burst!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_022: We're pleased to hear that! Now, I take it you are no longer plagued by nightmares?
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_WRIGHTBOY03685_000_: Not at all! I only have fun dreams now, like this one. It makes me not want to wake up again!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_024: Truly? If that's what you want, it can be arranged.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_WRIGHTBOY03685_000_: Uhhh, I-I have some chores to do, so I better wake up now. So long!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_026: It's done! I've merged the boy's dream with Lyhe Mheg!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_030: Let that be a reminder that pixies aren't to be trusted... <snort>
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_031: Oh, come now, it was just a jest! I prefer my mortals alive and happy, I'll have you know. Dead and unhappy ones don't give us fun dreams to harvest.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_032: But enough about that─we still have nightmares to vanquish. What do you say we investigate Amh Araeng next?
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_033: Sounds good to me. Based on my preliminary sniffing, the stench of nightmares is concentrated in Mord Souq. Can you tell us what manner of dreams are common there?
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_034: Hmmm... As I recall, most dreams are to do with water. Folk going thirsty, searching for a water hole─that sort of thing.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_035: So their need is simply for safety and survival. It stands to reason, given that the region is an inhospitable desert. Without further ado, then, let us make for Mord Souq and search for the source of the nightmares!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_036: What? Did I say something strange?
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_040: Ugh, what a dull and dusty place... There isn't a single pretty flower around, nor anything that looks tasty.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_041: Instead, I see these revolting worms everywhere...and people eat them! Yech, just thinking about it makes my stomach turn...
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_042: Well, to each their own, and to me they look quite palatable. I can imagine them bursting in one's mouth, releasing the slimy goodness within... <slurp> Perhaps I shall take some back with me...
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_043: Oh, don't even think about bringing them to Lyhe Mheg! I will murder you!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_044: Hmph, I prefer nightmares at any rate. Speaking of which, we should get to work. As before, we are looking for a slumbering child. I doubt there'll be too many of them in such a bustling marketplace.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_045: How can you be sure the child will be sleeping?
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_046: An Lad's nightmares induce an unnatural drowsiness. Those affected cannot easily resist it.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_047: <sniff> <sniff> This entire town... It smells so ripe, so tantalizing!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_HAWKER03685_000_051: Oh, don't worry about the boy. He's bone tired, is all. Hasn't been getting much sleep of late, on account of the nightmares.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_HAWKER03685_000_053: Investigating nightmares, you say? Well, it's no secret why my son has them. We were traveling through the desert when his sister...
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_HAWKER03685_000_054: I'm sorry. It's still too fresh. Now, if you'll excuse me, I've got some errands to run. Don't worry about the boy. He's safe enough sleeping there.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_HAWKER03685_000_055: Just─if you plan on heading outside, be sure you carry plenty of water, all right?
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_HAWKER03685_100_055: Out there, it's a matter of life and death...
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_056: The boy is plainly in the grip of a nightmare, yet he gives off no scent. He's the source, and no mistake!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_057: Right then, let's tend to business before his father returns. Have at it, Ezel!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_ANLAD_000_059: Don't interfere anymore. I'm warning you.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_060: Oh, will you stop doing that!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_ANLAD_000_061: The child and I, we created a watery friend together. If you give it form, you will get hurt...or worse.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_062: Hmph, your ugly nightmares are no match for us! We'll take care of this one like we did the others!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_063: Unnngh... It feels like a storm is raging in my belly...
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_ANLAD_000_064: Why? Why must you torment me? I only want to fill this hole in my heart. A hole where a friend used to be. Alone inside that cramped old castle, how I longed to see them...
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_066: This absolutely can't wait! I-I'm─hurk─going to be sick!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_100_066: Phew... Thank goodness it didn't come back up inside the village...
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_067: So frustrating not being able to interact with dreams directly...
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_068: Not a smell on this child! He is our source, I'm certain of it!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_HAWKER03685_000_069: Me? I'm a flower vendor. I get blooms from the Crystarium and travel around selling them with my son. I'd ask if you were interested, but something tells me they're not uncommon where you're from.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_071: Oh, seriously! Why do they always have to look so hideous!?
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_072: The worms in town looked palatable. This...does not.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_MORDBOY03685_000_07: Leave me alone, monster... Go away...
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_080: You did it! You did it!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_082: Come, let's hurry back to Mord Souq and look in on the child. We'll leave the talking to you.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_083: As far as storms in bellies go, I'd say that one was quite stormy...
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_MORDBOY03685_000_09: I-I suppose? Don't laugh, but...I think I met  in a dream.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_HAWKER03685_000_093: In a dream! Well now, isn't that amazing!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_HAWKER03685_000_095: Sorry, sorry. It's just...I don't remember when you were last so lively. But tell me, what kind of dream was it?
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_HAWKER03685_000_097: The same one, then. I'm sorry I wasn't here. It must have been hard...
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_MORDBOY03685_000_09: No, it was different this time. This ,  appeared and trounced the water monster!
But that's not all. At the place where the monster fell, flowers began to bloom. They reminded me of the promise I made to Enile. The promise that, one day, I'd fill Amh Araeng with flowers.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_HAWKER03685_100_100: I see... One day, son. One day we'll make your sister's wish come true. Mark my words.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_MORDBOY03685_110_10: Well, we have to go now. But whoever you are, I hope to see you again.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_MORDBOY03685_100_10: Thank you, pale pixie. For helping me to remember.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_102: The boy is well again! Another job well done!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_103: But...he was thanking An Lad. Why do you suppose...?
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_104: As I understand it, his little sister died of thirst in the desert. Latching onto this ordeal, An Lad had planted a nightmare in the form of that water monster.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_105: And though we were the ones who helped him to conquer the nightmare, ironically, it was its very existence that brought him hope.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_107: It's certainly something to chew on. But for now, let us return to Lyhe Mheg. Another gate awaits!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_111: Tyr Beq, are you all right? You haven't uttered a word since we returned.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_112: ...Hm? Oh! S-Sorry, I was deep in thought. That's not very pixie-like at all, is it?
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_113: Go ahead, ! You know what to do!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_SYSTEM_000_100: By freeing the little boy in Mord Souq from his nightmares, you and yours have reclaimed the dreams of those in Amh Araeng.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_SYSTEM_000_101: Tyr Beq appears eager to further beautify Lyhe Mheg, and for this they require your aid...
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_114: 'Tis time to throw wide the gates to Amh Araeng!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_115: And that's that! We'll go on ahead back to Lydha Lran. Come and see us when you're ready, all right?
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_116: More dream bubbles! I look forward to seeing what fantastical shapes they will assume!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_120: Thanks to you, we've reclaimed the dreams of yet another region. I'm really, truly grateful, .
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_121: Now, about An Lad... It's strange, but I can't help but feel as if I know them.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_122: As you know, I built Lyhe Mheg together with my departed best friend. But maybe─just maybe─that friend has...
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_123: ...No. No, it couldn't be them. I'm being silly. You set Titania free, . Everyone knows that.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_124: W-Wait! Do you mean to say that your friend was the previous Titania!?
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_125: Back then, they weren't Titania yet. They were simply a kind-hearted pixie who saw fit to befriend me, eccentric as I am. Together we built Lyhe Mheg. Together we had the finest fun.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_126: They're very dear to me. That's why, no matter what, I want to protect our garden. Like they protected all of us from the sin eaters.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_100_127: I see. Close as you were, it isn't implausible that you would sense your friend in another form. And the dream of being alone in a castle is suggestive indeed...
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_EZELII_000_127: Be that as it may, I do not see how An Lad could be the reincarnation of your friend. After all, pixies are born of the souls of children. But wait... Could it be the aether that is gathered...?
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_128: You know, never mind! I'm sure I'm just being sentimental and silly.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_TYRBEQ_000_129: As I said, it's not pixie-like to overthink things. Let's do something fun and productive instead─like filling Amh Araeng with happy dreams!
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_SYSTEM_000_140: You have achieved Respected reputation with the Dreamspinners.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_SYSTEM_000_141: New pixie society daily quests are now available from Uin Nee in Lydha Lran.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_SYSTEM_000_142: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Uin Nee as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_SYSTEM_000_143: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Uin Nee. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_SYSTEM_000_144: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Jul Oul.
TEXT_BANPIX003_03685_SYSTEM_000_150: In order to undertake the next allied society main quest, you must first complete the main scenario quest “Out of the Wood.”
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_000: Ah, ! I've been thinking... Yes, yes, I know, I said that I wouldn't overthink things.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_001: <snort> You are still troubled by the possibility that An Lad was born of Titania's aether?
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_002: Hmmm, I don't know how you see such things, but to us pixies, taking on the aether of another doesn't make you that person. You're simply another pixie.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_003: Such a view is certainly in keeping with what is known of pixies─that you aren't empathetic by nature. Yet I thought you would have more of an attachment to your friend, at least.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_004: Well, the simple fact is, a pixie is a pixie. It doesn't matter whose soul they came from, or that they inherited someone's dreams. Having said that, if that someone was my friend, I feel as though I want to...I don't know. Understand them, I suppose?
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_005: What's more, when Titania's consciousness leaked out of the castle, we all felt their torment as if it were our own.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_006: If An Lad was indeed born of their aether, then that torment is literally their own. And I can't help but feel sorry for them.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_007: Before they became the king, my friend wasn't so different to the rest of us. Just loved a little more by nature, is all. Deep down, I don't think that An Lad is so different either.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_008: There must be something we can do to help them. And to begin with, I want to ask that boy in Mord Souq a few questions. Come, let's go to Lyhe Mheg!
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_MORDBOY03685_000_01: Oh, it's so good to see you again! Isn't the pale pixie with you today? The poor, lonely one?
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_011: You mean An Lad... Did you speak with them?
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_MORDBOY03685_000_01: Just a little, in my dream. There was something about them─something that reminded me of my sister.
I found them crying alone in a cold and empty place. I felt sorry for them and said that I'd be their friend.
I don't remember clearly, but they tried to create water for my sister. Only they were really clumsy, and made the water into a monster instead.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_016: Wait, that nightmare wasn't even meant to be a nightmare?
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_MORDBOY03685_000_01: Right. Everything turned into a mess in the dream, but I'm grateful to An Lad. They gave me the chance to face my fears...and helped me to remember my promise to my sister.
Uh oh, it's time to get up... I have to go now, but you can call me again any time!
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_019: This boy thanked An Lad, as you'll recall. I want to ask him what happened exactly.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_100_019: To be able to speak with people as they sleep... It's a convenient power, I must admit.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_020: <sigh> The more I learn about An Lad, the more I feel sorry for them...
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_021: By the intensity of your concern, one would be forgiven for thinking you were a mortal. Perhaps it's due to the time you have spent rollicking in their dreams, and more recently, the company you've been keeping.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_022:
What? You think  is rubbing off on me?
...Ack, I don't care about all that right now!
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_023: We have another region to reclaim─the Rak'tika Greatwood. As I recall, many there have dreams about wanting to be useful to others, and to have others regard them well.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_024: I see. I believe my master referred to this as the need for self-esteem. In any case, you'll be pleased to know I've already sniffed out where the nightmares are concentrated. Let us make for Slitherbough!
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_025: An Lad tried to create water in their dreams, only to make that nightmare? I can't well imagine the darkness they carry with them.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_030: I don't like it here... I feel as if someone─or something─is watching me...
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_031: These woods are ancient. I would not be surprised if the spirits of eld still abided here.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_032: Let us be quick about our task. As before, we seek a slumbering child.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_033: Right, Ezel and I will search the south. , we leave the east to you.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_034: <sniff> <sniff> The stench of nightmares hangs heavy in the air. The source is bound to be near!
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_SLITHERBOUGHGIRL036: Please... You have to believe me... <sob>
A flying pig...and a pixie? Am I still dreaming?
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_045: The denizens of Slitherbough are magically gifted, and as a child, she would possess a natural affinity to pixies. It's not a wonder that she can see you.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_SLITHERBOUGHGIRL036: I-I'm sorry, but I'm not myself right now. Every time I close my eyes, it's the fort all over again... Everything burning all over again... <sob> Those animals, they were my friends...
I can't─I won't let any more animals suffer the same fate! I'm going to become a priestess, and then everyone will listen to me!
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_049: It's all right. We're going to make the nightmare disappear. Such ugliness has no place in Lyhe Mheg.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_050: We'll watch over you and keep you safe. So rest easy now, and go back to sleep.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_051: An intriguing change. Yes, most intriguing indeed... <snort>
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_052: Hmph, don't you have a nightmare to devour?
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_054: An Lad!? Come out and show yourself! We have to talk!
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_055: They don't appear to be in a talkative mood.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_056: Grrr, why don't you listen for a change!?
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_057: Uhhh... My poor belly...as if there's─hurk─a volcano in there... It...it begins!
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_059: Ugh, it doesn't get any easier to look at... ─get ready, now!
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_072: Yeowch! The air around it is hot enough to burn!
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_081: Phew... A moment later and I would have been roast...
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_082: Porxelain. Porxies become porxelain, not roast.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_083: Anyway, the nightmare is gone. Let's see how the little girl is doing back in Slitherbough.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_084: Phew... That was too hot for comfort...
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_SLITHERBOUGHGIRL036: Oh! I was wondering where you had gone!
I wanted to thank you. For helping me in my dream.
Clear as day. You see, for as long as I can remember dreaming, I've had prophetic dreams. I make it a point to note what I see in them.

And two years ago, I saw what was about to befall Fort Gohn─the sin eater attack and the fire that broke out. I tried to warn everyone. Tried to tell them to flee. But no one would believe me. No one save Master Matoya. But by the time I got word to her, it was too late...
I felt so powerless then. Simply because I was a child, I had no voice. I wanted so badly to be heard, to be respected, I dedicated myself to becoming a priestess and proving my worth.

But no matter how I tried, it felt as though I never could do well enough. Always, I feared that I would fail. That I wouldn't be able to protect anyone or anything. Then the nightmares started, and I was made to relive that day. Made to feel my powerlessness, over and over.

I had just about given up hope when you came and showed me that dream. Thanks to your vanquishing the nightmare, I feel at peace now. With myself and who I want to be. May I ask to whom I owe my gratitude?
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_A1_000_001: I'm an old friend of Master Matoya's.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_A1_000_002: We're warriors who fight to reclaim dreams.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_SLITHERBOUGHGIRL036: Truly? You're Master Matoya's friend? There's no one I admire and respect more! She's so wise, and gentle, and beautiful... Ah, I want to be just like her!
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_100: I'll have to pay this Matoya's dream a visit. I'll be sure to make you appear as well, . We can dress you up like this, and...ooh, yes! Like that!
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_102: Indeed, indeed. All know the Warriors of Darkness, but we are the Warriors of Dreams. <snort>
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_SLITHERBOUGHGIRL036: Warriors of Dreams... I'm not familiar with such heroes, but 'tis plain you are a force for good. Perhaps I shall strive to become one too!
Well, I had best return to my training. Though I will keep working hard, I won't let the fear of failure burden me anymore. My thanks again, and please take care!
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_105: Well now, to be seen and appreciated... I could get used to this! But come, let's return to Lyhe Mheg and open the gate before An Lad finds a new target!
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_100_110: This is the gate to the Rak'tika Greatwood. Go on and lift the seal!
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_SYSTEM_000_110: By freeing the little girl in Slitherbough from her nightmares, you and yours have reclaimed the dreams of those in the Rak'tika Greatwood.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_SYSTEM_000_111: Tyr Beq appears eager to further beautify Lyhe Mheg, and for this they require your aid...
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_120: With that, there's just one gate left!
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_123: Before the nightmares, there wasn't a fifth gate. I couldn't begin to guess what's beyond.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_124: And you didn't think to mention this!? <sigh> Never mind... One can't expect a pixie to adhere to logic...
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_ANLAD_000_126: So this is Lyhe Mheg. It always seems cold and forbidding no matter where I go, but here it's...different. Here it's warm and inviting.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_ANLAD_000_127: To think that dreams could be so beautiful...
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_ANLAD_000_128: Fear not. I've hardly any power left. And yet...I don't want to fall asleep. I don't want to have that dream again. The one inside the castle on the lake...
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_129: Lyhe Ghiah... Then you were indeed seeing Titania's dreams.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_ANLAD_000_131: I'm not sure. It's the dream of a lonely soul that my heart shows me. A dream of rollicking and playing with a dear friend.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_ANLAD_000_132: Would that I could rollick and play too. But every dream I touch turns into a nightmare. And everyone despises me, mortals and pixies alike...
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_133: An Lad, you always talk of what someone else wants, but what of yourself? What are your own desires?
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_ANLAD_000_134: I...I don't know. I know only that, in the dream of the castle, a nasty monster appears. In a terrible, grating voice, it whispers in my ear: “You were born to bring nightmares─a plague.”
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_135: What!? Hear me, An Lad! With the powers you possess, you mustn't question your own existence! If you do, your essence will thin out until it is consumed!
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_136: Ack, I've had enough of all this doom and gloom! I'll be your friend, all right? So please, let's put an end to all this!
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_140: Huh? It didn't seem to do anything...
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_144: All proceeds apace thus far! Come, let us unseal the fourth gate! <snort>
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_150: I don't know what An Lad did to me, but I seem fine. <yawn> Just a little tired, perhaps...
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_EZELII_000_151: I would surmise that, had you shared An Lad's needs, you would have become a source for the nightmares like the children.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_152: Is that why they said I couldn't be their friend? Because I don't share their needs?
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_154: Oh, for the love of... Why do they have to make things so complicated?
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_TYRBEQ_000_155: Well, there isn't much we can do about An Lad until they choose to reappear. Let's focus instead on filling Rak'tika with fun and happy dreams! When you have time, , Uin Nee is always looking for help!
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_SYSTEM_000_160: You have achieved Honored reputation with the Dreamspinners.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_SYSTEM_000_161: New pixie society daily quests are now available from Uin Nee in Lydha Lran.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_SYSTEM_000_162: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Uin Nee as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_SYSTEM_000_163: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Uin Nee. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_SYSTEM_000_164: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Jul Oul.
TEXT_BANPIX004_03686_SYSTEM_000_200: In order to undertake the next allied society main quest, you must first complete the main scenario quest “Out of the Wood.”
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_000: <yawn> , I feel so sleepy... Is this the effect of An Lad's spell...?
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_001: Given that they tried to plant a nightmare in you, it's little wonder you should feel drowsy. If the urge is so strong, why don't you just sleep?
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_002: N-Not on your life! If I have a nightmare, you'll come and suck on me!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_003: If you are not tormented by an unfulfilled need, you shouldn't be plagued by nightmares. But in the event that you were...yes, I would suck on you. <slurp>
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_004: I'm never going to sleep again! Never, ever!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_005: If you say so. Now then, may I suggest we inspect Lyhe Mheg for anomalies? And while we're there, perhaps we can look in on the little girl in Slitherbough.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_SLITHERBOUGHGIRL036: I had a feeling that we would meet again ere long!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_011: I take it you've not had nightmares since. All is well with you, little one?
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_SLITHERBOUGHGIRL036: Yes, thank you! Now that the fear of failure no longer consumes me, a pall has lifted from my heart. I feel happier than I have in a long time.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_013: That's wonderful to hear. Now tell me, did you meet An Lad─the pale pixie─in your dreams?
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_SLITHERBOUGHGIRL036: Only briefly. But that was enough for me to see their torment. Theirs is a lonely soul, one which draws powerful emotions to it.
And though I only caught fragments, in the deepest depths of their heart, I glimpsed this realm. And I glimpsed you, Tyr Beq.
Feeling sorry for An Lad, I befriended them. But I ended up being caught in that nightmare.
Oh! I'm sorry, but I must go! My mother is calling!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_019: With her talent, this little girl should be able to tell us about her dreams in more detail. <yawn> Ugh, can barely keep my eyes open...
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_100_019: What would Tyr Beq's nightmare taste like, I wonder... <slurp>
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_020: An Lad might have spurned me, but I won't give up. I want to become their friend, I truly do.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_021: I feel their loneliness so very keenly. And I think it's because of all the mortal hearts I've glimpsed, together with you and Ezel.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_022: I don't know why, but when I think about An Lad, my chest tightens up. Am I being strange? And if I were, would you still stand by me? Or would you run for the hills?
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_A2_000_001: Eccentric or no, we're with you.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_A2_000_002: We wouldn't dream of abandoning you.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_023: Hear, hear! We've come this far together! We're with you to the end!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_025: With that settled, let's discuss our next course of action. Now, you said that the fifth gate didn't exist prior to the nightmares.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_026: Yes, we fashioned only four. Someone else must have created the fifth─someone as skilled in manipulating dreams as me.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_027: This is problematic indeed. Up till now, we lifted the seals by vanquishing the nightmares in the regions beyond the gates. This time, however, we do not know where the gate leads.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_028: Hold on, now. If An Lad was in Lyhe Mheg, does that mean...?
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_029: Hm! The likelihood is passing high─the place is Il Mheg. And the fact that the gate is sealed means an individual already exists who is the source of the nightmares.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_030: Someone here in the faerie kingdom, who is constantly plagued by terrible dreams... I can't imagine anyone more likely than An Lad themself.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_031: So we help An Lad, like we helped the children. Free them from the nightmare that's...that's... <yawn> Can't fight it...any...more...
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_032: It was only a question of when. Let's leave Tyr Beq to rest for now and do what we can in the meantime.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_033: So, if we are to help An Lad, it is essential that we understand them. To that end, I suggest that we learn all that we can of the previous Titania by speaking with the fae folk. Let's split up for this task and reconvene here afterwards.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_034: An Lad was as an empty vessel, highly susceptible to outside influence. And it's difficult to imagine a stronger influence than that of the faerie king.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_OSESIGUN_000_040: You wish to know about our previous monarch? As I recall, before their ascension, they were exceptional at wielding the power of nature. Oh, and they were seldom seen without their bosom friend─a pixie of pink.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_OSESIGUN_000_041: The tragic manner of their downfall is a source of immeasurable pain for us. Never will we forget their sacrifice.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_OSESIGUN_000_042: ...Hm? Payment for the information? No, no, that will not be necessary. If anything, we are the ones who owe you thanks for setting our monarch free.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_OULSIGUN_000_043: The old Titania? Of course, how could we forget? They protected us from sin eaters, and we're forever grateful.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_OULSIGUN_000_044: I even remember them before they became king. They weren't so different from the rest of us.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_OULSIGUN_000_045: Aye, they liked making mischief, drinking milk, rollicking in dreams─all the usual pixie pleasures. It must have been hard for them, alone inside that castle.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_OULSIGUN_000_046: But enough about that! Play with me, play with me! It isn't fair that Tyr Beq gets to spend all that time with you!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_IALAJUL_000_047: Curious about the previous Titania, you say? Of course, I should be glad to tell you what I know.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_IALAJUL_000_048: When they became a sin eater, it was with great sorrow that we resolved to seal them away inside Lyhe Ghiah. Tyr Beq opposed the decision to the last.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_IALAJUL_000_049: I cannot claim to know the heart of a pixie, but if I were Titania, I would have liked nothing more than to be praised. To be remembered.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_IALAJUL_000_050: Now then, if I may ask, are you not being subjected to mischief? For your own good, I advise against getting too intimate with the pixies.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_OSESIGUN_000_051: The tragic manner of our king's downfall is a source of immeasurable pain for us. Never will we forget their sacrifice.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_OULSIGUN_000_052: The old Titania protected us from sin eaters, and we're forever grateful. If they were still here, we'd invite them to play with us.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_IALAJUL_000_053: Titania gave their all for us. Were I them, I would have liked nothing more than to be praised. To be remembered.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_060: There you are, . What were you able to learn about Titania?
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_061: Ahhh! You went around prying while I slept!? Hmph, and people complain that pixies have no propriety!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_062: But...to know that everyone still remembers my friend─still remembers their sacrifice... It makes me happier than I can say.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_063: 'Tis plain that the two of you were the closest of friends. All the fae folk with whom I spoke attested to that.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_064: With my obsession for dreams, I was considered strange even among pixiekind. No one wanted anything to do with me, but they accepted me as I was. Without them, I would have been all alone, like An Lad.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_065: <gasp> I see now... An Lad─they're the pixie I used to be!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_066: Like me, all they need is for someone to accept them as they are!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_067: I see! Self-actualization, I believe my master called this need, and I daresay it will provide us with a clue to unsealing the final gate!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_068: It doesn't matter whose soul An Lad was born from. Doesn't matter whose aether they inherited. They're a pixie like the rest of us.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_069: As a fellow pixie, I can't let them suffer anymore. I can't let them stay in that dark, lonely place.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_070: What's more, I can't help but feel that my friend was the one who guided them to me.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_071: They loved everyone, they did. “No one should be alone,” I can almost hear them say...
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_072: They reached their hand out to me once upon a time. Now it's my turn to reach mine out to An Lad.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_073: Come, let's go to Lyhe Mheg and find An Lad! If we have to, we'll pound on the gate until they come out!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_THONSUL_000_080: Tyr Beq, thank heavens you're here! There's trouble in Lyhe Mheg! Terrible trouble!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_THONSUL_000_082: I can't say for certain, but there's a power welling up within! A terrible power!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_083: What!? Could it be An Lad!?
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_084: I'm going inside. If it's An Lad, I'm the only one who can stop them.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_085: Now, wait just a─ Confound it! I'm going with you!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_THONSUL_000_086: If you go too, there's no guarantee you'll come out alive...but please go anyway! Go and help Tyr Beq!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_101: An Lad's power is running rampant. By questioning their own existence, they are causing their essence to unravel...Lyhe Mheg along with it!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_102: If this realm collapses, there's no telling how the minds of those whose dreams are connected to it will be affected.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_103: Yet one thing is all but certain: An Lad themself will disappear.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_104: No! They're my friend! I can't let that happen!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_105: Please! Please help me help An Lad!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_ANLAD_000_108: When I was thirsty, no one gave me anything to drink... When I wanted to play, they drove me away...
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_ANLAD_000_109: I just wanted a friend. Wanted someone to tell me that I did well. But everyone treats me like a plague...
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_120: An Lad! It's all right! We're fighting with you!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_ANLAD_000_121: <sob> It's no use... I'm no use...
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EYEBALL03687_000_12: Yes, yes, embrace your self-doubt. Your fear, your hatred.
The wretched world has given you naught but torment. You will reward them in kind. Give them their deepest, darkest nightmares.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_150: The nightmare is fading! We did it!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_151: Silly pixie! Don't lose control like that ever again! That nightmare of yours was no joke!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_153: Yes, yours! And it caused a great deal of trouble!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_155: All well and good to apologize, but don't you think you have something else to say to ? 's the one who vanquished your nightmare.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_ANLAD_000_156: I was dreaming. Dreaming that I was imprisoned alone inside a great castle.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_ANLAD_000_157: I was so lonely and scared... It was so terribly silent, I felt as though I was losing myself...
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_ANLAD_000_158: But you came, . You came and freed me. Thank you.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_A1_000_002: It was harder the first time.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_100_159: So, An Lad. Now that your nightmare is gone, we can make lots and lots of fun dreams together!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_ANLAD_000_159: But I don't know how to make fun dreams. I'm afraid I'll only make more nightmares.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_160: Look, it's true that you're a little different from the rest of us. It's true you have a few things to learn.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_161: But there's no need to rush. Just do what you think feels right, and all will be well.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_162: Even if you do end up creating a nightmare, there's no need to fret. Ezel here will make short work of it.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_163: Just so! I only ask that you don't keep the dreamer for yourself! <snort>
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_164: And if that happens, we'll just fix up the nightmare, add a pinch of pixie magic to make it fun again!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_165: Did you know, An Lad? Like a rainbow that appears after the storm, no dream is more beautiful than the one you see after conquering a nightmare.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_166: So I want you to fly tall. Because you're one of us, a proud pixie of Il Mheg.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_167: That's right! Rain, hail, or shine, the Kingdom of Rainbows is your home!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_100_167: Here, you can always be yourself!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_ANLAD_000_169: Ahhh, my heart swells with song! I...I can't help but want to dance!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_171: Do as your heart bids you, and dance! Dance with me!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_182: I knew you had it in you!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_ANLAD_000_183: This is what it means to have fun! I never imagined it would feel so amazing!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_ANLAD_000_184: Come, ! Come and play with us!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_SYSTEM_000_185: By freeing An Lad from their nightmares, you and yours have reclaimed all the dreams in Norvrandt.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_SYSTEM_000_186: Forever young and carefree, the pixies shall rollick with their guests in Lyhe Mheg, this night and all the nights to come!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_190: Do you see all of this, ? This is our precious Lyhe Mheg, and if it weren't for you, it wouldn't still be here.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_191: And neither would this hopelessly silly pixie!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_193: Oh, yes! You're the silliest...and dearest of all!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_194: I must say, when they behave thus, pixies can be quite adorable.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_195: From here on, , I'll continue watching over Lyhe Mheg with my friends. We'll revel and rollick and make sure that the garden is always filled with fun.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_196: And different though our kinds may be, I count you among the very best of friends.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_197: So please, come and visit us often and play with us!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_ANLAD_000_198: Why don't we turn  into a leafman? That way  can stay with us forever.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_199: ...An Lad. If there's one thing you must never do, it's lay a hand on .
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_ANLAD_000_200: All right, if you say so...
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_201: Right, I should assure everyone outside that all is well again. Let's return to Lydha Lran for now.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_EZELII_000_202: In An Lad's marvelous creations, I can fairly sense Titania's hand. And though it was for but a moment, I thought I saw not two, but three pixies dancing.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_ANLAD_000_203: Ahhh, such fun! This is all new to me, but it somehow feels nostalgic. As if I've found a missing part of myself.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_210: I've told the other pixies about everything. They understand now that An Lad isn't a danger, and welcome them as one of us. It's simple like that with our kind.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_211: And though we've restored Lyhe Mheg to its full splendor, it doesn't mean our work is done. We need to ensure that the realm is always beautiful and filled with fun, and for this we need to keep on collecting dream bubbles.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_TYRBEQ_000_212: I hope that you'll continue to lend the Dreamspinners a helping hand, ─for the fun and happiness of pixies and mortals alike!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_ANLAD_000_213: Tyr Beq and the others are happy...and that makes me happy!
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_SYSTEM_000_220: You have achieved Sworn reputation with the Dreamspinners.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_SYSTEM_000_221: You will receive an experience point bonus upon completion of the pixie society daily quests.
TEXT_BANPIX005_03687_SYSTEM_000_222: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Jul Oul.
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_TYRBEQ_000_000: Oh, , how nice of you to visit! Thanks to you, we're having more fun in dreams than we've ever had. We're really, truly grateful─us pixies and the children both!
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_TYRBEQ_000_001: When we first created Lyhe Mheg, I never dreamed that it could become such a beautiful place. Everything in it is a treasure, and I couldn't be prouder of what we have!
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_EZELII_000_002: And lest you wonder, I continue to fight the good fight, devouring nightmares across the realm, including those An Lad accidentally creates.
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_TYRBEQ_000_003: Ah, speaking of An Lad, they've been wanting to speak with you, . If you have a moment, let's go and see them in Lyhe Mheg together.
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_TYRBEQ_000_011: An Lad, I'd swear you haven't budged from this spot since I last saw you. Have you been gazing out at Lyhe Mheg again?
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_ANLAD_000_012: I have... It's hard to explain, but simply gazing out at the place makes my heart sing. It's a feeling I remember from another life.
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_ANLAD_000_013: ? There's something I've been wanting to tell you.
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_ANLAD_000_014: You helped me to fill the void in my heart. To find a purpose for my existence. For that, I'm eternally grateful.
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_ANLAD_000_015: Though I've stopped seeing Titania's dreams, their will lives on in me. And I'll honor it, by watching over Lyhe Mheg.
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_TYRBEQ_000_016: Born of the souls of children as we are, we pixies tend to get caught up in the moment and our feelings. We need someone to watch out for us, to find us when we lose ourselves. That's to say, we're not meant to be alone. And from now on, we'll see to it none of us is alone ever again.
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_TYRBEQ_000_017: . I know I've already thanked you a dozen times, but I want to thank you again. You didn't only free my friend─you freed their will as well. And now, everyone may revel in their precious Garden of Dreams as they had intended. Mortals and pixies alike.
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_TYRBEQ_000_018: I also want to say...I'm absolutely green with envy! It's so unfair that the king has you all to themself!
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_EZELII_000_019: I must admit I'm envious too. Would that the king would share  with us... <snort>
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_ANLAD_000_020: Yes, even a little piece of  would be nice...
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_FEOUL_000_021: (-Feo Ul-)Oh, good grief, when will everybody learn!? This mortal is mine, do you hear me!? Mine, mine, mine!
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_TYRBEQ_000_022: <gulp> ...O-On second thought, it's more than plenty that you visit from time to time.
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_ANLAD_000_023: Yes, please come and see me again.
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_TYRBEQ_000_025: Well, I should get back to my tasks. An Lad─I could use some help. Do you want to come with me to see Uin Nee?
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_TYRBEQ_000_026: Take as much time here as you like, . We'll be waiting outside when you've had your fill.
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_TYRBEQ_000_031: I must say, it saddens me that I can't be your branch. But whenever you're feeling weary, know that I'll always be ready with an invigorating dream for you.
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_TYRBEQ_000_032: Tell me, . Before you met us, did you ever imagine that mortals and pixies shared such a connection? How do you think people would react if they learned that we're spinning their fun-filled dreams?
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_ANLAD_100_033: Well then, if people still have nightmares, then they would know who's to blame.
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_EZELII_000_035: There's only so much one porxie can do, you know. If necessary, perhaps I shall ask my master to make more of me... <snort>
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_TYRBEQ_000_036: Well, I shouldn't keep you any longer. Brief though it was, it's truly been a joy adventuring with you, .
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_TYRBEQ_000_037: But whenever you can spare the time, I hope that you'll visit us. After all, we can never have enough help making dreams fun and beautiful!
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_SYSTEM_000_100: You have achieved Bloodsworn reputation with the Dreamspinners.
TEXT_BANPIX006_03688_SYSTEM_000_101: You will receive an experience point bonus upon completion of the pixie society daily quests.
TEXT_BANPIX101_03689_UINNEE_000_001: Oh, once it was so fluffy and floofy and poofy, and now it's so...not! Whatever is this world coming to?
TEXT_BANPIX101_03689_UINNEE_000_002: I speak, of course, of the Woolen Way! Wasn't that obvious? Do try to keep up, dear mortal. Anyhow, the Woolen Way lies just north of here. Once upon a time, it was a grand road whereby mortals would transport giant balls of fleecy wool to and fro, fro and to. Doesn't that sound positively lovely?
TEXT_BANPIX101_03689_UINNEE_000_003: Of course it does! That's why I've a mind to spin a dream of a road so soft and fleecy you'd think it was made from the wool of a thousand sheeps! Er, flocks...of sheeps? Anyhow, to do that I'll need a big ball of wool. Actually, three big balls of wool! You'll be a dear and fetch them for me, yes?
TEXT_BANPIX101_03689_UINNEE_000_020: Well? I can't wait forever for my wool, you know. I've dreams to spin and places to be!
TEXT_BANPIX101_03689_UINNEE_000_021: Why, just look at how large and fluffy this one is! And this one even more! You've truly outdone yourself, dear mortal. With this, I can spin the wooliest way my dreamers have ever dreamed!
TEXT_BANPIX101_03689_UINNEE_000_022: Nu Mou legend has it that in the days when mortals lived in these parts, great wagons went up and down the Woolen Way, each packed to the brim with the fluffiest of fleeces to be carried to market.
TEXT_BANPIX101_03689_UINNEE_000_023: These days─alas!─only the name remains. <sniff> Is that not the saddest story you've ever heard? But no matter, for we shall spin a new Woolen Way in the dreams of the children─and one even more glorious than ever before!
TEXT_BANPIX101_03689_UINNEE_000_024: Why, I can just picture them bouncing up and down on a road of fleece and fluff like a giant cloud! Wouldn't you like to join them? But watch out─it will be so dreamy and delightful you just might never want to wake up! Tee hee!
TEXT_BANPIX102_03690_UINNEE_000_001: Oh, aren't they lovely? Vibrant blooms of all colors bursting forth from the intertwining branches─truly bountiful floral bouquets come to life! You've seen them ambling about here in Lydha Lran, haven't you?
TEXT_BANPIX102_03690_UINNEE_000_002: I just know the children would love them as much as I do. Were it not for one oh-so-small rub, that is. You see, they have an awfully nasty tendency to stomp on smaller creatures─not on purpose, I'm sure─and crush them under the mighty trunks that form their feet.
TEXT_BANPIX102_03690_UINNEE_000_003: That's when I got to thinking! I thought, why, all I need to do is weave a spell to bring them down to a smaller size! And so I did precisely that! Sadly, it worked so well that I didn't even notice when one of the tiny little creatures snuck away!
TEXT_BANPIX102_03690_UINNEE_000_004: Why, I simply couldn't bear to keep the children waiting any longer! You'll track my little creation down and bring it back to me, yes? Yes? And if it puts up a fight, don't hesitate to bash it on the head once or twice to remind it to behave!
TEXT_BANPIX102_03690_UINNEE_000_030: Well, if it isn't my favorite mortal! Did you manage to capture my darling little basket? Because I might have to find a new favorite mortal if you didn't.
TEXT_BANPIX102_03690_UINNEE_000_031: Oh dear...look at all those battered branches. It looks like it put up quite a fight. But not to worry! Oh, no, not at all! My magic will have it patched up good as new in the flutter of a wing!
TEXT_BANPIX102_03690_UINNEE_000_032: To think the teensy-weensy version would be so lively when its bigger brethren are so restful and relaxed. Is it possible that smaller creatures are more wont to dash and dart about with little aim or reason?
TEXT_BANPIX102_03690_UINNEE_000_033: Why, just the other day, I saw it trying to plant a new flower on itself. When the aroma attracted a curious little creepy-crawly, it completely forgot about the flower and chased the insect across the fields, where it saw another flower, and...why, it's as if it cannot keep its mind on a single thing for more than mere moments at a time!
TEXT_BANPIX102_03690_UINNEE_000_034: But what was I talking about again? Anyhow, no matter. I really should be getting along spinning dreams of my flowering little friend. You'll help me if it gets away again, won't you?
TEXT_BANPIX103_03691_UINNEE_000_001: Oh, how I tire of these same old toys of mine! If only I had something new and exciting to play with, oh, the wondrous dreams I could spin!
TEXT_BANPIX103_03691_UINNEE_000_002: How about those precious little treasures that those most vexing pixies over by the Bookman's Shelves have found? The ones they had the nerve to hoard all for themselves! Hmph!
TEXT_BANPIX103_03691_UINNEE_000_003: What sort of trinkets are they, you ask? How am I supposed to know? They won't so much as let me see them! But hmm...yes. Yes, indeed... Maybe if you, my favorite mortal, were to ask nicely─with a pretty, pretty please─they just might oblige! Yes, I do believe they might!
TEXT_BANPIX103_03691_UINNEE_000_004: You speak our tongue quite well, yes? All you need to do is tell them how [jumpingly cute] they are, and I'm sure they'll be singing a different tune in no time at all. Then once you have their treasures, you just trot them back here to me. Then everyone's happy, yes?
TEXT_BANPIX103_03691_COLLECTORPIXIE_000_: Well, well! If it isn't Uin Nee's favorite mortal! , was it? Whatever brings you to... Wait, I know what this is!
If Uin Nee has sent you to get your hands on our treasures, well, then they can just flutter off whence they came! We found these, and that means we'll be keeping them, thank you very much!
TEXT_BANPIX103_03691_SYSTEM_100_011: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase that contains the words “snae ling” to earn the favor of the covetous pixie.
TEXT_BANPIX103_03691_COLLECTORPIXIE_000_: Why, of all the─! , you're making me blush!

Still, if you think that just because you're the hero who brought back the night, that you can just saunter in and charm us into sharing our treasures with you, then...come to think of it, you're right!

After all, why keep our precious possessions all for ourselves when they could be spun into dreams and bring joy to all the children in the realm. Oh, what a lovely thought that is! Just promise me you'll take care of it, yes?
TEXT_BANPIX103_03691_UINNEE_000_020: Oh! My favorite mortal is back! And what's that in your hands? Could it be!? Yes, yes, you must show me at once!
TEXT_BANPIX103_03691_UINNEE_000_021: What a lovely collection of insect wings! A brilliant wing that shines with all the colors of the rainbow, a fluffy wing covered with flaxen hair! Why, these would make beautiful hair ornaments for me and my friends!
TEXT_BANPIX103_03691_UINNEE_000_022: Why, what a lovely bouquet! I don't believe I've ever seen blooms quite like these before. I would make a crown of flowers to adorn the heads of the dear children in dreams of pure blossoming bliss!
TEXT_BANPIX103_03691_UINNEE_000_023: A collection of stones...and just look at how round they are! Come to think of it, they resemble the eyes of those pesky, nasty Fuath. Perhaps I will simply throw them as far as─oh, but I mustn't waste them so. I will polish them into a charming set of marbles for the children!
TEXT_BANPIX103_03691_UINNEE_000_024: Those greedy little pixies were most smitten when you told them how [jumpingly cute] they were, were they not? I thought they might be! You know, you could tell me the same from time to time if you'd like. Tee hee!
TEXT_BANPIX103_03691_UINNEE_000_025: But where was I? Oh, yes. I'm sure that they'll be all too quick to hoard and hide away the next shiny little thing they get their hands on, so I do hope you're ready to charm them again for me. Farewell for now, my favorite mortal!
