TEXT_BANPIX104_03692_UINNEE_000_001: Oh, but which of them was my favorite? Is it the one who once tried to sneak up on me and pluck my wings? Or the one who was just so cute when he confessed his love to me that I simply had to keep him by my side forever and a day!
TEXT_BANPIX104_03692_UINNEE_000_002: You've seen my collection of delightful little leafmen, have you not? Always basking blithely in the light of the sun, sprouting new fronds here, there, and everywhere!
TEXT_BANPIX104_03692_UINNEE_000_003: I had a mind to give them a little trim from time to time, but pointy objects are too prickly and perilous for my liking, don't you know. But you, my favorite mortal─you don't seem the type to be bothered by blades and shears, now do you?
TEXT_BANPIX104_03692_UINNEE_000_004: So why don't you run along and give my foliating friends a little trim? And don't forget to bring back some of their pretty little leaves! The children in the Garden of Dreams do so much love to pile them up and jump inside!
TEXT_BANPIX104_03692_SYSTEM_000_010: Abundant green foliage sprouts from every nook and cranny of the leafman's body, such that many of the leaves and branches have become matted and tangled together.
TEXT_BANPIX104_03692_SYSTEM_000_011: With a few snips, you remove the overgrowth from the leafman's body, leaving it looking as prim and trim as the day it was born!
TEXT_BANPIX104_03692_UINNEE_000_020: Was there something you needed? Oh, but of course! You were going to prune my precious little leafmen for me. Well, did you?
TEXT_BANPIX104_03692_UINNEE_000_021: Thank you ever so much! I knew there was a reason why you were my favorite mortal. Oooh, and look at these lovely fronds you've brought back for me! Why, perhaps I'll spin them into a little leafman for the children!
TEXT_BANPIX104_03692_UINNEE_000_022: Some of them don't have so many friends, you know? It truly breaks my heart to see. And so I'll fashion them a whole horde of leafmen to play with! They should get along swimmingly─after all, the leafmen used to be mortals, too!
TEXT_BANPIX104_03692_UINNEE_000_023: Sometimes I wonder what it's like to be a leafman. Have you ever wondered, too? If you have, why, that could certainly be arranged! You need only say the─wait, why are you backing away from me like that?
TEXT_BANPIX105_03693_UINNEE_000_000: Well, if it isn't my favorite mortal! And do you know why you're my favorite? Why, it's because you have a knack for showing up precisely when I need something done. Like now, for example!
TEXT_BANPIX105_03693_UINNEE_000_001: You see, I've asked a Nu Mou crafter to craft me a delightful new toy to bring to the children in their dreams, and I promised I'd repay them with something very, very special─an echevore tail, to be precise!
TEXT_BANPIX105_03693_UINNEE_000_002: Have you ever seen an echevore tail? You can smell them or sip from them, and they have the taste and aroma of sweet, sweet honey! A bit too sweet for my liking, to tell the truth, but the Nu Mou just can't seem to get enough of them.
TEXT_BANPIX105_03693_UINNEE_000_003: But there's a bit of a rub. The sweetest of the sweet echevores can only be found distressingly close to the stamping grounds of those oh-so-nasty Fuath. Just imagining being gripped in those slimy, slippery, slobbery hands makes me─ick! Why did you make me think such unpleasant thoughts!?
TEXT_BANPIX105_03693_UINNEE_000_004: Hmph! As penance, I demand that you go forth and fetch the echevore tail that I seek! And if you see any Fuath along the way, feel free to smack them in their smarmy faces with those stupid little hats of theirs!
TEXT_BANPIX105_03693_UINNEE_000_010: <sniff> Is that sweet, sweet honey I smell? I knew you wouldn't come back empty-handed! Well, hand it over then, already!
TEXT_BANPIX105_03693_UINNEE_000_011: Why, I say, this is the sweetest aroma I've ever had the pleasure of smelling! Perhaps those Nu Mou do know what they're talking about. Perhaps they won't mind if I take just a teeny-tiny smidgen...
TEXT_BANPIX105_03693_UINNEE_000_012: Ahem! Which is to say, of course I'm not thinking of taking a sip! We pixies have far more refined palates than those silly Nu Mou. We're not ones to sit around all day sucking on these icky tails!
TEXT_BANPIX105_03693_UINNEE_000_013: At any rate, thank you as always for being so subser─er, helpful! So helpful! Please come back again soon! Now, just a tiny little... Hmm? You're still here?
TEXT_BANPIX106_03694_UINNEE_000_000: Answer me this, : when you were a child, what was your favorite dream you ever dreamed? Wait, you were a dreaming child once, yes? That's how it works, is it not?
TEXT_BANPIX106_03694_UINNEE_000_001: Anyhow, let me guess: you loved to dream of going on grand adventures. Journeying to the bottom of the deepest waters! Braving perilous ruins in search of ancient treasures! Why, that's what I'd like to dream of if I were a mortal child!
TEXT_BANPIX106_03694_UINNEE_000_002: Yes, I do believe that settles it: something precious from the ruins of the House of the First Light should be just what I need to spin the most stirring and dramatic dream ever! And you're going to bring it to me─for the children, of course!
TEXT_BANPIX106_03694_UINNEE_000_003: What sort of relic will make the children happy? Well, how should I know? Only one of us has been a mortal child once, and it certainly isn't me! Anyhow, I'll leave it up to you. If I don't like what you bring me, I'll just send you back for more! Tee hee!
TEXT_BANPIX106_03694_UINNEE_000_010: Ooh! You're back! Wait...back from where, again? Oh, that's right! Tell me: what wondrous relic did you find for me under the waters?
TEXT_BANPIX106_03694_UINNEE_000_011: Why, it's a teensy-weensy figure of a knight. How very interesting!
TEXT_BANPIX106_03694_UINNEE_000_012: They say that in the old days of Voeburt, people used to play a game where they moved these bitsy people around a board. It doesn't sound nearly as fun as spinning dreams, but to each their own, I suppose.
TEXT_BANPIX106_03694_UINNEE_000_013: A silver ring...? It's so strangely cold to the touch. And these engravings...
TEXT_BANPIX106_03694_UINNEE_000_014: Ack! These runes are to ward away pixies! Whatever is the meaning of this, !? Could it be that─gasp!─you don't like me as much as I like you?
TEXT_BANPIX106_03694_UINNEE_000_015: Why, it's an old Voeburtite coin! They say that back in the days of the Kingdom, you could buy all sorts of things with these. I haven't seen one of these in years...
TEXT_BANPIX106_03694_UINNEE_000_016: Anyhow, I simply must polish it up to the finest sheen! Only the very best for my dreamers!
TEXT_BANPIX106_03694_UINNEE_000_017: In any event, I do believe this will make for a most rousing treasure hunt for the children. If only you could be a child again, yes? I'd like nothing more than to spin you a dream as a token of my thanks!
TEXT_BANPIX107_03695_UINNEE_000_000: Oh, no! I've gone and done it again─forgotten something deathly important! Forgotten what, you say? Silly mortal─that's what I'm trying to remember!
TEXT_BANPIX107_03695_UINNEE_000_001: Oh, but of course─witchweed petals! Somehow I've managed to completely exhaust my supply! This simply won't do. No, not at all!
TEXT_BANPIX107_03695_UINNEE_000_002: Fortunately, you've turned up just at the right time to help me set things right! It's really most impressive how you always seem to know when I need you. Now, off with you to Good Jenanna's Grace, where the most frilly and flowery of witchweeds roam! Don't worry, I'll look after things here.
TEXT_BANPIX107_03695_UINNEE_000_010: Oh, look who's back! Did you bring the─wait, what was it that I asked you for again?
TEXT_BANPIX107_03695_UINNEE_000_011: But of course! Witchweed petals! How could I forget? Speaking of forgetting, I completely forgot to tell you why I needed them in the first place didn't I?
TEXT_BANPIX107_03695_UINNEE_000_012: If you were paying attention─and you always pay attention, don't you─I'm sure you noticed how witchweeds change their petals to resemble the shape of their prey. The poor little creatures approach, thinking they've found a friend, and─GULP! GNASH! No more little creature.
TEXT_BANPIX107_03695_UINNEE_000_013: <sniff> Poor little things... Anyhow, where was I? Oh yes! If I have witchweed petals, all I need to do is weave a simple spell and I can spin all sorts of cute animals for my little dreamers!
TEXT_BANPIX107_03695_UINNEE_000_014: But whatever sort of creature shall I conjure up first? Perhaps a little ladybug? A wriggly worm? Perhaps an army of itsy-bitsy spiders! Wait─how about all of them! Yes, I'll simply bury them in bugs! Don't you wish you were a child still so you could dream such lovely dreams?
TEXT_BANPIX108_03696_UINNEE_000_000: Oh, hello there, ! Apropos of absolutely nothing, have you ever been to Lyhe Ghiah? It's a most wonderful place, home to a magnificent castle and lovely balls of fluffy mallow that float up and down, to and fro in the gently rustling winds.
TEXT_BANPIX108_03696_UINNEE_000_001: Well, I was thinking about what I could do to make the children's dreams that much sweeter, and that's when it hit me with all the force of a giant fluffball! I could fill them with poofy, puffy mallow! Wouldn't that just be the most delightful dream ever? Of course it would!
TEXT_BANPIX108_03696_UINNEE_000_002: But to do that I'll need tufts of mallow, and I simply couldn't bear to take time out of my dreamspinning duties to flutter all the way over to Lyhe Ghiah! After all, what would the children do without me? It's a good thing you came here to offer your aid! That is why you came here, isn't it?
TEXT_BANPIX108_03696_UINNEE_000_010: Welcome back! Are those tufts of mallow bursting from your pocket, or are you just happy to see me? Or is it both? It's definitely both, isn't it?
TEXT_BANPIX108_03696_UINNEE_000_011: I knew I could count on you. And just look at these fluffy little tufts! They might not strike you as much now, but once I've worked my magic, they'll sprout into airy balls of fantastic fluff fleecier than the thickest sheep's wool!
TEXT_BANPIX108_03696_UINNEE_000_012: Yes, my dreamers will just love floating through the sky on massive clouds of mallow! Why, I'd even like to try it myself! Not that there's anything wrong about flying with good old-fashioned wings, of course. All the flitting and fluttering just gets a bit tiring from time to time, that's all. <yawn> I think I've earned myself a rest!
TEXT_BANPIX109_03697_UINNEE_000_000: You know, sometimes I feel guilty about always asking you to run to and fro performing errands for me. But don't worry─I'm not going to do anything like that today! Today, I'm going to tell you a story. A story of moss fungus, and of children.
TEXT_BANPIX109_03697_UINNEE_000_001: Moss fungus often grows on graves, and because of this, Kholusians believe it to be a most baleful thing, and a harbinger of death, disease, and all sort of other nasty things. Because of this, many children have nightmares of being chased after by giant moss funguses! Is it moss funguses?
TEXT_BANPIX109_03697_UINNEE_000_002: Anyhow, this got me thinking. Wouldn't it be so sweet if someone put these poor dreamers' hearts at ease by bringing me the cap of a slain moss fungus, that I could spin it into a dream to show the children that there's nothing to fear about these funny-looking creatures?
TEXT_BANPIX109_03697_UINNEE_000_003: I'm not asking you to do this. Heavens no! I'm merely saying that if someone were inclined to perform this kind gesture, all they would need to do is take an oh-so-short trip to Sextuplet Shallow and rip the cap off one of the unsuspecting moss funguseses that live there. Don't worry, though─I'm sure my dreamers won't mind living in abject fear for another day or two.
TEXT_BANPIX109_03697_UINNEE_000_010: Hm? You have something for me? But I didn't even ask you for anything!
TEXT_BANPIX109_03697_UINNEE_000_011: The cap of a moss fungus! However did you know that I was looking for one of these? It's almost as if you had the power to enter my mind! But whatever can I do to reward your selfless and entirely self-motivated gesture?
TEXT_BANPIX109_03697_UINNEE_000_012: I know, I'll tell you another story about moss fungus! Once upon a time in a mortal kingdom that is no more, people would sometimes play little tricks on those they didn't like by sneaking a teensy-weensy bit of moss fungus poison into their drinks every day.
TEXT_BANPIX109_03697_UINNEE_000_013: Guess what would happen then? The poor person would gradually grow sick and eventually die, and nobody would be the wiser! That's quite the trick, don't you think? Why, I wish I'd thought of it myself! By the way, can I interest you in a sip of water before you go? Tee hee!
TEXT_BANPIX110_03698_UINNEE_000_000: Shall we play a guessing game, ? Guess what I love more than anything in the world! No, it's not you, silly. It's nectar! Sweet, luscious, lovely nectar!
TEXT_BANPIX110_03698_UINNEE_000_001: And guess what I love almost as much as nectar? Why, the simply perfect porxies the Nu Mou made for us to gather all the nectar we can drink!
TEXT_BANPIX110_03698_UINNEE_000_002: Now let me guess: you've always wanted to ride a porxie, too? Well, then today's your lucky day! Simply speak to my friend Lugg Aenc, and they'll have you on the back of one of our fetching little familiars in no time! Doesn't that sound like fun?
TEXT_BANPIX110_03698_LUGGAENC_000_010: Greetings, friend! Do not worry─Uin Nee has already explained everything to me. You'll be taking one of our porxies out to harvest a healthy supply of nectar, correct? It really is too kind of you to volunteer for such a tedious task. In any event, I'm happy to afford you with one of my personal favorites.
TEXT_BANPIX110_03698_LUGGAENC_000_011: Are you quite all right? When the porxie returned alone, I'd worried that you'd taken a nasty fall. Good to see that you're still up and about─Uin Nee's getting terribly impatient about that nectar you promised them.
TEXT_BANPIX110_03698_SYSTEM_000_012: The porxie inhales deeply, filling its nose─and one can only assume other parts of its inner anatomy─with sweet, sweet nectar. You try not to think about how Uin Nee intends to extract said nectar from the innards of the little beast.
TEXT_BANPIX110_03698_SYSTEM_000_013: The aroma of sweet nectar wafts toward your nose. Unfortunately, you have no way of harvesting it on your own. Speak to Lugg Aenc in Lydha Lran so that you might procure a porxie and remedy the situation.
TEXT_BANPIX110_03698_UINNEE_000_020: Oh, hello there. A porxie just came back with a belly full of the sweetest, most succulent nectar. I don't suppose you had anything to do with that, did you? In any event, I do hope you enjoyed your little flight!
TEXT_BANPIX110_03698_UINNEE_000_021: Yes, I simply can't wait to drink deep of that sweet, sweet nectar! Oh, perhaps you were wondering how we get the nectar out of the porxie?
TEXT_BANPIX110_03698_UINNEE_000_022: Well, if you must know...I try not to think about that part. It gets a bit icky from time to time, you see. Why, there was one time when a porxie sneezed just as I was about to─yuck! On second thought, I don't think I'm thirsty anymore. Oh, why did you have to remind me about that!?
TEXT_BANPIX111_03699_UINNEE_000_001: Oh dear, dear, dear! At this rate, the children will wake up before we get there!
TEXT_BANPIX111_03699_UINNEE_000_002: It's my friend, you see. We made a promise to go frolicking in Lyhe Mheg, but they're nowhere to be seen! They must've fallen asleep! Can you believe it!?
TEXT_BANPIX111_03699_UINNEE_000_003: Hmph! I'd better stay here on the off chance they come looking for me. What I need is someone to go and find them in my stead... And who else would show up just in time but my favorite mortal! Well then, off you go!
TEXT_BANPIX111_03699_SLEEPINGPIXIE03699_: Not the beavers! Not the beavers! <snore>
TEXT_BANPIX111_03699_SYSTEM_000_010: Although you have found the sleeping pixie, they show no signs of waking up any time soon.
TEXT_BANPIX111_03699_UINNEE_000_020: You found them! That's terrific! So...where are they?
TEXT_BANPIX111_03699_UINNEE_000_021: Hmm... Such a deep sleep can only mean one thing. They'll probably be returning to Glorianda any day now.
TEXT_BANPIX111_03699_UINNEE_000_022: What are you looking at me like that for? Must I explain everything? <sigh> Very well.
TEXT_BANPIX111_03699_UINNEE_000_023: You see, even we pixies don't know where we come from. One day we simply awaken─with a poof, or so I like to think! We're alive! And then eventually we lie down to go to sleep and simply fade away...
TEXT_BANPIX111_03699_UINNEE_000_024: Some say we pass into a never-ending dream, where we return to Glorianda, the legendary Forebear of Pixies.
TEXT_BANPIX111_03699_UINNEE_000_025: Or maybe that sleepyhead is just being lazy! Anyway, I've got plenty to keep me busy while I wait for them to wake up, like sending silly mortals running here, there, and everywhere to carry out my bidding! Muahahaha!
TEXT_BANPIX111_03699_UINNEE_000_026: Pixies who sleep for too long sometimes fade away into their dreams, where they return to Glorianda. That silly so-and-so has been going to Mithai Glorianda rather frequently, so maybe their time has come?
TEXT_BANPIX111_03699_UINNEE_000_027: Not that it's any of my concern. I just don't like to be kept waiting! But you'll keep me amused in the meantime, won't you?
TEXT_BANPIX112_03700_UINNEE_000_001: Tyr Beq was telling me all about your trip to Kholusia. Is it true that the ocean is even bigger than Longmirror Lake? I hear the mortals there love to go boating, where they can forget their troubles and maybe catch a fish or two.
TEXT_BANPIX112_03700_UINNEE_000_002:
I'd love to try it here, but those horrid Fuath are bound to show up and spoil our fun! 
...Oh, of course! We can do it in Lyhe Mheg instead, and have the children join us too!
TEXT_BANPIX112_03700_UINNEE_000_003: There's just one problem: I haven't the faintest idea what a boat looks like. Perhaps we can try making one from the wing of a deepglider...which I'm sure you'll be more than willing to collect for me!
TEXT_BANPIX112_03700_UINNEE_000_020: I have a vague recollection of asking you to bring me something... What was it?
TEXT_BANPIX112_03700_UINNEE_000_021: Ah, yes! I remember now! This should work nicely. Not that I have a clue what to do with it...
TEXT_BANPIX112_03700_UINNEE_000_022: So it needs to float on the water and support the weight of several small children. It can't be that difficult to make a thing like that from a bit of lizard skin, can it?
TEXT_BANPIX112_03700_UINNEE_000_023: And since we won't be boating on real water, as long as we can conjure up something that at least looks like a boat, it should be fine. Oh yes, we'll have the finest adventures with the children on the ocean blue! ...It is blue, isn't it?
TEXT_BANPIX113_03701_UINNEE_000_001: Il Mheg is full of all sorts of creatures, some nicer than others. We pixies are particularly fond of sheep, with their fluffy, fluffy wool and tasty milk. And the children love them for the same reason!
TEXT_BANPIX113_03701_UINNEE_000_002: Now, a shepherd friend of mine says they need a hand with their flock. Obviously, I'm far too busy to go flitting about picking up droppings, combing out lice, or whatever it is, so perhaps you could go in my place?
TEXT_BANPIX113_03701_SHEEPPIXIE_000_010: Here to help me tend to my precious fluffies, are you? I hope you're ready to work, because this won't be easy!
TEXT_BANPIX113_03701_SHEEPPIXIE_000_011: The food that sheep eat affects the fluffiness of their wool. I've tried feeding them every type of plant you can imagine, and nothing works better than grass that grows on high plateaus.
TEXT_BANPIX113_03701_SHEEPPIXIE_000_012: The problem is, it takes us so long to fly to any of these places, and even when we get there, we can only carry a small amount back. It's hardly enough for even one mouthful!
TEXT_BANPIX113_03701_SHEEPPIXIE_000_013: We need someone who not only has the means to fly, but big hands to pick up big clumps of grass. Oh, and a near-bottomless bag to store it all. And I daresay you'll do nicely. Off you go, now! Start up at Anden's Airs, and don't take all day about it!
TEXT_BANPIX113_03701_SHEEPPIXIE_000_015: If you've got time to stand here with your mouth hanging open like a hungry chick, you've got time to pick that grass for me! Off you go!
TEXT_BANPIX113_03701_SHEEPPIXIE_000_030: It looks like my sheep have caught a whiff of that grass you're carrying. Come on, let's be having it!
TEXT_BANPIX113_03701_SHEEPPIXIE_000_031: Ooh, it smells so good that I might have to sample some myself! Did you know, these little darlings are descended from sheep who once lived high in the mountains? That would explain why they love this grass more than any other.
TEXT_BANPIX113_03701_SHEEPPIXIE_000_032: So, Anden, what do you think of your flock now?
TEXT_BANPIX113_03701_SHEEPPIXIE_000_033: Oh, you're not familiar? Anden was a shepherd who used to live on a cliff overlooking Longmirror Lake. He really loved his sheep, and stayed to care for them in Il Mheg to the very end.
TEXT_BANPIX113_03701_SHEEPPIXIE_000_034: Kind-hearted as we pixies are, we decided to turn him into a lovely leafman! This way, he can watch over his flock forever and ever...
TEXT_BANPIX113_03701_SHEEPPIXIE_000_035: Anden loved his sheep, and they love him back. Oh yes, they love to nibble away at his leaves, but I try not to let them eat too much or there'll be nothing left of him!
TEXT_BANPIX113_03701_SHEEPPIXIE_100_035: Oh, Anden may be outside as well, but this Anden is just as much an Anden as ever there was one! Isn't that right, Anden?
TEXT_BANPIX113_03701_SHEEPPIXIE_000_036: Anyway, that's enough stories for one day. You'd better get to Uin Nee to tell them I won't be requiring any more assistance for the time being. Oh, and by the way, thank you. I almost forgot to say that.
TEXT_BANPIX113_03701_UINNEE_000_040: So, what did you end up doing? Picking grass? That sounds easy, even for a silly mortal like you! At least it didn't tax that head of yours too much.
TEXT_BANPIX113_03701_UINNEE_100_040: So, what did you end up doing? Picking grass? That sounds easy, even for a silly mortal like you! At least it didn't tax that head of yours too much.
TEXT_BANPIX113_03701_UINNEE_000_041: Most importantly, the sheep seemed pleased with the food you brought them. If we ever need any more, we'll know who to ask!
TEXT_BANPIX114_03702_UINNEE_000_000: I've been trying to come up with new ways to help the children have fun and memorable dreams, but I'm struggling to come up with any ideas.
TEXT_BANPIX114_03702_UINNEE_000_001: Ah! That's it! I'm thinking about this too much. I need something unexpected, something spontaneous. After all, dreams are by their very nature unpredictable! And I think I know the perfect place to search for inspiration.
TEXT_BANPIX114_03702_UINNEE_000_002: The rivers that flow from the east carry a whole hodgepodge of things from other lands, which collects in the waterfalls. Why not go and see what you can find?
TEXT_BANPIX114_03702_UINNEE_000_003: I could go myself, but I wouldn't want to deprive you of the chance to prove your usefulness. There's junk to be collected, so you'd best get to it!
TEXT_BANPIX114_03702_UINNEE_000_004: I'm not looking for anything in particular, I just need ideas!
TEXT_BANPIX114_03702_SYSTEM_110_010: You find an oddly smooth branch!
TEXT_BANPIX114_03702_SYSTEM_120_010: You find a fruit of the forest!
TEXT_BANPIX114_03702_SYSTEM_000_010: A phooka comes tumbling out of nowhere!
TEXT_BANPIX114_03702_UINNEE_000_020: So, did you come across anything surprising?
TEXT_BANPIX114_03702_UINNEE_000_021: Hmm... That's a fine piece of...whatever it is. Porcelain, I think. Yes! I can transform it into a cup and host a tea party! We might need more than one cup, though.
TEXT_BANPIX114_03702_UINNEE_000_022: A branch? Not quite as unusual as I was hoping for, I must say. Bits of wood like this are rather commonplace in Il Mheg, you know. Still, it's about the right size for a magic wand. Perhaps the children can pretend to be wizards!
TEXT_BANPIX114_03702_UINNEE_000_023: What's this? Fruit of some description? I can't tell a pixieberry from my elbow, I have to say. Ah! If we plant this, it can grow into a great big tree, and we can make a treehouse!
TEXT_BANPIX114_03702_UINNEE_000_024: Eh? A phooka nearly fell on you!? Rather you than me!
TEXT_BANPIX114_03702_UINNEE_000_025: Still, it was worth all the trouble! It's strange to think something so mundane could lead to such a fantastic idea! Of course, we have my imagination to thank for that. Honestly, where would you be without me?
TEXT_BANPIX115_03703_UINNEE_000_001: , help! Il Mheg is being invaded!
TEXT_BANPIX115_03703_UINNEE_000_002: Sort of. By “invaded,” I mean, a stranger has shown up and started chasing our porxies!
TEXT_BANPIX115_03703_UINNEE_000_003: I wouldn't mind so much if it weren't for the fact our pets are supposed to be gathering flower seeds for use in dreams. Go and put a stop to this silliness, would you?
TEXT_BANPIX115_03703_TALLFUATH_000_010: One, two! One, two, three, four!
TEXT_BANPIX115_03703_TALLFUATH_100_010:
On an epic adventure, the intrepid hero is here!♪
A Fuath to be reckoned with, evildoers frozen in fear!♪
In the name of joy, he dances his merry jig!♪
Let none keep him from the enchanted flying pig!♪
TEXT_BANPIX115_03703_TALLFUATH_000_011: Oh, porxie, how do I love thee? Let me count the ways! But why must you always flee when I draw near? Why, I ask youuu!
TEXT_BANPIX115_03703_TALLFUATH_000_013: The mere thought I could be causing them distress has left me quite flabbergasted! And to think they would spurn my affections...it is preposterous, I tell you!
TEXT_BANPIX115_03703_TALLFUATH_000_014: I was merely passing through to trade with the Nu Mou when I saw their precious pink companions. That adorable snout, that curly tail... It was love at first sight! Wait for me, porxies!
TEXT_BANPIX115_03703_SCAVENGER_000_015: No more, please! I'll leave Il Mheg and never come back, I swear!
TEXT_BANPIX115_03703_SCAVENGER_000_016: Oh, you're not a faerie? Thank goodness.
TEXT_BANPIX115_03703_SCAVENGER_000_017: I was trying to catch one of those little flying pigs, for research purposes. But then I discovered that they're the faeries' creations. Even if I managed to get my hands on them, I'd never be able to take something so dangerous back to civilization!
TEXT_BANPIX115_03703_SCAVENGER_000_018: And if the pixies find me, they'll turn me into one of those leafmen! It's high time I quit this godsforsaken place!
TEXT_BANPIX115_03703_FAKEMYSTEL_000_019: Hello! I am a very rich lady from Eulmore! I expect you to  when greeting one of my standing!
TEXT_BANPIX115_03703_FAKEMYSTEL_000_020: Ha ha! Just joking! I'm actually a pixie in disguise. Walking around like a mortal certainly makes a change from all that flitting about!
TEXT_BANPIX115_03703_FAKEMYSTEL_000_021: Chasing porxies? Why, yes, as a matter of fact, I was. It's a bit hard to keep up with them, though. Perhaps I need some more practice with this “one foot in front of the other” business!
TEXT_BANPIX115_03703_FAKEMYSTEL_000_022: And if the other pixies have a problem with me chasing those flappy-eared porkers, I could leave them alone, I suppose. After all, 'tis hardly fitting for a “lady” to engage in such unseemly behavior!
TEXT_BANPIX115_03703_UINNEE_000_030: So I take it the porxies will be resuming their duties? Good. I won't let them shirk their responsibilities! Not even if they're cute and adorable and I want to squeeze them and squeeze them until... Gah!
TEXT_BANPIX115_03703_UINNEE_000_031: No! I mustn't allow them to beguile me! I have a job to do! And for your part in...whatever this was, I'm making you an honorary “Protector of Porxies”!
TEXT_BANPIX116_03704_UINNEE_000_000: Rubies! Emeralds! Sapphires! Oh, how they sparkle! Not that we have many chances to see them here in Il Mheg. From what I hear, they're very valuable, which must be why the scavengers work so hard to dig them up.
TEXT_BANPIX116_03704_UINNEE_000_001: That's given me another brilliant idea! We should decorate Lyhe Mheg with jewels of our own!
TEXT_BANPIX116_03704_UINNEE_000_002: Of course, we don't need to go through all the trouble of finding real gemstones, just something with a vague resemblance. Our magic will do the rest!
TEXT_BANPIX116_03704_UINNEE_000_003: You look like you've got time to spare. Why don't you make yourself useful and collect some nice, shiny pebbles for me?
TEXT_BANPIX116_03704_UINNEE_000_004: There should be some down by the lake. And if you see any Fuath, give them a whack from me!
TEXT_BANPIX116_03704_UINNEE_000_020: Come on then, hand it over!
TEXT_BANPIX116_03704_UINNEE_000_021: Well, it's a bit plain, but I suppose it'll do. I might even be able to turn pebbles like these into gold coins, so the children can see how it feels to be rich!
TEXT_BANPIX116_03704_UINNEE_000_022: Of course, it will all disappear when they wake up, but they can enjoy it while the dream lasts. Even if they're penniless in real life, they'll live like royalty in Lyhe Mheg!
TEXT_BANPIX117_03705_UINNEE_000_001: Tyr Beq tells me that the land called “Amh Araeng” is nothing like Il Mheg. It's a dry, hot place where hardly anything grows. No flowers, no rivers, no lakes!
TEXT_BANPIX117_03705_UINNEE_000_002: Some of the children there have never even seen a fish before! Imagine that! And yes, I think we both know where this is going...
TEXT_BANPIX117_03705_UINNEE_000_003: That's right! I want you to bring me a fish to show the children in the Garden of Dreams. A nice, pretty one with shiny scales!
TEXT_BANPIX117_03705_UINNEE_000_004: Now, this level of preparedness may come as a surprise, but I've already had one of my underlings set a trap down in Deepwood Swim. Much easier than messing about with hooks and whatnot. All you have to do is go and see if we've caught anything!
TEXT_BANPIX117_03705_UINNEE_000_020: So? What have you got for me?
TEXT_BANPIX117_03705_UINNEE_000_021: Oh, yes. These are...rainbowy twinkle trout. That's what we'll call them. I have big plans for you, little ones! You won't be swimming in boring old water like all the other fish, you'll be soaring through the skies of Lyhe Mheg!
TEXT_BANPIX117_03705_UINNEE_000_022: And if we catch some more of these, they can all fly together to make a giant fish-rainbow! Ha ha! It's no wonder everyone thinks I'm a genius!
TEXT_BANPIX118_03706_UINNEE_000_000: Do you know who I feel sorry for? The children of Amh Araeng. Why? Because water is so precious there, they can barely have enough for a bath, let alone play games like “Dunk the Witch” or “Bismarck's Bluff”!
TEXT_BANPIX118_03706_UINNEE_000_001: Luckily for them, I've come up with another one of my ingenious plans! We're going to fill Lyhe Mheg with water!
TEXT_BANPIX118_03706_UINNEE_000_002: That way, the children have the time of their lives, and we pixies will be able to splish and splash to our hearts' content without being pestered by those pesky Fuath.
TEXT_BANPIX118_03706_UINNEE_000_003: All we need is an icewater undine heart. Once I've worked my magic on it, we'll have rivers and waterfalls galore! Naturally, you'll be the one collecting the heart, though I doubt its owner will be too happy to part with it. Don't worry, you probably won't be horribly killed!
TEXT_BANPIX118_03706_UINNEE_000_010: Did you manage to steal an icewater undine's heart? Literally, I mean.
TEXT_BANPIX118_03706_UINNEE_000_011: Ooh, a fine specimen! With this, we can create all the water we need!
TEXT_BANPIX118_03706_UINNEE_000_012:
Soon, Lyhe Mheg will be filled with the sounds of children's laughter as they splash and swim and drag each other into the depths, just like the Fuath! It's only a dream, so it's all perfectly safe, unless the rumor about “if you die in your dreams, you die in real life” is true...
I might have to check that at some point, actually.
TEXT_BANPIX119_03707_UINNEE_000_001: , I need your help! My friend went to pick flowers a while ago, but no one has seen hide nor hair of them since!
TEXT_BANPIX119_03707_UINNEE_000_002: I suspect it was the work of─ No, it's too soon to say for certain.
TEXT_BANPIX119_03707_UINNEE_000_003: The best thing to do is send out a search party, consisting of...well, you of course!
TEXT_BANPIX119_03707_UINNEE_000_004: You should probably start looking where all the prettiest flowers grow, which would be east of Phisor Lran. And if it's what I think it is, be prepared for an epic encounter that will shake the heavens! Or at least cause them to wobble a bit...
TEXT_BANPIX119_03707_PICKFLOWERPIXIE_000: Sorry, but as you can see, I'm rather busy. Or perhaps you're here to help?
Uin Nee was worried about me? I'm quite safe, I assure you! And if anything were to disturb me, these porxies will send them on their merry way!
But since you've come all the way here, perhaps you could watch my back while I carry on picking flowers? On the off chance that any beasties show, throw one of my adorable companions at them!
TEXT_BANPIX119_03707_SYSTEM_000_013: If any enemies appear, throw a porxie at them. You may move the camera, as well as zoom in and out. Target the enemy and throw a porxie with .
TEXT_BANPIX119_03707_PICKFLOWERPIXIE_000: (-Another Flower-picking Pixie-)That's odd... Did you see another pixie picking flowers here? No? Oh, well. I'll just have to finish the job by myself! Tra-la-la!♪
TEXT_BANPIX119_03707_PICKFLOWERPIXIE_100: Phew! That should be enough for the time being. So, was there any trouble? No? Jolly good. Thanks for keeping an eye out for me. Ta-ta for now!
TEXT_BANPIX119_03707_UINNEE_000_020: So, you made it back, at least.
TEXT_BANPIX119_03707_UINNEE_000_021: Though to be honest, I don't have much hope of ever seeing my friend again. Do you know what happened to them?
TEXT_BANPIX119_03707_A1_000_002: Some things are best left a mystery.
TEXT_BANPIX119_03707_A1_000_003: Even when I close my eyes, I can still see the...the beavers.
TEXT_BANPIX119_03707_UINNEE_000_023: No, not the beavers! Don't let their appearance fool you; there is no greater evil in all of Il Mheg than those long-toothed horrors.
TEXT_BANPIX119_03707_UINNEE_000_024: That's fine. I'd already jumped to my own conclusions anyway!
TEXT_BANPIX119_03707_UINNEE_000_025: Oooh! It sounds like you'll be having some fantastic nightmares! If you ever manage to sleep again, that is.
TEXT_BANPIX119_03707_UINNEE_000_026: In any case, it sounds like the flower collection is proceeding apace, and we'll soon be able to decorate Lyhe Mheg with beautiful flowers. And if we have to lose a pixie or three in the process, so be it!
TEXT_BANPIX120_03708_UINNEE_000_001: Oh, the marchioness! Hers would be just the thing!
TEXT_BANPIX120_03708_UINNEE_000_002: And why are you looking at me like that? The marchioness, the marchioness! You know─the big, flowery tree that looks like it's probably in charge of all of the other flowers? Her little subjects would be the perfect addition to Lyhe Mheg, and you know it!
TEXT_BANPIX120_03708_UINNEE_000_003: The children of Amh Araeng have so few opportunities to see flowers in bloom, after all. But the Dreamspinners can make anything possible! And I intend to prove it! With flowers! So do try to keep up.
TEXT_BANPIX120_03708_UINNEE_000_004: We'll need at least three blooms from the March if we're to properly decorate Lyhe Mheg. And make sure you get positively lovely ones. I will mock you for having bad taste if you don't!
TEXT_BANPIX120_03708_UINNEE_000_020: You have them? Very well, then, prepare to be judged! They had better be delightful...
TEXT_BANPIX120_03708_UINNEE_000_021: Oh, they're perfect! I knew you'd have impeccable taste, darling mortal.
TEXT_BANPIX120_03708_UINNEE_000_022: The marchioness was once a darling mortal herself, you know. Oh yes. She led her troops to protect the land that she loved so very much. When the eaters came, she fought till the bitter end, though her face was a mask of blood and tears...
TEXT_BANPIX120_03708_UINNEE_000_023: And when she could fight no more, we pixies turned her into a tree! So that she could live on, form as grand and beautiful as her spirit. I'm sure she appreciated it. Otherwise, why would she bloom so brightly?
TEXT_BANPIX120_03708_UINNEE_000_024: Never you mind all of that, though. We have flowers to plant and dreams to spin!
TEXT_BANPIX121_03709_UINNEE_000_000: So, I was playing in a Mordling's dream the other day─yes, yes, hello to you, too─and he starts talking about wanting to eat a “whole bucketful of wrigglers”! And I said I could make that happen, helpful Dreamspinner that I am, though I had absolutely no idea what he was on about...
TEXT_BANPIX121_03709_UINNEE_000_001: Well, as it turns out, wrigglers─an extraordinarily weird sort of worm, apparently─aren't easy to come by in Il Mheg. By which I mean that we don't have any at all, let alone a bucket's worth!
TEXT_BANPIX121_03709_UINNEE_000_002: Not to worry, though! If I just work a little bit of magic on something sufficiently wiggly, it should come to the same thing. Approximately. Probably.
TEXT_BANPIX121_03709_UINNEE_000_003: Either way, we won't know until we try! Which is why I need you to fetch me the wiggly bit of an anemone. The sooner the better, favorite mortal of mine!
TEXT_BANPIX121_03709_UINNEE_000_010: By the undulating of that sack, I take it you've snagged what we need!
TEXT_BANPIX121_03709_UINNEE_000_011: Perfect! Oooh, that is positively disgusting!
TEXT_BANPIX121_03709_UINNEE_000_012: With a few minor adjustments, I should have no trouble making this into a dream-wriggler. None at all! Now, where did I put that phlegm I've been saving...
TEXT_BANPIX122_03710_UINNEE_000_000: Phookai! Everyone loves a good phooka! Those wide, staring eyes, that vaguely menacing hopping... Ah, you never know if they want to hug you or murder you! Adorable! And there are plenty to be found around Lyhe Ghiah.
TEXT_BANPIX122_03710_UINNEE_000_001: A fantastic idea for what to spin next, I'm sure you agree! In fact, I was so sure that I've already set up the traps!
TEXT_BANPIX122_03710_UINNEE_000_002: I went through quite a hunting-and-trapping phase a while back, so I'm something of an expert on the subject. My strategically placed pits are guaranteed to have caught us something, so all you need to do is head over and retrieve our prizes!
TEXT_BANPIX122_03710_UINNEE_000_003: Now, phookai do tend to get a bit bitey when cornered, but worry not─I've prepared these enormous sacks! Just shove them in before they can figure out what's happening to them, and there should be no problem. Brilliant, I know!
TEXT_BANPIX122_03710_UINNEE_000_010: Ah, I see the sacks came in handy! You're welcome!
TEXT_BANPIX122_03710_UINNEE_000_011: Those traps aren't all that hard to get out of, you know. I think even phookai might manage it, if they could focus long enough. But they just don't have the attention span. Poor things...
TEXT_BANPIX122_03710_UINNEE_000_012: One dove in headfirst, you say? Ahahaha! How delightful! I wonder why it did that. I don't suppose you speak phooka, by chance? No?
TEXT_BANPIX122_03710_UINNEE_000_013: Ah, well. Now that we have our phookai, though, the fun can begin! ...Or it could, if I had decided what sort of dream to spin. What do you think?
TEXT_BANPIX122_03710_A1_000_001: Feral phookai make for a weird enough dream on their own.
TEXT_BANPIX122_03710_A1_000_002: You could put them in an arena, maybe.
TEXT_BANPIX122_03710_UINNEE_000_014: True! Just look at their funny little faces! And it is important to appreciate the simple things in life.
TEXT_BANPIX122_03710_UINNEE_000_015: Ah, and that's why you're my favorite mortal! What an amusing suggestion. Do you think they'd actually fight, or just sort of...blink at each other? Either way, it's perfect!
TEXT_BANPIX122_03710_UINNEE_000_016: It's time for me to get to spinning, then! Don't worry─I will absolutely, positively let you know how it goes next time we speak!
TEXT_BANPIX123_03711_UINNEE_000_001: Tell me, my favorite mortal, have you ever had a hideout? Mortal children seem to love them, so I thought─why not try it out? Then I hid in a log for five days and five nights, and no one found me. It was amazing! Then I got bored, so I came back.
TEXT_BANPIX123_03711_UINNEE_000_002: Anyway, while I was there, it occurred to me that the children in the Rak'tika Greatwood aren't usually allowed to leave their villages. And that means that they can't make hideouts! I mean, sure, they could hide in the village, but people would find them.
TEXT_BANPIX123_03711_UINNEE_000_003: And it doesn't count if other people can find it, right? Right!? If any old adult can stumble across it, that's not a hideout, that's just sad.
TEXT_BANPIX123_03711_UINNEE_000_004: I decided right then and there that I would dream up a perfect hiding place for those poor little darlings. And what better to make it from than one of those giant mushrooms the Nu Mou live in? Nothing! There's nothing better. It was a rhetorical question.
TEXT_BANPIX123_03711_UINNEE_000_005: Tragically, Father Collard's Chambers is absolutely swarming with the lawless ones, which makes it impossible to harvest mushroom spawn. If something isn't done, my brilliant plan will never come to fruition, and...I'm sure you can see where this is going. Do it for the children!
TEXT_BANPIX123_03711_BALLOON_000_010: Halt! Who dares lay hands on our fungi?
TEXT_BANPIX123_03711_UINNEE_000_020: Oh, there you are! You know, I realized after you left that I didn't tell you how to tell one mushroom spawn from another. I do hope you figured it out!
TEXT_BANPIX123_03711_UINNEE_000_021: Oh, well done! Such a clever mortal you are. We should be able to grow this one nice and tall, then pop it into a dream, and...voilà! Greatest hideout ever. We don't even need to put it in a dank old cave! Imagine the possibilities...
TEXT_BANPIX123_03711_UINNEE_000_022: Wait─I don't have to imagine them! I can make them. Haha, fantastic!
TEXT_BANPIX124_03712_UINNEE_000_001: You found me! Oh, wait─it wasn't my turn to hide... Or was it?
TEXT_BANPIX124_03712_UINNEE_000_002: Hiding and seeking are both just too much fun! Especially with the little dreamers. Why, it's so much fun that sometimes, I forget that they're meant to wake up!
TEXT_BANPIX124_03712_UINNEE_000_003: Those little ones from the Rak'tika Greatwood, though, are far too good at this! And we can't keep letting them win─we have a reputation to uphold. That's why we've been training day and night! Mostly day, though. Do you want to join us?
TEXT_BANPIX124_03712_UINNEE_000_004: I'll let you have my turn as seeker, then! Do you know what to do when you've found someone? Sneak right up behind them and yell “Beaver”! ...Well, the sneaking and yelling are optional, but it's much more fun if you really scare the wings off of them!
TEXT_BANPIX124_03712_KAKUREINOTIPIXIE_00: Goodness me, Uin Nee is worse at this than I thought! Maybe I'll have a nap...
TEXT_BANPIX124_03712_SYSTEM_000_011: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter “Beaver” to let the concealed pixie know that the game is up.
TEXT_BANPIX124_03712_KAKUREINOTIPIXIE_00: Uin Nee got a mortal to do their dirty work, did they? Hmph, you don't scare me! Not like those Viis children...
TEXT_BANPIX124_03712_UINNEE_000_020: Well? Well!? Did you find them?
TEXT_BANPIX124_03712_UINNEE_000_021: You did! I knew you would─you're such a clever mortal. And now I'm going to show them how it's done! Just as soon as I remember whether I was hiding or seeking.
TEXT_BANPIX124_03712_UINNEE_000_022: Once we've had a bit more practice, those children won't stand a chance! Muahahaha!
TEXT_BANPIX125_03713_UINNEE_000_000: Well, favorite mortal, we could be frolicking with porxies in dreams right now. But nooo! Those awful, nasty lawless ones just had to go and make off with the one I ordered from Pla Enni, so both I and the dreams are...porxieless!
TEXT_BANPIX125_03713_UINNEE_000_001: Ugh! Ugh, I say! Oooh, when I get my hands on those porxienappers...
TEXT_BANPIX125_03713_UINNEE_000_002: Wait! I don't need to get my hands on them! Because we have your much larger hands! Good, good. Go and punch a porxienapper in the face for me, mortal!
TEXT_BANPIX125_03713_SYSTEM_000_005: The porxie is considerably calmed by your ministrations. After sparing you an affectionate snort, it turns toward Lydha Lran.
TEXT_BANPIX125_03713_UINNEE_000_010: Safe and sound! And round! And cute! Exactly what I was hoping for! I can spin the loveliest of dreams with a porxie so charming...
TEXT_BANPIX125_03713_UINNEE_000_011: <sigh> But first I suppose I should inform the Nu Mou in Pla Enni that it arrived safely after all. They were so very anxious about it. Some fae really need to learn to calm down, if you ask me...
TEXT_BANPIX126_03714_UINNEE_000_001: Mortal! Our nectar porxie has a problem! And the porxie's problem is making the porxie itself a problem! For me!
TEXT_BANPIX126_03714_UINNEE_000_002: I think its nose is stuffed. I keep pointing it at the flowers, but it only bumps its face into them. Repeatedly. Without siphoning a single drop of nectar!
TEXT_BANPIX126_03714_UINNEE_000_003: Can you take it out to sniff some Voeburtwort? The Nu Mou are always telling me how it clears the sinuses─and they would know!
TEXT_BANPIX126_03714_UINNEE_000_004: I would go myself, but I'd really rather not. It's rather...snotty. I've given it over to Lugg Aenc to deal with for now.
TEXT_BANPIX126_03714_LUGGAENC_000_010: I am told that you are here to take the porxie out for a good nasal clearing? Wonderful. I'm sure that will come as something of a relief to it─the herbs and the respite from Uin Nee both.
TEXT_BANPIX126_03714_LUGGAENC_000_011: You need only guide it toward the fresh Voeburtwort that grows wild near Pla Enni. The plants shall do the rest.
TEXT_BANPIX126_03714_LUGGAENC_000_015: Yes, the porxie returned safely. It still appears to have something of an issue with discerning scents, however. Tried to eat my satchel. You may need to have another go at the Voeburtwort.
TEXT_BANPIX126_03714_SYSTEM_000_020: The porxie unceremoniously snorts sprigs of Voeburtwort into both nostrils and, after a moment, sneezes out a large quantity of snot. Presumably this is a good sign.
TEXT_BANPIX126_03714_SYSTEM_000_021: The porxie inhales deeply, accidentally sucking a few herbs and grasses into its nose. However, it does seem to be breathing more freely now.
TEXT_BANPIX126_03714_SYSTEM_100_021: The Voeburtwort is indeed quite fragrant, and you feel your sinuses clearing instantaneously. Guide the suffering porxie to experience the same sweet relief.
TEXT_BANPIX126_03714_UINNEE_000_030: Thank you for taking care of that disgusting issue! I'll admit, when we shoved all of that stuff up its nose, I didn't expe─
TEXT_BANPIX126_03714_UINNEE_000_031: Oh, come to think of it, I neglected to explain, didn't I? You see, I took the porxie into the Garden of Dreams so that the children could play with it. But, well, they discovered that it could inhale just about anything, and one thing led to another...
TEXT_BANPIX126_03714_UINNEE_000_032: Ah, it was hilarious! You should join us next time! ...What?
TEXT_BANPIX127_03715_UINNEE_000_000: Nothing makes me pity your kind quite like swings. After all, who needs a silly contraption like that when you can fly?
TEXT_BANPIX127_03715_UINNEE_000_001: Yet you...you have to tie a piece of wood to a tree branch and hope that it doesn't snap, dropping you to the ground and killing you instantly! All for the chance to go higher, and higher, and feel like you're about to take flight. But you won't! It's depressing, is what it is.
TEXT_BANPIX127_03715_UINNEE_000_002: The children do seem to like them, though. And if they want a sad simulacrum of flight, who am I to refuse? In any case, I have a tree and this piece of wood I picked up off of the ground, so I've practically built the entire thing already!
TEXT_BANPIX127_03715_UINNEE_000_003: All that we need is rope! Strong rope, preferably. Falling to your death is no fun at all, even if it is a dream. Maybe you could get me some of that sturdy psammead silk everyone raves about? Pretty please?
TEXT_BANPIX127_03715_UINNEE_000_004: It's the big, nasty mother psammeads that have the strongest silk. They're always a bit reluctant to come out of hiding, but fortunately, they'll come scuttling if you attack the smaller ones!
TEXT_BANPIX127_03715_UINNEE_000_010: How are the psammeads? Still crawly and unsettling?
TEXT_BANPIX127_03715_UINNEE_000_011: Oh, yes! This should be more than strong enough. I'll have to trick some mature mortals into testing it first, of course. Wouldn't want to risk the children! Once it's properly spun into the dream, maybe I'll even give it a try myself!
TEXT_BANPIX127_03715_UINNEE_000_012: I admit, the thought of being gently rocked is somehow soothing. Back and forth, back and forth... If I close my eyes, I can almost remember...
TEXT_BANPIX128_03716_UINNEE_000_001: Dearest mortal, is there anything more tragic than unrequited love? Nay! Nay, says I! Oh, the heartbreak! The pining! The woe! How could anyone with a shred of compassion in their heart ignore a mortal so besieged by melancholy longings!?
TEXT_BANPIX128_03716_UINNEE_000_002: Not me! And that's why I made a love potion! Well, a dream love potion. A real one would be downright creepy! We fae do have some scruples, you know.
TEXT_BANPIX128_03716_UINNEE_000_003: The problem is, I'm new to all of this alchemy nonsense, and I have no idea if my potion will work! I keep trying to sneak up on sleeping Nu Mou to test it, but it's like they can smell me coming!
TEXT_BANPIX128_03716_UINNEE_000_004: I'm sure that you could manage it, though! And I know you wouldn't want to stand in the way of true love! Well, fake true love. Well, dream fake true love. Anyway! Go and test the potion!
TEXT_BANPIX128_03716_NUMOU03716_000_012: Goodness, if it isn't the very hero who restored to us the night!
TEXT_BANPIX128_03716_NUMOU03716_000_013: What brings you here today? And looking so lovely, I might add! Yes... I daresay I've never seen such a divine visage in all my life...
TEXT_BANPIX128_03716_NUMOU03716_000_014: W-Wait! I didn't mean to express my undying affectio─ Oh no! I've done it again!
TEXT_BANPIX128_03716_NUMOU03716_000_015: Please, um... Please read this, when you have a moment. Which will likely be never, as I'm sure you're most busy being clever and courageous and─ Er, forget that I said anything!
TEXT_BANPIX128_03716_NUMOU03716_000_016: Oh, I knew the leafmen would come for me! It was only a matter of time!
TEXT_BANPIX128_03716_UINNEE_000_021: Oooh, a letter written in fae! Let me see!
TEXT_BANPIX128_03716_UINNEE_000_022: Hmm... Oh dear... Well, that's─ Oooh. And... Ahahaha! Haha... Oh, that doesn't even rhyme! HahahaHAHAHA!
TEXT_BANPIX128_03716_UINNEE_000_023: Haha... <wheeze> Ahem! You probably shouldn't look at this. It's painfully embarrassing. For them, and also for you. But don't worry─the potion will wear off after a while, and they won't remember a thing!
TEXT_BANPIX128_03716_UINNEE_000_024: It looks like I might need to water it down a bit for next time, though. There's smitten, and then there's...whatever in the name of Titania that drivel was supposed to be. Back to the cauldron I go!
TEXT_BANPIX128_03716_UINNEE_000_025: Huh. That's interesting. Now, if they had seen an irresistibly attractive leafman, it might still be usable, but that doesn't seem to be the case...
TEXT_BANPIX128_03716_UINNEE_000_026: Maybe it didn't work because Nu Mou are too different from you mortals? Or maybe that specific Nu Mou has a bizarre fixation on leafmen! I could check their dreams to make sure, but I'm a little afraid of what I might find...
TEXT_BANPIX128_03716_UINNEE_000_027: Best to try a different formula, I think! I can count on you to test a new batch when I'm done, right? Of course I can!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_WORRYINGMOTHER_000_: Oh, hello there. You're the sweet  staying with Master Matoya, are you not? I've been meaning to thank you for looking after my boy that one time. His name's Valan. You remember him, don't you?

He's always running around with his friend Quinfort. You know, the one who so much enjoys hearing the sound of his own voice. Why, just moments ago, he rushed in here, then went dashing off, shouting about how he'd made a discovery “of staggering import” over in Fanow.

Valan, bless his heart, went running after him. I know these parts aren't as dangerous as they once were─and Quinfort apparently has made some friends among the Viis─but still...I can't help but worry.
Would you be so kind as to follow after them, and make sure Valan doesn't get into anything over his head? You can tell him his mother sent you.

The sin eaters do not plague the land like they once did. And yet, the Greatwood is vast, and there are any number of nasty critters lurking in the shadows. If anything became of my boy, I don't know what I'd do...
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_000_006: How many times must I tell you, Valan!? When the will of the wood summons me, I must heed its call!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VALAN_000_010: For the last time, Quinfort! Would it kill you to actually explain yourself before you go dashing around the forest like a madman!?
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_000_011: What nonsense do you speak, Valan? The Keeper of Whispers would never be so insolent as to keep the gods waiting when They would share with me Their wisdom! Why, the mere notion is preposterous! Blasphemous, even!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VALAN_000_013: My mother sent you? Dear heavens, I'm sorry for dragging you into this. As you might suspect, Quinfort's ranting and raving about the “will of the wood” again.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VALAN_000_014: When he ran off shouting about prophecies, I simply had to follow along to make sure he didn't get himself into any trouble. The Viis said we were welcome at any time, of course, but would it kill the man to be a bit more circumspect?
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VALAN_000_015: Oh, that reminds me. Whatever happened to that squirmy little fellow that Quinfort─for whatever ungodly reason─believes to be the “Great Serpent of Ronka”? Does it still travel with you, or did it get squished somewhere along the way?
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_000_016: What ignorance is this, Valan!? The divine protector has returned to slumber in its nest deep in the heart of Rak'tika, from which it speaks to me in my dreams even now!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_000_018: O, great one! Is it truly you, returned to grace your loyal servant with your presence in this time of need!? Truly, the wood has answered my pleas!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VALAN_000_019: If the “great serpent” has been with you all this time, , I can only imagine what sort of dreams he's been having...
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VALAN_000_020: And yet...as skeptical as I am, the Viis seem to put stock in his visions. If there's even a hint of truth to them, who knows what we're in for...
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_100_021: Muahahaha! I know, my good friend, for I have seen it a thousand thousand times in my visions! This venerable forest is on the verge of entering a new age of harmony! For the great serpent shall let out a mighty cry, and in so doing summon forth they who did serve great Ronka in times of eld!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_100_022: Verily, the arrival of the heirs to wisdom ancient and true is nigh at hand! Now is the time! We must follow where the great serpent leads, and in doing so lay claim to a great future!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VALAN_100_024: I'm sorry to impose, , but would you mind helping me go after him? There's only one path forward through the forest, so he shouldn't be too hard to find.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VALAN_100_030: He must be around here somewhere...
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VALAN_100_031: Look, over in that flower bed! Someone's there!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VIISGUARDA_000_021: A rat who speaks? Who are you, and why do you trespass in our sacred forest!? Answer me, or we will be dining on rat stew this night!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_022: (-Bewildered Beastman-)Ye gads! Oh, do have mercy! I assure you─yes, most assuredly─that we come in peace!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_000_023: Put down your arms! If my visions speak true─and I have never known them to speak otherwise─this mousy fellow and his diminutive companion are none other than the descendants of a proud Ronkan tribe of old!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VIISGUARDB_000_024: You... You are from Slitherbough, yes? One of the so-called Night's Blessed?
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VALAN_000_025: There you are! I swear, Quinfort, do you take pleasure in driving me mad?
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VALAN_000_026: Forgive my friend here. He simply cannot control himself sometimes. I promise you I'll give him a stern talking-to when we get home. Now, Quinfort...
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VIISGUARDA_000_027: Hm? Friends of the ally of Ronka, are you? You are quite bold─or quite foolish─to rush forward before the spearpoint of a Viis as you did.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VIISGUARDB_000_028: And who─or what─is this one? I have not seen him nor any of his ilk before. And yet you say he is a descendant from a proud tribe of Ronka?
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_000_029: Most assuredly so! For I did foresee his coming in a vision granted to me by none other than the great serpent itself!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_03: (-Beastman Child-)Look, Father! There's two of them!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_034: (-Obsequious Beastman-)A Qi-what? I fear you must be mistaken. But this is understandable. After all, my people have lived in hiding for generations. Few─if any─of those on the outside are familiar with our kind. Alas, how far our noble tribe has fallen...
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_035: (-Obsequious Beastman-)What is this? The great serpent travels with you as well? Curious. How very curious, indeed...
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_000_036: A most auspicious encounter this is! For a friend of the great serpent is a friend of ours, yes? Pray, my good sir, do enlighten us as to the name of your most ancient and venerable tribe.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_037: (-Obsequious Beastman-)...Ahem. We are the Qitari. You call us an ancient and venerable tribe, and...I cannot deny that we are very much that.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VIISGUARDA_000_038: The Qitari? That is a name I have heard from my elders. And yet, I was told that the last Qitari vanished a hundred years ago.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VIISGUARDA_000_039: Those of us born after the Flood never paid the stories much heed, but... You say that we truly stand before a Qitari in the flesh?
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VIISGUARDB_000_040: However it may be, it is clear that the ally of Ronka and  friends mean us no harm. Let us put down our arms.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_05: (-Qitari Child-)Father and I have come in search of a great arfi-tact of our past! Great stones buried deep in a cave by his father's father's father's─how many fathers were there again, Father?
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_052: (-Qitari Father-)Chaqurl! Have you forgotten your manners? It would be untoward not to introduce ourselves to our honored new friends.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_053: I am Qitarl Natl of the Qitari, and this is my foolish child, Chaqurl Qhotl. Do forgive us for our impropriety.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_05: Yes, do forgive us for our impo-priety!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_055: For nigh on a century, our tribe has made its home in the shadow of the Light─deep in the forests on the far side of Qitana Ravel, by the rushing waters of Rak'tika Falls.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_056: We did not always hide in the darkness─this place we now stand was once our home. Then came that fateful day when the skies were flooded with Light. Facing certain doom, our forebears fled the forests─but not before a band of the bravest gave their lives to store away our greatest treasures for safekeeping, with the hope that one day their children's children might unearth them anew.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_057: These are the artifacts of which my son spoke─the Qitari stelae, mighty stone monoliths engraved with the accumulated knowledge of our people in its entirety.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_000_058: Of course! It is precisely as I saw it in the visions the great serpent bestowed upon me! A proud and ancient tribe of scribes and scholars! The stewards of knowledge of ancient Ronka!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_059: ...Oho. You are most insightful, my friend. Indeed, we were once known as the Stewards of Note─a title that fittingly describes both our duties as keepers of written knowledge, and the surpassing aptitude with which we pursued the task. Our ancestors served proudly as scribes and scriveners for many a generation of Ronkan emperors.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_060: It is a role that came quite naturally to our people. For you see, we are not blessed with the longer lifespans of your kind. Thus, from our earliest days, we have been most meticulous about recording the happenings and learnings of our lives in precise and painstaking detail.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_061: The Qitari stelae─or, more specifically, the carvings and etchings that grace their surfaces─represent the summation of all the knowledge and wisdom we have acquired over the years. They represent, one might say, the collective memory of our people, passed down through the ages from generation to generation.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_06: Long have we dreamed of returning here to search for the stones, and reclaiming our legacy. And yet! Nasty, nasty sin eaters and worse stood in our path, making the journey far too pair-lious to even attempt!

Then, one day, the skies turned dark! I trembled in terror, but next thing I knew, the great serpent was hopping and squirming beside me! He told me that a path through the Ravel had been cleared, and we were free to go home at last!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_064: Precisely. And so it was that my boy and I received the blessings of our fellow Qitari, and became the first of our kind in generations to return to this part of the Greatwood. Unfortunately, we were immediately set upon by all sorts of nasty creatures, forcing us to retreat and ponder our course of action.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VIISGUARDA_000_065: ...Where we came upon you, and threatened you at spearpoint. Pray forgive us, allies of Ronka. We knew not who you were, nor all you had suffered to arrive here.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VIISGUARDB_000_066: You intend to remain here in the Greatwood to search for these...stelae of yours, was it? Worry not. We shall tell all in Fanow of you─that you are friends, and not to be harmed. And with that, we must be on our way. Go in peace.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_067: Dear me, but that was a close one, wasn't it? I was all but certain Chaqurl and I were going to end up skewered. Were it up to me, I would have left the boy behind for his safety. But he is ever a curious one, and would hear nothing of it.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_06: I'm not a child anymore, Father! I'm all of three summers!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VALAN_000_069: Three!? Why, when I was three, I could barely walk straight!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_070: Oho! I do not doubt that is so, good sir. But for our people─the oldest of whom would be lucky to see twenty summers─Chaqurl here is almost a Qitari grown.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_071: ...But enough about us. If I might change the subject, you know your way around the Greatwood, yes? I have reason to believe that our forefathers buried the stelae in a cavern that extends deep into the mountains near the Ox'Dalan Gap. Perhaps you might be willing to─
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_07: Come, Father! We must follow him!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_000_074: But of course! It all makes sense now! It is the great serpent who guided you here to us, and now─together─we must heed its clarion call! Say no more, great stewards of Ronka! It would be our honor to assist you in your noble cause!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_075: That is most kind of you, good sir. In that case, pray allow me to oblige. Let us follow where the great one leads.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_100_080: The mere sight of the divine protector, humbling itself so as to crawl on the ground, that its loyal servants may rediscover and reclaim their proud past! Why, it nigh brings a tear to my eye!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VALAN_100_081: Wonderful...his vision actually proved true. Now I'll never hear the end of it.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_100_082: And so we finally return to this place after one hundred years. But what awaits us here? The mere prospect stirs my heart and makes me tremble in anticipation...
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_SYSTEM_100_084: The serpent wriggles and writhes about excitedly. It appears most eager to see what lies beyond the sealed cave entrance.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_09: Father! Could this be the place?
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_091: Let us see, now... The mark on the cave's entrance appears to be an ancient Ronkan ward. This is promising, and yet...problematic.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_092: Do allow me to explain. We Qitari worship Ox'Dalan, god of the dead and the world below. Our forebears no doubt believed that if they sealed away the stelae deep within the bowels of the land, Dalan Himself would watch over them and keep them safe until the day their descendants returned.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_000_093: Most fascinating! Your knowledge of Ronkan tradition is impressive, indeed! However do you manage to know so much, despite your chronicles of history being lost to you for so long?
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_094: Many ruins can be found near Rak'tika Falls, within the wood we have called home since the Flood. We have made an effort to explore and excavate them as best we could, that our Ronkan roots would not be entirely forgotten.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_000_095: A most admirable goal─and one near and dear to my own heart, as well! For you see, I am one of the Night's Blessed, who traveled to these parts after the Flood. I, too, have a deep personal interest in the beliefs and traditions of the ancient civilization that once flourished here!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_000_096: In fact, I have done extensive research looking into my own ancestors, and was pleased to discover that I can trace my lineage back to none other than the great sage Dwatl himself!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_100_096: And  here is a true ally of Ronka. Why, as the Viis tell it,  coming was foretold by the last emperor himself!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_097: The descendants of Ronka and their allies reunited across the years? Oh, joyous day! This meeting must truly be a gift from the great serpent!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VALAN_000_098: I can vouch for  here─ is the very  who drove the Lightwarden from these lands. As for the descendant of the great sage what's-his-name, I'd suggest you let at least half of his ramblings go in one ear and out the other.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_099: Could it truly be...? But yes, our hero stands before us! We watched your battle in the Ravel from the shadows. The moment you struck down that beast of Light, we knew that a new age was nigh. Oh, never have I seen such gallantry and valor!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_10: I saw the battle, too! Never have I seen such vallantry and galor!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_101: At any rate, my good ... I am keen to begin the excavation, but I fear it won't be so simple. The warding seal here bars our entrance, and we will have to find a way to break it if we hope to proceed.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_102: If what I have gleaned from my research is correct, this will require an object of immense arcane power. A relic that will speak to the seal, and convey that the Qitari have returned to claim what is ours. An object imbued with the mystical energies of the forest itself...
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_10: Yes, an object with the glow of the Greatwood─as you always say, Father! I shall find it for you!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_104: Your enthusiasm is admirable, Chaqurl. But let us not get ahead of ourselves. This is a perilous place, and I have no intention of seeing you get snatched up by some terrible beast.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_105: And so I turn to the hero of the Ravel and the son of Dwatl. My good , might you know of someone who could aid us in our search?
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_A2_000_002: I know the Greatwood like the back of my hand.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_106: Oh, lucky day! Clearly, you are not merely a hero on the battlefield, but a  of many talents indeed. We would be ever so indebted to you if we could impose upon you just this once.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_10: Yes, we would be most in-tedd-ed, my good ! Or was it ? Father, I can never tell which is which!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_108: Enough prattling, Chaqurl. We must find a way to open this portal at once, that we might summon our fellow Stewards here and begin searching for the stelae in earnest.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_109: O, ally of Ronka. Qitarl Natl of the Qitari bows down and beseeches you. Will you lend us your aid and help my people reclaim our long-lost legacy? I promise you the debt will not go unpaid.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_110: I realize I ask much of you, and so soon after we met. Needless to say, pray take as much time as you require to consider our offer. Should you be inclined to offer your strength and wisdom to us, just say the word.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_100_110: The descendants of the proud Qitari, emerged from the shadows to reclaim their legacy after a century! Mighty stone monoliths inscribed with the wisdom of the ages! Why, I can just feel the wondrous secrets of ancient Ronka stirring me to the depths of my soul!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VALAN_100_111: Is there anything you can't do? No wonder Master Matoya is so happy to have you around.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_CHAQURLQHOTL_100_11: After the battle, when the skies went dark, I could hardly believe my eyes! After all, I'd never seen the...er...what's the opposite of day again?
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_114: I am happy to greet you again, my good . What say you? Have you given any thought to my entreaty?
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_A3_000_001: The ally of Ronka stands with you.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_A3_000_002: The ally of Ronka has more important things to do.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_116: I see. Well, that is a shame, isn't it? And here I thought we were getting on so well. But I forget myself. Of course, you are free to conduct your business as you see fit. Should you ever have a change of heart, my son and I will be waiting here...patiently.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_000_117: Powerfully spoken, ! Truly, this shall mark a new dawn in the annals of Ronkan history! As the great sage is my witness, I say: let the Qitari rise to glory anew!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_118: We are truly in your debt, ally of Ronka. I entrust the vital task of finding an object with the glow of the Greatwood to you. As for where to begin your search...
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_000_119: Leave that to me, my long-snouted friend! Did you mayhap notice that the serpent your dear Chaqurl brought along has a rather distinctive pattern of scales on its most exquisite body? I have reason to believe that this pattern will indeed lead us to that which we seek!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_000_121: Hark unto the serpent's cry! And know that the points of light that glow amidst the stripes represent those precise spots where the aether that flows through the Greatwood is most densely concentrated!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_000_122: Behold! Here, in the northwestern reaches of the Blind Forest of Yx'Maja─conveniently marked by this slimy little scar─we can see what is doubtless a convergence of sorts. If anywhere, it is there we will find a specimen of sufficient power to breach the seal!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_100_122: Behold! Here, in the northwestern reaches of the Blind Forest of Yx'Maja─conveniently marked by this slimy little scar─we can see what is doubtless a convergence of sorts. If anywhere, it is there we will find a specimen of sufficient power to breach the seal!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_200_122: Behold! Here, in the western reaches of Mjrl's Regret─conveniently marked by this slimy little scar─we can see what is doubtless a convergence of sorts. If anywhere, it is there we will find a denizen of the deep whose scales are imbued with sufficient power to breach the seal!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_300_122: I might add that─if my encyclopedic knowledge of forest fauna serves me well─these creatures are known to have a particular fondness for fruit worms.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_123: Oho! If the son of Dwatl says it is so, then surely it would behoove us to pay heed.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_124: When you return with the relic, pray let Chaqurl see it once. I would have my boy gain firsthand knowledge of the wisdom of his forefathers.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_130: Have you had any luck in finding the relic we seek, good ? I do not mean to hurry you, but I would very much like to get on with the excavation before I die of old age.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_13: Father says that with you on our side, we're sure to open the door and begin the ex-vacation any time now!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_VALAN_000_132: I don't put much stock in Quinfort's ramblings, but even a madman can stumble upon a fragment of truth from time to time. As for whether whatever you find will serve our purposes, I guess we'll just have to see, won't we?
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QUINFORT_000_133: The great serpent has spoken! Yes, it is as clear to me as a clarion call from the heavens! Ancient aetheric energy will be summoned forth, and the door shall open, revealing a pathway to great secrets of the past!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_SYSTEM_000_135: The serpent wriggles and writhes about excitedly. It appears eager to see what lies beyond the sealed cave entrance.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_15: You have returned! And what's this? Do I see something glowing on your person?
Why, it's beautiful! Oh, thank you, sirmadam─or was it madamsir? Now, Father says I need simply point it at the door, and...
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_080: My word... It opens! Oh, splendid! Splendiferous!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_08: Splen-fid-erous indeed! Look, Father! The seal is broken!
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_082: It has, Chaqurl...it has. And with this, after a hundred years...we stand on the verge of reclaiming our legacy.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QITARLNATL_000_083: But our task has only begun. There will be digging─yes, much digging─and delving. We must relay the triumphant tidings to our tribesmen, and summon them here to assist in the excavation. Yes, from this day, the Stewards will not rest until a new page in the annals of Qitari history has been writ.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_08: Do not worry, Father! I will work as hard as any Steward to reclaim our less-agy! Oh, Sirmadam ─you will help us in our quest, yes?
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_SYSTEM_000_085: Sealed tight for a century, the door to the ancient cave now lies open, and the Qitari excavation effort can begin in earnest.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_08: Good ! You must meet my mother! Mother will be running the camp and seeing that everything is in order. Isn't that right, Mother? Yes?
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_QHOTERLPASOL_000_08: My son speaks true. Reclaiming our history is about more than grand discoveries of ancient artifacts. There is much that must be done to ensure we can go about our daily lives in this place. And so I would call upon you for aid from time to time, if you would not be disinclined to help us.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_SYSTEM_000_088: Will the Stewards' excavation effort succeed? Will the lost stelae of the Qitari return to the light, that young Chaqurl might one day know the wisdom of his ancestors? Or are ancient secrets destined to stay forever shrouded in darkness? Only the gods know...
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_SYSTEM_000_160: You have achieved Friendly reputation with the Qitari.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_SYSTEM_000_161: Qitari society quests are now available from Qhoterl Pasol at Hopl's Stopple.
TEXT_BANQIQ001_03794_SYSTEM_000_162: Furthermore, you may now purchase wares from Yuqurl Manl.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_00: Good ! It was , wasn't it? Mother tells me you've been working your tail off around the Stopple! Is that why I can't see your tail, perhaps?
Anyhow! Thanks to you, Father says that we're ready to begin the ex-vacation! Isn't this all so exciting?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_003: Chaqurl. We must remember to remain calm and composed. These caves are vast, their tunnels burrowing deep into the bowels of the land. Slow, steady, and circumspect is the order of the day.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_004: As we speak, a preliminary exploration team is surveying the tunnels to determine where we might best begin the excavation. We will await their findings before deciding on the best way to move forward.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_00: Understood, Father! I promise to be sir-sumspect. Does that mean we can begin digging already?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_006: Towarl Manol! What news from the depths?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_TWARLMANOL_000_007: Digmaster Qitarl. I fear we encountered something rather...unexpected. I fear that we may not be able to commence the excavation effort as quickly as we had hoped...
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_00: We can't start digging? But why? What did you find down there?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_TWARLMANOL_000_009: No sooner had we stepped through the entrance, our whiskers twitching in anticipation of the wonders that awaited, than did we see them─nasty creatures swarming in every nook and cranny of the caves!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_010: ...A most troubling development indeed. We Qitari are scribes, not warriors. Indeed, it was the presence of fearsome fiends─and worse─blocking our way through the Ravel that kept us trapped for a hundred years. Are we doomed to suffer a similar fate here?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_A1_000_001: I did defeat the Lightwarden, you know.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_A1_000_002: I can do more than just gather things.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_011: The ally of Ronka and bringer of the night would fell these terrible beasts for us? I would like little more than to take advantage of your kindness, but...I fear there is a rub.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_013: ...A rub. In our preliminary explorations of the Stopple, we have discovered that another ward seals off the tunnels below. A ward not unlike the one that barred the entrance, but with one notable─and unfortunate─difference.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_014: It is a ward impassable to all but the servants of Dalan─namely, the Qitari. No, I fear we will have to find our own way to dispatch the beasts that have burrowed their way up from the depths...
