TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_01: But without Sirmadam 's aid, we'll be chewed up the moment we step in there─tails and whiskers and all!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_018: Indeed...and yet, it does not move. Till now, we have had only to follow where it goes. This time, it appears we must fully grasp the import of his message. A message which, sadly, is beyond my comprehension. If only there were someone who─but, of course! The son of Dwatl!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_01: The son of... You mean, that tall fellow who likes to wave his arms in the air when he talks!?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_020: The very same. Ahem.... It appears we will require your assistance once more. Might you be so kind as to see my boy safely to Slitherbough, that he might summon this Quinfort for us?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_02: Would you kindly, ? Father and I would appreciate it ever so muchly and more! Now come along, great serpent!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_030: The Qitari boy told me you came seeking Quinfort's counsel. Are you sure you're feeling quite okay, ?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_03: Slitherbough is full of tunnels, too! If Father wasn't waiting for us back at the Stopple, I'd love to go digging and delving here, too!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QUINFORT_000_040: What's this you say!? Fell beasts prowl the tunnels at every turn? No doubt they are remnants of the shadows that wander the forests come to life! Demons, come to suck dry the currents of aether that give the Greatwood life, reducing our home to a withered husk!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_041: They could be that. Or they could simply be nasty little brutes that crawled their way up from between the rocks. You know, like the ones around here.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_04: Valan, my good sirmadam! You know of these creatures, too?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_043: I do. Mother tells me that when our ancestors first came to Slitherbough, they were set upon by a swarm of ravenous creatures that crawled up from below. Fortunately, one of the elder priests managed to utter an incantation that drove them away.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_044: If you look closely at the walls around us, you can see glyphs carved in them. The same protective magic that saved our forefathers then has been worked into the very walls around us. In a sense, the settlement of Slitherbough itself serves as a ward against the dangers that lurk beneath us.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QUINFORT_000_045: Just so, Valan! And it is precisely wards and incantations of this sort that I have made the focus of my studies of late!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_04: I remain ever impressed with your knowledge, my good sirmadams. Might it be too much to ask if you could teach this incantation to the great serpent, that he might protect us in our expedition below?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QUINFORT_000_048: Wh-What...what blasphemy do you speak, child!? Do you think me, a humble servant of the wood, so brazen as to believe he could enlighten the divine protector itself!?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_049: <sigh> Look...this isn't exactly my area of expertise, but it strikes me that there might be a simpler way to approach this.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_050: Why don't we simply fashion a talisman or two for them? You know, like the ones we've always used to keep danger at bay. I can craft a simple object to serve as the vessel, then Quinfort can mutter a few words and enchant it as he sees fit.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_100_050: Tradition dictates that the talisman be fashioned from materials indelibly connected to the bearer's home. Those of us who live in Slitherbough usually gather what we need from the Citia Swamps, but for our Qitari friends, we'll have to look further east.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_051: ...your knowledge of rocks and stones just might serve us well here. Why don't you head over to Mjrl's Regret and see if you can't find us a serpent's-eye? It's a rare gem that we often carry about to ward off danger.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_100_051: ...your knowledge of trees and shrubs just might serve us well here. Why don't you head over to Mjrl's Regret and see if you can't find us a spectral cocoon. It's a casing of spun silk that we often carry about to ward off danger.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_200_051: ...your angling aptitude just might serve us well here. Why don't you head over to Mjrl's Tears and see if you can't fish us up a shimmershell. It's a sea-dwelling creature whose husk we often carry about to ward off danger.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_300_051: If you're in need of appetizing bait, I figure a fruit worm should suffice. Speaking of fruit worms, doesn't the way they wriggle and squirm remind you of─on second thought, never mind.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QUINFORT_000_052: And I shall immediately begin weaving an incantation especially tailored to protect our good friends from the sort of terrifying creatures that infest the caves and tunnels they seek to explore! Muahahaha! A foolproof plan if ever there was one!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_053: Chaqurl, you can stay here with me in Slitherbough and help me collect the other materials I need. It'll be the perfect opportunity to introduce you to my fellow Blessed.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_054: Once we have everything we need, let's meet up again at Hopl's Stopple. I want to test the effectiveness of the talisman for myself before we leave Chaqurl and his friends on their own.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QUINFORT_000_064: I can scarce wait to put my prodigious talents to use for the sake of our Qitari friends!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_065: Oh, there you are! Were you able to find something suitable for making our talisman?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_066: Why, yes. This should serve us quite well. Just give me a moment or two─I'll round up the materials Chaqurl and I gathered from the village and whip up something in no time.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_067: Just add a feather here, here, and here, then thread through this length of rope, and...yes, this should do it!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_07: It's...it's beautiful! And this will let us begin the ex-vacation in safety, you say?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_071: Not so fast. The talisman needs to be enchanted before it's of any use. As it is now, it's little more than a fancy little ornament.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_072: Well, Quinfort? This is the moment you've been waiting for, isn't it?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QUINFORT_000_073: Muahahaha! Say no more! Stand back and bear witness as Quinfort, descendant of Dwatl, weaves an incantation the likes of which your eyes have never seen!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_074: Why do I have a bad feeling about this...?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QUINFORT_000_075: Worry not, dear Valan! In truth, at first I was uncertain which of the many prayers I have memorized would serve us best. A traditional chant of the Night's Blessed? But wait...the Qitari are an ancient race, so perhaps this calls for an incantation from ancient Ronka?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QUINFORT_000_076: Long did I ponder─choose poorly, after all, and it could mean death and destruction for our friends, if not the forest itself! Fortunately, it was then that the great serpent came to me in a vision, enlightening me as to the precise words that will deliver us to salvation: words which have long been writ in the Gospel of Quinfort!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_077: You're going to enchant this talisman with ramblings from your dream diary? Now I really have a bad feeling about this...
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QUINFORT_000_078: Do not be silly, Valan. The great serpent speaks through me, and I am but a vessel for his divine wisdom. Hark, it is precisely as it says in chapter fifty-two, verse five...
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QUINFORT_100_078: “The goddess's claws stained cerulean, she did await the arrival of the stewards. The coming of the darkness marked a new dawn; a proud people returned to the wood where the egg once fell from high above...”
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QUINFORT_200_078: “O, Great Serpent of Ronka, gifted to us by the heavens! Hear the plea of the great sage's scion, and guide the children of Ronka safely to their ancestral home!”
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QUINFORT_000_079: O, Great Serpent! Do tell me, were my prayers heard?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_08: Why, I've never heard an in-tank-ation so inspiring! Your powers truly are something else, Master Quinfort!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QUINFORT_000_082: Oho! You are wise beyond your years, my young Qitari friend. My knowledge is vast, my powers indeed prodigious, and it is more than an honor to wield them in service of your esteemed people!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_083: Though he's prone to bouts of madness from time to time, Quinfort is an accomplished priest. The talisman should serve you well.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_084: Splendid. Our excavation effort has already been delayed for far longer than we can afford.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_085: Well, Chaqurl? This is the moment of truth. There is no telling what dangers lurk beneath us. Are you quite certain you wish to accompany me to the tunnels below?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_08: But of course, Father! Why else would I have come to this place with you? Together, we will unearth the secrets of our far-forethers, and reclaim our history!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_087: Very well. It is clear you do not take the task lightly. Perhaps you are coming of age after all. And with that, I believe it's time we started digging.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_SYSTEM_001_032: Qitarl Natl and Chaqurl Qhotl have safely returned from their preliminary investigation of the tunnels.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QUINFORT_000_091: Yet more manifestations of the great serpent! Whatever have we done to deserve such a blessing!?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_092: Well, Chaqurl? Were you able to find any of the tablets you were searching for?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_SYSTEM_000_095: The great serpent wriggles about and lets out a clear, clarion call. It would seem that it wishes to aid the Qitari in their effort to reclaim their history.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QUINFORT_000_096: What is this!? Another incarnation of the great serpent made manifest before us!? Whatever could be the meaning of this!? I must know at once!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_097: ...Ahem. If you could settle down for just a moment, Master Quinfort, I will explain in detail all I witnessed down below.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_09: Father and I found a stone! It was big and square and covered with all sorts of writings, just like in the legends!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_099: As my boy says, we did indeed find the stelae. Or at least...one piece of them.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_101: According to Qitari legend, the stelae comprised four perfectly square stones, stacked to form a massive pillar. Which is to say, what we have found is but one part of the larger whole...
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_102: And if that were not unfortunate enough, even the single stela we found has been badly weathered through the years. In many places, the engravings are all but indecipherable.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_103: That is not all we found. Lying beside the shattered stone were several sad piles of bones─no doubt the remains of our once-proud forefathers who carried the stelae down below. I shudder to think of their last moments, torn apart by sin eaters as they hid away our legacy for safekeeping.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_10: Father and I thought to carry the stone to the surface, but in that moment, something jumped out and stood in our path!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QUINFORT_000_106: Are mine eyes to be believed!? The behatted serpent that first accompanied our Qitari friends remains on the surface, which means...we are graced by yet another incarnation of the divine protector!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_107: A third manifestation of the great serpent? Just how many of them are there, anyway?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_100_108: At the very least, this is the only one we encountered on our expedition. And yet, if it traveled here from somewhere to guide us in our efforts, it would not be unreasonable to assume that there are others where this one came from.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_108: In truth, it appeared and spoke to us just as we stood before the shattered stone. I cannot help but believe it was conveying to us a message, just as its brethren guided us to these ancient tunnels.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_109: Chaqurl and I pondered the matter, and we believe that we understand. The great serpent bids us to unearth what remains of the scattered and weathered stelae, and piece together our people's history anew with our own hands and minds.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_110: I see. If the stones truly have been scattered and weathered by time, that's the best you could hope to do.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QUINFORT_000_111: Yet surely you must have been able to make out something from what remained of the stone! What chronicles of eld were writ there!?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_112: ...Ahem. What we were able to make of the markings could be described thus: a mighty Ronso wearing a crown─no doubt meant to represent the first emperor of Ronka, stood tall with a blade raised high over his head.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_113: Before him, cowered a Qitari─one of our forefathers, no doubt. The carving would seem to depict the momentous occasion that was the first encounter between our people and the empire.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_114: And the implications could not be more clear. Doubtless our ancestors, ill-suited for battle, were conquered and subjugated by the might of Ronka, under whose yoke they would find new purpose as the stewards of history.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_11: A most fascinating interpretation, Father. But if I might be so bold, I saw the drawings quite differently.

I do not believe the Ronkan emperor would be so cruel as to threaten the poor, weak Qitari. No, I believe that he found us vulnerable and at the mercy of the fearsome beasts of the forest. He slew the beasts by his own hand, and befriended our ancestors, giving us new purpose as his subjects.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_117: Your optimism is admirable, my boy, but I fear that such a bright and cheery interpretation of events is unlikely at best. History is full of harsh truths from which we must not avert our eyes.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_11: But tales are still sung of the first emperor's might and majesty to this day, are they not? I simply cannot fathom that he would be so cruel as to enslave our people!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_119: If you ask me, both theories seem reasonable. But if you intend to keep a record of history to pass down to posterity, you're going to have to choose one.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QUINFORT_000_120: Two conflicting theories of the past─one to be etched in stone and sung until the end of time, and the other, destined to be consigned to the dust of the deep, dank caverns below! Truly, this is a turning point in the grand tapestry that is the history of the Qitari...!
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_VALAN_000_121: Yes, yes. At any rate, I believe we've done all we can here.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QUINFORT_000_122: Valan! I say, Valan─have you no interest in witnessing this momentous occasion in history!?
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_123: I would not think of insisting that my interpretation is the only valid one. And yet, I cannot simply toss it aside in favor of my son's rose-colored view of the past.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_QITARLNATL_000_127: It does, and this time its message could not be more clear. It believes that , the ally of Ronka, should be the one to weigh the options at hand and decide which version of history shall be inscribed upon the stone.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_SYSTEM_000_150: The Qitari father and son have arrived at conflicting interpretations of the events depicted on the stela. At the bidding of the Great Serpent of Ronka, it has fallen to you to determine which version of history will be recorded.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_SYSTEM_000_151: You have achieved Trusted reputation with the Stewards.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_SYSTEM_100_151: Borrowing the wisdom of the Night's Blessed, the Qitari have set up warding talismans around Hopl's Stopple. Free from the danger of wandering beasts, the excavation effort should proceed smoothly from here.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_SYSTEM_400_151: Furthermore, yet another serpent clad in curious armor has arrived at the Qitari camp.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_SYSTEM_200_151: In order to continue the Qitari quests, speak with either Qitarl Natl or Chaqurl Qhotl, and choose the interpretation of history that you find most convincing.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_SYSTEM_300_151: Your choice will affect not only the restoration of the stela, but history as it will be told for years to come. Once you make your choice, you will be unable to go back, so choose carefully.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_SYSTEM_000_152: New Qitari society daily quests are now available from Qhoterl Pasol at Hopl's Stopple.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_SYSTEM_000_153: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Qhoterl Pasol as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_SYSTEM_000_154: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Qhoterl Pasol. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANQIQ002_03795_SYSTEM_000_155: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from Yuqurl Manl.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_SYSTEM_000_002: The serpent jumps about joyfully. It appears that the Qitari excavation effort is proceeding swimmingly. Speak with Chaqurl Qhotl and see if there is anything you might do to lend a hand.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CHAQURLQHOTL_100_01: Oh, ! You'll be happy to know that the charm your friends fashioned for us worked most splendidly! We've been able to reach deeper depths than ever before!
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_01: And thanks to you, the restoration of the first stela is all but complete! You simply must see it!
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_012: ...Ahem. You'll also be pleased to know that the relics and records that turned up in our subsequent trips below have confirmed that the interpretation of history that you espoused was indeed and indubitably true.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_013: We came upon many ritual instruments in the tunnels below. It would seem that─in the empire's earliest days─the Ronkans would offer individuals chosen from the races they conquered as living sacrifices to their gods. The markings on the first stela depict just such a scene.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_014: But this was not simply a cruel and callous tradition. Once these conquered peoples were recognized by the Ronkan gods, they were welcomed into Ronkan society, and given the chance to serve the empire and live peaceful, prosperous lives under its auspices.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_015: It is a somewhat chilling tale, but we must be grateful to our ancestors, who gave their own lives that we who followed might live a brighter future.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_01: To think that I am only alive today because my forefathers spilled their blood... It is a bit much to take in all at once, but I'm sure I will come to understand.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_017: We came upon many ritual instruments in the tunnels below. It is most clear that─let it suffice to say─we Qitari have never been particularly adept at the art of war. So it was that our ancestors searched far and wide for a safe haven where they could call home.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_018: Ronka, on the other hand, was composed of many strong peoples─the Ronso, brave warriors; the Drahn, adept at the arcane arts; and the Viis, peerless archers─all working together for the empire's prosperity.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_019: Not long after the Qitari first made contact with the empire, our skill as scribes and scriveners became evident to high-ranking court officials, and we were offered a prominent role in Ronkan society in return for our loyal service.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_02: Four races so different, all living and working together for the greater good! Oh, what I wouldn't give to be able to live just one day in those glorious days of the empire!
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_021: ...But our work is far from done. Indeed, in our explorations, we have found what appears to be an entrance leading to an even deeper level of the caves. I have little doubt that the remaining stelae lie further below.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_022: I have sent a team below to conduct a preliminary investigation before we begin the next phase of the excavation in earnest. My trusted scout Towarl Manol should be here to make her report at any─
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_TWARLMANOL_000_023: Master Qitarl! I bring news from below! News that I fear...is not good.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_024: Again!? I swear─if we Qitari did not have rotten luck we would have none at all. Do tell...what did you find down there?
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_TWARLMANOL_000_025: Entering the second stratum, we came upon a shrine to our protector, Ox'Dalan. It appeared to have been ravaged by the beasts that lurk below, but still it stood after all these years...
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_026: A shrine, you say? No doubt it was erected by our ancestors, most likely to ward off some greater danger that lurks further below...
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_TWARLMANOL_000_027: This was my thought as well, Master Qitarl. A cave-in? A flood? Fearsome creatures from the deep? We were too fear stricken to press onward, not knowing what manner of calamity might befall us...
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_02: But we must press on somehow! Can we not appeal to Dalan somehow, that He might protect us as we delve further?
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_029: Indeed...perhaps there is a suitable ritual for the occasion. Sadly, if there is, I fear it is beyond my knowledge...
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_A1_000_001: I think I know a Viis who could help you...
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_A1_000_002: Perhaps you might find an answer in Fanow?
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_03: Why, yes! Indeed, the Viis are nothing if not well versed in Ronkan tradition!
The one with hair the color of night─Master Lanille, was it? I hear she has lived as long as ten Qitari! Yes, I am certain she will have knowledge that will serve us well!
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_031: Long-lived as they are, the wisdom they have passed down through generations doubtless rivals that which our ancestors recorded. If anyone can help us, I daresay it is them.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_03: Good ! Pray take me to Fanow at once. I would meet their Master Lanille, that I might partake in her deep knowledge of ancient Ronkan rites.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_04: So many Viis in one place! I can scarce believe my eyes!
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_PHYNA_000_042: ! You grace us again with your presence. Me? I will be departing on my journey any day now. Yes, as soon as I decide where my destination will be...
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CIUNA_000_043: Welcome back, . For better or for worse, little has changed with me since last we met. Phyna, too, is as indecisive as ever...
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_LANILLE_000_045: We had heard rumors the Qitari had returned to the Greatwood, but did not expect to receive a visit so soon. Just seeing you brings back memories of olden times...
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_04: Memories? Do you mean that...you knew my ancestors?
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_LANILLE_000_047: ...I am older than you might think, my little friend. Anyhow, the answer is yes. Have you heard the name Shiparl Toqal? She was a close friend of mine, and would come calling often to exchange news of the wood.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_04: Shiparl Toqal? I do believe I saw that name on Father's family tree. But if I recall correctly, she was my...great-great-great-great-great-great-great-great-grandmother!
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_LANILLE_000_049: Ahahaha! It was that long ago, was it? How quickly the years fly by. Still, I am heartened by your presence, young Chaqurl. For many years after the Flood, I feared we would never see one of your kind again.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_LANILLE_100_049: And you, . Welcome back to Fanow. What brings you to us this day?
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_LANILLE_000_050: ...I see. Our Qitari friends seek to discover their history, and reclaim the knowledge and lore of their ancestors. An admirable goal, indeed. And doubtless not a simple task.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CIUNA_000_051: We would be honored to lend you our aid, and reforge the bonds between our peoples that were so strong in the days of Ronka. Now, do tell me more about these tunnels you are exploring!
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_PHYNA_000_052: My dear sister has quite a weakness for ancient Ronkan ruins and relics, you see.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_PHYNA_000_053: To tell the truth, I had been preparing to leave the Greatwood on a journey of the realm. But if the Qitari require my aid, perhaps I could postpone my departure just a bit longer...
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_LANILLE_000_055: It would seem that the great serpent smiles upon our partnership as well. This is auspicious, indeed.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CIUNA_000_056: Master Lanille, what knowledge of the Qitari lives on here in Fanow?
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_LANILLE_000_057: Very little, I am afraid─the tales I can remember hearing from my dear departed friend, and no more. Sadly, the precise details of Qitari rites and rituals are beyond my recollection.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_LANILLE_000_058: And yet, I do recall Shiparl once mentioning that Qitari prayers to Ox'Dalan were remarkably similar in form to our own petitions to Yx'Maja.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_LANILLE_000_059: It is not so surprising, perhaps, given how closely our two peoples were connected in those days. If we were to teach you one of our own traditions, mayhap you could adapt it for your own purposes?
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_06: You would do this for us!?
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_LANILLE_000_061: Gladly, old friend. But first, we will need to prepare a simple altar for performing the rite, and find ourselves a suitable offering.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_LANILLE_000_062: The liver and blood of an ancient beast, together with pristine water from a sacred spring near the K'mul Astropolis. Yes, I do believe this will suffice.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_LANILLE_100_062: The liver and blood of an ancient beast, together with the root of a spiritweed, a rare shrub that grows near the K'mul Astropolis. Yes, I do believe this will suffice.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_LANILLE_200_062: The liver and blood of an ancient beast, together with a single Dalan's claw─a rare crustacean that lurks in the chill waters of the Lozatl.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CIUNA_000_063: I know the ways of the beasts of the wood─leave the hunting to me. As for the final offering, I suspect  would have little difficulty acquiring it, yes?
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_LANILLE_000_064: Excellent. In the meanwhile, I will teach the ritual to young Chaqurl here. Were the passage into the tunnels larger, we would accompany you ourselves, but alas...
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_06: Do not worry, my good Master Lanille! I will learn the words and gestures well, and Dalan will hear our plea! Just you wait and see!
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_PHYNA_000_066: You're a spirited one, child. But be forewarned: Master Lanille is a strict taskmistress.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_06: Egads! F-Forgive me, my friends. I will do my best. Anyhow, let us all reconvene at Hopl's Stopple when we are finished with our allotted tasks.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CHAQURLQHOTL_100_07: Master Lanille won't be too hard on me, will she?
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_LANILLE_100_071: I thank you, friend. It is not every day that we can reunite with friends from an age long past.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_SYSTEM_100_073: The great serpent lets out a high-pitched squeal. It appears to be quite pleased to see the Qitari and the Viis working together toward a common good.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_080: I was wondering when you might return, ! Have you found the offering that we require?
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_082: The Viis believe that one of their rituals will suffice to appease Dalan? I am skeptical, but I suppose we have little choice but to try. Should you find a suitable offering, pray bring it to us.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_081: The Viis believe this will suffice as an offering to Dalan? ...Very well, so be it. As soon as Chaqurl and the Viis arrive, we shall begin the second phase of the excavation.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CIUNA_000_085: Why, just look at all the Qitari scurrying about! I had heard they were an industrious people, but to see it with my own eyes is impressive indeed!
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_PHYNA_000_086: Hail, and well met. I am Phyna of Fanow, and this is my sister Ciuna. We have come to assist in the ritual of which your son has doubtless told you.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_087: Greetings, greetings. Please accept my apologies for making a fuss so close to your village, and without properly paying my respects. I fear I've been quite preoccupied with my duties here...
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_PHYNA_000_088: There is no need for that, friend. It is we who should apologize for our sisters who gave you such a fright upon your return home...
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CIUNA_000_089: As you may well know, our peoples were strong friends and allies in the days of Ronka. It is our honor to reforge those bonds in the present day. Should you require anything of us, you need but say the word.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_PHYNA_000_090: Anyhow, thanks to  here, it would seem we have all the offerings needed to proceed with the ritual. Do you remember all that Master Lanille taught you, Chaqurl?
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_09: But of course! I said the words over to myself a hundred hundred times on the way here! I will do your Master Lanille and my people proud!
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_092: I should hope so, my son. Very well! Let the dig begin!
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_SYSTEM_000_072: Qitarl Natl and Chaqurl Qhotl have safely returned from their investigation of the tunnels.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_PHYNA_000_103: Another avatar of the great serpent? What is the meaning of this?
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CIUNA_000_104: It would seem that things beyond our understanding are afoot in the depths below...
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_11: I...I cannot say for sure. We found a second stela, but I fear─much as the last one─it proved too massive to carry to the surface.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_116: Just as we were pondering our next course of action, this armor-clad fellow arrived, and let out a mighty─
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_118: ...Er, precisely. While I cannot confess to fully understand the import of what it is saying, I can only surmise that the serpent once again wishes for us to call upon the wisdom of the ally of Ronka─, that is─and restore the stela to its erstwhile form.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_119: And yet, much as last time, the engravings are weathered to no small degree. I have my own thoughts about what they signify, but I would hear my son's theory first. What say you, Chaqurl?
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_12: Well, let me see now... One marking was clearly of a Viis, nocking a bow. Then I could make out the semblance of a Qitari, its arms seemingly held in the air...
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CIUNA_000_121: The image of a Viis on a Qitari stone? How fascinating...
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_12: Just as the first stela depicted our history with the Ronkan Empire, no doubt these markings tell of the first encounter between our two peoples...

Having befriended the benevolent Ronkans, our people then met the Viis, skilled hunters and wise to the ways of the forest! So pleased were our ancestors, that they threw their hands into the air in glee!
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_124: That is a most...optimistic interpretation, my boy.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_125: And yet I feel it is more logical to read the stone a different way. Doubtless the Viis came upon our ancestors, small and scurrying about the forest, and took them for prey.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_126: Facing arrows pointed at their hearts, our ancestors threw up their hands in sheer terror. So it was that the Viis─newcomers to the Greatwood─nearly came into conflict with the mighty Ronkan Empire...
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_PHYNA_000_127: Our legends tell of how the goddess Yx'Maja guided our people to the forest, but say little of what awaited us upon our arrival there. As far as we can say, both theories are more than plausible. Still, I would hope to believe...
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_PHYNA_000_128: ...No. I will say no more. It would ill behoove me to stick my nose in matters of Qitari lore.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CIUNA_000_129: I agree. Qitari history should be written by the Qitari themselves. In any event, we are pleased that we were able to contribute to your cause in some small way.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CIUNA_000_130: We shall return to Fanow, but please do not hesitate to call upon us again. There is still much catching up to do between our peoples.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_QITARLNATL_000_131: Once again, it seems we find ourselves with a choice to make...
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_13: Yes, ! Do impart unto us your wisdom once more! How are you inclined to interpret our history?
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_SYSTEM_000_135: Again, father and son have arrived at different theories regarding the history of the Qitari as recorded on the stela. At the bidding of the great serpent, it falls to you to serve as mediator.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_SYSTEM_000_136: You have achieved Respected reputation with the Stewards.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_SYSTEM_000_137: With the wisdom and blessing of the Viis, an altar to Ox'Dalan has been constructed at Hopl's Stopple. Doubtless this will serve to protect and impart good fortune to the Qitari as they continue to explore the tunnels.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_SYSTEM_000_138: New Qitari society daily quests are now available from Qhoterl Pasol at Hopl's Stopple.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_SYSTEM_000_139: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Qhoterl Pasol as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_SYSTEM_000_140: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Qhoterl Pasol. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANQIQ003_03796_SYSTEM_000_141: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from Yuqurl Manl.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_SYSTEM_000_002: The great serpent wriggles and writhes about with glee. It appears to be eagerly anticipating what new discoveries the Qitari excavation effort might bring. Speak with Chaqurl Qhotl and see how things have been progressing since last you met.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_01: Oh, hello there, friend! It's a most splen-fid-erous day here at the Stopple. The ritual that the Viis so kindly taught us has allowed us to delve deeper into the tunnels, and you won't believe the wonders we've found!
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_015: It is as my boy says. Our exploration of the second stratum is nearly complete, and you'll be pleased to know that the relics and treasures we have found have all but confirmed that your interpretation of the second stela was indeed the correct one.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_016: The first encounter between our ancestors and the Viis was not a pleasant one. Countless of our ancestors were hunted down in the forest, skinned, and turned into pelts and stews. Needless to say, the Ronkan Empire did not take kindly to this...
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_017: The emperor had a mind to drive the Viis from the Greatwood, if not to eradicate their kind entirely. But our forebears used their wits and powers of persuasion to convince both sides that establishing an alliance would be in the best interests of all parties.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_018: Hearing our impassioned pleas, the Viis repented their violent ways. In time, they even came to worship the Ronkan gods, believing that it was Yx'Maja Herself who granted the Ronkan emperor the vision that convinced him in the end to show mercy.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_01: We share a positively horrifying past, but the Viis and Qitari are friends today, and that is what matters more than anything!
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_020: Our forebears welcomed the Viis when they arrived in the Greatwood. Despite our clear differences in aspects like lifespan, stature, and martial aptitude, our two peoples forged a strong bond, not unlike that shared by Yx'Maja and Ox'Dalan, our guardian deities.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_021: We also found records of a story told since olden times. In it, a Viis and a Qitari were hunting together in the wood, when they suddenly fell into a deep sinkhole.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_022: Their bodies bruised and with no source of nourishment, they had no choice but to wait for a rescuer to come. Knowing that his short lifespan was nearly at an end, the short-lived Qitari offered his own flesh to his Viis companion, that she might survive for many years to come.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_02: <sniff> Could there be a more wart-harming tale of friendship and devotion? Why, it brings a tear to my eye!
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_024: I am also pleased to report that in our search, we did also manage to find a passage leading even further into the Stopple's depths. Yes, I have little doubt that another stela awaits us should we continue to delve below.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_02: I trust that Towarl is in-gest-ivating the matter as we speak?
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_026: As a matter of fact, she returned a short while ago. Towarl is nothing if not circumspect. I have no doubt her survey of the tunnels was most thorough.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_027: And yet...I fear the news is not all good. Poor Towarl collapsed into a shivering heap almost immediately upon her return, and has remained in bed─silent and with a dreadful fever─ever since. As such, I have sent for our friends in Slitherbough to come to our aid.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_028: I do believe I just saw them over there. Come, . I would be most obliged if you could join us in getting to the bottom of all this.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_000_029: We came as soon as we could. What sort of malady has stricken the poor little fellow?
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_030: According to those who accompanied her, the passage below was blocked by a vast water vein. Towarl and her team had no choice but to dive in and attempt to swim their way onward through the depths. It would seem the chill of the water took quite a toll on their bodies, Towarl most of all...
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QUINFORT_000_031: Or perhaps they encountered a fearsome leviathan lurking in the deep, who did lash out at them with its tentacles in furious rage! O, for woe! My heart goes out for this brave, battered soul...
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_032: ...Ahem. Fortunately, her life appears to be in no danger. And yet, I fear that the Stopple is far from an ideal environment for sheltering the wounded and infirm...
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_000_033: I would have to agree. Talismans and shrines may do well to ward off the creatures of the deep, but they will do little to keep a shivering body warm and nurse the sick back to good health.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_000_034: .... The Qitari live a simple life, eschewing luxury. We of the Night's Blessed are similar, and I, too, believe frugality to be an admirable trait.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_000_035: And yet, I daresay they deserve to live in better comfort than this. Wouldn't you agree? Perhaps there is something we could do for them...
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_03: Master Valan! Your mag-man-imity is most touching, indeed!
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_000_037: What are friends for, if not to help one another in trying times?
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_038: We would be most obliged to you for your aid. In the meantime, I will suspend our exploration of the tunnels until such time as we find a way to traverse those frigid and treacherous waters.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_000_039: I'll go gather the supplies we need to keep your friend here safe. We'll need something to warm her body, and medicine to ease her fever...
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QUINFORT_000_040: An elixir of life for the afflicted Qitari fellow!? Leave that to Quinfort, son of Dwatl, potion-maker nonpareil! Yes, I do believe I can procure the ingredients I need from our friends in Fanow.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_000_041: As for keeping her warm, I do believe I know just the thing─something my mother always used to make for me when I caught cold as a child. All I'll need is a kindling crystal from Lake Tusi Mek'ta...
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_100_041: As for keeping her warm, I do believe I know just the thing─something my mother always used to make for me when I caught cold as a child. All I'll need is some serpent pepper from Lake Tusi Mek'ta...
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_200_041: As for keeping her warm, I do believe I know just the thing─a magma eel stew, just like Mother always used to make. All I'll need is one of those fiery critters from Lake Tusi Mek'ta...
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_300_041: I reckon a fruit worm will suffice as bait. Never failed me, at least.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_000_042: I would fetch it myself, but I fear it would be treacherous going for one such as me. Could I trouble you with the task, ?
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_04: You are most mu-fin-icent indeed, my friends. Is there nothing I could do to be of assistance?
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_000_044: I intend to return here and tend to poor Towarl. Perhaps you could help me look after your friend?
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_04: Consider it done! Whatever I might do to be of help, I am at your every keck and ball!
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_SYSTEM_000_052: The serpent lets out a plaintive cry. It appears to be deeply concerned for the ailing Towarl Manol.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_05: Poor Towarl...if only there was more that I could do for her!
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_000_054: I wasn't sure what to think of them at first, but there's something rather endearing about these little mousy fellows. As friends of Ronka and neighbors here in the Greatwood, I can't help but wish them well.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QUINFORT_000_053: Why, I can scarcely wait to lend my ample expertise in the field of potion-making to our Qitari companions! It will require ingredients in ample quantities from both Slitherbough and Fanow, but there can be no doubting it is for a cause noble and true!
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_LANILLE_000_055: I am most sorry to hear that one of our Qitari friends has been stricken ill. I can only hope that our traditional remedies will help to ease her suffering.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_060: How goes the search, ? Have you managed to locate anything that might keep poor Towarl warm?
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_062: On behalf of all the Stewards, please accept my apologies for always burdening you so. I promise you that your good deeds will not go unappreciated.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_061: Fascinating...how gently warm to the touch it is. Yes, I daresay this should help to warm Towarl's body and ease her pain.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QUINFORT_000_064: Worry not, my friends! I prepared some extra doses and shared them with the remaining members of the excavation team. Should any of them exhibit similar symptoms to poor Towarl, relief is only a quaff of Quinfort's quintessential elixir away!
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_000_065: Towarl seems to be feeling quite a bit better already. At this rate, I daresay she'll be back on her feet in no time.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_066: I cannot thank you enough, my friends. Poor Towarl...I must tell her just how much I appreciate all she has done for us when she wakens.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_06: Oh! Oh, Father─I have it! Yes, in-tube-idably I do!
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_068: Ch-Chaqurl!? Are you quite all right? Have what, I say?
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_06: When I took 's discovery into hand, my entire body was filled with a gentle wave of warmth from within! Why, if we were to give one to each member of the ex-vacation team...
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_070: ...They could stay warm and toasty even as they navigated the frigid waters below! Simply ingenious, my boy!
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_071: Master Valan. Master Quinfort. Might I trust you to look after our dear Towarl in my stead? I would return to the excavation, that I might deliver to my friend a discovery that is sure to have her dancing in the tunnels!
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QUINFORT_000_072: Leave it to us, my friend! There could be no greater honor than to lend my prodigious talents to a proud race of Ronka!
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_07: That settles it! Let the third stage of the ex-vacation begin!
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_SYSTEM_000_042: Qitarl Natl and Chaqurl Qhotl have safely returned from their investigation of the tunnels.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QUINFORT_000_083: What news do our friends bring from below!? Why, I can scarcely wait to hear about the latest wonders of history and cultural heritage they have unearthed!
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_000_084: Towarl's looking like her hale and hearty old self again. Still a bit pale in complexion...but then again I suppose that's not out of the ordinary for their kind.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_09: ! My friends! We return─our serpent friend with us─and I am pleased to report that the third stela has been found! Sadly, much like the first two, it has seen better days.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_091: We must count our blessings that it survives at all, what with the ravaging sin eaters, rushing waters, and worse that it has faced over the years.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_09: Indeed. Why, I can scarcely imagine the horrors our forefathers faced when they braved the depths so long ago...
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QUINFORT_000_094: “Have no fear, and lament not the past, O brave sons of Ronka! For in reclaiming your legacy this day, you forge the path to a brighter and ever more prosperous future!” So sayeth the divine protector, and may its words give you strength!
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_000_095: Well, the sentiment is an admirable one, at least...
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_000_096: But do tell. What were you able to make of the stone?
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_097: What we could discern of the markings was most curious indeed. It showed a single Qitari holding a fish over his head, and standing next to him, a curious creature that resembled a miniature catfish man with two little legs.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QUINFORT_000_098: A catfish man, you say!? Why, I have pored through every encyclopedia on Master Matoya's shelf, and never so much as heard of such a thing! What manner of fantastic and ancient beast might you have discovered!?
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_000_099: You are the most well traveled of us, . Have you ever seen or heard of such a creature in your journeys?
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_A1_000_002: I had a good catfish stew once...
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_000_101: A curious race of fishmen that live far to the East? No wonder we haven't heard of them here in Norvrandt. Doubtless they were one of the many ill-fated peoples swallowed up by the Flood.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_000_102: You joke, , but why is it that I have a feeling you know more than you're letting on? But I won't pry─after all, we all have our secrets.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_000_103: In any event, these catfish men sound most appetiz─I mean, fascinating. I would be quite curious to find out more.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_104: Ahem...I have a theory as to what the markings signify. Ahem...it was a time of old, when famine ravaged the forest! In trying times, our ancestors and these catfish men each laid claim to a vital fishing ground. That the creatures no longer inhabit these parts can mean only one thing...
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_105: The proud Qitari─the might of the great Ronkan Empire behind them─drove these slippery creatures from the Greatwood, reclaiming the food supply as theirs and theirs alone. Bereft of a source of nourishment, the catfish men died out one by one, and met their eventual extinction.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_10: Believe me, Father, I am not so naive to think this was another bright and happy chapter in history. No doubt the famine you speak of truly did befall our forest home.

All the more reason that when these catfish men showed up on our doorstep, on the verge of collapsing from hunger, our far-forethers did offer them fish, that they might sustain themselves for the days to come.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QUINFORT_000_109: Most fascinating theories, the both of them! And yet, I would posit another: I have read of an ancient coin emblazoned with the image of a catfish that was said to predate the Ronkan Empire. Is it not plausible─even probable─that it might be the currency of an ancient civilization of fishmen that flourished in the depths below─
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_000_110: ...No, it isn't, and I think we've heard enough theories for the day.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_VALAN_100_110: At any rate, Quinfort and I should be getting back to Slitherbough. If you're ever in need of warding charms or far-fetched theories, you know where to find us.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_111: I must say, there is something quite compelling about the thought of a great civilization of subterranean-dwelling fish people. Perhaps I should reconsider my─
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_QITARLNATL_000_113: ...Or perhaps not! At any rate, it would appear that once again my son and I have arrived at conflicting interpretations of our people's past. And so we turn once more to you, ally of Ronka. Which version of history shall be told?
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_11: Friend ! Pray lend us your sage wisdom and acute insight!
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_SYSTEM_000_115: Once more, the Qitari father and son have arrived at different interpretations of past events as depicted on the stela. At the bidding of the great serpent, it falls to you to determine which version of history will be told.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_SYSTEM_000_116: You have achieved Honored reputation with the Stewards.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_SYSTEM_100_116: Thanks to the supplies provided by the people of Slitherbough, Hopl's Stopple is more hospitable than ever. No doubt the Qitari will be able to return to their excavation effort with newfound vigor!
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_SYSTEM_000_117: New Qitari society daily quests are now available from Qhoterl Pasol at Hopl's Stopple.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_SYSTEM_000_118: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Qhoterl Pasol as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_SYSTEM_000_119: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Qhoterl Pasol. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_SYSTEM_000_120: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from Yuqurl Manl.
TEXT_BANQIQ004_03797_SYSTEM_000_121: Normal-quality items gathered in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_SYSTEM_000_002: The great serpent lets out a high-pitched squeal. It appears to be feeling anxious about something. Speak with Chaqurl Qhotl and see how the excavation effort fares.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_01: Welcome back! The Stopple's feeling more comfortable than ever, thanks to all those helpful supplies you and our friends from Slitherbough brought to us! Father and I have also gone diving in the depths below some twenty times now, and you won't believe all we've found!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_015: Indeed, my boy. Perhaps the most important discovery of all was that of relics and records confirming the interpretation of history engraved on the newly restored third stela.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_016: During the age of famine, the catfish people were driven from the forest by our ancestors, who sought to protect the fishing grounds that were their most important source of nourishment. After this, no records or remnants of them were found in any of the lands ruled by the Ronkan Empire.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_017: While it is possible that survivors and their descendants lived on outside Norvrandt, it is all but impossible that they could have survived the Flood of Light. Thus, we can safely say that their race is essentially extinct.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_01: Poor catfish people... I would have─<sniff>─shared my food with you...
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_019: Our ancestors enjoyed amiable relations with these curious catfish people, and indeed did share our food supply with them, allowing them to survive the age of great famine.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_020: To their misfortune, however, they were a stubborn folk. When they refused to worship the deities of Ronka in favor of their old gods, they were driven from the land. Whether they still live on in some far-off land, none can say...
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_02: Poor catfish people... If we ever meet someday, I promise I'll be your friend...
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_022: At any rate, we have explored all there is to explore in the third stratum, meaning that it is time we ventured further below. Unfortunately, we find ourselves in a bit of a bind...
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_023: My most trusted scout, Towarl Manol, has yet to make a full recovery from her ailment. On the contrary, others here in the Stopple have been suffering from similarly unpleasant symptoms─even those who did not accompany Towarl on her expedition below.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_024: I must say, I find myself quite at a loss. Might you be so kind as to accompany me as I look into the matter, ?
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_025: Towarl was on the verge of making a full recovery when her condition took a sudden turn for the worse. And it pains me to say that she is not the only one so afflicted.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_026: The symptoms were mild at first, but in no time their fevers flared up, the pain and dizziness so severe that they cannot even rise to their feet.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_027: The medicine that Master Quinfort brought from Fanow has served to ease their discomfort somewhat, but with more of us being stricken by the day and their conditions ever worsening, I fear it will not be long until we exhaust our supply...
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_028: I am loath to impose upon your generosity once more, but might you be willing to go back and procure another batch from our friends? Surely they will take pity on our plight...
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_02: Forgive me for not being able to travel with you, . I must stay here and help Father tend to the sick.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_03: I hope Towarl feels better soon. Going digging without her just isn't the same!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_PHYNA_000_040: Of late, I have had my hands full providing supplies to the Stewards. While it saddens me to delay my journey yet again, I am happy to lend my aid where it is needed.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CIUNA_000_041: Did young Chaqurl not accompany you this time? What a shame─I was hoping to hear about his latest discoveries.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_LANILLE_000_045: ...This is most distressing news. Rest assured that we will not stand idly by as our Qitari friends suffer.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_LANILLE_000_046: If our remedies may serve them well, I am happy to provide you with as much as you need. That said...
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_PHYNA_000_047: To tell the truth...a similar malady to the one of which you speak has come to Fanow as well. While only a few have taken ill thus far, I must say this does not bode well...
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CIUNA_000_048: Now that you mention it, a traveling merchant from Slitherbough who sojourned here just days ago had a similar tale to tell. Whatever this affliction is, I fear it seems to be spreading.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_LANILLE_000_049: Qitari, Viis, and Humes alike...all stricken by a mysterious plague that spreads in the blink of an eye. In all the years I have lived, never have I heard of such a thing.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_LANILLE_000_050: I hope I am mistaken, but my instincts tell me this is no common chill. I fear that the medicine I gave you will offer little more than a momentary reprieve from the pain...
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_PHYNA_000_051: Do not say such things, Master Lanille! This lack of confidence ill befits you.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_PHYNA_000_052: Though it pains me, I suppose there is little we can do but ease the suffering as best we can until we can determine what has caused this.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CIUNA_000_053: Pray deliver the medicine to young Chaqurl and the ailing Qitari. Should our efforts to find a cure bear fruit, we shall send word at once.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_LANILLE_000_055: Mayhap it is some ancient plague that once afflicted the Greatwood... But if so, why does it return today, so many years later? I fear I am at a loss for answers...
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_PHYNA_000_056: I have resolved to put off my journey until we discover the cause behind this pox. I simply cannot abandon our Qitari friends, nor risk spreading the disease beyond Rak'tika...
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CIUNA_000_057: Word has it that the Night's Blessed have a mind to cut off all contact with outsiders until they can find a cure for the disease. If only there were something we could do...
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_SYSTEM_000_061: The serpent lets out a mournful cry. It appears to be deeply concerned for the well-being of the stricken Qitari.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_06: ! Did you bring the medicine from Fanow!?
Oh, thank you! Your be-ven-olence knows no bounds! But...but just look! Whatever am I to do...?
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_100_07: Not long after you left us, Father suffered a terrible coughing fit. He has not gotten out of bed since, and one by one, the others have joined him...

Father believes that there is a chance that we brought some ancient pox back with us from the ruins beneath the Stopple. Or that we ourselves have spread this disease in traveling to these parts from our former home. But as for the truth, we cannot─
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_073: My friends, are you all here!? I bring most grievous tidings from Slitherbough!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_074: It's Valan! He has taken ill with the plague!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_075: He exercised the utmost caution when tending to poor Towarl, but to no avail! For the disease has stricken him too, and with great vengeance!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_077: ...Indeed. I fear that it is none other than he who─albeit unwittingly─carried the pox back to Slitherbough.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_078: Is it true that the Viis of Fanow, too, suffer from this frightful affliction!? A great plague, threatening to claim the lives of all who call the Greatwood home! I shudder at the thought...
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_07: We have no choice. From today, all Qitari who still stand will devote every waking moment to in-gest-ivating the disease!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_08: Yes, in Father's name, I hereby suspend the ex-vacation effort and─
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_084: Put away not your shovels and spades, young Chaqurl! The excavation must go on, for verily, so spake the divine protector of Ronka!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_085: Aye, many a prayer have I offered to the great serpent on behalf of the ailing, and today my prayers have been heard!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_086: Through me, Dwatl's own blood, the divine protector shall lead you to a cure for this frightful plague. Trust in it─in me─and the suffering of our peoples will soon come to an end!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_08: Master Quinfort! O, Great Serpent of Ronka! Of course, you speak true!
If Father is right, and we Qitari are res-bon-sipple for the spread of the disease, then the answers we seek might yet be found along with the undiscovered stela.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_09: After all, if this is indeed some ancient pox, it stands to reason that our far-forethers left behind some record of it. A record that may very well shed light upon its cause...and its cure!
With poor Father bedridden, it falls to me to carry on the dig! I will find the stela and save our people, even if I must do it alone!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_092: Your bravery is most admirable, young Chaqurl. And yet─even with the divine protector watching over you─are the tunnels not too dangerous for a child?
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_09: I am no child, Master Quinfort! I have lived three whole years, and in just these recent days have accompanied Father into the depths time and again! No one is better prepared to search for the stela than me!
Oh, thank you, ! A vote of con-dif-ence from you means the world to me! Mark my words: I will get to the bottom of this!
Your concern is touching, , but have no fear! You have given me─and all of the Stewards─great strength. Mark my words: I will get to the bottom of this!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_096: Such courageous words, spoken from one so young! Chaqurl Qhotl, you truly are a shining example for all your people...!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_097: Worry not for your dear father.  and I will see that he wants for nothing while you are exploring down below. Go in safety, and know that we pray for your success.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_100: Young Chaqurl continues to impress, does he not? I would be lying to say I am entirely unconcerned, but I have faith that he will be safe under the great serpent's watchful eye.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_SYSTEM_000_102: The serpent lets out a passionate cry and bounces about confidently. It appears moved by the young Qitari lad's courageous decision to venture deeper into the caves on his own.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_10: It is not simply for the future of my fellow Qitari that I must find the next stela...
It is for Father, for Valan, for the Viis who suffer in Fanow... For all those who call Rak'tika home, I must succeed! Let the ex-vacation begin!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_SYSTEM_000_072: Chaqurl Qhotl has safely returned from his exploration of the tunnels!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_100_120: You return, my young friend! Thanks be to the great serp─what's this? Do mine eyes deceive me? You return alone...
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_100_12: Indeed. On all our previous ex-vacations, an avatar of the great serpent─clad in a suit of armor─arrived to welcome Father and I to the stela's resting place. This time, there was none to be found...
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_100_122: Inconceivable! The great serpent forsaking a descendant of Ronka in their time of need!?
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_100_12: In-tube-itably, the divine protector moves in mysterious ways.
But worry not, my friends! For I was able to locate the fourth stela myself! And─thanks be to the divine protector─there was barely a scratch or scrape on it!
Yes, using the tools and techniques you have supplied to us, I do believe we will be able to raise it to the surface in pristine condition!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_126: Remarkable! Truly, you are a paragon of Ronkan industriousness and ingenuity! Now do tell─did the stone provide any new insights that might help us fend off the plague?
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_12: Oh, Master Quinfort! You will see for yourself once we raise it to the surface, but let me tell you what I saw with my own eyes!

Pictured provident-ly in the center was none other than the great serpent itself! Atop its head sat a gloriously large and fluffy green mass. Before the serpent, a man in Ronkan garb raised his hands in sheer julib-ation!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_129: Glorious! This is incontrovertible proof that the divine protector guided our ancestors to enlightenment just as it guides us today!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_13: Sadly, Father is in no condition to share with us his thoughts on the carvings─but no matter! With the stela in im-pec-ulate condition, I am confident that my in-pertritation is the correct one!
Yes, there can be no doubting it! With a mighty “scree!”, the great serpent did bestow upon the Ronkan people a giant tuft of grass-green fluff, which cured them of a dreadful pox!
No doubt it is to guide us to this very knowledge─the cure that would save our people─that the great serpent appeared before me!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_133: Truly! The great serpent works in mysterious ways, but there can be no doubting that what happened here today was none other than a divine miracle!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_134: Ally of Ronka or no, I will entertain no wild theories or speculation about what has happened here today. The great serpent has granted us a miracle, and we must show proper obeisance!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_135: If I might be so bold as to expand upon your insight, young Chaqurl, I believe I can identify precisely that miraculous object which the serpent did carry on his blessed pate.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_136: Verily, this can be none other than that greatest blessing of Rak'tika─Ronkan moss, which grows so verdant and lush in our forest home!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_137: If I recall from my studies, Ronkan moss can be harvested from numerous sources, but in particular certain rocks found in the Husk, upon which it grows in great abundance.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_100_137: If I recall from my studies, Ronkan moss can be harvested from numerous sources, but in particular certain species of tree found in the Husk, upon which it grows in great abundance.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_200_137: If I recall from my studies, Ronkan moss can be harvested from numerous sources, but in particular from a species of turtle found in the Red Chalice, upon whose shell it grows in great abundance.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_13: , ally of Ronka! You have my word that this is the last time I will impose upon you. Might you be so kind as to go forth in search of the moss that will save my people?
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_139: Splendid! And I, young Chaqurl, will make for Fanow. The Viis will doubtless have insight to share on how to brew the moss into a proper elixir.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_14: I am deeply og-bliged to you, my friends. I will tend to Father and pray that his condition has not worsened in the meantime. Until we meet again!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_15: The great serpent has spoken! The moss will heal Father and our friends once and for all─I am sure of it!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QUINFORT_000_151: Does my encyclopedic knowledge of Ronkan flora surprise you? For it should not. Valan and I used to run about in the forest and collect rare shrubs and fronds since we were knee-high to a wood raider.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_LANILLE_000_152: So the fourth stela has been found. Welcome tidings in these trying times, indeed. If there is aught we can do to aid our Qitari friends, you need but say the word.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_PHYNA_000_154: Ronkan moss, you say? I fear that it does not grow in these parts. I pray that you find it, and find it swiftly─the fate of the forest depends upon it.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CIUNA_100_154: A type of moss that holds the power to heal the sick? I cannot help but wonder if this was one of the many wonders birthed by Ronkan mastery of the arcane.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_15: Did you find the moss, friend? Oh, please say you did!
Splendid! Splen-fid-erous! Why, it looks just as it did on the stela! We must prepare the medicine at once...
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_SYSTEM_000_110: Following the method illustrated by the carvings on the fourth stela, the Stewards brewed an elixir from the Ronkan moss, and distributed it to their ailing friends. Before long, the symptoms eased, and a brighter mood returned to the Stopple.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_SYSTEM_000_111: No longer lacking for manpower, Chaqurl Qhotl and his friends built a workshop where the medicine could be produced in large quantities to be distributed across the Greatwood.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_113: Ahem! Reports have it that our friends in Slitherbough and Fanow are well on their way to making a complete recovery. All of Rak'tika truly is in your debt, . I have no words to express my gratitude...
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_11: You have my grad-atude as well, ! And we must not forget the great serpent, who guided us to the cure! Speaking of which...where did it go?
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_115: It is not our place to question the workings of the divine, my boy. No doubt it felt its role here was done, and returned to a place where only the gods know.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_11: Does that mean─<sniff>─I'll never see it again?
Did I hear what I think I heard!?
The serpent returns to us! Or...perhaps it was watching over us from behind the stela all along?
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_120: Doubtless so, Chaqurl. Indeed...the great serpent truly does work in mysterious ways.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_SYSTEM_000_121: And so it was that the Qitari reclaimed the history and knowledge of their forefathers, and in so doing, played their role in returning peace to the Greatwood─just as foreseen by a certain prognosticating priest. All was according to the great serpent's plan...or was it?
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_161: Ah, . I cannot thank you enough for all you have done on behalf of my boy─no, on behalf of all the Stewards.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_162: You will be pleased to know that we have succeeded in producing the mossy brew in large quantities. Any fears of a plague sweeping through the Greatwood are well behind us.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_16: Did you ever find out what caused the disease, Father?
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_164: It is difficult to say for certain, but I do have a theory. Plants, blossoms, and trees abound in the Greatwood, all possessing their own seeds and spores─some of which can be quite poisonous.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_165: Lesser poisons exist as well. In that case, one might build up an immunity if one lives for long enough in their presence. At the same time, different areas of the wood are home to different flora, each bearing their own poisons.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_16: And so, living for a hundred years far away from this place, you say we have a different...in-num-ity than our friends in Slitherbough and Fanow?
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_167: Precisely, my boy. More precisely, we carry an element of the poison within us, and it is this which protects us from their harmful effects.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_168: The downside of this, of course, is quite clear. When these poisons are carried to a new place, where others are not accustomed to them, the selfsame thing that protects us from their effects can have harmful effects on others─just as the poisons our own bodies are unaccustomed to can harm us.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_16: So, the sickness...it was all our fault for coming here?
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_170: Perhaps...and perhaps not. We are not the only ones who traveled here when the path through the Ravel was opened. We Qitari, the creatures of the forest we saw on our way...doubtless the spread of the pox was inevitable.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_171: And besides, in coming here, we have rediscovered a powerful elixir fashioned by our forefathers─one that we might use to prevent any further outbreaks of disease among those who call the Greatwood home.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_172: Looking back, I suspect that matters such as these were a source of great consternation in the days of the empire, when peoples moved about the Greatwood often and in droves.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_173: No doubt this is why it was the Ronkans who discovered the cure─with the guidance of their divine protector, of course.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_17: The same divine protector who remembers well the events of those days, and who led us back to the remedy it had shared with our forefathers so many years ago.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_175: The fourth stela has been reclaimed, and with it, another piece of our heritage. And yet, the Qitari did not do this alone...
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_176: You, ally of Ronka. Your friends Quinfort and Valan. Our loyal allies among the Viis. All played a part in making this day happen. Given our peoples' mutual histories, it is perhaps fitting─wouldn't you say, Chaqurl?
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_17: In-tube-itably! At long last, I understand how people must have felt in the days of Ronka, when our peoples cooperated and lived together in a great cil-ivization!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_QITARLNATL_000_178: The wisdom of our forefathers has saved us today. But we must not rest easy. We must continue to learn and record our experiences, that our own wisdom might serve those who follow in our footsteps.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_17: There is still much that I would study as well! Pray come back to visit us, my friends─I would be happy to share with you all the wonderful things I am sure to learn!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_100_17: After all, while the serpent with the hat has gone off somewhere, the helmeted one remains with us. Surely, this is a sign that there is still much to explore in the tunnels below!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_CHAQURLQHOTL_200_17: After all, why would it remain with us if there were not additional pathways and passages through which it seeks to guide us? Oh, I can hardly wait to see what may yet be unearthed!
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_SYSTEM_000_180: You have achieved Sworn reputation with the Stewards.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_SYSTEM_000_182: Yet more embodiments of the great serpent have taken up residence in Hopl's Stopple. They appear quite pleased to see the Qitari stelae restored to their former glory.
TEXT_BANQIQ005_03798_SYSTEM_000_184: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from Yuqurl Manl.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_00: Oh, ! On behalf of all the Stewards, I thank you for your tireless efforts. You have our sincere glad-itude!
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_006: Indeed. We Qitari must bear the responsibility of having spread the pox to these parts of the forest. Finally, we have brought this painful chapter of our history to a close─and we could not have done so without your invaluable aid.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_007: At first, I feared we might damage our relations with the Night's Blessed and the Viis beyond repair. Instead, we have managed to overcome the plague together, and in doing so, the time-tested bonds between our peoples are stronger than ever before.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_00: I travel to Slitherbough and Fanow all the time to share tidings from the forest with my newfound friends!
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_010: And with the guidance of the great serpent, we have reclaimed long-lost knowledge─not just of our own kind, but of great Ronka itself.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_011: In studying the restored stela, I have had occasion to reflect and ruminate on the history of the empire. It truly was a great civilization, controlling and exerting influence over all of ancient Norvrandt.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_012: The Ronkans ruled the land with an iron fist, and thought little of subjugating other peoples through force. And yet, by uniting myriad races under their banner, the empire did much to ensure peace and prosperity for its citizens.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_013: Yet, as Ronka continued to grow, there emerged more and more those who grew dissatisfied with life under the rule of the throne.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_014: No doubt, that was eventually what brought about its downfall. After all, even the greatest power will not last forever─just as even the mightiest tree will one day fall.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_015: It was a civilization of great enlightenment, welcoming myriad peoples and uniting them under a single banner to live in peace and prosperity.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_016: Hume and Viis, Qitari and Ronso─living side by side and working towards a common good, the artistic and academic accomplishments of the empire were many. And yet this─its greatest strength─would also prove its downfall...or so my theory holds.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_017: As the empire expanded and the years went on, once-strong friendships and alliances began to turn sour. Small disagreements flared into all-out conflicts, and Ronka, once akin to a mighty tree that seemed as if it would stand forever, began to splinter from within...
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_018: I imagine Ronka in its final years, withered and dying. No doubt the emperor sat on his throne, waiting in vain for the arrival of one who would restore his empire to its former glory. Waiting for the ally of Ronka...
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_01: Compared to the long and storied history of Ronka, my own three years seem as in-fig-nificant as a drop of water in a great and gushing river.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_020: I understand the sentiment, my boy, but it is not so.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_021: While the lifespan of any one Qitari may be short, we must never underestimate the value of our shared knowledge and wisdom, accumulated through our many experiences and recorded for the sake of posterity.
