TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_022: Just as our forefathers did their part to shape the course of Ronkan history, so, too, will the discoveries you have made serve to forge the future of our people─and the Greatwood itself.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_023: But we must not forget our friends and allies, without whose aid we may not have survived to see this day. Might I trust you to convey our gratitude to them on my behalf, Chaqurl?
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_02: But of course, Father! Consider our glad─no, gratitude conveyed!
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_025: Hoho! Ever learning, I see. , might I trust you to escort my son to Fanow? I would not be able to forgive myself if anything unfortunate happened to him on this day of triumph.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_02: Come, ! Master Lanille will be overjoyed to see us, I'm sure!
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_03: And to think the Viis all but scared my whiskers off when we first met! I must say, I'm happy to call them friends today.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_PHYNA_000_031: The Qitari excavation was a success, and the sickness that plagued the forest has all but subsided? These are good tidings indeed. So why is it that I cannot help but feel a bit...sad?
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CIUNA_000_032: What I would not give to see the stelae with my own eyes! Sadly, at the moment, my duties keep me here.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_LANILLE_000_035: It pleases me to hear that all is well at the Stopple. We are honored to have done our small part to be of service to our Qitari friends. Never did I think I would live to see this age-old alliance of Ronka rekindled.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_03: For us as well, Master Lanille! From ancient rituals to the remedies that eased our pain in trying times, there is so much wisdom that we learned from you. I am certain that this is only the start of a long and fruitful friendship!
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_LANILLE_000_037: You are wise beyond your years, my young friend, and there is much that you and your people have already taught us.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_LANILLE_000_038: Promise that you will continue to share with us your gleanings from history, that we might put them to use ourselves in protecting and preserving our forest home.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_PHYNA_000_040: All's well that ends well, yes? And now, I do believe the time has finally come that I stop tarrying and take to the road.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_04: Are you going somewhere, my good madam Phyna?
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_PHYNA_000_042: I will depart on a journey that has been far too long in the making. I intend to travel beyond the Greatwood's reaches in search of Viis who live scattered across the land, that they might join us here in Rak'tika to together preserve and pass down the wisdom of Ronka.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_PHYNA_000_043: Fanow has always been my home, and it will not be easy for me to leave it behind. And yet I will leave with the knowledge that the forest is in good hands. Promise me that you will not let Ciuna get into too much trouble, yes?
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CIUNA_000_044: I daresay you are the one who needs looking after, Sister. Perhaps I should accompany you?
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_PHYNA_000_045: Hah! Rest assured, I am more than capable of taking care of myself.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_LANILLE_000_046: Forgive me if I refrain from stepping in the midst of this sibling squabble. Go in safety, Phyna, and know that the azure blooms will always guide you home.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_PHYNA_000_047: Thank you, Master Lanille. I will return.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_PHYNA_000_048: And with that, I had best be off...before I find another reason to delay my journey any longer. Young Chaqurl, ...promise me that you will be well.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_PHYNA_000_050: And you as well, Ciuna. No matter how far my journey may carry me, know that a part of me is always here with you.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_05: <sniff> Saying good-bye is not easy, is it? But it is time we returned to the road again ourselves. We must pay our respects to Valan and Quinfort, after all.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_LANILLE_000_053: Very well. We will not keep you any longer. Do pass along our respects to our friends in Slitherbough. I was not certain what to think of that Quinfort at first, but he has proved a loyal friend.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_05: But of course! Should you ever have time, do come visit Father and I. Nothing would make me happier than to be able to show you around the Stopple!
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_LANILLE_000_055: The Qitari, the Night's Blessed... The empire may have fallen, but it would seem Ronka has as many allies today as ever. I am truly blessed to have been able to live to see this day.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CIUNA_000_056: It won't be the same with Sister away, but she shall return someday. In the meantime, there is no time to sit around feeling lonely─I will have to work harder than ever to protect our forest from those who would cause it harm.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QUINFORT_100_060: In addition to the medicine, I offered an invocation to the great serpent in the name of each and every one of the afflicted. Judging from the spring in Valan's step, I daresay my prayers were heard!
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_100_06: Master Valan! Are you certain you should be up and about like this?
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_VALAN_100_065: Have no worries, my little friend. I'm feeling like my old self again. I hear that all is well again in the Stopple, too─that's truly a relief.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_VALAN_100_066: I shudder to think of what would have happened to all of us here in the Greatwood if you hadn't made your discovery. Truly, we owe a debt of gratitude to your ancestors and their wisdom.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QUINFORT_100_067: And truly, we all owe a debt to the Great Serpent of Ronka, by whose divine auspices young Chaqurl was led to the stela on which the cure was inscribed! Yes, praise be to the serpent! Praise be!
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_VALAN_100_068: <sigh> Do you think you could keep your voice down a bit? Some of us are still recuperating from a life-threatening plague, you know.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_VALAN_100_069: Speaking of which, Chaqurl...whatever made you think that little fellow was the great serpent in the first place? When Quinfort first started rambling on to that end, I thought he'd finally lost the last of his wits.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_100_07: An excellent question, Valan─and one I have been giving some thought to myself. Father had always told me tales of how the Ronkans worshipped a great serpent as their guardian and protector, but there were no clear records of its physical appearance.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_07: On the night that darkness returned to the skies, the small creature we now know well arrived before us wearing that curious hat.
Intrigued, I followed after it. It led me through the Ravel, where I saw that the passage to our an-central homeland was at long last open once more.

Jumping for joy, I picked the small creature up and ran home to share the news with Father. With a tear in his eye, he gazed at me deeply and spoke these words: “The great serpent itself has arrived to guide us home.” In that moment, I knew it must be so.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QUINFORT_000_074: A moment of divine inspiration, no doubt, and not altogether unlike my own! Yes, this is most fascinating, indeed.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QUINFORT_000_075: In my own case, the great serpent has appeared before me in my visions for as long as I can remember. Time and again, it shared with me the words of wisdom that I have so dutifully recorded as the Gospel of Quinfort.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QUINFORT_000_076: One day, it called out to me with a terrifying scree, warning of a great calamity that was to befall the Greatwood if I did not rise to action. It was shortly after that we came upon that tiny creature in the forest, and I recognized it immediately as the incarnation of our divine protector.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QUINFORT_000_077: It is clear now that all was leading up to this day. Its first appearance in my visions, our meeting─all has been part of the great serpent's grand design to restore peace, harmony, and prosperity to the forest!
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_07: Truly, we would never have been able to rediscover our history, nor overcome the spread of the plague were it not for the serpent's guidance and wisdom.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QUINFORT_000_079: Clearly, your forefathers revered the great serpent, as well. Why else would they have engraved it atop the final stela, buried deepest and furthest from the sin eaters' reach?
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QUINFORT_000_080: Now, this immaculately preserved stela stands before us as incontrovertible proof that this tiny creature is indeed that which we all instinctively perceived it to be─the manifestation of Ronka's divine protector who hath come once more in our time of need to guide our peoples through trying times and into a new generation of peace and prosperity!
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QUINFORT_000_082: Last time, after its work was done, the great serpent left us, going off to some place where only gods dare to tread.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_VALAN_000_083: Actually, it's just been following  about on  adventures, you know...
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QUINFORT_000_084: What nonsense is this, Valan? Clearly, the great serpent has been watching over us all this time.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QUINFORT_100_084: In any event, it is clear that we owe the serpent a debt of gratitude. It would be remiss for us not to make a pilgrimage to a site where we might properly pay obeisance.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_08: I would like nothing more than to pay o-seib-ance, Master Quinfort...but there is no telling where the serpent has gone. Where might we go that it might hear our words?
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QUINFORT_000_086: Fear not, my young Qitari friend, for I know just the place. The ancestral slumbering place of the great serpent─the mighty crystal that has appeared before me time and again in my visions.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QUINFORT_000_087: I speak of none other than Fruit of the Protector, cradled amidst the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta. Valan and I make the trek there nigh every day to express our gratitude to the great serpent for deigning to share its divine guidance with us.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_VALAN_000_088: Don't look at me like that, . I didn't go every time, and when I did it was just to keep Quinfort here out of trouble!
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_08: And just how should we go about expressing our glad-itude to the great serpent?
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QUINFORT_000_090: An astute question, my young friend! If you wish, I would be happy to share with you some choice passages from the Gospel of Quinfort that would be most suitable for the occasion. For example, there is chapter fifteen, verse five, which begins as follows: “O, hearken unto the heavenly scree...”
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_VALAN_000_091: Never mind Quinfort's ramblings. I'm sure the serpent would appreciate it all the more if you thanked it in your own words. And so would the rest of us...trust me.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_09: Er...thank you, Valan. I believe I will do just that.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QUINFORT_000_095: Ah, but of course! How could I forget chapter nine, verse eleven!? And chapter two, verse two! Oh, if only I had the time to share the entire gospel with my Qitari friend!
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_VALAN_000_096: I was afraid Quinfort's ramblings would go to Chaqurl's head, but the boy seems to have a good head on his shoulders.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_06: Well, here I am. But...what words can truly convey my feelings to the great serpent?
Perhaps I should just keep it simple. Yes...
O great serpent! Thank you ever so much for watching over us! You have my most sincerest glad-itude!

It was by your guidance that my people have reclaimed our history, and that I have made so many new friends and allies! I promise that we will never forget you, and to pass down tales of you for generations and generations to come!
Do...do you think the serpent heard my words?
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_10: When the crystal glimmered and glowed, it almost felt like it was speaking to me. Do you believe this means the serpent heard my words?

At the very least, I take heart in knowing that I have conveyed my thanks to the serpent, and to all of our new friends throughout the forest. And with this, I can return to Father and the Stopple with my head held high.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_115: I cannot thank you enough for accompanying my son throughout the forest. To the end, you have gone above and beyond on our behalf. It is a debt of gratitude the Qitari will not soon forget.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_116: In reclaiming our heritage and history, we have also rekindled time-honored bonds of friendship with our fellow residents of Rak'tika.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_117: The Night's Blessed, the Viis, the great serpent...and not the least of all, , ally of Ronka─all have played a part in events that will be etched in the annals of history.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_100_118: Yes, the Stewards shall see to it that these events are handed down to our children, and our children's children, and so on until long after we ourselves are gone. You have our word.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_118: In the meantime, we shall continue our excavation of the tunnels beneath the Stopple. I have even considered commissioning the creation of a new stela, on which all we have gleaned in recent days may be recorded for posterity.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_11: Father and I might not have seen eye to eye in our in-pert-tretations of history, but I can assure you that we are of a like mind regarding the future we would forge for our people!
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_QITARLNATL_000_120: <sniff> Oh, how you have grown, Chaqurl! It nigh brings a tear to my eye...
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_12: Thank you for everything, ! I know that there are many places you must journey, but know that you will always have a home here in the Stopple! Is that not so, O great serpent?
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_SYSTEM_000_130: You have achieved Bloodsworn reputation with the Stewards.
TEXT_BANQIQ006_03799_SYSTEM_000_131: You will receive an experience point bonus upon completion of the Qitari society daily quests.
TEXT_BANQIQ021_03800_QITARLNATL_000_001: Weathered as they are, the meaning behind the engravings on the first stela are quite clear. The first Ronkan emperor subjugated our ancestors by force and conscripted them into service.
TEXT_BANQIQ021_03800_QITARLNATL_000_002: There can be no doubting this. Surely you agree that my theory is far more logical than the faerie tale proposed by my son, yes?
TEXT_BANQIQ021_03800_SYSTEM_000_003: If you elect to vouch for Qitarl Natl's theory, the stela will be restored to reflect his interpretation of history. Proceed, and you will be unable to view the stela as Chaqurl Qhotl envisions it.
TEXT_BANQIQ021_03800_SYSTEM_000_004: The rewards you receive and the content of the quests to follow will be the same regardless of the choice you make. You are free to choose the version of history you find most compelling.
TEXT_BANQIQ021_03800_Q1_000_000: Will you lend your support to Qitarl Natl's theory of Ronkan history?
TEXT_BANQIQ021_03800_QITARLNATL_000_006: Splendid! I was quite certain that we would see eye to eye. With the ally of Ronka vouching for my theory, surely my fellow Qitari will be convinced of its accuracy.
TEXT_BANQIQ021_03800_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_00: If you are so convinced, then... Well, perhaps Father is right after all. In any event, I would be honored to assist in the restoration of the stela!
TEXT_BANQIQ021_03800_QITARLNATL_100_008: At long last, the task of restoring our ancestors' legacy can begin in earnest! Good , pray remain with us and see our life's work through to the end!
TEXT_BANQIQ021_03800_QITARLNATL_000_008: Without further ado, I shall call for the Stewards' most skilled artisans. Let the restoration begin at once!
TEXT_BANQIQ021_03800_SYSTEM_000_010: The first stela has been restored, its engravings now clearly reflecting Qitarl Natl's theory of Ronkan subjugation.
TEXT_BANQIQ021_03800_SYSTEM_000_011: Protected by the talisman fashioned for them by the Night's Blessed and heartened by rediscovering a piece of their heritage, the Stewards now pursue their excavation efforts with newfound zeal. Should you choose, continue to aid them in their cause.
TEXT_BANQIQ021_03800_SYSTEM_100_010: The first stela has been restored, its engravings now clearly reflecting Chaqurl Qhotl's theory of Ronkan beneficence.
TEXT_BANQIQ021_03800_SYSTEM_100_011: Protected by the talisman fashioned for them by the Night's Blessed and heartened by rediscovering a piece of their heritage, the Stewards now pursue their excavation efforts with newfound zeal. Should you choose, continue to aid them in their cause.
TEXT_BANQIQ022_03801_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_00: Father may have his reasons for thinking as he does, but I choose to believe in a brighter version of history.

Yes, I am quite certain that the Ronkan emperor was a benevolent man who protected our ancestors from fearsome beasts and bestowed upon them a position of honor in their society. Surely you can agree?
TEXT_BANQIQ022_03801_SYSTEM_000_003: If you elect to vouch for Chaqurl Qhotl's theory, the first stela will be restored to reflect his interpretation of history. Proceed, and you will be unable to view the stela as Qitarl Natl envisions it.
TEXT_BANQIQ022_03801_SYSTEM_000_004: The rewards you receive and the content of the quests to follow will be the same regardless of the choice you make. You are free to choose the version of history you find most compelling.
TEXT_BANQIQ022_03801_Q1_000_000: Lend your support to Chaqurl Qhotl's theory of Ronkan history?
TEXT_BANQIQ022_03801_CHAQURLQHOTL_100_00: Oh, thank you! I am most glad to know that you are a cup-half-full type like myself!
TEXT_BANQIQ022_03801_QITARLNATL_000_006: I cannot help but feel my boy is too optimistic for his own good, and yet... If you would choose to believe his theory, good , there is no reason why I cannot do the same.
TEXT_BANQIQ022_03801_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_00: At long last, I can look upon the history of my people in all its glory! But our work is far from over. Pray continue to lend us your aid!
Father and I will send for our finest artisans. The work must begin at once!
TEXT_BANQIQ031_03802_QITARLNATL_000_001: History is full of cruelties and harsh truths. While my boy would propose a starry-eyed view of our past, I prefer to face reality with my eyes wide open.
TEXT_BANQIQ031_03802_QITARLNATL_000_002: The Viis and Qitari forged a friendship trusted and true. Acknowledging the unpleasant nature of our first encounter allows us to appreciate that all the more. Surely you agree, ?
TEXT_BANQIQ031_03802_SYSTEM_000_003: If you elect to vouch for Qitarl Natl's theory, the stela will be restored to reflect his interpretation of history. Proceed, and you will be unable to view the stela as Chaqurl Qhotl envisions it.
TEXT_BANQIQ031_03802_SYSTEM_000_004: The rewards you receive and the content of the quests to follow will be the same regardless of the choice you make. You are free to choose the version of history you find most compelling.
TEXT_BANQIQ031_03802_Q1_000_000: Lend your support to Qitarl Natl's theory?
TEXT_BANQIQ031_03802_QITARLNATL_000_005: Excellent. I was quite certain that you would see things my way. With the ally of Ronka vouching for my theory, I'm certain Chaqurl and my fellow Qitari will see the light.
TEXT_BANQIQ031_03802_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_00: Do you truly think so? Then perhaps there is something to Father's theory after all... In any event, the choice has been made, and I am happy to do what must be done.
TEXT_BANQIQ031_03802_QITARLNATL_000_007: Splendid, my boy! And with that, let the restoration of the second stela begin! Good , do stay with us and help us see our mission through to the end.
TEXT_BANQIQ031_03802_QITARLNATL_000_008: I shall summon the artisans! Oh, but I can scarcely wait to see another piece of our history take form!
TEXT_BANQIQ031_03802_SYSTEM_000_010: The second Qitari stela has been restored to depict Qitarl Natl's interpretation of the first encounter between the Qitari and the Viis.
TEXT_BANQIQ031_03802_SYSTEM_000_011: Protected by the new altar erected according to the traditions of the Viis and heartened by rediscovering another piece of their heritage, the Stewards have returned to their excavation efforts with newfound zeal. Should you choose, continue to aid them in their cause.
TEXT_BANQIQ031_03802_SYSTEM_100_010: The second Qitari stela has been restored to depict Chaqurl Qhotl's interpretation of the first encounter between the Qitari and the Viis.
TEXT_BANQIQ031_03802_SYSTEM_100_011: Protected by the new altar erected according to the traditions of the Viis and heartened by rediscovering another piece of their heritage, the Stewards have returned to their excavation efforts with newfound zeal. Should you choose, continue to aid them in their cause.
TEXT_BANQIQ032_03803_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_00: You, too, saw how Master Lanille welcomed us when we visited Fanow, yes? Why, it is simply post-preperous to think that the friends of my great-great-great─and so on─grandmothers and grandfathers hunted us like vermin!
Yes, I am quite certain that the Viis were our friends from the earliest of days. The Qitari in the markings is meant to be raising his hands in sheer joy. Surely you agree?
TEXT_BANQIQ032_03803_SYSTEM_000_003: If you elect to vouch for Chaqurl Qhotl's theory, the second stela will be restored to reflect his interpretation of history. Proceed, and you will be unable to view the stela as Qitarl Natl envisions it.
TEXT_BANQIQ032_03803_SYSTEM_000_004: The rewards you receive and the content of the quests to follow will be the same regardless of the choice you make. You are free to choose the version of history you find most compelling.
TEXT_BANQIQ032_03803_Q1_000_000: Lend your support to Chaqurl Qhotl's theory?
TEXT_BANQIQ032_03803_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_00: Spli-fen-derous! Oh, thank you, . I knew you would see things as I did!
TEXT_BANQIQ032_03803_QITARLNATL_000_006: You believe my son has the right of it? Well...I suppose there is something to be said for adopting a brighter view of history. Very well, let us proceed with the restoration.
TEXT_BANQIQ032_03803_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_00: At long last, another piece of our history comes into focus! But our struggle to reclaim our legacy goes on. Pray continue to lend us your aid!
Father and I will send for our finest artisans. The work must begin at once!
TEXT_BANQIQ041_03804_QITARLNATL_000_001: The meaning of the markings on the third stela could not be more clear. Our forebears went to war with the catfish people over control of the fishing grounds.
TEXT_BANQIQ041_03804_QITARLNATL_000_002: With the might of the great Ronkan Empire on our side, we drove those slimy creatures out of the Greatwood once and for all, and never were their kind seen again. Truly a triumphant day in history, would you not agree?
TEXT_BANQIQ041_03804_SYSTEM_000_003: If you elect to vouch for Qitarl Natl's theory, the stela will be restored to reflect his interpretation of history. Proceed, and you will be unable to view the stela as Chaqurl Qhotl envisions it.
TEXT_BANQIQ041_03804_SYSTEM_000_004: The rewards you receive and the content of the quests to follow will be the same regardless of the choice you make. You are free to choose the version of history you find most compelling.
TEXT_BANQIQ041_03804_Q1_000_000: Speak out in favor of Qitarl Natl's theory?
TEXT_BANQIQ041_03804_QITARLNATL_000_005: Magnificent! I knew that a wise and impartial observer such as you would see things as I did.
TEXT_BANQIQ041_03804_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_00: I would rather not think of our ancestors as aggressors...and yet, perhaps there is truth to what Father says. If this is your decision, I will learn to accept it.
TEXT_BANQIQ041_03804_QITARLNATL_000_007: That is most mature of you, my boy. And with that, let us begin the restoration of the stela without further ado. You, too, are curious to see what form it takes, are you not? Do stay around for a while.
TEXT_BANQIQ041_03804_QITARLNATL_000_008: And with that, I shall call for the artisans. Oh, what a splendiferous day this has turned out to be!
TEXT_BANQIQ041_03804_SYSTEM_000_010: The third Qitari stela has been restored to depict Qitarl Natl's interpretation of the history between the Qitari and the ill-fated catfish people.
TEXT_BANQIQ041_03804_SYSTEM_000_011: Outfitted with supplies and conveniences brought by the Night's Blessed, Hopl's Stopple is more hospitable than ever before. Rejoicing in their newfound comfort, the Qitari have returned to their excavation effort with renewed energy and enthusiasm. One can only imagine what marvelous discoveries are yet to come!
TEXT_BANQIQ041_03804_SYSTEM_100_010: The third Qitari stela has been restored to depict Chaqurl Qhotl's interpretation of the history between the Qitari and the ill-fated catfish people.
TEXT_BANQIQ041_03804_SYSTEM_100_011: Outfitted with supplies and conveniences brought by the Night's Blessed, Hopl's Stopple is more hospitable than ever before. Rejoicing in their newfound comfort, the Qitari have returned to their excavation effort with renewed energy and enthusiasm. One can only imagine what marvelous discoveries are yet to come!
TEXT_BANQIQ042_03805_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_00: Father may interpret the markings differently, but I am certain that my ancestors were not so cruel and violent as he would say. When famine struck the forest, we Qitari took pity on the catfish people, and shared with them our freshest catches!

That they vanished from the Greatwood after this is a pity, but I know that our forefathers did all they could to save their slippery little friends. This is most definitely, most in-tubit-ably the case, do you not agree?
TEXT_BANQIQ042_03805_SYSTEM_000_003: If you vouch for Chaqurl Qhotl's theory, the third stela will be restored to reflect his interpretation of history. Proceed, and you will be unable to view the stela as Qitarl Natl envisions it.
TEXT_BANQIQ042_03805_SYSTEM_000_004: The rewards you receive and the content of the quests to follow will be the same regardless of the choice you make. You are free to choose the version of history you find most compelling.
TEXT_BANQIQ042_03805_Q1_000_000: Lend your support to Chaqurl Qhotl's theory?
TEXT_BANQIQ042_03805_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_00: Mag-fin-icent! I knew we shared a like mind, you and I.
TEXT_BANQIQ042_03805_QITARLNATL_000_006: Perhaps the boy is right, and history is at times not so cruel as it may seem at a glance. In any event, if you truly find his version of events more compelling, I see no reason to object.
TEXT_BANQIQ042_03805_CHAQURLQHOTL_000_00: Spli-fen-derous! And with that, let's get the restoration of the third stela started! You'll stick around to see that everything is done right, won't you? Whenever you are ready to begin, just say the word!
Are you ready, ? Then Father and I shall call for our best artisans at once!
TEXT_BANQIQ101_03806_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: Rigorously as we work, we quickly wear down our tools until there's nothing left save the hilt. And a tool with only a hilt is no tool at all, I'm sure you'll agree.

To be sure, not all of our implements have hilts, but the point stands that we need to replace them quite regularly. And it's my responsibility to ensure that we always have the materials with which to make them.
TEXT_BANQIQ101_03806_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: To that end, I'd be much obliged if you could mine for me, shall we say, three chunks of iron ore. They can be found in the Blind Forest of Yx'Maja. My thanks in advance, good .
TEXT_BANQIQ101_03806_QHOTERLPASOL_000_02: To that end, I'd be much obliged if you could gather for me, shall we say, three clumps of flax. They can be found in the Blind Forest of Yx'Maja. My thanks in advance, good .
TEXT_BANQIQ101_03806_QHOTERLPASOL_000_03: To that end, I'd be much obliged if you could catch a clawbow for me. They're native to the Blind Forest of Yx'Maja, and I'm given to understand that fruit worms make the best bait. My thanks in advance, good .
TEXT_BANQIQ101_03806_QHOTERLPASOL_100_01: Remember, it's three chunks of iron ore I require. You will find them in the Blind Forest of Yx'Maja. My thanks in advance, good .
TEXT_BANQIQ101_03806_QHOTERLPASOL_100_02: Remember, it's three clumps of flax I require. You will find them in the Blind Forest of Yx'Maja. My thanks in advance, good .
TEXT_BANQIQ101_03806_QHOTERLPASOL_100_03: Remember, it's a clawbow I require. They're native to the Blind Forest of Yx'Maja, and I'm given to understand that fruit worms make the best bait. My thanks in advance, good .
TEXT_BANQIQ101_03806_QHOTERLPASOL_000_05: Jolly good, you're returned. And with the requested item, I trust?
TEXT_BANQIQ101_03806_QHOTERLPASOL_000_06: My, such splendid chunks of ore these are! They shall make the sturdiest shovels and pickaxes, oh yes!
TEXT_BANQIQ101_03806_QHOTERLPASOL_000_07: My, such splendid clumps of flax these are! They shall make the sturdiest rope, oh yes!
TEXT_BANQIQ101_03806_QHOTERLPASOL_000_08: My, such a splendid specimen of clawbow this is! Their sturdy pincers can find use in many a tool, oh yes. My gratitude, good !
TEXT_BANQIQ101_03806_QHOTERLPASOL_000_09: Thanks to your kind assistance, we have all that we require for now, but we'll have need of more before long. I hope that you'll lend us your procuring expertise again.
TEXT_BANQIQ102_03807_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: The underground caverns we explore are terribly dark places. Without some manner of illumination, we couldn't see our own whiskers, never mind go about our digging.
TEXT_BANQIQ102_03807_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: Would you be so kind, good , as to mine for me some flint in the K'mul Astropolis? The stones are necessary for striking a fire. Three or so should suffice splendidly.
TEXT_BANQIQ102_03807_QHOTERLPASOL_000_02: Would you be so kind, good , as to gather for me some plant seeds in the K'mul Astropolis? From them we can extract an oil which we use as lamp fuel. Three bags' worth should suffice splendidly.
TEXT_BANQIQ102_03807_QHOTERLPASOL_000_03: Would you be so kind, good , as to catch for me a trout in the Red Chalice? From them we can extract an oil which we use as lamp fuel.
TEXT_BANQIQ102_03807_QHOTERLPASOL_100_01: Oh, there you are. May I ask how the flint stones are coming along? You'll have the best luck searching in the K'mul Astropolis.
TEXT_BANQIQ102_03807_QHOTERLPASOL_100_02: Oh, there you are. May I ask how the seeds are coming along? You'll have the best luck searching in the K'mul Astropolis.
TEXT_BANQIQ102_03807_QHOTERLPASOL_100_03: Oh, there you are. May I ask how the trout is coming along? You'll have the best luck searching in the Red Chalice.
TEXT_BANQIQ102_03807_QHOTERLPASOL_000_04: Welcome back,  . Dare I hope you've obtained that which I seek?
TEXT_BANQIQ102_03807_QHOTERLPASOL_000_05: Ah, splendid! This shall serve us well for several outings!
As you may have heard, we Qitari do not see as well as some other peoples, and must rely on such things to help us find our way in the dark. For this gift of sight, you have my heartfelt thanks.
TEXT_BANQIQ103_03808_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: Ours is a large undertaking, and we expect to be hunkered down here for a good long while. That being the case, I've a mind to add some creature comforts to the Stopple.
, I'd be in your debt if you could procure a few things to help me make this place a home away from home.
TEXT_BANQIQ103_03808_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: Specifically, I require three slabs of slate. These can be had in the depths of Lake Tusi Mek'ta. Many thanks, , and happy digging!
TEXT_BANQIQ103_03808_QHOTERLPASOL_000_02: Specifically, I require three lengths of water ivy. These can be had in the depths of Lake Tusi Mek'ta. Many thanks, , and happy gathering!
TEXT_BANQIQ103_03808_QHOTERLPASOL_000_03: Specifically, I require an eryops. They dwell in the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta, and are passing fond of fruit worms. Many thanks, , and happy fishing!
TEXT_BANQIQ103_03808_QHOTERLPASOL_100_01: While there's no avoiding getting a little wet, the slate ought not pose you too much trouble. I await your return with bated breath!
TEXT_BANQIQ103_03808_QHOTERLPASOL_100_02: While there's no avoiding getting a little wet, the water ivy ought not pose you too much trouble. I await your return with bated breath!
TEXT_BANQIQ103_03808_QHOTERLPASOL_100_03: So long as you use fruit worms as bait, the eryops ought not pose you too much trouble. I await your return with bated breath!
TEXT_BANQIQ103_03808_QHOTERLPASOL_000_04: Ah, there you are, . May I ask if you have that which I requested?
TEXT_BANQIQ103_03808_QHOTERLPASOL_000_05: Yes, this is absolutely splendid! My gratitude!
By making the Stopple more comfortable, our workers will be better rested. And a rested worker is a productive worker! Oh yes, perhaps we can look into extending the length of shifts...
TEXT_BANQIQ104_03809_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: Digging is whisker-warping work, as I'm sure you will agree. If one is to keep at it day in and day out, one must have good, nourishing meals.

If you're willing,  , might I trouble you to bring some ingredients so that I can prepare a hearty meal for everyone? My Chaqurl, in particular, is still a growing boy, and few things please me more than to see his belly full and round.
TEXT_BANQIQ104_03809_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: For the dish I plan to make, I still require three ant eggs. If you search in the vicinity of Mjrl's Regret, you should be able to dig them up readily enough.
TEXT_BANQIQ104_03809_QHOTERLPASOL_000_02: For the dish I plan to make, I still require three silkworms. If you search in the vicinity of Mjrl's Regret, you should be able to gather them readily enough.
TEXT_BANQIQ104_03809_QHOTERLPASOL_000_03: For the dish I plan to make, I still require a robber crab. If you fish at the Lozatl using fruit worms, I daresay they'll bite readily enough.
TEXT_BANQIQ104_03809_QHOTERLPASOL_100_01: Three ant eggs ought to suffice for the dish I plan to make. If you search in the vicinity of Mjrl's Regret, you should be able to dig them up readily enough.
TEXT_BANQIQ104_03809_QHOTERLPASOL_100_02: Three silkworms ought to suffice for the dish I plan to make. If you search in the vicinity of Mjrl's Regret, you should be able to gather them readily enough.
TEXT_BANQIQ104_03809_QHOTERLPASOL_100_03: One robber crab ought to suffice for the dish I plan to make. If you fish at the Lozatl using fruit worms as bait, I daresay they'll bite readily enough.
TEXT_BANQIQ104_03809_QHOTERLPASOL_000_05: How fares the procuring effort, good ?
TEXT_BANQIQ104_03809_QHOTERLPASOL_000_06: Ah, splendid! I shall stew these eggs with spices and serve them with cornbread.
A delectable combination, as my Chaqurl will attest. He doesn't leave so much as a single crumb behind!
TEXT_BANQIQ104_03809_QHOTERLPASOL_000_07: Ah, splendid! Plump and fresh as they are, these silkworms are best prepared simply─fried and salted.
If there's a way to my husband's stomach, I can say with confidence that this dish is it. The shine in his eyes doesn't lie!
TEXT_BANQIQ104_03809_QHOTERLPASOL_000_08: Ah, splendid! I shall boil this crab whole with vegetables and serve it with steamed grains!
I'm not too proud to admit that this is my personal favorite. Ah, the mere thought of it makes my mouth water... <slurp>
TEXT_BANQIQ104_03809_QHOTERLPASOL_000_09: Without further ado, I shall set about preparing the meal. We are all in for a treat, and it is thanks to you, good !
TEXT_BANQIQ105_03810_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: Thanks to Master Valan's kind introduction, we were able to establish friendly relations with the good folk of Slitherbough.
To mark the occasion, we presented them with our special fertilizer. So happy were they with the gift, they asked if they could have more!
Oh yes, we now have an arrangement in place where we provide fertilizer to the settlement in exchange for fresh vegetables.
If you're not otherwise occupied,  , would you mind taking some fertilizer and using it on the crops at Slitherbough? When you have finished, please report to a woman named Ersabel.
TEXT_BANQIQ105_03810_ERSABEL_000_010: Qhoterl Pasol sent you to fertilize our crops, did she? My thanks for your trouble.
TEXT_BANQIQ105_03810_ERSABEL_000_011: I know not how the Qitari make the stuff, but in all my years, I've not seen any fertilizer work as effectively as theirs.
TEXT_BANQIQ105_03810_ERSABEL_000_012: It makes our vegetables grow like a charm, and we're all too happy to share the harvest with our Qitari friends. Please see this delivered to them.
TEXT_BANQIQ105_03810_ERSABEL_000_020: My thanks again for the fertilizer. Please see that the vegetables are delivered to Qhoterl Pasol.
TEXT_BANQIQ105_03810_QHOTERLPASOL_000_03: Welcome back, good . May I ask if you have the vegetables?
My, such splendid crops these are, fairly bursting with the land's vitality! They're a blessing from Dalan Himself!
Everyone will be overjoyed for this treat─my dear husband not least of all!
TEXT_BANQIQ106_03811_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: Once we descend into the caverns, you'll appreciate that it isn't always practical to return to the surface to satisfy every bodily whim.
In light of this, I provide our workers with some rations to take with them, and I'd be grateful if you could assist me by obtaining an ingredient.
TEXT_BANQIQ106_03811_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: Scorpions are what I require─three ought to do nicely. You will find them if you search in the Husk.
TEXT_BANQIQ106_03811_QHOTERLPASOL_000_02: Wild berries are what I require─three handfuls ought to do nicely. You will find them growing in the Husk.
TEXT_BANQIQ106_03811_QHOTERLPASOL_000_03: A piranha is what I require─just one ought to do nicely. You will find them swimming in the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta, but you'll need to be handy with a spear.
TEXT_BANQIQ106_03811_QHOTERLPASOL_000_04: As they say,  , one can't work on an empty stomach─much less when one isn't down in the caverns. So please, bring me the ingredient.
TEXT_BANQIQ106_03811_SYSTEM_100_040: In order to proceed with this quest, you must first complete the quest “A New Fishing Ex-spear-ience” and unlock spearfishing.
TEXT_BANQIQ106_03811_QHOTERLPASOL_100_01: That's three scorpions I require, good . You will find them if you search in the Husk.
TEXT_BANQIQ106_03811_QHOTERLPASOL_100_02: That's three handfuls of wild berries I require, good . You will find them growing in the Husk.
TEXT_BANQIQ106_03811_QHOTERLPASOL_100_03: That's a piranha I require, good . You will find them swimming in the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta.
TEXT_BANQIQ106_03811_QHOTERLPASOL_000_05: Welcome back,  . Did your procurement efforts meet with success?
TEXT_BANQIQ106_03811_QHOTERLPASOL_000_06: Oho, such lively scorpions these are! And this one almost stung me, the cheeky fellow! But it won't be stinging anyone after I've fried it up to a crisp, oh no.
TEXT_BANQIQ106_03811_QHOTERLPASOL_000_07: Oho, such plump, juicy berries these are! I shall press them to make invigorating drinks for our workers in the event they can't readily find groundwater.
TEXT_BANQIQ106_03811_QHOTERLPASOL_000_08: Oho, such a lively piranha this is! And it almost took a bite out of me, the cheeky fellow! But it won't be biting anyone after I've cleaned out its guts and hung it up to dry, oh no.
TEXT_BANQIQ106_03811_QHOTERLPASOL_000_09: With that, I shall set about the preparations at once. My thanks for your kind assistance, good !
TEXT_BANQIQ107_03812_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: You're doubtless aware,  , that we Qitari possess eminently keen noses. Even in pitch-black darkness, we can discern one of our own from another and locate them.

However, the caverns we explore can be filled with strange gases that confuse our sense of smell. To cut through this haze, we've taken to using a special perfume, which I would concoct with your assistance.
TEXT_BANQIQ107_03812_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: At Mjrl's Regret, it is possible to find amber─a key ingredient in the perfume. Will you not mine three pieces for me?
TEXT_BANQIQ107_03812_QHOTERLPASOL_000_02: At Mjrl's Regret, it is possible to find lavender─a key ingredient in the perfume. Will you not gather three sprigs for me?
TEXT_BANQIQ107_03812_QHOTERLPASOL_000_03: In the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta dwells a fish called the pirarucu─a key ingredient in the perfume. Will you not catch one for me?
TEXT_BANQIQ107_03812_QHOTERLPASOL_000_04: That will suffice to make a goodly batch of the stuff to help keep us safe during our explorations. Much obliged, good !
TEXT_BANQIQ107_03812_SYSTEM_100_040: In order to proceed with this quest, you must first complete the quest “A New Fishing Ex-spear-ience” and unlock spearfishing.
TEXT_BANQIQ107_03812_QHOTERLPASOL_100_01: It is possible to find amber at Mjrl's Regret. I'd be much obliged if you could obtain three pieces for me.
TEXT_BANQIQ107_03812_QHOTERLPASOL_100_02: It is possible to find lavender at Mjrl's Regret. I'd be much obliged if you could obtain three sprigs for me.
TEXT_BANQIQ107_03812_QHOTERLPASOL_100_03: It is possible to find pirarucu in the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta. I'd be much obliged if you could catch one for me.
TEXT_BANQIQ107_03812_QHOTERLPASOL_000_05: <sniff> <sniff> You've returned with what I seek, and no mistake. Now, if I might examine it...
TEXT_BANQIQ107_03812_QHOTERLPASOL_000_06: My, such a potent smell! This will serve most splendidly, oh yes!
With a spot of refining, it will make a scent that is unmistakable in the caverns. Hehe, 'tis time once again to put my skills as a perfumer to use!
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: During one of our recent outings, we came upon some lovely jadeite adornments. The stones each bear an etching of a Viis, which marks them as relics of the Ronkan Empire.
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_QHOTERLPASOL_100_00: As a gesture of friendship, I've a mind to present them to the good folk of Fanow, but I believe that the gift would be all the more meaningful coming from you, the ally of Ronka.
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: I should be so very grateful were you to deliver these three adornments in my stead, good .
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_TILMET_000_010: Greetings, ally of Ronka. Is there something you require? ...A gift for me, you say?
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_TILMET_000_020: Well now, this is indeed a surprise. In the times of the empire, such jadeite adornments symbolized magical might.
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_TILMET_000_021: They were prized items, and I am honored to receive it. Pray pass my regards to our friends of the Qitari.
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_TILMET_000_030: Oh, another adornment? I know not what I've done to deserve such kindness, but I'm thankful nonetheless.
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_OLMET_000_040: Well met, honored ally. What brings you to Fanow this day?
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_OLMET_000_050: ...Hm. Unless I am mistaken, this adornment was crafted in ancient times to commemorate the friendship between our people and the Qitari.
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_OLMET_000_051: The whorled pattern enclosing the Viis symbolizes eternity─a prayer for enduring harmony, I shouldn't doubt.
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_OLMET_000_052: This is a gift of no less than a piece of history, and I am duly grateful for it. My heartful thanks to our Qitari friends.
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_OLMET_000_060: Oh, you wish to give me another one of these? Far be it from me to decline the generosity of our Qitari friends. My thanks.
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_SHOINA_000_070: Hm? You have something for me, you say?
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_SHOINA_000_080: My, such a lovely adornment this is. To simply gaze upon it makes me feel closer to our ancestors.
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_SHOINA_000_081: Please give the Qitari my thanks, and tell them that they may call upon me in times of need.
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_SHOINA_000_090: Oh, another one of these lovely adornments. Please give the Qitari my thanks, and tell them that they may call upon me in times of need.
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_TILMET_000_100: I am honored for the gift. Pray pass my regards to our friends of the Qitari.
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_OLMET_000_101: This is a gift of no less than a piece of history. My heartful thanks to our Qitari friends.
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_SHOINA_000_102: Please give the Qitari my thanks, and tell them that they may call upon me in times of need.
TEXT_BANQIQ108_03813_QHOTERLPASOL_000_11: Ah, welcome back,  . May I ask how the adornments were received?
...Splendid, splendid. Should we chance to unearth more, I will be certain to make gifts of them again.
TEXT_BANQIQ109_03814_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: Thanks to the protective enchantments of the Night's Blessed, we may carry out our exploration without fear of fiends. Of course, enchantments are wont to lose effect over time, and when that happens, we must be prepared to protect ourselves.
To that end, I intend to concoct a potent poison, and I would be most grateful if you could obtain an ingredient for me.
TEXT_BANQIQ109_03814_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: Chalcanthite is what I require, and it can be mined at the Husk. Three clusters or so should be suitable for our purposes.
TEXT_BANQIQ109_03814_QHOTERLPASOL_000_02: Tarantulas are what I require, and they can be found at the Husk. Three or so should be suitable for our purposes.
TEXT_BANQIQ109_03814_QHOTERLPASOL_000_03: A poison catfish is what I require, and it can be caught at Mjrl's Tears with a fruit worm on your hook. A single creature should be suitable for our purposes.
TEXT_BANQIQ109_03814_QHOTERLPASOL_000_04: Please bring me the three chalcanthite clusters I require to make my poison. Remember, they can be mined at the Husk.
TEXT_BANQIQ109_03814_QHOTERLPASOL_000_05: Please bring me the three tarantulas I require to make my poison. Remember, they can be found at the Husk.
TEXT_BANQIQ109_03814_QHOTERLPASOL_000_06: Please bring me the poison catfish I require to make my poison. Remember, they can be caught at Mjrl's Tears with a fruit worm on your hook.
TEXT_BANQIQ109_03814_QHOTERLPASOL_000_07: Pleased for your return, good . Were you successful in procuring the ingredient I requested?
TEXT_BANQIQ109_03814_QHOTERLPASOL_000_08: Splendid, my thanks for your kind cooperation. Lest you wonder, the poison works by robbing fiends of their movement. Applied to dart tips, it won't slay outright, but it will afford us an opportunity to retreat to safety.
Of course, I pray that our people needn't resort to such measures at all. May merciful Dalan ever bless us and keep us safe from harm.
TEXT_BANQIQ110_03815_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: Underground caverns can be frightfully dangerous, you know! The workers are constantly tripping over and grazing their snouts and whatnot.

Thankfully, the Viis were kind enough to share a recipe for a salve that works wonders for scrapes and cuts. If you're not terribly busy, I was wondering if you'd help gather some of the necessary ingredients?
TEXT_BANQIQ110_03815_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: For now, I need some mineral oil, which you should be able to find near the K'mul Astropolis. There's no rush, but sooner is always infinitely preferable to later!
TEXT_BANQIQ110_03815_QHOTERLPASOL_000_02: For now, I need some greenwattle, which you should be able to find near the K'mul Astropolis. There's no rush, but sooner is always infinitely preferable to later!
TEXT_BANQIQ110_03815_QHOTERLPASOL_000_03: For now, I just need a piece of pondfrond, which grows in the Lozatl. It's rather difficult to find, but a fruit worm will lead you right to it. By all accounts, they're drawn to the smell!
TEXT_BANQIQ110_03815_QHOTERLPASOL_000_04: How are those ingredients coming along?
TEXT_BANQIQ110_03815_QHOTERLPASOL_000_05: How are those ingredients coming along?
TEXT_BANQIQ110_03815_QHOTERLPASOL_000_07: I can tell by the spring in your step you've met with some success. Come along then, let's see what you've brought me!
TEXT_BANQIQ110_03815_QHOTERLPASOL_000_08: Splendid! With this, I'll have a fresh batch of ointment ready in no time at all, though I cannot help but feel that, in this case, prevention would be better than cure.
Perhaps if the workers could refrain from injuring themselves at every given opportunity, there wouldn't be such high demand for the stuff. Until then, I may have need to call on your talents again!
TEXT_BANQIQ111_03816_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: We Qitari are experts at weaving clothes, bags, and so on, which we decorate in the traditional manner using various colors.
But with so many of us preoccupied with excavating the caves, we've had little time to gather the raw ingredients for producing the dyes we need.
TEXT_BANQIQ111_03816_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: Were an altruistic volunteer to bring me a small quantity of purple pigment, I think a reward of some sort would be in order.
TEXT_BANQIQ111_03816_QHOTERLPASOL_000_02: Were an altruistic volunteer to bring me a small quantity of turmeric, I think a reward of some sort would be in order.
TEXT_BANQIQ111_03816_QHOTERLPASOL_000_03: Were an altruistic volunteer to bring me a spiralshell, I think a reward of some sort would be in order. And were said volunteer to use fruit worms as bait, I'm sure they'd snag one in a jiffy!
TEXT_BANQIQ111_03816_QHOTERLPASOL_000_04: The Blind Forest of Yx'Maja would be an excellent place to begin your search, but watch out for beasties, especially those tarichuks. Oh, I can't stand them!
TEXT_BANQIQ111_03816_QHOTERLPASOL_000_05: The Blind Forest of Yx'Maja would be an excellent place to begin your search, but watch out for beasties, especially those tarichuks. Oh, I can't stand them!
TEXT_BANQIQ111_03816_QHOTERLPASOL_000_06: The southern part of Mjrl's Regret is where you're most likely to find one, but don't let those caracals catch you by surprise!
TEXT_BANQIQ111_03816_QHOTERLPASOL_000_07: Do you have something for me, by any chance? I'm dye-ing to see it! <snort>
TEXT_BANQIQ111_03816_QHOTERLPASOL_000_08: With this, we'll be able to bring a touch of Ronkan elegance to our textiles. The patterns with which we adorn ourselves come from their ancient culture, you see.
Those that feature a pair of straight, parallel lines represent harmony, whereas spirals are a symbol of the never-ending cycle of nature, for example.
Perhaps you would consider wearing some of our traditional garments yourself? I think you'd look rather fetching in one of our hats!
TEXT_BANQIQ112_03817_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: Sometimes I wish I didn't have such a sensitive nose. When the workers come back from the caves, they carry with them the most pungent of odors! It really is quite unbearable!

Unfortunately, even a thorough scrubbing with warm water does little to remove the stench. I fear there is little choice but to resort to a rarely used treatment, and as you can imagine, the ingredients required are also rather rare themselves...
TEXT_BANQIQ112_03817_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: First, I'll need roughly three pinches of natron. Your cooperation will be most appreciated, I assure you!
TEXT_BANQIQ112_03817_QHOTERLPASOL_000_02: First, I'll need roughly three marimo. Your cooperation will be most appreciated, I assure you!
TEXT_BANQIQ112_03817_QHOTERLPASOL_000_03: First, I'll need a sponge, the living sort, but you'll need to hook the little scoundrel with your spear as they're far too crafty to take any bait. Your cooperation will be most appreciated, I assure you!
TEXT_BANQIQ112_03817_SYSTEM_100_040: In order to proceed with this quest, you must first complete the quest “A New Fishing Ex-spear-ience” and unlock spearfishing.
TEXT_BANQIQ112_03817_QHOTERLPASOL_000_04: Oh! I forgot to mention that you'll need to dive into the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta to find it!
TEXT_BANQIQ112_03817_QHOTERLPASOL_000_05: Oh! I forgot to mention that you'll need to dive into the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta to find them!
TEXT_BANQIQ112_03817_QHOTERLPASOL_000_06: It seems that Lake Tusi Mek'ta is relatively free of large, flesh-eating beasts, so your chances of being devoured alive are actually quite low! Welcome news, I'm sure!
TEXT_BANQIQ112_03817_QHOTERLPASOL_000_07: Have you brought what I asked for? Please say you have!
TEXT_BANQIQ112_03817_QHOTERLPASOL_000_08: Marvelous! Once the concoction is ready, those reeking reprobates will be the very pinnacle of cleanliness in just a few scrubs!
At the top of my list of candidates are my husband and son. Their combined stench is enough to curdle milk!
TEXT_BANQIQ113_03818_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: We've uncovered all sorts of precious relics, although some are in better condition than others.
As such, many of these artifacts are in desperate need of repair, which is where our special adhesive comes in particularly handy. Sadly, we've just run out, and need to prepare a fresh batch.
TEXT_BANQIQ113_03818_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: If you're feeling charitable, could I trouble you for a few lumps of clay? I'd be ever so grateful for any assistance you can provide!
TEXT_BANQIQ113_03818_QHOTERLPASOL_000_02: If you're feeling charitable, could I trouble you for a few trilliums? I'd be ever so grateful for any assistance you can provide!
TEXT_BANQIQ113_03818_QHOTERLPASOL_000_03: Cockles are an essential ingredient in the mixture, but they're rather difficult to catch, so you'll need to get close and use a spear or some such to prise it from the rock. I'd be ever so grateful for any assistance you can provide!
TEXT_BANQIQ113_03818_SYSTEM_100_040: In order to proceed with this quest, you must first complete the quest “A New Fishing Ex-spear-ience” and unlock spearfishing.
TEXT_BANQIQ113_03818_QHOTERLPASOL_000_04: I'm told there are ample amounts in Mjrl's Regret, which is not the easiest of places for us Qitari to reach. Presumably you have some means of getting there more quickly?
TEXT_BANQIQ113_03818_QHOTERLPASOL_000_05: I'm told there are ample amounts in Mjrl's Regret, which is not the easiest of places for us Qitari to reach. Presumably you have some means of getting there more quickly?
TEXT_BANQIQ113_03818_QHOTERLPASOL_000_06: I'm told that Lake Tusi Mek'ta is positively lousy with the things, though we Qitari are not especially well suited to swimming in deep water. We're just too buoyant for our own good!
TEXT_BANQIQ113_03818_QHOTERLPASOL_000_08: Oh my, this is perfection itself! Those priceless pots shall remain shattered no longer!

While some may argue that the relics should be kept as we find them, I'd much rather see them restored to their original state, as the ancient Ronkans intended them. Besides, who would want to look at a pile of broken fragments?
TEXT_BANQIQ114_03819_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: The Morning Stars are protected by all sorts of Ronkan-built guardians, living statues that keep intruders at bay.

Since we're also striving to preserve their legacy, I think it's only fair to have them defend us while we explore the caverns! If you were to say “la-hee” to one of the dolls that lie dormant, it would surely heed your call and spring to our aid!
TEXT_BANQIQ114_03819_SYSTEM_000_010: The Ronkan doll rests in silence.
TEXT_BANQIQ114_03819_SYSTEM_000_011: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter “la-hee” to wake up the sleeping doll.
TEXT_BANQIQ114_03819_QHOTERLPASOL_000_03: It's a miracle! The guardian has arrived! In fact, it clambered down into the caverns just before you got here, and is no doubt shooing off whatever might threaten our workers.
Best of all, now that it's awake, it will continue patrolling without rest or need to be fed. Perhaps we can even get it to assist in the excavation itself...
TEXT_BANQIQ114_03819_QHOTERLPASOL_000_04: The ancient word of power you spoke, “la-hee,” actually means “wake up” in the Ronkan tongue, but was also used as a greeting.
It is said that those favored by the gods can even hear the voice of the ancients, carried on the wind as they travel through the Greatwood. Perhaps you have had such an experience yourself?
TEXT_BANQIQ115_03820_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: Goodness me! I may not look it, but I'm incredibly busy. Just keeping track of the recent discoveries is enough to make my head spin! Not to mention all the maps and charts we draw...
That's why I have to make detailed records of everything, and we only use traditional methods passed down from the Ronkans.
I'll need several chunks of graphite, which we'll grind down and use to produce ink. Fear not, the reward will make it worth the trouble, I assure you!
I'll need several tarichuk feathers, which we'll use for writing quills. Fear not, the reward will make it worth the trouble, I assure you!
I'll need a silver kitten, whose skin is used in the ink-making process. Fear not, it's a type of fish, not an actual kitten! I must say, it's rather fortunate I remembered to mention that...
The Blind Forest is where we usually go to gather things like that, but none of the others can spare the time...
The Blind Forest is where we usually go to gather things like that, but none of the others can spare the time...
Our fishers usually go to the Red Chalice with a bucket of fruit worms to catch them, but I'm afraid you're the only one who can spare the time...
TEXT_BANQIQ115_03820_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: Oh, I am glad to see you safe and sound. I hope you didn't run into any trouble on my account!
Splendid! That's exactly what I was after! It won't be long before I'll have a brand-new set of writing supplies, with which I shall scrawl away to my heart's content!

Other than unearthing lost treasures, we Qitari love nothing more than keeping records of our achievements. Even those too young to write can often be seen drawing maps of the places they've visited. Adorable, isn't it?
TEXT_BANQIQ116_03821_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: Our Viis friends have presented us with an enormous haul of venison as a sign of their appreciation for our work. The only problem is, there's so much of it, we'll need to smoke the meat before it goes rotten!
Could I be awfully impertinent and ask you to bring me some rock salt? Sprinkling it on the meat beforehand draws out the rich, gamy flavors!
Could I be awfully impertinent and ask you to bring me some tree bark? Naturally, only the most splendid will suffice.
Could I be awfully impertinent and ask you to spear me a Night's bass? It may not be the most obvious choice, but apparently, smoking it together with the deer meat helps to preserve it.
If I could tear myself away from my duties here, I'd probably start by searching around the K'mul Astropolis. Something about the place simply screams “splendid,” wouldn't you agree?
If I could tear myself away from my duties here, I'd probably start by searching around the K'mul Astropolis. Something about the place simply screams “splendid,” wouldn't you agree?
If I could tear myself away from my duties here, and I had even the slightest inkling of how spearfishing works, I'd probably try my luck at Lake Tusi Mek'ta.
TEXT_BANQIQ116_03821_SYSTEM_000_007: In order to proceed with this quest, you must first complete the quest “A New Fishing Ex-spear-ience” and unlock spearfishing.
TEXT_BANQIQ116_03821_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: Have you brought that which I requested? Time is of the essence!
My word, this is splendid! Just the fragrance alone makes me want to gobble it all up, even without the venison...
Ah, of course, that would rather defeat the purpose of having you rush around before the meat spoils. And we wouldn't want the Viis' generous gift to go to waste, now, would we?
TEXT_BANQIQ117_03822_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: The workers have been experiencing all manner of difficulties of late. Worst among them are the cave-ins, which lead to cracked skulls and blocked tunnels. While we're still working on a solution to the former, we at least have a plan for the latter: explosives!
I'll spare you the details, but to make our destruction-dealing devices, we'll need a smattering of saltpeter. Any you can provide will be gratefully received!
I'll spare you the details, but to make our destruction-dealing devices, we'll need a smattering of mugwort. Any you can provide will be gratefully received!
I'll spare you the details, but to make our destruction-dealing devices, we'll need a magmatongue. A generous serving of fruit worms on your hook, and they'll be jumping at the chance to be caught!
The Husk is the place most likely to have what we seek, though I must warn you, it's rather a long trip from here.
The Husk is the place most likely to have what we seek, though I must warn you, it's rather a long trip from here.
While they tend to move from place to place, a large number was seen at Mjrl's Tears recently. Perhaps that would be a suitable location to begin your search?
TEXT_BANQIQ117_03822_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: Do you have what I need to try my hand at making explosives?

Ah, yes. This is just what I was looking for. Probably. Once it's been combined with grasses, saltpeter, charcoal, sulphur, and just a tiny splash of urine─not mine, I might add─we should be ready to blast through that rubble!
To be quite frank, I've not much experience in this sort of thing, but it seems like that I can eventually perfect it through trial and error. After all, what is the worst that could happen?
TEXT_BANQIQ118_03823_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: I must say, the workers are doing a tremendous job of excavating all those relics, though I can't help but notice that some of them are beginning to flag, to varying degrees.
What they need is motivation! Luckily, I have a cunning plan... Uterl Matl has already agreed to assist me, so pray speak with him to learn what it entails.
TEXT_BANQIQ118_03823_UTERLMATL_000_010: Greetings, my good ! I take it you are here at Qhoterl Pasol's request, yes? The truth is, we have uncovered a rather bizarre artifact in the deeper levels of the cavern. An urn, but one like no other.
TEXT_BANQIQ118_03823_UTERLMATL_000_011: For inside was, for want of a more grandiose word, a whistle. Or perhaps it was a flute... Whatever it is, one brave soul took it and played a brief melody, and a moment later, something appeared within the otherwise empty vessel: the great serpent itself!
TEXT_BANQIQ118_03823_UTERLMATL_000_012: Why, I could hardly believe my eyes, but what happened next was perhaps even more miraculous. Our divine visitor did release a heavenly light, and those who did receive of this blessing were as Qitari reborn, filled with vigor! Now, listen carefully...
TEXT_BANQIQ118_03823_UTERLMATL_000_013: I pray this  finds you well, my good ! I trust you are ready to continue efforts to invigorate our workforce?
TEXT_BANQIQ118_03823_UTERLMATL_000_014: By using the sacred whistle, you are to guide the great serpent to my fellows and grace them with its mystical light. I shall be praying for your success, my most esteemed and gracious comrade!
TEXT_BANQIQ118_03823_UTERLMATL_000_015: You have been chosen by the great serpent itself to act as its earthly emissary! Truly, there is no greater honor.
TEXT_BANQIQ118_03823_TIREDQITARI_000_020: Good heavens above! I have never felt so alive!
TEXT_BANQIQ118_03823_VAGUEQITARI_000_021: Blessing of the great serpent itself, eh? Can't say I've done much to deserve it, but I'll take it all the same. Praise be!
TEXT_BANQIQ118_03823_TIREDQITARI_000_022: Don't we have enough relics by now? What are we planning to do with them all anyway?
TEXT_BANQIQ118_03823_VAGUEQITARI_000_023: Shirking my duties? Never! I'm just resting my legs. And my eyes.
TEXT_BANQIQ118_03823_SYSTEM_000_024: Some of the Qitari workers are struggling to find motivation. Guide the great serpent and release its peculiar light.
TEXT_BANQIQ118_03823_UTERLMATL_000_025: Your sacred duty is complete? May the gods smile upon you, good ! No doubt Qhoterl Pasol will be as pleased as I to hear these most fortuitous of tidings.
TEXT_BANQIQ118_03823_QHOTERLPASOL_000_03: I trust all went according to my─if I may say so─brilliant plan? It seems word of your exploits has spread quickly, and the other workers are all doing their utmost to unearth yet more relics!

As for the questions surrounding our divine benefactor and the reasons for its involvement, the great serpent moves in mysterious ways. Sometimes, it'll wiggle. Other times, it'll bob up and down and let out a mighty “scree!” Yes, we are truly blessed.
TEXT_BANQIQ119_03824_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: Greetings, good ! Our excavation proceeds apace, and just recently our workers unearthed a tablet inscribed with an ancient song.
Oh, don't look so bewildered! Music has ever been a beloved pastime of the Qitari. As a matter of fact, this relic contains one of our great epics, immortalized in a captivating melody.

I would see this culturally significant piece performed once again, that it may live on in the hearts of our children, and their children's children, and thus return to the rich tapestry of our history. And that, , is where you come in.
Three holey stones from the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta ought to serve my needs. No two of these stones has holes in the same place, and the right ones make splendid flutes.

I require three stalks taken from plants found in the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta. Hollow on the inside, they should produce just the sound we need to bring this melody to life. Don't worry about the name, you'll know them when you see them.
Catch a treescale, which dwells in the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta. Their shells can be used to make all manner of instruments.
While you may think it an instrument of a primitive sort, a stone flute can produce sounds most pleasing to the ear. The holey stones found in Lake Tusi Mek'ta are ideal for making them.
Hollow stalks from the plants found in Lake Tusi Mek'ta make ideal wind instruments, and can produce a range of sounds to accompany most any refrain.

The shells of the treescale─which are common in Lake Tusi Mek'ta─are versatile materials for crafting of all sorts, and musical instruments are no exception. And be sure to take some fruit worms to use as bait!
TEXT_BANQIQ119_03824_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: Ah, you're returned! I trust you've what I requested?

Yes, this will do splendidly! There is naught as stirring as an expertly crafted melody─even the Ronkans showed obeisance to Ox'Charl by composing songs of worship, that the moon and sky might remain firmly in their place.
Music honors the gods eternal while also making timeless our most epic tales. And I daresay it is ever so slightly more entertaining than a dry narrative, wouldn't you agree?
Perhaps soon we'll put the deeds of the Warrior of Darkness to song, so that none forget the turnings of fate that restored night to the world.
TEXT_BANQIQ120_03825_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: These stone tablets are among the Stewards' most revered relics. However, nature holds a somewhat less sentimental view of them, and so it falls to us to keep the elements from diminishing their splendor.

If we wish for our children and our children's children to look upon the stones with the same sense of awe that we do now, we must have tools to maintain them. If you would aid me in crafting such instruments, I would be forever in your debt.
Polishing the tablets with gravel would ensure that their luster never fades. I'm informed that you can find it strewn about Mjrl's Regret.

Fallen leaves and dust must be cleared away diligently, or soon the tablets would be swallowed by nature's detritus. With broombush from Mjrl's Regret to sweep the dust away, this daily chore should go by all the quicker.

The tablets must be scoured regularly, lest their sheen wane and they become indistinguishable from a common slab of rock. The hard scales of the pipira─quite common in the Lozatl─are well suited to this task. Don't forget to take fruit worms!

Whether it be on the morrow or one thousand summers from now, I wish to see every tablet as radiant as the histories contained within. Gravel mined from Mjrl's Regret should help us achieve this goal.
Nature's castoffs would bury us all if left unchecked. Broombush from Mjrl's Regret should aid us in staving off this constant threat.
To keep the tablets immaculate for generations, we must scour them regularly. Pipira from the Lozatl possess scales that will endure this task for moons to come.
TEXT_BANQIQ120_03825_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: You have the look of someone who's been gathering to  heart's content! Please tell me you managed to procure the materials I asked for in your fervor.

I knew I was right to count on you! My days of late have been filled with sweeping, polishing, and generally worrying over the condition of the tablets. I daresay these new materials will allow me to speed through my chores!
Finally I'll have time to rest my aching knees and throbbing wrists. This work is taxing, 'tis true, but the thought of my ancestors enjoying the fruits of my labor─our labor─makes it all worthwhile.
TEXT_BANQIQ121_03826_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: What splendid timing! We've just unearthed what appears to be a map pinpointing the location of a treasure left by our forebears. If I'm reading this correctly, it's somewhere near the Deliberating Doll...

Would that I could spare the time to dig for it myself, but alas, my work here is endless. However, I'm fortunate enough to know one enterprising  with a singular talent for gathering! I would be ever so grateful if you brought this piece of our heritage back to me.
TEXT_BANQIQ121_03826_SYSTEM_000_010: You dig until you hit something solid, and after dusting off the dirt you see it is a coffer of Ronkan design. This must be the treasure Qhoterl Pasol sent you to find.
TEXT_BANQIQ121_03826_QHOTERLPASOL_000_02: Did you find it!? Oh, I can scarce imagine what wonders our forebears left for us!

Hmm... Most unusual...most fascinating! The seal adorning this box dates back to the time of the Ronkans─one can only guess at exactly how long ago it was buried. Perhaps its contents will provide a clue.
Oh! Did you hear that? It sounded as if something was moving inside. Let's see...

Oh no. Oh dear. I fear we've made a grave mistake. I must return this whence it came, lest we invite calamity upon ourselves and all Qitari to come. Needless to say, but if you value your life at all, do not dig this box back up!
Ah! A tablet from the age of Ronka! Now, what does it say...
Fascinating. It seems to be an inventory of the spirits provided to the workers during the construction of this temple. And by the looks of it, the libations flowed freely!
Some things never change. It is often at the bottom of an empty bottle where we find the resolve to endure the most arduous tasks. My husband finds that resolve nightly, hah hah!
Goodness gracious! Chestnuts─a veritable hoard of them! Entirely too many for me to eat on my own, of course. Here, take some.
TEXT_BANQIQ121_03826_QHOTERLPASOL_000_03: Wait! On second glance, these are rotten to the core and appear to be dry as a bone besides. Lucky for you I noticed in time, or you would've been in for an uncomfortable night. Here, I'll dispose of these for us. No, no, I'll do it myself.
Well then, now wasn't that an experience! Perhaps not exactly what either of us was expecting, but nonetheless I look forward to seeing what further secrets the earth holds.
TEXT_BANQIQ122_03827_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: Good day,  ! You look to be the well-traveled sort─have your journeys taken you to the Great Pyramid of Ux'ner?

I ask because one of the noble Viis told me of the owl statues housed within the pyramid, equipped with deadly traps meant to deter even the most intrepid grave robbers. Upon hearing the story, I was struck with inspiration.

I realized these very ruins could be equipped with such measures! Our surroundings are positively lousy with vicious beasts, and a few clever traps would go a long way to set everyone's mind at ease. Could I trouble you to assist me in making them?
The device I have in mind will make use of the latent energies stored within magical stones. If you would bring me some from the K'mul Astropolis, I would be ever so grateful.
The device I envision will make use of the latent energy stored in the nuts strewn about the K'mul Astropolis. I would be ecstatic if you could gather some and bring them to me.

I have designed a device which makes use of the potent energy stored within the pearls of the shellfish dotting Mjrl's Tears. While fishing them up from the depths may seem a daunting task, use fruit worms as bait and you'll be done before I even have a chance to miss you.
The latent power stored within the stones littered about the K'mul Astropolis ought to be just what I need. I'll wait here patiently until you return.
The nuts flourishing near the K'mul Astropolis are bursting with arcane energy, which should make for a trap as deadly as it is delicious.

The pearls that can be found in Mjrl's Tears are seeping with arcane energy, which should make for a sufficiently potent trap. Please go and snag some shellfish─but remember to use fruit worms when you do!
TEXT_BANQIQ122_03827_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: You're back! Do you have the materials I asked for? Please say yes─I can feel the fiends encroaching further by the moment!

Ah, yes, dangerous and breathtaking! With these I'll fashion an arcane scarecrow that is as lethal as its visage is menacing! I mustn't make it too bone-chilling, of course, lest my Chaqurl soil himself in terror! Hah!
TEXT_BANQIQ123_03828_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: Under the great serpent's auspices, we've been able to treat a range of common diseases. However, prevention is worth a ponze of cure, and so I mean to do all within my power to ensure our workers are in tip-top shape.

Our workers venture daily into the unknown and risk life and limb in the pursuit of our shared history. Needless to say, it is of the utmost importance that they remain hale and hearty. After all, we won't make much progress if our workers are dropping like flies!
To that end, I plan on cooking up something that will fortify their bodies against the most persistent of ailments. Would you aid me in gathering the ingredients I require?

The rocks dotting the Blind Forest of Yx'Maja may not themselves be edible, but the worms which make their homes in them are practically meals unto themselves! They would make a splendid feast for my workers, and for myself besides!
The lush woods of the Blind Forest of Yx'Maja are a bounty of nutritious plants and delectable treats. The honey from beehive chips can help the body stave off an otherwise debilitating illness.

The Red Chalice is brimming with wildlife both dangerous and nourishing. Let's stick with the latter and go fishing, eh? Some trout should suffice─their eggs are said to bolster the mind and gird the body. Don't forget to bring fruit worms!
Hurry off to the Blind Forest of Yx'Maja. Or go leisurely, so long as you return with worms!
The Blind Forest of Yx'Maja awaits with its bounty. Take your fill, so long as you return with some beehive chips for me!

No need to face down snarling fiends today, my friend. Simply pluck a trout plump with eggs from the waters of the Red Chalice and bring it here. Don't expect to catch anything without fruit worms, however!
TEXT_BANQIQ123_03828_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: There you are! Did you have any trouble procuring the ingredients I requested?
Ah, I feel reinvigorated just by looking at such a splendid specimen! Whatever it is I end up cooking out of this, I aim to make it the talk of the camp!
TEXT_BANQIQ124_03829_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: The other day residents from Slitherbough brought a gift most divine─chicken eggs! And let me tell you, to say that their flavor was transcendent hardly begins to describe the experience!

I had scarce tasted the first egg when I knew we must have more. Being the enterprising Qitari that I am, I've arranged to exchange our precious stones for their precious eggs. One of nature's bounties for another─a capital bargain if I do say so myself!
We have already delivered our first cache of stones, but someone must pick up the eggs from Slitherbough. If you would be so kind, I'll ensure that you're handsomely compensated!
TEXT_BANQIQ124_03829_POULTRYFARMER03829_: I take it you're here about the eggs, then? I'd love to give them to you, but I'm afraid I've run into a snag. One of my chickens fled the coop, you see, clucking like the sky itself was falling down!
Gods only know where she is now, but I reckon I'd find her quicker if I had another set of eyes looking for her. What say you? Lend a hand and I'll give you the pick of my best eggs!
If you catch sight of her, use this sack to scoop her up. I'll stay around the village, while you go ahead and look around the outskirts─I reckon you might hear her before you see her!
I've searched everywhere, but I haven't seen hide nor down of that pesky bird. I hope you've had better luck than me.
Ah, that's her all right! You're a godssend! I was worried she'd been gobbled up whole by some bigger animal. She always lays the best eggs─it would've been a tragedy to lose her.
Speaking of eggs, I believe these are for you. And as I promised, here's a few more on top as your just reward. Give my regards to the Qitari, and let them know I'm open for business any time!
TEXT_BANQIQ124_03829_QHOTERLPASOL_000_03:
Would that the Qitari could lay eggs. Hmm, perhaps if I...
Oh! You're back! Do you have them!? Do you!?

Oh, you have saved─
Hmph, I mean, splendid! These eggs are even more pleasing to behold than the last batch, and there are so many of them! I would've sent one of my workers to fetch these, but the sad truth is that no Qitari could be trusted with the task.
The eggs would have been devoured before they were one yalm from Slitherbough. That you showed enough restraint to deliver them untouched truly speaks to your heroic pedigree!
TEXT_BANQIQ125_03830_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: As we dig deeper underground, we encounter ever more boulders obstructing our path. We must now refine our tools─reinforce them to withstand these harsh environs and those harsher still to come. I'd owe you a great debt indeed if you were to aid me in gathering the materials I need to do so.

In the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta you can mine a splendid dense iron ore, which should do nicely in improving our pickaxes. Take care, however, as you may find things more vicious than rocks barring your way!

In the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta you can find bunches of sturdy roots, which should come in handy when we have to haul material out of the caves. Take care, however, as you may find things more vicious than rocks barring your way!

In the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta you can catch the diamondtongue, whose scales can withstand the most extreme elemental stresses. Take care, however, as you may find things more vicious than rocks barring your way!
Remember, I need some of that oh-so-splendid dense iron ore from Lake Tusi Mek'ta. Safe mining, my friend!
Remember, I need a bunch of roots from the floor of Lake Tusi Mek'ta. Safe gathering, my friend!
Remember, I need a diamondtongue from the depths of Lake Tusi Mek'ta. I pray you don't fish up something you shouldn't have!
TEXT_BANQIQ125_03830_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: Ah, it's good to see you returned! Seeing as you have all your limbs and various extremities, I take it you were able to obtain the items I requested?
Splendid! With ore of this quality, I'll be able to construct pickaxes that are nigh indestructible─I daresay they'll last longer than our expedition will!
Splendid! These sturdy roots will make the perfect rope─strong enough to withstand the weight of even the most enormous boulders.
