Splendid! The scales of the diamondtongue are as enchanting as they are robust. With these I can make boots that will let us traverse the most rugged terrain with ease.
These new tools will ensure that our younglings survive to dig well until their twilight years, should the need arise─perhaps they'll even pass them down to their children!
TEXT_BANQIQ126_03831_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: Our workers discovered a vast body of water while excavating an underground cave, and found it absolutely teeming with fish. This blessing will provide a steady supply of sustenance as we dig deeper. That is, of course, if we can catch the fish.
A lure made from animal bones should prove irresistible, and the Husk has no shortage of desiccated remains. My workers and I would be grateful if you could bring some to us.

Worms would make ideal bait, but only the most plump and juicy will do. Those in the Husk are fat from feasting on the remains littering the area. My workers and I would be grateful if you would bring us some─for the fish, of course, not for us!

Fish can't well resist a plump, juicy bug at the end of a hook, but a simple fruit worm won't do if we wish to catch the most succulent fish. However, a fruit worm may suffice to catch what we need. Go to Mjrl's Regret with fruit worm on hook, and bring us back a splendid larva.
The fish are certain to go wild for a lure made of animal bone. Make your way to the Husk, and you'll practically trip over what we need.
We need worms, and lots of them. Big, juicy ones─the type that practically carpet the Husk. I trust you aren't too squeamish to handle them.
The task is simple: use a bug to catch a bug. Head to Mjrl's Regret, pole in hand and fruit worm on hook, and you should have what we need in no time.
TEXT_BANQIQ126_03831_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: Now there's my able gatherer! Well, did you get the items? We're ever so eager to begin feasting.

You've outdone yourself once again! Until now, we've been subsisting on preserved food. It fills our bellies, but I'm of the philosophy that a meal is meant to be savored. Perhaps finally we can forget the fact that we're toiling away under the earth, if even just for one meal.
TEXT_BANQIQ127_03832_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: Ah, such splendid timing! It would seem your singular ability to coax the great serpent into obedience with a mere whistle has made you quite the commodity. Uterl Matl was just asking after you, and requested that I send you his way with haste. The matter seemed quite urgent─so urgent, in fact, that he ran off before I had a chance to inquire as to the details!
TEXT_BANQIQ127_03832_UTERLMATL_000_010: Ah, good , let me thank you for answering my summons on such short notice. My time spent with the great serpent has given me a certain intuition when it comes to anticipating its needs, and recently I've noticed something peculiar about its behavior.
TEXT_BANQIQ127_03832_UTERLMATL_000_011: It fidgets inside the vase restlessly, but I don't sense that it yearns for freedom. No, this is another matter entirely. It wishes to free something from within itself─doubtless that mystifying light it has a habit of disgorging from its eyes.
TEXT_BANQIQ127_03832_UTERLMATL_000_012: I must admit I am grateful for the serpent's forbearance in the matter, when it is we who are obliged to serve. And serve we shall─with your help, of course. Pray bring the serpent to Fruit of the Protector, where it can shed light to its little heart's content.
TEXT_BANQIQ127_03832_UTERLMATL_000_013: You've arrived just in time! The great serpent is full to bursting with that mysterious light, and I'd be loath to find out what happens were we to let it build up any further. Go on now, you know what to do.
TEXT_BANQIQ127_03832_UTERLMATL_000_014: Best not leave the great serpent alone for too long─I dread to think what would happen if it was forced to contain itself any longer. Just blow on the whistle here and guide it to Fruit of the Protector so it can do what it needs to do.
TEXT_BANQIQ127_03832_SYSTEM_000_020: A brilliant flash of light accompanies the release of unmeasurable quantities of magical energy. The great serpent appears content with itself.
TEXT_BANQIQ127_03832_SYSTEM_100_020: The air here is teeming with magical energy. This might be the perfect place to let the great serpent do its business.
TEXT_BANQIQ127_03832_SYSTEM_110_020: Speak with Uterl Matl at Hopl's Stopple to mount the Great Vessel of Ronka, and unleash its peculiar light into the area around Fruit of the Protector.
TEXT_BANQIQ127_03832_UTERLMATL_000_021: Now there's my favorite little serpent! And it looks so accomplished, so great! I believe a treat is in order. As for your treat, my good , Qhoterl Pasol may be able to help you with that!
TEXT_BANQIQ127_03832_QHOTERLPASOL_000_03:
I trust Uterl Matl's task was not too daunting...
Oh, I see! What an unorthodox request. However, it seems that Uterl Matl, and more importantly the great serpent, were more than pleased with your performance.
Humble creatures such as we are can but guess as to the serpent's wishes, and carry them out as dutifully as we can manage. In that respect, I believe we have done splendidly!

You should be honored to have been given this task, and should you be asked to undertake it once more, I suggest you treat it with the same gravity as you did today. So long as the great serpent is happy, the Qitari are happy─and that should make you happy, old !
TEXT_BANQIQ128_03833_QHOTERLPASOL_000_00: Thanks to your tireless efforts, our excavation is nearing its completion. The gifts of the past we've uncovered here will be a boon to future Qitari, to be sure, but we mustn't keep our discoveries to ourselves. No, I intend to spread knowledge of Ronka to every corner of the world!

To that end, I mean to author a definitive history of Ronka with my own hands. Moreover, I intend to use an ingenious system of woodblocks and ink to produce enough copies so that no curious mind goes unsated.

If you would be an ally of history, then I have just the task for you. Pray bring me a slab of black stone from Mjrl's Regret. While it may appear a common stone at first glance, we have long used it to make writing instruments.

If you would be an ally of history, then I have just the task for you. Pray bring me hemp from Mjrl's Regret. I can't start writing without paper, and the material made from this hemp is as sturdy as it comes.

If you would be an ally of history, then I have just the task for you. Pray return with a mammoth shellfish from the depths of Lake Tusi Mek'ta. Though they may be tricky to snag with your spear, their sacs contain enough ink to fill countless inkwells.
The world is eager to learn the truth of Ronka. Return here with the black stone and I shall begin writing at once!
The world is eager to learn the truth of Ronka. Return here with the hemp and I shall begin writing at once!
The world is eager to learn the truth of Ronka. Return here with the shellfish and I shall begin writing at once!
TEXT_BANQIQ128_03833_SYSTEM_000_008: In order to proceed with this quest, you must first complete the quest “A New Fishing Ex-spear-ience” and unlock spearfishing.
TEXT_BANQIQ128_03833_QHOTERLPASOL_000_01: I am always glad to see you, and now more than ever! Have you brought the materials I requested?

Splendid, as always! I eventually hope to distribute my chronicle throughout Norvrandt, although it would be prudent to begin with a smaller proving ground, such as the Greatwood. Assuming I meet with success here, my ambitions know no bounds!
A Steward can ask for no greater honor than this task I've given myself, and I shan't rest until I see it done!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_000_000: Bugger my beard! You scared the life out of me!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_000_001: Phew... For a moment, I thought you were a hobgoblin. Seems being so far from Tomra has got me jumping at shadows. Hold on. I know you...
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_100_001: (-Regitt-)You're the one who was helping Ronitt! As for me, the name's Regitt. I forgot to introduce myself before, but I was there when that off little lad gave his first proper lali-ho. What? You don't remember me?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_SAILEWQ_000_002: In all fairness, the fact you're covered from head to toe in identical outfits does make it a little difficult to tell one dwarf from the next...
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_EUELISS_000_003: Well, they have their ways and we have ours. Anyway, it's wonderful to see you again, . Regitt was just asking us for directions.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_000_004: (-Regitt-)I'd almost forgotten about that! Actually, I was on my way to...what was it called? Crystaltown? No, no, that's not it. Something to do with crystals... Gah! Why can't I remember the sodding name!?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_EUELISS_000_005: You see, Ronitt is nowhere to be found. He did leave a note behind in Tomra, though.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_000_006: (-Regitt-)Yes! The letter! I have it right here.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_100_007:
(-Ronitt's Letter-)To whoever might be concerned,
I am off to the Crystarium to find my first and best friend, .
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_100_008:
(-Ronitt's Letter-)If the chief asks where I've gone, just make something up. The automata will take care of my work, so he should have no reason to complain. Oh, and don't forget to feed them while I'm away! With coal, that is.
Bye!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_000_009: (-Regitt-)That's what it says, anyway. That boy may have mastered the fine art of a good, old-fashioned lali-ho, but that won't get him very far in the...Crystarea, or whatever it's called.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_SAILEWQ_000_010: Yes, and even if the opening pleasantries go as planned, it's what comes after that matters most. He'd be the first to admit that polite conversation isn't exactly his forte...
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_EUELISS_000_011: Since he went there looking for , maybe the two of you could go and find him before he gets into─or causes─any trouble.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_000_012: (-Regitt-)That reminds me, will Ronitt being away lead to any difficulties in the “rock phosphate for grog” arrangement between our villages?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_EUELISS_000_013: The Orehound Ogre he built seems to be going about its work as normal, even without him here to operate it, so I think we'll be fine for the time being.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_000_014: (-Regitt-)All right, that settles it. We're off to find Ronitt! Although, I should probably point out that this is actually the first time I've gone more than a malm or so outside of Tomra. I'm counting on you, so please try to keep the mishaps and misadventure to a bare minimum!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_000_015: (-Regitt-)Not that I'm scared, mind you! Ho ho, not one bit... Ahem! Without any further ado, let's make haste for the Crystaforium!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_EUELISS_000_016: And we wish you both a safe journey to the Crystarium! Hee hee!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_EUELISS_100_016: All by himself? I can't see that ending well...
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_EUELISS_000_017: I must admit, I don't envy you having to keep an eye on not one, but two dwarves in a place like the Crystarium. Who knows what sort of trouble they'll get into?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_SAILEWQ_000_018: I have a feeling it won't take long to find him. For better or worse, dwarves have a habit of drawing attention wherever they go!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_000_020: I've never seen so many people in one place! Unfortunately, not one of them is our errant engineer.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_000_021: Where could he be? I wouldn't be surprised if he's whimpering in some corner, wishing he'd never come here. With all these big folk walking about, he's probably scared one of them'll trip over him!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_CITYGUARD_000_022: Well, slap my arse and call me a phooka! You're the second honest-to-gods dwarf I've seen !
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_000_023: Really!? So, where was the first?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_CITYGUARD_000_024: Over at the Mean, playing hide-and-seek by the looks of it. Or maybe he was just lost?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_000_025: That's him, it's got to be! Come on, , let's go and nab him before he runs off again.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_CITYGUARD_100_025: Another dwarf? Or is it the same one I saw before?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_CITYGUARD_000_026: I remember when dwarves were just something you'd only hear about in stories. But now, I'm seeing them all over the place!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_000_030: So, this is the Mean, eh? From the name, I thought it'd be full of scowling faces, but they all seem quite friendly. Anyway, where'd Ronitt get to?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_100_050: So many of them... So soddin' tall... I wish  were here!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_KATLISS_000_060: So, when you heard that  is staying in the Crystarium, you came here looking for ? That's quite the journey for one so young.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_061: Gettin' here was easy! Startin' conversation's what's hard. Every time I try givin' someone a good, ol'-fashioned lali-ho, they look at me like I'm daft or somethin'!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_000_062: Never mind all that─you found  in the end. Or  found you, more like. Come to think of it, why were you looking for  in the first place?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_063: It's simple, really. I always thought  was just a...I dunno, helpful traveler or some such, but the chief tells me 's a hero who risked life and limb to save the world!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_064: When I heard that, I thought that it's only right that I do the same! Trouble is, I'm not sure where to start. But I'm not goin' back to Tomra until I find a way to prove myself your equal!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_065: And while I'm not much of a fighter, there are other ways I can help those in need. Because unlike the rest of my village, who can't think beyond their next pint of ale, I've got big dreams! Ambitions!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_000_066: Now, now. There's nothing wrong with a well-earned drink or ten after a hard day's work, but that's besides the point. How can you hope to compete with someone like ?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_100_067: You might be known as the greatest warrior the world's ever seen...
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_067: But there's one thing I can do better than you: craftin'!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_A1_000_001: Ha! I'm a crafter too, you fluffy-bearded nincompoop!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_A1_000_002: Actually, I've been known to dabble in artisanry myself.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_KATLISS_000_069: Why,  has been putting  skills as  to help around the Mean for some time now.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_KATLISS_000_070: Now there's a surprise. Had I known sooner, I'd have asked you to help around the Mean. If you have a moment to spare, come and see me. I've all sorts of tasks lined up for a master crafts.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_071: Trust me to make friends with one of those annoyin' people who's good at everythin'... I suppose there's no need to make it into a competition, though. Why don't we, uh...what's the word...cooperate? There might be someone around here who needs our help.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_072: How about you, miss? Got anythin' that needs mendin'? Or maybe one of my patented automata can carry out a few menial tasks?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_KATLISS_000_074: We did receive a report a few days ago of a caravan of merchants being attacked by roving sin eaters, not far from Sullen.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_KATLISS_000_075: While they were able to escape without any casualties, they had no choice but to abandon almost all of the produce they were transporting. I fear it's only a matter of time until it happens again. Is there anything you can do?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_077: This Fetchomatic Mechatoad might come in handy. A few extra spiky bits should do the trick. Hmm... On second thought, it might take more than that. I'll need somewhere to use as a workshop to carry out some modifications...
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_KATLISS_000_078: You mean to say you build these yourselves? It certainly is...imposing. In a way only a three-wheeled mechanical frog can be.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_000_079: Now there's a fine compliment if ever I heard one! I think... This example of dwarven engineering was lovingly crafted by young Ronitt, here. He's a descendant of the great blacksmith Watts, and well on his way to becoming the pride of Tomra in his own right!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_KATLISS_000_080: Yes, judging by the quality of his work, I can see why.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_KATLISS_100_081: In fact, I have a proposal. If you're willing to lend us your expertise, we can arrange space for you to use as a workshop.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_KATLISS_000_081: When I say “space,” that's essentially all there is. We'd planned to build a storehouse near the Ostall Imperative, but we had to divert our resources elsewhere, and it was never completed. It seems to me you'd put it to good use.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_KATLISS_000_082: After all, a friend of 's is a friend of ours.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_083: That's very generous of you, miss! I'll turn that place into a first-class workshop in two shakes of a newborn's beard!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_KATLISS_000_084: Excellent. I'll inform those at the Imperative, so they aren't too surprised when automata start appearing out of the blue. I suggest you make yourselves known to Lorathia, who owns the land. She's a regular at the Clearmelt springs, so try there first.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_085: Sounds like some meetin' and greetin' is in order. I reckon it'll go a lot smoother if you're there to cover for me in the likely event I put my foot in it somehow. I also have no bloody idea how to get there. So, lead the way!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_KATLISS_000_086: Please give Lorathia my regards, and do try not to be discouraged if she seems a little...irascible at first.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_090: So, this is Clearmelt, eh? Funny name for a bunch of rocks and a couple of ponds, if you ask me. More importantly, where's that Lorathia person?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_091: You there! Old crone! I'm lookin' for Lorathia. You know where she is?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_LORATHIA_000_092: (-Lorathia-)Call me an old crone again and I'll rip that silly beard off and shove it down your throat, you mouthy little gobshite.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_LORATHIA_000_093: (-Lorathia-)But if it's Lorathia you're after, you're looking at her. What do you want?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_LORATHIA_000_094: (-Lorathia-)Katliss sent you, did she? Hmm... If she thinks you're all right, that's good enough for me.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_LORATHIA_000_095: (-Lorathia-)So, tell me, what are you planning to make in this workshop of yours? And don't go thinking you can impress me with a load of technical jargon. I was an engineer myself, you know.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_096: I'm gonna modify this here automaton so that it can transport goods and keep them safe from sin eaters.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_LORATHIA_000_097: (-Lorathia-)Pah! It won't be transporting much of anything with those stubby little arms, let alone fend off attackers.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_LORATHIA_100_097: (-Lorathia-)And even if it could store goods in its torso, by the time it's done windmilling into the bastards, all those wares will have been shaken to buggery. Good luck to the poor sods who have to sell that.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_098: Yeah, but the windmillin's the best part!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_000_099: Ronitt, the old woman has a point, you know.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_LORATHIA_100_100: (-Lorathia-)Less of the “old,” or I'll use that beard of yours to scrub the baths, with the rest of you still attached!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_100_101: So, we need a way to carry as much as possible while strikin' the sin eaters from a distance...
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_LORATHIA_100_103: (-Lorathia-)Wicked white... It's so old, the ink's probably the only thing holding it together.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_100_104: The design's from the days before the Flood, the brainchild of the great Watts himself. It's a self-propelled transportation device, armed to the teeth. I call it...
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_100_105: Its thick iron shell keeps the cargo inside safe and sound, while the cannon blasts any attackers to smithereens!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_100_106: What an amazing coincidence that you've had the perfect solution in your pocket this whole time! Even before you knew what the problem was!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_100_107: This ain't no coincidence. Ever since I found a bunch of blueprints in a tightly locked safe back when I was little, I've taken them with me wherever I go. Never know when Watts's ideas might come in handy!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_100_108: 'Course, I'm not just gonna make one of these, oh no. I'll make a whole bunch of 'em, and send them all over Norvrandt. Soon everyone'll see how great dwarven engineerin' really is!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_LORATHIA_100_109: (-Lorathia-)But this only shows how it should look from the outside, with no mention of the inner workings. Are you sure you can pull this off?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_100_110: I'd bet my beard on it!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_110_110: And to be honest, dwarven technology's come a long way since Watts's time. He probably didn't design the insides because there was no way to actually make somethin' like this back then.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_100_111: Luckily, we've got my skills to bring Watts's ideas to life. I'll have a prototype up and runnin' in no time!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_100_112: Listen, Ronitt. You're not the only one who knows how to swing a hammer around here. If we combine our efforts, it'll be ready even sooner.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_LORATHIA_100_114: (-Lorathia-)I must say, I'd be interested to see how this all turns out. I'll let you use my land, as long as you don't turn it into a smoldering crater.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_100_115: You won't regret this! But if we're to build a workshop, we'll need a few more pairs of hands. I'll head back to Tomra and round up some volunteers.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_LORATHIA_120_115: (-Lorathia-)If this place is going to be overrun with dwarves, at least give me some way to tell you apart.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_LORATHIA_130_115: (-Lorathia-)How am I meant to know who's who if you all dress like that?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_140_115: Not sure if you realize this, madam, but we dwarves don't exactly have extensive wardrobes. But, in the interests of a smooth-running operation, I'll ask my friend Karutt if there's anything we can do.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_100_116: Pff. So much for helpin'. More like “bugger off back to Tomra and leave poor Ronitt to do everythin' by himself!” Well, you're still here, so you can give me a hand instead. Let's go and take a look at this plot of land, shall we?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_100_117: These hot springs look awfully...hot. I'd go for a dip myself, but I'm worried my head would boil inside my helmet! Taking it off first is out of the question, obviously.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_LORATHIA_110_118: Nothing better than a long soak in the springs, and Clearmelt has the best for malms around. It's a shame I can't have the whole place to myself!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_LORATHIA_100_118: That land used to belong to a relative of mine who moved to the Crystarium to get away from the sin eaters. Since then, I've been at a loss as to what to do with it. I'm not exactly inundated with potential tenants, as you can well imagine.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_120: Welcome to the workshop! Or “workshop-to-be,” I suppose I should call it. Either way, this is where Watts's vision will become reality.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_121: Although, I have to admit, it's not gonna be as easy as I've made out. Havin' you here does make the task seem less dauntin', though.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_122: And even though I was a bit miffed at first to hear you're into craftin' as well─stealin' my thunder and all that─I'm glad we've got somethin' in common.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_126: If you can lend a hand between whatever it is the Warrior of Darkness does the rest of the time, it'd mean the world to me.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_127: So, what do you say, ? Will you help me?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_A3_000_001: What the world needs now is tanks, sweet tanks. Of course I'll help.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_A3_000_002: No. You talked yourself into this. Build your own damned tanks.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_128: Ah. Not quite the answer I was hopin' for. Well, if you change your mind, you know where to find me.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_129: Phew! I was worried you was gonna say no for a moment there! Now, let's make some tanks!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_130: Erm, but before that, there are a few things we need to get in order. We won't get much work done without somethin' at least resemblin' a workshop.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_131: If you're in the mood for helpin', maybe you could rustle me up some basic parts? I've got a list of everythin' I need. Anyone with even a passin' interest in metalworkin' should be able to manage it, so I'm sure you'll be fine!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_132: If you're in the mood for helpin', maybe you could rustle me up some basic supplies? I've got a list of everythin' I need. Anyone with even a passin' interest in handicrafts' should be able to manage it, so I'm sure you'll be fine!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_133: If you're in the mood for helpin', maybe you could rustle me up a few concoctions? I've got a list of everythin' I need. Anyone who's so much as brewed a pot of tea should be able to manage it, so I'm sure you'll be fine!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_134: As another example of my incredible foresight, I've already had the Fetchomatic Mechatoad collect a load of random─I mean, potentially very useful─materials on the way over. This should be enough.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_135: If you somehow manage to bugger it up, don't worry. We've got plenty more. I'll be takin' care of the rest of the preparations, so come and see me when you're done.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_136: Run into some difficulties, did you? Not to worry, there's more where that came from. In the automaton's belly, that is.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_137: Run into some difficulties, did you? Not to worry, there's more where that came from. In the automaton's belly, that is.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_138: Run into some difficulties, did you? Not to worry, there's more where that came from. In the automaton's belly, that is.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_146: All done? Let's see what you've brought me, then!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_147: Ah. I gotta say, I wasn't expectin' it to be quite this good. Not showin' off, are you?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_148: Me and the Mechatoad'll take care of the rest, so you go and put your feet up for a bit. Don't want you takin' all the credit, now!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_100: There you are! Welcome to Watts's Anvil!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_000_101: The two of you did all this!? I can't believe it!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_KARUTT_000_102: I-Is that you, Ronitt? Why, I...I hardly recognized you! Have you done something with your beard?
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_104: Accordin' to the legends, Watts had a brown beard and white horns. Seein' as I'm his descendant, I thought I'd follow suit!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_105: Now that we've got a proper workshop, we can get started on makin' a prototype of the Rollin' Tankard.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_RONITT_000_106: To tell the truth, I'm not used to havin' this sort of pressure. Still, I've got you and the others here to do the heavy lif─essential tasks, so I'm sure everythin' will go exactly as planned!
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_REGITT_000_107: Speaking of essential tasks, I'll be handling the supply of the various parts and whatnot, so come and see me when you're ready to show us those skills of yours.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_SYSTEM_000_108: Ronitt and his fellow dwarves have thrown themselves wholeheartedly into their newest enterprise, namely, to provide trundling death machines for the needy.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_SYSTEM_000_150: You have achieved Friendly reputation with Watts's Anvil.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_SYSTEM_000_151: Dwarf society quests are now available from Regitt at Watts's Anvil.
TEXT_BANDWA001_03896_SYSTEM_000_152: Furthermore, you may now purchase wares from Mizutt.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_RONITT_000_000: Heh! Not only are you talented, but hardworkin', too! You've really made a difference around here.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_RONITT_000_001: As for me, I've never made anythin' like this before, so it's takin' a while to get the engine right. Who'd have thought makin' a tank could be so complicated?
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_RONITT_000_002: I reckon I'll have it worked out before long, but there's one problem I've been strugglin' with: the fuel. S'pose it wouldn't hurt to ask the others if they've got any ideas.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_RONITT_000_010: All right , it seems like the cobalt coal we use for automata ain't gonna cut it. The tank's just too heavy even when it's empty, never mind with a full load of cargo.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_KARUTT_000_011: 'Course, makin' it lighter is an option, but we can't cut back on armor or those sin eaters'll rip through it like it were paper. And there ain't no point puttin' a limit on the amount it can carry 'cause that defeats the purpose of it.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_KARUTT_000_012: A-Actually, I'm not sure it's a good time to m-mention this, but...
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_REGITT_000_013: I get the feeling we're being watched. If one of those bastard hobgoblins has followed us here, I'll smash its bloody head in!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_015: Bah! I've no time to deal with underlings. It's the twice─nay, thrice-cursed Ronitt I seek! I, Ozogg the Gogg, proud descendant of the great Watts, challenge you to a test of skill, with Watts's hammer on the line!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_RONITT_000_016: What the hells are you talkin' about!? If you're a descendant of Watts, I'm a two-headed amaro! His blood flows in my veins, not yours!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_RONITT_000_020: Besides, can't you see I'm busy!? I'm tryin' to build a prototype of the Rollin' Tankard!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_021: A what? I don't have a clue what you mean, but it sounds fascinating!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_022: N-Not that I care what any of you and your band of dundering dunderheads are up to! All I want is to challenge you and prove who's the better engineer. Surely, your pride compels you to accept? Unless you're scared, that is...
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_RONITT_000_024: I ain't scared of nothin'! If it's a showdown you're after, a showdown's what you'll get, but not until I finish this tank. 'Course, the quicker it gets done, the quicker you can pit your “skill” against mine...
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_027: Oh, I see what you're getting at...
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_028: This is your roundabout way of asking for my help, isn't it?
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_029: Ha! Judging by the sorry state of that...whatever it's supposed to be, you certainly need it! If this is what it takes for you to relinquish Watts's hammer, so be it, you...you...shambling charlatan!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_KARUTT_000_030: I-Is that the sound of impending d-disaster I hear?
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_RONITT_000_031: I assume you've got at least some craftin' chops to back up that mouth of yours.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_032: I'll have you know that even Gogg babies can produce better work than the shoddy rubbish that passes for engineering in Tomra! And from what I gather, you've started building that tank of yours without even considering what sort of fuel to use!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_033: I'll be here until my next nameday if I wait for you lot to find a solution for yourselves, so I'll let you use the Gogg's secret formula, which is sure to work. Naturally, I'll expect something in return: grog! And plenty of it!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_KARUTT_000_035: M-Maybe we can get some for the r-rest of us, while we're at it. Nothing like a drunken buzz to increase pr-productivity. Yes, definitely.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_KARUTT_000_036: But th-there's nowhere to get decent brew for malms around, and we lack the m-means to make it ourselves...
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_037: Bless my beard, you call yourselves dwarves!? Tell you what: I'll build you a brewing machine, on the condition I can have grog from it whenever I want. Agreed?
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_038: I'll need an assistant, though. You, over there! Lend me a hand, would you?
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_RONITT_000_039: I've heard some convoluted schemes in my time, a few of them my own, but this is somethin' else. Ah well, as long as it doesn't interfere with my work, I couldn't give a hob's arse what she does. I think we can spare you for a bit, so why not humor her?
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_040: I'll be installing the machinery at the top of those steps, so when you're ready to see a real engineer in action, just say the word. And if you even think about sabotaging it to make me look bad, I...I...shall be very cross!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_050: Listen, I didn't just pick you at random, you know. I've been watching from afar and I've seen the way you work. While I won't go so far as to say I'm impressed, you're a cut above the rest of these talentless hacks.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_051: I'd be interested to see how you cope when working alongside someone of my caliber. While I design the brewing apparatus, I'll have you produce a few basic components.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_052: Of course, we won't be doing much brewing without brewing vats, so show me what you're capable of!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_053: As you can imagine, we'll need all manner of filters to remove any impurities, which is where you come in!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_054: We can't make ale without yeast, so I'd like you to prepare a batch for me!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_055: Hmm... I suppose you'll be needing the raw materials, won't you? Let me see...
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_KARUTT_000_056: Um, I th-think there should be some in the automaton.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_057: Problem solved! It seems the Tholls' habit of carrying a load of rubbish around with them actually paid off for once. Well then, what are you waiting for? I'm keen to show this bunch of reprobates what proper grog tastes like!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_KARUTT_000_058: A-And we're keen to do the tasting! Let's get to work, sh-shall we?
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_059: You won't be making much of anything without the proper materials. Now, hurry up and get some from that bucket of rust they call an automaton.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_060: You won't be making much of anything without the proper materials. Now, hurry up and get some from that bucket of rust they call an automaton.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_061: You won't be making much of anything without the proper materials. Now, hurry up and get some from that bucket of rust they call an automaton.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_KARUTT_000_062: I m-must say, I'm much better at br-brewing than I am at smithing. The results are a lot t-tastier, too!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_081: Took you long enough, but it was worth the wait. Now, we're only a few simple steps away from producing lovely, lovely Gogg grog!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_KARUTT_000_082: Erm, actually, I was h-hoping to try a new recipe I've come up with that uses l-local ingredients.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_084: Ha! This ought to be good for a laugh! I'll bet it tastes even worse than the usual dregs you Tholls serve up. As long as we switch over to my recipe afterwards, I don't see the harm in trying, though.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_SYSTEM_000_101: Under Ozogg's watchful eye, Watts's Anvil is now equipped with a fully functioning brewery, an essential part of any tank-building facility.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_SYSTEM_000_102: With the majority of the workforce now blind drunk, the next logical step is to begin producing large quantities of highly flammable fuel for their experimental war machine.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_100_110: These Tholls certainly seem to be enjoying the booze. I suppose I could do them the honor of passing a little across my palate...
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_110: By Watts's beard! This is incredible! In fact, it might be even better than the ale we make in Komra!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_KARUTT_000_111: Though the recipe is of m-my own invention, your brewing techniques are the key to its unique fl-flavor, Ozogg!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_RONITT_000_112: I hope you don't mind me interruptin' this knees-up to discuss your side of the bargain. What are you plannin' to do about my tank fuel, eh!?
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_113: Planning? Why, it's already been dealt with. Take a closer look!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_REGITT_000_114: Eh? Looks like a brewin' vat to me.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_115: Ha! That shows how much you know! Behold, the patented Gogg ethanol mill!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_116: By fermenting various forms of vegetation, like dry grass and so on, then distilling it a few times, we're able to produce fuel that can be used in a range of machines.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_117: What do you think of that, you...you...simpleminded simpletons!?
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_RONITT_000_118: That's bloody brilliant! And you started workin' on it before we even gave you your grog? You don't waste any time, that's for sure.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_REGITT_000_119: It really is quite remarkable. I'd say our doubts have been laid to rest, at least as far as her skills as an engineer are concerned.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_120: Ha! Let this be a lesson to all you naysayers! But the proof, as they say, is in the pudding, and you'll see the true extent of my genius once you feast your eyes on the power of ethanol fuel!
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_RONITT_000_121: Yeah, let's not get ahead of ourselves. For all we know, the whole thing might blow up in our faces! But I suppose it would be poor form not to express my appreciation, so...thanks, Ozogg.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_OZOGG_000_122: Try not to sound too enthusiastic about it! But if you're in the mood for giving praise, I reckon  deserves some, too.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_RONITT_000_123: Yes, all right, I hadn't forgotten! Good work, . Ozogg couldn't have done it without you.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_KARUTT_000_086: I w-wonder what sort of grog we could make from l-local ingredients? I don't really f-fancy traveling all the way back to T-Tomra every time we run out.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_SYSTEM_000_130: You have achieved Trusted reputation with Watts's Anvil.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_SYSTEM_000_131: New dwarf society daily quests are now available from Regitt at Watts's Anvil.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_SYSTEM_000_132: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Regitt as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_SYSTEM_000_133: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Regitt. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANDWA002_03897_SYSTEM_000_134: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Mizutt.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_000: It's time to work on the most interestin' part of the Rollin' Tankard's design: the cannon!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_001: Me and the others have a few things to go over first, so come and join us in the usual place.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_002: ...But those bastard sin eaters won't even get the chance to test our defenses if we blow their heads off first! That's why we need a cannon. The bigger, the better. 'Course, there were no sin eaters back in Watts's time, but with a bit of Tholl ingenuity...
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_OZOGG_000_003: Hold it right there! Aren't you afraid I'll steal your secrets? And why did you even invite me to this meeting in the first place?
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_004: Well, you want me to finish buildin' these tanks, don't you? Our reasons might be different, but we're workin' towards the same goal.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_REGITT_000_005: Yeah! Besides, you've already built the brewery, the ethanol mill, and shared a bunch of your secrets with us. You're on board now whether you like it or not!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_OZOGG_100_006: I didn't agree to become one of your lackeys! I come and go as I please!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_OZOGG_000_006: And how do I know all this stuff about sin eaters isn't some elaborate ruse? You could be building these war machines to attack Komra!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_KARUTT_000_007: Well, we weren't pl-planning to, but now that you mention it...
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_008: Ozogg, that's a load of claptrap and you know it. If we wanted to invade Komra, it be as easy as snatchin' the helmet off a baby, and we wouldn't need no tanks, neither! We just wanna help people, that's all.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_OZOGG_000_010: Hmph! That's all very noble, I'm sure, but I'm only here for one thing: Watts's hammer! If getting my hands on it means I have to help with your idiotic plan, so be it!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_011: Idiotic? That's rich comin' from you! And maybe you should wait till I've finished explainin' about the cannon before you start judgin'!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_KARUTT_000_012: Y-You mean to say sin eaters won't run away, even if they're injured? Watts's beard... What have we g-gotten ourselves into!?
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_OZOGG_000_014: Why injure them when you can kill them outright? They won't be getting up again if you blast them to smithereens. A nice bit of gunpowder should do the trick, but I wouldn't trust you Tholls not to blow yourselves to bits in the process.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_015: , you've fought sin eaters, haven't you? Got any suggestions?
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_A1_000_001: Bombarding them with magic from a distance usually gets the job done.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_A1_000_002: A beam of pure energy. It'll look pretty, too.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_016: Magic? Dunno about that, mate. I think hiring a qualified mage to go along for the ride might get expensive. But if there was a way to produce a similar effect using machinery, that would be worth explorin'.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_017: So, we can destroy sin eaters and look good while we do it? Well, it's got my vote!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_OZOGG_000_018: Hmm... The only method I can think of would be to charge a crystal with aether and then release it all in one go. Though I hate to say it, but this is rather outside of my field of expertise.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_REGITT_000_019: Why don't you ask that Lorathia lady over at Clearmelt? She used to be an engineer.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_020: It's worth a try, I guess.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_021: I'd feel a lot better if you came with me, for moral support, like. To tell the truth, I find her a bit intimidatin'... A-Anyway, let's get goin'!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_030: Phew! Thank the gods you're here! I was afraid I'd have to talk to her by myself. Ah well, here goes nothin'...
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_LORATHIA_000_032: Bloody hells. I see your manners haven't improved since the last time we met. <sigh> Whatever it is you came to say, spit it out. I've got guests arriving soon.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_LORATHIA_000_033: You want to fit the tanks with aether cannons? So you do have more than sawdust in that head of yours.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_034: Seems like a backhanded compliment to me, but I'll take it all the same! Though I must admit, I'm not used to workin' with aether and whatnot. Don't s'pose you know anythin' about it?
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_LORATHIA_000_035: As a matter of fact, I'm the one who designed the crystal cannons lining the walls of the Crystarium.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_036: Nah, you're pullin' my leg. I've had a lot of strange coincidences lately, but that's not even remotely feasible. Wait...you're serious, aren't you?
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_LORATHIA_000_037: Of course I am! But if you want me to share my secrets, you'd better make it worth my while!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_038: Ah! I know where this is leadin'! You're gonna send us to the ends of the earth on some godsforsaken errand, just to test our resolve, aren't you?
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_LORATHIA_000_039: No, you bloody idiot, that's not what I mean at all! Listen, I have some friends coming over for tea and I want the pair of you to join us.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_040: Tea? That's slightly less perilous than I was expectin'. But what does that have to do with anythin'?
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_LORATHIA_000_041: If you shut your piehole, you might find out! My guests are twin sisters whose supply caravans run the length and breadth of Norvrandt. I reckon they'll have more than a passing interest in buying those tanks of yours.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_042: Buy? You mean to tell me we could make a profit on these tanks? I was plannin' to give 'em away for nothin', but I might as well take the opportunity to line my pockets.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_LORATHIA_000_043: It's clear your friend's not much of a businessman, so you'd better do the talking.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_LORATHIA_000_044: I still have some things to prepare before my guests arrive, so give me a few moments, would you?
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_100_044: All I have to do is shut up and let you handle it. So why am I so nervous!?
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_LORATHIA_110_044: Now that everything's in order, we're ready to begin. Try not to look so tense, dear!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_SYSTEM_000_044: Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to engage Lorathia's guests in polite conversation and extol the virtues of Ronitt's master plan. Choose the best responses and generate interest in the Rolling Tankard.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_SYSTEM_000_045: This coming together of great minds─plus Ronitt─will take several minutes. You may wish to cancel any pending Duty Finder registrations.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_IRIOLVA_000_056: What a pleasure it is to make your acquaintance. Lorathia tells us you're in the transportation business, much like Cobleva and I.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_COBLEVA_000_057: Yes, we were rather hoping you'd help us with a little problem we've been having of late: hordes of ravenous sin eaters. Terribly irritating, as I'm sure you can imagine.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_IRIOLVA_000_058: Is it true that you and yours are presently engaged in the construction of some sort of vehicle capable of warding off such assailants?
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_SYSTEM_000_060: Ward off? Turn them into mincemeat, more like!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_SYSTEM_000_061: It transports goods safely while repelling all manner of threats.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_IRIOLVA_000_062: Oh, I say! That sounds positively ghastly! And I don't think our clients will take too kindly to having their wares covered in bits of mangled sin eater.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_100_063: Well, ah...the cannons are only to be used in emergencies! It's not like the tanks would be sent out lookin' for trouble or nothin'!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_063: (Oi, might wanna spare them the grisly details, you know?)
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_IRIOLVA_000_064: Well, that does sound rather impressive! This could be precisely what we need.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_065: If any sin eaters dare show up, the Rollin' Tankard can deal with 'em before they get anywhere near.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_100_065: (Heh heh, seems like you've got a way with words. Keep this up and they'll be putty in our hands!)
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_COBLEVA_000_066: It does occur to me, however, that this all seems awfully complicated. Those used to working with amaro may struggle to operate these vehicles of yours.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_SYSTEM_000_068: The controls are manned by a purpose-built automaton.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_SYSTEM_000_069: What could possibly go wrong? Just pull the levers and see what happens!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_COBLEVA_000_070: The wonders of modern technology never cease to amaze me. Machines driving machines... Whatever next!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_LORATHIA_000_071: If all it takes is giving instructions to the automaton, anyone could do it. Quite an elegant solution, I must say.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_100_071: (You just made that up, didn't you? Ah well, we can work all that out later! For now, carry on doin' what you're doin'!)
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_COBLEVA_000_072: It strikes me that trial and error is somewhat ill-advised when dealing with heavy weaponry. I'd hate to blow up something I'm not supposed to!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_073: Oh...um... Hahaha! That was just one of 's little jokes! What  really means is that an automaton will take care of everythin'!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_100_073: (Bloody hells! Even I wouldn't say somethin' that bleedin' stupid!)
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_IRIOLVA_000_074: While this is all very intriguing, young Ronitt, I would feel much more comfortable doing business with you if I could see your face, that I may better read your intentions. Though I do not doubt your sincerity, consider it a matter of courtesy.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_075: Y-You want me to take off my h-helmet? B-But...
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_SYSTEM_000_078: And then what!? You want him to dance on the table for you!?
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_IRIOLVA_000_079: Oh, I beg your pardon! That was incredibly rude of me.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_COBLEVA_000_080: We are, much to our embarrassment, unfamiliar with dwarven customs. You were very kind to intervene and prevent any further impertinence on our part.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_081: Thanks, . If you weren't here, I don't know what I would've done!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_100_081: (Bugger my beard! Why'd you have to say that!? Gods, this is awkward...)
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_IRIOLVA_000_082: Well, I think we've covered most of the pertinent points.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_COBLEVA_000_083: There is, however, one last thing we would like to ask before we reach a decision. What do you think we sisters value most in all the world?
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_IRIOLVA_000_088: Oh dear! That's not quite the answer we were looking for.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_COBLEVA_000_089: We would like to think that honesty is the bare minimum we can expect from others, especially those with whom we would do business.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_IRIOLVA_000_090: Luckily, we have been able to ascertain through the course of this conversation that the two of you possess this in abundance.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_COBLEVA_000_092: What would life be like without a little excitement? And what could be more exciting than an ambitious new enterprise, such as the one you are proposing!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_IRIOLVA_000_093: It seems that with our business acumen and your...tanks, we have a match made in the heavens!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_100_094: Haha! We did it! And they've really taken a shine to you, it seems.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_SYSTEM_000_094: Iriolva and Cobleva's joyous response bodes well for Ronitt and his Rolling Tankards. You have almost certainly secured buyers for his tanks, provided they reach completion.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_100_095: Phew! That was a bit of a struggle, but we got there in the end! Nicely done!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_SYSTEM_000_095: Iriolva and Cobleva's warm response bodes well for Ronitt and his Rolling Tankards. It appears that you have secured buyers for his tanks, provided they reach completion.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_100_096: Ungh... I'm glad that's over. Maybe you ought to let me do the talkin' next time, eh?
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_SYSTEM_000_096: Iriolva and Cobleva were clearly unimpressed by your conversation skills, or lack thereof. In spite of your series of blunders, however, hope is not yet lost. There yet remains the possibility they may purchase Ronitt's tanks after all.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_LORATHIA_000_097: Of course, seeing is believing. Once the tanks are finished, you should put on a demonstration. We'd all be interested to see those aetherial cannons in action, but actually getting them up and running will be no easy task, I assure you.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_LORATHIA_000_098: Lucky for you, I know just the man to point you in the right direction. I'll write you a letter of introduction requesting he help you in this little endeavor.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_LORATHIA_000_099: It's been a while since we met, and I can't for the life of me remember how they take their tea...
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_LORATHIA_100_100: Give this letter to Rosard in Ballistics. He looks a bit imposing, but he's friendly enough.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_LORATHIA_100_101: Then again, if it's you doing the asking, I'm sure he'd be more than happy to help.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_102: Hmph! One of these days, the people of Norvrandt'll be climbin' over each other for the chance to do me a favor, just you wait and see!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_103: But until then, I've got a lot of work ahead of me, so let's get goin'!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_LORATHIA_000_104: I've known that Rosard since he was knee-high to a phooka. Wait, do they even have knees?
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_COBLEVA_000_105: Lorathia always serves such wonderful tea, and the scenery here is to die for!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_IRIOLVA_000_106: Is that the distant rumbling of tanks I hear? Or perhaps I'm getting ahead of myself?
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_107: Are we done yet? All this bein' polite's worn me out...
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_ROSARD_000_110: Greetings! What can I do for you this fine ?
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_111: ...and blow their bloody heads off! That's the plan, anyway.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_ROSARD_000_112: Ho ho! If it's aether-based firepower you're after, I have just the thing. Right behind me, as it happens!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_ROSARD_000_113: This model was mass-produced and installed along the perimeter of the Crystarium, specifically to deal with sin eater assaults. Those bastards soon give up the ghost after a blast of concentrated aether to the face! Bwahaha!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_114: I like the sound of that!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_ROSARD_000_115: I can't take the credit for these crystal cannons, though. Lorathia's the one who originally designed them. I suppose you could call her my mentor.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_ROSARD_000_116: If she says I'm to assist you, who am I to refuse? Now, let me see about getting you copies of our cannon blueprints.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_ROSARD_000_117: A pleasant surprise, I take it? Ha, that's the Lorathia I know. Behind that sharp tongue and piercing gaze, she's one of the most caring people you'll ever meet. I expect she appreciates what you're doing, especially considering what happened at Holminster.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_ROSARD_000_118: Not to mention that we in the Crystarium owe much and more to you for restoring the night sky. It's not every day we get the chance to aid the Warrior of Darkness !
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_ROSARD_000_119: And it goes without saying we here in the Crystarium are extremely grateful for everything you're doing. You're an inspiration to us all!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_ROSARD_000_120: At any rate, every sin eater your tanks put down is one less for our soldiers to deal with, so sharing the plans for the crystal cannons is the least we can do.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_ROSARD_000_121: In the meantime, I'll look forward to hearing of your success.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_122: It won't be long before tales of the Rollin' Tankards are on the lips of everyone in Norvrandt. Many thanks, Rosard!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_123: Come on, . We've got cannons to build! To the Anvil!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_100_123: Crystal cannon? Check. Big man? Check. This must be the place.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_ROSARD_000_124: When Lorathia was here, she'd spend about half her time working and the other half drinking tea. She still got more done than the rest of us put together, though.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_LORATHIA_000_125: Rosard give you what you need, did he? Better get to work, then!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_130: I swear, everywhere we go, people treat you like you're some sort of hero! I suppose bein' a hero's most trusted friend is the next best thing, so I'll settle for that.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_131: Havin' said that, when it comes to buildin' these tanks, you're still my assistant! Ha! And it just so happens I've got some work for you.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_132: There's more to these cannons than just crystal, as you can probably guess. In fact, there are so many different parts, it makes my head spin just thinkin' about it!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_133: I reckon there are a few things you can put together for me, though. Shouldn't be too hard for someone as skilled as you.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_134: I reckon there are a few things you can put together for me, though. Shouldn't be too hard for someone as skilled as you.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_135: I reckon there are a few things you can concoct for me, though. Shouldn't be too hard for someone as skilled as you.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_136: As usual, you'll find everythin' you need in the Fetchomatic Mechatoad. And if not...well, you're a clever . You'll come up with somethin'.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_137: Don't worry about botchin' it. There are plenty more materials where those came from.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_138: Don't worry about botchin' it. There are plenty more materials where those came from.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_139: Don't worry about botchin' it. There are plenty more materials where those came from.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_146: Well? Don't keep me in suspense!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_147: Heh! Looks like all that time spent around a master engineer like me is payin' off.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_148: Once I've built and fine-tuned the cannon, the prototype tank'll be ready!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_RONITT_000_149: After that, it's just a matter of producin' more of the same as quickly and cheaply as possible. Not that I'll be cuttin' any corners, mind!
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_SYSTEM_000_100: With the final piece of the puzzle, the crystal cannon, in place, the Rolling Tankard prototype is all but complete.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_SYSTEM_000_101: However, this marks only the beginning of Ronitt's plans, as it will take more than a single tank to ensure the safe transportation of goods to and from various locations across Norvrandt.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_SYSTEM_000_200: You have achieved Respected reputation with Watts's Anvil.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_SYSTEM_000_201: New dwarf society daily quests are now available from Regitt at Watts's Anvil.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_SYSTEM_000_202: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Regitt as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_SYSTEM_000_203: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Regitt. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANDWA003_03898_SYSTEM_000_204: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Mizutt.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_000: I've been puttin' the prototype through its paces, doin' a bit of fine-tunin' along the way. I'm happy to say it's now complete!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_001: I reckon I probably could've done it all by myself eventually, but havin' everyone else chip in with the work definitely helped.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_002:
If we keep this up, Watts's Anvil will be able to achieve “world domination through technology”!
Hmm... Might need to work on the slogan a bit.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_003: All right, if we're gonna produce more Rollin' Tankards, we'll need to find a way to speed up the process. Time for a meetin'!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_004: We're almost ready to take over─I mean, “save” the world with our tanks!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_005: I hope you haven't forgotten about what's in store for you once they're finished.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_100_005: 'Course not! But in the meantime, I've got bigger fish to fry.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_XAMOTT_000_006: (-???-)You, boy! What the bloody hells do you think you're playin' at, consortin' with Goggs! Bunch of stinkin' scruffybeards, the lot of 'em!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_GLAGG_000_007: (-???-)Watch your tongue, Xamott, or I'll pull it out with my pliers!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_009: Gah! And my chief's here, too!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_XAMOTT_000_010: So this is where you young'uns have been all this time... Explain yourselves, and spare me any limp-bearded excuses! Wait, what is that!?
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_011: Behold, the Rollin' Tankard! One of the lost designs of the great Watts, in the flesh! Well, “in the metal,” I suppose, but the point still stands!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_GLAGG_000_012: Yes, but what the bloody hells is it?
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_XAMOTT_000_013: Never mind that, what I want to know is how you got your grubby little mitts on Watts's designs? They were locked in an unbreakable safe!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_014: Unbreakable? Don't think so, Chief. I opened that back when I was a nipper. And I thought, it's “finders keepers,” so I helped myself to the plans inside.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_XAMOTT_000_016: Taking such revered artifacts without permission is strictly forbidden! I should banish the bloody lot of you!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_017: Steady on, Chief! I didn't even realize it was against the rules!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_GLAGG_000_018: As for you, young lady, you'd better have a damned good excuse for this behavior. And I notice that ethanol mill over there is of Gogg design. If I find you've been sharin' our secrets with the Tholl, your life won't be worth livin'!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_XAMOTT_000_019: You can't go replicatin' Watts's ideas willy-nilly. For all we know, this could bring about the destruction of Tomra! In any event, his great works are far beyond the capabilities of you whelps!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_XAMOTT_000_020: And to make matters worse, the Gogg know all about it now! What's to stop them from buildin' their own tanks and wagin' war on us!?
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_KARUTT_000_021: I-I don't like the s-sound of that...
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_REGITT_000_022: Maybe this weren't such a good idea after all...
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_023: Stop snivelin', you two! Why would Watts design somethin' like this if he didn't want anyone to make it!? We're carryin' on his legacy!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_024: If taking the plans is against the rules, why did no one here know about it? Surely someone would've said something to Ronitt if it's that severe a crime.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_XAMOTT_000_025: W-Well, you'd think that bein' in a locked safe would be enough of a deterrent, but obviously not! Bugger my beard, do I have to spell everythin' out? ...Truth be told, I never thought anyone would break the soddin' lock like that.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_026: I didn't mean no harm by it, honest! Maybe if I explain why I wanted to build Watts's tank, you'll understand...
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_XAMOTT_000_027: Hmm... You're cleverer than you look, Ronitt. I suppose it's no good havin' all that technology if we're the only ones who benefit from it.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_XAMOTT_000_028: But let's make one thing clear: if you go producin' a load of shoddy work, the Tholl will be the laughingstock of Norvrandt. Do you swear on Watts's beard that you'll do a proper job of it?
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_XAMOTT_000_030: To prove that you can produce quality and quantity, I want you to complete five tanks by the next Beardtide festival. Think you can manage that?
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_XAMOTT_000_032: Should you fail, every Tholl here will be sent straight back to Tomra. And that's not all! Ronitt must return Watts's hammer. Those are my conditions. Don't disappoint me!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_033: Hmph! We'll be holding a demonstration at the bottom of that hill over there on Beardtide! Just you see!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_034: Only five by Beardtide? Ha! Why not make it ten? Challenge accepted!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_036: I've got something to take care of! But I'll be back soon!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_040: The more I think about it, the more it pisses me off!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_041: The only reason the chief is givin' me such a hard time about this is because he reckons I'm not up to the task!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_042: I've also got a sneakin' suspicion he made up that rule and Watts's plans just to make my life miserable. He can't bear the thought of me showin' him up with my engineerin'!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_043: It looks like the only thing for it is to get those tanks built, on the double. You see, Beardtide takes place roughly once a year, when it's time for the chief of Tomra to have his beard washed.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_044: Judgin' by the state of it, I'd say we don't have long left. We need to have as many people workin' on the tanks as possible, and that means makin' the workshop a lot bigger.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_045: 'Course, I've already come up with a plan, but I need you to bring me some supplies. And this time, only your very best work will do. Got that?
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_046: 'Course, I've already come up with a plan, but I need you to bring me some supplies. And this time, only your very best work will do. Got that?
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_047: 'Course, I've already come up with a plan, but I need you to bring me some supplies. And this time, only your very best work will do. Got that?
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_048: You'll find everythin' you need in the Mechatoad.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_049: I suppose you're wonderin' why it's called the Fetchomatic Mechatoad? Well, it fetches all the materials we could possibly need automatically, and it's also a mechanical toad. Comin' up with great names is just one of my many talents, you know!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_050: I suppose you're wonderin' why it's called the Fetchomatic Mechatoad? Well, it fetches all the materials we could possibly need automatically, and it's also a mechanical toad. Comin' up with great names is just one of my many talents, you know!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_051: I suppose you're wonderin' why it's called the Fetchomatic Mechatoad? Well, it fetches all the materials we could possibly need automatically, and it's also a mechanical toad. Comin' up with great names is just one of my many talents, you know!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_060: I assume you got there in the end?
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_061: Bugger m─ Ahem! Oh yes, very good, except for this, ah...slight impurity here. It should suffice, though.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_062: Ha ha, just jokin'! It's damn near perfect! This'll go a long way in makin' the workshop bigger and better than ever.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_063: One thing's botherin' me, though. I haven't seen Ozogg since she wandered off. I heard from one of the others she was loiterin' by somethin' called Radisca's Round.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_064: Since Chief Xamott almost bloody well banished me for takin' Watts's plans, I reckon an even harsher punishment's in store for Ozogg. I mean, I bet their chief didn't take too kindly to her givin' away their secrets and buildin' us an ethanol mill!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_065: Now, I know what you're thinkin': “Look at that daft sod Ronitt, worryin' about a Gogg.” Well, I ain't! I just...wanna know if there's somethin' I should be worried about, which isn't the same thing at all!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_066: Even if there was, I doubt she'd tell me or any of the other Tholls, so maybe you could have a word with her?
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_067: Thanks, 'preciate it. If you could find out what her chief said, and if it's any cause for concern, it'd go a long way to puttin' my mind at ease.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_070: Oh, it's you, . Is something the matter?
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_071: Hahaha! Ronitt sent you to check up on me? Maybe he doesn't despise me as much as he'd have everyone believe! Ahahaha!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_072: Haha...ha... Oh dear, I haven't laughed that hard in a long time. If you must know, I didn't come down here to sulk, I just wanted to have a look around where the demonstration is due to take place.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_073: If anything ruins Ronitt's big day, I'll have to wait even longer to pit my skills against his!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_074: But, if I'm being honest, there's a bit more to it than that. , will you promise not to tell the others?
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_075: The truth is, I've no plans to return to Komra once this is all over. In fact, I'd already made that decision the day I left. So it makes no difference to whether I'm banished or not.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_076: I couldn't care less what the chief or anyone else thinks about me, as long as I can carry on with my engineering. The feeling of having an idea and seeing it come to life right before your eyes... It's indescribable!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_077: The thing is, as one of Watts's descendants, everyone has had such high expectations of me, even as a child. “Build this, build that. Craft me some copper rings. No, not those copper rings, the other sort.”
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_078: When the pressure got too much, I'd sneak away from my teachers to play with the junk I'd collected from around the village.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_079: That's how I first met Ronitt. He was a few years younger than me─he still is, as far as I know─but just like me, he was picking up pieces of scrap metal and imagining all the things he could make from them.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_080: When I went over to speak to him, I found we were as alike as two peas in a pod. He loved to make things just as much as I did, and in that brief time we spent together, we talked all about the ideas we'd had, and even made a sort of mechanical doll!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_081: As a sign of our newfound friendship, I gave him a Gogg coin, and promised that we'd meet again... But someone must've seen us. When I got back home to the village, my parents forbade me from playing with “that Tholl boy.”
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_082: And, well, that was the last I saw of him. He was so young, I doubt he remembers any of it, but I'll always cherish the memories of that day, that simple joy of making something for its own sake.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_083: Seeing Ronitt and his friends working together reminded me of how I felt on that day. I'd rather be here helping them build something that will make a difference to the whole of Norvrandt than only doing what's best for the Gogg.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_084: Ahem! And once that's over and done with, I'll have a chance to prove that I'm a better engineer than Ronitt and claim Watts's hammer. For that is my true objective, oh yes!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_085: It's true! Well, I suppose I don't really need the hammer as such. I just thought a little competition would be healthy for the both of us.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_086: Hmm... But I have the feeling that you're far too skilled to be taking orders from someone like Ronitt. Why are you helping him, anyway?
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_A1_000_002: Wherever these talented hands are needed, I will be there.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_A1_000_003: Because there's money to be made. Presumably.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_087: Oh, how very noble! ...I'm being sarcastic, in case you hadn't noticed.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_088: Well, if the staggering level of incompetence around Watts's Anvil is anything to go by, those talented hands of yours will find no shortage of work.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_089: I wouldn't get your hopes up. Ronitt may be surprised to find there is a lot less demand for his so-called masterpieces than he realizes. Besides, I don't recall him mentioning that you would receive any of the profits.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_090: We all have our own reasons for being here, I suppose. And it's not like anyone is forcing us to do this. I'm just glad to have someone other than those boorish Tholls to speak to. I mean you, by the way.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_091: Honestly, I can't see how they get anything done over in Tomra. Did you see the way Ronitt let their chief talk him into that ridiculous ultimatum?
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_092: If they don't get those tanks finished in time, that'll be the end of Watts's Anvil and everything I've worked for will go up in smoke. And worst of all, I'll never get the hammer if Ronitt loses it in this stupid wager!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_OZOGG_000_093: Luckily, I have a plan, but I'll need some time to mull over the finer points. For now, let's get back to the workshop.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_096: Hmm... She just went to look over the demonstration site? Seems she wants us to pass Chief Xamott's test, even if it's only for the chance to challenge me for Watts's hammer. Main thing is, she's stickin' around long enough to help with the tanks.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_097: But enough talk, let's get to work! Because if this doesn't go exactly accordin' to plan, we're done for! Oh gods...I'm not used to this sort of pressure!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_100: What do you think of the new, improved workshop? There's no way we can fail now, right? Actually, don't answer that...
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_101: It won't take us anywhere near as long to build the other four tanks as it did the first, but we still have our work cut out for us. Might have to tell the others no sleep till we're done!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_RONITT_000_102: And don't go thinkin' that excludes you! I'm expectin' great things from you in the days leadin' up to Beardtide, so no slackin'!
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_SYSTEM_000_103: Watts's Anvil is now equipped with everything needed to produce Rolling Tankards en masse.
TEXT_BANDWA004_03899_SYSTEM_000_104: But with the day of reckoning fast approaching, will Ronitt and his comrades be able to complete a column of tanks that meets Chief Xamott's exacting standards?

TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_000: I've got some bad news and some more bad news. Which do you want first?
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_001: All right, I'll pick. For starters, I hear the chief's been spendin' more and more time checkin' his beard in the mirror...
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_002: That can only mean one thing: it's almost Beardtide!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_003: What are we gonna do!? At this rate, we'll never make it!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_004: ...As for the other bit of bad news, some of the workers have turned tail and ran back to the village before they get in any more trouble! Now, there ain't enough people to handle production or bring in raw materials!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_005: Regitt, Karutt, and the others are already at their breakin' point. I even thought about askin' Ozogg for help, but I can't bloody find her!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_006: Think, Ronitt, think! There must be a way! Maybe a nice, relaxin' stroll will clear my head.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_007: Yeah, a quick trip to scenic Dampsole should sort me right out. And whatever you do, don't follow me! Even if you think I might get eaten by hungry beasties, don't follow me. Yes, definitely don't do that.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_SYSTEM_000_008: Ronitt definitely does not want you to follow him to Dampsole.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_010: Haha! I see you understood my subtle hints!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_011: You see, I wanted a word with you, away from the others. It's a bit of a touchy subject, and I don't want 'em gettin' discouraged or nothin'.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_012: You're good at keepin' secrets, ain't you?
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_013: Phew... All right. Truth is, I'm findin' it all a bit much. The pressure, the responsibility. I've always been a loner, and nothin' I ever did made a lot of difference to anyone else.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_014: Whereas it seems to me, you're the opposite. By the sounds of it, people are always turnin' to you for help. Don't you ever worry you'll make some sort of horrible mistake and...I dunno, cause the end of the world or somethin'? What's your secret?
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_A1_000_001: Just relax and let your talent do the work.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_A1_000_002: I get by with a little help from my friends.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_015: Yeah, solvin' problems is what I do best!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_016: You're right. I didn't get this far without my friends, and I'm gonna need 'em in the days to come. Watts's Anvil ain't just a place, it's the people who make it what it is!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_017: So, what you're sayin' is I'm just scared of failure? You're damned right I am! ...But maybe if I concentrate on succeedin' instead of not failin', things should start goin' my way!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_018: Thanks, I feel a lot better now. And with the great Watts's blood flowin' in my veins, there ain't nothin' I can't overcome!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_019: 'Course, I've got Watts's hammer as well, thanks to you findin' it for me!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_100_019: Not that I ever use it, mind you. I'm keepin' it safely hidden away until the day comes that I'm skilled enough to wield it myself. This thing? Just a normal, everyday hammer, mate. Nothin' special, but gets the job done.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_110_019: Point is, it gives me somethin' to look forward to, a reason not to give up. Can't go disappointin' my illustrious ancestor now, can I?
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_120_019: Still, honin' my own skills is all well and good, but if I really wanna go down in the history books, I've gotta think big, think beyond what I'm capable of doin' on my own.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_130_019: And with friends like you, how can I go wrong?
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_020: Right, I'd better get back to the workshop before I run out of steam again. I've found my motivation, now all I need is a plan. Hmm... I wonder what Watts would do at a time like this. A shame his expertise was in automata and not tanks.

TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_KARUTT_000_024: Yes, we heard everything. I wish you'd s-said something sooner! Y-You don't have to bear the b-burden on your own, you know. Let us sh-share the load!
