TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_041: That reminds me, I thought Ozogg was supposed to be around here somewhere!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_OZOGG_000_043: Sorry to keep you waiting. I took the liberty of inviting a few friends of yours.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_LORATHIA_000_044: I knew it was only a matter of time before you needed my help. My skills don't come cheap, you know!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_EUELISS_000_045: Sai-Lewq and I may not be engineers, but we're also not averse to a bit of hard work!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_SAILEWQ_000_046: Yes, just point out what needs doing and leave the rest to us. Really, considering all you've done for us, Master Ronitt, it would be our pleasure to assist you.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_047: You traveled all this way just to help me! Well, not you, Lorathia, you only live 'round the corner, but I'm grateful all the same! I'm so happy, I... I...
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_048: <sniff> All right! There's plenty of work to be done and not much time to do it!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_049: As for you, , just because all these people have shown up doesn't mean you're off the hook!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_LORATHIA_150_049: When I agreed to let you lot use my land, I had no idea the place would end up like this.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_LORATHIA_100_049: And to think it would be used to build the very same cannons I designed for the Crystarium. Sometimes I feel that life is a series of bizarre coincidences. Or is that what people call fate?
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_EUELISS_110_049: If there's one thing the people of Wright know about, it's producing alcohol, so imagine our surprise when we learned that Ronitt's tanks use ethanol for fuel. It seems Sai-Lewq and I will be making a greater contribution than we'd thought!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_SAILEWQ_120_049: I've made plenty of alcohol in my time, but never any strong enough to be used as fuel! Well, not intentionally, that is! Say, this could be a new avenue of business for Wright...
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_OZOGG_130_049: I wonder if I'll still be able to carry on engineering when I'm Lorathia's age?
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_LORATHIA_140_049: Oi! I'll have you know, I've got more than a few good years left in me!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_050: Time to put my plan into action. By usin' a load of existin' automaton parts, I'll be able to upgrade the workshop and build the rest of tanks, even with just this small number of us.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_051: Still, there are a few things that need to be made from scratch, and I've got a whole crate's worth of parts I want you to make. Anythin' less than perfection and it might blow up in our faces, so bring me your finest work, all right?
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_052: Still, there are a few things that need to be made from scratch, and I've got a whole crate's worth of parts I want you to make. Anythin' less than perfection and it might blow up in our faces, so bring me your finest work, all right?
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_053: Still, there are a few things that need to be made from scratch, and I've got a whole crate's worth of solutions and chemicals I want you to mix. Anythin' less than perfection and it might blow up in our faces, so bring me your finest work, all right?
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_054: The Fetchomatic Mechatoad'll dish out whatever materials you might need. I'm countin' on you, !

TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_SYSTEM_000_100: With the day of reckoning looming ever closer, Ronitt has decided that it would be quicker to construct an entire factory, complete with automaton workers, than build four tanks identical to the one he has already completed, but Ronitt's mind moves in mysterious ways.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_SYSTEM_000_101: For what Ronitt lacks in effective time management he more than makes up for with sheer stubbornness in the face of overwhelming odds. Perhaps this is what has earned him the respect and loyalty of his ragtag collection of friends?
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_SYSTEM_000_102: And yet, in spite of Ronitt's efforts, time refused to slow, heartless bastard that it is.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_104: The chief'll be here any moment, and I still have one more tank to finish!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_OZOGG_000_105: , I have an idea! Come with me!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_OZOGG_000_106: We'll try to buy you some time. You get that last tank completed, no matter what it takes!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_OZOGG_000_110: Phew! I'm not used to all this running about! Here, take this.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_OZOGG_000_111: It's nitrobrew, an alcoholic beverage that doubles as paint stripper, and it's strong enough to knock out a bison. If we leave these kegs in the road, Xamott is bound to help himself to a few swigs.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_OZOGG_000_113: Look, there isn't much time, and this is the best I could come up with! Just put them over there and let dwarven nature take its course.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_OZOGG_000_114: Hurry up! It'll all be for naught if he spots you!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_OZOGG_000_150: What!? He's already here! And why is Chief Glagg with him!?
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_OZOGG_000_151: But more importantly, did the nitrobrew do its job?
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_XAMOTT_000_152: It musht be...my lucky day! <hic> And beshides...be a shame to let all that <hic> grog go to waste...
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_GLAGG_000_153: For once, I...<hic>...agree with you... You old shwine... <hic>
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_OZOGG_000_157: Come on, Ronitt! They won't stay like this forever!

TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_XAMOTT_000_162: Yes, I notice a distinct lack of tanks. I declare this contest well and truly─
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_164: The hills are alive with the sound of...TANKS!♪
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_168: The Rollin' Tankards, at your service!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_170: What's wrong with you two? Aren't you gonna congratulate me on my hard-earned victory?
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_OZOGG_000_171: No, we're bloody well not! Have you any idea what you've put us through!?
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_100_172: Did I say “my hard-earned victory”? Of course, what I meant to say was “our hard-earned victory”! Yes, yes! A slip of the tongue, that's all! I-Is...that any better?
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_XAMOTT_000_173: Well, Ronitt. You did it, fair and square. No underhanded, dirty tricks. At least none that I'm aware of.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_GLAGG_000_174: Ozogg! Though I have yet to decide your punishment for consortin' with Tholls, I will say this: you have demonstrated the superiority of Gogg engineerin', without which, those tanks would never have seen the light of day!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_OZOGG_000_175: Listen, Chief. I didn't do this because I'm a Gogg, I did this because I'm a member of Watts's Anvil, so stick that in your pipe and smoke it!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_XAMOTT_000_176: All this talk of Tholl and Gogg has reminded me of somethin' important.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_XAMOTT_000_177: We don't often talk about this, but when I were a lad, my chief once told me that Tholl and Gogg were once part of a single tribe.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_XAMOTT_000_178: And into that one tribe was born a boy. His name...was Watts. He was blessed with curiosity and imagination in abundance, and grew up to become the greatest inventor our kind has ever known.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_XAMOTT_000_179: But sadly, the automata that he created caused a rift in our people. Some wanted to use them as workers, while others saw them as tools of war.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_GLAGG_000_180: Pah! And we all know how that ended. The limp-bearded Tholls, content to dig their holes and till their soil, and the mighty Goggs crushing their enemies and sowing the fields with their blood! Glory to Komra!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_GLAGG_000_182: A pox!? Is that the worst you Tholls can muster!?
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_183: Stop squabblin', the pair of you! I wanna hear the rest of the story!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_XAMOTT_000_184: Ah, yes, as I was saying... Watts was beside himself to think that his beloved inventions could lead to so much strife. He locked away the rest of his designs, so that they could never bring harm to his fellow dwarves.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_185: And those designs included the tank... It all makes sense now. No wonder he didn't want no one findin' 'em. But if I hadn't opened that safe, somebody else would've eventually.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_XAMOTT_000_186: How did you open it, anyway? It was locked tight!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_187: Erm... Well, it was a long time ago, so I ain't quite sure, but I remember I used a coin. One given to me by a Gogg, I think.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_OZOGG_000_188: Ah! That coin! It's the one I gave you!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_189: Eh!? You mean you're that Gogg girl, from all those years ago!?
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_XAMOTT_000_190: Maybe this is how Watts planned it all along... His descendants, workin' side by side.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_XAMOTT_000_191: It weren't the technology what were at fault. It was us dwarves and our bickerin' what caused us to live apart as Tholl and Gogg. But now, one of Watts's ideas might build a bridge between us...
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_GLAGG_000_192: Oh, shut up, you daft sod! You think this is all it takes to wash away generations of bad blood!? Pah! ...But on the other hand, we Goggs admire Watts just as much as you Tholls. If you're right─which would be a first─it's worth some thought.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_GLAGG_000_193: Trouble is, it all seems a little too convenient. The coin, the chance reunion, all the other coincidences, and there are probably a load more I don't even know about!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_XAMOTT_000_194:
“Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.”
You see, all the coincidences in the world won't do you no good if you ain't got the gumption to make the most of 'em. Somethin' Ronitt and Ozogg have in spades.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_XAMOTT_000_195: Right, that's enough blatherin' out of me. I'm off for a pint at the Crystarium on my way home.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_XAMOTT_100_195: And if you two think this is the end, think again! Five tanks is just the start. It'll take more'n that to solve the world's troubles!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_196: All right, I hear you. Now, bugger off and let us get on with it.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_197: That's funny... I thought those two were enemies. Probably got more in common than they realize. Anyway, it's time we got back to the Anvil!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_200: So you an' Ozogg bought me some time, did you? Should've bought a bit more by the sounds of it!
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_201: Heh, just jokin'. If it weren't for you two, I'd never have made it. I s'pose that's what Watts's Anvil is all about: you lot workin' your arses off to make me look good. Somethin' like that, anyway.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_RONITT_000_202: But it's like the chief said, a measly five tanks ain't gonna right the world's wrongs. So, I reckon...five hundred ought to do it! We'd better get back to work, an' no slackin'!

TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_SYSTEM_000_204: You will receive an experience point bonus upon completion of the dwarf society daily quests.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_SYSTEM_000_205: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from Mizutt.
TEXT_BANDWA005_03900_SYSTEM_000_210: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_000: Just who I was hopin' to see!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_002: Haha! A fine lali-ho if ever I heard one!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_003: Hmm... Nah, I don't think that'll catch on, mate. I'd stick to a good old-fashioned “lali-ho” if I were you. But I'm glad you're here, all the same!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_004: Ha! Don't tell me your head's gettin' soft in your old age! Or maybe you're just pullin' my leg? Either way, it's great to see you!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_005: Since the last time we spoke, we've been busier than ever. Our first payin' customers, Iriolva and Cobleva, have already started usin' Rollin' Tankards to ferry their goods about.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_006: So far, there've been no reports of any horrendous accidents or anythin', which is a relief.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_007: We'll be aimin' for the same high level of quality for the rest of the tanks, and thanks to our new friends, word's been gettin' around fast.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_008: Orders have been flyin' in thick and fast! This is goin' better'n I dared dream!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_010: 'Course, it wouldn't be the same without all of the others, so I'll go an' round 'em up. In the meantime, why don't you go over to Clearmelt and wait with Lorathia?
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_LORATHIA_000_020: Oh, I see you're the opposite of what they call “fashionably late.” Since you're here, you can help me get everything ready.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_100: Heh, I'm surprised you resisted the temptation to start diggin' in before we got here!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_101: I bet you ain't never seen a feast like this! We've got the best grub Norvrandt has to offer. Eueliss and Sai-Lewq even brought a keg of their famous ale over from Wright!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_102: "But how did they carry somethin' so heavy all this way?“ I hear you cry.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_LORATHIA_000_105: Those things might be armed to the teeth with some of the world's most advanced weaponry, but it's what they carry that makes the real difference. People across the land can get what they need, when they need it.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_LORATHIA_000_106: Not to mention a few of life's luxuries, too!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_EUELISS_000_107: It seems all of our hard work has finally paid off!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_EUELISS_000_108: To think that Wright is at long last able to produce its own ale again! Thanks to you and Ronitt, we've had the best barley crops in years.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_SAILEWQ_000_109: Even our very first batch has earned the approval of our village's most demanding beer aficionados. And due to the much improved quality of the soil, we have begun growing our own fruit, the juice of which we've brought for the younger ones and teetotalers to enjoy.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_OZOGG_000_110: All right everyone, it's time for a toast! So raise a tankard of ale, or tankard of juice if you're a mewling whelp like Ronitt─
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_111: Watch it, Ozogg, or you'll be wearin' that drink of yours!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_112: Ahem! To the continued success of Watts's Anvil and all of our friends!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_114: The years of struggle and adversity seem a distant memory to the inhabitants of the First as they strive for a better tomorrow.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_115: In particular, the dwarves of Kholusia will have a vital role to play in the days to come, with their ingenuity and diligence paving the way to unlimited possibilities.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_SYSTEM_000_116: And even after the dishes were cleared away, the celebrations continued...
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_REGITT_000_120: Shay there, ... You don't sheem drunk in the <hic> shlightesht.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_KARUTT_000_121: <hic> I...w-would jusht l-like to shay... To shay...
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_REGITT_000_123: Oi, Karutt! At leasht <hic> finish your shentence afore you fall ashleep!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_REGITT_000_124: I think...what he meansh ish...we all owe you our heartfelt thanksh, eshpecially Ronitt.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_KARUTT_000_125: Afore you showed up, he wouldn't shay boo to a gooshe, but now, <hic> he's turned into a great leader! Musht be from following your <hic> example.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_REGITT_000_126: We know you've got other people out there who <hic> need you, sho it would be shelfish to expect you to shtay, but we're grateful for the time you've <hic> shpent with ush.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_KARUTT_000_127: It m-means <hic> a lot, it really does.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_REGITT_000_128: And if you're ever passhing through, be sure to pay ush a visit!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_KARUTT_000_129: <hic> Anyway, w-we'd besht be heading b-back to the Anvil. <hic> Shafe travels!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_REGITT_000_130: Oh, and make sure you shay <hic> good-bye to Euelissh and Shai-Lewq afore you leave. They've been meaning to shpeak with you!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_SAILEWQ_000_141: Eueliss and I were just talking about you. We were wondering if the ale was to your liking, and then it occurred to me that you may not even drink in the first place.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_SAILEWQ_000_142: Do you, ah, partake in the odd tipple?
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_A2_000_001: No, I never touch the stuff.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_A2_000_002: I've been known to wet my whistle on occasion.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_A2_000_003: You can't buy love, but you can buy alcohol, which is better.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_SAILEWQ_000_143: Then perhaps we have found another customer for our soon-to-be-famous fruit juice! And be sure to tell your friends!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_SAILEWQ_000_144: Yes, and no doubt the volume varying in accordance with the nature of said occasion! A happy one such as this calls for more than a mere sip or two, I daresay!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_SAILEWQ_000_145: Words to live by! Perhaps we can use that as our slogan?
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_EUELISS_000_146: Can I say, Sai-Lewq, how wonderful it is to see you in such high spirits! You're like a changed man!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_EUELISS_000_147: A change we have you to thank for, . Considering all you've done for us and our village, I cannot imagine how we will ever repay you, so if there is aught you need, just say the word!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_SAILEWQ_000_148: My sentiments exactly. I dread to think what would have become of us without your intervention.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_EUELISS_000_149: Yes, and we owe a debt of gratitude to Master Ronitt, as well. Thanks to him and his automaton, my father's dream has at long last come true!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_SAILEWQ_000_150: If we take a leaf out of Ronitt's book by combining ingenuity with hard work, there is nothing we cannot achieve.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_EUELISS_000_151: Maybe the next time you come to Wright, we'll have something new to show you. Our doors are always open, so don't be a stranger!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_SAILEWQ_000_152: Ah! I almost forgot to ask, but have you spoken with Ozogg? It seems there is something she would like to discuss with you.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_SAILEWQ_000_154: I must say, this is quite the gathering!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_OZOGG_000_155: This ale from Wright really hits the spot!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_156: Who does she think she is, callin' me a “mewlin' whelp”!? I don't even know what that means, but I assume it's an insult!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_LORATHIA_000_161: I'm sure  has room for some more. Have you tried these wrigglers from Amh Araeng? If you can pluck up the courage, they're quite delicious!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_100_162: Yeah! I can't get enough of 'em!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_OZOGG_000_162: Urp... Just thinking about them is making me queasy.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_LORATHIA_000_163: Come on, live a little! It's like I always say: youth is wasted on the young.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_OZOGG_000_164: Yes, and it'll be even more of a waste if a gifted engineer like me chokes to death on some godsforsaken worm! I've got to look after myself if I want these plans of ours to come to fruition.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_165: Anyway, Lorathia, I'll bet your best years are still ahead of you. In fact, why don't you come and help out at Watts's Anvil? It's gotta be better'n drinkin' tea and soakin' in the hot springs all day!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_LORATHIA_000_166: When you get to my age, you'll learn to appreciate things like that, you mark my words! Still, it wouldn't do to let my skills get rusty. I suppose I could pop over and do a spot of welding from time to time.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_OZOGG_000_167: Actually, , there's something I want to say to you.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_OZOGG_000_168: For most of my life, I've been living according to others' expectations, without thinking about what I want. But thanks to you, I've made up my mind!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_OZOGG_000_169: Like you, I'm going to pursue my own goals, my own dreams. That's why I've decided to carry on here, where I can express myself and be who I want to be.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_OZOGG_000_170: Rather than wasting my life being bound by traditions and rules, I want to be free to go where I please and do as I please.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_LORATHIA_000_171: But don't you want to go back to your village? All the Tholls here have permission to travel between Tomra and the Anvil whenever they want. What about you?
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_OZOGG_000_172: Well, it's not as though I've been banished. Not yet, anyway.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_OZOGG_000_173: I can hardly go back to Komra now, can I?
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_OZOGG_000_174: From this day forth, I am no longer a Gogg! I shall live only as Ozogg, descendant of Watts himself. I answer to no one!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_180: You can't just take off your helmet like that! I-It's...indecent!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_LORATHIA_000_181: Hahaha! I think he's just getting flustered by the sight of a pretty girl!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_OZOGG_000_182: Ahahaha! How can he expect to beat me in a battle of wits if he turns into a babbling buffoon every time I take my helmet off? Watts's hammer is as good as mine!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_OZOGG_000_183: That reminds me, I should get started on my next creation and prove my superiority once and for all! Time to head back to the Anvil!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_LORATHIA_000_184: And it looks like I might be joining you sooner rather than later.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_LORATHIA_000_185: You young'uns have brought me some much-needed excitement, and I can't wait to see what you'll come up with next.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_LORATHIA_000_186: When I heard they were bringing worms over from Amh Araeng for us to eat, I thought they'd gone barmy. But having tasted them, I can see the appeal!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_EUELISS_000_187: While we'll be taking it one step at a time, if we continue our efforts, Wright will go from strength to strength!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_SAILEWQ_000_188: If only our dearly departed were here with us now... I should like to think they are watching over us even at this very moment.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_LORATHIA_000_189: This certainly makes a difference from the usual crowd we have here at Clearmelt!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_190: That Ozogg! Ain't she got no shame!? Just because she don't wanna go back to Komra, there's no need to...to...expose herself like that!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_191: I know you ain't a Tholl or a Gogg, so I don't expect you to understand, but you agree with me, don't you?
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_A3_000_001: This is the worst thing that's ever happened in Lakeland. The worst thing!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_A3_000_002: You should take off your helmet, too. You might find it liberating.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_192: Yeah, exactly! I should give her a piece of my mind!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_194: No, absolutely not, never! I'd rather lose my whole damn head than remove my helmet! Grrr... This is all Ozogg's fault! She needs a bloody good talkin' to.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_196: Bugger it, I can't remember what I was gonna say now! Urngh...somethin' about thankin' you, or whatever it was...
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_197: Well, I s'pose I should express my gratitude for stickin' with me through thick 'n thin, even when it looked like this whole plan was gonna blow up in my face.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_198: I know sometimes I can get a bit jealous of you havin' so many talents compared to me, bein' the savior of the bleedin' world and all that.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_199: But I know you ain't doin' it to steal my thunder, you're just tryin' to be a good friend. And you are. The very best.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_200: Bloody hells, keep this up an' I'll start bawlin' like a newborn! Anyway, the struggle to get those tanks might be over, but me, Ozogg, and the others'll carry on here.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_RONITT_000_201: So if you ever feel like showin' off those skills of yours, you know where to come. In the meantime, best of luck with savin' the world or whatever you'll be doin'!
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_SYSTEM_000_210: You have achieved Bloodsworn reputation with Watts's Anvil.
TEXT_BANDWA006_03901_SYSTEM_000_211: You will receive an experience point bonus upon completion of the dwarf society daily quests.
TEXT_BANDWA101_03902_REGITT_000_001: As you know, we're going to need a bloody mountain of bits and pieces to make our tanks...and bugger me if those soldiers at the castle didn't kindly offer to help out.
TEXT_BANDWA101_03902_REGITT_000_002: So, in exchange for them sharing their supplies, we've promised to fix up their gear and whatnot. A little give-and-take, you understand.
TEXT_BANDWA101_03902_REGITT_100_002: I've already sent a tinkerer over to Ostall to start repairing equipment, but he's working all on his own. Could probably use a hand...and look, you've got two of them!
TEXT_BANDWA101_03902_CRAFTSDWARF03902_10: Oh, did Regitt send you, too? Brilliant! I've plenty of arms and armor to knock back into shape, but not enough parts to mend them.
I'd appreciate it if you could take these scraps and put together three repair kits for mending blades, spearheads, and the like. The automaton will cough up more materials if you need them.
I'd appreciate it if you could take these cutoffs and put together three repair kits for mending hafts, scabbards, and the like. The automaton will cough up more materials if you need them.
I'd appreciate it if you could take these leftover oils and put together three repair kits for greasing, polishing, and the like. The automaton will cough up more ingredients if you need them.
Otherwise, you can just drop them in my lap when you're done!
TEXT_BANDWA101_03902_CRAFTSDWARF03902_00: Lali-ho! You have those repair kits I needed?
Aye, that's the stuff! ...In fact, these kits might be better quality than the gear I mean to fix!
Ahem, right, I'd best get to work. You can head on back to Regitt and tell him we're holding up our side of the bargain!
Thanks for the help─you've made my job a damn sight easier!
TEXT_BANDWA101_03902_REGITT_000_030: Back already, are you? How fares our tinkerer?
TEXT_BANDWA101_03902_REGITT_000_031: It sounds like he was well pleased with your contribution─thanks for that, ! We're guests in this neck of the woods, after all, and I reckon it's wise we stay on the garrison's good side.
TEXT_BANDWA101_03902_REGITT_000_032: The best way we can repay their hospitality, though, is to make our tanks as good as they can be. The protection they'll give to the merchant caravans will mean one less headache for the soldiers to worry about!
TEXT_BANDWA102_03903_REGITT_000_001: Considering the nature of our work, it's unavoidable that the Anvil accumulates its fair share of oil and grime. But as we labor away at our tasks, all that filth finds its way into our whiskers!
TEXT_BANDWA102_03903_REGITT_000_002: A dwarf can't be expected to concentrate while his beard resembles a cotton boll dragged through a puddle of mud! And the worst of it is, we're always running low on grooming supplies!
TEXT_BANDWA102_03903_REGITT_000_003: I need you to find our procurer over at Fort Jobb, and help him stock up on beardcare essentials. This is an emergency!
TEXT_BANDWA102_03903_DAILYDWARF03903_000: Lali-ho! Regitt getting impatient, is he? Well, the Fort Jobb folk just traded me a bundle of choice materials, so you can get straight to crafting.
Here, see if you can't use something in that lot to forge two pairs of trimming scissors. The Mechatoad has more bits and bobs in reserve should you need them.
Here, see if you can't use something in that lot to make a couple of grooming brushes. The Mechatoad has more bits and bobs in reserve should you need them.
Here, see if you can't use something in that lot to mix up a couple of jars of styling cream. The Mechatoad has more bits and bobs in reserve should you need them.
Now, I was going to ask you to visit me when you're finished, but you might as well deliver those kits directly to Regitt. Hopefully I'll get the chance to groom my own beard once I get back!
Like I said, if you run out of materials, just tap on the Mechatoad here. Oooh, I can feel my beard bristling with anticipation!
Like I said, if you run out of materials, just tap on the Mechatoad here. Oooh, I can feel my beard bristling with anticipation!
Like I said, if you run out of ingredients, just tap on the Mechatoad here. Oooh, I can feel my beard bristling with anticipation!
You have those grooming goods ready? Go ahead and run them over to Regitt at the Anvil!
TEXT_BANDWA102_03903_REGITT_000_030: There you are! Any luck with those beardcare supplies?
TEXT_BANDWA102_03903_REGITT_000_031: Lali-ho-ho-ho! Aye, this'll help turn my whiskers back into the lush, silky strands they were meant to be! No more hair-based distractions for me!
TEXT_BANDWA102_03903_REGITT_000_032: <sigh> ...Back on Kholusia, we had all the time in the world to care for our beards. Since we set up our workshop here, though, grooming has taken second place to all this frenzied tank business...
TEXT_BANDWA102_03903_REGITT_000_033: Still, even if our beards do look a bit bedraggled, it's because of how hard we've been working!
TEXT_BANDWA103_03904_REGITT_000_001: Our Rolling Tankards will be the culmination of much careful planning and applied theory, which is why I want to entrust the most vital elements to a master artisan of proven quality. ...Aye, that would be you!
TEXT_BANDWA103_03904_REGITT_000_003: There's much to be done, but Shigitt can give you the details─and the resources─you need to proceed. We're counting on you, !
TEXT_BANDWA103_03904_SHIGITT_000_010: Ready to make some core components for the Tankard, then? Glad to have you aboard.
TEXT_BANDWA103_03904_SHIGITT_000_012: Right, so what I need from you is four tempered nozzles, highly resistant to heat─they'll be used in the fuel injection device for emergency escapes, so we'll want to be sure they work. Start with these materials, and let me know if you need more.
TEXT_BANDWA103_03904_SHIGITT_000_013: Right, so what I need from you is four padded cushions for the tank's interior─we need to make sure the automaton inside is properly protected from impacts. Start with these materials, and let me know if you need more.
TEXT_BANDWA103_03904_SHIGITT_000_014: Right, so what I need from you is four durable tracks of rubber for the wheels─when the going gets rough, we'll want the tank to keep rolling. Start with these ingredients, and let me know if you need more.
TEXT_BANDWA103_03904_SHIGITT_000_016: Once you're satisfied, take what you've made straight to Regitt, and he'll pass it on to the tank engineers. They're eager to put everything together!
TEXT_BANDWA103_03904_SHIGITT_000_017: You've got everything you need, so all that remains is the application of some elbow grease!
TEXT_BANDWA103_03904_SHIGITT_000_018: You've got everything you need, so all that remains is the application of some elbow grease!
TEXT_BANDWA103_03904_SHIGITT_000_019: You've got everything you need, so all that remains is the application of some elbow grease!
TEXT_BANDWA103_03904_SHIGITT_000_020: Out of materials already? ...Fine. I suppose I can spare some from the stores.
TEXT_BANDWA103_03904_SHIGITT_000_021: Out of materials already? ...Fine. I suppose I can spare some from the stores.
TEXT_BANDWA103_03904_SHIGITT_000_022: Out of ingredients already? ...Fine. I suppose I can spare some from the stores.
TEXT_BANDWA103_03904_REGITT_000_031: Now this is some fine work...very fine indeed! With parts of this quality, our tanks will perform even better than Watts could've imagined! Lali-ho-ho-ho, I am moved to tears! Flabbergasted! Duly impressed!
TEXT_BANDWA103_03904_REGITT_000_032: ...Uh, not that I'm trying to flatter you so you'll accept an even more difficult task next time or anything like that! I just...know how to appreciate true artisanship! Yes!
TEXT_BANDWA104_03905_REGITT_000_001: Bugger me silly! When we came here, no one had the courtesy to tell us these gremlins would be even more of a pain in the arse than hobgoblins! Just imagining those bug-eyes and mangy fur gets my blood boiling something fierce.
TEXT_BANDWA104_03905_REGITT_000_002: As if their incessant chattering wasn't enough of a nuisance, the soldiers at the Ostall Imperative tell me they have a natural curiosity for machinery─a curiosity that ends with the machines in a pile of scrap more often than not.
TEXT_BANDWA104_03905_REGITT_000_003: Needless to say, we can't suffer an infestation of those vermin. That's why, with the help of those aforementioned soldiers, I've built these traps to keep them at bay. Go ahead and lay them around for me, would you?
TEXT_BANDWA104_03905_REGITT_000_020: From the looks of things, it seems the traps were as effective as I was led to believe. That ought to keep those pests out of our beards for the time being.
TEXT_BANDWA104_03905_REGITT_000_021: To think that the sight of mere sweets would inspire such fear in the gremlins. If what the soldiers told me is true, however, it's not the sweets themselves that are dangerous so much as what they herald: pixies!
TEXT_BANDWA104_03905_REGITT_000_022: Legend has it that if you spot candy in the wild, those winged hoodwinkers will be nearby. And for all the gremlins' penchant for trickery, even they wouldn't dare get between a pixie and their confectionary. Perhaps when I set the traps next, I'll stay behind to see if the stories are true.
TEXT_BANDWA105_03906_REGITT_000_001: A wheel's axle takes the brunt of the wear and tear, and never has that been more true than with our tanks. We've been experimenting with a few different designs, but judging from the screeching some have been making, it seems like they're not up to the task.
TEXT_BANDWA105_03906_REGITT_000_002: I reckon we could use your help in crafting a solution to this pressing matter, considering your knack for handiwork. 'Course, reputation only counts for so much, so I trust you'll give the parts a thorough testing before we put them to use.
TEXT_BANDWA105_03906_REGITT_000_003: Shigitt's the one in charge of the supplies, and it's him that'll fill you in on what we need. Off you go, now.
TEXT_BANDWA105_03906_SHIGITT_000_010: Ah, come to help with my tests, have you? Very good─the results of these trials could prove paramount to the further development of our tanks.
TEXT_BANDWA105_03906_SHIGITT_000_011: Of course, considering their size, it would be folly to test the parts on the tanks straightaway. That's why we'll be using automata for now. Much safer─a malfunctioning automaton never hurt anyone...as far as I know.
TEXT_BANDWA105_03906_SHIGITT_000_012: Now then, take these and work your magic to make three of my new load-bearing mechanisms. If you misplace or otherwise find yourself in need of more parts, you can always get more from Ronitt's automaton.
TEXT_BANDWA105_03906_SHIGITT_000_013: Now then, take these and work your magic to make three of my new load-bearing mechanisms. If you misplace or otherwise find yourself in need of more parts, you can always get more from Ronitt's automaton.
TEXT_BANDWA105_03906_SHIGITT_000_014: Now then, take these and work your magic to make three measures of my specialized oil─it should make those wheels as quiet as a cat's footsteps. If you misplace or otherwise find yourself in need of more parts, you can always get more from Ronitt's automaton.
TEXT_BANDWA105_03906_SHIGITT_000_016: Once you're finished, give the parts to my workers in Weathering and you can commence with the testing. I await positive results, and failing that, enlightening ones!
TEXT_BANDWA105_03906_DAILYDWARF03906_000: Oh, so you've brought what I asked for? Good, good. Now let's just stick them right in here...
TEXT_BANDWA105_03906_SYSTEM03906_000_032: Without making a sound, the automaton zooms off at full speed until it becomes a speck on the horizon.
TEXT_BANDWA105_03906_DAILYDWARF03906_000: Well, off it goes! But did you hear that? Or should I say, did you not hear that? I daresay it wouldn't wake a baby. Well done, well done!

And now─
Oh, where'd it go!? I'd better find it before it falls off a cliff, or worse─automata don't exactly grow on trees! In the meantime, tell Regitt that the parts should be ready for use.
TEXT_BANDWA105_03906_SYSTEM03906_000_035: The automaton starts with a jolt, and without making a sound, zooms off into the distance at a frightening speed.
TEXT_BANDWA105_03906_DAILYDWARF03906_000: Would you look at that! Not a squeak! Something seems to be wrong with the speed-limiting mechanism, but that's hardly a fault of yours. Perhaps I might call on your expert counsel later to address this new issue.
Now, where did it go...? I'd best send someone to find it before it crashes into some poor, unsuspecting soul. You go and tell Regitt the parts you made are in perfect working order.
TEXT_BANDWA105_03906_REGITT_000_040: Welcome back! I can tell by the grease on your hands that you've been hard at work. And judging by the smile on your face, I reckon the tests were a rousing success!
TEXT_BANDWA105_03906_REGITT_000_041: For the good of the Anvil, we must continue developing and testing ever more complex parts. Then one day, we'll have a fleet of tanks that are silent not because they're broken down, but because they've been so masterfully built!
TEXT_BANDWA105_03906_REGITT_000_042: Of course, even the most well-designed machines still need regular maintenance, but building them properly in the first place is half the battle. I sense many more tests are in store for us both!
TEXT_BANDWA106_03907_REGITT_000_001: Do you know what it's like to be too clever for your own good? Of course you do. Try as we might, we dwarves just can't stop birthing ideas─our minds are like broken dams of creativity. The only problem is that we have so many ideas that we've plumb run out of materials to write them down with!
TEXT_BANDWA106_03907_REGITT_000_002: We're quite particular about what we use to immortalize our designs─you can't expect us to be satisfied with any run-of-the-mill ink and parchment! If they were made by one with your talents, however, I'm sure everyone would be more than happy.
TEXT_BANDWA106_03907_REGITT_000_003: The quartermaster at Fort Jobb should have the supplies you need, but he's always going to and fro gathering what needs gathering. It's really a matter of luck whether he's there now or not.
TEXT_BANDWA106_03907_DAILYDWARF03907_000: So you're the one meant to help with the blueprints, eh? Good, good. I have a keen eye for materials, but when it comes to actually putting them together, I'm all thumbs!
If the other dwarves don't get what they need, we'll soon have a riot on our hands. Nothing's worse than having an idea stewing in your head with no way to let it out into the world!

I suppose we should start by having you make the most essential of materials: a pen nib. Can't very well write with some stick off the ground, can you? Take these materials, and if you run out for any reason, the automaton will be happy to oblige you with more.

I suppose we should start by having you make the most essential of materials: paper. Two large sheets should do─more than enough space to fit in even the most labyrinthine of designs. Take these materials, and if you run out for any reason, the automaton will be happy to oblige you with more.

I suppose we should start by having you make the most essential of materials: ink. Two vials of the fast-drying type should do─that's plenty enough for even the most ambitious dwarf to pen their next brilliant invention. Take these ingredients, and if you run out for any reason, the automaton will be happy to oblige you with more.
Once you've done your part, make haste to the Anvil and deliver the supplies to Regitt. Doubtless there are many workers who are going positively nutty for all the ideas trapped in their noggins.
I realize that perfection is the progeny of trial and error. If for whatever reason you require more materials, simply procure them from the nearby automaton.
I realize that perfection is the progeny of trial and error. If for whatever reason you require more materials, simply procure them from the nearby automaton.
I realize that perfection is the progeny of trial and error. If for whatever reason you require more materials, simply procure them from the nearby automaton.
It would seem your reputation is well deserved! Now take what you made to Regitt before he gets it in his head that we're lazing about.
TEXT_BANDWA106_03907_REGITT_000_030: Do you have the materials? I do hope so─I can feel my budding ideas withering away...
TEXT_BANDWA106_03907_REGITT_000_031: Ah, these will do nicely! Even the most ambitious design starts with a blueprint, and so the ink and parchment are tools equally as important as the hammer and anvil!
TEXT_BANDWA106_03907_REGITT_000_032: I reckon this should keep us settled for a while yet, but as I said before, the flow of ideas is constant. I may have need of your services again sooner rather than later.
TEXT_BANDWA107_03908_REGITT_000_001: So, you've been wandering around the Anvil for a while now. Out of all the myriad materials we produce here, which do you reckon is the one we use the most of on a day-to-day basis?
TEXT_BANDWA107_03908_REGITT_000_002: If you guessed steel plates, then congratulations─seems your eyes are as keen as your hands. Indeed, the sound of a hammer on steel is the sound of creation here at the Anvil─the birth of anything from a simple chest to a tank fit for combat.
TEXT_BANDWA107_03908_REGITT_000_003: Just like your eyes and your hands, I suppose your mind is keen enough to gather what I might be asking you to make next, then. We're constantly running low on steel sheets, and the whole of the Anvil would be grateful if you made a few for us. Go and see our smithy over at Weathering and tell him I sent you.
TEXT_BANDWA107_03908_DAILYDWARF03908_000: I take it you're the crafter who's meant to “save my arse,” as Regitt put it. He was quite effusive in regards to your skills, in his way, and if even half his blustering is true, then I'm glad to have you.

The materials we can gather here are altogether different from those we have in Kholusia, and we have our hands full trying to keep up with increasing demand. Any way you could help us would be a godssend.
I think a few ingots ought to help us along. Three, to be precise. This ore I've procured should suffice, but if for whatever reason you run out of materials, just get more from the automaton.

A proper sheet of metal has to be scoured to a mirror shine, and for that we need the proper tools. Here, take these and let's see what you can come up with. If for whatever reason you run out of materials, just get more from the automaton.

Dull metal reflects the dullness of the builder's ambition, and so we polish our sheets to a mirror shine. For that, of course, you need something stronger than spit, and that's where you come in. Take these, and if for whatever reason you run out of materials, get more from the automaton.
Once you're finished, bring the materials to Regitt at once. Doubtless he is eager to begin ramping up production.
Remember, if you run out of materials, the automaton is here to provide whatsoever you need.
Remember, if you run out of materials, the automaton is here to provide whatsoever you need.
Remember, if you run out of materials, the automaton is here to provide whatsoever you need.
Well, what're you doing? Don't stand around here─take the supplies to Regitt!
TEXT_BANDWA107_03908_REGITT_000_030: Ah, you are returned! I trust there were no insurmountable hurdles this time around.
TEXT_BANDWA107_03908_REGITT_000_031: Perfection! With this we can produce even more sheets than we were before─and that means more metal for everyone!
TEXT_BANDWA107_03908_REGITT_000_032: We use the sheets for everything from our helmets, to our homes, to our tanks! We will never be without a need for them, or for your expert hand.
TEXT_BANDWA108_03909_REGITT_000_001: I trust all is well with you, . Would that I could say the same for myself. My scouts have recently spotted a suspicious figure skulking about, doubtless looking for an opportunity to abscond with our precious metals.
TEXT_BANDWA108_03909_REGITT_000_002: Make no mistake, if that scoundrel dares to step foot in my workshop, I won't hesitate to take my hammer and give whoever─or whatever─it is a walloping they won't soon forget, but I must admit I don't savor the thought of doing so. My talents lie in crafting, not combat.
TEXT_BANDWA108_03909_REGITT_000_003: You, however, are artisan and warrior both! I would ask you to patrol the area where the suspect was last sighted, and if you spot anyone, greet them with a hearty lali-ho. I pray you're able to resolve this matter with words, but if they should prove hostile, well...I'll pray for your safe return!
TEXT_BANDWA108_03909_ELF03909_000_010: And just who the hells are you, eh? Quite the unsavory type, and believe me, I would know. Stay well away if you know what's good for you.
TEXT_BANDWA108_03909_SYSTEM_000_110: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing the word “lali-ho” to greet the Nightshade elf.
TEXT_BANDWA108_03909_ELF03909_000_011: You...you're in league with those sodding dwarves! Well, you go back to your masters and tell them one thing: Lakeland belongs to the elves─every ilm of it!
TEXT_BANDWA108_03909_GUARD03909_000_012: Well, well, I didn't expect to see the bleedin' hero of the realm on today of all days! To what do I owe the honor?
TEXT_BANDWA108_03909_SYSTEM_000_112: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing the word “lali-ho” to greet the vigilant guard.
TEXT_BANDWA108_03909_GUARD03909_000_013: Oh, I know that one! That's what them dwarves over at the Anvil say, innit? A few of them came down this way and hailed me with those selfsame words.
TEXT_BANDWA108_03909_GUARD03909_000_113:
Lali-ho! Heh heh...
Well, wherever you're headed, stay out of trouble, yeah?
TEXT_BANDWA108_03909_SYSTEM_000_114: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing the word “lali-ho” to greet the wayward gremlin.
TEXT_BANDWA108_03909_GREMLIN03909_000_01: Lali-ho! Lali-ho, lali-ho! Ho ho ho!
TEXT_BANDWA108_03909_SYSTEM_000_016: The gremlin mimics the greeting repeatedly, looking quite pleased with itself as it scampers away.
TEXT_BANDWA108_03909_REGITT_000_020:
Who─ Who's that!?
Oh, it's you, at last! Well, what did you find out about this intruder?
TEXT_BANDWA108_03909_REGITT_000_021: Phew, you couldn't have come with better news. Truth be told, I practically soiled myself just imagining what I might have to do with this hammer if something surly were to come this way. Out of pity for them, of course, not fear for myself!
TEXT_BANDWA108_03909_REGITT_000_022: Regardless, I'm glad we had you to check up on things for us. Always prepare for the worst, eh? Speaking of which, if any other suspicious fellows wander near the Anvil, I trust I can count on you once more.
TEXT_BANDWA109_03910_REGITT_000_001: We're well on our way to producing ethanol by the barrelful, and we'll soon have enough to fuel a whole battalion of tanks. That is, of course, if someone doesn't mistake it for ale and drink it all!
TEXT_BANDWA109_03910_REGITT_000_002: Regardless, it doesn't matter how much ethanol we have if we've nowhere to store it. And considering the size of the battalion I'm imagining, we'll need storage sites up and down Lakeland!
TEXT_BANDWA109_03910_REGITT_000_003: First things first: we build barrels─lots of them. Or should I say, you build barrels. Shigitt should have all the supplies you need. Run along now!
TEXT_BANDWA109_03910_SHIGITT_000_010: Ah, so you're here to help with the barrels. I'm glad to have a strapping  like you to assist me.
TEXT_BANDWA109_03910_SHIGITT_000_012: I'll need three metal hoops, sturdy enough to last a dozen years' weathering. These supplies should do, but if you find yourself short, then the Fetchomatic Mechatoad can always give you more.
TEXT_BANDWA109_03910_SHIGITT_000_013: I'll need three wooden staves, sturdy enough to last a dozen years' weathering. These supplies should do, but if you find yourself short, then the Fetchomatic Mechatoad can always give you more.
TEXT_BANDWA109_03910_SHIGITT_000_014: I'll need three bottles of varnish, resilient enough to last a dozen years' weathering. These supplies should do, but if you find yourself short, then the Fetchomatic Mechatoad can always give you more.
TEXT_BANDWA109_03910_SHIGITT_000_016: Once you've worked your magic, deliver your finished product to our cooper over at the Ostall Imperative. The Anvil's a mite small for the number of barrels we're hoping to make, so we've arranged to borrow a bit of storage.
TEXT_BANDWA109_03910_DAILYDWARF03910_000: So you've come from the Anvil, have you? Well met. I oversee the construction and maintenance of our barrels, which store the dwarves' lifebloods: ale and oil! What have you brought for me today?
Fine craftsmanship, this is. I daresay I couldn't do better myself. Any barrels I make with these will be as solid as they come. Go ahead and inform Regitt that my work will begin at once.
Yes, I'm still here admiring your excellent work. I'm sure Regitt is eager to know that construction of the barrels will soon be underway.
TEXT_BANDWA109_03910_REGITT_000_040: Welcome back! No, there's no need to tell me─I can see by your face that you carried out your task with characteristic aplomb.
TEXT_BANDWA109_03910_REGITT_000_041: When we began to increase production of ethanol, it seemed only meet that we would use the same barrels we've always used to store our ale. For countless generations they've proven most effective at keeping their contents inside themselves. What more can you ask for?
TEXT_BANDWA109_03910_REGITT_000_042: Of course, we'll continue to use them to store ale, a resource more precious than any other! Oh, if only there was a way to fuel our tanks with that most wonderful ambrosia!
TEXT_BANDWA110_03911_REGITT_000_001: Our tanks may be imposing, but without their engines they're no more useful than a pile of scrap. The engine's not the only moving part, either─there are countless other gears and valves that need daily maintenance.
TEXT_BANDWA110_03911_REGITT_000_002: I might even say our tanks are even more demanding than our beards! That is why you should be honored to receive the noble task of helping us keep them in tip-top shape. Our tanks, that is─not our beards.
TEXT_BANDWA110_03911_REGITT_000_003: Shigitt has all the details, and the supplies besides. I've already sent word ahead to expect you.
TEXT_BANDWA110_03911_SHIGITT_000_010: Ah, there you are! This task has ramifications for our safety and livelihoods, and I would trust none other than you to get it done right.
TEXT_BANDWA110_03911_SHIGITT_000_012: I require something small, but utterly essential: a single screw. I've chosen the materials most painstakingly─we cannot accept anything less than perfection for every step of this project. I've programmed the automaton to select its materials with equal care if you should run out.
TEXT_BANDWA110_03911_SHIGITT_000_013: I require a cloth made from fine fibers of the utmost quality. I've chosen the materials most painstakingly─we cannot accept anything less than perfection for every step of this project. I've programmed the automaton to select its materials with equal care if you should run out.
TEXT_BANDWA110_03911_SHIGITT_000_014: If the engine is the heart of our tanks, then oil is their lifeblood. One bottle should do for now. I've chosen the materials most painstakingly─we cannot accept anything less than perfection for every step of this project. I've programmed the automaton to select its materials with equal care if you should run out.
TEXT_BANDWA110_03911_SHIGITT_000_016: Once you're finished, I think you know who to visit next. Godsspeed!
TEXT_BANDWA110_03911_REGITT_000_030: Back at last! And with vital parts for our engines, no doubt!
TEXT_BANDWA110_03911_REGITT_000_031: Hmm, yes, this certainly lives up to the high standards you've set thus far. I had it in mind to simply maintain the engines, but this may very well improve them.
TEXT_BANDWA110_03911_REGITT_000_032: Perhaps so much so that a new model name is in order. What do you say? How about...the Hellacious Hobsmasher Hammer Mark IX! For what is an anvil without a hammer to strike upon it?
TEXT_BANDWA110_03911_SYSTEM_000_033: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANDWA111_03912_REGITT_000_001: For generations us dwarves have made our livelihoods by wresting hidden veins of minerals from the earth with our own hands.
TEXT_BANDWA111_03912_REGITT_000_002: That being said, here at the Anvil the number of hands we have is somewhat limited, and as the scale of our operations grows, we must look without to find whatsoever help is available. And right now, it seems that is you!
TEXT_BANDWA111_03912_REGITT_000_003: Head to the Hour of Certain Durance, where one of my workers oversees the mining operations. Our tasks there are endless, and I've no doubt he will have something that requires your expertise.
TEXT_BANDWA111_03912_DAILYDWARF03912_000: Ah, you've come at exactly the right time! We've just discovered a vein of ore in this slab of rock here, and I was getting ready to blow it wide open. But now that you're here, why don't you do the honors?

Ah hah! I love the smell of thermite in the morning! Some are frightened of a little explosive, but I always say that if you take the proper precautions and keep your distance, it's no more dangerous than farming!
Whew! If you had been just a few ilms closer, that explosion might have been slightly...messier. But, all's well that ends well, I always say. A little dust and debris never harmed no one, after all!
Ah, there's nothing like an explosion to get the juices flowing, eh? I'll get to sorting through the rubble for the choicest minerals─you go tell Regitt our work here is done. For now, at least.
TEXT_BANDWA111_03912_REGITT_000_030: You're back, and judging from the fine layer of dust covering you, you've carried out your task splendidly!
TEXT_BANDWA111_03912_REGITT_000_031: Despite what you saw today, there's a lot more to mining than tossing explosives at rocks. Our knowledge of the trade is as deep and vast as the mountains we venture into, and we can sniff out veins of ore that've escaped the noses of the finest miners of Lakeland.
TEXT_BANDWA111_03912_REGITT_000_032: So stick with us, and there's no telling what riches might be in store for you! Rest assured I'll be calling upon you again when we hit the mother lode.
TEXT_BANDWA112_03913_REGITT_000_001: Production of ethanol is proceeding apace, but as you well know, I'm a dwarf who aims ever higher in all aspects. Our ethanol can always be more pure, burn more efficiently, and be more gentle on our engines.
TEXT_BANDWA112_03913_REGITT_000_002: It's time we used a bit of trial and error to refine our processes. If luck is on our side, we'll discover a way to improve our ale distillation as well.
TEXT_BANDWA112_03913_REGITT_000_003: We are conducting a series of experiments as we speak, and are in constant need of supplies until we get it just right. You've proven trustworthy and capable thus far, so I can think of no better  for the task. Shigitt should have everything you need to get started.
TEXT_BANDWA112_03913_SHIGITT_000_010: Who would've thought that the Gogg ethanol formula would prove so effective? Still, we Tholls aren't to be outdone, and we're not above asking for your help in creating a superior version. Our main dwarf in charge has decided to conduct his delicate work in Clearmelt, far from the hustle and bustle of the Anvil.
TEXT_BANDWA112_03913_SHIGITT_000_012: Since you're planning to go there anyway, perhaps you could take something with you? I'd like you to make three metal flasks, able to withstand even the most extreme temperatures. If you should run out of materials, the automaton is standing by to provide you with more.
TEXT_BANDWA112_03913_SHIGITT_000_013: Since you're planning to go there anyway, perhaps you could take something with you? I'd like you to make three filtration devices, essential for sieving out the impurities from raw ethanol. If you should run out of materials, the automaton is standing by to provide you with more.
TEXT_BANDWA112_03913_SHIGITT_000_014: Since you're planning to go there anyway, perhaps you could take something with you? I'd like you to make three batches of yeast. We're trying to refine our fermentation methods, and for that we need as much yeast as we can produce. If you should run out of ingredients, the automaton is standing by to provide you with more.
TEXT_BANDWA112_03913_SHIGITT_000_016: Take your time, and when you're done, deliver the goods to my man in Clearmelt. I do hope his experiments are bearing fruit.
TEXT_BANDWA112_03913_DAILYDWARF03913_000: You there! What's that in your hand? Is it...? Oh, it is!

Apologies for my brusque greeting. I've been here lost in my experimentations for so long...<hic>...I've quite forgotten what it's like to speak with another person. But these supplies...<hic>...these supplies will keep me busy for some time!
Yes, the experiments must go on! <hic> And on and on, until we've managed to expunge every single impurity from our lovely ethanol!

You have my thanks. <hic>
What? Did I taste the ethanol? But of course, all...all in the name of thorough research! And now...<hic>...thanks to you, I shall synthesize a richness of flavor hitherto unknown to any dwarf!

What!? <hic>
I'm not tasting the ethanol! Pure ethanol, that's what I'm testing for! You go on ahead and tell Regitt those exact words. Go on now.
TEXT_BANDWA112_03913_REGITT_000_040: Welcome back! <sniff> From that divine scent I take it you found Clearmelt without trouble. How is the research coming along?
TEXT_BANDWA112_03913_REGITT_000_041:
Ah, I see...
I knew I had picked the right dwarf for the job! A diligent worker and circumspect researcher, he is. I do worry about him being alone for so long, so I may be asking for your help again soon!
TEXT_BANDWA113_03914_REGITT_000_001: Ethanol has produced some astonishing results, but we've had our fair share of mechanical mishaps. The engines get so hot that sometimes they just start steaming like an elemental out of water!
TEXT_BANDWA113_03914_REGITT_000_002: This problem must be squared away quickly, for without our tanks we'll have little to show for our time here besides barrels of ale! My men are hard at work building cooling devices for the engines, and I would have you lend them your expertise.
TEXT_BANDWA113_03914_REGITT_000_003: The team has headed to Inviolate Witness to mine stones we might make use of, and if you head there now you should catch up with them. With all of you working together, I'm sure this burning issue will be quenched in no time at all!
TEXT_BANDWA113_03914_DAILYDWARF03914_000: Ah, you're Regitt's workhorse. Here just in time, too─this rock we pulled out of the earth is still wet to the touch.

Word has it you've got a knack for crafting, so use it to make two cooling plates. A couple of those should absorb the brunt of the heat those engines give off. The automaton is here in case you run out of materials for any reason.

Word has it you've got a knack for crafting, so use it to make two cooling plates. A couple of those should absorb the brunt of the heat those engines give off. The automaton is here in case you run out of materials for any reason.

Word has it you've got a knack for crafting, so use it to make two vials of coolant. A couple of those should absorb the brunt of the heat those engines give off. The automaton is here in case you run out of ingredients for any reason.
Since I'm sure you're used to this by now, you know to deliver the finished goods to Regitt. When everything's all sorted, we mean to put these cooling agents to a live test.
Guess even someone with your reputation can't get it right every time. The automaton is standing by with any materials you might require.
Guess even someone with your reputation can't get it right every time. The automaton is standing by with any materials you might require.
Guess even someone with your reputation can't get it right every time. The automaton is standing by with any ingredients you might require.
All finished? Well, what're you waiting for? Deliver them to Regitt before he tans our hides!
TEXT_BANDWA113_03914_REGITT_000_030: Great work, as always! Ah, well, I suppose I shouldn't make assumptions. You did finish what I asked, right?
TEXT_BANDWA113_03914_REGITT_000_031: Wonderful! This should put a damper on those overactive engines. We'll begin testing these at once!
TEXT_BANDWA113_03914_REGITT_000_032: You know, I'd wager gil to gingerbread that your masterwork here could be put to use in the ale vats as well... Ah, what am I saying! Tanks, then ale! Tanks, then ale!
TEXT_BANDWA114_03915_REGITT_000_001: I'm not sure you're aware of this, but Girutt, one of our engineers, has used the principles used in the ethanol mill to build his own brewery.
TEXT_BANDWA114_03915_REGITT_000_002: Of course, we've already got one, but that didn't stop him from making his own that produces ethanol spirits for drinking. Upon hearing the news, I was inspired to open a tavern in the Anvil, to give Lakelanders libations the likes of which few have tasted, while also making our coinpurses heavy with profit.
TEXT_BANDWA114_03915_REGITT_000_003: We've been brewing our unique brand of booze and using the gil we've earned to help fund work on the Rolling Tankards. Some might say it would be downright irresponsible to use a precious resource in the pursuit of coin, but I say to them in return: bah! Besides, a full treasury would surely suit our purposes better than an empty one, wouldn't you say?
TEXT_BANDWA114_03915_REGITT_000_004: Of course you agree! That's why I've chosen none other than you to aid Girutt in improving our budding tavern! Go speak with him─I believe you'll find him most amenable.
TEXT_BANDWA114_03915_GIRUTT_000_010: So you're the one Regitt is so keen on, are you? Well, take these and earn your keep, then.
TEXT_BANDWA114_03915_GIRUTT_000_011: A proper drink needs a proper mixin', and for that not just any old cup will do. It has to be done right, and if you're as good a metalsmith as they say, I reckon you'll get it on your first try. If you're not as good as they say, Ronitt's automaton is here with whatever you need.
TEXT_BANDWA114_03915_GIRUTT_000_012: A proper drink needs a proper tankard, and for our tavern only the best will do. It has to be done right, and if you're as good with your hands as they say, I reckon you'll get it on your first try. If you're not as good as they say, Ronitt's automaton is here with whatever you need.
TEXT_BANDWA114_03915_GIRUTT_000_013: We don't mean to serve just any grog here. It has to be the best, and if your sense of taste is as keen as they say, I reckon you can whip up just the flavorings we need on the first try. If you're not as good as they say, Ronitt's automaton is here with whatever you need.
TEXT_BANDWA114_03915_GIRUTT_000_014: Once you're done, bring it here and we'll see if you live up to your reputation.
TEXT_BANDWA114_03915_GIRUTT_000_025: Done already, eh? Well, give it here.
TEXT_BANDWA114_03915_GIRUTT_000_026:
Wha─!?
This is...words fail me! Give me a moment to gather my thoughts here...
Ahem. Well done. Needless to say, you met my every expectation, and a few more besides. This is the very embodiment of the quality we strive for at Luca's Locket!
TEXT_BANDWA114_03915_GIRUTT_000_027: I believe Regitt will be overjoyed to see what you've wrought as well. So overjoyed, in fact, that I sense a generous reward is in your future.
TEXT_BANDWA114_03915_REGITT_000_030: Back already! I take it Girutt was the kind and sensible taskmaster he always is.
TEXT_BANDWA114_03915_REGITT_000_031: The nature of our work here is boom and bust, and it will serve us well to have an alternate stream of gil to ride through the lean times.
TEXT_BANDWA114_03915_REGITT_000_032: Speaking of which, this is for you. An honest wage for an honest day's work. I hope it's enough to entice you to help us once again, should the need arise.
TEXT_BANDWA114_03915_SYSTEM_000_033: Luca's Locket is now open for business! Speak with Girutt any time to help out behind the bar.
TEXT_BANDWA114_03915_SYSTEM_000_034: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANDWA115_03916_REGITT_000_000: Ugh, where are they!? Those automata were due back ages ago! I sent them into the trees to gather materials, but they're nowhere to be seen.
TEXT_BANDWA115_03916_REGITT_000_001: We'll never be able to build our tanks at this rate. But if I just traipse off into the undergrowth to find them, I risk becoming as lost as that forest's titular shepherd. I really should study that map a bit more...
TEXT_BANDWA115_03916_REGITT_000_002: Anyway! You're here now, and you are─I assume─far more familiar with the local geography. Do me a favor and bring back that pair of directionally challenged dolts!
TEXT_BANDWA115_03916_TALLFUATH_000_010: Greetings, good mortal! What brings you into this wondrous woodland? If you've business with me, then I'm afraid it must wait. I have a previous and pressing engagement!
TEXT_BANDWA115_03916_TALLFUATH_000_020: Mischievous mortal, explain yourself at once! Why do you seek to abscond with this marvelous and mystical Fuath?
TEXT_BANDWA115_03916_TALLFUATH_000_022: O cruel truth! I thought myself chasing some new worldly kin, who had sheathed their fae form with an iron-hard skin...
TEXT_BANDWA115_03916_TALLFUATH_000_023: So much time, wasted! There are precious herbs to pluck and potions to brew. Take your prize and bother me no more!
TEXT_BANDWA115_03916_REGITT_000_030: Lali-ho! You found our wayward automata, then?
TEXT_BANDWA115_03916_REGITT_000_040: Got myself a stack of spare parts to fix these two. They don't seem particularly damaged at first glance, but let's take a look and see what went wrong... Hm?
TEXT_BANDWA115_03916_REGITT_000_041: Out of fuel...? But I gave 'em enough to last for bloody hours! Something must've been chasing them to burn up coal that fast. See, this is why we need those tanks!
TEXT_BANDWA116_03917_REGITT_000_000: If our tanks are to cross the length and breadth of Norvrandt, then they need to withstand all manner of climates. Rain or shine! Even if they trundle across the blazing sands of Amh Araeng, our inventions need to keep on keeping on!
TEXT_BANDWA116_03917_REGITT_000_001: We need sturdy components. Heat-resistant components. Components that won't melt and droop because we had no idea just how ferocious the desert sun could be.
TEXT_BANDWA116_03917_REGITT_000_002: We need you─and your experience with arid conditions─to craft us a robust example we can work from. Shigitt will provide you with the raw materials.
TEXT_BANDWA116_03917_SHIGITT_000_010: Come to help with those heat-resistant components, have you? Wonderful. We Tholls hail from cooler climes, as you know, and we could certainly use your insight.
TEXT_BANDWA116_03917_SHIGITT_000_020: Here. I've selected some promising materials─let's see you forge three cogwheels that won't warp or bend when the going gets hot. If you decide to scrap it and try again, you can poke Ronitt's automaton for extra crafting supplies.
TEXT_BANDWA116_03917_SHIGITT_000_030: Here. I've selected some promising materials─let's see you make three insulation covers that'll protect a tank's insides from overheating. If you decide to scrap it and try again, you can poke Ronitt's automaton for extra crafting supplies.
TEXT_BANDWA116_03917_SHIGITT_000_040: Here. I've selected some promising materials. Let's see you mix up three pots of oil─the sort that won't bubble or boil when the going gets hot. If you decide to scrap it and try again, you can poke Ronitt's automaton for extra crafting supplies.
TEXT_BANDWA116_03917_SHIGITT_000_050: Oh, I forgot to mention: take the finished components to our researcher over near the Bridges. He'll know what to do!
TEXT_BANDWA116_03917_DWARF03917_000_090: Lali-ho! Regitt said you'd be along. Got something for me, I hope?
TEXT_BANDWA116_03917_DWARF03917_000_100: Oooh, nice work. I'll cart these off into the desert right now, and see how they hold up! I'd appreciate it if you could let Regitt know that our trial run is underway.
TEXT_BANDWA116_03917_REGITT_000_110: My thanks, ! I'm sure your components will perform beyond expectations.
TEXT_BANDWA116_03917_REGITT_000_111: ...Out of curiosity, just how hot does it get out in Amh Araeng? Are we talking skin-searing winds? Boot soles burning in the shade? Sudden geysers of molten lava!? I might just go and see for myself...
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_REGITT_000_000: Grrr. I sent our trader out to purchase cannon parts, but he's taking his sweet time getting back. Surely he didn't get lost following the road...? ...Ah! I bet my beard he's stuck haggling with the merchant.
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_REGITT_000_001: You've struck your fair share of bargains, I expect. Would you mind wandering down to Sullen? Our beleaguered buyer might need help sealing the deal.
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_MORDMERCHANT03918_0: Another trader? You'll have to wait your turn.
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_DWARF03918_000_020: Regitt was worried, was he? Well he should've given me a fatter sack of coin! This merchant won't part with the parts we need no matter how much I plead for a cheaper price...
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_DWARF03918_000_030: ...I know! Maybe you can forge something pretty from the stock I have with me. Some manner of trinket that's like to catch a Mord's beady eye!
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_DWARF03918_000_040: ...I know! Maybe you can craft something pretty from the stock I have with me. Some manner of bespoke household fitting that's like to catch a Mord's beady eye!
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_DWARF03918_000_050: ...I know! Maybe you can concoct something tasty from the stock I have with me. Some manner of herbal tea or suchlike that's pleasing to a Mord's palate!
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_DWARF03918_000_060: Don't be shy about asking for more materials if you come up short. I'll be here, just waiting to see this bloke's reaction when you offer to trade him your latest masterpiece!
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_DWARF03918_000_070: If you're happy with your creation, you can hand it directly to our merchant friend here.
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_DWARF03918_000_071: If you're happy with your creation, you can hand it directly to our merchant friend here.
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_DWARF03918_000_072: If you're happy with your creation, you can hand it directly to our merchant friend here.
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_DWARF03918_000_080: Ran out of bits and pieces, did you? Well, here's a few more!
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_DWARF03918_000_081: Ran out of bits and pieces, did you? Well, here's a few more!
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_DWARF03918_000_082: Ran out of ingredients, did you? Well, here's a few more!
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_MORDMERCHANT03918_0: Hm? You offer to pay the difference for the dwarf? Fine. Coin or barter, it's all the same to me.
...Yes! Agreed! The parts are yours! Take them, take them!
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_DWARF03918_000_102: You're a handy sort to have around, , thank you! If you're headed back to the Anvil, please let Regitt know I'm on the way with the cannon parts.
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_DWARF03918_000_110: Head on back to Regitt. I'll be along with the parts once I've settled accounts here.
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_MORDMERCHANT03918_0: If I'd known you had goods like that for trade, I would've doubled the price. We make more deals in the future, yes?
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_REGITT_000_120: The haggling's all sorted, then? That's great news!
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_REGITT_000_121: We might find work-arounds for some of those materials, but we need the gemstones. Nothing else comes close to their aether-expanding properties...
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_REGITT_000_122: Aye, I hate to say it, but even a dwarf'd be hard-pressed to improve upon the Crystaville's design. That Lorathia lady and her students really know how to build a cannon!
TEXT_BANDWA117_03918_SYSTEM_000_130: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANDWA118_03919_REGITT_000_000: Making these tanks is one thing...but getting folk to actually use them is another.
TEXT_BANDWA118_03919_REGITT_000_001: Any merchant worth his salt'll be wary of some unknown, untested artisan, so we've launched a campaign to spread the name of Watts's Anvil far and wide!
TEXT_BANDWA118_03919_REGITT_000_002: The only problem is, I'm worried that our chosen promoter's not quite ready for the world beyond Tomra. His schedule should put him in Fort Jobb at the moment, and I'd appreciate it if you could lend him a bit of support!
TEXT_BANDWA118_03919_DWARF03919_000_010: Look at this, ! I managed to gather me a good-sized crowd.
TEXT_BANDWA118_03919_DWARF03919_000_011: When you need to grab folks' attention, the good ol' “lali hop” works just as well here as it does back home!
TEXT_BANDWA118_03919_DWARF03919_000_012: Now that everyone's watching, though, I feel a bit silly dancing alone. It might help to hear a few words of encouragement...
TEXT_BANDWA118_03919_DWARF03919_000_013: You feel the weight of an expectant gaze from beneath the dwarf's helmet. Maybe a heartfelt psych up is just what the promoter needs.
TEXT_BANDWA118_03919_DWARF03919_000_020: I don't know if I can go through with this...
TEXT_BANDWA118_03919_DWARF03919_000_021: You feel the weight of an expectant gaze from beneath the dwarf's helmet. Maybe a heartfelt psych up is just what the promoter needs.
TEXT_BANDWA118_03919_DWARF03919_100_030: I, uh... No. I don't think that's going to help.
TEXT_BANDWA118_03919_DWARF03919_100_031: You feel the weight of an expectant gaze from beneath the dwarf's helmet. Maybe a heartfelt psych up is just what the promoter needs.
TEXT_BANDWA118_03919_DWARF03919_000_030: Aye, that's got the fire going again. Right, give me some room!
TEXT_BANDWA118_03919_DWARF03919_000_031: This performance courtesy of Watts's Anvil! We forge even better than we dance!
TEXT_BANDWA118_03919_DWARF03919_000_032: Thanks, , I think I'm over my stage fright now. You can let Regitt know that I'll be letting everyone here know that, you know...we exist and everything.
TEXT_BANDWA118_03919_DWARF03919_000_040: I'll be staying around this area for a while, making sure every single soul has heard the name of Watts's Anvil.
TEXT_BANDWA118_03919_DWARF03919_000_041: Please tell Regitt the campaign is proceeding as planned!
TEXT_BANDWA118_03919_REGITT_000_050: Welcome back! How fares the campaign?
TEXT_BANDWA118_03919_REGITT_000_051: ...The lali hop? What a fantastic idea! Traditionally, we'd use it to warm up on a cold morning, but it seems to be just as effective at warming up a crowd.
TEXT_BANDWA118_03919_REGITT_000_052: Maybe I'll round up a few fellows and join in the next performance. A troupe of dancing dwarves ought to turn a few heads!
TEXT_BANDWA119_03920_REGITT_000_000: Do you know what the most important part of test-firing cannons is? Having wagonloads of destructible targets! If you're not blowing things into tiny pieces, then you're not really test-firing!
TEXT_BANDWA119_03920_REGITT_000_001: We've been cobbling a few dummies together whenever we get a spare moment, but there never seems to be enough... So here's my proposal: we'll pay you to provide us with a supplementary supply.
TEXT_BANDWA119_03920_REGITT_000_002: Have a word to Shigitt, and he'll load you up with whatever scrap materials you need!
TEXT_BANDWA119_03920_SHIGITT_000_010: You're here to help make more targets? Well, thank Watts's beard for that. I swear they were about to start in on the ale casks...
TEXT_BANDWA119_03920_SHIGITT_000_020: Take this lot. Should be enough to make three or so scrap metal dummies, but Ronitt's automaton has more if you need it.
TEXT_BANDWA119_03920_SHIGITT_000_030: Take this lot. Should be enough to make three decent-sized wooden dummies, but Ronitt's automaton has more if you need it.
TEXT_BANDWA119_03920_SHIGITT_000_040: Take this lot. Should be enough to make three big blocks of gelatin─perfect for gauging explosive power. You can pick up more materials from Ronitt's automaton if you need them.
TEXT_BANDWA119_03920_SHIGITT_000_050: As soon as they're ready, I want you to haul those targets over to our bombardier at the Stay. You have no idea how much I appreciate your cooperation...
TEXT_BANDWA119_03920_DWARF03920_000_090: Lali-ho! You have that fresh supply of targets I ordered?
TEXT_BANDWA119_03920_DWARF03920_000_100: Oho! I'll get this new firing range set up straightaway. Keep 'em coming, !
TEXT_BANDWA119_03920_DWARF03920_000_110: Once I get my eye in, them targets don't last long! Better tell Regitt not to ease off on the deliveries, or I'll have to start looking for other things to blast!
TEXT_BANDWA119_03920_REGITT_000_120: Good work, ! That should tide us over for a little while.
TEXT_BANDWA119_03920_REGITT_000_121: At first we were using automata as targets, but it was a bugger of a job putting them back together after a direct hit. Then we had Shigitt screaming about the “waste of perfectly good resources” and such...
TEXT_BANDWA119_03920_REGITT_000_122: No, to properly test cannon fire you need a properly made dummy. And I reckon you're just the artisan to make 'em!
TEXT_BANDWA120_03921_REGITT_000_000: Our Rolling Tankards're meant to protect merchants from stray eaters and their ilk. They can't be dainty little tin frogs, now can they!? No, we need those tanks sturdy enough to shrug off the most monstrous of maulings!
TEXT_BANDWA120_03921_REGITT_000_001: That's why we've assigned a crew for developing new materials that can enhance our armor plating.
TEXT_BANDWA120_03921_REGITT_000_002: If you're keen to add your talents to the mix, you'll find our chief surveyor and his team out searching for potential resources over near Radisca's Round.
TEXT_BANDWA120_03921_DWARF03921_000_010: Lali-ho! You're that artisan Regitt's been gabbin' about, are you? Then get your tools and whatnot ready, 'cause you're right on time to lend a hand!
TEXT_BANDWA120_03921_DWARF03921_000_020: See, I've just had an epiphany about alloys. Smelt me an ingot using these materials in the proper ratio, and we'll have ourselves a new metal component for reinforcing armor plates!
TEXT_BANDWA120_03921_DWARF03921_000_030: See, I've just had an epiphany about structural integrity. Craft me some cushioning using these materials, and we'll have ourselves a new component for absorbing impact on armor plates!
