TEXT_BANDWA120_03921_DWARF03921_000_040: See, I've just had an epiphany about structural integrity. Craft me some coating using these materials, and we'll have ourselves a new component for reducing wear and tear on armor plates!
TEXT_BANDWA120_03921_DWARF03921_000_050: Don't be afraid to ask for more resources should you need them─I don't bite! Otherwise, once you're satisfied, you can cart your creation straight back to Regitt. We've got a bit more digging to do!
TEXT_BANDWA120_03921_DWARF03921_000_060: Once you're satisfied, you can cart your creation straight back to Regitt. We've got a bit more digging to do!
TEXT_BANDWA120_03921_DWARF03921_000_061: Once you're satisfied, you can cart your creation straight back to Regitt. We've got a bit more digging to do!
TEXT_BANDWA120_03921_DWARF03921_000_062: Once you're satisfied, you can cart your creation straight back to Regitt. We've got a bit more digging to do!
TEXT_BANDWA120_03921_DWARF03921_000_070: Eh? Made a mess of things, have you? Not to worry, we've dug up a pile of all the stuff you're likely to need!
TEXT_BANDWA120_03921_DWARF03921_000_071: Eh? Made a mess of things, have you? Not to worry, we've dug up a pile of all the stuff you're likely to need!
TEXT_BANDWA120_03921_DWARF03921_000_072: Eh? Made a mess of things, have you? Not to worry, we've dug up a pile of all the stuff you're likely to need!
TEXT_BANDWA120_03921_REGITT_000_080: Our master crafter returns! What have you got for me, then?
TEXT_BANDWA120_03921_REGITT_000_090: Well, bugger me! I never even thought of trying something like that! We need to start testing right away!
TEXT_BANDWA120_03921_REGITT_000_091: For the initial trial, we'll forge some plate armor using your new component, and then strap it onto a nice big Galdjent lad. I'm hoping it withstands all the axe blows, 'cause that's when we get to break out the muskets! Boom boom boom!
TEXT_BANDWA120_03921_REGITT_000_092: ...What? You didn't think I was serious, did you? We don't test like that anymore! ...Not since the accident.
TEXT_BANDWA120_03921_SYSTEM_000_100: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANDWA121_03922_REGITT_000_000: Grrr! Those good-for-nothing, slow-footed, heavy-helmed sluggards are still not back from Clearmelt!
TEXT_BANDWA121_03922_REGITT_000_001: I gave my lads permission to soak in the springs for a bell or two, but we're way past that now! I'll wager my grandfather's whiskers that all thoughts of work have evaporated with the steam.
TEXT_BANDWA121_03922_REGITT_000_002: Speaking of steam, I think I feel some coming out my ears. You'll have to go and get them─I'm liable to take a pickaxe to their lazy skulls if I go myself.
TEXT_BANDWA121_03922_DWARFA03922_000_011: ...Eh? Regitt sent you? W-Wait, how long has it been!? 'Scuse me, must dash!
TEXT_BANDWA121_03922_DWARFB03922_000_020: Phew, my skin is all tingling. I feel like a boiled egg...
TEXT_BANDWA121_03922_DWARFB03922_000_021: What do you mean “time's up”? ...Oh bugger! Regitt is going to crack my well-cooked head!
TEXT_BANDWA121_03922_DWARFC03922_000_030: <belch> Nothin' like a shtrong brew after a─<hic>─hot bath.
TEXT_BANDWA121_03922_DWARFC03922_000_031: ...Back to─<hic>─work? Fine. The walk should shober me─<hic>─up. A bit.
TEXT_BANDWA121_03922_REGITT_000_040: My thanks, ! Those limp-bearded layabouts finally stumbled in!
TEXT_BANDWA121_03922_REGITT_000_041: I understand, I do─after all, there's not a Tholl alive who hasn't lingered overlong in the secret springs of Mt. Gulg. When you're up to your earlobes in soothing hot water, anyone can forget the passage of time.
TEXT_BANDWA121_03922_REGITT_000_042: But what I can't forgive is forgetting your bloody duties! Oh, I'll have those lads chained to their workbenches until every task they missed is checked off the ledger! And then some!
TEXT_BANDWA122_03923_REGITT_000_000: A few well-placed words from Lorathia, and we've got ourselves a gaggle of prospective buyers. They're over at Clearmelt right now, waiting on a demonstration of the Rolling Tankard's firepower!
TEXT_BANDWA122_03923_REGITT_000_001: One of us could pilot the tank, of course... But, you know, I'd feel far more confident if a seasoned warrior such as yourself was guiding the cannon. Wouldn't be anywhere near as impressive if we missed the bloody target, eh?
TEXT_BANDWA122_03923_REGITT_000_002: Off you go, then! Wamutt will give you the pre-demonstration briefing.
TEXT_BANDWA122_03923_WAMUTT_000_010: Where've you been!? We need to get this show on the road!
TEXT_BANDWA122_03923_WAMUTT_000_011: Briefing shmiefing! Just get in the tank, drive it over to Clearmelt, and blast the target into next week! Easy!
TEXT_BANDWA122_03923_WAMUTT_000_020: What are you waiting for? Head over to Clearmelt, and blow those merchants away! Uh, with the demonstration─not the cannon.
TEXT_BANDWA122_03923_SYSTEM_000_021: An automaton stands immobile, awaiting its fate with what seems almost an air of resignation... Speak to Wamutt at Watts's Anvil to pilot a Rolling Tankard, then command its main cannon to fire upon the automaton target.
TEXT_BANDWA122_03923_AUDIENCE03923_000_0: (-Entranced Entrepreneur-)Oh, my! That cannon has quite a kick! Let's see you fire it one more time, if you please!
(-Entranced Entrepreneur-)Splendid! Just splendid! Enough power to discourage even the most monstrous eater, I'd wager. Mark me down as very interested, master dwarf.
TEXT_BANDWA122_03923_DWARF03923_000_041: (-Dwarven Promoter-)Nice shootin', ! You can head back to the Anvil, if you like─I think Regitt'll be happy to hear how it all went!
TEXT_BANDWA122_03923_REGITT_000_050: Now there's the grin of a  who just left a smoking hole in the ground. I take it this means the demonstration went as planned?
TEXT_BANDWA122_03923_REGITT_000_051: Aye, we could describe it all we want, but Lorathia was right─there's naught better than showing off the destruction firsthand. I reckon we'll need to make this a regular event!
TEXT_BANDWA123_03924_REGITT_000_000: With all the extra hours we've been working, it's become a struggle to stay focused. So I thought to myself, “a good gulp of strong dwarven ale'll perk me right up!”...only it seems to have had the opposite effect.
TEXT_BANDWA123_03924_REGITT_000_001: <yawn> As luck would have it, Ronitt's designed some special tool he claims can solve our drowsiness dilemma─we just need someone alert enough to put it together.
TEXT_BANDWA123_03924_REGITT_000_002: Do me a favor and talk to Shigitt before he passes out, will you? He'll have everything you need.
TEXT_BANDWA123_03924_SHIGITT_000_010: <yawn> ...Oh, I must have dozed off for a moment. Yes. Supplies. For Ronitt's grandly named “Unfailing Eye Opener.”
TEXT_BANDWA123_03924_SHIGITT_000_020: With your skills, forging a simplified shock prod shouldn't prove too much of a challenge. And even if it does, I've stocked the automaton over yonder with surplus materials.
TEXT_BANDWA123_03924_SHIGITT_000_030: With your skills, crafting a nice whippy coeurl o' nine tails shouldn't prove too much of a challenge. And even if it does, I've stocked the automaton over yonder with surplus materials.
TEXT_BANDWA123_03924_SHIGITT_000_040: With your skills, mixing up a batch of sinus-singeing pepper powder shouldn't prove too much of a challenge. And even if it does, I've stocked the automaton over yonder with surplus materials.
TEXT_BANDWA123_03924_SHIGITT_000_050: Once the “Unfailing Eye Opener” is ready, take it to a particularly sleepy lad gathering resources over by the Hour of Certain Durance. He's volunteered to be the first vict─uh, test subject.
TEXT_BANDWA123_03924_DWARF03923_000_090: Zzz... Buh? Lali─? Ho, is that the...whatchamacallit? The “Eye Opener”?
TEXT_BANDWA123_03924_DWARF03923_000_100: Hmmm. It looks a little more unpleasant than I'd expected. Still, I'll try anything to ward off this blasted sleepiness for a while.
TEXT_BANDWA123_03924_DWARF03923_000_110: So I just press this button here, and─ayayayayayaya!!! Id...id my fathe thuppothed to be thith numb!?
TEXT_BANDWA123_03924_DWARF03923_000_120: So I just flick this on my skin, and─owowowowowow!!! Bloody beardless bairns, that feels like a hundred bee stings all at once!
TEXT_BANDWA123_03924_DWARF03923_000_130: So I just flip open the pouch and breathe in nice and dee─eeeeeek! <cough> My nose! <splutter> My throat! <wheeze> My poor, tortured eyes!
TEXT_BANDWA123_03924_DWARF03923_000_140: (-Wide-awake Dwarf-)<pant> <pant> Well, that... That was an experience. You know, for some odd reason, I sort of want to try it again...
TEXT_BANDWA123_03924_DWARF03923_000_141: (-Wide-awake Dwarf-)I think I'm ready to get back to work now. You can tell Regitt I feel...awakened...in more ways than one.
TEXT_BANDWA123_03924_REGITT_000_150: Zzz... Huh? Who!? Me!? Asleep on my feet? Never! So, uh, how did the testing go?
TEXT_BANDWA123_03924_REGITT_000_151: ...Wide awake, eh? “In more ways than one,” he said? I don't know what that means, but I might have to test it for myself. Good job, !
TEXT_BANDWA123_03924_SYSTEM_000_160: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANDWA124_03925_REGITT_000_000: You're a wanted , . In a good way, I mean! One of the two brothers in charge of our tanks' exterior design has asked me to ask you if he can borrow your artisanal expertise. I always forget which one is which...
TEXT_BANDWA124_03925_REGITT_000_001: Anyway, if you're free to lend a hand, you'll find him collecting parts and materials over at Radisca's Round.
TEXT_BANDWA124_03925_DWARF03925_000_010: Lali-ho, ! Regitt passed on my message, then? Good! Now we can get down to making some properly eye-catching accessories.
TEXT_BANDWA124_03925_DWARF03925_000_011: See, if I were a merchant in the market for a tank, I'd want a catalog of custom options designed to grab folks' attention the moment I rolled into town!
TEXT_BANDWA124_03925_DWARF03925_000_012: My big brother, on the other hand, seems fixed on the idea of fading into the background. What a wasted opportunity!
TEXT_BANDWA124_03925_DWARF03925_000_020: I need you to help me change his mind...by forging an irresistible range of shiny silver attachments!
TEXT_BANDWA124_03925_DWARF03925_000_030: I need you to help me change his mind...by crafting an unforgettable assortment of colorful pennants!
TEXT_BANDWA124_03925_DWARF03925_000_040: I need you to help me change his mind...by mixing a seductive selection of vivid paints!
TEXT_BANDWA124_03925_DWARF03925_000_050: Here, take these materials from the stock I've collected...and feel free to ask if you need more. Once you're done, deliver the goods to Regitt─that'll show my brother the benefits of standing out from the crowd!
TEXT_BANDWA124_03925_DWARF03925_000_060: Take the finished product back to the Anvil. Regitt will know what to do!
TEXT_BANDWA124_03925_DWARF03925_000_061: Take the finished product back to the Anvil. Regitt will know what to do!
TEXT_BANDWA124_03925_DWARF03925_000_062: Take the finished product back to the Anvil. Regitt will know what to do!
TEXT_BANDWA124_03925_DWARF03925_000_070: Looking for some spare materials? Help yourself.
TEXT_BANDWA124_03925_DWARF03925_000_071: Looking for some spare materials? Help yourself.
TEXT_BANDWA124_03925_DWARF03925_000_072: Looking for some spare materials? Help yourself.
TEXT_BANDWA124_03925_REGITT_000_090: So this is the kind of thing he was talking about...
TEXT_BANDWA124_03925_REGITT_000_091: Assuming our tanks become commonplace, the merchant caravans'll be wanting ways to distinguish themselves from their competitors. And these custom options are just the answer we need! Fine work, !
TEXT_BANDWA124_03925_REGITT_000_100: This...all feels so familiar. You're saying it was the younger brother this time? But...the concept is the complete bloody opposite! Ugh, I'm sorry these dolts have dragged you into their little design dispute...
TEXT_BANDWA124_03925_REGITT_000_101: Still, I suppose if this rivalry results in more custom options for our buyers, then it's a victory for us either way. Thanks again for your fine work, !
TEXT_BANDWA125_03926_REGITT_000_000: Ozogg's ethanol will keep our tanks rolling well enough for the time being, but even she agrees that the future holds room for improvement. We reckon the answer might lie in the techniques used for brewing grog, which we can adapt to create new types of fuel.
TEXT_BANDWA125_03926_REGITT_000_001: To that end, we've decided to research as many regional brews as we can get our hands on. Any one of these fermented delights could hold the key to producing an alternative that's safe, cheap, and easy to make.
TEXT_BANDWA125_03926_REGITT_000_002: ...You're likely wondering what your role is in all this. Well, it's a simple one this time: I give you the coin, and you buy the grog.
TEXT_BANDWA125_03926_REGITT_000_003: I know, I know, you're more than just an errand , but believe me─you're the only one I can trust with this job. Anyway, off to Sullen with you. Should be a bloke there waiting with our order.
TEXT_BANDWA125_03926_MERCHANT03926_000_0: ...The cask for Master Regitt? Yes, yes, I have it ready right here. If I might trouble you for the payment...?
Thank you, , and remember: lift with your legs, not with your back. I bid you good day.
TEXT_BANDWA125_03926_REGITT_000_030: Back with that cask already? No, uh, “trouble” on the road, then?
TEXT_BANDWA125_03926_REGITT_000_040: ...It's still sealed! I mean, of course it is! I knew I could count on you!
TEXT_BANDWA125_03926_REGITT_000_041: If I'd sent a Tholl to buy that grog, you could bet your grandmother's boots he'd have to stop somewhere and “sample the merchandise.” That's why I had to ask you instead.
TEXT_BANDWA125_03926_REGITT_000_042: Speaking of sampling, I should probably take a little sip myself. You know, just to make sure it's─ No! This is for research! Ahem, you can go now, !
TEXT_BANDWA126_03927_REGITT_000_000: Perfect. Just bloody perfect... Hm? Oh, our odd-job automaton is broken. Poor thing looks about ready for the scrap heap.
TEXT_BANDWA126_03927_REGITT_000_001: And no, we didn't shoot it with a cannon, if that's what you're thinking─it fell to pieces all on its own! Ugh, we're not going to get much done around here until our favorite runner and fetcher is fixed.
TEXT_BANDWA126_03927_REGITT_000_002: That is─as you might have guessed─where you come in. Shigitt will explain how you can best lend a hand.
TEXT_BANDWA126_03927_SHIGITT_000_010: Thanks for coming, ! We could use another artisan to help speed the repairs along.
TEXT_BANDWA126_03927_SHIGITT_000_020: What I need from you is a flexible metal sheet for reinforcing the automaton's chassis. We patched up the gaping hole with a serving tray, but that was really only a temporary solution...
TEXT_BANDWA126_03927_SHIGITT_000_030: What I need from you is a replacement casing for protecting the automaton's main joints. We can't have it rolling through the dirt and the mud with all its...uh...“bits” exposed.
TEXT_BANDWA126_03927_SHIGITT_000_040: What I need from you is a fresh batch of oil for the automaton's reserves. It's running low after leaking from several, um, “unplanned” perforations, and the supply's been contaminated with debris in any case...
TEXT_BANDWA126_03927_SHIGITT_000_050: Here's some raw materials to get you started. Anything else, you can pick up from Ronitt's helper across the way.
TEXT_BANDWA126_03927_SHIGITT_000_051: Once you're satisfied with your work, I want you to deliver it to our tinkerer. You'll find him way out in the ruins they call the “Mortal Irons.” Safety precautions, and all that.
TEXT_BANDWA126_03927_DWARFA03927_000_080: <shudder> I thought that last bump on the road would be the end of me... Now, the sooner that artisan arrives, the sooner I can─ Oh! Lali-ho! You've brought my supplies, then?
TEXT_BANDWA126_03927_DWARFA03927_000_081: Aye, this should do the trick. Thank you kindly!
TEXT_BANDWA126_03927_DWARFA03927_000_082: I know it's an odd place to make repairs, but we were worried about secondary explosions. Wouldn't do to have sparks flying near the Anvil's fuel barrels now, would it? Ahem, you should probably be on your way. Try not to stomp, eh?
TEXT_BANDWA126_03927_DWARFA03927_000_090: Thanks again for making the trek all the way out here. I think I have what I need to get this clanker fixed up and stable again.
TEXT_BANDWA126_03927_REGITT_100_100: ...Oh, good, you look decidedly unscorched. How did it go?
TEXT_BANDWA126_03927_REGITT_000_100: Glad to hear that. Took us all by surprise when that automaton blew up, but I'm confident our tinkerer will get it working again!
TEXT_BANDWA126_03927_REGITT_000_101: You should've seen it! Just ran off in the middle of a chore and spontaneously self-destructed. All we did was have it toiling from dawn till dusk, dusk till dawn, day in, day out, for weeks on end. Must've been defective.
TEXT_BANDWA126_03927_REGITT_000_102: But with your high-quality contribution, I'm sure it'll soon be back at the grindstone─this time even grindier than before!
TEXT_BANDWA126_03927_SYSTEM_000_110: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANDWA127_03928_REGITT_000_000: You're a wanted , . In a good way, I mean! One of the two brothers in charge of our tanks' exterior design has asked me to ask you if he can borrow your artisanal expertise. I always forget which one is which...
TEXT_BANDWA127_03928_REGITT_000_001: Anyway, if you're free to lend a hand, you'll find him collecting parts and materials over at Radisca's Round.
TEXT_BANDWA127_03928_DWARF03928_000_010: Lali-ho, ! Regitt passed on my message, then? Good! Now we can get down to making some stealth-enhancing accessories.
TEXT_BANDWA127_03928_DWARF03928_000_011: See, if I were a merchant in the market for a tank, I'd want a catalog of custom options designed to lower my profile and reduce the risk of alerting eaters and other wild beasts!
TEXT_BANDWA127_03928_DWARF03928_000_012: My little brother, on the other hand, seems fixed on the idea of announcing one's presence to the whole damn world. Who would want such a thing!?
TEXT_BANDWA127_03928_DWARF03928_000_020: I need you to help me change his mind...by forging a practical range of camouflage-patterned attachments!
TEXT_BANDWA127_03928_DWARF03928_000_030: I need you to help me change his mind...by creating a crafty assortment of camouflage netting!
TEXT_BANDWA127_03928_DWARF03928_000_040: I need you to help me change his mind...by mixing a sneaky selection of camouflage-coating paint!
TEXT_BANDWA127_03928_DWARF03928_000_050: Here, take these materials from the stock I've collected...and feel free to ask if you need more. Once you're done, deliver the goods to Regitt─that'll show my brother the benefits of blending into the background!
TEXT_BANDWA127_03928_DWARF03928_000_060: Take the finished product back to the Anvil. Regitt will know what to do!
TEXT_BANDWA127_03928_DWARF03928_000_061: Take the finished product back to the Anvil. Regitt will know what to do!
TEXT_BANDWA127_03928_DWARF03928_000_062: Take the finished product back to the Anvil. Regitt will know what to do!
TEXT_BANDWA127_03928_DWARF03928_000_070: Looking for some spare materials? Help yourself.
TEXT_BANDWA127_03928_DWARF03928_000_071: Looking for some spare materials? Help yourself.
TEXT_BANDWA127_03928_DWARF03928_000_072: Looking for some spare materials? Help yourself.
TEXT_BANDWA127_03928_REGITT_000_090: So this is the kind of thing he was talking about...
TEXT_BANDWA127_03928_REGITT_000_091: Assuming our tanks become commonplace, the merchant caravans'll be wanting an edge over their competitors in the survival stakes. And these custom options are just the answer we need! Fine work, !
TEXT_BANDWA127_03928_REGITT_000_100: This...all feels so familiar. You're saying it was the older brother this time? But...the concept is the complete bloody opposite! Ugh, I'm sorry these dolts have dragged you into their little design dispute...
TEXT_BANDWA127_03928_REGITT_000_101: Still, I suppose if this rivalry results in more custom options for our buyers, then it's a victory for us either way. Thanks again for your fine work, !
TEXT_BANDWA128_03929_REGITT_000_000: I, ah, I know this is short notice and all, but...have you got time to help us with an extended trial?
TEXT_BANDWA128_03929_REGITT_000_001: The bloke we trained to command the tank is, uh, “indisposed” at the moment, and no one else is willing or able to take the wheel. As it were.
TEXT_BANDWA128_03929_REGITT_000_002: Please, speak with Wamutt, and he'll brief you on the particulars. You're all we've got, !
TEXT_BANDWA128_03929_WAMUTT_000_010: You're our stand-in? Good, then we can get started!
TEXT_BANDWA128_03929_WAMUTT_000_011: There's naught to it really: just drive up to the Stay, then blast all the targets with the cannon. Commence trial!
TEXT_BANDWA128_03929_WAMUTT_000_020: You see, “commence trial” means “bloody go!” Try not to miss any of them dummies.
TEXT_BANDWA128_03929_SYSTEM_000_021: A group of crude wooden dummies awaits obliteration... Speak to Wamutt at Watts's Anvil to pilot a Rolling Tankard, then command its main cannon to fire upon the targets.
TEXT_BANDWA128_03929_REGITT_000_040: The trial went well, then? Targets blown into sufficiently small chunks and all that? Good to hear!
TEXT_BANDWA128_03929_REGITT_000_041: Our original pilot stumbled in after a few too many mugs, and I couldn't let him near a tank in that condition. There'll be no drinking and firing on my watch!
TEXT_BANDWA128_03929_REGITT_000_042: Anyway, I'm happy to say we've kept to our testing schedule, and it's all thanks to you!
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_000: Ah, ! Just who I was hoping to see. Do you have a moment?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_001: Just when I thought normalcy had finally returned to us, I received word of some truly peculiar hippo sightings.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_002: Yes, hippos! A veritable herd of hippos...
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_003: Hurtling down the highroad, no less!
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_A1_000_003: Huh. I thought that was normal for Thavnair...
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_005: Yes, well... Though hippos have long inhabited Vanaspati, it is quite unusual to see them in such numbers outside their natural habitat─let alone harrying travelers on the highroad!
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_006: Yet harried the travelers are. If these hippos have been displaced by the fires that beset the jungle during the Final Days, we must find them a more suitable home for the sake of all concerned.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_007: I would normally ask the Radiant Host for help with such affairs, but they already have so much on their hands. And Ogul happens to be away, so could I ask you to look into the matter?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_008: Oh, thank you! You are truly a blessing.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_009: I don't know much more than what I have already told you, but I am sure others in Yedlihmad have spotted a hurtling hippo or two.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_010: I can only repeat what I've told you─hippos, hurtling, et cetera─but with any luck, the other townsfolk will have more details for you.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_RESIDENTSA_000_015: Hurtling hippos, you say? Oh yes, I saw them. Barreling down the highroad at tremendous speed. It was frightening just to watch.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_RESIDENTSA_000_016: They kicked up so much dust that I couldn't get a clear look at them, but everyone on the island knows that smooth silhouette. An adorable-yet-fearsome creature, the hippo...
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_RESIDENTSB_000_017: Is this about those dreadful Arkasodara up north? Hitching carts to their hippos, and Cinduruva knows what else...
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_RESIDENTSB_000_018: If they've come down to join the other refugees, I don't doubt they'll be stirring up trouble. As if we don't have enough people leeching off our goodwill already...
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_RESIDENTSC_000_019: Yes, I've seen hippos on a number of occasions, over by the Great Work─and this is the second time I've answered that question in as many bells!
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_RESIDENTSC_000_020: One of the refugees came by asking the very same not moments ago. Trna, I think her name was.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_RESIDENTSC_000_021: If you're looking for the same hippos, maybe she could help? She set off towards the Perfumed Rise, last I saw.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_RESIDENTSA_000_022: I wonder why those hippos chose the highroad... Perhaps they prefer running on the strait and narrow?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_RESIDENTSB_000_023: I can't believe they had the gall to bring their hippos! This town needs some limits on its charity, if you ask me.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_RESIDENTSC_000_024: Trna headed up the highroad. If you're still looking for hippos, maybe you should go after her.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_025: ...What're you lookin' at? Can't you see I'm in the middle of somethin' here!?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_027: ...Damn. I was hopin' to put paid to this before it got outta hand.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_028: Well, those hippos you're lookin' for should be rollin' through any moment now. Just stand back an' watch.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_MARU_000_032: (-Rider-)What? Why's there fruit in the middle of the...?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_033: You've done it now, you hamsaheads!
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_034: Maru! What'd I tell you about ridin' this highroad?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_MARU_000_036: Erm... W-Well, the roads back home ain't good for ridin' no more, Boss. We ain't got much of a choice...
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_A2_000_002: Keep it off the highroad, will you?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_038: Yeah! Roarin' down a main road, kickin' up dust storms─you're scarin' people!
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_039: What, you already forgot about the Tower of Zot? The fires and the screamin' and the people turnin'? You really think that raisin' a racket's what we need right now!?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_040: In case you ain't got it through your heads yet, I'll spell it out for you─our racin' days are over. They were over yesterday, and they were over the day before that too!
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_041: ...I take it this solves your hippo mystery.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_042: Now all that's left is to apologize for these sorry sods. Care to tell me where to direct our grovelin'?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_043: Alright. Let's have a chat with this Kancana.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_100_044: You're comin' too, Maru! I left you in charge, an' the one in charge takes responsibility. That's how it goes.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_044: You'll be there to give your report or somethin', right? See you soon enough, then.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_050: Now, who might these fresh faces be? I was expecting news about hippos, but perhaps you've brought back a few lost souls as well?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_051: Somethin' like that. Trna's the name, an' on behalf of my hippos an'...associates here, I apologize for the commotion.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_052: We're used to racin' our hippo carts on the less-traveled paths of Vanaspati, you see. We never took much to “society” even before the sky started rainin' fire─mostly just kept to ourselves an' lived off the land.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_053: But bein' new to these parts is no excuse. We should've known better than to take the highroad at high speed, an' we're sorry for any, er...undue distress we might've caused.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_054: We ain't got much to offer, but we'll make it up to you however we can. Thavnair's in a bad way, so if we're ever goin' to do any good for anybody, now's the time.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_055: ...Or at least I'd like to think. I ain't got much in the way of ideas concernin' how misfits like us can contribute.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_SYSTEM_000_056: A crew of Arkasodara looking for purpose, and speedy hippos to steer them true...
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_SYSTEM_000_057: Perhaps there is something Trna and her associates can contribute to a recovering Thavnair...
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_A3_000_001: Have you ever considered delivery work?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_A3_000_002: I think driving hippo carts could be an incredibly useful skill.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_059: Delivery work? You think we could really do somethin' like that? I mean, a hippo cart's the fastest set of wheels there is, but...
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_060: ...Skill? You think so? We've only ever seen it as a hobby, but...
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_061: It's an excellent idea. Local trade is on its way to recovery, and the timely delivery of goods via hippo cart can only be a boon.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_062: However, delivery work requires a great deal of trust. You are transporting someone's precious possessions, after all.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_063: You will not only need to learn the trade, but earn the respect of the people as well.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_064: Everyone starts somewhere, so there's no need to feel intimidated! If this sounds like something you'd like to try, then why not let  show you how it's done?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_065: It just so happens that a parcel intended for the Great Work was accidentally off-loaded here today. It's filled with medicinal herbs from Gridania, so I'd like it sent over as soon as possible.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_066: Would you be a dear and deliver it with Trna? With your worldly experience, I'm sure you will serve as a shining example of professionalism.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_067: I'll entrust the parcel to you, Trna. I have no doubt that you will see it safely to its destination.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_068: Sorry for takin' you outta your way, , but I look forward to seein' a professional do...whatever it is a professional does.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_069: I'll be waitin' by the gates, so give me a shout when you're ready to go.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_070: You truly have a gift for finding those in need. I can't help but want to nurture each and every one!
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_071: I know it's a little more work than you bargained for, but do lend Trna and her associates a helping hand. I see great potential in them...
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_MARU_100_072: Sure, we wouldn't have to scrounge for food anymore, and it'd keep us busy like the boss wants, but... If wishes were hippo carts, beggars'd ride, y'know?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_076: My partner Saurya here's pullin' the fastest cart on the island. I stowed the goods we're deliverin' under the seat, so they won't get damaged or nothin'.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_077: An' we ain't about to leave you high an' hippo-less─there's another cart just for you!
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_078: Our hippos are usually shy around strangers, but you were there with the fruit earlier, so you've got nothin' to worry about. They're smarter than to bite the hand that feeds.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_MARU_000_079: We don't let just anybody ride our carts, but if Boss thinks you can handle it...
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_080: No need for bellyachin', Maru. We ain't racin' the carts down the highroad like some hamsaheads I know. Now, off we go, slow an' steady...
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_082: Not a bad way to travel, eh? My crew designed these carts from scratch, you know.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_083: Historically, we Arkasodara never went around in chocobo carriages and the like. But at some point I got to wonderin'...why not?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_084: Sure, we're a heavy bunch, but nothin's impossible if you put your mind to it, right? Well, after auditionin' all kinds of critters, we finally came 'round to hippos.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_085: Hippo ridin's a team effort. Our hippos can sprint with the best of 'em, but they ain't got a lot of stamina, so a good rider knows when to push and when to let up.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_090: Here we are, safe an' sound. Now we hand over the goods, right?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_ALCHEMIST04545_000_: (-???-)You wouldn't happen to be talking about an imported package, would you?
I've been expecting a delivery ship, but seen neither keel nor prow of it...
Wait...aren't you the one who saved Nidhana?
Ah, I see! Well, thank you both for going out of your way to bring this over. You've saved me considerable grief.
No large trading vessels can dock here, you see?
Usually, our orders are off-loaded at Alnair and thence shipped by dhow, but they sometimes get mixed in with packages destined for Yedlihmad.
And then the logistical nightmare begins, I'm afraid. May I check to see if you indeed have my herbs?
Importing these is trying enough without delivery mishaps, so I'm relieved they made it here safely.

And to think that all of the hippo hubbub was, in fact, industrious delivery work! A little frightening to watch without proper context, but you've done a marvelous job. I'll be sure to call upon your services again.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_101: That wasn't a delivery...but I guess a little misunderstandin' never hurt anyone.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_102: People sure do trust you, though. I got trusted just standin' next to you!
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_103: And he looked so happy about his herbs... Had me smilin' right along with him. Maybe we really can make a difference with this delivery business!
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_110: Thanks for showin' me the ropes─and for doin' all the talkin', too.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_111: I'd like to get straight back to Kancana, but from the looks of it, your hippo needs a breather. No surprise, considerin' what it's been through lately.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_112: Here's what we'll do─I'll let this big boy rest up a bit, while you go on ahead with Saurya.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_113: I'm trustin' you with my prized set of wheels, so be careful. No scratches or nothin'. Just ride like you did comin' here and there shouldn't be any problems.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_SYSTEM_000_114: Should you become separated from your cart, speak with Trna at the Great Work to ride it again.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_116: When Saurya came runnin' back by herself, I got worried! You want to give it another shot?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_SYSTEM_000_120: Her mission accomplished, a triumphant Saurya trundles away with the cart in tow. Kancana will be pleased to hear of your successful delivery.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_SYSTEM_000_121: Speak with Trna at the Great Work to board the hippo cart, then ride it to Yedlihmad.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_125: Welcome back!  just told me all about your successful delivery. Thank you for your help, Trna.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_126: What did you think of your first job?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_127: The delivery part seems pretty straightforward, even for our ilk. But the whole “buildin' trust” thing won't be easy.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_128: Still, it's not like we can give up an' go home to Vanaspati. Sooner or later, we'll have to get used to livin' with other folks.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_129: An' you should've seen how relieved that alchemist was when he got his supplies! Feels nice to know we did some good in the world...
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_130: There is no greater reward for a job well done, in my experience. If you choose to continue on this path, I am certain the joy you bring will be returned to you tenfold.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_131: As this is a new endeavor for you and your associates, however, I do believe it best if someone oversees your progress.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_132: , you did so much for Ogul that I have to ask─will you lend your aid to Trna and her associates?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_133: I know we're a right crew of misfits, , but I promise you we're hard workers. Give us a chance, an' we'll make you proud.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_A6_000_001: You've got spirit, kid! I'm with you!
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_A6_000_002: This is going to take a lot of work...
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_135: Thank you! I swear you won't regret this!
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_136: Oh, I don't know about that. Something tells me that Trna and her associates are quick studies. I'm sure that if you all work together, you will make good progress in no time.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_137: Now that that's settled, I think it is time you saw your new home.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_138: You see, I have come into possession of an old trading post that has since fallen into disuse.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_139: The structures may be a little worse for wear, but the plot itself is very conveniently located. You are free to fix it up however you would like.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_MARU_000_140: Y-You're just...gonna let us use it? Just like that?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_141: I will lease it to you for a small fee. That is to say, if your new business fails to turn a profit, I may have to rethink the use of that space one day.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_142: But we can talk about the particulars later. For now, how about you go and take a look? I've marked its location on this map.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_143: Gladly! Thanks for everythin' you've done for us.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_144: Let's reconvene at our new headquarters! I'll round up my people.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_KANCANA_000_145: I have high hopes for that one. If there is anything else I can do to help, do not hesitate to let me know.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_MARU_000_146: It's bigger than I thought, but what a dump! I'm grateful, of course, but... <sigh>
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_151: As you can see, this place ain't no Meghaduta. But once we get the basics up an' runnin', it'll start feelin' like home in no time.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_MARU_000_152: We'll need a cart shed, for starters...and a place to store packages an' whatnot...
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_MARU_000_153: If I'm honest, Boss, I'm still not sure about all this. But if you say we should give it a shot, I guess I can try...
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_154: Thanks, Maru. I'm countin' on you, y'know.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_155: Alright─as of today, we're makin' our name as reliable delivery workers. We've got a lot to learn, but don't go easy on us. Teach us everythin' you know!
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_156: Now, we need a name for our new business. Somethin' real...trustworthy. Hmm...
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_MARU_000_157: Boss, we gotta fix this place up! We ain't got time to be worryin' about names. What's wrong with our team name, anyway?
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_TRNA_000_158: Our team name? Y-You're right! We don't need to be fancy─just fast, reliable, and ridin' hippo carts. “Hippo Riders” it is!
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_SYSTEM_000_160: Led by their charismatic leader, Trna, the Hippo Riders have retired from racing and rebranded themselves as speedy delivery workers!
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_SYSTEM_000_161: However, they are still known on the island as local delinquents. Use your experience as an adventurer and trusted hero to help them better their reputation!
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_SYSTEM_000_165: You have achieved Friendly reputation with the Hippo Riders.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_SYSTEM_000_166: Arkasodara society quests are now available from Maru in Svarna.
TEXT_BANARK001_04545_SYSTEM_000_167: Furthermore, you may now purchase wares from Ghanta.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_000: ! Here to see how we're gettin' along, are you? Let me go an' grab Maru.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_001: Thanks to your help and Kancana's odd jobs, we've been keepin' our carts rollin' and stayin' outta trouble.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_002: Communicatin' with the locals still feels dauntin' at times, but Maru here's made us some gulal to break the ice!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_003: Er, maybe you don't know what I'm talkin' about─gulal is this bright, colored powder used in some of Thavnair's religious traditions.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_004: There's an old belief that you'll be blessed with good luck an' spared from evil if a visitor sprinkles you with a healthy handful. It's enough to make even the most stubborn buggers happy to welcome us.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_MARU_000_005: Sisters know it's been nothin' but bad business for everyone, lately. I reckon a little extra luck would do us all good...
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_006: That it would. Though our own luck might be better if my girl Saurya didn't start gallopin' with glee when she gets so much as a glimpse of the stuff...
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_007: But all in all, we've been gettin' our name out there an' learnin' the job. Might be slow goin', but we're makin' good progress.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_MARU_000_008: But Boss... Is slow goin' really gonna cut it? So long's I get to ride, I ain't got no problems, but...
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_MARU_000_009: Our carts ain't exactly designed for haulin' cargo. No one beats us for speed, but practically speakin'...
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_MARU_000_010: Sooner or later, some silver-tongued dab hand's gonna come along with carriages or boats that can carry loads an' loads of packages. An' then where will we be? Outta work, that's where...
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_011: Our carts might not best a carriage in freight, but it's like you said, Maru─at speed, we're unbeatable.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_012: If only there was some way to make the most of it... To offer a service that no one else could do better...
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_A1_000_001: Ask not and ye shall receive no answer...
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_A1_000_002: Don't look at me. Maybe your customers will have some ideas.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_014: True. We won't get anywhere marinatin' in our own juices. Let's ask around an' see what speedy services folks might need.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_015: ...Is what I'd say if I knew the first thing about makin' small talk. Which I don't. Help me out?
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_016: Let's start at the Great Work─I got a delivery request from an alchemist there, so me an' Saurya'll head over first.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_017: I'll meet you by the aetheryte after I've picked up the goods.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_SYSTEM_000_018: You wait by the aetheryte, but see no sign of Trna, who should have arrived before you. Has trouble befallen her...?
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_SYSTEM_000_019: Perhaps you should search the area for any wayward hippos.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_020: What the─ Y-You're amazin'! You put down that beast like it was nothin'!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_026: You really saved our skins, ! Me an' Saurya zipped over when we heard yelpin', but it was everythin' I could do to just keep that beast at bay...
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_ALCHEMIST04546A_000: And I don't know what would have become of me if you hadn't! Allow me to express my sincerest gratitude.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_028: A-Anyway, am I imaginin' things or does it smell like fruit around here? If I was a vajralangula, I'd come runnin' too.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_ALCHEMIST04546A_000: You've a sharp nose, miss. Yes, I was in Yedlihmad on an errand when a merchant bade me take this fruit, insisting it was delicious and perfectly ripe.

How was I to know that every beast in Saltwind's Welcome should agree with his claims wholeheartedly? I thought escaping that herd of drooling gaja would be the worst of it, but my hopes were fruitless, as it were.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_031: Well, the next time you've got somethin' to haul, call the Hippo Riders. Me an' my associates do fast, safe deliveries by hippo cart.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_ALCHEMIST04546A_000: Yes, I've heard talk of hippo couriers as of late! Never did I imagine one would come speeding to my rescue. I will absolutely call upon your services in the future.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_033: I'm gonna load his fruit onto the cart an' see him into town.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_034: I've still gotta pick up that package, so come find me inside the Great Work. This time for sure!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_035: Here's our customer. Let's pick up the goods and get goin'.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_ALCHEMIST04546B_000: Aaah! You're the couriers, aren't you? You're here! You're already here!
Huh? But you're with the Students of Baldesion, aren't you? What business have you with our parcel!?
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_038: I dunno about any Bal...bald students or nothin', but 's helpin' out with our new delivery service.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_ALCHEMIST04546B_000: Really? Supporting small businesses, how grand!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_040: So, er... Can I have the goods now?
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_ALCHEMIST04546B_000: Ack! W-Well, you see... Th-That is to say... It's not quite ready yet!

I overslept, is the thing─just a tiny little bit─so I was rushing to get it all prepared. And that's when I made this truly minuscule error in the formula and it...well, it exploded. Quite explosively.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_043: E-Exploded? That's, er... My condolences. In that case, I'll just hang around here while you're gettin' it ready. ...No rush.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_044: Let's go an' do the talkin' thing while we wait. See what our potential customers need most right now.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_ALCHEMIST04546B_000: My colleagues unceremoniously ejected me from the laboratory, but they are hard at work getting the shipment together, I promise you!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_ALCHEMIST04546C_000: What's this, what's this!? Do I need this, that, or the other!? No, no, no! I'm flying free and feeling fine!
I finished all my assigned work, which means I now have three delicious days for my personal research. I'll eat and sleep when I'm dead, but until then─ALCHEMY!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_ALCHEMIST04546D_000: Do I need anything? Well...the Radiant Host used up its entire stock of medicinal supplies during the Final Days, so requests for replenishment keep pouring in without end.
I can't remember the last time I sat down for dinner with my family. It seems like a different lifetime by now...
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_057: That's, er, unfortunate. I wish I could help, but I dunno the first thing about medicine...
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_ALCHEMIST04546E_000: To eat! To sleep! Perchance to lick...?
Do I need something? Why, I'm glad you asked─I've depleted my stores of honey!

I haven't a moment to spare for such trivial affairs as eating, but cognitive functioning dramatically decreases without regular sustenance, so I came up with a brilliant scheme─lick honey throughout the day for quick and easy nourishment. Only now there's none to be had, as I've licked it all up!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_061: We could start beekeepin', I guess? “Honey Honey Hippos” does have a ring to it... Then again, I'm not sure how many people'd use a high-speed honey service...
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_ALCHEMIST04546C_000: There are so many formulae to try! What if I just try them all...at the same time!?
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_ALCHEMIST04546D_000: I hope I can eat dinner with my family again someday. While I still have a family, that is...
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_ALCHEMIST04546E_000: I suppose I'll have to order more honey... Or perhaps invent a comparable substance to lick!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_ALCHEMIST04546B_000: I am ever so sorry to have kept you waiting! It's all here, packed up safely and hardly singed at all.
I would like you to take this to a colleague of mine at Palaka's Stand. He's an alchemist named Yezahn. Well built for a bookish type. Handsome. You can't miss him.
Oh, you're acquainted, are you? What a small world indeed!
He's still the same as ever, watching over his little one and Palaka's Stand alike. He requested replenishments for medicinal supplies, so hopefully this should tide them over.
I also threw in a handful of finished samples...and the whole explosion incident stays between us, yes!?
Now if you'll excuse me, I should eat something before my hands start shaking again. Oh, but do give him my regards!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_072: These alchemists don't seem to stop for nothin'─even meals. Ain't no denyin' that their work's important, but it's a miracle they haven't all keeled over by now...
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_073: Hmm... What if the vittles came to them?
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_074: ...But I'm gettin' ahead of myself. This package ain't gonna ride to Palaka's Stand on its lonesome. Introduce me to this Yezahn when we get there, will you?
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_075: Is this Yezahn? He is pretty sturdy lookin'...
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_YEZAHN_000_080: , what a pleasant surprise! I knew a shipment would be arriving soon, but I never expected you to be with it.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_YEZAHN_000_081: Are you playing the part of carter these days, then?
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_082: The alchemist who sent this said it's herbs for medicine...an' somethin' about finished samples, too.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_YEZAHN_000_083: Is that so? I know how busy the work keeps them─it's very generous of them to send ready concoctions.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_YEZAHN_000_084: I wanted to get straight to work replenishing our medicinal stores, so your prompt arrival is welcome indeed.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_085: Oh, if it's prompt you want, you ain't gotta look no further! The Hippo Riders'll deliver anythin' to anywhere in a flash!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_086: 'Course, we're always fine-tunin' our carts an' services, so as to better, er, serve the area. Seein' as you're the one lookin' out for folks over here, I want to pitch you an idea.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_087: My impression is that folks over at the Great Work are so busy, they barely have time to eat. That can't be good for the alchemy─not to mention the alchemists─so I'm thinkin' we start deliverin' fresh food by hunger-harryin' hippo!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_088: Only, startin' a service for just a handful of peaky alchemists ain't exactly gonna pay the rent. You think folks here could use some grub-runners?
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_YEZAHN_000_090: It has long been tradition to send food to those working in the jungle, so I'm fairly certain you'll find our residents amenable to such a service.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_YEZAHN_000_091: As these hot and humid climes tend to spoil foodstuffs easily, we like to deliver meals as soon as they are prepared.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_YEZAHN_000_092: However, transporting victuals in this jungle can prove somewhat dangerous.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_093: You mean that the smell attracts all sorts of hungry critters, right?
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_YEZAHN_000_094: Precisely. And what with our fighting fit currently healing or engaged in other matters, we simply haven't the manpower to spare on escorting meals.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_095: ...But our hippos are a different story!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_096: A hippo cart can outrun most anythin' in this jungle, so you ain't gotta worry on that front.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_097: Thanks for weighin' in! I've gotta consult with my associates, but somethin' tells me you can look forward to fresh meals from now on. Call it a lunch hunch.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_098: Alright, . Let's head back to Svarna for a team meetin'.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_100: It was just as you said, ─askin' around earned us some bright ideas!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_MARU_000_101: You think of somethin' good, Boss?
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_102: Food, Maru! Eats! We're gonna deliver meals with these wheels!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_MARU_000_104: Mouthwaterin' meals delivered wherever, whenever... Wish I could order somethin'.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_MARU_000_105: We got it cinched, Boss! Ain't nothin' that'll deliver faster or fresher than our carts!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_106:
Hold your hippos, Maru─we've still gotta sort somethin' out. Where are we gettin' this food in the first place? Takin' meals from Palaka's Stand to the jungle is one thing, but if we've gotta ride all the way to Yedlihmad or
Radz-at-Han for ready-mades...
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_MARU_000_107: Good point. Popular dishes'll be hard to keep in stock...
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_MARU_000_108: What if we had a kitchen here? We could make our own meals!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_109: Yeah... Fresh ingredients from merchants in Yedlihmad... The daily catch from fishers in Akyaali!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_MARU_000_110: An' most importantly─we get an endless supply of food!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_MARU_000_111: I might be a genius, Boss. Wait here, I'll have a kitchen goin' in no time!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_SYSTEM_000_112: Thanks to Maru's enthusiasm, Svarna has a new kitchen!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_SYSTEM_000_113: The Hippo Riders' reputation has risen to formerly delinquent carters. Make the most of their expanded services to help improve their social standing!
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_SYSTEM_000_115: You have achieved Trusted reputation with the Hippo Riders.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_SYSTEM_000_116: New Arkasodara society daily quests are now available from Maru in Svarna.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_SYSTEM_000_117: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Maru as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_SYSTEM_000_118: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Maru. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_SYSTEM_000_119: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Ghanta.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_SYSTEM_000_125: Trna is now accompanying you. Keep her at your side to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_SYSTEM_000_126: You can leave Trna behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with her and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_SYSTEM_000_127: If you wish to have Trna accompany you again, return and speak with her at the original location.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_129: The alchemists here are an odd bunch, eh? Includin' our latest customer. Kinda feels like I've stepped into another dimension or somethin'.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_130: Alright, I think I've got a good sense of things. Let's head back an' see if the goods are ready.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_Q4_000_131: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Trna?
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_132: Somethin' came up? Well, when you're done, come find me by our customer.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_000_133: You're back! Let's get goin', then.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_TRNA_100_133: The goods should be ready to go by now. Let's check in with our customer.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_SYSTEM_000_134: You must be accompanied by Trna and have her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_BANARK002_04546_SYSTEM_000_135: Trna has yet to arrive. Be sure she is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_000: Happy to see you, . I've actually got somethin' to tickle your thinker with. Hey Maru, get over here!
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_001: Startin' with the good news─looks like the hottest thing on Thavnair is Svarna's new tandoor! Folks can't get enough of our homemade grub.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_MARU_000_002: Bein' able to eat whenever we want's about the best idea I ever came up with. All you really need in life is a kitchen.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_003: Which brings us to our recent pickle─all the new business we're gettin' is really wearin' down our hippos. We can't afford to lay off the work, but my poor girl Saurya's got bags under her eyes...
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_A1_000_001: Do the hippos have comfy beds?
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_A1_000_002: This calls for a dip in the spa.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_005: Y'know, I've never given creature comforts much thought before...but if it's for our hippos, maybe it's time to start.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_007: Hm? Oh, if it ain't Ghasa. What're you doin' back so early? You're supposed to be out on delivery, ain't you?
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_GHASA_000_008: That's just it, Boss! We got trouble. The order I was out deliverin'─it got snatched! Straight outta my arms!
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_GHASA_000_009: Just when I enter the jungle, this bloke jumps out at me like I'm servin' two for one at his favorite meyhane!
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_GHASA_000_010: I pull up so I don't ride straight into him, but he rushes me, grabs the food I'm holdin', an' takes off!
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_GHASA_000_011: How dare he!? Stealin' my food and runnin' around in flashy armor, like he ain't gotta answer to nobody...
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_013: Alright, alright. Forget that loon, Ghasa. Remake the order and get it delivered, on the double.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_014: , you up for stretchin' your legs? Let's see if we can't find this son of a bhujamga.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_015: Good. I'll go an' hitch up Saurya...
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_016: ...If she'll even let me. How am I gonna convince her this time?
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_017: ...Like I said, we've got a thief to catch. Meet me over at the Shroud of the Samgha, and we'll see if he left any naan crumbs.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_GHASA_000_018: Merciful Sisters! I just hope whoever's waitin' for this ain't got a temper...
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_021: Me and Saurya just made a sweep, but we didn't see nothin' outta the ordinary.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_022: Not surprisin', of course. No thief I've ever met sticks around to face the music.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_023: Anyway, see if you can pick up anythin' we might've missed. A jungle's always movin', after all. You never know what you might find.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_024: Me and Saurya'll catch up in a little bit. Let me know if you find anythin' suspicious.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_GHASA_000_025: Hey, Saurya... Be a good girl an' let's go, okay? You wanna see some pretty colors? Where's the gulal...
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_SYSTEM_000_030: As you survey the area for suspicious activity, you spot an armed Arkasodara...
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_SYSTEM_000_031: You recognize her as the hunter, Sula! She lifts her hand in salutation before disappearing into the jungle.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_SYSTEM_000_032: As you survey the area for suspicious activity, some nearby leaves rustle and...a murderous asvattha appears!
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_SYSTEM_000_035: Your survey of the area yields not a suspicious person, but two adorable hippo calves. You may smell more like hippo than you think, because they cling to you as a comrade.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_SYSTEM_000_036: Without a herd to protect them, these two calves might easily fall prey to other wild beasts. It would be best to pause your search for now and accompany them to safety.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_SYSTEM_000_038: This energetic hippo calf looks ready to follow you. It nudges the shy hippo calf beside it in encouragement.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_SYSTEM_000_039: Trna should know what to do...
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_100_045: Where's Saurya, you're wonderin'? Don't worry, she ain't got hippo-napped or nothin'. I'll tell you about it later, but for now, let's keep lookin' for our bandit!
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_045: How'd it... Wait, where'd you get those hippos!?
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_046: Don't tell me you're the type that can't help pickin' up strays if they look at you all winsome-like.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_047: Nothin' suspicious save these little 'pots, huh? Strange there weren't other hippos, though...
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_048: Me an' Saurya also made an odd find─a Radiant who'd gotten smacked around by a beast─but no sign of our thief. Anyway, I bundled 'em into the cart an' sent Saurya off to Palaka's Stand.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_049: Let's head over as well. Ghasa should be there with his delivery by now, an' I wanna get his account again.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_050: Bring those calves while you're at it. It's too dangerous to leave 'em out here alone.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_GHASA_000_051: S-Sorry to keep you waitin'! Two Hippo Rider Specials─fast, fresh, an' ready to eat!
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_OGUL_000_052: Oh! At last, I partake in the famed Hippo Rider Special! The spicy tandoori prawns...the sumptuous fish tikka!
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_OGUL_000_053: If only Grandmother could see me now, ordering fresh fish in the custom of the locals...
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_RACASHIR_000_054: Teacher really seems to like Thavnairian cuisine. I wonder if it's very different from her homeland's...
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_100_055: Hey, where'd the juniors go? Make sure they get here safe, will you?
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_055: Looks like that Radiant got back safe. One of their friends just thanked me.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_OGUL_000_056: Greetings, ! Yezahn tells me you've taken to the shipping trade?
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_057: You sure do know everybody, don't you?
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_058: Apologies for the delay of your delivery─some scoundrel ran off with the first batch we sent.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_GHASA_000_059: What's this island comin' to that Arkasodara can't even trust each other not to act like two-gil thieves? An' that's not even gettin' into the bugger's poor taste in armor... Anyway, we're terribly sorry to have kept you waitin', miss.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_OGUL_000_060: Think nothing of it! It was only the most minor of delays.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_OGUL_000_061: I'm more worried about this scoundrel you mentioned. I've been patrolling this area for some time, and this is the first I've heard of an Arkasodara...
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_OGUL_000_063: I-In any case, I'll be sure to keep my eyes extra sharp whilst patrolling! We can't have M-Matanga running wild and pilfering prawns, now, can we?
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_RACASHIR_000_064: You're making an odd squeaking noise, did you know? And your tikka is getting cold...
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_OGUL_000_065: Right you are, young Racashir! Let us eat. As Grandmother used to say, “An empty stomach leads to forest fires”! Or was it “friendly fire”? Forgive me, I feel faint.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_OGUL_000_066: After we partake of these delicious meals, we shall scour the jungle for any nefarious suspects. I will send word if we find anything.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_GHASA_000_067: So? Are you gonna introduce me, or should I skip straight to the cuddlin'?
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_GHASA_000_068: They were alone!? Usually calves this young are glued to their parents, but you're sayin' there were no other hippos around?
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_GHASA_000_069: My deliveries are done, so why don't I go and have a look 'round the waterin' holes up north? See if my expert eye don't pick up somethin' useful.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_GHASA_000_070: Truth be told, these darlin's probably smell too much like us to be goin' back to their herd now. Take 'em home so we can make sure they grow up right, will you, Boss?
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_071: Ghasa can be a hot-head, but he's a real hippo whisperer. Ain't no one knows 'em better.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_072: I'll take the juniors back to Svarna. Stop by later when you get the chance.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_075: The calves are makin' themselves right at home. Nothin' better than havin' a herd, after all.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_MARU_000_076: You went out lookin' for a bandit an' brought back hippo calves instead? You're pretty bad at findin' things, . But they sure are cute...
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_GHASA_000_078: I searched high an' low, Boss, but there's not a hippo to be had for gil or glory. Judgin' by their tracks, the herd must've up an' left in a hurry.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_079: So you think the calves got left behind in the scramble...
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_080: I reckon nothin' short of an outright blaze would be enough to separate cow from calf, but I ain't heard news of any fires recently...
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_GHASA_000_081: Somethin' else might have done it, Boss─or someone. I found tracks that looked an awful lot like an Arkasodara's.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_GHASA_000_083: If it is, they're still short a hippo. Looked to me like the hippos cleared off before whoever it was got close enough to snatch one.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_GHASA_000_084: Can't rule it out, to be sure. Thankfully, I didn't find no grisly bits or nothin', so either way, the hippos probably got away safely.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_GHASA_000_085: In any case, we've got a no-good, grub-grabbin', hippo-harassin' lowlife on our hands. We've gotta be extra careful till we catch this bandit!
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_086: Maybe so, but us Hippo Riders are professionals now. We can't let nothin' stop us from deliverin'...
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_087: Son of a bhujamga! The creature comforts!
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_089: I am, but our hippos ain't! If this thief comes anglin' for our deliveries again an' the hippos are too tired to haul themselves outta there, we're done for.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_TRNA_000_090: An' I'm not feelin' great about our odds, seein' as even Saurya was tippin' me the cold shoulder earlier. I thought I'd hafta pull her in the cart.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_GHASA_000_091: If it's rest our poor 'pots need, then our first order of business is a proper sleepin' stable. Long overdue, if you ask me. An' for our new additions, a wadin' pool─it's safer if they can swim right at home.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_MARU_000_092: I guess we could fix up that old fishpond an' make a splash. It ain't deep enough for the bigger hippos, though.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_GHASA_000_093: It's better than nothin'! An' we can't keep 'em cooped up in Svarna all the time anyway─that's no good for the hippo soul. May as well take 'em out for proper bathin' excursions.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_MARU_000_094: I guess they are the ones doin' most of the legwork─but this ain't no small project, Ghasa. You better be helpin' me build all of this...
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_SYSTEM_000_095: Thanks to Maru and Ghasa's exhaustive efforts, Svarna has a new stable and wading pool!
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_SYSTEM_000_096: The Hippo Riders are now known as “unique” couriers, which is presumably an improvement. Make the most of their rested and refreshed hippos!
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_SYSTEM_000_100: You have achieved Respected reputation with the Hippo Riders.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_SYSTEM_000_101: New Arkasodara society daily quests are now available from Maru in Svarna.
TEXT_BANARK003_04547_SYSTEM_000_102: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Maru as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.

TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_000: Nice to see you, . If you've a moment, I'll tell you the latest.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_001: Thanks to our cool an' breezy stables, our hippos have been gettin' all sorts of luxurious shut-eye─an' the little 'pots can't be tempted away from their splashin'. All in all, our growin' family's burstin' with energy.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_002: Good thing too, seein' as our services are in ever-higher demand. Folks have even started comin' around an' petitionin' for employment, if you can believe it!
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_003: We've always liked keepin' our business to ourselves, so the thought of welcomin' in strangers felt dreadfully queer at first. But helpin' others is what Riders do, so we've got some new faces on the team.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_MARU_000_004: Besides, as swamped in requests as we are, we'd be lost without the extra help...
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_006: I appreciate the enthusiastic chorus, Ogul─but what've you gone an' done to your head?
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_008: This is hardly the time for jesting! We are in crisis, I tell you. Crisis! There are Gajasura in the jungle!
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_009: Ever since you mentioned that thieving Matanga, I've had this terrible suspicion. I had to know for certain, so I cleverly camouflaged myself with this gaja disguise and set out to investigate.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_MARU_000_010: That's...a disguise? An' ain't you sweatin' an awful lot?
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_011: I would choose a pool of sweat over a pool of blood any day! Between the Au Ra and Gajasura, there can be naught but violence and requital.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_012: And there is no doubt as to what I witnessed─a Gajasura in the flesh!
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_013: The image of it shall haunt my dreams─those red eyes...that devilish armor...that cart drawn by a frothing hippo!
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_015: He declared his name with a ghastly voice─Acala. I became an edifice of fear. He asked if I was his Matanga brethren!
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_016: In that moment, all I could envision was my own death and dismemberment by that beastly creature. Before I knew what had happened, I heard my own voice cry out:
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_017: “Not I! I am but a passing Manusya!”
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_MARU_000_018: Manusya do have bodies of men and heads of beasts, so if you squint...really hard... Never mind, ain't no way anyone'd buy that.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_019: Actually, he was terribly polite about it. Pressed his hands together and bowed deeply before leaving me be.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_020: You're sayin' you let him go? Ain't no doubt he's the bandit we're lookin' for! You're a fighter, ain't you!?
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_021: I-I'm sorry. While I have come to cherish the Arkasodara as my friends and allies, Gajasura...are another matter entirely.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_022: When I came to my senses, I searched the area and found one of your associates injured and missing his cart─no doubt the same cart now in Acala's possession. Luckily, your man's injuries seemed manageable, so I saw him to Palaka's Stand, where Yezahn is treating him now.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_023: Is that so? Then I owe you my thanks. Sorry for losin' my temper like that─everyone's entitled to their weaknesses.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_024: Anyhow, even if he did give us leg bail, he can't've gone far! I say we track him down while the trail's hot an' take back what's ours.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_025: Then let us reconvene at the Shroud of the Samgha. I shall take you to the very place I encountered him!
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_026: Saurya's in Svarna with the others. I won't be responsible for my actions if she gets taken too.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_027: I've left Maru in charge, but if this Acala character really is Gajasura, I'd like to get back sooner rather than later.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_030: This is where I saw him. From here, he rode off on that stolen hippo cart...but I can't for the life of me remember which direction he went.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_031: I was so paralyzed by fear that north could have been south and east, west. To let a phobia get the better of me like this... Can I really call myself an adventurer?
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_032: There ain't much use cryin' over spilt chai. You were caught by surprise, end of story. We should stay grounded and focus on what we know.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_034: Grandmother would often say that the trail to prey begins at a hunter's feet.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_035: And look here! On the ground, beneath our feet─wheel tracks! Departing in a southwesterly fashion.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_036: I say we divide our efforts to preclude any Gajasura trickery. I shall accompany Trna as her guard, while , you survey the area for hidden villainy. I'm counting on you!
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_SYSTEM_000_037: Sweeping your gaze across the area, you see no trace of Gajasura─hidden, villainous, or otherwise.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_SYSTEM_000_038: You listen closely to the sounds around you: the faint rustling of wind through leaves, the snuffling of wild beasts. No hippo carts.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_039: ! I thought I heard fightin'. You okay?
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_040: Looks like we've finally found our man. His eyes really are red...
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_ACALA_000_041: Heard fighting! You hurt battle brothers!?
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_045: Ghhhnnn... M-M-My M-Matanga t-tolerance won't be d-defeated by the l-likes of you!
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_ACALA_000_046: Why no fire? Thavnair full of fire, Acala hear, good for conquest...
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_047: I ain't got the foggiest idea what delusions you're ridin' in on, but I'll tell you one thing─you're pickin' a fight with the wrong island. You'd best give back what you took an' skip along home.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_ACALA_000_048: No! Not leave till conquest Thavnair! Small Gajasura, shame to tribe─no place for Acala and battle brothers!
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_ACALA_000_049: Travel far to prove strength, protect brothers! Conquest Thavnair, home for brothers!
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_A2_000_001: We won't stand by and let you conquer Thavnair.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_ACALA_000_051: You silence! Acala no fight today. Battle brothers must eat medicine.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_052: I see your reasonin', but you ain't got no right to involve my hippo. Let him go. Now!
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_ACALA_000_053: Your food, good taste. Wagon, good ride. Good for battle brothers. Soon, your home conquest for Acala! Remember!
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_054: Hey! Get back here, you─ Argh! What kinda person compliments your cookin' before ridin' off with hostages!?
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_055: H-He's gone. I-If hippo carts weren't so fast, w-we could have given chase...
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_056: ...He said somethin' about bein' small, but he didn't seem much different than us Arkasodara. Are other Gajasura seriously massive or somethin'?
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_057: Oh, about twice as big as your average Arkasodara! It is even said that their leader, the grand regent, is indeed so grand that to gaze upon their full stature is to break your neck looking upwards!
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_058: In comparison, Acala seemed quite modestly sized. Were his compatriots similar?
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_059: I see, only slightly bigger, then... Still, they must be considered quite small by their other brethren.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_060: He said they had no place to go. Can't say I don't know how that feels...
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_A3_000_001: But can you forgive what he's done?
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_A3_000_002: He didn't seem very open to negotiations...
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_062: I know, I know. But keepin' his brothers safe came before anythin', didn't it? Hard to damn him for that.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_063: Gettin' pushed out of society just for bein' who you are can really work you woe. Makes you wonder if you were ever worth anythin' to begin with. No wonder he's itchin' to prove himself...
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_064: On the Azim Steppe, the very notion that Gajasura could be capable of such nuanced emotions is─pardon me for saying so─preposterous.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_065: However, judging a book by its cover does nothing but feed fear and misunderstanding. This is something I certainly learned thanks to my experiences in Thavnair.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_066: You've gotta judge others by their actions. Of course, so far Acala's mostly injured my associate, stolen my property, and kidnapped my hippo, but still...
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_067: Back in Vanaspati, we lived in a small village pretty cut off from the rest of the island. People had their opinions of you, an' it was no easy thing changin' anyone's mind.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_068: I remember buttin' heads with the other villagers to an' again over how they treated us. Even made plans to leave town without a hippo to my name, once. So, I think I might know how Acala's feelin', if only a little...
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_070: Now, let us brace ourselves with some adventuring fundamentals─review of the information at hand.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_071: The bandit responsible for the assault of a Hippo Rider, theft of personal property, and kidnapping of an innocent hippo is a Gajasura called “Acala.” According to him, he and his compatriots are here to conquer Thavnair, so as to prove themselves to their fellows and secure a home of their own.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_072: Acala also seems to have taken a fancy to our carts─which means he's got good taste─but it also means that Svarna's high on his list to conquer.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_073: If I rallied my people an' had you two there to back us up, we could probably put down Acala and his crew, full stop. But I'd rather it not come to blows.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_074: I'm not goin' soft or nothin', but causin' a hurly-burly don't exactly right any wrongs. I wanna talk with the others an' see if we can't figure out a way to do this civilly.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_075: Settling matters peacefully should also put you on the right side of the Radiant Host. I shall be sure to relay your plight to them in a most sympathetic fashion.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_OGUL_000_076: Now I shall away to Palaka's Stand to check in on your ailing associate. Once he feels well enough to travel, I will send him along.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_077: , I'd like your input on our strategy. I'll head back to Svarna first to round up the others.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_GHASA_000_081: Not only does he biff an innocent courier, he vanishes with our hippo!? When I'm through turnin' that scamp into paste, he'll wish he were turmeric...
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_082: Normally, I'd hand you the pestle with pleasure, Ghasa. But things ain't so simple. After all, in another lifetime, us and Acala might've been brothers.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_MARU_000_083: I agree with the boss... Don't feel right pushin' around someone who's been through the same thing we have...
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_GHASA_000_084: Still! Knowin' that bastard swindled his way into our sweet hippo's heart is bringin' me to tears faster than Maru and his damned onions! Since when do our hippos trust the likes of Gajasura anyway!?
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_085: Well, with so many jobs takin' us hither an' yon, our hippos've gotten used to all sorts of different folk. Even Acala's just one in a crowd.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_086: Makes you think─if he can learn to ride a cart, anyone can.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_087: ...Anyone and everyone, I should say. An' why not?
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_088: We gather people here like you an' Ogul─y'know, adventurers─and when a job comes in, we send 'em out on their own hippo carts.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_089: Havin' a crew of strong arms hangin' around the place gives us the advantage, just in case Acala ever decides to pay us a visit.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_090: But they don't all have to be brawlers, neither. Say we've got some alchemists─we could send 'em anywhere on the island to take care of injuries. The right deed for any need, sort of a thing.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_A4_000_001: Opening an Adventurers' Guild, are we?
