TEXT_BANARK004_04548_A4_000_002: There will be refreshments, I trust?
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_092: Why not? Stop by, have a drink, hear what work's available. I think I'm on to somethin' here, if I do say so myself.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_093: If I can get a linkpearl connection goin' with Kancana, that'd be even better. We could give each other moment-to-moment updates.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_TRNA_000_094: Maru! We've got a kitchen, so how hard could a meyhane be, eh? Get me a meyhane, Maru!
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_MARU_000_095: M-Meyhane! You got it, Boss─I'll get a meyhane runnin' in the twinklin' of a hippo's eye!
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_SYSTEM_000_100: Thanks to the efforts of Maru and the others, Svarna has a new meyhane!
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_SYSTEM_000_101: The Hippo Riders are now trustworthy couriers of some repute. Connect with contacts across Thavnair to reach exciting new heights of business!
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_SYSTEM_000_105: You have achieved Honored reputation with the Hippo Riders.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_SYSTEM_000_106: New Arkasodara society daily quests are now available from Maru in Svarna.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_SYSTEM_000_107: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Maru as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_SYSTEM_000_108: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Maru. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANARK004_04548_SYSTEM_000_109: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Ghanta.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_000: , am I glad to see you! Haven't made much headway on our Gajasura problem, but let me tell you about the rest of it.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_001: Like I said, no tearful reconciliation or nothin', but havin' folks at the meyhane's been givin' us peace of mind. Between our little outfit an' Kancana's contacts, we've got every sort of adventurer you could ever need.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_MARU_000_002: Ogul's been stoppin' by when she can, too. She's gotten mighty good at ridin'. I think she's got the instincts of a racer...
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_A1_000_001: Once Ogul finds her groove, she's unstoppable!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_A1_000_002: As a fellow adventurer, she makes me proud.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_004: There's no doubt she's been settin' a great example for our recruits.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_005: So much so that even the Radiant Host's been askin' us for guards an' lookouts to patrol the roads.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_006: Works out in our favor, seein' as we'll be the first to know if Acala ever decides to─
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_GHASA_000_009: We just got word─a whole mob of Gajasura's closin' in on us. An' I don't think it's 'cause they got wind of our deal on lassis or nothin', neither.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_GHASA_000_010: They'll be here any moment, Boss. What do we do!?
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_011: Ghasa, go and find Ogul at Palaka's Stand an' have her report here. Then, I want you to make the rounds and tell folks in this area to be on the alert. I've got a hunch Acala's only after us, but just to be safe.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_012: Maru, I want you to keep up your maintenance on the carts. No need to panic, but if matters should run awry, I want everyone ready to leave, understand?
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_013: I'm goin' to relay the situation to our friends at the meyhane. As for you, , I'd like you to go an' graciously welcome our Gajasura guests.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_014: Any fights picked with you, you've got my permission to finish. But I don't want no blood on your hands. Don't mean to make things complicated, but that's how it's gotta be.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_015: I'll owe you one. Report back when you've a handle on things, yeah?
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_016: I sent off some extra fighters, but I'd like you to go an' make sure nothin' gets out of hand. Nothin' permanent, remember!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_OGUL_000_017: Ghasa apprised me of the s-situation─I came as quickly as I c-could!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_OGUL_000_018: I'm g-glad I made it in time, but t-to think a whole horde of bloodthirsty G-Gajasura may not be far behind... <shudder>
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_ACALA_100_017: Bhaaa-ha-ha-haaa! Your home, conquest for Acala!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_020: Welcome back. As you can see, we're at a bit of a deadlock with our favorite hippo enthusiast here.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_OGUL_000_021: Th-This is hardly the time to be glib, Trna. B-But rest assured that I am prepared to do all that is necessary in s-self-defense─even if that should be a swift and decisive o-offense!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_023: I'm angry, Ogul. When I think about what Acala's stolen and who he's hurt, I start boilin' like afternoon soup. But skewerin' him ain't gonna solve the bigger issue.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_024: I say we talk, first. See if we ain't so different after all.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_ACALA_000_025: You too weak for Acala! Leave! Leave hippos, go!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_026: You want us to leave Svarna? That ain't an option, an' you know that.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_027: But if you've got such a hankerin' for our hippo carts, there is another way─you could always join us.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_028: Me an' my associates─me an' my people─we built this place to welcome us when nowhere else would. So there ain't no version of this where we simply up an' leave 'cause you demand it.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_029: But you know exactly what I'm talkin' about, don't you? You know what it's like to have no place to welcome you. To need to take care of your people, no matter what. That's why I don't wanna fight you.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_ACALA_000_030: Your people no place for home? But you protect people... You...same as Acala?
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_ACALA_000_031: But Acala hit your people! Tell truth─you forgive no Acala!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_032: Like I said, I'm angry. No one messes with my family and gets away with it. That's why I wanna settle things with you, leader to leader. Fair an' square.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_ACALA_000_033: Bhaaa-ha-ha-ha! Acala hit stronger than weak you! Acala win!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_034: Sure keen on violence, ain't you? When I say “settle things,” I'm not talkin' about a fight─I'm talkin' about a race. On hippo carts!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_035: If I lose, I swear on my honor as a racer that I'll agree to your terms. But if I win, you repent for what you've done...and you join us. Peaceably. Deal?
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_ACALA_000_036: You, fool! Acala win race, take hippos, take wagons!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_037: You can try. We'll start the race from that harbor town right there, an' ride the highroad all the way up past the quarry further on.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_ACALA_000_038: Agree. Acala wait at town. But Acala wait not long!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_OGUL_000_039: W-Well, he was more reasonable than I expected. But lest he decide to perpetrate any knavery, I shall keep a sharp eye over him!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_042: I ain't gonna go back on what I said, but I really shouldn't have called Acala out like that...
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_043: Not 'cause I think I'll lose─not on your life! But we had to crawl our way up from bein' nothin' but reckless misfits, and now that we've made somethin' of ourselves, I'm gonna ride the highroad an' blow whatever respect we earned to the wind...
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_044: What's done is done, I guess. Now we just gotta focus on keepin' things fair. Don't want Acala workin' a traverse around us, not when everyone's futures are at stake.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_045: Damn it all... How're we supposed to make this work?
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_A2_000_001: What if the race were a sanctioned event?
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_A2_000_002: Invite a crowd to watch. Acala's not likely to work anything then.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_047: That's genius, ! An official hippo race between the Arkasodara and Gajasura... That'd be, well, legendary!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_048: If we do that, not only do we stay legitimate, but we'd be hostin' an event that everyone can enjoy─like a festival!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_049: I know I said our racin' days were over, but this is goin' to be one for the chronicles, . I'll show you a race you'll never forget!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_050: Alright. I'll have Ogul smooth things over with the Radiant Host while my associates spread the word about our upcomin' scurry! Come an' meet me in Yedlihmad─can't keep Acala waitin' too long.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_051: Ogul said the Radiant Host was a little perplexed, but they gave us their blessin' nonetheless! Better to settle our differences peacefully, in their words.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_052: My associates are out gatherin' the locals, so let's talk terms with Acala while we can.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_OGUL_000_040: Leave supervising Acala to me! Rest assured, I shall not be fainting any time soon─mind over matter, as Grandmother would say. Mind over matter!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_ACALA_000_055: You not ready? Acala ready. Acala no patience!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_056: Keep your armor on. We've gotta wait for our audience to show up. Don't wanna start without our kinsfolk cheerin' us on, now do we?
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_ACALA_000_057: Kins? Race, battle. Not show off! No kins!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_058: C'mon, Acala─our “kins” are goin' to make sure both sides play fair. Besides, if you win, they'll officially be your kins, right?
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_060: Speakin' of which, I've got a proposition for you─seein' as this race is gonna determine the future of both our peoples, I'd like to declare it a cooperative effort.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_061: Only the two of us'll be ridin' the track, of course, but my team's gonna be backin' me up from the sidelines. You're welcome to do the same, if you'd like.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_ACALA_000_062: Hmph! Battle, Acala win alone! Acala strong!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_ACALA_000_065: Where kins!? Acala ready to win!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_070: I think it goes without sayin' that this race ain't just about the Hippo Riders. The whole island─and all the people on it─are countin' on us to win this.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_071: So here's my plan─I'm gonna give you a linkpearl, like the ones me an' my associates use. That way we can be in contact durin' the race.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_072: I'll have Maru and Ghasa standin' by at key points along the track so that they can give you updates on our progress.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_073: I want you to use that information to advise me durin' the race. Sound okay?
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_074: Not to lay on the pressure, or anythin'. I take full responsibility for how I ride, but just in case I lose my head, I want you to keep me focused.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_A3_000_002: I think I already lost my head somewhere... But I'll do my best.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_076: Thanks, pal. I'm countin' on you.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_077: All that's left is gettin' Saurya ready to run. Then there ain't nothin' stoppin' us.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_078: She likes those bright colors... What do you reckon the chances are of a rainbow conveniently poppin' out of nowhere, eh? If only...
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_MARU_000_079: Hah...hah... I m-made it! Boss, I─ <wheeze>
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_080: Maru! What're you doin' here? And sweatin' like Ogul in that gaja head. What happened? What's the matter?
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_MARU_000_081: N-Nothin', Boss. I brought you somethin' for your race...
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_MARU_000_082: Saurya goes wild for bright colors, right? So I used some of our leftover gulal to make a rainbow! Just throw this, and she'll perk right up for sure...
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_083: If this ain't a sign from the divinities, I don't know what is. Maru, you hamsahead, you really came through! We're gonna win this thanks to you!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_084: I'll save this for just the right moment. Can't hit the ground runnin' too hard after all.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_085: Keep that in mind when you're coachin' me. Pacin' is important for a race this long. Anyway, go on ahead to the goalpost over by the Giantsgall Grounds. I'll see you when I bring home a victory!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_086: Maru, I want you watchin' the highroad around the Great Work. I'll fill you in on the details by linkpearl.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_087: Even after all this time, I always get nervous before a race. But all I've gotta do is trust myself, trust my girl, an' ride!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_088: Wait for me by the goalpost─Racashir's goin' to be callin' the race, so he should be there by now too.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_RACASHIR_000_089: I really hope Trna wins the race...
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_RACASHIR_000_090: From what teacher says, if the Gajasura end up taking over Thavnair, we're all in trouble.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_OGUL_100_091: Ghhhnnnnnn! I sh-shan't be intimidated! I have cast all f-fear from my body now! Th-This time for certain!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_RACASHIR_000_095: Teacher, we're all ready over here.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_OGUL_000_096: It seems that preparations at the goalpost are complete. Racers, are you ready?
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_OGUL_000_097:
Citizens of Thavnair─I welcome you to the very first Hannish Hippo Hustle!
Representing the Arkasodara and our very own Hippo Riders...Trna!!!
Representing the Gajasura, the mighty...Acala!!!
Racers, take your mark!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_ACALA_000_100: Acala win! Run, run! Conquest for Acala!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_GHASA_000_101: (-Ghasa's Voice-)That Gajasura bastard! Pushin' our precious hippo that hard─I'm so mad, I'm sweatin' blood!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_GHASA_000_102: (-Ghasa's Voice-)The boss's eatin' dust, but the road's not lookin' too good up ahead... What's your call!?
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_A4_000_001: Don't lose to that bastard! Full speed ahead!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_A4_000_002: Save your strength! The road's lookin' rocky.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_105: Ain't no good, the road's a mess. Sorry, but I'm gonna hang back for now!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_MARU_000_107: (-Maru's Voice-)They're passin' by the Great Work, an' it looks like Acala's hippo might be reachin' its limit. Not surprisin', seein' how hard he's pushin' it...
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_MARU_000_108: (-Maru's Voice-)Chances are good Acala's not goin' to take much more of a lead, but it's your call...
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_A5_000_002: Hold steady till the final spurt!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_110: Ain't gotta tell me twice! C'mon, Saurya, let's show him what we've got!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_111: Loud an' clear. We'll bide our time for a grand finish!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_ACALA_000_112: You! Fast, more fast! Run, run, run!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_SYSTEM_000_113: The two hippo carts are hurtling towards the goal at breakneck speed! Give your final piece of advice to Trna for the win!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_A6_000_001: Boss! Give it everythin' you've got.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_115: Hya-haaah! Been waitin' for this! Get ready to see lightnin'!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_RACASHIR_000_119: By a hippo's nose, the victor of the Hannish Hippo Hustle is...TRNA!!!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_ACALA_000_120: Acala lose... Why!? You trick Acala!?
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_121: No, we didn't trick you. We just know our hippos, that's all. What they like. How much they can take.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_122: Hippos are livin', breathin' creatures, same as us. Havin' to run that hard, for that long─all while pullin' a heavy bloke like you? No mystery why your hippo melted its grease.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_ACALA_000_123: Hippo slow because grease melt... Acala understand.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_124: And I did say that your people could support you durin' the race. But you insisted on ridin' alone. They're your “battle brothers,” ain't they? I bet they would've loved to help.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_125: I might be in charge, but if I've gotta rely on others to protect my people, I'm not hesitatin'. You can only do so much by yourself.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_127: Of course, trustin' folks enough to do that didn't exactly come naturally to me neither.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_128: Me and my people, we used to be nothin' but a bunch of misfits. We didn't really belong nowhere, an' no one really wanted us around in the first place.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_129: People like us ain't got a lot of options─you either scrape by on the outskirts so that you ain't a bother, or leave for someplace new an' hope that you can prove yourself somehow.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_130: But it ain't gotta be like that. You can be you an' still build trust an' contribute somethin' positive, however small. Misfit or no, at some point you realize that none of us are really so different.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_131: So I believe in you, Acala. I think if no-good racers like us can turn things around, you an' your people can too. You ain't gotta conquer nothin' to protect your brothers now.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_132: A deal's a deal, right? Join us. Become a Hippo Rider an' see where the cart takes you.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_ACALA_000_133: Acala your words understand. Acala, you, not different. But Acala Gajasura. This bad...
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_134: Our tribes may have their differences, but as for you an' me...that's just a racin' rivalry now. An' everyone watchin' saw how hard you were tryin' for your people. Might take some time, but I think you'll find a place here.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_135: So, what do you say? Come back with us to Svarna?
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_ACALA_100_136: Acala lose race... Sad. But for battle brothers, new home. Acala protect brothers. So Acala glad. Much glad.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_140: Thanks for the stellar advice! Couldn't have done it without you.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_141: Ain't no way I was losin', but I'm glad this didn't end with Acala's people bein' chased off the island.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_142: It got a little tense when a bunch of Gajasura came walkin' in, bold as brass, but I explained the situation an' everyone's bein' good-hearted about it. It's like I said─none of us are so different.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_143: But enough about that─people loved the race! When was the last time I rode like that!? Wind against my face, crowds cheerin' me on... Heh, now that I think about it? Might've been a first.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_144: Next time the Hannish Hippo Hustle rolls around, we should start it from Svarna. Or finish it. Or both! Think of the traffic we'd get at the meyhane...
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_145: Who knew thinkin' up new ways to excite other folks would be so...well, excitin'? This─all of this─is thanks to you, . I can't thank you enough.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_TRNA_000_146: Alright, let's get to it! Our brand-new racin' gate ain't gonna build itself, after all!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_SYSTEM_000_150: In commemoration of the historic race between the representatives of the Arkasodara and Gajasura peoples─and the peace thereby achieved─a gate has been erected in Svarna!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_SYSTEM_000_151: The Hippo Riders' reputation has soared to legendary heights. Backed by their diligence and hard-earned skills, Trna and her associates will continue to spread joy throughout all of Thavnair!
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_SYSTEM_000_155: You have achieved Sworn reputation with the Hippo Riders.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_SYSTEM_000_156: You will receive an experience point bonus upon completion of the Arkasodara society daily quests.
TEXT_BANARK005_04549_SYSTEM_000_159: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Ghanta.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_000: Thanks for stoppin' in, . It's always good to see you.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_001: Nothin' much to report, if you can believe it. Acala an' his pals still have their challenges, but we're takin' it slow an' gettin' to know each other.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_002: They've certainly got their own, er, style that some folks find surprisin'. But I figure so long as we reach an understandin' somewhere in the middle, we'll keep gettin' along just fine.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_003: Luckily, all of Acala's battle brothers now have it on good authority that “Trna strong!” so they listen to what I've gotta say without a fuss.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_004: They're a sight to see around supper, too─not even Maru shovels down grub with that much gusto. But they help out with work how they can, so I'm not worried.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_005: ...At least, I wish I wasn't. See, I just got word that Kancana's on her way over. Apparently, she's got somethin' important to discuss.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_006: I'm sure it ain't bad, but just thinkin' about it has my knees shakin'. Would you mind terribly if I asked you to sit in?
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_008: Thanks, . I can always count on you. She should be here soon.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_009: It's gotta be about Svarna. What if she says we've gotta leave?
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_KANCANA_000_015: Trna! Thank you for making the time to chat. I know you have quite the busy schedule, so I shall get straight to the point.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_KANCANA_000_016: About this land─I believe our terms were that I would lease you this space contingent on your profits, correct?
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_KANCANA_000_017: Oh, there is no need to look so terrified! Everyone on the island knows just how hard you and your associates have been working.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_KANCANA_000_018: I had a feeling that you would take well to delivery work, but when I heard that you welcomed a group of Gajasura into your midst, well! “Surprised” wouldn't cover the half of it. You have done what no Arkasodara before could, and it is truly remarkable.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_KANCANA_000_019: After you've accomplished so much for your community, who would I be to come here and demand that you return this land? No, no, you have no need to worry.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_OGUL_000_020: Seeing Gajasura perform honest work before my very eyes─I'd write home about it, but nobody back home would believe me!
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_021: To tell you the truth, sometimes I can't believe it myself. We may come from different places, but me an' Acala an' all our people shared a lot of the same pain. And none of us really knew what to do with it.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_022: But now look at us! Helpin' others like we've been helped ourselves, an' doin' a damn fine job of it! ...Passable, anyway.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_023: And that's thanks to you, , for helpin' out so much. An' Kancana, for believin' in us and lendin' us this space in the first place. An' Ogul, for always bein' here in a pinch.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_024: Maru an' Ghasa...the rest of my associates... They've all been here, with me, through every sort of thing you can imagine. Even Acala's been a big part of our journey.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_025: It's 'cause of everyone that we got this chance to see ourselves as somethin' bigger than just “misfits.” So on behalf of all my Riders, I truly thank you. From the bottom of my heart.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_KANCANA_000_026: I still have the highest of hopes for you, Trna. You and your associates are no longer just delivering parcels and people, after all. You are delivering hope and inspiration to all those on this island.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_KANCANA_000_027: Which brings me back to why I have come here today.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_KANCANA_000_028: I would like to gift you the deed to this land, Trna.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_KANCANA_000_029: Consider this my investment in a happy, healthy Thavnair. Continue building your business into something you feel truly represents the Hippo Riders, and I will feel more than repaid.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_KANCANA_000_030: I believe that the people of Svarna will bring us closer to the brilliant future we all hope for. Make us proud, Trna.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_031: ...Those words mean more to us than you'll ever know. Thank you.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_032: I promise you, we ain't gonna let you down! The Hippo Riders, we...we're gonna deliver everyone straight to a better tomorrow!
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_KANCANA_000_033: Now, there's that enthusiasm I love so much! Here's to that better tomorrow─and to seeing it with you!
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_035: Now that I've got the future of a whole island loaded into my cart, I think it's about time to toss caution to the wind an' ride like I never rode before!
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_036: I've got so many ideas I wanna try! Like, listen to this─once Thavnairian tourism gets goin' again, we could do hippo-cart tours! Take folks to see all the prettiest places.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_037: Heh, I've gotten so used to thinkin' up these sorts of ideas, but if you hadn't said what you did back then, none of us would even be here, you know?
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_038: What, did you forget? You were the very first person who ever said that me an' my hippo carts could be somethin' useful. Might've been a throwaway comment to you, but to me─to us─it meant everythin'.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_039: Who'd have thought a handful of words could change the Hippo Riders from misfittin' racers to an independent business? Must be your own sort of magic, . But we'll be repayin' your kindness every day goin' forward. You can count on that.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_TRNA_000_040: Alright! Enough chitchat─we've got goods to deliver! Mouths to feed! Drinks to pour! An' most importantly? Hippo carts to ride!
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_SYSTEM_000_041: You have achieved Bloodsworn reputation with the Hippo Riders.
TEXT_BANARK006_04550_SYSTEM_000_042: You will receive an experience point bonus upon completion of the Arkasodara society daily quests.
TEXT_BANARK101_04551_MARU_000_001: I promised the boss I'd try an' get the cart rollin', but lazin' about here ain't exactly goin' to make a job of it...
TEXT_BANARK101_04551_MARU_000_002: It ain't much, but I tried makin' some handbills... You think you could pass 'em out around Yedlihmad?
TEXT_BANARK101_04551_MARU_000_003: Tell folks that if they bring back one of these, they'll get a discount. That sounds professional, right? Anyhow, I'll leave the talkin' to you─I know you'll explain it good.
TEXT_BANARK101_04551_DOCKER04551_000_011: A start-up delivery service...by hippo cart? And here I thought chocobo carriages were the only viable option. What an intriguing angle.
TEXT_BANARK101_04551_DOCKER04551_000_012: I only off-load luggage, so delivery arrangements are out of my hands, but I'll take this to my friends at the harbor guild. They may yet find some use for it.
TEXT_BANARK101_04551_DOCKER04551_000_013: Oh, the Hippo Riders! Yes, my friend at the harbor guild tried them straightaway. Wouldn't stop gushing about their speedy carts.
TEXT_BANARK101_04551_DOCKER04551_000_014: If you could spare a few more handbills, I know of some others who will appreciate that discount!
TEXT_BANARK101_04551_DOCKER04551_000_015: I'll be sure to pass this along.
TEXT_BANARK101_04551_TRADERWOMAN04551_00: A delivery service! By hippo cart, no less. This is perfect timing─it just so happens that I need a parcel delivered to the Giantsgall Grounds without delay.
“Fastest on the island,” are they? I shall certainly put them to the test! Thank you, I'll head over straightaway.
Those speedy Hippo Riders! No false advertising there─they had my package to its recipient in no time at all. Count me a satisfied customer!
I daresay it's time to redeem my second discount. I wonder if I could persuade them into a fixed contract...
TEXT_BANARK101_04551_THINKINGARKASODARA0: Oh! The Hippo Riders! I know a fellow who works there!
Nothing would make me happier than supporting an Arkasodara-run business like this. I simply must find something for them to deliver!
Out promoting the Hippo Riders again? I found something to deliver, and they had it in Radz-at-Han in no time at all─and at a discount!
Of course, I'll be needing it shipped back now, so could I trouble you for another handbill? Oh, and some extras for my friends!
TEXT_BANARK101_04551_MARU_000_030: Handed out the handbills, have you?
TEXT_BANARK101_04551_MARU_000_031: I'm glad we piqued some interest. Handin' out adverts ain't glamorous, but it sure gets the job done...
TEXT_BANARK101_04551_MARU_000_032: I'll keep thinkin' up new ways of gettin' our name out there. Come by again when you've got the time...
TEXT_BANARK102_04552_MARU_000_001: Tell me, ─you're from Eorzea, ain't you?
TEXT_BANARK102_04552_MARU_000_002: Just so happens we've got a deal lined up with an Eorzean trader, but... We don't want no trouble, is all. You don't mind actin' as my middleman, do you?
TEXT_BANARK102_04552_MARU_000_003: Alright, you'll need to pick up our side of the bargain from a fisher called Khanga in Akyaali. Hand him this─he'll know what to do.
TEXT_BANARK102_04552_MARU_000_004: Take what he gives you to the Eorzean trader at the docks in Yedlihmad, an' then report back with the goods once you've finished. Easy, right?
TEXT_BANARK102_04552_KHANGA_000_011: Ah. Maru's “favor,” yes... I see you've brought payment in full.
TEXT_BANARK102_04552_KHANGA_000_012: He wanted these seen safely into the hands of a certain Lominsan visitor. I assume I can trust you with the rest?
TEXT_BANARK102_04552_KHANGA_000_013: Have you not a delivery to make?
TEXT_BANARK102_04552_LIMSAMARINER04552_0: Ho, there! You wouldn't happen to be Master Maru's associate, now would you?
Oh, good! I've been eagerly awaiting your arrival, . Yours is my final trade, so it's back to the diamond of the Rhotano I go.

These? Why, they're the finest dried ingredients this side of the Bounty! Make for a glorious soup stock...and fetch a glorious price, at that. Limsa Lominsa is a culinary capital, after all. For her chefs, only the very best will suffice.
Well then, a pleasure doing business with you! This crate contains Master Maru's goods─send him my regards, yes?
TEXT_BANARK102_04552_MARU_000_031: Brilliant! I knew you were the right  for the job. I reckoned that skipper might've skipped clear away if one of us came lumberin' at him, fish or no...
TEXT_BANARK102_04552_MARU_000_032: Oh, this? It's a prototype for a new kinda wheel. There's this really reputable company in Limsa that's comin' up with upgrades for our carts.
TEXT_BANARK102_04552_MARU_000_033: We've gotta make sure we can handle any road now that we're ridin' all over the island. Can't wait to give these a spin...
TEXT_BANARK103_04553_MARU_000_001: Listen, ─an important part of ridin' is bein' ready to ride at all times. And that means keepin' up regular maintenance on your cart.
TEXT_BANARK103_04553_MARU_000_002: It so happens that we're runnin' low on certain spare parts, and gettin' more of 'em... Well, let's just say it's best suited for fightin' types, eh? Like you!
TEXT_BANARK103_04553_MARU_000_003: If you could swing by the old Hamsa Hatchery an' fetch me some manjusaka vines, I'd be much obliged.
TEXT_BANARK103_04553_MARU_000_004: You're gonna have to take down some small fry to get to the gnarlier chap, but his are the vines we want. A healthy handful should do!
TEXT_BANARK103_04553_POPMESSAGE_000_010: A gnarled manjusaka unfurls before you!
TEXT_BANARK103_04553_MARU_000_021: These are perfect! Our hippos appreciate your kindness. As do I.
TEXT_BANARK103_04553_MARU_000_022: You see, these vines are what stand between the yoke and our precious hippos' skin─an' believe you me, you never wanna see a blistered hippo.
TEXT_BANARK103_04553_MARU_000_023: We always make sure to keep fresh vines in reserve, but go through 'em quicker than you might think. I hope you won't mind fetchin' some again when the time comes...
TEXT_BANARK104_04554_MARU_000_001: We might have trouble, ─one of our Riders has gone missin'.
TEXT_BANARK104_04554_MARU_000_002: Last we heard from him, he was headin' back here from Palaka's Stand, but that was some time ago.
TEXT_BANARK104_04554_MARU_000_003: You think you could spare a moment to join our search? We've covered the ground between here and the Wakeful Torana so far, but beyond that...
TEXT_BANARK104_04554_WORRIEDARKASODARA04: Oh, blessed be! Someone came lookin'!
You won't believe the beast we just ran into. Ugliest thing I've seen since the Final Days...
Well, we spanked away like our skins depended on it, but my delivery got jostled outta the cart.
To make matters worse, when I pull 'round to fetch it, my wheel slams into a rock, an' now I'm spinnin' six ways to nowhere!
My girl was in hippo hysterics─I had to cut her loose to stop her bellowin'. I hate to put you out like this, but you think you could lend me a hand an' bring me my cargo?
It's just one wooden crate. I think I spotted it by that boulder over there.
Shapin' up to be one of those days, I'm afraid─but knowin' that cargo's safe would make all the difference.
TEXT_BANARK104_04554_SYSTEM_000_020: Return the fallen cargo to the harried Rider's cart before your arms give out.
TEXT_BANARK104_04554_SYSTEM_000_021: You will have three minutes to complete the task. Should you fail, return to the starting location and begin anew.
TEXT_BANARK104_04554_WORRIEDARKASODARA04: That's it! Thank the Sisters. And you!
I'll head home as soon as we're ready to ride. Let Maru know we're alright, will you?
I've still gotta check the cart an' coax my girl back under the yoke─tell Maru we'll be on our way shortly, yeah?
TEXT_BANARK104_04554_MARU_000_040: So that's what happened! Thank the Sisters that everyone's alright...
TEXT_BANARK104_04554_MARU_000_041: Our Riders are usually pretty good at avoidin' the nastier beasties, but a jungle's still a jungle... Sounds like our carts could use some adjustments, too...
TEXT_BANARK104_04554_MARU_000_042: Anyroad, I'll mention it to the boss. Thanks for bein' a pal, .
TEXT_BANARK105_04555_MARU_000_001: Got a moment to spare? I've been wantin' some flowers to lay down as an offerin' to Sanduruva...
TEXT_BANARK105_04555_MARU_000_002: Only a certain kind'll do, though─dark green astamudgara. They only grow at Night's Watch, to the east of Yedlihmad.
TEXT_BANARK105_04555_MARU_000_003: They'll fall to bits if you don't pick 'em right, but I reckon you've got a delicate touch. More so than any of us clumsy oafs, that's for certain...
TEXT_BANARK105_04555_MARU_000_004: Anyhow, a pair of our Riders'll be standin' by in case you need assistance gettin' up or down. Flower pickin' ain't their forte, but I've never seen such hippo-cart derrin'-do...
TEXT_BANARK105_04555_MARU_000_011: Yeah, these are the ones! An' in great condition, too.
TEXT_BANARK105_04555_MARU_000_012: Of all eight colors of astamudgara, they say Sanduruva likes this dark green the best.
TEXT_BANARK105_04555_MARU_000_013: When you're prayin' for good business, it's these flowers or nothin'. We've gotta make sure we're pullin' out all the stops, after all...
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_MARU_000_001: One of our new recruits has been takin' his sweet time with his delivery...
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_MARU_000_002: He ain't irresponsible, just...not the best conversationalist. You think you could check in on him an' make sure he's alright?
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_MARU_000_003: He's probably loiterin' nervously around the Great Work somewhere. Give him a nudge in the right direction if he ain't makin' progress.
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_WOMAN04556_000_004: B-By the Sisters! This man just snuck up on me and started shouting! What does he want? I'm terrified to ask!
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_MYSTERIOUSALCHEMIST: This man has been standing here, squirming in silence for some time. Is he in distress?
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_WOMAN04556_000_011: S-Stop shouting at me! Just tell me what you want and leave me be!
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_SHYNESSDELIVERER045: N-No, I didn't mean─! Th-The boss always says to s-speak up, so I just─! Er!
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_A1_000_001: Pause. Now take a deep breath.
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_A1_000_002: You must speak confidently, man! From your diaphragm!
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_A1_000_003: Eye contact is key. Steady, unblinking eye contact...
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_SYSTEM_100_013: After several uncomfortable moments, it becomes clear that this method isn't working. Try advising him again.
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_SHYNESSDELIVERER045: D-Deep breaths? O-Okay... That... Oh, that feels better... Whooo...
I think I can take it from here, ! Thanks for your help─an' tell Maru that I'll be back soon!
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_MYSTERIOUSALCHEMIST: He appears to be in deep thought, but I'm not certain why he wishes I bear witness to it...
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_SHYNESSDELIVERER045: I-I knew what I was gonna say... But now I can't remember nothin'... Er...
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_A2_000_001: Have you a written list of your objectives?
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_A2_000_002: Remember, man! Remember with sheer willpower!
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_A2_000_003: Just start talking until you figure it out.
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_SYSTEM_100_023: After several uncomfortable moments, it becomes clear that this method isn't working. Try advising him again.
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_SHYNESSDELIVERER045: Oh, th-that's right! I wrote it down, didn't I? 'Cause I knew somethin' like this might happen! Ha! I got so nervous, I even forgot that I remembered that I'd forget!
Thanks, ─I think I'll be alright! Tell Maru that I'll be back soon.
I remember their name... But what did they look like again...? Oh no...
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_A3_000_001: I'm sure Nidhana could point you in the right direction.
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_A3_000_002: Just introduce yourself to everybody here. You're bound to remember at some point!
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_A3_000_003: Start screaming their name. I'm sure someone will come running.
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_SHYNESSDELIVERER045: I-If I could do that, I would've done it already!
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_SYSTEM_100_031: The nervous Rider's shoulders slump dejectedly. Try advising him again.
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_SHYNESSDELIVERER045: O-Oh! I was so focused on tryin' to fix it myself, I never considered askin' for help!
Thanks, ! I can take it from here. Tell Maru not to worry no more!
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_MARU_000_040: So that's what he was up to... Thanks for steerin' him true.
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_MARU_000_041: His nerves can really get the better of him, but he's been downright stubborn about helpin' out with deliveries.
TEXT_BANARK106_04556_MARU_000_042: We'll keep him runnin' errands closer to home, but I hope you won't be averse to helpin' him out again, should he need it. I know it'd mean the world to him...
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_MARU_000_000: Wanna go throw stuff at the locals? It's a lot more fun than you might imagine...
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_MARU_000_001: ...What's that look for? I ain't up to no good or nothin', if that's what you're thinkin'!
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_MARU_000_002: There's an old island tradition that says peltin' folks with gulal─er, colored powder, very soft─protects 'em from evil an' brings good fortune. Each color even has its own particular blessin'─red for health, blue for tranquility, yellow for plenty, an' so on.
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_MARU_000_003: I thought we could throw some from our carts to promote the Hippo Riders. It'll get our name out there, plus give us an excuse to start communicatin' with more folks...
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_MARU_000_004: But why not see for yourself? Maybe start at Palaka's Stand─they got hit hard by the Final Days, so feel free to start flingin' at all an' sundry.
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_MARU_000_005: Talk to Vata over there an' he'll set you up with one of our carts. Happy tossin'!
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_VATA_000_006: Hallo, ─headin' over to Palaka's Stand, are we?
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_VATA_100_006: I've loaded your cart with a classic selection of gulal. Here's an easy way of rememberin' what's what─fighters see red, eh? An' nervous saps get the blues. Heheh! An' yellow...well, you've just gotta remember yellow's for plenty, now don't you? Right then, off you go!
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_VATA_000_007: You take a corner goin' too fast or somethin'? It's alright─I ain't the type to peach on a fellow daredevil. Just hold on tighter this time, eh?
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_RESIDENTS04557A_000: All quiet on the jungle front... So far, anyway...
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_SYSTEM_100_010: Speak with Vata in Svarna to board the hippo cart, then throw gulal at this unsuspecting personage.
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_RESIDENTS04557A_100: Gulal? What a pleasant surprise. You wouldn't happen to have any red, now, would you?
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_RESIDENTS04557A_000: Such a beautiful, vibrant color! And that distinctive, pleasant aroma... It may take a while to wash off, but that's simply part of the fun.
Red gulal is known to nurture good health and ward away injury. I daresay I'll be able to finish my patrol without incident today!
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_RESIDENTS04557B_000: What's to become of the village's defenses? Not to mention the temples. There's far too much to do...
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_SYSTEM_100_013: Speak with Vata at Svarna to board the hippo cart, then throw gulal at this unsuspecting personage.
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_RESIDENTS04557B_100: Wah! Y-You surprised me! ...Is that gulal? You wouldn't happen to be carrying blue, would you!?
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_RESIDENTS04557B_000: Aaah! What a refreshing hue. Blue, for a peaceful spirit. I can't remember the last time I spared a moment for happiness like this...
There is still so much to be done, but it is precisely in such trying times that one must find and maintain an inner peace. Thank you for reminding me of this.
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_RESIDENTS04557C_000: Will our supplies last at this rate? But can we afford to order more? What to do...
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_SYSTEM_100_016: Speak with Vata at Svarna to board the hippo cart, then throw gulal at this unsuspecting personage.
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_RESIDENTS04557C_100: It feels like an age since I last saw some gulal! I don't suppose you have any other colors? Yellow, perhaps?
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_RESIDENTS04557C_000: How bright and brilliant! Like a shower of sunshine. Bringing us gulal during these hard times─you Hippo Riders know just what this island needs!
Watching our supplies dwindle had me in a state of great unease─but with this blessing for plenty, I feel more optimistic. I hope fortune favors you with the same kindness you have shown me.
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_MARU_000_020: Welcome back! Judgin' by your smudgy hands, I'm assumin' it went well?
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_MARU_000_021: Our gulal is made from a Hannish recipe─it uses turmeric, bilva, an' some other medicinal herbs, so it's actually pretty good for you. Or so says the alchemist who taught me how to make it...
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_MARU_000_022: But the most important ingredient─accordin' to that alchemist─is the prayer you've got in your heart for the person you're throwin' it at.
TEXT_BANARK107_04557_MARU_000_023: I dunno much about the science of it, but they say gulal works. An' if we were able to spread some cheer to even a few people, that's good enough for me!
TEXT_BANARK108_04558_MARU_000_000: ! We're in a delicate situation here─I need you to bring me a huge sack of hamsa eggs, straightaway!
TEXT_BANARK108_04558_MARU_000_001: Nilopala Nourishments is makin' a riddance, so I had our man in the city buy a whole host of eggs while the buyin's good.
TEXT_BANARK108_04558_MARU_000_002: ...Only, eggs are too fragile to transport by hippo cart, an' he's still out on delivery. Could you hustle over to him an' pick up that sack of eggy goodness for me?
TEXT_BANARK108_04558_MARU_000_003: He's waitin' for you west of the Wakeful Torana. Make sure nothin' cracks on your way back!
TEXT_BANARK108_04558_DELIVERYMAN04558_00: Maru got you the message! Good, 'cause I've been sittin' on these eggs. ...Not literally, of course.
I'll be back on the road as soon as I sort these packages, but make sure you get those to Maru before they spoil in this heat.
When I relayed how many Maru wanted, the hamsa handler thought I was jestin'. Careful not to crack any on your way back, eh? It's a full bag.
TEXT_BANARK108_04558_MARU_000_008: Nothin' broken, nothin' spoiled! Another eggscellent job by ! ...Too much?
TEXT_BANARK108_04558_MARU_000_009: Hamsa eggs are a standard ingredient in loads of Thavnairian recipes, but they spoil quicker than you might think.
TEXT_BANARK108_04558_MARU_000_010: Hence Nilopala's riddances─ever since they recovered those hamsa from the old hatchery, they've been overflowin' with eggs that have to sell without delay.
TEXT_BANARK108_04558_MARU_000_011: Luckily for us, our menu thrives on hamsa eggs! Rich masala omelettes...spicy kai-jiao...deep-fried telur balado... The possibilities are endless!
TEXT_BANARK108_04558_MARU_000_012: Thanks for your help, . An' feel free to pay a visit to our kitchen any time.
TEXT_BANARK109_04559_MARU_000_000: , you haven't seen a broodin' Rider carryin' a couple of jugs of valras oil, have you?
TEXT_BANARK109_04559_MARU_000_001: He's a tough bloke, so I didn't think twice about sendin' him off to pummel valras─but now I'm worried somethin' might've happened.
TEXT_BANARK109_04559_MARU_000_002: I reckon you're even tougher than he is, so would you mind seekin' him out? He should be on the Perfumed Rise somewhere─an' hopefully he ain't dismantled.
TEXT_BANARK109_04559_ROUGHDELIVERER04559: ...I owe you my thanks. Circumstances forbade my retreat.
I shall retrieve the oil and return posthaste. Tell this to Maru, if you would.
Upon seeing this fragile creature in mortal peril, I am shamed to admit that I forgot myself... Tell Maru I shall return with the oil anon.
TEXT_BANARK109_04559_MARU_000_020: Did you find him in one piece?
TEXT_BANARK109_04559_MARU_000_021: Of course he did... He's usually a sober-minded fellow, but all bets are off when a little critter gets involved.
TEXT_BANARK109_04559_MARU_000_022: Anyway, I'm relieved to hear he's alright. Wasn't sure what I was gonna do if he wasn't...
TEXT_BANARK109_04559_MARU_000_023: I'll keep this in mind the next time I send him out on a job. Thanks for helpin' out as always, !
TEXT_BANARK110_04560_MARU_000_000: , would you be willin' to go scrape me up some redbloom anemones? There's this recipe I wanna try...
TEXT_BANARK110_04560_MARU_000_001: You'll wanna look just off the coast of Saltwind's Welcome. If you could grab me a couple growin' close to the water's surface, I'd be much obliged.
TEXT_BANARK110_04560_MARU_000_011: These're them! Redblooms are universal─fishers use 'em for moochin', and they're delicious deep-fried or steamed in coconut milk. With fronds like these, who needs other anemones?
TEXT_BANARK110_04560_MARU_000_012: ...A-Anyway, since they're so popular, you're only allowed to harvest 'em from certain areas. Don't wanna get too greedy, after all...
TEXT_BANARK111_04561_MARU_000_000: You got time to spare? 'Cause I've got grub to share. Specifically with the folks protectin' the ruins an' temples in the Shroud of the Samgha...
TEXT_BANARK111_04561_MARU_000_001: Here, take these sweets an' eats an' follow the sound of rumblin' bellies. Tell them the Hippo Riders sent you...
TEXT_BANARK111_04561_RADIANTHOSTA04561_0: What ho! Is something the matter?
For me? Why, my greatest thanks to you, good !
Of all the things to encounter in these jungles, a warm meal is a welcome surprise indeed.
We have resumed our regular patrols, so you may rest easy under the watchful eye of the Radiant Host. Be sure to pass along my regards to your Riders!
TEXT_BANARK111_04561_RADIANTHOSTB04561_0: If it isn't ! What brings you out this far?
Warm vittles with ripe amra for dessert! Why, my empty stomach was just serenading me with discontent but moments ago─might you have heard it?
If this aroma is to be believed, I daresay I shall soon become a true fanatic of the Hippo Riders' meal service. My thanks to you!
TEXT_BANARK111_04561_ROOKIESTEWARD04561_: Oh, hello! Have you business with me?
Who would I be to deny such delectable generosity? I humbly accept!

We are by no means yet free of the shadow of misfortune, but it is precisely for this reason that I became a steward. After I have partaken in your kindness, , I shall finish the rest of my rounds with vigor!
TEXT_BANARK111_04561_MARU_000_042: Those temples an' ruins are important parts of our culture, so sendin' out the occasional warm meal to our guardians is the least we can do. Here's a little somethin' for you, too...
TEXT_BANARK112_04562_MARU_000_001: ! Just the  I need. You ain't squeamish, right?
TEXT_BANARK112_04562_MARU_000_002: I've got two sacks of kitchen scrap that need deliverin'. You mind?
TEXT_BANARK112_04562_MARU_000_003: ...Don't look at me like that! One man's chaff is another man's...well, that's his own business, ain't it? Anyway, one goes to an alchemist at the Great Work and the other to a hamsa handler at Palaka's Stand. Quick now, before they drip!
TEXT_BANARK112_04562_AVIDALCHEMIST04562_: ! Just who I desired to meet. And you have something for me?
Yes, yes! What delightful detritus! Dripping with alchemical potential─oozing with medicinal worth!

But never mind that. Allow me to inquire upon you─have you experienced any peculiar bodily phenomena as of late? Embarrassing injuries? Abnormal stretching? Troubling shrinkage? Sleepiness at nighttime or perpetual hunger or acute awareness of the hairs upon your─

Oh, but I have forgotten myself! My apologies, dear ! I only meant to offer some experimental─er, rather, groundbreaking concoctions for your use, should you so desire them. Next time, perhaps! I shan't detain you!
TEXT_BANARK112_04562_YOUNGHANSAKEEPER045: The  from the Hippo Riders! Thank you for making the journey.
You are ever so kind to share your vegetable scraps. Our hamsa love nothing better!

Watching our lovely little hamsa gorge on feed till they're round and soft and ready for slaughter...m-makes your mouth water, doesn't it? <slurp> Methinks a feast is in order...to thank you for your generosity, of course! I'll go sharpen the axe.
Oh, you have other plans? Well, just name the day and we'll break out the spits...
TEXT_BANARK112_04562_MARU_000_020: Thanks for takin' care of that. Don't it feel good knowin' our offal ain't goin' to waste?
TEXT_BANARK112_04562_MARU_000_021: As for that alchemist an' handler...well, they're passionate folk, eh? An' big admirers of yours! ...Did I not mention that?
TEXT_BANARK113_04563_MARU_000_001: ! There's an asvattha growin' over by Pavana's Remorse that I'd like to nip in the bud. Or seed, as it were.
TEXT_BANARK113_04563_MARU_000_002: Normally, we'd send someone to burn it─our jungles have enough of those things wigglin' around as it is.
TEXT_BANARK113_04563_MARU_000_003: Only this time, I hear from the kitchen that one of our cooks wants to use it for...well, just thinkin' about it gives me the creeps. Anyway, could you go 'round an' get it for me?
TEXT_BANARK113_04563_MARU_000_004: Asvattha seeds are naturally coated in poison, so you'll need to douse it with this antidote first. Try an' bring it back in one piece, but don't lose a hand doin' it.
TEXT_BANARK113_04563_SYSTEM_000_020: The fizzling of the antidote subsides, and you successfully extract a round asvattha seed! Svarna's cook should be delighted. Report back to Maru with your find.
TEXT_BANARK113_04563_MARU_000_030: Uuugh! I ain't even gotta ask─you got that seed. Sisters spare me that wretched scent...
TEXT_BANARK113_04563_MARU_000_031: Thanks, I guess. These ain't rare in Vanaspati, but there ain't no gettin' used to 'em...
TEXT_BANARK113_04563_MARU_000_032: But the cook should be pleased─divinities help us all. Supposedly, drainin' the poison an' soakin' the rotten thing in spirits makes for some amazin' liquor.
TEXT_BANARK113_04563_MARU_000_033: Ain't no way I'd ever drink it, but I suppose someone will...
TEXT_BANARK114_04564_MARU_000_001: Havin' fresh food around the place is truly a blessin', but our kitchen's caught the attention of some hanuman langurs─an' the boss wants it sorted now.
TEXT_BANARK114_04564_MARU_000_002: I reckon if we've been reelin' 'em in with the scent of our Hippo Rider Specials, we can use a different sort of smell to drive 'em out...
TEXT_BANARK114_04564_MARU_000_003: Namely, gulal! It ain't toxic, but certain jungle critters can't stand its, er, unique aroma.
TEXT_BANARK114_04564_MARU_000_004: Talk to Vata an' he'll tell you what sort of gulal makes a hanuman langur gag. Oh, an' take a cart while you're at it─we want those langurs to know that our hippos mean business. Stenchy business.
TEXT_BANARK114_04564_VATA_000_010: How's it rollin'? Out to fling pigment at langurs, are we?
TEXT_BANARK114_04564_VATA_100_010: Through proper research and suchlike, I've learned that yellow gulal is most effective for drivin' away hanuman langurs. Or maybe I accidentally hit one when I was throwin' a blessin' for plenty one day, an' haven't stopped laughin' since. Who's to say?
TEXT_BANARK114_04564_VATA_000_011: Just don't forget─you've got a live hippo yoked to your cart, eh? In the immortal words of my mum, “Those who don't hold on, fall off.” Ta-ta!
TEXT_BANARK114_04564_VATA_000_012: The secret to throwin' the perfect arc of gulal? Don't throw yourself with it.
TEXT_BANARK114_04564_SYSTEM_000_020: According to Vata, yellow gulal is best for driving away hanuman langurs. Summon the color wheel to your mind's eye and try again!
TEXT_BANARK114_04564_SYSTEM_000_021: Speak with Vata in Svarna to mount the hippo cart, then throw yellow gulal at hanuman langurs.
TEXT_BANARK114_04564_MARU_000_030: You're yellow up to your elbows! I'll bet the langurs can smell you from malms away.
TEXT_BANARK114_04564_MARU_000_031: Still, somethin' tells me we haven't seen the last of 'em, so I might borrow your throwin' arm again before long...
TEXT_BANARK115_04565_MARU_000_001: You know what a starmite is, right? Those hulkin' bugs? Well, they're on my blacklist now!
TEXT_BANARK115_04565_MARU_000_002: I got chased by one the other day over by the old Hamsa Hatchery. My hippo startled so badly, I thought for sure I was goin' overboard...
TEXT_BANARK115_04565_MARU_000_003: The starmites themselves ain't as dangerous as the fear they instill in our poor hippos, but a hazard's a hazard. Think you could lend us your hand of judgment an' cull the buggers?
TEXT_BANARK115_04565_MARU_000_004: You remember those starmites you squashed? Well...they're bein' avenged.
TEXT_BANARK115_04565_MARU_000_005: It's hard to tell what's more shaken─our sweet hippos' hearts or our cargo. Either way, all that's waitin' for us on those roads is bugs an' sorrow...
TEXT_BANARK115_04565_MARU_000_006: You've gotta help us, . Head back over to the Perfumed Rise an' reunite those starmites with their maker...
TEXT_BANARK115_04565_MARU_000_020: You're a savior, ! We can ride easy now, knowin' there are fewer starmites on the roads...
TEXT_BANARK115_04565_MARU_000_021: Bein' chased is bad enough, but if we were to hit one at any speed, the cart would be wrecked an' the darlin' hippo injured─if not worse.
TEXT_BANARK115_04565_MARU_000_022: Safe ridin's no trivial thing, so I might ask for your help smashin' starmites again sometime. Thanks for always lookin' out for us.
TEXT_BANARK116_04566_MARU_000_001: Look what I've got, ─soap nuts! The folks at Palaka's Stand sent them over, so I made some hippo soap.
TEXT_BANARK116_04566_MARU_000_002: Palaka's Stand sent over more soap nuts, so you know what that means─more hippo soap!
TEXT_BANARK116_04566_MARU_000_003: Our hippos are bathin' down at the Great Work as we speak... You think you could run this to the caretaker for me?
TEXT_BANARK116_04566_SYSTEM_000_009: This hippo is peacefully wading in the clear, clean water.
TEXT_BANARK116_04566_DELIVERER04566_000_: Hallo, ! Come to take a dip?
Oh, you brought soap! That's awfully kind of you. Our hippos love gettin' lathered.
Say, care to give it a try? It isn't hard─just use that soap and start scrubbin'!
Yes, that soap! Don't be shy─lather it on!
TEXT_BANARK116_04566_SYSTEM_000_022: The hippo's eyes crinkle with delight as you lather it up with soap.
TEXT_BANARK116_04566_DELIVERER04566_000_: All soaped up? Now, roll up those sleeves and get to scrubbin'!
Hahaha, that's it! Just look at her─well pleased indeed!
Keepin' our hippos relaxed an' happy is an important part of the job. We aren't Riders without our hippos, after all! Thanks for the soap─tell Maru we'll be along soon.
Doesn't she look like happiness itself? I'll let her enjoy the water a little longer before headin' back.
TEXT_BANARK116_04566_MARU_000_040: Did the hippos like their soap?
TEXT_BANARK116_04566_MARU_000_041: I'm glad... I like usin' soap nuts 'cause they clean real well without irritatin' hippo skin. Hippos sweat differently than we do, so you've gotta be careful not to throw off their natural balance.
TEXT_BANARK116_04566_MARU_000_042: We can always wash up here, but lettin' our hippos relax down at the Great Work does wonders for their mood. An' there ain't no sight sweeter than a happy hippo...
TEXT_BANARK117_04567_MARU_000_001: ... Have you ever gazed into a hippo's big, dark eyes and known in your heart there ain't nothin' cuter in this whole wide world? I sure have...
TEXT_BANARK117_04567_MARU_000_002: Makes me wanna give 'em all their favorite treats─fruit, veggies, alfalfa...
TEXT_BANARK117_04567_MARU_000_003: An' freshwater weeds! Those are so popular among our 'pots, I can never seem to pick enough...
TEXT_BANARK117_04567_MARU_000_004: I feel a freshwater feast comin' on, so could you wrangle us some weeds? You can find 'em sproutin' from the banks of Ksiroda, just east of Yedlihmad. Three bundles would make me─and our sweet hippos─forever grateful!
TEXT_BANARK117_04567_MARU_000_021: And we feast tonight! We used to save these for special occasions since they only grow in southern Thavnair, but I guess movin' down here has its perks.
TEXT_BANARK117_04567_MARU_000_022: Still─the waters of Ksiroda flow from Vanaspati, you know? So in a way, it's like our old home is still takin' care of us. ...That's what I like to think, anyway.
TEXT_BANARK118_04568_MARU_000_000: We've got a runaway on our hands, . A hippo runaway, that is...
TEXT_BANARK118_04568_MARU_000_001: One of our 'pots has a really robust appetite, but recently it's been a little too robust. We've started rationin' him─'cause it ain't good to overfeed─but he didn't take well to that an' ran off in a huff.
TEXT_BANARK118_04568_MARU_000_002: One of our Riders spotted him barrelin' towards the jungle─I think he's frustrated an' angry at all of us, but maybe he'll hear reason if it's comin' from you?
TEXT_BANARK118_04568_MARU_000_003: Take him some feed as a peace offerin'─we've got three kinds you can choose from. Tell him we ain't tryin' to make him suffer, we just wanna make sure he's healthy...
TEXT_BANARK118_04568_SYSTEM_000_007: The hippo inhales the dried grass with alarming speed, then trots away in the direction of Svarna.
TEXT_BANARK118_04568_SYSTEM_000_009: The hippo demolishes the vegetables with rapturous gusto, then skips away in the direction of Svarna.
TEXT_BANARK118_04568_HIPPO04568_000_010: Pohhh? Poh poh, poh poh poh! Poh...
TEXT_BANARK118_04568_SYSTEM_000_011: The hippo masticates Ghasa's formula with a complicated expression of wounded gratitude, before faithfully plodding away in the direction of Svarna.
TEXT_BANARK118_04568_SYSTEM_000_012: You should report back to Maru and see if reconciliation has been achieved.
TEXT_BANARK118_04568_MARU_000_013: You're back! An' right on the tail of our runaway─I knew he'd come around if you explained it.
TEXT_BANARK118_04568_MARU_000_014: Oh, you decided to go with the dried grass blend? I can smell it on your hands...
TEXT_BANARK118_04568_MARU_000_015: Dried grass might not seem like enough food for big critters like hippos, but it's actually got a lot of nutrients an' goes easy on the stomach. Stores well too, so it's a handy sort of feed to have around...
TEXT_BANARK118_04568_MARU_000_016: Oh, you chose the vegetable mix? Your hands smell like tubers...
TEXT_BANARK118_04568_MARU_000_017: Our hippos like the crunch on that one, plus it's got loads of vitamins... We even tried addin' those imported─what're they called? Carrots of happiness? Perks the hippos up every time...
TEXT_BANARK118_04568_MARU_000_018: Oh, you brought him Ghasa's special recipe, didn't you? I'd know that fruity smell anywhere...
TEXT_BANARK118_04568_MARU_000_019: Our man Ghasa, he loves hippos more than anyone I've ever met. He spent ages comin' up with the perfect combination of nutrients and medicinal herbs to fill our hippos' bellies while keepin' 'em refreshed an' healthy...
TEXT_BANARK118_04568_MARU_000_020: Anyroad, all's well that ends well, I guess. Thanks for bein' our mediator─we'll be sure to work out an agreement with our hungry 'pot.
TEXT_BANARK119_04569_MARU_000_000: Our hippos are all sweet softies, but behind those plump, whiskery lips, they're packin' serious tusks that need regular care.
TEXT_BANARK119_04569_MARU_000_001: We like usin' pisaca scales to file 'em down, but pisaca scales have this tendency of comin' attached to pisaca. That's where you come in...
TEXT_BANARK119_04569_MARU_000_002: If you leave this spoiled meat by their stampin' grounds, one's sure to come stampin'. Just make sure it ain't got brittle scales, okay? An old pisaca should have what you're lookin' for...
TEXT_BANARK119_04569_MARU_000_011: Oh, these are perfect! Thanks for your help.
TEXT_BANARK119_04569_MARU_000_012: So far as I know, pisaca scales are the only tool tough enough to handle Thavnairian hippo tusks. Wild hippos scrape theirs against giantsgall, but they can swallow bits of rock doin' that. Upsets their stomachs...
TEXT_BANARK119_04569_MARU_000_013: But thanks to you, Svarna's hippos will have shaved tusks an' healthy bellies! The keystones of hippo health. ...Probably.
TEXT_BANARK120_04570_MARU_000_000: Now that we've got stables and water for the hippos, everythin's in place for them to thrive. 'Course, it falls on us to keep it all maintained so that they can live long and happy lives.
TEXT_BANARK120_04570_MARU_000_001: That's where you an' this knife come in, ─I need you to head over to the grove of great trees west of Purusa an' scrape off some sap from their bark. Hackin' away at three or so should get you enough to keep repairs goin' for some time yet.
TEXT_BANARK120_04570_MARU_000_002: I marked the spot on your map, in case you somehow miss the towerin' boughs. An' remember─that sap's for workin', not eatin'.
TEXT_BANARK120_04570_MARU_000_010: So, how'd it go? Were the trees generous with the juice?
TEXT_BANARK120_04570_MARU_000_011: Thank you kindly, . This'll be a boon in the days ahead.
TEXT_BANARK120_04570_MARU_000_012: When this sap hardens, water bounces off of it like a sword on a shield. I reckon fortifyin' the wadin' pool with it'll keep any troublesome leaks from springin' up. For a time, leastways.
TEXT_BANARK120_04570_MARU_000_013: You have to anticipate problems before they happen, else everythin' will break all at once. I'll keep makin' the rounds, and give you a shout should I need your capable hands again.
TEXT_BANARK121_04571_MARU_000_000: I've been meanin' to ask you this for some time, , but truth be told, I was nervous. Thought it might be too dangerous...
TEXT_BANARK121_04571_MARU_000_001: But then Kancana told me that your adventures've tossed you into the maw of death an' back again. I figure handlin' some explosives is child's play compared to that...right?
TEXT_BANARK121_04571_MARU_000_002: ...Well, you're still here, so I'll take that as a sign of tacit agreement. We need someone to break up the mudstone around Ksiroda an' bring back a piece. The alchemists keep tellin' me this is the best way, but...just mind your fingers, alright?
TEXT_BANARK121_04571_MARU_000_010: There you are─an' with fingers an' toes still attached! I take it that means the alchemists were right after all.
TEXT_BANARK121_04571_MARU_000_011: Good, good─these'll do it. Mixin' mudstone into water makes a paste that keeps the skin safer from sun an' wind than just about anythin'.
TEXT_BANARK121_04571_MARU_000_012: You might not think it to look at 'em, but hippos have a delicate hide. If you don't keep it nice and moist, it'll crack like so much mud on a hot day. We're really in your debt this time.
TEXT_BANARK121_04571_MARU_000_013: Sure, maybe you could've just broken up the stone with a hammer an' chisel...but now I don't gotta worry about someone accidentally settin' those demolishers alight an' blowin' us all into the next life, neither.
TEXT_BANARK122_04572_MARU_000_000: Next up's a bit of huntin'─a task I'm woefully unfit for. You're just the  we need, though.
TEXT_BANARK122_04572_MARU_000_001: Your prey're creatures that make even the hardiest Radiant squirm in terror or...somethin'. I don't rightly know, but I wager the prospect of that kinda foe gets your juices flowin'.
TEXT_BANARK122_04572_MARU_000_002: Make your way, weapon in hand, to the Shroud of the Samgha, and be on the lookout for the odqan that stalk the area. Stalk them in turn, and collect two fragments of their hardened skin. ...That sound good? It does, don't it?
TEXT_BANARK122_04572_MARU_000_010: Welcome back. You're lookin' fierce─I guess the fever of battle still hasn't left you. Hope you didn't slay more odqan than you needed...
TEXT_BANARK122_04572_MARU_000_011: Ah, you've really outdone yourself this time, . After I grind these up to a fine powder, I reckon the spirits we brew from 'em will have people talkin'─and drinkin'─long past hippo bedtime.
TEXT_BANARK122_04572_MARU_000_012: They say an alchemist stumbled upon the recipe after a string of failures─he was tryin' to make an explosive liquid out of the powder, you see, but only got a liquidy liquid. At his wit's end, he decided to drown his sorrows with the tepid mixture.
TEXT_BANARK122_04572_MARU_000_013: Imagine his surprise when the first drop hit his tongue, showin' that what the solution lacked in blastin' power, it made up for in flavor! Wasn't long before his libation spread to every corner of the island and he was hailed as a genius.
TEXT_BANARK122_04572_MARU_000_014: That's the story, anyroad. Believe it or not, the brew disappears almost as fast as we can make it, so I'm sure I'll be askin' for your help again sooner rather than later...
TEXT_BANARK123_04573_MARU_000_000: I've been lookin' for you, . I'm in need of a strong swimmer, and you look like you could keep up with a hippo in the water.
TEXT_BANARK123_04573_MARU_000_001: A friend of mine just came back from Yedlihmad, bearin' a request from Kancana herself...
TEXT_BANARK123_04573_MARU_000_002: The Font of Maya is in sore need of a deep cleanin', and we─which means you─gotta help. Kancana wants the moss gatherin' along the stone walls cleared away.
TEXT_BANARK123_04573_MARU_000_003: An' as you know, I don't like to see anythin' go to waste, so I'm thinkin' I might find a use for the moss. Take these baskets with you and bring back whatever you find growin' under the water's surface.
TEXT_BANARK123_04573_MARU_000_010: You're lookin' as dry as a hippo bakin' under the sun. Did you manage to gather the moss?
TEXT_BANARK123_04573_MARU_000_011: Ah, good─I was worried you'd take one look at them waters and think better of your choices. I'll let Kancana know that the temple should be lookin' a bit more pristine.
TEXT_BANARK123_04573_MARU_000_012: As luck would have it, hippos go mad for this moss. An' it don't hurt that it provides them with all the nutrients a growin' 'pot needs! Well, how about a bite?
TEXT_BANARK123_04573_MARU_000_013: Hahaha! I'm just kiddin'. I know you've got much more refined tastes─maybe you can indulge 'em with this bit of coin? I even know a service that offers fast, fresh grub, delivered right to you...
TEXT_BANARK124_04574_MARU_000_000: Our meyhane setup's been bringin' in folk from all over the island and beyond. It's hard work, but the proprietor couldn't be happier to keep the libations flowin'.
TEXT_BANARK124_04574_MARU_000_001: That bein' said, no paradise is without its faults. We've got more than a few regulars who keep promisin' to pay, yet keep showin' up with empty purses and goin' home with full bellies.
TEXT_BANARK124_04574_MARU_000_002: We keep askin' them to pay up, but it seems our words slip their mind as soon as the liquor slides down their gullet. I was wonderin' if maybe you could help us out with this little problem.
TEXT_BANARK124_04574_MARU_000_003: Three of these delinquents are at this very moment workin' at the Giantsgall Grounds. I think if a fierce-lookin'  like yourself were to doubt their intentions to settle with us, they might think twice before shirkin' their debt again.
TEXT_BANARK124_04574_BUSYMAN04574_000_01: Hey, I'm workin' here! I don't have time for chitchat!
TEXT_BANARK124_04574_SYSTEM_100_010: This man has no interest in conversation, but a healthy dose of doubt might earn his attention.
TEXT_BANARK124_04574_BUSYMAN04574_000_01: Huh? The Hippo Riders sent you? H-Hey now, you don't have to scowl at me like that. I have their money—here, take it.
I should've settled up earlier, but you know how things go...right? I'll make the proper apologies soon enough, so you go and tell them how cooperative I was, eh? ...Please?
TEXT_BANARK124_04574_ONABREAKMAN04574_00: What, you think I'm some kind of thief!? I'll have you know a friend of mine works at the meyhane, and he's been hounding me to no end. Don't worry—if I was going to run, I'd have done it already.
TEXT_BANARK124_04574_SYSTEM_100_013: He doesn't seem too worried about his mounting debt. Perhaps you make him doubt his current financial strategy.
TEXT_BANARK124_04574_ONABREAKMAN04574_00: ...Huh? You're really in a fit of pique, aren't you? I didn't know the meyhane needed funds that badly.
All right, all right, I'll pay what I owe. Don't know what I'd do with my evenings if I couldn't spend them at the meyhane. You go ahead and tell Maru I'll be along with his money within the bell.
TEXT_BANARK124_04574_CHECKINGWOMAN04574_: Excuse me, , but as you can see, I'm quite busy...
TEXT_BANARK124_04574_SYSTEM_100_016: She seems distracted by her work. Make her doubt her priorities.
TEXT_BANARK124_04574_CHECKINGWOMAN04574_: What!? You said I owe how much!? I'm embarrassed to say, but I'm always four sheets to the wind by the time I settle the bill...

Can you take this to the kind people at Svarna? I've even put in a bit extra by way of apology for my...oversight. And while I'll tell them myself when next I see them, for now I'd be grateful if you apologized in my stead.
TEXT_BANARK124_04574_MARU_000_020: I hope there wasn't any trouble. While they can be surly with a few drinks in 'em, they're good-natured in the daylight. Or so I hope.
TEXT_BANARK124_04574_MARU_000_021: Well, well─you're still plenty persuasive, it seems. Truth be told, more'n a few of the quarriers comin' to the meyhane to blow off steam are friends and relatives of the good folks helpin' us out here in Svarna.
TEXT_BANARK124_04574_MARU_000_022: In the interest of maintainin' good relations, I never pestered them overmuch, but now I'm comin' to realize that some just can't help takin' a malm if you give them an ilm.
TEXT_BANARK124_04574_MARU_000_023: I'll have a talk with the proprietor about how we should deal with this problem in the future... I'm thinkin' we'll be needin' a solution sooner rather than later. Thanks for your help today, .
TEXT_BANARK125_04575_MARU_000_001: , there you are. We've need of a stout pair of legs an' a strong back for a delivery, and you came springin' to mind...
TEXT_BANARK125_04575_MARU_000_002: The Radiant Host commissioned a major delivery, an' while the hippos hauled the supplies quick enough, we ain't got enough help off-loadin' them. You up for a bit of exercise?
TEXT_BANARK125_04575_MARU_000_003: You'd be doin' us a huge favor, and make no mistake. If you're keen, talk to the Rider at the Hamsa Hatchery and he'll get you started straightaway.
TEXT_BANARK125_04575_DELIVERER04575_000_: Ah, so you're the help that Maru sent word about, eh? Lucky you—we've just unloaded the carts, and all that's left is to bring them to their destination.
See that great tent over there? Take this crate over to the Radiant Host quartermaster waiting inside and the job'll be done. I'll be right behind you with the rest of the crates.
TEXT_BANARK125_04575_SYSTEM_000_012: Deliver the crate of supplies to the Radiant Host quartermaster awaiting you at the specified location in the tent.
TEXT_BANARK125_04575_SYSTEM_000_013: You will have two minutes to complete the task. Should you fail, return to the starting location and begin anew.
TEXT_BANARK125_04575_DELIVERER04575_000_: Take one of the crates here and deliver it to the Radiant Host in the tent. I'll carry the rest.
TEXT_BANARK125_04575_RADIANTSOLDIER04575: Ah, I take it those are the supplies we requisitioned! Apologies for the bulk─I can tell by the sweat on your brow that carrying them here was no easy feat.
It appears the other Rider will be along soon with the rest of the crates, so you can go ahead and thank Maru for another job well done.
The Rider should be here soon with the rest of the supplies, so let Maru know we appreciate him arranging all of this.
TEXT_BANARK125_04575_DELIVERER04575_000_: You've got what it takes to haul crates with the best of us, I reckon. I can handle the rest, so go and give Maru my regards.
TEXT_BANARK125_04575_RADIANTSOLDIER04575: What's that? Oh, I'm just waiting for the supplies we've ordered. They should be here any moment now...
TEXT_BANARK125_04575_MARU_000_040: I'm guessin' the supplies made it without a hitch? Another job well done─but I ain't never doubted you.
TEXT_BANARK125_04575_MARU_000_041: Havin' folks like the Radiant Host as our regular partners gives our business some legitimacy in Radz-at-Han, but we'd never have made it this far in buildin' relationships without your help. Your contribution's been noted─wrote it down an' everythin'.
TEXT_BANARK126_04576_MARU_000_001: Ah, there you are─an' just when I'd given up hope of findin' you. I've received word of a delivery gone awry near the Great Work, and was dreadin' havin' to go myself...
TEXT_BANARK126_04576_MARU_000_002: This task requires some skill in swimmin', you see, and while I can manage to stay afloat, we Arkasodara ain't much known for our grace in the water. I resigned myself to a few lost crates, but now my prospects are lookin' brighter.
TEXT_BANARK126_04576_MARU_000_003: What do you say? If you don't mind a dip in the waters nearby, head to the Great Work and speak to the Rider there. I reckon he shouldn't be hard to find.
TEXT_BANARK126_04576_DELIVERER04576_000_: Oh divinities, oh no... Oh! Did Maru send you? Please tell me Maru sent you. My crates went flyin' into the water, and the current's gonna drag 'em clear away before long...

I managed to pick up a few that've washed up ashore, but there's three out there that I ain't reachin' unless I up and turn into a hippo myself. If you could haul those back here, we'll be right as rain.

I was sure I'd have to either drown or be struck down by Trna's “disappointed” face...but now that you're here, I can breathe easy. That is, so long as you catch those crates before they're swept away...
Did you find the goods? Those waves are so rough, I hope nothin's damaged...
Oh, thank you, thank you! The delivery was going smoothly as any other till somethin' spooked my hippo─poor dear toppled the cart right over in their excitement.

I was lucky enough not to catch a hoof to the trunk, so I grabbed what I could, but the rest went tumblin' into the waters. I shudder to think what would've happened if I had to brave the sea myself...

Sweet Sisters, I can feel the clammy hands of death clawin' at my lungs just thinkin' about it! I reckon a bit of slow an' steady crate stackin' would do me good just about now, so why don't you go ahead an' tell Maru I won't be long?
Truth be told, the ocean an' I never really got along. Thanks to you, it can stay that way! I'll make sure the shipment is all in place─you go ahead an' tell Maru I'll be completin' my delivery soon.
TEXT_BANARK126_04576_MARU_000_040: Welcome back, . Was the situation as dire as the Rider made it out to be?
TEXT_BANARK126_04576_MARU_000_041: I see... Looks like we're in your debt once again. I can't help but wonder what got into that hippo, though... This all happened 'round about the Great Work, you say?
TEXT_BANARK126_04576_MARU_000_042: Might've been some particularly fragrant concoction brewed by one of the alchemists... Or maybe it was somethin' else entirely. Either way, we'd do well to find out the cause before this happens again...
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_MARU_000_001: One of our Riders sent word about a strange figure harassin' him durin' a delivery in the Shroud of the Samgha. Might be yet another rovin' Gajasura out for “conquest”...or, knowin' him, just shadows playin' tricks on the eye.
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_MARU_000_002: Still, I ain't about to ignore his cry for help, no matter how prone to panickin' he might be. Mind goin' over there and checkin' up on him? If this “figure” is somethin' we should worry about, I trust you'll find the best way to handle it.
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_DELIVERER04577_000_: Oh, it's you! My savior! Please do somethin' about that stranger followin' me!
They keep bangin' on trees and callin' out to the Manusya. I dunno what they want from 'em, but it can't be good! I swear I heard that voice comin' from every direction at once...
They scared me so bad I ran all the way here, an' I ain't keen on goin' back out again. Can't deliver nothin' with those whispers stalkin' my every step.
I'd put my pana on it bein' one of those no-good Gajasura the boss was talkin' about. That means dressin' up as a divinity's the only way to get through to 'em─accordin' to Ogul, anyway.

I crafted a guise just like she said, an' I've been bringin' it everywhere in case someone brave enough to wear it came by. Maybe if you put it on an' tell 'em, “Your god is come,” or somethin' mystical like that, you can get 'em to let me deliver in peace.
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_SYSTEM_100_014: You must continue wearing the Manusya disguise in order to progress.
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_SYSTEM_200_014: You will change back to your normal garments if you move too far away. Look to your map for the garment change's area of effect.
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_SYSTEM_300_014: Speak with the perturbed Rider to restore or prolong the garment change.
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_DELIVERER04577_000_: Looks like the disguise fits you perfectly, eh? If you find that Gajasura, start proclaimin', “Your god is come,” and do whatever it takes to get 'em to stop scarin' me half to death.
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_DELIVERER04577_200_: Ready to play at bein' divine? Well then, put this on!
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_GAJASURA04577_000_0: ...O divine that guide! Heed woeful plea!
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_SYSTEM_000_019: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing the words “Your god is come” to assert your divinity.
