TEXT_BANARK127_04577_SYSTEM_100_019: You must wear the Manusya disguise in order to progress.
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_GAJASURA04577_000_0: O divine Manusya! Here after search for so long! Please...listen to problem. Big problem!
Talk hard. No can make friends. What do?
Advice good! Divine Manusya wise. Thanks to Manusya!
Thank you, O divine! Question awkward, but... All Gajasura in village walk naked, but here Matanga cover bodies... What do?
Manusya wisdom precious indeed! Try advice! Thank you, O divine.
See pretty Au Ra in Palaka village...heart pounding in chest. But Au Ra are hated of Gajasura. Not know what feel...
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_A3_000_001: It's time to forget the hatred you feel toward the Au Ra.
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_A3_000_002: Why not gift her some beautiful flowers?
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_GAJASURA04577_000_0: Oh, the insight of divinities! Will try hard to follow. Thank you!
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_ARKASODARA04577_100: Bless me with your wisdom, divine Manusya! Hear my words!
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_ARKASODARA04577_000: That voice...? You're , aren't you!? What in the world are you doing dressed like that?
Oh, a fellow Arkasodara was frightened by my prayers? My apologies, but I often recite my prayers absent-mindedly while I go about my work gathering herbs.

The alchemists of the Great Work often call out to the island's divine protectors so as to receive their blessing. However, I now realize how passersby may get the wrong impression... I shall be more mindful in the future!
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_DELIVERER04577_000_: Did you find that terrible monster!? Did you!? Please say yes!
Ah, so my life wasn't in danger... Good news, to be sure. Thanks for investigatin' in my stead.
You can tell Maru I'll be deliverin' that shipment just as soon as my heart stops poundin' from the terror of it all.
Looks like I can continue with the delivery... Soon as I get a moment to calm down, that is. Tell Maru I won't be long!
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_MARU_000_050: So, did you find out who our mysterious figure was?
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_MARU_000_051: As I suspected, a whole pile of nothin'. Still, better that than monsters, or worse─more food thieves! We should be givin' thanks to the divinities for their protection.
TEXT_BANARK127_04577_MARU_000_052: An' to you, of course. I'll try to get our mutual friend to stop jumpin' at every sound he hears, but I wouldn't count on it...
TEXT_BANARK128_04578_MARU_000_000: The meyhane has drawn people of all stripes to our little corner of the realm, and for that I'm grateful. That bein' said, the strain on our supplies grows with every new face, and I need your help to stave off an impendin' shortage.
TEXT_BANARK128_04578_MARU_000_001: I'm talkin' about Akyaali crab legs─as popular as they are pointy! Still, the creature that bears 'em should be easy prey for you. I reckon they'll know it, too, so don't be stingy with the bait if you want 'em to come scuttlin'.
TEXT_BANARK128_04578_MARU_000_002: Just to be on the safe side, you'd best set down three of these fish, eh? Space 'em out, too, so as to better your chances. Safe huntin', friend.
TEXT_BANARK128_04578_SYSTEM_000_003: There don't appear to be any hungry crabs in the area.
TEXT_BANARK128_04578_MARU_000_004: Ah, there you are. I hope you had a chance to enjoy the spray of salt water on your face durin' your hunt. Did you get the legs?
TEXT_BANARK128_04578_MARU_000_005: Ah, yes... These are exactly what I was lookin' for. Thank you for bringin' me such fine specimens─we'll feed many a hungry Hippo Rider with these.
TEXT_BANARK128_04578_MARU_000_006: ...An' plenty of visitors besides, no doubt. Not a lot of cooks linin' up to duel those spindly buggers, even if their meat makes for some of the most mouthwaterin' seafood on the island.
TEXT_BANARK128_04578_MARU_000_007: Toss 'em in a curry and their flavor still sings through the spices, or throw 'em in a biryani for some delightful texture. And that's just the beginnin'...
TEXT_BANARK128_04578_MARU_000_008: 'Course, if they ain't fresh, they ain't nearly as tasty, so it may not be long before we're needin' more. Until then!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_002: At long last, we're open for business! And that's not all...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_003: This unit recommends you allow the squeaky life-form to elaborate. Please be advised that this recommendation does not extend to other conversations.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_010: For one thing, we've cleaned the place up since your last visit. That counter is clean enough to eat off of!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_011: We've also recruited additional Omicrons to our cause. They have absolutely naught better to do, and are thus stationed here at all hours.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_012: I fear their lack of customer-service experience may prove an issue, however, so I think it best that our first patrons be similar to the people of Etheirys. You lot have been awfully understanding of our slipups with the moon...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_013: To fulfill that objective, this unit has taken the liberty of ordering the replication of passably intelligent life-forms based on data recovered from the Dead Ends. These life-forms now exist as tangible simulations, much like this unit itself, allowing them to enjoy café services.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_100_013:
If you orient your ocular orbs to my right, you will find Patron-001 and
Patron-002, of the Karellian people...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANA_000_014: Prepare to die, traitor. I shall now obliterate your hideous helm, and your belligerent brain with it!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANA_100_014: Ideological alignment with the Global Community is the only way to restore peace─that, and the utter annihilation of our enemies!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANB_000_015: You would say that, mongrel. You have long since ceased to see beyond the leash around your neck. Or perhaps it's that tasteless headwear that's cutting off oxygen to your brain.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANB_100_015: You and your masters know naught of righteousness. The peace you offer is but apathy─self-determination subjugated to the pull of the yoke. Pray that you at last know freedom in death!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_017: ...As you can see, it's not going as well as we had hoped.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_018: <whirr> The data indicates that while the Karellians prospered materially under the Global Community, the antiestablishment Freedom Fighters fought back against its oppressive social conditions, leading to total annihilation of both civilization and star.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_019: Um...excuse me! It seems like both of you want the same thing─to put an end to this conflict and live happily ever after.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_020: ...Also to murder each other, but that didn't turn out so well for you last time. How about you take a seat and talk this over?
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_021: I suppose this will have to do for the time being.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_022: For, you see, I have something even more important to show you. With me!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_023: Can you see it? Here, at the end of the universe, a new star has been born!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_024: Furthermore, readings confirm that this unidentified star is composed of dynamis.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_026: With the Endsinger gone, Ultima Thule should no longer be doomed to despair. Yet what kind of star─what civilization!─could have arisen out of the dynamis of this place, I shudder to think.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_027: That is precisely why this unit recommends eliminating potential threats immediately. The looming specter of a hostile civilization is not conducive to carrying out current orders to “Live.”
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_028: Have you learned nothing from the Karellians!? We cannot simply go about annihilating everybody who looks at us askance. Besides, it would be a shame to waste any potential resources the star has to offer─it's not as if we're rolling in tea leaves out here.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_031: <whirr> This unit finds the eminently killable life-form's outlook to be intolerably naive.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_032: I'll show you “eminently killable,” you...weird-looking fork!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_035: Ahem. Anyway, I propose that─with your help, ─we first investigate this newborn star. There will be plenty of time for annihilating later, should such measures be called for.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_036: <whirr> If both eminently killable life-forms insist, you may access the research portal from Base Omicron. This unit will accompany you for your own safety.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANA_000_040: Does this place even have a menu?
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANB_000_050: Hmph. Hot beverages are but an opiate to the masses.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_060: Of all these brilliant machine-building machines...why did we get stuck with the rude one?
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_061: Beyond this portal you will find a research area constructed for the purposes of collecting data on the new star. You may proceed─with caution─to the star from there.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_062: Color me impressed! By Stigma-4, that is. It's the one that made all of this. Now, look sharp, Forky!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_070: This unit has already given the order to increase the instruments and materiel available in A-4 Research. Potential enemies will not find Base Omicron unprepared.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_071: Apparently, if we wish hard enough, this will teleport us all the way to the new star. How hard is “hard enough”?
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_079: If Ultima Thule is governed by sentiment...does that mean this huge thing came straight from someone's heart?
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_080: Initializing scan of planet's surface and core...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_081: Environmental scans inconsistent with data from previously recorded planets. No signs of civilization detected. This unit can only assume that the star is entirely new.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_083: <whirr> Emergency alert from the Last Dregs.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_085: <thunk> Ahem. This unit will now transmit directly from Stigma-4.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_STIGMA4_000_086: (-Stigma-4-)Emergency alert: Customers designated “Patron-001” and “Patron-002” resisting delivery of sustenance. Weapons have been drawn. Please advise.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_087: "Resisting“? What in the world did you serve them?
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_STIGMA4_000_088: (-Stigma-4-)As proposed by the flea-ridden manager, staff first attempted to provide patrons with locally rendered carrots. These were rejected as “not food.”
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_STIGMA4_000_089: (-Stigma-4-)Gordhona oil and Omicron grease were also rejected, despite databases indicating that these substances fulfill 95% of the criteria for designation as “food.” Words unsuitable for transmission also issued forth from patrons at this time.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_STIGMA4_000_090: (-Stigma-4-)The torrent of verbal abuse activated the Gordhona guardian's moderation filters, causing it to set weapons systems to “purge.” All remaining units have withdrawn behind available cover.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_STIGMA4_000_091: (-Stigma-4-)Projections indicate a 99.9783% chance of failure should further arbitration be attempted by current staff. Management support requested.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_093: After all, artificial carrots just aren't right! Where's the fresh-and-juicy crunch? Where's the slight aftertaste of dirt!?
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_A2_000_001: Have you ever tried any other food?
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_A2_000_002: This may sound far-fetched, but perhaps they don't like carrots.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_095: I don't know why anyone would bother putting other things in their mouth when there are perfectly good carrots lying about, but very well. I suppose we'll need to concoct some sort of nutritious admixture?
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_096: Data indicates that cultivation prospects in Ultima Thule are abysmal. To manufacture ingredients would require a dedicated production plant.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_097: Given the fate of our aforementioned carrots, that simply will not do. But what of this new star? Could it not be used to cultivate the fresh culinary ingredients we need?
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_098: Ah, I can see it now... Our customers' contentment upon tasting the most delicious and nutritious cuisine they've ever had! The sight should delight me as much as one hundred carrots of happiness, at least.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_100: <whirr> Scanning soil... Acidity, moisture content, and temperature within acceptable parameters.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_101: And it's soft under my paws, as if it's simply begging for cultivation.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_102: Indeed, analysis indicates that 56.2% of cultivars registered to database during prior conflicts with organic civilizations would be suited to this environment.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_104: I suppose, given the nature of this place, it's not unreasonable to believe that residual energies from Meteion's nest could have coalesced into a new star─nor that said star would be as susceptible to emotion as the rest of the dynamis around here.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_105: This theory is excessively convenient, but the data does not contradict it.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_106: Your ability to insult me even when we're in agreement never ceases to amaze. Fortunately for you, I have better things to do than bicker with a bucket of bolts right now.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_107: O magicks of creation, feel the craving deep within my soul, and grant me endless carrots!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_108: ...Perhaps gluttony does not qualify as an emotion.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_109: Bugger... Yet my hopes for the café do, apparently.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_110: Unlike my─however sincere─visions of carrots specifically, that intangible hope for a potential future took form as tillable earth. In which case, perhaps the joy of as-yet-unrealized possibility is the key to success here.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_112: “Elysion”! A joyful land where our hopes may come to rest.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_113: The mythology at work here remains alien to this unit, but the overexcited organism's speculation has merit. Dynamis has been demonstrated to make the impossible possible.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_114: However, the data also shows that it lends itself as easily to ill as to good. If the beings of Ultima Thule succumb to despair once more, the consequences will be dire─this unit does not even need to run the calculations to be sure.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_115: Oh, boil my carrots! I forgot all about the customers. We must attend to them with all haste, lest they warp the nature of the star!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANA_000_120: Euuurgh! This is what I get for breaking bread with the Freedom Fighters. My mouth is so oily...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANB_000_121: Do I look like a Peacekeeper to you!? That metallic taste will haunt me till the day I die...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_124: <whirr> This unit must admit that its projections were insufficient for having failed to anticipate this outcome.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_130: Please, if you would just sit down for a nice, calming cup of tea...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANB_000_131: As if I would fall for your ruse a second time! That “food” you served us made me long for the days of chewing a boot in the trenches.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANA_000_132: Deeply though it pains me, I must agree. That was the least palatable vegetable I have ever eaten, wartime or no. If I die, my blood is on your hands...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_133: Heavens, we can't have that! We wish only to satisfy our customers─to bring them joy so that they may never again fall to despair.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_134: What dishes would bring you joy, if I might ask?
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANB_000_136: Everything we typically eat, from beans to beef, is manufactured according to specifications that I could not begin to guess at─but I would take anything even approaching normal at this point. Perhaps a salad to cleanse the palate of that horrid oil...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANA_000_137: ...As long as there are none of those genetically modified logs in it this time.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_139: I see! Two salads with completely organic ingredients, coming right up!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_141: How soon your paltry grey matter forgets─there is a dearth of produce in this corner of the universe. Even on the new star, seeds will require time to grow.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_140: Oh, but surely  can do something about that!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_142: You are a , are you not? Surely there must be some manner of edible flora around here, inconspicuous though it may be.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_143: And I daresay local ingredients are something of a conversation starter, so that could be the next step toward our patrons resolving their, er...differences. Wouldn't that be lovely?
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_144: You need only relax and wait. We'll serve you a delicious dinner yet!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_147: Reluctantly reviewing natural resource database... <ping> Promising nodes located.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_149: Liverworts growing upon stone formations in the Reah Tahra area show acceptable nutrient composition. Based on recent analysis of customer culinary preferences, you may wish to aim for a high wort-to-rock ratio.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_150: Onions growing in the Reah Tahra area show acceptable nutrient composition. Database indicates they may also provide desired “flavor” to the impending salad.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_151: Flora found in the wellspring of regret has been rated by other organic life-forms as “edible,” and shows acceptable nutrient composition.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_152: You may wish to purchase gold salmon roe from Omicron N-0598 in A-4 Research for this mission and similar endeavors in Ultima Thule. All proceeds go to Omicron enhancement initiatives.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_153: While you do that, we'll see if we can't scrounge up a few more ingredients from our stores.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_154: Though I still cannot imagine why one would prefer other foodstuffs to carrots, I must admit that I find this culinary experimentation rather invigorating!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANA_000_155: Are you planning to feed us those ashen plants over there? Never been fond of ash in my mouth, though I suppose there might be a certain nostalgia to it now...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANB_000_156: I struggle to understand why you have ushered us back into existence in this fashion. The wheel of time does not turn in reverse...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_170: The return of allied life-form  is most welcome. This unit can only hope that the other organic life-forms will now cease their whining.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_171: Quality and quantity of provided ingredients exceed expected parameters.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_172: Yours, maybe. I knew  would go above and beyond! Now to put these greens to the test...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANA_000_175: Needless to say, I fear for my life. But now that you've gone to so much trouble, I suppose we should try it...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANB_000_179: An astoundingly robust spectrum of flavor and texture...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANB_000_180: I was unaware that food could possess such pleasant complexity. Mass-produced dishes pale in comparison!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANA_000_181: Watch your tongue! The Global Community solved world hunger through automation, you know. You lot would have scurvy thrice over without it.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANA_100_182: Still, I must admit that the flavor is unique. Though we replicated a wide variety of cultivars in our factories, just as many were consigned to history. I see now what a loss that was...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANA_100_183: There is an appeal to having the freedom to choose what you eat, is there not? Though I recognize the validity of your “world hunger” argument...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANA_100_184: Perhaps there is room for both perspectives at this table. As this peculiar waiter observed, our haste to elevate one at the expense of others has not served us well in the past.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANA_100_185: Odd words to hear from a Freedom Fighter. But not wrong...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_182: That's the spirit! I'm certain you two have plenty in common, if you're willing to hear each other out.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_183: In the meantime, why not help us with the gardening? Release some of that pent-up energy that has you shouting at each other all of the time.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_184: Think about it─it's honest, nonviolent work. And the more you grow, the more new flavors you can experience!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_185: We have a patch of land on a new star that has your names on it! Well, your patron designations, anyway. What do you say?
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANA_000_186: I cannot claim that I'd be happier on the battlefield. I fought in the name of peace until there was naught left to fight, or to fight for...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANA_000_201: There has to be a better way. Maybe in safeguarding life rather than taking it, I'll find out what that is.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANB_000_187: I hesitate to align my ethos with that of a Global Citizen... Yet it is true that we now have the freedom to choose a better future.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANB_000_188: Very well. I shall put down my arms, and travel a different path this time around.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANA_000_205: Then it's a truce! Let us plant those vegetables!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_206: Oooh, I smell hope! It smells like carrots of happiness, if you were wondering. Perhaps Elysion can smell it too...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_189: Inconclusive and 80% nonsensical. However, possibilities resulting from this unlikely alliance approach the infinite.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_190: I suppose that means we'll have to go and see for ourselves! Come along, patrons.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_203: At the very least, our Karellian friends should be able to cultivate those unusual salad vegetables you found. If they can grow here, they can grow anywhere.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_200: Despite the small yet statistically significant chance of their being greeted by hostiles, the naive life-form has sent Patron-001 and Patron-002 ahead to Elysion. This unit suggests we make haste in confirming what effects, if any, their emotions have wrought on the star.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_SYSTEM_000_207: The Karellians' heartfelt hopes for a peaceful future have taken form as resplendent gardens!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_SYSTEM_000_208: Nevertheless, much of the newborn star remains as unto a blank canvas. What other hopes will the power of dynamis bring to life?
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANB_000_210: As I was considering the myriad possibilities we might sow upon this unmarred land, I was filled with a strange sense of...optimism. Next I knew, there were plants all about!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_KARELEANA_000_211: I don't know where it came from, but I'm glad for the sudden appearance of that agriformer. It's a relic of the days before we fully automated food production, but it will make nurturing the plants much easier.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_212: The Karellians seem to be multiplying... I wonder if these ones were pulled from the mire of despair out there, just like our patrons. In any case, we're going to need more salad!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_213: <whirr> Dynamis-based alterations to the local environment exceed all but the most improbable of projections. Data from prior civilizations indicates that organic customers will be pleased with the vegetation available for consumption.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_214: This unit proposes a temporary retreat to A-4 Research to discuss future salads, and salad-adjacent matters.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_220: Our efforts have borne fruit more strange and beautiful than I could have possibly imagined!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_221: <whirr> All management units are present. This unit will now run multiple cognitive simulations of the Last Dregs' future.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_223: Analysis complete. Simulations suggest that further consultation with reconstructed life-forms and changes to the nature of Elysion will both be beneficial in increasing future customer satisfaction.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_224: Overall, friendly interaction appears key to the success of Last Dregs objectives, which are vital to the ongoing mission to “Live.”
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_225: In other words, if we continue to value our patrons, our café will become an ever-greater source of joy!
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_226: This unit would not make such a fanciful projection, but nevertheless agrees with the general trajectory proposed.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_227: The ongoing assistance of allied life-form  will also be invaluable. Will you continue to act as a management unit?
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_A3_000_002: I swore I'd never go back to retail...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_231: This unit is asking you nicely. Also, it is technically “food service.”
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_100_231: Pretty please, ! I know that with your help, a wonderful future awaits.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_N7000_000_232: In preparation for the next phase of operations, this unit proposes strategically repositioning matrix Stigma-4 to this location, that it may better assist in coordinating planetary and café objectives. Transmission of orders will commence at your signal.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_STIGMA4_000_238: Retrothrusters on cooldown. Initiating matrix installation.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_235:
Speaking of which─we have one more installation to attend to! Hold still,
N-7000...
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_236: Perfect! Now I can tell which Omicron the insults will be coming from. It also signifies your role in this operation quite well, does it not?
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_237: <whirr> Crude...yet effective. This unit will consent to wearing the large-eared life-form's primitive accessory.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_JAMMINGWAY_000_239: Now, my loyal crew─to work! The possibilities are infinite, so there's much to be done.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_SYSTEM_000_240: You have achieved Friendly reputation with the staff and patrons of the Last Dregs.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_SYSTEM_000_241: Omicron society quests are now available from Stigma-4 in A-4 Research.
TEXT_BANOMI001_04601_SYSTEM_000_242: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from Omicron N-0598.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_001: <whirr> This unit is pleased to inform you that culinary ingredient supply has stabilized, and relations with reconstructed Karellians are rated as “friendly.”
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_002: As conditions for proceeding with the next phase of operations are optimal, this unit has taken the liberty of ordering additional customers. Patron-003 and Patron-004 are being transported to the Last Dregs even as we exchange communication signals.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_003: What sort of patrons has Stigma-4 reconstructed for us this time, I wonder? We may as well see for ourselves!
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_010: <whirr> Sensors indicate that Patron-003 and Patron-004 are “around here somewhere.”
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_011: The café has a pleasant ambience about it these days, wouldn't you say, ? The Karellians aren't even shouting at each other!
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_OMI04602_000_013: <whirr> Patrons were seated according to “table with a view” protocol and served in accordance with “salad” protocol, which have produced a satisfaction rate of 124% among customers to date.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_014: Excellent work, unit! 'Tis always better to speak with customers after they've been fed...
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_015: These patrons are of the “Grebuloff” race, known for its metallurgy. Records indicate that this civilization originated amidst the shining blue seas of its home planet, later adapting to life on its landmasses. Thus, the Grebuloff diet includes both fish and plant matter.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_018: Oh dear! Is the salad not to your liking?
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_019: The organic life-forms' preferences confound this unit's logic circuits. Please provide additional data.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_GREBULOFFB_000_021: (-Nostalgic Grebuloff-)Oh, I hope you won't take this personally. It's a perfectly lovely salad, only...
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_GREBULOFFA_000_022: Waaaaaah! I miss home so much... <sniff>
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_023: I see... The salad brings back painful memories. Could we get you something else, perhaps?
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_GREBULOFFA_000_024: All our friends are dead... WAAAAAAH!
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_025: W-Wait! How about a cup of tea?
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_026: What are we going to do!? We made our customers cry. Cry!
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_028: We need to catch them before they can escape through the portal to another Ostrakon. If we can't cheer them up quickly, their woe will plunge this whole place into despair!
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_041: Audio input registers no whimpering in this vicinity. This unit can only conclude that Patron-003 and Patron-004 have utilized the portal to teleport to Base Omicron.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_042: Curse their advanced technological comprehension born of generations of metalworking innovation!
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_043: Fear not, anxiety-prone life-form─the Base Omicron perimeter is perpetually monitored by patrol units. This unit will transmit recorded data of customer service interactions to aid in detection of rogue patrons.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_044: Well then, what are you waiting for!?
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_050: Fugitive identification data has been transmitted to all patrol units. This unit will review Base Omicron security recordings while you gather testimonial evidence.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_051: I suppose we should be thankful that it isn't a rogue Omicron we're after. Needle in a haystack, that would be.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_OMICRON04602A_000_0: <beep> Fugitive “Grebuloff” data downloaded. Initializing pattern-matching sequence...
Sighting confirmed. Last known location: territory between Base Omicron and clouded portal. Target life-forms were deemed “annoying, but non-threatening,” warranting no interaction.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_OMICRON04602B_000_0: <whirr> Anomalous data detected in clouded portal transmission record. Timecode suggests these unregistered life-forms may be the “Grebuloffs” you are looking for.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_060: Camera recordings confirm that Patron-003 ran screaming through Base Omicron, followed closely by Patron-004. Did any patrol units provide additional data?
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_061: Then there is a high probability that the clouded portal was the customers' point of egress...
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_062: How do their little legs run so fast!? Asking for a friend...
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_063: At any rate, that portal leads to Ostrakon Tria. Let us make for the abode of the Ea. At the least, there may be more eyewitnesses.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_EA04602_100_075: Ah, to search for those long lost. I too have known this need...or have I?
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_071: Per this Ea unit, the rogue customers may be somewhere nearby.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_EA04602_000_072: If it is indeed the well-armored beings you speak of, they entered our abode crying for water. Incidentally, their crying produced water as well, which one must assume is why they were carrying on so.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_EA04602_000_073: Regardless, we told them of the wellspring of regret. Perhaps it brings them spiritual comfort, as we once found in our holy places─or perhaps they continue to weep, even now.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_074: ...This unit would not venture to theorize. However, projections do indicate that once the Grebuloffs locate a water source, they will entrench there. Despite their sophistication, their nature subjects them to certain base instincts.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_076: If only they had stayed for tea... They must be awfully dehydrated by now. Come on!
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_EA04602_000_075: If only the Ea retained the capacity to care for other individuals as you do... Alas, even should you obliterate my companion here before my eyes, I would experience only minor inconvenience.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_081: Allied units must remain alert to fluctuations in dynamis. Engaging spatiotemporal monitoring...
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_GREBULOFFB_000_083: Fathomless deep! You followed us all the way out here?
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_084: It is our responsibility as café managers─though we underestimated your determination and lung capacity, I must admit. Do you feel better now that you've seen the water?
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_085: Query: is the imbecilic life-form malfunctioning? This unit lacks many of the traits shared by organic races, but even so, the visual data could not be more conclusive.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_086: I shan't dignify that with a response. But...how do you feel?
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_GREBULOFFB_000_089: Yes, bad! We finally escaped those pointy terrible machines, only to find...this! We can't dive in this miserable little puddle─it's barely suitable for dipping!
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_GREBULOFFB_000_090: I don't want to be in this strange land! I want to go home! But we've lost so much...did we finally lose our ocean, too?
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_094: I'm...not certain I understand. Are oceans truly that superior to lakes? Our seas on the moon don't even have water most of the time...
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_095: Ah, like in Old Sharlayan? Big and blue, with a horizon all its own?
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_097: This unit has never seen such a thing. Omicron protocol is to evaporate significant water sources that may be of use to the enemy before landing.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_098: There are no oceans in Ultima Thule, that's for certain.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_099: Even so, there must be something here that brings back pleasant memories of the sea, rather than depressing ones...
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_100: You would know, ! What's unique about the ocean, aside from all the water?
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_A1_000_001: The beach has a sort of...smell.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_102: In that case...perhaps we can harness the scent you recall to evoke memories of relaxing days at the shore.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_103: This unit acknowledges the potential of this course of action. Comparison of data from the Dead Ends and records on the Ragnarok shows significant similarities between the chemical compositions of the oceans of Etheirys and the Grebuloffs' star.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_104: Sea smell it is! Once  sniffs out a sufficiently ocean-scented ingredient, we'll sprinkle it on a delicious dish to raise our customers' spirits.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_106: Isolating odiferous compounds and querying database...
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_107: <ping> Chemical match found. Salt mined from deposits at approximate coordinates “14, 17, 2” will produce a similar odor to the “sea salt” of your home star.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_108: <ping> Chemical match found. Constituent amino acids of the legumes located at approximate coordinates “13, 14, 2” will be useful in simulating the smell of your oceans. Similar amino acids are present in dragon scales─however, these are not so easily digested.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_109: <ping> Convenient chemical matches found among the life-forms present in the wellspring of regret. This unit assumes your olfactory senses are sufficient to discern which ones.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_110:
May this unit once again suggest the purchase of gold salmon roe from unit
N-0598 in A-4 Research? It is scientifically proven effective in attracting organic life-forms.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_111: Surely we can find some manner of dish to cook with that! Perhaps a soup?
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_112: This unit suggests worrying about that after allied units reconvene at the Last Dregs. In the meanwhile, protocol requires that management gently prod the customers until they regain their faculties.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_120: I do recall a distinct odor near the Last Stand in Old Sharlayan...was that the ocean?
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_GREBULOFFB_000_121: I could go for a spot of dinner after so much sprinting. What do you have in mind?
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_GREBULOFFA_000_122: <sniffle> I'm sorry... You're all─<hic>─so kind... Waaah!
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_123: <whirr> Customer vital signs stabilized. Social acceptability of issuing dinner invitations restored to 100%.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_125: Huzzah! It's time to get cooking!
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_GREBULOFFA_000_126: <sniff> This salty, tangy, vaguely fishy aroma... How bittersweet it is...
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_GREBULOFFB_000_127: Astounding! It tastes just like the tide!
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_GREBULOFFA_000_128: (-Emotional Grebuloff-)An invigorating flavor, as if I've waded in and accidentally swallowed a lungful!
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_GREBULOFFA_000_129: (-Emotional Grebuloff-)...Ah, such fond memories! Even if they do sting a bit.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_GREBULOFFB_000_130: We had many, many a good day, thanks to our beautiful sea.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_GREBULOFFB_000_131: If I could go back to those times, I would treasure the blessings it gave us. I would keep it safe from harm...
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_133: Observational units report rapid changes to Elysion's landscape. All signs point to Grebuloff influence.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_134: Really!? Well, this bears seeing for ourselves!
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_136: This unit fears for the cardiovascular system of the excitable life-form, and recommends not keeping it in suspense any longer.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_135: Hurry, hurry! The Grebuloffs have already gone!
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_SYSTEM_000_115: From their profound love and appreciation, the Grebuloffs' ocean has been reborn! It will make a fine home for myriad aquatic creatures.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_SYSTEM_000_116: There is yet much room for Elysion to grow and change. What other hopes will the power of dynamis bring to life?
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_140: It may be a bit smaller than the real thing, but it certainly smelled like an ocean to me! And did you see the happy looks on the Grebuloffs' helmeted little faces?
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_141: This unit did see, and appreciates allied units' assistance in fulfilling this objective.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_142: We have land, we have sea...one does wonder what could possibly come next. Not to mention what menu items it will inspire!
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_143: ...More importantly, this mission is evolving. Analysis of statements made by the Grebuloffs, as well as their overall demeanor, indicates that their memories originated just prior to their star's ultimate demise.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_144: Once reconstructed, the individuals initially remained in a state of deep despair over what had befallen their world, and its seas in particular.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_000_145: Via Operation: Soup, however, café management restored to them their will to carry on. These events have caused this unit to reevaluate the significance of the current mission. Mission significance and satisfaction with current orders are now rated as “high.”
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_N7000_100_146: <whirr> Yet this unit has unresolved queries. Metaphysically, this unit and other life-forms in Ultima Thule are naught but simulations─memories reconstructed with dynamis. Regardless of our actions, can these “lives” truly be categorized as meaningful?
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_146: ...Not to cut your existential crisis short, bolt head, but do we not have data proving that you're as metaphysically significant as anyone else? Our customers affected the dynamis of Elysion, and that's a fact.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_JAMMINGWAY_000_147: You lot may be a little different, but your feelings─your hopes, your dreams? Those are real. So let's get out there and serve up some smiles, eh? We can't do it without you.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_SYSTEM_000_149: You have achieved Trusted reputation with the staff and patrons of the Last Dregs.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_SYSTEM_000_150: New Omicron society daily quests are now available from Stigma-4 at A-4 Research.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_SYSTEM_000_151: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Stigma-4 as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_SYSTEM_000_152: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Stigma-4. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANOMI002_04602_SYSTEM_000_153: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from Omicron N-0598.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_001: <whirr> Greetings, . This unit commends your fulfillment of objectives relating to the care and feeding of Grebuloff customers. Pescatarian menu items, in particular, have met with high approval ratings.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_002: Current mission is proceeding─as audio records indicate your people would say─“swimmingly, hahaha.”
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_003: We've learned much from the Karellians and Grebuloffs, and the Last Dregs is now the site of joyful cultural exchange. But don't take our word for it─come and see!
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_010: Café status: moderately busy. Waiting times nominal.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_011: We should keep an eye on that one. They've already polished off three bowls of soup today.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_012: Well-fed Grebuloffs provide important mission data. Soup-related sacrifices must be made.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_013: Oho... You like making customers happy! Admit it!
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_100_014: <whirr> This unit merely acknowledges customer satisfaction as more conducive to mission objectives than mutual hostility. Speaking of which, Patron-005 and Patron-006 should be closely monitored...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_014: Try to change the subject on me, will y─ Wait, who are Patron-005 and Patron-006?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_015: Hail, newcome patrons! I, Jammingway, would like to personally welcome you to the Last Dregs. Can you tell me a bit about your home star?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_OMICRON04603_000_01:
Analyzing metaphysical waveform... Nihilism protocols activated.
<beep>... <beep>... <beeeeeep>
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_NIBIRAENOMI_000_018: (-Ominous Figure-)It has shared in our truth and shed the self. This is well. The universe, too, is finite. Only in death may we embrace true infinity...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_019: Did you just assassinate my barista? Why would you do that!?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_020: <whirr> Situational analysis complete. New customers are of the Nibirun civilization. This society eliminated concepts deemed unpleasant by organic life-forms, such as “war” and “death.” In so doing, individuals attained physical immortality and a state of unified comprehension.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_100_020: Their projections were insufficient, however. The Nibirun people only realized that the elimination of strife would similarly destroy their sources of joy when it was too late. At that point, they jointly decided it would be preferable to return to nonexistence.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_021: Pardon this unit for a moment... Halting shutdown processes. Troubleshooter initialized. Repair features and self-determination algorithm restored.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_NIBIRAENOMI_000_022: Why have you returned this being to the finite? The golden mercy of Ra-la was so close at hand...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_023: Sweet Mother, this is terrifying! Cultural exchange be damned─we can't let them near the other patrons.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_024: On the contrary─this unit believes that exposure to other civilizations may benefit these customers, and invites them to tour the local simulations of dead worlds.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_NIBIRAENOMI_000_025: To be certain, the nature of other civilizations is a long-held curiosity of ours. It may be...interesting to discuss their inherent futility.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_026: That is “the spirit”! All societies in Ultima Thule are subject to unique manifestations of despair, so this unit recommends comparing each to the tragic perfection of the Nibirun.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_NIBIRAENOMI_000_027: We are in favor. To arrive at philosophical resonance with such beings will fill much time before blessed obliteration...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_A1_000_002: I hope you have a plan to prevent this place from falling to despair.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_029: You have already demonstrated to the peoples of Ultima Thule that despair can be overcome. Projections indicate that, once restored, hope is not so easily extinguished.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_030: Hmm... So you think they'll be able to help each other, like you saved M-104 just now?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_100_030: I suppose I should be glad that they took you up on it. Those Nibirun make my fur stand on end! I don't want them anywhere near Elysion...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_031: It would be nice if we could cure them of their ennui, of course, but I cannot see how.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_032: <whirr> The Nibirun are the last dead civilization with sufficient data for replication. Should it prove impossible to turn them into satisfied customers, the probability of further developments on Elysion is low.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_033: Oooh, that is frustrating. Why must they be so much scarier than the other two? I retract my complaints about our soup budget.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_034: Well, what if we invite patrons from another civilization instead? The Ea, for instance.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_100_034: There is no reason we have to build all of our own customers, and they seem rather thoughtful. At the very least, it would make good practice in philosophical debate.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_035: This unit cannot guarantee that any amount of practice would prepare you to treat with the Nibirun. However, it agrees that inviting local life-forms to the Last Dregs would be good for business.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_038: I probably should have asked beforehand, but do the Ea have mouths? That seems a rather important detail in this context...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_039: Current objective: convince prospective Ea patrons of the desirability of Last Dregs sustenance.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_100_039: We'll search for potential customers in this vicinity. Can you ask around at the scary stone circle where everyone stares at the sky? Thanks in advance!
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_040: Searching for key promotional features... <clunk> This unit regrets not installing marketing modules.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_041: Come now─good food, new friends, and a hopeful ambience are obviously our selling points!
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_042: The corporeal beings derive meaning from patronizing this “café,” you say? Felicitations.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_043: Personally, I have long since parted from such material concerns in favor of staring contemplatively into the abyss. To begin chasing hopes and dreams now would be to betray my very principles.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_100_043: If it is any comfort in your frivolous pursuits, know that I, too, likely once sought meaning─though I can no longer recall such a time. Now, if you will excuse me, there is much staring to be done.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIB_000_044: A venue for replenishment and discourse, you say? We once visited similar establishments. They are memorialized today through the existence of our “restaurant,” where we traditionalists gather to restore our aether and vent our petty miseries upon one another.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIB_000_045: Your civilization is young, so perhaps you do not yet understand that one such location is more than enough. Even the most transcendent minds can only withstand so much vacuous discourse...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIB_100_045: Further details of our restaurant's historical counterparts have been lost to the inexorable flow of time, so they cannot have been terribly important.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_050: Ugh... Must they all be so condescending?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_052: One would think they could at least show a bit of respect to you, of all people! Out of self-preservation, if naught else...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_053: <whirr> The probability of further developments on Elysion is now infinitesimal.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_054: No─I refuse to give up. Their terrible attitudes are all the more reason to make them see the light!
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_055: Between the three of us, we will get them to enjoy themselves!
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_056: ...Implicit threat acknowledged. Initializing joint operation protocols.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_100_057: However, this unit also must acknowledge the non-zero probability of failure. In such a scenario, the odds of ever securing the patronage of the Ea and Nibirun must be revised to “hopeless.” Projections indicate that the business may not survive this outcome.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_057: You're as bad as they are sometimes, do you know that?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_058: , you mentioned that the Ea once offered you food, did you not?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_059: So they don't consider themselves beyond the concept of repast. There must be a way to build on that to make them understand...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_071: This unit will attempt to analyze Ea thought patterns for vulnerabilities.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_NIBIRAENOMI_000_072: Indeed, why seek more than these malformed stelae? To those approaching the infinite, such an abode is enough.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_073: You interrupt my staring once again. Curious. Is this a physical compulsion?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_074: Er, no. We're simply seeking an enlightened opinion. You seem very...focused, so surely none would be better suited to answer a few questions.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_075: ...I suppose that would be within the bounds of my principles─and as time is inherently meaningless, you will not cost me what might otherwise have mattered. Pray wait a moment, and I will see if other rationally minded individuals are interested in this diversion.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_076: Huzzah! I leave the debating to you, ─see if you can stimulate their inquiring minds enough to draw them to the café!
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_SYSTEM_000_077: Objective: Choose the appropriate phrases to generate interest in the Last Dregs.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_SYSTEM_000_078: As the resulting pontification may take several minutes, you may wish to cancel any pending Duty Finder registrations.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_079: Truly, there is naught like a rousing examination to take one's mind off the ceaseless torment of existence. Should we start with three hundred fifty thousand, one hundred and seventy-three questions or so? As is customary.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_080: Three hundred and fifty thousand!? I was thinking more in the neighborhood of three...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_081: ...I see that in my cognitive agitation, I neglected to account for your base intellects. Carry on with your paltry queries, then.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_A3_000_001: Do you enjoy a good meal?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_A3_000_002: Do you have an interest in gustatory sensations?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_083: Quite. Many traditionalists consume sustenance, and I partake in the occasional absorption of quality aether at the restaurant myself.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIB_000_084: A transparent line of inquiry. We have little need of another restaurant─I told you as much already.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_085: Oh dear... I fear you misunderstand what we mean by the term! The food at the Last Dregs offers an entirely different experience than aetherial absorption, I assure you.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_086: This unit fears the question may have been excessively simplistic. Data on the Ea indicates a clear preference for mental stimulation via theoretical concepts.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_087: We long ago abandoned the pursuit of gustatory sensations. Though we yet consume aether to sustain ourselves, we do not experience any particular sensation beyond the satiation of hunger.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIB_000_088: That is perfectly sufficient. Though I am curious─you indicated that many beings gather to consume sustenance at your “café.” Do these beings experience gustatory sensations in unison? Does this not confuse and upset them?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_089: Quite the opposite! Taste is key to customer satisfaction─and our customers are very satisfied, I assure you.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_100_090: <whirr> Curiosity detected. This unit concludes that your question piqued their interest.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_100_091: The diminutive being suggests that gustatory sensations are a primary consideration for your establishment. Biologically, however, these are naught more than a secondary mechanism to prevent primitive organisms from starving to death. Explain this contradiction.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_A4_000_001: Biology is not the only determinant of a good life, you know.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_A4_000_002: Perhaps to truly comprehend our argument requires tasting for yourselves...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_100_093: Is it your contention that regardless of their evolutionary purpose, gustatory sensations provide intangible─perhaps psychological or spiritual─benefits? Intriguing...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIB_100_094: ...But ultimately unconvincing, if your aim remains to entice us to your “café.” The perception of sustenance is necessarily determined by the nature of one's gustatory and olfactory organs, so to assume that all beings would experience the same positive outcomes is preposterous.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_100_096: Intellectual stimulation is present, but curiosity levels are not yet critical. This unit proposes additional discourse.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_100_097: ...Perhaps. It is conceivable that, having dispensed with our corporeal vessels, a prolonged absence of sensations experienced by way of the nervous system has limited our imaginations to a degree.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIB_100_098: If only we had possessed the forethought to record our gustatory perceptions for posterity... An unfortunate oversight, to be certain.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_100_099: Yet not an insurmountable one! If you were to visit the Last Dregs, we could help you reclaim some of the knowledge that was lost.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_100_100: <whirr> Enticement detected... This unit proposes following this conversational trajectory to its natural terminus.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_101: Though I acknowledge that there is some logic to your argument, we are perhaps at an impasse, given our forms' lack of physicality. Nevertheless, I am curious to know what manner of “taste” you would present us with, had we gustatory organs.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_A5_000_001: The best taste in all of Ultima Thule─nay, the universe!
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_A5_000_002: A taste of your former lives as corporeal beings, perhaps.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_100_103: A disappointing─though unsurprising─suggestion. Perhaps your intellect simply lacks the capacity to understand that physical perceptions are subjective and therefore fallible...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIB_100_104: Even allowing for the possibility of a “best taste” regardless of culture and individual gustatory perception, I am unconvinced of the benefit of this knowledge. If we longed for ultimately meaningless physical experiences, we would not have done away with our corporeal forms.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_100_105: But you do acknowledge the existence of meaningful experiences. What do you long for, then?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_100_106: Based on past data, this unit suggests that altering the menu to suit the civilization in question would be prudent.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_100_107: Indeed, it is rational to assume that as corporeal beings with unique gustatory organs, we too once found certain sensations particularly stimulating.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIB_100_108: If your “café” is capable of providing knowledge of such long-lost sensations, we would welcome the experience.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_100_109: If anyone can do it, we can! We've served a variety of civilizations already─with great success, I might add.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_100_110: <whirr> Operational success imminent. Allied units must remain engaging for critical final phase.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_111: The preparation of historically accurate sustenance will be no simple task, yet the hirsute being insists on accomplishing it. Is this compulsion intrinsically or extrinsically motivated?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_A6_000_001: My journal does suggest that making you happy will help progress my current quest...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_A6_000_002: It is our deepest and most heartfelt desire to see hope restored to the universe.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_113: ...And increases in customer satisfaction lead to positive changes in the nearby dynamis? How...mathematically sound.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIB_000_114: I see now that this was all a game to you. That is fair enough, given my own reasons for participation...yet this behavior is quite unlike the primitive organic beings of our records. I grow increasingly uncertain of your ability to fulfill our desires.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_115: Our wish to recreate the Ea's favorite flavors is extremely organic, I swear! Primitive, even!
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_116: Though the Ea delight in logical argument, acknowledgement of their place as gears in an unfeeling machine of progress has distressed them. Analysis indicates their expectations of allied units have been dampened by this display of cold rationality.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_117: How very primitive of you! Very well, I am convinced that your establishment will offer an authentic experience of the shackles of the flesh.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIB_000_118: “Heartfelt,” it says! How charmingly irrational. Nary a mention of the tangible impact our hope would have on the surrounding dynamis.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_119: There are those too, of course─but most of all, what we want is for our patrons to enjoy themselves!
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_120: <whirr> This unit does not disagree with the assessment of organic life-forms as “primitive,” though it is rich in irony given the irrationality on display at present.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_121: In any case, mission objective complete. Allied units' performance will be logged as “optimal.”
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_122: In any case, mission objective complete. Allied units' performance will be logged as “capable.”
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_123: In any case, mission objective complete. Allied units' performance will be logged as “mostly acceptable.”
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_124: ...We see that you indeed had few questions. When may we partake in sensory experiences?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_125: Well, first we will need to prepare a full course for gustatory experimentation...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIB_000_127: Experimentation, you say! That sounds most agreeable.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_128: If this unit may suggest it, 's flesh would make a suitable medium.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_129: Oh, I quite agree. No one has tasted more tastes than the intrepid .
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_130: palate is refined, and  bravery unmatched!
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_131: will be the perfect candidate to try any and all dishes we prepare. Then you need only scan and transmit the sensory perception data to the Ea's consciousnesses.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_132: It is unclear, at present, what their people may have eaten in their corporeal days, but we can begin by finding out what sort of tastes they enjoy, then refine the recipe from there.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_133: Regardless, we shall need to fire up the ovens immediately! Last I checked our inventory, the kitchens are well stocked with vegetables, fish, and Sharlayan cookbooks...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_134: The probability that the Ea's historical diet was identical to that of the life-forms of Etheirys is astronomically low. This unit proposes incorporating ingredients from other worlds as well.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_136: <ping> Calcite deposits near the ship Ragnarok may contain mineral content suitable for use as an additive. Data indicates that organic life-forms love additives.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_137: <ping> Flora near the vitrified fort may contain content suitable for use as “seasoning.” Data indicates that organic life-forms love seasonings.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_138: <ping> An aquatic life-form similar to Etheirys's tuna can be found in this very settlement. Data indicates that this creature is particularly pungent and may be useful in stocks.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_139: This unit once again recommends the highly affordable gold salmon roe available in A-4 Research as materiel for this operation.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_140: Don't hesitate to taste test in the field!
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_142: Remaining allied units should proceed to the Last Dregs for recipe analysis. This unit will answer any further customer questions.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_150: Don't worry─I'm certain that N-7000 would speak up if you were about to eat anything that might be lethal.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_151: Gustatory perception...how exciting! Are these beings seated in anticipation of the sensations overwhelming their fragile nervous systems?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIB_000_152: To think that we can finally reclaim the sensations of our fleshy past...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_153: <whirr> The Ea have thus far asked 81,120 questions. This unit can feel the last remnant of its patience slipping...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_154: A timely rescue. Chemical composition of ingredients within expected parameters.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_156: Not half bad, if I do say so myself. Dig in, !
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_157: Initializing progressive scan of gustatory inputs...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_SYSTEM_000_159: The pasta is not unlike that of Etheirys, although the otherworldly flavor adds a tang of complexity. As for the Ea...surely any gluten-tolerant life-form enjoys a massive bowl of carbohydrates?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_SYSTEM_000_160: You are struck with a sudden certainty that Jammingway either borrowed or stole this recipe from the Last Stand, although the locally sourced flavoring adds an unexpected spiciness to the medium-rare meat inside. Your tongue is now tingly.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_SYSTEM_000_161: Was that fish staring into your soul just now? Hopefully not. In any case, its pallid flesh must have thoroughly absorbed the added alien flavor. You certainly tasted...something.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_162: Gustatory data received. Transmitting to Patron-007 and Patron-008...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_163: So these are the “flavors” of which you speak...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_164: Thank you for helpfully categorizing each as “sweet,” “salty,” “sour,” “bitter,” or “savory”─I fear I am quite overcome by the medley.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_165: It is impossible to say whether this sensory assault is identical to what I might have once felt when consuming sustenance...yet it is a useful reference to ruminate upon nevertheless.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_166: Then it was well worth the effort, in my book!
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_167: Tell me, did any of the dishes strike you as particularly enjoyable?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIB_000_168: The first stimulated me in a most pleasing fashion. How was this flavor derived?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_169: Ah, that was flavored with local ingredients harvested by , garnished with powdered miracle shrimp─a type of crustacean the Grebuloffs are farming in Elysion.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIB_000_170: Pulverized crustaceans! The nature of gustatory sensations is inscrutable indeed...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_171: That we found these ones pleasing perhaps indicates that we, too, once consumed mutilated decapods.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_172: I cannot imagine why we would have left that behind. I am grateful to have even simulated the experience.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_173: ...And there we have it. Do you think this will be enough to bring about more changes to Elysion?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_174: Inconclusive. This unit proposes that allied units ascend to scan for signs of change.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_176: I'm quite curious about what changes to the terrain might come of the Ea's emotions. As a people, they do tend toward the abstract...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_175: Stigma-4 confirms that alterations have occurred. Let us proceed with the scan.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_090: These creatures certainly weren't here before...but what are they? They put me in mind of Etheirys's jellyfish.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_091: <whirr> No results found in database. Furthermore, these life-forms differ from the simulations in Ultima Thule on a molecular level.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_092: You mean...a new species has been born? Here?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_093: Is it so illogical? Elysion's climate is suitable for the growth of complex vegetation, and a significant portion of its surface is occupied by sea. Many life-forms have arisen from similar environments.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_094: This unit would venture that under these conditions, the Ea's yearning for a corporeal past were sufficient to cause dynamis to coalesce as organic life.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_097: ...And such very adorable life you are! Yes, you are!
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_098: Like unto newborn babes...or so I assume. Eons have passed since we Ea have held a child.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIB_000_099: Yet is it not conceivable that some part of us remembers? If these creatures arose from our fondness for the past...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIA_000_100: ...They may indeed be the nascent forms mentioned in our ancient records.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_101: I do see a certain resemblance. Would you like to give these little ones a name, then?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIB_100_102: We lost the meaning to our names long ago, leaving us only the simple phonemic system we now employ for individuals. The suggestion that we might impart the significance of these children via nomenclature is depressingly ludicrous.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_EAOMIB_100_103: ...Nevertheless, we shall call them “Miw Miisv.” A peculiar name to share, perhaps, but one we may find the meaning in together.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_100_104: I cannot spell that to save my life, but it sounds lovely!
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_BANOMIA_000_102: I should like to remain with the Miw Miisv for a time. They doubtless know much of gustatory sensation and other such facets of corporeality.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_BANOMIA_000_103: In serving as their guardians, we may yet reclaim some of what was lost...
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_SYSTEM_000_104: New life has arisen from the Ea's longing. Nurture and protect the Miw Miisv, for they have much to share.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_SYSTEM_000_105: There is yet room for Elysion to grow and change. What other hopes will the power of dynamis bring to life?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_200: It will be a great deal more difficult to focus with those creatures about... They're so wibbly-wobbly!
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_201: <whirr> This unit requests you contain yourself. Energy levels are already low due to patrons' ceaseless querying.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_204: However, this unit does admit to curiosity regarding the new life-forms.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_205: Though it is probable that the Miw Miisv share data with the Ea's genetic memory, possibilities for their development are infinite. This differentiates them from other dynamis-based life-forms.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_JAMMINGWAY_000_206: Or maybe they're just one more indication that you lot aren't doomed after all. This place was built for endings, it's true, but we have seen many a beginning. Let's keep that trend going, shall we?
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_N7000_000_207: Affirmative. Our mission remains one constant among many variables.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_SYSTEM_100_110: You have achieved Respected reputation with the staff and patrons of the Last Dregs.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_SYSTEM_100_111: New Omicron society daily quests are now available from Stigma-4 at A-4 Research.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_SYSTEM_100_112: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Stigma-4 as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_SYSTEM_100_113: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Stigma-4. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANOMI003_04603_SYSTEM_100_114: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from Omicron N-0598.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_001: <whirr> Miw Miisv status: thriving. According to recent scans, the Ea also emit pleased vibrations.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_002: They aren't the only ones! Members of quite a few civilizations have been enjoying watching the Miw Miisv frolic, and customer satisfaction has risen accordingly.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_003: On that note─it is just about time for our regular rounds at the café. Care to join?
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_010: Café status: bustling. Installation of additional seating recommended.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_011: As you can see, the Last Dregs is now patronized by entities of all ages─and we have expanded our beverage range to accommodate both the young and the very, very old accordingly.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_012: Now that the Miw Miisv and the Ea have settled in, the timing to introduce new patrons is optimal.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_013: As a matter of fact, I was just thinking the same!
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_014: We've had such good luck with the Ea, it only seems natural that we invite the dragons next. They too are residents of Ultima Thule, after all.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_015: <whirr> Shall this unit scan your cranial cavern for irregularities? We Omicrons are the dragons' mortal enemies─they would not willingly break bread or any other substance with us. Projections indicate they may be traumatized by the very suggestion.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_016: Are you worried about them? How endearing!
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_017: Yet if Ultima Thule is to move forward, its people cannot remain mired in the conflicts of the past. It would befoul the dynamis, for one thing, and bugger up our hard work. You must learn to live in harmony!
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_018: <whirr> Acknowledged...but this unit will excuse itself from promotional efforts. The probability of the Dragonstar's life-forms reacting adversely to Omicron presence in their territory exceeds acceptable parameters.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_019: Parameters, shmarameters. It may be risky, but if the dragons are to believe that the Omicrons have turned over a new leaf, I can think of no better ambassador.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_020: You may not be able to rewind time and un-conquer the Dragonstar, but you can certainly strive to do better in the future we're creating. Dynamis makes the impossible possible─you said so yourself!
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_021: ...Encouragement tentatively internalized. This unit will attempt to serve as an ambassador for peace.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_022: Then it is off to Reah Tahra we go!
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_030: Good perpetual evening, good sir, madam, or other! Can I interest you in a hot cup of coffee?
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_NIBIRAENOMI_000_031: The mournful dirge that echoes through this place is pleasing to the ear. Why do some of these individuals still rage against their fate?
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_032: This unit has detected an additional hurdle to fulfilling the current objective.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_033: Excuse me! Can I interest you in, er...anything? Anything at all!?
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_034: Hello!? Ignoring me won't make me go away!
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_035: ...I wondered how a tuft of floss did come to clamor so, but 'tis no more than one of thy strange companions. This explaineth much.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_036: Wilt thou not leave me to my slumber? So long have I been weary...
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_037: We have just the thing for that─coffee! Delectable cuisine, as well. Why not stop by the Last Dregs and see what the civilizations of Ultima Thule are raving about?
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_038: I realize that you may have complicated feelings about my Omicron friend here, but we would nevertheless offer you a place to eat, drink, and be merry!
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_039: Art thou attempting to provoke me...? Though I suppose it matters not.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_040: Neither grief nor hate stir within me, for my flame hath long since flickered and died.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_041: <whirr> The news that you do not wish to inflict vengeful obliteration upon the Alphatron Star should be welcome. However, this unit finds it unexpectedly difficult to process.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_042: Are you certain you do not desire revenge? Not even a micron? It may be advisable to gnaw on this unit in the name of experimentation, lest your conclusion be premature.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_043: To what end? The destruction of a single machine changeth naught─meaneth naught.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_044: Aye, we dragons once reveled as thou wouldst have me do. In the mountain's shadow did we gather to sing. Yet even our melodies are naught but memory now...
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_045: If I no longer weep for the silence, machine, why dost thou believe I have aught to spare for thee?
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_046: <whirr> Conversational difficulty levels critical. This unit requests permission to retreat.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_047: Not so fast! The Karellians' apocalyptic aggression didn't stop us, and neither will this dragon's depression.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_048: All of our patrons have needed a little help in learning to hope again. It's just a matter of discerning what they value and how to provide it.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_049: Fortunately, we have the great  at our side! I've heard tell that you have no little experience treating with dragons.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_050: And though the dragons here may not recall their passions, if the Dragonsong War is any indication, their brethren on Etheirys possess no such problem.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_051: Surely there is at least one dragon of your acquaintance with whom we can consult?
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_A1_000_001: Vrtra will explain in terms we can understand.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_A1_000_002: Vidofnir is wise, and has been kind to me.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_100_053: Vrtra!? Satrap of Radz-at-Han? Oh, no, I wouldn't dream of calling him away from his work for this.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_053: Vidofnir it is, then. As a leader of her people and an arbiter of peace, she must have some advice about disagreeable dragons.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_054: And she doesn't sound like the sort to let her elders on the Dragonstar wallow for eternity.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_055: Etheirys's historical records are not registered to this unit's database, but the proposed course sounds logical as described.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_100_056: It is statistically probable that they will not welcome assistance from a former enemy...but this unit believes that we must restore hope to dragonkind.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_057: Then it's decided. Do we need to pack chassis wax or anything?
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_058: This unit must remain in Ultima Thule to ensure the smooth operation of the Last Dregs while allied life-forms are away. However, a portable communications drone can be dispatched for the journey.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_059: How convenient! Let us make for Anyx Trine posthaste!
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_060: Would that I could recall the feel of the mountain breeze...but even that lieth beyond my power now.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_061: Communications network fully operational. This unit will ensure that customer experience remains optimal in your absence, and wishes you a pleasant traversal of space.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_VIDOFNIR_000_070: Dost thou ever rest, Little One? Thou hast brought salvation to the star, yet thy countenance bespeaks a mission.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_VIDOFNIR_000_071: The will of the star hath blessed thee with charming companions.
