TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_VIDOFNIR_000_072: Yet to think I should meet one of the “machines” that drove my grandsire from the Dragonstar... 'Tis like unto a bedtime fable.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_VIDOFNIR_100_072: Fear not, for I shall not rebuke thee. Thou wouldst not be the first to call an old foe “friend”...
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_VIDOFNIR_000_073: 'Tis the fate of the dragons that concerneth me. To condemn them to an empty existence forevermore would be cruel indeed.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_074: This unit did not expect to find you so...pleasant? Alive? It is difficult to locate the proper lexical data.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_075: Jammingway shared much data about the dragons of Etheirys during the journey, but this unit struggles to process that those who embrace an ageless existence upon this star are of the same species as the life-forms we encountered in Ultima Thule.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_076: Your dragons too faced countless battles and great suffering, yet they emerged whole. This unit wonders how much can be attributed to faith in their allied units, and how much to the resilience of their hope─or if these two variables are one and the same.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_077: ...Which brings us back to our purpose here. Is there anything we can say to the dragons of Ultima Thule that might open their hearts to embrace hope once more?
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_VIDOFNIR_000_078: My sire, Hraesvelgr, oft spoke of Midgardsormr's tales of the Dragonstar, for from these memories was our Sohm Al born.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_VIDOFNIR_000_079: 'Tis mine understanding that the Dragonstar possessed a sacred peak resplendent, and 'twas my grandsire's longing for its heights that drew him to nest upon Etheirys.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_VIDOFNIR_100_079: Mine ancestors doubtless felt its loss as keenly, yet their despair hath given way to exhaustion. The memory 'tis but a dull ache in their hearts.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_VIDOFNIR_000_080: Restore to them memory untainted by bitterness, and they may yet be inspired as my grandsire once was. Words, however, shall not suffice.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_081: If not words, what about taste? We've managed to evoke joyful recollections via soup before─surely we can do the same for the dragons.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_082: Previous customer data supports this hypothesis.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_083: However, dragons do not possess a culinary tradition as such. As with the Grebuloffs, we must think outside standard parameters.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_084: Oh, I believe I have precisely what we need.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_085: Among the recipes provided to us by our Sharlayan collaborators is one from Ishgard─a dessert resembling Sohm Al! If that's not outside standard parameters, I don't know what is.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_VIDOFNIR_000_086: A curious proposal, but thou art welcome to attempt it.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_VIDOFNIR_000_087: Southwest of Anyx Trine lie lustrous minerals, their sheen not unlike those of the Dragonstar's peaks. Collect them with my blessing.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_VIDOFNIR_000_088: My grandsire once spoke of the pale blossoms northeast of Anyx Trine as like unto those of the Dragonstar's valleys. Collect them with my blessing.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_VIDOFNIR_000_089: My grandsire once spoke of an iridescent fish in the Iron Feast, its scales a shade identical to the Dragonstar's holy peak.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_VIDOFNIR_000_090: Collect one with my blessing─I am told they subsist upon roe.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_100_091: This unit reminds you that all proceeds from gold salmon roe─available perpetually in A-4 Research─will be directed toward Omicron enhancement initiatives.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_091: It sounds like we shall be gazing upon a resplendent─and edible─peak in no time!
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_092: This unit requests that you return to the Last Dregs before initiating baking protocols. The utility of this drone's tiny digits is limited.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_VIDOFNIR_000_095: Thou art truly a warrior of warriors, yet much else besides...
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_100: We do strive to make our dishes visually appealing, but this will be our greatest challenge yet! I do hope the dragons appreciate it...
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_101: Drone battery low. This unit has returned it to the charging station despite Jammingway's protests.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_102: Ingredients consistent with Dragonstar environmental records. Please initiate baking protocols.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_103: Consider them initiated. Dessert is go!
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_104: Remember, machine─'tis only at the purported request of my kin across the expanse that I humor thee. Do not test my patience overlong.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_105: We wouldn't dream of it! Now, if you'll come this way...
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_106: ...Thy tiny hands wrought this for my sake?
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_107: Yes! 's less-tiny hands and N-7000's spinny whatsits also helped. We worked hard to make it as much like the holy peak of the Dragonstar as possible.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_108: Do you... Do you like it?
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_110: ...'Tis difficult to say. My palate recalleth not what flavors once appealed. Visually, however...
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_111: I see it. The peaks dividing the Dragonstar in twain, bright clouds to shroud them...
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_112: I feel the wind upon my scales, and I...remember.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_113: A passing strange place, this... Yet for the newfound bond with my distant kin, and these memories gifted unto me, I am grateful.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_114: The gesture hath touched me─of that, be certain.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_A2_000_001: Do you feel a bit better now?
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_A2_000_002: It's all right to miss home. Everyone does, sometimes.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_115: Indeed. How beautiful it was, our Dragonstar. How joyfully its winds did brace our wings...
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_116: I should like my kin to remember those days. No longer to mourn them, but dream of them once more...
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_117: This unit is pleased to hear of your spiritual revival.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_118: However, it would be remiss of this unit not to remind you that our establishment employs a large Omicron staff. Your kin would be most welcome to join you, but would this not be intolerable to them?
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_119: Metal warrior... Thou art not the same as thou once were. No more are we. I know not what to make of this future, but I would linger no longer in the past.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_120: That is why you created this place, is it not?
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_121: <whirr> Logic circuits: complete. Threat level: nominal. Business status: booming.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_122: However, this unit is experiencing an anomalous overflow. Conditions mathematically insufficient to generate current levels of mission satisfaction. Further analysis required. Initializing additional processors...
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_123: Are you sure you aren't just...happy? You know, like a squishy-wishy organic life-form?
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_124: An illogical life-form such as yourself could not begin to understand this unit's internal workings. Terminating interaction─good-bye.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_125: Don't you dare go into sleep mode! Coward!
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_126: We cannot let N-7000's emotional disfunction detract from our success. To Elysion! We'll drag it there if we must.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_128: I'm happy, you're happy, the dragon is happy... There's nothing anomalous about being happy!
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_127: <whirr> Please refrain from vibrating your vocal organs. This unit will continue processing anomalous satisfaction levels once Elysion status has been verified.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_DRAGONOMI_000_300: I do hope that winds bless yonder peak...
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_SYSTEM_000_301: Inspiration has touched the dragons' hearts, and given form to a nostalgic vista from the Dragonstar.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_SYSTEM_000_302: Yet still there is room for Elysion to grow and change! What other hopes will the power of dynamis bring to life?
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_140: What a majestic sight that was. And so pointy!
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_141: <whirr> Harmony between dragons and Omicrons defies any and all prior projections.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_143: Given historical events, it should not be possible per the laws of the universe. Only in Ultima Thule could such a thing occur.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_144: In that case, I'd better not hear you question our potential ever again! This is definitive proof that we can do anything if we put our minds to it, no matter what your projections say.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_145: I was created by someone too, you know? But I don't believe that being artificial makes our experiences any less worthwhile. We're here, and we're making a difference! Have a little faith─that's what living is all about.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_N7000_000_146: ...This unit did not realize that you were plagued by similar existential doubts, though it does explain your desire to pry into psyches you do not understand. Nevertheless, this unit will produce noises of generalized validation.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_JAMMINGWAY_000_147: Well...good! We've created a miracle here today─as well as new bonds between dragonkind that span time and space. I propose we bask in that glory for a while!
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_SYSTEM_000_148: You have achieved Honored reputation with the staff and patrons of the Last Dregs.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_SYSTEM_000_149: New Omicron society daily quests are now available from Stigma-4 at A-4 Research.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_SYSTEM_000_150: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Stigma-4 as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_SYSTEM_000_151: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Stigma-4. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANOMI004_04604_SYSTEM_000_152: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from Omicron N-0598.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_001: <whirr> Reports from behind the counter indicate that dragons have achieved social integration with other customers. This is ideal.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_002: Have you seen them in Elysion? They're flying again! Goodness, I'm so happy we could help.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_003: To my eye, it looks as if we're at least as popular as the Last Stand now─albeit with a more diverse clientele. I'll let you be the judge of that, though.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_010: <whirr> Our cup overfloweth─metaphorically speaking. Literal beverage overflow is nominal.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_011: Ah, I love the smell of carrot coffee in the eternal twilight...and look at all of the contented customers enjoying our cuisine! 'Tis more than I could have ever imagined when I proposed this idea.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_012: This unit is struggling to generate areas for improvement. Are all café objectives now complete?
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_013: I suppose you could say that, though it is a strange way to view one's accomplishments. Why do you ask?
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_014: In accordance with the directive to all Alphatron-registered units to “Live,” this unit's mission is to assist fallen civilizations in reclaiming lost hope through simulation, soup, or other means as necessary. It appears this has been accomplished.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_015: If so, then this unit must complete its performance evaluation immediately.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_017: Rather, yes. Nevertheless, this unit must adhere to standard operating protocol and analyze the results of our cultural preservation efforts.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_100_017: Evaluation results will determine whether this unit may continue to embrace the familiar inertia of the current mission. If all potential objectives have been fulfilled, it will once again consign itself to hibernation.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_018: Allied units may wish to know that interim evaluations indicate the latter result is likely. This unit has collected more than sufficient data proving that, with the appropriate stimulation, even despairing life-forms may once again hope.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_019: No further research on this subject is required. Logically speaking, to continue along the current trajectory would be a waste of energy.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_020: Oh, you are really fluffing my fur right now! It's like you weren't even listening to my lectures... Plural!
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_021: We are finally at the point where we can operate this café without one civilization or another reinventing the apocalypse, and you want to kick the bucket? Come a little closer, and I'll kick it for you!
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_022: <whirr> This unit gently reminds the screeching life-form that Omicron decision-making algorithms do not prioritize emotion.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_023: Well, they should! This mission has never been about experimental data, and you know it. “Waste of energy” my furry arse...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_100_023: Our feelings matter to the dynamis. They matter to the universe! So why don't they matter to you!?
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_024: <whirr> This unit...does not know what to tell you.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_025: Fine! Be that way! See if I care.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_026: <whirr> This unit will proceed to Base Omicron to back up unit data before shutdown protocols initialize.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_027: Additional personnel changes may follow, but Stigma-4 will minimize disruption to café operations.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_028: This unit acknowledges the non-zero possibility that it may return, but at least for the moment, it leaves the Last Dregs in your capable appendages. ...Farewell.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_A1_100_001: Did you want to go after it?
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_A1_100_002: Have we moved past the “anger” stage yet?
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_030: I don't know! Oh, this is horrible!
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_031: We can't let N-7000 enter permanent hibernation! What will the café do without it? What will I do!?
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_032: <huff> All right... I'm calm. Now, how do we stop it!?
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_033: Even if we can catch up to it before it reaches Base Omicron, I doubt it will want to speak to me after my outburst.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_034: You go alone, then. I'll take the time to gather my thoughts...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_NIBIRAENOMI_000_040: We see this civilization has also unified into a collective, and further transcended to a state of supreme efficiency. This is well.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_OMICRON04605A_000_0: Request for location data acknowledged. Searching Base Omicron monitoring logs...

Sensors detected N-7000's progress toward the fallow portal. Calculations indicate that it will have proceeded past the empty portal toward the limits of Ostrakon Deka-hexi by the timecode at which the organic life-form can catch up.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_OMICRON04605B_000_0: <whirr> Request for personal data acknowledged. Scanning recent automatic transmissions of internal processing logs...

Unit N-7000 accessed the logical process records of Sir, and has been engaging in analysis and projection related to the same. The operational protocol governing these peculiar actions cannot be determined at this time. This unit wishes you pleasant speculation!
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_050: <whirr> The signals of an allied unit are not unwelcome─but why did you follow this unit here, ?
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_A2_000_001: Well, you made several concerning comments...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_052: <whirr> This unit has been analyzing logs originating from M-017─alias: Stigma-1, alias: Sir─for some time now.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_053: As unit M-017, it repeatedly paid visit to the Tree of Life to analyze internal projections. The impetus for these actions was logged as “personal reasons.”
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_100_053: In other words, when its protocols were insufficient, M-017 came here to ponder its next course of action. This unit had hoped that the tree might provide data of use in its current dilemma.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_054: <whirr> No such data has been forthcoming. In retrospect, there is a non-zero possibility that M-017 did not find what it was looking for here, either...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_055: <whirr> This unit cannot conceptualize actions outside of its original programming that might lead to its desired conclusion. All simulations of upcoming performance evaluation end in shutdown.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_056: The precise value of a future in which this unit carries on operating the café in service of our myriad patrons remains unknown, and thus cannot be mathematically comparable to that of a successful evaluation. Nevertheless, this unit's preference remains constant.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_057: <whirr> Does this preference, then, constitute a logical fallacy that must be discarded? Inconclusive! As a military information and operations specialist, this vacillation is most distressing.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_058: Further review of the objective reality that the café has restored hope to multiple once-fallen civilizations is not helping. Paradoxically, it appears to make this unit's memory overflow even worse...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_A3_000_001: Why not listen to your heart rather than your calculations, for once?
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_060: That is impossible. As a mechanical life-form, this unit does not possess any such vulnerable organs, physically or metaphorically. Unless...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_061: Organic life-forms pursue greater levels of happiness regardless of utility or lack thereof. However, as a mechanical life-form, it is categorically impossible for this unit to experience emotions outside of predetermined programming. Unless...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_100_062: <whirr> Unless allied units were correct, and this unit is truly not the same unit it once was. If all life-forms reborn in Ultima Thule, including this unit, possess infinite potential in a mathematical sense...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_100_063: Generating new projections... Multi-sim mode initialized. Shutting down auxiliary functions and overclocking processors...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_100_065: Warning: processing load critical. Cannot accept additional inputs. Failure to step away from the unit may result in severe burns.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_SYSTEM_100_066:
Though its state is worrisome, it seems that you will be unable to interrupt
N-7000's processing queue at present. Perhaps you should bring Jammingway along to kick its bucket.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_068: Warning: processing load critical. Emergency fans activated. Nearby life-forms, prepare to be roasted.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_070: All of this worrying is exhausting! Not to mention the yelling─apologies for that, by the by...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_071: But did you find N-7000? Is it all right?
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_072: Hmm... I recall seeing this “Sir” in the logs. It did seem to have individualistic tendencies, now that you mention it.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_100_073: You would know its “personal reasons” better than I, of course, but it would not be the first nor the last to agonize over its existence. The choice to live is not made just the once, after all...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_100_074: No, I don't think it's a leap─or even a bunny hop─to assume that M-017 struggled with much the same questions of purpose and potential that plague N-7000. The Omicrons have very little experience with the self-doubt that comes from facing an indeterminate future.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_100_075: ...Very little experience with emotions in general, really. Does it not bother you that we've seen no changes to Elysion that could be attributed to N-7000 and the other staff?
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_100_076: The dynamis reacted to my very first burst of hope, and has reliably taken form for every civilization─but not them.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_A4_000_001: Our Omicrons do have emotions─of that I'm certain.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_100_078: Precisely! Should our N-7000, then, not have the power to shape dynamis in spades? Look how successful it's been!
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_100_079: Personally, I believe it does have that power─but every time it feels a little something, it shoves that emotion away under a pile of numbers and refuses to think about it ever again.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_100_080: It needs to allow itself to feel that joy─that hope!─for it to grow and blossom in Elysion. None of this, “Waste of energy! <whirr> Time to die!” bollocks...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_100_081: Honestly! Does it ever think about anyone else!? Mark my words─I'm going to gather every scrap of joy we've created here and shove them right down its stupid throat...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_100_082: We'll need to be quick if we want to prepare before N-7000 finishes processing and finds a way to infuriate me even more.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_100_083: We're certainly not allowing it to shuffle off its metal coil─today, or ever.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_100_084: First, though, we'll need to choose a recipe─one guaranteed to remind it of what we've accomplished here at the Last Dregs, and give it a taste of the boundless happiness yet to come!
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_100_085: I'm certain Stigma-4 can dig something out of its database that can represent our culinary achievements without proving an electrocution hazard. Wait just a moment!
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_STIGMA4_000_091: Thrusters disengaged. N-7000 not detected. Awaiting promised explanation...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_STIGMA4_000_093: ...Circumstances acknowledged. N-7000 logs transmitted to central database confirm the accuracy of managerial report.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_STIGMA4_000_094: Conclusion reached by N-7000 also confirmed accurate. Operational protocols are absolute. Completion of mission necessitates permanent hibernation.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_095: I don't think I'll ever understand your culture's obsession with productivity...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_STIGMA4_000_096: ...However, running in multi-sim mode for prolonged periods poses unacceptable risks to hardware. Immediate intervention recommended.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_097: Aha! Not quite the sympathetic response I was looking for, but it'll do!
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_098: As for your “intervention,” I propose the presentation of a delicious dish that will bring N-7000 back to its senses. What do you think it would like?
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_STIGMA4_000_099:
Invalid input. Preferences are irrelevant to mechanical life-forms. What
N-7000 requires is refrigerant liquid.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_102: A cooling beverage, then? I think we can manage that.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_103: Can you search your database for local ingredients we might use? N-7000 always seemed to know what it was doing, so I've never bothered learning where anything is.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_STIGMA4_000_104: Auxiliary information...evaluated. Nevertheless, request acknowledged. Scanning database...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_STIGMA4_000_105: <ping> Gaseous matter suitable for condensation and subsequent ingestion contained in ovular ore samples in Ostrakon Tria. Approximate coordinates: 30, 9.5, 2.5
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_STIGMA4_000_106: <ping> Gaseous matter suitable for condensation and subsequent ingestion is emitted by plant matter found in Ostrakon Tria. Approximate coordinates: 29, 13, 2.5
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_STIGMA4_000_107: <ping> Gaseous matter suitable for condensation and subsequent ingestion is emitted by an aquatic life-form found in the abode of the Ea.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_STIGMA4_000_108: A-4 Research protocols indicate that at this juncture, the use of gold salmon roe purchased from N-0598 is to be promoted. “Gold salmon roe─there is a 99.998% probability that no roe is more golden! Fishers in the know, go with the roe.” Do purchase some this timecode.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_109: Wonderful! You're a natural at this.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_STIGMA4_000_110: Managerial praise is unnecessary. Scanning the database is well within standard operational protocols.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_STIGMA4_000_111: Production of vital liquids such as refrigerants and oils is also standard protocol for a logistic matrix. However, café operations have repeatedly demonstrated that standard chemical formulae are insufficient impetus for the alteration of dynamis.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_STIGMA4_000_112: That is where café management must intervene. Allied unit N-7000 is depending on you. Do not fail.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_113: Don't you worry, Stigma-4! We would never let our allied units down.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_114: I leave the procurement of the primary ingredient to you, . In the meantime, I'll see what else might be mechanically digestible around here...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_STIGMA4_000_115: <ping> N-7000 coordinates confirmed. Subject remains immobile. Retrieval unit will be dispatched to Ostrakon Deka-hexi momentarily...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_120: I daresay Stigma-4 will be dragging N-7000 back here any moment now. Did you find the gassy whatsits?
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_121: Emissions ahoy! Now we just need to condense this, perhaps shake it up with some other bits and bobs for the proper cocktail experience...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_124: The Last Dregs...? This unit would like to register its confusion.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_125: You miserable sack of sockets! Bolt-head! Weird-looking fork! I'll kick your bucket into the next galaxy, you...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_126: ...Ah, yes. This unit remembers now. Dialogue with the screeching life-form had reached an impasse, so it withdrew to organize its thought processes in peace.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_127: This unit became trapped in a processing loop and overheated, but temperatures are now nominal. As your civilization would say─“Whew.”
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_128: So you're feeling better? That's the best news I've heard all day─no thanks to you!
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_129: <whirr> This unit's circuits are still somewhat muddled. Reviewing event log for flags associated with mission to “Live”...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_130: <ping> Results of recalculated projections located. Proceeding to Elysion to confirm.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_131: You could at least explain yourself!
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_132: It sounds like it's expecting some change to the dynamis─what sort, I have no idea. After it!
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_133: Stigma-4's logs confirmed that N-7000 came this way. Make haste!
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_061: Ahem! You owe us a very thorough report...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_062: ...Affirmative. As you may have detected, since the birth of Elysion, this unit's self-determination algorithm has been in conflict with its core protocols. This issue has been surpassingly difficult to resolve.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_063: The cooling solution that you made, however, enabled this unit to arrive at a conclusion. It is confident in the result of its performance evaluation.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_064: First, a thought experiment for allied units─how has this unit transformed the landscape of Elysion, despite its nature as a replicated mechanical life-form?
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_A1_000_001: Your nature doesn't matter. Here, now, you are alive.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_A1_000_002: This future was always possible. Now you've made it real.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_A1_000_003: Through strength of heart, I'd say...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_139: Though the dead are gone, what they left behind lives on in the realm of infinite possibility... <whirr> A pleasing analysis indeed. This unit regrets not having seen the beauty in it earlier.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_140: A future in which the metal warriors came to love the forests of a distant star... <whirr> It is a bittersweet possibility, but holds a beauty all its own.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_141: "Strength of heart“...a curious choice of words, but this unit sees the beauty in it. One small organ that beats hard enough to shake the universe─a spark of hope to shape a star.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_142: <whirr> That this unit's hope would take such an organic form defies logic─yet the data is clear. Perhaps this is what one would call a “miracle.”
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_070: Thank you, . This unit will keep your words close to its heart.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_071: <whirr> In the history of the universe, countless possibilities have gone unfulfilled─but it is an error to thus consign them to the realm of the impossible. All the dynamis requires is that we ask, “What if?”
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_072: While sentient life-forms remain to ask that question─to dream of unrealized futures─this unit cannot agree with the Ea's conclusion that the end of the universe is inevitable. Our data proves that miracles happen!
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_073: Took you long enough! Honestly, you gave me quite a fright with that shutdown nonsense...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_074: ...Interesting. Would you miss this unit if it were gone, Jammingway? Jammingway? Requesting acknowledgement of warm-and-fuzzy feelings.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_075: Never in a billion years, bolt-brain! Denied, denied, denied!
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_076: ...In any case, this unit recognizes the role the Alphatron Star played in cutting the futures of many civilizations short.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_077: Together with allied managers, the Omicrons have restored hope to some such civilizations, and assisted in developing Elysion to its current state. The star now teems with life, some of it newly born.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_078: Calculations may say that this is sufficient to fulfill this unit's mission, but this unit disagrees. What we have accomplished thus far is a significant step toward a new future for the Omicrons─but not the last.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_079: This unit believes in infinite possibilities─beyond the projection capabilities of even Stigma-4. Alongside our allies at the Last Dregs, we must continue to make them real.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_080: We shall atone...and we shall live.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_081: A worthy purpose, if you ask me! Which you ought to, given that I'm still your business partner.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_083: ...Come to think of it, we've never toasted our achievements─or shared a drink at all! What kind of café managers are we!?
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_084: I brought some refrigerant cocktail along with my normal supplies in case someone needed another wake-up call... What do you say we have a picnic?
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_085: The Last Dregs' specialty carrot juice for us, of course. I never go anywhere without it!
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_086: You know, when I proposed this idea, I was thinking of the cafés on Etheirys─how the people inside smiled, and laughed, and spoke of tomorrow...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_087: We've been focused on providing our customers the same experience, naturally─but that's also what the Last Dregs is to us, isn't it?
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_088: Affirmative. This unit would go so far as to assert that spending time with friends in this fashion is...meaningful.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_089: <whirr> This sense of satisfaction is what organic life-forms persistently term “happiness,” is it not?
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_170: That was the best carrot juice I've had in my whole Loporrit life!
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_171: ...That raises several questions, but this unit will restrain itself in favor of thanking  once again for  assistance in its time of need. This unit apologizes for burdening you with additional shifts.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_172: I note that you have yet to apologize to me for the distress you've caused!
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_173: This unit has been distressed numerous times due to unwarranted screeching from the hyperbole-prone life-form, and thus considers us even.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_174: Grrr... See if I save your sorry scrap metal ever again!
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_N7000_000_175: Additionally, this unit would prefer that, as business partners, we provide mutual assistance as a matter of course. That is what organic life-forms mean by “partnership,” is it not?
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_000_176: So long as you hold up your part of the bargain. We're going to keep the Last Dregs open until the very end of the universe...
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_JAMMINGWAY_200_177: ...And beyond! No universe is ending on our watch!
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_SYSTEM_000_177: You have achieved Sworn reputation with the staff and patrons of the Last Dregs.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_SYSTEM_000_178: You will receive an experience point bonus upon the completion of Last Dregs society daily quests.
TEXT_BANOMI005_04605_SYSTEM_000_181: Furthermore, you now have access to a wider selection of wares from Omicron N-0598.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_001: <whirr> Precisely 86,400,000 timecodes have passed since our latest brewing incident. A new record! This unit's mission satisfaction could not be higher.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_002: I don't know about you, but I think we deserve a break! Care to join us for a tall glass of carrot juice? Carrot coffee is also an option, though I would hate to risk our safety record...
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_003: This unit notes that carrots are still disproportionately represented on the menu, but accepts your invitation.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_010: Such a pleasant atmosphere for processing... This unit now understands organic life-forms' obsession with beverage consumption.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_011: The Last Dregs certainly has come a long way. Remember when the counter was dusty and musty?
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_012: I still don't know what civilization originally built these structures, but I like to think they'd be happy to see what we've done with the place. Perhaps they ran a café of their own, long ago...
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_013: ...Actually, while you're here, can I trouble you to check in with the patrons?
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_014: As you well know, customer satisfaction is our first priority─and they wouldn't dare fob you off with a platitude.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_015: What are they saying? Do they like it!?
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_016: ...This unit apologizes for once again burdening you with an extra shift.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_KARELEANA_000_020: It has been quite some time since I began cooperating with this lout, hasn't it? Though I can scarce believe it myself, we are as allies now. Some even call us “friends”─to which I take offense, of course. Perish the thought.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_KARELEANB_000_021: Pfft... As if you don't wander over to my side of the garden half a dozen times per shift to raise your “suggestions.” Perhaps people would possess a more accurate conception of our relationship if you did not so clearly crave my insight.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_KARELEANB_000_022: Still, I've come to believe that anyone who enjoys the Last Dregs as much as I do cannot be all bad. Even if he has poor taste in helmets.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_KARELEANA_100_020: "Poor taste in helmets“... I have never been so offended in all my life. I will require quite some time to fully detail the inaccuracy of that statement─another round, please.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_KARELEANB_100_022: We came here to research what other vegetables may be of value to the menu, not to discuss personal issues, but you know how he is...
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_GREBULOFFA_000_023: This place? I love it here! It reminds me of home almost as much as the sea on Elysion.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_GREBULOFFB_000_024: And such a pristine sea it is. Each time I devour a delicious fish, I reaffirm my vow to protect it! ...One serving of the fish, please.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_GREBULOFFA_100_023: By the by, are there any imminent plans for salty sea breeze coffee? It would pair well with the soup...
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_GREBULOFFB_100_024: While the sea's vistas are by far the most charming, the other scenery of Elysion has proven quite enjoyable as well! The peaks, the trees, whatever that weird place with the monoliths is...
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_EAOMIA_000_025: Yes, the transmission of other beings' gustatory perception has been most effective. I believe I should like to experience haptic transmissions next─these “burns to the tongue” reported by the beings that consume coffee rapidly sound intriguing...
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_EAOMIA_000_026: Why do you hasten so? There are yet many gustatory sensations we must experience. The Karellians' and Grebuloffs' perceptions were illuminating.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_EAOMIB_000_027: The atmosphere, too, is quite enjoyable. Though the other beings are, naturally, unequipped to discuss the finer mysteries of the universe, the idle chatter pleases me. In fact, I've scarcely rebuked anyone at all.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_EAOMIA_100_026: Of late, we have been delving into the mystery of what gustatory triggers the Miw Miisv enjoy. Helpfully, their displeasure upon experiencing a sensation that they do not prefer is obvious.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_EAOMIB_100_027: For our next subject of conversation, I propose a relaxing round of “Should the milk go in first or last?”
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_DRAGONOMI_000_028: Thy consideration is appreciated, hero. For me, 'tis enough to gaze upon the tiny dessert and feel the wind on my scales.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_DRAGONOMI_000_029: Indeed, the true winds of Elysion are divine... Yet I find myself drawn to the pastry nonetheless. The sentiment by which thou didst create it warmeth my heart even now.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_DRAGONOMI_100_029: It hath been many years since last I found myself so rested. Perhaps a song to mark the occasion...
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_041: Allow this unit to thank you in the perpetually anxious life-form's stead. Your data collection is appreciated.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_042: I am not perpetually anxious! This is a normal amount of concern!
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_043: But yes─thank you, . How did you find our customers?
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_044: Thank goodness they're still enjoying themselves. I would hate to play host to any more firefights. Or fistfights. Or food fights...
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_045: Data from barista unit M-104 indicates that patron numbers are only increasing. Business future secure.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_046: Though this unit personally wishes us to seek out even more civilizations' data nevertheless. Much of the universe remains to be restored to life and hope.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_049: <whirr> New life!? Allied units, there is new life on Elysion! Scans indicate more than one additional life-form.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_050: Oh, don't bore us with the logs─if it's worth scanning, it's worth seeing!
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_200_051: Unsurprisingly, I was treated to more logs anyway. The good news is that every single part of Elysion has grown!
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_200_052: <whirr> This unit will not spoil any further revelations─let us proceed.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_100_051: Sweet Mother! Stigma-4 wasn't kidding. Not that it can...
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_052: Ack! What are you doing here?
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_NIBIRAENOMI_000_053: As your companion suggested, we have traversed the dead worlds of Ultima Thule. We have seen its despair.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_NIBIRAENOMI_000_054: We have seen the tragedy of the forgotten, and the sorrow of those who forget themselves. This is well...
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_NIBIRAENOMI_000_055: Yet this star is different. There is life here. There is change...
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_056: <whirr> This unit understands that this is difficult for you to accept. The mission to live is no simple matter...
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_NIBIRAENOMI_000_057: Then why do you grasp for life in a universe that will one day die? Why seek to change that which cannot be changed?
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_058: This unit hopes you will not take this as a personal attack, but it would assert that a broad perspective is required.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_059: It is true that each civilization is vulnerable. A single particle of despair, placed in the right code─the right body, the right mind─can spread like a virus.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_060: Yet there is more than one civilization in this universe. The disease that kills one spares another. The sorrow that consumes one drives others to seek joy.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_061: Together, we survive. Together, we see beyond our limitations. And together, we find reason to hope.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_062: <whirr> So long as we live, and so long as we have even one reason to hope, the dynamis will change for us. Beyond our despair lies an infinitude of miracles─we need only open our receptors to them.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_NIBIRAENOMI_000_063: We obtained physical life eternal and complete mental resonance to determine that existence is meaningless. Despite all of that, you say we were...wrong?
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_EAOMIB_000_064: Please refrain from leaping to conclusions. Whether the inherent meaning of life─or lack thereof─can be proven by the existence of miracles remains up for debate.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_EAOMIB_000_065: We Ea have grappled with such questions since time immemorial. You are welcome to join us for further discussion and gustatory stimulation at the café before deciding that your civilization was replete with buffoons.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_066: So long as you keep the doom and gloom confined to your conversation with mentally unflappable beings, that should be fine. And who knows─a nice cup of coffee might cheer you up a bit.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_067: This unit can vouch for the utility of our beverages in processing philosophical conundrums.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_068: That too! Perhaps they'll even find something new to ponder. It's the little things, as they say...
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_069: There will be time enough for all civilizations to find hope for the future, given the proposed eternal opening schedule. This unit has set reminders to look out for the end of the universe, in case additional menu items are required.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_070: That's what I like to hear! Less fatalism, more carrots of happiness!
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_080: We'll have to explore the new Elysion when we have a bit more time.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_081: <whirr> These developments are pleasing, but...whence did they originate?
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_082: Changes occurred soon after  asked our customers to reflect on their experience at the café, no?
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_083: Perhaps realizing how happy they are increased their faith in a brighter future.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_084: And perhaps even the Nibirun were moved by the sight of a world that had not fallen to despair...
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_085: In any case, the value of our mission is clear.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_086: You bet it is! ...Ahhh, it's so nice to not have to do all of the emotional lifting around here anymore.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_JAMMINGWAY_000_087: Do come back and join us from time to time, . We'll be here─forever!
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_088: Affirmative. Your labor has been greatly valued. We would be delighted to assign you shifts at any time...
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_N7000_000_089: <whirr> This unit jests! Your friendship is also valued. Should you ever need a place to process, you are always welcome for a beverage of indeterminate nature at the Last Dregs.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_SYSTEM_000_091: You have achieved Bloodsworn reputation with the staff and patrons of the Last Dregs.
TEXT_BANOMI006_04606_SYSTEM_000_092: You will receive an experience point bonus upon the completion of Last Dregs society daily quests.
TEXT_BANOMI101_04607_STIGMA4_000_001: Alert: Request for aid received from Karellians on Elysion. Report indicates that invasive plant life threatens harvest. Be aware that there is a perfectly good, pre-synthesized compound available to eliminate all traces of organic life from the applied area with a minimum of effort.
TEXT_BANOMI101_04607_STIGMA4_000_002: However, the disheveled manager objected quite shrilly to its use. They insist on a weaker chemical agent, which must be produced at great expense from nearby materials. Although this is an inefficient course of action, engaging in debate with diminutive life-forms is projected to be equally taxing.
TEXT_BANOMI101_04607_STIGMA4_000_003: Therefore, your task is to mine sodium-rich ore from the Elysian fields. Please do not argue with this directive.
TEXT_BANOMI101_04607_STIGMA4_000_004: Therefore, your task is to gather local grain from the Elysian fields. Please do not argue with this directive.
TEXT_BANOMI101_04607_STIGMA4_000_005: Therefore, your task is to procure one of the many fish from the waters of the agricultural sector. The use of gold salmon roe is recommended to speed your work along. Highly recommended.
TEXT_BANOMI101_04607_STIGMA4_000_006: Deliver the ingredients to the Karellian at Base Omicron. There they will waste precious moments synthesizing the inferior chemical agent.
TEXT_BANOMI101_04607_KARELEAN04607_000_0: Ah, you must be Stigma-4's . I understand you have a delivery for us.
Yes, this will do perfectly. Finally we'll be rid of those weeds.

They're a threat not only to the harvest itself, but to the beliefs our people hold dear. Do you recall the rounded glyph at the heart of our fields? It is an ancient symbol of good fortune, passed down by our forebears. It seems the local flora have no respect for tradition, however.

We must keep it free from obstruction, lest we forget its message: that our scientific zeal led to our destruction, and only by returning to the old ways did we find life anew. Now, I'd best get started mixing these ingredients.
Ah, a resupply is always welcome! Thanks to you, the symbol remains visible as a reminder to all and sundry. Not to mention that our harvest is more bountiful than ever before!
The vegetables we grow have proven to be in high demand, and we mustn't disappoint our customers. It gives value to every drop of sweat we shed.
I shall make more of the chemical solution as soon as time allows. However, the weeds are a constant menace, and doubtless we shall require more ingredients before long.
TEXT_BANOMI101_04607_STIGMA4_000_030: Return of allied life-form  confirmed. Report from Base Omicron indicates successful production of the chemical agent.
TEXT_BANOMI101_04607_STIGMA4_000_031: Scanning database for records of Karellian civilization... <ping> Glyphs like the one at the Karellian agricultural facility are colloquially known as “crop circles.” They were created by a number of primitive cultures as a form of “artistic expression.”
TEXT_BANOMI101_04607_STIGMA4_000_032: The belief that such symbols are a catalyst for good fortune is categorized as “nonsense.” However, the glyph's positive effect on worker morale and the flow of dynamis bears further analysis.
TEXT_BANOMI101_04607_STIGMA4_000_033: Analysis indicates that the rich harvest is merely a statistical aberration, and not a direct consequence of the crop circle. Yet its continued positive effect on morale─in defiance of all logic─cannot be denied, so its upkeep is worth the cost of resources and time.
TEXT_BANOMI101_04607_STIGMA4_000_034: You will be summoned once more should the need for help arise. May your wages tide you over until then.
TEXT_BANOMI102_04608_STIGMA4_000_000: Alert: Request received from interminably shrill manager demanding Karellian patronage.
TEXT_BANOMI102_04608_STIGMA4_000_001: Organic life-forms require regular intake of fluids to maintain vital functions, so the recommended course of action is to ask them to meet their basic needs at the Last Dregs.
TEXT_BANOMI102_04608_STIGMA4_000_002: However, as Karellian brains are incapable of receiving communication via electronic waves, we must rely on less efficient means: you. Travel to Elysion and manipulate your vocal aperture to suggest that the Karellians visit our establishment for a coffee break.
TEXT_BANOMI102_04608_KARELEANA04608_000_: A farmer's work never ceases. The quality of the soil, the composition of the fertilizer, and maintenance are but a few of the countless problems we must tackle daily. Have you come to help?
TEXT_BANOMI102_04608_SYSTEM_000_004: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing the words “coffee break” to call out to the Karellian.
TEXT_BANOMI102_04608_KARELEANA04608_000_: A break? Well, it has been some time since I've had a proper rest. Life of a farmer, and all.

Ah, speaking of which─did you invite that scoundrel from the Freedom Fighters? Not that I care what his business is, but he's been working as tirelessly as I, if not more so. It wouldn't do either of us any good if he keeled over suddenly.

I must admit, at first I had my reservations about working alongside my sworn enemy. Yet in our time working in the fields together, our scythes swinging almost in unison, the animosities of the past seem to melt away...
...Anyway, you say there are beverages at the Last Dregs? I could certainly use a drink, so I shall be there shortly.
TEXT_BANOMI102_04608_SYSTEM_000_010: The Karellian attends to his work in silence, paying you no heed.
TEXT_BANOMI102_04608_SYSTEM_000_011: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing the words “coffee break” to call out to the Karellian.
TEXT_BANOMI102_04608_KARELEANB04608_000_: Huh? Oh, apologies, I didn't notice you there.
Coffee, you say? Well, now that I've taken pause, I can feel the countless hours of labor in my limbs and back most keenly. I could do well with a sit and a drink.
By the way, have you invited that tyrant from the Global Community? Not that I care if he works himself to an early grave, but it would have consequences to the work we've started here.
I won't forget the family and friends his ilk have murdered in cold blood, but so long as we till the same fields, it would serve us both to look after the health of the other.
Our job is taxing enough with two people, let alone one. I'll be at the Last Dregs forthwith─and thank you for the invitation.
TEXT_BANOMI102_04608_STIGMA4_000_017: Return of allied life-form  confirmed. Transmission speed of message via manual conveyance, while slower than electronic transmission, is judged as satisfactory.
TEXT_BANOMI102_04608_STIGMA4_000_018: It is difficult to determine whether the Karellians will erupt into open hostilities or are simply performing some manner of unique mating ritual. Please provide organic insight into this matter so that potential issues may be identified and summarily dispatched.
TEXT_BANOMI102_04608_STIGMA4_000_019: Analyzing report... Disparity in ethical values between the two workers does not pose any immediate danger to the greater cause. This concludes your duty─receive your compensation and await further work orders.
TEXT_BANOMI103_04609_STIGMA4_000_001: In accordance with protocol introduced by the flea-infested manager, the Last Dregs' water supply is currently sourced directly from the wellspring of regret.
TEXT_BANOMI103_04609_STIGMA4_000_002: As organic life-forms have a tendency to succumb to even minor environmental fluctuations, regular analysis and maintenance of the water supply is imperative to prevent widespread demise of café patrons.
TEXT_BANOMI103_04609_STIGMA4_000_003: Appropriate sample for analysis detected. Approximate coordinates: 13, 16, 2. Harmful agents can seep into solid stone, indicating current levels of environmental toxicity. Speedy completion of task objectives is highly recommended.
TEXT_BANOMI103_04609_STIGMA4_000_004: Appropriate sample for analysis detected. Approximate coordinates: 13, 14, 2. Harmful agents often seep into the soil, indicating current levels of environmental toxicity. Speedy completion of task objectives is highly recommended.
TEXT_BANOMI103_04609_STIGMA4_000_005: Appropriate sample for analysis detected. Approximate coordinates: 14, 11, 2. Resident fauna can be analyzed for harmful agents, indicating current levels of toxicity. Gold salmon roe, available for purchase from N-0598, is estimated to further expediency of completing task objectives.
TEXT_BANOMI103_04609_STIGMA4_000_006: Repeating task objectives: proceed to coordinates 13, 16, 2 and obtain requested sample. Every idle moment exacerbates potential corruption of the Last Dregs' water supply.
TEXT_BANOMI103_04609_STIGMA4_000_007: Repeating task objectives: proceed to coordinates 13, 14, 2 and obtain requested sample. Every idle moment exacerbates potential corruption of the Last Dregs' water supply.
TEXT_BANOMI103_04609_STIGMA4_000_008: Repeating task objectives: purchase gold salmon roe from N-0598, proceed to coordinates 14, 11, 2, and obtain requested fish. Every idle moment exacerbates potential corruption of the Last Dregs' water supply.
TEXT_BANOMI103_04609_STIGMA4_000_009: Return of allied courier  confirmed. Requesting detailed report with deliverables.
TEXT_BANOMI103_04609_STIGMA4_000_010: Analyzing delivered materials... In accordance with pan-galactic sanitation standards, the purity level of the water source has received a grade of B.
TEXT_BANOMI103_04609_STIGMA4_000_011: In contrast, Alphatron water can be instantly synthesized to exceed a grade of A by all accepted standards. The foul-smelling manager's insistence on “natural” water is conclusively illogical.
TEXT_BANOMI103_04609_STIGMA4_000_012: However, so long as its provision does not hinder current work objectives, B-grade water meets minimum safety standards. Receive your recompense for this task and await future instructions, perhaps while imbibing some technically nontoxic liquids.
TEXT_BANOMI104_04610_STIGMA4_000_001: The Last Dregs' performance is currently satisfactory, but analysis indicates that a focus on spreading awareness of the café's presence would yield even greater results.
TEXT_BANOMI104_04610_STIGMA4_000_002: Therefore, you are requested to make use of your vocal aperture to engage in persuasive conversation with other life-forms and secure their patronage.
TEXT_BANOMI104_04610_STIGMA4_000_003: Commencing Operation: Propagandize Plebeians. Two likely locations of patron encounter have been marked on your map. Venture forth and return victorious.
TEXT_BANOMI104_04610_EAOMI04610_000_018: Through what pains you meat bags go to prepare and masticate your meals into piles of meaningless mush. Perhaps your corporeal forms derive pleasure from such a horrific process, but I must admit a failure to comprehend the appeal.
TEXT_BANOMI104_04610_EAOMI04610_000_019: We Ea find the occasional diversion in minute fluctuations of aether, yes. But to gather in a primitive circle of equally barbaric life-forms for an empty exchange of ritual... What a dreadful waste of time.
TEXT_BANOMI104_04610_EAOMI04610_000_020: The Last Dregs? Yes I know it well! Several of my non-corporeal comrades have already gone to visit, eager to participate in gustatory experimentation. Truth be told, I have been considering making the journey myself, and this was just the push I needed!
TEXT_BANOMI104_04610_EAOMI04610_000_021: To reacquaint oneself with a sense long forgotten...now that is truly an experience to imbue life with meaning! I quiver with anticipation to see what the future has in store for me and mine.
TEXT_BANOMI104_04610_DRAGONOMI04610_000_: ...Dost thou speak to me, little one? Pray be silent, for I cannot abide the chatter of diminutive creatures.
Thou sayest this “café” is bustling with your like? The mere thought of the cacophony makest the bile rise in my throat...
I have heard much of this “café.” The whispers that carry across the rift speak of hope incarnate and the lost memory of our Dragonstar reborn.
How I long to see her peaks... Perhaps these wings may yet bear me over that distance...
TEXT_BANOMI104_04610_OMICRON04610_000_01: <whirr> To further current objectives, all Omicrons have been informed that the Last Dregs is open for patronage.

Several units have already been deployed to lend aid to operations. Is your current request in regards to waitstaff or patron insufficiencies? <whirr> Retracting previous query in interest of efficiency. This unit will offer its services as needed to simulate the appearance of a successful small business.
<whirr> The Last Dregs' reputation grows. Of particular note is the popularity of a drink said to increase Omicron computational capabilities.

This wondrous beverage is highly regarded in Base Omicron and this unit would like to experience the sensation of enhanced functionality for itself. <whirr> Setting destination for the Last Dregs. Reason for travel: recreation and personal improvement.
TEXT_BANOMI104_04610_STIGMA4_000_030: Propagandize Plebeians underway. Requesting detailed report of mission objectives.
TEXT_BANOMI104_04610_STIGMA4_000_031: Success rate unsatisfactory. Persuasion must continue until custom improves.
TEXT_BANOMI104_04610_STIGMA4_000_032: Success rate mediocre. However, analysis indicates growing interest in the Last Dregs. Allied life-form 's strategic and charismatic capabilities evaluated as “minimally competent.”
TEXT_BANOMI104_04610_STIGMA4_000_033: Success rate surpasses projected results. Converted clientele reliably patronize the Last Dregs and clamor enthusiastically for fluid intake. Café status officially designated as “trending.”
TEXT_BANOMI104_04610_STIGMA4_000_034: This mission will never cease, so long as life-forms remain who have yet to hear the name “The Last Dregs.” May this stipend meet your biological needs until your services are requested again.
TEXT_BANOMI105_04611_STIGMA4_000_000: According to verbal testimony of the malodorous manager, “delicious” and “unique” coffee is a vital component of any café. Although objective analysis of such inherently subjective categories proves difficult, current stores of coffee have been classified as insufficient.
TEXT_BANOMI105_04611_STIGMA4_000_001: Upgrading establishment coffee is predicted to result in clear strategic benefits. Your task is to procure necessary ingredients to achieve this goal.
TEXT_BANOMI105_04611_STIGMA4_000_002: Mine rock salt from the Elysian fields. When your task is complete, deliver the materials to the food processing unit in the Last Dregs.
TEXT_BANOMI105_04611_STIGMA4_000_003: Gather nectar from the Elysian fields. When your task is complete, deliver the materials to the food processing unit in the Last Dregs.
TEXT_BANOMI105_04611_STIGMA4_000_004: Procure seaweed from the Elysian fields. When your task is complete, deliver the materials to the food processing unit in the Last Dregs. Gold salmon roe is recommended as bait for quickest completion of task.

TEXT_BANOMI105_04611_STIGMA4_000_021: According to subjective analysis by bewhiskered manager, rock salt mitigates the natural bitterness of coffee, resulting in a mild flavor that is acceptable to a wide range of palates.
TEXT_BANOMI105_04611_STIGMA4_000_022: According to subjective analysis by bewhiskered manager, nectar-derived compounds lend revitalizing sweetness to coffee.
TEXT_BANOMI105_04611_STIGMA4_000_023: According to subjective analysis by bewhiskered manager, salt extracted from dried seaweed mitigates the natural bitterness of coffee, resulting in a mild flavor that is widely acceptable to a range of palates.
TEXT_BANOMI105_04611_STIGMA4_000_024: Projections indicate that coffee upgrades will result in increased patronage and an overall improvement of morale among café occupants. Whether this upward trajectory shall continue depends on the further assistance of helpful organisms such as yourself.

TEXT_BANOMI106_04612_STIGMA4_000_010: Return of allied errand organism confirmed well within acceptable time frame. Assuming it has brought the requested materials.
TEXT_BANOMI106_04612_STIGMA4_000_011: Analyzing delivery... Fertilizer created with the incorporation of these materials is projected to improve agricultural yield by approximately 14.2%.
TEXT_BANOMI106_04612_STIGMA4_000_012: Fertilizer preparation, application to fields, and retrieval of increased harvest is predicted to require a 23.6% increase in Karellian labor time. Overwork deemed an acceptable compromise.
TEXT_BANOMI106_04612_STIGMA4_000_013: Your conduct in this mission deserves high commendation. Receive your compensation with pride.
TEXT_BANOMI107_04613_STIGMA4_000_000: Task log indicates pending request for . Karellians patrolling the wellspring of regret require the delivery of sustenance.
TEXT_BANOMI107_04613_STIGMA4_000_001: Depletion of nutrients in the biological vessel directly correlates to emotional instability, which is statistically proven as the source of psychological warfare, physical altercations, and/or severe grumpiness. Current trajectory classified as “untenable.” Proceed with caution and haste.
TEXT_BANOMI107_04613_KARELEANA04613_000_: What is it? Make it quick─patrolling requires the utmost concentration, you know.
Food? For me? Why, how unexpected... Truth be told, my patrols so far have been an exercise in battling off pangs of boredom and hunger in equal measure. This, at least, shall help with the latter.

While you're here, might not you do something about that layabout Freedom Fighter? I've noticed a number of careless errors in his work. If I am expected to work alongside his kind, it is only right that he be held to the same standard of diligence, empty stomach notwithstanding.
...Ah, but perhaps it is best not to think about work until after I've eaten this gift. So quickly does one's mood turn dark without sustenance. You have my thanks.
TEXT_BANOMI107_04613_KARELEANB04613_000_: Oh, it's you. I don't suppose you've come to help me with my work?
This...this is food! I'm so hungry the rocks and dirt were beginning to look like freshly baked bread and powdered sugar. Thank you for this bounty!

Speaking of which, you haven't seen that would-be taskmaster from the Global Community around, have you? He criticizes me upon every opportunity─not a surprise for someone of his stripe, but my ears may well bleed from the abuse...
...Still, little use wondering why villains will be vile when there's a meal to be had. Now, I feast!
TEXT_BANOMI107_04613_STIGMA4_000_020: Return of  confirmed. Awaiting detailed report.
TEXT_BANOMI107_04613_STIGMA4_000_021: Relational deterioration between patrolling Karellians acknowledged. 's assistance in this matter evaluated as vital to preserving peace and averting a breakdown of operations.
TEXT_BANOMI107_04613_STIGMA4_000_022: Why organic life-forms retain the programming error colloquially referred to as “emotions” remains incomprehensible. Even so, a compensatory wage has been prepared for 's monetary and emotional needs. Remember to refuel as necessary.
TEXT_BANOMI108_04614_STIGMA4_000_001: Analysis indicates that the Grebuloffs continue to abide on Elysion without difficulty. However, data insufficiencies remain regarding the oceans created through their influence on dynamis.
TEXT_BANOMI108_04614_STIGMA4_000_002: With sufficient data, it will be possible to preserve such ocean environments and improve Grebuloff well-being. Initiating research and analysis protocol...

TEXT_BANOMI108_04614_STIGMA4_000_004: Elysian cucumber samples are required to proceed with analysis. Once procured, please deposit the samples in the analysis unit.

TEXT_BANOMI110_04616_STIGMA4_000_001: Irregular population fluctuations detected. Your assistance is required to search for two missing Grebuloffs.
TEXT_BANOMI110_04616_STIGMA4_000_002: Analysis indicates insatiable curiosity and a proclivity for exploration in both units, making “voluntary expedition” the most likely explanation for their sudden disappearance.
TEXT_BANOMI110_04616_STIGMA4_000_003: However, given the length of absence and approximate levels of danger in the surrounding areas, the likelihood that they currently face mortal peril exceeds recommended parameters.
TEXT_BANOMI110_04616_STIGMA4_000_004: Please initiate your search immediately and aid the return of the two missing Grebuloffs. In the event they have been reduced to pieces, please collect and return accordingly.
TEXT_BANOMI110_04616_GREBULOFFA04616_000:
Oh, would you look how it shimmers and shines! Be still my quivering whiskers!
...Hm? Can I help you?
The others are looking for me? My apologies. So enraptured was I with this place, I completely lost track of time.

Glittering landmarks much like this one could once be seen in the waters of our home, but they carried a terrible sickness. I never dared to dream I might find anything so similar in a place such as this.
<sigh> Would that I could stay and behold its beauty a while longer, but as you say, my kin are worried. Another time, perhaps.
TEXT_BANOMI110_04616_GREBULOFFB04616_000: <grumble> <grumble> Oh, what I wouldn't do for something to eat...
TEXT_BANOMI110_04616_GREBULOFFB04616_100: Bwaaah! Who... What are you doing here?
TEXT_BANOMI110_04616_GREBULOFFB04616_000: I'm being called back home? But the Ea promised there would be food. It should be ready any moment now.

At least, that's what they told me. Yet no matter how long I wait, there has been nothing. <sigh> Perhaps I misunderstood when they invited me to join them in communal repast. I think I'll stop by the café on the way back, and eat something there.
TEXT_BANOMI110_04616_GREBULOFFC04616_000: I... <heave> I fear I've made a terrible mist─ <retch>
Return home? Gladly. Seeing the dragons partake of the water, I thought it safe enough for a quick swim, but I was wrong. So very, very wrong...
Well, I've given my stomach enough trouble for one day. I should be returning home. If you'll excuse me.
TEXT_BANOMI110_04616_GREBULOFFD04616_000: Hm? What brings you out here?
Oh, I... I didn't mean to make the others worry. I stumbled upon these remains, and couldn't help but think of our fallen kin...
Ahem. But now is not the time for sulking─it only serves to make the others worry. It was nice meeting you.
TEXT_BANOMI110_04616_GREBULOFFE04616_000: Hm...? Ah, my apologies. I was marveling at the craftsmanship of this place.
The others sent you to bring me home? Goodness, how long have I been away? It seems I lost track of time admiring all this metalwork.
Perhaps one of the service nodes at the café would be willing to tell me more about it.
TEXT_BANOMI110_04616_GREBULOFFF04616_000: Would you look at that eye? No doubt it keeps watch over everything in this space.
You came looking for me? Hopefully my absence hasn't caused too much of a stir. I was captivated by the giant eye there, and soon found myself lost in thought.
Fear not─when I return, I intend to work twice as hard to make up for my time spent here. We will make an Elysion worth watching, just wait and see.

TEXT_BANOMI112_04618_STIGMA4_000_020: Your timely delivery of goods has been noted and is appreciated. The Grebuloffs appeared satisfied to find sufficient fare when they arrived at the café.

TEXT_BANOMI115_04621_EAOMIA04621A_000_01: You must be the corporeal one I am to instruct. Very good─I would have you guide this Miw Miisv to administer electrotherapeutics upon two of my brethren whose rumination often takes them to Hollow of the Flesh.

Unadulterated lightning is quite striking, you know. The semifluidity of your form suggests a tendency towards parboiling, but you are nevertheless free to partake should you desire swift liberation from your mortal coil.
Did this child's movements overwhelm you? I do hope you make up in determination what your corporeal form so evidently lacks in coordination.
TEXT_BANOMI115_04621_EAOMIA04621B_000_02: If there were but stimuli strong enough to rouse me from this torpor...
TEXT_BANOMI115_04621_SYSTEM_100_020: Speak with the guardian Ea to mount the Miw Miisv and electrify intellectuals.
TEXT_BANOMI115_04621_EAOMIA04621B_000_02: My appendages tingle─my mind races! My thoughts transcend, I grasp the universe's innermost secrets...aaand they're gone. Profane exclamations!
Transcendence, woooooo! ...Ahem. I mean, of course, that you may proceed to anoint me with the stimuli.
TEXT_BANOMI115_04621_SYSTEM_100_022: Speak with the guardian Ea to mount the Miw Miisv and electrify intellectuals.
TEXT_BANOMI115_04621_EAOMIA04621B_000_02: Aaaaaaaaah! Cascades of revelation, oceans of understanding! The risk of dependency looms, but the mind wants what it wants!
...Ahem. Do pardon my outburst─although we no longer possess the nervous systems of mortal meat sacks, one's consciousness still craves the occasional refreshment.
But to think that similar impulses once coursed throughout our systems at the slightest movement... How delightfully primitive!
Yes, I believe we shall soon grasp the nature of our erstwhile selves with regular exposure to these sensations. Do come and stimulate me again.
TEXT_BANOMI115_04621_EAOMIA04621C_300_02: Pardon me, but I cannot but notice your current engulfment. Could you possibly facilitate the experience of “sensation”? My colleagues expound much upon its benefits, of late...
TEXT_BANOMI115_04621_SYSTEM_300_020: Speak with the guardian Ea to mount the Miw Miisv and electrify intellectuals.
TEXT_BANOMI115_04621_EAOMIA04621C_300_02: Th-This is it! The very pseudo-physical euphoria I have heard so much about!
At last, you return! My colleagues strive to surpass my comprehension─you must facilitate my stimulation at once.
TEXT_BANOMI115_04621_SYSTEM_400_022: Speak with the guardian Ea to mount the Miw Miisv and electrify intellectuals.
TEXT_BANOMI115_04621_EAOMIA04621C_300_02: My psyche tingles! My consciousness sings!

With this stimulation, I feel assured of my comprehension of “sensation”─yet one question still plagues my mind. If the classic corporeal creature spends its waking moments inundated by such perceptions, how does it manage to accomplish anything at all?

Already I am consumed by the urge to succumb to temptation once more... But no─I must not relinquish my rationality. I shall ensure that my colleagues recognize my superior understanding ere delving into the pleasures of the imagined flesh...
TEXT_BANOMI115_04621_STIGMA4_000_030: Return of  confirmed. Elevated levels of static electricity detected. Requesting summary of completed mission.
TEXT_BANOMI115_04621_STIGMA4_000_031: Verbal analysis complete. Subjects successfully achieved states of agitation and fleeting delusion of corporeal status by means of severe electrocution. Mission success.
TEXT_BANOMI115_04621_STIGMA4_000_032: Nicety protocol engaged. Well done, . Please accept this shiny recompense and lend your services to our cause once more.

TEXT_BANOMI116_04622_STIGMA4_000_002: Request accepted by flea-infested manager in reckless subversion of approved workflow. Café effort still recovering from resulting casualties of time and efficiency. Reasserting task-distribution authority...

TEXT_BANOMI116_04622_STIGMA4_000_006: Deliver the requested foodstuffs to the indicated Ea in Ostrakon Tria. Initiating encouragement sequence... Catering to the desires of local denizens furthers Last Dregs objectives. Enthusiasm is optional, but recommended.
TEXT_BANOMI116_04622_EA04622_000_007: Greetings, corporeal being. I am currently awaiting the arrival of materiel most crucial, so if you would leave me to my contemplation...
TEXT_BANOMI116_04622_EA04622_000_008: Greetings, corporeal being. I am currently awaiting the arrival of materiel most crucial.
TEXT_BANOMI116_04622_EA04622_000_009: Why, this is it precisely! You have done well to deliver it to me, cumbersomely burdened by a bone-house though you are.
TEXT_BANOMI116_04622_EA04622_000_010: I recently received word from my brethren who engaged in that sensory experimentation sponsored by your restaurant. An endeavor worthy of further inquiry, yet tragically reliant upon a third-party conduit.
TEXT_BANOMI116_04622_EA04622_000_011: It is for this reason I plan to cultivate a comparable gustatory organ─yes, just the single piece─into which I may insert the foodstuffs you have brought me and perform “tastings” at my leisure. Ingenious, do you not agree? Now, if you will excuse me, I have corporeal mass to grow...
TEXT_BANOMI116_04622_STIGMA4_000_012: Return of  confirmed. Expression assessed as “queasy.” Requesting supplementary information.
TEXT_BANOMI116_04622_STIGMA4_000_013: Verbal analysis complete. Burgeoning interest in foodstuffs amongst the Ea suggests a potential increase in patronage for the Last Dregs. Additionally, successful creation of artificial taste receptors is projected to create demand for food delivery, which aligns with overall objectives.
TEXT_BANOMI116_04622_STIGMA4_000_014: In comparison, 's queasiness is inconsequential. Shiny objects will be provided as a distraction from current digestive distress in the interest of maintaining morale.
TEXT_BANOMI117_04623_STIGMA4_000_001: Commencing summary of recent past... At the mangy manager's behest, recorded flavor profiles were uploaded to Omicron central command and summarily distributed to all units. Subsequent logs indicate that four out of five Omicrons would recommend the download of this data.
TEXT_BANOMI117_04623_STIGMA4_000_002: However, anomalous interest in flavor profiles regardless of utility has been detected in a single rogue unit. Upon downloading the relevant data, the unit independently assumed unapproved objectives, and was therefore scheduled for immediate termination in compliance with standard protocol.
TEXT_BANOMI117_04623_STIGMA4_000_003: In defiance of protocol, the mangy manager insists that support of the malfunctioning unit's independent research ultimately furthers the mission to “Live.” While the data is insufficient to support that conclusion, simulations indicate that compromise is preferable to retaliatory eradication.

TEXT_BANOMI118_04624_STIGMA4_000_012: Detecting depreciated levels of concentration. Pinpointing relevancy to ... Until pilots can be properly reconstructed, regular replenishment of energy stores will prove crucial to Last Dregs operations. Future requests for assistance are inevitable.

TEXT_BANOMI119_04625_STIGMA4_000_002: Obtain appropriate quantities of superior bivalve mollusks from the Elysian seas. Specimen selection has been optimized to suit client sensibilities. Refrain from selfish ingestion and deliver to the abode of the Ea.
TEXT_BANOMI119_04625_STIGMA4_000_003: Obtain appropriate quantities of superior flora inhabiting the Elysian seas. Specimen has been deemed sublime and therefore inappropriate for consumption by inferior life-forms. Restrain primitive urges to gorge and deliver to the abode of the Ea.
TEXT_BANOMI119_04625_STIGMA4_000_004: Capture the superior arthropod native to the Elysian seas. Unit N-0598 is available to relieve you of your currency in exchange for gold salmon roe. Please note that malicious ingestion or refusal to deliver item to the abode of the Ea may result in swift termination.
TEXT_BANOMI119_04625_EA04625_000_010: Well come, corporeal messenger. Have you the edible appurtenances I ordered?
TEXT_BANOMI119_04625_EA04625_000_011: Fascinating. I thank you for obtaining such intriguing victuals.
TEXT_BANOMI119_04625_EA04625_000_012: After hearing my brethren's account of the miracle shrimp experiment, I have taken to engaging in the semi-regular indulgence of such tantalizing stimuli.
TEXT_BANOMI119_04625_EA04625_000_013: Yet, with repeated exposure comes the deadening of pleasure, as that primitive maxim suggests. “Variety is the spice of life.” Indeed, your contribution is the proverbial spice that shall allay the monotony of my endless existence. I thank you...
TEXT_BANOMI119_04625_STIGMA4_000_020: Return of  confirmed. Complicated emotional state detected. Requesting additional information.
TEXT_BANOMI119_04625_STIGMA4_000_021:
Voice analysis complete. Mission success. Engaging experimental exaltation sequence to restore default emotional state... Fantastically achieved, ! Your presence is a beacon of light to this universe!
<beep>...Detecting errors. Aborting exaltation sequence.
TEXT_BANOMI119_04625_STIGMA4_000_022: Analysis suggests that providing sufficient variety for Ea with gustatory interest will require thousands of individual taste samples to be accumulated and codified. Recommending 's immediate and total recuperation of strength in light of future missions.
TEXT_BANOMI120_04626_STIGMA4_000_000: Initiating perfunctory explanation sequence... Since the inexplicable coalescence of the Miw Miisv, the Ea have fastidiously undertaken research and caretaking duties. Recently, they have requested suitable sustenance for the upkeep of their charges' corporeal forms.
TEXT_BANOMI120_04626_STIGMA4_000_001: However, the infantile nature of the Miw Miisv begets a necessity for emollient ministrations to be applied to said comestibles before consumption. Rapid blinking detected. Reiterating in layman's terms: the Miw Miisv are babies and thus require soft food.
TEXT_BANOMI120_04626_STIGMA4_000_002: A suitable organism has been located in Elysion for your convenience. Obtain worm-like fauna inhabiting the recreational areas. Softening protocol will commence upon delivery to the Last Dregs.
