TEXT_BANOMI120_04626_STIGMA4_000_021: Supplementary information regarding factors such as behavior and appropriate nourishment of Miw Miisv remains largely unavailable due to anomalous origin. However, limited data suggests multitudinous similarities between Ea and Miw Miisv.
TEXT_BANOMI120_04626_STIGMA4_000_022: Further demands of 's assistance deemed highly probable. Accept these compensatory objects and stand by for future orders.
TEXT_BANOMI121_04627_STIGMA4_000_000: Correspondence from Ea received. In adherence to updated nurturing protocols, acquisition and delivery of materials deemed “comfy” by organic life-forms has been requested.
TEXT_BANOMI121_04627_STIGMA4_000_001: Analyzing available resources... <meep> Viable material identified. Projections indicate 99.9842% compatibility with the tender epidermis of infantile Miw Miisv.
TEXT_BANOMI121_04627_STIGMA4_000_002: Imparting mission objectives: obtain appropriate amounts of clay from the recreational areas in Elysion and deliver it to the abode of the Ea, where a nanny awaits.

TEXT_BANOMI121_04627_STIGMA4_000_004: Imparting mission objectives: obtain coral from the recreational areas in Elysion and deliver it to the abode of the Ea, where a nanny awaits. A share of proceeds from the sale of gold salmon roe will be donated to further Miw Miisv nourishment.
TEXT_BANOMI121_04627_EA04627_000_010: You must be the fleshy one I ordered. Did you come complete with useful pieces?
TEXT_BANOMI121_04627_EA04627_000_011: Yes, yes...precisely what I had in mind! The corporeal frames of our children are ever so delicate, so I thought soft and natural environs might better attend to their physical needs.
TEXT_BANOMI121_04627_EA04627_000_012: I would have gathered the required materials myself, but lacking a body makes such labor quite impossible. Providing for progeny by the sweat of one's brow... Such is a life we can but barely remember. Anyway, I hope you will lend us your brow again sometime.
TEXT_BANOMI121_04627_STIGMA4_000_020: Return of  confirmed. Requesting additional information.
TEXT_BANOMI121_04627_STIGMA4_000_021: Verbal analysis complete. Satisfied nanny confirmed. Mission success.
TEXT_BANOMI121_04627_STIGMA4_000_022: The true nature of the Miw Miisv continues to elude comprehensive analysis. Satisfactory periods of stasis unattainable. Diverting Last Dregs resources to data acquisition protocols... Recommending  strengthen  own data acquisition protocols, regardless of relative insignificance.
TEXT_BANOMI122_04628_STIGMA4_000_000: Analysis of soft and gooey life-form Miw Miisv suggests that its capacity to emit an electrical charge will be extremely effective in the extermination of small invertebrates. This analysis has been performed for...reasons. Mission-critical reasons.
TEXT_BANOMI122_04628_STIGMA4_000_001: Reports indicate the dragons are regularly accosted by a swarm of buzzing arthropods of similar description. This presents a favorable opportunity to put the Miw Miisv's electrical manipulation capabilities to the test, while simultaneously expelling the aforementioned pests.
TEXT_BANOMI122_04628_STIGMA4_000_002: The successful incorporation of allied unit into the Miw Miisv's gelatinous flesh will be critical for the completion of objectives. Comply with the guidance of the advanced pest extermination unit in station Reah Tahra and destroy enemy arthropods without fail.
TEXT_BANOMI122_04628_WORKER04628_000_010: Bzzzt... Allied life-form recognized. Commencing mission briefing... <beep> The microscopic invertebrates pestering the dragons nest within rock cavities.
TEXT_BANOMI122_04628_WORKER04628_000_011: Allied life-form must assimilate itself into the Miw Miisv, head to the indicated coordinates, and emit an electrically charged blast to exterminate the hostile arthropods. Show no mercy.

Allied life-form must allow itself to be enveloped by the Miw Miisv, head to the indicated coordinates, and unleash an electrically charged blast to exterminate the hostile arthropods. Sooner than later.
TEXT_BANOMI122_04628_SYSTEM_000_013: Without the Miw Miisv and its Electric Flux, there is little you can do but look at this rocky outcrop. Speak with the advanced pest extermination unit to become enveloped in the entity's gooey goodness.
TEXT_BANOMI122_04628_SYSTEM_000_020: A host of repulsive insects still smoking from the electric blast crawl out from under the rocks. Though they struggle to creep forward, it is mere moments before their bodies grow entirely motionless.
TEXT_BANOMI122_04628_STIGMA4_000_030: Report received from on-the-ground extermination unit. Allied unit's performance has been rated as “excellent.”
TEXT_BANOMI122_04628_STIGMA4_000_031: Considerable reduction of irritability detected in dragons inhabiting Reah Tahra. Positive influence on area's dynamis anticipated.
TEXT_BANOMI122_04628_STIGMA4_000_032: Electrical manipulation capabilities displayed by the Miw Miisv have proven invaluable in completing today's objective. However, analysis will require additional extermination data. Your continued assistance in merciless annihilation would be most welcome.
TEXT_BANOMI123_04629_STIGMA4_000_000: According to an incomprehensible theory offered by the flea-ridden manager, draconic patronage remains below preferred levels due to the dark environment in which they live “dampening their spirits.”
TEXT_BANOMI123_04629_STIGMA4_000_001: As protocol requires compliance with management orders even when they are stupid, the furnishing of Reah Tahra with vibrant and colorful organisms must be duly coordinated. Allied unit, you shall be charged with delivering the specimens.
TEXT_BANOMI123_04629_STIGMA4_000_002: Procure a few clumps of bioluminescent rock moss from the Elysian fields, and deliver them to the advanced environmental stimulation unit in Reah Tahra.
TEXT_BANOMI123_04629_STIGMA4_000_003: Procure a number of lucent flowers from the Elysian fields, and deliver them to the advanced environmental stimulation unit in Reah Tahra.

TEXT_BANOMI123_04629_OMICRON04629_000_01: Bzzzt... Allied life-form detected. This unit is unable to confirm presence of requested items in your belongings. Immediate procurement of said items strongly encouraged.

Delivery of items confirmed. All appears to be in order. You may return to Stigma-4 for mission debriefing and compensation when ready.
TEXT_BANOMI123_04629_STIGMA4_000_020: Mission report from the advanced environmental stimulation unit has been received. Engaging monologue sequence to share results of analysis as an expression of appreciation for 's cooperation...
TEXT_BANOMI123_04629_STIGMA4_000_021: Invasion of the Dragonstar led to its eventual destruction. The barrens the dragons inhabit is a simulation born from that memory. Significant change in the environment is not expected at this stage, but outlook for positive shift in their sentiment has marginally increased.
TEXT_BANOMI123_04629_STIGMA4_000_022: Conclusion: this mission has no end in sight. Allied unit is requested to accept compensation for mission completion, and make its preparations to receive new orders.
TEXT_BANOMI124_04630_STIGMA4_000_000: Research is underway to develop a new menu for draconic patrons of the Last Dregs. At present, preliminary trials using resources available on Elysion are being performed to recreate the “taste of home” the dragons once enjoyed on their planet.
TEXT_BANOMI124_04630_STIGMA4_000_001: It has been proposed that an organic life-form's touch may aid in this effort, and for that reason, your services are requested. Receive the full mission briefing from the advanced culinary research unit stationed in the Elysion area dedicated to youth recreation.

Your mission is thus: procure samples of true dragon fruit from vegetation patches in the vicinity, and deliver them to present coordinates at maximum achievable speed.

TEXT_BANOMI124_04630_STIGMA4_000_030: The advanced culinary research unit sent communication of mission success. 's contribution was noted favorably.
TEXT_BANOMI124_04630_STIGMA4_000_031: Current evaluation of the difficulty of mission to recreate comestibles native to the Dragonstar remains high at present, but within realistic boundaries nonetheless. Further analysis of available culinary methods necessary.
TEXT_BANOMI124_04630_STIGMA4_000_032: Additional problems are anticipated. The dragons' prodigious size necessitates that a sustainable means of amassing enough provisions to satisfy their appetite be determined. Research and development of aquaculture done in parallel may prove a promising solution...
TEXT_BANOMI125_04631_STIGMA4_000_001: The hirsute proprietor of the Last Dregs has decreed the dragons residing in Ostrakon Deka-okto be offered rudimentary tools for grooming─“gifts,” in its words─as a “gesture of kindness.”
TEXT_BANOMI125_04631_STIGMA4_000_002: The obstinate and prickly proprietor was advised the tools be synthetically recreated to no avail. It has instead been decided the implements be inferior substitutes of organic origin, as that would somehow be “more genuine.” Hence, the allied unit's services are required.
TEXT_BANOMI125_04631_STIGMA4_000_003: Further elucidation deemed unnecessary. Mission initiation requested. Proceed to Elysion and secure precisely three whetstones from rock formations in the recreational areas. Then, make your way to Reah Tahra, where you may offer the items to the saddest dragon you can find.
TEXT_BANOMI125_04631_STIGMA4_000_004: Further elucidation deemed unnecessary. Mission initiation requested. Proceed to Elysion and secure plants with an objectively soft and fluffy texture from the recreational areas. Then, make your way to Reah Tahra, where you may offer the items to the saddest dragon you can find.
TEXT_BANOMI125_04631_STIGMA4_000_005: Further elucidation deemed unnecessary. Mission initiation requested. Proceed to Elysion and secure a single clump of astral algae from water holes located within the recreational areas. Use of gold salmon roe in its retrieval recommended.
TEXT_BANOMI125_04631_STIGMA4_000_006: After procuring said item, you are to deliver it to the saddest dragon you can find in Reah Tahra.
TEXT_BANOMI125_04631_DRAGON04631_000_007: Little one... Why hast thou come? I wish to be left in peace, that I may continue to reminisce upon the days of old...
TEXT_BANOMI125_04631_DRAGON04631_000_008: Little one... Art thou an ally of the strangely attired rabbit? It appeared before me not long ago, insisting it wished to offer me a gift...
TEXT_BANOMI125_04631_DRAGON04631_000_009: Why hast thou presented me with this rough rock?
TEXT_BANOMI125_04631_DRAGON04631_000_010: A most peculiar plant...what is it for?
TEXT_BANOMI125_04631_DRAGON04631_000_011: Soft flora indeed...but I do not understand thine intent in presenting it to me.
TEXT_BANOMI125_04631_DRAGON04631_000_012: Thou wouldst gift me mementos of the Dragonstar? Hmm. Perhaps if I squint, I shall see some resemblance...
TEXT_BANOMI125_04631_DRAGON04631_000_013: Regardless, 'tis heartening to know that some would remember us, even now. I thank thee and thine for the sentiment.
TEXT_BANOMI125_04631_STIGMA4_000_014: Allied unit has returned unscathed in spite of anticipated mission failure. Requesting full report.
TEXT_BANOMI125_04631_STIGMA4_000_015: The dragon expressed...gratitude? Preposterous. Projections indicated cataclysmic results.
TEXT_BANOMI125_04631_STIGMA4_000_016: Reassessment of annoying proprietor's intelligence will be necessary. Commencing reevaluation...<bleep> Fatal error detected. Process terminated.
TEXT_BANOMI126_04632_STIGMA4_100_001: In the leporid proprietor's dubious wisdom, it has been decided that teeth polishing tools are to be supplied for maintenance of the oral cavities of draconic clientele, and incorporated into a new service offered to café patrons.
TEXT_BANOMI126_04632_STIGMA4_100_002: Determining suitable matter to fulfill this purpose requires an extensive search covering billions of entries across thousands of databases...a trifling task. Material located.
TEXT_BANOMI126_04632_STIGMA4_100_005: Allied unit  is hereby requested to relocate to the Elysian seas, where it may procure porous stones from rocky outcrops in the vicinity.
TEXT_BANOMI126_04632_STIGMA4_100_006: Allied unit  is hereby requested to relocate to the Elysian seas, where it may procure suitably fibrous kelp from vegetation patches in the vicinity.
TEXT_BANOMI126_04632_STIGMA4_100_007: Allied unit  is hereby requested to relocate to the Elysian seas, where it may procure helpless spongy life-forms. Use of gold salmon roe as a lure is projected to be effective.
TEXT_BANOMI126_04632_STIGMA4_100_008: Samples may be delivered to the advanced dental polishing unit stationed in Reah Tahra, which will fabricate them into tools and perform experimental teeth maintenance. Your swift completion of objectives is appreciated.
TEXT_BANOMI126_04632_OMICRON04634_100_00: <whirr> Once requested samples have been converted into tools, this unit will approach the nearest dragon, demand the unclenching of said dragon's jaw, and proceed to climb inside of its mouth to perform extensive teeth polishing. Estimated chances of survival: less than one percent.
TEXT_BANOMI126_04632_OMICRON04634_100_01: <whirr> Once requested samples have been converted into tools, this unit will approach a nearby dragon, demand the unclenching of said dragon's jaw, and proceed to climb inside of its mouth to perform extensive teeth polishing. Estimated chances of survival: less than one percent.
Initializing material conversion process... This unit will now transition to dental polishing protocols to carry out its mission. Good-bye, allied life-form...
TEXT_BANOMI126_04632_STIGMA4_100_012: Return of allied unit  acknowledged. Your contribution to the universe's aggregate dental hygiene levels is greatly appreciated. Initializing gratitude monologue...
TEXT_BANOMI126_04632_STIGMA4_100_013: ...Review of records of conflict on the Dragonstar indicate dragons maintained oral hygiene by masticating on rocks and similar objects. Necessity of a dental polishing service now brought into question.
TEXT_BANOMI126_04632_STIGMA4_100_014: Nevertheless, there is a non-zero possibility of positive reception by café patrons. Production of specialized teeth cleaning drones added to queue, with trial runs to ensue. Allied unit's continued cooperation remains categorized as “necessary.”
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_STIGMA4_000_001: Communication from the Ea residing in Ostrakon Tria received. Word has spread of 's use as a flesh medium for sensory perception data, ergo additional non-corporeal entities now desire a demonstration.
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_STIGMA4_000_002: This experience could easily be achieved by visiting the café. Preliminary calculations, however, suggest that appeasing them with a trial in their colony will prove an effective means of publicity for the Last Dregs.
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_STIGMA4_000_003: You are responsible for reintroducing the thought entities to the notion of gustatory stimuli, and it is therefore your responsibility to acquiesce to their demands. Visit the abode of the Ea and make contact with the itinerant server unit at your earliest convenience.
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_EAOMI04633_000_010: Ah, you must be our fleshy medium for the demonstration. I am eager to discover what sensations this gustatory experience will entail!
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_OMICRON04633_000_01: Bzzzt... Visual confirmation of allied unit 's arrival. Preparations for the demonstration are complete.
Please begin consumption of one of the three available organic substances. Now initializing scan of allied life-form's gustatory inputs...
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_A1_000_001: The potentially metaphorical single slice of bread.
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_A1_000_003: The low-grade choking hazard of an extra-sticky rice ball.
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_EAOMI04633_000_014: Oh my, it's begun! Look at how the poor, fleshy thing is forced to fill its oral cavity with the organic foodstuff, using its lingual nerve to collect flavor as it masticates matter with its teeth! Then, the finale...deglutition. How messy! How troublesome! How primitive!
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_OMICRON04633_000_01: Gustatory data received. Awaiting command to transmit data to the inexplicably narrating life-form.
Gustatory data received. Awaiting command to transmit data to the inexplicably narrating life-form.
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_EAOMI04633_000_020: Yes, yes, give me the data! Shock my senses, I beg you!
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_EAOMI04633_000_022: Oh... Oh my! What is this sensation─this signal from a phantom organ I do not possess? How wonderfully bizarre!
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_EAOMI04633_000_023: Yes, yes, I am confident what you consumed was the kneaded and baked result of finely powdered grain. “Why not simply ingest the grain in its original state,” I pondered, but my proverbial eyes have been opened! Not only does it have a uniquely satisfying mild flavor, but an unbelievably soft texture too!
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_EAOMI04633_000_024: Invigorating flavors of acidity and sweetness wash over me─the firm, succulent texture of the victual immovable from the forefront of my mind. So this is what fruit tastes like... Who would have thought the reproductive body of a seed could have such a rich flavor?
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_EAOMI04633_000_025: Setting aside the curious decision to shape it into a ballistic, this pale grain is more flavorsome than it has any right to be. So soft as to be nearly viscous, so starchy as to be nearly sweet...
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_EAOMI04633_000_026: I now understand that fleshy ones do not consume organic substances strictly out of nutritional necessity, but for stimulation such as this. How altogether fascinating...indeed, I must see this café for myself!
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_OMICRON04633_000_02: Departure of screeching non-corporeal entity confirmed. This unit will return to its duties at the Last Dregs, where countless such beings doubtless await. Allied unit is encouraged to return to A-4 Research for mission debriefing.
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_STIGMA4_000_030: Return of allied unit recognized. Requesting full mission report.
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_STIGMA4_000_031: Congratulations on your successful ingestion. Though this outcome was expected, it is also desirable. Guerrilla demonstration will be logged as an effective means of encouraging interest in sensory perception.
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_STIGMA4_000_032: It is fortunate that a number of Ea were present during your execution of objectives. Due to their lack of physical form as well as conditional operating protocols, luring them to the Last Dregs has been surpassingly difficult, even for tactical specialists.
TEXT_BANOMI127_04633_STIGMA4_000_033: However, those who watched this demonstration from afar may choose to participate in the future. Should the opportunity present itself to carry out a similar operation, your services will be required once more.
TEXT_BANOMI128_04634_STIGMA4_100_001: A crucial component of expanding the Last Dregs' customer base is to improve the overall sentiment of the inhabitants of Ultima Thule, starting with their surrounding environment. Notably, Ostrakon Deka-okto, the area in which the dragons dwell, has considerable soil contamination.
TEXT_BANOMI128_04634_STIGMA4_100_002: Scans indicate that there may be substances with a minuscule chance of counteracting such contamination on Elysion.
TEXT_BANOMI128_04634_STIGMA4_100_003: Allied unit  is therefore requested to procure samples of metalsand from the zones dedicated to unproductive dithering─in a timely fashion. You are not to join in the dithering.
TEXT_BANOMI128_04634_STIGMA4_100_004: Allied unit is therefore requested to procure samples of Elysian herbs from the zones dedicated to unproductive dithering─in a timely fashion. You are not to join in the dithering.
TEXT_BANOMI128_04634_STIGMA4_100_005: Allied unit is therefore requested to procure a piscatory sample from the zones dedicated to unproductive dithering─in a timely fashion. You are not to join in the dithering. For maximum efficiency, use of gold salmon roe as bait is advised.
TEXT_BANOMI128_04634_STIGMA4_100_006: The target was produced by alien technology, and has not yet been analyzed sufficiently to enable replication. The sooner you collect it, the sooner the soil purification unit can begin synthesizing a compound and provide valuable data.
TEXT_BANOMI128_04634_OMICRON04632_100_00: <whirr> Program for purification of soil contamination has halted at 5.29% progress. Standing by for procurement of necessary samples.
<whirr> Awaiting distribution of the requested samples in accordance with commands for the soil purification program.

<ping> Acknowledging receipt of samples. This unit will begin analyzing composition of retrieved specimens and initialize sequence for generation of remedial substances. Allied life-form should return to Stigma-4 for mission debriefing and compensation.
TEXT_BANOMI128_04634_STIGMA4_100_010: Transmissions from soil purification unit confirm the delivery of requested samples. Allied unit is commended for successful completion of objectives.
TEXT_BANOMI128_04634_STIGMA4_100_011: However, the degree to which the synthesized compound can purify the soil remains surpassingly small, and the current methodology's labor productivity is entirely unacceptable. The logical response would be to scrap the program in its entirety.
TEXT_BANOMI128_04634_STIGMA4_100_012: Unfortunately for the efficiency of our operation, the flea-bitten proprietor disagrees. Allied unit is urged to stand by, as projections indicate its services will be needed again in the near future...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_000: , my friend! My chum, my pal, my old earthen flatware... How delighted I am to finally, finally see you again!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_003: Phew! You had me worried for a moment there, with how your eyes glazed over like that...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_004: Why, I am the Way whom you helped to find his way─Dreamingway!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_100_004: I knew we'd get there eventually!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_005: In any case, I am truly glad to have found you at last. Etheirys is quite a bit larger than one anticipates, isn't it?
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_007: And it is ever so intact. A touch of widespread destruction, yes, but you and your friends did a remarkable job of saving it.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_008: I can see why you prefer to stay, really I do...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_009: ...But you must understand, you've left a fair few of my fellow Loporrits in a bind.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_010: Their sole purpose in life was to prepare the moon for mankind, and now that you're not coming... Well, they're depressed. Not to mention bored!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_011: I know what that's like. To while away the days drifting from one dull task to another, occasionally bumping into walls...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_012: You managed to set me to rights, though. My days of listlessness are over, and I'm happier pursuing music than ever I was before! So I wondered...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_014: Could you not help my fellow Loporrits as you helped me? Not all by yourself, of course─I promise that I'll be there every hop, skip, and jump of the way!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_016: It would be best if you met the Loporrits in question yourself, so please join me in Bestways Burrow as soon as you are able.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_017: Thank you! They're in a sorry state at the moment, but surely we can find some way to help...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_021: Now that you're here, you've likely noticed that some of the other Loporrits seem a bit...floppy. Perhaps if you speak with them, you can get a clearer understanding of their plight.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_023: Once you're done, we shall formulate a plan of action forthwith!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_024: Do you see what I mean about the others? They're like carrots with the juice sucked out!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LOPORRITA04681_000_: Why do I seem so sad? Oh, I don't know, perhaps because my entire life's work was all for naught? What a question...
Yes, a few representatives from Etheirys have come to visit Livingway's new archive, but it's not the same!
The moon was supposed to be hustling─bustling, even─with people, who would all live happily ever after in our wondrous residential facilities.
But not a single one of you has moved in...
What's so wrong with moon living, huh!?
We worked so hard to make sure you would be comfortable here, and it's gone entirely to waste.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LOPORRITB04681_000_: To think my carrots will ever remain untasted by mankind...
And what of the Loporrits? Day in, day out, we eat carrots, we grow carrots, we eat carrots again...
...It's as if the carrots are growing us. Was this their plot all along!?
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LOPORRITC04681_000_: You know those days that simply feel bad? When the carrots taste bland, and nothing sounds like fun, and you don't want to talk to your friends even though they're right here...
Well, all of my days are those days...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LOPORRITA04681_000_: Is dusty old Sharlayan that much better than the moon? Is it!?
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LOPORRITB04681_000_: I'm trapped... Trapped in a vicious carrot-based cycle...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LOPORRITC04681_000_: Maybe I'll take a nap. Again.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LOPORRITA04681_000_: Do you want to live here? No, I didn't think so...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_060: I see from your face that you've met some of our wayward Ways. Depressing, isn't it?
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_061: I wish I knew how to bring them out of the doldrums. Did you have any ideas?
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_A2_000_001: Perhaps they can yet find new dreams of their own.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_A2_000_002: Why not start by telling them of your dream?
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_062: New dreams! Why, I cannot believe I hadn't thought of that myself!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_063: You mean the one about the carrots the size of starships, or─ Oh! My dream.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_064: If each of my fellows had their own dream to guide them, they would be cured of their melancholy as surely as I was!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_068: Of course, finding one's dream is easier said than done...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_069: Perhaps we can help them on their respective ways by introducing the myriad options available. It took significant trial and error in my case, after all.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_070: If we gather the Loporrits who already have dreams together in a centralized location, that should make for a decent start.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_071: We simply show my listless fellows the fun to be had in various pursuits, and─BAM!─they'll be struck with inspiration so hard that we'll have to carry them out on stretchers.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_072: An operation of this scale will require permission from Livingway, though...and I am but one of the frankly excessive number of Loporrits under her authority. As she often reminds us, our passing whims must be processed in the order they are received.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_073: Your whims, on the other paw, are practically the whims of Etheirys itself, and would be prioritized accordingly! You'll lend your support to my petition, won't you?
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_100_080: It's her! Quickly, put on your best “person of Etheirys with high hopes for the future” face!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LIVINGWAY_110_080: Why, ! What a pleasure to see you. May I say that you're looking especially person-like today?
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LIVINGWAY_000_080: And Dreamingway besides! Is there something I can assist you with? I have yet to find a willing instructor in the Ishgardian horn, I'm afraid...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_081: Oh, no, um... That is to say, you will have doubtless noticed that many a Loporrit's fur is looking less than sleek lately. As to what can be done about it...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LIVINGWAY_000_083: I see... I have been grappling with the selfsame concern. Large though projects like the Excitatron are, they are simply insufficient to occupy everyone here.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LIVINGWAY_000_085: So I say─why not? We have the whole moon at our disposal, and there's no reason a small portion of it should not be dedicated to Loporrit enrichment.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LIVINGWAY_000_087: I even know a few folks who I am certain would be willing to share their dreams. Wait just a moment...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LIVINGWAY_000_089: First, allow me to introduce Coiningway. They have a zest for monetary matters big and small, and dream of minting their own currency.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LIVINGWAY_000_090: Though your venue will primarily be a marketplace of dreams, you shall doubtless require a more tangible system to ensure that your collaborators are compensated fairly.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_COININGWAY_000_091: That, I daresay, is where I come in! Rest assured that your participation in my experimental market will be invaluable in proving the moon's viability as an economic power.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LIVINGWAY_000_092: ...Managingway here will also be happy to join you. They were responsible for determining the layout of our facilities, delineating development projects, ensuring goals were met by each work division, and other such administrative matters.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LIVINGWAY_000_093: Unfortunately, with the exodus canceled, much of their work has dried up, and it has been...difficult to find another suitable outlet for their enthusiasm.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_000_094: According to my projections, each and every stage of this project must needs be strictly scheduled in order to meet target metrics. Would you like to see my charts?
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_095: Oooh, charts! How fortunate we are to be working with true experts in...whatever it was that you said.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_100_096: As well as , of course! You will be staying, I hope?
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_097: There is no greater expert in helping Loporrits find their dreams than you. Even should we scour the moon─nay, the universe─
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_110_097: We will require a skilled artisan if we are to meet our goals. My files indicate that you have significant experience in this area?
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_120_097: I have already added your name to the list of staff. It would be disruptive to remove it now, so I too must ask for your cooperation.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_098: Phew! I feel much better knowing you will be here to help.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_099: Of course you do! Who do you think you are?
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_100: W-Wait! You mean to say that you won't help us?
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_101: B-B-B-B-But what about everyone's dreams? And hopes? And hopeful dreams? Certainly you could spare a moment or two?
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_100_101: Phew! I feel much better knowing you will be here to help.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LIVINGWAY_100_102: Do try to avoid causing  undue trouble, yes?
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LIVINGWAY_000_102: Now, I have taken the liberty of designating a space for your activities.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LIVINGWAY_000_103: Just beyond that door is a room to which we never assigned a real purpose. We've been using it for storage, but no one will be terribly put out if you use it as your venue.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_105: I cannot thank you enough, Livingway!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_106: I suppose the best way to show my gratitude will be to put that room─and my staff here─to good use. Come along, everyone!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LIVINGWAY_000_107: I fear they know not what trials lie in wait. One trial, in particular... <sigh> What ever shall we do with our most wayward Way?
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_000_108: There, there, and... Yes, that layout will allow us to maximize efficiency...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_COININGWAY_000_109: I must say, I was expecting a glorified closet, but this location is not half bad.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_SUPPORTER_000_110: <blip> Greetings! This supporter has been programmed to assist with dreaming-related needs. Today's automatically generated suggestion is: Chocobo Jousting!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_120: I didn't think it was possible to dream any bigger than I already have, but look at this place!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_121: It still needs a lot of work before we can open to the dreamless public, however, so without further ado...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_000_123: Before we begin to build, it is vital that we clarify our vision to ensure unity of purpose and stoke the flames of motivation. Otherwise, we shall find ourselves giving up halfway through─or worse, executing inefficient processes.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_124: I...see? In that case, I suppose my vision is to build a stage for musical performances. That is my dream, after all.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_COININGWAY_000_126: We will also require a commercial area wherein my new currency can change paws. I imagine we might procure a variety of merchandise as well.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_COININGWAY_000_127: Then I assume you will take care of the more tedious labor. Meanwhile, I shall be polishing my currency and meditating upon the finer points of value determination. I can scarcely wait to begin pricing!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_000_128: As far as labor is concerned, I am happy to contract Buildingway's services. The construction systems at his disposal should see our tasks carried out that much the swifter.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_000_134: That said, the components we use in our construction efforts will greatly benefit from a master crafts's touch. , that is to be your responsibility.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_110_134: I like your attitude, ! I can see that you'll go far here.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_000_135: For the moment, you should focus on creating metal components for Dreamingway's stage. It is vital that we prevent any wibbling, wobbling, or outright collapse.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_000_136: For the moment, you should focus on creating components for the frame of Dreamingway's stage. It is vital that we prevent any wibbling, wobbling, or outright collapse.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_000_137: For the moment, you should focus on creating varnish for Dreamingway's stage. It is vital that we prevent errant splinters from hindering our performers' potential. Do mind the aesthetics as well.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_000_138: I have taken charge of our inventory, so you need only deliver the fruits of your labor to me.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_000_139: That should be everything you need, but if you require additional raw materials, you will find this dreaming supporter fully stocked!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_000_140: Please consult the dreaming supporter if you require raw materials. Now, where was I...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_000_141: Please consult the dreaming supporter if you require raw materials. Now, where was I...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_000_142: Please consult the dreaming supporter if you require raw materials. Now, where was I...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_SUPPORTER_000_143: Thank you for your materials request! <blip> Oh dear! It appears that the necessary supplies are in your possession. Project management requires that all materials be used before more are provided.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_SUPPORTER_000_144: Thank you for your materials request! <blip> Oh dear! It appears that the necessary supplies are in your possession. Project management requires that all materials be used before more are provided.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_SUPPORTER_000_145: Thank you for your materials request! <blip> Oh dear! It appears that the necessary supplies are in your possession. Project management requires that all materials be used before more are provided.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_SUPPORTER_000_146: Thank you for your materials request! <blip> Here you are─happy laboring!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_SUPPORTER_000_147: Thank you for your materials request! <blip> Here you are─happy laboring!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_SUPPORTER_000_148: Thank you for your materials request! <blip> Here you are─happy laboring!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_149: Oh, I can scarcely wait to see our new stage!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_COININGWAY_100_149: Please leave the matter of our currency to me. I assure you it will be worth its weight in gold.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_000_151: These are precisely what I asked for! Well done, .
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_000_152: Now, for liability reasons, I must ask you to wait here during construction. Pray give us a few moments to activate the building systems.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_160: Behold! The stage of my dreams, from which we shall share the joys of music with all of Loporrit-kind!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_161: Impressive, is it not? Even more so when we...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_163: I wrote this one myself! Doesn't it make you want to hippity hop?
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_000_164: Frankly, you've exceeded my expectations. Rarely is the first stage of a project such a success.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_COININGWAY_000_165: Allow me to draw your attention to the shopping station. When you are handsomely rewarded with my original Loporrit carats, you will doubtless enjoy spending them here.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_000_166: You've certainly outdone yourself. Though I still have my doubts as to whether you'll find anyone to purchase that slide.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_COININGWAY_000_167: But wait─there's more! If you will kindly follow me...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_COININGWAY_000_168: Naught bespeaks a well-run organization with plentiful financial returns like uniforms!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_MANAGINGWAY_000_169: I do feel rather more official now. These shirts should keep our mutual goals at the forefront of our minds.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_COININGWAY_000_170: A friend mentioned to me that the bards and musicians of Etheirys often don peculiar accessories, so the glasses seemed appropriate for Dreamingway. And now we can locate our leader at a distance!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_171: Thank you, Coiningway! They do lend a certain weight, possibly of expectation. I will do my utmost not to disappoint!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LOPORRIT04681_000_1: Pardon me, but what is this place? I couldn't help but follow the music, and before I knew what was happening, I had hopped all the way here!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_173: This, my friend, is a workshop─the workshop of dreams!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_174: Hm, that does have a nice ring to it, doesn't it? Almost...musical. In any case, feel free to stay for as long as you like!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_LOPORRIT04681_000_1: Where...am I? Everyone looks so...happy. Am I allowed to join in? Oh, I wish someone could tell me what to do...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_177: I do hope they find their way. Surely there's a dream out there for everybody...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_178: Thank you for helping to make mine a reality.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_DREAMINGWAY_000_179: But we're just getting started! There are still plenty of dreams out there to make space for, and Loporrits to lure into our helpful clutches!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_TALKINGWAY_000_181: (-???-)What is this ruckus? Can't they just be quiet? Hopping around like fools won't change anything one whit...
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_SYSTEM_000_182: Dreamingway's Dreaming Workshop is now open to the public! Patrons can dance the night away at the musicking station, or shop until they flop at the shopping station.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_SYSTEM_100_182: There is much yet to be done, however, if each Loporrit is to find new purpose. Continue expanding the workshop to see what dreams may come!
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_SYSTEM_000_183: You have achieved Friendly reputation with the Dreaming Ways.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_SYSTEM_000_184: Loporrit society quests are now available from Managingway in Hoper's Hold.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_SYSTEM_000_185: Furthermore, you may now purchase wares from Coiningway.
TEXT_BANLOP001_04681_SYSTEM_000_186: For your convenience, the Loporrits have linked the teleportation portal in the Dreaming Workshop to one near the aetheryte in Bestways Burrow.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_000: Our musicking station is a rousing success! I must admit that I understand less than half of what Coiningway says about the circulation of carats, but they seem rather pleased with the shopping station's results as well.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_001: I do wish we had more dreams on offer, however. This cannot possibly be enough to satisfy every Loporrit's needs.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_MANAGINGWAY_000_008: I believe I know a Loporrit who can help.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_009: A Loporrit with a vision─nay, a dream!?
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_MANAGINGWAY_000_010: Just so. She adores fixing all manner of things, whether they need it or not. You may have some difficulty convincing her to set up a station here, however.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_012: Surely we can convince her if we try! What's her name?
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_MANAGINGWAY_000_014: Repairingway. She's been rather fixated on the machines in Greatest Endsvale of late, so I shouldn't be surprised to find her there.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_015: In that case, let us sally forth forthwith!
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_016: ...And by “us,” I of course mean you and me, ! We require your powers of persuasion as a person of Etheirys.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_017: Oooh, that is one dilapidated supporter! We must have found the right Loporrit.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_REPAIRINGWAY_000_02: That I am. And you are...?
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_022: I'm Dreamingway, and this is the illustrious ! We're here to invite you to join a project of utmost import.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_REPAIRINGWAY_000_02: Oh? And what would that be?
...Yes, I can see why that problem sorely needs fixing. I can't reach half the mechanisms in Bestways Burrow for melancholy Loporrits draping themselves about.

Even so, my paws are quite full, I'm afraid. Should I be derelict in my repair duties, we'll be even shorter on supporters than we already are. Or the moon will go flying off into the great expanse, and then where would we be?
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_026: Good point. I should hate to inconvenience everyone by hurling us out into the cosmos...
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_REPAIRINGWAY_000_02: I can recommend someone with similar talents, however. His name is Inventingway, and he is quite mechanically inclined.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_028: And you think he would be willing to assist?
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_REPAIRINGWAY_000_02: Oh my, yes. He has been more than happy to help in the past. I would call upon him more often, in fact, if only his repairs weren't so...experimental.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_REPAIRINGWAY_000_03: In any case, you need only say that your project will allow him to work with machines, and he shall doubtless agree without any further consideration.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_REPAIRINGWAY_100_03: I'm certain he would be happier experimenting freely in your workshop than operating within the confines of practicality out here.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_REPAIRINGWAY_000_03: Why, just the other day I asked him to repair one of our carrot creation stations, and next I knew, the thing had sprouted limbs and was dancing about to “improve sprinkler efficacy”...
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_032: He certainly sounds like my kind of Loporrit! Do you know where we might find him now?
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_REPAIRINGWAY_000_03: To the north of here, perhaps? I've noticed that he enjoys gazing out upon the machinery while he considers his next harebrained schematic.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_034: Thank you ever so much for your assistance! Oh, and best of luck with the repairs.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_INVENTINGWAY_000_03: (A potential client...? Be calm, Inventingway. Temper your enthusiasm. Temper...it... <wheeze>)
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_REPAIRINGWAY_000_03: I do hope Inventingway finds his place with you. He means well, I'm relatively certain.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_INVENTINGWAY_000_04: Wh-Who's asking!? ...That is to say, how may I help you?
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_042: Repairingway told us that you might be willing to join us in Hoper's Hold. You see...
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_INVENTINGWAY_000_04: Sweet Mother Hydaelyn! I thought you were here with a repair job, but you're saying that I can make any machine I dream up?
Anything I can dream of, huh...
This is the greatest day of my life!!!
...That is to say, I would be delighted to join you. I enjoy working on machines a normal amount!
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_INVENTINGWAY_100_04: It was I who invented the supporters, in fact. Granted, I didn't anticipate that your people would turn out to be so small, which inevitably resulted in the supporters identifying them as unauthorized organisms and initializing their “murderous rampage” sequences...
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_INVENTINGWAY_000_04: ...But I wanted to fix that! If I had been given the chance, I know I could have. Project management, though, wanted to “go another way.”
Repairingway's offered a few odd jobs to keep me occupied while I look for a new role, but I think my innovative take on carrot cultivation may have been the last straw...
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_INVENTINGWAY_000_05: Which is why I am truly grateful for a position where I can be myself! How can I possibly thank you, er...
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_053: Dreamingway! And no thanks necessary─I only hope you'll do your best to share your dream with our fellow Loporrits.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_INVENTINGWAY_000_05: You bet I will! I'll share like no one has ever shared before, and then they'll see! They'll all see!
...That is to say, I look forward to working with you. I have a number of large projects in mind, so I may bring along a few friends with time on their paws, and...
Where ever am I going to find a pneumatic saw? All my best tools were reappropriated when I was dismissed from my position...
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_058: Why don't you come back to the Dreaming Workshop and discuss it with Managingway? They have a way of finding what we need.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_INVENTINGWAY_000_05: That's good, because I need a great many things.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_060: We'll be setting up a whole new station, so please come and find us in Hoper's Hold when you have a chance.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_INVENTINGWAY_000_06: Bugger me! And here I always thought this was a closet!
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_SUPPORTER_000_062: Greetings! If you require direction, please speak with Dreamingway. <blip> Today's automatically generated suggestion is: Crater Sledding!
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_070: Welcome back! As expected, Managingway turned Inventingway's requests into a tidy and particular list, then hopped off to oversee their procurement.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_071: They did mention something that they would like you to prepare. Er, what was it again...?
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_072: Ah, yes! “Ahem! Tools suitable for tuning machines large and small. Extra durable, in case Inventingway's enthusiasm gets the best of him.”
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_073: Ah, yes! “Ahem! Insulation suitable for preventing any unwanted shocks or conflagrations.”
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_074: Ah, yes! “Ahem! Machine oil that passing Loporrits will not mistake for a refreshing beverage.”
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_075: That seems simple enough, doesn't it? They even provided the necessary materials.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_076: If you run out, of course, feel free to ask the dreaming supporter for more!
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_077: We stocked the dreaming supporter with extra supplies, but please do take only as much as you need. Coiningway says our budget margins are rather starved at present, the poor things.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_078: We stocked the dreaming supporter with extra supplies, but please do take only as much as you need. Coiningway says our budget margins are rather starved at present, the poor things.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_007: We stocked the dreaming supporter with extra supplies, but please do take only as much as you need. Coiningway says our budget margins are rather starved at present, the poor things.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_SUPPORTER_000_080: Thank you for your materials request! <blip> Oh dear! It appears that sufficient supplies are in your possession. Project management gently reminds you that all materials must be used before more are provided.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_SUPPORTER_000_081: Thank you for your materials request! <blip> Oh dear! It appears that sufficient supplies are in your possession. Project management gently reminds you that all materials must be used before more are provided.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_SUPPORTER_000_082: Thank you for your materials request! <blip> Oh dear! It appears that sufficient supplies are in your possession. Project management gently reminds you that all materials must be used before more are provided.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_SUPPORTER_000_083: Thank you for your materials request! <blip> Here you are─may all your digits remain intact!
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_SUPPORTER_000_084: Thank you for your materials request! <blip> Here you are─may all your digits remain intact!
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_SUPPORTER_000_085: Thank you for your materials request! <blip> Here you are─may all your digits remain intact!
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_090: I do hope you enjoyed crafting those items! If you're satisfied with what you've made, I can take them off your paws.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_091: Good heavens, such fine quality! Have you ever thought about changing your name to “Craftingway”?
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_092: I'll leave you to think about that while I get Inventingway set up. No doubt he is itching to astound us with his creations!
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_100: Oooh, I'm astounded! Also confounded─but mostly astounded!
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_INVENTINGWAY_000_10: Rest assured that this was merely the warm-up before the sprint! Ah, my mind races with ideas...
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_MANAGINGWAY_000_102: They certainly are...unique. I daresay even I would struggle to find a use for most of these─but as we never specified you do aught but live your dream, I suppose it's only fair to rate your performance “above average.”
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_INVENTINGWAY_000_10: And here they come─my disciples! Gaze upon these machines and let the inspiration flow through you!
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_MANAGINGWAY_000_104: Welcome to the Dreaming Workshop! If anyone would like to try their paw at the dreams we have on display, please do inquire about our free trials!
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_TALKINGWAY_000_105: (-???-)And now useless machines. Is it not enough that we have no use ourselves?
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_TALKINGWAY_000_106: (-???-)Hmmm... If I can use this ironic display to demonstrate the depths of our irrelevance, my petition to reactivate the hibernation stations may at last be approved.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_TALKINGWAY_000_107: (-???-)...Struggle to your hearts' content, my friends. Show us the meaning of futility.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_109: Someone who's not interested in the machining station, it seems. But we have plenty of Loporrits who are, and that's what matters!
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_DREAMINGWAY_000_110: If we continue to draw such enthusiastic crowds to each station we build, everyone will have their own dream in no time!
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_SYSTEM_000_111: The Dreaming Workshop is now home to a brand-new machining station, and many technological wonders besides. There is much yet to be done, however, if each Loporrit is to find new purpose. Continue expanding the workshop to see what dreams may come!
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_SYSTEM_000_112: You have achieved Trusted reputation with the Dreaming Ways.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_SYSTEM_000_113: You may raise their faith in you further by continuing to assist with the Dreaming Workshop.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_SYSTEM_000_114: New Loporrit society daily quests are now available from Managingway in Hoper's Hold.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_SYSTEM_000_115: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Managingway as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_SYSTEM_000_116: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Managingway. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANLOP002_04682_SYSTEM_000_117: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Coiningway.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_000: The machining station has surpassed our wildest imaginings! What are those things?
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_001: Mechanical mysteries aside, we've gathered a good crowd. Yet I know we can do more. I feel it in my ears!
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_100_001: I asked the others if they had any ideas, and apparently, Managingway has it all planned out.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_002: Managingway, can you share your thoughts with ?
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_MANAGINGWAY_000_003: Certainly. Ahem! Consider, if you will, the traditional Loporrit diet─carrots, carrots, and more carrots. Many of us, myself included, have in fact subsisted exclusively on carrots.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_MANAGINGWAY_000_005: Contact with the people of Etheirys, however, has revealed a whole world of non-carrot foodstuffs, in addition to fascinating trades and traditions entirely centered around food.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_MANAGINGWAY_000_006: If a Loporrit's heart harbored a secret passion for such cuisine, how would they know? They would not─until they visited our one-of-a-kind cooking station, that is.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_007: A delicious idea, is it not? ...I'm genuinely asking─I too have eaten naught but carrots, you see.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_MANAGINGWAY_000_008: And thus we arrive at our primary issue─staffing. There are few Loporrits with sufficient knowledge of cuisine...
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_MANAGINGWAY_000_009: Oh, no. Oh, no no no. Hoper's Hold would be stuffed to the brim with pudding before the day is out! The acoustics would be dreadful─and I doubt Inventingway's machines are pudding-proof.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_010: Perhaps we should ask Cookingway after all. There truly is no better Loporrit for the job!
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_MANAGINGWAY_000_011: He does seem to be the natural choice, doesn't he?
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_MANAGINGWAY_000_012: Unfortunately, he's currently studying with the Sharlayans. We would need to coax him back to the moon if he is to work with us.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_013: Perhaps he won't need coaxing! We won't know until we try!
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_014: ...Though I don't fancy wandering through the city by myself again, what with the gleaners running to and fro. They never watch where they're swinging those pointy knees of theirs. Please, would you come and protect me from the knees?
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_015: I am in your debt! Together we shall brave the fearsome aetheryte plaza...
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_020: All those people... All those knees... But we must approach if we are to inquire as to Cookingway's whereabouts!
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_021: Not that the folk of Etheirys are terribly good at telling us Loporrits apart. Hmmm...
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_022: Perhaps we can begin by simply asking if they've seen any Loporrits about. Aside from me, that is. Shall we?
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_SYSTEM_100_024: Dreamingway is now accompanying you. Keep him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_SYSTEM_110_024: You can leave Dreamingway behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with him and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_SYSTEM_120_024: If you wish to have Dreamingway join you again, return and speak with him at the original location.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_031: I see why your tours of Etheirys come so highly recommended! My fear of becoming hopelessly lost or trampled has fallen at least fifty percent with you by my side.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_032: Quick, to the Studium! Wherever that is!
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_033: Gazing at it from the faraway moon, we always imagined Etheirys to be the most beautiful place...
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_034: And truly, it is. I'm glad it's still here.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_100_034: Seeing so many shops lined up, I can't help but feel excited─who knows what's in store?
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_110_034: We wanted the other Loporrits to experience that same sense of anticipation, so Managingway and I used this place as a reference for the Dreaming Workshop. Can you tell?
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_Q3_000_035: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Dreamingway?
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_036: Oh, did you have a personal matter to take care of? All right! I'll go and stand very still in the aetheryte plaza until you get back.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_037: Standing very still suited me far better than becoming hopelessly lost! Shall we continue our search now?
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_038: Standing very still suited me far better than becoming hopelessly lost! Shall we continue our search now?
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_SYSTEM_000_039: You must be accompanied by Dreamingway and have him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_SYSTEM_000_040: Dreamingway has yet to arrive. Be sure he is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_CITIZENA04683_000_0: Loporrits? I have seen a few in passing, though I have not yet had the pleasure of speaking with any.
Loporrits? Yes, I do recall seeing a few of your kin earlier this .
One appeared to be off to the Last Stand, while the other was walking toward the Studium.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_053: Sharlayans truly are as knowledgeable as they say! Thank you, good sir!
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_CITIZENB04683_000_0: What adorable little creatures those Loporrits are. Is it acceptable to ruffle their fur, I wonder...
I did see a Loporrit not long ago, in fact. They were watching diners at the Last Stand and muttering something about...
...Pudding? Yes, I could have sworn they were murmuring, “How's the pudding?” Most peculiar.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_058: Hmmm... I have a sneaking suspicion that your mystery mutterer is not the Loporrit we're looking for, but I appreciate the information nevertheless!
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_CITIZENC04683_000_0: What a lovely breeze we're having!
Oh, another Loporrit! This must be my lucky day!
I was indeed just speaking with one of your kind about his research into Far Eastern recipes─a particular interest of mine. I must say, that fellow has good taste.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_100_063: Recipes, you say? Why, that must have been Cookingway! Do you happen to know where he went?
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_CITIZENC04683_000_0: Not precisely, though he headed off toward the west side of town. Perhaps he went to research more recipes.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_064: In any case, your assistance in this matter has been greatly appreciated!
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_100_064: Based on what we've gleaned thus far, I believe the unidentified Loporrit headed for the Studium is most likely our Cookingway. In which case, we shall be right on his tail!
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_CITIZENA04683_000_0: I assume the fellow headed for the Last Stand was planning on a meal, and the one approaching the Studium was engaged in research of some kind. Though for all I know, it could be the opposite.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_CITIZENB04683_000_0: ...Is there something in the pudding that I should be aware of?
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_CITIZENC04683_000_0: I do hope that little fellow finds the recipes he's searching for!
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_COOKINGWAY_000_068: Why, if it isn't ! You're well, I hope?
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_COOKINGWAY_000_072: What happened to your clothing? It's very...yellow.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_COOKINGWAY_000_074: Heavens! I had no idea that our fellow Loporrits were in such dire straits.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_COOKINGWAY_000_075: It's only right that I do what I can to help them.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_COOKINGWAY_000_076: ...And I must admit that I'm eager to test the many recipes I have learned here on Etheirys.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_COOKINGWAY_000_077: I know I've been a bit fixated upon carrots in the past, but I'm a changed Loporrit now. There's a whole world of flavor out there, and it's time that we brought it to Bestways Burrow!
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_COOKINGWAY_000_079: Of course, I will need a kitchen...
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_COOKINGWAY_100_079: I can provide my own pots and pans, but I would appreciate your assistance with dishes and utensils. Most of Etheirys's cuisine is not so conducive to gnawing as one might expect.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_080: Leave it to us! I saw a “chop stick” once!
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_COOKINGWAY_000_081: Yes, about that... It would probably be best for you to consult Master Dickon at the Last Stand about the details. He'll show you what you'll need to prepare, and in what quantities.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_COOKINGWAY_000_082: Meanwhile, I shall return to the burrow and begin preparing my kitchen. There is much to be done!
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_084: Let's go and speak with this “Master Dickon.” I imagine that you have a rough idea of what utensils are, but it never hurts to get a second opinion.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DICKON_000_090: Well, if it isn't my favorite temporary server.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DICKON_000_091: ...And I see you've brought one of the cute little moon fellows, too.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DICKON_000_092: Tableware for the Loporrits? Well, why not?
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DICKON_000_093: You'll need dishes and bowls, of course, some cutlery...perhaps tablecloths and mats as well. One moment─I'll make a list.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DICKON_000_096: Don't mention it─just save a place for me. I'll get up there one of these days...
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_097: Please do! I'll even send you a proper invitation once we're operational.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_098: Speaking of which─it's time we returned to Hoper's Hold. Those sticks won't chop themselves!
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DICKON_000_099: I hope your friend's as good as his word─I'd love to try lunar cuisine.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_COOKINGWAY_100_099: Huh. I always thought this was a cupboard.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_SUPPORTER_110_099: Greetings! If you require direction, please speak with Dreamingway. <blip> Today's automatically generated suggestion is: Treant Trimming!
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_100: Ah, there you are! I turned Master Dickon's list over to Managingway, of course, so preparations are well underway.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_101: They did ask me to ask you to craft a few things though, if you don't mind.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_103: Specifically─fancy table mats! Oh, how exciting.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_104: Specifically─gentle dish soaps! Oh, how exciting.

TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_120: ! I trust your work went to plan─Managingway's plan, that is.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_121: Oh, is that what those are supposed to look like? Fascinating...
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_122: Cookingway has already arranged his kitchen according to his very exacting preferences, so we should have everything we need to get started. I hope you worked up an appetite!
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_130: Feast your eyes on the cooking station! Mmm... What shall we eat first?
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_COOKINGWAY_000_131: Welcome! Do taste as many dishes as you like─each recipe has been prepared with loving care. If you have any questions about the flavors or techniques involved, I should be more than happy to instruct you.
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_DREAMINGWAY_000_133: I should like to speak with them, but they're always running off...
TEXT_BANLOP003_04683_SYSTEM_000_134: The cooking station is now open, servicing the hungry Loporrits of Hoper's Hold and beyond. There is much yet to be done, however, if each is to find new purpose. Continue expanding the workshop to see what dreams may come!

TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_000: ! You recall that curious character who we've seen─for lack of a better term─lurking about Hoper's Hold, don't you?
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_001: Well, I hear tell that they also spend a great deal of time lurking about the Watcher's Palace. A regular Lurkingway, that one.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_002: In any case, it seems that the Dreaming Workshop isn't meeting their needs. I should like to ask them how we can be more helpful. Would you join me?
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_003: Perfect! I've already checked all our nooks and crannies, so with any luck, they'll be lurking by the Watcher's Palace as we speak...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_004: They must be around here somewhere...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_010: Perhaps they grew tired of the view, and decided to take their lurking elsewhere...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_013: Hail, my good Way! If I'm not mistaken, you have come to enjoy the offerings of our Dreaming Workshop a number of times, have you not?
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_TALKINGWAY_000_014: Though I suppose watching you pointlessly exert yourselves has been entertaining enough.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_015: That's, er...good? But I was hoping that we might assist you in finding a dream of your own!
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_TALKINGWAY_000_016: And what is it you expect me to dream of? Fanciful machines? Colorful cuisines? I think not.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_TALKINGWAY_000_017: Without the people of Etheirys to delight in them, such pursuits are meaningless, one and all.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_TALKINGWAY_000_019: No matter. Your exertions have their place─in supporting my petition to Livingway.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_TALKINGWAY_000_020: When she authorizes my hibernation, I shall dream sweet dreams at last...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_031: That's a lot of nonsense, if I do say so myself. You can hardly follow your dreams while you're asleep!
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_032: Perhaps Livingway will understand better than I do. It sounds like our ashen-furred friend has spoken of this matter to her before.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_100_040: Why is it so difficult to find anyone today? Livingwaaay!
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_110_040: There you are, Livingway! Might we have a word?
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LIVINGWAY_000_040: So soon? I had thought your project was proceeding apace.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_041: Overall, yes...but we're struggling with one Way in particular. Are you familiar with an ashen-furred Loporrit? Red eyes, mysterious, absolutely adorable until they open their mouth?
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LIVINGWAY_000_042: Oh, yes. I was aware they had paid visit to Hoper's Hold, but I wasn't aware that you were aware...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LIVINGWAY_000_043: Perhaps you may yet succeed where I have not.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LIVINGWAY_000_044: You are aware, , that the Loporrits were created to prepare the moon for man's arrival, and that these preparations required substantial time and effort.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LIVINGWAY_000_045: All bent toward our common goal in their own way, but some Loporrits went above and beyond. One in particular...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LIVINGWAY_000_047: This most passionate of Ways took the name “Counselingway.” Their role was to lend a listening ear and provide advice to the people of Etheirys─something we anticipated would be sorely needed, given the abrupt displacement you all were to face.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LIVINGWAY_100_047: More than any other, they sought to understand your people. They studied, they practiced...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LIVINGWAY_000_048: ...And they looked forward to the day when they would finally, finally meet you.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LIVINGWAY_000_049: As you can imagine, the change of plans came as a terrible shock. They became uninterested in their former pursuits, and are adamant that naught of worth remains for them to do.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LIVINGWAY_000_050: I was unable to persuade them otherwise─and after some time, they disappeared from the burrow altogether.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LIVINGWAY_000_051: It was shortly thereafter that other Loporrits began sighting an ashen-furred Way wandering Mare Lamentorum.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LIVINGWAY_000_053: Even I didn't recognize them at first. I wondered whence this new Way had sprung.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LIVINGWAY_000_054: Then I watched them stand out there, gazing at the sky─at Etheirys─and I realized...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LIVINGWAY_000_055: It was the grief that had changed them. A loss too heavy to bear.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LIVINGWAY_000_056: It came as no surprise when they asked to be put back into hibernation.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LIVINGWAY_000_057: ...Yet I cannot allow it. Even with the Final Days averted, there must be a place for us in this world. I know there is─we need only reach out our paws.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LIVINGWAY_000_058: I said as much, but it's as if they cannot hear me. And no matter how many times I refuse them, they return with their petition for eternal sleep.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_059: It would be a tragedy to lose a Loporrit with so much love in their heart...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_060: We must find a way to help them! To give them a new dream.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_061: Not that I know what that would be...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_063: Thank you for telling us of this, Livingway.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_064: We should ask the others for help. This matter is of dire import!
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_065: I shall see you in Hoper's Hold soon, then.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LIVINGWAY_000_067: If anyone can save Counselingway, it's you lot. And they can be saved─I must believe that.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LIVINGWAY_000_068: So please, do everything in your power. On behalf of Loporrit-kind, I beseech you.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_100_070: There you are! Come, we must bring Managingway into our confidence.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_MANAGINGWAY_000_071: This Counselingway has visited the workshop several times, correct? Yet we have seen no measurable results thus far.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_MANAGINGWAY_000_072: And they are not the only Loporrit to have been dissatisfied with our offerings. Though a significant portion have gravitated to the dreams on display, many remain uninterested.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_MANAGINGWAY_000_073: We must try a different tack─one that targets this demographic specifically.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_100_073: I see! But what could a Loporrit who doesn't fancy music or mechanics or mealtime possibly enjoy?
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_MANAGINGWAY_100_073: We might look to what else they have in common...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_MANAGINGWAY_000_076: Assuming my mental register is correct─and it usually is─the remaining wayward Ways had roles that would have involved direct contact with the people of Etheirys.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_MANAGINGWAY_000_077: In addition to consulting roles like Counselingway's, there were those specializing in guiding the people around our facilities, interpreting, and other aspects of hospitality.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_079: All of them would have been especially disappointed to find out that our guests weren't coming. They could hardly carry out their work alone...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_081: What if we didn't wait for them to take interest in a new dream all by themselves?
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_082: If we bring everyone together to work toward a common goal, it may remind them what it's like to have a purpose again!
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_MANAGINGWAY_000_083: Teamwork is key, to be sure, but what sort of project could we give them?
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_A1_000_002: Never underestimate the value of art.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_110_085: Yes, I imagine the musically disinclined wouldn't enjoy singing very much. Perhaps something that involves using their paws...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_130_085: Look at these boring walls we have! Surely they could use a touch of paint, or─gasp!─a mural.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_MANAGINGWAY_000_085: Expressing oneself through art is a proven means of processing negative experiences... Though some may prefer a medium other than paint. Never fear─I shall arrange for a variety of supplies.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_MANAGINGWAY_000_086: At minimum, we can expect to attract Counselingway's attention once more.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_087: Just where we want them─paying attention!
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_088: For the time being, let us focus on gathering as many wayward Ways as possible.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_089: With you here, it should be easy! Even the most listless Loporrit would jump at the chance to work together with a representative of mankind.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_090: We only need to find them! Again.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LOPORRITA04684_000_: Painting? I don't know much about art, I'm afraid.
But if you insist, I can join you as moral support. My job was supposed to be helping people in need, after all...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LOPORRITB04684_000_: You want to create something...together? Is that allowed? I can't see much of a point in it.
Yet I can hardly refuse a request from a person of Etheirys. Even now...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LOPORRITC04684_000_: Express my feelings through art? That sounds difficult.
Though if it helps people─or even just you─I suppose we can give it a try...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_SUPPORTER_000_106: Greetings! If you require direction, please speak with Dreamingway. <blip> Today's automatically generated suggestion is: Whisker Waxing!
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_110: Thanks to your persuasive person-ing, we have more participants than we know what to do with!
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_111: I jest, of course. Managingway always knows what to do! Speaking of which...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_112: They've asked that you create a few brushes out of metal. Some of our painters may become quite...vigorous in their expression.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_113: They've asked that you create a few palettes. Some of our painters would like to use a great many colors!
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_114: They've asked that you create additional paints. Some of our painters firmly believe that quantity equals quality!
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_115: As always, Managingway has provided supplies─for your convenience and ours. More can be had from the dreaming supporter if you need them.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_116: I may step away to make sure that no one else attempts to paint the wall with Cookingway's frosting, but trust that you will find me here when you're done!
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_117: I love the smell of fresh art supplies! <sniff> Don't you?

TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_130: Just in time to prevent further frosting-based incident! I'll take those off your paws.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_131: I shall see these distributed to our artists posthaste!
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_132: I can hardly wait to see the finished product...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_140: I had hoped they would enjoy themselves, but I never imagined they would become so absorbed in their work─nor create such a magnificent mural! This is by far our greatest success yet.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_TALKINGWAY_000_141: Art? Truly, you're making my task too easy...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_TALKINGWAY_110_141: Do not call me that. 'Tis a relic of a life I care not to remember.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_120_141: Noted! Would you like to try your paw at painting?
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_MANAGINGWAY_000_143: There is a distinct lack of unified vision here...yet somehow, it works. Art is a mystery indeed.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_LOPORRITA04684_000_: I had no idea that art could be so liberating. I haven't had this much fun in ages!
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_TALKINGWAY_000_145: ...Fun? Perhaps I once knew what that was like...
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_146: With all of the Loporrits we've helped, I'd like to think we've done our part.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_DREAMINGWAY_000_147: Still, we cannot stop. No─we will not stop! Not until we've helped Counselingway, and anyone else who has yet to find a dream.
TEXT_BANLOP004_04684_SYSTEM_000_148: The imaging station is now open, allowing once-wayward Ways to vent their innermost emotions through creative pursuits. There are yet Loporrits that want for new purpose, however. Continue expanding the workshop to see what dreams may come!
