TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_000: Could you join us for a moment, ?
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: My survey of Bestways Burrow morale indicates that the situation is as we suspected─though our efforts have reached the majority of wayward Ways, a few yet remain in the doldrums.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: The erstwhile Counselingway first among them, of course.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_003: I've stretched my imagination ever so hard for dreams that might inspire them, but nothing concrete has come to mind...
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_MANAGINGWAY_000_004: I propose that we examine the issue of their personal motivation more closely. Per Livingway, they were once passionate about their work, after all.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_MANAGINGWAY_000_005: We cannot change the fact that the people of Etheirys won't be coming to live on the moon, but reaching out to them is hardly beyond our means.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_MANAGINGWAY_100_005: There is naught stopping us from utilizing our ashen-furred associate's communication skills to aid mankind, albeit remotely.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_006: Thus making their old dream their new dream... But what sort of station would be suitable?
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_A1_000_001: One for sharing useful information with the people of Etheirys.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_A1_000_002: Perhaps a station that individuals could contact with questions?
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_007: Your people's ears aren't very large, though. How could they hear what's being said?
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_008: That would be quite similar to not-Counselingway's previous job. How would people contact us, though?
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_A1_100_001: You might use one of those Garlean “radios”─so long as you refrain from any mind-bending schemes.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_A1_100_002: Everyone and their minion seems quite happy to call me via linkpearl.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_100_007: "Schemes“ sound bad, but ”radio“ sounds intriguing! Tell me more...
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_110_007: ...And you can truly hear distant voices through the tiny box? Incredible!
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_100_008: Linkpearls! I had entirely forgotten. That would have made finding you on Etheirys a lot easier...
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_MANAGINGWAY_110_008: Unfortunately, to purchase dedicated linkpearls for the entire population of the star would be stretching our budget rather thin. To say naught of the nightmarish logistics of distribution...
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_009: We simply must find a way to transmit to these radios. For science!
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_MANAGINGWAY_110_011: Eyes on the project objectives, please. That said, I quite agree.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_MANAGINGWAY_000_013: If Garlemald has such technology, it is likely that the Sharlayans have studied it, if not invented similar devices of their own.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_MANAGINGWAY_000_015: If so, they may have shared its secrets with Livingway. No doubt Inventingway will have thoughts on the matter as well...
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_016: I leave the technical details in your capable paws, Managingway. In the meanwhile, I should like to have a chat with the Loporrit formerly known as Counselingway...
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_017: Please join me in inviting them to join us!
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_021: You want me to assist the people of Etheirys...remotely?
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_022: Construction of the station is underway as we speak. Using the magic known as “radio,” we can transmit all manner of noises across space and...darker space!
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_023: For instance...music! Goodness, we could share my music, couldn't we?
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_024: Do not bother the people of Etheirys with that noisome beeping.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_025: If we are to employ this station of yours, surely there are myriad better uses.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_100_027: Many of Etheirys's people lost loved ones during the Final Days, did they not? We could let them know that they're not alone.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_028: Or─purely as an example, you understand─we could use our unique vantage point to describe cloud formations.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_030: <sigh> With that information, those on the ground could more accurately predict incoming storms, forestalling ill-fated forays.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_031: You truly are an expert in helpfulness! Those things never would have occurred to me.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_032: I suppose I can come and look in on you once you've completed your facilities. Clearly, someone needs to tell you where you're going wrong...
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_034: I can hardly wait for you to join us. Together, we shall create radio noises like no one has heard before...
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_035: ...Though I suppose we need to actually finish the station first.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_036: We'll see you there! In the Dreaming Workshop! Make sure to come!
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_SUPPORTER_000_039: Greetings! If you require direction, please speak with Dreamingway. <blip> Today's automatically generated suggestion is: Unsettling Staring!
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_MANAGINGWAY_000_041: We are on schedule─though I have been awaiting 's return. I trust  will have little difficulty producing equipment to the vague and mysterious specifications provided by our Sharlayan correspondents.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_MANAGINGWAY_000_044: We will require a “microphone,” or several. I am told that the material inside the device responds to sound waves to produce a signal that can then be transmitted via radio.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_MANAGINGWAY_000_045: We will require a “soundboard.” I am told that this device adjusts the signal produced by the “microphone”─and can even produce sounds of its own.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_MANAGINGWAY_000_046: We will require tiny bottles of oil for knobs, dials, and the like. No, I do not know what sort of knobs and dials.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_MANAGINGWAY_000_047: These are the materials─I assume you can manage the rest on your own.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_MANAGINGWAY_000_048: Should you require additional supplies, as always, our stocks are with the dreaming supporter.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_MANAGINGWAY_000_049: I will be occupied in ensuring that no one shocks themselves into a stupor whilst assembling the booth, but Dreamingway should be free to collect your finished creations.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_050: Having trouble creating the thingamabobs, are you? Surely Managingway won't mind if you collect a few more supplies from the dreaming supporter...

TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_SYSTEM_000_059: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_060: This equipment is incredibly delicate, you say? Well, I suppose I don't need to shake the box, strictly speaking...
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_061: Oooh, it's even weirder than I expected.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_062: I shall exercise the utmost caution as I hop over to Managingway with this, I promise!
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_A2_000_001: Won't you dream of a brighter future with us?
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_A2_000_002: If you wish to speak to my people, the microphone is yours.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_072: My dream was always to be of help to your people.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_073: I have always wished to speak with the people of Etheirys.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_075: Do you think my voice will reach them?
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_076: Of course it will! That's the magic of radio.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_078: I would like to assist with this station, if you're still amenable to the idea. You won't find a harder working Way─I promise you that.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_080: And with that, the broadcasting station is complete! Though we might want to check whether it's working.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_MANAGINGWAY_000_081: We never did decide on the content of our first message. For once, I fear I am rather at a loss...
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_082: That's where our newest Way comes in!
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_DREAMINGWAY_000_085: There must be something you'd like to share with the people of Etheirys in honor of this special occasion.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_086: Test... Test... P-People of Etheirys, are you there?
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_087: Can you hear me, far away as I am? All the way from the moon?
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_088: I hope I can be of use to you. I hope I can tell you something you didn't know before. I hope that, in your darkest moments, I can lift your spirits...
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_100_088: ...But perhaps I should start from the beginning.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_090: We awaited your arrival on the moon. 'Twas to be under the most unfortunate circumstances, to be sure─yet that only increased the determination with which we set to our preparations.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_091: In the end, of course, the Final Days were averted. The moon was no longer needed.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_093: Make no mistake─we are glad for your fortune! If you are happy, we are happy. But for many of us─myself included─this marked an end to our very reason for being.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_094: ...Until some Loporrits dared to dream again. To show us that there is always hope, so long as we reach for each other.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_095: Should you ever lose sight of your dreams, I hope you'll remember that you are not alone. We are here, and the future is a dream we all share.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_097: That concludes our inaugural broadcast. Thank you, one and all, for listening.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_098: From the bottom of my heart, and on behalf of Loporrit-kind, I wish you the very best.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_099: Was it too long? It felt awfully short... Do you think they could hear well enough?
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_100: I suppose we shall never truly know our audience.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_TALKINGWAY_000_101: But if my voice reached even one person...that is enough for me.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_SYSTEM_000_103: You have achieved Sworn reputation with the Dreaming Ways.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_SYSTEM_000_104: You may raise their faith in you further by continuing to assist with the Dreaming Workshop.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_SYSTEM_000_105: You will receive an experience point bonus upon completion of the Loporrit society daily quests.
TEXT_BANLOP005_04685_SYSTEM_000_106: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Coiningway.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_DREAMINGWAY_000_000: ! I have a task of the utmost import for you.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_DREAMINGWAY_000_001: After our inaugural broadcast, many of the Dreaming Workshop's Loporrits were inspired to share their own histories and aspirations via the radio...
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_DREAMINGWAY_000_002: And it seems the people of Etheirys have been listening!
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_DREAMINGWAY_000_003: We've received a number of letters, you see─addressed to all and sundry Ways.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_DREAMINGWAY_000_004: I haven't been able to stop smiling since I read mine. I am painfully delighted!
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_DREAMINGWAY_000_005: Yet I would doubtless be more so had my letter been delivered by a person of Etheirys in the flesh. What do you say?
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_DREAMINGWAY_000_006: Those letters are for Coiningway, Inventingway, Cookingway, and Ta─er, the Loporrit of many names! Some of them “Counselingway” and others “the voice behind the microphone”...way? Ahem.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_DREAMINGWAY_100_006: In any case, I cannot wait to hear how they all react!
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_DREAMINGWAY_000_007: Though I am certain the shrieks of jubilation will carry, do fill me in on the particulars, yes?
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_COININGWAY_000_010: Not here to spend your carats today? A pity. I do work so tirelessly to price our merchandise fairly...
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_COININGWAY_000_011: What is this? A letter from a Sharlayan economist...? Oh, heavens. It's happening. It's finally happening!
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_COININGWAY_000_012: (-Economist's Letter-)Having heard the fascinating tale of your success in establishing a new currency and independent market, my colleagues and I would like to formally invite you to submit to our rousing quarterly report...
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_COININGWAY_000_013: Such a heartwarming letter I have never received! I must pen a reply posthaste─not to mention my submission.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_COININGWAY_000_014: I owe you thanks, . Without your earnest cooperation, the carat's time to shine may never have come. Trust me when I say that my gratitude is beyond measure.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_COININGWAY_000_016: It is most fortunate that I thought to offer wares sold in gil. The economists of Etheirys shall revel in the comparisons I am able to provide...
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_INVENTINGWAY_000_02: Hail, ! Have you seen a loose screw anywhere?
...No matter, I can carry on regardless. Doubt not that this next machine will astonish even your adventurer's eyes!
...A letter from Etheirys? Curious. I wasn't aware that the postmoogle teleporters had passed safety inspection.
Let me see... Bugger me, these letters are tiny...
Why, the writer is Garlean! “Restoration”...“recovered scrap”...“minimal explosions”...
I see! With this information, I can surely design a machine or two to assist in Garlemald's reconstruction. How fortunate that they heard my broadcast.
It is only a matter of time before my inventions are beloved far and wide. First Garlemald, then Etheirys, then...the universe!
...That is to say, I look forward to being of assistance to people in need.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_COOKINGWAY_000_030: Can I interest you in a turn at the whisk? We've been overwhelmed with orders of late─what you see behind me is the last Way standing.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_COOKINGWAY_000_031: Nevertheless, I am glad that everyone appreciates our Etheirys-inspired cuisine.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_COOKINGWAY_000_032: I must confess─I worry that my inclinations still tend too heavily toward carrots. Yet I can hardly ask this lot for other ideas...
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_COOKINGWAY_000_033: Fresh inspiration, you say? I certainly hope so...
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_COOKINGWAY_000_034: A letter from Master Dickon himself! What a happy surprise.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_COOKINGWAY_000_035: ...And he's included a recipe of his own devising! This is precisely what I need to break free from my carrot-based confines.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_COOKINGWAY_000_036: “Let me know if this inspires any new dishes up there,” he says. I certainly will.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_COOKINGWAY_000_037: And I hope that you will sample whatever we cook up next!
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_COOKINGWAY_000_039: Do come back for a meal once in a while, ─or at least dessert.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_TALKINGWAY_000_040: Ah, well met! Can I help you with anything this ?
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_TALKINGWAY_000_041: For me? From persons of Etheirys? Oh, I hope I didn't say something to offend them...
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_TALKINGWAY_000_042: The first is from a Garlean refugee... “I miss my homeland dearly, but your voice reminded me that even here, I'm not alone. Thank you for lifting my spirits.”
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_TALKINGWAY_000_043: And this one appears to have been written by a child's paw...
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_TALKINGWAY_000_044:
(-Child's Letter-)Dear Radio Loppit,
How did you learn to talk like people? You are very good. I want to be a radio when I grow up too!
Love, Me
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_TALKINGWAY_000_048: I once believed I would never again look forward to tomorrow...
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_TALKINGWAY_000_049: But Dreamingway's hope is infectious, isn't it? I owe him─and you─more than I can say.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_TALKINGWAY_000_051: I'd like to share something with you, if you don't mind...
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_TALKINGWAY_000_052: I've been pondering a new name for myself. My dream may have not changed all that much, but I am a different Way than I once was.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_TALKINGWAY_000_053: I was alone for quite some time, you understand─long enough to make me appreciate the value of a kind word. Now that I have returned to the fluffle, I find myself wanting to speak with your people and my fellow Loporrits as much as I can. So, after some discussion...
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_TALKINGWAY_000_055: (-Talkingway-)I shall be a friendly voice to the people of Etheirys─and to those closer to home.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_TALKINGWAY_000_057: (-Talkingway-)I hope you will consider me a friend, too.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_A1_000_001: I wouldn't have it any other way.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_A1_000_002: Say no more, Talkingway! ...Or do! Yes.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_TALKINGWAY_000_058: (-Talkingway-)Thank you, ! For your kindness...and for listening.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_SYSTEM_000_059: With this delivery to your new friend Talkingway, all of the letters have been safely seen into the right paws.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_SYSTEM_100_059: Dreamingway will surely be delighted to know of the joy with which they were received.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_DREAMINGWAY_000_061: That's even better than I dreamed! The people of Etheirys have been ever so kind...
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_DREAMINGWAY_000_062: ...Including those who have yet to listen to our broadcast!
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_DREAMINGWAY_000_063: According to one of the letters Managingway received, word of our station has spread far and wide, and many of your fellows are keen to get their paws on radios of their own─to little success, I'm afraid...
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_DREAMINGWAY_000_064: But we're here to help! Inventingway has gathered his disciples, and they are producing radios as we speak. We shall see them delivered to Etheirys with all speed!
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_DREAMINGWAY_000_066: Can you imagine? The whole star, listening to us!
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_DREAMINGWAY_000_067: To be honest, I was uncertain we would ever make it this far. To find new dreams for each and every Loporrit seemed a monumental task...
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_DREAMINGWAY_000_068: Yet look at them now! They've come so far...and who knows what they'll dream up next?
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_DREAMINGWAY_000_069: I'm eager to start composing again. Get ready to hop along to my next hit!
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_DREAMINGWAY_000_070: None of our dreams would have been possible without you, . On behalf of all of us─thank you ever so much!
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_DREAMINGWAY_000_071: And remember─should you want for a friendly ear or a well-eared friend, we are always here for you!
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_SYSTEM_000_072: You have achieved Bloodsworn reputation with the Dreaming Ways.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_SYSTEM_000_073: You will receive an experience point bonus upon the completion of Loporrit society daily quests.
TEXT_BANLOP006_04686_SYSTEM_000_074: You have learned the emote Ear Wiggle!
TEXT_BANLOP101_04687_MANAGINGWAY_000_000: Considering the success of our musicking station, I do believe its equipment will require extra maintenance.
TEXT_BANLOP101_04687_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: Can you imagine the glum disappointment that awaits us should our music fail to play during peak merriment? I shudder to even consider it.
TEXT_BANLOP101_04687_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: I tasked one of our Ways with preparing spare parts for the audio apparatus. However, that was some time ago, with nary a whisper of their progress since.
TEXT_BANLOP101_04687_MANAGINGWAY_000_003: Could I trouble you to lend them assistance? They are no doubt hard at work in Greatest Endsvale.
TEXT_BANLOP101_04687_LOPORRIT4687_000_01: Have you come to help me? Oh, you are very nice. There are still so many pieces I must make and I've been making them for ever so long...
Like these metal parts for our amplifiers. Could you make some of those? I have plenty of supplies here, if you need any more.
Like these little parts for our speakers. Could you help with some of those? I have plenty of supplies here, if you need any more.
Like these delicate parts for our wiring. Could you make some of those? I have plenty of supplies here, if you need any more.
Once you're finished, go on ahead and take them to Managingway. I may be a while yet...

TEXT_BANLOP101_04687_LOPORRIT4687_000_02: Did you run out of supplies? Goodness knows I've plenty to spare...
TEXT_BANLOP101_04687_MANAGINGWAY_000_030: How fares our helper? Have they made progress with the spare parts?
TEXT_BANLOP101_04687_MANAGINGWAY_000_031: Marvelous! With these pieces, I daresay our music will be free of malfunction for some time yet.
TEXT_BANLOP101_04687_MANAGINGWAY_000_032: Originally, our audio apparatus was meant to broadcast Burrow-wide announcements for our guests, but as we no longer expect visitors from Etheirys, we repurposed the equipment.
TEXT_BANLOP101_04687_MANAGINGWAY_000_033: Only time will tell if our musicking station's requirements exceed the capabilities of our apparatus...but in the meantime, we shall do our utmost to keep everything in working order.
TEXT_BANLOP101_04687_MANAGINGWAY_000_034: I do hope you will assist us again, . Please accept this small token of our appreciation.
TEXT_BANLOP102_04688_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: Ah, , your timing is impeccable. I have good tidings─the melodies of the musicking station appear to have struck a proverbial chord with a number of our Ways, who have incidentally come to me with a request.
TEXT_BANLOP102_04688_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: The music awoke something in them─the desire to play an instrument themselves. Naturally, we must nurture these burgeoning embers of passion within their hearts in a timely fashion, lest they be extinguished. I trust I can count on you?
TEXT_BANLOP102_04688_MANAGINGWAY_000_003: ! It seems even more of our Ways have developed an interest in playing an instrument. Might I ask for your help once more? Your support would mean the world to them.
TEXT_BANLOP102_04688_MANAGINGWAY_000_004: Assuming that's a yes, allow me to point you in the direction of Greatest Endsvale, where you will find Pipingway eager to share all of the details with you. Best of luck!
TEXT_BANLOP102_04688_SUPPORTER4688_100_0: <beep> This supporter would be positively thrilled to replenish any and all necessary materials should the need arise!
TEXT_BANLOP102_04688_PIPINGWAY_000_010: There you are, ! Allow me to bring you up to speed. We've already requested some of the engineers to draw up plans for fabricating wind instruments designed for paws like yours truly.
TEXT_BANLOP102_04688_PIPINGWAY_000_011: That said, we can hardly cobble together a random assortment of materials and call it a day. No, we need the finest components─ones suited to making an instrument sing, and not...er, scream? That, my esteemed artisan friend, is where you come in!
TEXT_BANLOP102_04688_PIPINGWAY_000_013: Good to see you, ! Wouldn't you know it─after hearing us play our new instruments, a bunch of our fellow Ways are now hoping to join us. So many, in fact, that we frankly can't keep up with the demand!
TEXT_BANLOP102_04688_PIPINGWAY_000_014: So...erm, we could really use your help again!
TEXT_BANLOP102_04688_PIPINGWAY_000_015: Please see if you can craft a tuning slide with this assortment of delicate metals!
TEXT_BANLOP102_04688_PIPINGWAY_000_016: Please see if you can craft a pipe with these exquisite woods we procured from Etheirys!
TEXT_BANLOP102_04688_PIPINGWAY_000_017: Please see if you can craft a lubricant with these materials! We must stick all manner of moving bits together, you know. Instruments are so delightfully odd!
TEXT_BANLOP102_04688_PIPINGWAY_000_018: Should you run out of materials, the doing supporter beside me can provide whatever you need.

TEXT_BANLOP102_04688_PIPINGWAY_000_030: Do let me know when you've finished!
TEXT_BANLOP102_04688_PIPINGWAY_000_031: Oh, it's beautiful! We'll be able to make such wonderful instruments with this─not to mention music!
TEXT_BANLOP102_04688_PIPINGWAY_000_032: I will take this marvelous component to the engineers. Thank you so much for lending us a paw, and do give Managingway my regards!
TEXT_BANLOP102_04688_MANAGINGWAY_000_033: You are returned. And by your countenance, I take it you were able to assist them with their production woes.
TEXT_BANLOP102_04688_MANAGINGWAY_000_034: Thank you, . You've played an instrumental role in helping our Ways see their dreams to fruition. I hope that you continue to do the same for others.
TEXT_BANLOP103_04689_MANAGINGWAY_000_000: Thanks to the Loporrit carats developed by Coiningway, the moon's economic influence is expanding in leaps and bounds.
TEXT_BANLOP103_04689_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: If we are to maintain this stellar growth, we need to produce more coins. As a counterfeiting countermeasure, however, the process is extremely involved.
TEXT_BANLOP103_04689_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: That being the case, we'd be grateful if you could lend your skills to the manufacturing effort. My stockpiling colleague in the Carrotorium will provide you with the materials you need.
TEXT_BANLOP103_04689_LOPORRIT04689_000_0: You're helping us manufacture Loporrit carats? Wonderful, wonderful!
Using these materials, I want you to prepare the components needed to make a precision mold.
Using these materials, I want you to prepare the components needed to make polishing cloth.
Using these materials, I want you to prepare the components needed to make polishing agent.
Once you've finished, please deliver the items to Managingway. And if you run out of materials, I'll furnish you with more from my stockpile.
You want more materials? But you still have some─I can see it sticking out of your bag. I'm the one stockpiling here, not you.
You need more materials? But you still have some─I can see it sticking out of your bag. I'm the one stockpiling here, not you.

TEXT_BANLOP103_04689_MANAGINGWAY_000_030: There you are. Do you perchance have some coin manufacturing components for me...?
TEXT_BANLOP103_04689_MANAGINGWAY_000_031: Excellent, I will pass these on to Coiningway at once. Here is a Loporrit carat by way of thanks for your troubles.
TEXT_BANLOP103_04689_MANAGINGWAY_000_032: ...Hm? Judging by your expression, it seems you're not pleased by the choice of reward. But believe me when I say there's a perfectly sound economic reason for it.
TEXT_BANLOP103_04689_MANAGINGWAY_000_033: You see, a currency is only worth something if people have confidence in it, and confidence comes from widespread circulation. That's to say, your possessing the carats imbues them with value─value that you benefit from!
TEXT_BANLOP103_04689_MANAGINGWAY_000_034: But on the other side of the proverbial coin, excess circulation diminishes a currency's value. It's a fine balancing act, but rest assured I shall manage it with all meticulousness!
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: While most of our Ways are content with rhythmical hopping, Shakingway has recently expressed a desire to master the ways of “dance.”
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: As I understand it, mankind's myriad cultures are well versed in this activity, so I was hoping you might humor his request for a...dancing battle? I'm not entirely clear on the particulars.
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_MANAGINGWAY_000_005: ! Our dancing friend Shakingway has been asking for you.
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_MANAGINGWAY_000_006: Might you spare him a moment? It seems he wishes to battle again.
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_MANAGINGWAY_000_007: You'll find him practicing in Bestways Burrow. I have no doubt he is itching to witness your “moves.”
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SHAKINGWAY_000_010: Come one, come all! Challenge Shakingway and fall!
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SHAKINGWAY_000_011:
Aaah! Y-You're that person! A-Ahem...
You there, person-─
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SHAKINGWAY_000_013: A challenge of dance? All right, very well! I'll dance you to death and send you to...uh...was it “hells”?
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SHAKINGWAY_000_014:
Aaah! It's you! Erm...
Come again to see my moves? You will find me much improved!
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SHAKINGWAY_000_015: At the musicking station, the fates will decide. On our battle I'll wager my name and my pride!
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SHAKINGWAY_000_020: My dancing skill is second to none! You can show me your moves, but I've already won!
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SYSTEM_100_020: Shakingway is getting ahead of himself. Show him the dance of a real champion.
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SHAKINGWAY_000_021:
Whoa, what was that? Such beauty, such grace... Erm!
Ha-ha-ha, your dance is weak! I'm still the dance master of whom all speak!
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SYSTEM_000_022: Shakingway doesn't acknowledge that movement as dance. Only dance will change his opinion of you.
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SHAKINGWAY_000_023:
What the─!? That was amazing! How did you─I-I mean!
You were lucky! That was luck! Bet you can't do it again, you...puck?
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SHAKINGWAY_000_024:
If this is a dream, don't wake me... Ahem! I-I mean!
Is that really the best you can do? Then do it again─but you can't, can you?
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SYSTEM_000_025: It seems you've caught Shakingway's attention. Show him your dance again for the win.
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SHAKINGWAY_000_030: Lost your nerve? Don't want to play? The reigning champ is Shakingway!
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SYSTEM_100_030: Shakingway is gaining confidence again. Finish him by showing him your dance.
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SHAKINGWAY_000_031: Ha! You only had a lucky streak─my sensational moves cannot be beat!
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SYSTEM_000_032: Shakingway doesn't acknowledge that movement as dance, and to make matters worse, he now derides you in slant rhyme. Demand his respect with an unparalleled display of dance.
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SHAKINGWAY_000_033: Hgk! Th-That... That was amazing. The  moves you render... You have earned my due surrender.
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SHAKINGWAY_000_034: How strange... Watching your dance has filled me with inner peace. I feel confident...courageous, even. A-Ahem!
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SHAKINGWAY_000_035: Th-This isn't over! I may retreat, but next time I will not be beat!
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_SHAKINGWAY_000_036: I'll chase my dream till I'm king of the moon─I'll have my revenge! We'll meet again soon!
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_MANAGINGWAY_000_040: Ah, you're back. I just saw Shakingway dash past with tears in his eyes, so I assume you won your little bout?
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_MANAGINGWAY_000_041: Revenge, you say? Then it sounds as though we shall require more of your time in the future.
TEXT_BANLOP104_04690_MANAGINGWAY_000_042: I do hate to trouble you, but sometimes I wonder if he isn't simply in need of a playfellow. Thank you for your kindness, .
TEXT_BANLOP105_04691_MANAGINGWAY_000_000: Coiningway's dream of opening a shopping station has been realized, but its available products are still rather limited.
TEXT_BANLOP105_04691_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: After considering what else we might offer, we have collectively decided that memorabilia inscribed with your signature would be a most desirable item. You are the moon's leading celebrity, after all.
TEXT_BANLOP105_04691_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: Those personalized memorabilia you provided us proved more popular than we anticipated. We sold them all just as soon as we stocked them!
TEXT_BANLOP105_04691_MANAGINGWAY_000_003: Might you craft us some more? Needy Ways await.
TEXT_BANLOP105_04691_MANAGINGWAY_000_004: We will, of course, provide adequate compensation for your time, labor, and use of your likeness. One of our Ways eagerly awaits you in Greatest Endsvale whenever you wish to begin production.
TEXT_BANLOP105_04691_LOPORRIT04691_000_0: Oooh! , welcome, welcome! You've come to make some memorabilia for us, yes? It's an honor to assist you, .
Anything you make is certain to sell like carrot cake, but our Ways would particularly love something with your name on it. And perhaps your face. Whatever you think is best!

TEXT_BANLOP105_04691_MANAGINGWAY_000_040: Thank you for your cooperation, . For all the help and hope you've given us, I am sure those mementos will be our shopping station's best seller.
TEXT_BANLOP105_04691_MANAGINGWAY_000_041: Speaking of which, I must secure one for myself... Er, strictly for managerial purposes! Ahem.
TEXT_BANLOP106_04692_MANAGINGWAY_000_000: The multicolored blaze of our musicking station is quite dazzling, don't you agree? Whenever I wander over, I feel as though I've entered an exhilarating new cosmos.
TEXT_BANLOP106_04692_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: Yet beautiful as our lights are, they must receive proper maintenance lest their brilliance be dimmed by time.
TEXT_BANLOP106_04692_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: Luckily, I have found a Way well suited to preserving our lights' healthy glare. He should be gathering materials for spare parts in the Carrotorium─might you go and lend him your assistance?
TEXT_BANLOP106_04692_LOPORRIT04692_000_0: ...What? Oh. You're the one Managingway sent. Pieces for the lights. Right.
Here. See if you can make any metal conductors with these. I have more if you run out.
Here. See if you can make any cosmetic attachments with these. I have more if you run out.
Here. See if you can make any internal conductors with these. I have more if you run out.
I have other things to do, so take what you make back to Managingway.
...Can I help you? Then maybe we can work in silence.

TEXT_BANLOP106_04692_MANAGINGWAY_000_030: How does your work proceed on the spare parts for our lights?
TEXT_BANLOP106_04692_MANAGINGWAY_000_031: Excellent! Just what we needed. I shall update our list of inventory immediately.
TEXT_BANLOP106_04692_MANAGINGWAY_000_032: In addition to providing the perfect ambience in which to hop, our lighting was designed with certain symbolism in mind. The smaller lights are scattered about as stars, and the mirror balls...well, they represent Etheirys, of course!
TEXT_BANLOP106_04692_MANAGINGWAY_000_033: Every star is precious and every light a beacon of hope. I do hope you will continue helping us preserve our little cosmos, !
TEXT_BANLOP107_04693_MANAGINGWAY_000_000: According to recent surveys, the availability of handheld carrotlights has dramatically increased overall musicking satisfaction.
TEXT_BANLOP107_04693_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: But a review of data from the past three cycles reveals that we must increase production of said lights by six percent if we are to meet current demand.
TEXT_BANLOP107_04693_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: I have asked Keepingway to procure additional supplies and begin assembly immediately, so could you offer them your assistance?
TEXT_BANLOP107_04693_KEEPINGWAY_000_010: By my whiskers am I glad to see you! When Managingway told me how many lights we needed to make, I thought I might cry.
TEXT_BANLOP107_04693_KEEPINGWAY_000_011: We're currently short on decorative parts, so could you handle those? The doing supporter is stocked with extra materials if you need them.
TEXT_BANLOP107_04693_KEEPINGWAY_000_012: We're currently short on handles, so could you craft some of those? The doing supporter is stocked with extra materials if you need them.
TEXT_BANLOP107_04693_KEEPINGWAY_000_013: We're currently short on glowy bits...um, the things that make the carrotlights light up? Y-You probably know better than I do! The doing supporter is stocked with extra materials if you need them.
TEXT_BANLOP107_04693_KEEPINGWAY_000_014: When you've finished, go and tell Managingway. I'll have the others start assembling from the pieces we have!

TEXT_BANLOP107_04693_MANAGINGWAY_000_030: How goes carrotlight production? Have we reached our six percent?
TEXT_BANLOP107_04693_MANAGINGWAY_000_031: Oh, thank goodness! With this, our Ways should be sufficiently supplied with carrotlights for the time being.
TEXT_BANLOP107_04693_MANAGINGWAY_000_032: We have also received requests for a wider variety of colors, as well as improvements to the carrotlights' basic functionality. Exciting times await!
TEXT_BANLOP107_04693_MANAGINGWAY_000_033: I hope I can count on your future assistance, but for now, please accept this small token of our appreciation.
TEXT_BANLOP108_04694_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: Ever since we built the musicking station, many Ways have developed a liking for music.
TEXT_BANLOP108_04694_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: Many more, however, remain unaware of the station's pleasures, and I would like you to help spread the word.
TEXT_BANLOP108_04694_MANAGINGWAY_000_003: If you're willing, please report to Ridingway yonder. He has charge of the advertising effort, and will provide you with instructions.
TEXT_BANLOP108_04694_RIDINGWAY_000_010: Ah, if it isn't . Here to help us advertise the musicking station, yes?
TEXT_BANLOP108_04694_RIDINGWAY_000_011: There isn't anything to it, really. You just need to play a spot of music for some Ways out there.
TEXT_BANLOP108_04694_RIDINGWAY_000_012: Without further ado, ride this moon-hopper over to the Carrotorium. Once there, use its hop-step function near a crowd. The feel-good sound it produces is bound to put a spring in our fellows' steps!
TEXT_BANLOP108_04694_RIDINGWAY_000_020: Ride the moon-hopper over to the Carrotorium, and use its hop-step function near a crowd. The feel-good sound it produces is bound to put a spring in our fellows' steps!
TEXT_BANLOP108_04694_SYSTEM_000_021: Some Loporrits have gathered here. Speak with Ridingway in Hoper's Hold to mount the moon-hopper, then perform the hop-step in their midst.
TEXT_BANLOP108_04694_LOPORRIT4694_000_03: (-Playful Loporrit-)Ooh, what agreeable, uplifting music! I can't help but want to rollick!
(-Playful Loporrit-)We can enjoy such feel-good sounds any time at this musicking station, you say? Thank you, we'll head there at once!
(-Playful Loporrit-)Oho, if it isn't the feel-good sounds of the musicking station! Such a wonderful place that was!
(-Playful Loporrit-)It's been too long since my last visit. I'll quickly finish up my work, then head over there again and hop till I drop!
TEXT_BANLOP108_04694_LOPORRIT4694_000_04: (-Languid Loporrit-)M-My tail and ears, they move as if they possessed a mind of their own... What in creation was that joyful sound?
(-Languid Loporrit-)The musicking station... I never knew such a marvelous place existed. I'll pay a visit as soon as I can.
(-Languid Loporrit-)Oh, there it is again, the sound that makes my tail and ears want to dance...
(-Languid Loporrit-)I must say, I was quite impressed with the musicking station, with its animated atmosphere. I must pay another visit after work.
TEXT_BANLOP108_04694_MANAGINGWAY_000_050: There you are, . My colleagues at the musicking station are pleased to report a measurable increase in guests.
TEXT_BANLOP108_04694_MANAGINGWAY_000_051: This is no doubt due to your efforts. We hope to advertise the facility on a regular basis, and when next we do so, I trust we can depend on you again.
TEXT_BANLOP109_04695_MANAGINGWAY_000_000: In no small part due to your efforts, many Ways have begun frequenting the Dreaming Workshop. And while this is a pleasing development, the increase in traffic has led to more filth, which our cleaners struggle to deal with.
TEXT_BANLOP109_04695_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: I raised the matter with Inventingway, who has agreed to upgrade the cleaner machina. He simply requires some components, which I would like you to supply.
TEXT_BANLOP109_04695_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: You recall the cleaner, yes? Inventingway believes there's room to upgrade it further, and it would be remiss of us to ignore this opportunity to further improve operational efficiency. To wit, I'd like you to supply the necessary components once more.
TEXT_BANLOP109_04695_MANAGINGWAY_000_003: If you would take yourself to Greatest Endsvale, my cleanly colleague there will furnish you with the requisite materials. Many thanks in advance!
TEXT_BANLOP109_04695_LOPORRIT04695_000_0: I'm a lean, mean, cleaning machine! ...Actually, that's the machine over there─and we're going to upgrade it, you say!? Music to my ears!

TEXT_BANLOP109_04695_MANAGINGWAY_000_030: Do you perchance have a cleaner component for me?
TEXT_BANLOP109_04695_MANAGINGWAY_000_031: Much obliged! I will deliver this to Inventingway at once!
TEXT_BANLOP109_04695_MANAGINGWAY_000_032: Though our friend tends to come up with nonsensical inventions, with appropriate management, he also produces highly useful ones. I shall do my best to steer his genius in the right direction!
TEXT_BANLOP110_04696_MANAGINGWAY_000_000: Among the Ways, there is one whose task was to preserve information. His name is Savingway, and he has since awakened to the dream of recording our voices.
TEXT_BANLOP110_04696_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: To that end, he is in the midst of developing a supporter with voice-recording functionality, and has requested some components for it.
TEXT_BANLOP110_04696_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: If you're willing to craft these components, please seek out Keepingway yonder. He will provide you with guidance as well as the necessary materials.
TEXT_BANLOP110_04696_KEEPINGWAY_000_010: Working on Savingway's request, are you? Then you've come to the right Way!
TEXT_BANLOP110_04696_KEEPINGWAY_000_011: What he needs is a component for the circuit board. Here are the materials─if you require more, the doing supporter will assist you.
TEXT_BANLOP110_04696_KEEPINGWAY_000_012: What he needs is a component for the organic conductor. Here are the materials─if you require more, the doing supporter will assist you.
TEXT_BANLOP110_04696_KEEPINGWAY_000_013: What he needs is a component for the liquid semiconductor. Here are the materials─if you require more, the doing supporter will assist you.
TEXT_BANLOP110_04696_KEEPINGWAY_000_014: Once the item is ready, hop-skip over with it to Savingway. You'll find him at work in the northwest of the Carrotorium.

TEXT_BANLOP110_04696_LOPORRIT04696_000_0: Haha, great success! While there's some distortion, the quality is already quite serviceable, and we should be able to improve upon it!

TEXT_BANLOP110_04696_LOPORRIT04696_200_0: I've never heard such a horrifying sound... Is it simply data corruption, or something else? I must look into it...
TEXT_BANLOP110_04696_LOPORRIT04696_000_0: Well, though much remains to be done, we've confirmed the supporter's operation. I'll keep working on my dream─the dream that everyone will be able to listen to their favorite sounds, be it a loved one's voice or a song, no matter where they are. I hope that you'll lend me a hand again!

I'll keep working on my dream─the dream that everyone will be able to listen to their favorite sounds, be it a loved one's voice or a song, no matter where they are. I hope that you'll lend me a hand again!
TEXT_BANLOP110_04696_MANAGINGWAY_000_031: Well now, not only did you craft and deliver the component, you also attended the start-up test? Savingway would have appreciated that, I'm sure. I thank you as well.
TEXT_BANLOP110_04696_MANAGINGWAY_000_032: Be it the hum of activity as we work or songs we love, many are the sounds worth preserving. Through efficient and effective management, I shall do my part to help Savingway realize his dream!
TEXT_BANLOP110_04696_SYSTEM_000_040: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANLOP111_04697_MANAGINGWAY_000_000: There's been an emergency call from Inventingway! One of his supporters under development has taken off without warning.
TEXT_BANLOP111_04697_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: There's been an emergency call from Inventingway! Another one of his supporters has taken off without warning.
TEXT_BANLOP111_04697_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: We tracked the machine as far as Heimdall's Last Sight, where deadly Allagan weapons are known to prowl.
TEXT_BANLOP111_04697_MANAGINGWAY_000_003: As much as I dislike delegating dangerous tasks, we need you to find and retrieve the supporter. Please hurry...and be careful!
TEXT_BANLOP111_04697_SYSTEM_000_010: The supporter has ceased to function. Managingway will be eager to have it back.
TEXT_BANLOP111_04697_MANAGINGWAY_000_020: Ah, you're back, and none the worse for the wear, thank goodness. You were able to retrieve our runaway supporter, I hope?
TEXT_BANLOP111_04697_MANAGINGWAY_000_021: We're in your debt! Lest you wonder, this machine was designed to serve as our playmate.
TEXT_BANLOP111_04697_MANAGINGWAY_000_022: In taking off as it did, it appears to have mistakenly identified the Allagan weapons as friends.
TEXT_BANLOP111_04697_MANAGINGWAY_100_022: We're in your debt─again. It appears the machine still mistakenly identifies the Allagan weapons as friends...
TEXT_BANLOP111_04697_MANAGINGWAY_000_023: We all need dreams, and it's a fine thing that Inventingway is dedicated to realizing his. I just wish he didn't create work for others in the process. It rather defeats the purpose of coming up with inventions to make our lives easier.
TEXT_BANLOP112_04698_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: Ah, just the person I was looking for. Another bright-eyed dreamer has come to me seeking help─Protectingway.
TEXT_BANLOP112_04698_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: Her dream is to see that all Loporrit-kind enjoy a long and healthy life abrim with safety. At present, she's hard at work on an invention to protect us from parasitic fungal spores─and the infectious diseases they can induce. Nasty stuff.
TEXT_BANLOP112_04698_MANAGINGWAY_000_003: The moon's surface is full of all sorts of perils─inhale even one stray spore and we could find ourselves with a runny nose, rashes all over, or heavens, even loss of fur! If she can find some way to prevent such travesties from occurring, I for one would welcome it.
TEXT_BANLOP112_04698_MANAGINGWAY_000_004: Ah, . Do you have a moment to spare? Protectingway has requested your aid once again.
TEXT_BANLOP112_04698_MANAGINGWAY_000_005: It seems her invention─the parasital infection protection suit, or PIPS for short─works, and now she wishes to bolster its production.
TEXT_BANLOP112_04698_MANAGINGWAY_000_006: For the sake of all Loporrits present and─well, present, I ask that you meet her in Bestways Burrow, and assist her with the production of this invaluable device.
TEXT_BANLOP112_04698_PROTECTINGWAY_000_0: Ah, hello there! I take it Managingway sent you here to assist me. Your help is much appreciated!

As Managingway undoubtedly informed you, I'm constructing a suit designed to shield the wearer from infectious spores. Unfortunately, I'm short on deft paws able to craft the most essential components─or rather I was, until you came.
It would be wonderful if you could use these spare metal parts to craft a fastener for the suit to ensure it stays airtight! Should you run out of materials, I'm just a hop, skip, and a jump away!

It would be wonderful if you could craft an airtight fabric for the suit─can't have it letting in the stray fungal matter, after all! Should you run out of materials, I'm just a hop, skip, and a jump away!
It would be wonderful if you could craft an adhesive to ensure the suit remains airtight! Should you run out of materials, I'm just a hop, skip, and a jump away!
When you've finished, please take the component to Managingway. I wish to implement it into the suit straightaway upon my return to the machining station!
What's that? You've run out of materials? But... I clearly see you holding them right there!
What's that? You've run out of materials? But... I clearly see you holding them right there!

TEXT_BANLOP112_04698_MANAGINGWAY_000_020: ! How do matters fare with Protectingway?
TEXT_BANLOP112_04698_MANAGINGWAY_000_021: Ah, I see you've already crafted the necessary material. If it were anyone else, I would be inclined to put this through several inspections─but I know we're in good paws with you. Protectingway will doubtless be thrilled.
TEXT_BANLOP112_04698_MANAGINGWAY_000_022: Still, I wonder why she thought to create a protective suit. Rather than address a symptom of the problem, would it not be more effective to attack its source, and eradicate the infectious fungi in the first place?
TEXT_BANLOP112_04698_MANAGINGWAY_000_023: Well, it is not for me to question the dream of another. My thanks for your kind assistance!
TEXT_BANLOP113_04699_MANAGINGWAY_000_000: Tell me, have you heard of a fellow by the name of Thrillingway? An eccentric one, he is─he believes it is the sublime rush of a thrill that colors the blandness of life with meaning. I cannot say I agree, but nevertheless, he seeks our help with fulfilling his dream.
TEXT_BANLOP113_04699_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: He desires an instrument of some kind to help him discover new thrills. Unfortunately, our very best minds have been unable to grasp what precisely it is that he wishes for.
TEXT_BANLOP113_04699_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: Do you remember Thrillingway? He's come to us again, seeking a new instrument for thrills. My fellows have tried everything, but have again been unable to come up with anything that would please him.
TEXT_BANLOP113_04699_MANAGINGWAY_000_003: As a person who has seen thrills of all sorts, I believe you are the only one who can understand him. You're our last hope, in any case.
TEXT_BANLOP113_04699_MANAGINGWAY_000_004: Keepingway yonder has various materials at paw to craft what is needed. If anyone can do this, it's you.
TEXT_BANLOP113_04699_KEEPINGWAY_000_010: Here to assist with the matter concerning Thrillingway, yes? Your help is much appreciated! I should have everything you need right here, but I'm afraid the exact process of the desired item's construction is beyond my understanding...
TEXT_BANLOP113_04699_KEEPINGWAY_000_011: It seems he requires a pair of shears─but not just any pair. No, he desires blades sharp enough to carve fur clean off! <shudder> See what you can do with these pointy pieces of metal.
TEXT_BANLOP113_04699_KEEPINGWAY_000_012: He wants a sturdy coil of rope suitable for binding all four limbs of...a “friend,” allegedly. I would prefer not to know any further details, so if you could just see what you can do with this sack of materials here...
TEXT_BANLOP113_04699_KEEPINGWAY_000_013: Seems he wants a highly acidic gel for some dubious purpose I did not have the heart to inquire about. Honestly, I think it's best if we don't know. So, uh, see what you can do with these toxic substances...
TEXT_BANLOP113_04699_KEEPINGWAY_000_015: When you've finished, please deliver the item to a certain terrified Loporrit in Greatest Endsvale. Just look for a fellow trembling with fear, you can't miss 'em. They'll take over the delivery from there.
TEXT_BANLOP113_04699_KEEPINGWAY_100_015: Given the unique and trying nature of the request, you may find yourself in need of additional materials. Should that be the case, simply approach the doing supporter yonder for replenishments.

TEXT_BANLOP113_04699_LOPORRIT04699_000_0: D-D-Did you bring the item Th-Thrillingway requested? Oh sweet Mother Hydaelyn, I'm too afraid to look... <whimper>
Oh dear, y-you actually made it. But is it safe to deliver it to him? The th-things he'll do... <shiver>

TEXT_BANLOP113_04699_MANAGINGWAY_000_040: You're returned! For you to have completed so unusual a request with such aplomb, you truly were the right person for the job.
TEXT_BANLOP113_04699_MANAGINGWAY_000_041: Thrillingway appears to be quite pleased with the item, but I must say his behavior has grown increasingly erratic. I suppose it will be fine as long as he's happy, and no one gets hurt... No one has been hurt, right?
TEXT_BANLOP113_04699_SYSTEM_000_050: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANLOP114_04700_MANAGINGWAY_000_000: Ah, , you couldn't have come at a better time. You see, Inventingway's been tinkering around with one of the supporters─as he is wont to do─and claims to have come up with the next best thing since carrots.
TEXT_BANLOP114_04700_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: Now, I take no joy in asking yet another favor of you, but it seems he needs help of the non-Loporrit variety with conducting some kind of experiment. Would you be willing to lend the fellow a paw?
TEXT_BANLOP114_04700_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: If you are, you'll find his assistant nearby the Carrotorium entrance. He'll be happy to give you all the particulars.
TEXT_BANLOP114_04700_LOPORRIT04700_000_0: You must be the person we ordered! Oh, don't look at me like that, we've nothing nefarious planned. We just need you to help us run a little test for our latest invention: the dream maker!
But what is this dream maker, you ask─or so I imagine you will. Why, it's a marvelous machine that analyzes a subject's mind, and, wait for it─grants them their innermost desire. Brilliant, isn't it?

Lest you worry, I'm the subject of this experiment. The maker's sensors are regretfully indiscriminate at present, causing it to confuse any old Loporrit that goes near it with me. That's where you come in.
You need simply head west from here, where you'll find the dream maker in standby mode, and input the voice command, “dream bigger.” From there, the maker will execute the experiment as programmed.
It's just west of here, as I mentioned. You need only say “dream bigger” aloud beside it, and the maker should carry out its designed function.
TEXT_BANLOP114_04700_SUPPORTER04700_000_: <bleep> <bloop> Well how do you do! This maker of dreams is feeling awfully useless simply awaiting commands, so just sing out the magic words whenever you're ready and we can get to work!
TEXT_BANLOP114_04700_SYSTEM_000_021: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing the words “dream bigger” to activate the dream maker.
TEXT_BANLOP114_04700_SUPPORTER04700_000_: <beep> Oh, my! There's the command, right in this maker's auditory inputs! Now activating the dream realization protocol... Performing a remote analysis of the target subject... Oooh, dream identified! How predictable! Carrots!
TEXT_BANLOP114_04700_SYSTEM_000_023: The dream maker departed to enact some dubious function in relation to the spunky Loporrit's innermost desire. Return to him to report the results of the experiment.
TEXT_BANLOP114_04700_SUPPORTER04700_100_: <boop> Hello again! Thanks to you, another dream has been realized. With that, it's time...this dream maker...went to sleep...
TEXT_BANLOP114_04700_LOPORRIT04700_000_0: Ah, you came back. Good thing you did, as I'm feeling awfully perturbed. It beggars belief, but as I stood here pondering what manner of fantastical dream the maker would fulfill, it flew up to me and shoved a bloody carrot in my mouth!

As the carrot slipped down my throat, I had just enough time to give it a cursory lick─and from its flavor discovered I was choking on what could only be an iron carrot. I feel as if I could hop to Etheirys and back!

Though that's not of much use to anyone, is it now? I suppose the experiment is a failure, but I'd be lying if I said I've never wished for the strength to tear this thing apart with my bare paws... Only every now and then, mind you.

As my vision blurred, and my desperate gasps for air went unheeded by the maker─focused on plunging the carrot down my throat as it was─my head began to feel light...light as if I'd just eaten a philosopher's carrot! Right now, I bet I could solve any mystery of the great expanse!
Given the result, we can surely declare the experiment a success. I mean, if this isn't irrefutable proof that Inventingway's visionary designs will lead us to greatness, I don't know what is!

First I was shocked, then I was scared, until finally, I managed to swallow the damn thing. My gut tells me it was a carrot of happiness, but─ Ah, and there's the warm, fuzzy feeling... Ohohoho! Happiness has come knocking, my friend!
Eh heh heh heh! The experiment was a success! No, it was a failure! Bahaha, I no longer care!
I-In any case, the experiment is finished! I'd better return to Inventingway and apprise him of the results─would you mind reporting to Managingway?
TEXT_BANLOP114_04700_MANAGINGWAY_000_040: Ah, you're back. How did the experiment go?
TEXT_BANLOP114_04700_MANAGINGWAY_000_041: Mhmm...mhmm... I see. Well, the assault by carrot notwithstanding, it sounds like Inventingway and his team are thoroughly enjoying their work on this dream maker of theirs.
TEXT_BANLOP114_04700_MANAGINGWAY_000_042: I only hope that no ill comes of their good intentions─wouldn't want another nasty incident like that affair with the Big Cheese. At any rate, it seems they've more tests to conduct, so do try to give them a paw again when you can spare the time.
TEXT_BANLOP115_04701_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: ! Pardon my plumpness, but we need printing materials, and lots of them.
TEXT_BANLOP115_04701_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: With the establishment of the cooking station, a growing number of our Ways have developed an interest in cooking, you see, and so Cookingway decided to put together a beginner's cookbook.
TEXT_BANLOP115_04701_MANAGINGWAY_000_004: Alas, with the number of would-be culinarians increasing at such speed, the cookbooks sold out in the blink of an eye, and with a dearth of the necessary printing materials, we're unable to make any more.
TEXT_BANLOP115_04701_MANAGINGWAY_000_005: ! Pardon my plumpness, but we once again find ourselves with a shortage of printing materials.
TEXT_BANLOP115_04701_MANAGINGWAY_000_006: Cookingway's cookbook is popular as ever, and without your help, we'll never be able to keep up with demand.
TEXT_BANLOP115_04701_MANAGINGWAY_000_007: We would be duly grateful if you could speak with Keepingway yonder, and use the ingredients he has at hand to craft the necessary materials.
TEXT_BANLOP115_04701_KEEPINGWAY_000_010: Here about the printing materials, yes?
TEXT_BANLOP115_04701_KEEPINGWAY_000_011: Then without further ado, please use these spare parts to cast a number of matrices for the book's typesetting. Should you run out of parts, the yonder doing supporter has plenty more available.
TEXT_BANLOP115_04701_KEEPINGWAY_000_012: Then without further ado, please use these lengths of wood to produce the finest quality paper carats can buy. Should you run out of wood, the yonder doing supporter has plenty more available.
TEXT_BANLOP115_04701_KEEPINGWAY_000_013: Then without further ado, please use these vials filled with perfectly safe chemicals to produce a suitable ink for the book. Should you run out of ingredients, the yonder doing supporter has plenty more available.
TEXT_BANLOP115_04701_KEEPINGWAY_000_014: When you've finished, please deliver the items to Managingway. Good luck!

TEXT_BANLOP115_04701_MANAGINGWAY_000_021: How fares the procurement of printing materials? We wouldn't want to keep those cooking hopefuls waiting for too long...
TEXT_BANLOP115_04701_MANAGINGWAY_000_022: Perfect─we can restart production immediately. Thank you, as always, for rising to the occasion!
TEXT_BANLOP116_04702_MANAGINGWAY_000_000: The cooking station has been a smashing success since its grand opening, and I couldn't be more pleased! ...Well, perhaps I could be more pleased should the others stop clambering over one another just to get a taste of Cookingway's culinary twists on the traditional carrot.
TEXT_BANLOP116_04702_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: Unfortunately, his indispensable carrot chiller has broken down amidst the overwhelming demand, and many of us─myself included─wish for it to be repaired posthaste. The drop in productivity the workshop suffers in its absence is not to be borne.
TEXT_BANLOP116_04702_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: , have you heard? Oh, it's just awful─the carrot chiller you helped to repair has broken down again!
TEXT_BANLOP116_04702_MANAGINGWAY_000_003: As you're aware, the cooking station's frozen beverages are the talk of the hold, and nary a soul can keep their paws off of them. Hence, the carrot chiller is─or rather was in perpetual use. Inventingway himself is seeing if he can refine the design to prevent this from happening again.
TEXT_BANLOP116_04702_MANAGINGWAY_000_004: One of our Ways in charge of overseeing repairs has already gone to inspect it, but surely the process would go faster if you were there to assist them. I urge you to meet with them in the Carrotorium as soon as you are able.

I will set about getting the chiller up and running again with what you've made. Pray return to Managingway and let them know it will soon be in working order!

TEXT_BANLOP116_04702_MANAGINGWAY_000_040: Oh, that's wonderful news, . It sounds like the machine will be ready much sooner than we'd anticipated. I cannot thank you enough.
TEXT_BANLOP116_04702_MANAGINGWAY_000_041: Why does the carrot chiller see such fierce demand, you ask? Well, allow me to answer your question with another: how would you react to a delicious beverage comprised of pulverized chilled carrots?
TEXT_BANLOP116_04702_MANAGINGWAY_000_042: I thought so. The staff at the cooking station can even combine your favorite carrots and blend them into an original drink to keep you alert and refreshed─or whatever else you fancy, I suppose. Hmmm, perhaps I should put in my next order sooner rather than later...

TEXT_BANLOP117_04703_MANAGINGWAY_000_000: Greetings, . I was just thinking about how important this endeavor of ours truly is. You see, one of our fellow Ways was recently inspired to pursue a dream of their own─one they never would have discovered if not for Cookingway's example.
TEXT_BANLOP117_04703_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: In the end, that's what all of this is about─helping one another find and pursue our individual dreams. Alas, our friend was out in the midst of this pursuit, foraging for culinary ingredients, when their tools broke.
TEXT_BANLOP117_04703_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: I hate to impose, but since they refuse to return, it would do much to ease our concern if someone like you─a person well accustomed to voyages on the moon's surface─were to search for our willful friend and help them repair their equipment. You'll do it, won't you?
TEXT_BANLOP117_04703_SUPPORTER04703_000_: Greetings and salutations! Normally, this supporter would offer you materials, but is not currently authorized to do so!
TEXT_BANLOP117_04703_LOPORRIT04703_000_0: Curse those mushrooms and their sturdy stems! I was just trying to get some samples and now my equipment is buggered to the star and back! ...Managingway did send you, didn't they? I would hate to have done all this ranting at some random passerby.

Anyway, do you think you could make a blade sharp enough to cut through hardy fungi with these steel components? No need to worry about running out of materials─the supporter I brought along has plenty more where that came from!

Anyway, after nearly losing a paw from my blade rebounding off of those infernal fungi, a nonslip handle has quickly risen to the top of my priorities. Would you be able to make one with these materials? The supporter I brought along has plenty more where that came from, should you need it!

Anyway, I can't have my tool jamming on me again. Do you think you could prepare some oil with these materials so I can ensure the blade is in perfect form? The supporter I brought along has plenty more where that came from, should you need it!
When you've finished, please hand the item here so I can complete the repairs. I'm not leaving until I've cut out every last tasty ilm of those mushrooms!

TEXT_BANLOP117_04703_LOPORRIT04703_000_0: This is perfect! Once I've installed it into my equipment, I should have no problem collecting samples of those deceptively firm fungi! And when I have...I shall make a dish the likes of which Cookingway himself has never even dreamed of making!
Ahem. Well, I'm going to go chop up some mushrooms. You should head back and let Managingway know everything here is just fine. This...might take a while.
TEXT_BANLOP117_04703_MANAGINGWAY_000_030: Welcome back! I take it our foraging friend is okay?
TEXT_BANLOP117_04703_MANAGINGWAY_000_031: I neglected to mention this earlier, but their dream is to cook undiscovered species of fungi, and enjoy the twofold thrills of exterminating harmful types of mushrooms whilst simultaneously discovering delectable new ones. And, as I understand, mushroom cuisine is also rather popular on Etheirys.
TEXT_BANLOP117_04703_MANAGINGWAY_000_032: Whether they produce a new mouthwatering recipe, or eradicate harmful fungal species first... I suppose we can't complain either way!
TEXT_BANLOP118_04704_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: Thanks to you, Cookingway's station is running as smoothly as carrot-based butter. On the other paw, my manager's eye has noticed that the Loporrits who patronize it make up only a fraction of its potential customer base...
TEXT_BANLOP118_04704_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: Thanks to your generous assistance, the cooking station remains popular as ever. That said, I wager we could increase its customer base further by conducting another promotional campaign.
TEXT_BANLOP118_04704_MANAGINGWAY_000_003: It so happens that Cookingway is of the same mind, and has made a selection of samples to help spread word. And who better to distribute them than you, a person from Etheirys no self-respecting Loporrit could refuse?
TEXT_BANLOP118_04704_MANAGINGWAY_100_003: Ahem. Now, if I may take your silence as tacit agreement, I would point you towards Keepingway, who currently has the food samples in an insulative container under his care. Pray speak with him for the rest of the particulars.
TEXT_BANLOP118_04704_KEEPINGWAY_100_004: Good to see you! Come to help with distributing these food samples, have you? Just a moment...
TEXT_BANLOP118_04704_KEEPINGWAY_100_005: Voilà! Cookingway's very own carrot steak. According to him, it's an original recipe that takes the rich flavor of a fresh carrot and, ahem, “revolutionizes” it into a hot, meat-like dish.
TEXT_BANLOP118_04704_KEEPINGWAY_100_006: One taste of this, and no Way will be able to resist taking another bite. Aye, I bet the cooking station will be bustling like never before when everyone comes hopping for seconds! Now, I'd be much obliged if you could distribute these samples in the Carrotorium before they become cold!
TEXT_BANLOP118_04704_LOPORRIT4690_000_01: Now that I've finished my duties, I'd better fetch something to eat. I'm positively starving...
This savory, seductive aroma that pulls at my chest and teases my stomach can only be...carrot! Oh goodness me, I'm salivating rather profusely. May I take a bite?

Wh-What in Mother Hydaelyn's name is this!? It's absolutely scrumptious! How could I have lived in ignorance of such supreme delectableness for so long? I must have more... Excuse me, I will be at the cooking station if you have need of me!
O-Oh my...the carrot steak. Have you brought another sample for me?
How can a carrot be so succulent and sweet? Goodness, this dish truly is delicious!
But I bet it would be even better hot off the stove... Pardon me, friend, I must give the stomach what it wants!
Mmm, another healthy and hearty day of growth for my carrots! Won't be much longer until they're ready for consumption... Oh, er, didn't see you there. Did you need something?
TEXT_BANLOP118_04704_LOPORRIT4690_000_02: Er, is this a grilled carrot? Ugh, the ignorance. It is the very raw fleshiness of carrots that make them sublime. To cook one is criminal. Alas, I cannot reject a gift from a person of Etheirys. Very well, I shall take a bite─but just the one.

How rich a flavor...how provocative a texture! And the garnish─this fragrant spice─takes the carrot's delightfully simple taste and gives it complexity─nay, vibrancy! To think that a carrot could be transformed into something quite so different, and yet so dainty...

I know this fragrance! As if I could ever forget the dish which took the sublimity of carrots and made it divine! Even now, my paws move with a mind of their own... I-I am all but helpless to resist...
Oooh, how unchangingly provocative its texture! How heavenly its rich flavor...
I can dine upon more exquisite dishes like this by visiting the cooking station, you say? Very well, then. If you'll excuse me.
<yawn> ...Hmm, what's that rumbling noise? Or is it growling? ...Oh, it's my stomach! Mayhap I ought to have eaten before my nap.
You're distributing samples of food from the cooking station? How timely! It looks to be some sort of steak...made from carrots? I-It smells good...
TEXT_BANLOP118_04704_LOPORRIT4690_000_03: W-Wow! It's so juicy! And its texture so soft! Is this the sensation carnivores feel when gorging on an animal's flesh?
I can get more of this by visiting the cooking station, right? Then that's where I'm headed! Thanks for the sample!
Oh, have you brought another sample of the carrot steak? I was just daydreaming about it!

Mmmmmm! I can't get enough of this sensation! Each time I take a bite, the carrot's rich juices gush into my mouth, and it makes me feel like an unstoppable predator! There are more of these freshly prepared at the cooking station, right? Then I'm off for seconds!
TEXT_BANLOP118_04704_MANAGINGWAY_000_040: Welcome back, . You'll be pleased to know that the cooking station is now abuzz with hungry customers, eager to devour Cookingway's delicious cuisine!
TEXT_BANLOP118_04704_MANAGINGWAY_000_041: We have you─and the undeniable delectability of the carrot steak─to thank for this. No doubt Cookingway is thrilled with the results. Your assistance, as always, is appreciated!
TEXT_BANLOP119_04705_MANAGINGWAY_000_000: Recently, Cookingway's culinary enterprises have been on fire! To borrow a colloquialism, of course. I assure you that nothing in our cooking station is unduly alight.
TEXT_BANLOP119_04705_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: Many Loporrits have expressed an interest in cuisine, but we simply don't have enough whisks and spoons to go around.
TEXT_BANLOP119_04705_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: Perhaps you could lend your crafting expertise to our plight? One of Cookingway's sous-chefs should be feverishly assembling the necessary kitchen implements in the Carrotorium, but I am sure they would be glad of the help.
TEXT_BANLOP119_04705_LOPORRIT04705_000_0: You've come to make kitchen items for us? Oh, thank you! My fur's been in quite the ruffle over our shortage.

We're quite short on metal mixers, you see. And have you tried whipping cream by paw? We can't have another fainting Way. Tell me if you need more supplies, but if you could start working at once, I would be forever grateful.

We don't have nearly enough happiness dishes, you see. Everyone's been very polite about it, but you can see it in their eyes when they have to use a regular dish... Tell me if you need more supplies, but if you could start working at once, I would be forever grateful.

We're almost out of this miraculous substance that allows you to control the sense of taste. Have you heard of “spice” before? Anyway, tell me if you need more supplies, but if you could start working at once, I would be forever grateful.
Take what you've made back to Hoper's Hold, and Managingway will see it delivered to the cooking station. Oh, cooking station... How I long for you...
You have what you need, don't you? Then hurry! The Ways are depending on us!
You have what you need, don't you? Then hurry! The Ways are depending on us!

TEXT_BANLOP119_04705_MANAGINGWAY_000_030: How goes the kitchenware assembly? Our aspiring cooks seem eager to get started.
TEXT_BANLOP119_04705_MANAGINGWAY_000_031: Splendid! Cookingway will be ecstatic to hear that more Ways can now try their paws at his passion.
TEXT_BANLOP119_04705_MANAGINGWAY_000_032: We have noted a direct correlation between bouts of vigorous rhythmic hopping and subsequent traffic to the cooking station. The relationship between music and food seems ripe with exciting new possibilities, don't you agree?
TEXT_BANLOP119_04705_MANAGINGWAY_000_033: Not to mention Cookingway's tireless efforts to create new menu items. Often have I seen him quizzing our Ways in regards to their preferences. Watching such collaboration is food for the soul...to borrow another colloquialism, of course.
TEXT_BANLOP119_04705_MANAGINGWAY_100_033: Not to mention Cookingway's tireless efforts to create new menu items. It seems he keeps in regular contact with Jammingway about the Last Dregs' more popular dishes. Watching such collaboration is food for the soul...to borrow another colloquialism, of course.
TEXT_BANLOP120_04706_MANAGINGWAY_000_000: Prodigious hopping at the musicking station seems to have awakened a passion for physical fitness within some of our Ways.
TEXT_BANLOP120_04706_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: Finding such hopping insufficient to reach their goals, they have requested items that may help enhance their athleticism.
TEXT_BANLOP120_04706_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: Keepingway is gathering the necessary supplies for athletic equipment as we speak. Would you be willing to dash over and help?
TEXT_BANLOP120_04706_KEEPINGWAY_100_010: Thank you for helping, ! I gathered everything I thought might help with, um, exercise.
TEXT_BANLOP120_04706_KEEPINGWAY_100_011: For instance, this pole. If you attach heavy objects to either end, you could lift it over your head and...and people would think, “Wow, that's really something!” That sounds good, right? I'll have you make that.
TEXT_BANLOP120_04706_KEEPINGWAY_100_012: For instance, this spring. It's sort of tough, so if you attached handles, you could pull on it and, um, become really tired so you can nap? That sounds good, right? I'll have you make that.
TEXT_BANLOP120_04706_KEEPINGWAY_100_013: For instance, these bitter powders. I'm...not sure what's in them, but I think I heard that bitter things are good for you, so mixing these together should make something...good. Right? I'll have you do that.
TEXT_BANLOP120_04706_KEEPINGWAY_100_014: Don't worry about running out of supplies─the doing supporter is well stocked.
TEXT_BANLOP120_04706_KEEPINGWAY_100_015: Once you're finished, take it over to Greatest Endsvale. That's where those Ways have exercise. Or do exercise. I'm not really sure what they're doing, to be honest...

Mother's mercy! I-Is that what I think it is!?
With this, our dreams of toning our muscles to the density of iron carrots may yet be realized! I must go and tell the others!
