TEXT_BANLOP120_04706_MANAGINGWAY_000_040: It seems you've made some energetic Ways very happy indeed! I thank you, . Something tells me we haven't heard the last of their demands.
TEXT_BANLOP120_04706_MANAGINGWAY_000_041: Perhaps I too will consider stacking my body, as they say. ...Or was it “building”? Ahem!
TEXT_BANLOP120_04706_SYSTEM_000_050: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: It's come to my attention that a number of our Ways have been working themselves to the bone in pursuit of fulfilling their dreams─indeed, some are reportedly overcome with fatigue.
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: I can understand the desire to devote one's all to realizing a goal, but to do so at the cost of one's very own health...it is not only doomed to lead to undue exhaustion, but it is all so very inefficient. I daresay some deft management is in order.
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_MANAGINGWAY_000_003: As managing is what I do best, I would have you to coordinate with Ridingway yonder, and revitalize our weary comrades with the best cure for a pair of drooping ears: music.
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_RIDINGWAY_000_010: Ah, . Here to get a bounce back in some of our Ways' hop, eh?
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_RIDINGWAY_000_011: Well, nothing brings it out like music. Once they hear some merry melodies, the thought of exhaustion will be the furthest thing from their minds as the uncontrollable urge to move takes over.
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_RIDINGWAY_000_012: But don't let me keep you here with all this talk─you ought to get hopping! Board the moon-hopper here, and perform the hop-step when you come across any exhausted Ways. We're counting on you!
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_RIDINGWAY_000_013: Seems the moon-hopper returned with some unexecuted protocols. Sorry for the trouble, but I'd appreciate it if you could hop back out there and continue to revitalize any exhausted Ways you find with the hop-step.
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_LOPORRIT04707A_000_: <yawn> Oh, what I wouldn't do to curl up somewhere for a nice long nap. But the items for the shopping center...I must make more...
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_SYSTEM_100_020: Speak with Ridingway in Hoper's Hold to mount the moon-hopper, then perform the hop-step in the midst of exhausted Loporrits.
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_LOPORRIT04707A_000_: Wh-What thrilling music! I thought I couldn't move another step, but now I could skip to my hibernation chamber! Once I've had a few winks, I'll get back to making items!
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_LOPORRIT04707B_000_: <yawn> I-I can't remember the last time I slept... I've been working on new inventions day in and day out without even so much as a...as a... I don't even know. Ugh, curse my admiration for Inventingway and my sycophantic desire to be recognized!
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_SYSTEM_100_022: Speak with Ridingway in Hoper's Hold to mount the moon-hopper, then perform the hop-step in the midst of exhausted Loporrits.
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_LOPORRIT04707B_000_: My, what a comforting melody! Just by hearing it I feel as though the panic that constantly hounds me may subside for even a moment─and look! Even my paws have begun to shake less violently!
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_LOPORRIT04707B_100_: You have my thanks. I never knew music could do such wonderful things, but now that I do, I shan't be wasting any more time with this “sleep” business. I have inventions to build! A boss to curry favor with! Failure to live in fear of!
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_LOPORRIT04707C_100_: I cannot move an ilm. An ilm, I tell you! I've been cooking up meals as the orders come at the cooking station, but they never, ever, stop coming in! I just want to rest...whatever that even looks like...
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_SYSTEM_000_025: Speak with Ridingway in Hoper's Hold to mount the moon-hopper, then perform the hop-step in the midst of exhausted Loporrits.
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_LOPORRIT04707C_000_: This music...it's wonderful! I feel hope again! I feel alive! I could cook a hundred hundred more meals! Thank you for playing it. I was so weary I nearly forgot the joy I found in cooking. It is my dream, and as hard as it may be at times, it does truly bring me joy. I will continue to do my best!
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_MANAGINGWAY_000_030: You are returned! Tell me, how did our exhausted Ways feel after hearing the music you played for them?
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_MANAGINGWAY_000_031: Superb! Thanks to you and the wonders of music, my fellows were able to regain a bit of their lost vigor. It truly puts the power of melodies in a new light.
TEXT_BANLOP121_04707_MANAGINGWAY_000_032: Management takes many forms, and caring for one's health is but one of them. Alas, it would seem some of our Ways have yet to grasp the concept, and so I do fear I shall be calling upon your help again in the near future.
TEXT_BANLOP122_04708_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: Our imaging station has been awash with Ways eager to try their paws at painting.
TEXT_BANLOP122_04708_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: However, as with many of our endeavors, zealousness has overwhelmed available supply, and we find ourselves at a loss. A loss of paint, in this case.
TEXT_BANLOP122_04708_MANAGINGWAY_000_003: Paintingway has just left for Lovingway's Darlings to gather the necessary supplies for more. Might you lend them your support? I haven't the heart to explain to another Way that we are currently out of Sunshine Yellow...
TEXT_BANLOP122_04708_SUPPORTER4708_000_0: <blip> Ready and happy to provide for you.
TEXT_BANLOP122_04708_PAINTINGWAY_000_010: What a relief to see you, . I was hoping I might ask for your help!
TEXT_BANLOP122_04708_PAINTINGWAY_000_011: I'm currently gathering mushrooms that will make our pigments sparkle something wonderful, but if you could help prepare some other supplies for me, our paint shall be done in half the time.
TEXT_BANLOP122_04708_PAINTINGWAY_000_012: You seem to know your way around metal, so could you grind me a glimmering powder? Our paint will blind our artists with its brilliance! ...Hopefully only metaphorically. This doing supporter should have any extra supplies you need.
TEXT_BANLOP122_04708_PAINTINGWAY_000_013: You seem to have clever fingers, so could you make me a small agitator? And before you try a person-joke, I mean the tool─I'll need it to mix the paint. This doing supporter should have any extra supplies you need.
TEXT_BANLOP122_04708_PAINTINGWAY_000_014: You seem to know how to mix a good concoction, so could you create me an additive to moderate hue? Sunshine Yellow is trickier than you'd think, and the Ways won't settle for Lemon anymore. This doing supporter should have any extra supplies you need.

TEXT_BANLOP122_04708_PAINTINGWAY_000_022: Lovely! Just what the artist ordered.
TEXT_BANLOP122_04708_PAINTINGWAY_000_023: I've finished up here, so I'll head back and start mixing. Thank you for your help, and do see Managingway about a reward─you've earned it!
TEXT_BANLOP122_04708_MANAGINGWAY_000_030: Now, that is the look of a  who has made a significant contribution to the happiness of artistic Loporrits!
TEXT_BANLOP122_04708_MANAGINGWAY_000_031: The drive to create with one's own paw─be it art or destiny─is nothing but inspirational. It truly demonstrates the strength of each of our Ways.
TEXT_BANLOP122_04708_MANAGINGWAY_000_032: Through the creativity you have been helping us cultivate, we are slowly awakening to our full potential. Self-congratulatory though it may sound to say, I do believe our future shines bright upon the horizon.
TEXT_BANLOP123_04709_MANAGINGWAY_000_000: , might I trouble you for a moment?
TEXT_BANLOP123_04709_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: While it warms the heart to see so many Ways excited about painting, it has come to our attention that certain artists are allowing their creativity to overflow the bounds of the imaging station.
TEXT_BANLOP123_04709_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: It seems as though an enthusiastic artist has been coloring outside the lines once more.
TEXT_BANLOP123_04709_MANAGINGWAY_000_003: I do not condone the destruction of creative endeavors, but neither can I forgive an infringement of the rules. Would you be so kind as to scrub away the unauthorized artwork?
TEXT_BANLOP123_04709_SYSTEM_000_010: The paint melts away with ephemeral beauty. Even cleaning can be creative!
TEXT_BANLOP123_04709_MANAGINGWAY_000_020: Thank you for cleaning those up. Another moment and we'd all be subject to Livingway's wrath...
TEXT_BANLOP123_04709_MANAGINGWAY_000_021: You may be pleased to hear that our creative culprit has been apprehended and given a strict talking-to.
TEXT_BANLOP123_04709_MANAGINGWAY_000_022: Apparently, deliberately shirking the rules is an integral part of their artistic process, but such a reason shouldn't belie common courtesy. I must give some thought as to how one manages such a creative desire...
TEXT_BANLOP124_04710_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: Our imaging station is the pride of Hoper's Hold. Is not a Way entitled to the paint of their paws? I, for one, say “Yes!”
TEXT_BANLOP124_04710_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: ...In principle, anyway. So long as that paint doesn't get smeared into fur or dripped from whiskers. Or splashed everywhere. Oh, , we are in desperate need of soap!
TEXT_BANLOP124_04710_MANAGINGWAY_000_003: Could you make us some? Please? Just to mop up our more creative and forgetful Ways before they track their artistic ambitions all over the burrow.
TEXT_BANLOP124_04710_MANAGINGWAY_000_004: Removingway is cleaning up paint in Greatest Endsvale as we speak. Go to them. They are well versed in suds. Please, do hurry!
TEXT_BANLOP124_04710_REMOVINGWAY_000_005: ! And not a moment too soon. Something tells me one more colorful footprint might pickle Managingway's carrots for good.
TEXT_BANLOP124_04710_REMOVINGWAY_000_006: Here, these materials should yield some strong soap. A capable crafter like you could probably make it blindfolded! ...Though I don't recommend it.
TEXT_BANLOP124_04710_REMOVINGWAY_000_007: Here, these materials should yield some strong soap. A capable crafter like you could probably make it blindfolded! ...Though I don't recommend it.
TEXT_BANLOP124_04710_REMOVINGWAY_000_008: Here, these materials should yield some strong soap. A capable crafter like you could probably make it blindfolded! ...Though I don't recommend it.
TEXT_BANLOP124_04710_REMOVINGWAY_000_009: Take it straight to Managingway once you've finished. The sooner, the better, I'd say. And if your hand slips, this doing supporter should have all you need to start again.

TEXT_BANLOP124_04710_MANAGINGWAY_000_019: Have you any soapy succor? I just saw a Way pass by splattered from nose to tail...
TEXT_BANLOP124_04710_MANAGINGWAY_000_020: Magnificent! I could kiss you, ! ...People express that sentiment at times like these, correct? Baffling, but if it conveys my thanks, I should be glad to share such theoretical intentions.
TEXT_BANLOP124_04710_MANAGINGWAY_000_021: Our dreams are ever strengthened─and now thoroughly purified─by your efforts. I do hope you will help us again...especially when the soap runs out.
TEXT_BANLOP125_04711_MANAGINGWAY_000_000: Some of our artists have been so prolific in their painting that they now claim to lack sufficient inspiration.
TEXT_BANLOP125_04711_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: One Way in particular has become quite disheartened─so much so that they have taken to conversing with the very nothingness that plagues them. To be frank, I'm more than somewhat concerned.
TEXT_BANLOP125_04711_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: I do hate to trouble you with such a gloomy affair, but could you perhaps offer them some encouragement? You should find them wandering Greatest Endsvale and muttering sad words.
TEXT_BANLOP125_04711_LOPORRIT04711_000_0: Aaah! Y-You frightened me. Have you come to hear of my emptiness?

With these two paws, I have depicted my entire existence. The moon. The Loporrits. The...well, that's about it, really. I have painted everything and now nothing seems new or interesting. Oh, whatever is left for me...?
TEXT_BANLOP125_04711_A2_000_002: You could try drawing a person.
TEXT_BANLOP125_04711_A3_000_003: Bunnies. Lots and lots of bunnies.
TEXT_BANLOP125_04711_LOPORRIT04711_000_0: Etheirys? But so many Ways have already painted it. A bright, blue orb suspended in unending darkness...
But wait! If I were to draw the landscapes that may or may not exist upon Etheirys...that could be very lovely!
A person? If you only knew how many Ways have drawn the people who were meant to join us...the people who never came...
But wait! If I were to draw a Loporrit as a person...that could be something remarkable!
Etheirys has Loporrits!? Why haven't I heard of this!? I must draw them straightaway!
I feel alive again─inspired! I didn't think it possible. Thank you, . And thanks to Managingway for sending you!
TEXT_BANLOP125_04711_MANAGINGWAY_000_030: Right on schedule! Our muttering friend has gotten straight to work at the imaging station, and I managed to sneak a glance at their progress.
TEXT_BANLOP125_04711_MANAGINGWAY_000_031: I do believe they are recreating images from Etheirys. Regardless of accuracy, the awe they hold for Mother Hydaelyn's star is palpable in their work.
TEXT_BANLOP125_04711_MANAGINGWAY_000_032: It is...unique to say the least. “Terrifying,” may be a more accurate word. A beast of neither man nor Loporrit, grinning eerily from the confines of a dark prison...? Ahem.
TEXT_BANLOP125_04711_MANAGINGWAY_000_033: I do believe they are drawing what you would call a “bunny.” While anatomically questionable, their work exhibits a tangible curiosity and excitement regarding the creatures.
TEXT_BANLOP125_04711_MANAGINGWAY_000_034: At the end of the day, the priority of art is its creation, not its analysis. So long as our Way remains bright-eyed and bushy-tailed, I am quite satisfied.
TEXT_BANLOP125_04711_MANAGINGWAY_000_035: Still, the flow of inspiration is known to be fickle, so I may call upon you again should our Ways require it. Until next time.
TEXT_BANLOP126_04712_MANAGINGWAY_000_000: Troubling...very troubling, indeed... , would you consider destruction to be an art form?
TEXT_BANLOP126_04712_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: Our imaging station was conceived as a place for all Ways to express their creativity, but one among us claims destruction to be his true calling. And while I do not judge the viability of artistic endeavors on principle, destroying the artwork of others simply will not do.
TEXT_BANLOP126_04712_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: I decided to exercise a modicum of managerial authority and direct this Way's destructive tendencies towards a noble goal. To wit, the elimination of menacing fungi!
TEXT_BANLOP126_04712_MANAGINGWAY_000_003: As a self-proclaimed aficionado of obliteration, the Way in question has agreed to my terms in exchange for specialized weaponry...which I promised you would provide. He should be standing just outside. Best not to keep him waiting.
TEXT_BANLOP126_04712_MANAGINGWAY_000_004: Ah, . It seems as though our aficionado of obliteration has strayed from the noble path again. Would you be so kind as to craft him more fungi fighters? He...well, he has broken the other ones.
TEXT_BANLOP126_04712_MANAGINGWAY_000_006: He should be waiting for you just outside, burning with anticipation just as passionately as before.
TEXT_BANLOP126_04712_LOPORRIT04712_000_0: Comrade! Long have I waited. We have arms to prepare, . Fungi to finish!
Devastation is my dream and ruin my aim. Take these materials. Construct for me a device capable of smashing even the most malignant mushroom into jam. Jam upon which we may feast!
Devastation is my dream and ruin my aim. Take these materials. Construct for me a device capable of smashing even the most malignant mushroom into jam. Jam upon which we may feast!

Crush as many materials as you like─the doing supporter has more. Beat upon it with your fists until it yields what you desire. So have I done! Then deliver the weapons to me, and your work will be finished. Mine, however─mine will have only just begun...

TEXT_BANLOP126_04712_LOPORRIT04712_000_0: Do you have it? My instruments of havoc?
Yes...yes! You have done me a great service, comrade. The creativity burns within me─a star of rampant smashing!
I will grind that fungi to the finest powder─vaporize its every spore! For it is not for vengeance nor ambition that I fight─it is for art. Art, I say! The battle has begun! Hyahahahahahaha!
TEXT_BANLOP126_04712_MANAGINGWAY_000_030: You've returned! And in one piece, I am glad to see. Our aficionado of obliteration seems to be making quick work of the fungi already, while our Ways' artwork lives to fight another day.
TEXT_BANLOP126_04712_MANAGINGWAY_000_031: An artist on Etheirys is said to have likened creative expression to an explosion of aetheric energy. Perhaps our destructive friend took that sentiment a tad too literally.
TEXT_BANLOP126_04712_MANAGINGWAY_000_032: Anyhow, so long as his energies are directed towards honorable goals, his unique art form poses no concern. Should he stray, however...I hope I can count on you.
TEXT_BANLOP127_04713_MANAGINGWAY_000_000: This may come as a shock to you, , but it seems our Ways have developed an insatiable interest in clothing!
TEXT_BANLOP127_04713_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: Is this not a remarkable achievement of individuality? Why, we have always worn identical garb for as long as I can remember.
TEXT_BANLOP127_04713_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: Yet as we speak, one of our Ways is busy gathering a range of materials with which to make fashion. I was hoping you might assist them─they asked for you by name, after all. You'll find them in the Carrotorium.
TEXT_BANLOP127_04713_LOPORRITA04403_100_: O-Oh! How wonderful to see you again. D-Do you remember me? I was the one who made you and your friends outfits when you first arrived! Um...I-I've practiced quite a lot since then!
I'm still in the process of gathering supplies, but I thought that maybe...you could craft something for us?
TEXT_BANLOP127_04713_LOPORRITA04403_200_: Thank you for your help the other day! Everyone really liked what you made, so maybe...you could craft something for us again?
TEXT_BANLOP127_04713_LOPORRITA04403_000_: I was thinking something shiny and impressive, like a buckle. Buckles are “in,” right? I have these materials to work with. L-Let me know if you need more.
I was thinking a “chic” accessory might be nice. Did I use that word right? I have these materials to work with. L-Let me know if you need more.
I was thinking something glittery that will make the fabric sparkle. Is that hard to do? I have these materials to work with. L-Let me know if you need more.
When you're done, I'd like you to go and show Managingway what you made. I'll be thinking up “trendy” new designs, if you need anything.
Hi! Did you need something? No? Okay.
Hi! Did you need something? No? Okay.
Hi! Did you need something? No? Okay.
Oh, you've run out of material! It is sort of tricky to twist the thing, isn't it? A-Anyway, here you are.
Oh, you've run out of material! Um, I don't really know what “chic” means, so I'll leave it to you, okay? A-Anyway, here you are.
Oh, you've run out of material! No such thing as too glittery, right? A-Anyway, here you are.
TEXT_BANLOP127_04713_MANAGINGWAY_000_031: My, how daring! I do believe I would enjoy wearing something like this myself.
TEXT_BANLOP127_04713_MANAGINGWAY_000_032: I wonder what sort of outfit this will help create. The possibilities seem endless when one stops to consider them.
TEXT_BANLOP127_04713_MANAGINGWAY_000_033: That Way is both hardworking and determined, so I have no doubt their journey upon the road of fashion will be long and fruitful. I do hope you will lend them your expertise again!
TEXT_BANLOP127_04713_SYSTEM_000_040: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_MANAGINGWAY_000_001: . I am in desperate need of your assistance.
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_MANAGINGWAY_000_002: We have recently discovered a genius among our Ways. Her indubitable skill and logic-defying innovation have quickly shown her to be a paragon of the Loporrit art world.
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_MANAGINGWAY_000_003: Consider my distress, then, when she came to me seeking an assistant. Though all our Ways possess eagerness and creativity in bounds, none, I fear, could understand her vision. None, perhaps, except you.
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_MANAGINGWAY_000_004: Her name is Sparkingway, and I have been told to direct you to the Striking Brand in northern Mare Lamentorum where she waits. I cannot claim to understand the methods of a genius, but I beg that you assist her with whatever she requires.
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_MANAGINGWAY_000_005: Sparkingway, our resident artistic genius, has requested your assistance once more. It seems she was greatly impressed by your dedication last time.
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_MANAGINGWAY_000_006: She says she will be waiting for you by the Striking Brand, as before. Take care, . And thank you.
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_SPARKINGWAY_000_010: You must be . Managingway said you would come. My name is Sparkingway.
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_SPARKINGWAY_000_011: I hear you are comfortable with handling explosive materials. That is comforting to hear, indeed. Here. Throw this at me.
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_SPARKINGWAY_000_013: There is no need to look so alarmed. As far as carrotsine tanks go, it is rather small. Although just as liable to ignite upon impact.
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_SPARKINGWAY_000_016: Art is pain, . And pain is inspiration. So throw it at me. Throw with all your might!
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_SPARKINGWAY_000_017: . How good it is to see you again.
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_SPARKINGWAY_000_018: Our artistic gains from last time proved well worth the singed fur. The wonders I created were unlike any I have ever produced. But the dream of an artist is not to rest upon her laurels. We are always hungry, . Aching for the next idea.
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_SPARKINGWAY_000_020: Aching as my body will once you hit me with this carrotsine tank. Now throw, my friend. Throw with the strength of art!
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_SPARKINGWAY_000_025: ...O-Once more. I have not seen it yet. Not felt it sear my eyes. Hit me, ! One more time!
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_SPARKINGWAY_000_026: Be not afraid of greatness! Throw!
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_SPARKINGWAY_000_028: O spark of inspiration... With this broken form...I shall create you...
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_SPARKINGWAY_000_030: Thank you, . Managingway will see that you are duly rewarded. I must return to my atelier before the light of my eyes or inspiration fades...
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_MANAGINGWAY_000_031: I believe I heard an explosion... Erm, I trust Sparkingway was satisfied with your assistance?
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_MANAGINGWAY_000_032: Well, you do often hear of artists suffering for their craft, so I imagine the scale for geniuses must exceed all supposition. I do hope she manages to finish her art before art finishes her, as it were.
TEXT_BANLOP128_04714_MANAGINGWAY_000_033: I shall check upon her later to see if she requires any further assistance. In the meantime, please accept this as thanks for supporting the proliferation and success of Loporrit fine art.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_000: Here for a status report, ? I quite understand─I get terribly anxious whenever I have to step away from the café. Why, just the other day I returned to find that a Grebuloff had snuck behind the counter to bathe in the soup...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_001: Such incidents aside, the Last Dregs couldn't be more successful. We're bustling with business, and Elysion is thriving!
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_002: Yet, as the manager of this operation, I would be remiss not to ponder new ways to juice a little more happiness out of this carrot.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_N7000_000_003: <whirr> This unit hastens to indicate that the current levels of juice and happiness are within optimal parameters. Any attempt to push either beyond capacity may prove disruptive to the present equilibrium.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_004: Of course it would be disruptive, you glorified can opener!
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_005: A threat to the status quo it may be, but innovation is the lifeblood of business. And think of our patrons' delight should we treat them to, say, thrilling entertainment over a cup of carrot coffee!
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_006: Whatever we do needs to be truly spectacular, though─so good that even the Nibirun won't simply stare morosely. If only I had any ideas whatsoever...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_A1_000_001: The Dreaming Ways are full of ideas. Can't vouch for quality, though.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_A1_000_002: Perhaps you should pay a visit to Hoper's Hold. It's quite a sight.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_008: Really, now? I had heard that they were cooking up something in the hold, but I had no idea the project was such a success!
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_009: I must see it for myself. Interested in a trip to Bestways Burrow, ? I'd appreciate your opinion on any possibilities I turn up.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_010: I trust you can mind the café, N-7000. Contact me via the Ragnarok's systems should there be any more soup scandals!
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_015: So this is the new Hoper's Hold, eh? I must say, it's a significant improvement over the old crates and buckets.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_016: As for these “stations” that everyone's hopping to join...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_017: That one over there is a true work of art! I particularly appreciate their taste in subject matter.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_018: However, one can hardly expect half a dozen civilizations to share the same aesthetic sensibilities. I shudder to imagine the pontification and gunfire that would ensue if we asked our patrons to paint a mural...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_019: Those machines remind me of N-7000─right down to the ears! They would fit in quite well with our current staff.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_020: Then again, that would hardly be an innovative addition, would it? We already have more condescending numerical projections than we could possibly need.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_021: I suppose music is another matter of taste, though those Loporrits certainly seem to be having fun.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_022: Do you think a mournful dragon would enjoy being blasted with laser lights while it sings its ancient melodies? No? Pity.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_023: A shop! Perhaps our patrons would enjoy a selection of knickknacks sold alongside our regular menu items...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_024: ...Though mining those Omicron coins requires a truly exorbitant amount of processing power. And what if increased circulation led to a drop in omnitoken value? Mother forfend!
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_025: This station looks familiar. I wonder if Cookingway has any new recipes to share.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_026: But there is quite a bit of carrot on the menu already. N-7000 would doubtless whirr and whinge about the lack of variety...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_027: Gasp! Is that a broadcasting station!? Oh, I do so love a good transmitter...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_028: I wonder what sort of messages they're sending?
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_A2_000_001: They're speaking to the people of Etheirys, to let them know they're not alone.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_A2_000_002: "You're listening to Hope FM! Stay tuned for more Talking&Ways, all day and all night (moon time).“
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_030: Color me intrigued! Ensuring widespread access to receivers seems like hard work, but well worth the effort indeed.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_031: We could adjust the tuning of the Ragnarok's communications facilities to receive this transmission in the Last Dregs...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_032: But it still may not provide the level of crowd-pleasing excitement we're aiming for. Hmm...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_033: While each and every one of these stations is wonderful in its own right, I fear none are quite suitable for our goals. Perhaps Dreamingway can dream up something special for us?
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_034: It's so good to see Dreamingway again! ...Do you think he can get me one of those shirts?
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_DREAMINGWAY_000_040: Oho,  and...is that Jammingway!? It's been so long, I had started to think they were avoiding me...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_DREAMINGWAY_000_041: You opened a café out in Ultima Thule? That's one Mother of a dream!
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_DREAMINGWAY_000_043: Well, I am honored to be consulted about your upcoming event! Now we only need to work out what it is...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_DREAMINGWAY_000_044: Have you spoken with Talkingway yet?
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_DREAMINGWAY_000_045: They receive letters from listeners across the star. Surely one or two have mentioned exciting happenings on Etheirys! Wait here.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TALKINGWAY_000_051: It's a pleasure to see you again. I would be happy to assist in your endeavors however I can.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_052: Forgive me...but have we met before?
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TALKINGWAY_000_053: Ah, yes. You would remember me as “Counselingway”─but I have recently taken the name “Talkingway” in honor of my new dream.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_054: How wonderful! I look forward to working with you, Talkingway.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TALKINGWAY_000_055: Dreamingway mentioned that you are in search of rousing entertainment for your patrons, and one possibility hops to mind.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TALKINGWAY_000_056: If our listener mail is any indication, Thavnair's hippo cart races have been drawing quite the crowd of late. Folk come from far and wide to “see those hippos hurtle,” 'tis said.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_057: Hurtling hippos! Why, that does sound exciting! We could set up a racecourse in the nekropolis to give Last Dregs patrons a prime view of the action.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_058: A stirring contest of speed and skill the likes of which Ultima Thule has never before seen... Surely that will pique even the Nibirun's interest.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_059: Any ideas on how we might approach these hippo racers, ?
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_060: Their leader is a friend of yours? You really do know everyone. I hope we can count on you for an introduction!
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_DREAMINGWAY_000_061: A hippo hustle in Ultima Thule sounds like the sort of entertainment that should be available to all. Could our radio station provide a live broadcast of the event?
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_062: But of course! With the Ragnarok as a relay, there's no signal we cannot boost.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TALKINGWAY_000_063: I should like nothing more than to share the joy of such an experience with our listeners across Etheirys. And I certainly would be curious to attend myself.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_DREAMINGWAY_000_064: Then it's settled! We'll make a start on the preparations. I trust you can convince the hippos to traverse the sea of stars?
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_065: To Thavnair! You said we're looking for a woman named “Trna,” correct?
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_066: Ooh, I can hardly wait! In fact, I can't. See you there!
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_DREAMINGWAY_000_067: Leave the broadcasting setup to us! We're becoming quite proficient in connecting the thingies to the whatsits, you know.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TALKINGWAY_000_068: We'll need a few moon-hoppers to carry the equipment... Hmm, and perhaps Inventingway can assist with the technical details...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_069: This is my first time meeting an Arkasodara in person! ...Do my ears look all right?
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_075: This little one with you? They've been there pattin' their ears for a while now─an' starin'. Got a lot of starin' goin' on.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_076: Radio? Yeah, I've heard of it. One of my crew lugged a radio contraption all the way here from Old Sharlayan.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_077: That could be who sent you the letter about the Hannish Hippo Hustle, come to think of it.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_078: Your races are the talk of the star! We'd love to bring that sort of excitement out to Ultima Thule. Though it is a wee bit of a trek from here...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_079: Ultima Who? Now them I ain't never heard of. They live across the sea somewhere, I take it?
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_080: As buoyant as our hippos are, we can't send 'em out into the wide world on their own. You'd need Acala and me to race 'em safely, and I have too much work here at home to abandon my post. I can't thank you enough for takin' an interest in our operation, though.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_082: It's truly a shame, but I would hate to make the Hippo Riders disappoint their own customers in the name of entertaining ours. What to do...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_083: I'm sorry to turn you down─especially after you came all this way.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_085: Dreamingway and Talkingway were excited for this plan too... We mustn't give up just yet.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_086: I'm calling a strategy meeting! To be held... Well, that post over there looks like as good a place as any.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_090: I understand Trna's passion for her work─I feel the same about my own.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_091: Perhaps someone else might race on her behalf...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_ACALA_000_093: Ahem. I heard your conversation. Acala─I want to race Trna. And I know Trna wants to race!
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_094: Acala...you're the one Trna mentioned, aren't you?
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_ACALA_000_095: Never, Trna's work ends. When she finishes with hippos, she teaches us the common tongue so we fit in. She teaches us Hannish manners and fairness in trade.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_ACALA_000_096: Aca─I find your language difficult, but my speaking improves. Trna says so. But Trna has no time to ride hippos now.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_ACALA_000_097: She cares about hippos and the Hippo Riders. Her kin. Always, she helps us.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_ACALA_000_098: But she forgets we can help her. Always, we want to help her.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_099: I see. Trna is a great leader, but she takes every responsibility upon herself. No wonder she has no time left over to race hippos...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_ACALA_000_100: Always, Trna listens to you. You must talk sense at her.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_101: Yes, I quite agree. If, in her heart of hearts, Trna wants to race, that's all the more reason for us to host a hippo hustle!
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_102: Do you think you can convince her to come around?
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_103: Just wear her down until she agrees. It'll be fun!
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_OGUL_000_105: , what a surprise! Are you here to speak with Trna as well?
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_110: You hold it right there. I know that look─but you'll find I ain't so easily persuaded.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_SYSTEM_000_111: The following event cannot be skipped. You may wish to cancel any pending Duty Finder registrations.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_115: You know how important our delivery business is─you helped us get our start! So why try to talk me out of it?
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_A4_000_002: You can make deliveries later. Opportunity is knocking now!
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_A4_000_003: I know you live for excitement─don't you want to explore the unknown?
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_117: Is that all you could come up with, or do you just think I'm one wheel short of a cart?
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_118: "Later“? Speedy deliveries are our business! We can't be speedy if we're deliverin' later.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_119: Of course I would. There's only so many times you can race the same course without it startin' to feel like a chore. But too many folks are relyin' on our services for me to go gallivantin'.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_A5_000_001: They'll survive for a few days without shawarma delivery.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_A5_000_002: Acala's worried about you, you know.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_A5_000_003: Doesn't your hippo deserve a change of scenery?
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_121: The shawarma ain't the issue here! The Hippo Riders are nothin' if not reliable─and if we're not reliable, we're nothin'.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_122: I told him there ain't nothin' to worry about. I miss racin', to be sure, but the Hippo Riders come first. Business couldn't be better─and I'd like to keep it that way.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_123: Saurya's a happy hippo so long as she's runnin'. Don't think she much notices the scenery─I'd have a lot less steerin' to do if she did.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_A6_000_001: Have I ever led you astray before?
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_A6_000_002: Surely it won't fall apart in just one day.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_A6_000_003: I recall a heartwarming lesson learned during the inaugural Hannish Hippo Hustle...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_125: No, which makes it even more perplexin' that you're insistin' we let all of our hard work go to waste.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_126: You ain't got the slightest idea how much work we do in a day. I've half a mind to put you on stable duty so you can see how fast it piles up...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_127: That was a race for the ages, to be sure. An' it was all thanks to our team here.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_128: Like I always say, you can only do so much by yourself...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_129: ...I do say that, don't I? Yet here I am, actin' like Acala back when he first got here.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_130: Guess I was right that him and I ain't so different─in more ways than I knew.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_131: All right, fine! The Hippo Riders'll pull together to keep things movin' in Thavnair, and you'll have your race.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_TRNA_000_132: You win, you win. Just give me a moment to speak with Maru and Ghasa.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_OGUL_000_134: So this race of yours will be taking place in a faraway land? I had best join you─for everyone's safety, of course.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_140: I knew you would come through for us. Why, you had her convincing herself by the end!
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_N7000_000_142: (-N-7000-)Affirmative. Several shrill life-forms have come bearing word of a “hippo hustle” to take place in the nekropolis. As serving units have automatically initialized advertising protocols, this unit requests swift confirmation that these reports are accurate.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_143: They are accurate! And tell those units that I like their initiative.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_144: As for my fellow Loporrit life-forms, I recommend a tall glass of carrot juice for each. They're sure to place additional orders...
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_N7000_000_147: (-N-7000-)Prioritizing request for managerial assistance on the customer service front. Ending transmission.
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_148: Don't you terminate this transmission on me! ...Rude!
TEXT_BANALL310_04787_JAMMINGWAY_000_149: What was that all about, I wonder?
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_001: We decided to come and settle in while you and Jammingway handled the hippos─and I'm so glad we did! The carrot juice is simply divine.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_002: Talkingway and Inventingway are off taking in the sights, but they'll be back in time for the race.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TRNA_000_003: I'm comin', I'm comin'! Hold your hippos.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_ACALA_000_004: Race will be good. Ac─I can feel it.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_OGUL_000_005: No harm will come to our comrades on my watch! And I shall be watching quite avidly, I expect...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_010: Initiating a new call doesn't work either...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_011: I doubt that it's anything serious, but perhaps you should check on N-7000 just in case. You typically carry at least one object suitable for a light bludgeoning, do you not?
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_012: I'll work out the finer details with Trna and see the Hippo Riders safely to Ultima Thule. I trust that the café will be intact when we arrive!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_013: Time to find out how many hippos the Ragnarok's hold can hold!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_015: <whirr> Your return is most welcome. However, one managerial life-form remains conspicuously absent.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_016: Understood. This unit will initiate idling protocols until Jammingway arrives. Carrot-based refreshments have already been distributed to the newcome life-forms.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_100_016: And such refreshing refreshments they were!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_017: Furthermore, as your sensory organs will have detected, the usual customers have vacated the premises.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_018: This unit will now convey additional context. <whirr> Once upon a timecode...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_019: ...So, to sum up, we no longer need worry for lack of patrons. In fact, the Last Dregs being empty is quite inconceivable!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TRNA_000_020: ! Oh, thank the Sisters. Wasn't sure we'd make it, 'specially after that experimental aetheryte...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_021: Oi! Where are our customers!? You had one job, you buttons-for-brains...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_022: <whirr> Elevated body temperature detected in nagging life-form. This unit recommends swift consumption of chilled liquids.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_023: As for the customers, they have temporarily ceased their consumption of fine café fare to prepare for the upcoming race.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_024: The Karellians procured a transport vessel with the assistance of Stigma-4. Presently, the Global Citizens and Freedom Fighters are conducting a joint test-drive.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_025: Meanwhile, the Grebuloffs expressed a long-standing desire to float about within the Miw Miisv, which were eagerly volunteered by their Ea caretakers to serve as steeds. This unit's ethical algorithms are still processing.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_026: The dragons, too, intend to participate. Soaring through Elysion's mountains has revived their passion for flight, and they have expressed a desire to see more of Ultima Thule from above.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_027: Unexpected, but I'll take it! So long as our patrons reach happiness, the means by which they travel matters not.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_028: This unit agrees, and hopes that all patrons will be replete with joy upon their inevitable defeat by the superior Omicron vehicle. Artillery may be involved.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_ACALA_000_030: Artillery is no match for Acala! I dodge!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_OGUL_000_031: This is shaping up to be a gauntlet fiercer than Bardam's Mettle...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_032: <whirr> This unit also invited the Nibirun to share the singular experience of losing to the Omicrons, but their registration remains pending. Nevertheless, they have conceded to observe the other civilizations' preparations.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_033: We'll have to hope that the overall excitement sweeps them up eventually. For now, we have our own preparations to attend to.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_034: <whirr> On that note─this unit recalls that the “Inventing” life-form wished to speak with  regarding said preparations.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_035: Reports of critical levels of static electricity indicate the likely presence of this ally at Base Omicron.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_036: Now, this unit must return to supervising Stigma-4's production of racetrack features. Engaging enthusiasm protocols...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_038: If Inventingway is having difficulties with the radio relay, don't hesitate to direct him to me. I have a knack for whacking unruly machines into shape, if I do say so myself...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_039: But first, I should prepare a drink or two to help our Hannish guests feel at home. Perhaps some carrot chai?
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TRNA_000_040: Odd spot for a restaurant. I don't reckon delivery to Thavnair'd be sustainable in the long run, but we should bring some grub back for Maru, at least.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_ACALA_000_041: Later, we race. For now, we lunch!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_OGUL_000_042: Grandmother always said that naught reveals more about a people than their food, and these dishes certainly look...educational. Which would Racashir like most, I wonder?
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_100_043: This will be our best broadcast yet, I can feel it!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_INVENTINGWAY_000_04: Aha! Just the person of Etheirys I was hoping to see.

As our Omicron friend doubtless relayed to you, this race is no longer a mere spectator sport. The people of Ultima Thule will be bringing the best their civilizations have to offer─and they mean to win.
Should the Arkasodara, then, be left to defend Etheirys's honor all on their own? Nay, says I! Mother put her faith in the myriad peoples of the star for a reason.
Fortunately, we brought a number of moon-hoppers to help prepare for the hustle. With a little help from good old Inventingway, there's no reason that one can't haul you to victory!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_A1_000_001: I had been hoping to join the contest!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_A1_000_002: N-7000 mentioned artillery. That might be a reason.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_INVENTINGWAY_000_05: Then the moment of my─er, our─triumph will soon be upon us!
Artillery, schmartillery. You can't pulverize what you can't catch!
I have already taken the liberty of altering this moon-hopper. Dazzle your competition with the hyper hop-step, or press the big “boost” button to outstrip them with ease─actually, why not do both?
Do mind your power reserves, though─even with my prodigious skill, there are only so many batteries I can shove into this chassis.
Now, hop along and tell N-7000 to add one more entrant to the roster! I'll catch up once I've discovered where this final screw belongs...
...Safety features? What could we possibly need those for?
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_056: Was Inventingway annoying the Omicrons? Perhaps we can learn from his methods.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TRNA_000_057: This is gonna be one queer hustle...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_ACALA_000_058: First, I have eaten. Now, victory awaits!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_OGUL_000_059: Jammingway asked for my help at the starting line! Me being an expert, and all.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_065: <whirr> Race preparations continue in accordance with projections. Did the “Inventing” life-form raise any matters of note?
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_066: You'll be joining the fray!? How thrilling!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_067: <whirr> Entrant registered. This unit will now provide supplementary information regarding the course.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_100_067: Please direct your orbs toward this geographical data display.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_068: The race will begin at the starship Ragnarok in Ostrakon Deka-okto.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_069: Once Jammingway and Ogul signal the commencement of hostilities, competitors may proceed across Reah Tahra toward Ostrakon Tria. Passage through the checkpoint rings is mandatory.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_OGUL_000_070: Those rings look rather lofty. How are the hippo carts to get through?
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_071: In Ultima Thule, emotions become reality. You only need believe to make your hippos fly!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TRNA_000_072: Did you just call me an “Ultimate Fool”? Because I'd have to be, to believe somethin' like that.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_073: <whirr>-hem. Once in Ostrakon Tria, racers will enter the artillery zone, which extends from the periphery of the ostrakon to the abode of the Ea. This exciting enhancement is sponsored by the Alphatron civilization.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TRNA_000_074: Wait, you were serious about the artillery? What if my Saurya gets hit!?
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_075: Out of concern for the curiously smooth four-legged life-forms, Stigma-4 is presently manufacturing nonlethal cannons. Encountering these painless projectiles will result in no more than explosive removal from the course.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_076: Those who remain unblasted should continue to Ostrakon Deka-hexi, and proceed through Base Omicron.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_077: Then it is merely a matter of reaching the finish line, located at the Last Dregs.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_ACALA_000_078: I win! Then, I feast on tiny desserts!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_079: <whirr> Note that, in accordance with Omicron contest protocols, there are no restrictions on contrivances mechanical, magical, or maniacal during the race. This concludes the briefing.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TRNA_000_080: Well, at least I packed my rainbow gulal. Saurya should be happy to run for it, no matter where she is.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_ACALA_000_081: You brought gulal? Why you do not share? Sharing is caring!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TRNA_000_082: We've been through this, Acala. Your hippo's never shown it a lick of interest─you just like throwin' things.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_083: Go ahead and make your preparations. I need to make sure that N-7000 isn't understating the firepower of those cannons...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_084: Once that's taken care of, I'll retrieve your moon-hopper and meet you at the Ragnarok!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_086: Grab your most durable headgear and wait for me by the Ragnarok!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TRNA_000_087: Once you work out what your hippo likes, you can throw some of that instead.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_OGUL_000_089: See you at the starting line!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_SYSTEM_100_090:
Upon commencing the race, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TALKINGWAY_000_095: Test... Test... People of Etheirys, are you there?
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TALKINGWAY_000_096: We are your hosts, Talkingway and Dreamingway, coming to you live from the very edge of the universe.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_097: And here among the stars, the Hyper Hustle is about to begin!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TALKINGWAY_000_098: This contest for the ages will see competitors race across a land as barren as it is beautiful, vying to be the first across the finish line.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_099: You won't want to miss a moment of this, folks! Now, let's introduce our racers.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_100: Hauled by the speedy Saurya is a courier as fast as she is reliable! All the way from Thavnair, it's Trna the Hippo Rider!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_101: Next, a Gajasura as fearsome on the track as he is fearless on the battlefield. Honed in the fires of the Hannish Hippo Hustle─I, Acala!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_102: Let's hope that Peacekeeper's less peaceful functions are disabled. Hailing from Karellen, a team of once-bitter enemies turned fast friends─the Citizens of Freedom!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_103: Our next entrant may look more frolicsome than furious, but pass them at your peril. Supported by the ever-so-darling Miw Miisv, it's...the electrifying Grebuloff X!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_104: This mean, clean, speeding machine is ready to put the “alpha” back in “Alphatron civilization.” Say hello to the lethal Lambda unit V1C70RY!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_105: But lo─what wisdom rides the winds of Elysion and fair peaks once forgot? The Dragon Star has joined the fray!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_106: Last but not least, a sword in the darkness... A beacon of hope... The champion of Eorzea! Friends across the universe, we present the one and only Hurrier of Light!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_107: What's this? A Nibirun challenger? Um... (Are they supposed to be there? I thought the Hurrier was our last participant...)
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_109: Did you prepare a vehicle? We can lend you a moon-hopper, if you'd like...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TRNA_000_111: What in the name of the mug-swappin' Mrga? Saurya's a good girl, but she ain't no divinity. How's a normal hippo meant to compete with that!?
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_112: Like I said, you and your hippo need only let your competitive spirits burn bright. Where there's a will, there's a way! Quite literally.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TRNA_000_113: ...I suppose I'll toss some gulal and hope for the best.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TALKINGWAY_000_115: Our racers have assembled at the starting line. Who will surpass the rest to emerge triumphant?
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_116: (-Jammingway and Ogul-)On your mark... Get set...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TALKINGWAY_000_118: And they're off, with the Nibirun god Ra-la taking the lead!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_119: Sweet Mother! A juicy jolt from the Miw Miisv has sent the Lambda unit tumbling! Does this spell defeat for V1C70RY!?
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TALKINGWAY_000_120: The other competitors race on. They are now entering the next area─and the field of automated artillery!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TALKINGWAY_000_121: The Citizens of Freedom are going in! We have received a transmission from the Peacekeeper: “This is naught compared to the carnage on Karellen! YAAAH!” ...You heard it here, folks.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_122: And the Peacekeeper is downed by double cannon blast! How fortunate that the Karellians wear helmets.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TALKINGWAY_000_123: I, Acala's cart is enveloped in a cloud of gulal!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_124: A ploy to distract competing hippos, perhaps? Or did he fall prey to rainbow temptation?
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TALKINGWAY_000_125: Whatever the cause, it has only made Trna the Hippo Rider's cart fly all the faster!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TALKINGWAY_000_126: She has overtaken the Hurrier of Light for second place!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_SYSTEM_000_127: To claim victory, you must overtake both Trna's hippo cart and the Nibirun's Ra-la.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_INVENTINGWAY_000_12: I have already taken the liberty of altering this moon-hopper. Dazzle your competition with the hyper hop-step, or press the big “boost” button to outstrip them with ease─actually, why not do both?
Do mind your power reserves, though─even with my prodigious skill, there are only so many batteries I can shove into this chassis.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_A3_000_001: Mash the boost button until you surpass both racers.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_A3_000_002: Use boost to overtake the hippo cart, then distract Ra-la with the hyper hop-step.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_A3_000_003: Grab Saurya's attention with the hyper hop-step, then boost yourself past Ra-la.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_SYSTEM_000_131: (-Shrill Echo-)"Weren't you listening to my brilliant explanation, !? There's no way the batteries can sustain that much boosting!“
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_SYSTEM_000_132: As you consider this option, you reflect upon your prior experiences with the Nibirun. They may not be the distractable sort...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_133: The hippo has halted! Overwhelmed by the euphony of my song, no doubt!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TALKINGWAY_000_134: And the Hurrier of Light has taken second place, to cries of “This ain't over, !” from Trna the Hippo Rider!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TALKINGWAY_000_135: This is it, folks─the final stretch! The Hurrier of Light has pushed the moon-hopper to hair-raising speeds, but Ra-la is still one leap ahead! Who will emerge victorious!?
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TALKINGWAY_000_136: We have word from N-7000 at the finish line. The winner of the Hyper Hustle is...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TALKINGWAY_000_137: The Hurrier of Light, by a nose!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_NIBIRAENOMI_000_141: Our chosen form was suitable, our performance, flawless. Yet victory was not ours to claim.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_NIBIRAENOMI_000_142: It has been long since we have experienced this quickening of the pulse. This...vexation.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TRNA_000_143: That's racin' for ya. Just when you think you've got it, some grinnin' idiot comes shootin' past to take the gold. Then sometimes, you get to be that grinnin' idiot!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TRNA_000_144: And that's the thrill of it! You never know if it'll go your way. You just race with all you've got.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_145: That you're upset to have lost can only mean one thing─you want to win next time!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_146: That's a dream worth chasing! Trust me, I'm an expert.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_NIBIRAENOMI_000_147: We do feel...a yearning. A yearning to race once more. A desire to triumph...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_A4_000_001: Happy to leave you in the dust any time!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_A4_000_002: Looks like my hopper's going to need more batteries...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_NIBIRAENOMI_000_149: This is well. We will engage with the other patrons of this establishment to develop a superior stratagem.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_150: <whirr> Dynamis readings indicate a positive effect on the local environment. In accordance with Jammingway's aspirations, the Last Dregs has become an ever greater source of hope.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_151: Despite the significant expense, extensive property damage, and crushing defeat incurred, this unit rates the Hyper Hustle as “worth it.”
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_152: <whirr> Congratulations, allied unit . This unit has already requested the manufacture of an Omega unit to be cultivated into a worthy competitor via racing trials. Please anticipate your defeat.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TRNA_000_153: I never thought you could be so tricky! Still, I'm glad we got to ride together─let's do it again sometime.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_ACALA_000_154: Betrayed! Betrayed by rainbow gulal! Next time, I follow Trna's advice. I learn my hippo's favorite things.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_155: Do you think we could fit a racetrack in Hoper's Hold?
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TALKINGWAY_000_156: Congratulations on your victory, . Though in truth, I'm just relieved that everyone survived...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_INVENTINGWAY_000_15: What did I tell you? The very universe is in the palm of my paw!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_OGUL_000_158: You are as formidable on the track as on the battlefield! I shall do my best to learn from your example.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_160: To think you did all of that on a Loporrit-built craft! I'm delighted that we could play some small part in your triumph.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_161: And I'm even more delighted that the Nibirun have finally found something to work toward.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_162: Still, I'll be glad to resume our usual service. Maybe make myself a nice carrot coffee while I'm behind the counter...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TRNA_000_165: You were right, I admit it─I had a great time racin'. Even if I didn't understand half of what was goin' on...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TRNA_000_166: But as fun as it was, I need to be gettin' on home to Thavnair. Don't wanna leave the Hippo Riders alone for too long, lest some hamsaheads start gettin' restless...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_167: We've finished packing up the broadcasting equipment, so we'll be heading back to the Dreaming Workshop ourselves.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_168: So soon? It'll feel so empty out here in the cosmic void without you...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_169: <whirr> Affirmative. But did we not have one more objective to complete before the other organic life-forms depart?
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_100_171: Talkingway! Inventingway! Help me lift this. One, two...hup!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_172: It's for you, ! A trophy befitting the victor of the Hyper Hustle.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_173: As you can see, it was designed in the image of the Last Dregs, the Hippo Riders, and also the Dreaming Ways!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_174: That reminds me─we brought a few commemorative gifts as well.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_100_174: Talkingway! Inventingway! Help me lift these. One, two...hrrrgh!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_175: One for the Last Dregs, and one for Svarna! You have an eatery there too, I hear?
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_DREAMINGWAY_000_176: Then I hope you'll let us keep you company at mealtimes. Whether it's weather advisories, hopping music, or simply a friendly voice you need, Hope FM is here for you!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_TRNA_000_177: So this is a radio contraption too? Has bigger ears than the other one I saw...but I'll be sure to listen with the crew.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_178: I was just thinking we should get one of these! Our patrons are going to love it.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_N7000_000_179: <whirr> Projections anticipate increased customer satisfaction in the “ambience” category.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_180: Thank you, . We wouldn't be here if you hadn't brought us together.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_181: I think I speak for everyone when I say that this day will shine like a newborn star in our memories. I hope you feel the same.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_182: Just don't let it eclipse the possibility of more unforgettable days to come. After all...
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_JAMMINGWAY_000_183: Look across the sea, up at the moon, past the distant stars...and you'll find us waiting for you!
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_SYSTEM_000_190: You have achieved Allied reputation with the Hippo Riders, the Dreaming Ways, and the staff and patrons of the Last Dregs.
TEXT_BANALL320_04788_SYSTEM_000_191: Through your efforts, your allies from Etheirys to the stars beyond have forged bonds of friendship that promise to remain strong through the years. You are truly a hero to societies throughout the universe!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_001: Hmmm. Maybe meeting with  won't be so easy after all. Mablu said  be around here somewhere though...
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_003: The mighty warrior who traveled the length and breadth of Tural, taking in its myriad sights, sounds, and smells─even those within the otherworldly dome!?
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_004: The savvy haggler who helped the Third Promise acquire a saddle worth ten pel in the thousands column, despite starting with a mere hundred!?
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_005: My inner abacus is clacking away! You're the missing piece I've been looking for. The missing piece of my brand-new enterprise, that is!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_006: Ahem... Sorry about that. I got a little carried away. I'm just so happy to finally meet you.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_007: (-Liplu-)I'm Liplu, a merchant. Until recently, my business was bedclothes─all woven from the finest alpaca wool.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_008: (-Liplu-)My dear friend Mablu told me all about you. I hear you gave her the nudge she needed to embark upon her journey as a peddler. I can't begin to thank you enough.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_009: (-Liplu-)But I'll get straight to the point. I have a proposal for you today, . How would you like to become a special advisor for a trailblazing tourism venture? I call it the Turali Travel Agency!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_011: (-Liplu-)Of course, you'll be compensated for your time! You'll also be the first in line for all kinds of treats and trinkets, not to mention a wealth of exciting experiences!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_012: (-Liplu-)You don't have to answer right away...but if any of this has roused your interest, please come and visit me in Ok'hanu.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_013: (-Liplu-)We can go over the finer details there! I'll be waiting for you─along with the rest of my associates!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_500: Ah, there you are! Thank you for coming!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_503: You've mastered the Hanuhanu greeting! But I wouldn't expect anything less from someone so well traveled.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_100_503: After traveling across Tural, it's no wonder you've learned the local custom!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_504: Allow me to introduce myself again. I'm Liplu, the founder of the Turali Travel Agency. With me are my brother, Yubli, and my Hanuhanu associates. We'll be happy to explain the ins and outs of our budding enterprise.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_505: You were there for the ascension ceremony, weren't you?
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_506: Dawnservant Wuk Lamat spoke of growing to love her people all the more as she got to know them better─of how she wanted us to live with joy in our hearts and smiles on our faces.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_507: Well, those words certainly left their mark. The capital's residents are eager to learn about their fellow Turali, who in turn yearn to foster understanding.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_508: You see it too, don't you? An unmistakable business opportunity! Well, that's precisely where the Turali Travel Agency comes in. We'll answer that burgeoning demand!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_YUBLI_000_509: Our goal is to help revitalize this community as it attempts to rebuild after the great storm. Promoting Kozama'uka as a tourist destination will provide a much-needed source of income for the region, and with it, all the benefits that follow.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_YUBLI_000_510: Of course, we wouldn't be having this conversation had we not consulted the Hanu beforehand. After much discussion, they kindly agreed to set aside a tract of land by Dock Poga for development. And would you believe it, the villagers are flocking to join our staff!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_GENUHANU_000_511: As Liplu said, the people are eager to learn about their fellow Turali─and we Hanu are eager to share our culture with them as well!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_GENUHANU_000_512: Much as when you helped us to revive Ihih'hana, we hope to welcome many outsiders into our home, that we may know one another better and enjoy each other's company! And what better way to do so than to support this tourism initiative?
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_513: Of course, tourism is an industry new to Tural. This is unfamiliar territory in many respects, and people understandably have their concerns.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_514: But who better to assuage those concerns than someone who's roamed far and wide, and met with countless Turali from all over the continent!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_GENUHANU_000_020: Mablu introduced Liplu to Elder Zanuhali. She would often visit our village to peddle her wares, and it was because of her we saw fit to consider the proposal.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_GENUHANU_100_020: When we first gathered to discuss the issue, Liplu painted a vivid picture of the impact her venture would have on the region, financial and otherwise.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_ZELIHALI_000_021: The Pelupelu strive to spread happiness through trade.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_ZELIHALI_000_022: It's little wonder they find a warm welcome wherever they go. Their guiding principle has earned them a great deal of trust over the years.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_XENUHANU_000_023: You're aware that Kozama'uka was ravaged by a mighty storm, yes? By welcoming more travelers to our land, we stand to gain many new customers─not to mention the opportunity to work for the travel agency itself. In this way, we hope to raise the funds we need to rebuild and recover.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_XENUHANU_000_024: This will also be an excellent chance for the rest of Tural to get to know us! No matter how you look at it, we'd be fools not to cooperate with Liplu and her brother.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_YUBLI_000_025: I handle the managerial side of the enterprise. If you decide to join us, I'll be counting on your insights to help me solve the little problems we'll no doubt encounter along the way.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_026: The core of our business is providing accommodations and guided tours for the local area. As we speak, Wuk Evu is putting his shipwright skills to use heading up construction for our base of operations by Dock Poga.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_027: From sourcing foodstuffs to souvenirs─and everything in between─we're working hand in glove with the good people of Ok'hanu to make sure this venture benefits everyone involved!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_028: Still, there are a few things I'm worried about. The guided tours, for example.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_029: Visitors will journey here after making a reservation at our office in Tuliyollal, and we'll have to guarantee their safety every step of the way. After all, we can't expect our customers to handle themselves like you can!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_030: And that leads us neatly back to my proposition! So, how about it? Can we count on your help as a special advisor while the travel agency finds its feet?
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_A3_000_002: Once propositioned, who am I to refuse...?
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_031: Aha! I knew we could count on you!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_ZELIHALI_000_032: Wonderful. Although I'm loath to put you to work straightaway, I would seek your assistance.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_ZELIHALI_000_033: We guides have each devised a plan for our prospective tours, based on our knowledge of our homeland, but we'd benefit greatly from the input of a worldly traveler like yourself. Honest opinions only!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_YUBLI_000_034: Liplu, perhaps you could accompany  and appraise the tours as well? I'll stay behind and oversee construction with Wuk Evu.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_035: A fine idea! Guides, please wait in your respective tour locations. I will take  to each of you in turn!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_036: When you're ready, just say the word! I'm as keen as the Hanuhanu are to hear your thoughts.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_040: All set? Now then─our three guides have planned three unique tours, so we will speak with them one at a time before proceeding to the next.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_041: We'll start by paying a visit to Genuhanu in the Fields of Gold, who I am told wishes to showcase local industry with a focus on the village and reed fields. Let's go!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_043: There's something enchanting about the sight of all these reeds swaying in the wind. Especially at night, when you can see the fireflies dancing among them...
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_GENUHANU_000_044: I'm glad you're here. I almost couldn't bear the wait... Right, let me explain my concept for the tour.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_GENUHANU_000_045: ...Ahem. First and foremost, I see this as a chance for our customers to understand we Hanu─and where better to learn than right here among our reed fields?
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_GENUHANU_000_046: After all, reeds are at the very heart of our culture! Just cast your gaze across these lush fields, and you'll get a sense of what defines us.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_GENUHANU_000_047: But that's enough about my thoughts. What do you think? I should like to believe this is a place those not of the Hanu can also appreciate, but...
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_A5_000_001: I think visitors will take a keen interest in the reed fields.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_A5_000_002: Perhaps reeds shouldn't be the sole focus.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_A5_000_003: They'll be out of harm's reach, at the very least.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_048: The paddies are a unique part of the local landscape. Not everyone will have seen such a sight before. But, perhaps you could also show them your villages? That way they'll have a better idea of how the Hanu live.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_050: The tour should absolutely involve the reeds, but as  suggests, I think visitors will want to learn about other aspects of Hanuhanu culture too! Perhaps giving them a tour of local settlements will serve as a worthy introduction to your traditions.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_052: My thoughts exactly. As safety is a concern, staying close to more developed areas would be wise indeed. And if you'll allow me to make a suggestion, why don't you show visitors your villages before taking them to see the fields? Then they can get a sense of what day-to-day life is like here.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_053: Yes, yes, I think the plan is coming along nicely! To summarize: if we begin by guiding guests around the villages, they'll see how reeds are so tightly interwoven with Hanuhanu culture. That way, they'll appreciate the precious resource growing in your paddies all the more!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_GENUHANU_000_054: I was so excited about showing visitors our fields, I hadn't considered that they might like to learn about the normal everyday lives of we Hanu too. I appreciate the suggestion!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_055: Consider also having a range of handicrafts on offer that visitors might purchase if so inclined. Perhaps a mix of practical household items and more esoteric trinkets─charms and the like?
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_056: Alright, let's head for Breath Between next. Zelihali has proposed a walking tour of the river, and ought to be waiting for us there.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_060: The waters here are dazzlingly clear, don't you think? And filled with a bounty of fish besides!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_061: Of course, the current is awfully strong as well. We must take care that no guests fall in, lest they be swept away in an instant.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_GENUHANU_000_062: Hmmm. A tour that takes in the villages and the fields...
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_ZELIHALI_000_063: Ah! I completely lost track of time... My attention was whisked away by the endless waters of Ku'uxage.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_ZELIHALI_000_064: If you didn't already know, Ku'uxage means “big tongue” in our language. Hehe, if you aren't careful, you might find yourself slurped up and taken off by the current!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_065: You know, I bet insights into the language like that would prove a hit with visitors!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_ZELIHALI_000_066: I'm glad you think so, but I'm still a little unsure of my plan. The idea is to guide guests along the river, explaining the language and local history as I go, but...is that really enough entertainment?
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_A6_000_001: A leisurely, educational stroll sounds delightful!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_A6_000_002: I hope you're well prepared for any water-related mishaps.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_A6_000_003: Ooh! How about working in a spot of fishing too?
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_ZELIHALI_000_067: Hearing that from someone so well traveled is a relief!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_ZELIHALI_000_068: Rest assured that guides and villagers will be on hand to respond! We Hanuhanu are rather buoyant, and given our command of the wind, we're well equipped to intervene should any incidents occur!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_ZELIHALI_000_069: I see! Offering an activity besides sightseeing is a wonderful idea!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_ZELIHALI_000_070: I appreciate your advice! Whatever form the tour takes, I want to make sure our guests leave completely satisfied. I'll be sure to confer with Liplu as I hammer out the details.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_071: It's time we went to see Xenuhanu! He's proposed a magical spelunking tour in which visitors can marvel at the natural beauty of the world beneath our feet. To Cave Kikitola!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_080: The soft green light reflecting off the rocks, the cool, crisp air, the tinkling of the flowing water... I feel as though I'm in the presence of the divine.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_ZELIHALI_000_081: Hehe. It's so exciting thinking of ways to entertain our future visitors.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_XENUHANU_000_082: There you are! I was starting to feel lonesome waiting for you to arrive. Let's get straight to it, shall we?
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_XENUHANU_000_083: Cave Kikitola is the source of many minerals and medicinal ingredients. For generations, it's been held as a sacred site of healing.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_XENUHANU_000_084: I'm sure visitors will be enamored with the cave's natural beauty, but the route here from the villages is long and arduous, and the interior is rather dark... I fear it might not be a suitable reward for the challenge of simply getting here.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_A7_000_001: Given the cave's symbolic importance, I think it's a splendid idea.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_A7_000_002: Visitors could try their hand at collecting medicines and minerals.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_A7_000_003: I'm more concerned about all the fiends nearby...
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_085: I think customers will appreciate visiting a place that holds such spiritual significance for the Hanuhanu.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_086: Xenuhanu mentioned that the Hanu come here to gather minerals and medicines─that sounds like it could make for an enjoyable activity for visitors to take part in. Imagine if they could have their findings made into souvenirs...the possibilities are endless!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_087: But as he said, the cave is somewhat remote─we can't discount the possibility of tour groups running afoul of fiends on the way here. Perhaps we'd be better off reserving this course for more seasoned travelers...
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_088: An excellent suggestion! Of course, with any such plans, respect for the cave and its significance for the Hanu would be paramount.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_089: The souvenirs we acquire in our journeys can be quite near and dear to us. I think visitors would love to take a piece of their trip back home, and the villagers could make use of any surplus materials as well.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_090: But as Xenuhanu said, the cave is somewhat remote─we can't discount the possibility of tour groups running afoul fiends on the way here. Perhaps we'd be better off reserving this course for more seasoned travelers...
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_XENUHANU_000_091: You might be right. Compared to the other plans, at least, the fiend threat is certainly an issue... I should've given that more consideration.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_092: Well, we could reserve this course for particularly...seasoned customers. So long as they are accompanied by guides capable of dealing with any unfortunate encounters, we should be able to mitigate the risk.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_093: Besides, the cave is truly stunning─not to mention rich in resources. I think the experience could prove highly educational. With a detailed plan and plenty of safeguards in place, I foresee a lot of demand for such a tour!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_XENUHANU_000_094: I must say, the two of you are full of fine ideas!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_XENUHANU_000_095: I'm starting to get excited! Just give me a little longer and I'll have my plan ready.
