TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_096: Well, with that, we've heard all three proposals from our guides. I'm sure you're tired after all that traipsing around, but let's get back to Ok'hanu, shall we?
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_XENUHANU_000_100: A special tour for seasoned travelers... Hmmm.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_101: Sorry to have taken up so much of your time, but you helped address the guides' worries and brought some excellent suggestions to the table.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_102: While we were out there, a question I've been pondering came to mind.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_103: What exactly is it that we're selling with the Turali Travel Agency? It's not as simple as peddling produce or providing a service. If we're unsure, we'll have a hard time enticing customers.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_106: For the longest time, I couldn't pinpoint the answer, but hearing those proposals made it crystal clear: we're in the business of ephemeral experiences!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_107: It is our responsibility to curate every moment of a visitor's stay and ensure they leave with wonderful memories that last a lifetime. That way, our customers will be sure to fall in love with Kozama'uka and its people!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_100_107: I can practically hear my inner abacus clacking away! Provided we hold fast to our principles, and remember that we're here to serve our customers above all else, I'm confident they'll have no qualms about parting with their hard-earned pel!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_108: The Turali Travel Agency will be synonymous with experiences both exceptional and unforgettable!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_109: I'll have to drive that message home when I promote our enterprise in the capital. Then there's the matter of making sure the benefits outweigh the burdens for the Hanu. Ah, there's so much to do!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_110: But before all that, how about we take a look at our soon-to-be-built base of operations near Dock Poga? Knowing my brother and Wuk Evu, I daresay they've made remarkable progress already.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_111: Apparently, they're ready to start construction! The blueprints have been finalized, and all the materials are to hand.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_112: Once the work is finished, then the countdown really begins. Here's hoping for satisfied customers, and more importantly, happiness for all involved, be they Hanu, Pelu, or adventurer extraordinaire!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_LIPLU_000_113: It's so wonderful to have you on board! Let's work together and make this a stunning success!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_WUKEVU_000_800: What do you say we get this thing built?
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_SYSTEM_000_801: With construction work on the Turali Travel Agency complete, Liplu and her associates have their eyes set on establishing Kozama'uka as a top tourist destination!
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_SYSTEM_000_802: Yet a host of challenges remain before their goals can be realized. As special advisor, it is your duty to offer support and guidance as they embark on this exciting new enterprise.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_SYSTEM_000_803: You have achieved Friendly reputation with the Turali Travel Agency.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_SYSTEM_000_804: Pelupelu society quests are now available from Yubli at Dock Poga.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_SYSTEM_000_805: Furthermore, you may now purchase wares from Pavli.
TEXT_BANPEL001_05193_SYSTEM_000_806: You have learned the emote Ohokaliy!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_000: ! So good to see you again. Thanks to you, the Turali Travel Agency is almost ready to open for business!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_001: Though truth be told, we've already taken our first booking! And so soon after we started promoting our services in Tuliyollal! A momentous occasion indeed!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_002: Our first customer is a Hhetsarro named Tseeya. Apparently, he works for the Wing of Reflection in the capital.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_003: He's traveling by alpaca, and should arrive any moment now. I'd like you to join me in giving him a warm Kozama'uka welcome. I've got a few loose ends to tie up here, but I'll join you by the entrance when I'm done.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_010: Tseeya, I presume? Welcome! How was your journey?
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_011: Well met, Liplu. Thanks to my fuzzy friend here, I had a delightful trip. It speaks volumes that you've partnered with the porters to ensure your customers are well cared for.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_012: What a spectacular place this is. The journey alone has raised my expectations─such breathtaking views!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_013: I've always longed to explore Yok Tural, but I lacked the courage to take that first step.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_014: So when I heard of your venture, Liplu, I couldn't believe my luck. I look forward to seeing what you've got in store for me.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_015: You won't soon forget your time here. That's a Turali Travel Agency guarantee!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_016: Well, without further ado, let's get you registered. If you head to the reception, I'll be with you shortly.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_017: I have a small favor to ask...
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_100_017: Tseeya has requested a guided tour, and I'd hate for something to happen to our very first guest. Having you keep an eye on things would take the weight off my mind.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_200_017: May I impose upon you to accompany Tseeya and his guide as they explore the local area?
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_300_017: Excellent! Well, I better go and deal with the paperwork. Come and find me when you're ready.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_018: Apparently, tours are specifically tailored to customers' requests.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_ZELIHALI_000_019: I'd be lying if I said I wasn't a little nervous...
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_020: Just to confirm, you booked the “Hanuhanu Culture Experience,” correct?
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_021: That's right. If I could squeeze in a spot of fishing too, that'd be wonderful. I'm a keen angler in my spare time, you see.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_ZELIHALI_000_022: Absolutely! In that case, we can stop by Breath Between on our route. But first, I'll give you a thorough tour of our village.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_023: Now, customer safety is paramount for the Turali Travel Agency, which is why our special advisor, , will be joining you.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_024: You were part of the Dawnservant's entourage during the rite of succession, weren't you? Everyone at the Wing of Reflection knows your exploits well. How reassuring that you'll be watching over us!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_ZELIHALI_100_024: Likewise. It's heartening to have you with us. And on that note, shall we make our way to Ok'hanu?
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_025: Safe travels! I hope you have a wonderful time!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_026: I'm sure there's no cause for concern, but I'm trusting you to keep our very first customer safe!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_ZELIHALI_000_030: During the rite of succession, Dawnservant Wuk Lamat helped us restore the Lifting of Wings─Ihih'hana─to its former glory. This is the float that was repaired for the festival.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_031: Ahh. I'd heard tales, but to see the real thing is something else entirely!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_032: I'm starting to get a sense of how important reeds are to the Hanuhanu, not to mention how many different things you use them for─cooking, construction, the list goes on... Fascinating!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_ZELIHALI_000_033: Nothing could make me happier than seeing other Turali take an interest in our culture. That alone makes this job worthwhile.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_ZELIHALI_000_034: Now that you've visited Ok'hanu, let's head for Breath Between and see if those fish are biting today! Oh, and in case you were wondering, we even use reeds as bait!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_SYSTEM_000_035: Tseeya's tour is progressing smoothly, and the pair have set off for a spot of fishing at Breath Between. Continue to keep an eye on them and ensure that neither come to any harm.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_036: It doesn't get much better than this...
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_ZELIHALI_000_037: I'm glad to see you're enjoying yourself!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_040: It isn't every day you get to cast your line in such beautiful surroundings. I'll be coming back with my own gear, that's for sure!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_ZELIHALI_000_041: We Hanu love to feel the wind in our feathers as we fish. It is as though we are cradled by Kixaihih's divine protection, from head to talon.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_042: Say, I don't suppose you know of any fishing spots off the beaten trail? There are a fair few anglers here besides us, and I haven't had a single bite yet...
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_ZELIHALI_000_043: Perhaps Cave Kikitola would fit the bill. It's a modest walk away, but the fish are plentiful, and one may cast their line in peace and quiet.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_044: That sounds perfect! If it's not too much trouble, I'd love to make the trip!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_ZELIHALI_000_045: My only concern is the fiends... But I ought to do all I can to accommodate Tseeya's wishes...
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_ZELIHALI_000_046: Of course. Let's make our way there. Onward, to Cave Kikitola!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_SYSTEM_000_047: Tseeya seems to be enjoying the tour so far, but danger may be afoot... Follow the pair to Cave Kikitola and keep watch as they continue fishing.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_048: Aha! A remarkable spot indeed. Makes all those hours chained to my writing desk worthwhile... Can we stay here a little longer?
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_ZELIHALI_000_049: Take all the time you need! I'm quite happy standing here enjoying the scenery.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_SYSTEM_200_053: The sound of flowing water echoes throughout the cavern as you scan your surroundings and listen intently for signs of trouble. Fortunately, no beasts reveal themselves to you...
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_SYSTEM_000_053: ...In the darkness, something hungers. A foul presence draws near, with murderous designs...
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_POPMESSAGE_100_053: Loathsome creatures emerge from the water!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_POPMESSAGE_200_053: Another fell beast is drawn to the stench of blood!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_054: What an excellent catch! Thanks for bringing me here.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_ZELIHALI_000_055: Oh no, the pleasure is all mine! If it pleases you, we can have the cook serve your fish at your next meal. And leftovers may be dried and prepared as a treat for the journey home.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_ZELIHALI_000_056: And with that, let us return to Dock Poga. Thank you again for standing watch on our tour!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_060: That was such marvelous fun. I have high hopes for the enterprise. Although...
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_ZELIHALI_000_061: Phew... Thanks to you, I made it through my first tour without incident.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_062: Ah, welcome back! Tseeya and Zelihali just returned.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_063: What a wonderful experience. Not only did I learn about the area and its people, but the tour was tailored to my every whim. This'll be the talk of Tuliyollal!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_064: That said, I couldn't help but notice one glaring flaw. You're aware of what I speak, aren't you, ?
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_065: Hmmm? Did something happen during the tour?
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_A1_000_002: The tour itself was uneventful, but...
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_A1_000_000: I may have had to dispatch a few ravenous fiends.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_066: I think your definition of “noteworthy” differs somewhat from the norm. You dispatched some fiends, didn't you? Albeit so swiftly that I never felt as though I was in danger.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_067: Ah, you speak of the fiends you dispatched, yes? Albeit so swiftly that I never felt as though I was in danger.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_068: You did indeed, yes. Albeit so swiftly that I never felt as though I was in danger.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_069: You dealt with these fiends by yourself? Are you alright?
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_070: There are few who could've handled the creatures so effortlessly, and that's where the problem lies.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_071: One day, you will take your leave of the Turali Travel Agency, and they will be hard-pressed to find someone of comparable skill. How then is the agency to ensure the safety of future guests, I wonder...?
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_072: I see what you're saying... Having  here with us is truly a blessing, but not a blessing we can rely upon forever.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_100_072: Exactly. Customer safety should be a core pillar of your business. You'll need stronger measures in place to account for any dangers that may arise.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_073: I should mention that the Wing of Reflection considers tourism to be a vital part of our nation's future. All the more so as we forge ties with foreign powers and promote the exchange of cultures moving forward.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_TSEEYA_000_074: Complications notwithstanding, I'm glad I could personally experience the joys of sightseeing. Please don't hesitate to consult with us so we may iron out any other issues, and nurture this industry together in the months and years to come.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_075: We should be glad to do so! And may I say that devising a security plan that doesn't require our resident adventurer will be a top priority!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_ZELIHALI_100_075: I feel ashamed. It never crossed my mind that entrusting our safety to  alone might be a problem...
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_ZELIHALI_000_076: I'd like to do my part to protect our guests during their stay. I think I speak for all my fellow guides when I say that. Perhaps our special advisor would be willing to train us?
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_077: A wonderful idea. Your skill with wind magicks is a boon for sure, but your local knowledge, and experience dealing with the region's fiends makes you all the more qualified for this duty!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_078: Still, to be safe, I propose we assign two guides per tour group. That way we alleviate the burden and better guarantee group safety.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_079: Though, we'll need proper facilities: a place to train and space to house supporting staff. It could amount to quite the expenditure...
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_080: My inner abacus is clacking away! It's telling me this is a prime investment opportunity, made possible because we identified the problem early!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_LIPLU_000_081: Of course, we're still counting on your help, ! There's plenty to be done besides guide training and warding off fiends. We may have welcomed our first customer, but the real test is yet to come!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_SYSTEM_000_165: A new guide training facility has been established at the Turali Travel Agency's base of operations, where candidates may look to your example as they hone their skills.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_SYSTEM_000_166: The new policy of assigning two guides to each group will ensure none come to harm in your absence. Continue assisting Liplu and her associates, and ensure visitors leave refreshed, reinvigorated, and ready to spread the word about Kozama'uka's all-new tourist enterprise!
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_SYSTEM_000_105: You have achieved Trusted reputation with the Turali Travel Agency.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_SYSTEM_000_106: New Pelupelu society daily quests are now available from Yubli at Dock Poga.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_SYSTEM_000_107: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Yubli as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_SYSTEM_000_108: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Yubli. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANPEL002_05194_SYSTEM_000_109: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Pavli.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_000: Did you hear? Business is booming at the Turali Travel Agency! Thanks to you and the Hanu, we've been seeing stellar sales.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_001: And our new policies and training are all paying off─not a single one of our customers has been accosted by fiends. Needless to say, they find the presence of their guides-turned-protectors thoroughly reassuring!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_002: Still, a few issues have come to light. First and foremost, our reach.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_100_002: So far, our tours have been limited to downstream Kozama'uka, but many guests have expressed a desire to see the region's upper reaches.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_003: With that in mind, I contacted Mablu and asked her to gauge how receptive the Moblins might be to the whole tourism concept.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_004: We're about to hold a meeting to discuss the matter, and I'd love to have you join us! When you're ready, head to Elder Zanuhali's residence in Ok'hanu!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_005: There you are! The meeting will be held on the second floor.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_006: Earthenshire's Rediroq will be joining us. I look forward to hearing about the potsworn's position on tourists coming to visit.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_007: Mablu seemed to think the artisans were enthused. Still...I can't help but feel nervous.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_ZANUHALI_000_008: What an honor this is. Rediroq, Liplu, and  ! Thank you for coming.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_REDIROQ_000_009: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... Rediroq didn't know you were involved in lookytour busydeals! How delightful it is to meet again!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_REDIROQ_000_010: The peddler mentioned your proposal to bring tourists to Earthenshire, and we should be glad to welcome them with open arms! The potsworn were very supportive too.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_012: Though I have to ask─what if our customers distract your artisans from their work? I'd hate for this arrangement to negatively impact Earthenshire's trade.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_REDIROQ_000_013: No need for worryfrowns! Many potsworn themselves think contact with outsiders will provide fresh inspiration!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_REDIROQ_000_014: We are happy to guidewalk visitors, too. Until recently, many helphands were recovering from hurtyfeels, but the situation has greatly improved!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_REDIROQ_000_015: Besides, it will bring more opportunities to sell craftygoods! Mobbies will make sure the potsworn can keep working unhindered, even during the lookytours!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_ZANUHALI_000_016: It should indeed. Our wares are proving popular with visitors to Ok'hanu, and the proceeds have enriched the community. Everyone stands to benefit.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_017: It fills me with joy to hear stories of happiness spread through trade!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_REDIROQ_000_018: Rediroq does have one question! The great stairs are still impassable as repairs are ongoing, so how will visitors reach Earthenshire?
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_ZANUHALI_000_019: Liplu and I have discussed the matter at length...
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_020: We'll send them over on flying punutiys!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_A1_000_002: ...I don't know how to respond to that.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_021: A handful of punutiy barges ply the waters between upstream Kozama'uka and Tuliyollal, but there's no direct route to the downstream region.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_022: The massive waterfall that lies between complicates matters. Traveling by boat, you have to head downstream, then join Ihuykatumu and double back. It's quite convoluted.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_ZANUHALI_000_023: But there is an alternative. Though seldom used since the Flight of We Wingless was built, we Hanu once imbued punutiys with the gift of flight, enabling them to transport passengers over the falls.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_ZANUHALI_000_024: The method requires vast quantities of reeds, hence why we were unable to employ it during the rite of succession. But this might be the perfect occasion to revive the old ways.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_REDIROQ_000_025: Quickjump between Earthenshire and downstream Kozama'uka! Rediroq likes the sound of that!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_026: Of course, we'll need staff well versed in punutiy care. Which is why I've already reached out to some beastkeepers! Part of me balks at the idea of spending all that pel...
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_027: But my inner abacus assures me that this is yet another worthwhile investment!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_100_027: There isn't a moment to lose. It's time to make airborne punutiy travel a reality once more!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_GENUHANU_000_029: I couldn't stand the idea of leaving all the work to our special advisor, so I came along to help. The others should be here shortly.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_030: I'm glad our plans for expansion look set to succeed! For their cooperation, I'll see to it that our Moblin and Hanu partners get their fair share of the profits!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_031: But let's first ensure that there will be additional profits to share in the first place...
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_GENUHANU_000_032: We'll need a large effigy to channel our wind magicks into the punutiys, and for that we'll need plenty of reeds, not to mention reams of cloth stitched with aether-enriched flight feathers... But you can leave preparations for the latter to us Hanu.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_033: I have business in the capital, so I'll procure the punutiys. Come to think of it, I'll have to commission Wuk Evu to build an enclosure for them too.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_034: Which leaves the reeds... I realize this is grunt work, , but permit me to entrust the harvest to you.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_GENUHANU_000_035: Speak with Gonahanu in the Fields of Gold. He'll point you in the right direction.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_036: Anyhow, I'd best be off! Let's reconvene later!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_GONAHANU_000_040: Well met! Zanuhali said you require some reeds.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_GONAHANU_000_041: The plants nearby are ready to harvest. Feel free to take as much as you need. After all, we have you and your friends to thank for the bumper crop!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_GONAHANU_000_042: You know, these days, we get plenty of visitors to the fields. Some even ask to help with the harvest!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_GONAHANU_000_043: It's a joy to see, that's for sure. Anyway, it won't be long until the next Ihih'hana. I hope you can join us again!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_GONAHANU_000_044: Ah, sorry─I should let you get to work instead of talking your ear off! Once you have what you need, deliver the reeds to Lanuhali in Kozanuakiy.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_GONAHANU_000_045: As I said, once you've finished gathering your share, take it to Kozanuakiy and give it over to Lanuhali. My colleagues and I will handle the remainder of the harvest.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LANUHALI_000_046: Hello there. I hear you might have some reeds for me!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LANUHALI_000_047: I wasn't expecting such a haul! Thank you. Together with the reeds my fellow Hanu have collected, we should have enough to construct the effigy.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LANUHALI_000_048: The first step will be to dry the reeds with a little help from our wind magicks. Once the effigy itself is complete, all that will be left to do is swaddle it in special cloth.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LANUHALI_000_049: You needn't worry about the details, though. We'll see to the rest! Return to the travel agency in case they have need of you there.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LANUHALI_000_050: We often see visitors here in Kozanuakiy. They listen to our tales of Kixaihih with such interest. Being able to share our culture is a joyful thing indeed.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_051: Ah, there you are! I just got back myself. The beastkeepers are on their way with the punutiys as we speak.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_052: Once the creatures are capable of flight, it'll be a quick hop to Earthenshire. I'm planning to offer bespoke tours for customers wishing to purchase potsworn crafts straight from the source!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_LIPLU_000_053: Thankfully, Wuk Evu agreed to work on the enclosure. Once the effigy is finished, we'll just need to wait for Zanuhali to arrive!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_ZANUHALI_000_164: Divine wind, lay claim to the effigy! Grant these water-bound beasts the gift of flight!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_SYSTEM_000_165: Thanks to the efforts of all involved, the Turali Travel Agency is now replete with its own punutiy enclosure and wind effigy!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_SYSTEM_000_166: With the aid of the flight-imbued aquatic creatures, visitors may now experience the upper reaches of Kozama'uka. Yet as the agency continues to broaden its horizons, it will need you to ensure that business keeps pace!
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_SYSTEM_000_105: You have achieved Respected reputation with the Turali Travel Agency.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_SYSTEM_000_106: New Pelupelu society daily quests are now available from Yubli at Dock Poga.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_SYSTEM_000_107: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Yubli as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_SYSTEM_000_108: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Yubli. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANPEL003_05195_SYSTEM_000_109: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Pavli.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_000: What am I going to do... I can't seem to find anyone up to the task.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_001: Oh, ! You have the wonderful habit of appearing exactly when I need you! I've got a problem on my hands...
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_002: Don't worry, the agency's doing just fine. The Earthenshire tours have been a runaway success, and if bookings stay steady, we'll soon recoup all the recent outlays.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_100_002: Well, that's actually the problem. The upper reaches of Kozama'uka are proving too popular─we're struggling to meet demand with our current number of tour guides.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_003: I want to address the issue before the burden starts wearing the staff down... You aren't aware of anyone in need of work who knows the region like the back of their hand, are you?
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_A1_000_002: Sounds like a job for the Moblins.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_A1_000_003: A certain bandit gang comes to mind...
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_004: Hmmm. There are only a handful of Hanu who know the region around Earthenshire, and they're already on the payroll! Sorry to dismiss your suggestion, but do you have any other ideas?
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_005: That would be ideal, but the Moblins have the potsworn to attend to... I'd be loath to ask any more of them. Do you have any other suggestions?
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_006: You don't mean the bandits who kidnapped Dawnservant Wuk Lamat during the rite of succession!? I'm sure they know the area well, but...
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_007: Ah, hold on... I do remember hearing about a group of miscreants who turned themselves in to the Landsguard not long after the ascension ceremony. Apparently, they were later released on parole.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_008: I suppose if they're willing to atone for their crimes and genuinely wish to make a fresh start...
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_009: My inner abacus is clacking away! It says we should speak with them, at the very least!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_100_009: Reduce the strain on our staff, have former bandits give back to the communities they wronged... Yes, yes─everyone stands to gain much from a potential arrangement!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_010: Would you be willing to help track down these bandits?
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_011: I knew I could count on you! Let's head to Many Fires and see what we can glean from the locals!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_012: I'm looking for a group of recently pardoned bandits... Does that ring any bells?
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_MOB05196A_000_013: Has Mobbie heard windtalk of bandits? I'm afraid not. These parts have been peaceful of late. Plenty of time to fish!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_MOB05196A_000_014: Although I did eyecatch a scrawny fisher in the woods not far from Deceiver's Mantel...
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_MOB05196A_000_015: A Tonawawta with crazyhair as bright as jinglyshine! I wonder who he was...
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_MOB05196B_000_016: Ah, you seek news of the bandits let out on parole? Sneakytakers, the lot of them!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_MOB05196B_000_017: They spread many badfeels in the village with their crimes. Cheese was not for them!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_MOB05196B_000_018: Apparently, they were eyecatched not so long ago. Mobbie dreads to think about the inevitable recidivism...
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_MOB05196B_000_019: I hope they've had time to reflect on the wrongness of dirtytaking and are ready to make an honest living!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_PELUPELUPEDDLER0519: My goodness, it's you! You came here with Dawnservant Koana seeking information about the bandit that waylaid me. Is there anything I can help you with this time?
Ah, you wish to know what happened to Wawkesa and his band of brigands after all that? Well, I gather they surrendered to the Landsguard.
They even confessed the whereabouts of their stolen goods, that everything might be returned to their rightful owners. Sure enough, my merchandise made its way back to me.
Apparently, some of their victims were so moved by the gesture that they petitioned the Landsguard for a more lenient sentence. Perhaps that's why Vow Wuk Lamat granted them parole.
I don't know how they've fared thence, but I've heard nothing to suggest they've been causing trouble.
Anyhow, you'll have to excuse me. I must meet with a client in Urqopacha. I do hope we meet again someday!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_031: Hmmm. So they turned themselves in, returned the stolen goods, and are now living in the wilds after being pardoned. What's more, it seems they haven't fallen back into old habits...
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_032: Let's make for the woods to the south. That's where the angler spotted Wawkesa, right? Hopefully we'll run into him there!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_033: I must admit, I regret being so bold... But then again, what do I have to fear with you by my side!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_034: Starting to think I'm not cut out for fishing...and a man can't live off scrounging berries forever. What to do...
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_035: Aaagh! Y-You're that salted devil of a sellsword!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_036: L-Listen, I turned myself in─even gave back what I stole! Put that life behind me for good. What more could you possibly want from me!?
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_A2_000_001: I have a proposition for you.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_A2_000_002: I came to personally ensure you got what you deserve.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_A2_000_003: Oh, I don't want anything from you...
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_037: And why should I trust you!? You're here to get revenge for the kidnapping, aren't you!?
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_038: I assure you, as my associate says, we really do have a proposition for you. I'm Liplu. It's a pleasure to meet you.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_039: Y-You came to get revenge for the kidnapping!?
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_040: Quite the opposite. We've come with a business proposal. My name's Liplu, by the way. It's a pleasure to meet you.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_041: You're Wawkesa, yes? My name's Liplu, and I have an exciting business proposal for you!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_042: I'll get straight to the point. If you're serious about keeping to the strait and narrow, and making amends for your past crimes, perhaps you'd like to work with us...at the Turali Travel Agency!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_043: Work for you!? Hah─I see your scheme! Plotting to haul me off to the mines under the guise of “employment,” aren't you!?
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_044: Curse you blackhearts! I ate dirt to survive after I escaped! I won't set foot inside another mine while there's still breath in my lungs!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_046: ...That was unexpected. And all that talk of mines... He seemed genuinely traumatized.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_047: , I want to find out what happened to him. Hopefully, that way, we can clear up this misunderstanding and have a proper discussion.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_048: I hate to ask, but could you find Wawkesa and bring him back here? He was awfully fast, but I doubt he could outrun you!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_049: If you could bring Wawkesa back, it would be much appreciated! I'm sure he's still nearby.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_050: <wheeze> I don't care how fast they are... <wheeze> They'll never find me here...
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_052: Unbelievable. I ran full pelt, and yet... Ah, what's the use.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_053: Listen, I know what we did was inexcusable, but after it came to a head, we made an oath─an oath to never walk that path again. I won't bother another soul, I'll live out my days on the fringes... Please, just leave me be!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_054: You're saying this is all a misunderstanding...? Well, it's clear there's no escaping you regardless. Fine, I'll hear her out...and put my fate in your hands.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_060: Don't worry, I'm not going anywhere. Your associate says she wants to talk, and I'm prepared to listen.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_061: I apologize if we frightened you, Wawkesa. That wasn't our intention. Are you willing to tell us why you fled?
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_062: Before we get to that, I want you to be honest. Do you really have a proposition for me that doesn't involve dragging me back to those godsforsaken mines?
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_064: I'll be honest with you. Me and the rest of the gang first came here after fleeing Xak Tural.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_065: I'm sure I don't need to tell you, but Shaaloani's been a hotbed of development since they found blue gold beneath the plains.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_066: Among the folk that got their hands on a drilling permit, there were more than a few looking to get rich quick. The kind of despicable bastards who didn't think twice about sending kids into the tunnels. And we, well...we worked for the worst of the worst.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_067: Day after day, toiling and wasting away. Till we died or escaped, we eventually realized. So we smuggled ourselves out in empty ceruleum barrels.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_068: You can imagine what happened next. That vidraal of a foreman tried to hunt us down, so we fled to Kozama'uka and took to banditry, as much to conceal our identities as to make ends meet.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_069: Right or wrong be damned, we would survive. But...when we heard that Dawnservant Wuk Lamat spoke of our plight during the ascension ceremony, we decided to turn ourselves in.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_070: After a time, she showed us mercy and gave us a pardon. Even so...there's still that fear of what might happen if the foreman or his lackeys were to find us...
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_071: Thank you for sharing your story, and telling me of the struggles you and your friends have experienced.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_072: Let me assure you that I do not wish to bind you with contracts or chains. I offer only the opportunity for you and your comrades to provide for yourselves. To make an honest living on your own terms. So...how about it? How does working at the Turali Travel Agency sound?
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_073: Th-That's more than any of us dared hope for. But what if word gets back to the foreman? If someone shows up to haul us away, and we drag you into our affairs...
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_074: I'll need to look into it to be sure, but I honestly don't think there's much chance of that happening. Thanks to the efforts of the Dustwatch and the Daybreakers, Shaaloani's no longer the lawless place it used to be.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_075: Besides, I've been working on a plan to help reintegrate former outlaws into society. I'll be sounding out the Wing of Reflection to see if they can't support the initiative. I'm sure the new Dawnservants will give their blessing!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_076: Incredible! But, you know, it feels like we should be begging you for the opportunity... We've burned so many bridges. I'll make damn sure you don't regret this!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_077: That said, what exactly are we supposed to do for you? About all we're good for is manual labor and pathfinding. Though I do also know my way around a cookfire after feeding miners for all those years.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_078: Hmmm...This wasn't part of the plan, per se, but I think your culinary skills might come in handy! A restaurant on-site could be a real earner!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_100_078: As for your comrades, we've been looking for individuals with an intimate knowledge of upstream Kozama'uka who are also capable of handling themselves! My plan was to employ them as guides-turned-protectors after a thorough assessment and proper training.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_079: I'd say it's about time we got back and continued preparations. Wawkesa can meet us back at the agency in Dock Poga once he contacts his friends!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_080: Real, honest work... Something tells we won't get another chance like this.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_081: Welcome back, ! I reached out to the Wing of Reflection, and it was just as I thought. It seems Wawkesa's fears were unfounded.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_100_081: The situation in the ceruleum fields has changed dramatically in the past few years. Groups like the Daybreakers have put an end to the practice of child labor, and the Dustwatch have all but stamped out the violent duels that used to be so common.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_200_081: As for the company you and your comrades worked for, they have long since been shut down by the Daybreakers.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_082: For its part, the Wing of Reflection is committed to the restoration and preservation of law and order in Shaaloani. Any new unscrupulous drilling operations are swiftly dealt with. You needn't worry about anyone coming after you!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_WAWKESA_000_084: In that case, we can commit to doing our part and repaying our debts! We've decided to set aside some of our earnings and repay folk for all the hurt we caused, you see.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_LIPLU_000_085: Wonderful! Simply wonderful! It's a pleasure to have you on board!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_SYSTEM_000_500: Thanks to the efforts of Liplu and her special advisor, Wawkesa and his comrades have agreed to join the Turali Travel Agency! With this influx of new recruits, the shortage of staff that had threatened to curtail expansion into Earthenshire has been resolved.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_SYSTEM_000_501: While his former crewmates begin their training as guides, Wawkesa himself will be devising a menu of delicious local dishes as head chef of the agency's brand-new eatery. Be sure to assist him and his crew of former brigands on their road to rehabilitation!
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_SYSTEM_000_105: You have achieved Honored reputation with the Turali Travel Agency.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_SYSTEM_000_106: New Pelupelu society daily quests are now available from Yubli at Dock Poga.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_SYSTEM_000_107: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Yubli as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_SYSTEM_000_108: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Yubli. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANPEL004_05196_SYSTEM_000_109: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Pavli.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_000: , good to see you! Have you heard? The new eatery is a roaring success!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_001: It seems Wawkesa's time as a cook in Shaaloani exposed him to all kinds of cuisines. The young fellow is both surprisingly skilled and commands an impressive repertoire. His comrades, too, have proven worthwhile additions, having taken well to guide work.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_002: Besides that, there's been an interesting development. You remember Tseeya, the Wing of Reflection representative, don't you? Our very first customer.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_003: Well, we were discussing my initiative to support former outlaws, and all of a sudden, he tells me there was something he wished to discuss in person. He's on his way to Dock Poga as we speak.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_004: I hope you can join me for the discussion! He ought to be here any moment now.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_TSEEYA_000_005: Thank you for setting aside the time to meet with me.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_006: Tseeya! It's wonderful to see you again. You seem in fine fettle indeed!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_TSEEYA_000_007: Likewise, it's heartening to see you and the business doing so well. The strides you've made since my first visit are remarkable.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_TSEEYA_000_008: Your expansion into upstream Kozama'uka with flying punutiys was quite the feat, and your decision to employ former bandits has done much for the wider community. A superb achievement! Know that my colleagues back in Tuliyollal are equally impressed.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_TSEEYA_000_009: Last time I was here, I spoke of our position on tourism and foreign relations... It is with regards to this that the Wing of Reflection would seek your assistance.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_010: But of course! My inner abacus is clacking away, and it's urging me to do everything I can to support you. We'd love nothing more than to show foreign guests the delights Tural has to offer!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_011: Although, visitors from overseas are still few and far between. What exactly would you have us do?
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_TSEEYA_000_012: You are aware that Tuliyollal recently entered into an alliance with Radz-at-Han. As it so happens, we've received a visitor from the city-state.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_TSEEYA_000_013: When we told her about the Turali Travel Agency, she expressed an interest in experiencing the region for herself. Would you be willing to provide one of your tours?
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_014: It'd be our pleasure. Fortunately, we have a slot available!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_TSEEYA_000_015: Excellent. The visitor's name is Rasafbaht. She is an Au Ra, like our esteemed adventurer, and an alchemist by trade.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_TSEEYA_000_016: Excellent. The visitor's name is Rasafbaht. She is of the Au Ra, a people known for their curved horns and ornate scales. I should also mention that she's an alchemist by trade.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_TSEEYA_000_017: I shall return to Tuliyollal and inform her of the plan at once. I'll procure an alpaca porter for her journey─if you could attend her when she arrives, I'd be much obliged.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_020: To think the Wing of Reflection would entrust us with the nation's honored guest. What better way to promote Tural as a premier tourist destination!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_021: We wouldn't be in this position if it weren't for you and all our hardworking staff!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_022: Now then, we can't leave anything to chance! We'll need to be fully prepared for Rasafbaht's arrival.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_023: I don't suppose you've visited Radz-at-Han? I'd like to learn as much as I can about our guest's homeland.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_024: Of course, I needn't have asked! I'm not surprised in the least that our special advisor has traveled so far and wide.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_025: From what I've heard, the climate of Thavnair is similar to that of Kozama'uka, so I presume our guest will not be overwhelmed by the heat and humidity. My primary concern is the local cuisine.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_026: Would you mind speaking to Wawkesa and sharing your knowledge of Hannish fare with him? It may inspire him to prepare a suitable menu!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_WAWKESA_000_030: Ah, hey there. Anything I can help you with?
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_WAWKESA_000_031: It's an honor to welcome a guest from across the salt! Putting together a menu to suit their tastes ought to make for a fun challenge!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_WAWKESA_000_032: So, what might one find on the dinner table in Radz-at-Han?
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_A1_000_002: Hannish spirits are renowned by one and all─wouldn't be a meal without a drop or two.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_A1_000_003: Searingly spicy food, and lots of it.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_WAWKESA_000_033: Fruit, you say? Given our similar climate, I'd say Turali fruits should suit her palate.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_WAWKESA_000_034: Fond of their booze, are they? Hmmm. Kozama'uka isn't famed for its liquor. I suppose I'd have to turn to the Pelu and their mezcal.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_WAWKESA_000_035: Food that packs a spicy punch, huh? In that case, the Moblins' flavorful cuisine might be better received than the more subdued Hanu fare.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_WAWKESA_000_036: In any event, I'll whip up a meal that puts local flavors front and center, and work in a few flourishes to suit our guest. Let Liplu know I've got this covered!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_038: Rasafbaht, I presume? It's a pleasure to meet you! I'm Liplu, the founder of the Turali Travel Agency. I'll be your tour guide!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_RASAFBAHT_000_039: Thank you for accommodating me at such short notice! I am Rasafbaht, yes, and I represent the High Crucible of Al-Kimiya, Radz-at-Han's state-sponsored alchemical workshop.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_RASAFBAHT_000_040: Oh! You're , aren't you!? What a coincidence!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_RASAFBAHT_000_041: Forgive me, you must not remember. I'm one of the alchemists you met at the Great Work. My associates and I, er...examined your friend Estinien.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_042: Ah, I see you already know each other!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_RASAFBAHT_000_043: Well, I think it's a little more one-sided than “each other” suggests... The people of Radz-at-Han─no, all of Thavnair and beyond─owe a debt of gratitude to !
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_044: The same goes for all of us here at the Turali Travel Agency! 's done so much to support our enterprise, not to mention the nation at large!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_RASAFBAHT_000_045: Incredible! Fate certainly works in mysterious ways...
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_047: Seeing as how the two of you are already acquainted, perhaps you'd care to join us on the tour?
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_A2_000_002: She'll have her own personal protector!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_048: Wonderful. Allow me to escort you to your room, Rasafbaht, I'm sure you'll want to unpack your belongings.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_049: Would you mind waiting here? We'll be back in no time!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_RASAFBAHT_000_050: I can't wait to see what Kozama'uka has to offer! This is going to be marvelous!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_500: Sorry to keep you waiting! Let's get going, shall we?
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_TSEEYA_000_061: Rasafbaht's satisfaction is writ plain upon her face. I am deeply indebted to the agency and all its hardworking staff.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_062: I'm so relieved everything went off without a hitch! And who'd have thought we'd get to watch the Hanu rehearsing for the next Ihih'hana!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_063: I can only hope Rasafbaht enjoyed her experience as much as I believe she did...
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_RASAFBAHT_000_064: I want to thank you all for everything you've done! This was a true delight!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_RASAFBAHT_000_065: The climate may be similar to that of Thavnair, but the native flora has been a sight to behold! Speaking as an alchemist, there were so many intriguing specimens─such potential!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_RASAFBAHT_000_066: And the people and their culture... It was fascinating to learn how the Hanuhanu use reed-woven floats to channel their magicks during rites and rituals!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_RASAFBAHT_000_067: Oh, and the punutiys were simply adorable! This will all make for a very engaging account when I report back to Vrtra.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_RASAFBAHT_000_068: Our two nations may have forged an alliance, but the ink has barely begun to dry on the parchment.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_RASAFBAHT_000_069: Indeed, it was thanks to the efforts of the Scions that an agreement was reached at all. It would be presumptuous to claim that Tuliyollal and Radz-at-Han truly understand one another yet.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_RASAFBAHT_000_070: Which is why the satrap sent me─to explore the potential for other mutually beneficial arrangements, and to confirm the friendship between our nations will stand the test of time.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_TSEEYA_000_071: The Hanu and their unique magical traditions, the plant specimens you spoke of... You think this knowledge would benefit Radz-at-Han?
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_RASAFBAHT_000_072: If we're able to maintain relations and encourage the flow of people between our two nations, Radz-at-Han stands to gain a great deal. Of that I'm certain!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_RASAFBAHT_000_073: Besides, there's so much more I wish to learn about this land! I plan on spending the rest of my time here doing just that!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_074: Wonderful, simply wonderful! When you return to Radz-at-Han, I hope you let everyone know what a great place Kozama'uka is to visit─or better yet, the whole of Tural!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_076: Well, I suppose we should head back to the agency!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_080: You just leave the rest to us. We'll make sure the remainder of Rasafbaht's stay is truly unforgettable!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_TSEEYA_000_081: Rasafbaht is resting in her quarters. I must say, I'm relieved the tour ended without incident... Thank you for everything you've done.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_TSEEYA_000_082: For our visiting alchemist, I daresay Kozama'uka's vegetation seemed like a veritable cornucopia.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_TSEEYA_000_083: Any discoveries made via the alliance will benefit Tuliyollal as much as Radz-at-Han. Indeed, this type of exchange is precisely what the Wing of Reflection had hoped for.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_TSEEYA_000_084: I shall make my proposal to Dawnservant Koana as soon as I return to the capital. There's no doubt in my mind─the tourism industry deserves our official backing. And once we may offer it, we shall have a commemorative monument erected to make this clear to one and all.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_085: Your support means a great deal, but I can't understate the role  and the people of Kozama'uka had to play in our success!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_LIPLU_000_086: Their happiness is just as important to me! The pel we earn must serve to enrich the community. Which is why I can't rest on my laurels for even a moment!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_SYSTEM_000_800: Thanks to the travails of Liplu and her associates, the Turali Travel Agency is on the cusp of receiving official backing from the Wing of Reflection!
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_SYSTEM_000_801: The future is bright for Tural's incipient tourism industry. With the Pelu principle of mutually beneficial trade underpinning the endeavor, where tourists tread, happiness is soon to follow.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_SYSTEM_000_105: You have achieved Sworn reputation with the Turali Travel Agency.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_SYSTEM_000_106: You will receive an experience point bonus upon the completion of Pelupelu society daily quests.
TEXT_BANPEL005_05197_SYSTEM_000_109: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Pavli.
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_000: ! Thanks to you, the Turali Travel Agency goes from strength to strength. The Wing of Reflection's backing has been a real boon, and we're seeing more traffic than ever!
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_001: And it so happens we're due a visit from another special guest today. As you have many times before, will you join me in welcoming them?
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_002: Thank you! Let's go and wait by the Wing of Reflection's monument outside.
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_003: I appreciate how generous you are with your time, I really do. Our guest should be here any moment now...
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_011: So good to see you, Mablu! Welcome to the Turali Travel Agency's Kozama'uka branch!
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_012: That's right, today's guest is none other than my dear friend, Mablu. I'm sure you noticed, but she's had a hand in practically every aspect of the enterprise.
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_013: From procuring supplies to facilitating critical communications and relaying news from trading posts all across Tural─she's been a huge help!
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_014: And let's not forget that it was Mablu who introduced me to you!
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_015: The Turali Travel Agency wouldn't be the institution it is today without your tireless efforts. You both have my eternal gratitude!
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_MABLU_000_016: I'm just as grateful! After all, I've gained my fair share of pel as well.
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_MABLU_000_017: Still, I can't hold a candle to you, Liplu. Forging ties with the community and securing the endorsement of the Wing of Reflection... As a fellow entrepreneur in pursuit of our shared goal, I shall have to redouble my efforts!
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_018: I never told you this, but after Mablu first committed to becoming a peddler, she came to the alpaca wool bedding emporium I was operating at the time and put to me a business proposal.
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_019: Due to recent events, Tural has known much hardship, both great and small, and she wondered if perhaps we, through our mercantile pursuits, might do something to hasten the nation's recovery.
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_MABLU_000_020: From the terrible storm that destroyed bridges and rendered the Flight of We Wingless impassable, to the sudden death of Gulool Ja Ja...we've had much cause to grieve. But it is our way to spread happiness through trade, and I had to believe we could still make a difference as only we Pelu could.
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_MABLU_000_021: When you and your comrades returned in triumph, there were festivities during which I spoke with many Turali. I sensed the people's growing desire to learn about their neighbors and share their own culture in turn. That's why I told Liplu I saw an opportunity ripe for the taking...
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_022: And so I decided to establish the Turali Travel Agency. Mablu would keep in touch as she peddled her wares on the road, supporting us with her observations and insights. We were business partners in a Turali revitalization initiative, so to speak.
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_023: The more we expanded our operations, the more people and communities to which we could bring visitors and their pel. With everyone's help, we've enriched many lives. But this is only the beginning!
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_MABLU_000_026: Through trade we'll continue to bring Turali together and give them ample cause to smile. After all, that's what we Pelu do─now and always!
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_027: You're right about that! Ahh, I can hear my inner abacus clacking away. It's proud we can hold true to our traditions, and just as convinced as I am that all our dreams will come true!
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_028: I hope you both keep the Turali Travel Agency in mind wherever you might be. Do be sure to send plenty of customers our way!
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_030: Where would I be without you, ? You've contributed so much to the agency, and aided us in assembling an amazing group of collaborators.
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_031: The Hanuhanu are a joy to work with, and the Moblins are thrilled to have found an all-new audience for their crafts...
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_032: Not to mention the alpaca porters and punutiy hands pleased with all the extra pel in their pockets.
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_033: But as I keep saying, we wouldn't have been able to forge those ties in the first place if it weren't for your help.
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_034: I'm sure you're tired of me singing your praises, but I really do owe it all to you! Thanks for sticking with me as I've taken these first real steps towards my dream.
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_035: I wonder where the next steps will lead me. Homeward to Urqopacha? Or perhaps I should set my sights on Xak Tural? Who knows, one day the Turali Travel Agency may even have an Alexandrian branch!
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_LIPLU_000_036: After all, a path only extends as far as you're willing to walk, and my legs have plenty of life left in them!
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_SYSTEM_000_105: You have achieved Bloodsworn reputation with the Turali Travel Agency.
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_SYSTEM_000_106: You will receive an experience point bonus upon the completion of Pelupelu society daily quests.
TEXT_BANPEL006_05198_SYSTEM_000_107: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Pavli.
TEXT_BANPEL101_05199_YUBLI_000_001: We can't simply wait around and hope customers find us of their own accord. It's vital people are made aware of the Turali Travel Agency's existence!
TEXT_BANPEL101_05199_YUBLI_000_002: To that end, I had these promotional flyers made up. Can I trouble you to distribute them in Ok'bek'be?
TEXT_BANPEL101_05199_YUBLI_000_003: Traders traveling from the capital often visit the settlement. I'd have you seek out potential customers and give them a flyer. Ideally, they'll then spread the word about our enterprise to their associates and loved ones.
TEXT_BANPEL101_05199_YUBLI_000_004: The Hanuhanu residing in Ok'bek'be are already familiar with the agency, so try and target other Turali when handing out the flyers. Travel safely!
TEXT_BANPEL101_05199_CITIZENA05199_000_0: Are you here on business too?

“The Turali Travel Agency”... How intriguing. I must say, distributing flyers like this is such an efficient means of conveying information. I'll make sure this gets seen wherever my peddling takes me.
Ah, it's you again. One of the friends I showed that flyer to made a booking with the agency and had a wonderful time. I'll happily take another and spread the word even further!
TEXT_BANPEL101_05199_CITIZENB05199_000_0: Hm? You have something for me?

A travel agency based in Kozama'uka? And with an office in Tuliyollal... Come to think of it, my mother is always talking about visiting the region. I'll have to show her this when I get back to the capital.
More promotion for that new travel agency? As it so happens, a friend of mine's been asking to see the flyer. With this I can put an end to their pestering! Much obliged.

Hmmm. A travel agency offerin' guided tours? A fine idea! Ever since I visited Kozama'uka on business, I've been itchin' to return. With an enterprise like this in the region, I might just have to bring my family along with me.
I'm glad you dropped by with another flyer! Some family friends were eager to find out more. I'll show 'em this next time I'm home.
TEXT_BANPEL101_05199_YUBLI_000_025: I appreciate your help handing out the flyers. Given the number of visitors passing through, Ok'bek'be might just be the best location in Kozama'uka to promote the travel agency.
TEXT_BANPEL101_05199_YUBLI_000_026: Of course, flyers are available outside our office in Tuliyollal, but there's nothing like a grassroots approach to really generate awareness.
TEXT_BANPEL101_05199_YUBLI_000_027: Each flyer we hand out is a potential customer in the making. My job is to make sure expectations are exceeded if and when they decide to visit!
TEXT_BANPEL102_05200_YUBLI_100_001: The travel agency is planning to add Ok'hanu souvenirs and mementos to our store shelves. We'll take but a small operating fee, of course, while the bulk of the profits will be funneled back to the local artisans.
TEXT_BANPEL102_05200_YUBLI_000_002: The wares in question will all be items the Hanu craft on a daily basis. We thought such goods would make the perfect keepsakes, and so negotiated a deal to sell them directly to our customers.
TEXT_BANPEL102_05200_YUBLI_000_001: Our travel agency offers various services, one of which is the sale of Ok'hanu souvenirs and mementos. We take but a small operating fee, while the bulk of the profits are funneled back to the local artisans.
TEXT_BANPEL102_05200_YUBLI_000_003: The quality crafts we sell have been very popular─so much so that we've been having trouble keeping the shelves stocked...
TEXT_BANPEL102_05200_YUBLI_000_004: We're expecting a new batch at any moment, as a matter of fact. Would you mind visiting one of our industrious artisans and picking up the next delivery?
TEXT_BANPEL102_05200_CITIZENA05200_000_0: Can I assume you've come to collect the souvenirs?
I want to impress the agency's customers with the quality of our craft, so I've been working doubly hard to ensure everything is perfect. Here, please hurry this shipment back to Yubli!
Please see those souvenirs directly back to Yubli. I'd hate for his customers to be disappointed.
TEXT_BANPEL102_05200_YUBLI_000_010: You have the new batch of souvenirs?
TEXT_BANPEL102_05200_YUBLI_000_011: Ah, excellent. Thank you very much!
TEXT_BANPEL102_05200_YUBLI_000_012: In case you were curious, this time the sack was filled with Hanuhanu dolls. The figures are woven out of the village's cherished reeds, and were originally placed in the home as a ward against harm.
TEXT_BANPEL102_05200_YUBLI_000_013: In case you were curious, this time the sack was filled with feather charms. They're fashioned to serve as talismans for safe travel, and are made from flight feathers that the Hanu molt naturally over time.
TEXT_BANPEL102_05200_YUBLI_000_014: In case you were curious, this time the sack was filled with shawls, made from the same breathable fabric worn by the Hanu. They're quite fashionable, if you ask me!
TEXT_BANPEL102_05200_YUBLI_000_015: Thank you again for your help. If past experience is anything to go by, these will soon sell out as well, so I'd appreciate any time you can spare for these delivery runs!
TEXT_BANPEL103_05201_YUBLI_000_000: It's heartening to see Dock Poga so vibrant and bustling, but the increased traffic has drawn some...unwanted visitors.
TEXT_BANPEL103_05201_YUBLI_000_001: We're facing an infestation of u'outs. If we're to protect our customers from those roving seedkin, we'll need to routinely thin their numbers...
TEXT_BANPEL103_05201_YUBLI_000_002: I'd appreciate the assistance of our special advisor in this matter! Sightings have been reported in the Stride of the Sun. Please survey the area and deal with any u'outs that emerge!
TEXT_BANPEL103_05201_YUBLI_000_004: Thank you for dealing with the seedkin. For the time being, our customers need not fear their predations.
TEXT_BANPEL103_05201_YUBLI_000_005: In fact, we've just taken delivery of an extract known to ward off u'outs and their ilk. I plan to spread the repellent in the area as an additional precaution.
TEXT_BANPEL103_05201_YUBLI_000_006: That said, such measures are by no means permanent. When the creatures return, I hope I can count on your help again!
TEXT_BANPEL104_05202_YUBLI_000_000: It is heartening to see our staff taking to their work with such aplomb. Nonetheless, I'm concerned as to whether the locals are coping with the change.
TEXT_BANPEL104_05202_YUBLI_000_001: After all, the Turali Travel Agency is the nation's first homegrown tourist enterprise. I'm sure there are those who have their misgivings, no matter how open-minded they appear.
TEXT_BANPEL104_05202_YUBLI_000_002: I don't suppose you'd be willing to inquire on my behalf? There's a Hanu priest in Kozanuakiy I'd like you to speak with. I wish to hear his opinion about our enterprise.
TEXT_BANPEL104_05202_KOZANUAKIYHANUHANU0: Hello there. How can I be of assistance?
You seek my thoughts on the matter of tourism? When Liplu initially outlined her plans, it struck me as a wonderful experiment, so to speak.
But as with all experiments, the excitement comes with a degree of anxiety. What kind of visitors can we expect? How will the community weather the change? Such are our concerns.
Tourism? I had my misgivings, but given recent developments, I'm glad to have kept an open mind.

In fact, we welcomed our first sightseer just the other day. They were fascinated by our custom of Ihih'hana, and pledged to return during festival season, that they might witness it with their own eyes.
My thoughts on tourism? A wonderful endeavor!

I cherish the conversations I'm able to have with visitors. I'm just as delighted to hear about their culture and customs as I am to share my own. In fact, all of this has made me keen to do some sightseeing myself.
I want to do all I can to ensure visitors enjoy their time with us. If that contributes to the success of Liplu and her associates, all the better.
TEXT_BANPEL104_05202_YUBLI_000_015: Welcome back. What did you glean from the priest?
TEXT_BANPEL104_05202_YUBLI_000_016: Ah, so he has his concerns about the type of travelers who might visit the region. In that case, we ought to let the Hanu know we thoroughly screen customers as part of our booking process. That should help dispel any misgivings.
TEXT_BANPEL104_05202_YUBLI_000_017: That sounds like a meaningful exchange. It's encouraging to hear of success stories like this.
TEXT_BANPEL104_05202_YUBLI_000_018: Marvelous! It sounds like the priest has been thoroughly enjoying the influx of visitors! We couldn't have wished for a better outcome.
TEXT_BANPEL104_05202_YUBLI_000_019: Either way, we must make sure the Hanu can reflect back and be thankful they supported us from the outset. I hope you continue to do your part too!
TEXT_BANPEL105_05203_YUBLI_000_000: Would you be willing to spend some time with the alpacas? The fuzzy creatures need extra-special care in the heat and humidity, and I was hoping you'd oblige.
TEXT_BANPEL105_05203_YUBLI_000_001: To maintain the herd in peak condition, the peddlers periodically treat them with insect repellent. The recipe itself is courtesy of the Hanuhanu.
TEXT_BANPEL105_05203_YUBLI_000_002: I'll give you enough vials of repellent to get the job done. Drop by the enclosure and sprinkle a few drops on each alpaca's back. That's all there is to it!
TEXT_BANPEL105_05203_SYSTEM_000_005: The alpaca murmurs contentedly. With its lustrous coat gleaming, the creature looks ready to charge around in delight.
TEXT_BANPEL105_05203_ALPACAHANUHANU05203: Easy girl, easy! They're just trying to keep you healthy!
TEXT_BANPEL105_05203_SYSTEM_000_007: You hear the creature breathing softly. It seems completely at ease.
TEXT_BANPEL105_05203_SYSTEM_000_009: You must have surprised the alpaca while it was drinking. Fortunately, it appears unoffended by the intrusion.
TEXT_BANPEL105_05203_YUBLI_000_010: Thank you for handling that. How are the alpacas faring?
TEXT_BANPEL105_05203_YUBLI_000_011: I see, I see... It always surprises me how creatures in the same herd can behave so differently. We'll have to make sure we cater to their individual temperaments!
TEXT_BANPEL105_05203_YUBLI_000_012: The Hanu use the same repellent on their younglings. It's about as pungent as you'd expect for something that wards off the region's pests, but it's perfectly harmless.
TEXT_BANPEL105_05203_YUBLI_000_013: The Turali Travel Agency relies as much on the alpacas as any other member of staff. They're just as deserving of the finest care!
TEXT_BANPEL106_05204_YUBLI_000_000: We receive regular alpaca feed shipments from Urqopacha by way of the capital. We're due a delivery, but the Pelu in charge is nowhere to be seen...
TEXT_BANPEL106_05204_YUBLI_000_001: He's a reliable fellow, so I don't suppose for a moment that he's just abandoned the cargo. Would you mind going to see what the problem is? Knowing the usual delivery schedule, I imagine he's somewhere nearby.
TEXT_BANPEL106_05204_YUBLI_000_002: We're due another shipment of feed, but as usual, it's proving difficult to transport without the aid of the alpacas...
TEXT_BANPEL106_05204_YUBLI_000_003: I'd be grateful if you could find the courier and carry the feed back to the alpaca enclosure.
TEXT_BANPEL106_05204_HARDWORKER05204_000: <pant> <pant> Talk about backbreaking labor─this load is far too heavy for me! Still, I can't let the alpacas down!
Ah, you look like you've carried a crate or two in your time! Would you be willing to help?
<pant> <wheeze> Ah, y-you're the one who lent a hand last time! I'd be grateful for your help again!
Take that wooden crate and deliver it to the alpaca handler. Anything to lighten the load is appreciated! I'll be right along, just as soon as I've...<wheeze>...caught my breath.
If you'd kindly take that wooden crate over to the alpaca handler...<wheeze>...I'd be eternally grateful! I just need to rest a while longer...
TEXT_BANPEL106_05204_SYSTEM_000_010: Deliver the wooden crate to the alpaca handler in Dock Poga before the time runs out.
TEXT_BANPEL106_05204_SYSTEM_000_011: You will have ninety seconds to complete the task. Should you fail, return to the starting location and begin anew.
TEXT_BANPEL106_05204_SYSTEM_000_012: Be wary of attacks from enemies, which will sap your strength.
TEXT_BANPEL106_05204_ALPACAMANAGER05204_: The shipment ought to be here by now...
TEXT_BANPEL106_05204_SYSTEM_000_014: Collect the conscientious courier's wooden crate by the Stride of the Sun and deliver it to the alpaca handler.
TEXT_BANPEL106_05204_ALPACAMANAGER05204_: Ah, that must be part of the order... Thanks for the help!
You did well to manage. I swear those crates weigh as much as a fully grown punutiy! They're full of special feed for the alpacas─enriched with succulent highland corn.
Even when they get tired or sick and lose their appetite, we mix in a handful of the good stuff and they soon perk up!

Honestly, one whiff is all it takes to distract them. So much so that they simply refuse to carry the feed and just stand there on the spot, kicking up a fuss. Hence why it falls to us to handle the cargo.
Great to see you pitching in to help again! Much obliged. This'll keep us going for the time being.
I tell you, transporting the feed is quite the task. We're so used to the alpacas handling the heavy loads. When it falls to us to carry the odd crate or two, it's easy to get overwhelmed.
Anyway, I appreciate the assistance. Feel free to let Yubli know the shipment has arrived.
I'll have to wait for the rest to arrive. In the meantime, would you mind letting Yubli know the shipment has been taken care of?
TEXT_BANPEL106_05204_YUBLI_000_023: Thanks for helping with the delivery. The alpacas will be delighted their favorite treat is back in stock!
TEXT_BANPEL106_05204_YUBLI_000_024: We've tried all manner of tricks to get them hauling the feed, but nothing works. Even with an airtight seal on the crates, they soon sniff out the corn and refuse to comply!
TEXT_BANPEL106_05204_YUBLI_000_025: Suffice it to say we'll have need of your crate-carrying services again. Until next time!
TEXT_BANPEL107_05205_YUBLI_000_000: One of our newly recruited tour guides wishes to rehearse before beginning their duties in earnest.
TEXT_BANPEL107_05205_YUBLI_000_001: When it comes to local knowledge, you couldn't ask for a better guide. Alas, they struggle with public speaking... Perhaps you could offer some advice and encouragement?
TEXT_BANPEL107_05205_YUBLI_000_002: Our guide-in-training seeks further practice. Can I count on your help again?
TEXT_BANPEL107_05205_GUIDETRAINING05205_: Y-You're the agency's special advisor! Did Yubli send you to help me practice? F-Forgive me if I'm a little nervous...
H-Hello, Special Advisor! Thanks for helping out again. I shall do my best!
A-Ahem. Let's see. Ah, yes, the waterway right in front of us... It's a tributary of Miyakabek'zu.
The river itself splits into several waterfalls... As a matter of fact, Cave Kikitola was formed over millennia by three of those very same falls. At least, that's what people say.
Each of the waterfalls has a name, and well, the names are quite...vivid.
For example, Xopek'...ah, no, that's not it! S-Sorry!
Xopik' means “necksblood,” and Xo'onu means “armsblood.” Then there's Xodune, which means “legsblood.” Each name relates to, er, you see, the blood spilled, as it were, by our forebears...
TEXT_BANPEL107_05205_A1_000_001: Try to maintain your rhythm until the very end!
TEXT_BANPEL107_05205_A1_000_002: No need to be so nervous!
TEXT_BANPEL107_05205_GUIDETRAINING05205_: Aaah! I'm so sorry! I let my nerves get the better of me...
Th-Thank you! I just need to stay calm and let the trivia do the talking...
Where was I? Ah, yes. Back when the giants still ruled Kozama'uka, Hanu who refused to submit to their tyranny were put to death and dismembered.

Their mutilated bodies were thrown into the river, and from there flowed piecemeal over the separate waterfalls... Although the falls are a beautiful sight to behold, they also remind we Hanu of the sacrifices made by those before us.
And that concludes my introduction to the three falls of Cave Kikitola. Thank you for listening!
Ahem. On this tour, I shall be explaining all about Ok'hanu─one of our villages.

The settlement is surrounded by paddies, and the reeds grown there have been our livelihood for generations. The crop has many different uses. Not only are the reeds edible, but artisans use them in all manner of crafts.
I personally recommend the dolls they make with reed offcuts. They're especially popular with young Hanu! Ah, I suppose some of our guests won't be interested in toys...
TEXT_BANPEL107_05205_A2_000_001: Try to really sell your recommendation!
TEXT_BANPEL107_05205_A2_000_002: You're doing just fine. Keep it up!
TEXT_BANPEL107_05205_A2_000_003: You could prepare another tidbit to share with customers uninterested in dolls.
TEXT_BANPEL107_05205_GUIDETRAINING05205_: M-My apologies! I was feeling so anxious...
Th-Thank you! Of course, there are plenty of keepsakes I can recommend besides!
Er, let's see... If you wish to make a purchase, please head to the northern side of the aetheryte plaza. There are plenty of stalls to browse, so I'm sure you'll find something to suit your tastes.
And for the anglers, there's no shortage of fishing supplies. As a matter of fact, we even offer a special fishing tour for those looking to make the most of the local waterways.
Thank you for listening. I hope you've learnt a great deal about Ok'hanu!
I stumbled over my words here and there, but as long as I keep practicing, I know I can succeed! Thank you for your help!
I know I'm capable of being an excellent guide─I just need to build up my confidence. Thanks again for all your insight!
TEXT_BANPEL107_05205_YUBLI_000_060: Sounds like our guide-in-training benefited from the rehearsal. With a little more practice, they'll soon be ready for their first customer.
TEXT_BANPEL107_05205_YUBLI_000_061: Thank you. Perhaps you can offer some more advice the next time you find yourself at a loose end!
TEXT_BANPEL108_05206_YUBLI_000_001: This is quite the quandary. One of our guests came to tell me they'd lost something rather important while out walking. The only problem is, the rest of our staff are currently occupied...
TEXT_BANPEL108_05206_YUBLI_000_002: I'm afraid this might be a job for the Turali Travel Agency's agile advisor. Could I trouble you to locate the lost article? We ought to act quickly, before it gets stolen or washed downstream.
TEXT_BANPEL108_05206_YUBLI_000_003: Please be on the lookout for a canvas bag. The customer seems to think they lost it at Breath Between.
TEXT_BANPEL108_05206_SYSTEM_000_010: A bag of sorts sits abandoned on the boardwalk. A sweet, fruit-like smell emanates from inside.
TEXT_BANPEL108_05206_SYSTEM_000_011: A compact satchel rests forlornly on the boardwalk. A ledger titled Notes on the Flora and Fauna of Kozama'uka is peeking out from within.
TEXT_BANPEL108_05206_SYSTEM_000_012: A small pouch lies seemingly forgotten on the boardwalk. Its weighty heft suggests a cargo of coins.
TEXT_BANPEL108_05206_SYSTEM_000_013: You carefully collect the lost property. Return to Dock Poga and deliver the bag to Yubli.
TEXT_BANPEL108_05206_YUBLI_000_020: , welcome back! Did you locate the lost property?
TEXT_BANPEL108_05206_YUBLI_000_021: Thank you! This fits the customer's description exactly. I shall see it gets returned to the owner posthaste.
TEXT_BANPEL108_05206_YUBLI_000_022: In case you were wondering, this belongs to one of our Mamool Ja guests. They were carrying a bunch of rare, glowing bananas native to Mamook. It's lucky you found it before some hungry fiend gobbled up the bag whole!
TEXT_BANPEL108_05206_YUBLI_000_023: In case you were wondering, this satchel and the ledger it contains belong to an arcanist. They mentioned that they've been roaming the land, recording their observations on plant and animal life. No doubt the notes within represent years of work. They'll be delighted to get this back.
TEXT_BANPEL108_05206_YUBLI_000_024: In case you were wondering, a visitor from Shaaloani was using this to store all the pel they'd put aside for their trip. They were quite flustered when they realized the bag was missing.
TEXT_BANPEL108_05206_YUBLI_000_025: Thanks again for finding the lost property. It would be such a shame if a misplaced bag marred a guest's memory of their time in Kozama'uka!
TEXT_BANPEL109_05207_YUBLI_000_001: I've just had word that a pair of our guides encountered a fiend during their tour! Thankfully, they were able to dispatch the foul creature and keep their customer safe.
TEXT_BANPEL109_05207_YUBLI_000_002: Clearly, our policy of assigning two guides per guest was a wise call. Not to mention the investment made in training facilities and so forth. Still, the guides are keen to seek your counsel. Can I trouble you to speak with them?
TEXT_BANPEL109_05207_YUBLI_000_003: I believe they headed south from Ok'hanu. Please see how they're faring.
TEXT_BANPEL109_05207_HANUHANU05207_000_0: Ah, thank you for coming! This toucalibri came flying at us, but as you can see, it was no match for the two of us. Being able to support one another during the incident was remarkably reassuring!
We're concerned about our guest, though. He's been a little out of sorts since the attack, muttering about this and that. I fear the incident has upset him.
