Would you be willing to speak with him and find out what the matter is? The two of us will stand guard while you do.
I'm not quite sure what's wrong with our guest. Perhaps he's in shock after the incident... Could you talk to him for us?
TEXT_BANPEL109_05207_TOURIST05207_000_02: Kozama'uka is practically bursting at the seams with life! That fiend rushed right at us with such vigor! And the guides─so gallant! What a thrill!
Ah, the Hanuhanu fellows are concerned about my well-being? My apologies. I got so caught up in the sheer magnificence of this place!
I was startled when that bird came screeching out of the trees, but the guides soon dealt with the creature. Seeing them command the wind with such poise was a sight to behold!
TEXT_BANPEL109_05207_HANUHANU05207_000_0: Ah, I'm glad you weren't frightened by the ordeal.
TEXT_BANPEL109_05207_HANUHANU05207_100_0: Thank you for intervening, Special Advisor.
TEXT_BANPEL109_05207_HANUHANU05207_000_0: It seems like the area is safe enough for us to resume the tour. Perhaps you'd care to tell us how the experience struck you when we do?
TEXT_BANPEL109_05207_TOURIST05207_000_02: I feel so alive! There's nothing like a sightseeing trip to really put you in the heart of it all!
TEXT_BANPEL109_05207_HANUHANU05207_000_0: I see! It's a relief to see you weren't disturbed by the encounter.
TEXT_BANPEL109_05207_HANUHANU05207_100_0: And thank you, Special Advisor, for lending a hand.
TEXT_BANPEL109_05207_HANUHANU05207_000_0: We avoid the most dangerous routes, but that doesn't entirely negate the possibility of encountering a fiend or two. We'll do our best to remain vigilant, but, for whatever reason, we always seem to run into trouble with you...
TEXT_BANPEL109_05207_YUBLI_000_030: It seems the customer was enthralled by the ordeal, not to mention the Hanu's command of wind magicks. I daresay he won't soon forget that experience! Nonetheless, we might need to reconsider our safety precautions...
TEXT_BANPEL109_05207_YUBLI_000_031: Honestly, I'm surprised the customer responded so positively. I suppose those with a desire to travel are simply brave and inquisitive by nature, and that gentleman a good deal more than most!
TEXT_BANPEL109_05207_YUBLI_000_032: Having you on hand to deal with the problems we can't resolve ourselves is reassuring. You have my thanks as always.
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_YUBLI_000_001: Customer feedback is essential for any business seeking to improve its services. If you have the time to spare, I'd ask that you assist me in conducting a survey among our guests!
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_YUBLI_000_002: I wish to know which aspects of the region and its culture they're interested in, and how they feel about their experience so far.
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_YUBLI_000_003: Please seek out three guests in Ok'hanu. By sending along you, our special advisor, my hope is that they'll provide frank, unfettered feedback!
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_TONAWAETAN05208_000: A guest survey about the appeal of Hanuhanu culture? Hmmm. I'm an architect by trade, so I often end up viewing the world from a professional standpoint...

I'm certainly fascinated by the local construction methods. Of course, there are plenty of Hanuhanu living in the capital, but it's remarkable to see the differences between the structures here and the Hanu-built houses in Tuliyollal.

I must say I'm awed by the expressiveness of reeds as a building material. From the houses to the festival floats and effigies, the designs have such wonderful personality. And when those yellow stems catch the spray from the river, they glint like gemstones in the sunlight. It's such a beautiful sight.
I definitely found myself enthralled by the House of Winds High! Ok'hanu has its charms, but to see architecture and the natural world in such harmony is a rare treat indeed.
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_SYSTEM_000_014: You jot down the red-haired Tonawawta's thoughts.
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_TONAWAETAN05208_000: Wherever I go, examining the local architecture is one of my favorite pastimes!
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_HANUHANU05208A_000_: My guest certainly knows a thing or two about architecture. As a matter of fact, I'm learning a great deal from him!
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_SHETONA05208_000_01: You want to hear about my experience so far? I was about to go and get something to eat, but I'm happy to stop and chat for a moment.

I've enjoyed learning about the Hanuhanu and their relationship with reeds. I was surprised to find out that the crop is also a staple part of the local diet. I tried some myself─so crisp and delicious!

Well, for starters, the rivers here are teeming with life. And with all the locally made rods and whatnot for sale, it's an angler's paradise! Hehe, I can't wait to sample some fresh fish dishes later!
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_SHETONA05208_000_02: I visited Uyuypoga the other day. Apparently, the name means “fruit trees” in the local tongue. The Hanuhanu say that the forest's abundance flows from Kixaihih's shrine. I definitely sensed that power while I was there!
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_SYSTEM_000_021: You jot down the silver-haired Shetona's thoughts.
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_SHETONA05208_000_02: It's been tough deciding what to eat. Everything looks so mouthwatering!
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_XBRAAL05208_000_023: My take on the local culture? Not sure I've got anything all that insightful to say─I'm just here out of curiosity. Still, I'm happy to share my thoughts.
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_XBRAAL05208_000_024: That float over there─the Hanu use that for Ihih'hana, right? I only caught a glimpse of them rehearsing during the tour, but it's clear the festival means a lot to them.
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_XBRAAL05208_000_025: The Fields of Gold were a real spectacle. I get the impression reeds are a fundamental part of daily life in the region. Either way, seeing the crop gently swaying in the breeze is something I won't soon forget.
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_XBRAAL05208_000_026: I have a newfound respect for the Hanuhanu and their wind magicks. They may be bulky, but watching them leap down from on high and land without so much as a whisper was simply marvelous!
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_SYSTEM_000_027: You jot down the cobalt-haired Xbr'aal's thoughts.
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_XBRAAL05208_000_028: One thing's for certain, there's far too much to see in a single trip!
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_HANUHANU05208B_000_: Seeing our guests delight at what we consider commonplace is a real joy!
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_YUBLI_000_040: Welcome back. How did the survey go?
TEXT_BANPEL110_05208_YUBLI_000_042: These responses will be crucial in formulating our ongoing plans as a business. You have my sincere thanks!
TEXT_BANPEL111_05209_YUBLI_000_001: On one of our recent tours around the Fields of Gold, several guests asked whether they could help with work in the paddies. This got me thinking─perhaps we could offer such an experience as part of a bespoke new tour!
TEXT_BANPEL111_05209_YUBLI_000_002: I thought it fitting that our special advisor be among the first to take part! I'd love to hear your honest thoughts.
TEXT_BANPEL111_05209_YUBLI_000_003: The “Fields of Gold Farming Taster Tour” is proving wildly popular. It seems visitors enjoy the sense of connection with the local environment and Hanu way of life the experience provides. It's as smooth a start as I could have hoped for.
TEXT_BANPEL111_05209_YUBLI_000_004: Nonetheless, there is always room for improvement. Despite having already experienced the tour, I daresay you'll have some more useful insights.
TEXT_BANPEL111_05209_YUBLI_000_005: Speak with the paddy tour guide in the Fields of Gold. They'll provide you with more details!
TEXT_BANPEL111_05209_HANUHANU05209_000_0: If it isn't the special advisor! Welcome! It's a pleasure to have you taking part. Let's make a start, shall we?
Reeds thrive in these paddies, but they still require regular tending.

One thing we look out for is when reeds sprout too close to one another, as they tend to grow slender and stunted. To ensure a healthy crop, we routinely thin the reeds until they're ready to harvest.
The slender reeds we pluck out during the process are used by artisans to make all manner of goods. Which is why we'll be offering guests on this farming taster a discount on reed handicrafts!
TEXT_BANPEL111_05209_TOURIST05209_000_01: Haha, now that's a clever ploy! I'm just happy to get a hands-on experience, but once I'm finished in the fields, I might have to browse a few of the stalls back in the village!
I wanted to see how the reeds I tended to last time were faring, so I signed up again!
TEXT_BANPEL111_05209_HANUHANU05209_000_0: That's wonderful to hear! It's a pleasure to share our customs with visitors, whether it be festivals or farming techniques!
You'll soon spot the overcrowded clusters that need tending to. All you need to do is pull out the stunted plants!
TEXT_BANPEL111_05209_TOURIST05209_000_01: I'm an assistant grower at Seafoam Fields in Tuliyollal. I thought I'd come and see Hanu horticulture firsthand. Some of their methods might prove useful on our plots back home.
TEXT_BANPEL111_05209_HANUHANU05209_000_0: As I said, it's easy to spot the overcrowded clusters. If you'd be so kind as to pull out the excess plants, that would be much appreciated!
Wonderful! I couldn't have done a better job myself. Feel free to leave the reeds you uprooted on the ground. My associates and I will come and gather them up later.
TEXT_BANPEL111_05209_TOURIST05209_000_03: Whew, I'm starting to feel it in my back...but that's all part of the fun. I think I'll keep going for a while longer.
TEXT_BANPEL111_05209_HANUHANU05209_000_0: Thanks for your help. Usually we spread our rich blend of natural fertilizer after thinning out the reeds, but you can leave that step to us.
TEXT_BANPEL111_05209_TOURIST05209_000_03: A little back pain won't stop me. Not while there's work to be done!
TEXT_BANPEL111_05209_YUBLI_000_040: There you are, . It seems like you enjoyed your time in the fields!
TEXT_BANPEL111_05209_YUBLI_000_041: Thinning reeds may be a mundane task, but it's essential to ensure the health of the crop. As long as we receive positive feedback from those taking part, we'll look to offer the experience again during the next harvest season.
TEXT_BANPEL111_05209_YUBLI_000_042: Some visitors have signed up for the experience multiple times. They seem to enjoy seeing the reeds they tended to steadily flourish.
TEXT_BANPEL111_05209_YUBLI_000_043: Ultimately, I think the Hanu will appreciate having a regular stream of helpers in their reed fields. I hope you consider taking part again soon!
TEXT_BANPEL112_05210_YUBLI_000_000: As you well know, the Turali Travel Agency has put in place measures to deal the ever-present threat of fiends. Chief among them is training our guides in the art of visitor protection.
TEXT_BANPEL112_05210_YUBLI_000_001: As it so happens, one of our guides-in-training is eager to study your martial prowess firsthand.
TEXT_BANPEL112_05210_YUBLI_000_002: The young Hanu is waiting by the Stride of the Sun. I'd ask that you go and speak with them.
TEXT_BANPEL112_05210_YUBLI_000_010: The guide-in-training you so kindly assisted has asked to see your fighting methods once again.
TEXT_BANPEL112_05210_YUBLI_000_011: They're waiting near the Stride of the Sun, just like last time. Seek them out and offer what help you can.
TEXT_BANPEL112_05210_HANUHANU05210_000_0: Ah, you must be the travel agency's special advisor! Thank you so much for coming. I can't wait to see your skills in action!
TEXT_BANPEL112_05210_HANUHANU05210_100_0: It's a privilege to learn from the fearless warrior who helped slay Valigarmanda. I'll be sure to take plenty of notes!
TEXT_BANPEL112_05210_HANUHANU05210_200_0: Special Advisor! Thank you for coming. I learnt a great deal from you last time, but I still have a long way to go. I hope you don't mind me requesting your tutelage again.
TEXT_BANPEL112_05210_HANUHANU05210_000_0: I left a hunk of meat in the underbrush to try and lure out some fiends. If you could deal with any creatures that appear, I shall watch at a safe distance and study your technique.
It was all over so quickly! I couldn't take note of everything, but the way you anticipated the enemy's movements and positioned yourself during the fight was very instructive!
I hope to take what I've learned here and apply it to my training─the safety of my future customers depends on it!
A truly impressive display! I doubt I'll be able to mimic every technique you used, but I'm getting a better sense of how to use space during a fight!
I'll be incorporating everything I've learned into my daily training. Thanks again!
TEXT_BANPEL112_05210_YUBLI_000_050: When it comes to fending off fiends, I can't think of a better reference point than your considerable skills. I'm sure our young guide-in-training gained much from the experience!
TEXT_BANPEL112_05210_YUBLI_000_051: Guides bear a heavy burden of responsibility. Not only must they keep guests safe, they have to ensure their tours are enjoyable and informative. Every onze of training is vital!
TEXT_BANPEL112_05210_YUBLI_000_052: We Pelu may be ill-suited to combat, but seeing our guides persevere with their training is inspiring. I'll endeavor to keep contributing to the agency in my own way! As ever, your help is greatly appreciated.
TEXT_BANPEL113_05211_YUBLI_000_000: As part of our ongoing efforts to ward off fiends from the area, we've been using a powerful incense. Stocks have dwindled, however, and we'll soon need to craft a new batch.
TEXT_BANPEL113_05211_YUBLI_000_001: Unfortunately, we don't have the necessary ingredients to hand. We create the incense using the nectar of a particularly fragrant flower. The only trouble is it grows in a somewhat perilous location─there aren't many we can ask to brave the trip.
TEXT_BANPEL113_05211_YUBLI_000_002: But I don't imagine our special advisor will have much trouble! Here, take these extractors. Using them, you should be able to harvest the nectar without harming the foliage. Head for Xodune─the plant is known to bloom in the surrounding area.
TEXT_BANPEL113_05211_YUBLI_000_010: Welcome back. Were you able to harvest sufficient nectar?
TEXT_BANPEL113_05211_YUBLI_000_020: I recognize that scent! Excellent work, .
TEXT_BANPEL113_05211_YUBLI_000_021: It was the Hanuhanu who shared the repellent recipe with us. Apparently, it's especially effective at warding off fiends native to Kozama'uka.
TEXT_BANPEL113_05211_YUBLI_000_022: Thanks to that powerful scent, fiend encounters are down, and customer satisfaction is up! It's also alleviated some of the burden placed on our guides-turned-protectors. Anyway, we soon get through the stuff, so I'll let you know the next time our stocks need replenishing!
TEXT_BANPEL114_05212_YUBLI_000_000: The reconstruction of the Flight of We Wingless is ongoing, yet a surprisingly large number of visitors express interest in seeing the wreckage. As such, we've been busy organizing tours to accommodate them.
TEXT_BANPEL114_05212_YUBLI_000_001: The main problem we're facing, however, is navigating the scattered pieces of broken lumber. Aside from how untidy it looks, we cannot have our guests stumbling over and possibly injuring themselves on errant planks of jagged wood.
TEXT_BANPEL114_05212_YUBLI_000_002: But I think I've hit upon an elegant solution. Might I trouble you to head over there and retrieve three of the offending obstacles? All will be explained upon your return.
TEXT_BANPEL114_05212_YUBLI_000_010: You recall the souvenirs we were making out of the wreckage of the Flight of We Wingless? Well, they've proven to be unexpectedly popular.
TEXT_BANPEL114_05212_YUBLI_000_011: Would you mind heading back to the stairs and picking up a few more pieces of scrap lumber?
TEXT_BANPEL114_05212_YUBLI_000_020: Do you have the scrap lumber? Let's see what we have to work with!
TEXT_BANPEL114_05212_YUBLI_000_030: Hmmm... These are actually in fairly good condition, all things considered. With a little work, we should be able to make use of them.
TEXT_BANPEL114_05212_YUBLI_000_031: Upon visiting the Flight of We Wingless, our guests have been asking for something to remember the experience by. That's where I had the idea of fashioning the salvaged lumber into decorative boards.
TEXT_BANPEL114_05212_YUBLI_000_032: Once we've sanded off the rough edges, we'll brand the planks with the travel agency's emblem and sell them as souvenirs.
TEXT_BANPEL114_05212_YUBLI_100_032: Not only will this help to clean up the area around the stairs, but it will also provide the tangible memento our visitors have been asking for. I think the proposal has potential...but we shall see how the sales go.
TEXT_BANPEL114_05212_YUBLI_000_033: Ah, I should mention that we spoke to Tseeya and secured permission from the Wing of Reflection to repurpose the scrap lumber. The wood did once belong to a national structure, after all, and part of the profits will be donated towards the stairs' restoration.
TEXT_BANPEL114_05212_YUBLI_000_034: Such details aside, I must also extend to you our continued gratitude. We greatly appreciate your assistance with every facet of our enterprise, no matter how trivial it might seem.
TEXT_BANPEL114_05212_YUBLI_000_040: My thanks. I'll send these over to Shiplu, our mender, and have her whip up some more decorative boards.
TEXT_BANPEL114_05212_YUBLI_000_041: The more souvenirs we can sell, the quicker the Flight of We Wingless will be restored to its former glory!
TEXT_BANPEL115_05213_YUBLI_000_001: , I need your help: we've sighted an aggressive apollyon stalking the trails.
TEXT_BANPEL115_05213_YUBLI_000_002: Such creatures usually stick to the wilds, but occasionally one will stray closer to a village in search of prey. We must put these opportunistic predators down with decisive force, and impress upon others that our territories are off-limits.
TEXT_BANPEL115_05213_YUBLI_000_003: Our latest report has it roaming somewhere near the Glostfired Bank. We would greatly appreciate you culling this threat─preferably before it has the chance to harm anyone.
TEXT_BANPEL115_05213_YUBLI_000_004: Welcome back! You squashed that nasty vilekin, I take it?
TEXT_BANPEL115_05213_YUBLI_000_005: The tour guides have managed to protect our visitors from any aggressive creatures encountered on the road thus far, but an apex predator like that is nothing to trifle with. Better for both guide and the guided to not encounter them at all, I say!
TEXT_BANPEL115_05213_YUBLI_000_006: We're devising our own ways for keeping away unwelcome wildlife, yet demonstrating that the territory belongs to a fierce protector remains the most effective method. We are fortunate to have you and your swift intervention!
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_YUBLI_000_001: Hello, . Can I interest you in a tour of upstream Kozama'uka?
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_YUBLI_000_0002: As it happens, the Moblin who volunteered to serve as one of our upstream guides has requested the company of our special advisor. He'd like to use this opportunity to practice his presentation, and also share with you the story of his homeland.
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_YUBLI_000_003: The Moblin who volunteered to serve as one of our upstream guides has once more requested the company of our special advisor. Another chance to practice, as it were.
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_YUBLI_000_004: Should you find yourself in a cooperative mood, you'll find our Moblin guide by the Glostfired Bank. I hope you find the tour both educational and entertaining!
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_GUIDEA05214_000_010: Thank you for coming, Special Advisor. Mobbie will not waste your precious time, and launch straight into the lookytour!
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_GUIDEA05214_000_011: Many many yearmonths ago, the Moblins who made their homes here lived alongside the Yok Huy. Every handful of earthriches they gathered went to the giants. But then one day, the Yok Huy left, and only Moblins remained.
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_GUIDEA05214_000_012: Though free of their oppressors, Mobbies were bereft of providers and protectors. What to do, what to do!? So they took their bountiful resources and turned to the cleverhand races. The potpacts had begun!
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_GUIDEA05214_000_013: In the beginning, the Moblins grabsnatched artisans and forced them to craft. But when Gulool Ja Ja came, he taught us a better way. Since then, helphands ensure goodliving for the potsworn, and together they earn much jinglyshine!
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_GUIDEA05214_000_014: Mobbie has many tongueflaps yet to share, but let us save them for the next seeingsights stop. Sorry to keep you, but he needs someone to practice on!
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_GUIDEA05214_000_21: These are the Shoals of No Return, where languish the abandoned boats of those who failed in their search for the golden city. See how the current gushflows strong and wide!
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_GUIDEA05214_000_22: Kozama'uka is a land of abundant water. Meltwater rushfalls down from the blessed mountains of Urqopacha, making of our homeland a lush and fertile paradise.
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_GUIDEA05214_000_23: With rain also being plentiful, the rivers are prone to overflowing. But Mobbies are clever! We make our pothomes easy to closeseal, so flooding is hardly a problem.
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_GUIDEA05214_000_24: That same natural hazard, however, would have been why most seekers of the golden city turned back. Who wants to explore when every ruin and cave is floodfilled with water?
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_GUIDEA05214_000_25: Mobbie will avoid those places for the lookytour, of course. He'll stick to the safe places, the pretty places, and teachshow our customers the beauty of Kozama'uka.
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_GUIDEA05214_000_26: Thank you for helping Mobbie practice his tongueflaps. He still has queasyguts at the thought of guiding a group, but he feels much better about it now!
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_GUIDEA05214_000_031: Welcome to Many Fires! Once used as a base camp for the workers building the Flight of We Wingless, it eventually became a shortstop for weary travelers!
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_GUIDEA05214_000_032: Following Tuliyollal's foundation and Gulool Ja Ja's coronation, it was the Dawnservant who ordered the great stairs' construction. What began as a request from Kozama'uka's peoples soon became a national enterprise, and even the Yok Huy participated in the communal building effort.
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_GUIDEA05214_000_033: The project promised to enliven the region with much trade and traffic. Mobbie heard from Grandmobbie that neighbors came together in mutual thanksharing and joyspreading in a celebration that lasted three entire days!
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_GUIDEA05214_000_034: As predicted, the stairs brought new prosperity to Kozama'uka, but this goodliving ended when the storm smashdashed the structure to kindling...
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_GUIDEA05214_000_035: This is why we Moblins are grateful for the Turali Travel Agency and their lookytours for reinvigorating both upriver and down!
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_GUIDEA05214_000_036: Thank you for helping Mobbie practice his tongueflaps. He still has queasyguts at the thought of guiding a group, but he feels much better about it now!
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_YUBLI_000_040: Welcome back. By the thoughtful look on your face, it seems the tour was most enlightening!
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_YUBLI_000_041: We were fortunate indeed to have the Moblins offer their expertise on the upriver regions. After all, who is better versed in the area's history and landmarks than the local residents?
TEXT_BANPEL116_05214_YUBLI_000_042: The tours themselves will, of course, be accompanied by an armed escort so that no harm comes to our guides or our customers. We wish for this to be an enriching business opportunity for everyone involved.
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_YUBLI_000_000: Are you fond of punutiys, ? Many people are, it seems. After starting our new tours at Breath Between, customers have begun making requests to spend time with the beasts.
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_YUBLI_000_001: If I could enlist your services as special advisor once more, I'd like you to help answer these requests and gauge how well our visitors respond.
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_YUBLI_000_002: What say you, ? Ready to ride a punutiy again? It's become a popular duty among the agency workers, with everyone wanting to take a turn, but you seem to have a natural affinity for the creatures.
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_YUBLI_000_003: When you're ready, you'll find Miisul Ja waiting by the river with the particulars of your task. I shall see you upon your return!
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_MIISULJA_000_004: You'll be our rider today, will you? Good, good, glad to have you aboard! I'll need you to hop straight on the punutiy and take yourself over to where our customers are enjoying the marvels of Breath Between.
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_MIISULJA_000_005: When you find them, have your mount show off her “bosom brook” move. The people will love it, and the punutiy gets to enjoy some much-needed water-play!
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_MIISULJA_000_006: Once you've finished entertaining the visitors, feel free to hop off and report directly to Yubli. Don't worry─the punutiys are trained to come back here to me.
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_MIISULJA_000_007: If you're looking for your punutiy, she wandered back a little while ago. Ready to head off again?
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_TOURISTA05215_000_0: This is so exciting. I just love those pudgy punutiy cheeks!
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_SYSTEM_000_009: Speak with Miisul Ja at Dock Poga to mount a punutiy and perform Bosom Brook for the waiting tourists.
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_TOURISTA05215_000_0: Oh, would you look at that! So powerful, so graceful...and the way the water sparkles is so pretty!
It was worth taking the tour just for this. The punutiy seems to be enjoying herself, too! She must like working with you!
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_TOURISTB05215_000_0: I had them bring me to Breath Between for a spot of fishing, but I was told we could see punutiys here as well. That's an experience I don't mind waiting for.
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_SYSTEM_000_013: Speak with Miisul Ja at Dock Poga to mount a punutiy and perform Bosom Brook for the waiting tourists.
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_TOURISTB05215_000_0: Well, I never! Never knew a punutiy could move like that, I mean. Such a clever creature...
Even if I don't catch anything today, I'll be going home happy after that performance!
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_TOURISTC05215_000_0: The guide told me this is the spot to be if we want to see a punutiy...
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_SYSTEM_000_017: Speak with Miisul Ja at Dock Poga to mount a punutiy and perform Bosom Brook for the waiting tourists.
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_TOURISTC05215_000_0: I can hardly wait to share the tale of this magnificent beast with my kin back home. Thank you so much.
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_YUBLI_000_025: Welcome back, . The guides tell me our customers were well pleased with your punutiy performance!
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_YUBLI_000_026: According to Miisul Ja, punutiys are highly social creatures. They're known to put on these displays of water-based magicks as a sign of affection for those they consider friends.
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_YUBLI_000_027: The behavior is also said to help lower anxiety and promote the animals' well-being. Our new idea also provides the punutiys with much-needed exercise, and as such, Miisul Ja is only too happy to have us continue with the practice.
TEXT_BANPEL117_05215_YUBLI_000_028: I hope you can find the time to help us again─for the sake of both our customers and the punutiys!
TEXT_BANPEL118_05216_YUBLI_000_000: The residents of Earthenshire have shared a worrying report with us. It seems an Urqopacha morbol has been spotted slithering around the area, possibly fled here since Valigarmanda's reawakening.
TEXT_BANPEL118_05216_YUBLI_000_001: That particular breed is known to belch volcanic gases─or something close to it. Should it be allowed to roam unchecked, I can only imagine the disruption it would cause to our tour routes.
TEXT_BANPEL118_05216_YUBLI_000_002: Please, I ask that you travel to Miyakabek'zoma and slay this malodorous monster. The pristine air of Kozama'uka must be preserved!
TEXT_BANPEL118_05216_YUBLI_000_005: You've dispatched that mountain morbol, then? This will come as a welcome relief to the area's inhabitants─people and punutiy alike can breathe easy once more.
TEXT_BANPEL118_05216_YUBLI_000_006: The natural beauty of Kozama'uka is a national treasure and our industry's greatest asset. It is in the agency's best interest to heed the warning calls of our neighbors, and do all we can to keep that beauty unspoiled.
TEXT_BANPEL118_05216_YUBLI_000_007: Your assistance is most appreciated. We'll keep watch for further incursions, and may need your help again should other such pests rear their pestilent heads.
TEXT_BANPEL119_05217_YUBLI_000_000: Our precious punutiys are full of life, as always. Their newly acquired ability to fly has them in high spirits, if you'll excuse the jest, but their airborne jaunts do seem to leave them ravenous of appetite.
TEXT_BANPEL119_05217_YUBLI_000_001: They need meals of densely packed nutrients to keep them aloft, and Chekochuk, our Moblin cook acquaintance, has promised to prepare a suitable repast. Would you mind heading over to Many Fires to collect the punutiy's feed?
TEXT_BANPEL119_05217_CHEKOCHUK_000_002: Pfffkohhh... Lowlander is helphanding for the lookytour business? Chekochuk was expecting you!
TEXT_BANPEL119_05217_CHEKOCHUK_000_003: Chekochuk gathered many different foodstuffs and tried many different foodmixes, but his latest bellyfiller is sure to satisfy even the most hungrytummed punutiy!
TEXT_BANPEL119_05217_CHEKOCHUK_000_004: Quickly, now! Take this cookmobbie's offering and still those bellygrowls!
TEXT_BANPEL119_05217_YUBLI_000_007: The Moblin sounded quite confident in his creation, did he? Well, it certainly has some heft! We shall see how the punutiys fare on this new, nutrient-rich diet...
TEXT_BANPEL119_05217_YUBLI_000_008: The punutiys seem to absolutely adore this stuff. I really must pass on my regards to the chef...
TEXT_BANPEL119_05217_YUBLI_000_009: Thank you for going out of your way to make the delivery. We'll be ordering Chekochuk's feed on a regular schedule, so we'd appreciate any assistance you can provide with future shipments.
TEXT_BANPEL120_05218_YUBLI_000_000: . As our special advisor, I would like you to have the experience of feeding the punutiys.
TEXT_BANPEL120_05218_YUBLI_000_001: Aside from Miisul Ja, the chief beast handler, only a handful of other workers ever perform this vital task...
TEXT_BANPEL120_05218_YUBLI_100_001: But if we can train the creatures to eat calmly from anyone's hand, then I believe such an activity would make a fine addition to our sightseeing menu.
TEXT_BANPEL120_05218_YUBLI_000_002: I'd like you to take part in feeding the punutiys again. Our customers are flocking in now to try out the experience, but there's a certain animal who has taken quite a shine to you.
TEXT_BANPEL120_05218_YUBLI_000_003: Please head on over to the punutiy pen, and the Hanu keeper will guide you through the feeding process.
TEXT_BANPEL120_05218_FEEDINGHANUHANU_000: Ah, my assistant feeder has arrived! Come, come, don't be shy!
That right there is a cornflour treat we give to the punutiys in between regular feedings.
Now, the trick is not to hold it with the fingers, but to rest it on your palm. Hold the treat up in front of our hungry girl, and she'll happily gobble it down.
Just balance the treat on your open palm, bring it close, and the punutiy will do the rest!
TEXT_BANPEL120_05218_SYSTEM_000_010: The punutiy greedily inhales the cornflour treat. Her rounded face lights up with what can only be described as a look of bliss.
TEXT_BANPEL120_05218_FEEDINGHANUHANU_000: Aw, look how happy she is! Judging by that reaction, there should be no problem allowing our customers to experience feeding time.
What a happy punutiy! She really does seem to enjoy being fed by you!
Please head back to Yubli and let him know how well things went!
Please head back to Yubli and let him know how well things went!
TEXT_BANPEL120_05218_YUBLI_000_016: Thank you for helping with the chores. If the punutiys are happy, then I'm happy too.
TEXT_BANPEL120_05218_YUBLI_000_017: Still, you must have a way with animals to so easily win them over. We'll have to add you to the feeding roster on a more permanent basis!
TEXT_BANPEL121_05219_YUBLI_000_000: It is heartening to see the alpaca crias so full of life. Recently, however, the rambunctious little darlings have been escaping the enclosure and running loose around the agency grounds.
TEXT_BANPEL121_05219_YUBLI_000_001: I shudder to imagine what might happen should they wander off into the wilds beyond... We've been watching them as closely as we can, but there is a certain troublesome trio that has mastered the art of escape and evasion.
TEXT_BANPEL121_05219_YUBLI_000_002: I've been told that today is no exception, and would like you to assist with rounding up these fugitive crias. After all, who better to track down an expert at hiding than an expert at finding, like yourself?
TEXT_BANPEL121_05219_YUBLI_100_002: Once you have apprehended the escapees, I ask that you hand them over to the alpaca handler. He will be somewhere on the grounds, assisting with the search.
TEXT_BANPEL121_05219_SEARCHPELUPELU05219: Where have those infuriating fluffballs run off to!?
TEXT_BANPEL121_05219_SYSTEM_000_006: You have apprehended all the fugitive crias. Deliver your captives to the frantic alpaca handler.
TEXT_BANPEL121_05219_SEARCHPELUPELU05219: Gah, I can't find them anywhere!
You caught them!? That's all three accounted for─and blessedly uninjured, thank the gods...and you, of course!
They've only just found their feet, you see, so running has become their favorite new pastime. All they want to do is break out and dash around, and I swear it will be the death of me...
Or would be, if they weren't so damnably adorable. I'm thrilled to see our babies grow healthy and strong, but I will need to keep a closer eye on them!
TEXT_BANPEL121_05219_YUBLI_000_011: You caught them already!? This is why we have you as our special advisor.
TEXT_BANPEL121_05219_YUBLI_000_012: I've helped with returning them to the enclosure before, and capturing even one of the crias took all of my patience and cunning. The endeavor also ended with me having to clean spit off my goggles...
TEXT_BANPEL121_05219_YUBLI_000_013: They may be a handful already, but the alpacas we're raising here will only continue to grow in number. We'll need to take lessons from the Urqopacha ranch if we're to do our best to care for them.
TEXT_BANPEL122_05220_YUBLI_000_001: Wawkesa has requested the meat of a certain monstrous bird that dwells in the upper reaches of Kozama'uka─an ingredient he's apparently familiar with from the time he lived in the area.
TEXT_BANPEL122_05220_YUBLI_000_002: I fully endorse his wish to introduce more variety to the eatery, so I thought to send our most experienced warrior to procure it. What say you?
TEXT_BANPEL122_05220_YUBLI_000_003: Wawkesa has made another procurement request! His Ligaka thigh special was most well received, and he needs to restock his meat supply.
TEXT_BANPEL122_05220_YUBLI_000_004: Blowing on this game bird whistle near the falls of Miyakabek'zoma should bring a fledgling of Ligaka right to your location. Once you have the meat we need, please make the delivery to Wawkesa.
TEXT_BANPEL122_05220_WAWKESA_000_005: I made a request to Yubli for fresh ingredients, but I didn't expect they would send you. Well, I, uh...appreciate the help. Truly.
TEXT_BANPEL122_05220_WAWKESA_000_020: Oh, you've brought the meat I tasked Yubli with procuring?
TEXT_BANPEL122_05220_WAWKESA_000_021: Now that's a nice hunk of bird! The dishes we used to make from this back in our old, uh, “hunting grounds” were always camp favorites.
TEXT_BANPEL122_05220_WAWKESA_000_022: The Hanu prefer leafy greens and bugs over beast flesh, so there's not much around in the way of meaty cuisine. A few customers mentioned they'd like something to sink their teeth into, though, and that got me to thinking about a new menu.
TEXT_BANPEL122_05220_WAWKESA_000_023: The meat is tasty enough just grilled over charcoal... Or maybe I can try that fried bird recipe Chekochuk taught me about!
TEXT_BANPEL122_05220_WAWKESA_000_024: People seem to love the recipe Chekochuk taught me for frying the thigh and coating it in “tangyspices.” I can see it becoming a local specialty.
TEXT_BANPEL122_05220_WAWKESA_000_025: The distinctive flavor─packed with savory tenderness─is something only the fledgling of Ligaka can provide. You have my thanks, as does Yubli. You've done me a great favor here!
TEXT_BANPEL122_05220_YUBLI_000_029: Any troubles procuring the meat? If all is well, I can take the whistle off your hands for now.
TEXT_BANPEL122_05220_YUBLI_000_030: I'm glad to hear Wawkesa was pleased! Such ingredients are difficult to come by without someone trained in battle─which makes us very lucky to have you around.
TEXT_BANPEL122_05220_YUBLI_000_031: Wawkesa's cuisine is greatly enjoyed by our visitors, so I hope you'll be willing to help out again soon!
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_YUBLI_000_001: Those former bandits make for surprisingly hard workers. I admit, I was nervous about employing them at first, but now I can't imagine running the agency without them.
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_YUBLI_000_002: I wonder, however, if they have any qualms about the work they do for us. As you know, the Wing of Reflection is supporting the initiative and we need to report our progress... Would you mind heading out and assisting with the employee interviews?
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_YUBLI_000_003: Our group of former bandits is working as hard as ever. It's gratifying indeed to watch them develop a sense for the sightseeing business.
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_YUBLI_000_004: Speaking of which, the time has come to make our regular report to the Wing of Reflection. Would you mind heading out and assisting with the employee interviews?
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_YUBLI_000_005: A Hanu guide is out at Many Fires with one of them this very moment, lending a sympathetic ear to their concerns.
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_SHETONA05221_000_00: You want to hear our worries and woes? You people are too good to us...
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_HANUHANU05221_000_0: Ah, you're just in time! Please feel free to chime in while we discuss this lady's concerns.
Tell us, how do you feel about your tour guide duties? It's fine if you're simply enjoying the work, but please don't hesitate to share any issues you've encountered.
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_SHETONA05221_000_01: Hrmmm... There was something bothering us lately...
Those of us from the old gang, well, we're not the most polite bunch. We try to watch our tongues, but old habits die hard...and we're afraid the customers are put off by our rough way of talking.
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_A1_000_001: You can work on improving it, slowly but surely.
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_A1_000_003: The Hanu and the Pelu have their own quirks, as well.
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_HANUHANU05221_000_0: Exactly. There's no need to force yourself! The important thing is that you inform our guests in a friendly manner.
Exactly. There are definitely those who prefer the rougher edge─it can make you seem a more capable guide out here in the wilderness!
Yes, we all speak a little differently! That's exactly the kind of thing our customers are here to enjoy.
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_SHETONA05221_000_01: My friends and me, we're not the cleverest bunch. We know the trails, and we swing a mean axe, but when it comes to explaining the history of a place, we come up short on details...
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_A2_000_001: You'll pick it up as you go.
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_A2_000_002: You can give your own perspective.
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_A2_000_003: A mean axe makes up for a lot!
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_HANUHANU05221_000_0: Exactly. Every day is a chance to learn! Besides, we local guides will be right by your side should you need us!
Yes, don't sell yourself short! You know a side of Kozama'uka's wilds that we can only imagine.
Exactly! Your martial skills are a great asset! Greater knowledge of the lands we tour through will come in time.
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_SHETONA05221_000_02: I hadn't thought about it like that... My thanks! That actually made me feel better! I'll let my comrades know we've been worrying ourselves over nothing.
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_HANUHANU05221_000_0: I'm glad we were able to put your concerns to rest.
Now it's time we returned to our guide practice. Please send my best regards to Yubli!
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_YUBLI_000_030: Thank you for listening and providing encouragement. Our newer trainees may have been outlaws once, but none can deny the effort they're making to redeem their less-than-savory past.
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_YUBLI_000_031: Although, just between you and me, the chance to be escorted by a former bandit has become something of a draw for certain customers...
TEXT_BANPEL123_05221_YUBLI_000_032: In any case, as the agency continues to expand, I'm sure new concerns will arise. I'd appreciate it if you could be there for them again when the time comes!
TEXT_BANPEL124_05222_YUBLI_000_001: An important shipment has just arrived from Earthenshire, delivered to the nearest wharf by punutiy. The problem, however, is that the crate is extremely heavy.
TEXT_BANPEL124_05222_YUBLI_000_002: I'd like to have it moved before arriving customers trip over it, but our Moblin porter appears to be struggling with the weight.
TEXT_BANPEL124_05222_YUBLI_000_003: Could you go down to the wharf and lend a hand? The porter will tell you where the crate needs to be.
TEXT_BANPEL124_05222_MOBLIN05222_000_010: Special Advisor! Thank you for coming to handhelp floppyarm Mobbie!
TEXT_BANPEL124_05222_MOBLIN05222_000_011: Potsworn goldwork is a popular choice for Kozama'uka memorykeeping! But a crate holding many goldcrafts is too much bulkyweight for one Moblin to move. Please, he needs an ironarm adventurer to carry it to the supply officer!
TEXT_BANPEL124_05222_SYSTEM_000_013: Deliver the crate of goldwork to the supply officer waiting outside the travel agency storehouse before the time runs out.
TEXT_BANPEL124_05222_SYSTEM_000_014: You will have sixty seconds to complete the task. Should you fail, return to the starting location and begin anew.
TEXT_BANPEL124_05222_MOBLIN05222_000_020: That crate is too heavy for Mobbie, but the supply officer will be waiting! Please make the delivery with careful eyewatchings and quicksteps!
TEXT_BANPEL124_05222_MOBLIN05222_000_021: What's wrong? Was the crate too much bulkyweight even for you? Maybe you just need a shortrest before trying again!
TEXT_BANPEL124_05222_MOBLIN05222_000_022: Something else tickling your braincage? Mobbie is happy to leave the potsworn goldcraft in your capable helphands!
TEXT_BANPEL124_05222_WORKER05222_000_025: The goods we ordered should have been delivered by now...
TEXT_BANPEL124_05222_SYSTEM_000_026: Collect the Moblin porter's crate of goldwork from the wharf and deliver it to the supply officer.
TEXT_BANPEL124_05222_WORKER05222_000_030: Ah, is that the shipment from Earthenshire? Thank you for bringing it in. I would have picked it up myself, but sorting out our inventory has kept me chained to the storehouse.
TEXT_BANPEL124_05222_WORKER05222_000_031: Potsworn craft is in high demand, and maintaining a steady supply has been a logistical headache, to say the least. We've just had a customer asking about availability, so I'd like to get this goldwork on the shelves sooner rather than later.
TEXT_BANPEL124_05222_YUBLI_000_040: Thank you for taking care of that delivery so quickly!
TEXT_BANPEL124_05222_YUBLI_000_041: The potsworn's goldwork we sell in our shop is highly sought after by customers with more...expensive taste. It seems a memento like this becomes all the more special for having found it in such memorable surrounds.
TEXT_BANPEL124_05222_YUBLI_000_042: Which is all to say that if we're not careful, our stock soon runs dangerously low. I'd be grateful if you could help out again should we need a hand!
TEXT_BANPEL125_05223_YUBLI_000_001: I have a request from Wawkesa─something about making an urgent delivery to a guide out in the middle of a sightseeing tour.
TEXT_BANPEL125_05223_YUBLI_000_002: Could you please talk to him and see what you can do to help?
TEXT_BANPEL125_05223_WAWKESA_000_010: Did Yubli send you my way? Good, because I really need someone to make a food delivery.
TEXT_BANPEL125_05223_WAWKESA_000_011: When the tours head out to far-flung places, I pack lunches for the groups to take with them─one each for the customers, and one for the guide. Can't have them going hungry, now, can I?
TEXT_BANPEL125_05223_WAWKESA_000_012: Well, today, a guide friend of mine took the lunches with her as she usually does. Being an incurable scatterbrain, though, she only grabbed the customer packs and forgot to take her own.
TEXT_BANPEL125_05223_WAWKESA_000_013: My scatterbrained friend has headed off on a tour without her lunch again...
TEXT_BANPEL125_05223_WAWKESA_000_014: I need someone to deliver a meal to our forgetful guide before she pushes too far on an empty stomach. You'll find her somewhere around Marsh Ligaka─hopefully upright and not fainted by the wayside.
TEXT_BANPEL125_05223_WAWKESA_000_015: My friend's Tonawawtan, like me. Head to Marsh Ligaka and follow the sounds of her belly rumbling.
TEXT_BANPEL125_05223_TONAWAWTA05223_000_: Oooh, I'm so hungry I'm starting to smell the lunch I forgot to bring. ...Wait, do you have it with you!?
And here I was resigned to finishing the tour on an empty stomach! Thank you for hiking all this way just for me!
We'll take a break to eat the food Wawkesa packed for us, then we'll be on our way. You can let them know back at Dock Poga that everything's going to schedule!
Once we're done eating here, we'll get back on the trail. Thanks again for bringing my lunch!
TEXT_BANPEL125_05223_WAWKESA_000_025: Did you manage to find my hungry friend? I reckon she'd forget her own feet if they weren't attached to her legs.
TEXT_BANPEL125_05223_YUBLI_000_030: Welcome back, . You were able to make Wawkesa's delivery, then?
TEXT_BANPEL125_05223_YUBLI_000_031: He puts a lot of thought into those lunches of his, making sure they're both filling and filled with a good mix of healthy foods.
TEXT_BANPEL125_05223_YUBLI_000_032: Such meals are essential for those longer tours into the wilderness, so hopefully his forgetful friend will remember hers next time!
TEXT_BANPEL126_05224_YUBLI_000_000: When the giant paper wasps near Dock Tumu start to swarm, they become a danger to anyone nearby.
TEXT_BANPEL126_05224_YUBLI_000_001: We currently have one of Wawkesa's comrades out there handling the threat for us. A most driven individual, I must say...
TEXT_BANPEL126_05224_YUBLI_100_001: Even so, there are more wasps than we first expected, and I'm worried he might be overwhelmed.
TEXT_BANPEL126_05224_YUBLI_100_000: The paper wasps near Dock Tumu have begun swarming again.
TEXT_BANPEL126_05224_YUBLI_110_000: And once again, that same driven employee of ours has volunteered to cull their numbers. While I admire his dedication, I fear that one man─all alone in the ones column─will be hard-pressed to stem the swarm.
TEXT_BANPEL126_05224_YUBLI_000_002: He should be fighting in the Dewspun Bank, so I wonder if you could make your own way there and help eradicate a few of the pests. Once you've thinned the swarm, please check in on our self-appointed exterminator.
TEXT_BANPEL126_05224_EMPLOYEE05224_000_0: I hope you're here to kill wasps! I'd thought to squish all these stingers myself, but there are so many out here!
Good to see you, Special Advisor─especially when you're covered in wasp innards. I appreciate the help.
That should keep things quiet around here for a time, but I'll be watching and waiting. More of those buzzing terrors will hatch soon enough, and someone has to be on hand to thin the swarm.
TEXT_BANPEL126_05224_YUBLI_000_030: Thank you for assisting with the paper wasp extermination. They come to scout for suitable nest locations, and it's always best to deal with the “advance party” before the nest builders start to gather.
TEXT_BANPEL126_05224_YUBLI_000_031: As for your fellow eradicator, I have him taking a well-earned rest. We appreciate his passion for the work, but I'd prefer he pace his efforts lest he find himself injured─or worse.
TEXT_BANPEL126_05224_YUBLI_000_032: Things being as they are, however, I may need to call on you again to help ease his self-assigned burdens!
TEXT_BANPEL127_05225_YUBLI_000_000: Wawkesa's eatery has been a sound success so far. His approach of tailoring the menu to individual tastes has won him plaudits from visitors, but when supplies run low, he is sometimes unable to furnish guests' requests.
TEXT_BANPEL127_05225_YUBLI_000_001: In fact, he has just used the last of a certain key spice... It grows here in Kozama'uka, but the journey is a long one, and few can spare the time to forage.
TEXT_BANPEL127_05225_YUBLI_000_002: I'm loath to trouble you, but I'd have you gather Ihuyka achiote for our resident chef. Three sprigs should yield enough seeds for Wawkesa's cooking. Deliver your harvest to him when you're done!
TEXT_BANPEL127_05225_WAWKESA_000_010: Well met, adventurer. I heard you'll be fetching me some fresh achiote. Appreciate the help.
TEXT_BANPEL127_05225_WAWKESA_100_020: That was quick. Did you get the achiote I needed?
TEXT_BANPEL127_05225_WAWKESA_000_021: Ihuyka achiote belongs to same family as the achiote that grows in Yak T'el. Usually, the seeds are ground up into a powder for use in the kitchen.
TEXT_BANPEL127_05225_WAWKESA_000_022: Achiote is just about essential in Xbr'aal cooking. Same goes for the cuisine here in Kozama'uka. A sprinkle or two really elevates a dish. I also use it to add a touch of color to grilled meat and the like. I couldn't do without it, personally!
TEXT_BANPEL127_05225_WAWKESA_000_023: Anyway, I appreciate you traipsing all the way out there to keep my operation running. Be sure to give Yubli my thanks as well.
TEXT_BANPEL127_05225_WAWKESA_000_030: With a good supply of achiote, I'll be able to keep our guests from Yak T'el happy. As I said, I appreciate the help.
TEXT_BANPEL127_05225_YUBLI_000_040: May I presume your foraging mission was a success? No doubt Wawkesa was pleased.
TEXT_BANPEL127_05225_YUBLI_000_041: It seems his time as a cook in Shaaloani gave him a thorough education in a variety of cuisines. Funny that he should end up catering for an entirely different clientele here at the agency.
TEXT_BANPEL127_05225_YUBLI_000_042: Thank you, . I shall be in touch next time Wawkesa's spice supplies are running low. I'll warn you now though, with all the flavorsome food on the menu, you might find yourself foraging again quite soon!
TEXT_BANPEL128_05226_YUBLI_000_000: One of our alpaca handlers has taken his charges down by the water for some play time. Miisul Ja, however, thinks that they shouldn't have all the fun to themselves.
TEXT_BANPEL128_05226_YUBLI_000_001: She tells me the punutiys are looking on with envy, and is keen to give the animals a chance to sniff each other over. Both sides are incurably curious creatures, so I think it a worthwhile endeavor.
TEXT_BANPEL128_05226_YUBLI_100_001: As you've proven well-liked by all manner of beasts, I would like you to be present to help facilitate. Should the prospect interest you, head over to the punutiy pen and speak with Miisul Ja.
TEXT_BANPEL128_05226_WATERPELUPELUL05226: The alpacas are eager to frolic in the water─we're just waiting on the punutiy.
TEXT_BANPEL128_05226_MIISULJA_000_002: Ah, I thought Yubli might send you. As you've probably heard, I want to give the punutiys and the alpacas a chance to meet each other.
TEXT_BANPEL128_05226_MIISULJA_000_003: This old beastkeeper has seen your natural rapport with the animals, so it makes sense that you should be there to oversee proceedings.
TEXT_BANPEL128_05226_MIISULJA_100_003: All you really need to do, though, is ride over and have the punutiy perform her water trick. The alpacas will love it! I'll be here in case you hop off and lose your mount before you're done.
TEXT_BANPEL128_05226_MIISULJA_110_003: Yes, yes, your punutiy is here. Mount up and off you go!
TEXT_BANPEL128_05226_WATERPELUPELUL05226: Miisul Ja roped you in for this animal meet and greet, did she? I think it's a fine idea.
I've heard that the magical spray of the punutiy's water conjuration works to dispel unwelcome heat. As such, I wanted the alpacas to bathe in it for their well-being as much as for their enjoyment.
And they certainly enjoyed it, from what I can see. Having them play together like this on a regular basis will go far towards keeping them healthy and content.
TEXT_BANPEL128_05226_SYSTEM_000_010: The alpacas appear eager to begin their playtime. Speak with Miisul Ja at Dock Poga to mount a punutiy and perform Bosom Brook for the waiting animals.
TEXT_BANPEL128_05226_WATERPELUPELUL05226: The alpacas are eager to frolic in the water─we're just waiting on the punutiy.
TEXT_BANPEL128_05226_SYSTEM_000_012: Speak with Miisul Ja at Dock Poga to mount a punutiy and perform Bosom Brook for the waiting alpacas.
TEXT_BANPEL128_05226_SYSTEM_000_014: The alpacas are frolicking happily after bathing in the punutiy's watery display.
TEXT_BANPEL128_05226_WATERPELUPELUL05226: Thank you for bringing the animals together! After that refreshing shower, the alpacas are more lively than ever!
TEXT_BANPEL128_05226_MIISULJA_100_015: If punutiys could be said to grin, I'd say she enjoyed herself immensely! Hopefully we can organize another playdate with the alpacas soon.
TEXT_BANPEL128_05226_YUBLI_000_016: The way punutiys behave around those they wish to be close with, you can sense an undercurrent of caring in their actions.
TEXT_BANPEL128_05226_YUBLI_000_017: The fact that their stunning water display has the added effect of magically cooling others down, and thus making life in this humid land more tolerable, it's... Well, it's just fascinating.
TEXT_BANPEL128_05226_YUBLI_100_017: We have much to learn from these acts of caring, and can use those lessons to improve our customers' experience. Such business aside, I must thank you again for helping to make this precious interaction happen!
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_GOTOLLJA_000_000: , nice to see you. Do you have a moment?
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_GOTOLLJA_000_001: This may not come as a surprise, since you personally helped negotiate our import of foreign crops, but a researcher has recently arrived from Sharlayan.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_GOTOLLJA_000_002: I've a mind to go and pay my respects, but...
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_GOTOLLJA_000_003: Well, I know little about Sharlayans, and I'm worried I'll cause offense. Could you come along, if only for my peace of mind?
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_GOTOLLJA_000_004: My thanks. Her name is Anggir, and she should be in the southern district of the city.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_GOTOLLJA_000_010: This must be her. I'm humbled she'd travel so far for our sakes.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_020: Hello there. May I be of assistance?
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_GOTOLLJA_000_021: And I'm Gotoll Ja, former mercenary. Now I fashion whatever odds and ends need making.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_GOTOLLJA_000_022: The Autarch says you've come to oversee the growth of new crops here in Mamook, so we wanted to express our gratitude.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_023: That's very kind of you. My name is Anggir, and it's my pleasure to be at your service.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_024: When I first heard my assignment, I was intrigued. A forest dominated by the aetheric influence of meteorites...
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_025: Rest assured, we shall soon have an experimental gainery up and running. New crops will flourish here, this I promise.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_027: Indeed, my chief concern at the moment is not one of potential, but one of manpower. Mamook is rather sparse in population, is it not?
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_GOTOLLJA_000_028: Yes, most of our able-bodied workers have left, either to become mercenaries or, er...for other reasons. I myself would be glad to help, but I doubt one extra body will count for much.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_030: (-???-)You should use wivres! Put to the right use, our wivres can solve about any problem!
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_GOTOLLJA_000_031: Ruvoll Ja! How many years has it been? I thought you had moved to Tuliyollal for good!
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_032: When I heard change was in the air for Mamook, I had to come and see it for myself.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_033: Using wivres sounds like an excellent idea. We could hitch them to plows, have them cart heavy equipment...
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_034: All we need now is someone willing to gather extra materials we require.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_GOTOLLJA_000_036: I know a few gatherers, but most are getting on in years. We'll have to find an adventurous soul if you need anything more than local mushrooms or the odd medicinal herb.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_037: I handle beasts, not ore and timber. You?
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_A1_100_001: I'm an adventurous gatherer─leave it to me!
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_A1_100_002: For the right price, I'll handle just about anything.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_039: Then it's settled! You'll be well compensated, I promise.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_090_039: I look forward to working with you, friend!
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_100_039: , Ruvoll Ja, you both have my thanks.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_040: Think nothing of it! I'll gather what wivre handlers I can find and explain the situation. I'm sure they'll be happy to help as well!
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_GOTOLLJA_000_043: ..., would you mind going with Ruvoll Ja? He's a good lad, but he gets ahead of himself sometimes.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_GOTOLLJA_000_044: You've more than proven your talent for communication, so if he's struggling to make his point, lend him a hand, would you?
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_050: I appreciate your cooperation. I'll be here planning the particulars if you need anything.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_DOPPROA05255_100_05: My wivre's trained for battle. I doubt it'll be much use on a farm...
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_DOPPROB05255_110_05: Remind me why we're here again?
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_DOPPROC05255_120_05: My darling has needs! I won't force him to do work he doesn't enjoy!
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_060: As I've been saying, wivres are the answer!
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_DOPPROA05255_000_06: ...But ours are specifically trained for combat. How do you reckon they'd help with farming?
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_062: Oh , perfect timing. Tell them one wivre's worth a least ten men on the field, won't you?
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_SYSTEM_000_064: The wivre handlers stand in awkward silence. Try convincing them on behalf of Ruvoll Ja.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_SYSTEM_000_071: An awkward silence lingers. Try speaking on behalf of Ruvoll Ja.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_DOPPROA05255_000_08: Believe me, we all want new crops here in Mamook. I'm happy to help─I just want to know how a wivre trained for battle could be useful.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_A1_000_001: We need wivres to haul equipment.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_A1_000_002: We need wivres to pull our plows.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_DOPPROA05255_000_08: I see...a wivre with the strength for combat should have no problems with that. Very well, the both of us will be over presently.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_DOPPROB05255_000_09: What does he expect our wivres to do, exactly? Hoe with their horns?
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_A2_000_002: Gotoll Ja will outfit them with farming equipment.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_DOPPROB05255_000_09: That...makes far more sense. If that's what you need done, we can do it.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_DOPPROB05255_100_09: Oh, that makes far more sense. I can trust Gotoll Ja's handiwork, so count me in.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_DOPPROC05255_000_10: My precious wivre only smashes things. I'd love to be of service, but if my darling can't smash something to bits, then I'm afraid we're at an impasse.
That sounds...well, smashing! Leave it to me and my wivre─we'll have the garden beds free of obstructions in a blink.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_110: That was incredible! You convinced them all to help just like that.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_111: Now, there's one last person I think we need.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_112: His name is Kageel Ja and he's a najool─er, Ja Tiika banana farmer. We can trust his expertise.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_120: This is Kageel Ja. We've been best friends since childhood, but... Well, after I moved to Tuliyollal, we haven't had much contact.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_KAGEELJA_000_130: ...You were part of the Third Promise's retinue, weren't you? What brings you here now? And with Ruvoll Ja?
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_131: We just met, actually. A researcher from afar is beginning work on a gainery here, and we're both lending a hand.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_136: I was hoping you might help out as well, knowing as much as you do about farming in these forests.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_KAGEELJA_000_137: You think I'd aid a traitor who abandoned his homeland for the comforts of Tuliyollal?
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_KAGEELJA_000_138: ...Pffft, the look on your face! I'm kidding, I'm kidding. Although it's in great part thanks to this  here that such words can be said in jest. Much has changed for Mamook.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_KAGEELJA_000_139: If my best friend has finally come home, I'd be a fool to refuse his pleas.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_141: Joking aside, your words didn't ring hollow, Kageel Ja. To many, I was a traitor to everything Mamook once stood for. ...A traitor to my friend for never writing.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_100_141: It broke my heart to leave, but I couldn't stand the zealotry of blessed siblings... Now that the old teachings have been left in the past, I want to do everything I can for Mamook's future.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_110_141: Thank you, Kageel Ja, for your forgiveness. I hope that you, , and I can help find a new way forward.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_143: All right, hopefully we have enough people to get started! Let's go and ask Anggir if she needs anything else.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_180: Gotoll Ja is helping outfit the wivres with carts and plows. They'll be along afterwards.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_KAGEELJA_000_181: I just introduced myself to Anggir. Let me know how I can help.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_190: Thank you for your aid in recruiting the others. With a handful of wivres, our worker shortage is now but a trifle.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_191: The handlers have their orders, but there's one thing I would yet ask of you.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_192: While fertile, this soil needs some additions to better accommodate the seeds and starters I've brought with me.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_200: I think some charcoal should balance out its acidity nicely. Perhaps you could bring some from the Xobr'it Cinderfield?
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_210: I think some charred bark should balance out its acidity nicely. Perhaps you could bring some from the Xobr'it Cinderfield?
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_220: I think a cindershell should balance out its acidity nicely. Perhaps you could bring us one from Iq Rrax Tsoly?
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_221: According to local fishers, golden stonefly nymphs should serve you well as bait.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_100_221: I've attained the proper permissions from Iq Br'aax to gather from the Ut'ohmu Horizon. As long as your work is done respectfully, we have nothing to fear.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_230: We'll begin setting up a base of operations in the meantime, so let me know once you've acquired what we need.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_240: It's a relief to have Kageel Ja work with us. He's been growing najool forever, so he and Anggir should be unstoppable!
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_KAGEELJA_000_241: Preparing the land before planting is an incredibly important step. If we have any hope for our new seedlings, we should take pains to do it properly.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_250: Welcome back. I trust you have what I asked for?
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_251: Perfect, just what I had hoped. I'll have the wivre handlers mix our fertilizer into the soil as they till it.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_DOPPROD05255_000_30: Cart's secure. We're ready when you are.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_KAGEELJA_000_301: Just about... Yes, this should be ground finely enough to distribute evenly.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_302: Once we've tilled the soil for beds, we can begin planting in earnest. Ruvoll Ja, can I count on your continued support?
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_303: Me? But Kageel Ja's the one who grows things.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_304: And you have grown our hopes into a viable operation by recruiting the necessary allies. Charisma like yours is essential for this gainery's success.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_306: All right, I'll do what I can. On my pride as a Mamool Ja─for Mamook!
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_307: Your assistance would be invaluable, , if you can spare the time.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_309: After all these years, my homestead is about to realize true progress. I would love to have you with us as we build a brighter future for my people.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_A5_000_001: I'll help. On my pride as an adventurer─for Mamook!
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_A5_000_002: When you put it that way, I can't really say no.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_320: Thank you. I'm in your debt!
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_330: I know I'm asking a lot of you. I'm truly grateful.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_340: It's heartening to have you with us.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_KAGEELJA_000_341: Sorry for the wait. The wivres are ready.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_342: Thanks, Kageel Ja. Let's get started!
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_RUVOLLJA_000_400: This gainery will give Mamook another chance. I can just feel it.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_ANGGIR_000_401: I can feel it too. Let's show the world what these lands can grow.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_SYSTEM_000_403: From hopes yet to fully blossom, Mamook has established a gainery! Help the Mamool Ja come to love the land that supports them by aiding the farmers of Gok Golma.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_SYSTEM_000_450: You have achieved Friendly reputation with the farmers of Gok Golma.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_SYSTEM_000_451: Mamool Ja society quests are now available from Kageel Ja in Gok Golma.
TEXT_BANMAM001_05255_SYSTEM_000_452: Furthermore, you may now purchase wares from Veerul Ja.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_000: , did you see? The plants Anggir brought from Sharlayan are growing. They're actually growing!
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_ANGGIR_000_001: All is going to plan so far, yes, but overconfidence begets error. In truth, we've detected evidence of harmful insects upon our crops recently.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_003: Insects? Can't we just stamp them out?
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_ANGGIR_000_004: If only it were so simple. Every one you find represents another hidden ten, another hundred─indeed, we may be facing an infestation of thousands if left unchecked.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_ANGGIR_000_005: Which is why we must find a companion plant for our crops posthaste.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_ANGGIR_000_006: As the name suggests, companion plants support each other's growth in myriad ways, not least of all in deterring pests.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_ANGGIR_100_006: While the samples I've brought with me should thrive in this particular aetheric environment, their efficacy against local fauna has yet to be tested. We would be wise to pick a local variety of plant for the job instead.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_007: In other words, we need a plant native to these forests that will repel those insects.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_ANGGIR_000_008: Precisely. Might you have any suggestions?
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_A1_000_002: What about trees of living light?
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_A1_000_003: How about some kind of seedkin?
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_010: Maybe...though I feel I've heard Kageel Ja complain about bug problems for najool before, so it's hard to say...
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_ANGGIR_000_015: You mean those large trees that cling to meteorites, correct? I'm uncertain how we'd replicate the phenomenon near our gainery...not to mention the time it would take for such trees to reach maturity...
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_ANGGIR_000_020: I hadn't even considered the possibility, but such a creature may be exactly what we need. Surely local seedkin have adapted to repel insects that plague their own bodies.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_030: What about a branchbearer? It looks like a bird, but it's actually an ambulatory plant. I've heard it emits these great bursts of energy to ward off pests.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_ANGGIR_000_033: Sounds like it may be well worth our time to capture one. Can you do it?
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_034: Leave it to me. We Doppro are used to taming all sorts of beasts, not just wivres.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_035: But, on the off chance that the creature becomes aggressive, I'll need someone to back me up in a fight. Will you come along?
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_ANGGIR_000_036: Then I'll leave the matter to you both. In the meantime, I'll investigate the scope of the damage done by these insects.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_037: The sooner we return, the better. Let's meet up northwest of Golmajiik Grove. We're sure to find branchbearers there.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_ANGGIR_000_040: A seedkin in the shape of a bird? How curious... I simply must take readings of its aetheric emissions!
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_050: There should be plenty of branchbearers around here. They mimic birds to attract carnivores, then leech energy from their would-be predators.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_051: In theory, either of us could act as a decoy to lure one over, but that may well end in violence. Taming creatures is about trust, after all, not physical dominance.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_052: I'd like to make it an offering instead. Something rich in the energies it likes. Are you up to the task?
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_060: Excellent! Then could you bring me some glowing mineral water from Cenote Neyozzote? Contact with the meteorites there should make it particularly potent.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_070: Excellent! Then could you bring me some glowing seeds from Cenote Neyozzote? Contact with the meteorites there should make them particularly potent.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_080: Excellent! Then could you bring me some glowing waterweed from Cenote Moxutural? Contact with the meteorites there should make it particularly potent.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_081: Any old golden stonefly nymph should be able to reel some in.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_091: While you tend to that, I'll scout out a good candidate.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_100: Did you find something our branchbearer might like?
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_101: Even richer in energies than I imagined! The rest you can leave to me─I'll show you traditional Doppro taming at its best!
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_100_114: I'm glad you accepted my gift. It represents the bond we share as beings of this forest.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_115: All's well that ends well, as you can see!
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_100_115: ...Not to say I emerged completely unscathed, but so it goes sometimes.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_110_115: Once it realized I meant no harm, we came to an understanding.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_116: The Doppro magicks I cast on what you brought me certainly didn't hurt my chances either.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_117: Anyway, let's have Anggir take a look and see if our new friend will benefit our garden.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_SYSTEM_000_132: The branchbearer seems calm and regards you with a friendly gaze.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_ANGGIR_000_140: I've studied my share of seedkin, but I've never seen anything quite like this specimen. It's a marvel!
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_141: I hope it can help with our pest problem...
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_143: Well, it's made itself right at home!
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_ANGGIR_000_144: An aetheric emission so potent you can see it!? No doubt this is an instinctual measure taken against irritants.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_ANGGIR_000_145: And given its amicable behavior, it seems keen on protecting us as well. If we can direct its attentions to our gainery, I daresay the plague of insects won't stand a chance!
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_147: Will you help protect our little garden?
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_RUVOLLJA_000_149: Haha, I'll take that as a yes. I'll have my colleagues tame more of these fine creatures.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_ANGGIR_000_152: Wonderful. Let us coordinate our efforts with the branchbearers to create a hospitable environment for our crops.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_ANGGIR_000_200: They seem the best of friends, do they not?
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_SYSTEM_000_201: You were successful in befriending beneficial companions for the gainery! Thanks to the branchbearers' aetheric emissions, Gok Golma's crops are no longer harrowed by pests.
TEXT_BANMAM002_05256_SYSTEM_000_202: Mamook's first harvest brings with it both wonder and delight. Continue your efforts to help support the Mamool Ja and their burgeoning hopes!
