TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_000: The branchbearers have settled in nicely. Those pesky bugs are gone and our next harvest is well on its way.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_001: Only, local beasts have been encroaching upon Gok Golma recently, threatening our workers and trampling our crops.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_003: We've taken immediate action, of course. I asked Gotoll Ja if he could develop some kind of repellent, like the two of you once did for wild wivres.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_004: I was just about to go and pick up the prototype. Since you're here, why don't you come along?
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_010: Gotoll Ja has been of incredible help. Not only does he manufacture our gardening equipment, he even fashions research tools for Anggir.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_GOTOLLJA_000_0020: ! Now this is a pleasant surprise. You look well.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_GOTOLLJA_000_021: I reworked the old smoke bombs into traps that issue smoke for an extended period, allowing ample time for our farmers to flee if necessary.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_GOTOLLJA_000_022: But these are only a stopgap. Able-bodied fighters patrolling the area would do a far better job for security, if you ask me.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_024: That may be so, but we can't spare any of our workers... We may have to try recruiting Mamool Ja who moved to Tuliyollal, like me.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_028: Since you've got a knack for convincing people, I'd like you to join me. My first stop will be Exultation, so stop by when you have a moment!
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_GOTOLLJA_000_030: Off he goes... He's always been earnest, that one. It's just a matter of conveying his thoughts coherently to others...
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_CALMXBRAAL_000_031: I'm relieved to see you hale and whole! When you said you were returning to Mamook, I didn't know what to think...
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_040: Ah, you're here! I was just catching up with an old friend.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_041: In fact, he was kind enough to direct me to Mireel Ja, a fellow expatriate from Mamook.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_042: Normally Mireel Ja works as a bodyguard, but as luck would have it, he's relaxing by Downripple . Let's go and find him.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_050: This is Mireel Ja, one of the finest fighters I know. I hope he'll hear us out.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_CALMXBRAAL_000_051: Mireel Ja should be somewhere near Downripple. Take care of Ruvoll Ja, won't you?
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_MIREELJA_000_060: Well, well, aren't I popular today.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_MIREELJA_000_061: ...Wait, I know you! You're the Dawnservant's right-hand !
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_062: Even you, Mireel Ja? I had no idea  was such a celebrity.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_MIREELJA_000_063: Celebrity doesn't begin to describe it─at least, not among us mercenary types. To become a fighter like , recognized by the Vow of Resolve herself, is a dream for no few of us.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_MIREELJA_000_066: So, to what do I owe this honor? Ruvoll Ja, I thought you'd gone back to Mamook.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_067: I have─and I want you to return with me.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_MIREELJA_000_068: Don't take this the wrong way, but even if Mamook has changed, I still prefer the freedom of Tuliyollal to that dismal forest.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_MIREELJA_000_070: Besides which, you can eat here. Truly eat! Najool just doesn't compare to what the city can offer.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_071: But that's the whole point! We have more vegetables than ever, and we're still planning to add more!
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_A1_000_001: Maybe start at the beginning, Ruvoll Ja.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_080: Oh! That's right, he doesn't know yet! Let me explain...
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_MIREELJA_000_081: Well, color me impressed. A Mamook that not only grows something other than najool, but works with outsiders to do so.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_082: Exactly! We need to protect what we've worked so hard to build. Won't you help us?
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_MIREELJA_000_087: Fine. Since you're this invested, I'll go and give it a look. But if I'm forced to eat even a single najool, I'm out of there...
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_088: Haha, fair enough! Gok Golma is a sight to behold, though─you won't regret this!
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_091: Some of our crops are still young, but to have this much variety thriving so vigorously... It's a wellspring of hope.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_ANGGIR_100_091: I just had the honor of meeting Mireel Ja. Having an ally of his stature is reassuring indeed.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_MIREELJA_000_100: By the gods... There isn't a najool in sight!
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_MIREELJA_000_101: Now I understand your excitement. This is an unprecedented achievement for Mamook.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_103: Isn't it? We need to shore up our defenses, and that's where you come in. What do your eyes see that mine don't?
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_MIREELJA_000_104: Hmm... A weak fence, for starters. You have supplies and tools to reinforce them, I hope?
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_106: The tools I'll take care of, and  is as good a gatherer as you'll find. Any supplies we need, 'll procure!
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_MIREELJA_100_110: Then I'd have you bring us soft limestone for the new barriers. You should be able to find some around Ankledeep.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_MIREELJA_100_115: Then I'd have you bring us supple ivy for the new barriers. You should be able to find some around Ankledeep.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_MIREELJA_100_120: Then I'd have you bring us an anklefish. Its bones are sturdy and good for making barriers.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_MIREELJA_100_121: You should be able to fish them from Ankledeep using golden stonefly nymphs.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_RUVOLLJA_000_131: We'll apprise Anggir of our plan. Once you have the supplies, you can deliver them directly to her. We're counting on you!
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_ANGGIR_000_140: Welcome back. I understand we're reinforcing our fences.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_ANGGIR_000_141: Lovely, I believe this is precisely what Ruvoll Ja described. I hope a sturdy wall will solve our problems...
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_ANGGIR_000_200: I'm surprised by how many of Mireel Ja's associates hearkened to his call. Thanks to their patrols, our gainery feels safer than ever.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_ANGGIR_000_201: Beasts should no longer trouble us, and come harvest time, we should have more than enough people to lend a hand.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_ANGGIR_100_201: I'll admit, the glow of our yield surprised me at first, but closer inspection revealed that these plants mirror najool in their reaction to the aetheric environment. Their appearance has no negative effect on nutrients nor palatability.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_SYSTEM_000_202: More Mamool Ja expatriates have now gathered in Gok Golma to protect its precious bounty.
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_SYSTEM_000_203: Given the regularity of harvests, a space has been allocated for the trade of fresh produce. This can only bode well for the Mamool Ja and their dietary repertoire!
TEXT_BANMAM003_05257_SYSTEM_000_250: You have achieved Respected reputation with the farmers of Gok Golma.

TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_000: Just look at our crop stores, ! Mamook now has choice when it comes to food! We never could have seen this day if not for your help.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_001: But we can still do better. More can flourish yet, I just know it!
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_002: As passionate as always, I see. While I wish I could agree with you, I'm afraid we may be reaching the extent of our crop variation.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_003: Currently, this forest restricts us in two ways: one, the meteorites' unique aether, and two, a distinct lack of natural sunlight. Crops that can grow under both these conditions are, unfortunately, limited.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_004: Removing even one of those restrictions would certainly increase our options─assuming such a feat were possible, of course.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_006: We've considered how to let sunlight in before, but it's not as easy as felling a tree or two.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_007: If only we could reference another locale that cultivates flora in near-total darkness...
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_010: It's true that Labyrinthos was built underground, but the sheer amount of resources required for its construction dwarfs what we can afford to do here. Perhaps there's another place we can use as a reference...
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_020: That's right... When I was in Tuliyollal, I heard about what happened in Yyasulani. They say the dome is rife with lightning energies and an endless night lingers over the land.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_022: Fascinating. And yet they successfully farm there?
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_024: Yyupye's Halo, you say? I have a permit to visit Xak Tural... Why don't we go and see it for ourselves?
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_025: I also possess the requisite permissions, so I can join you. If we compare the data of this forest to that of Yyupye's Halo, we may well find a clue relevant to our current conundrum.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_026: It'll be a long journey, so we haven't a moment to lose. Lead the way, !
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_040: To think the sun once shone so brightly here... It's a different sort of darkness than that of the Ja Tiika Heartland.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_041: With lightning-aspected aether this dense in the atmosphere, it's little wonder that thick thunderclouds obscure the sky as they do.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_042: I could probably stand in awe of this place all , but we have a duty to fulfill. We need to ask the residents here about their farming techniques.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_043: We're ready when you are, so just lead the way!
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_SYSTEM_000_051: Ruvoll Ja and Anggir are now accompanying you. Keep them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_SYSTEM_000_052: You can leave your quest companions behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with them and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_SYSTEM_000_053: If you wish to have your companions join you again, return and speak with them at the original location.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_SYSTEM_000_055: Your companions have yet to arrive. Be sure they are at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_070: In Tuliyollal, I remember once sharing a table with a Shetona from Yyasulani. I can't imagine how they must feel to see their homeland so transformed...
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_071: The infrastructure here is unlike Sharlayan, Garlean, or even Allagan technologies. I must take great care in my study of this place...
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_SYSTEM_000_080: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companions?
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_081: Did something come up? That's fine, we'll be waiting by the entrance when you're done.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_082: Did you have other business? We shall wait for you by the entrance, so come and find us when you're finished.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_FARMERSA05258_000_1: Hmm? Can I help you with something?
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_SYSTEM_000_101: You must be accompanied by Ruvoll Ja and Anggir and have them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_FARMERSA05258_000_1: Our little farm has caught your fancy? I can hardly blame you─keeping crops alive in environs such as these is no small feat, if I do say so myself.
We use electrope equipment to supply our plants with the nutrients and light they require. The key to good gardening is understanding the unique needs of each species, after all.
Humidity levels, check. As for lighting...
Well, as you can see, we grow our crops in circles at Yyupye's Halo.
The reason is simple─this contraption converts lightning-aspected energy to create an ideal environment for our crops, from humidity and lighting to temperature and soil quality.
...Hang on, I've seen you before! With Shaloaci, no? She's away on business at the moment, but I'll let her know you dropped by. She'll be sorry to have missed you.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_151: So these towers act as an artificial sun for their plants...
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_152: Far smaller than what we have in Labyrinthos, but no less effective for the growth of crops.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_160: These folks have worked hard to achieve the impossible. I'm all the more inspired to do the same!
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_161: That said, we'll be nothing but a bother if we stand around here. Let's regroup and discuss our next steps.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_FARMERSA05258_000_1: The lightning may impede our farmwork, but it also energizes our towers. Both a blessing and a curse, you might say.
To us, it's only natural that our beds are round, but developing this style of agriculture was the result of trial and error.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_SYSTEM_100_171: Light pours onto the garden beds from the tower, which seems to serve as an artificial sun.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_180: I thought I'd learned a decent amount about the outside world after leaving Mamook, but I still don't know the half of it, do I...
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_182: Thanks for guiding us here. This trip was well worth it.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_184: Indeed. We can neither develop such infrastructure overnight, nor can we discount the differences between Heritage Found and the Ja Tiika Heartland...
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_185: However, the knowledge that aspected aether may be converted into something equivalent to natural light is invaluable. We may not possess this “electrope,” but perhaps magicks can achieve a similar effect?
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_186: The Boonewa are peerless when it comes to magic! Let's head back and ask Kageel Ja. He's probably missing us about now anyway.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_190: If we could truly create artificial sunlight... Oh, the possibilities!
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_200: Hold on a moment while I fetch Kageel Ja.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_KAGEELJA_000_201: Ruvoll Ja explained your idea... If you're looking to achieve the impossible with magicks, shouldn't you speak with our mightiest practitioner instead?
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_KAGEELJA_000_204: He's different now. And he wants the best for this gainery, same as anyone. I'm sure he'd help, if you asked.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_207: ...But I left. Surely I'm little more than a traitor in his eyes.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_A2_000_001: He's changed his ways, I promise.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_A2_000_002: Then you'll just have to win him over.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_210: You were instrumental in freeing Mamook from the shackles of blessed siblings, so I guess you'd know better than most...
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_215: You're right. This is for Gok Golma─for Mamook.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_100_220: Then if your mind is made up, shall we request an audience?
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ZEREELJA_000_222: Just the other day, my wife brought me a sample from your harvest. I could hardly believe how flavorful it was.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_224: Thank you. It is an honor to receive such kind words.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ZEREELJA_000_225: I hear that you require a Boonewa's expertise?
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_226: Y-Yes! We were hoping to create light here. With magic. So we can grow an even wider variety of crops!
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_228: We made a journey to Yyasulani by 's guidance and studied the agricultural techniques of Heritage Found.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_229: The harsh climate there is constantly obscured by dark clouds. Yet by way of special devices, the farmers create artificial sunlight enough to maintain healthy beds of crops.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_KAGEELJA_000_230: Instead of devices, we thought Boonewa magicks might achieve something similar. Do you think it possible, Autarch?
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ZEREELJA_000_231: Weaving illusions into reality is indeed possible for us. But you require more than simple “light,” no?
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_234: It is as you say. The light in question must deliver properties necessary for our plants' nutrition and at appropriate levels.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_238: I am happy to explain in detail if you believe such a feat can be achieved.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ZEREELJA_000_239: ...It can. The magicks will require eligible vessels, however. Created from material replete with energy.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_240: Understood! We'll procure whatever you need!
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_250: He's cooperating... The Autarch really has changed.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_251: Anyway, we need to gather materials for those vessels. The Autarch said rich in energy, so I know just the thing!
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_255: Chunks of meteorite harvested from Cenote Jayunja. You can't get more concentrated energy than that.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_260: Bark from trees of living light in Cenote Jayunja. You can't get more concentrated energy than that.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_265: Meteorfish from Cenote Jayunja. You can't get more concentrated energy than that. They'll bite easily enough if you use golden stonefly nymphs.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_270: This all comes down to you, ─bring us what we need for the vessels and we'll take care of the rest!
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_280: Did you find what we need for the vessels?
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_281: Perfect! This is good, concentrated energy! I'll bring it to the Autarch, and we'll get started right away.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_300: Such remarkable magicks... These lights illuminate our gainery as though it were midday.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_301: And you may have noticed Gok Golma's latest addition. I don't know how Ruvoll Ja and the others found time to prepare a kitchen, but it makes readying our yields for consumption easier than ever.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_303: Admiring the kitchen, are you? One day, it'll make some legendary dishes─even one to rival xibruq pibil!
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_ANGGIR_000_304: An admirable dream. With passion like yours, I'm certain it shall come true.
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_305: If we can make a meal, we can share a meal. Just like Gulool Ja Ja did on that battlefield, to end an endless war...
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_RUVOLLJA_000_306: Creating a dish that brings our Iq Br'aax neighbors to the table again...this is my next hope for Gok Golma. I hope we become living proof that Mamook has changed for the better!
TEXT_BANMAM004_05258_SYSTEM_000_307: As the gainery flourishes, so too do Ruvoll Ja's dreams for the future of his homeland. Whether Mamook will prove herself capable of restoring relations with the people of Iq Br'aax, however, remains to be seen...

TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_000: Thanks for all your help around the gainery, . More crops than ever are thriving under our new lights.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_ANGGIR_000_001: The kitchen has been getting good use as well, and I've heard nothing but glowing reviews of our produce. Dare I ask how the preparation of your “legendary” dish proceeds, Ruvoll Ja?
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_002: P-Perfectly! Can't wait to start cooking, in fact.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_004: Not at all! In Tuliyollal, I never wanted for places to eat, so I never picked up the habit. You?
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_ANGGIR_000_005: If I had the time to develop culinary prowess, I'd rather be researching. As long as it's nutritionally sound, I take little heed of what I eat.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_A1_000_001: So I'm the only chef here?
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_A1_000_002: I could theoretically follow a recipe, I suppose...
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_010: A  of many talents, eh? But for the new dish I'm thinking of, we'll need specific help.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_020: Namely, help from the people of Iq Br'aax. To make the next xibruq pibil, their cooperation is paramount.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_21: I was hoping to show them what we've been growing in Gok Golma...
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_ANGGIR_000_023: That's a wonderful idea. Do you have any acquaintances in Iq Br'aax? I understand proactive communication may have been sparse, even in light of the peace accord.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_A1_100_001: Ty'at Roh from the Brethren of Br'aax is a friendly sort.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_A1_100_002: I'm sure Hunmu Rruk would be welcoming.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_024: You know Ty'at Roh as well? I met him when the brethren came through on official business. Lovely fellow!
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_025: I-I'm not sure I've got the courage to approach the Xbr'aax Rax directly. Maybe someone a little lower on the chain of command. For instance, there's a fellow named Ty'at Roh who'd lend us a friendly ear. He's always happy to chat when the Brethren of Br'aax visits on business.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_026: Let's see if we can't find him in Iq Br'aax!
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_ANGGIR_000_040: Ruvoll Ja seems even more excited than usual. It would be wonderful if his dream can be realized.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_041: Looks like we caught him on his return from patrol! I'm relieved.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_TYATROH_000_050: Ruvoll Ja! ! What odd-yet-welcome bedfellows! What can I do for you?
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_052: We had something to ask. You know about Gok Golma, right?
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_053: I was hoping that we could use the vegetables grown in our gainery to fashion a new sort of cuisine. Together, with Iq Br'aax.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_TYATROH_000_054: If it's cuisine you want, talk with Bol Tst'ei. Since retiring from the Brethren of Br'aax, he's become fascinated with cooking.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_TYATROH_000_055: He'll even travel all the way to Tuliyollal for ingredients to whip up some new, odd thing. And I'll vouch for the quality─I've enjoyed many a delicious supper from old Bol Tst'ei!
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_TYATROH_000_057: I saw him just now on the north side of town. If you hurry, you may be able to catch him!
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_058: Bol Tst'ei... Got it! Thank you, Ty'at Roh.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_TYATROH_000_060: According to Bol Tst'ei, there's no greater joy in life than cooking up new dishes. Check the north side of town and see if he's not there cooking, or thinking about cooking, or talking about cooking, or preparing to cook...
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_061: (Bol Tst'ei...Bol Tst'ei... Gods, let me pronounce his name correctly...)
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_070: I know your face, adventurer. But what business have you here, Mamool Ja?
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_071: P-Pardon me, sir, but are you Bol Tst'ei? We're looking for a culinary expert, and Ty'at Roh suggested we seek you out...
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_073: We've been growing vegetables in Mamook, you see. Crops of all colors, shapes, and sizes. And we wanted to make a new dish with our produce alongside our friends here in Iq Br'aax.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_074: So you'd have me cook for you? As your “friend”? You speak lightly of what you know little, boy.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_075: I grew up on stories of the old war and know all too well the facade of peace that has poisoned this forest. For years I've watched Mamook shift not an ilm, chasing false dreams of blessed siblings while looking down on us as lessers.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_076: ...You're right. I left Mamook for that very reason. I moved to Tuliyollal because I hated my homeland. But when I heard that my people stood on the precipice of change, I remembered how to hope.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_077: If the fruits of our labors can be shared with you─if our communities can make a new dish that puts the past behind us─that, I believe, will serve as real proof. It will be Mamook's first, purposeful step into a bigger, brighter world.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_078: ...I suppose having a look at these vegetables couldn't hurt. The company you keep certainly lends credence to your plea.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_079: Thank you, sir. Allow me to escort you to our gainery, Gok Golma.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_090: One step at a time. I have every confidence this will work.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_100: I can hardly believe... I never imagined the Ja Tiika Heartland could offer such yields...
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_101: I was hoping we could combine our ingredients. Crops from our gainery and the bounty from your forests. Just like xibruq pibil was made.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_102: Xibruq pibil? You dream big, boy, I'll give you that.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_103: These crops were first grown for Mamook's own welfare, but I would share them with our Xbr'aal brothers and sisters. I firmly believe that together, our peoples are stronger.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_ZEREELJA_000_107: Allow me to humbly beg your assistance as well.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_ZEREELJA_100_107: I have renounced the old teachings and acknowledge the mistakes of the past. Mamook must make amends. Will you not help us to do so?
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_108: If the Autarch himself is asking, I obviously stand in a brand-new Mamook.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_109: Very well. If you wish to join hands with us Xbr'aal, let us feast together once more.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_110: The bounties you have grown here will be reimagined into a dish befitting both our peoples.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_ZEREELJA_000_112: And you have done well with this gainery. ...It has given me much to think about regarding Iq Br'aax.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_ZEREELJA_000_113: Send word once preparations have been made. I should be glad to attend the banquet.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_114: We have our work cut out for us. Let's see this through.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_115: First of all, I'd like to know more about Mamool Ja culinary preferences. Could I ask you to conduct such a survey for me?
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_116: If you don't mind, I'll leave you to it, . I plan to return to Iq Br'aax.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_117: I'd like to invite as many people as I can to our banquet─including the Xbr'aax Rax, once I pluck up the nerve.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_118: Thank you. If we all work together, I just know we can make this a success!
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_150: Seems like you have a nice kitchen here as well. Let me know when you have an idea as to how I should be using it.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_TULIYOLLALHOOBIGO05: My favorite food? Well, I couldn't get enough of tacos when I was in Tuliyollal.
The weight of them in your hand, the satisfaction of biting in... You really felt like you were eating, you know? And Aunt Tii's signature spice! Mmm...
...Oh, but I'm sure whatever you end up making will also be good! If there's any way I can help, let me know!
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_OLDBOONEWA05259_000: Hmm... When I was young, I used to think meat was such a delicacy, but this belly of mine can't tolerate it much anymore.
Now I prefer the sweet vegetables we grow in that lovely garden of ours. I'm sure other old folk like myself feel similarly.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_FRIENDLYDOPPRO05259: My favorite dish is xibruq pibil! It was the talk of the city after the rite of succession.
Not only is the meat delicious, but knowing that our najool leaves play such a crucial role is a point of pride.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_190: You're back. What did you discover?
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_191: That's helpful, thank you. With a better understanding of folks' preferences, I believe I know what sort of dish we're looking for...
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_200: But we'll need natural yeast for the bread. Can you bring me some from Xd'aa Talat Tsoly?
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_205: But we'll need some Xbr'aal herbs for the right touch. Can you bring me some from Xd'aa Talat Tsoly?
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_210: But we'll need some Xbr'aal loach for the marinade. Could you fish me one from Xd'aa Talat Tsoly? They should bite at golden stonefly nymphs.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_220: Good. I'll start preparing the kitchen and other ingredients, so hurry back as soon as you can.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_230: Did you find what we need?
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_231: Yes, this'll do nicely. Good work. You can leave the rest of the preparations to me.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_000_232: I imagine Ruvoll Ja will be back soon. If there's anyone else you'd like to invite to the banquet, now would be the time.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_ANGGIR_000_240: Word has it that we're in for quite the feast!
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_ANGGIR_000_241: My role here has been strictly one of research and facilitating the growth of new crops in Mamook.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_ANGGIR_000_252: But it is a joy and honor to know that those very crops will now link two disparate peoples. Shall we go and assist the banquet preparations?
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_100_290: Feast your eyes upon Yak T'el's newest creation, the bounty of two forests...
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_BOLTSTEI_100_292: The Brethren of Br'aax supplied the game, and the farmers of Gok Golma the vegetables. After marinating the meat to juicy perfection, I placed it in soft, fresh bread and prepared a sweet-yet-spicy sauce for those who desire it.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_HUNMURRUK_000_301: I could hardly refuse Ruvoll Ja's impassioned entreaty, to say nothing of 's presence here today. I am simply fulfilling my duty as Xbr'aax Rax.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_ZEREELJA_000_302: Even so, I thank you for your attendance...and apologize for the wrongs we have done you.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_HUNMURRUK_000_303: Do you speak of Mamook's rejection of the peace forged by xibruq pibil?
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_HUNMURRUK_000_304: Or perhaps the tragic “accident” that befell my daughter sixteen years ago?
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_HUNMURRUK_000_306: Whether or not our communities join hands is a matter for the next generation to decide.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_HUNMURRUK_000_307: Seeing one and all gathered here today, I have little worry for the future.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_HUNMURRUK_000_308: But some evils can neither be forgotten nor forgiven. Sixteen years ago, an assassin was sent to kill my young daughter. By your order or influence, I know not, but the fact remains.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_ZEREELJA_100_308: ...A sin for which I would forfeit my life, if it would help our peoples choose the path of reconciliation.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_HUNMURRUK_000_309: Forfeiting your life again? I thought you were chided for that after the Feat of the Brotherhood.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_HUNMURRUK_100_309: From what I hear, you were offered friendship and community instead.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_HUNMURRUK_110_309: My daughter would never extend such offers lightly.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_HUNMURRUK_000_310: You underestimated the vivacity of my little girl. Today of all days, I will speak proudly of her strength and compassion...as her father.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_ZEREELJA_000_311: She survived... For this, I am truly grateful.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_313: Not so long ago, a sight like this would have been inconceivable.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_314: Mamook was never a place we could love. Being born here meant you either adhered to the zealotry of blessed siblings or escaped these forests forever.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_315: But now we have something real to be proud of. We owe so much to you and Anggir.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_ANGGIR_000_318: As I recall, it was because a certain someone eagerly suggested wivres that we were able to establish this gainery in the first place. Your devotion, Ruvoll Ja, garnered the cooperation of myriad peoples, which in turn has made Gok Golma blossom.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_319: Then we need to make sure that each new harvest brings joy to all in this forest.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_RUVOLLJA_000_320: For a Mamook we can love!
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_SYSTEM_000_326: With the cooperation of the Xbr'aal and creation of tiika selvaas, relations between Iq Br'aax and Mamook have improved.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_SYSTEM_000_327: Unprecedented cheer fills Mamook as her citizens regain pride and love for their homeland, Gok Golma the manifestation of their hopes for a brighter future...
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_SYSTEM_000_400: You have achieved Sworn reputation with the farmers of Gok Golma.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_SYSTEM_000_401: You will receive an experience point bonus upon the completion of Mamool Ja society daily quests.
TEXT_BANMAM005_05259_SYSTEM_000_402: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Veerul Ja.
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_RUVOLLJA_000_000: , perfect timing. Do you have a moment?
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_RUVOLLJA_000_001: Bol Tst'ei has some new recipes he'd like someone to try, so I thought you could come along.
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_RUVOLLJA_000_003: Great, then let's go and find him at the kitchen.
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_RUVOLLJA_000_010: Gok Golma has been abuzz with people recently─even visitors from outside the city!
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_BOLTSTEI_000_020: You brought  as well. Good, good, have a seat.
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_RUVOLLJA_000_021: Don't mind if we do! Let's see...
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_TYATROH_100_021: If it isn't  and Ruvoll Ja! Well met!
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_TYATROH_000_022: Mmm, now that smells amazing! Bol Tst'ei, give me a tiika selvaas, quick as you can!
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_RRALVAW_000_023: You're on the job, fool! We've just stopped by for a delivery, and next we've got our patrol. Straighten up, now!
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_TYATROH_000_024: But I could just down it in a gulp! <sigh> Never mind, after I get back from patrol, then...
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_TYATROH_000_029: See you later! I'll be back for that tiika selvaas─have one ready!
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_RUVOLLJA_000_030: Visits like these from the brethren or other folks from Iq Br'aax have become more and more commonplace. It fills me with pride to see it.
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_RUVOLLJA_000_031: But that aside, we were having a seat...
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_TULIYOLLALMAM05260_: Ruvoll Ja! I've got a question about our next crop rotation─could you spare a moment?
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_BOLTSTEI_000_034: Busy as ever, I see. Everyone wants Ruvoll Ja's ear these days. I thought I could give the poor lad some peace by having him try a new dish.
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_RUVOLLJA_000_036: Sorry, sorry! Let's eat, shall we?
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_BOLTSTEI_000_037: I've got three different projects I'm working on, and I'd be much obliged if you'd try one of them. Which'll it be?
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_BOLTSTEI_100_037: A salad of three fresh vegetables paired with Turali quinoa and served with smoked fish. Everything you need in one dish.
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_BOLTSTEI_110_037: A glowing tomato and onion base simmered till the ty'aitya meat melts in your mouth. I've got just the special blend of spices to curtail its natural gamy flavor.
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_BOLTSTEI_120_037: Feeling adventurous, are we? Well, I won't tell you what goes in it, lest I spoil the surprise.
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_SYSTEM_140_037: The sweet and crunchy vegetables pair perfectly with the smoked fish, and the grains add enjoyable texture. You polish off your serving in an instant!
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_SYSTEM_150_037: The stewed ty'aitya has a distinct, rich taste that you could get used to. You down the whole of it!
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_SYSTEM_160_037: Bracing yourself, you take a spoonful of mystery soup. You might as well have ... You .
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_BOLTSTEI_170_037: No need to give me your thoughts─all is written plain on your face. I'll eventually be adding these dishes to the menu, so come by whenever you have a hankering.
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_RUVOLLJA_000_050: I have to hand it to Bol Tst'ei─he really comes up with the most unique cuisine!
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_RUVOLLJA_000_051: Seeing everyone dine here makes me realize that food has become something more than just a means of survival for Mamook. It's become a source of joy.
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_RUVOLLJA_000_052: A happy side effect, perhaps, but I'm grateful nonetheless.
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_RUVOLLJA_000_053: Anyway, I have to go and chat with Anggir; apparently, she wants to consult me on something. Care to join?
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_RUVOLLJA_000_060: Without Anggir's knowledge, Gok Golma would still be but a flight of fancy. We owe her much and more.
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_ANGGIR_000_070: Oh, , you came along too. This works out nicely, then.
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_ANGGIR_000_071: I wanted to tell you that Gok Golma has been offered a place in the Turali Agricultural Association. Outside communities have officially come to recognize our efforts!
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_ANGGIR_100_071: Given how well our goals have been accomplished, I think it only natural that I consider a new pursuit.
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_RUVOLLJA_000_072: You don't mean...you're returning to Sharlayan?
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_ANGGIR_000_073: Hm? Oh, heavens no! I only meant to say that I intend to pursue a study of selective breeding!
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_ANGGIR_110_073: Crops more bountiful, flavorful, and nutritious than we have yet developed. Mamook's economy and reputation would surely stand to benefit─yet the thought that Gok Golma might rise to the heights of horticultural excellence is what thrills me. Don't you agree?
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_RUVOLLJA_000_075: Of course! I can think of no better way to show how much Mamook has changed. We may even convince more folks to return from Tuliyollal!
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_RUVOLLJA_000_076: As a Mamool Ja, Mamook is and always will be my homeland. I can now hold my head high when I say that.
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_RUVOLLJA_000_077: And that's only because you both were here to help. Thank you─I can't say it enough!
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_RUVOLLJA_000_081: , I'll keep doing what I can to help Anggir with her research, so if you ever find the time and inclination, feel free to stop by!
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_ANGGIR_000_082: We'll be waiting, ready to show you a gainery the likes of which you've never seen.
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_SYSTEM_000_100: You have achieved Bloodsworn reputation with the farmers of Gok Golma.
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_SYSTEM_000_101: You will receive an experience point bonus upon the completion of Mamool Ja society daily quests.
TEXT_BANMAM006_05260_SYSTEM_100_101: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Veerul Ja.
TEXT_BANMAM101_05261_KAGEELJA_000_000: The improved quality of the soil has done wonders for our budding crops, but the weeds have also seen fit to grow in abundance.
TEXT_BANMAM101_05261_KAGEELJA_000_001: A perfect opportunity to test a new concoction Anggir has devised to discourage their growth. Might I trouble you to help procure ingredients for it?
TEXT_BANMAM101_05261_KAGEELJA_000_002: The weeds in the fields seem to sprout nearly as fast as we can pull them. For a mercy, Anggir's weed killer has proven a boon in curbing their growth.
TEXT_BANMAM101_05261_KAGEELJA_000_003: I fear we're running low, however, so I would again ask that you help us procure ingredients.
TEXT_BANMAM101_05261_KAGEELJA_000_005: What we lack most at present is spring water from Cenote Neyozzote. Have care not to get lost─the paths there are said to be quite dark.
TEXT_BANMAM101_05261_KAGEELJA_000_006: If you search about Cenote Neyozzote, there are herbs whose oils are said to hinder the growth of other plants. Have care not to get lost, though─the paths are known to be quite dark.
TEXT_BANMAM101_05261_KAGEELJA_000_007: In the waters around Cenote Moxutural, there is a fish whose innards can be used to hinder the growth of weeds.
TEXT_BANMAM101_05261_KAGEELJA_000_008: They're said to be quite fond of golden stonefly nymphs, so I would suggest bringing a few to use as bait. You'll know when you've caught one.
TEXT_BANMAM101_05261_KAGEELJA_000_010: Bring me spring water from Cenote Neyozzote, and I will see to the rest.
TEXT_BANMAM101_05261_KAGEELJA_000_011: Bring me a bundle of the herbs we need from Cenote Neyozzote, and I will see to the rest.
TEXT_BANMAM101_05261_KAGEELJA_000_012: Bring me one of those fish from Cenote Moxutural, and I will see to the rest. Shouldn't take long for them to start biting with a golden stonefly nymph on your line.
TEXT_BANMAM101_05261_KAGEELJA_000_016: Excellent! With this, I imagine we'll not want for deterrent for quite some time.
TEXT_BANMAM101_05261_KAGEELJA_000_017: I can still remember when only a few hands were needed to quickly pick the weeds. That we need go to such lengths to contend with them can be frustrating, yet strangely gladdening.
TEXT_BANMAM101_05261_KAGEELJA_000_018: It is a reminder of the newfound bounty our land may provide given the proper care. Hope for a better tomorrow has taken root here in Yak T'el.
TEXT_BANMAM101_05261_KAGEELJA_000_019: That's not to say our work has become easier, of course─the resilience of the weeds has seen to that.
TEXT_BANMAM101_05261_KAGEELJA_000_020: Now, if you'll excuse me, there are crops that want for tending, and weeds for wilting.
TEXT_BANMAM102_05262_KAGEELJA_000_000: Ah, what fortuitous timing. We've been meaning to try enriching the fields with manure, you see, and...well... Might I trouble you to gather wivre leavings for us?
TEXT_BANMAM102_05262_KAGEELJA_000_001: Good to see you, my friend. You'll be happy to know the leavings you gathered for us proved more effective than we dared hope. In fact, we're of a mind to try more with different crops. Might I bother you to collect a few more sacks?
TEXT_BANMAM102_05262_KAGEELJA_000_002: You'll not have to look far in the Ja Tiika Heartland. The hunters there looking for mushrooms are, more often than not, accompanied by wivres. Should you see them, you're certain to find all that we need.
TEXT_BANMAM102_05262_KAGEELJA_000_003: Three sacks of leavings should suffice, I think. Once you have them, Kubeel Ja over in Gok Golma will gladly take them off your hands.
TEXT_BANMAM102_05262_CITIZENA05262_000_0: Kageel Ja told me I might find you out here. Well, if it's leavings you want, you're welcome to them. Take as much as you like.
TEXT_BANMAM102_05262_KUBEELJA_100_009: Welcome, friend. Judging by that odor, I take it Kageel Ja sent you?
TEXT_BANMAM102_05262_KUBEELJA_000_012: There it is! Didn't help much with growing the najool, but I can think of a few crops worth trying this with.
TEXT_BANMAM102_05262_KUBEELJA_000_013: Wonderful. I know just where to use this. You have my thanks, friend.
TEXT_BANMAM102_05262_KUBEELJA_000_014: Thanks again for all your help. Give my regards to Kageel Ja, won't you?
TEXT_BANMAM102_05262_KAGEELJA_000_015: You're back! Empty-handed, but you carry the unmistakable smell of a job well done.
TEXT_BANMAM102_05262_KAGEELJA_000_016: Compost made from fallen leaves and such was fine when we only had najool to worry about, but a more diverse selection of crops calls for richer soil. And that's where animal manure comes in.
TEXT_BANMAM102_05262_KAGEELJA_000_017: Dirty business, I know, but a ready supply of leavings is a blessing we can ill afford to ignore.
TEXT_BANMAM103_05263_KAGEELJA_000_001: We recently received a request from Anggir for samples of the vegetation here. Apparently, she's keen to know what effect they have, if any, on our crops.
TEXT_BANMAM103_05263_KAGEELJA_000_002: Anggir's tests on the crops are going well, but she has need for more materials if you'd be willing to lend a hand.
TEXT_BANMAM103_05263_KAGEELJA_000_003: Plants with a unique aetheric signature such as those in Cenote Jayunja would likely make for the best candidates.
TEXT_BANMAM103_05263_KAGEELJA_000_004: The moss-covered rocks there would almost certainly be a boon to her work. Might you be willing to go and collect a few samples?
TEXT_BANMAM103_05263_KAGEELJA_000_005: A sampling of the foliage there would almost certainly be a boon to her work. Might you be willing to go and collect some?
TEXT_BANMAM103_05263_KAGEELJA_000_006: A sampling of the algae there would almost certainly be a boon to her work. Might you be willing to go and collect some? Golden stonefly nymphs are said to be drawn to the stuff, so they may help you find what we require.
TEXT_BANMAM103_05263_KAGEELJA_000_010: Anggir would be ever so grateful for any moss-covered rock samples you can find.
TEXT_BANMAM103_05263_KAGEELJA_000_011: Anggir would be ever so grateful for any promising foliage samples you can find.
TEXT_BANMAM103_05263_KAGEELJA_000_012: Anggir would be ever so grateful for any algae samples you can find.
TEXT_BANMAM103_05263_KAGEELJA_000_020: So, were you able to find anything promising?
TEXT_BANMAM103_05263_KAGEELJA_000_021: My, what a fine specimen. Anggir will be thrilled!
TEXT_BANMAM103_05263_KAGEELJA_000_022: Someday soon, we hope to fully understand the power of the meteorite that invigorates the trees of living light, and this research is a most important first step.
TEXT_BANMAM103_05263_KAGEELJA_000_023: Imagine the possibilities─we would be able to choose varieties of crops better suited to the land, or perhaps even create altogether new ones! I can hardly wait to see how her work bears fruit.
TEXT_BANMAM104_05264_KAGEELJA_000_001: Given the lack of direct sunlight here in the Ja Tiika Heartland, the cooler temperatures of the soil continue to be a point of concern.
TEXT_BANMAM104_05264_KAGEELJA_000_002: Thankfully for us, Anggir has arrived at a solution─fermented fertilizer. Apparently, it invigorates the soil, generating heat as the compost decomposes.
TEXT_BANMAM104_05264_KAGEELJA_000_003: The fermented fertilizer has proven more effective than we dared hope, which is why I would ask you help us procure more materials.
TEXT_BANMAM104_05264_KAGEELJA_000_004: That's not to discount the efforts of the Boonewa mages, mind you. Their illuminations have also helped to warm the soil. Which is why our combined efforts will make the fields all the more productive.
TEXT_BANMAM104_05264_KAGEELJA_000_005: For your part, I need you to find some suitable soil around Cenote Neyozzote. It should contain traces of organic material essential for fermentation.
TEXT_BANMAM104_05264_KAGEELJA_000_006: For your part, I need you to find some sodden tree bark around Cenote Neyozzote. The excess water makes it easier to ferment.
TEXT_BANMAM104_05264_KAGEELJA_000_007: For your part, I need you to catch a mudfish in the waters around Moxutural Zooj. They're fairly small, which makes them perfect for fishmeal.
TEXT_BANMAM104_05264_KAGEELJA_000_008: If you have trouble getting them to bite, try golden stonefly nymphs. They're sure to be tugging on your line in no time at all.
TEXT_BANMAM104_05264_KAGEELJA_000_009: When you've finished, take anything you find to Kubeel Ja.
TEXT_BANMAM104_05264_KUBEELJA_000_013: Kageel Ja tells me you're bringing supplies for the new fertilizer. Well, my hands are quite full at the moment, so I'll take any help I can get.
TEXT_BANMAM104_05264_KUBEELJA_000_014: Arrived with those fertilizer supplies, have you? Well, let's have them.
TEXT_BANMAM104_05264_KUBEELJA_000_018: Wonderful. I'll get to mixing the fertilizer right away.
TEXT_BANMAM104_05264_KUBEELJA_000_019: Thanks again for those supplies. Won't be long before we have a fresh new pile of fertilizer.
TEXT_BANMAM104_05264_KAGEELJA_000_020: Finished handing off the supplies, I see. Kubeel Ja must have been thrilled.
TEXT_BANMAM104_05264_KAGEELJA_000_021: And relieved, I'm sure. The right soil temperature is absolutely crucial during the budding stage.
TEXT_BANMAM104_05264_KAGEELJA_000_022: With this fertilizer, the fields are certain to thrive, so I hope you'll help keep us stocked with supplies.
TEXT_BANMAM105_05265_KAGEELJA_000_001: Say, . If you plan to be out and about, I don't suppose you could procure us some najool stems from Golmajiik Grove?
TEXT_BANMAM105_05265_KAGEELJA_000_002: In case you're wondering about the sudden demand, Anggir requires a few specimens for testing. Seems she has plans to repurpose them.
TEXT_BANMAM105_05265_KAGEELJA_000_003: I'm told the last batch you brought us yielded promising results, but Anggir requires more data...and more specimens for testing, of course.
TEXT_BANMAM105_05265_KAGEELJA_000_004: In any event, we'll have plenty of time to discuss her experiments further when you return. Once you arrive at the grove, tell Kiishel Ja I sent you. She'll supply you with the stems we need.
TEXT_BANMAM105_05265_KIISHELJA_000_005: Here on behalf of Kageel Ja, yes? The stems are ready and waiting─feel free to take as many as you need.
TEXT_BANMAM105_05265_KIISHELJA_000_006: It does my heart good to know they won't be going to waste. Send the folks at the gainery my best regards!
TEXT_BANMAM105_05265_KAGEELJA_000_007: Welcome back. How fared your trip to the grove?
TEXT_BANMAM105_05265_KAGEELJA_000_008: Much obliged, . These are excellent samples...and sufficiently fibrous, as well.
TEXT_BANMAM105_05265_KAGEELJA_000_009: Najool stems are found where the fruit meets the leaves, you see. To the undisciplined eye, one might mistake them for a part of the tree trunk. While they are perfectly edible, we tend to dispose of them after the harvest.
TEXT_BANMAM105_05265_KAGEELJA_000_010: Anggir, however, believes their naturally occurring fibers could be utilized to craft string and cloth. And with these samples at her disposal, she'll be able to put those theories to the proof.
TEXT_BANMAM105_05265_KAGEELJA_000_011: As you might expect, Anggir's success has only strengthened her resolve to craft textiles from these stem fibers, so she's eager to continue her research.
TEXT_BANMAM105_05265_KAGEELJA_000_012: If we require any more of them in the future, I'll be sure to keep you informed.
TEXT_BANMAM106_05266_KAGEELJA_000_001: Fieldwork takes its toll on all of us─our tools included. Daily upkeep is as vital to a tool as good soil is to our crops.
TEXT_BANMAM106_05266_KAGEELJA_000_002: That said, repair supplies are in high demand around the gainery, and we could use a hand replenishing our stock.
TEXT_BANMAM106_05266_KAGEELJA_000_003: We're currently in need of aqueous tsolystones─you'll find them north of the dirigible landing. The Xbr'aal often sharpen their scythe blades with those stones, and we'd do well to learn from their example.
TEXT_BANMAM106_05266_KAGEELJA_000_004: To prevent their tools from rusting, the Xbr'aal often coat their tools with natural plant oils from the Ut'ohmu Horizon, and we mean to do the same. I'm told you'll be able to gather your fill by Yak Awak Tsoly.
TEXT_BANMAM106_05266_KAGEELJA_000_005: The soft flesh of tsoly sponges is ideal for keeping our tools free of dirt and grime. The Xbr'aal use them regularly as well. As their name implies, you'll find them dwelling among the fresh waters of Yak Awak Tsoly.
TEXT_BANMAM106_05266_KAGEELJA_000_006: They're quite fond of golden stonefly nymphs, so I suggest you stock up on them if you haven't already.
TEXT_BANMAM106_05266_KAGEELJA_000_007: Once you've gathered enough, make for the fields and find Kubeel Ja, who manages our tool supply. He'll see to it that your provisions are put to good use.
TEXT_BANMAM106_05266_KUBEELJA_100_010: Ah, I take it you're the one responsible for procuring the repair supplies? Travel to the upper reaches of the forest is, well... It's no easy journey for us, you understand. Your assistance is much appreciated.
TEXT_BANMAM106_05266_KUBEELJA_100_011: You must be the one Kageel Ja mentioned. Here to contribute some repair supplies for the tools, yes?
TEXT_BANMAM106_05266_KUBEELJA_100_012: Hm... This should do nicely. I'll add it to the storehouse as soon as I'm able. Many thanks for the assistance.
TEXT_BANMAM106_05266_KUBEELJA_200_012: You have a good eye for quality materials, friend. I'll be sure to bring your supplies to the storehouse as soon as I'm able.
TEXT_BANMAM106_05266_KAGEELJA_000_013: There you are, . I hear you made quick work of procuring the extra repair supplies.
TEXT_BANMAM106_05266_KAGEELJA_000_014: You have my thanks. Every tool inevitably takes on wear and tear with time─even more so with daily use. Proper maintenance and care is essential if we're to keep them in tip-top condition.
TEXT_BANMAM106_05266_KAGEELJA_000_015: The same can be said for the folks who use the tools as well. So when your body needs a break, you'd best listen to it, you hear? We've plenty more to ask of you, after all, and we'd prefer you stay well rested for the tasks ahead!
TEXT_BANMAM107_05267_KAGEELJA_000_001: Maintaining our fields' soil quality is a daunting task, but a necessary one─and one I'd like your assistance with, if you don't mind.
TEXT_BANMAM107_05267_KAGEELJA_000_002: You recall the materials we used as fertilizer before we planted our first crop, yes? Our supply is dwindling, so we'll need to replenish our stores with items of similar quality, and soon.
TEXT_BANMAM107_05267_KAGEELJA_000_003: Given the soil's current condition, I believe some sandstone from the Xobr'it Cinderfield should serve us well. I realize it's a bit of a journey, but the results will be well worth it, I'm sure.
TEXT_BANMAM107_05267_KAGEELJA_000_004: Given the soil's current condition, I believe some deadwood from the Xobr'it Cinderfield should serve us well. I realize it's a bit of a journey, but the results will be well worth it, I'm sure.
TEXT_BANMAM107_05267_KAGEELJA_000_005: Given the soil's current condition, an Iq Rrax whelk should serve us well. You'll have no trouble reeling them in as long as there's a golden stonefly nymph at the end of your line.
TEXT_BANMAM107_05267_KAGEELJA_000_006: Once you reach the Xobr'it Cinderfield, keep your eyes open for that sandstone. It should provide just the right amount of nutrients for our soil to thrive.
TEXT_BANMAM107_05267_KAGEELJA_000_007: Once you reach the Xobr'it Cinderfield, keep your eyes open for deadwood logs. They should provide just the right amount of nutrients for our soil to thrive.
TEXT_BANMAM107_05267_KAGEELJA_000_008: An Iq Rrax whelk should provide just the right amount of nutrients for our soil to thrive. Hook a golden stonefly nymph to your line, and you'll be reeling one in before you can say “najool!”
TEXT_BANMAM107_05267_KAGEELJA_000_009: Good to see you returned, . I take it you found our materials without issue?
TEXT_BANMAM107_05267_KAGEELJA_000_010: Ah, quality specimens, as usual. This is a great help to us.
TEXT_BANMAM107_05267_KAGEELJA_000_011: The soil wants for nutrients after the harvest, and any new fields we plow will demand supplementary fertilizer as well, so your contributions will go a long way towards a more bountiful crop. I hope I can count on you again when next our supplies grow sparse.
TEXT_BANMAM108_05268_KAGEELJA_000_001: The branchbearers are hard at work fighting the pests that plague our garden. I want to give them everything they need to thrive.
TEXT_BANMAM108_05268_KAGEELJA_000_002: Fortunately, the forest has all the materials we require. Might I count on you for their retrieval?
TEXT_BANMAM108_05268_KAGEELJA_000_003: Thanks, . I'd be much obliged if you could extract a few vials of energy-imbued water from mineral deposits near Cenote Neyozzote. They say that the water can bring out the best in a branchbearer's glow.
TEXT_BANMAM108_05268_KAGEELJA_000_004: Thanks, . I'd be much obliged if you could gather young leaves from trees around Cenote Neyozzote. The soft foliage will provide comfortable beds for our friends.
TEXT_BANMAM108_05268_KAGEELJA_000_005: Thanks, . I'd be much obliged if you could retrieve a waterweed fish from Cenote Moxutural. Branchbearers seem to love the things, perhaps due to the fish's affinity with algae. You'll have no trouble reeling one in using golden stonefly nymphs as bait.
TEXT_BANMAM108_05268_KAGEELJA_000_006: I'd be much obliged if you extracted a few vials of energy-imbued water from deposits around Cenote Neyozzote. Let's give the branchbearers all that they need.
TEXT_BANMAM108_05268_KAGEELJA_000_007: I'd be much obliged if you gathered young leaves from trees around Cenote Neyozzote. Let's give the branchbearers all that they need.
TEXT_BANMAM108_05268_KAGEELJA_000_008: I'd be much obliged if you retrieved a waterweed fish from Cenote Moxutural. The fish can be reeled in using golden stonefly nymphs as bait.
TEXT_BANMAM108_05268_KAGEELJA_000_010: Were you able to find what we need?
TEXT_BANMAM108_05268_KAGEELJA_000_011: Ah, this is perfect! Thank you, . The branchbearers will be delighted.
TEXT_BANMAM108_05268_KAGEELJA_000_012: The way they chirp and flap their wings when receiving treats never fails to move my heart. Maybe it's an odd thing to say about an expressionless plant, but I think they're cute...
TEXT_BANMAM108_05268_KAGEELJA_000_013: I'll do my best to deepen my understanding of the branchbearers so that we can provide the ideal habitat for them. I hope you'll continue to support our efforts!
TEXT_BANMAM109_05269_KAGEELJA_000_001: The branchbearers have proven extremely effective at culling the pests infesting our crops.
TEXT_BANMAM109_05269_KAGEELJA_000_002: Yet there are limits to what they can do, which is why we have decided to introduce a repellent long used in Golmajiik Grove. Anggir had some ideas on how we could improve it for use in the gainery.
TEXT_BANMAM109_05269_KAGEELJA_000_003: The repellent you helped us prepare last time worked wonders─so much so that we've already depleted our stock. Naturally, we're looking to make more.
TEXT_BANMAM109_05269_KAGEELJA_000_004: I was hoping you might assist us by procuring the materials we need.
TEXT_BANMAM109_05269_KAGEELJA_000_005: North of the dirigible landing, you can mine ore which contains a substance the insects abhor. Could I trouble you to retrieve some?
TEXT_BANMAM109_05269_KAGEELJA_000_006: The sap extracted from trees roundabouts Yak Awak Tsoly contains a substance the insects abhor. Could I trouble you to extract some?
TEXT_BANMAM109_05269_KAGEELJA_000_007: The waterweeds found in the waters of Yak Awak Tsoly contain a substance the insects abhor. You should have no trouble gathering some using golden stonefly nymphs as bait.
TEXT_BANMAM109_05269_KAGEELJA_000_008: Ore mined north of the dirigible landing contains a substance that the pests hate. Any you find would be welcome.
TEXT_BANMAM109_05269_KAGEELJA_000_009: Sap extracted from trees in the vicinity of Yak Awak Tsoly contains a substance the pests hate. Any you find would be welcome.
TEXT_BANMAM109_05269_KAGEELJA_000_010: We can extract a substance from the waterweeds of Yak Awak Tsoly that the pests hate. You should have no trouble gathering some by offering golden stonefly nymphs as bait.
TEXT_BANMAM109_05269_KAGEELJA_000_015: Welcome back, . Were you able to find what I requested?
TEXT_BANMAM109_05269_KAGEELJA_000_016: Excellent, this is precisely what we need for our repellent.
TEXT_BANMAM109_05269_KAGEELJA_000_017: The vegetation of the upper forests is quite different than that of the Ja Tiika Heartland. Indeed, the environment there contains many properties harmful to our local pests. In some ways you could say there's no end to this forest's inner conflict.
TEXT_BANMAM109_05269_KAGEELJA_000_018: Yet by joining hands, those selfsame disparities can become a boon. ...I could get sentimental just thinking about it.
TEXT_BANMAM109_05269_KAGEELJA_000_019: Ahem. As we plan to make regular use of this repellent, I hope we can count on you again sometime.
TEXT_BANMAM110_05270_KAGEELJA_000_001: Can I interest you in an herbal compress to soothe your hurts?
TEXT_BANMAM110_05270_KAGEELJA_000_002: I daresay such an offer would be welcome to our farmers, hard at work in the gainery day after day. I requested Anggir to create them specially.
TEXT_BANMAM110_05270_KAGEELJA_000_003: And so she did─in fact, she made more than enough for everyone in Gok Golma!
TEXT_BANMAM110_05270_KAGEELJA_000_004: The compresses you distributed last time are the talk of the town, and Anggir was kind enough to make more for us.
TEXT_BANMAM110_05270_KAGEELJA_000_005: I'll make sure everyone here gets one, but if you could distribute some in Mamook, that would be a great help.
TEXT_BANMAM110_05270_KAGEELJA_000_006: Try to prioritize the elderly and those involved in physical labor, if possible.
TEXT_BANMAM110_05270_BACHAN05270_000_010: When you reach my age, climbing a staircase becomes an ordeal in itself. Ah, but what do we have here?
TEXT_BANMAM110_05270_BACHAN05270_000_011: My... The ache in my knees is completely gone! I must say, that is one effective compress.
TEXT_BANMAM110_05270_BACHAN05270_000_012: Oh wonderful, you've brought another compress! ...Ah, and just like that, the pain is gone. I can't thank you enough, my dear.
TEXT_BANMAM110_05270_JICHAN05270_000_014: A compress? Fine, I'll humor you. Not like it'll do any─
TEXT_BANMAM110_05270_JICHAN05270_000_015: Gods, that's good! My back hasn't felt like this in ages. You have my thanks.
TEXT_BANMAM110_05270_JICHAN05270_000_016: One of those compresses again? Well, don't mind if I do. It eases my back pain like nothing else. I appreciate it.
TEXT_BANMAM110_05270_NICHAN05270_000_017: With our rounds finished and training completed, I'd say we can pack it up for the day. ...Oh, didn't see you there. How can I help you?
TEXT_BANMAM110_05270_NICHAN05270_000_018: ...Incredible. Like the ephemeral glow of a tree of living light, so too does my pain go quietly into the misty night.
TEXT_BANMAM110_05270_NICHAN05270_000_019: ...A truly soothing compress. I feel lighter than air, as though I've been blessed with wings that will bear me upon this heavenly scent to the very seat of the gods eternal.
TEXT_BANMAM110_05270_KAGEELJA_000_020: Thank you for distributing the compresses. Did people take a liking to them?
TEXT_BANMAM110_05270_KAGEELJA_000_021: Wonderful, I am glad that they were well received. Anggir analyzed medicinal herbs from both the lower and upper forests to create an effective remedial agent for us Mamool Ja, you see.
TEXT_BANMAM110_05270_KAGEELJA_000_022: I mention this in case you are tempted to try one of the compresses for yourself─the stimulation may be too much. Perhaps she can further adapt the formula, and one day make compresses that can be used by all. No doubt they would be popular in a place like Tuliyollal.
TEXT_BANMAM110_05270_KAGEELJA_000_023: Until then, I believe she intends to make additional prototypes until she's satisfied with their quality. Please lend me a hand when the time comes to distribute them again.
TEXT_BANMAM111_05271_KAGEELJA_000_001: After consulting Anggir, we've decided to use Sharlayan-developed growth formula on our crops.
TEXT_BANMAM111_05271_KAGEELJA_000_002: Due to the unique properties of our forest, however, the ingredients need to be modified. I was hoping you could gather some local materials for us.
TEXT_BANMAM111_05271_KAGEELJA_000_003: The growth formula you helped us create last time was very effective. I was hoping we could count on you again for additional batches.
TEXT_BANMAM111_05271_KAGEELJA_000_004: Salt of living light from Cenote Jayunja should be just what we need.
TEXT_BANMAM111_05271_KAGEELJA_000_005: Mushrooms of living light from Cenote Jayunja should be just what we need.
TEXT_BANMAM111_05271_KAGEELJA_000_006: Shellfish of living light from Cenote Jayunja should be just what we need. You can reel them in with golden stonefly nymphs.
TEXT_BANMAM111_05271_KAGEELJA_000_007: Once you reach Cenote Jayunja, you should be able to mine salt of living light from rocky outcrops in the area. We'll need some to concoct our growth formula, so I'm counting on you.
TEXT_BANMAM111_05271_KAGEELJA_000_008: Once you reach Cenote Jayunja, you should be able to find plenty of mushrooms of living light in the area. We'll need them to concoct our growth formula, so I'm counting on you.
TEXT_BANMAM111_05271_KAGEELJA_000_009: Once you reach Cenote Jayunja, you should be able to catch shellfish of living light by using golden stonefly nymphs. We'll need the shellfish for our growth formula, so I'm counting on you.
TEXT_BANMAM111_05271_KAGEELJA_000_010: Were you able to procure what I requested?
TEXT_BANMAM111_05271_KAGEELJA_000_011: You never disappoint, . This is exactly what we need.
TEXT_BANMAM111_05271_KAGEELJA_000_012: I understand from Anggir that growth formula is commonly used to strengthen flora and boost yields in lands across the salt.
TEXT_BANMAM111_05271_KAGEELJA_000_013: I'm always interested to learn about different farming techniques, and with our knowledge combined, I'm certain our gainery will flourish. I hope you'll stay alongside us as it does!
TEXT_BANMAM112_05272_KAGEELJA_000_001: Sorry, , but I need you to make a trip to the upper forest. Are you up for it?
TEXT_BANMAM112_05272_KAGEELJA_000_002: Our gainery is the new face of Mamook, so I'd like it to be tidy and well-kept for all who come to visit.
TEXT_BANMAM112_05272_KAGEELJA_000_003: With that said, I'd be grateful if you collected some Ut'ohmu natron from the vicinity of Iq Br'aax. It can be used as a cleaning agent.
TEXT_BANMAM112_05272_KAGEELJA_000_004: With that said, I'd be grateful if you collected some concentrated Ut'ohmu plant oil from the vicinity of Iq Br'aax. It can be used as a cleaning agent.
TEXT_BANMAM112_05272_KAGEELJA_000_005: With that said, I'd be grateful if you collected an Ut'ohmu trout from Xd'aa Talat Tsoly. We can extract a decent polishing agent from it.
TEXT_BANMAM112_05272_KAGEELJA_000_006: Be sure to use golden stonefly nymphs as bait. We have some for sale here, in case you weren't aware.
TEXT_BANMAM112_05272_KAGEELJA_000_007: I would be grateful if you collected some Ut'ohmu natron from around Iq Br'aax. We'll need it as a cleaning agent.
TEXT_BANMAM112_05272_KAGEELJA_000_008: I would be grateful if you collected some concentrated Ut'ohmu plant oil from around Iq Br'aax. We'll need it as a cleaning agent.
TEXT_BANMAM112_05272_KAGEELJA_000_009: I would be grateful if you caught an Ut'ohmu trout from Xd'aa Talat Tsoly. We can extract a decent polishing agent from it.
TEXT_BANMAM112_05272_KAGEELJA_000_010: Be sure to bait your line with golden stonefly nymphs.
TEXT_BANMAM112_05272_KAGEELJA_000_012: Perfect, exactly what I requested. Thank you.
TEXT_BANMAM112_05272_KAGEELJA_000_013: You may have noticed during your venture, but the Xbr'aal people also use such cleaning agents in their daily lives.
TEXT_BANMAM112_05272_KAGEELJA_000_014: The upper forest is far more exposed to the elements, which requires greater structural maintenance and upkeep.
TEXT_BANMAM112_05272_KAGEELJA_000_015: So when I noticed our buildings needed some brushing up, I consulted our Xbr'aal neighbors. They were good enough to recommend some materials, and invited us to gather as much as we needed. If it's to keep this place presentable, I may well take them up on that offer again...
TEXT_BANMAM113_05273_KAGEELJA_000_000: The quick work the branchbearers made of those pesky bugs is the talk of Golmajiik Grove. In fact, I've recently received a request for pest control over there.
TEXT_BANMAM113_05273_KAGEELJA_000_001: You can ride, can't you? Hop onto one of our birds and direct its energies towards our najool. Rest assured you'll be rewarded for your work.
TEXT_BANMAM113_05273_KAGEELJA_000_002: I received word that the pests have stayed away from the najool for the most part, but we'll never be rid of them for good. Mind riding over to the grove for a little upkeep?
TEXT_BANMAM113_05273_KAGEELJA_000_003: Ziraal Ja has been training our branchbearers, so he'll have a mount ready for you. Have fun, !
TEXT_BANMAM113_05273_ZIRAALJA_060_008: Here for a branchbearer? You're in luck─I have just the one for you.
TEXT_BANMAM113_05273_ZIRAALJA_070_008: Now, if you fall off for whatever reason, just come back here. The birds can find their way back home on their own.
TEXT_BANMAM113_05273_ZIRAALJA_080_008: Once you're finished with your work in the grove, you can go ahead and report directly to Kageel Ja.
TEXT_BANMAM113_05273_ZIRAALJA_090_008: Ah, you made it back. The branchbearer arrived not too long ago, so go ahead and mount up again. Better luck this time.
TEXT_BANMAM113_05273_SYSTEM_100_008: Kageel Ja needs your help ridding the najool of pests. Speak with Ziraal Ja to mount a branchbearer and use its Shrouded Luminescence ability on the najool.
TEXT_BANMAM113_05273_CITIZENB05273_000_0: (-Golmajiik Grove Worker-)Now we'll be rid of those bugs... Thank you, truly.
TEXT_BANMAM113_05273_KAGEELJA_000_010: Good work over in Golmajiik Grove, ! I heard that the branchbearer found its way back, as well.
TEXT_BANMAM113_05273_KAGEELJA_000_011: Bugs love najool, and keeping them away is a constant battle. But now we have an edge in that fight, and for that we're grateful.
TEXT_BANMAM113_05273_KAGEELJA_000_012: Gok Golma was created to serve the good of Mamook, and better najool harvests are a boon for everyone. Cooperation with Golmajiik Grove is the surest path to prosperity.
TEXT_BANMAM113_05273_KAGEELJA_000_013: I'm sure Golmajiik Grove is relieved to have fewer bugs buzzing around. Too many can affect the harvest, and that affects us all.
TEXT_BANMAM113_05273_KAGEELJA_000_014: That being said, pests are called that for a reason. They'll return, and when they do, I hope I can call on you once again.
TEXT_BANMAM114_05274_KAGEELJA_000_000: , are you free for some gathering on the Ut'ohmu Horizon? Anggir needs samples for her research.
TEXT_BANMAM114_05274_KAGEELJA_000_001: She's hoping to see if Gok Golma's development has affected the flow of ambient energy in Yak T'el. I'll collect samples from the Ja Tiika Heartland, so with your help we can form a full picture of our gainery's influence.
TEXT_BANMAM114_05274_KAGEELJA_000_005: Anggir said she'd like stones from the Xobr'it Cinderfield. Simple enough if you can handle the trek, eh?
TEXT_BANMAM114_05274_KAGEELJA_000_006: Anggir said she'd like bark from trees in the Xobr'it Cinderfield. Simple enough if you can handle the trek, eh?
TEXT_BANMAM114_05274_KAGEELJA_000_007: Anggir said she'd like a moss sample from Iq Rrax Tsoly. Simple enough if you can handle the trek, eh? Remember to bring golden stonefly nymphs for bait.
TEXT_BANMAM114_05274_KAGEELJA_000_010: Remember, Anggir is looking for stones from the Xobr'it Cinderfield. It's rather far, but I trust your legs are up for it.
TEXT_BANMAM114_05274_KAGEELJA_000_011: Remember, Anggir is looking for bark from the Xobr'it Cinderfield. It's rather far, but I trust your legs are up for it.
TEXT_BANMAM114_05274_KAGEELJA_000_012: Remember, Anggir is looking for a moss sample from Iq Rrax Tsoly. It's rather far, but I trust your legs are up for it. Oh, and don't forget your golden stonefly nymphs.
TEXT_BANMAM114_05274_KAGEELJA_000_015: You're back even quicker than I expected, . Were you able to find the samples Anggir asked for?
TEXT_BANMAM114_05274_KAGEELJA_000_016: Ah, she'll be quite pleased with this. Excellent work!
TEXT_BANMAM114_05274_KAGEELJA_000_017: You know, Anggir has actually been studying the flow of energy around the area ever since Gok Golma was established.
TEXT_BANMAM114_05274_KAGEELJA_000_018: We've done quite a bit of work on the gainery since then, but our accomplishments would mean little if we're negatively impacting the forest as a whole. Anggir takes these inspections very seriously.
TEXT_BANMAM114_05274_KAGEELJA_000_019: So you can see why we needed your trustworthy hands for the task. We would be grateful if you could help us when we need samples again.
TEXT_BANMAM114_05274_KAGEELJA_000_020: These samples will help us understand how the forest is doing for now. I hope you'll lend us a hand when Anggir does her next survey.
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_KAGEELJA_000_001: With the fields sown, the plants grown, and our stores flush with vegetables, Gok Golma is meeting every expectation!
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_KAGEELJA_000_002: But despite all our success, many in Mamook remain unaware of the bounty in their midst.
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_KAGEELJA_000_003: Which is why I'd like you to take to the streets and use your considerable fame to help share the gainery's latest news with everyone.
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_KAGEELJA_000_006: Well...maybe not everyone. But if you could let, say, three or so people know that the vegetables are ready to eat, then word of mouth should do the rest.
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_KAGEELJA_000_004: Ah, . Thanks to your well-placed proclamations, the number of customers visiting our humble stall grows day by day.
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_KAGEELJA_000_005: Even so, we'd like to keep reminding people that fresh vegetables are available whenever they need them. Would you mind heading out again and spreading word of the gainery's ripened produce?
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_MOB05275A_000_007: I'm still wondering what to have for dinner tonight. Najool and fish stew is all well and good, but I get tired of the same flavors...
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_MOB05275A_000_008: Hm, what to make for dinner... Those vegetables we had last time were such a refreshing─and delicious─change from the usual fare. Perhaps I'll pick up something from the gainery.
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_SYSTEM_000_009: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing the words “The gainery has fresh vegetables” to let people know the stall has produce available.
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_MOB05275A_000_010: What's this? What vegetables? Najool is the only crop that grows around here...
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_MOB05275A_000_011: I knew they were trying something, but you say the fields produced so much they could open a stall? That's wonderful! I need to head over right now and see what they have!
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_MOB05275A_000_013: Oh, it's you! Thank you for bringing that stall to my attention─I could hardly believe how good those vegetables tasted!
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_MOB05275A_000_014: And you say they have fresh stock available? I've gone from having practically no choice to almost too much to choose from, but that's a problem I'm more than happy to face when it comes to mealtime.
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_MOB05275B_000_015: What shall I eat for dinner today? It'd be nice to have something new for a change...
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_MOB05275B_000_016: What a treat. I haven't had greens like that in, well, ever. I should visit the gainery again...
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_MOB05275B_000_017: Speak up, young one. Did I hear you say “fresh vegetables”?
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_MOB05275B_000_018: Grew them at that gainery, did they? Yes, I might just take a look at this fresh produce of yours. I'm so tired of najool, I can barely remember what meal I'm up to...
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_MOB05275B_000_019: Oh, it's you again! My old girl and I tried those gainery greens, and I swear they had us chirping like hatchlings.
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_MOB05275B_000_020: The fact you managed to grow any new crops at all beneath these gloomy trees is cause for celebration. They'll be seeing me at that stall again, you can be sure of that.
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_MOB05275C_000_021: Phew, what a day. Now, what to do with the rest of it...
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_MOB05275C_000_022: Phew, what a day. Time to make another visit...
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_MOB05275C_000_023: Who!? What!? Oh, hello. Were you talking about...vegetables?
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_MOB05275C_000_024: Ah yes, I'd heard they were growing crops over there. And harvesting enough to sell the surplus, it seems. This is great news, thank you for letting me know!
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_MOB05275C_000_026: They have fresh produce again today? That's good, because I was just about to pay their stall a visit.
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_MOB05275C_000_027: Maybe I'll make a fried mushroom and vegetable dish. Or slice and grill them to eat alongside a nice brew. So many possibilities!
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_KAGEELJA_000_028: It seems you have a knack for promotions! We've had several customers say they came to pick up produce after meeting you in town.
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_KAGEELJA_000_029: As a farmer, nothing brings me more joy than hearing people praise the taste of our wares. We'll have to work hard, though, if we're to keep up a steady supply of good, quality vegetables.
TEXT_BANMAM115_05275_KAGEELJA_000_030: We all have our parts to play, and we're grateful for any help you can offer!
TEXT_BANMAM116_05276_KAGEELJA_000_001: We've had markedly less trouble with wildlife since our Hoobigo brethren began guarding the gainery.
TEXT_BANMAM116_05276_KAGEELJA_000_002: They've become an irreplaceable part of our operations, and as such, we would like to provide what they need to keep their arms and armor maintained. Can I ask your help in procuring these supplies?
TEXT_BANMAM116_05276_KAGEELJA_000_003: Speaking of which, they were most impressed with the repair supplies you procured for their weapons last time. Which is why I would like to ask you to do so again.
TEXT_BANMAM116_05276_KAGEELJA_000_004: I'm told the rock mined from around Cenote Jayunja makes perfect whetstones for honing and polishing the bone weaponry favored by our guards. Bring me a selection, and I'll see them into the right hands.
TEXT_BANMAM116_05276_KAGEELJA_000_005: I'm told the lumber harvested from trees around Cenote Jayunja is the perfect material for replacing hilts and handles and such. Bring me an armful, and I'll see it makes its way into the right hands.
TEXT_BANMAM116_05276_KAGEELJA_000_006: I'm told the shellfish caught in Cenote Jayunja are perfect for creating the intricate patterns that adorn our traditional weaponry. Take some golden stonefly nymphs for bait and you should have no trouble.
TEXT_BANMAM116_05276_KAGEELJA_000_007: I'd like you to mine some rock around Cenote Jayunja. They should make the perfect whetstones for our Hoobigo's bone blades.
TEXT_BANMAM116_05276_KAGEELJA_000_008: I'd like you to harvest some lumber from the trees around Cenote Jayunja. It should be the perfect material for repairing or replacing weapon hilts and handles.
TEXT_BANMAM116_05276_KAGEELJA_000_009: I'd like you to catch shellfish from Cenote Jayunja. Golden stonefly nymphs should make for suitable bait, or so I've heard.
TEXT_BANMAM116_05276_KAGEELJA_000_015: How did you fare? Were you able to find the materials we needed?
TEXT_BANMAM116_05276_KAGEELJA_000_016: My thanks! I'm certain our Hoobigo friends will be as impressed with your eye for quality as I am.
TEXT_BANMAM116_05276_KAGEELJA_000_017: Warriors are far more effective if they can keep their weapons in good repair. Such supplies will always be in demand, so I may call on your procurement expertise again in the future.
TEXT_BANMAM117_05277_KAGEELJA_000_001: Even when people are at odds, talking out a solution is at least a possibility. Unfortunately, the wild creatures which seek to ravage our crops are not so open to reason. We have to be more...inventive.
TEXT_BANMAM117_05277_KAGEELJA_000_002: Which is why we're embracing the use of Gotoll Ja's smoke bombs. You're familiar with them, yes? The plan is to further improve upon the design and make them in large quantities.
