TEXT_BANMAM117_05277_KAGEELJA_000_003: In that respect, the new smoke bombs you helped us make have been highly successful in repelling unwelcome wildlife. Our comrades use them so often that Gotoll Ja has made another request for the base materials.
TEXT_BANMAM117_05277_KAGEELJA_000_005: As the ingredients in question require a delicate touch, however, I was hoping to call upon you and your steady hands to procure them.
TEXT_BANMAM117_05277_KAGEELJA_000_006: One of the main materials─tungsten powder─can be mined near Ankledeep. We'll use it to add an explosive pop to our smoke bombs.
TEXT_BANMAM117_05277_KAGEELJA_000_007: One of the main materials─Yak T'el verbena─can be harvested near Ankledeep. When rubbed or struck, it produces a pungent smell that most fiends can't seem to abide.
TEXT_BANMAM117_05277_KAGEELJA_000_008: One of these materials─the smokeshell─can be fished up from Ankledeep.  As the name implies, it provides the base component for the billowing cloud our bombs produce.
TEXT_BANMAM117_05277_KAGEELJA_000_009: Apparently they're best caught using golden stonefly nymphs as bait.
TEXT_BANMAM117_05277_KAGEELJA_000_010: You can mine tungsten powder near Ankledeep. We'll use it to add an explosive pop to our smoke bombs.
TEXT_BANMAM117_05277_KAGEELJA_000_011: You can harvest Yak T'el verbena near Ankledeep. When rubbed or struck, it produces a pungent smell that most fiends can't seem to abide.
TEXT_BANMAM117_05277_KAGEELJA_000_012: The smokeshell can be fished up from Ankledeep. Apparently they're best caught using golden stonefly nymphs as bait.
TEXT_BANMAM117_05277_KAGEELJA_000_015: Any trouble collecting the smoke bomb ingredients?
TEXT_BANMAM117_05277_KAGEELJA_000_016: Yes, everything seems to be intact. The care you take with transporting these volatile materials is always appreciated.
TEXT_BANMAM117_05277_KAGEELJA_000_017: Word from Gotoll Ja is that we'll be making our new smoke bombs much more compact than the ones used to scare off the rampaging wivres.
TEXT_BANMAM117_05277_KAGEELJA_000_018: While perhaps not as accomplished as you, we have a growing number of our brethren venturing out to gather resources for the gainery.
TEXT_BANMAM117_05277_KAGEELJA_000_019: Having these improved bombs on hand means they can brave even the most fiend-infested depths of the forest and return unscathed. A brilliant invention that helps to preserve lives─and our way of life.
TEXT_BANMAM118_05278_KAGEELJA_100_001: In recent days, we've had a steady drip of locals returning to Mamook from Tuliyollal and across the salt.
TEXT_BANMAM118_05278_KAGEELJA_100_002: The former mercenaries among them have been eager to take up posts as gainery guards, but even the best suffer minor wounds during their tussles with encroaching wildlife. In order to treat these injuries and ailments, I'd like to keep a good stock of healing medicines on hand.
TEXT_BANMAM118_05278_KAGEELJA_100_003: Yak T'el moss is always a useful ingredient. I would appreciate whatever you can bring me from the vicinity of Cenote Neyozzote.
TEXT_BANMAM118_05278_KAGEELJA_100_004: Ja Tiika cranberries are always a useful ingredient. I would appreciate whatever you can bring me from the vicinity of Cenote Neyozzote.
TEXT_BANMAM118_05278_KAGEELJA_100_005: Cexudross fish are always a useful ingredient. I would appreciate whatever you can catch from Bitterbark Cenote. As always, golden stonefly nymphs will serve you well.
TEXT_BANMAM118_05278_KAGEELJA_100_006: If you have the time, we could use a few clumps of Yak T'el moss from the vicinity of Cenote Neyozzote.
TEXT_BANMAM118_05278_KAGEELJA_100_007: If you have the time, we could use some Ja Tiika cranberries from the vicinity of Cenote Neyozzote.
TEXT_BANMAM118_05278_KAGEELJA_100_008: If you have the time, we could use a Cexudross fish or two from Bitterbark Cenote. As always, golden stonefly nymphs will serve you well.
TEXT_BANMAM118_05278_KAGEELJA_100_009: Hello, . Did you find the ingredients we're looking for?
TEXT_BANMAM118_05278_KAGEELJA_100_010: Yes, this is exactly what we need. Thank you for going to the trouble─getting to some of these cenotes can be a journey in itself.
TEXT_BANMAM118_05278_KAGEELJA_100_011: It's said that the traditional medicines made from these ingredients are the same as those handed out to soldiers during our war with the Xbr'aal. In those days, it was the duty of those unsuited to battle to gather the necessary materials.
TEXT_BANMAM118_05278_KAGEELJA_100_012: That time has passed, thankfully, but the healing remedies still prove as effective as ever. I may call on you again if our stock of ingredients runs low.
TEXT_BANMAM119_05279_KAGEELJA_100_000: Things around here have become so much busier than when we began, eh, ?
TEXT_BANMAM119_05279_KAGEELJA_100_001: Even the Brethren of Br'aax have been known to stop by and stay awhile. It's proven a great spot for them to interact with our customers from Mamook.
TEXT_BANMAM119_05279_KAGEELJA_100_002: Which is why I want to go one step further and make of the gainery a place where everyone can feel welcomed and relaxed. To that end, I spoke with one of our visitors and learned that the Xbr'aal use a pleasing aroma to create a restful atmosphere.
TEXT_BANMAM119_05279_KAGEELJA_100_003: The aromatic materials you procured for us were well praised by the Brethren of Br'aax─the scent made them feel right at home.
TEXT_BANMAM119_05279_KAGEELJA_100_004: As lovely as the aroma is, however, it only lasts for so long... We'll have to make gathering fresh batches a part of our regular duties.
TEXT_BANMAM119_05279_KAGEELJA_100_005: Should you happen to be in the area, I'm told you can find deposits of aromatic salt north of the dirigible landing. A few pinches should be enough for us to create a welcoming fragrance.
TEXT_BANMAM119_05279_KAGEELJA_100_006: Should you happen to be in the area, I'm told you can find sweet-smelling white flowers near Yak Awak Tsoly. A few blooms should be enough for us to create a welcoming fragrance.
TEXT_BANMAM119_05279_KAGEELJA_100_007: Should you happen to be in the area, I'm told you can catch a species of sweetfish at Yak Awak Tsoly. One should be enough for us to create a welcoming fragrance.
TEXT_BANMAM119_05279_KAGEELJA_100_008: Oh, and be sure to take a supply of golden stonefly nymphs to use as bait.
TEXT_BANMAM119_05279_KAGEELJA_100_010: If you've time on your hands, the Xbr'aal are said to favor the scent of a certain aromatic salt found north of the dirigible landing.
TEXT_BANMAM119_05279_KAGEELJA_100_011: If you've time on your hands, the Xbr'aal are said to favor the scent of a certain white flower found near Yak Awak Tsoly.
TEXT_BANMAM119_05279_KAGEELJA_100_012: If you've time on your hands, the Xbr'aal are said to favor the scent of a certain species of sweetfish found at Yak Awak Tsoly. You should be able to catch them using golden stonefly nymphs as bait.
TEXT_BANMAM119_05279_KAGEELJA_100_015: Can I assume you've brought our aromatic ingredient?
TEXT_BANMAM119_05279_KAGEELJA_100_016: I thought as much! I smelled such a pleasant scent as you approached.
TEXT_BANMAM119_05279_KAGEELJA_100_017: ...Hm, does that mean both Xbr'aal and Mamool Ja are fond of similar smells? We spent so many years in conflict over our differences, but I wonder what else we might have in common.
TEXT_BANMAM119_05279_KAGEELJA_100_018: Appreciating a calming fragrance is something I'd never considered until the brethren began their visits. Each of our cultures has much to learn from the other.
TEXT_BANMAM120_05280_KAGEELJA_000_000: Have you ever eaten a branchbearer's fruit? A hunter of the Brethren of Br'aax I've been speaking to recently has admitted to a craving for its sweet and tart flavor.
TEXT_BANMAM120_05280_KAGEELJA_000_001: In the spirit of our growing friendship, I thought it might be nice to gift him one. We have branchbearers right here in Gok Golma, after all, and clever hands like yours for harvesting...assuming you don't mind helping?
TEXT_BANMAM120_05280_KAGEELJA_000_002: Do you remember the Xbr'aal you gathered the branchbearer fruit for? It seems he approves of our birds' bounty, and wonders if we could spare another one.
TEXT_BANMAM120_05280_KAGEELJA_000_003: In return, he's willing to bring us a share of the meat they acquired from their hunt in the upper forests. It's a favorable bargain for all involved, so I would like to ask your help again with the harvesting.
TEXT_BANMAM120_05280_KAGEELJA_000_004: You should find some berry-bearing birds wandering the gainery. Once you've picked a nice big one, please deliver it directly to our sweet-toothed friend in Iq Br'aax.
TEXT_BANMAM120_05280_SYSTEM_000_007: You pluck the heavy fruit from the branchbearer, much to its apparent relief. Deliver the freshly picked gift to the waiting sweet-toothed hunter.
TEXT_BANMAM120_05280_CITIZENA05280_000_0: Come from the gainery, have you...?
Oh, you brought the branchberry─just as Kageel Ja promised!
Many amongst the brethren are fond of the taste, but we rarely partake from the lower forest where the branchbearers roam. I'll have to visit Kageel Ja and return the favor with a gift of my own.
Ah, you've brought another branchberry! Kageel Ja's thoughtfulness is much appreciated, as is yours for trekking all this way to make the delivery.
Those of us in Iq Br'aax have a great fondness for sweet and tangy flavors. Please let Kageel Ja know that I'll be along shortly with the goods to hold up our end of the bargain.
TEXT_BANMAM120_05280_KAGEELJA_000_015: You delivered the fruit, then? The hunter mentioned they were a favorite amongst the Xbr'aal, and I'm glad to hear he was pleased with it.
TEXT_BANMAM120_05280_KAGEELJA_000_016: We Mamool Ja find the flavor a touch too sour, and so usually mix them into a sweet drink made from crushed najool.
TEXT_BANMAM120_05280_KAGEELJA_000_017: Seeing as our neighbors enjoy the taste straight from the branch, however, we'll have to remember to set a portion of the harvest aside.
TEXT_BANMAM121_05281_KAGEELJA_000_000: The crops are coming along nicely for the most part, but I'm a little concerned for the few plants that aren't thriving quite as much.
TEXT_BANMAM121_05281_KAGEELJA_000_001: I see some yellowing leaves here and there, some slow growers and the like... So after discussing the matter with Anggir, we've decided to make a vitalization tonic and I would like your help with gathering one of the prime ingredients.
TEXT_BANMAM121_05281_KAGEELJA_000_002: The tonic we made for the struggling plants seems to be doing the trick, so I'd like to mix up some more for future use.
TEXT_BANMAM121_05281_KAGEELJA_000_003: A quality tonic requires quality ingredients, however, and who better to procure them than you?
TEXT_BANMAM121_05281_KAGEELJA_000_005: If you're in the vicinity of Ankledeep, you should be able to find deposits of the mineral dust we need. Watch your step out there!
TEXT_BANMAM121_05281_KAGEELJA_000_006: If you're in the vicinity of Ankledeep, you should be able to harvest the viscous nectar we need. Watch your step out there!
TEXT_BANMAM121_05281_KAGEELJA_000_007: If you find yourself at Ankledeep, you should be able to catch the particular thick-boned fish we need. Golden stonefly nymphs are the best bait to use, I hear.
TEXT_BANMAM121_05281_KAGEELJA_000_010: Procurement of the mineral dust we need falls to you. It should be found somewhere around Ankledeep.
TEXT_BANMAM121_05281_KAGEELJA_000_011: Procurement of the viscous nectar we need falls to you. It should be found somewhere around Ankledeep.
TEXT_BANMAM121_05281_KAGEELJA_000_012: Procurement of the thick-boned fish we need falls to you. It should be found somewhere around Ankledeep and can be caught using golden stonefly nymphs as bait.
TEXT_BANMAM121_05281_KAGEELJA_000_015: Any luck finding that tonic ingredient?
TEXT_BANMAM121_05281_KAGEELJA_000_016: Yes, perfect. This will do nicely, thank you!
TEXT_BANMAM121_05281_KAGEELJA_000_017: The tonic we make will help maintain the health of the plants themselves. We improved their surroundings─enriching the soil, adding compost, repelling insects and such─but nurturing the vegetables directly was something we were missing.
TEXT_BANMAM121_05281_KAGEELJA_000_018: As Anggir lent her expertise to the process, I have high hopes for the tonic's ongoing effectiveness. I also hope to have your continued assistance should we need another batch of ingredients!
TEXT_BANMAM122_05282_KAGEELJA_000_000: . Are you interested in doing some work with a branchbearer? You'll be helping improve the quality of our compost.
TEXT_BANMAM122_05282_KAGEELJA_000_001: According to Anggir's research, the light bursts emitted by the branchbearers should amplify the nutritional value of decaying matter, and I'd like to test that theory on our compost beds.
TEXT_BANMAM122_05282_KAGEELJA_000_002: These beds are basically pits where we bury things like fallen leaves, scraps of fish, and manure, then wait for teeny-tiny creatures to turn it all into rich compost. We have several of them situated at the base of trees found around the gainery.
TEXT_BANMAM122_05282_KAGEELJA_000_003: The branchbearers' luminescence had just the effect Anggir predicted, making our compost richer than ever before.
TEXT_BANMAM122_05282_KAGEELJA_000_004: As such, my task for you involves mounting up on one of our bird-shaped plant friends and encouraging it to illuminate each compost bed in turn. Speak to Ziraal Ja to get started.
TEXT_BANMAM122_05282_ZIRAALJA_100_013: Kageel Ja told me the details of your task. Feel free to take one of the branchbearers─they'll enjoy the change of scenery.
TEXT_BANMAM122_05282_ZIRAALJA_110_013: Should it happen that you hop off and lose your mount, just come on back to me. The birds know the way home.
TEXT_BANMAM122_05282_ZIRAALJA_120_013: As for the compost beds, look for them at the base of the large trees on the outskirts of Gok Golma. Have the branchbearer shine its luminescence on each bed, then head straight back to Kageel Ja to let him know it's done.
TEXT_BANMAM122_05282_ZIRAALJA_130_013: Not quite done? The branchbearer wandered in a little while ago, so I wondered, but let's get you mounted up again.
TEXT_BANMAM122_05282_SYSTEM_000_014: Kageel Ja needs your help enriching the compost. Speak with Ziraal Ja to mount a branchbearer and use its Shrouded Luminescence ability on the compost beds.
TEXT_BANMAM122_05282_KAGEELJA_000_015: The branchbearer cooperated without a fuss, then? Some of them run a bit wild from time to time, and I was worried they might make the job difficult for you.
TEXT_BANMAM122_05282_KAGEELJA_000_016: Unpredictable temperaments aside, Anggir tells me their light and energies may have other uses we've yet to discover.
TEXT_BANMAM122_05282_KAGEELJA_000_017: We'll do our best to keep looking into the possibilities. If you wouldn't mind helping out, then so much the better!
TEXT_BANMAM123_05283_KAGEELJA_000_000: It is absolutely vital that we control excess humidity in our vegetable stores. We've been replacing the drying agents at frequent intervals, but sometimes we simply don't have any hands free for this seemingly never-ending task.
TEXT_BANMAM123_05283_KAGEELJA_000_001: Seeing our dilemma, a helpful hunter of the Brethren of Br'aax told us of a long-lasting moisture-absorbing material they make use of in the upper forest.
TEXT_BANMAM123_05283_KAGEELJA_000_002: It sounds to me like something we should try. Can I ask you to head up there and gather what we need?
TEXT_BANMAM123_05283_KAGEELJA_000_003: The drying agent we made out of the materials you brought back is far superior to what we were using before. We've even taken to buying those same materials directly from the Brethren of Br'aax.
TEXT_BANMAM123_05283_KAGEELJA_000_004: Unfortunately, however, the humidity under the Ja Tiika Heartland's canopy is so great that even this improved drying agent loses its effect all too quickly. Can I ask you to make another journey to the upper forest and gather more of what we need?
TEXT_BANMAM123_05283_KAGEELJA_000_005: You should be able to find deposits of moisture-absorbing diatomite at the Xobr'it Cinderfield.
TEXT_BANMAM123_05283_KAGEELJA_000_006: You should be able to find a source of moisture-absorbing lumber at the Xobr'it Cinderfield.
TEXT_BANMAM123_05283_KAGEELJA_000_007: You should be able to fish up a moisture-absorbing mollusk from Iq Rrax Tsoly. Just make sure you have a supply of golden stonefly nymphs for bait.
TEXT_BANMAM123_05283_KAGEELJA_000_010: The diatomite deposits at the Xobr'it Cinderfield should provide a suitable drying agent.
TEXT_BANMAM123_05283_KAGEELJA_000_011: The moisture-absorbing lumber harvested at the Xobr'it Cinderfield should provide a suitable drying agent.
TEXT_BANMAM123_05283_KAGEELJA_000_012: The moisture-absorbing mollusks caught from Iq Rrax Tsoly should provide a suitable drying agent. Be sure to take a supply of golden stonefly nymphs with you for bait.
TEXT_BANMAM123_05283_KAGEELJA_000_015: Hello, , how can I─ Oh, the drying agent! What do you have for me?
TEXT_BANMAM123_05283_KAGEELJA_000_016: Yes, this is exactly what the hunter was talking about. I'll put it to use immediately!
TEXT_BANMAM123_05283_KAGEELJA_000_017: Thanks to everyone's hard work, our harvests continue to grow ever more bountiful. But by the same token, we require ever more drying agents to maintain a dry environment for our growing stores of fresh produce.
TEXT_BANMAM123_05283_KAGEELJA_000_018: Without these materials you've gathered for us, we'd be in danger of waking up to a pantry of rotting vegetables...
TEXT_BANMAM124_05284_KAGEELJA_000_001: So does Gok Golma spend yet another day bathed in golden light... Ever since the Boonewa mages worked their magicks, the crops have never looked healthier.
TEXT_BANMAM124_05284_KAGEELJA_000_002: If I recall, it was you who procured the energy-rich vessels that helped make the lights a possibility in the first place.
TEXT_BANMAM124_05284_KAGEELJA_000_003: Aside from the power provided by the base vessel, however, it seems the spell also requires a consumable catalyst to sustain its effect. As such, I must once again call upon your gathering expertise.
TEXT_BANMAM124_05284_KAGEELJA_000_005: And thanks to the spell catalyst you so kindly acquired, the illumination over the gainery remains undimmed...for the moment.
TEXT_BANMAM124_05284_KAGEELJA_000_006: Unfortunately, no source of energy lasts forever. If you're willing to lend a hand, the time has come to replenish our stocks.
TEXT_BANMAM124_05284_KAGEELJA_000_007: The ice crystals mined around the area of Ankledeep should be sufficient for our needs. The purer, the better.
TEXT_BANMAM124_05284_KAGEELJA_000_008: The water crystals found in the area of Ankledeep should be sufficient for our needs. The purer, the better.
TEXT_BANMAM124_05284_KAGEELJA_000_009: The crystalfish caught in Ankledeep should be sufficient for our needs. I imagine you have some golden stonefly nymphs left over for bait.
TEXT_BANMAM124_05284_KAGEELJA_000_010: Please head to Ankledeep and dig up the purest ice crystals you can find.
TEXT_BANMAM124_05284_KAGEELJA_000_011: Please head to Ankledeep and gather the purest water crystals you can find.
TEXT_BANMAM124_05284_KAGEELJA_000_012: Please head to Ankledeep with a pocketful of golden stonefly nymphs, and see if you can land us a sizable crystalfish.
TEXT_BANMAM124_05284_KAGEELJA_000_015: Welcome back, . Heh...you have the look of a person who's found exactly what they were looking for.
TEXT_BANMAM124_05284_KAGEELJA_000_016: Yes, our lights should shine all the brighter with such a dazzling source of energy.
TEXT_BANMAM124_05284_KAGEELJA_000_017: I cannot overstate the beneficial effects of the illumination, especially given the way our vegetables have thrived beneath its glow...
TEXT_BANMAM124_05284_KAGEELJA_000_018: We've seen steady increases in both yield and variety of crops, which means a more bountiful dinner table for everyone in Mamook! Your contributions, past, present, and future, are most appreciated.
TEXT_BANMAM125_05285_KAGEELJA_000_001: Hello, . Can I ask you to make a delivery of our finest vegetables? It's for our Xbr'aal neighbors...
TEXT_BANMAM125_05285_KAGEELJA_000_002: I mean, think on it─much of the ore and fish and such we've been gathering have come from the Ut'ohmu Horizon. It only seems right that we express our thanks for letting us share their resources.
TEXT_BANMAM125_05285_KAGEELJA_000_003: Hello, . Can I ask you to make another delivery of vegetables to our Xbr'aal neighbors?
TEXT_BANMAM125_05285_KAGEELJA_000_004: Ever since they sent us back that selection of meats in exchange, the practice of gifting each other comestibles has become a regular occurrence─one highly anticipated by many on both sides.
TEXT_BANMAM125_05285_KAGEELJA_000_005: As such, I'd like you to make your way to the middle of the Xobr'it Cinderfield. A Xbr'aal I've been in contact with will be there to accept the delivery.
TEXT_BANMAM125_05285_MOB05285_000_006: Volunteered to make the delivery, did you? I appreciate you meeting me halfway.
TEXT_BANMAM125_05285_MOB05285_000_007: Now that's a hefty sack of goods. I must admit, a lot of us have been curious to see what Mamook has been growing in its new vegetable fields.
TEXT_BANMAM125_05285_MOB05285_000_008: Here, I come bearing gifts as well. This is an assortment of meats our young Ty'at Roh brought back from the hunt.
TEXT_BANMAM125_05285_MOB05285_000_009: My thanks. Xbr'aal aren't terribly fond of vegetables as a rule, but your tasty produce seems to be the exception.
TEXT_BANMAM125_05285_MOB05285_000_010: Oh, and here─these meats are for you. The young hunters are eager to see them delivered to our friends in Mamook.
TEXT_BANMAM125_05285_MOB05285_000_011: Please take the sack to Kageel Ja along with our best regards. It is my hope that this surge of goodwill between our peoples becomes more than a passing sentiment.
TEXT_BANMAM125_05285_KAGEELJA_000_012: Welcome back, . You didn't run into any trouble while making the delivery, did you?
TEXT_BANMAM125_05285_KAGEELJA_000_013: He sent you back with a gift? We were trying to thank them! I expected nothing in return, but I'm grateful, nonetheless.
TEXT_BANMAM125_05285_KAGEELJA_000_014: Ah, and they've had another successful hunt, I see. I do enjoy this new custom of sending gifts back and forth.
TEXT_BANMAM125_05285_KAGEELJA_000_015: Thanks to the gainery and its bounty, we have a wonderful opportunity to rebuild relations with the Xbr'aal. Please help us continue nurturing this budding friendship.
TEXT_BANMAM126_05286_KAGEELJA_000_001: Mamook's traditional dishes tend to be sparse when it comes to seasonings. Aside from the salt taken from Bitterbark Cenote, the sweet flavoring provided by najool, and a fermented fish sauce, there isn't much else we add to our food.
TEXT_BANMAM126_05286_KAGEELJA_000_002: So for those who have gone on to experience Tuliyollal's varied cuisine, our local fare is decidedly lacking in comparison.
TEXT_BANMAM126_05286_KAGEELJA_000_003: On a related note, I've heard a Xbr'aal visitor mentioning certain ingredients found in the upper forest that might improve the taste of our vegetable soup...
TEXT_BANMAM126_05286_KAGEELJA_000_004: The seasoning you acquired for us the last time has been praised by both the local Mamool Ja and our visiting Xbr'aal friends.
TEXT_BANMAM126_05286_KAGEELJA_000_005: It's been so popular, in fact, that our stores are running dangerously low...
TEXT_BANMAM126_05286_KAGEELJA_000_006: Would you be so kind as to bring back some of the rock salt found near Iq Br'aax? It's said to have a smoother flavor than the stuff we extract from Bitterbark.
TEXT_BANMAM126_05286_KAGEELJA_000_007: Would you be so kind as to harvest some of the white pepper found near Iq Br'aax? It's said to have a spicy kick that enhances the flavor of the vegetables.
TEXT_BANMAM126_05286_KAGEELJA_000_008: Would you be so kind as to pull up some algae from Xd'aa Talat Tsoly? It should go well with the soup once dried and ground into a powder.
TEXT_BANMAM126_05286_KAGEELJA_000_009: Bait your hook with a golden stonefly nymph─an interested fish will drag the algae along for you to pluck free from the water.
TEXT_BANMAM126_05286_KAGEELJA_000_010: The rock salt in question should be found in the vicinity of Iq Br'aax.
TEXT_BANMAM126_05286_KAGEELJA_000_011: The white pepper in question should be found in the vicinity of Iq Br'aax.
TEXT_BANMAM126_05286_KAGEELJA_000_012: You should be able to pull up the algae I spoke of from Xd'aa Talat Tsoly.
TEXT_BANMAM126_05286_KAGEELJA_000_013: Attract the fish with golden stonefly nymphs and they'll bring the algae to you.
TEXT_BANMAM126_05286_KAGEELJA_000_014: How went your hunt for seasonings?
TEXT_BANMAM126_05286_KAGEELJA_000_015: Yes, this will do nicely. My thanks for braving the beasts of the Ut'ohmu Horizon.
TEXT_BANMAM126_05286_KAGEELJA_000_016: Right, I say we get this ingredient prepared and popped into a soup straightaway. Hopefully our Mamook customers find the taste to their liking.
TEXT_BANMAM126_05286_KAGEELJA_000_017: Glad I am that our choice of ingredient found favor with the customers. Our cooks, too, seem thrilled to have a new flavor to experiment with.
TEXT_BANMAM126_05286_KAGEELJA_000_018: As it so happens, this flavor also complements tiika selvaas. Serving it with a side of tasty soup has only made our new dish all the more popular.
TEXT_BANMAM126_05286_KAGEELJA_000_019: You know, if this can persuade even the studious Anggir to finish a meal over returning to her research, then I think we're onto a winner.
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_KAGEELJA_000_001: Can I ask a favor, ? I need you to make a delivery of vegetables to a Mamook resident.
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_KAGEELJA_000_002: More and more people have been visiting Gok Golma of late, but for those raising little ones or suffering from illness, it can be difficult to make it out here.
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_KAGEELJA_000_003: So it was that we started a delivery service...only to realize we rarely have enough people on hand to make the deliveries. It would help us enormously if you could see this order to its destination.
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_KAGEELJA_000_004: There you go─a basket full of fresh produce! The note inside will tell you its intended recipient.
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_MOB05287A_000_005: Finally. Why does she always wake up as soon as I lay her in bed? <yawn> I might need a nap myself...
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_MOB05287A_000_006: Oh, my order! Sorry I couldn't pick it up in person─with a hatchling in the house, it can be hard to step outside even for a moment.
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_MOB05287A_000_007: I honestly don't know how I lived without the gainery's vegetables. They give me the energy to keep going, and taste so good that even my fussy child will eat an entire bowlful if I grate them first.
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_MOB05287A_000_008: Thank you for the delivery, and please give my best to Kageel Ja.
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_MOB05287A_000_009: Thank you again for bringing my order. Some days it's just impossible to leave the house...
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_MOB05287B_000_010: <cough> <splutter> Sore throat, sore head, dizzy spells, and now to make things worse, an empty stomach... Just end it all and put me out of my misery.
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_MOB05287B_000_011: <cough> Sorry, I didn't see you there. This must be the order my friend put in for me.
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_MOB05287B_000_012: You are the savior of empty bellies, and by extension, the world itself. Had I wrestled with this hunger much longer, my suffering would have rent the very star asunder!
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_MOB05287B_000_013: <cough> Don't look at me like that, I'm in pain! <sniff> In any case, you have my thanks...as does Kageel Ja, if you would be so kind as to pass them on.
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_MOB05287B_000_014: I'm sure my apocalyptic mood will improve somewhat once I get a little food in me...
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_MOB05287A_000_015: Ugh, even sitting still doesn't stop it from hurting. That'll teach me to overdo things...
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_MOB05287A_000_016: Ah, you've brought my food, thank you. I injured my foot, you see, and was forced to rely on a kind soul to make the delivery.
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_MOB05287A_000_017: It's just... I was watching those young ones out at the gainery night and day, doing their part to build a better Mamook.
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_MOB05287A_000_018: And I thought, “I should be doing something, too!” So I went out to help pick some herbs, slipped on a rock, and...well, now look at me. Not as spry as I once was, I'm afraid.
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_MOB05287A_000_019: I appreciate you going out of your way for an old fool. Don't worry─I have someone stopping by later to help me cook these lovely vegetables.
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_KAGEELJA_000_020: , you're back. No issues with the delivery, then?
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_KAGEELJA_000_021: Yes, our customers are always so pleased to see their vegetables arrive. Thank you for shouldering the task this time.
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_KAGEELJA_000_022: In ways both large and small, the new crops have changed not only how people in Mamook think about food, but how they act around each other.
TEXT_BANMAM127_05287_KAGEELJA_000_024: I'd like to think our continued efforts at the gainery will ensure that these changes are for the better. Here, take this for your trouble.
TEXT_BANMAM128_05288_KAGEELJA_000_001: Hmmm, mixing in the more colorful vegetables might make the juice more appetizing... Oh, and we could try adding ingredients from the upper forest.
TEXT_BANMAM128_05288_KAGEELJA_000_002: Hmmm, maybe instead of just mashing the vegetables, we could strain them through cloth or boil them down into a stock...?
TEXT_BANMAM128_05288_KAGEELJA_000_003: We need a drink that pairs well with the tiika selvaas. Maybe something smooth with a rich flavor...? In which case, it might be best to serve it hot...
TEXT_BANMAM128_05288_KAGEELJA_000_004: We need a drink that pairs well with the Yak T'el salad and the stewed ty'aitya...and somehow also that suspicious-yet-popular soup. Perhaps a lighter beverage? Or maybe lean into an even spicier concoction?
TEXT_BANMAM128_05288_KAGEELJA_000_005: ...Oh, ! Sorry, I was just thinking about a new beverage we could serve at the kitchen.
TEXT_BANMAM128_05288_KAGEELJA_000_006: Are you busy at the moment? If not, I could use your help procuring the less common ingredients I have in mind...
TEXT_BANMAM128_05288_KAGEELJA_000_007: Specifically, a few bottles of spring water drawn from the reserves north of the dirigible landing. Chilled or heated, it's known for its smooth and clear taste.
TEXT_BANMAM128_05288_KAGEELJA_000_008: Specifically, a few baskets of leopardfang tea leaves harvested from the area around Yak Awak Tsoly. It's not the easiest variety to brew, but I hear patience is rewarded with a most flavorful tea.
TEXT_BANMAM128_05288_KAGEELJA_000_009: Specifically, a certain tea grass hauled up from Yak Awak Tsoly. I hear it has a rich and full-bodied flavor, bursting with the blessings of the cenote.
TEXT_BANMAM128_05288_KAGEELJA_000_010: Yet only skilled fishers are able to use golden stonefly nymphs to snag the grass and fish up this precious treasure. I am, however, fully confident that you're up to the task.
TEXT_BANMAM128_05288_KAGEELJA_000_011: If you don't mind, I'll need a few bottles of spring water drawn from the reserves north of the dirigible landing in the upper forest.
TEXT_BANMAM128_05288_KAGEELJA_000_012: If you don't mind, I'll need a few baskets of leopardfang tea leaves harvested from the area around Yak Awak Tsoly.
TEXT_BANMAM128_05288_KAGEELJA_000_013: If you don't mind, I'll need a certain tea grass hauled up from Yak Awak Tsoly. It's a little difficult to procure, but golden stonefly nymphs should help you with the task.
TEXT_BANMAM128_05288_KAGEELJA_000_015: Do you have the ingredient I asked for?
TEXT_BANMAM128_05288_KAGEELJA_000_016: Yes, this is wonderful quality─as will be the beverage our kitchen makes with it.
TEXT_BANMAM128_05288_KAGEELJA_000_017: A juice stall in Tuliyollal, you say? I'd like to work with this Boonewa someday and see what colorful and delectable drinks we might create.
TEXT_BANMAM128_05288_KAGEELJA_000_018: Cooking is a fine art, but I see now the world of possibility in making drinks. I can't wait to try out different mixes and enjoy them alongside our foods!
TEXT_BANMAM128_05288_KAGEELJA_000_019: Imagine Gok Golma becoming a place where people from all over the nation come to relax─a place where they share their favorites from the menu, and make plans to return time and again. Wouldn't that be nice?
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_001: Ah, a traveler from across the salt. Greetings. You may call me Fahrafahr.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_002: You seem the type to have friends all along the width and breadth of our continent. Do you by chance know any particularly skilled artisans? If you could introduce them to me, I would be eternally grateful...
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_003: You are a deft hand at crafting? Well, then I am in luck─as is all of Worlar's Echo. We are under threat, you see, and require the help of one such as you to survive.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_004: A great avalanche has swallowed a place known as Zirgorteh the Open-armed, once home to a sacred altar and its keepers. Although thankfully uninhabited at the time, I fear this was no accident...
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_005: No, this destruction was caused by the snow spirits of Urqopacha.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_006: While we Yok Huy lived in harmony with these spirits for generations, they have as late become possessed by an inconsolable rage. None know why, and attempts at reason have only stoked their anger further.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_007: There is, however, a way to quell the spirits: a ceremony known as the Pact, which must be performed at the altar which was once so carefully maintained. An old friend taught me this.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_008: Yet therein lies our problem...the avalanche swept away much of the altar and its surroundings.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_009: We must repair it quickly so the rite can be performed. If we fail, all of Urqopacha may succumb to the spirits' wrath.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_A2_000_001: I like a challenge, but I want to see what I'm working with first.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_A2_000_002: I'm having trouble imagining the extent of the damage...
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_011: That is to be expected. Very well, let us visit what little remains─it will help you understand more clearly what is at stake.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_012: To the south of Worlar's Echo you will find stairs leading to the ritual site. The guard at the top will allow us passage up the mountain.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_100: You came─good. Before we cross the pass, might I ask your name?
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_101: ...? Wait...the very same  who felled Valigarmanda!? My apologies, I had no idea I was among one of our saviors.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_102: Not that I was doubtful before, but I suddenly feel much better about our chances for success. Come now, our destination is not far.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_200: This is what remains of Zirgorteh the Open-armed. The damage is unlike anything I have ever seen. Even our histories contain few stories of such destruction...
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_100_200: That structure at the far end is the Breathless Altar, where the ritual was performed. Although to see it now, one could hardly guess what purpose it served...
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_201: Do you feel that? Something beyond the usual chill in the air...
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_203: They left, thank goodness. To think they would be so bold...
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_204: You have seen now the frenzy which grips them. Yet...they looked almost frightened by you. Have you encountered the spirits before?
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_205: You bested them during the Feat of Proof? Well, I should expect no less from one who defeated a tural vidraal. If you are even half as good at crafting as you are at fighting, I believe we are in good hands.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_206: Yet even if the spirits are felled, they will be born again when next the snow falls. And they will rage.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_207: The Pact is the only way we can set things to rights. Yet even if the altar were whole, there are none left who know how the ritual was conducted.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_208: Dartorgor was the final caretaker remaining and a dear friend of mine. However, before the avalanche buried all this, her body was lost in a tragic accident...
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_100_208: What little I know of the Pact, I learned from her. I never encouraged her to speak more of the sacred practice...but now I wish I had.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_110_208: Now I must make up for my lack of curiosity. I will learn how to appease the spirits in Dartorgor's stead.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_209: For many years she was Urqopacha's silent guardian, and I shall take up the mantle she left behind.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_210: Now that you have seen the scale of the undertaking before you, I ask you once more: will you join me in rebuilding Zirgorteh the Open-armed?
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_A1_000_001: Count me in. I'm interested to see this “Pact” for myself.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_A1_000_002: I was fated to meet that spirit again, it seems.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_213: Thank you, ! You have given me hope in these dark times.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_100_213: Before we get started on the altar proper, we should first restore the building where Dartorgor lived so we might have shelter.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_110_213: It was, fittingly, called Warmth, and she lodged there with the other caretakers. It should make the perfect base from which to conduct our restoration.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_214: Now, rest assured I do not intend for just us to shoulder this burden. We would do well to recruit a few more pairs of helping hands.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_215: I suppose that will be my first request. Please ask around Worlar's Echo for anyone willing to lend their aid, and I will make what preparations I can for the work ahead.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_NOPLI_000_220: Well, well, I didn't expect to see you here!
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_MUSCLEYOKHUY05330_0: You need help rebuilding Zirgorteh the Open-armed? Ah, I know the place─a group of Yok Huy lived up there and looked after an altar, right?
Was quite the trek, as I recall. They would visit from time to time.

I knew there weren't many of them left, but hadn't heard the last of them had gone... Terrible news, but if you're going to rebuild their legacy, you'll need brawn. And I have plenty of that to offer!
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_DIGGINGYOKHUY05330_: The spirits have been acting passing strange, it is true. Their usually harmless tricks have become malicious, with merchants and other innocents being attacked unprovoked.
Usually, they appear on snowy days and invite passersby to frolic under the falling flakes. What could have gotten into them?
Regardless, this problem affects all of us in Urqopacha. If repairing the altar will help, then my supply of masonry is at your disposal.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_MURFURLUR_000_306: It has been too long since last we met, . I am come here with Nopli to trade, but the people seem unsettled somehow.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_MURFURLUR_000_307: Ah, the spirits... That explains why we were attacked by a group one snowy day not long ago. We greeted them kindly as usual, but were assailed with icy magick without warning.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_MURFURLUR_000_308: I had no choice but to drive them back or risk Nopli's life, but the incident has been troubling me ever since. They are our neighbors here in Urqopacha, after all, and we have lived in harmony for so long.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_NOPLI_000_309: I take it that's why you're recruiting others to your aid. You never change, do you? Always eager to help those in need.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_NOPLI_000_310: Unfortunately, the life of a merchant demands that we don't rest our feet for too long. But perhaps we can send others your way─only the best, of course!
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_NOPLI_000_311: We promise to share what you told us today with anyone whose ear we can bend. Now let's be off, Murfurlur!
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_VUYARGUR_000_312: The avalanche caused all that damage? I see... You know, I spoke with Dartorgor once, some years ago now.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_VUYARGUR_000_313: She said she lived alone in the mountains, and was the sole keeper of an altar up there. Despite her solitary life, she seemed a bright and kind soul.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_VUYARGUR_000_314: I was saddened to hear her body was lost when she suffered that terrible fall. I had always hoped she would visit again and tell me more about her unique experiences.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_VUYARGUR_000_315: Although I only met her the one time, I will not soon forget Dartorgor. To honor her memory, I pledge my aid in Zirgorteh the Open-armed's reconstruction.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_VUYARGUR_000_316: My trade is carpentry, but I am ready and willing to help wherever it is needed. I shall speak with Fahrafahr to see where I can be of use.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_VUYARGUR_000_317: It seems the others have already crossed into the valley. I'll go soon as well, after I discuss a few matters with Fahrafahr.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_400: You did well, . I think we have a dependable crew to get started with. Vuyargur here seems especially eager to pitch in.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_VUYARGUR_000_401: If I may, Fahrafahr, I can do much more than shovel snow and haul stones. I am willing to assist in planning the reconstruction from start to finish.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_VUYARGUR_000_402: With you in charge of the larger picture, I can assign people to work where it is needed most. Having overseen many projects of this scale, I believe this to be the surest path to completion.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_403: You would do all that? Then I would be grateful to accept your help, Vuyargur.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_VUYARGUR_000_404: You are most welcome to it. Now before we get started, do you happen to know where Dartorgor's living sepulchre can be found?
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_VUYARGUR_000_405: Upon it must be engraved stories of her life and work. It may shed some light on the mysteries of the snow spirits and the Pact itself.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_406: It was likely erected near the altar, but if so...then it, too, may have been buried in the avalanche.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_VUYARGUR_000_408: I see... Well then, since the snow must be cleared away anyways, we can search for the sepulchre in the meantime. We will find it, I am certain.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_WURFURTAR_000_409: Oh, there you are! You're the ones rebuilding the altar, right? Nopli told me you needed more help!
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_WURFURTAR_000_410: When I saw how fearlessly he wheeled and dealed with the Chirwagur, I knew I had to become his pupil in trade─and so here I am!
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_WURFURTAR_000_411: Consider me Nopli's eyes and ears. If you need someone to make deals with other merchants or procure supplies, then leave it to me!
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_VUYARGUR_000_412: I know Nopli has been making a name for himself as of late. If he vouches for you, then welcome aboard.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_413: This project is off to a better start than I ever imagined. We have all the help we need and then some, so now is as good a time as any for the Hands of Zirgorteh to rebuild Warmth!
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_415: Speak to me when you are ready to use those expert skills I recruited you for, !
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_WURFURTAR_000_420: Of course I've heard of you, ─Nopli couldn't stop singing your praises! If there's anything you need, I'll be here.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_500: Now, first things first─restoration of our soon-to-be living quarters. The heavy lifting and building can be left to us Yok Huy, while you craft the supplies we need for some of the finishing touches.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_501: If we are to live among these frozen peaks, we require flooring which will insulate us from the cold. The space is large, so we'll need a few boxes worth. Can I count on you for that?
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_502: If we are to live among these frozen peaks, we require flooring which will insulate us from the cold. The space is large, so we'll need a few boxes worth. Can I count on you for that?
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_503: If we are to live among these frozen peaks, we require an insulating agent to put on the floors and protect us from the cold. The space is large, so we'll need a few boxes worth. Can I count on you for that?
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_504: Here should be everything you require for the task, but if by chance you run out, Wurfurtar will provide you with more.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_505: While you do that, I shall assign tasks to the others. Let us get to work, then!
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_510: Have you run out of materials? Worry not, for Wurfurtar can replenish your supplies.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_WURFURTAR_000_525: Of course I've heard of you, ─Nopli couldn't stop singing your praises! If there's anything you need, just say the word.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_WURFURTAR_000_540: You need more supplies? Well, Nopli is always saying that an artisan should never be bound by scarcity, and I agree! Here, take all you need.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_601: Ah hah! I see your skills were no mere boast. Excellent work!
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_602: Now thanks to you, Warmth will be a place worthy of its name. Please feel free to rest a while─we will take it from here!
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_650: Why, everyone works so eagerly, as if they have forgotten entirely the biting cold without. The sight truly speaks to the quality of your contribution.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_651: The road ahead of us is long, but I am glad we have taken our first step upon it together. I hope you will continue to lend us your expertise.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_FAHRAFAHR_000_652: Are you watching, Dartorgor? I promise you that soon, the spirits and Yok Huy will live in peaceful harmony once again.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_SYSTEM_000_653: The collapsed living quarters have been repaired, marking the beginning of Zirgorteh the Open-armed's restoration!
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_SYSTEM_000_654: Yet the snow spirits must still be appeased. Only by continuing their work can Fahrafahr and her crafters quell the spirits' rage and bring peace to the mountains.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_SYSTEM_000_700: You have achieved Friendly reputation with the Hands of Zirgorteh.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_SYSTEM_000_701: Yok Huy society quests are now available from Vuyargur in Shelter.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_SYSTEM_000_702: Furthermore, you may now purchase wares from Rarkorgor.
TEXT_BANYOK001_05330_SYSTEM_100_702: Moreover, you may now use mounts within Zirgorteh the Open-armed.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_001: Your work thus far has been greatly appreciated, . Each time I look upon our progress I am impressed anew at everyone's diligence.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_002: In fact, we have already moved on to our next step: building the stonemasons' workshop.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_100_002: It will be essential to restoring the Breathless Altar to its former grandeur. Each stone that was swept away must be made again─in the traditional Yok Huy fashion, no less.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_003: Such is the way for all of our ceremonial spaces. And since transporting so much stone from Worlar's Echo would only result in broken bricks and sore backs, the workshop will be our most vital project yet.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_004: I have entrusted its construction to a skilled mason named Girzorhor, and work was proceeding apace until a certain...incident occurred. I have yet to hear the details, but it seems progress has stalled.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_005: I mean to go and speak with him, and would be grateful if you could accompany me. It might be easier to solve whatever problem awaits us if we tackle it together.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_000_010: No, this is too much... I must leave!
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_100: Here we are, . This is Girzorhor, and as you can see he is...distraught.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_101: My words do not seem to reach him. I know not what has happened, only that he is intent on leaving.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_102: Perhaps a softer voice than mine might soothe his fright. Might you give it a try, ?
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_000_105: No, this is too much... I must leave!
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_SYSTEM_000_110: Girzorhor is trembling with fear. Try to soothe his troubled heart.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_115: My words seem to have no effect on him, but perhaps he would listen to a more soothing voice. Please try, .
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_000_200: Ah, apologies for ignoring you before. I was panicked, and barely aware of my surroundings. I...should probably explain why.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_000_201: While I was going about my tasks for the day, I caught sight of one of the snow spirits. It pranced about playfully and approached...then pelted me with icy magick!
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_000_202: I managed to flee before I was impaled by a frozen spear, but now that I have seen the extent of their wrath, I cannot risk my life working here!
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_203: I warned everyone to be wary of the spirits, but it seems I failed to convey just how dangerous they could be.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_204: And while I understand Girzorhor's fear, this attack only emphasizes how crucial it is for us to complete restoration of the altar─and for that, we need his expertise.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_205: , would you come with me to Worlar's Echo to help convince our mason to return? There must be some way to sway him.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_210: I tried reasoning with him, but he seems set on staying put. Perhaps you can make him see how crucial he is to our work.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_000_300: Oh, I remember you. Apologies, but if you mean to convince me to climb back up that mountain, I must refuse.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_A2_000_001: Why did you let the spirits get so close?
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_A2_000_002: Remember the importance of our work. All of Urqopacha depends on it.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_100_300: It was as I said. The spirits seemed inviting...but then their mood turned foul so quickly.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_110_300: But...but I understand now. If I was taken by surprise so easily, others might be as well. That is precisely why we must restore the altar, is it not?
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_120_300: All of Urqopacha? I know the altar and ceremony are meant to appease the spirits, but...
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_130_300: I...I understand now. If I was taken by surprise so easily, others might be as well. That is what we work for, do we not? To restore peace to Urqopacha.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_000_301: Yes...I understand your point. Yet the very memory of that terrible moment sends a chill down my spine that keeps my legs firmly planted here.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_302: I understand your feelings, Girzorhor. I feel them, too. Yet Dartorgor was courageous in the face of all that─and so must we be.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_000_303: Dartorgor? Ah, the one who lived in the mountains before the avalanche.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_304: Yes. She once told me that the spirits had been there since ancient times, and wrought calamity upon any who dared to encroach upon their home.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_305: When our forebears settled there, they were battered by avalanches and snowstorms...until they performed the Pact for the first time.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_306: Ever since, the ritual and the altar it is performed upon served as the foundation for a peaceful coexistence with the spirits.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_307: Dartorgor bore that responsibility alone for many years, keeping disaster at bay. Yet she is with us no longer, and someone must follow in her footsteps. I must follow.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_000_308: You take on this burden, even knowing full well the danger it poses?
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_309: Dartorgor would have wanted it this way. When she would descend from her home, she would stay with me. I treasure each and every one of those memories.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_DARTORGOR_000_310: (-Dartorgor-)You really must see how Ryoqor Terteh and the other spirits frolic during the ritual. You'd never think they could just as easily bury us all under a hail of snow.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_DARTORGOR_000_311: (-Dartorgor-)The Pact is all that protects us from that fate, and soon I shall be its sole inheritor. Although I am young still, perhaps it's time to begin looking for a pupil.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_DARTORGOR_000_312: (-Dartorgor-)Oh, I know! It could be you, Fahrafahr! ...Haha, I jest, I jest!
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_313: That was our final conversation. On the way back, she suffered that terrible accident...
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_314: Had we kept the memory of the Pact alive in Worlar's Echo...had we maintained the roads leading to and from the altar...then Dartorgor may still be with us. Her loss was a tragedy of indifference.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_100_314: Yet the memory of her devotion gives me courage. That, and the presence of , who so bravely stood before Valigarmanda.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_000_316: You traveled from across the salt and risked life and limb for Tural...and if you can do that for us, I should not balk at doing the same.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_000_317: But I am no fighter. If the spirits were to attack again, what would I do?
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_A1_000_001: Flee to Warmth─you'll be safe there.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_A1_000_002: Hurl a few rocks at them!
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_319: That indeed may be the wisest course of action. The spirits would be loath to enter a warm room, and their will may falter upon seeing so many Yok Huy gathered together.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_320: Hah, spoken like a true warrior. However, it may be best to seek refuge rather than risk antagonizing the spirits further.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_100_320: Ah, I know. What if you were to flee back to Warmth? The spirits would be loath to enter a warm room, and their will may falter upon seeing so many Yok Huy gathered together.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_000_321: I think...I think I can manage with that. Very well, Fahrafahr, I shall return to the Hands.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_000_322: Yet before I do, I must confess something. I was so flustered during my flight from the spirits that I dropped my most important tools. They are lost to the snows now, and I fear I cannot work without them...
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_323: Well, you can see to that, right? Surely a set of stonemason's tools─chisels and the like─crafted by your hands will serve as a fine replacement for what Girzorhor lost. I shall provide you with all the materials you need.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_324: Well, you can see to that, right? Surely a set of stonemason's tools─equipment for precise measuring and such─crafted by your hands will serve as a fine replacement for what Girzorhor lost. I shall provide you with all the materials you need.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_325: Well, you can see to that, right? Surely a set of stonemason's tools─putty to repair cracks in stones and such─crafted by your hands will serve as a fine replacement for what Girzorhor lost. I shall provide you with all the materials you need.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_000_326: I would be in your debt, . Once you've finished, please bring the tools to me and I will get back to work as soon as I can.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_000_330: I look forward to seeing what tools your hands can create, but I know as well as anyone that perfection takes time. So, do not hesitate to ask Fahrafahr for more materials if you need them.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_345: I have plenty of spare materials with me. If you run out, simply let me know.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_360: I have no shortage of supplies, so feel free to try as many times as you need until you are satisfied with the result.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_000_400: What do you have there? Might I have a closer look...?
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_000_401: Ah hah! This is masterful work indeed! Even better than what I had before, in fact. Fahrafahr was right to put her trust in you─and I will follow suit.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_000_402: Now, I should make good on my promise and get back to it. The workshop I build shall be worthy of these splendid tools.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_403: Ah, nothing is more encouraging than seeing an artisan so eager to test his new equipment! Thank you, .
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_404: I must return to Shelter to attend to my own work, but please stop by for a chat whenever you have a free moment.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_500: I am overjoyed Girzorhor has returned. His absence would have been sorely felt.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_501: In fact, I am beginning to think his ordeal was a blessing in disguise, for he works with even more zeal than before.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_502: I was even able to tell a story of my time with Dartorgor, and in doing so give her the chance to lend her strength to the present. Nothing could make me happier.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_550: Now that we can make traditional stonework here, we can use it in the buildings we repair, as well. And with each brick laid, we draw one step closer to completion.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_GIRZORHOR_000_551: The patterns you see are among the oldest used by our people. Many depict scenes of us living side by side with the snow spirits, and making them has been quite the educational experience.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_000_552: I only hope that Dartorgor is proud to see the progress we have made.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_FAHRAFAHR_100_552: I shall continue to work and learn, for Dartorgor's sake. I encourage you to do the same, .
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_SYSTEM_000_553: The construction of Masons' Work has been completed, allowing for the creation of traditional Yok Huy stonework!
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_SYSTEM_000_600: You have achieved Trusted reputation with the Hands of Zirgorteh.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_SYSTEM_000_601: Continue working with the Yok Huy to deepen your relationship.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_SYSTEM_000_602: New Yok Huy society daily quests are now available from Vuyargur in Shelter.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_SYSTEM_000_603: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Vuyargur as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_SYSTEM_000_604: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Vuyargur. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANYOK002_05331_SYSTEM_000_605: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Rarkorgor.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_001: , what perfect timing! I was just about to make my way up the mountain, but now that you are here, there is a small but vital task I would entrust to you.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_002: You see, we are currently in the process of restoring a larder Dartorgor used to store not only foodstuffs, but apparently also ceremonial offerings used during the Pact.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_003: We found many different food items when we uncovered its ruins, but as of yet we have no way of knowing which were for eating, and which were used as offerings.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_004: There is a merchant in Worlar's Echo by the name of Kurbulur with whom Dartorgor often had dealings. I thought perhaps he might know if any of the wares she traded for were used in the ritual.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_100_004: I would send one of our own to seek him out, but every pair of hands is busy clearing out the remaining snow. I was just about to join them, in fact─Dartorgor's living sepulchre has yet to be found, after all.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_110_004: That leaves you to speak with the merchant on our behalf─a much less laborious task than the one that awaits me, I promise! Can you do this for us?
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_005: Thank you, ! Remember, the merchant's name is Kurbulur. I hope his knowledge can aid us!
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_010: Worry not, a bit of manual labor will warm us against the cold. Your help is welcome, but surely you would rather be below speaking with Kurbulur, eh?
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_100: Dartorgor? From the mountain? Ah, yes, I remember her. We would trade on occasion.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_101: Though she never mentioned this “Pact” you speak of. Thinking back, however, it does shine a new light on one peculiar aspect of our dealings...
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_102: As I recall, she would usually ask for an assortment of dried meats and seasonings─the types of food that would last. Such items as would be difficult to come by in those snowy peaks.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_103: Nothing peculiar about that, to be sure, but the tender she used was unusual. You see, she traded me corn and corn seeds which she claimed to grow herself.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_104: Quite the strange crop for such a frigid clime, right? Well, she said it was a singular type, bred over generations to withstand the freezing weather. Of course, I couldn't deny such an uncommon opportunity...
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_105: ...But I took one bite of the corn and regretted my choice straightaway, hah!
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_106: Still, I figured I could sell it as feed or process it into something usable, so I accepted her produce whenever she visited. Dartorgor seemed to have a hard life up on the mountain, so I was happy to provide her with what she needed.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_107: One time I suggested that growing something else besides inedible corn might solve her food problems. What do you think she said to that?
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_108: She said, “My order took great care in cultivating it to match the tastes of our dear friends.”
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_109: Considering she lived alone, I wasn't quite sure what she meant, but she was so earnest in her answer I decided not to press further.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_110: But now the pieces are falling into place. I gather this corn has something to do with your ritual.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_111: You know, I've been wanting to meet Fahrafahr and her “Hands of Zirgorteh” for some time. Allow me to accompany you up the mountain.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_112: Word of work being done at Zirgorteh has reached us here in Worlar's Echo, and I've wondered how I could contribute. Now's my chance to find out.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_SNOWYOKHUY05332_000: Is this a friend of yours, ?
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_120: I admit, I was quite surprised when I sighted Kurbulur emerge from the passage. Still, he is more than welcome, and I have let him know all about the challenges we face.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_200: There you are, . Fahrafahr here might be young, but she takes to leading naturally. I'm impressed by how much progress everyone's made so far.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_SNOWYOKHUY05332_000: Most of the others are resting now, but Fahrafahr had us clearing snow all day long! I can barely lift my arms!
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_202: Haha! A hard day's work deserves a hearty reward, wouldn't you agree? I'll treat you to some of my most delicious wares when this is done!
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_203: By the way, Fahrafahr. Do you have any insight as to what Dartorgor was referring to before? Those “dear friends” she and the others grew the corn for?
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_204: She must have meant the snow spirits. The corn must have been a crucial part of the ritual.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_205: Given that it was grown and harvested among the snow, it makes sense that the spirits would have a taste for it. I suppose the larder housed a healthy stock of the crop.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_206: Even so, I fail to see how anyone─spirits or no─could eat that stuff. Perhaps the caretakers processed it somehow before making an offering?
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_207: Without knowing their techniques, however, growing it now may not be the wisest path.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_SNOWYOKHUY05332_000: Oh, sorry to interrupt, but I've been meaning to mention the large stone we found buried under the snow. The carvings were quite distinct...
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_212: Are you saying you found a sepulchre...? Dartorgor's living sepulchre!?
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_213: If it is indeed the stone we've been searching for, then it should hold all the answers we need.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_100_213: The way forward is clear─we finish shoveling the rest of the snow!
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_SNOWYOKHUY05332_100: If only it were so simple... The snow around the stone is frozen solid. Maybe icepicks could help us free it?
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_214: With tools like that we risk damaging the stone, and thus losing forever the precious stories carved into it. As of now, we lack the means to remove it cleanly from the ice.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_100_214: , could you return with me to Shelter? The tools we need require a deft hand to craft, and I cannot make them alone.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_110_214: Much appreciated. Then let our focus be on seeing the sepulchre safely rescued.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_120_214: In the meantime, the others should continue their work on the larder. Remember to give yourselves time to rest every once in a while!
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_KURBULUR_000_215: Since I'm already here, I may as well stay a while and help. Let's see if young Fahrafahr has a place for me.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_SNOWYOKHUY05332_000: We'll have the larder back in shape before you know it! You two do what you need to get that stone free from the snow!
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_300: If my intuition is correct, Dartorgor's sepulchre will contain details on the offering. And while I would like it uncovered as quickly as possible, the task must be attended to with care.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_301: Which is why I would entrust no one else with crafting the tools we require. You are not one to disappoint, after all.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_302: I think metal scrapers suited for delicate work should help us clear the ice without damaging the sepulchre's inscriptions. Can I trust you to make them for us?
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_303: Brushes will help us clear away snow so we can more easily see the hard ice underneath. Can I trust you to make them for us?
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_304: I require a fluid that will help us maintain a constant temperature around the stone─I fear drastic fluctuations may cause it to crack and damage. Can I trust you to make it for us?
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_305: Wurfurtar will keep you stocked with all the supplies you need. Good luck, , although I know you need it not.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_310: Your work will help us uncover the sepulchre while preserving the precious information it holds. Remember, if you need more supplies, Wurfurtar is standing by.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_WURFURTAR_000_325: Hard at work, eh? Fahrafahr has told me to give you all the supplies you need─seems she's sparing no expense.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_WURFURTAR_000_340: The sepulchre's still stuck in the ice, is it? Well, these supplies should help craft whatever it is you need to fix that!
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_400: Have you finished already? Good, good. May I have a look?
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_401: As I said, you do not disappoint! These will certainly help us free the sepulchre from that stubborn ice.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_402: With work on the larder going well, our goal feels so close at hand. I want to rush headlong to the end, but I know haste will only set us back.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_450: Beautiful, is it not? Despite his age, Kurbulur may have hauled more snow than the rest of us combined!
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_451: Having a place to store our daily foodstuffs will certainly make our lives easier. Of course, we also intend to devote space to the cold-resistant corn after we can grow and harvest it.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_452: I hear the others have already found a plot for cornfields, so the larder may become crowded soon enough. I only hope we can figure out exactly how the plant fits into the ritual.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_454: Although it may take time, I promise to read every single word you left us.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_455: I always enjoyed the wisdom and wit of your conversation, and now I have been blessed to speak with you again. Nothing could make me happier.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_FAHRAFAHR_000_456: Deciphering the story of Dartorgor and the spirits will take time, so please be patient. It seems I must consult the surrounding stonework to glean its whole meaning.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_SYSTEM_000_457: The high larder has been restored, giving the Yok Huy a place to store their food.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_SYSTEM_000_458: Dartorgor's living sepulchre may hold the secrets to the Pact, but there is yet work to be done until it is deciphered!
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_SYSTEM_000_500: You have achieved Respected reputation with the Hands of Zirgorteh.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_SYSTEM_000_501: Continue working with the Yok Huy to deepen your relationship.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_SYSTEM_000_502: New Yok Huy society daily quests are now available from Vuyargur in Shelter.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_SYSTEM_000_503: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Vuyargur as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_SYSTEM_000_504: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Vuyargur. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANYOK003_05332_SYSTEM_000_505: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Rarkorgor.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_001: It is always good to see you at Shelter, . You will be pleased to hear I have finished reading Dartorgor's living sepulchre, and it was just as illuminating as we had hoped.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_002: There are more good tidings, as well. Kurbulur spread word of our work throughout Worlar's Echo, and another Yok Huy has joined us, ready and eager to contribute.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_003: He brought with him a stone golem, which our people used in ancient times to build the very settlement that stretches below us!
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_100_003: I am unfamiliar with their workings myself, but I know that long ago, some among us could bend stone to their will. I hear the golems can work without tiring, making them perfect beasts of burden.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_004: For despite our strength, even Yok Huy require rest. But with a golem at our disposal, we could make progress toward our goal day and night.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_005: You want to see it in action, yes? I would be happy to show you, but it is ancient and must be tested thoroughly before we set it to work.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_006: For now, allow me to show you the sepulchre and share with you what I learned about the Pact. Come with me, will you?
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_100: Once I found the threads connecting the glyphs on the sepulchre to those on the nearby pillars, I was able to piece their stories together. They told of Dartorgor's life here, and of course, the Pact.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_101: Apparently, the close bond Dartorgor's forebears came to share with the spirits was formed almost entirely by chance.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_102: You see, the Yok Huy living here drank a corn liquor called kirkahryar to warm their bodies against the cold. One particularly frigid day, they noticed the spirits lingering about near where the liquor was stored, as if drawn by the scent of the drink.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_103: Thus the Yok Huy made their first offering, curious as to what would happen. The once temperamental spirits became placid almost at once─friendly, even.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_104: In fact, they started visiting often, regaling the Yok Huy with their strange games and charming antics.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_105: Eventually the altar was built, and the Pact was performed to serve the spirits their favorite libation. Over generations, their bond deepened...
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_106: But each generation of Yok Huy numbered fewer than the last.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_107: Dartorgor saw her family depart, one by one, until only she remained.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_108: Even so, she was not lonely. Her parents lived on in her memory, and the spirits were by her side.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_109: Dartorgor's sepulchre contained vivid scenes of her frolicking in the snow with the spirits. Of them gazing up at the moonlit sky together.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_110: One passage was dedicated to the time she and the spirits saw the frostblooms. The flowers blossom only rarely, and Dartorgor plainly cherished the moment.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_111: But then the stories end so suddenly...because she...
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_112: ...My apologies, . Her absence pains me, but this feeling means she is yet with me. And that is enough.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_113: Dartorgor's sepulchre has shown us the way. An offering of kirkahryar is sure to calm the spirits once again.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_114: Since Kurbulur manages our foodstuffs, he should know how soon the corn liquor can be ready. Let us ask him, .
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_200: Kurbulur already knows what I discovered, and I think he should have useful advice about the kirkahryar.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_KURBULUR_000_300: I haven't heard of kirkahryar before, but it explains the corn's odd flavor. It was never meant to be eaten.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_KURBULUR_000_301: We recently found a ruined building, and I thought it might've been a kitchen or something of the like. But now I'm thinking that's where they made the drink.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_302: Dartorgor has given us a gift, truly. We know what to restore next!
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_100_302: The golem would help us complete that task much faster, and its testing should hopefully be done by now. We should go check on them!
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_303: This will actually be my first time seeing a golem with my own eyes. Another new experience for which I have Dartorgor to thank!
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_KURBULUR_100_303: Hah, look at her! Fahrafahr's spirits seem lighter than ever! Dartorgor must be proud.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_KURBULUR_110_303: I heard they were testing the golem on the outskirts of Worlar's Echo. You're in for a sight, ─best get going before you miss the show!
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_KURBULUR_000_305: We've already set aside space for the corn and were getting ready to plant the seeds once we knew their exact purpose. I suppose that time has come!
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_GOLEMYOKHUY05333_00: Huh? Are you talking to me? I'm thinking, here...
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_315: This is the golem? Is it supposed to be so...still?
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_400: You seem to recognize our new stony friend. Have you encountered one of these before?
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_100_400: You fought them in Yak T'el? Why, is there any corner of Tural that does not bear your footprints?
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_401: This golem was apparently used for building, so we need not worry about being attacked, even if it was moving.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_GOLEMYOKHUY05333_00: Hmm. And it won't be moving until we have what we need.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_403: This is the fresh volunteer I spoke of. And although he was kind enough to bring the golem, it appears something is lacking...
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_100_403: If you tell us what it is, perhaps we can help.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_GOLEMYOKHUY05333_00: Something's wrong with the parts that make it move. Tell me, what do you know about the golems?
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_405: Only that they were used long ago. I never had the chance to see them build Worlar's Echo.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_100_405: I would very much like to hear more about them, however. Perhaps even  here would learn something new.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_GOLEMYOKHUY05333_00: Very well. I take it even a youngling like you knows that some Yok Huy were masters of the stone around us.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_GOLEMYOKHUY05333_10: And although many now know them as machines of war, their original purpose was to shoulder the burden of physical labor.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_GOLEMYOKHUY05333_00: They built our houses and paved the ground beneath our feet. The secrets of stone were passed down through generations, and my forebears were proud of what their knowledge had provided our people.
But then we foolishly went to war. The servants we had used for creation were instead outfitted to destroy. The golems were turned into weapons...
When peace came again, we looked to less cumbersome and dangerous tools. The golems fell into disuse and gathered dust in storehouses.
When I heard of your work here, I knew it was a chance to prove their worth once again. I brought this golem all the way here on my own, but the long years haven't been kind to its delicate parts.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_412: I think I understand. You require replacements, yes?
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_GOLEMYOKHUY05333_00: That's right. And spare parts aren't exactly easy to come by, so we'll have to make them ourselves.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_414: If you tell me what you need, I can ask one of our artisans to make them.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_A1_000_002: You must swear not to use them as weapons again.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_GOLEMYOKHUY05333_00: Why, I would be in your debt. And if you're worried about its armaments, rest assured they are broken beyond my skill or desire to repair them.
