Believe me, I couldn't do that even if you asked me. All its armaments have long since ceased to function, and I've not the skill or desire to repair it.
My best guess is that the energy transmission components in our golem are worn out. To make more, we'd need parts that are highly conductive to magical energies. That should get it moving.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_419: You know, I think Wurfurtar can help us out with this problem. Come, , let us see if he can procure the materials we need.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_GOLEMYOKHUY05333_00: We need to power the golem before it can move, and for that we need components that can conduct energy all throughout its massive frame. I hope you can find what we need.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_SYSTEM_000_430: The golem lacks the components required to make aether flow throughout its stone body.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_500: Good news, ! Wurfurtar was able to use his connections to provide us with highly conductive materials!
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_501: These should be enough to make metal circuits that will enhance the flow of energy through the golem's body. Can I count on you to craft them?
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_502: These should be enough to make components that will enhance the flow of energy through the golem's body. Can I count on you to craft them?
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_503: These should be enough to make a lubricant that will enhance the flow of energy through the golem's body. Can I count on you to craft it?
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_504: If you need a resupply of materials, just ask Wurfurtar for more.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_505: Good luck, . If we can get that golem walking again, we'll have both the brewery and the altar fully restored in no time!
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_510: Do you have enough materials? If you need more, Wurfurtar will provide.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_WURFURTAR_000_525: We are so close to finishing our work! If there's anything you need to help make that happen, just ask.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_WURFURTAR_000_540: Need more supplies, ? Take as much as you need!
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_545: Are you finished? Oh, I can barely wait to see...
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_546: Ah, fantastic work, although I expected no less! Still, to think you could craft a perfect replacement part for a mechanism so ancient─truly, your imagination astounds me.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_547: While you were doing the creative part, we managed to find some stone which should help patch up some of the other wear and tear. Let us return to the keeper.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_548: Assuming everything goes to plan, then our long project will be as good as finished!
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_550: Look at what everyone's hard work has achieved. The golem, too, was every bit as helpful as we had hoped. The Breathless Altar is restored at last!
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_000_551: Now we only need wait for the kirkahryar to ferment, and the Pact can begin. Until then, there are plenty of odds and ends to wrap up.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_100_551: By the way, . Would you like to share a drink with me when it is done?
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_FAHRAFAHR_110_551: Of course, the first batch of kirkahryar will be used for the ritual, but I see no harm in a little indulgence afterwards. Nothing is sweeter than the fruits of one's labors, after all.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_SYSTEM_000_552: With the restoration of the kirkahryar house and the Breathless Altar, Zirgorteh the Open-armed has been restored to its former glory!
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_SYSTEM_000_553: Keep assisting Fahrafahr to ensure a successful Pact that will restore peace to Urqopacha.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_SYSTEM_000_600: You have achieved Honored reputation with the Hands of Zirgorteh.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_SYSTEM_000_601: Continue working with the Yok Huy to deepen your relationship.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_SYSTEM_000_602: New Yok Huy society daily quests are now available from Vuyargur in Shelter.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_SYSTEM_000_603: Furthermore, you will be able to undertake three additional quests from Vuyargur as a reputation bonus. This bonus is available until the daily reset time for allied society quests.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_SYSTEM_000_604: These additional quests will become available after accepting all current daily quests from Vuyargur. Please be advised that you cannot undertake these quests if you have no remaining allowances.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_SYSTEM_000_605: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Rarkorgor.
TEXT_BANYOK004_05333_SYSTEM_000_700: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_001: , ! There you are, and just in time!
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_002: We have finally finished our first batch of kirkahryar, and it seems the scent has attracted the snow spirits!
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_003: If we can get them to approach the altar, we can finally perform the Pact!
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_100_003: I wish to begin preparations right away, but I require your aid in a small matter. Will you help us?
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_004: I simply need you to take a jar of kirkahryar and place it on the altar. That should draw the spirits near, and then we can begin the ritual!
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_005: I will begin preparations for the ritual. Once you bring the kirkahryar to the altar, we can begin!
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_YOKHUYBREWERY05334_: The spirits are here, you say? Well, if you need kirkahryar for the ritual, I certainly have enough barrels of the stuff.
As much as I would like to see the offering for myself, too many of us may scare the spirits off, so I leave it in your and Fahrafahr's capable hands.
You must promise to come back and tell me how it was. For my part, I will pray the spirits return to their playful nature.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_099: The spirits should be close. Now that the kirkahryar is in its rightful place, we need only wait. It might be best if we hide, though... How about over there?
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_103: It spoke! They accepted the offering!
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_100_103: Dartorgor told me about you, you know. She taught me that kirkahryar would quell the rage that sometimes grows within you. I only hope we can speak as friends once more.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_RYOQORTERTEH_000_10: Dartorgor...? But, she is not here now? How boring. We hate her...
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_105: Hate...? What do you mean? Was Dartorgor not a dear friend? Did you not live here together in peace?
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_RYOQORTERTEH_000_10: Dartorgor abandons us! She breaks her promise to look at the blooming flowers together!
We wait for her, even as flowers wilt. Dartorgor never returns!
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_108: I have something I must share with you. Dartorgor's body is gone...
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_RYOQORTERTEH_000_10: Gone? What do you mean? We do not understand!
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_111: The spirits return on each snowy day. They do not pass from this world, nor have any concept of life and death.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_112: So they believe Dartorgor abandoned them. That she broke her promise to stay with them.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_113: And Dartorgor was not the first. The spirits watched as their friends went away, until none remained. They endured loss after loss...
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_RYOQORTERTEH_000_11: You, too, will abandon us...with no good-byes. We will not play with you...
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_300: Well, at least Ryoqor Terteh was composed enough to speak...
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_301: A small step forward, but its parting words were far from encouraging. Given the strength of their bond with Dartorgor, I can only imagine how betrayed they must feel at her departure.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_302: If they come to hate us Yok Huy, they will shun the Pact as well. Then it will be but a matter of time until they rage again─or worse.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_303: We must think of a solution before that happens. Do you mind coming with me to Dartorgor's sepulchre so we can discuss the matter?
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_400: The eternal nature of the spirits means they view things quite differently from us. Their bodies are always revived, no matter what damage it may suffer.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_401: So even if I were to form a strong bond with them, they would only experience the same pain again when my own body passed.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_402: There must be a way to make them understand, yet no answers come to me. I tried to imagine what Dartorgor might do, but still...nothing.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_403: Do you have any ideas, ? This is as much for the sake of the spirits as it is for us, so even the smallest bit of advice would be much appreciated.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_A2_000_001: Remind me what the Yok Huy believe about death, again?
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_A2_000_002: Can we not leave a physical reminder?
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_405: Of course... So long as we are remembered, we yet live. Just as Dartorgor yet lives inside me.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_406: You mean like the living sepulchres? Yes... So long as we are remembered, we yet live. Just as Dartorgor yet lives inside me.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_100_406: But how can we make the spirits understand something so foreign to their own experience?
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_407: We cherish the sepulchres as a symbol of the connection between memory and life.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_408: Yet even if the spirits cannot grasp that concept, if we were to explain their purpose in simpler terms─that the sepulchres immortalize precious memories of our time together─then perhaps they will understand.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_409: A sepulchre dedicated to the spirits would show them that even when I am gone, our bond will live on. That me, Dartorgor, and all the other Yok Huy who frolic in the snow will be with them forever!
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_410: Yet even if we made such a thing, the sepulchre would have no meaning if the spirits were unwilling to see it.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_411: , could you invite them to come view the frostblooms? I believe such an invitation will be too tantalizing for them to resist.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_412: I shall see to it that both the flowers and sepulchre are ready for their arrival, but I may need your help somewhere along the way.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_416: When the spirits are calm, they tend to wander. I remember they were often sighted on the road to Worqor Zormor─tell a few about the frostblooms, and word is sure to spread.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_RORRLOHTEH_000_501: Oh joy! But where is Dartorgor? We want to see her. We want to see flowers with her!
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_RORRLOHTEH_000_502: Dartorgor promises to see flowers with us!
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_RORRLOHTEH_000_503: Maybe...Dartorgor comes? Maybe this time...and if Dartorgor comes, we will go!
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_SYSTEM_000_504: There are no more spirits in sight. Return to Fahrafahr and inform her of your success.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_600: Thank you for speaking with the spirits. I only hope the sepulchre has its intended effect.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_603: Speaking of which, I believe we shall require your aid in that regard. You see, we realize the spirits likely cannot read our inscriptions, which would quite defeat the purpose of the sepulchre.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_604: Yet if they were engraved with chisels imbued with magic energies, we believe the spirits would grasp their intended meaning. You can take care of that, right?
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_605: Yet if they were polished by tools imbued with magic energies, we believe the spirits would grasp their intended meaning. You can take care of that, right?
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_606: Yet if they were painted by a substance imbued with magic energies, we believe the spirits would grasp their intended meaning. You can take care of that, right?
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_607: If you could craft what we require, we would be in your debt. Here, these materials should be enough for now, but if you perchance run out, Wurfurtar can replenish your supplies.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_610: The future of the Hands─and of Worlar's Echo itself─depends on our success here, but I know you require no additional motivation to produce your best work. Remember that Wurfurtar stands ready with more supplies if you require them.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_WURFURTAR_000_625: The spirits' moods shift directions more often than a flake in a snowstorm, don't they? Luckily my store of supplies is something you can always rely upon to be full.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_WURFURTAR_000_640: If it's supplies you need, I have you covered. Fahrafahr's told me how important this task is, so come back as many times as you need!
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_645: Have you finished? This may be your most important contribution yet, so I am anxious to see the finished product.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_646: Ah, I see my concern was misplaced. Impressive as always, ! With these we can get the sepulchre ready for the spirits right away.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_647: Soon they shall know just how much we value their companionship. For all you have done, , I would extend a personal invitation to the unveiling of the sepulchre and the frostblooms.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_RYOQORTERTEH_000_65: We remember this one. They say the flowers bloom. Dartorgor makes that promise, too...
Dartorgor...who is not here. Where does she go? Why does she leave us?
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_652: Dartorgor is with you, even now!
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_653: Before we see the flowers, there is something I would show you. Follow me, please.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_655: We Yok Huy call this a living sepulchre. On them we carve the stories of our lives lived while we walked the earth.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_656: This one belongs to Dartorgor. On it are recorded the days spent frolicking with you and the other spirits.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_657: When the Yok Huy─ No, when all peoples reach the end of their lifespan, they must leave their bodies behind.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_100_657: Yet so long as we have these sepulchres, the lives they lived will never be forgotten. The happy times, the joyous moments...they will last forever.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_RYOQORTERTEH_000_65: Your words... We do not understand. You say Dartorgor is here, but she is not. That is no comfort...
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_659: There is something else I would show you. It is at the altar.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_660: This, too, is a living sepulchre. One we recently made, which is dedicated to you and yours.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_661: At the moment, we have only recorded your time spent with Dartorgor. From this day forward, though, we hope to add many more stories of days spent in peace and playfulness.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_100_661: We are not like the spirits─the time comes for all of us when we must leave this world.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_110_661: Yet even when I am gone, this will remain. And those who come after me will carve their memories upon this stone as well. Their memories of their time with you.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_662: So there is no need to be lonely any longer. We will be here with you always─just like Dartorgor.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_RYOQORTERTEH_000_66: We will not be alone? Never again?
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_100_663: Yes, and neither will I. Dartorgor lives on still, within me.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_110_663: And when my body passes from this world, Dartorgor and I will live on within you. Within you, and within those who carry on the Pact after us.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_FAHRAFAHR_000_664: And now, I know you were promised flowers. Let us view them together─the story of that moment shall be the next to be inscribed on the sepulchre.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_SYSTEM_000_666: The flowers are so pretty, aren't they? We can see them together every time they bloom.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_RYOQORTERTEH_000_66: Dartorgor comes... Dartorgor remembers her promise. Remembers us.
Now we play! Play with our new friends!
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_SYSTEM_000_700: You have achieved Sworn reputation with the Hands of Zirgorteh.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_SYSTEM_000_701: The snow spirits have been placated and have reforged their bond of trust with the Yok Huy.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_SYSTEM_000_702: You will receive an experience point bonus upon completion of Yok Huy society daily quests.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_SYSTEM_000_703: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Rarkorgor.
TEXT_BANYOK005_05334_SYSTEM_000_800: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_FAHRAFAHR_000_001: Greetings, ! Your continued efforts at keeping the altar maintained have been much appreciated.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_FAHRAFAHR_000_002: Seeing it in pristine shape seems to set the spirits' hearts at ease, and our friendship grows stronger by the day. They accept our offerings with glee, and seek opportunities for play more often than ever before.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_FAHRAFAHR_000_003: If you have a free moment, come visit us at Zirgorteh the Open-armed. The spirits would be overjoyed to see you, I am sure.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_FAHRAFAHR_000_005: Ryoqor Terteh comes to chat whenever it sees me. It never tires of telling me of its days spent capering about the mountains.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_RORRLOHTEH05335A_00: Play with us! Come, hide in the snow and we search for you!
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_GIRZORHOR_000_101: You won't find me this time! Hah, to think I was ever scared of such a little thing.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_RORRLOHTEH05335B_00: A big feast for you! Is it good? Is it delicious?
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_KURBULUR_000_103: I offered this little one some kirkahryar, and it gave me this chunk of snow in return.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_KURBULUR_000_104: Seems this is their idea of food... Heh, well, who am I to deny such a gift?
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_RORRLOHTEH05335C_00: The crafty one comes! Craftiest of all! We put the story of the crafty one on the big rock!
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_YOKHUY05335_000_106: The spirits remember you well, . The artisan who helped them forget rage and remember joy.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_YOKHUY05335_000_107: They understand that the living sepulchre is where memorable things are recorded. If you don't mind, we might dedicate a section to you.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_A1_000_001: I would be honored to be a part of the Yok Huy's history.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_A1_000_002: I need some time to think about it...
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_YOKHUY05335_000_109: Good, good. The story of the Hands of Zirgorteh would be incomplete without mention of your many contributions.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_YOKHUY05335_000_110: Of course, I understand completely. But I believe the story of the Hands of Zirgorteh would be incomplete without mention of your many contributions.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_YOKHUY05335_000_111: You have my personal thanks, as well, for helping us find our way through this crisis.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_GIRZORHOR_000_115: The spirits are─well, in high spirits, I suppose! They seem even more lively than before, in fact.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_RORRLOHTEH05335A_00: Play in the snow with us! Play and play and play!
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_KURBULUR_000_125: Truth be told, I had my doubts about growing and brewing corn all the way up in these snowy peaks. Now I see all those hours spent shoveling snow were worth it after all.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_RORRLOHTEH05335B_00: We wash down our drink with a hearty helping of snow! You eat, too?
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_YOKHUY05335_000_135: We owe you a debt we can never repay, . Without your help, I can't imagine what the valley would look like now.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_RORRLOHTEH05335C_00: Crafty one can eat all the snow they can swallow!
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_FAHRAFAHR_000_200: Did you visit with the snow spirits?
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_RYOQORTERTEH_000_20: The crafty one has our gratitude. With so many new friends, we will never be bored!
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_FAHRAFAHR_000_202: You have my gratitude as well, . Your skilled hands helped us rebuild our relationship with the spirits into something even stronger than it was before.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_FAHRAFAHR_100_202: Speaking of which, I have noticed something peculiar during our interactions.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_FAHRAFAHR_110_202: When the spirits “play,” it seems to enhance the ice energy in the surrounding air. This causes freshly fallen snow to bond more closely with old layers, making them much less likely to separate.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_FAHRAFAHR_120_202: This means that the snow spirits were never directly responsible for the avalanches. In fact, by frolicking with Dartorgor, they prevented countless disasters.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_RYOQORTERTEH_000_20: Dartorgor lives inside us! We are together always!
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_FAHRAFAHR_000_204: We could never have come this far without you, . You will always be welcome in Zirgorteh the Open-armed.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_FAHRAFAHR_000_205: Once things settle down, I plan on making my own sepulchre.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_FAHRAFAHR_000_206: And from this day forward, the spirits and the Yok Huy shall walk side by side. Dartorgor is proud, I can feel it.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_FAHRAFAHR_000_207: That being said, there is still work to be done before we can rest. If you would lend us your skills again, we would happily accept the aid.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_SYSTEM_000_209: You have achieved Bloodsworn reputation with the Hands of Zirgorteh.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_SYSTEM_000_210: You will receive an experience point bonus upon completion of Yok Huy society daily quests.
TEXT_BANYOK006_05335_SYSTEM_000_211: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from Rarkorgor.
TEXT_BANYOK101_05336_VUYARGUR_000_001: With Warmth now happily restored, our work has commenced in earnest. There shall be a constant need to clear away snow, and I would grateful if you could contribute some equipment for that purpose.
TEXT_BANYOK101_05336_VUYARGUR_000_002: , might I trouble you to contribute more equipment for clearing away snow?
TEXT_BANYOK101_05336_VUYARGUR_000_003: Snow becomes unmanageable if allowed to accumulate unchecked. I would ensure that the tools are always available, that anyone may tend to the removal in their spare moments.
TEXT_BANYOK101_05336_VUYARGUR_000_004: When you are ready, please seek out Xarhorkur at Zirgorteh the Open-armed. She will furnish you with the materials you need.
TEXT_BANYOK101_05336_XARHORKUR_000_005: Welcome, . I understand you are helping us make snow removal equipment.
TEXT_BANYOK101_05336_XARHORKUR_000_006: We would be grateful if you could craft some tool heads. Here are the necessary materials─should you require more, you need but say the word.
TEXT_BANYOK101_05336_XARHORKUR_000_007: We would be grateful if you could craft some tool handles. Here are the necessary materials─should you require more, you need but say the word.
TEXT_BANYOK101_05336_XARHORKUR_000_008: We would be grateful if you could concoct some snow melting agent. Here are the necessary ingredients─should you require more, you need but say the word.
TEXT_BANYOK101_05336_XARHORKUR_000_009: When you have finished, please deliver your handiwork to our provisioner yonder. Our thanks for your kind assistance!
TEXT_BANYOK101_05336_XARHORKUR_000_010: In need of more materials, are you? ...Ah no, it seems you still have some.
TEXT_BANYOK101_05336_XARHORKUR_000_013: In need of more materials, are you? Then please take these.
TEXT_BANYOK101_05336_YOK05336MOB_000_017: Ah, do you have some snow removal tools for me, perchance?
TEXT_BANYOK101_05336_YOK05336MOB_000_018: Oho, these look to be excellent quality indeed. They shall serve us very well. You may return to Vuyargur with my gratitude.
TEXT_BANYOK101_05336_VUYARGUR_000_019: How fared you with the snow removal tools?
TEXT_BANYOK101_05336_VUYARGUR_000_020: All crafted and delivered, then. We are in your debt.
TEXT_BANYOK101_05336_VUYARGUR_000_021: While snowflakes are light as air, they can quickly form burdensome piles. We must be diligent in clearing away snow, and for that we can never have too much equipment.
TEXT_BANYOK101_05336_VUYARGUR_000_022: In this, and many other things, we hope we can rely on your continued cooperation.
TEXT_BANYOK102_05337_VUYARGUR_000_001: Since our work commenced, we have been needing to transport large amounts of supplies to Zirgorteh the Open-armed.
TEXT_BANYOK102_05337_VUYARGUR_000_002: While we have simple, sturdy carts for this purpose, there is presently not enough to meet demand. I wish to build more, and ask that you furnish us with some necessary parts.
TEXT_BANYOK102_05337_VUYARGUR_000_003: , might I trouble you to furnish us with cart components again?
TEXT_BANYOK102_05337_VUYARGUR_000_004: The conveyances assembled using your parts are highly favored for their maneuverability, and I have a mind to build more.
TEXT_BANYOK102_05337_VUYARGUR_000_005: Garharlor yonder has the materials you require, so please present yourself to him. My thanks in advance.
TEXT_BANYOK102_05337_GARHARLOR_000_006: You are helping us build carts? Good, good, quality components are always welcome.
TEXT_BANYOK102_05337_GARHARLOR_000_007: Without further ado, then, please use these materials to prepare parts for the underframe. If you run out, I shall provide you with more.
TEXT_BANYOK102_05337_GARHARLOR_000_008: Without further ado, then, please use these materials to prepare parts for the dampener. If you run out, I shall provide you with more.
TEXT_BANYOK102_05337_GARHARLOR_000_009: Without further ado, then, please use these materials to prepare parts for the axle. If you run out, I shall provide you with more.
TEXT_BANYOK102_05337_GARHARLOR_000_010: When the items are ready, you may deliver them directly to Vuyargur. I wish you happy crafting.
TEXT_BANYOK102_05337_GARHARLOR_000_011: Do you require more materials? You need but say the word if so.
TEXT_BANYOK102_05337_GARHARLOR_000_014: You require more materials? Here, please use these.
TEXT_BANYOK102_05337_VUYARGUR_000_018: Ah, . How are the cart components coming along?
TEXT_BANYOK102_05337_VUYARGUR_000_019: Sturdy and light... At scarcely more than a glance, you were able to identify a point for improvement. You truly are an extraordinary artisan.
TEXT_BANYOK102_05337_VUYARGUR_000_020: You spare no effort, and it shows in the finish. I receive these with thanks.
TEXT_BANYOK102_05337_VUYARGUR_000_021: We Yok Huy traditionally build with stone and wood, and typically prioritize strength at the cost of weight.
TEXT_BANYOK102_05337_VUYARGUR_000_022: Given the mountainous terrain in which the carts will be used, however, it would be wise to keep weight to a limit. Your components help us to achieve that, and I shall enjoy assembling the final product with them.
TEXT_BANYOK103_05338_VUYARGUR_000_001: It goes without saying, but we require a prodigious amount of supplies for the restoration. In order to augment our stores, Nopli has kindly introduced us to a traveling trader from the capital.
TEXT_BANYOK103_05338_VUYARGUR_000_002: When I spoke with the trader about what we require, I chanced to mention your involvement in the restoration─and what should he do but request your crafting services as payment.
TEXT_BANYOK103_05338_VUYARGUR_000_003: , do you recall the merchant who requested your services as payment for supplies? Well, so impressed was he by your previous effort, he would like to engage you again.
TEXT_BANYOK103_05338_VUYARGUR_000_004: The man is presently come to Worlar's Echo. If you are willing to take on the task, I will see to it that you are duly compensated for your labors.
TEXT_BANYOK103_05338_PELUPELU05338_000_0: Ah, so you are ! I've heard much about your expert artisanry. It's an honor to make your acquaintance!
Now, you'll excuse me if I get right to business. Of late, the people of the city have developed a fondness for foreign things. I'd like you to craft items that fill that niche.
, it's always a pleasure. This hardly came as any surprise, but your previous creations fairly flew off the shelves!
Now then, as Vuyargur will have told you, I'd like you to craft more articles of foreign design.

This time, I seek Eorzean-style house plaques─three of them, shall we say. These materials should suffice for the quantity, but if you have need of more, please help yourself to the contents of that crate.

This time, I seek Eorzean-style wall decorations─three of them, shall we say. These materials should suffice for the quantity, but if you have need of more, please help yourself to the contents of that crate.

This time, I seek paint of a color uncommon in Tural─three pots, shall we say. These ingredients should suffice for the quantity, but if you have need of more, please help yourself to the contents of that crate.
TEXT_BANYOK103_05338_SYSTEM_000_012: The crate appears to be filled to the brim with sundry materials─none of which you require at this time.
TEXT_BANYOK103_05338_SYSTEM_000_013: You obtain additional crafting materials from the crate.
TEXT_BANYOK103_05338_PELUPELU05338_000_0: Dare I hope the requested items are ready?
Oho, marvelous! These are bound to fetch a high price! Here, please accept these supplies as payment for your services.
Vuyargur will find they're more than what we agreed on, but in light of what you've provided, it's only fair. You have my heartfelt thanks!
TEXT_BANYOK103_05338_PELUPELU05338_100_0: My thanks again for your services, and please pass along my regards to Vuyargur!
TEXT_BANYOK103_05338_VUYARGUR_000_017: Ah, you are returned. Did everything proceed smoothly with the merchant?
TEXT_BANYOK103_05338_VUYARGUR_000_018: Goodness me, this is far more supplies than I was expecting! If this is what's considered fair payment, then your work must have been impressive indeed.
TEXT_BANYOK103_05338_VUYARGUR_000_019: With foreigners being regarded more favorably of late, decorating one's home in foreign fashion has apparently become commonplace. For the merchant to invest in this venture, he must have had confidence in your familiarity with the arts from across the salt.
TEXT_BANYOK103_05338_VUYARGUR_000_020: The Pelupelu never cease to amaze me with their eye for opportunity. And thanks to your capable cooperation, we were able to secure a generous amount of supplies.
TEXT_BANYOK103_05338_VUYARGUR_000_021: Should the merchant return with another request, I hope that we can depend on your expertise again.
TEXT_BANYOK104_05339_VUYARGUR_000_001: We Yok Huy use glowstone as a source of light in our homes, and we wish to employ it at the altar as well.
TEXT_BANYOK104_05339_VUYARGUR_000_002: As the stone lies deep in the earth alongside fossilized matter, however, we must rely on seasoned mountaineers for its location and excavation.
TEXT_BANYOK104_05339_VUYARGUR_000_003: I have tasked one such individual with the work to the north of Worlar's Echo. Might I trouble you to pay him a visit to see if he has found anything for us?
TEXT_BANYOK104_05339_VUYARGUR_000_004: I have tasked our mountaineer with excavating glowstone again. Might I trouble you to pay him another visit to see if he has found anything for us?
TEXT_BANYOK104_05339_VUYARGUR_000_005: As before, he should be performing his work to the north of Worlar's Echo. The way can be treacherous, so do take care with your footing.
TEXT_BANYOK104_05339_YOK05339_000_006: Vuyargur sent you to collect the glowstone, did he? Here, take this.
TEXT_BANYOK104_05339_YOK05339_000_007: That there is an exceptionally pure example, far rarer than what was requested and laborious to find. But in view of your efforts to restore peace to our land, I render it up gladly.
TEXT_BANYOK104_05339_YOK05339_000_008: Ah, it's you again. Here for the glowstone, I take it. You may take this with you.
TEXT_BANYOK104_05339_YOK05339_000_009: Should Vuyargur require more, I should be glad to provide. These old bones may creak more than they used to, but I consider it my little way of contributing to the cause.
TEXT_BANYOK104_05339_YOK05339_000_010: I am counting on your success─we all are.
TEXT_BANYOK104_05339_VUYARGUR_000_011: Did the mountaineer have glowstone for us?
TEXT_BANYOK104_05339_VUYARGUR_000_012: Well now, this is a fine specimen indeed, of a quality befitting ceremonial use. It is very generous of him to yield such.
TEXT_BANYOK104_05339_VUYARGUR_000_013: Perhaps you already know this, but we Yok Huy have a ritual whereby we prolong the radiance of glowstone by sprinkling it with saltwater imbued with prayers.
TEXT_BANYOK104_05339_VUYARGUR_000_014: We Yok Huy have a tradition whereby we prolong the radiance of glowstone by sprinkling it with saltwater imbued with prayers.
TEXT_BANYOK104_05339_VUYARGUR_000_015: Those prayers harbor the desire for our lives to endure in serenity, like the stone's gentle glow.
TEXT_BANYOK104_05339_VUYARGUR_000_016: I shall pray for the same as I put this glowstone to use in our work. My thanks for the delivery, .
TEXT_BANYOK105_05340_VUYARGUR_000_000: Xarhorkur, one of our toolkeepers, was kind enough to prepare us portable hand warmers to stave off the mountain's bitter chill. To prolong their use, however, we must swap out their components from time to time.
TEXT_BANYOK105_05340_VUYARGUR_000_001: Ah, . It is time once again for a few of our hand warmer components to be replaced. Might I request your assistance?
TEXT_BANYOK105_05340_VUYARGUR_000_002: We must ensure the warmers remain at a reasonable temperature, so I'd like to entrust you with the creation of new parts. Xarhorkur possesses the materials for the job─simply ask, and she shall provide.
TEXT_BANYOK105_05340_XARHORKUR_000_005: Here about the hand warmers, yes? Very good. I'm relieved we have a crafter like yourself to aid us!
TEXT_BANYOK105_05340_XARHORKUR_000_0010: Here are the requisite materials─and I have more where that came from if you require it. With them, I'd like you to craft a set of metallic casings.
TEXT_BANYOK105_05340_XARHORKUR_000_011: Here are the requisite materials─and I have more where that came from if you require it. With them, I'd like you to craft a set of storage pouches.
TEXT_BANYOK105_05340_XARHORKUR_000_012: Here are the requisite materials─and I have more where that came from if you require it. With them, I'd like you to craft a set of warming cinders.
TEXT_BANYOK105_05340_XARHORKUR_000_013: When your work is finished, you'll want to deliver your goods to our supplier. He'll see to it that they find a new home.
TEXT_BANYOK105_05340_XARHORKUR_000_020: You are in possession of hand warmer materials already, are you not? Then all is well.
TEXT_BANYOK105_05340_XARHORKUR_000_030: Ah, I see you've run out of materials. Here you are─a spare set.
TEXT_BANYOK105_05340_SUPPLYMANAGER_000_0: Yes? And what business might you have with me?
What splendidly crafted components! And with such impeccable timing, as well... We've seen more of our warmers requiring maintenance of late, so this is much appreciated.
Ah, I see you've brought more replacement components for the hand warmers! I'd be delighted to pass these on to our workers. Thank you as always for the assistance.
Work will proceed all the smoother with fresh hand warmers at our side. Thank you again for providing the spare parts.
TEXT_BANYOK105_05340_VUYARGUR_000_050: So you've crafted and delivered the warming components, have you? My thanks, . Laboring in the cold is no easy task, but the warmth you've provided means our work will proceed apace.
TEXT_BANYOK105_05340_VUYARGUR_000_051: Perhaps you are wondering why we do not simply “dress” for these climes, as others might. We Yok Huy have thicker skin than other races, you see. Our bodies are naturally resistant to cold...for the most part.
TEXT_BANYOK105_05340_VUYARGUR_000_052: Unfortunately, the skin on our fingers is comparatively thin, so we must take care to keep them warm when the mountain grows merciless. The work is grueling at times, yes...but with fresh hand warmers, we have little to fear.
TEXT_BANYOK105_05340_VUYARGUR_000_053: Your support here means a great deal to us all, so allow me to thank you once more on the project's behalf. As ever, I eagerly await your next innovations.
TEXT_BANYOK106_05341_VUYARGUR_000_000: I'm told the restoration workers residing on the mountain are running low on critical materials. We've a mind to replenish a few daily necessities, if you're willing to contribute.
TEXT_BANYOK106_05341_VUYARGUR_000_001: Our supplier at Warmth has but recently taken inventory. He should be able to give you a more detailed report of what we currently lack.
TEXT_BANYOK106_05341_VUYARGUR_000_002: The workers tell me our stock of daily necessities is dwindling yet again. I'd like to resupply our stores as soon as possible─with your invaluable aid, of course.
TEXT_BANYOK106_05341_VUYARGUR_000_003: In light of this, I imagine the supplier at Warmth has already taken inventory. He should be able to inform you of the goods we currently lack.
TEXT_BANYOK106_05341_SUPPLYMANAGER_000_0: With so many restoration workers choosing to dwell here, the demand for living necessities increases by the day... That said, we can barely keep up.
We're sorely in need of silverware, so I'd like to make that our first priority. I've already prepared the necessary materials─you are free to take more from the crate there, should you require it.

We're sorely in need of cleaning cloths, so I'd like to make that our first priority. I've already prepared the necessary materials─you are free to take more from the crate there, should you require it.
We're sorely in need of medicine, so I'd like to make that our first priority. I've already prepared the necessary materials─you are free to take more from the crate there, should you require it.
TEXT_BANYOK106_05341_SYSTEM_000_020: The crate appears to be filled to the brim with sundry materials─none of which you require at this time.
TEXT_BANYOK106_05341_SYSTEM_000_030: You obtain additional crafting materials from the crate.
TEXT_BANYOK106_05341_SUPPLYMANAGER_000_0: Ah, you're back. The crafting went smoothly, I take it?
Let's see here... Yes, this is just enough! On behalf of our workers, I offer my thanks.
Your presence is a gift to us, , and I am sure Vuyargur is of the same mind. I wager he's just as eager to hear of your efforts, so I'll leave you to report the good news to him.
Thank you again, . Now, you'd best be off to Vuyargur. Wouldn't want to keep him waiting, would you?
TEXT_BANYOK106_05341_VUYARGUR_000_050: The restocking went smoothly? Excellent! Many thanks to you, . The journey from the peaks to Worlar's Echo is a lengthy one, which makes replenishing our supplies a rather thorny task...
TEXT_BANYOK106_05341_VUYARGUR_000_051: Until we are fully self-sufficient, your aid will be vital to us, just as it was today. It is my hope that we can count on you again when next our stores grow scarce.
TEXT_BANYOK107_05342_VUYARGUR_000_000: A merchant caravan has been paying more frequent visits to Zirgorteh the Open-armed of late. Glad as we are to host them, I cannot help but fear for their health in these frigid climes.
TEXT_BANYOK107_05342_VUYARGUR_000_001: I'd like to craft them some warm garments to ward off the bitter winds, but I know little and less about crafting garb for smaller folk...
TEXT_BANYOK107_05342_VUYARGUR_000_002: Might I ask you to design these vestments in my stead? Something that will keep any visitor from succumbing to the cold, no matter their size... An adjustable poncho, perhaps.
TEXT_BANYOK107_05342_VUYARGUR_000_005: Excellent news, . Your handcrafted ponchos have been the talk of Zirgorteh the Open-armed. In fact, I've received word that one of our merchant visitors wishes to purchase a few garments from you.
TEXT_BANYOK107_05342_VUYARGUR_000_006: I do not mean to impose, but would you be so kind as to prepare a few more? Our guest would be most grateful for them.
TEXT_BANYOK107_05342_VUYARGUR_000_007: Garharlor over there possesses a surplus of clothing material, so do not hesitate to make use of his stock.
TEXT_BANYOK107_05342_GARHARLOR_000_010: Looking to design some cold-resistant garb for our guests, you say? Then you've come to the right place. To ensure there's enough to go around, I suggest you craft three sets.
TEXT_BANYOK107_05342_GARHARLOR_000_020: If you could fashion up ponchos durable enough to withstand bone-chilling winds, yet lightweight enough for our smaller guests, why, that would be ideal! I've a wealth of materials at the ready, so if you need more, do feel free to ask.
TEXT_BANYOK107_05342_GARHARLOR_000_021: If you could fashion up ponchos durable enough to withstand rough mountain roads, yet comfortable and lightweight enough for our smaller guests, why, that would be ideal! I've a wealth of materials at the ready, so if you need more, do feel free to ask.
TEXT_BANYOK107_05342_GARHARLOR_000_022: If you could fashion up ponchos durable enough for proper insulation, yet lightweight enough for easy travel, why, that would be ideal! I've a wealth of materials at the ready, so if you need more, do feel free to ask.
TEXT_BANYOK107_05342_GARHARLOR_000_023: When you've finished with those garments, you'd do well to make for Worlar's Echo and seek out our Pelupelu merchant friend.
TEXT_BANYOK107_05342_GARHARLOR_000_030: You've enough materials, I hope? Good, good. If you do happen to run out, I'd be happy to provide more.
TEXT_BANYOK107_05342_GARHARLOR_000_040: In need of extra materials? Well, we've no shortage of them! Here you are.
TEXT_BANYOK107_05342_CITIZENA05342_000_0:
Oh, dear... The mountain winds are as biting as ever.
Hm? Can I help you, friend?
Ponchos for me and mine? Oh, how delightfully warm... And the size is adjustable, as well? A fine quality product indeed! I'm certain I could climb the mountain in comfort with this.
It would be my pleasure to wear it. Thank you kindly for your hard work! Please do send my regards to Vuyargur as well.

Flawless as ever, I see! My friends have scarcely stopped speaking of these ponchos since I presented them with theirs, you know. It's why I thought to buy them in bulk─to spread word of the wonderful work you're doing!
And with more in circulation, perhaps more merchants like myself will make the trek up the mountain...or so I hope! Now, then, I must be off, but mark my words: I'll be back!
TEXT_BANYOK107_05342_VUYARGUR_000_060: The ponchos were well received, were they? I'm pleased to hear it. There are many products we cannot procure from Worlar's Echo alone, so the more merchant visitors we have, the better.
TEXT_BANYOK107_05342_VUYARGUR_000_061: As our work continues, I do not doubt the restoration will see the mountain flourish with guests. Perhaps it would be prudent to craft a surplus of ponchos for them in the future...
TEXT_BANYOK107_05342_VUYARGUR_000_065: Thank you for delivering the ponchos to our merchant friend, . He and his fellows are a vital aspect of our restoration project.
TEXT_BANYOK107_05342_VUYARGUR_000_066: The Hands of Zirgorteh will not be the only ones to benefit from their patronage. As our mountain flourishes with merchants and guests, I am certain that Worlar's Echo shall grow and prosper from it as well.
TEXT_BANYOK108_05343_VUYARGUR_000_000: The preservation of our stonework has been paramount to the Yok Huy since time immemorial, and the methods of doing so have passed down through generations.
TEXT_BANYOK108_05343_VUYARGUR_000_001: One such method is the use of melting salts. We must regularly spread them around the stones, lest their edges crack and dull from the bitter cold.
TEXT_BANYOK108_05343_VUYARGUR_000_002: It has proven vital to our restoration, and we seek extra pairs of hands to aid us in the salting. If you wish to lend yours, our stonekeeper can apprise you of the details.
TEXT_BANYOK108_05343_VUYARGUR_000_005: Our new stonework stands as proud as ever, but we must continue to salt the stones if we wish to preserve their integrity. If you've time to aid us again, we would be most grateful.
TEXT_BANYOK108_05343_VUYARGUR_000_006: Seek out our stonekeeper at the workshop─he will provide you all you need.
TEXT_BANYOK108_05343_CITIZENA05343_000_0: Here to help salt the stonework, you say? Your timing couldn't be better.
The work is quite simple, really. For your part, I'd like you to scatter the salts around Warmth.
I'll take care of the other areas, so once you've applied your share, you're free to report back to Vuyargur.
Here to assist, yes? Much obliged. I was just about to start the salting, so why don't we split the work again? I'll leave Warmth to you, as before.
You needn't worry about the other areas─I'll cover them, as usual. Once you've applied your share, you're free to report back to Vuyargur.
TEXT_BANYOK108_05343_VUYARGUR_000_020: I hear you were hard at work spreading melting salts at Warmth! The stonekeeper and I greatly appreciate the effort. Were you aware that the salts we use are brought to us by Nopli?
TEXT_BANYOK108_05343_VUYARGUR_000_021: As he tells it, he's procured a healthy supply from the Yok Huy at Chirwagur Saltern. He is brave to consort with such dangerous folk...but that fearlessness speaks to his experience as a merchant.
TEXT_BANYOK108_05343_VUYARGUR_000_025: In any event, fresh snowfall is inevitable in a place like this, so I do not doubt we shall have need of you again before long.
TEXT_BANYOK108_05343_VUYARGUR_000_026: All finished with the salting, then? Very good. Fresh snow will be upon us again soon, I imagine...but when that time comes, I hope you'll be open to offering your assistance.
TEXT_BANYOK109_05344_VUYARGUR_000_000: The Pelupelu merchants have been quite helpful in procuring the necessary supplies for our work here, but they like to trade in more than just coin. They have expressed great interest in traditional Yok Huy handicrafts.
TEXT_BANYOK109_05344_VUYARGUR_000_001: Their interest is so great, in fact, that our usual artisan is quite overwhelmed by the demand. Perhaps you could lend him your expertise?
TEXT_BANYOK109_05344_VUYARGUR_000_005: More and more, the Pelupelu merchants have been requesting traditional handicrafts in lieu of coin. Might you help our artisan keep up with demand?
TEXT_BANYOK109_05344_VUYARGUR_000_006: You can find him in Worlar's Echo─and please hurry. I would rather not have our helpers collapse from overexertion.
TEXT_BANYOK109_05344_CITIZENA05344_000_0: Vuyargur sent you? Good, good. Truth be told, I'm not certain how far behind I am. All the more reason to get started right away, eh?

Most popular as of late are candlesticks adorned with traditional Yok Huy patterns. If you could craft me some using these materials, that should keep the Pelupelu merchants happy for a while. And if you need more, just take them from this crate.

Most popular as of late are accessories adorned with traditional Yok Huy patterns. If you could craft me some using these materials, that should keep the Pelupelu merchants happy for a while. And if you need more, just take them from this crate.

Most popular as of late is medicinal soap common in Worlar's Echo. If you could craft me some using these materials, that should keep the Pelupelu merchants happy for a while. And if you need more, just take them from this crate.
TEXT_BANYOK109_05344_SYSTEM_000_020: The crate appears to be filled to the brim with sundry materials─none of which you require at this time.
TEXT_BANYOK109_05344_SYSTEM_000_030: You obtain additional crafting materials from the crate.
TEXT_BANYOK109_05344_CITIZENA05344_000_0: Finished already? Let's see what you have, then.
Ah, these will trade well. Much appreciated, ─this takes a huge weight off my back.
All that's left is to pack this up along with what I've made and deliver them to the Pelupelu. I hope we can depend on your help when they come to trade again.
TEXT_BANYOK109_05344_VUYARGUR_000_050: When our artisans craft a thing, they draw upon our long history and generations of wisdom passed down from our forebears. I knew you would do honor to our deep-rooted traditions.
TEXT_BANYOK109_05344_VUYARGUR_000_051: Interest in our crafts seems to grow by the day, so I expect the merchants will be back. And when they arrive, I hope you'll lend us your skills once more.
TEXT_BANYOK109_05344_SYSTEM_000_100: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANYOK110_05345_VUYARGUR_000_000: Ah, . Just the  I wanted to see. We have a shortage of tools at Masons' Work, and I was hoping you could help shore up our supplies.
TEXT_BANYOK110_05345_VUYARGUR_000_001: This is rather an urgent task, as I would rather not have everyone idle for too long. Go speak with the supervisor at Masons' Work to find out exactly what we need.
TEXT_BANYOK110_05345_CITIZENA05345_000_0: You're the one helping us with the new tools? I'm glad to have you─we didn't expect so many eager hands to join us, and now we have to make them productive. So let's get right to it.
We need hammers, and lots of them. Luckily, there should be more than enough materials in this crate.
We need measuring tools, and lots of them. Luckily, there should be more than enough materials in this crate.
We need polish for the stone, and lots of it. Luckily, there should be more than enough materials in this crate.
TEXT_BANYOK110_05345_SYSTEM_000_020: The crate appears to be filled to the brim with sundry materials─none of which you require at this time.
TEXT_BANYOK110_05345_SYSTEM_000_030: You obtain additional crafting materials from the crate.
TEXT_BANYOK110_05345_CITIZENA05345_000_0: Finished yet? I hope so─our workers are getting restless without a task to keep them busy.
Ah, these will do. These will do splendidly! I'll pass these around straightaway.
TEXT_BANYOK110_05345_VUYARGUR_000_050: With the right tools in the right hands, everything seems to be back on schedule.
TEXT_BANYOK110_05345_VUYARGUR_000_055: This is among the largest projects I have ever helped oversee, and there simply are not enough experienced stonemasons to meet our demand. So we have begun teaching the new volunteers.
TEXT_BANYOK110_05345_VUYARGUR_000_056: Such skills are not learned overnight, as you well know, and every mason worth his salt has his fair share of worn-down tools to thank for his mastery.
TEXT_BANYOK110_05345_VUYARGUR_000_060: What you made us today will be put through its paces, you can be sure. If we need more─and I have a feeling we will─I hope we can count on you again.
TEXT_BANYOK111_05346_VUYARGUR_000_000: One of our younger workers is off on an errand but has been gone for some time. He is capable, but tends to get lost in his own thoughts...I suspect this is to blame for his current absence.
TEXT_BANYOK111_05346_VUYARGUR_000_001: I have need of his help elsewhere, so if it is not too much trouble, could you find him and give him a solid poke to get his mind back on track?
TEXT_BANYOK111_05346_VUYARGUR_000_002: Unfortunately, our favorite absent-minded worker seems to have been waylaid by his own thoughts again. I even told him I had another task waiting upon his return, but that didn't seem to help his focus.
TEXT_BANYOK111_05346_VUYARGUR_000_003: No doubt he is gazing at some mound of rocks or another. Could you find him and give him a good poke? That ought to bring him back to reality.
TEXT_BANYOK111_05346_CITIZENA05346_000_0: Ah, I see... So this goes like this. And then that...goes like that.
TEXT_BANYOK111_05346_SYSTEM_000_006: The captivated apprentice is deep in thought. Perhaps a slight poke might wake him from his daydream.
TEXT_BANYOK111_05346_CITIZENA05346_000_0: Wh-What─!? You snuck up on me! ...Why did you do that?
Vuyargur told you to look for me? ...Oh my, I completely lost track of time! This structure here caught my attention, you see. I thought maybe I could learn something by studying it.

Do you feel it? The majesty which radiates from the very stones themselves. Their patterns are intricate yet without a hint of ostentation. The superior craftsmanship has ensured that their beauty has not faded, even after so many years.
Oh, there I go again. I could speak of these for hours still, but I had best return to Vuyargur. Thank you for reminding me!
Ah, these stones seem to have a hold on me... I'll get back to work, I promise. Thank you for coming to find me!
TEXT_BANYOK111_05346_VUYARGUR_000_020: Thank you for finding my young worker, . He returned to his duties not long ago, and was quite apologetic.
TEXT_BANYOK111_05346_VUYARGUR_000_021: He is young and inexperienced still, but his skill in stonemasonry is plain to see. His boundless curiosity is doubtless to thank for that, but it also causes him to become entranced by the constructs of our forebears.
TEXT_BANYOK111_05346_VUYARGUR_000_022: Given our long lives, I normally would not be concerned about such things. But we have the snow spirits to consider, and they will not wait while we remain idle. Thank you for bringing him back to his senses.
TEXT_BANYOK111_05346_VUYARGUR_000_025: You found him more quickly than I expected you would. I suppose finding lost things comes naturally to the well traveled.
TEXT_BANYOK111_05346_VUYARGUR_000_026: Now that he has returned to his tasks, he can put all the knowledge gleaned from his reveries to use. You can expect great things from him, , of that I am certain.
TEXT_BANYOK112_05347_VUYARGUR_000_000: Thanks to everyone's efforts, Masons' Work is operating at full capacity. But masonry is far from neat, and debris piles up by the day. I was hoping you could help us solve this growing problem.
TEXT_BANYOK112_05347_VUYARGUR_000_001: If you are willing, please go to the workshop and speak with my worker there. She should have an idea of what we need to start cleaning up proper.
TEXT_BANYOK112_05347_CITIZENA05347_000_0: Vuyargur said he was sending someone─I assume that's you? We need to deal with the debris before it gets in the way of our work.

Mind you, I don't mean to simply dispose of it. The fragments can be crushed into gravel for laying pathways or used to build foundations. We can also mix it with limestone to make materials we use for repairs.
To that end, I would ask you to make gravel from these leftover stone fragments. If you run out, there's always more in this crate.
To that end, I would ask you to make these leftover stone fragments into material we can use to pave roads. If you run out, there's always more in that crate over there.
To that end, I would ask you to mix these leftover stone fragments with limestone to make repair materials. If you run out, there's always more in that crate over there.
TEXT_BANYOK112_05347_SYSTEM_000_020: The crate appears to be filled to the brim with sundry materials─none of which you require at this time.
TEXT_BANYOK112_05347_SYSTEM_000_030: You obtain additional crafting materials from the crate.
TEXT_BANYOK112_05347_CITIZENA05347_000_0: Finished? Wasn't too difficult, I hope.
Good, exactly as ordered! The pile of debris is a touch smaller, and we have supplies to keep building. An efficient use of resources, if you ask me.
I'll take these over to the other workers right away. Tell Vuyargur I appreciate him sending such capable help.
TEXT_BANYOK112_05347_VUYARGUR_000_050: I suppose you were surprised we reuse the debris. Well, masonry is about more than simply breaking down stone, you know. One must learn to use every last pebble.
TEXT_BANYOK112_05347_VUYARGUR_000_051: Of course, not being a stonemason myself, I learned that wisdom from our expert. Without people like her, I wager we would still be freezing in the snow. Thank you for your help today, .
TEXT_BANYOK112_05347_VUYARGUR_000_055: I am glad we need not worry about the debris piling up for a while yet. But our work is far from finished, so I suspect we will require your aid again soon enough. Until then, .
TEXT_BANYOK113_05348_VUYARGUR_000_000: Ah, . I am glad to report that operations at the workshop are proceeding apace, with ample deliveries of stone arriving from Worlar's Echo.
TEXT_BANYOK113_05348_VUYARGUR_000_001: Yet these deliveries must take the treacherous path to Zirgorteh the Open-armed. A slip of the foot might spell an untimely end, and with the trail growing ever busier, I believe it is high time we endeavored to prevent such unhappy accidents.
TEXT_BANYOK113_05348_VUYARGUR_000_002: Though some of the trail was repaired mere days ago, we fight a constant battle against the elements. Already, we have received reports of another section becoming dangerous to traverse. It is imperative we carry out additional repairs before anyone comes to harm.
TEXT_BANYOK113_05348_VUYARGUR_000_003: Could I ask for your assistance in preparing the supplies required? I have asked Garharlor to ready the requisite materials.
TEXT_BANYOK113_05348_GARHARLOR_000_010: Vuyargur has apprised me of the situation. Here, let me give you the materials you'll need.
TEXT_BANYOK113_05348_GARHARLOR_000_011: As part of the repairs, we'll be driving large nails into the earth to stabilize the ground underfoot. It would be much appreciated if you could assist in their production. Feel free to let me know if you require additional materials.
TEXT_BANYOK113_05348_GARHARLOR_000_012: As part of the repairs, we will be covering parts of the trail with fabric that reduces the risk of slips and falls. It would be much appreciated if you could assist in its production. Feel free to let me know if you require additional materials.
TEXT_BANYOK113_05348_GARHARLOR_000_013: When repairing the trail, we will need to ensure that everything is securely joined and fastened with a reliable adhesive. It would be much appreciated if you could assist in its production. Feel free to let me know if you require additional materials.
TEXT_BANYOK113_05348_GARHARLOR_000_014: Once the supplies are complete, please take them directly to Vuyargur. I'm sure he and the workers will put it to good use.
TEXT_BANYOK113_05348_GARHARLOR_000_015: Are you in need of additional materials? ...Ah, I see you already have some. I am sure Vuyargur will be most pleased to receive the completed supplies.
TEXT_BANYOK113_05348_GARHARLOR_000_018: Are you in need of additional materials? Please, take these.
TEXT_BANYOK113_05348_VUYARGUR_000_030: Have you brought the supplies to help fix the trail?
TEXT_BANYOK113_05348_VUYARGUR_000_031: Thank you. Rest assured that our work on the repairs shall be held to the same high standard as yours.
TEXT_BANYOK113_05348_VUYARGUR_000_032: Accidents can go unnoticed for too long in snowy, mountainous terrain. In many cases, the injured are beyond saving by the time they are found. All the more reason to prevent such situations from arising in the first place.
TEXT_BANYOK113_05348_VUYARGUR_000_033: And while those traveling the path are ultimately responsible for their own safety, we must do all we can to reduce the risks they face.
TEXT_BANYOK113_05348_SYSTEM_000_050: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANYOK114_05349_VUYARGUR_000_000: Late again... <sigh> Oh, . Some workers gathering materials in the Shades of Grief have yet to return for their break. I have impressed upon them the importance of regularly scheduled rest for overall productivity, and yet!
TEXT_BANYOK114_05349_VUYARGUR_000_001: As an added incentive, I have prepared a fresh batch of chairo, a warming stew much loved in these parts. I suspect a hot meal will make them forget their tasks for a few brief moments.
TEXT_BANYOK114_05349_VUYARGUR_000_002: Could I trouble you to visit the Shades of Grief and inform them that the chairo is ready?
TEXT_BANYOK114_05349_SYSTEM_000_021: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter “The chairo is ready” to grab the Yok Huy's attention.
TEXT_BANYOK114_05349_YOKHUYWORKERA05349_: My favorite! We Yok Huy can't get enough of the stuff. If you cut me open, I daresay I'd bleed chairo!
I must return while the pot is warm. My thanks, friend!
TEXT_BANYOK114_05349_YOKHUYWORKERB05349_: Ow-ow-ow, my back...! Still, I must press on...!
Uwah! I near jumped out of my skin...
I-I mean...ahem. Apologies, I did not notice you approach. Did I hear you mention chairo?
Why, it is long past time for my break! And I shall feel all the more rested after a hot meal.
With Nopli providing us with so many different ingredients and spices as of late, people have been experimenting with new chairo recipes. I wonder what's stewing today!
TEXT_BANYOK114_05349_VUYARGUR_000_040: My thanks for passing along the message. Both workers returned safe and sound and are presently enjoying a well-earned repast.
TEXT_BANYOK114_05349_VUYARGUR_000_041: The restoration is arduous work, to be sure, and they are wont to overexert themselves. Though my chairo started as a simple way to encourage more regular breaks, I must say it has turned into quite the culinary adventure...
TEXT_BANYOK114_05349_VUYARGUR_000_042: Of late, I have been experimenting with different meats and spices to create the most rejuvenating meal possible. Several have proved quite a hit with the workers—at this rate, I'll be opening my own eatery!
TEXT_BANYOK114_05349_VUYARGUR_000_043: Even so, I suspect our workers may continue to neglect their breaks without someone to remind them. I hope I may count on your help in rounding them up again!
TEXT_BANYOK115_05350_VUYARGUR_000_000: Given the arduous nature of performing physical labor so high up in the mountains, we are lucky to have someone in Worlar's Echo who puts great thought into making provisions for our workers.
TEXT_BANYOK115_05350_VUYARGUR_000_001: She has requested the aid of a skilled artisan in her latest enterprise. Might I ask you to pay her a visit?
TEXT_BANYOK115_05350_VUYARGUR_000_002: Do you remember our gastronomist friend? Apparently, she has some ideas on ways to improve the provisions which require the aid of a skilled artisan.
TEXT_BANYOK115_05350_VUYARGUR_000_003: She should be able to give you more details in person. She can usually be found in the southwestern section of Worlar's Echo.
TEXT_BANYOK115_05350_MEALIMPROVEMENTYOKH: You must be the artisan! Vuyargur is quick—I only sent word for help a short while ago.
I've been wanting to make some bite-sized provisions that won't easily spoil. Then, just the other day, I heard something quite interesting from a Pelupelu trader.

Apparently, the Tonawawta of Xak Tural mix dried meat and fruit with animal fat then mold it into solid chunks. The traditional dish sounds perfect for our weary workers, so I thought I'd best make a big batch for everyone.
Oh, it's you! It's great to work with you again.
The last batch of preserved meat went down a treat, so I've decided to make it even better!
I have the ingredients, but if I want to make large quantities efficiently, I'm going to need some specialized equipment. And that's where you come in!
I'm in need of molds to ensure the ingredients harden into chunks of a uniform size. If you run out of materials, you can find more in that crate.
I'm in need of presses to quickly and efficiently crush the ingredients. If you run out of materials, you can find more in that crate.
I want to add a subtle flavor as an accent, so the workers don't tire of the provisions. Could you make a suitable spice mix? If you run out of materials, you can find more in that crate.
Once you've finished, I'll be glad to take them off your hands. The sooner I start work on this batch, the sooner the workers in the mountains can fill their bellies!
If you run out of materials, you can help yourself to some more from that crate over there. Let me know once your work is complete!
TEXT_BANYOK115_05350_SYSTEM_000_023: The crate appears to be filled to the brim with sundry materials─none of which you require at this time.
TEXT_BANYOK115_05350_SYSTEM_000_026: You obtain additional crafting materials from the crate.
TEXT_BANYOK115_05350_MEALIMPROVEMENTYOKH: This is perfect! I knew it would be worth requesting an expert artisan—the quality speaks for itself.
Right, I'd best get to work! You can tell Vuyargur that I'll bring the preserved meat to him as soon as it's ready.
Now that I have such wonderful equipment, I can't possibly make substandard snacks! Tell Vuyargur I'll be bringing the provisions along shortly.
TEXT_BANYOK115_05350_VUYARGUR_000_040: My thanks for your kind assistance. I have no doubt that the preserved meat will prove popular.
TEXT_BANYOK115_05350_VUYARGUR_000_041: To have a nutritious snack that can be carried up the mountain is extremely convenient. I hear it can even be dissolved in hot water to whip up a warming stew.
TEXT_BANYOK115_05350_VUYARGUR_000_042: And our friend is ever thinking of ways to refine her recipes, so I expect her cooking will only improve. Suffice to say, both she and her creations are popular amongst the workers. I hope I can call upon you again should she need any additional assistance!
TEXT_BANYOK115_05350_SYSTEM_000_050: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANYOK116_05351_VUYARGUR_000_000: Salt is vital to our operations—both to grit icy paths and preserve food—and it is high time that we replenished our stocks. Unfortunately, we have encountered a minor issue...
TEXT_BANYOK116_05351_VUYARGUR_000_001: Our Chirwagur supplier has requested you by name. Would you be willing to complete the trade in our stead?
TEXT_BANYOK116_05351_VUYARGUR_000_002: My thanks. You should find him to the northwest of Worlar's Echo. All you need do is hand over this talisman in exchange for the salt. And...stay on your guard.
TEXT_BANYOK116_05351_YOKHUYENEMYA_000_01: It is you—good. I waited. We trade salt for talisman.
Talisman will be buried in saltern. Even greater divine blessing.
Do you...remember me? I was with Vorporlor. Traded crystal with Nopli. Now, we meet again.
You go to snow mountain with Yok Huy. Why?
How is work on snow mountain?
You are strange. <chuckle> Always involve self. Always interesting stories.
My kin will not meet outsiders. But you are interesting. To you, I will trade the divine blessing.
Here. Salt. Let us trade again. The divine blessing for your stories.
TEXT_BANYOK116_05351_VUYARGUR_000_020: Ah, you are returned! Did the trade go as planned?
TEXT_BANYOK116_05351_VUYARGUR_000_021: My thanks. Chirwagur salt is the finest around, but they bear us a great deal of hostility. Negotiations are often a fraught affair...
TEXT_BANYOK116_05351_VUYARGUR_000_022: Though it seems they have placed their trust in you, . I hope I can count on your diplomatic dealings should they request your presence again!
TEXT_BANYOK117_05352_VUYARGUR_000_000: There is little fear that food will rot in the chilly mountain air, but keeping provisions unspoiled for the long term calls for even colder temperatures. This is why we store things in a proper larder.
TEXT_BANYOK117_05352_VUYARGUR_000_001: Storage methods also vary by foodstuff, with some needing to be kept in boxes or sacks, often with a regularly replenished stock of drying agents.
TEXT_BANYOK117_05352_VUYARGUR_000_002: As our food supply grows, however, we find ourselves running short of these storage necessities. Should you happen to be bereft of a meaningful task, I'm certain Xarhorkur would welcome your crafting expertise on the mountaintop.
TEXT_BANYOK117_05352_XARHORKUR_000_010: Ah, here to help with the larder, are you? Perfect. I have all the crafting materials required for shoring up our dwindling storage supplies.
TEXT_BANYOK117_05352_XARHORKUR_000_011: Speaking of which, my task for you today is to put together some sturdy metal tins. Please do not hesitate to ask should you need anything else to get the job done.
TEXT_BANYOK117_05352_XARHORKUR_000_012: Speaking of which, my task for you today is to fashion some sturdy leather sacks. Please do not hesitate to ask should you need anything else to get the job done.
TEXT_BANYOK117_05352_XARHORKUR_000_013: Speaking of which, my task for you today is to prepare some batches of drying agent. Please do not hesitate to ask should you need anything else to get the job done.
TEXT_BANYOK117_05352_XARHORKUR_000_014: Once you have the new storage supplies in hand, pray head across the way and deliver them to the lardermaster.
TEXT_BANYOK117_05352_XARHORKUR_000_015: Ah, ! I have more materials if you─ No? I shall let you get on with it, then!
TEXT_BANYOK117_05352_XARHORKUR_000_018: Ah, ! A new batch of materials, is it? Take them, and my gratitude besides.
TEXT_BANYOK117_05352_FOODSTORAGEYOKHUY_1: Well, this is a pickle. We must do something about our storage situation before the next shipment of food arrives...
TEXT_BANYOK117_05352_FOODSTORAGEYOKHUY_0: Please tell me you've come with solutions to our storage woes...
Yes, these will be of considerable help! The thought of our foodstuffs languishing in an ill-prepared larder was an almost physical pain.
Should we have need of more storage supplies, I hope we can turn to you again! My thanks to you, and to Vuyargur for sending you my way.
Mealtime would be a sad affair indeed should our victuals suffer from being poorly stored. Please let Vuyargur know the larder is in good shape!
TEXT_BANYOK117_05352_VUYARGUR_000_040: Living on an icy mountainside means relying on food shipments from below, but the climb is such that we must plan for infrequent resupplies. Should we allow our larder's wares to spoil, our bellies would be in for a difficult spell.
TEXT_BANYOK117_05352_VUYARGUR_000_041: That is why the lardermaster and his helpers are so serious about foodstuff storage.
TEXT_BANYOK117_05352_VUYARGUR_000_042: It seems he was well pleased with your contributions, however, so I hope you consider lending us your crafting skills again should the need arise.
TEXT_BANYOK118_05353_VUYARGUR_000_000: The larder is rebuilt and our stock of food is plentiful...which should allow us to provide everyone with regular meals. It would seem, however, that the avalanche's destruction has left us little in the way of tableware to serve them in.
TEXT_BANYOK118_05353_VUYARGUR_000_001: As things stand, we're having to snatch away plates before someone has even swallowed their last bite so we can serve the next person waiting.
TEXT_BANYOK118_05353_VUYARGUR_000_002: While I am thankful the dining hall fare has been proving popular, I fear that the kitchenmaster cannot comfortably feed these greater numbers with the tableware available.
TEXT_BANYOK118_05353_VUYARGUR_000_003: Might you lend us your skills again, and craft us a way out of this quandary? Xarhorkur will have all the materials you require.
TEXT_BANYOK118_05353_FOODMANAGERYOKHUY05: Ah, we've used the last of the clean dishes... We'll have to get to scrubbing if we're to serve the next meal on time.
TEXT_BANYOK118_05353_XARHORKUR_000_011: Hammering out some serving pots to keep our stews and soups warm should be no trouble for an artisan of your caliber, yes? My material stores are at your disposal.
TEXT_BANYOK118_05353_XARHORKUR_000_012: Carving out some durable wooden crockery should be no trouble for an artisan of your caliber, yes? My material stores are at your disposal.
TEXT_BANYOK118_05353_XARHORKUR_000_013: Concocting a strong dish soap for cleaning the crockery in half─no, a third!─of the time should be no trouble for an artisan of your caliber, yes? My material stores are at your disposal.
TEXT_BANYOK118_05353_XARHORKUR_000_014: Once you've crafted the tableware supplies we need, please deliver them to the kitchenmaster─you should find him over by the entrance to the larder.
TEXT_BANYOK118_05353_XARHORKUR_000_015: A fresh batch of materials for you...? Ah, apologies, I see you have everything you need. Carry on!
TEXT_BANYOK118_05353_XARHORKUR_000_018: Yes, yes, please take whatever you require!
TEXT_BANYOK118_05353_FOODMANAGERYOKHUY05: Yes, what is it? Mealtime is swift approaching and there's a pile of dirty dishes that require my attention...
O merciful fate! This will spare me from having to wash everything the moment our diners gobble their last morsel.
Your contributions are much appreciated. After all, we want our workers to enjoy their meals─and indeed each other's company─without feeling rushed or needing to wait for their turn at the table.
When you see Vuyargur, tell him he needs to eat too. No one goes hungry on my watch.
TEXT_BANYOK118_05353_VUYARGUR_000_040: We are in your debt yet again. It may have seemed a trivial request, but being able to relax is also an important part of a meal.
TEXT_BANYOK118_05353_VUYARGUR_000_041: ...The kitchenmaster demands I come to table, does he? Well, perhaps I will stop by soon and take a bowl of one of his tasty stews.
TEXT_BANYOK118_05353_VUYARGUR_100_041: Another invitation to the dining table? After the hearty feast he prepared upon my last visit, it is difficult to refuse.
TEXT_BANYOK118_05353_VUYARGUR_000_042: The restoration work can be exhausting, but many have remarked upon the satisfaction they feel as Zirgorteh the Open-armed returns to its former glory. I, too, am finding much to savor as we labor and toil and break bread together in this common cause.
TEXT_BANYOK119_05354_VUYARGUR_000_000: Ah, , you may be just the volunteer I was looking for.
TEXT_BANYOK119_05354_VUYARGUR_000_001: The restoration efforts require a modest sum of coin, you see, and after considering our situation, a merchant friend was adamant he could find a demand for ice formed from mountain spring water.
TEXT_BANYOK119_05354_VUYARGUR_000_002: The arrangement has us carrying the ice down the slope to our peddler acquaintance, who then sells it in the city. Every step of the journey must be swift, however, lest the precious cargo begin to melt... And our plodding gait is simply too slow.
TEXT_BANYOK119_05354_VUYARGUR_000_003: Would you mind making the delivery in our stead? Make your way to the back of the high larder, and our ice harvester will break off the largest piece you can carry.
TEXT_BANYOK119_05354_STORAGEYOKHUY05354_: Another icicle for market? Hmmm, you might need a lighter one than usual....
Here you go─a freshly harvested hunk of ice made from mountain spring water.
Hurry this down the slope to Solace, and you should find our peddler friend waiting by the road to Kozama'uka.
The ice forms in the larder in large quantities, but I'm told city people pay good money for even the smallest shard. Best get that icicle to the peddler while there's something left of it to sell!
TEXT_BANYOK119_05354_ICEBLOCKPELUPELU053: Ah, you've brought the Yok Huy's ice down the mountain, have you?
Yes, yes, this is exquisite! So clear, so beautiful...

But as much as I'd like to stand here yapping about the various─and lucrative─applications of frozen mountain spring water in the culinarian field, I really must trot this over to Tuliyollal right away!
Thank you for the fleet-footed delivery, and please let Vuyargur know I'll bring him his share of the profits upon my return!
TEXT_BANYOK119_05354_VUYARGUR_000_030: Thank you for seeing the icicle safely into the peddler's hands. I imagine our patrons in Tuliyollal will be grateful for this new shipment as well.
TEXT_BANYOK119_05354_VUYARGUR_000_031: Ordinary ice can be created through magicks, of course, but when it comes to creating frozen dishes, I am given to understand that the gentle flavor of our natural spring water is highly coveted.
TEXT_BANYOK119_05354_VUYARGUR_000_032: In any case, we are fortunate to have this arrangement in place. I can only hope that the ice remains popular until we have completed work on the restorations.
TEXT_BANYOK120_05355_VUYARGUR_000_000: There are more restoration workers than ever now living atop the mountain, and we've been carting up food and other supplies to provide for their needs.
TEXT_BANYOK120_05355_VUYARGUR_000_001: However, we have a tendency to overestimate our helpers' appetites.
TEXT_BANYOK120_05355_VUYARGUR_000_003: I believe the plan is to have easily constructed shelving on hand, that we might compensate for these occasional logistical oversights. I ask that you speak with the lardermaster for the particulars.
TEXT_BANYOK120_05355_FOODSTORAGEYOKHUY_0: You're the artisan who's to help with our shelving project? It is assuring indeed to have Fahrafahr's trusted friend lend us  skills!
The idea is to avoid messy piles of provisions underfoot, so I want to make the most of the available space...
The shelving I have in mind will need some long, sturdy screws for easy assembly. This crate here should hold more than enough materials to forge several handfuls.
The shelving I have in mind will need wooden boards treated to withstand changing temperatures. This crate here should hold more than enough materials to craft several sets of shelves.
The shelving I have in mind will need an adhesive that binds both wood and stone with equal facility. This crate here should hold more than enough materials to mix up several pots' worth.
With that, I shall let you get to work. Give me a shout when you have the components ready!
Did you run out of materials? Take as much as you like from the crate.
TEXT_BANYOK120_05355_SYSTEM_000_019: The crate appears to be filled to the brim with sundry materials─none of which you require at this time.
TEXT_BANYOK120_05355_SYSTEM_000_022: You obtain additional crafting materials from the crate.
TEXT_BANYOK120_05355_FOODSTORAGEYOKHUY_0: Were you able to make what we needed?
Yes, this is exactly what I was hoping for!
Now I'll have shelving I can quickly put together whenever we bring in an overabundance of supplies. Please let Vuyargur know that our problem has been solved!
Now I'll have shelving I can quickly put together whenever we bring in an overabundance of supplies. Please let Vuyargur know that our problem has been solved!
TEXT_BANYOK120_05355_VUYARGUR_000_040: Thank you for helping out with our inventory conundrum.
TEXT_BANYOK120_05355_VUYARGUR_000_041: It was a simple enough matter, perhaps, but the high larder will only become more important as the days go by. We must consider the most suitable means to store goods not only in large quantities, but also in ever-growing variety.
TEXT_BANYOK120_05355_VUYARGUR_000_042: Foodstuffs, potables, sundry supplies... All these must be kept in a manner which leaves them unspoiled and undamaged.
TEXT_BANYOK121_05356_VUYARGUR_000_001: Good timing, . With the brawniest of my kin otherwise occupied with construction, I would prevail upon your strength.
TEXT_BANYOK121_05356_VUYARGUR_000_002: Some time ago I sent a courier to fetch culinary supplies for the larder, but I suspect he may be too heavily encumbered.
TEXT_BANYOK121_05356_VUYARGUR_000_003: If you could seek him out in Worlar's Echo, we would be most grateful for your helping hands.
TEXT_BANYOK121_05356_SHOKAFUI05356_000_0: Are you here to help me? Oh, thank the ancestors.
