I was so giddy about the restoration of the larder, I went around telling everyone I could find, and they showered me in foodstuffs to bring back!
It seems everyone's keen to see us complete the restoration of Zirgorteh the Open-armed, for I've been given another mountain of foodstuffs to bring back!
Not to be ungrateful, but I can only carry about ten of these heavy stone boxes, and I'll need to walk slowly, lest I drop the whole stack down the mountain.
Think you could deliver one to Garharlor over in Shelter? Your muscles may not thank you, but everyone else surely will!
Heavy, aren't they? You'll get the hang of it! Here, try again!
TEXT_BANYOK121_05356_SYSTEM_000_015: Collect the stone box of foodstuffs from the culinary courier and deliver it here to Garharlor.
TEXT_BANYOK121_05356_GARHARLOR_000_020: Ah, this must be the delivery I requested. Much obliged.
TEXT_BANYOK121_05356_GARHARLOR_000_021: Let's see here. Corn, beans, popotoes...and spices too!? Why, the box is stuffed to bursting!
TEXT_BANYOK121_05356_GARHARLOR_000_022: These are all pantry staples─ingredients commonly used in our most beloved Yok Huy soups. A generous offering indeed.
TEXT_BANYOK121_05356_GARHARLOR_000_023: Mmm... Smell that? With this much sweet corn, no belly shall go unfilled.
TEXT_BANYOK121_05356_GARHARLOR_000_024: Come to think of it, you weren't harassed by hungry alpacas on the road, were you? Perhaps we should be grateful that these stone boxes form an airtight seal...
TEXT_BANYOK121_05356_GARHARLOR_000_025: This looks to be tulidile jerky─the perfect staple for a larder, given its long shelf life.
TEXT_BANYOK121_05356_GARHARLOR_000_026: That said, I can't imagine something as delicious as jerky will go uneaten for long. Certainly not if I have the opportunity. <chuckle>
TEXT_BANYOK121_05356_GARHARLOR_000_027: Right then, that will be all I require of you. Speak to Vuyargur for your reward!
TEXT_BANYOK121_05356_GARHARLOR_000_028: Go and collect your reward from Vuyargur. You've earned it, my friend!
TEXT_BANYOK121_05356_VUYARGUR_000_030: Enjoyed some light exercise, did you, ? Rest those weary arms for as long as you like─but first, accept your reward with my thanks.
TEXT_BANYOK122_05357_VUYARGUR_000_003: Nnngh... Forgive my clamoring belly. Working in the cold, it seems I can scarcely digest a meal before I'm dreaming of the next.
TEXT_BANYOK122_05357_VUYARGUR_000_004: Still, I know those doing the heavy lifting and shoveling must be even more ravenous.
TEXT_BANYOK122_05357_VUYARGUR_000_005: The bitter cold has taken its toll on our stomachs, particularly those of us doing the lifting and shoveling.
TEXT_BANYOK122_05357_VUYARGUR_000_006: To replenish our dwindling food stores, a new cornfield is to be tilled at the foot of the mountain, but we've been asked to furnish the supplies ourselves.
TEXT_BANYOK122_05357_VUYARGUR_000_007: It is this task with which I would request your assistance, . Speak to Garharlor here, who shall provide you with everything you need.
TEXT_BANYOK122_05357_GARHARLOR_000_010: Ah, , I hear you'll be assisting us with preparations for the cornfield.
TEXT_BANYOK122_05357_GARHARLOR_000_011: I'd like you to build large, sturdy containers to hold compost. Should you run out of materials, I will gladly provide more.
TEXT_BANYOK122_05357_GARHARLOR_000_012: I'd like you to craft some tools used in plowing the fields. Should you run out of materials, I will gladly provide more.
TEXT_BANYOK122_05357_GARHARLOR_000_013: I'd like you to concoct growth formula for use on the crops. Should you run out of ingredients, I will gladly provide more.
TEXT_BANYOK122_05357_GARHARLOR_000_014: Oh, and once you've finished, hand it all straight to Vuyargur─he will know what to do with it.
TEXT_BANYOK122_05357_GARHARLOR_000_015: Have you run out of materials? ...Seems not. Carry on, then, and submit whatever you finish to Vuyargur.
TEXT_BANYOK122_05357_GARHARLOR_000_018: Have you run out of materials? Use these, then.
TEXT_BANYOK122_05357_VUYARGUR_000_025: Any progress on those field supplies?
TEXT_BANYOK122_05357_VUYARGUR_000_026: Oh, these will be perfect! I'll make sure they're sent to the site straightaway.
TEXT_BANYOK122_05357_VUYARGUR_000_027: And here's your reward for a job well─ <rumble>
TEXT_BANYOK122_05357_VUYARGUR_000_028: ...Ahem. I think it's time I went and found something to eat.
TEXT_BANYOK122_05357_VUYARGUR_000_029: And while our meals as of late have been pleasantly filling, we may need more supplies sooner rather than later. All this hard labor really works up an appetite!
TEXT_BANYOK123_05358_VUYARGUR_000_001: Ever since you helped us to restore the Breathless Altar, we have seen an influx of visitors come to pay their respects.
TEXT_BANYOK123_05358_VUYARGUR_000_002: As such, the keeper in charge has grown rather...impassioned about its maintenance.
TEXT_BANYOK123_05358_VUYARGUR_000_003: For that reason have I acquired this polishing powder from a merchant. Will you go and see it safely delivered into her hands?
TEXT_BANYOK123_05358_VUYARGUR_000_004: The altarkeeper has requested more polishing powder for the Breathless Altar. Would you kindly take it to her, ?
TEXT_BANYOK123_05358_VUYARGUR_000_005: And if she asks you to assist in its application...well, you won't mind, I hope.
TEXT_BANYOK123_05358_HAIDANYOK05358_000_: Polishing powder! Oh, thank you for bringing this to me! I was just admiring the crystals.
Pretty, aren't they? The hue differs from glowstone, but it is said to signify rich memories of the time when this place slept beneath the sea.
And according to Dartorgor's living sepulchre, the snow spirits are drawn to them, too, because they glint like ice in the sunlight! Isn't that something?
Sorry, what were we talking about? ...Right! The crystals! Need to polish them!
You know, it would mean much to the Breathless Altar if a storied warrior were to do the honors. Take this powder and polish to your heart's content!
The crystals would be most grateful if you were to assist me.
You may report back to Vuyargur now, . As altarkeeper, I shall attend to the rest personally.
TEXT_BANYOK123_05358_VUYARGUR_000_020: Welcome back, . I must thank you for not only delivering the polishing agent, but aiding in the maintenance work as well.
TEXT_BANYOK123_05358_VUYARGUR_000_021: After lying forgotten for all those years, the Breathless Altar has been raised high by the hands of Yok Huy and many others such as you.
TEXT_BANYOK123_05358_VUYARGUR_000_022: Zeal for crystals aside, the keeper's dedication motivates all of us to do our part in looking after the altar.
TEXT_BANYOK123_05358_VUYARGUR_000_023: I hope you will help us to preserve its radiance, that we may enjoy the snow spirits' favor for years to come.
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_VUYARGUR_000_001: Great news, . Nopli tells me no few Pelupelu wish to visit Zirgorteh the Open-armed.
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_VUYARGUR_000_002: I inquired with Fahrafahr, and she agrees that our beautiful altar ought to live on in the memories of any and all who would behold it.
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_VUYARGUR_000_003: Do you recall that mountaineering paraphernalia you made for us? Well, it seems word of mouth has attracted more prospective hikers from Wachunpelo.
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_VUYARGUR_000_004: Worlar's Echo is preparing to receive them, but they require the aid of an artisan, and I'd like to send you.
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_VUYARGUR_000_005: When you arrive, speak to the mountain guide for your assignment. Safe travels!
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_MTPEL05359_000_010: I'm told you'll be providing me with the equipment I need to make the climb. I shall expect your very best work!
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_MTPEL05359_100_010: The moment I heard about Zirgorteh the Open-armed, I knew I had to see it for myself. For that, I'll need to gear up!
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_MTYOK05359_000_011: Thank you for coming down, . This merchant placed an order with me, but I find I'm struggling to craft equipment for such small frames.
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_MTYOK05359_000_012: To complete this set of mountaineering paraphernalia, could you craft a pair of goggles to shield the eyes from the biting winds?
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_MTYOK05359_000_013: To complete this set of mountaineering paraphernalia, could you craft a pair of small-yet-sturdy snowshoes?
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_MTYOK05359_000_014: To complete this set of mountaineering paraphernalia, could you prepare a serving of rations to be stored in an insulated container?
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_MTYOK05359_000_016: In return, I'll furnish you with the materials you require. Say the word if you run short.
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_MTYOK05359_000_017: By all means, deliver the completed set directly to our Pelu friend here.
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_MTYOK05359_000_020: Having some trouble? I understand completely. Take these.
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_SYSTEM_000_023: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_MTPEL05359_000_025: Oh, I can't wait to see what you've made for me!
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_MTPEL05359_000_026: How did it go? Can I see it yet?
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_MTPEL05359_000_027: A worthy investment of coin, if I do say so myself. So long as I have this, I need fear no icy mountain trail!
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_MTYOK05359_000_028: The rumors don't do you justice, . I can but admire your craftsmanship.
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_MTYOK05359_000_029: Now then, let us begin the long climb!
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_VUYARGUR_000_030: Great work, . A fully outfitted Pelupelu passed by just now, chatting pleasantly with the mountain guide on their way to the Breathless Altar.
TEXT_BANYOK124_05359_VUYARGUR_000_031: Should anyone else take an interest in Zirgorteh the Open-armed, I hope we can count on you again.
TEXT_BANYOK125_05360_VUYARGUR_000_001: In the course of the brewery's work to produce kirkahryar, they happened to create a corn-based beverage the workers find quite rejuvenating.
TEXT_BANYOK125_05360_VUYARGUR_000_002: Alongside kirkahryar, the brewery produces a corn-based beverage that is quite popular among the workers.
TEXT_BANYOK125_05360_VUYARGUR_000_003: In fact, they can scarce keep up with demand, and the stock of ingredients is entirely depleted. As an artisan yourself, I suspect you have an eye for high-quality produce—would you mind picking some crimson Karvarhur blooms?
TEXT_BANYOK125_05360_VUYARGUR_000_004: We simmer them with the corn, and they grow on the northern shore of Karvarhur the First. Once you've collected a few blooms, please deliver them directly to the brewery.
TEXT_BANYOK125_05360_SAKEYOK05360_000_01: If you're here for the corn drink, I'm afraid you're out of luck! We've been drunk dry, and haven't the ingredients to make more...
As I said, we're out of─ What? Crimson Karvarhur blooms!? Have you come to replenish our stores?
Oh, thank you! Now I can get that thirsty lot off my back! Time to get to work!
Now I can get that thirsty lot off my back─once this batch is ready!
TEXT_BANYOK125_05360_VUYARGUR_000_015: I hear you delivered the flowers. Thank you, it is quite the trek to Karvarhur the First.
TEXT_BANYOK125_05360_VUYARGUR_000_016: Simmering them with corn and spice results in a fragrant, deep red—almost purple—beverage. Some swear by its restorative effects, and the ingredients are certainly wholesome enough.
TEXT_BANYOK125_05360_VUYARGUR_000_017: Given its popularity, I suspect we may find ourselves in a similar predicament again soon. I only hope supplies last long enough for me to get a drink myself!
TEXT_BANYOK126_05361_VUYARGUR_000_001: Forgive me, , but could I entrust you with more golem maintenance? Though its function is restored, a construct of its age needs regular upkeep.
TEXT_BANYOK126_05361_VUYARGUR_000_002: In the time since your last repair, a new malfunction has arisen, and it seems more parts will need replacing.
TEXT_BANYOK126_05361_VUYARGUR_000_003: Xarhorkur should have more information for you. You'll find her at Zirgorteh the Open-armed.
TEXT_BANYOK126_05361_XARHORKUR_000_004: Glad you're here, . The components we need are rather intricate, which is why I requested you and your deft hands for the job.
TEXT_BANYOK126_05361_XARHORKUR_000_005: Lest you worry, I've got all the materials you need to forge them right here. Let me know if you run out!
TEXT_BANYOK126_05361_XARHORKUR_000_006: Lest you worry, I've got all the materials you need to construct them right here. Let me know if you run out!
TEXT_BANYOK126_05361_XARHORKUR_000_007: Lest you worry, I've got all the materials you need to prepare them right here. Let me know if you run out!
TEXT_BANYOK126_05361_XARHORKUR_000_008: Oh, and once you've finished, go ahead and take them to the tinkerer for installation.
TEXT_BANYOK126_05361_XARHORKUR_000_009: Need more materials? ...No, evidently not. Carry on, then! The tinkerer will be glad to see you!
TEXT_BANYOK126_05361_XARHORKUR_000_012: Need more materials? Certainly! Here you are.
TEXT_BANYOK126_05361_GOLEMYOK05361_100_0: Hrmmm... Perhaps I ought to fine-tune the motor component...?
TEXT_BANYOK126_05361_GOLEMYOK05361_000_0: Your presence is a welcome one,  artisan. Have you a job in need of the golem's strength?
Oh, you're a saint! With any luck, these replacement parts will stop it from making that dreadful grinding sound... The keeper will be thrilled!
Oh, your timing couldn't be better! Whatever was causing that delayed response time, these replacement parts ought to fix it. The keeper will be thrilled!
Granted, we're still learning through trial and error at this stage, so we may have need to call upon you again, if that's all right. Many thanks!
TEXT_BANYOK126_05361_VUYARGUR_000_020: Once again, our golem is restored by your hand. Thank you, .
TEXT_BANYOK126_05361_VUYARGUR_000_021: Doubtless you have witnessed similar constructs in the region of Yak T'el─the former guardians of the old quarries.
TEXT_BANYOK126_05361_VUYARGUR_000_022: I should like to see them for myself one day, to take comfort in the unweathered vestiges of our ancestors.
TEXT_BANYOK126_05361_VUYARGUR_000_023: Much like our sepulchres, the structures we build are bearers of memory. It is a golem's duty to ensure they last for generations, and ours to ensure the golems do the same.
TEXT_BANYOK127_05362_VUYARGUR_000_001: Everyone is eager to start making the kirkahryar, but first we need the right tools for the job.
TEXT_BANYOK127_05362_VUYARGUR_000_002: The demand for kirkahryar will not be disappearing any time soon, and that means we will always need the right tools for the job.
TEXT_BANYOK127_05362_VUYARGUR_000_003: And as you know, some wear down faster than others, so I would ask for your help replenishing supplies. Xarhorkur at Zirgorteh the Open-armed should have everything you need to get started.
TEXT_BANYOK127_05362_XARHORKUR_000_005: I never imagined brewing would require so much equipment, but every day is a new lesson I suppose. I'm glad you're here to help out.
TEXT_BANYOK127_05362_XARHORKUR_000_006: I need you to make us some steel scrubbers. Make sure they're sturdy─the cleaning never ends over there!
TEXT_BANYOK127_05362_XARHORKUR_000_007: I need you to make wooden ladles so we can put the drink into the proper containers. And considering just how much there is, they better be sturdy!
TEXT_BANYOK127_05362_XARHORKUR_000_008: I need you to make a natural soap we can use to clean the containers. It's important to make it just right, so it won't affect the flavor of the liquor!
TEXT_BANYOK127_05362_XARHORKUR_000_009: I have all the materials you should need right here. If you run out, just ask me for more!
TEXT_BANYOK127_05362_XARHORKUR_000_010: Once you've finished, bring them to the worker in charge of our tools. Good luck!
TEXT_BANYOK127_05362_XARHORKUR_000_011: Out of materials, eh? ...Wait, it looks like you still have plenty!
TEXT_BANYOK127_05362_XARHORKUR_000_014: Ah, you've run out of materials, have you? Here, take as much as you need!
TEXT_BANYOK127_05362_SYSTEM_000_017: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
TEXT_BANYOK127_05362_SAKEYOK05362_000_02: Ah, this is splendid work! I'll make sure these are put to use right away!
The quality of kirkahryar is determined by the quality of each and every aspect of its creation, tools included. With these, I'm confident that our next batch will be among our most delicious yet!
TEXT_BANYOK127_05362_VUYARGUR_000_025: You say you were surprised by the passion of our worker? Well, when presented with such exquisite tools as the ones you made, who wouldn't get excited?
TEXT_BANYOK127_05362_VUYARGUR_000_026: The instruments we use most often should be of the highest quality. That will allow everyone at the kirkahryar house to make a libation worthy of our sacred ritual. May we depend on you again, .
TEXT_BANYOK128_05363_UYARGUR_000_001: , I have a favor to ask of you. I had sent someone to Icuvlo's Inn to replenish our larder, but she is rather late to return.
TEXT_BANYOK128_05363_UYARGUR_000_002: I fear she may have encountered some manner of trouble on the road. I would be grateful if you could search for her.
TEXT_BANYOK128_05363_SHOPPINGYOK05363_00: Oh dear, Vuyargur asked you to find me? I'm so sorry, I didn't mean to make him worry.
I'd heard that a feast was to be held for the snow spirits, you see, and I wanted to serve up something that they might enjoy with the kirkahryar.
But I couldn't think of anything, and the time got away... Would you happen to have any ideas?
I wanted to provide a treat for the spirits again─something different and new. But I couldn't think of anything, and the time got away... Would you happen to have any ideas?
TEXT_BANYOK128_05363_A1_000_001: How about another variety of liquor?
TEXT_BANYOK128_05363_A1_000_002: How about sweets prepared with ice?
TEXT_BANYOK128_05363_A1_000_003: There's no knowing the spirits' tastes.
TEXT_BANYOK128_05363_SHOPPINGYOK05363_00: Ah, so something that offers contrast. In which case, the Pelupelu's mezcal may be suitable.
The taste is rather different from kirkahryar, but perhaps some snow spirits will enjoy it.
Ah, of course, it stands to reason that snow spirits would prefer cold things.
In which case, perhaps I could freeze some flowers and fruits in a bed of ice. That would be both pretty and palatable, I daresay.
It's true, there's still much that we don't know about the spirits... That's why I spent so much time pondering it to no avail.
Perhaps by simply enjoying the occasion ourselves, we would make it more enjoyable for them. In which case, something that we ourselves like would be suitable.
Yes, the more I think on it, the more I feel confident in that approach. It will make for a wonderful banquet, I'm sure of it!
I'm much obliged for your guidance. Please assure Vuyargur that I'll be back as soon as I have what I need.
My thanks again for your guidance, and please assure Vuyargur that I'll be back as soon as I have what I need.
TEXT_BANYOK128_05363_UYARGUR_000_020: Were you able to find the supply runner?
TEXT_BANYOK128_05363_UYARGUR_000_021: So that is the way of it... I'm glad to hear that she was safe.
TEXT_BANYOK128_05363_UYARGUR_000_022: And thanks to your sage counsel, she was able to arrive at an answer to her dilemma. I shall look forward to seeing what she acquires for the snow spirits.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_ZELIHALI_000_001: Why, if it isn't our special advisor. You'll be pleased to know that business is booming at the Turali Travel Agency.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_ZELIHALI_000_002: I've scarcely had time to rest my feathers, in fact. But what about you, ? How goes the adventuring profession?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_A1_000_001: I'm in the middle of a grand quest as we speak!
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_A1_000_003: Truth be told, I'm feeling a touch fatigued.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_ZELIHALI_000_003: I'm glad to hear you're keeping busy. As the agency's reputation grows, we find ourselves with more and more customers from distant lands. It's been quite the challenge catering experiences for each of them!
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_ZELIHALI_000_004: To think that even you tire! I can't imagine the string of escapades that put you in such a state, but I'm certain you've earned some leisure time.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_ZELIHALI_000_005: Ah, that reminds me. Wawkesa said he wished to discuss a certain matter with you. If you have a moment, could you stop by the eatery?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_ZELIHALI_000_006: He and Liplu must want you to be part of this new plan they're cooking up.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_ZELIHALI_100_006: Now, I should go and greet our newest arrivals. It's always a pleasure to see you, !
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_100_007: And of course we should invite them, too...
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_010: So, for now, it might be best for you to start preparing the ingredients. Can you manage? It may end up being quite the guest list.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_WAWKESA_000_011: The more, the merrier... Ah, speaking of which, the guest of honor graces us with  presence.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_013: Why hello, ! What brings you to the Turali Travel Agency this day?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_014: I see... Well, it was fortunate you ran into Zelihali─there is indeed a certain matter we'd like to discuss with you!
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_015: You see, we've heard from our customers and fellow merchants about recent developments in both Urqopacha and Mamook. It seems both settlements have been revitalized by ambitious new ventures.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_016: Apparently these endeavors flourished thanks in part to the tireless contributions of a lone traveler, whose many skills helped pave the way from shaky beginnings to steadfast success!
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_017: As I heard more and more of these stories, I became certain of who this lone traveler was. I believe  stands before me now, in fact.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_A2_000_003: Each experience brought me closer to Tural's people.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_018: I knew it! I could imagine no one else as I heard of the traveler's many selfless feats. I'm glad to know it was you!
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_019: Now I'm certain you're the right  for a little task I need help with. Do you mind delivering two missives for me?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_100_019: I'm hoping to reach out to the people in charge of these new ventures at...Zirgorteh the Open-armed and Gok Golma, if I remember correctly.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_A3_000_002: Looking to expand the offerings of the Turali Travel Agency?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_020: Not yet, not yet. Before such considerations, I feel there is something we should all do together first. My inner abacus is telling me there is no better time to grasp this opportunity than now!
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_WAWKESA_000_021: We're planning to propose a little joint venture, is all. For now, though, we have to keep the details close to the chest. Sorry for the secrecy, but believe me when I say it'll benefit everyone involved.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_022: I knew we could count on you, !
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_023: I suppose it only makes sense to visit the closer destination first─Zirgorteh the Open-armed! While you're taking care of that, we'll be about our own preparations. Farewell for now!
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_024: The stories of Zirgorteh the Open-armed and Gok Golma have been on the lips of many as of late.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_025: I only hope our proposition is met with approval. You must be dying to know the details, but I promise patience will pay off!
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_FAHRAFAHR_000_030: Oh, ! It is good to see you. Have you come to lend a hand again?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_FAHRAFAHR_000_031: Hmm? A letter from the “Turali Travel Agency”? Let me see...
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_FAHRAFAHR_000_032: Ah... Yes... , have you by chance read this letter?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_FAHRAFAHR_000_033: I thought so. Then I shall keep the surprise a─ Ahem, I meant that it may come as a surprise that Liplu considers you her “special advisor.” No? Then I suppose there is no need for you to read the letter after all...certainly not.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_FAHRAFAHR_000_034: In any case, I think I shall read the rest of the letter together with Vuyargur. In the meantime, you should go speak with Ryoqor Terteh.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_FAHRAFAHR_000_035: The spirits ask daily when you will come and play with them. They will be overjoyed to see you.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_NOPLI_040: Now, what game shall we play next!?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RYOQORTERTEH_042: Look! The crafty one has come!  has come!
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_NOPLI_043: Indeed  has! Here to play with the spirits, ?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_MURFURLUR_044: Ryoqor Terteh's joy reflects my own. It is always an honor to meet with a hero of your pedigree. The Hands can always use the aid of one such as you.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_NOPLI_045: You're here to deliver a letter from the Turali Travel Agency? They've become the talk of Tural as of late...and you say you're their special advisor? You do get around, don't you?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_MURFURLUR_046: Yet you have not read the letter yourself? Curious. Given the agency's purpose, perhaps they intend to cooperate with the Yok Huy to attract more sightseers to this place.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_NOPLI_047: If that were the case, surely they would have come themselves. I recall the concern is managed by the selfsame siblings who oversaw the alpaca wool bedding emporium, and I know they prefer face-to-face business dealings.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_NOPLI_049: With the lion's share of the restoration work finished, many of the artisans are eager to start their next project. Such a proposal could provide that opportunity and breathe even more life into Urqopacha.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RYOQORTERTEH_050: We know not what “business” and “project” mean. Are you saying more little people like you will come?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_NOPLI_051: Well, it's too soon to say for certain. If that were the case, however, would you greet them happily?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RYOQORTERTEH_052: We would! More people means more friends to play with! Together we can remember all the friends who came before!
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_MURFURLUR_053: Oh ho. I see even the spirits have taken to the Yok Huy way of thinking. Nothing could make me happier.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RYOQORTERTEH_054: If we play more, then more snow will fall. The frostblooms will blossom, and everyone will smile. Fahrafahr will smile too, yes?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_A4_000_002: Remember not to freeze everyone solid.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RYOQORTERTEH_055: We knew it! Can we play now, crafty one?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RYOQORTERTEH_056: What do you mean!? Violence is never the answer, crafty one. You do not know this? We must be wary of you.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RYOQORTERTEH_057: Maybe crafty one needs to be reminded of why we are here. Will you play with us?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_NOPLI_058: I don't think you can refuse, nor do you wish to. We have pressing matters to attend to ourselves, but it's simply impossible to deny Ryoqor Terteh.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_MURFURLUR_059: To be honest, the two of us have been hard-pressed to keep up with the spirits during their games. With you on our side, perhaps the odds will even out.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RYOQORTERTEH_000_06: That was so much fun! Thank you, crafty one!
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_NOPLI_000_062: I'm positively drenched, but so long as Ryoqor Terteh is satisfied, I am glad to risk a little frostbite. Well played, everyone!
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_NOPLI_000_063: After all that, perhaps some time to warm up and rest would be well advised. Fahrafahr has surely read the letter by now, so why don't you return to Shelter?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RYOQORTERTEH_000_06: Come back again, crafty one! We will be waiting!
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_FAHRAFAHR_000_070: I can tell by the snow on your clothes that you indulged the spirits' playful whims. I hope that you look forward to visiting us as much as we look forward to welcoming you.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_FAHRAFAHR_100_070: Now, I believe I have kept you waiting for long enough. You are curious about the letter, yes?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_FAHRAFAHR_000_071: Liplu wrote of her plans for the future.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_FAHRAFAHR_000_072: It sounds marvelous, so could you please tell her that I would be honored to be a part of it?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_FAHRAFAHR_100_072: Unfortunately, I am unable to share any more than that. While your curiosity must be eating away at you, rest assured everything will be made clear soon enough.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_FAHRAFAHR_000_073: Judging by what I read, it seems your next destination is Gok Golma in Mamook. May your travels be swift.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_FAHRAFAHR_000_074: As for myself, preparations must be made for Liplu's endeavor. I look forward to seeing you again soon.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RUVOLLJA_000_075: Hello, ! Come to see how we're getting along? Gok Golma is more prosperous than ever, I'm glad to say.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RUVOLLJA_000_076: Since joining the Turali Agricultural Association, we've gained more and more customers from outside Mamook. We've even arranged a trial partnership for our crops to be used at a taco shop!
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RUVOLLJA_000_077: When I went to Tuliyollal to deliver them, I heard some relatives of mine were returning to Mamook for a visit. They're eager to see what change has come to the city.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RUVOLLJA_000_078: Apparently they're bringing along their younglings, so we're arranging to have them ride on a branchbearer. A bird's-eye view of the gainery is sure to leave a positive impression.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RUVOLLJA_000_079: That's about it for what's new around here. How have things been with you, ?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RUVOLLJA_000_080: A letter, you say? Ohhh, let me have a look... The Turali Travel Agency? I've heard people talk of it in the capital. Wait...you're their “special advisor”!?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RUVOLLJA_000_081: You do have friends everywhere, don't you? What else is in this letter? Let's see...
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RUVOLLJA_000_082: Hmm. I think Anggir should read this, as well. While we're doing that, why don't you pay a visit to the kitchen?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RUVOLLJA_000_083: Ty'at Roh is there to help Bol Tst'ei prepare a new dish. Gotoll Ja should be around too─I think they'd all be glad to see you.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RUVOLLJA_000_084: Once we've read the letter, I'll meet you at the kitchen. Until then!
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_TYATROH_000_085: Is that !? You've come just in time─old Bol Tst'ei's been struck with inspiration and whipped us up a delicious new dish!
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_BOLTSTEI_000_086: Well, I heard a few former Mamook residents were returning from Tuliyollal. I sensed an opportunity to use my cooking to show them how much their old home has changed, and the culinary wheels began to turn.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_BOLTSTEI_100_086: And besides, while tiika selvaas has earned a reputation among visitors, we mustn't rest on our laurels as artisans.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_GOTOLLJA_000_088: Ruvoll Ja and the others poured their sweat and tears into the gainery, and our relations with the Xbr'aal have at last started to improve. Ty'at Roh and the other hunters can visit without fear of menacing stares or harsh words.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_GOTOLLJA_000_089: Mamook has changed. The entirety of Yak T'el has changed. For the better, of course...but not everyone knows this, and it's our job to spread the good tidings.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_BOLTSTEI_000_090: According to Ruvoll Ja, while our crops are proving popular among those outside these canopies, people are still wary to step foot within Yak T'el.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_BOLTSTEI_000_091: Mamook has had a reputation as an inhospitable place for so long that many treat it as fact. Even I refused to believe it had changed until I saw it with my own eyes.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_TYATROH_000_092: But your food will get people thinking differently. They won't just hear about the change─they'll taste it. I would gladly volunteer for any flavor testing you might need.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_BOLTSTEI_000_093: I would have you sample my work, as well. My newest creation is called mux te'l, meaning “forest's radiance” in our tongue. I've deep-fried the shining najool peels and placed them atop a hearty soup.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RUVOLLJA_000_094: Apologies for the wait! I must say, your friend Liplu certainly has some interesting ideas.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RUVOLLJA_000_095: And after discussing it with Anggir, we've decided to help bring them to fruition! We'd like to begin preparations at once, but wanted to first confirm that the event is being held at Urqopacha.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RUVOLLJA_000_096: Oh, you don't know? But if you aren't there, then...
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_ANGGIR_000_097: Ruvoll Ja, perhaps we'd better leave this matter be for now.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_ANGGIR_000_098: For the time being, could you tell Liplu that we will happily take part in her plan?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_BOLTSTEI_000_099: I hope we'll be seeing you again soon, . I could talk cooking with you until the sun sets and rises again.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_TYATROH_000_100: I can barely believe the stories of the meals you've eaten! Please, you have to tell us more about the world's food next time.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RUVOLLJA_000_101: As for what I was saying before...we'll handle that ourselves. Give Liplu our regards, !
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_RUVOLLJA_000_110: Liplu wrote much about you in the letter. It seems many places aside from Gok Golma owe you a debt of gratitude.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_TYATROH_000_111: It was a pleasure to chat with you again, ! I'd like to hear more of your adventures next time─the places you've been, the things you've eaten, and the beasts you've slain!
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_ANGGIR_000_112: Tell Liplu we're looking forward to her plan... Hehe, and you should too.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_BOLTSTEI_000_113: Each region has flavors and textures it calls its own, it seems. The knowledge makes me realize there is plenty of room yet for my own cooking to improve.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_GOTOLLJA_000_114: Mamook will continue to change for the better, and I intend to lend my aid wheresoever I'm needed.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_121: You've returned at last! So, how was everyone? Did they have positive things to say about my letter?
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_122: They did!? Well, that's a huge relief!
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_123: And not that I doubted you for a moment, but their readiness to agree to my proposal shows me just how hard you worked for their benefit.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_124: There was something else I was curious about. How have your friends been faring since becoming established? Well, I hope.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_A5_000_001: There have been many new changes for everyone.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_A5_000_002: They've managed to find their footing and walk their own path.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_125: Ah, that is good to hear. They reached a malmstone with your help, but have the wherewithal to forge a future with their own hands.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_126: Much like we're doing here! The news is heartening, indeed.
TEXT_BANALL410_05462_LIPLU_000_127: And now that everything is settled...the true work begins!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_001: Allow me to thank you for delivering those letters, . I'll also offer my apologies for sending you hither and thither for such a minor task.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_002: No doubt your feet ache and your back cries out for respite!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_A1_000_002: A single step further and my legs might fall off.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_A1_000_003: My shoulders and neck have hardly been so sore.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_003: As expected from an adventurer of your caliber, you are positively indefatigable! Still, you did walk quite the distance, so I encourage you to take some time off to rest at our guest lodgings.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_005: As I thought, even heroes require rest! Why not take a break at our guest lodgings?
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_006: Come to think of it, despite all the trials and tribulations you've endured for our sake, I don't believe you've had the chance to stay with us. So, how about it?
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_007: Good, good! I anticipated you might agree to my suggestion, so your chambers are being prepared as we speak.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_008: Once they're ready, I'll have Genuhanu let you know. It shouldn't be long, but please make yourself at home in the meantime.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FONJEANTAINE_000_00: (-Familiar Voice-)Oh, is that... , is that you?
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FONJEANTAINE_000_01: I thought so! It's been so long, I'm not sure if you remember me. It's Fonjeantaine, of the potsworn!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_REDIROQ_000_011: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... It is a pleasure to happygreet you here of all places! Have you come for craftytasks?
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FONJEANTAINE_000_01: You're lodging here? Good for you. You always seem so busy, it's heartening to know you have the time to recuperate.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_REDIROQ_000_013: We are here on a delivery. Fonjeantaine's craftygoods have proven very popular as of late.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FONJEANTAINE_000_01: Fortunately for me. Customers have even made the journey all the way to Earthenshire to purchase them. I feel blessed that anyone would go to so much trouble for my work.
You played no small part in guiding me upon this path, , and for that I thank you.
Slowly but surely, I have overcome the impulse to compare myself to others, and become content simply to know my crafts bring joy to so many.
The seeds of that change were planted the day I met you and Wuk Lamat. And every day since then, I have become more certain that coming to Tural was the right choice.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_REDIROQ_000_018: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... But you cannot let success make you lazy. The life of an artisan is one of constant improvement!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_REDIROQ_000_019: When you are inspired with new ideas, quicktell Rediroq at once! That way you will always have what you need for your craftywork.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FONJEANTAINE_000_02: Since our business here is finished, it's about time we returned to Earthenshire. Rest well, , and may we meet again!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_GENUHANU_000_021: A most hearty welcome to our special advisor! If you're ready to see your room, allow me to guide you.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_GENUHANU_000_022: I must admit, attending to one such as you is quite the emotional experience. We owe you so much...and we aren't the only ones.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_GENUHANU_000_023: We recently had a customer visit from distant Alexandria. They told us about the various troubles that had recently befallen their nation.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_GENUHANU_000_024: We recently had a customer visit from distant Alexandria. Apparently they had taken part in some sort of martial competition there, and they told us about the various troubles that had recently befallen their nation.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_GENUHANU_000_025: It was you and your companions that saw them through those dark times. When I heard that our special advisor was risking life and limb for the sake of others, I was worried. But I was also in awe.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_GENUHANU_000_026: You fly freely and nobly as Kixaihih, and the least we can do is offer you a place of respite from your trials. It is an honor, in fact.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_GENUHANU_000_027: Ah, but there I go rambling again. Please, allow me to show you to your room!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_GENUHANU_000_029: Please make yourself at home. If there is anything you need, anything at all, you only need ask.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_GENUHANU_000_030: Oh, but before I go, Liplu said that Wawkesa wished to speak with you. If you have a moment, could you visit the eatery later? Until then, please enjoy your stay.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_TSEEYA_000_031: (-???-)Well, this is a surprise. Come to visit old friends, ?
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_A2_000_002: Oh, you work for the Wing of Reflection, don't you?
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_A2_000_003: Ah, who could forget Tseeya, the Turali Travel Agency's first customer.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_TSEEYA_000_032: Heh, I suppose a traveler of such renown can't be expected to remember every person  meets. I am Tseeya of the Wing of Reflection, your companion in arranging Rasafbaht's truly unforgettable experience.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_TSEEYA_000_033: I'm glad you remember. Then I suppose you also remember how much trouble we went through to ensure that Rasafbaht had an unforgettable experience.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_TSEEYA_000_034: I take it you've finally found time to relax. I've become quite fond of this place myself, and since my first tour I've arranged several more devoted entirely to fishing.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_TSEEYA_000_035: And since fate has brought us together again, there's something I've wanted to tell you ever since our last meeting.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_TSEEYA_000_036: Surely you've noticed the effect your actions have had on Tural. Long-standing issues that once gripped the nation now seem manageable.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_TSEEYA_000_037: A change set in motion more than eighty years ago, when Gulool Ja Ja stemmed the conflicts plaguing the continent and founded Tuliyollal. His Landsguard made the roads safe, and people could move more freely than ever before.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_TSEEYA_000_038: And with the Pelupelu given the mercantile reins, wares of all sorts flowed across Tural. But even so, its various peoples remained in their ancestral lands, following their established customs. The capital remained fundamentally separate.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_TSEEYA_000_039: However, Gulool Ja Ja had no intention of changing that. He understood that it would take time for a single “nation” of Tural to coalesce, and entrusted the next generation to see it realized.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_TSEEYA_000_041: With the succession of new Dawnservants, that new generation has come, and the Turali Travel Agency is but one of many enterprises reshaping our home. I hear that you aided some few of them, in fact.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_TSEEYA_000_042: People will have more chances to explore unfamiliar lands, more chances for mutual exchange. And as we come to better know our neighbors, we will learn to come together as a nation, and step forth into a brighter future.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_A3_000_001: I hadn't given it that much thought.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_A3_000_002: I was only adventuring as adventurers do.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_TSEEYA_000_043: I see. You were only doing what comes naturally, lending a helping hand to those in need.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_TSEEYA_000_044: To think actions that come so naturally to you would help revitalize a whole nation and the people who live within it. Such selflessness is truly moving.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_TSEEYA_000_046: I am grateful for your journey across Tural and for lending your strength to those you met. The Wing of Reflection shall do its utmost to ride these favorable winds as far as we can.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_TSEEYA_000_047: Now, I believe I've taken up enough of your time, . Rest well!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_SYSTEM_100_048: Time passes as you reflect upon the countless adventures that brought you to this moment...
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_SYSTEM_000_050: After a lengthy reverie, you recall that Wawkesa wishes to speak with you. Perhaps he is still about at the eatery.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_WAWKESA_000_051: Greetings, . Hope you were able to take your mind off things for a bit.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_WAWKESA_000_052: Heh, your face says it all. Here, cooked a little something up for you. I put my heart and soul into it, so you'd best hurry to your destination before it gets cold.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_WAWKESA_000_053: Didn't expect to be sent off so soon, did you? Liplu's waiting for you at Panaqpelu Retreat in Urqopacha─some hot springs run by another Pelupelu, as I understand.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_WAWKESA_000_054: But one thing before you go.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_WAWKESA_000_055: I just... Ah, I'll come out and say it. Back then with the Third Promise, all that kidnapping and whatnot...well, things weren't looking too bright after we ran into you.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_WAWKESA_000_056: 'Course, you were only doing right by your allies...but we'd never taken such a beating as you gave, nor been hounded so relentlessly afterwards. We were scared to death. When I saw you again, I was certain my final day had come.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_WAWKESA_000_057: But instead, my days have been full making food I love, and watching customers enjoy it. My old crew and I are even earning an honest wage...not bad for a bunch of former ne'er-do-wells. Not bad at all.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_WAWKESA_000_058: Our past crimes forgiven and our apologies taken at face value, all by the grace of you and Liplu. We owe you both a debt of gratitude we can never repay.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_WAWKESA_000_060: Still, maybe this meal will go some small way towards evening the scales. Best be off now to Urqopacha, !
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FAHRAFAHR_000_070: Why, we meet again. While I would love to catch up, you should speak with Liplu first. She organized this whole affair, after all.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_NOPLI_071: Murfurlur and I volunteered to guide Ruvoll Ja and the others from Yak T'el. They were splendid traveling companions.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_MURFURLUR_000_072: Fahrafahr told us about the plan. We offered our assistance most eagerly─who would pass up an opportunity for a dip in these hot springs, after all?
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_RUVOLLJA_000_073: You're finally here, . When the letter instructed us to come to Urqopacha, I jumped at the chance to see a new locale. It hasn't disappointed so far!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_ANGGIR_000_074: Liplu's proposal was too enticing to deny. Yet as excited as we all are, I have a feeling you'll be having the most fun.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_075: There you are, ! We've been waiting for you!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_076: Did you bring the food Wawkesa made?
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_077: Good, good! Thank you for carrying it all this way. Now, shall we begin?
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_078: On behalf of all those who work towards the betterment of Yok Tural, I'd like to welcome the guest of honor─you!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_079: Terribly sorry for keeping everything so secretive. I worried that you might shy away from attending this party if you knew what we were about.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_A4_000_002: I had a feeling something was going on.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_A4_000_003: I knew from the very first moment!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_100_080: My, my, how perceptive! Though I shouldn't be surprised. Thank you, then, for playing along with this little game.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_080: Originally, we had planned to hold this event at the travel agency. But as we heard more and more about your exploits around Tural, we began to envision something greater.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_081: An event that would bring together everyone you've helped!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_RUVOLLJA_000_082: We've been wanting to thank you for everything you've done, so Liplu's invitation provided the perfect opportunity. Bol Tst'ei made almost too much food for us to carry!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FAHRAFAHR_000_083: We brought kirkahryar, the snow spirits' favorite libation, among other traditional Yok Huy fare. I hope everyone eats and drinks their fill.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FAHRAFAHR_000_084: Ryoqor Terteh and the other spirits even expressed interest in coming. Perhaps their whims will guide them here at some point.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_085: Look around you, . All these people from across Tural are here because of you. To show their gratitude to a dear friend.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_086: Even so, a small matter weighs heavily on the hearts of all present...
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FAHRAFAHR_000_087: You see, while you were a highly valued contributor to our project, we scarcely knew anything about you. Admittedly, the challenges we faced left us with little time for leisure, but even so...
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_RUVOLLJA_000_088: People speak of your exploits in Tuliyollal quite often, and with each new story, I learn more and more of who you are. It made me realize how little we actually know of your life and that made me feel...somewhat sad.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_RUVOLLJA_000_089: More than as an advisor, helper, or artisan, I'd like to know you as a person.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_090: We all feel that way, you can be sure! So if it isn't too much trouble, we'd like you to tell us all about your life both within Tural and without!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_RUVOLLJA_000_091: But before that, why don't you change into something less dusty from travel? This is a party, after all, and we'd like you to relax.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_SYSTEM_000_092: All present are eager to speak with the guest of honor. Why not match their festive mood with equally festive attire? Battle will not be required of you during this quest.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FAHRAFAHR_000_100: This will be a good opportunity to strengthen our ties with the people of Yak T'el, as well. I look forward to hearing about your time with them.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_NOPLI_101: Liplu has reserved the venue for the rest of the day. Gigimolu would love this, fond of hot springs as he is, but unfortunately he's already on his way back to Eorzea.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_MURFURLUR_000_102: Apparently the beasts in these parts sometimes prey upon Pelupelu who have warmed their bodies in the hot springs. One of Nopli's trading partners almost met their end here, in fact.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_ANGGIR_000_103: I'm interested to see what crops are grown in Urqopacha and Kozama'uka. Hopefully I can take some samples home with me for research.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_104: After you delivered my letters, I came here to wait for everyone while you were resting at the travel agency. We managed to get everything ready just before you arrived.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_105: These secluded hot springs are the pride of the Pelupelu. The healing waters soothe back pain, sore muscles, and flagging spirits. Hopefully they provide some small measure of relief from your tireless adventuring.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_RUVOLLJA_000_106: Are you wearing that to the party?
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_Q5_000_107: Begin the party with your current gear?
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_108: Very well! Now, bring out the food and drink!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FAHRAFAHR_000_110: I did not expect Ryoqor Terteh to be so curious about the hot springs. To think it would actually try to enter those scalding waters... A sight I'll not soon forget, haha!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_NOPLI_111: That Pelu eater gave me quite the fright! But Murfurlur ensured that the party could continue unabated─he looks pleased with himself, doesn't he?
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_MURFURLUR_000_112: This party is in your honor, so it was only right that I stopped that hungry beast. My skill as a bodyguard has improved, has it not? I have your guidance to thank for that, too.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_ANGGIR_000_113: Everyone's stories gave me a clearer picture of Tural as a whole, and Liplu even arranged for me to visit the fields of reeds. This day proved to be more fruitful to my research than I imagined.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_RUVOLLJA_000_114: The food you brought was delicious! Maybe we should invite this Wawkesa to Gok Golma? My mouth waters to think what he and Bol Tst'ei might come up with if they put their heads together.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_115: What a grand time that was! Were you able to forget your worries, if even but for a moment?
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_A6_000_001: It's been a while since I was so relaxed.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_A6_000_002: Would that I had more time.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_A6_000_003: Our next party should be at the travel agency.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_116: I'm glad to hear that. You throw yourself into one battle after another, don't you? I doubt any of us could keep up if our lives depended on it!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_117: Surely no one would begrudge you a little rest and recuperation from time to time.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_118: I'm sure everyone here shares that sentiment. You throw yourself into one battle after another, don't you? I doubt any of us could keep up if our lives depended on it!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_119: Surely no one would begrudge you a little rest and recuperation from time to time.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_120: That's a great idea! That way, Wawkesa and anyone who couldn't make it this time can join. We can close the travel agency for a day and have a proper celebration!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_121: Of course, we'll invite everyone again. Wuk Evu, Tseeya, and Mablu would also love to come... Yes, let's do it sooner rather than later!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_122: Now, I'm sure the others would like to speak with the guest of honor. Why don't you indulge them?
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_130: Everyone's here to speak with the guest of honor─you! Why don't you see what they have to say?
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_RUVOLLJA_000_131: It's been a pleasure listening to your many fantastic tales, !
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_RUVOLLJA_000_132: But even after hearing your stories, I have trouble imagining them. One day I hope to see those “space carrots” with my own eyes!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_RUVOLLJA_000_133: Your journey gives us the motivation we need to make the gainery even better. You might even hear talk of Gok Golma at whatever far-flung locale your next adventure takes you!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_ANGGIR_000_134: And with outside orders increasing by the day, maybe it's time to dream bigger. Be more ambitious!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_RUVOLLJA_000_135: We'll make the people of Mamook proud!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_RUVOLLJA_000_136: Ah, I forgot to mention. Fahrafahr, Anggir, and I came up with an interesting idea. We want to see what Liplu thinks, and we hope you'll stick around to hear her thoughts!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_RUVOLLJA_000_140: I've been thinking about the future of Gok Golma─of all Mamook, in fact. We've come up with a proposal for Liplu, and we'd like you to be there when we discuss it!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_ANGGIR_000_141: Crops take root in the land, then bear fruit that forms the seeds of the next generation. In the same way, I hope Gok Golma bears seeds of lasting change for Mamook.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FAHRAFAHR_000_142: I can't remember the last time I stopped worrying about my duties and simply lived in the moment. Not since Dartorgor's passing, I think... Yet when I saw Ryoqor Terteh's joy writ so plain on its face, I realized anew all the work was worth it.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FAHRAFAHR_000_143: With Zirgorteh the Open-armed now restored, the time has come to look towards the future─to take this precious opportunity to decide how we wish to live our lives.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_NOPLI_144: Oh, I can only hope that means more business opportunities for us!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_MURFURLUR_000_145: I shall leave the counting of coin to Master Nopli. Yet if you ever require protection for any reason, I am always willing to lend my arm.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FAHRAFAHR_000_146: I am glad for the offer!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FAHRAFAHR_000_147: Speaking of which, we had a proposal of our own to share with Liplu before departing. I am glad I had the chance to speak with you, , as well as everyone else gathered here.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FAHRAFAHR_000_150: We intend to share our proposal with Liplu shortly. An idea for which we have this gathering to thank.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_NOPLI_151: What does the future hold for Zirgorteh the Open-armed? For all of Worlar's Echo? I understand Fahrafahr's desire to plan ahead.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_MURFURLUR_000_152: With the fellowship between the Yok Huy and snow spirits restored, Urqopacha feels blessed by favorable winds. Wherever they may lead us, I intend to continue safeguarding others, if only to repay the debt I owe you.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_500: At the risk of repeating myself, I'd like to thank you again for coming here, .
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_501: But that hardly begins to scratch the surface, doesn't it? For the time you've given us, and all the help you've offered, I owe you a debt I'm not likely to repay any time soon.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_RUVOLLJA_000_502: We wouldn't have come nearly as far without you, that's for sure. And now...
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_RUVOLLJA_000_503: ...In bringing us all together like this, you've given us opportunities for new endeavors. After a bit of discussion, we've come to realize our goals align almost perfectly.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FAHRAFAHR_000_504: Yes, I want people to know that life in Worlar's Echo has changed. That the snow spirits are no longer feared, but embraced, and that together we wish to shed the settlement's reputation as an isolated mountain community.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FAHRAFAHR_000_505: We all share similar goals. We would like the various peoples of Tural to remember each other not as strangers with esoteric customs, but as trusted neighbors.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FAHRAFAHR_000_506: To that end, we have a proposal for you, Liplu. Might we partner with the Turali Travel Agency? We would like travelers from across the continent to see our respective homes as they are now.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_507: That sounds like a wonderful plan! , as our special advisor, what are your thoughts?
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_A50_000_002: I think you anticipated this would happen.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_A50_000_003: I think your inner abacus has already given you the answer.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_508: Yes, in fact, my inner abacus has been clacking away furiously! Of course, I'm always looking for new opportunities for expansion, but believe me when I say celebrating you has been my top priority from the start.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_509: While we Pelu use commerce to build bridges between peoples, you bring them together through high adventure! How many others could say the same?
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_510: ...Now, while I regret to say it, I suppose this little gathering must draw to a close.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_RUVOLLJA_000_511: Don't be a stranger around Gok Golma, !
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_FAHRAFAHR_000_512: Come check in on Ryoqor Terteh and the other spirits, too! We will make a special batch of kirkahryar just for you.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_513: Surely you're already thinking of your next escapade, yes? Well, let's give you a hero's farewell!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_LIPLU_000_514: May we meet again soon, ! And may the road ahead of you be laden with good fortune!
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_SYSTEM_000_160: You have achieved Allied reputation with the Turali Travel Agency, the farmers of Gok Golma, and the Hands of Zirgorteh.
TEXT_BANALL420_05463_SYSTEM_000_161: Through your efforts, your allies of all shapes and sizes across Tural have forged bonds of friendship that promise to remain strong through the years. You are truly a hero to societies across the continent!
